name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_partial
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_partial
    {j R H : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (u : Finset ℕ) (hmem : ∀ m ∈ u, H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m) :
    ∑ m ∈ u, (orderedDivisorCount j m : ℝ) / m ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
        tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : u ⊆ finiteSmoothTailSet R H (u.sup id) := by
    intro m hm
    exact mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mpr
      ⟨(hmem m hm).1, Finset.le_sup (f := id) hm, (hmem m hm).2⟩
  have hle : ∑ m ∈ u, (orderedDivisorCount j m : ℝ) / m ≤
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H (u.sup id) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub ?_
    intro m _ _
    positivity
  exact hle.trans (finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error hj hH hR hu huSqrt)

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_tsum
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_tsum
    {j R H : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    Summable (fun m : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m} ↦
        (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∑' m : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m},
          (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
          tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (fun m : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m} ↦
      (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) := fun m ↦ by positivity
  have hpartial : ∀ s : Finset {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m},
      ∑ i ∈ s, (orderedDivisorCount j (i : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
          tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H) := by
    intro s
    have himg : ∑ i ∈ s, (orderedDivisorCount j (i : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        ∑ m ∈ s.image (fun i : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m} ↦ (i : ℕ)),
          (orderedDivisorCount j m : ℝ) / m := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image]
      intro a _ b _ hab
      exact Subtype.ext hab
    rw [himg]
    refine section10_corollary10_19_partial hj hH hR hu huSqrt _ ?_
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
    exact i.2
  exact ⟨summable_of_sum_le hnonneg hpartial, Real.tsum_le_of_sum_le hnonneg hpartial⟩

name: RankAmplification.exp_two_le_seven_half
statement: theorem exp_two_le_seven_half : Real.exp 2 ≤ 7.5
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    norm_num
  nlinarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9, Real.exp_pos 1]

name: RankAmplification.neg_one_le_log_log_two
statement: theorem neg_one_le_log_log_two : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : Real.exp (-1) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    have hinv : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 0.4 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_le_comm₀ (Real.exp_pos 1) (by norm_num)]
      have := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
      norm_num
      linarith
    linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  calc (-1 : ℝ) = Real.log (Real.exp (-1)) := (Real.log_exp _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.log (Real.log 2) := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hexp

name: RankAmplification.tauEulerLoss_le_four_mul
statement:
theorem tauEulerLoss_le_four_mul {j : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    tauEulerLoss j (1 - δ) ≤ 4 * j
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) := by
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hsqrt : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) = (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hbound : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    rw [hsqrt, inv_le_comm₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2]
  have hden : (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) := by linarith
  have hdenpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) := by linarith
  rw [tauEulerLoss, div_le_iff₀ hdenpos]
  nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) j]

name: RankAmplification.paper_weight_tail_error_le
statement:
theorem paper_weight_tail_error_le
    {j R H : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU H R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
      paperWeightTailConstant * j *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * R)) + rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R))
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hδ : rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hRone (zero_lt_one.trans hu) huSqrt
  have hloss : tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) ≤ 4 * j :=
    tauEulerLoss_le_four_mul hδ
  have hlogu : 0 < Real.log (rankinU H R) := Real.log_pos hu
  have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤ rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hlogu, one_mul]
    exact (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (zero_lt_one.trans hu)).trans (by linarith)
  have hthree : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 * (R : ℝ) := by
    have hRcast : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hR
    nlinarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hlogthree : 1 ≤ Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = Real.log (Real.exp 1) := (Real.log_exp 1).symm
      _ ≤ Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hthree
  have hA : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) := Real.log_nonneg hlogthree
  have hbracket :
      Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R) ≤
        10.5 * (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) +
          rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) := by
    have hsplit : 3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R) =
        3 * (rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) := by ring
    have hfirst : Real.exp 2 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) ≤
        7.5 * (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) + 1) := by
      have hinner : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
          Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) + 1 := by
        linarith [neg_one_le_log_log_two]
      nlinarith [exp_two_le_seven_half, Real.exp_pos 2]
    rw [hsplit]
    linarith
  have hbracketpos : 0 ≤
      Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R) := by
    have hlogtwo : Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤ 0 := by
      apply Real.log_nonpos (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
      linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
    have hpos : 0 ≤ 3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R) := by
      have hrw : 3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R) =
          3 * (rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) := by ring
      rw [hrw]
      linarith
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 2]
  have hfull : fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
      primeCountingConstant * (10.5 * (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) +
        rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R))) := by
    rw [fullULogUPrimeError]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracket primeCountingConstant_pos.le
  have hfullpos : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R H := by
    rw [fullULogUPrimeError]
    exact mul_nonneg primeCountingConstant_pos.le hbracketpos
  calc
    tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
        (4 * j) * fullULogUPrimeError R H :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hloss hfullpos
    _ ≤ (4 * j) * (primeCountingConstant * (10.5 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) +
          rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)))) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfull
      positivity
    _ = paperWeightTailConstant * j *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) +
          rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) := by
      rw [paperWeightTailConstant]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_uniform
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_uniform
    {J R H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ J →
      Summable (fun m : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m} ↦
          (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∧
        (∑' m : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m},
            (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
          Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
            paperWeightTailConstant * j *
              (Real.log (Real.log (3 * R)) +
                rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)))
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj _
  obtain ⟨hsummable, hbound⟩ :=
    section10_corollary10_19_tsum (j := j) hj hH hR hu huSqrt
  refine ⟨hsummable, hbound.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)⟩
  have := paper_weight_tail_error_le (j := j) hR hu huSqrt
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.paper_weight_tail_error_mono
statement:
theorem paper_weight_tail_error_mono
    {i J R H : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ J) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) :
    paperWeightTailConstant * i *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * R)) + rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) ≤
      paperWeightTailConstant * J *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * R)) + rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R))
proof:
:= by
  have hRcast : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hR
  have hthree : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 * (R : ℝ) := by nlinarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hlogthree : 1 ≤ Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = Real.log (Real.exp 1) := (Real.log_exp 1).symm
      _ ≤ Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hthree
  have hA : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) := Real.log_nonneg hlogthree
  have hlogu : 0 < Real.log (rankinU H R) := Real.log_pos hu
  have hratio : (0 : ℝ) ≤ rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R) :=
    div_nonneg (by linarith) hlogu.le
  have hcast : (i : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hij
  have hconst : 0 < paperWeightTailConstant := by
    rw [paperWeightTailConstant]
    have := primeCountingConstant_pos
    linarith
  have hstep : paperWeightTailConstant * (i : ℝ) ≤ paperWeightTailConstant * (J : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcast hconst.le
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hstep (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_margin
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_margin
    {J R H : ℕ} {A : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (hmargin : A + paperWeightTailConstant * J *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * R)) + rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) ≤
      rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) :
    ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ J →
      (∑' m : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth R m},
          (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (-A)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj hjJ
  refine ((section10_corollary10_19_uniform (J := J) hH hR hu huSqrt j hj hjJ).2).trans ?_
  refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
  have hmono := paper_weight_tail_error_mono (i := j) (J := J) hjJ hR hu
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.quartic_div_le_exp
statement: theorem quartic_div_le_exp {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : t ^ 4 / 256 ≤ Real.exp t
proof:
:= by
  have hfour : Real.exp (t / 4) ^ 4 = Real.exp t := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hstep : t / 4 ≤ Real.exp (t / 4) := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (t / 4)
    linarith
  calc t ^ 4 / 256 = (t / 4) ^ 4 := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (t / 4) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hstep 4
    _ = Real.exp t := hfour

name: RankAmplification.eventually_moving_rankin_room
statement:
theorem eventually_moving_rankin_room :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < movingK (x : ℝ) ∧ 2 * Real.log 2 ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) ∧
        8192 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 6 ∧
          Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hKratio := tendsto_movingK_div_R_half.eventually
    (Ici_mem_nhds (show (1 / 3 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num))
  have hbase : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop,
      0 < movingK t ∧ 2 * Real.log 2 ≤ movingK t ∧
        8192 * scaleL t ^ 2 ≤ movingK t ^ 6 ∧ Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL t := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive, eventually_movingK_pos,
      tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2),
      tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 5971968,
      tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1, hKratio] with
      t hcore hK hK2 hL hL2 hratio
    refine ⟨hK, hK2, ?_, by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]⟩
    have hR : 0 < movingR t := hcore.2.2.2.1
    have hRK : movingR t / 3 ≤ movingK t := by
      have hdiv : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ movingK t / movingR t := hratio
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hR] at hdiv
      linarith
    have hR2 : movingR t ^ 2 = scaleL t * log2 t := by
      simp only [movingR]
      exact Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have hK6 : (movingR t / 3) ^ 6 ≤ movingK t ^ 6 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hRK 6
    have hexp : (movingR t / 3) ^ 6 = (movingR t ^ 2) ^ 3 / 729 := by ring
    rw [hexp, hR2] at hK6
    have hL2cube : (1 : ℝ) ≤ log2 t ^ 3 := by nlinarith [hL2, sq_nonneg (log2 t)]
    have hgrow : scaleL t ^ 3 ≤ (scaleL t * log2 t) ^ 3 := by
      have e : (scaleL t * log2 t) ^ 3 = scaleL t ^ 3 * log2 t ^ 3 := by ring
      rw [e]
      nlinarith [hL, hL2cube, pow_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL t by linarith) 3]
    have hlow : (8192 : ℝ) * scaleL t ^ 2 ≤ scaleL t ^ 3 / 729 := by
      nlinarith [hL, sq_nonneg (scaleL t)]
    linarith
  exact (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hbase

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_moving
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_moving {δH : ℝ → ℝ} (hδ : Tendsto δH atTop (nhds 0)) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ H : ℕ, 3 ≤ H → H ≤ 2 * x →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) -
          δH (x : ℝ) * movingEta (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (H : ℝ) →
        ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ movingNatJ x →
          (∑' m : {m : ℕ // H < m ∧ IsSmooth (movingNatZ x) m},
              (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
            Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨herr, hfamily⟩ := lemma10_15_uniform_family hδ
  have hC : 0 < paperWeightTailConstant := by
    rw [paperWeightTailConstant]
    have := primeCountingConstant_pos
    linarith
  have h2C : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * paperWeightTailConstant := by linarith
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingUniformTailError (x : ℝ) ≤ (2 * paperWeightTailConstant)⁻¹ := by
    have hmem := herr.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (inv_pos.2 h2C))
    exact ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hmem).mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hfamily,
      eventually_two_le_movingNatZ, eventually_movingZ_half_le_natZ,
      eventually_moving_rankin_room, hsmall,
      eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hfam hZ2 hZhalf hroom hsmall heta hx0
  intro H h3H hH2x hlogH j hj hjJ
  have hKpos : 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) := hroom.1
  have hZmodel : movingZ (x : ℝ) = Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ)) := rfl
  have hZm : (0 : ℝ) < movingZ (x : ℝ) := by rw [hZmodel]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hZcast : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hZ2
  have hZR : (0 : ℝ) < (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlogZpos : 0 < Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogZle : Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) := by
    calc Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (movingZ (x : ℝ)) :=
          Real.log_le_log hZR (movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x)
      _ = movingK (x : ℝ) := log_movingZ _
  have hlogZge : movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : Real.log (movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤ Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_le_log (div_pos hZm two_pos) hZhalf
    rw [Real.log_div hZm.ne' (by norm_num), log_movingZ] at h1
    linarith
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by omega
  have hH3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h3H
  have hHreal : (H : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hH2x
  have hlogHpos : 0 < Real.log (H : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨hmargin, htailbound⟩ := hfam (H : ℝ) hH3 hHreal hlogH
  set v : ℝ := Real.log (H : ℝ) / movingK (x : ℝ) with hvdef
  have hvpos : 0 < v := div_pos hlogHpos hKpos
  have hv1 : 1 < v := by
    rcases lt_or_ge 1 v with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have hlogv : Real.log v ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hvpos.le h
      have hprod : v * Real.log v ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [hvpos, hlogv]
      linarith [hmargin, hKpos, heta]
  have hlogvpos : 0 < Real.log v := Real.log_pos hv1
  have huv : v ≤ rankinU H (movingNatZ x) := by
    rw [hvdef, rankinU]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hlogHpos.le hlogZpos hlogZle
  have hu1 : 1 < rankinU H (movingNatZ x) := lt_of_lt_of_le hv1 huv
  have hlogupos : 0 < Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) := Real.log_pos hu1
  have hloguv : Real.log v ≤ Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) :=
    Real.log_le_log hvpos huv
  have hu2v : rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ≤ 2 * v := by
    have hhalf : movingK (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
      have := hroom.2.1
      linarith
    have hstep : Real.log (H : ℝ) / Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log (H : ℝ) / (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hlogHpos.le (by linarith) hhalf
    have heq : Real.log (H : ℝ) / (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) = 2 * v := by
      rw [hvdef]
      field_simp
    rw [rankinU]
    rw [heq] at hstep
    exact hstep
  have hlogHle : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx0
    have h1 : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hHreal
    rwa [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hxpos.ne'] at h1
  have huK : rankinU H (movingNatZ x) * movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ 4 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hvK : v * movingK (x : ℝ) = Real.log (H : ℝ) := by
      rw [hvdef]
      field_simp
    have h1 : rankinU H (movingNatZ x) * movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ (2 * v) * movingK (x : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu2v hKpos.le
    have h2 : (2 * v) * movingK (x : ℝ) = 2 * Real.log (H : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hvK]; ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    have hlog2L := hroom.2.2.2
    linarith
  have husqrt : rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.le_sqrt (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) hZR.le]
    have hsq : (rankinU H (movingNatZ x) * movingK (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
        (4 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hKpos.le) huK 2
    have h1 : rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ^ 2 * movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
        16 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have e1 : (rankinU H (movingNatZ x) * movingK (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 =
          rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ^ 2 * movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      have e2 : (4 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [e1, e2] at hsq
      exact hsq
    have hK2pos : (0 : ℝ) < movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h2 : (512 * rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ^ 2) * movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
        movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have e1 : (512 * rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ^ 2) * movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2 =
          512 * (rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ^ 2 * movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring
      have e2 : movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 2 = movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 6 := by ring
      rw [e1, e2]
      linarith [hroom.2.2.1]
    have h3 : 512 * rankinU H (movingNatZ x) ^ 2 ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 4 :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_right h2 hK2pos
    have h4 : movingK (x : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ 512 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
      have hq := quartic_div_le_exp hKpos.le
      have hz : Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤ (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
        rw [← hZmodel]
        exact hZhalf
      linarith
    linarith
  have hAle : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) ≤ log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hinner : (1 : ℝ) < 3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hmono : 3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ 3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) := by
      have := movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x
      linarith
    exact Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hinner)
      (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hmono)
  have hGnn : 0 ≤ log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hlog3 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 3 := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = Real.log (Real.exp 1) := (Real.log_exp 1).symm
        _ ≤ Real.log 3 :=
          Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) (by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9])
    have hmul : Real.log (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)) = Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [hZmodel, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (Real.exp_ne_zero _), Real.log_exp]
    show (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)))
    rw [hmul]
    exact Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hAnn : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    calc (1 : ℝ) = Real.log (Real.exp 1) := (Real.log_exp 1).symm
      _ ≤ Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) (by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9])
  have hPnn : 0 ≤ rankinU H (movingNatZ x) / Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) :=
    div_nonneg (by linarith) hlogupos.le
  have hQnn : 0 ≤ v / Real.log v := div_nonneg hvpos.le hlogvpos.le
  have hPQ : rankinU H (movingNatZ x) / Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) ≤
      2 * (v / Real.log v) := by
    calc rankinU H (movingNatZ x) / Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) ≤
        (2 * v) / Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) :=
          (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hlogupos).mpr hu2v
      _ ≤ (2 * v) / Real.log v :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hlogvpos hloguv
      _ = 2 * (v / Real.log v) := by ring
  have hjJ' : j ≤ movingJ (x : ℝ) := hjJ
  have hjJreal : (j : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ (x : ℝ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hjJ'
  have hJnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ (x : ℝ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hBE : 2 * paperWeightTailConstant * movingUniformTailBound (x : ℝ) ≤
      movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
    simp only [movingUniformTailError] at hsmall
    rw [div_le_iff₀ heta] at hsmall
    calc 2 * paperWeightTailConstant * movingUniformTailBound (x : ℝ) ≤
        2 * paperWeightTailConstant *
          ((2 * paperWeightTailConstant)⁻¹ * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall h2C.le
      _ = movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by field_simp
  have herror : tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H (movingNatZ x)) *
      fullULogUPrimeError (movingNatZ x) H ≤ movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
    refine (paper_weight_tail_error_le (j := j) hZ2 hu1 husqrt).trans ?_
    calc paperWeightTailConstant * j *
          (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) +
            rankinU H (movingNatZ x) / Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x))) ≤
        paperWeightTailConstant * (movingJ (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          (log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)) + 2 * (v / Real.log v)) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hjJreal hC.le) (by linarith)
          (by linarith) (mul_nonneg hC.le hJnn)
      _ ≤ 2 * paperWeightTailConstant *
          ((movingJ (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
            (log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)) + v / Real.log v)) := by
        have hCJG : 0 ≤ paperWeightTailConstant * (movingJ (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
            log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)) :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC.le hJnn) hGnn
        nlinarith [hCJG]
      _ ≤ 2 * paperWeightTailConstant * movingUniformTailBound (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htailbound (by linarith)
      _ ≤ movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := hBE
  have hulogu : v * Real.log v ≤
      rankinU H (movingNatZ x) * Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) :=
    mul_le_mul huv hloguv hlogvpos.le (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨_, hbound⟩ := section10_corollary10_19_tsum (j := j) (R := movingNatZ x) (H := H)
    (by omega) hHpos hZ2 hu1 husqrt
  refine hbound.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
  have hneg : -rankinU H (movingNatZ x) * Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x)) =
      -(rankinU H (movingNatZ x) * Real.log (rankinU H (movingNatZ x))) := by ring
  rw [hneg]
  linarith [hmargin, herror, hulogu]

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_moving_witness
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_moving_witness :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ movingNatJ x →
      (∑' m : {m : ℕ // x < m ∧ IsSmooth (movingNatZ x) m},
          (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [section10_corollary10_19_moving
      (δH := fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) tendsto_const_nhds,
    eventually_ge_atTop 3] with x hmoving h3
  refine hmoving x h3 (by omega) ?_
  have hxone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ x by omega)
  have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hxone
  show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) - 0 * movingEta (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤
    Real.log (x : ℝ)
  have hLdef : scaleL (x : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) := rfl
  rw [hLdef] at hL ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_sixteen_four
statement: theorem rankinU_sixteen_four : rankinU 16 4 = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlogtwo : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)).ne'
  rw [rankinU]
  norm_num
  rw [show (16 : ℝ) = 2 ^ (4 : ℕ) by norm_num, show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ (2 : ℕ) by norm_num,
    Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_tsum_witness
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_tsum_witness (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) :
    (∑' m : {m : ℕ // 16 < m ∧ IsSmooth 4 m},
        (orderedDivisorCount j (m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU 16 4 * Real.log (rankinU 16 4) +
        tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta 16 4) * fullULogUPrimeError 4 16)
proof:
:= by
  refine (section10_corollary10_19_tsum hj (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ?_ ?_).2
  · rw [rankinU_sixteen_four]; norm_num
  · rw [rankinU_sixteen_four]
    rw [show ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]

name: RankAmplification.one_le_rankinU_iff
statement:
theorem one_le_rankinU_iff {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) (hH : 0 < H) :
    1 ≤ rankinU H R ↔ R ≤ H
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hR
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hH
  rw [rankinU, le_div_iff₀ hlogR, one_mul]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h
    rw [Real.exp_log (by linarith), Real.exp_log hHpos] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  · intro h
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by exact_mod_cast h)

name: RankAmplification.slotEncodingFactor_le_paperFactor
statement:
theorem slotEncodingFactor_le_paperFactor {J M : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hM : 0 < M) :
    slotEncodingFactor J M ≤ (4 * J * M) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:= by
  have hJM : 1 ≤ J * M := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.mul_ne_zero hJ.ne' hM.ne')
  have hone : (J + 1) * 2 ^ J ≤ (4 * J * M) ^ J := by
    have hJtwo : J + 1 ≤ 2 ^ J := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
    have hJJ : 1 ≤ J ^ J := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hJ
    calc
      (J + 1) * 2 ^ J ≤ (2 ^ J * J ^ J) * 2 ^ J := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_trans hJtwo (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hJJ))
      _ = 4 ^ J * J ^ J := by
        have h4 : (2 : ℕ) ^ J * 2 ^ J = 4 ^ J := by
          rw [← mul_pow]
          norm_num
        calc (2 ^ J * J ^ J) * 2 ^ J = (2 ^ J * 2 ^ J) * J ^ J := by ring
          _ = 4 ^ J * J ^ J := by rw [h4]
      _ = (4 * J) ^ J := (mul_pow 4 J J).symm
      _ ≤ (4 * J * M) ^ J := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by nlinarith) J
  have htwo : (J + 1) ^ J ≤ (4 * J * M) ^ J := by
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left
    nlinarith
  have hthree : (J * M + 1) ^ J ≤ (4 * J * M) ^ J := by
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_left
    nlinarith
  calc
    slotEncodingFactor J M = ((J + 1) * 2 ^ J) * ((J + 1) ^ J * (J * M + 1) ^ J) := rfl
    _ ≤ (4 * J * M) ^ J * ((4 * J * M) ^ J * (4 * J * M) ^ J) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hone (Nat.mul_le_mul htwo hthree)
    _ = (4 * J * M) ^ (3 * J) := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
      ring_nf

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_fibre_mass
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_fibre_mass {J y Y x H M m : ℕ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 0 < y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) (hm : 0 < m) :
    aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m ≤
      ((4 * J * M) ^ (3 * J) : ℕ) * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) *
        ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m)
proof:
:= by

  refine (aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass_le_weightedPower hY hx hM hm).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
  refine mul_le_mul ?_ (powerSourceTupleMass_le_exp hy) (powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg _ _ _ _)
    (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast slotEncodingFactor_le_paperFactor hJ hMpos

name: RankAmplification.section10_proposition10_11_unconditional
statement:
theorem section10_proposition10_11_unconditional {J y Y x H Hcode M : ℕ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M)
    (hthreshold : 2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y, (supplierReciprocalTail P x H : ℝ)) ≤
      ((4 * J * M) ^ (3 * J) : ℕ) * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  have hMpos : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_pos _) hM
  refine (section10_proposition10_11 hy hx hthreshold
    (hasWeightedPowerFibreBound_of_logSlot hY hx hM)).trans ?_
  have htail : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ htail
  rw [finitePowerEncodingFactor]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.exp_pos _).le
  exact_mod_cast slotEncodingFactor_le_paperFactor hJ hMpos

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotWidth_le_librarySlotWidth_add
proof:
:= by
  have hlogtwo : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le hlogtwo hT
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
    linarith
  have hlognonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
    linarith
  set k : ℕ := ⌊Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T⌋₊ with hk
  have hkle : (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hlognonneg hTpos.le)
  have hklog : (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hstep : (k : ℝ) * T ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← le_div_iff₀ hTpos]
      exact hkle
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]
  have hpow : (2 : ℕ) ^ k ≤ 2 * x := by
    have hcast : ((2 : ℕ) ^ k : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
      have hlogpow : Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.log_pow]
        exact hklog
      have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogpow
      rwa [Real.exp_log (by positivity), Real.exp_log hxpos] at this
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  have hklog2 : k ≤ Nat.log 2 (2 * x) := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num) hpow
  unfold paperSlotWidth librarySlotWidth
  omega

name: RankAmplification.librarySlotWidth_ge_scale_mul_paperSlotWidth
proof:
:= by
  have hlogtwo : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hxone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlognonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  set k : ℕ := ⌊Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T⌋₊ with hk
  have hcast : (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) - 1 - J = (k : ℝ) := by
    unfold paperSlotWidth
    push_cast
    ring
  have hkle : (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hlognonneg hT.le)
  have hleft : T / Real.log 2 * (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 := by
    have hstep : T * (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [mul_comm, ← le_div_iff₀ hT]
      exact hkle
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hlogtwo]
    exact hstep
  have hupper : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 ≤ (librarySlotWidth x : ℝ) := by
    have hlt : 2 * x < 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1) := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) _
    have hcastlt : (2 : ℝ) * (x : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ)) ^ (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1) := by
      have := hlt.le
      exact_mod_cast (by exact_mod_cast this : ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ))
    have hlogle : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) ≤ (librarySlotWidth x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
      have := Real.log_le_log hxpos hcastlt
      rw [Real.log_pow] at this
      unfold librarySlotWidth
      push_cast
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hlogtwo]
    exact hlogle
  rw [hcast]
  exact hleft.trans hupper

statement:

    {εlow εhigh εoff : ℕ → ℝ}

    (hoff : Tendsto εoff atTop (nhds 0)) :

proof:
:= by
  have hmax := tendsto_fixedRankMaximumError_zero hlow hhigh hoff
  have hquot : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 3 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  change Tendsto (fun x ↦ fixedRankMaximumError εlow εhigh εoff x +
    Real.log 3 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hmax.add hquot

name: RankAmplification.sum_three_fixedRankExponentialMajorant_le_combined
statement:
theorem sum_three_fixedRankExponentialMajorant_le_combined
    {J x : ℕ} {εlow εhigh εoff : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ)) :
    fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εoff x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εlow x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εhigh x ≤
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
        (fixedRankCombinedError εlow εhigh εoff) x
proof:
:= by
  let M := fixedRankMaximumError εlow εhigh εoff x
  have hlowM : εlow x ≤ M := le_max_of_le_left (le_max_left _ _)
  have hhighM : εhigh x ≤ M := le_max_of_le_left (le_max_right _ _)
  have hoffM : εoff x ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hmono (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ≤ M) :
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + ε * scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε hV.le]
  have hsum :
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εoff x +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εlow x +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εhigh x ≤
        3 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
    unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant
    linarith [hmono _ hoffM, hmono _ hlowM, hmono _ hhighM]
  calc
    fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εoff x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εlow x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εhigh x ≤
      3 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := hsum
    _ = fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
        (fixedRankCombinedError εlow εhigh εoff) x := by
      unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant fixedRankCombinedError
      change 3 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ))) =
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
            (M + Real.log 3 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) * scaleV (x : ℝ))
      have hcancel : Real.log 3 / scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
          Real.log 3 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
      rw [add_mul, hcancel]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [← add_assoc, Real.exp_add,
          Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankDiagonalEstimate_of_analyticData
statement:
theorem fixedRankDiagonalEstimate_of_analyticData
    {J : ℕ} {εlow εhigh εoff : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankAnalyticData J εlow εhigh εoff) :
    FixedRankDiagonalEstimate J
      (fixedRankCombinedError εlow εhigh εoff) 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨data.rank_pos,
    tendsto_fixedRankCombinedError_zero data.lowRank.1
      data.highRank.1 data.offDiagonal.1,
    by norm_num, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [data.lowRank.2, data.highRank.2, data.offDiagonal.2,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hlow hhigh hoff hV
  intro h hh hhy
  have hdecomp := fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_branches
    (FixedRankBranchBounds.mk (hlow h hh hhy) (hhigh h hh hhy) (hoff h hh hhy))
  have hsum := sum_three_fixedRankExponentialMajorant_le_combined
    (J := J) (x := x) (εlow := εlow) (εhigh := εhigh) (εoff := εoff) hV
  calc
    (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εoff x +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εlow x +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J εhigh x := hdecomp
    _ ≤ (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
          (fixedRankCombinedError εlow εhigh εoff) x := by
      linarith
    _ = (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) +
        1 * fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
          (fixedRankCombinedError εlow εhigh εoff) x := by ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_theorem10_14
statement:
theorem fixedRank_theorem10_14
    {J : ℕ} {εlow εhigh εoff : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankAnalyticData J εlow εhigh εoff) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
            (fixedRankCombinedError εlow εhigh εoff) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (fixedRankDiagonalEstimate_of_analyticData data).bound

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_analyticData
statement:
theorem fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_analyticData
    {J : ℕ} {εlow εhigh εoff : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankAnalyticData J εlow εhigh εoff) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x → Odd h →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
          (fixedRankCombinedError εlow εhigh εoff) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (fixedRankDiagonalEstimate_of_analyticData data).odd_bound

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.mem_deltaPrimeSupport
statement:
theorem mem_deltaPrimeSupport {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ} (hA₁ : A₁ ≠ 0) (hA₂ : A₂ ≠ 0)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ ↔ p.Prime ∧ (p : ℤ) ∣ 2 * delta A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂
proof:
:= by
  have hne : 2 * delta A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [delta]
    exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hA₁ hA₂) hdet)
  rw [deltaPrimeSupport, Nat.mem_primeFactors]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hdvd, -⟩
    exact ⟨hp, Int.dvd_natAbs.mp (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hdvd)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hp, hdvd⟩
    exact ⟨hp, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp (Int.dvd_natAbs.mpr hdvd),
      Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hne⟩

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.ofPaperData_leftValue
statement:
theorem ofPaperData_leftValue (A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ) (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁) (hA₂ : 0 < A₂)
    (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) (hprim₁ : Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1) (hprim₂ : Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (((ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).leftValue n : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = A₁ * (n : ℤ) + B₁
proof:
:= by
  show ((A₁.toNat * n + B₁.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = A₁ * (n : ℤ) + B₁
  push_cast [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hA₁.le, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hB₁.le]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.ofPaperData_rightValue
statement:
theorem ofPaperData_rightValue (A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ) (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁) (hA₂ : 0 < A₂)
    (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) (hprim₁ : Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1) (hprim₂ : Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (((ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).rightValue n : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = A₂ * (n : ℤ) + B₂
proof:
:= by
  show ((A₂.toNat * n + B₂.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = A₂ * (n : ℤ) + B₂
  push_cast [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hA₂.le, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hB₂.le]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.ofPaperData_leftValue_prime_iff
statement:
theorem ofPaperData_leftValue_prime_iff (A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ) (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁)
    (hA₂ : 0 < A₂) (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) (hprim₁ : Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1) (hprim₂ : Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ((ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).leftValue n).Prime
      ↔ Prime (A₁ * (n : ℤ) + B₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime,
    ← ofPaperData_leftValue A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet n,
    Int.natAbs_natCast]

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.ofPaperData_rightValue_prime_iff
statement:
theorem ofPaperData_rightValue_prime_iff (A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ) (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁)
    (hA₂ : 0 < A₂) (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) (hprim₁ : Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1) (hprim₂ : Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ((ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).rightValue n).Prime
      ↔ Prime (A₂ * (n : ℤ) + B₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime,
    ← ofPaperData_rightValue A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet n,
    Int.natAbs_natCast]

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.ofPaperData_exceptionalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem ofPaperData_exceptionalPrimeSet (A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ) (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁)
    (hA₂ : 0 < A₂) (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) (hprim₁ : Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1) (hprim₂ : Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) :
    (ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).exceptionalPrimeSet
      = deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ((A₁.toNat * B₂.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = A₁ * B₂ := by
    push_cast [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hA₁.le, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hB₂.le]
    ring
  have hy : ((A₂.toNat * B₁.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = A₂ * B₁ := by
    push_cast [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hA₂.le, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hB₁.le]
    ring
  have hd : max (A₁.toNat * B₂.toNat) (A₂.toNat * B₁.toNat) -
      min (A₁.toNat * B₂.toNat) (A₂.toNat * B₁.toNat) = (A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁).natAbs := by
    omega
  have ha : A₁.toNat = A₁.natAbs := by omega
  have hb : A₂.toNat = A₂.natAbs := by omega
  have hmod : (ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).exceptionalModulus
      = (2 * delta A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂).natAbs := by
    show 2 * A₁.toNat * A₂.toNat *
        (max (A₁.toNat * B₂.toNat) (A₂.toNat * B₁.toNat) -
          min (A₁.toNat * B₂.toNat) (A₂.toNat * B₁.toNat))
      = (2 * delta A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂).natAbs
    rw [hd, ha, hb, delta]
    simp only [Int.natAbs_mul]
    ring
  rw [GeneralAffinePair.exceptionalPrimeSet, hmod, deltaPrimeSupport]

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.mem_primePairCountSet_floor
statement:
theorem mem_primePairCountSet_floor {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ} {R : ℝ} {r : ℤ} :
    r ∈ primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R ↔
      (1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ ⌊R⌋) ∧
        (0 < A₁ * r + B₁ ∧ Prime (A₁ * r + B₁)) ∧ (0 < A₂ * r + B₂ ∧ Prime (A₂ * r + B₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [primePairCountSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.mem_primePairCountSet
statement:
theorem mem_primePairCountSet {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ} {R : ℝ} {r : ℤ} :
    r ∈ primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R ↔
      (1 ≤ r ∧ (r : ℝ) ≤ R) ∧
        (0 < A₁ * r + B₁ ∧ Prime (A₁ * r + B₁)) ∧ (0 < A₂ * r + B₂ ∧ Prime (A₂ * r + B₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_primePairCountSet_floor, Int.le_floor]

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.mem_primePairCountSet_of_prime
statement:
theorem mem_primePairCountSet_of_prime {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ} (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁)
    (hA₂ : 0 < A₂) (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) {R : ℝ} {r : ℤ} (hr1 : 1 ≤ r) (hrR : (r : ℝ) ≤ R)
    (hp₁ : Prime (A₁ * r + B₁)) (hp₂ : Prime (A₂ * r + B₂)) :
    r ∈ primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_primePairCountSet]
  refine ⟨⟨hr1, hrR⟩, ⟨?_, hp₁⟩, ?_, hp₂⟩
  · nlinarith
  · nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.primePairCountSet_eq_map
statement:
theorem primePairCountSet_eq_map (A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ) (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁) (hA₂ : 0 < A₂)
    (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) (hprim₁ : Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1) (hprim₂ : Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) (R : ℝ) :
    primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R =
      ((ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).primePairSet
          ⌊R⌋.toNat).map ⟨(Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ), Nat.cast_injective⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  rw [mem_primePairCountSet_floor, Finset.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hr1, hrR⟩, ⟨-, hp₁⟩, -, hp₂⟩
    have hcast : ((r.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = r := by omega
    refine ⟨r.toNat, ?_, hcast⟩
    rw [GeneralAffinePair.mem_primePairSet]
    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ofPaperData_leftValue_prime_iff, hcast]
      exact hp₁
    · rw [ofPaperData_rightValue_prime_iff, hcast]
      exact hp₂
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
    rw [GeneralAffinePair.mem_primePairSet] at hn
    obtain ⟨hn1, hnR, hp₁, hp₂⟩ := hn
    rw [ofPaperData_leftValue_prime_iff] at hp₁
    rw [ofPaperData_rightValue_prime_iff] at hp₂
    have hpos₁ : 0 < A₁ * (n : ℤ) + B₁ := by
      have hval := (ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).leftValue_pos n
      rw [← ofPaperData_leftValue A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet n]
      exact_mod_cast hval
    have hpos₂ : 0 < A₂ * (n : ℤ) + B₂ := by
      have hval := (ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).rightValue_pos n
      rw [← ofPaperData_rightValue A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet n]
      exact_mod_cast hval
    exact ⟨⟨by exact_mod_cast hn1, by omega⟩, ⟨hpos₁, hp₁⟩, hpos₂, hp₂⟩

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.growingConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem growingConstant_nonneg (S : Finset ℕ) :
    0 ≤ AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet S
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hmax : (64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss) ^ 2 ≤
      max ((64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss) ^ 2) AffinePrimePair.affineSmallMassConstant :=
    le_max_left _ _
  unfold AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.impliedConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem impliedConstant_nonneg (S : Finset ℕ) : 0 ≤ impliedConstant S
proof:
:= by
  unfold impliedConstant
  have := growingConstant_nonneg S
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.impliedConstant_mono
statement:
theorem impliedConstant_mono {S T : Finset ℕ} (h : S ⊆ T) :
    impliedConstant S ≤ impliedConstant T
proof:
:= by
  unfold impliedConstant
  have := AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_mono h
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.divLogSq_le_of_between
statement:
theorem divLogSq_le_of_between {x R : ℝ} (hx : 3 ≤ x) (hxR : x ≤ R) (hR2 : R < 2 * x) :
    x / Real.log x ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (R / Real.log R ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlog2x : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hstep : Real.log R ≤ 2 * Real.log x := by
    have h1 : Real.log R ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hR2.le
    have h2 : Real.log (2 * x) = Real.log 2 + Real.log x :=
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hlogRsq : 0 < Real.log R ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hlogxsq : 0 < Real.log x ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hsq : Real.log R ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.log x ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have key : x / Real.log x ^ 2 ≤ 4 * R / Real.log R ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hlogxsq hlogRsq]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxR (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.log x ^ 2)]
  calc
    x / Real.log x ^ 2 ≤ 4 * R / Real.log R ^ 2 := key
    _ = 4 * (R / Real.log R ^ 2) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.logSquaredScale_toNat_floor_le
statement:
theorem logSquaredScale_toNat_floor_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale ⌊R⌋.toNat ≤ 4 * (R / Real.log R ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : (3 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊R⌋ := by
    rw [Int.le_floor]
    exact_mod_cast hR
  have hZ : ((⌊R⌋.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = ⌊R⌋ := by omega
  have hcast : ((⌊R⌋.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((⌊R⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hZ
  have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊R⌋.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hcast]
    exact_mod_cast hfloor
  have hle : ((⌊R⌋.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ R := by
    rw [hcast]
    exact Int.floor_le R
  have hlt : R < 2 * ((⌊R⌋.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hcast]
    have h1 : R < ((⌊R⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one R
    have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊R⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : (1 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊R⌋)
    linarith
  exact divLogSq_le_of_between h3 hle hlt

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.card_primePairCountSet_le
statement:
theorem card_primePairCountSet_le (A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ) (hA₁ : 0 < A₁) (hB₁ : 0 < B₁) (hA₂ : 0 < A₂)
    (hB₂ : 0 < B₂) (hprim₁ : Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1) (hprim₂ : Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1)
    (hdet : A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0) {R : ℝ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    ((primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R).card : ℝ) ≤
      impliedConstant (deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂) * (R / Real.log R ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : (3 : ℤ) ≤ ⌊R⌋ := by
    rw [Int.le_floor]
    exact_mod_cast hR
  have hN : (3 : ℕ) ≤ ⌊R⌋.toNat := by omega
  have hcard : (primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R).card =
      ((ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).primePairSet
        ⌊R⌋.toNat).card := by
    rw [primePairCountSet_eq_map A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet R,
      Finset.card_map]
  have hconst :
      (ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).generalPairGrowingConstant
        = AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet
            (deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂) := by
    rw [GeneralAffinePair.generalPairGrowingConstant_eq_growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet,
      ofPaperData_exceptionalPrimeSet]
  have hbound :=
    (ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂
      hdet).card_primePairSet_le_generalPairGrowingConstant hN
  rw [hconst] at hbound
  have hCnonneg := growingConstant_nonneg (deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂)
  have hscale := logSquaredScale_toNat_floor_le hR
  calc
    ((primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R).card : ℝ)
        = (((ofPaperData A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet).primePairSet
            ⌊R⌋.toNat).card : ℝ) := by rw [hcard]
    _ ≤ AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet (deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂) *
          AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale ⌊R⌋.toNat := hbound
    _ ≤ AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet (deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂) *
          (4 * (R / Real.log R ^ 2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hCnonneg
    _ = impliedConstant (deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂) * (R / Real.log R ^ 2) := by
        unfold impliedConstant
        ring

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.exists_uniform_constant
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_constant (P : Finset ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℤ, 0 < A₁ → 0 < B₁ → 0 < A₂ → 0 < B₂ →
      Int.gcd A₁ B₁ = 1 → Int.gcd A₂ B₂ = 1 → A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ ≠ 0 →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℤ) ∣ A₁ → p ∈ P) →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℤ) ∣ A₂ → p ∈ P) →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℤ) ∣ A₁ * B₂ - A₂ * B₁ → p ∈ P) →
      ∀ R : ℝ, 3 ≤ R →
        ((primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R).card : ℝ) ≤ C * (R / Real.log R ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨impliedConstant (insert 2 P), ?_⟩
  intro A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet hleft hright hdiff R hR
  have hsubset : deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ ⊆ insert 2 P := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hprime, hdvd⟩ := (mem_deltaPrimeSupport hA₁.ne' hA₂.ne' hdet).mp hp
    have hpZ : Prime (p : ℤ) := Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp hprime
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, delta] at *
    rcases hpZ.dvd_mul.mp hdvd with htwo | hrest
    · left
      have hp2 : p ∣ 2 := by exact_mod_cast htwo
      exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hprime Nat.prime_two).mp hp2
    · rcases hpZ.dvd_mul.mp hrest with hslopes | hdetdvd
      · rcases hpZ.dvd_mul.mp hslopes with h1 | h2
        · exact Or.inr (hleft p hprime h1)
        · exact Or.inr (hright p hprime h2)
      · exact Or.inr (hdiff p hprime hdetdvd)
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R / Real.log R ^ 2 := by
    have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R := by linarith
    positivity
  calc
    ((primePairCountSet A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ R).card : ℝ)
        ≤ impliedConstant (deltaPrimeSupport A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂) * (R / Real.log R ^ 2) :=
      card_primePairCountSet_le A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ hA₁ hB₁ hA₂ hB₂ hprim₁ hprim₂ hdet hR
    _ ≤ impliedConstant (insert 2 P) * (R / Real.log R ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (impliedConstant_mono hsubset) hscale

name: RankAmplification.TwoLinearSieve.card_primePairCountSet_le_nonvacuous
statement:
theorem card_primePairCountSet_le_nonvacuous :
    (0 : ℤ) < 2 ∧ (0 : ℤ) < 3 ∧ (0 : ℤ) < 5 ∧ (0 : ℤ) < 7 ∧
      Int.gcd 2 3 = 1 ∧ Int.gcd 5 7 = 1 ∧ (2 : ℤ) * 7 - 5 * 3 ≠ 0 ∧
      (2 : ℤ) ∈ primePairCountSet 2 3 5 7 (10 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num, by decide, by decide, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  refine mem_primePairCountSet_of_prime (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ?_ ?_
  · rw [show (2 : ℤ) * 2 + 3 = 7 by norm_num, Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime]
    norm_num
  · rw [show (5 : ℤ) * 2 + 7 = 17 by norm_num, Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime]
    norm_num

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_le_gamma_mul_log
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_le_gamma_mul_log
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 0 < Y) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hinner : ∀ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤
        γ * (((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y))) :
    bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      γ * ((X : ℝ) * bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) *
        (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant))
proof:
:= by
  have _hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hX
  have hstep : bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y ≤ γ * bfpsSmallGammaKernel ξ X Y := by
    unfold bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution bfpsSmallGammaKernel
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
    intro d hd
    calc
      ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d *
            (γ * (((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hinner d hd) ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
      _ = γ * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y)) := by ring
  exact hstep.trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_log (ξ := ξ) (X := X) (Y := Y) hY) hγ

name: RankAmplification.bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_smallMangoldtSet
statement:
theorem bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_smallMangoldtSet
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hd : d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) :
    d ≤ X ∧ bfpsU (X / d) Y ≤ bfpsU X Y ∧
      bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / d) Y ≤ Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdata := mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet.mp hd
  have hset := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdata.1
  have hdpos : 0 < d := hset.1
  have hdX : d ≤ X := hset.2.1
  have hdReal : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hdpos
  have hdY : (d : ℝ) ≤ (Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdata.2
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  refine ⟨hdX, rankinU_nat_div_le hY hdpos hdX, ?_⟩
  have hlog : Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
  exact (rankinU_sub_nat_div_le hY hdpos hdX).trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog hlogY.le)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_largePrimeMagnitudeShell
statement:
theorem bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_largePrimeMagnitudeShell
    {X Y k p : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hp : p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k) :
    p ≤ X ∧ bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤ bfpsU X Y ∧
      bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤
        ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + Real.log 2 / Real.log (Y : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdata := mem_bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp
  have hpSet := mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hdata.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpSet.1.pos
  have hpX : p ≤ X := hpSet.2.1
  have hpReal : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPos
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  refine ⟨hpX, rankinU_nat_div_le hY hpPos hpX, ?_⟩
  have hpUpper : (p : ℝ) ≤ (Y : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hdata.2.2.1.le
  have hlogp : Real.log p ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
    calc
      Real.log p ≤ Real.log ((Y : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) := Real.log_le_log hpReal hpUpper
      _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := Real.log_pow _ _
  have hnum : Real.log (2 * (p : ℝ)) ≤
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y + Real.log 2 := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hpReal.ne']
    linarith
  refine (rankinU_sub_nat_div_le hY hpPos hpX).trans ?_
  calc
    Real.log (2 * (p : ℝ)) / Real.log Y ≤
        (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y + Real.log 2) / Real.log Y :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hlogY.le
    _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + Real.log 2 / Real.log (Y : ℝ) := by
      rw [add_div, mul_div_assoc, div_self hlogY.ne', mul_one]

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_and_bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_smallMangoldtSet
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_and_bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_smallMangoldtSet
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hd : d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) :
    (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
      bfpsU (X / d) Y ≤ bfpsU X Y ∧
        bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / d) Y ≤ Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hmono, hgap⟩ := bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_smallMangoldtSet hY hd
  exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size (X / d) Y, hmono, hgap⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_and_bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_largePrimeMagnitudeShell
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_and_bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_largePrimeMagnitudeShell
    {X Y k p : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hp : p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k) :
    (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
      bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤ bfpsU X Y ∧
        bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤
          ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + Real.log 2 / Real.log (Y : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hmono, hgap⟩ := bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_largePrimeMagnitudeShell hY hp
  exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size (X / p) Y, hmono, hgap⟩

name: RankAmplification.mem_boundedLowRankCofactorPairSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_boundedLowRankCofactorPairSet {X y J d m : ℕ} :
    (d, m) ∈ boundedLowRankCofactorPairSet X y J ↔
      ∃ N ∈ boundedLowRankCensusSet X y J,
        d = badLocalProduct N y ∧ m = goodLocalProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hdm
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hEq⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hdm
    have hpair : (d, m) =
        (badLocalProduct N.1 y, goodLocalProduct N.1 y) := hEq.symm
    exact ⟨N.1, N.2, congrArg Prod.fst hpair, congrArg Prod.snd hpair⟩
  · rintro ⟨N, hN, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨N, hN⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.card_boundedLowRankCofactorPairSet

name: RankAmplification.badLocalProduct_le_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet
statement:
theorem badLocalProduct_le_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet
    {X y J N : ℕ} (hN : N ∈ boundedLowRankCensusSet X y J) :
    badLocalProduct N y ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  have hNData := mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hNData.1
  exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hNpos (badLocalProduct_dvd hNpos.ne')).trans hNData.2.1

name: RankAmplification.goodLocalProduct_le_div_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet
statement:
theorem goodLocalProduct_le_div_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet
    {X y J N : ℕ} (hN : N ∈ boundedLowRankCensusSet X y J) :
    goodLocalProduct N y ≤ X / badLocalProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  have hNData := mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hNData.1
  rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (badLocalProduct_pos N y), Nat.mul_comm,
    ← eq_badLocalProduct_mul_goodLocalProduct hNpos.ne']
  exact hNData.2.1

name: RankAmplification.goodLocalProduct_mem_smoothTotientSet_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet
statement:
theorem goodLocalProduct_mem_smoothTotientSet_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet
    {X y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedLowRankCensusSet X y J) :
    goodLocalProduct N y ∈ smoothTotientSet (X / badLocalProduct N y) y
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_smoothTotientSet.mpr
  exact ⟨goodLocalProduct_pos N y,
    goodLocalProduct_le_div_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet hN,
    totient_goodLocalProduct_isSmooth hy⟩

    (badLocalPrimeSet N y).card < J
proof:

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankBadSourceSet_subset_sourceUniverse
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankBadSourceSet_subset_sourceUniverse
    {X y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    boundedLowRankBadSourceSet X y J ⊆ boundedLowRankSourceUniverse X J
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := mem_boundedLowRankBadSourceSet.mp hd
  apply mem_boundedLowRankSourceUniverse.mpr
  refine ⟨badLocalProduct_pos N y,
    badLocalProduct_le_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet hN, ?_⟩

name: RankAmplification.card_boundedLowRankBadSourceFiber_le_smoothTotientCount

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankCensusCount_eq_sum_badSourceFibers
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankCensusCount_eq_sum_badSourceFibers (X y J : ℕ) :
    boundedLowRankCensusCount X y J =
      ∑ d ∈ boundedLowRankBadSourceSet X y J,
        (boundedLowRankBadSourceFiber X y J d).card
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun N ↦ badLocalProduct N y
  have hmaps : (boundedLowRankCensusSet X y J : Set ℕ).MapsTo f
      (boundedLowRankBadSourceSet X y J : Set ℕ) := by
    intro N hN
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
  simpa [boundedLowRankCensusCount, boundedLowRankBadSourceSet,
    boundedLowRankBadSourceFiber, f] using Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankCensusCount_le_sum_badSourceImage

theorem boundedLowRankCensusCount_le_sum_badSourceImage

        smoothTotientCount (X / d) y
proof:
:= by

    card_boundedLowRankBadSourceFiber_le_smoothTotientCount hy

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_sum_sourceUniverse

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotPair_supplierPairSlot
statement:
theorem paperSlotPair_supplierPairSlot {J M : ℕ} (r : Fin J) (k : Fin M) :
    paperSlotPair (supplierPairSlot r k) = some (r, k)
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : ((supplierPairSlot r k : Fin (J * M + 1)) : ℕ) < J * M :=
    (finProdFinEquiv (r, k)).isLt
  rw [paperSlotPair, dif_pos hlt]
  have hfin : (⟨((supplierPairSlot r k : Fin (J * M + 1)) : ℕ), hlt⟩ : Fin (J * M)) =
      finProdFinEquiv (r, k) := rfl
  rw [hfin, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: RankAmplification.finsetSlotPrime_slotIndexOfFinset
statement:
theorem finsetSlotPrime_slotIndexOfFinset {M : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} (hcard : S.card ≤ M) (p : S) :
    finsetSlotPrime S (slotIndexOfFinset hcard p) = (p : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hval : ((slotIndexOfFinset hcard p : Fin M) : ℕ) = ((S.equivFin p : Fin S.card) : ℕ) := rfl
  have hlt : ((slotIndexOfFinset hcard p : Fin M) : ℕ) < S.card := by
    rw [hval]
    exact (S.equivFin p).isLt
  rw [finsetSlotPrime, dif_pos hlt]
  have hfin : (⟨((slotIndexOfFinset hcard p : Fin M) : ℕ), hlt⟩ : Fin S.card) = S.equivFin p :=
    Fin.ext hval
  rw [hfin, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: RankAmplification.paperWeightedCode_slotMap
statement:

name: RankAmplification.paperDemandSlot_carriedPrime
statement:
theorem paperDemandSlot_carriedPrime {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) (i : Fin J) :
    paperCarriedPrime a (paperDemandSlot hy hY hM a i) = a.1.value i
proof:
:= by
  have hblock : a.2.partition.blockOf (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i) = a.2.partition.blockOf i :=
    a.2.partition.blockOf_minBlockCode i
  have htype : (a.labelDescriptor (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i)).sourceType =
      (a.labelDescriptor i).sourceType :=
    congrArg (fun B : a.2.partition.Block ↦ (a.2.descriptor B).sourceType) hblock
  have hbase : (a.labelDescriptor (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i)).base =
      (a.labelDescriptor i).base :=
    congrArg (fun B : a.2.partition.Block ↦ (a.2.descriptor B).base) hblock
  unfold paperCarriedPrime
  rw [paperDemandSlot_pair hy hY hM a i]
  show finsetSlotPrime
      (paperDemandCandidates y (a.labelDescriptor (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i)).sourceType
        (a.labelDescriptor (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i)).base)
      (paperCandidateIndex hy hY hM a i) = a.1.value i
  rw [htype, hbase]
  exact finsetSlotPrime_slotIndexOfFinset _ _

name: RankAmplification.paperCandidateIndex_congr
statement:
theorem paperCandidateIndex_congr {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)

    (hbase : (a.labelDescriptor i).base = (b.labelDescriptor j).base)

name: RankAmplification.paperDemandSlot_congr
statement:
theorem paperDemandSlot_congr {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) {a b : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x} {i j : Fin J}
    (hcode : a.2.partition.minBlockCode i = b.2.partition.minBlockCode j)
    (htype : (a.labelDescriptor i).sourceType = (b.labelDescriptor j).sourceType)
    (hbase : (a.labelDescriptor i).base = (b.labelDescriptor j).base)
    (hvalue : a.1.value i = b.1.value j) :
    paperDemandSlot hy hY hM a i = paperDemandSlot hy hY hM b j
proof:
:= by
  unfold paperDemandSlot
  rw [hcode, paperCandidateIndex_congr hy hY hM htype hbase hvalue]

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotWidth_le_real
statement:
theorem paperSlotWidth_le_real {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) ≤ 1 + J + Real.log (2 * x) / T
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with hx | hx
    · subst hx
      simp
    · apply Real.log_nonneg
      have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
      linarith
  have hfloor : ((⌊Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hlog hT.le)
  have hcast : (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) =
      1 + (J : ℝ) + ((⌊Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    unfold paperSlotWidth
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hcast]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card_real
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card_real {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)) : ℝ) ≤
      (4 * J * (1 + J + Real.log (2 * x) / T)) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : (Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)) : ℝ) ≤
      ((4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (3 * J) := by
    have h := section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card (J := J) (x := x) (T := T) hJ
    exact_mod_cast h
  refine hnat.trans ?_
  have hbase : ((4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      4 * J * (1 + J + Real.log (2 * x) / T) := by
    have hJnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (J : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (paperSlotWidth_le_real (J := J) (x := x) hT) hJnonneg
    calc ((4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T : ℕ) : ℝ)
        = 4 * (J : ℝ) * (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ 4 * (J : ℝ) * (1 + J + Real.log (2 * x) / T) := hstep
      _ = 4 * J * (1 + J + Real.log (2 * x) / T) := by ring
  have hnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg hbase (3 * J)

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_display
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_display {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) :
    (∀ (a b : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) (i j : Fin J),
        a.2.partition.minBlockCode i = b.2.partition.minBlockCode j →
        (a.labelDescriptor i).sourceType = (b.labelDescriptor j).sourceType →
        (a.labelDescriptor i).base = (b.labelDescriptor j).base →
        a.1.value i = b.1.value j →
        (paperWeightedCode hy hY
              (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) a).2.2.2.2 i =
          (paperWeightedCode hy hY
              (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) b).2.2.2.2 j) ∧
      (∀ (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) (i : Fin J),
        paperCarriedPrime a
            ((paperWeightedCode hy hY
              (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) a).2.2.2.2 i) =
          a.1.value i) ∧
      Function.Injective
        (paperWeightedCode hy hY (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) :
          AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x → AggregateWeightedCode J y Y (paperSlotWidth J x T)) ∧
      (Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)) : ℝ) ≤
        (4 * J * (1 + J + Real.log (2 * x) / T)) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ hcode htype hbase hvalue ↦ paperDemandSlot_congr _ _ _ hcode htype hbase hvalue,
    fun a i ↦ paperDemandSlot_carriedPrime _ _ _ a i,
    section10_lemma10_10_paper_injective hy hT hyT hY,
    section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card_real hJ hT⟩

name: RankAmplification.workedEntry_blockOf_zero_eq_one
statement:
theorem workedEntry_blockOf_zero_eq_one :
    workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 0 = workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (1 : Fin 4) ∈ (workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1).1 :=
    workedEntry.2.partition.mem_blockOf 1
  have hblocks : workedEntry.2.partition.blocks = {{0, 1, 2}, {3}} := remark10_8_partition_blocks
  have hgen : ∀ B : Finset (Fin 4), B ∈ workedEntry.2.partition.blocks →
      (1 : Fin 4) ∈ B → B = {0, 1, 2} := by
    intro B hB hmemB
    rw [hblocks, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hB
    rcases hB with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [h] at hmemB
      exact absurd hmemB (by decide)
  have hset : (workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1).1 = {0, 1, 2} :=
    hgen _ (workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1).2 hmem
  apply workedEntry.2.partition.block_eq_of_mem
  rw [hset]
  decide

name: RankAmplification.workedEntry_demands_and_base
statement:
theorem workedEntry_demands_and_base :
    workedEntry.1.value 0 = 7 ∧ workedEntry.1.value 1 = 7 ∧
      (workedEntry.labelDescriptor 0).base = 7
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide, ?_⟩
  have hmem : (1 : Fin 4) ∈ (workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1).1 :=
    workedEntry.2.partition.mem_blockOf 1
  have hblocks : workedEntry.2.partition.blocks = {{0, 1, 2}, {3}} := remark10_8_partition_blocks
  have hgen : ∀ B : Finset (Fin 4), B ∈ workedEntry.2.partition.blocks →
      (1 : Fin 4) ∈ B → B = {0, 1, 2} := by
    intro B hB hmemB
    rw [hblocks, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hB
    rcases hB with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [h] at hmemB
      exact absurd hmemB (by decide)
  have hset : (workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1).1 = {0, 1, 2} :=
    hgen _ (workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1).2 hmem
  have hb1 : workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 1 = workedBlockOne := Subtype.ext hset
  have hb0 : workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf 0 = workedBlockOne :=
    workedEntry_blockOf_zero_eq_one.trans hb1
  have hstep : (workedEntry.labelDescriptor 0).base =
      (workedEntry.2.descriptor workedBlockOne).base :=
    congrArg (fun B : workedEntry.2.partition.Block ↦ (workedEntry.2.descriptor B).base) hb0
  have hdesc : workedEntry.2.descriptor workedBlockOne = Sum.inr workedPowerDescriptor :=
    worked_descriptor_blockOne
  rw [hstep, hdesc]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_sigma_not_injective
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_sigma_not_injective :
    (0 : Fin 4) ≠ 1 ∧
      paperDemandSlot (J := 4) (y := 2) (Y := 16) (x := 2000)
          (M := paperSlotWidth 4 2000 (Real.log 2)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
          (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := 4) (x := 2000) (T := Real.log 2)
            (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
            (by rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]; norm_num)) workedEntry 0 =
        paperDemandSlot (J := 4) (y := 2) (Y := 16) (x := 2000)
          (M := paperSlotWidth 4 2000 (Real.log 2)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
          (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := 4) (x := 2000) (T := Real.log 2)
            (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
            (by rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]; norm_num)) workedEntry 1 ∧
      ¬ Function.Injective
          (paperDemandSlot (J := 4) (y := 2) (Y := 16) (x := 2000)
            (M := paperSlotWidth 4 2000 (Real.log 2)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
            (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := 4) (x := 2000) (T := Real.log 2)
              (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
              (by rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]; norm_num)) workedEntry)
proof:
:= by
  have hblock := workedEntry_blockOf_zero_eq_one
  have hcode : workedEntry.2.partition.minBlockCode 0 = workedEntry.2.partition.minBlockCode 1 :=
    (workedEntry.2.partition.blockOf_eq_iff_minBlockCode_eq 0 1).mp hblock
  have htype : (workedEntry.labelDescriptor 0).sourceType =
      (workedEntry.labelDescriptor 1).sourceType :=
    congrArg (fun B : workedEntry.2.partition.Block ↦ (workedEntry.2.descriptor B).sourceType)
      hblock
  have hbase : (workedEntry.labelDescriptor 0).base = (workedEntry.labelDescriptor 1).base :=
    congrArg (fun B : workedEntry.2.partition.Block ↦ (workedEntry.2.descriptor B).base) hblock
  have hvalue : workedEntry.1.value 0 = workedEntry.1.value 1 := by decide
  have hslot := paperDemandSlot_congr (J := 4) (y := 2) (Y := 16) (x := 2000)
    (M := paperSlotWidth 4 2000 (Real.log 2)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := 4) (x := 2000) (T := Real.log 2)
      (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
      (by rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]; norm_num))
    (a := workedEntry) (b := workedEntry) (i := 0) (j := 1) hcode htype hbase hvalue
  refine ⟨by decide, hslot, ?_⟩
  intro hinj
  exact absurd (hinj hslot) (by decide)

name: RankAmplification.mem_nonsmoothNonSquareSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_nonsmoothNonSquareSet {x h y n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ nonsmoothNonSquareSet x h y ↔
      n ∈ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y ∧
        n ∉ squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt
proof:
:= by
  simp [nonsmoothNonSquareSet]

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_disjoint_nonSquareSet
statement:
theorem nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_disjoint_nonSquareSet (x h y : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt)
      (nonsmoothNonSquareSet x h y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hsquare hnonsquare
  have hsquare' :
      n ∈ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y ∩ squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt := by
    simpa [nonsmoothSquareSourceSet] using hsquare
  exact (mem_nonsmoothNonSquareSet.mp hnonsquare).2
    (Finset.mem_inter.mp hsquare').2

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_union_nonSquareSet
statement:
theorem nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_union_nonSquareSet (x h y : ℕ) :
    nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt ∪ nonsmoothNonSquareSet x h y =
      nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [nonsmoothSquareSourceSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter,
    mem_nonsmoothNonSquareSet]
  tauto

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_square_add_nonSquare
statement:
theorem nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_square_add_nonSquare (x h y : ℕ) :
    nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y =
      (nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card +
        (nonsmoothNonSquareSet x h y).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsmoothShiftedCount,
    ← nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_union_nonSquareSet x h y,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
      (nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_disjoint_nonSquareSet x h y)]

name: RankAmplification.canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_gt_of_mem_offDiagonalNonSquare
statement:
theorem canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_gt_of_mem_offDiagonalNonSquare
    {x h y n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ∈ offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt) :
    y < canonicalLargestPrimeProvider n
proof:
:= by
  have hoff := (mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet.mp hn).1
  have hnonsmooth := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp
    (mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet.mp hoff).1
  exact hnonsmooth.2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_prime_of_mem_offDiagonalNonSquare
statement:
theorem canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_prime_of_mem_offDiagonalNonSquare
    {x h y n : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hn : n ∈ offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt) :
    (canonicalLargestPrimeProvider n).Prime
proof:
:= by
  apply largestPrimeFactor_prime
  have hgt := canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_gt_of_mem_offDiagonalNonSquare hn
  change y < largestPrimeFactor n.totient at hgt
  change 1 < largestPrimeFactor n.totient
  omega

name: RankAmplification.canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_sq_not_dvd
statement:
theorem canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_sq_not_dvd
    {x h y n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hn : n ∈ offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt) :
    ¬(canonicalLargestPrimeProvider n) ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)
proof:
:= by
  intro hsquare
  have hnData := mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet.mp hn
  have hnonsmooth := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp
    (mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet.mp hnData.1).1
  apply hnData.2
  rw [mem_squareSourceSet_sqrt_cutoff hh hhy (hhy.trans hxy)]
  refine ⟨hnonsmooth.1, hnonsmooth.2.1, canonicalLargestPrimeProvider n,
    canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_gt_of_mem_offDiagonalNonSquare hn, ?_, hsquare⟩
  exact canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_prime_of_mem_offDiagonalNonSquare
    (hh.trans_le hhy) hn

name: RankAmplification.nonempty_canonicalLargestPrimeSkeleton
statement:
theorem nonempty_canonicalLargestPrimeSkeleton
    {x h y n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hn : n ∈ offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt) :
    Nonempty (LargePrimeSkeleton h n (canonicalLargestPrimeProvider n))
proof:
:= by
  have hnonsmooth := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp
    (mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet.mp
      (mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet.mp hn).1).1
  apply exists_largePrimeSkeleton hnonsmooth.1
    (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hh))
    (M := n.totient)
  · rfl
  · exact hnonsmooth.2.2.1.symm
  · rfl
  · exact hhy.trans_lt hnonsmooth.2.2.2
  · exact canonicalLargestPrimeProvider_sq_not_dvd hh hhy hxy hn

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonSquareSet_eq_nonsmoothNonSquareSet_of_odd

theorem offDiagonalNonSquareSet_eq_nonsmoothNonSquareSet_of_odd
    {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt = nonsmoothNonSquareSet x h y

name: RankAmplification.nonempty_canonicalLargestPrimeSkeleton_of_mem_nonsmoothNonSquare
statement:
theorem nonempty_canonicalLargestPrimeSkeleton_of_mem_nonsmoothNonSquare
    {x h y n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hn : n ∈ nonsmoothNonSquareSet x h y) :
    Nonempty (LargePrimeSkeleton h n (canonicalLargestPrimeProvider n))
proof:
