name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.n_eq_of_same_cofactors_of_not_diagonal
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.n_eq_of_same_cofactors_of_not_diagonal
    {h n p n' p' : ℕ} (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p)
    (hnotdiag : ¬s.IsDiagonal) (t : LargePrimeSkeleton h n' p')
    (hm₁ : s.m1 = t.m1) (hm₂ : s.m2 = t.m2) :
    n = n'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, _hc, hsk₁, hsk₂⟩ := s.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
  obtain ⟨d, _hd, htk₁, htk₂⟩ := t.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
  let C := c * p
  let D := d * p'
  have hsShift := s.normalized_shift_equation hsk₁ hsk₂
  have htShift := t.normalized_shift_equation htk₁ htk₂
  have hsLinear :
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * C + (s.m1 + h) =
        (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * C + s.m2 := by
    calc
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * C + (s.m1 + h) =
          s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) + h := by
        simp only [C]
        ring
      _ = s.m2 * (normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) := hsShift
      _ = (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * C + s.m2 := by
        simp only [C]
        ring
  have htLinear :
      (t.m1 * normalizedA t.m1 t.m2) * D + (t.m1 + h) =
        (t.m2 * normalizedB t.m1 t.m2) * D + t.m2 := by
    calc
      (t.m1 * normalizedA t.m1 t.m2) * D + (t.m1 + h) =
          t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * (d * p') + 1) + h := by
        simp only [D]
        ring
      _ = t.m2 * (normalizedB t.m1 t.m2 * (d * p') + 1) := htShift
      _ = (t.m2 * normalizedB t.m1 t.m2) * D + t.m2 := by
        simp only [D]
        ring
  have htLinear' :
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * D + (s.m1 + h) =
        (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * D + s.m2 := by
    simpa only [hm₁, hm₂] using htLinear
  have hslope :
      s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 ≠ s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 := by
    simpa only [LargePrimeSkeleton.IsDiagonal] using hnotdiag
  have hCD : C = D := affine_parameter_unique hslope hsLinear htLinear'
  have hnS : n = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * C + 1) := by
    calc
      n = s.m1 * s.q1 := s.n_eq
      _ = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * C + 1) := by
        rw [s.q1_eq, hsk₁]
        simp only [C]
        ring
  have hnT : n' = t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * D + 1) := by
    calc
      n' = t.m1 * t.q1 := t.n_eq
      _ = t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * D + 1) := by
        rw [t.q1_eq, htk₁]
        simp only [D]
        ring
  calc
    n = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * C + 1) := hnS
    _ = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * D + 1) := by rw [hCD]
    _ = t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * D + 1) := by rw [hm₁, hm₂]
    _ = n' := hnT.symm

name: RankAmplification.cofactorPair_injective_of_not_diagonal
statement:
theorem cofactorPair_injective_of_not_diagonal {h : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hoff : ∀ n, ¬(skeleton n).IsDiagonal) :
    Function.Injective (fun n ↦ ((skeleton n).m1, (skeleton n).m2))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (skeleton a).n_eq_of_same_cofactors_of_not_diagonal (hoff a) (skeleton b)
    (congrArg Prod.fst hab) (congrArg Prod.snd hab)

name: RankAmplification.card_skeletonNumbers_le_cofactor_bound_of_not_diagonal
statement:
theorem card_skeletonNumbers_le_cofactor_bound_of_not_diagonal
    {h X : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hoff : ∀ n, ¬(skeleton n).IsDiagonal)
    (hsmall : ∀ n, (skeleton n).m1 * (skeleton n).m2 ≤ X) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ X * (1 + Real.log X)
proof:
:= by
  let imagePairs := S.attach.image fun n ↦ ((skeleton n).m1, (skeleton n).m2)
  have hsubset : imagePairs ⊆ cofactorPairSet X := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    exact mem_cofactorPairSet.mpr
      ⟨(skeleton n).m1_pos, (skeleton n).m2_pos, hsmall n⟩
  have hcard : imagePairs.card ≤ (cofactorPairSet X).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  have himage : imagePairs.card = S.card := by
    change (S.attach.image fun n ↦ ((skeleton n).m1, (skeleton n).m2)).card = S.card
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _
      (cofactorPair_injective_of_not_diagonal S provider skeleton hoff)]
    exact Finset.card_attach
  rw [himage] at hcard
  exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard).trans (card_cofactorPairSet_cast_le X)

name: RankAmplification.mem_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet {x y P : ℕ} {c : ProviderCode} :
    c ∈ primeLargeCofactorCodeSet x y P ↔
      y < c.p ∧ c.p ≤ P ∧ c.p.Prime ∧
        (c.k1, c.k2) ∈ smoothFactorPairSet c.p ((2 * x * y) / c.p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hc
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzc⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hc
    obtain ⟨p, k₁, k₂⟩ := z
    have hzData := Finset.mem_sigma.mp hz
    have hpData := mem_squareSourcePrimeRange.mp hzData.1
    cases hzc
    exact ⟨hpData.1, hpData.2.1, hpData.2.2, hzData.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hyp, hpP, hp, hk⟩
    apply Finset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨c.p, (c.k1, c.k2)⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
      ⟨mem_squareSourcePrimeRange.mpr ⟨hyp, hpP, hp⟩, hk⟩

name: RankAmplification.sum_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet_eq
statement:
theorem sum_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet_eq (x y P : ℕ) :
    (∑ c ∈ primeLargeCofactorCodeSet x y P,
      ((x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1)) =
      ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
        smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeLargeCofactorCodeSet, Finset.sum_map, Finset.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  simp [smoothProviderPairMajorant, ProviderCode.denominator,
    sigmaToPrimeProviderCode]

name: RankAmplification.providerCodeImage_subset_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet
statement:
theorem providerCodeImage_subset_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet
    {x h y : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x)
    (hp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, (provider n).Prime)
    (hyp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, y < provider n)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hlarge : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S},
      x / y < (skeleton n).m1 * (skeleton n).m2) :
    providerCodeImage S provider skeleton ⊆
      primeLargeCofactorCodeSet x y (2 * x * y).sqrt
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
  let s := skeleton n
  apply mem_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hyp n, s.provider_le_sqrt_two_mul_xy
    (hnx n) hy hhy hxy (hlarge n), hp n, ?_⟩
  exact s.multiplier_pair_mem_large_cofactor_set
    (hnx n) (hp n).pos hy hhy hxy (hlarge n)

name: RankAmplification.card_largeCofactorSkeletonFamily_le_prime_sum
statement:
theorem card_largeCofactorSkeletonFamily_le_prime_sum
    {x h y : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x)
    (hp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, (provider n).Prime)
    (hyp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, y < provider n)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hlarge : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S},
      x / y < (skeleton n).m1 * (skeleton n).m2) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
        smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let C := providerCodeImage S provider skeleton
  have hcodeSubset : C ⊆ primeLargeCofactorCodeSet x y (2 * x * y).sqrt :=
    providerCodeImage_subset_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet
      S provider skeleton hnx hp hyp hy hhy hxy hlarge
  have hfibre (c : ProviderCode) :
      ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1 := by
    have hnat := providerCode_fiber_card_le S provider skeleton hnx hh
      (fun n ↦ hhy.trans_lt (hyp n)) c
    have hcast :
        ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((x / c.denominator + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hnat
    calc
      ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((x / c.denominator + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hcast
      _ = ((x / c.denominator : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1 := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right
          (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := x) (n := c.denominator)) 1
  calc
    (S.card : ℝ) = ∑ c ∈ C,
        ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast card_eq_sum_providerCode_fibers S provider skeleton
    _ ≤ ∑ c ∈ C, ((x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _hc ↦ hfibre c
    _ ≤ ∑ c ∈ primeLargeCofactorCodeSet x y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
        ((x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hcodeSubset
      intro c _hc _
      positivity
    _ = ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
        smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2) :=
      sum_primeLargeCofactorCodeSet_eq x y _

name: RankAmplification.card_offDiagonalSkeletonFamily_le_small_add_large
statement:
theorem card_offDiagonalSkeletonFamily_le_small_add_large
    {x h y : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hoff : ∀ n, ¬(skeleton n).IsDiagonal)
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x)
    (hp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, (provider n).Prime)
    (hyp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, y < provider n)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤
      (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
        ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
          smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_eq_small_add_large S provider skeleton, Nat.cast_add]
  apply add_le_add
  · let T := smallCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton (x / y)
    have hTS : T ⊆ S := smallCofactorSkeletonSet_subset S provider skeleton
    let providerT := restrictProvider hTS provider
    let skeletonT := restrictSkeleton hTS provider skeleton
    apply card_skeletonNumbers_le_cofactor_bound_of_not_diagonal
      T providerT skeletonT
    · intro n
      exact hoff (restrictFinsetIndex hTS n)
    · intro n
      have hnSmall := mem_smallCofactorSkeletonSet.mp n.2
      have hprod := hnSmall.2
      rw [skeletonCofactorProduct_of_mem hnSmall.1] at hprod
      simpa [T, providerT, skeletonT, restrictSkeleton, restrictFinsetIndex] using hprod
  · let T := largeCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton (x / y)
    have hTS : T ⊆ S := largeCofactorSkeletonSet_subset S provider skeleton
    let providerT := restrictProvider hTS provider
    let skeletonT := restrictSkeleton hTS provider skeleton
    apply card_largeCofactorSkeletonFamily_le_prime_sum
      T providerT skeletonT
    · intro n
      exact hnx (restrictFinsetIndex hTS n)
    · intro n
      exact hp (restrictFinsetIndex hTS n)
    · intro n
      exact hyp (restrictFinsetIndex hTS n)
    · exact hy
    · exact hh
    · exact hhy
    · exact hxy
    · intro n
      have hnLarge := mem_largeCofactorSkeletonSet.mp n.2
      have hprod := hnLarge.2
      rw [skeletonCofactorProduct_of_mem hnLarge.1] at hprod
      simpa [T, providerT, skeletonT, restrictSkeleton, restrictFinsetIndex] using hprod

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_square_add_canonicalSmall_add_large

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonSquareSet_card_cast_le_majorant
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonSquareSet_card_cast_le_majorant
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    ((offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) ≤
      nonsquareSkeletonMajorant x y

    (offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt)

    (hh.trans_le hhy) hh hhy hxy

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothShiftedSet_eq_empty_of_size_lt_cutoff
statement:
theorem nonsmoothShiftedSet_eq_empty_of_size_lt_cutoff
    {x h y : ℕ} (hxy : x < y) :
    nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro n hn
  have hnData := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp hn
  have hpgt : 1 < largestPrimeFactor n.totient := by omega
  have hpdvd : largestPrimeFactor n.totient ∣ n.totient :=
    largestPrimeFactor_dvd hpgt
  have hphiPos : 0 < n.totient :=
    Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hnData.1)
  have hple : largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ n.totient :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd hphiPos hpdvd
  have hphin : n.totient ≤ n := Nat.totient_le n
  omega

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonSquareSet_eq_empty_of_size_lt_cutoff
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonSquareSet_eq_empty_of_size_lt_cutoff
    {x h y : ℕ} (hxy : x < y) :
    offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro n hn
  have hnonsmooth := (mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet.mp
    (mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet.mp hn).1).1
  rw [nonsmoothShiftedSet_eq_empty_of_size_lt_cutoff hxy] at hnonsmooth
  exact Finset.notMem_empty n hnonsmooth

name: RankAmplification.nonsquareSkeletonMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem nonsquareSkeletonMajorant_nonneg (x y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ nonsquareSkeletonMajorant x y
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (x / y : ℕ) := by
    cases hq : x / y with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ q =>
        exact Real.log_nonneg (by
          exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le q)))
  unfold nonsquareSkeletonMajorant
  apply add_nonneg
  · positivity
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro p _hp
    unfold smoothProviderPairMajorant
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro k _hk
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.nonSquareTransferHypothesis_canonical
statement:
theorem nonSquareTransferHypothesis_canonical :
    NonSquareTransferHypothesis (fun x _h y ↦ nonsquareSkeletonMajorant x y)
proof:
:= by
  intro x h y hh hhy _hy
  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
  · exact offDiagonalNonSquareSet_card_cast_le_majorant hh hhy hxy
  · have hempty : offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt = ∅ :=
      offDiagonalNonSquareSet_eq_empty_of_size_lt_cutoff (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hxy)
    rw [hempty]
    simpa using nonsquareSkeletonMajorant_nonneg x y

name: RankAmplification.theorem1_6_exact_finite
statement:
theorem theorem1_6_exact_finite {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hhy : h ≤ y) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +

    nonSquareTransferHypothesis_canonical hodd hhy hy

name: RankAmplification.theorem1_6_exact_finite_expanded
statement:
theorem theorem1_6_exact_finite_expanded {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hhy : h ≤ y) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
            smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)

name: RankAmplification.theorem1_6_of_outerSmoothPairEstimate
statement:
theorem theorem1_6_of_outerSmoothPairEstimate
    {F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hF : OuterSmoothPairEstimate F)
    {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) + F x y

  unfold nonsquareSkeletonMajorant
  linarith [hF x y hy hxy]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.mem_affineCarrierOfFinite
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_affineCarrierOfFinite (S : Finset ℕ) (h u v : ℕ)
    [Finite (AffineSolution S h)] :
    (u, v) ∈ affineCarrierOfFinite S h ↔
      IsSUnitAffineSolution S h u v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (AffineSolution S h)
  constructor
  · intro huv
    obtain ⟨z, _hz, hz⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp huv
    have hzVal : z.1 = (u, v) := hz
    simpa only [hzVal] using z.2
  · intro huv
    let z : AffineSolution S h := ⟨(u, v), huv⟩
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨z, Finset.mem_univ z, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierOfFinite

theorem isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierOfFinite

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.finite_affineSolution_of_carrier
statement:
theorem finite_affineSolution_of_carrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {h : ℕ} {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier S h U) :
    Finite (AffineSolution S h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let target := {z : ℕ × ℕ // z ∈ U}
  let f : AffineSolution S h → target := fun z ↦
    ⟨z.1, (hU z.1.1 z.1.2).mpr z.2⟩
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro z w hzw
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun q : target ↦ q.1) hzw

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_iff_finite
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_iff_finite (h : ℕ) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h ↔
      Finite (AffineSolution (primeSupport h) h)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hU⟩
    exact finite_affineSolution_of_carrier hU
  · intro hfinite
    letI : Finite (AffineSolution (primeSupport h) h) := hfinite
    exact ⟨affineCarrierOfFinite (primeSupport h) h,
      isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierOfFinite (primeSupport h) h⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.isSUnitAffineCarrier_boundedAffineCarrier
statement:
theorem isSUnitAffineCarrier_boundedAffineCarrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {h B : ℕ} (hB : AffineSolutionHeightBound S h B) :
    IsSUnitAffineCarrier S h (boundedAffineCarrier S h B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro u v
  rw [boundedAffineCarrier, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · exact fun huv ↦ huv.2
  · intro huv
    have hbounds := hB u v huv
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)⟩, huv⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_heightBound
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_heightBound
    {h B : ℕ}
    (hB : AffineSolutionHeightBound (primeSupport h) h B) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h
proof:
:=
  ⟨boundedAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h B,
    isSUnitAffineCarrier_boundedAffineCarrier hB⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.affineSolutionHeightBound_of_carrier
statement:
theorem affineSolutionHeightBound_of_carrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {h : ℕ} {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier S h U) :
    AffineSolutionHeightBound S h (affineCarrierHeight U)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have huvMem : (u, v) ∈ U := (hU u v).mpr huv
  have hterm : u + v ≤ affineCarrierHeight U := by
    unfold affineCarrierHeight
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun z _hz ↦ Nat.zero_le (z.1 + z.2)) huvMem
  omega

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_iff_heightBound
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_iff_heightBound (h : ℕ) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h ↔
      ∃ B, AffineSolutionHeightBound (primeSupport h) h B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hU⟩
    exact ⟨affineCarrierHeight U, affineSolutionHeightBound_of_carrier hU⟩
  · rintro ⟨B, hB⟩
    exact terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_heightBound hB

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.isPrimeSupportUnit_empty_iff
statement:
theorem isPrimeSupportUnit_empty_iff {n : ℕ} :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit ∅ n ↔ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hnPos, hnSupport⟩
    have hempty : primeSupport n = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
      intro p hp
      exact Finset.notMem_empty p (hnSupport hp)
    rcases Nat.primeFactors_eq_empty.mp hempty with hn | hn
    · omega
    · exact hn
  · rintro rfl
    simp [IsPrimeSupportUnit]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.isSUnitAffineCarrier_zero
statement:
theorem isSUnitAffineCarrier_zero :
    IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport 0) 0 {(1, 1)}
proof:

  simp [IsSUnitAffineSolution, isPrimeSupportUnit_empty_iff]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_zero

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.mem_primitiveSUnitAffineCarrier
statement:
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem mem_primitiveSUnitAffineCarrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineCarrier S c U) {a b : ℕ} :
    (a, b) ∈ U ↔ IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineSolution S c a b
proof:
:=
  hU a b

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.mem_primitiveAffineCarrierOfFinite
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primitiveAffineCarrierOfFinite (S : Finset ℕ) (c a b : ℕ)
    [Finite (PrimitiveAffineSolution S c)] :
    (a, b) ∈ primitiveAffineCarrierOfFinite S c ↔
      IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineSolution S c a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (PrimitiveAffineSolution S c)
  constructor
  · intro hab
    obtain ⟨z, _hz, hz⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hab
    have hzVal : z.1 = (a, b) := hz
    simpa only [hzVal] using z.2
  · intro hab
    let z : PrimitiveAffineSolution S c := ⟨(a, b), hab⟩
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨z, Finset.mem_univ z, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.isPrimitiveSUnitAffineCarrier_of_finite
statement:
theorem isPrimitiveSUnitAffineCarrier_of_finite
    (S : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ) [Finite (PrimitiveAffineSolution S c)] :
    IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineCarrier S c
      (primitiveAffineCarrierOfFinite S c)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  exact mem_primitiveAffineCarrierOfFinite S c a b

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.finite_primitiveAffineSolution_of_carrier
statement:
theorem finite_primitiveAffineSolution_of_carrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineCarrier S c U) :
    Finite (PrimitiveAffineSolution S c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let target := {z : ℕ × ℕ // z ∈ U}
  let f : PrimitiveAffineSolution S c → target := fun z ↦
    ⟨z.1, (hU z.1.1 z.1.2).mpr z.2⟩
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro z w hzw
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun q : target ↦ q.1) hzw

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.normalizedSUnitA_isPrimeSupportUnit_of_affine
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitA_isPrimeSupportUnit_of_affine
    {S : Finset ℕ} {h u v : ℕ}
    (hsol : IsSUnitAffineSolution S h u v) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit S (normalizedSUnitA h u)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨normalizedSUnitA_pos hsol.1.pos, ?_⟩
  exact (Nat.primeFactors_mono (normalizedSUnitA_dvd_left h u)
    hsol.1.ne_zero).trans hsol.1.2

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.normalizedSUnitB_isPrimeSupportUnit_of_affine
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitB_isPrimeSupportUnit_of_affine
    {S : Finset ℕ} {h u v : ℕ}
    (hsol : IsSUnitAffineSolution S h u v) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit S (normalizedSUnitB h u)
proof:
:= by
  have hvEq : v = u + h := hsol.2.2.symm
  subst v
  refine ⟨normalizedSUnitB_pos hsol.1.pos, ?_⟩
  exact (Nat.primeFactors_mono (normalizedSUnitB_dvd_right h u)
    hsol.2.1.ne_zero).trans hsol.2.1.2

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.normalized_isPrimitiveSUnitAffineSolution
statement:
theorem normalized_isPrimitiveSUnitAffineSolution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {h u v : ℕ}
    (hsol : IsSUnitAffineSolution S h u v) :
    IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineSolution S (normalizedSUnitC h u)
      (normalizedSUnitA h u) (normalizedSUnitB h u)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨normalizedSUnitA_isPrimeSupportUnit_of_affine hsol,
    normalizedSUnitB_isPrimeSupportUnit_of_affine hsol,
    normalizedSUnit_coprime hsol.1.pos, normalizedSUnit_affine hsol.1.pos⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.IsPrimeSupportUnit.mul
statement:
theorem IsPrimeSupportUnit.mul
    {S : Finset ℕ} {m n : ℕ}
    (hm : IsPrimeSupportUnit S m) (hn : IsPrimeSupportUnit S n) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit S (m * n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Nat.mul_pos hm.pos hn.pos, ?_⟩
  change (m * n).primeFactors ⊆ S
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul hm.ne_zero hn.ne_zero]
  exact Finset.union_subset hm.2 hn.2

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.diagonalGCD_mem_shift_divisors
statement:
theorem diagonalGCD_mem_shift_divisors {h u : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    diagonalGCD h u ∈ h.divisors
proof:
:=
  Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨diagonalGCD_dvd_shift h u, hh.ne'⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalPrimitiveDivisorSUnitFiniteness_iff_finiteTypes
statement:
theorem terminalPrimitiveDivisorSUnitFiniteness_iff_finiteTypes (h : ℕ) :
    TerminalPrimitiveDivisorSUnitFiniteness h ↔
      TerminalPrimitiveDivisorFiniteTypes h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩ g hg
    exact finite_primitiveAffineSolution_of_carrier (hF g hg)
  · intro hfinite
    classical
    have hExists : ∀ g, ∃ U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ),
        g ∈ h.divisors →
          IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) (h / g) U := by
      intro g
      by_cases hg : g ∈ h.divisors
      · letI : Finite
            (PrimitiveAffineSolution (primeSupport h) (h / g)) :=
          hfinite g hg
        exact ⟨primitiveAffineCarrierOfFinite (primeSupport h) (h / g),
          fun _hg ↦ isPrimitiveSUnitAffineCarrier_of_finite
            (primeSupport h) (h / g)⟩
      · exact ⟨∅, fun hg' ↦ (hg hg').elim⟩
    choose F hF using hExists
    exact ⟨F, fun g hg ↦ hF g hg⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.divisor_isPrimeSupportUnit
statement:
theorem divisor_isPrimeSupportUnit
    {h g : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hg : g ∈ h.divisors) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit (primeSupport h) g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hg, ?_⟩
  exact Nat.primeFactors_mono (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hg) hh.ne'

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.primitive_reconstruction_isSUnitAffineSolution
statement:
theorem primitive_reconstruction_isSUnitAffineSolution
    {h g a b : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hg : g ∈ h.divisors)
    (hab : IsPrimitiveSUnitAffineSolution (primeSupport h) (h / g) a b) :
    IsSUnitAffineSolution (primeSupport h) h (g * a) (g * b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hab with ⟨ha, hb, _hcop, hab⟩
  have hgUnit := divisor_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hg
  refine ⟨IsPrimeSupportUnit.mul hgUnit ha,
    IsPrimeSupportUnit.mul hgUnit hb, ?_⟩
  have hgDvd : g ∣ h := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hg
  calc
    g * a + h = g * a + g * (h / g) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' hgDvd]
    _ = g * (a + h / g) := by ring
    _ = g * b := by rw [hab]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalPrimitiveDivisorFiniteTypes_of_terminalEvertse
statement:
theorem terminalPrimitiveDivisorFiniteTypes_of_terminalEvertse
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hE : TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h) :
    TerminalPrimitiveDivisorFiniteTypes h
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite : Finite (AffineSolution (primeSupport h) h) :=
    (terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_iff_finite h).mp hE
  intro g hg
  let f : PrimitiveAffineSolution (primeSupport h) (h / g) →
      AffineSolution (primeSupport h) h := fun z ↦
    ⟨(g * z.1.1, g * z.1.2),
      primitive_reconstruction_isSUnitAffineSolution hh hg z.2⟩
  letI : Finite (AffineSolution (primeSupport h) h) := hfinite
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro z w hzw
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hg)
    exact congrArg (fun q : AffineSolution (primeSupport h) h ↦ q.1.1) hzw
  · apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hg)
    exact congrArg (fun q : AffineSolution (primeSupport h) h ↦ q.1.2) hzw

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierFromPrimitive
statement:
theorem isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierFromPrimitive
    {S : Finset ℕ} {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    {F : ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hF : IsPrimitiveDivisorCarrierFamily S h F) :
    IsSUnitAffineCarrier S h (affineCarrierFromPrimitive S h F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro u v
  constructor
  · intro huv
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp huv).2
  · intro hsol
    rw [affineCarrierFromPrimitive, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, hsol⟩
    let g := diagonalGCD h u
    have hgMem : g ∈ h.divisors := diagonalGCD_mem_shift_divisors hh
    have hprimitive := normalized_isPrimitiveSUnitAffineSolution hsol
    have hnormalizedMem :
        (normalizedSUnitA h u, normalizedSUnitB h u) ∈ F g := by
      apply (hF g hgMem _ _).mpr
      simpa only [g, normalizedSUnitC] using hprimitive
    rw [primitiveReconstruction]
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨g, hgMem, Finset.mem_image.mpr ?_⟩
    refine ⟨(normalizedSUnitA h u, normalizedSUnitB h u),
      hnormalizedMem, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitA h u
    · exact (diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitB h u).trans hsol.2.2

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitiveDivisors
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitiveDivisors
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hprimitive : TerminalPrimitiveDivisorSUnitFiniteness h) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hprimitive
  exact ⟨affineCarrierFromPrimitive (primeSupport h) h F,
    isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierFromPrimitive hh hF⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitiveFiniteTypes
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitiveFiniteTypes
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfinite : TerminalPrimitiveDivisorFiniteTypes h) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h
proof:
:=
  terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitiveDivisors hh
    ((terminalPrimitiveDivisorSUnitFiniteness_iff_finiteTypes h).mpr hfinite)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_iff_primitiveFiniteTypes
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_iff_primitiveFiniteTypes
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h ↔
      TerminalPrimitiveDivisorFiniteTypes h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact terminalPrimitiveDivisorFiniteTypes_of_terminalEvertse hh
  · exact terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitiveFiniteTypes hh

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_quantitative
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_quantitative
    {h : ℕ} (hquant : TerminalQuantitativeSUnitBound h) :

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_quantitative
statement:
theorem terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_quantitative
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hquant : TerminalQuantitativeSUnitBound h) :
    TerminalPPTSameSupportBound h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hcard⟩ := hquant
  refine ⟨sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit h U,
    isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit hh hU, ?_⟩
  exact (card_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit_le h U).trans hcard

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.card_primitiveReconstruction_le
statement:
theorem card_primitiveReconstruction_le
    (h : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    (primitiveReconstruction h F).card ≤ primitiveFamilyCardSum h F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold primitiveReconstruction primitiveFamilyCardSum
  calc
    (h.divisors.biUnion fun g ↦
        (F g).image fun z ↦ (g * z.1, g * z.2)).card ≤
        h.divisors.sum fun g ↦
          ((F g).image fun z ↦ (g * z.1, g * z.2)).card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ h.divisors.sum fun g ↦ (F g).card := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro g _hg
      exact Finset.card_image_le

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.card_affineCarrierFromPrimitive_le
statement:
theorem card_affineCarrierFromPrimitive_le
    (S : Finset ℕ) (h : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    (affineCarrierFromPrimitive S h F).card ≤ primitiveFamilyCardSum h F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (card_primitiveReconstruction_le h F)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalQuantitativeSUnitBound_of_primitivePPT
statement:
theorem terminalQuantitativeSUnitBound_of_primitivePPT
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hPPT : TerminalPrimitiveDivisorPPTBound h) :
    TerminalQuantitativeSUnitBound h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hcard⟩ := hPPT
  refine ⟨affineCarrierFromPrimitive (primeSupport h) h F,
    isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierFromPrimitive hh hF, ?_⟩
  exact (card_affineCarrierFromPrimitive_le (primeSupport h) h F).trans hcard

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitivePPT
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitivePPT
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hPPT : TerminalPrimitiveDivisorPPTBound h) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, _hcard⟩ := hPPT
  exact terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_primitiveDivisors hh ⟨F, hF⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitTerminal.terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_primitivePPT
statement:
theorem terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_primitivePPT
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hPPT : TerminalPrimitiveDivisorPPTBound h) :
    TerminalPPTSameSupportBound h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hcard⟩ := hPPT
  let U := affineCarrierFromPrimitive (primeSupport h) h F
  have hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h U :=
    isSUnitAffineCarrier_affineCarrierFromPrimitive hh hF
  refine ⟨sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit h U,
    isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit hh hU, ?_⟩
  exact (card_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit_le h U).trans
    ((card_affineCarrierFromPrimitive_le (primeSupport h) h F).trans hcard)

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount

theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount (x h y : ℕ) :

    (nonsmoothShiftedCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount x h y)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_theorem1_1_two_sided
statement:
theorem fixedRank_theorem1_1_two_sided {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x →
      |(shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) -
          (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ)| ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankClosedError J) x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [fixedRank_theorem10_14_unconditional hJ] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hupper := hx h hh hhy
  have hlower : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) ≤
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount x h
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
  have hnonneg := fixedRankExponentialMajorant_nonneg J (fixedRankClosedError J) x
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RankAmplification.moving_theorem10_25_two_sided
statement:
theorem moving_theorem10_25_two_sided :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ movingNatY x →
      |(shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) -
          (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ)| ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant
          (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
            movingClosedTransferError) x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [moving_theorem10_25_unconditional] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hupper := hx h hh hhy
  have hlower : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) ≤
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount x h (movingNatZ x)
  have hnonneg := movingExponentialMajorant_nonneg
    (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
      movingClosedTransferError) x
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingCombinedError_closed_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingCombinedError_closed_zero :
    Tendsto (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
      movingClosedTransferError) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_movingCombinedError_zero
    movingLowRankCompressionHypothesis_unconditional.1
    movingClosedSupplierMassTailHypothesis.1
    tendsto_movingClosedTransferError_zero

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleV_mul_log_scaleV_div_scaleG_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_scaleV_mul_log_scaleV_div_scaleG_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ scaleV x * Real.log (scaleV x) / scaleG x) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hlogA : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.log (scaleA x) / scaleA x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp tendsto_scaleA_atTop
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h
  have hneg : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ -(2⁻¹ * (Real.log (scaleA x) / scaleA x)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (hlogA.const_mul (2⁻¹ : ℝ)).neg
  have hmain : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦
      2⁻¹ * (log2 x / scaleA x) + -(2⁻¹ * (Real.log (scaleA x) / scaleA x))) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_log2_div_scaleA_atTop.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)).atTop_add hneg
  apply hmain.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
  have hratio := scaleV_div_scaleG_eq_inv_scaleA hL hA
  have hlog := two_mul_log_scaleV hL hA
  have hrw : scaleV x * Real.log (scaleV x) / scaleG x
      = (scaleA x)⁻¹ * Real.log (scaleV x) := by
    rw [← hratio]; ring
  have hlogV : Real.log (scaleV x) = (log2 x - Real.log (scaleA x)) / 2 := by linarith
  rw [hrw, hlogV]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.mem_totientChainSet_three_one
statement:
theorem mem_totientChainSet_three_one {x n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ totientChainSet x 3 1 ↔
      1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ x ∧ n.totient = (n + 1).totient ∧ n.totient = (n + 2).totient
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_totientChainSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlow, hhigh, hchain⟩
    exact ⟨hlow, hhigh, by simpa using hchain 1 (by norm_num),
      by simpa using hchain 2 (by norm_num)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hlow, hhigh, hone, htwo⟩
    refine ⟨hlow, hhigh, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    interval_cases k
    · simp
    · simpa using hone
    · simpa using htwo

name: RankAmplification.chain_three_consecutive_bound
statement:
theorem chain_three_consecutive_bound :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (totientChainCount x 3 1 : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) + fixedRankClosedError 2 x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (0 : ℕ) < 2 := by norm_num
  filter_upwards [fixedRank_chain_odd_unconditional hQ (r := 3) (by norm_num),
    eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY 2 hQ] with x hx hY
  have hchain := hx 1 le_rfl (by omega) odd_one
  have hmaj : fixedRankExponentialMajorant 2 (fixedRankClosedError 2) x
      = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-Real.sqrt 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) + fixedRankClosedError 2 x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant
    norm_num
  rw [hmaj] at hchain
  exact hchain

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_chain_three_consecutive_error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_chain_three_consecutive_error_zero :
    Tendsto (fixedRankClosedError 2) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_fixedRankClosedError_zero (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.one_le_log_of_exp_one_le
statement:
theorem one_le_log_of_exp_one_le {u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) :
    1 ≤ Real.log u
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hu
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using h

name: RankAmplification.le_log_of_exp_le
statement:
theorem le_log_of_exp_le {a u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp a ≤ u) :
    a ≤ Real.log u
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos a) hu
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using h

name: RankAmplification.log_log_nonneg_of_exp_one_le
statement:
theorem log_log_nonneg_of_exp_one_le {u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) :
    0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u)
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.log_nonneg (one_le_log_of_exp_one_le hu)

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddlePhase_nonneg
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddlePhase_nonneg {u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) :
    0 ≤ dickmanSaddlePhase u
proof:
:= by
  unfold dickmanSaddlePhase
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := (Real.exp_pos 1).le.trans hu
  have hlog := one_le_log_of_exp_one_le hu
  have hloglog := log_log_nonneg_of_exp_one_le hu
  have hbracket : 0 ≤ Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1 := by
    linarith
  exact mul_nonneg hu0 hbracket

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddleDensity_pos
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddleDensity_pos (u : ℝ) :
    0 < dickmanSaddleDensity u
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.exp_pos _

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_pos
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_pos (C u : ℝ) :
    0 < dickmanSaddleUpperDensity C u
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.exp_pos _

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddleDensity_le_one
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddleDensity_le_one {u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) :
    dickmanSaddleDensity u ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [dickmanSaddleDensity, ← Real.exp_zero]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr (dickmanSaddlePhase_nonneg hu))

name: RankAmplification.dickmanLogErrorScale_nonneg
statement:
theorem dickmanLogErrorScale_nonneg {u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) :
    0 ≤ dickmanLogErrorScale u
proof:
:= by
  unfold dickmanLogErrorScale
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := (Real.exp_pos 1).le.trans hu
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log u := zero_lt_one.trans_le (one_le_log_of_exp_one_le hu)
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hu0 (log_log_nonneg_of_exp_one_le hu)) hlog.le

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddlePhase_strictMonoOn
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddlePhase_strictMonoOn :
    StrictMonoOn dickmanSaddlePhase (Set.Ici (Real.exp 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv huv
  have huPos : 0 < u := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans_le hu
  have hvPos : 0 < v := huPos.trans huv
  have hlogu : 1 ≤ Real.log u := one_le_log_of_exp_one_le hu
  have hlogv : 1 ≤ Real.log v := one_le_log_of_exp_one_le hv
  have hloguv : Real.log u < Real.log v := Real.strictMonoOn_log huPos hvPos huv
  have hlogloguv : Real.log (Real.log u) < Real.log (Real.log v) :=
    Real.strictMonoOn_log (zero_lt_one.trans_le hlogu)
      (zero_lt_one.trans_le hlogv) hloguv
  have hbracketU : 0 ≤ Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1 := by
    have := log_log_nonneg_of_exp_one_le hu
    linarith
  have hbracketV : 0 < Real.log v + Real.log (Real.log v) - 1 := by
    linarith
  have hbracket : Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1 <
      Real.log v + Real.log (Real.log v) - 1 := by
    linarith
  unfold dickmanSaddlePhase
  exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hbracket huPos).trans
    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right huv hbracketV)

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddleDensity_strictAntiOn
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddleDensity_strictAntiOn :
    StrictAntiOn dickmanSaddleDensity (Set.Ici (Real.exp 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv huv
  unfold dickmanSaddleDensity
  exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr <| neg_lt_neg <|
    dickmanSaddlePhase_strictMonoOn hu hv huv

name: RankAmplification.log_dickmanSaddleDensity
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_dickmanSaddleDensity (u : ℝ) :
    Real.log (dickmanSaddleDensity u) =
      -u * (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dickmanSaddleDensity, Real.log_exp, dickmanSaddlePhase]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.log_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity (C u : ℝ) :
    Real.log (dickmanSaddleUpperDensity C u) =
      -u * (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1) +
        C * (u * Real.log (Real.log u) / Real.log u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dickmanSaddleUpperDensity, Real.log_exp, dickmanSaddlePhase,
    dickmanLogErrorScale]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.log_dickmanSaddleDensity_error_bound
statement:
theorem log_dickmanSaddleDensity_error_bound {C u : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) :
    |Real.log (dickmanSaddleDensity u) +
        u * (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1)| ≤
      C * (u * Real.log (Real.log u) / Real.log u)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Real.log (dickmanSaddleDensity u) +
      u * (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1) = 0 := by
    rw [log_dickmanSaddleDensity]
    ring
  rw [hzero, abs_zero]
  have herr := dickmanLogErrorScale_nonneg hu
  unfold dickmanLogErrorScale at herr
  exact mul_nonneg hC herr

name: RankAmplification.log_dickmanSaddleDensity_two_sided
statement:
theorem log_dickmanSaddleDensity_two_sided {C u : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) :
    -dickmanSaddlePhase u - C * dickmanLogErrorScale u ≤
        Real.log (dickmanSaddleDensity u) ∧
      Real.log (dickmanSaddleDensity u) ≤
        -dickmanSaddlePhase u + C * dickmanLogErrorScale u
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_dickmanSaddleDensity, dickmanSaddlePhase]
  have herr := dickmanLogErrorScale_nonneg hu
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.log_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_sub_main
statement:
theorem log_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_sub_main (C u : ℝ) :
    Real.log (dickmanSaddleUpperDensity C u) + dickmanSaddlePhase u =
      C * dickmanLogErrorScale u
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity, dickmanSaddlePhase, dickmanLogErrorScale]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.self_le_dickmanSaddlePhase
statement:
theorem self_le_dickmanSaddlePhase {u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 2 ≤ u) :
    u ≤ dickmanSaddlePhase u
proof:
:= by
  have hu1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ u :=
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).trans hu
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := (Real.exp_pos 2).le.trans hu
  have hlog : 2 ≤ Real.log u := le_log_of_exp_le hu
  have hloglog : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) :=
    log_log_nonneg_of_exp_one_le hu1
  have hbracket : 1 ≤ Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1 := by
    linarith
  unfold dickmanSaddlePhase
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddleDensity_le_exp_neg
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddleDensity_le_exp_neg {u : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 2 ≤ u) :
    dickmanSaddleDensity u ≤ Real.exp (-u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dickmanSaddleDensity]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg (self_le_dickmanSaddlePhase hu))

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_dickmanSaddleDensity_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_dickmanSaddleDensity_atTop :
    Tendsto dickmanSaddleDensity atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine squeeze_zero'
    (Eventually.of_forall fun u ↦ (dickmanSaddleDensity_pos u).le) ?_
    Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 2)] with u hu
  exact dickmanSaddleDensity_le_exp_neg hu

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddleUpperExponent_le_neg_half
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddleUpperExponent_le_neg_half
    {C u : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hu : Real.exp (max 2 (4 * C)) ≤ u) :
    -dickmanSaddlePhase u + C * dickmanLogErrorScale u ≤ -u / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := (Real.exp_pos (max 2 (4 * C))).le.trans hu
  have hlogMax : max 2 (4 * C) ≤ Real.log u := le_log_of_exp_le hu
  have hlogTwo : 2 ≤ Real.log u := (le_max_left _ _).trans hlogMax
  have hlogC : 4 * C ≤ Real.log u := (le_max_right _ _).trans hlogMax
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log u := by linarith
  have hloglog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hloglog_le : Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ Real.log u :=
    Real.log_le_self hlogPos.le
  have hratio0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) / Real.log u :=
    div_nonneg hloglog0 hlogPos.le
  have hratio1 : Real.log (Real.log u) / Real.log u ≤ 1 :=
    (div_le_one hlogPos).2 hloglog_le
  have hscale : dickmanLogErrorScale u ≤ u := by
    rw [dickmanLogErrorScale]
    calc
      u * Real.log (Real.log u) / Real.log u =
          u * (Real.log (Real.log u) / Real.log u) := by ring
      _ ≤ u * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio1 hu0
      _ = u := by ring
  have hcorrection : C * dickmanLogErrorScale u ≤ u * Real.log u / 4 := by
    calc
      C * dickmanLogErrorScale u ≤ C * u :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hC
      _ ≤ (Real.log u / 4) * u := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hu0
      _ = u * Real.log u / 4 := by ring
  have hphase : u * Real.log u / 2 ≤ dickmanSaddlePhase u := by
    have hbracket : Real.log u / 2 ≤
        Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 1 := by
      linarith
    unfold dickmanSaddlePhase
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hu0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hbracket)]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hu0 hlogPos.le]

name: RankAmplification.dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_le_exp_neg_half
statement:
theorem dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_le_exp_neg_half
    {C u : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hu : Real.exp (max 2 (4 * C)) ≤ u) :
    dickmanSaddleUpperDensity C u ≤ Real.exp (-u / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dickmanSaddleUpperDensity]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (dickmanSaddleUpperExponent_le_neg_half hC hu)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_atTop {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    Tendsto (dickmanSaddleUpperDensity C) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine squeeze_zero' (g := fun u : ℝ ↦ Real.exp ((-1 / 2) * u))
    (Eventually.of_forall fun u ↦ (dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_pos C u).le) ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp (max 2 (4 * C)))] with u hu
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
      dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_le_exp_neg_half hC hu
  · have hlinear : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ ↦ (-1 / 2) * u) atTop atBot :=
      tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (by norm_num)
    exact Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp hlinear

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity_pos
statement:
theorem hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity_pos (C : ℝ) (H₀ R H : ℕ) :

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandOrTrivial
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandOrTrivial
    {C : ℝ} {H₀ R H : ℕ} (hHildebrand : HasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound C H₀) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      H * hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity C H₀ R H
proof:

  · rw [hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity, if_pos hrange]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity_pos
statement:
theorem bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity_pos
    (C : ℝ) (H₀ X Y base K : ℕ) :
    0 < bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity C H₀ X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity_pos C H₀
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X)
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦
      (hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity_pos C H₀
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
        (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)).le)

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandTerminalDensity_le_uniform
statement:
theorem hildebrandTerminalDensity_le_uniform
    (C : ℝ) (H₀ X Y base K : ℕ) :
    hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity C H₀ (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X ≤
      bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity C H₀ X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right <| Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦
    (hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity_pos C H₀
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
      (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)).le

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandShellDensity_le_uniform
statement:
theorem hildebrandShellDensity_le_uniform
    (C : ℝ) (H₀ X Y base K i : ℕ) (hi : i < K) :
    hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity C H₀ (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
        (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i) ≤
      bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity C H₀ X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity
  have hsingle :
      hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity C H₀ (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K,
          hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity C H₀ (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base j)
            (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base j) := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j _ ↦ (hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity_pos C H₀
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base j)
        (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base j)).le)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)
  exact hsingle.trans <| le_add_of_nonneg_left
    (hildebrandOrTrivialSmoothDensity_pos C H₀
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X).le

name: RankAmplification.hasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity_of_uniformHildebrand
statement:
theorem hasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity_of_uniformHildebrand
    {C : ℝ} {H₀ : ℕ} (hHildebrand : HasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound C H₀) :
    HasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity
      (bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity C H₀)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y base K _hbase _hK
  refine ⟨(bfpsHildebrandSaddleUniformDensity_pos C H₀ X Y base K).le, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandOrTrivial
      (R := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) (H := X) hHildebrand).trans <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (hildebrandTerminalDensity_le_uniform C H₀ X Y base K) (by positivity)
  · intro i hi
    exact (finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandOrTrivial
      (R := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
      (H := bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i) hHildebrand).trans <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (hildebrandShellDensity_le_uniform C H₀ X Y base K i hi) (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_of_uniformHildebrand
statement:
theorem hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_of_uniformHildebrand
    {C : ℝ} {H₀ : ℕ} (hHildebrand : HasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound C H₀) :

      (bfpsHildebrandSaddleGeometricBound C H₀)

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_of_uniformHildebrand
statement:

    {X Y : ℕ} (parameters : BFPSFiniteParameters X Y)
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData) {C : ℝ} {H₀ : ℕ}

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_of_uniformHildebrand
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_of_uniformHildebrand
    {X Y : ℕ} (parameters : BFPSFiniteParameters X Y)
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData) {C : ℝ} {H₀ : ℕ}
    (hHildebrand : HasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound C H₀) :

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_cast_le_of_uniformHildebrand
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_cast_le_of_uniformHildebrand
    {X Y : ℕ} (parameters : BFPSFiniteParameters X Y)
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData) {C : ℝ} {H₀ : ℕ}
    (hHildebrand : HasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound C H₀) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (parameters.saddleExponent data C H₀)
proof:

    (X := X) (Y := Y) parameters.X_pos parameters.c₀_pos parameters.c₀_le_c
  have hprime := smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_of_uniformHildebrand
    parameters data hHildebrand
  unfold BFPSFiniteParameters.saddleExponent
  exact hbase.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr <| add_le_add_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
        (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos parameters.c₀_pos).le) _)

name: RankAmplification.movingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis_of_uniformHildebrand
statement:
theorem movingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis_of_uniformHildebrand
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData)
    (parameters : BFPSMovingParameterChoice movingNatY)
    {C : ℝ} {H₀ : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hHildebrand : HasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound C H₀)
    (hdominance : MovingBFPSSaddleLemma27iiExponentDominance
      data parameters C H₀ ε) :
    MovingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis ε
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hdominance.1, ?_⟩
  have hxpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < x :=
    Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun x hx ↦ by omega⟩
  filter_upwards [hdominance.2, hxpos, eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with
      x hxdom hx hnatural
  intro W hW hWx
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_cast_le_of_uniformHildebrand
    (parameters x W ((Nat.sqrt_pos.2 hx).trans_le hW) hnatural.three_le_y)
    data hHildebrand
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hxdom hx hnatural.three_le_y W hW hWx)) (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.mem_smoothFactorPairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_smoothFactorPairSet {R X k₁ k₂ : ℕ} :
    (k₁, k₂) ∈ smoothFactorPairSet R X ↔
      1 ≤ k₁ ∧ 1 ≤ k₂ ∧ k₁ * k₂ ≤ X ∧ IsSmooth R (k₁ * k₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [smoothFactorPairSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.smoothFactorPairSet_product_mapsTo
statement:
theorem smoothFactorPairSet_product_mapsTo (R X : ℕ) :
    ((smoothFactorPairSet R X : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) : Set (ℕ × ℕ)).MapsTo
      (fun k ↦ k.1 * k.2) (finiteSmoothSet R X : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨hk₁, hk₂, hkX, hsmooth⟩ := mem_smoothFactorPairSet.mp hk
  exact mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr ⟨Nat.mul_pos hk₁ hk₂, hkX, hsmooth⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothFactorPair_fiber_card_eq_divisors
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := (smoothFactorPairSet R X).filter fun k ↦ k.1 * k.2 = m
  have hmData := mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm
  change F.card = m.divisors.card
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun k _ ↦ k.1)
  · intro k hk
    have hk' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hk
    have hprod : k.1 * k.2 = m := hk'.2
    apply Nat.mem_divisors.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hmData.1⟩
    exact ⟨k.2, hprod.symm⟩
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    have ha' := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
    have hb' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
    have haData := mem_smoothFactorPairSet.mp ha'.1
    apply Prod.ext hab
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel haData.1
    calc
      a.1 * a.2 = m := ha'.2
      _ = b.1 * b.2 := hb'.2.symm
      _ = a.1 * b.2 := by rw [hab]
  · intro d hd
    have hdData := Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd
    have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdData.1 hmData.1
    have hdm : d ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd hmData.1 hdData.1
    have hquotpos : 0 < m / d := Nat.div_pos hdm hdpos
    have hprod : d * (m / d) = m := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdData.1
    have hsmoothprod : IsSmooth R (d * (m / d)) := by
      rw [hprod]
      exact hmData.2.2
    refine ⟨(d, m / d), ?_, rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_smoothFactorPairSet.mpr
      ⟨hdpos, hquotpos, hprod.le.trans hmData.2.1, hsmoothprod⟩, hprod⟩

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothFactorPairSet_eq_sum_divisors
statement:
theorem card_smoothFactorPairSet_eq_sum_divisors (R X : ℕ) :
    (smoothFactorPairSet R X).card =
      ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, m.divisors.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (smoothFactorPairSet R X).card =
        ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X,
          ((smoothFactorPairSet R X).filter fun k ↦ k.1 * k.2 = m).card :=
      Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (smoothFactorPairSet_product_mapsTo R X)
    _ = ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, m.divisors.card := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      exact smoothFactorPair_fiber_card_eq_divisors hm

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothFactorPairSet_cast_eq
statement:
theorem card_smoothFactorPairSet_cast_eq (R X : ℕ) :
    ((smoothFactorPairSet R X).card : ℝ) = finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_smoothFactorPairSet_eq_sum_divisors, Nat.cast_sum,
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]

name: RankAmplification.multiplier_product_le_div_sq
statement:
theorem multiplier_product_le_div_sq {p k₁ k₂ X : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hprovider : (k₁ * p + 1) * (k₂ * p + 1) ≤ X) :
    k₁ * k₂ ≤ X / p ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : k₁ * p ≤ k₁ * p + 1 := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hright : k₂ * p ≤ k₂ * p + 1 := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hmul : (k₁ * p) * (k₂ * p) ≤ X :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul hleft hright).trans hprovider
  rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (pow_pos hp 2)]
  calc
    k₁ * k₂ * p ^ 2 = (k₁ * p) * (k₂ * p) := by ring
    _ ≤ X := hmul

name: RankAmplification.card_providerMultiplierFamily_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_providerMultiplierFamily_cast_le {p X : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hS : ∀ k ∈ S,
      1 ≤ k.1 ∧ 1 ≤ k.2 ∧ IsSmooth p (k.1 * k.2) ∧
        (k.1 * p + 1) * (k.2 * p + 1) ≤ X) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (X / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : S ⊆ smoothFactorPairSet p (X / p ^ 2) := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨hk₁, hk₂, hsmooth, hprovider⟩ := hS k hk
    exact mem_smoothFactorPairSet.mpr
      ⟨hk₁, hk₂, multiplier_product_le_div_sq hp hprovider, hsmooth⟩
  have hcard : S.card ≤ (smoothFactorPairSet p (X / p ^ 2)).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  calc
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ ((smoothFactorPairSet p (X / p ^ 2)).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    _ = finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (X / p ^ 2) :=
      card_smoothFactorPairSet_cast_eq _ _

name: RankAmplification.section10RankinAdmissibility_of_le
statement:
theorem section10RankinAdmissibility_of_le {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) (hRH : R ≤ H) :
    Section10RankinAdmissibility H R
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hR
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRone
  refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hR) hRH, hR, ?_⟩
  rw [rankinU, le_div_iff₀ hlogR, one_mul]
  exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by exact_mod_cast hRH)

name: RankAmplification.one_lt_rankinU_of_lt
statement:
theorem one_lt_rankinU_of_lt {H R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hRH : R < H) :
    1 < rankinU H R
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega)
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRone
  rw [rankinU, lt_div_iff₀ hlogR, one_mul]
  exact Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by exact_mod_cast hRH)

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_le_sqrt_of_le_pow
statement:
theorem rankinU_le_sqrt_of_le_pow {H R k : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hk : k * k ≤ R) (hHk : H ≤ R ^ k) :
    rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt (R : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega)
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hcast : (H : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) ^ k := by exact_mod_cast hHk
  have hlogH : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * Real.log (R : ℝ) := by
    have hstep : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((R : ℝ) ^ k) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hH) hcast
    simpa [Real.log_pow] using hstep
  have hu : rankinU H R ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [rankinU, div_le_iff₀ hlogR]
    exact hlogH
  refine hu.trans ?_
  have hksq : ((k : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ (R : ℝ) := by
    have hnat : ((k * k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
    calc ((k : ℝ)) ^ 2 = ((k * k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ (R : ℝ) := hnat
  calc (k : ℝ) = Real.sqrt (((k : ℝ)) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (Nat.cast_nonneg k)).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hksq

name: RankAmplification.fullULogUPrimeError_nonneg
statement:
theorem fullULogUPrimeError_nonneg {H R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU H R)

name: RankAmplification.tauEulerLoss_mono_rank
statement:
theorem tauEulerLoss_mono_rank {i j : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    tauEulerLoss i s ≤ tauEulerLoss j s
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) < 1 :=
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)
  have hden : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by linarith
  unfold tauEulerLoss
  have hnum : (i : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hij
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hden.le

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_finiteUniform
statement:
theorem section10_corollary10_19_finiteUniform {J R H X k : ℕ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hRH : R < H) (hk : k * k ≤ R) (hHk : H ≤ R ^ k) :
    ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ J →
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X ≤
        Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
          tauEulerLoss J (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : 0 < H := lt_trans (by omega) hRH
  have hu : 1 < rankinU H R := one_lt_rankinU_of_lt hR hRH
  have huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) :=
    rankinU_le_sqrt_of_le_pow hR hH hk hHk
  have hRone : 1 < R := by omega
  have hhalf : rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hRone (zero_lt_one.trans hu) huSqrt
  have hs : 0 < 1 - rankinDelta H R := by linarith
  have hErr : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R H := fullULogUPrimeError_nonneg hR hu huSqrt
  intro j hj hjJ
  refine (finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error hj hH hR hu huSqrt).trans ?_
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hmono := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (tauEulerLoss_mono_rank hs hjJ) hErr
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_hasBound

    ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ J →

name: RankAmplification.section10_corollary10_19_finiteMargin

name: RankAmplification.widePowerSlotIndex_injective
statement:
theorem widePowerSlotIndex_injective {J y Y x M : ℕ}
    (hM : globalSlotWidth J y Y x ≤ M) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun z : PowerSourceChoice y Y J × Fin (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1) ↦
        widePowerSlotIndex hM z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  have hval : ((finProdFinEquiv
        (Fintype.equivFin (PowerSourceChoice y Y J) z.1, z.2) : ℕ)) =
      ((finProdFinEquiv
        (Fintype.equivFin (PowerSourceChoice y Y J) w.1, w.2) : ℕ)) := by
    simpa [widePowerSlotIndex] using congrArg Fin.val h
  have hpair := finProdFinEquiv.injective (Fin.ext hval)
  have hfst : Fintype.equivFin (PowerSourceChoice y Y J) z.1 =
      Fintype.equivFin (PowerSourceChoice y Y J) w.1 :=
    congrArg (fun t : Fin (Fintype.card (PowerSourceChoice y Y J)) ×
      Fin (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1) ↦ t.1) hpair
  have hsnd : z.2 = w.2 :=
    congrArg (fun t : Fin (Fintype.card (PowerSourceChoice y Y J)) ×
      Fin (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1) ↦ t.2) hpair
  exact Prod.ext ((Fintype.equivFin (PowerSourceChoice y Y J)).injective hfst) hsnd

name: RankAmplification.widenedEncoding_injective
statement:
theorem widenedEncoding_injective {J y Y x M : ℕ}
    (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hx : 0 < x) (hM : globalSlotWidth J y Y x ≤ M) :
    Function.Injective fun a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x ↦
      (globalNumericalCode hY hx a, widenedCombinatorialCode hY hM a)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have hnum : globalNumericalCode hY hx a = globalNumericalCode hY hx b :=
    congrArg Prod.fst h
  have hcomb : widenedCombinatorialCode hY hM a = widenedCombinatorialCode hY hM b :=
    congrArg Prod.snd h
  have hL : aggregateLinearTuple a = aggregateLinearTuple b := by
    funext i
    exact congrArg Fin.val (congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val hnum) i)
  have htype : ∀ i, (a.labelDescriptor i).sourceType = (b.labelDescriptor i).sourceType := by
    intro i
    exact supplierSourceTypeBit_injective i
      (congrArg (fun c : SlotCombinatorialCode J M ↦ c.2.1 i) hcomb)
  have hslot : ∀ i : Fin J,
      (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i,
          widePowerSlotIndex hM (aggregatePowerTuple a i)
            (aggregateCandidateIndex hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) a i)) =
        (b.2.partition.minBlockCode i,
          widePowerSlotIndex hM (aggregatePowerTuple b i)
            (aggregateCandidateIndex hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) b i)) := by
    intro i
    exact supplierPairSlot_injective
      (congrArg (fun c : SlotCombinatorialCode J M ↦ c.2.2 i) hcomb)
  have hwide : ∀ i : Fin J,
      (aggregatePowerTuple a i,
          aggregateCandidateIndex hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) a i) =
        (aggregatePowerTuple b i,
          aggregateCandidateIndex hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) b i) := by
    intro i
    exact widePowerSlotIndex_injective hM (congrArg Prod.snd (hslot i))
  have hP : aggregatePowerTuple a = aggregatePowerTuple b :=
    funext fun i ↦ congrArg Prod.fst (hwide i)
  have hminBlock : ∀ i : Fin J,
      a.2.partition.minBlockCode i = b.2.partition.minBlockCode i :=
    fun i ↦ congrArg Prod.fst (hslot i)
  have hcand : ∀ i : Fin J,
      aggregateCandidateIndex hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) a i =
        aggregateCandidateIndex hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) b i :=
    fun i ↦ congrArg Prod.snd (hwide i)
  have hcode : aggregateCombinatorialCode hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) a =
      aggregateCombinatorialCode hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) b := by
    unfold aggregateCombinatorialCode aggregateDemandSlot
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
    · exact congrArg
        (fun g : Fin J → SupplierSourceType ↦
          (⟨⟨J, Nat.lt_succ_self J⟩, g⟩ : SourceTypeWord J)) (funext htype)
    · exact funext fun i ↦ congrArg (supplierSourceTypeBit i) (htype i)
    · exact funext fun i ↦ by simp only [hminBlock i, hcand i]
  refine aggregateWeightedCode_injective hY (le_refl (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1)) ?_
  unfold aggregateWeightedCode
  rw [hL, hP, hcode]

    (S.filter fun a ↦ a.2.linearPredecessorProduct = m).card ≤
      slotEncodingFactor J M * orderedDivisorCount J m
proof:

  have hfilter : (S.filter fun a ↦ a.2.linearPredecessorProduct = m) =
      S.filter fun a ↦ (globalSlotReconstruction hY hx hM).key a = m := by

name: RankAmplification.aggregatePredecessorFibre_card_le_paperSlots
statement:
theorem aggregatePredecessorFibre_card_le_paperSlots {J y Y x H M m : ℕ}
    (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hx : 0 < x) (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) :
    Fintype.card (AggregatePredecessorFibreEntry J y Y x H m) ≤
      orderedDivisorCount J m *
        (powerChoiceCount y Y J ^ J * slotEncodingFactor J M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Fintype.card_le_of_injective _
    (aggregatePredecessorFibreCode_injective (J := J) (y := y) (Y := Y) (x := x)
      (H := H) (M := M) (m := m) hY hx hM)).trans ?_
  have hcard : Fintype.card (AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m) =
      Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J (2 * x) m) *
        (powerChoiceCount y Y J ^ J *
          Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M)) := by
    simp [AggregateFibreCode, powerChoiceCount, Fintype.card_prod]
  rw [hcard]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul (positiveProductTuple_card_le_orderedDivisorCount J (2 * x) m)
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (slotCombinatorialCode_card_le J M))

name: RankAmplification.totient_div_eq_of_primeSupport_eq
statement:
theorem totient_div_eq_of_primeSupport_eq {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hsupport : primeSupport a = primeSupport b) :
    (a.totient : ℚ) / a = (b.totient : ℚ) / b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors, Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors]
  rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr ha),
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hb)]
  simpa [primeSupport] using congrArg
    (fun support : Finset ℕ ↦ ∏ p ∈ support, (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹)) hsupport

name: RankAmplification.totient_mul_eq_of_primeSupport_eq
statement:
theorem totient_mul_eq_of_primeSupport_eq {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hsupport : primeSupport a = primeSupport b) :
    a.totient * b = b.totient * a
proof:
:= by
  have hratio := totient_div_eq_of_primeSupport_eq ha hb hsupport
  have hcross : (a.totient : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (b.totient : ℚ) * (a : ℚ) :=
    (div_eq_div_iff (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr ha) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hb)).mp hratio
  apply Nat.cast_injective (R := ℚ)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using hcross

name: RankAmplification.not_isSameSupportIndex_of_odd
statement:
theorem not_isSameSupportIndex_of_odd {h j : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    ¬IsSameSupportIndex h j
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hjpos, hsupport⟩
  have hjne : j ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hjpos
  have hjhne : j + h ≠ 0 := by omega
  have htwo_dvd : 2 ∣ j ↔ 2 ∣ j + h := by
    constructor
    · intro hdvd
      have hmem : 2 ∈ primeSupport j :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_two, hdvd, hjne⟩
      rw [hsupport] at hmem
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
    · intro hdvd
      have hmem : 2 ∈ primeSupport (j + h) :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_two, hdvd, hjhne⟩
      rw [← hsupport] at hmem
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
  have heven : Even j ↔ Even (j + h) := by
    simpa only [even_iff_two_dvd] using htwo_dvd
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd j with hjeven | hjodd
  · have hjsum_even : Even (j + h) := heven.mp hjeven
    have hjodd' : Odd j := (Nat.even_add'.mp hjsum_even).mpr hodd
    exact (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hjeven) hjodd'
  · have hjsum_even : Even (j + h) :=
      Nat.even_add'.mpr ⟨fun _ ↦ hodd, fun _ ↦ hjodd⟩
    exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hjodd) (heven.mpr hjsum_even)

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportIndices_eq_empty_of_odd
statement:
theorem sameSupportIndices_eq_empty_of_odd {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    sameSupportIndices h = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [sameSupportIndices, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  exact not_isSameSupportIndex_of_odd hodd

name: RankAmplification.diagonal_mul_A_eq_mul_B
statement:
theorem diagonal_mul_A_eq_mul_B (h j : ℕ) :
    j * diagonalA h j = (j + h) * diagonalB h j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [diagonalA, diagonalB, diagonalGCD]
  rw [← Nat.mul_div_assoc j (Nat.gcd_dvd_right j (j + h)),
    ← Nat.mul_div_assoc (j + h) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left j (j + h))]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm j (j + h)]

name: RankAmplification.diagonal_affine_shift
statement:
theorem diagonal_affine_shift (h j r : ℕ) :
    j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) + h =
      (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) + h =
        (j * diagonalA h j) * r + (j + h) := by ring
    _ = ((j + h) * diagonalB h j) * r + (j + h) := by
      rw [diagonal_mul_A_eq_mul_B]
    _ = (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGamma_eq_totient_mul_B
statement:
theorem diagonalGamma_eq_totient_mul_B {h j : ℕ} (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    diagonalGamma h j = (j + h).totient * diagonalB h j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hjpos, hsupport⟩ := hsame
  have hjne : j ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hjpos
  have hjhne : j + h ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hcross : j.totient * (j + h) = (j + h).totient * j :=
    totient_mul_eq_of_primeSupport_eq hjne hjhne hsupport
  have hdiv := congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ n / diagonalGCD h j) hcross
  simpa only [diagonalGamma, diagonalA, diagonalB, diagonalGCD,
    Nat.mul_div_assoc j.totient (Nat.gcd_dvd_right j (j + h)),
    Nat.mul_div_assoc (j + h).totient (Nat.gcd_dvd_left j (j + h))] using hdiv

name: RankAmplification.diagonal_left_totient_eq_gamma_mul
statement:
theorem diagonal_left_totient_eq_gamma_mul {h j r : ℕ}
    (hprimeA : Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1))
    (hcoprimeA : Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) j) :
    (j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1)).totient = diagonalGamma h j * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.totient_mul hcoprimeA.symm, Nat.totient_prime hprimeA]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, diagonalGamma]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.diagonal_parametrization_totient_eq
statement:
theorem diagonal_parametrization_totient_eq {h j r : ℕ} (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j)
    (hprimeA : Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1))
    (hprimeB : Nat.Prime (diagonalB h j * r + 1))
    (hcoprimeA : Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) j)
    (hcoprimeB : Nat.Coprime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) (j + h)) :
    (j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1)).totient =
      ((j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1)).totient
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.totient_mul hcoprimeA.symm, Nat.totient_mul hcoprimeB.symm,
    Nat.totient_prime hprimeA, Nat.totient_prime hprimeB]
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  calc
    j.totient * (diagonalA h j * r) =
        (j.totient * diagonalA h j) * r := by ring
    _ = ((j + h).totient * diagonalB h j) * r := by
      rw [← diagonalGamma_eq_totient_mul_B hsame]
      rfl
    _ = (j + h).totient * (diagonalB h j * r) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.IsDiagonalRepresentation.totient_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrep with ⟨hsame, _, hn, hnh, hprimeA, hprimeB, hcoprimeA, hcoprimeB, _⟩
  calc
    n.totient = (j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1)).totient := congrArg Nat.totient hn
    _ = ((j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1)).totient :=
      diagonal_parametrization_totient_eq hsame hprimeA hprimeB hcoprimeA hcoprimeB
    _ = (n + h).totient := (congrArg Nat.totient hnh).symm

name: RankAmplification.IsDiagonalRepresentation.totient_eq_gamma_mul
proof:
:= by
  rcases hrep with ⟨_, _, hn, _, hprimeA, _, hcoprimeA, _, _⟩
  calc
    n.totient = (j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1)).totient := congrArg Nat.totient hn
    _ = diagonalGamma h j * r :=
      diagonal_left_totient_eq_gamma_mul hprimeA hcoprimeA

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet

name: RankAmplification.classical_h_two_family
statement:
theorem classical_h_two_family {t : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime (2 * t + 1))
    (hq : Nat.Prime (4 * t + 1)) :
    (2 * (4 * t + 1)).totient = (2 * (4 * t + 1) + 2).totient
proof:
:= by
  have hoddq : Odd (4 * t + 1) := ⟨2 * t, by omega⟩
  have hoddp : Odd (2 * t + 1) := ⟨t, by omega⟩
  have hcoprimeTwoQ : Nat.Coprime 2 (4 * t + 1) := hoddq.coprime_two_left
  have hcoprimeFourP : Nat.Coprime 4 (2 * t + 1) := by
    rw [show 4 = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Nat.coprime_pow_left_iff (by norm_num)]
    exact hoddp.coprime_two_left
  have hshift : 2 * (4 * t + 1) + 2 = 4 * (2 * t + 1) := by omega
  have htotientFour : Nat.totient 4 = 2 := by decide
  rw [Nat.totient_mul hcoprimeTwoQ, hshift, Nat.totient_mul hcoprimeFourP,
    Nat.totient_two, htotientFour, Nat.totient_prime hq, Nat.totient_prime hp]
  omega

name: RankAmplification.classical_h_two_family_mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedEqualTotientSet, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩, classical_h_two_family hp hq⟩

theorem classical_h_two_family_count_pos {t : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime (2 * t + 1))
    (hq : Nat.Prime (4 * t + 1)) :
    0 < shiftedEqualTotientCount (2 * (4 * t + 1)) 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedEqualTotientCount, Finset.card_pos]
  exact ⟨2 * (4 * t + 1), classical_h_two_family_mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet hp hq⟩

name: RankAmplification.badLocalPrimeSet_subset

    badLocalPrimeSet N y ⊆ primeSupport N
proof:

  exact (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1

name: RankAmplification.goodLocalPrimeSet_subset

name: RankAmplification.badLocalPrimeSet_disjoint_goodLocalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem badLocalPrimeSet_disjoint_goodLocalPrimeSet (N y : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (badLocalPrimeSet N y) (goodLocalPrimeSet N y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro q hbad hgood
  have hb := (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hbad).2
  have hg := (mem_goodLocalPrimeSet.mp hgood).2

name: RankAmplification.badLocalPrimeSet_union_goodLocalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem badLocalPrimeSet_union_goodLocalPrimeSet (N y : ℕ) :
    badLocalPrimeSet N y ∪ goodLocalPrimeSet N y = primeSupport N
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_badLocalPrimeSet, mem_goodLocalPrimeSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hq, _⟩ | ⟨hq, _⟩) <;> exact hq
  · intro hq
    exact (lt_or_ge y (largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N q))).elim
      (fun h ↦ Or.inl ⟨hq, h⟩) (fun h ↦ Or.inr ⟨hq, h⟩)

name: RankAmplification.badLocalProduct_pos

    (badLocalPrimeSet_subset N y hq)).pos _

name: RankAmplification.eq_badLocalProduct_mul_goodLocalProduct
statement:
theorem eq_badLocalProduct_mul_goodLocalProduct {N y : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    N = badLocalProduct N y * goodLocalProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    N = ∏ q ∈ primeSupport N, q ^ N.factorization q :=
      Nat.prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization hN
    _ = badLocalProduct N y * goodLocalProduct N y := by
      unfold badLocalProduct goodLocalProduct
      rw [← Finset.prod_union (badLocalPrimeSet_disjoint_goodLocalPrimeSet N y),
        badLocalPrimeSet_union_goodLocalPrimeSet]

name: RankAmplification.badLocalProduct_dvd

name: RankAmplification.goodLocalProduct_dvd
statement:
theorem goodLocalProduct_dvd {N y : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    goodLocalProduct N y ∣ N
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨badLocalProduct N y, (eq_badLocalProduct_mul_goodLocalProduct hN).trans
    (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩

name: RankAmplification.totient_eq_badLocalTotientProduct_mul_goodLocalTotientProduct
statement:
theorem totient_eq_badLocalTotientProduct_mul_goodLocalTotientProduct
    {N y : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    N.totient = badLocalTotientProduct N y * goodLocalTotientProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    N.totient = ∏ q ∈ primeSupport N, localTotientFactor N q :=
      totient_eq_prod_localTotientFactor hN
    _ = badLocalTotientProduct N y * goodLocalTotientProduct N y := by
      unfold badLocalTotientProduct goodLocalTotientProduct
      rw [← Finset.prod_union (badLocalPrimeSet_disjoint_goodLocalPrimeSet N y),
        badLocalPrimeSet_union_goodLocalPrimeSet]

name: RankAmplification.badLocalTotientProduct_dvd_totient

    (totient_eq_badLocalTotientProduct_mul_goodLocalTotientProduct hN).trans

name: RankAmplification.largestPrimeFactor_localTotientFactor_le_of_mem_good

name: RankAmplification.card_largeLocalTotientOccurrence
statement:
theorem card_largeLocalTotientOccurrence {N y : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :

proof:

name: RankAmplification.localTotientFactor_dvd_totient
statement:
theorem localTotientFactor_dvd_totient {N q : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hq : q ∈ primeSupport N) : localTotientFactor N q ∣ N.totient
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.card_badLocalPrimeSet_le_largePrimeRank

name: RankAmplification.card_badLocalPrimeSet_lt_rankThreshold
