name: RankAmplification.goodLocalTotientProduct_isSmooth
statement:
theorem goodLocalTotientProduct_isSmooth {N y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    IsSmooth y (goodLocalTotientProduct N y)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : goodLocalTotientProduct N y ≠ 0 :=
    (goodLocalTotientProduct_pos N y).ne'
  apply (isSmooth_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le hy hprod).2
  rw [largestPrimeFactor, max_le_iff]
  refine ⟨hy, Finset.sup_le ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  have hpDvd : p ∣ goodLocalTotientProduct N y := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  unfold goodLocalTotientProduct at hpDvd
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (hpPrime.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff
    (fun q ↦ localTotientFactor N q)).mp hpDvd
  exact (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hpPrime
    (localTotientFactor_pos
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (goodLocalPrimeSet_subset N y hq))).ne' hpq).trans
        (largestPrimeFactor_localTotientFactor_le_of_mem_good hq)

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRank_badLocalPrimeSet_card_lt

:= by

    (mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp (mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn).1).1
  exact card_badLocalPrimeSet_lt_rankThreshold hnpos.ne' hy
    (mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn).2.2

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneral_count_le_diagonal_add_three
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneral_count_le_diagonal_add_three
    {J x h y : ℕ} {E : ℝ}

    (hhigh : (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤ E)
    (hoff : (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) ≤ E) :
    (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) + 3 * E
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.three_mul_fixedRankGeneralMajorant_eq
statement:
theorem three_mul_fixedRankGeneralMajorant_eq
    {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} {error : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ)) :
    3 * fixedRankGeneralMajorant J error x T =
      fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
        (fun n ↦ error n + Real.log 3 / scaleV (n : ℝ)) x T
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralMajorant
  have hcancel : Real.log 3 / scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
      Real.log 3 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
  rw [add_mul, hcancel]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← add_assoc, Real.exp_add,
      Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_add_log_three_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_add_log_three_div_scaleV_zero
    {error : ℕ → ℝ} (herror : Tendsto error atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ error x + Real.log 3 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 3 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  simpa only [zero_add] using herror.add hlog

proof:

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedReconstruction
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedReconstruction
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) :
    HasWeightedPowerFibreBound J y Y x x.sqrt
      (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) J

proof:

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailSum_le_friable
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailSum_le_friable
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
        (supplierReciprocalTail P x x.sqrt : ℝ)) ≤
      finitePowerEncodingFactor J y (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y
          (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq (J y Y x : ℕ) :
    fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y Y x =
      2 * x * fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum J y Y x +
        4 * x * fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum J y Y x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum
    fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro P _hP
    ring

name: RankAmplification.natExponentialCutoff_inv_le_exp
statement:
theorem natExponentialCutoff_inv_le_exp
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    ((y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ Real.exp (-T + Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < y := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy)
  have hone : (y : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * y := by
    exact_mod_cast (show y + 1 ≤ 2 * y by omega)
  have hexp : Real.exp T ≤ 2 * y := hcutoff.2.le.trans hone
  have hinv : ((y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 2 / Real.exp T := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).2
    calc
      (y : ℝ)⁻¹ * Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * y) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (inv_nonneg.mpr hypos.le)
      _ = 2 := by field_simp
  convert hinv using 1
  rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg,
    Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneral_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneral_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp
    {J y Y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hyY : y ≤ Y)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤
      Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T + (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤ ((y : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ J :=
      sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_inv_pow (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy) hyY
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (-T + Real.log 2)) ^ J :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        (natExponentialCutoff_inv_le_exp hy hcutoff) _
    _ = Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T + (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum_le
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum_le
    {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hyY : y ≤ Y) (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T)
    (hscale : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x) :
    fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum J y Y x ≤
      Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
          (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  let a := fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x
  calc
    fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum J y Y x ≤
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
          (Real.exp a * (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro P _hP
      have hleft : 0 ≤ (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast supplierReciprocalMass_nonneg P x
      have hright : 0 ≤ Real.exp a * (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      exact (sq_le_sq₀ hleft hright).2
        (fixedRank_supplierMass_le_localExponent hJ hscale P)
    _ = Real.exp (a + a) *
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
          ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro P _hP
      rw [mul_pow, pow_two (Real.exp a), ← Real.exp_add]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (a + a) *
        Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T + (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (fixedRankGeneral_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp hy hyY hcutoff)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
          (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      dsimp [a]
      congr 1
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum_le
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum_le
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (hscale : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum J y Y x ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
          (supplierReciprocalTail P x x.sqrt : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro P _hP
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (fixedRank_supplierSupNorm_le_localExponent hscale hy P) (by
      exact_mod_cast supplierReciprocalTail_nonneg P x x.sqrt)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSupplierError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSupplierError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {tailError : ℕ → ℝ}
    (htail : Tendsto tailError atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J tailError) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (tailError x) 0) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using htail.max
      (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0))
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hscaled : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (6 * (J : ℝ)) *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hlog.const_mul (6 * (J : ℝ))
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hsum := hmax.add (hscaled.add hconst)
  have hsum0 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (tailError x) 0 +
      ((6 * (J : ℝ)) * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
        ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6) / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  refine hsum0.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  unfold fixedRankGeneralSupplierError fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent
  field_simp [hV.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le
    {J y Y x : ℕ} {T ρ : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hyY : y ≤ Y) (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hYx : Y ≤ x)
    (hscale : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ))
    (htail : fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression J y Y x ≤
      Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T + ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) :
    fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y Y x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J (fun _ ↦ ρ) x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hYtwo : Y ≤ 2 * x := hYx.trans (by omega)
  have htailSum : (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
      (supplierReciprocalTail P x x.sqrt : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T + ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailSum_le_friable
      (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy) hx hYtwo).trans htail
  have hweighted : fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum J y Y x ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
          (supplierReciprocalTail P x x.sqrt : ℝ) :=
    fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum_le (Y := Y) hscale hy
  have hweightedExp : fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum J y Y x ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x - (J : ℝ) * T +
        ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum J y Y x ≤
          Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
            ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
              (supplierReciprocalTail P x x.sqrt : ℝ) := hweighted
      _ ≤ Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
          Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T + ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htailSum (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hmass := fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum_le
    hJ hy hyY hcutoff hscale
  let common := -(J : ℝ) * T +
      2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
        (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)
  have hmassCommon : fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum J y Y x ≤
      Real.exp common := by
    refine hmass.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    dsimp [common]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hV.le)
  have hlocal0 : 0 ≤ fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x := by
    unfold fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (zero_le_one.trans hscale.log2_ge_one)
  have hfloor0 : 0 ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  have hρ : ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hV.le
  have htailCommon : fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum J y Y x ≤
      Real.exp common := by
    refine hweightedExp.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    calc
      fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x - (J : ℝ) * T +
          ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
          fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x - (J : ℝ) * T +
            max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by linarith
      _ ≤ common := by
        dsimp [common]
        linarith
  have hmajorant : fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y Y x ≤
      6 * x * Real.exp common := by
    rw [fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq]
    calc
      2 * x * fixedRankGeneralSupplierMassSquareSum J y Y x +
          4 * x * fixedRankGeneralSupplierWeightedTailSum J y Y x ≤
          2 * x * Real.exp common + 4 * x * Real.exp common := by
        exact add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmassCommon (by positivity))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htailCommon (by positivity))
      _ = 6 * x * Real.exp common := by ring
  calc
    fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y Y x ≤
        6 * x * Real.exp common := hmajorant
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J (fun _ ↦ ρ) x *
          scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hcancel :
          (2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
              (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6) /
                scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
            2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
              (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
      unfold fixedRankGeneralSupplierError
      simp only
      rw [add_mul, hcancel]
      have hexponent : -(J : ℝ) * T +
            (max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
              (2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
                (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6)) =
          common + Real.log 6 := by
        dsimp [common]
        ring
      rw [hexponent]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [Real.exp_add,
          Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperCutoff_le
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperCutoff_le
    (J : ℕ) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T c₀,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      y ^ J ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * C₀
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hC₀
  have heps : 0 < (1 / (a + 1) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsmall := scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL.bound heps
  have hsmallNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hsmall
  have hcore := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_moving_core_positive
  filter_upwards [hsmallNat, hcore] with x hsmall hcore
  intro y T c₀ hcutoff hwindow
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    scaleG_pos hL hcore.2.2.1
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hsmall
  have haG : a * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      a * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
          a * ((1 / (a + 1)) * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall ha
      _ = (a / (a + 1)) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hL.le
        exact (div_le_one (by positivity : 0 < a + 1)).2 (by linarith)
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) := one_mul _
  have hJT : (J : ℝ) * T ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * T ≤ (J : ℝ) * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = a * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by dsimp [a]; ring
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := haG
  have hxReal : (0 : ℝ) < x := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) < x :=
      (Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg x)).mp
        (by simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hL)
    positivity
  have hyExp : (y : ℝ) ^ J ≤ Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) := by
    calc
      (y : ℝ) ^ J ≤ (Real.exp T) ^ J :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hcutoff.1 _
      _ = Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  have hExpX : Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) ≤ Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hJT
      _ = (x : ℝ) := by rw [scaleL_eq, Real.exp_log hxReal]
  exact_mod_cast hyExp.trans hExpX

name: RankAmplification.one_le_pow_rank
statement:
theorem one_le_pow_rank {J y : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    y ≤ y ^ J
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy) (show 1 ≤ J by omega)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneral_highRank_of_friableEndpoint
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneral_highRank_of_friableEndpoint
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) {tailError : ℕ → ℝ}
    (htail : FixedRankGeneralWeightedFriableTailEndpoint
      J c₀ C₀ tailError) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
          (fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J tailError) x T
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperCutoff_le J hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, htail.2] with
      x hrange hupper hscale hV htailX
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hYx : y ^ J ≤ x := hupper y T c₀ hcutoff hwindow
  have hy : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  have hyY : y ≤ y ^ J := one_le_pow_rank hJ hy
  have hx : 0 < x := by omega
  have hcoverage := fixedHighRankShiftedCount_le_supplierCorrelation
    (x := x) (h := h) (y := y) (Y := y ^ J) (J := J)
      hrangeData.2 hhy (one_le_pow₀ hy)
  have hconvolution := fixedRankSupplierCorrelation_le_convolutionMajorant
    (J := J) (y := y) (Y := y ^ J) (x := x) (h := h)
      (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hh) (hhy.trans hrangeData.2) hhy
  have hsupplier := fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le
    hJ hy hyY hcutoff hx hYx hscale hV
      (htailX y T hcutoff hwindow)
  have hsupplier' : fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y (y ^ J) x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J tailError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    simpa [fixedRankGeneralSupplierError] using hsupplier
  calc
    (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankSupplierCorrelation J y (y ^ J) x h := hcoverage
    _ ≤ fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y (y ^ J) x := hconvolution
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J tailError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := hsupplier'
    _ ≤ fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
        (fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J tailError) x T := by
      unfold fixedRankGeneralMajorant fixedRankGeneralRate
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith [min_le_right (fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T) ((J : ℝ) * T)]

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom_pos
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom_pos
    (J : ℕ) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    0 < fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode
statement:
theorem rankinU_fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode
    {J Y x : ℕ} {C₀ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    rankinU (fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode J C₀ Y x) Y =
      (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode rankinU
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hYreal : (1 : ℝ) < Y := by exact_mod_cast hY
  field_simp [(Real.log_pos hYreal).ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_basic
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_basic
    (J : ℕ) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 ≤ fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x ∧
      (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ) ≤
        scaleV (x : ℝ) / fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀ ∧
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀) ≤
        (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤
        Real.log (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom_pos J hC₀
  have hqTop : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀)
      atTop atTop := tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.atTop_div_const hD
  have hqFour := hqTop.eventually_ge_atTop 4
  have hlogLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * Real.log (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀) ≤
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop _
  filter_upwards [hqFour, hlogLarge, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hq hlogLarge hV
  let q := scaleV (x : ℝ) / fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀
  let u := fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have huTwo : 2 ≤ u := by
    unfold u fixedRankGeneralFriableRank
    apply Nat.le_floor
    exact (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ q by linarith)
  have huPos : (0 : ℝ) < u := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < u by omega)
  have huLe : (u : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    unfold u fixedRankGeneralFriableRank
    exact Nat.floor_le hqPos.le
  have hqLt : q < (u : ℝ) + 1 := by
    unfold u fixedRankGeneralFriableRank
    exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one q
  have hhalf : q / 2 ≤ (u : ℝ) := by
    have huOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ u := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ u by omega)
    linarith
  have hlogModel :
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) /
          (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀)) =
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) -
          Real.log (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀) := by
    rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hD.ne')]
  have hmodelPos : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) /
      (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀) := by positivity
  have hlogHalf : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) /
        (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀)) := by
    rw [hlogModel]
    linarith
  have hmodelLe : scaleV (x : ℝ) /
      (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀) ≤ (u : ℝ) := by
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / (2 * fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀) =
          q / 2 := by
        dsimp [q]
        field_simp [hD.ne']
      _ ≤ (u : ℝ) := hhalf
  have hlogu := Real.log_le_log hmodelPos hmodelLe
  exact ⟨huTwo, huLe, hmodelLe, hlogHalf.trans hlogu⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneral_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneral_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_exp
    {J y x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hLTwo : 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    finitePowerEncodingFactor J y (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x)
proof:
:= by
  have hslot := fixedRank_slotEncodingFactor_le_exp hJ h hLTwo
  have hdiv : (J : ℝ) / y ≤ J :=
    div_le_self (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hy)
  unfold finitePowerEncodingFactor fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget
  calc
    (slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) ≤
      Real.exp (9 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) * Real.exp (J : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul hslot (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hdiv) (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_add]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode_le_tailCode
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode_le_tailCode
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode J C₀ (y ^ J) x ≤
        fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J (y ^ J) x
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ := 2 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  let eps : ℝ := 1 / (64 * (b + 1))
  have heps : 0 < eps := by dsimp [eps]; positivity
  have hGsmall := scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL.bound heps
  have hGsmallNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hGsmall
  have hLconst : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      64 * (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hcore := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_moving_core_positive
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_basic J hC₀,
      hGsmallNat, hLconst, hcore] with
      x hrange huData hGsmall hLconst hcore
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hy : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by omega
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hGsmall
  let Y := y ^ J
  let u := fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x
  let D := fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    dsimp [D]
    exact fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom_pos J hC₀
  have hYpos : 0 < Y := by dsimp [Y]; positivity
  have hlogy : Real.log (y : ℝ) ≤ T :=
    log_natCutoff_le_T hyPos hcutoff
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by
    exact (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hlogy0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hy)
  have hlogY : Real.log (Y : ℝ) = (J : ℝ) * Real.log y := by
    dsimp [Y]
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hlogY0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) := by
    rw [hlogY]
    positivity
  have hlogYupper : Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * T := by
    rw [hlogY]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogy (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hJTupper : (J : ℝ) * T ≤
      (J : ℝ) * C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * T ≤ (J : ℝ) * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hcoef : ((J : ℝ) * C₀) / D ≤ 1 / 64 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hD).2
    dsimp [D, fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom]
    have hprod : (J : ℝ) * C₀ ≤ ((J : ℝ) + 1) * (C₀ + 1) := by
      nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) by positivity]
    nlinarith
  have hVG : scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleG (x : ℝ) = scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact scaleG_mul_scaleV hG.ne'
  have huLog : (u : ℝ) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / 64 := by
    have huLe : (u : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / D := by
      simpa [u, D] using huData.2.1
    calc
      (u : ℝ) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≤
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) / D) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right huLe hlogY0
      _ ≤ (scaleV (x : ℝ) / D) * ((J : ℝ) * T) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogYupper (div_nonneg hV.le hD.le)
      _ ≤ (scaleV (x : ℝ) / D) *
          ((J : ℝ) * C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJTupper (div_nonneg hV.le hD.le)
      _ = (((J : ℝ) * C₀) / D) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [← hVG]
        ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 64) * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hL.le
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / 64 := by ring
  have hbG : b * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 64 := by
    calc
      b * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
          b * (eps * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGsmall hb
      _ = (b / (64 * (b + 1))) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [eps]
        ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 64) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hL.le
        apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 64 * (b + 1))).2
        nlinarith
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / 64 := by ring
  have hfixed : (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
      2 * (J : ℝ) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≤
        scaleL (x : ℝ) / 32 := by
    have hconst : (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 64 := by
      linarith
    have htwo : 2 * (J : ℝ) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≤
        b * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        2 * (J : ℝ) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≤
            2 * (J : ℝ) * ((J : ℝ) * T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogYupper (by positivity)
        _ ≤ 2 * (J : ℝ) *
            ((J : ℝ) * C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJTupper (by positivity)
        _ = b * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by dsimp [b]; ring
    linarith
  let N := 2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J) * Y ^ u
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by dsimp [N]; positivity
  have hlogN : Real.log (N : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 := by
    have hlogNid : Real.log (N : ℝ) =
        (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
          2 * (J : ℝ) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) +
            (u : ℝ) * Real.log (Y : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [N]
      push_cast
      rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
        Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
        Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [hlogNid]
    linarith [huLog, hfixed]
  have hNsquareReal : (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (x : ℝ) := by
    have hNreal : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hNpos
    calc
      (N : ℝ) ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * Real.log (N : ℝ)) := by
        rw [show 2 * Real.log (N : ℝ) =
            (2 : ℕ) * Real.log (N : ℝ) by norm_num,
          Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hNreal]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        linarith
      _ = (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [scaleL_eq, Real.exp_log]
        have : (1 : ℝ) < x :=
          (Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg x)).mp
            (by simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hL)
        linarith
  have hNsquare : N ^ 2 ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hNsquareReal
  have hNsqrt : N ≤ x.sqrt := Nat.le_sqrt'.2 hNsquare
  have hApos : 0 < 2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J) := by positivity
  apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hApos).2
  simpa [fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode, fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode,
    Y, u, N, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hNsqrt

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_le_sqrt
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ) ≤
        Real.sqrt (y ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  have hpolyReal :=
    (isLittleO_pow_exp_pos_mul_atTop 2 hc₀).bound
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  have hpoly : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ‖scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖Real.exp (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ))‖ :=
    ((tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually hpolyReal)
  have hTlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 ≤ c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).const_mul_atTop hc₀).eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hAone : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_basic J hC₀,
      hpoly, hTlarge, hAone,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hrange huData hpoly hTlarge hAone hL hA
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hD : 1 ≤ fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀ := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom
    nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) by positivity]
  have huV : (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    exact huData.2.1.trans (div_le_self hV.le hD)
  have hVG : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
    nlinarith
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le] at hpoly
  have hlogLower : T - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) :=
    T_sub_log_two_le_log_natCutoff
      (hTlarge.trans hwindow.1) hcutoff
  have hyLower : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (y : ℝ) := by
    have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr <|
      calc
        c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ T - Real.log 2 :=
          sub_le_sub_right hwindow.1 _
        _ ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) := hlogLower
    rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
      Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < y by omega))] at hexp
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hexp
  have hGsqY : scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (y : ℝ) :=
    hpoly.trans hyLower
  have huSq : (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      (y ^ J : ℕ) := by
    have huG := huV.trans hVG
    have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x := by positivity
    have hsq : (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
        scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hyY : y ≤ y ^ J := one_le_pow_rank hJ (by omega)
    have hyYreal : (y : ℝ) ≤ (y ^ J : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hyY
    exact hsq.trans (hGsqY.trans hyYreal)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le huSq

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerError_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerError_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerError J C₀ (y ^ J) x ≤
        fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x
proof:
:= by
  have hLlarge := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
      (Real.log 3)
  have hcore := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_moving_core_positive
  have hlogVlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      1 ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperCutoff_le J hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_basic J hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_le_sqrt J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      hLlarge, hcore, hlogVlarge] with
      x hrange hYx huData huSqrt hLlarge hcore hlogVlarge
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  let R := y ^ J
  let H := fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode J C₀ R x
  let u : ℝ := fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hRtwo : 2 ≤ R := by
    dsimp [R]
    have : 1 ≤ J := by omega
    exact (show 2 ≤ y by omega).trans
      (one_le_pow_rank hJ (by omega))
  have huEq : rankinU H R = u := by
    simpa [H, R, u] using rankinU_fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode
      (show 1 < y ^ J by omega)
  have huTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    change (2 : ℝ) ≤ (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast huData.1
  have huPos : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hloguPos : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogVPos : 0 < Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by linarith
  have huSqrt' : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [huEq]
    simpa [u, R] using huSqrt y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaHalf : rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt (show 1 < R by omega)
      (by rw [huEq]; exact huPos) huSqrt'
  have hloss := tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss (j := J) hdeltaHalf
  have hfullNonneg : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R H :=
    (primeRankinSum_nonneg R (rankinDelta H R)).trans
      (primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU hRtwo
        (by rw [huEq]; linarith) huSqrt')
  have hRx : R ≤ x := hYx y T c₀ hcutoff hwindow
  have hinner : Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.log 3 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (3 * (x : ℝ)) := by
        apply Real.log_le_log
        · positivity
        · exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hRx
      _ = Real.log 3 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by
          have : 0 < x := by omega
          exact_mod_cast this.ne'), scaleL]
  have hinnerLe : Real.log 3 + scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤
      2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    change Real.log 3 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) at hLlarge
    linarith
  have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hRtwo
    nlinarith
  have hloglog : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) ≤
      log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
    calc
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) ≤
          Real.log (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hinnerPos (hinner.trans hinnerLe)
      _ = log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hL.ne']
        simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
        ring
  have hD : 1 ≤ fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀ := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom
    nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) by positivity]
  have huV : u ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      u ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀ :=
        huData.2.1
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := div_le_self hV.le hD
  have hlogLower : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤ Real.log u :=
    huData.2.2.2
  have huDiv : u / Real.log u ≤
      2 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      u / Real.log u ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log u :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right huV hloguPos.le
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) /
          (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hV.le (by positivity) hlogLower
      _ = 2 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp
  have hlogTerm :
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := by
    have habs : -Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := neg_le_abs _
    linarith
  have hfull : fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
      primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
          12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
    unfold fullULogUPrimeError
    rw [huEq]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ primeCountingConstant_pos.le
    have hexp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogTerm (Real.exp_pos 2).le
    have hthree : 3 * u / Real.log u ≤
        12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
      have hratio0 : 0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
        div_nonneg hV.le hlogVPos.le
      calc
        3 * u / Real.log u = 3 * (u / Real.log u) := by ring
        _ ≤ 3 * (2 * scaleV (x : ℝ) /
            Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) := hmul
        _ = 6 * (scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by ring
        _ ≤ 12 * (scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) hratio0
        _ = 12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by ring
    exact add_le_add hexp hthree
  have hcoef0 : 0 ≤ (J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le
  unfold fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerError fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget
  have hmul := mul_le_mul hloss hfull hfullNonneg hcoef0
  change tauEulerLoss J (1 - rankinDelta H R) *
      fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
    ((J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant) *
      (Real.exp 2 *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
        12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))
  calc
    _ ≤ (J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss *
        (primeCountingConstant *
          (Real.exp 2 *
              (log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
            12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))) := hmul
    _ = _ := by ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget_div_scaleV_zero
    (J : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have htwo : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have habs : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hlogV : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hinv : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (1 : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hlogV
  have hfirst := ((hlog.add htwo).add habs).const_mul (Real.exp 2)
  have hsecond := hinv.const_mul 12
  have hinner := hfirst.add hsecond
  have hscaled := hinner.const_mul
    ((J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant)
  have hscaled0 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      ((J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant) *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
              Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
              |Real.log (Real.log 2)| / scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
          12 * (1 / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hscaled
  refine hscaled0.congr' ?_
  have hlogVne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
    hlogV.eventually_ne_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, hlogVne] with x hV hlogVne
  unfold fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget
  field_simp [hV.ne', hlogVne]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneral_friable_phase_saving
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneral_friable_phase_saving
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      T ≤ C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) →
      (J : ℝ) * T + fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x +
          fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x ≤
        (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let D := fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀
  let b : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * C₀
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (48 * D * (b + 1))
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by
    dsimp [D]
    exact fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom_pos J hC₀
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := by
    dsimp [D, fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom]
    nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) by positivity]
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hAraw := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (scaleA_isLittleO_log2.bound hc)
  have hlogCompare := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV
  have hlogLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      16 * D ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hencOne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x / scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
    (tendsto_fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget_div_scaleV_zero J).eventually
      (Iic_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hEulerOne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x / scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
    (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget_div_scaleV_zero J).eventually
      (Iic_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_basic J hC₀,
      hAraw, hlogCompare, hlogLarge, hencOne, hEulerOne,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x huData hAraw hlogCompare hlogLarge hencOne hEulerOne hcore
  intro T hT
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hL2 : 0 < log2 (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hlogV : 0 < Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    have : 0 < 16 * D := mul_pos (by norm_num) hDpos
    linarith
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hA.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le] at hAraw
  have hbfrac : b / (b + 1) ≤ 1 :=
    (div_le_one (by positivity : 0 < b + 1)).2 (by linarith)
  have hbase0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D) := by positivity
  have hAle : b * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D) := by
    calc
      b * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤ b * (c * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAraw hb
      _ ≤ b * (c * (3 * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))) := by
        gcongr
      _ = (b / (b + 1)) *
          (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D)) := by
        dsimp [c]
        field_simp [hDpos.ne', (show b + 1 ≠ 0 by positivity)]
        ring
      _ ≤ 1 * (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbfrac hbase0
      _ = _ := one_mul _
  have hAV := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  let Q := scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D)
  have hbAV : (J : ℝ) * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) =
      b * scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) = b * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
        dsimp only [b]
        ring
      _ = b * (scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by rw [hAV]
      _ = b * scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
  have hJT : (J : ℝ) * T ≤ Q := by
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * T ≤ (J : ℝ) * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = b * scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) := hbAV
      _ ≤ (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D)) *
          scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAle hV.le
      _ = Q := by dsimp [Q]; ring
  have hunit : 1 ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D) := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hDpos)).2 (by simpa using hlogLarge)
  have hVQ : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ Q := by
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) = scaleV (x : ℝ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) *
          (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * D)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hunit hV.le
      _ = Q := by dsimp [Q]; ring
  have henc : fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x ≤ Q := by
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hV).1 hencOne
    exact (by simpa using this : fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ)).trans hVQ
  have hEuler : fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x ≤ Q := by
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hV).1 hEulerOne
    exact (by simpa using this : fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ)).trans hVQ
  let u : ℝ := fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x
  have huLower : scaleV (x : ℝ) / (2 * D) ≤ u := by
    simpa [u, D] using huData.2.2.1
  have hlogLower : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤ Real.log u := by
    simpa [u] using huData.2.2.2
  have huNonneg : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; positivity
  have hleft0 : 0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (2 * D) := by positivity
  have hlogHalf0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 := by positivity
  have hRank : scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
        (4 * D) ≤ u * Real.log u := by
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (4 * D) =
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (2 * D)) *
            (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2) := by
        field_simp [hDpos.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ u * Real.log u :=
        mul_le_mul huLower hlogLower hlogHalf0 huNonneg
  have hfourQ : 4 * Q ≤ u * Real.log u := by
    calc
      4 * Q = scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
          (4 * D) := by dsimp [Q]; field_simp [hDpos.ne']; ring
      _ ≤ u * Real.log u := hRank
  have hsum : (J : ℝ) * T + fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x +
      fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x ≤ 3 * Q := by linarith
  have hQ : 0 ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q]; positivity
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralWeightedFriableTailEndpoint_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralWeightedFriableTailEndpoint_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    FixedRankGeneralWeightedFriableTailEndpoint J c₀ C₀ (fun _ ↦ 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_const_nhds, ?_⟩
  have hLTwo := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_basic J hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_le_sqrt J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode_le_tailCode J hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerError_le_budget J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneral_friable_phase_saving J hJ hC₀,
      hLTwo] with
      x hscale hrange hbasic huSqrt hcode hEuler hphase hLTwo
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  let R := y ^ J
  let H := fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode J C₀ R x
  let Hcanon := fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J R x
  let X := (2 * x) ^ J
  let u : ℝ := fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x
  have hfactor := fixedRankGeneral_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_exp
    hJ hscale hLTwo (show 1 ≤ y by omega)
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode
    exact Nat.pow_pos hRpos
  have hRtwo : 2 ≤ R := by
    dsimp [R]
    exact (show 2 ≤ y by omega).trans
      (one_le_pow_rank hJ (by omega))
  have huEq : rankinU H R = u := by
    simpa [H, R, u] using rankinU_fixedRankGeneralFriablePowerCode
      (show 1 < y ^ J by omega)
  have hu : 1 < rankinU H R := by
    rw [huEq]
    change (1 : ℝ) < (fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x by omega)
  have huSqrt' : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [huEq]
    simpa [u, R] using huSqrt y T hcutoff hwindow
  have htailPower := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    (j := J) (R := R) (H := H) (X := X) hJ hH hRtwo hu huSqrt'
  have htailBudget : finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-u * Real.log u +
        fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x) := by
    calc
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X ≤
          Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
            fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerError J C₀ R x) := by
        simpa [fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerError, H, R] using htailPower
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-u * Real.log u +
          fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [huEq]
        linarith [hEuler y T hcutoff hwindow]
  have hmono : finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R Hcanon X ≤
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X :=
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_antitone_cutoff
      (by simpa [H, Hcanon, R] using hcode y T hcutoff hwindow)
  have htail0 : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  have hencoding0 : 0 ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor J y
      (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) :=
    finitePowerEncodingFactor_nonneg _ _ _
  have hexponent : fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x -
        u * Real.log u + fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x ≤
      -(J : ℝ) * T := by
    have hsaving := hphase T hwindow.2
    change (J : ℝ) * T + fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x +
        fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x ≤ u * Real.log u at hsaving
    linarith
  calc
    fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression J y (y ^ J) x =
        finitePowerEncodingFactor J y (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) *
          finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R Hcanon X := by
      rfl
    _ ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor J y (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) *
          finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hencoding0
    _ ≤ Real.exp (fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x) *
          Real.exp (-u * Real.log u +
            fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x) :=
      mul_le_mul hfactor htailBudget htail0 (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x -
          u * Real.log u + fixedRankGeneralFriableEulerBudget J x) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent
    _ = Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T + 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by simp

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralHighError_zero

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonal_with_section5_rankin
statement:
theorem offDiagonal_with_section5_rankin
    {x h y : ℕ} {saving : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hy : 2 ≤ y)
    (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hRankin : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving) :
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
        ((x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
          2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) +
          2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
            (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := proposition9_6_offDiagonal_bound
    (x := x) (h := h) (y := y)
      nonSquareTransferHypothesis_canonical hh hhy (by omega : 0 < y)
  have houter := nonsquare_outer_sum_le hy hxy hRankin
  unfold nonsquareSkeletonMajorant at hfinite
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_offDiagonal_unconditional
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_offDiagonal_unconditional
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-T + variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hLone : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, hLone] with x hrange hroom hRankin hV hL
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hy : 2 ≤ y := by omega
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by omega
  have hxOne : 1 ≤ x := (by omega : 1 ≤ y).trans hrangeData.2
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hTlog : Real.log 2 ≤ T := by linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hinv := natCutoff_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg hTlog hcutoff
  have hRankinData := hRankin y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hfinite := offDiagonal_with_section5_rankin
    (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hh) hy hhy hrangeData.2 hRankinData
  let a := 1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)
  let M := Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4)
  let base := (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := by
    change 1 ≤ 1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)
    linarith [hL]
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := by
    dsimp [M]
    exact Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)))
  have hbase : 0 ≤ base := by dsimp [base]; positivity
  have hcut : 2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 4 * base := by
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ = 4 * base := by dsimp [base]; ring
  have hlogSqrt : Real.log 2 + 2 * T ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    linarith [hroomData.1, hroomData.2]
  have hsqrt : 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤ 2 * base := by
    change 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      2 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T))
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using two_natSqrt_le_two_mul_exp_neg hxPos hlogSqrt
  have hsmallFinite := smallCofactorLogTerm_le hxOne hyPos
  have hsmall : ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) ≤
      2 * a * base := by
    calc
      ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hsmallFinite
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-T)) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * a * base := by dsimp [a, base]; ring
  have hendpoint := section5_endpoint_log_bound_of_le
    hxOne hyPos hrangeData.2
  have hfactorPos : 0 ≤ section4MertensFactor
      (section5Ambient x y).sqrt := section4MertensFactor_nonneg _
  have hfactor : section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt ≤
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a) := by
    unfold section4MertensFactor
    dsimp [a]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hendpoint (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hfactorSq :
      (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 ≤
        (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a)) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hfactor, hfactorPos,
      show 0 ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a) by positivity]
  have hE2 : Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 = M := by
    dsimp [M]
    calc
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 =
          Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) := by ring
      _ = Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4 + 4 * Real.log 4) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add]
      _ = Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4) := by congr 1; ring
  have hreciprocal :
      (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
          (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 32 * M * a ^ 2 * base := by
    calc
      (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
          (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a)) ^ 2 *
            (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by gcongr
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a)) ^ 2 *
          (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ = 32 * M * a ^ 2 * base := by
        dsimp [base]
        rw [mul_pow, hE2]
        ring
  have hintermediate : 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) ≤
      2 * base := by
    have hexp : Real.exp (-(2 * T)) ≤ Real.exp (-T) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * base := by dsimp [base]; ring
  have hamb := section5Ambient_log_le_four_scaleL hxOne hyPos hrangeData.2
  have hupper :
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
        16 * a * base := by
    have hambNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) := by
      have hambOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ section5Ambient x y := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ section5Ambient x y by
          unfold section5Ambient
          exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
            (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hxPos.ne') hyPos.ne'))
      positivity
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
            (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ = 16 * a * base := by dsimp [a, base]; ring
  have haSq : a ≤ a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have honeMass : 1 ≤ M * a ^ 2 := by
    calc
      1 ≤ a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ M * a ^ 2 := le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg a) hM
  have haMass : a ≤ M * a ^ 2 := haSq.trans
    (le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg a) hM)
  have hcoeff :
      4 + 2 + 2 * a + 32 * M * a ^ 2 + 2 + 16 * a ≤
        128 * M * a ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hsum :
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
          (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          ((x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        base * (128 * M * a ^ 2) := by
    have hcoeffMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcoeff hbase
    have hfirstThree :
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
            (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) ≤
          4 * base + 2 * base + 2 * a * base :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add hcut hsqrt) hsmall
    have hlastThree :
        (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          32 * M * a ^ 2 * base + 2 * base + 16 * a * base :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add hreciprocal hintermediate) hupper
    calc
      _ ≤ (4 * base + 2 * base + 2 * a * base) +
          (32 * M * a ^ 2 * base + 2 * base + 16 * a * base) :=
        add_le_add hfirstThree hlastThree
      _ = base * (4 + 2 + 2 * a + 32 * M * a ^ 2 + 2 + 16 * a) := by ring
      _ ≤ base * (128 * M * a ^ 2) := hcoeffMul
  have hpoly := variableCutoffNonsmoothCoefficient_le_errorExp hL hV
  calc
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
          (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          ((x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := hfinite
    _ ≤ base * (128 * M * a ^ 2) := hsum
    _ ≤ base * Real.exp
        (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [a, M]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly hbase
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-T + variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [base]
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.isSection5ExponentialCutoff_log_nat
statement:
theorem isSection5ExponentialCutoff_log_nat {Y : ℕ} (hY : 0 < Y) :
    IsSection5ExponentialCutoff Y (Real.log (Y : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hYreal : (0 : ℝ) < Y := by exact_mod_cast hY
  unfold IsSection5ExponentialCutoff
  rw [Real.exp_log hYreal]
  exact ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperLog_window
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperLog_window
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow ((J : ℝ) * c₀ / 2)
        ((J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1)) x (Real.log (y ^ J : ℕ)) ∧
      (J : ℝ) * T - (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (y ^ J : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hTlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * Real.log 2 ≤ c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).const_mul_atTop hc₀).eventually_ge_atTop _
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      hTlarge] with x hrange hTlarge
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by omega
  have hTtwo : 2 * Real.log 2 ≤ T := hTlarge.trans hwindow.1
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hfloor := T_sub_log_two_le_log_natCutoff (by linarith) hcutoff
  have hlogUpper := log_natCutoff_le_T hyPos hcutoff
  have hlogPow : Real.log (y ^ J : ℕ) = (J : ℝ) * Real.log y := by
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hJnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ J := by positivity
  have hGnonneg : 0 ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_nonneg _
  have hlower : (J : ℝ) * c₀ / 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (y ^ J : ℕ) := by
    rw [hlogPow]
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * c₀ / 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) =
          (J : ℝ) * (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) / 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * T / 2 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.1 hJnonneg) (by norm_num)
      _ = (J : ℝ) * (T / 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * (T - Real.log 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hJnonneg
      _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log y :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfloor hJnonneg
  have hupper : Real.log (y ^ J : ℕ) ≤
      (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [hlogPow]
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * Real.log y ≤ (J : ℝ) * T :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogUpper hJnonneg
      _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.2 hJnonneg
      _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * ((C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
        gcongr
        linarith
      _ = (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring
  refine ⟨⟨hlower, hupper⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [hlogPow]
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError_zero (J : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError J) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ variableCutoffNonsmoothError x +
    (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using tendsto_variableCutoffNonsmoothError_zero.add hconst

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneral_offDiagonal_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneral_offDiagonal_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankGeneralMajorant J (fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError J) x T
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < (J : ℝ) * c₀ / 2 := by positivity
  have hC : 0 < (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1) := by positivity
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperLog_window J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      variableCutoff_offDiagonal_unconditional hc hC,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hlogWindow hoff hV
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hlogData := hlogWindow y T hcutoff hwindow
  let Y := y ^ J
  let U := Real.log (Y : ℝ)
  have hYpos : 0 < Y := by
    dsimp only [Y]
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have hyY : h ≤ Y := hhy.trans (one_le_pow_rank hJ (by omega))
  have hoffData := hoff h Y U hh hyY
    (isSection5ExponentialCutoff_log_nat hYpos) hlogData.1
  have hcancel : ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
      scaleV (x : ℝ) = (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
  have hexponent : -U + variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
      -fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T +
        fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hrate : fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T ≤ (J : ℝ) * T :=
      min_le_right _ _
    unfold fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError
    rw [add_mul, hcancel]
    dsimp [U, Y] at hlogData ⊢
    linarith [hlogData.2]
  calc
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-U + variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      simpa [Y, U] using hoffData
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
        (fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError J) x T := rfl

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_log_const_mul_scaleV_div_half_log2_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_const_mul_scaleV_div_half_log2_one
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (a * scaleV x) /
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x)) atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (2 * Real.log a) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_log2_atTop
  have hA : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (scaleA x) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log_scaleA_isLittleO_log2.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (1 : ℝ) +
      (2 * Real.log a) / log2 x - Real.log (scaleA x) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero, add_zero] using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1)).add
        hc).sub hA
  apply hmodel.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hApos hL2
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hApos)
  rw [Real.log_mul ha.ne' hV.ne']
  have hlogV := two_mul_log_scaleV hL hApos
  field_simp [hL2.ne']
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_generalWindow_log2_error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_generalWindow_log2_error_zero
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 (a * scaleV x) - log3 x + Real.log 2)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio := tendsto_log_const_mul_scaleV_div_half_log2_one ha
  have hlogRatio : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log
      (Real.log (a * scaleV x) / ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hcont := (Real.continuousAt_log (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).tendsto.comp hratio
    change Tendsto (Real.log ∘ (fun x ↦ Real.log (a * scaleV x) /
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x))) atTop (nhds 0)
    simpa only [Real.log_one] using hcont
  apply hlogRatio.congr'
  have hinner : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (a * scaleV x)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_scaleV_atTop.const_mul_atTop ha)
  filter_upwards [hinner.eventually_gt_atTop 0, eventually_log2_pos] with x hinnerPos hL2
  have hhalf : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x := mul_pos (by norm_num) hL2
  rw [Real.log_div hinnerPos.ne' hhalf.ne',
    Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hL2.ne']
  simp only [log2_eq, log3_eq]
  have hlogHalf : Real.log (1 / 2 : ℝ) = -Real.log 2 := by
    rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), Real.log_one]
    ring
  rw [hlogHalf]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_generalWindow_log2_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_generalWindow_log2_atTop {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 (a * scaleV x)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.log (a * scaleV x))) atTop atTop
  exact Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp <|
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_scaleV_atTop.const_mul_atTop ha)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_generalWindow_log3_error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_generalWindow_log3_error_zero
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ log3 (a * scaleV x) - log4 x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsecond := tendsto_generalWindow_log2_error_zero ha
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 (a * scaleV x) - log3 x)
      atTop (nhds (-Real.log 2)) := by
    have h := hsecond.sub (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Real.log 2) atTop (nhds (Real.log 2)))
    have hraw : Tendsto (fun x ↦
        (log2 (a * scaleV x) - log3 x + Real.log 2) - Real.log 2)
        atTop (nhds (-Real.log 2)) := by simpa only [zero_sub] using h
    apply hraw.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  have hsmall : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (log2 (a * scaleV x) - log3 x) / log3 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := hdiff.div_atTop tendsto_log3_atTop
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 (a * scaleV x) / log3 x)
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have hmodel := (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1)).add hsmall
    have hmodel' : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (1 : ℝ) +
        (log2 (a * scaleV x) - log3 x) / log3 x)
        atTop (nhds 1) := by simpa only [add_zero] using hmodel
    apply hmodel'.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_log3_pos] with x hL3
    field_simp [hL3.ne']
    ring
  have hlogRatio : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      Real.log (log2 (a * scaleV x) / log3 x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hcont := (Real.continuousAt_log (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).tendsto.comp hratio
    change Tendsto (Real.log ∘ (fun x ↦
      log2 (a * scaleV x) / log3 x)) atTop (nhds 0)
    simpa only [Real.log_one] using hcont
  apply hlogRatio.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_generalWindow_log2_atTop ha).eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      eventually_log3_pos] with x hleft hright
  rw [Real.log_div hleft.ne' hright.ne']
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_generalWindow_saddleBracket_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_generalWindow_saddleBracket_zero
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 (a * scaleV x) + log3 (a * scaleV x) - scaleA x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := (tendsto_generalWindow_log2_error_zero ha).add
    (tendsto_generalWindow_log3_error_zero ha)
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (log2 (a * scaleV x) - log3 x + Real.log 2) +
        (log3 (a * scaleV x) - log4 x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [scaleA_eq]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlo := (tendsto_generalWindow_saddleBracket_zero
    (show 0 < (1 / (C₀ + 1) : ℝ) by positivity)).abs
  have hhi := (tendsto_generalWindow_saddleBracket_zero
    (show 0 < (1 / c₀ : ℝ) by positivity)).abs
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ max
      |log2 ((1 / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleV x) +
        log3 ((1 / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleV x) - scaleA x|
      |log2 ((1 / c₀) * scaleV x) +
        log3 ((1 / c₀) * scaleV x) - scaleA x|) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [abs_zero, max_self] using hlo.max hhi
  have hdiv : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ max
      |log2 ((1 / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleV x) +
        log3 ((1 / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleV x) - scaleA x|
      |log2 ((1 / c₀) * scaleV x) +
        log3 ((1 / c₀) * scaleV x) - scaleA x| / c₀)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_div] using hmax.div_const c₀
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max
      |log2 ((1 / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
        log3 ((1 / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) - scaleA (x : ℝ)|
      |log2 ((1 / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
        log3 ((1 / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) - scaleA (x : ℝ)| / c₀)
      atTop (nhds 0)
  exact hdiv.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T ≤
        scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := 1 / (C₀ + 1)
  let b : ℝ := 1 / c₀
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hlogLower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < Real.log (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_scaleV_atTop.const_mul_atTop ha)).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
  have hlog2Lower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < log2 (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((tendsto_generalWindow_log2_atTop ha).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [hlogLower, hlog2Lower,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hlogLower hlog2Lower hcore
  intro T hwindow
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  let z := scaleL (x : ℝ) / T
  let lo := a * scaleV (x : ℝ)
  let hi := b * scaleV (x : ℝ)
  have hlo : 0 < lo := by dsimp [lo]; positivity
  have hhi : 0 < hi := by dsimp [hi]; positivity
  have hz : 0 < z := by dsimp [z]; positivity
  have hGV := scaleG_mul_scaleV hG.ne'
  have hloz : lo ≤ z := by
    have hden : T ≤ (C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
      hwindow.2.trans (by gcongr; linarith)
    calc
      lo = scaleL (x : ℝ) / ((C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
        dsimp [lo, a]
        field_simp [hG.ne', (show C₀ + 1 ≠ 0 by positivity)]
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / T :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le hT hden
      _ = z := rfl
  have hzhi : z ≤ hi := by
    calc
      z = scaleL (x : ℝ) / T := rfl
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1
      _ = hi := by
        dsimp [hi, b]
        field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne']
  have hlogLoZ : Real.log lo ≤ Real.log z := Real.log_le_log hlo hloz
  have hlogZHi : Real.log z ≤ Real.log hi := Real.log_le_log hz hzhi
  have hlogZ : 0 < Real.log z := by
    change 0 < Real.log (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) at hlogLower
    linarith
  have hlog2LoZ : log2 lo ≤ log2 z := by
    change Real.log (Real.log lo) ≤ Real.log (Real.log z)
    exact Real.log_le_log (by simpa [lo] using hlogLower) hlogLoZ
  have hlog2ZHi : log2 z ≤ log2 hi := by
    change Real.log (Real.log z) ≤ Real.log (Real.log hi)
    exact Real.log_le_log hlogZ hlogZHi
  have hlog2Z : 0 < log2 z := by
    change 0 < log2 (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) at hlog2Lower
    linarith
  have hlog3ZHi : log3 z ≤ log3 hi := by
    change Real.log (log2 z) ≤ Real.log (log2 hi)
    exact Real.log_le_log hlog2Z hlog2ZHi
  let M := max
      |log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ)|
      |log2 hi + log3 hi - scaleA (x : ℝ)|
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  have hbracket : log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤ M := by
    calc
      log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤
          log2 hi + log3 hi - scaleA (x : ℝ) := by linarith
      _ ≤ |log2 hi + log3 hi - scaleA (x : ℝ)| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ M := by exact le_max_right _ _
  have hzM : z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) ≤
      hi * M := by
    calc
      z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) ≤ z * M :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracket hz.le
      _ ≤ hi * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzhi hM
  have hsq := scaleG_sq hL.le hA.le
  have hidentity : fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T -
      scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T =
        z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankSmoothRate
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [hsq]
    ring
  have herrorIdentity : hi * M =
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError
    dsimp only [hi, lo, a, b, M]
    field_simp [hc₀.ne']
  rw [← hidentity, herrorIdentity] at hzM
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
statement:
theorem rankinU_fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
    {J Y x : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    rankinU (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J Y x) Y =
      (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode rankinU
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hlog : Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY)).ne'
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff_sub_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff_sub_one (J Y x : ℕ) :
    fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff J Y x - 1 =
      fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J Y x
proof:
:= by
  simp [fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_generalFriableRank
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_generalFriableRank
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x
proof:
:= by
  let D := fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom J C₀
