  have hD : 0 < D := fixedRankGeneralFriableDenom_pos J hC₀
  have hcoef : 0 < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J := by positivity
  have hden : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      D ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((((Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log2_atTop).const_mul_atTop hcoef).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop D)
  filter_upwards [hden, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hden hV hL2
  unfold fixedLowRankTailRank fixedLowRankTailRankScale
    fixedRankGeneralFriableRank
  apply Nat.floor_mono
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hV.le hD hden

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailRank_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailRank_le_sqrt
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (y ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_generalFriableRank J hJ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralFriableRank_le_sqrt J hJ hc₀ hC₀] with
      x hle hsqrt
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hleReal : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankGeneralFriableRank J C₀ x := by exact_mod_cast hle
  exact hleReal.trans (hsqrt y T hcutoff hwindow)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_split_parameters
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_split_parameters
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      2 ≤ x ∧ 1 ≤ y ∧ 1 ≤ fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff J (y ^ J) x ∧
      (y ^ J) ^ J ≤ fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff J (y ^ J) x ∧
      fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff J (y ^ J) x ^ J ≤
        fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ J] with x hx hrange hrank
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hy := (hrange y T hcutoff hwindow).1
  have hpow : (y ^ J) ^ J ≤
      (y ^ J) ^ fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by positivity) hrank
  refine ⟨hx, by omega, by simp [fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff], ?_, le_rfl⟩
  exact hpow.trans (by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
    omega)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError J (y ^ J) x ≤
        fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x
proof:
:= by
  have hLlarge := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 3)
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperCutoff_le J hC₀,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ 2,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailRank_le_sqrt J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive, hLlarge] with
      x hrange hupper huTwo huSqrt hcore hLlarge
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  let R := y ^ J
  let H := fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J R x
  let u : ℝ := fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ)
  have hRtwo : 2 ≤ R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    exact (show 2 ≤ y by omega).trans (one_le_pow_rank hJ (by omega))
  have huEq : rankinU H R = u := by
    simpa [H, R, u] using rankinU_fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
      (show 1 < y ^ J by omega)
  have huTwoReal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    dsimp only [u]
    exact_mod_cast huTwo
  have huPos : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hloguPos : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have huSqrt' : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [huEq]
    simpa [u, R] using huSqrt y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaHalf : rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt (show 1 < R by omega)
      (by rw [huEq]; exact huPos) huSqrt'
  have hloss := tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss (j := 1) hdeltaHalf
  have hRx : R ≤ x := hupper y T c₀ hcutoff hwindow
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hinner : Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.log 3 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (3 * (x : ℝ)) := by
        apply Real.log_le_log
        · positivity
        · exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hRx
      _ = Real.log 3 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by
          have : 0 < x := by omega
          exact_mod_cast this.ne'), scaleL]
  have hinnerLe : Real.log 3 + scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤
      2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    change Real.log 3 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) at hLlarge
    linarith
  have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hRtwo
    nlinarith
  have hloglog : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) ≤
      log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
    calc
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) ≤
          Real.log (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hinnerPos (hinner.trans hinnerLe)
      _ = log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hL.ne']
        simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
        ring
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogu : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log u :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) huTwoReal
  have huDiv : u / Real.log u ≤ u / Real.log 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left huPos.le hlogTwo hlogu
  have hlogTerm : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) -
      Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := by
    linarith [neg_le_abs (Real.log (Real.log 2))]
  have hprime : fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤ primeCountingConstant *
      (Real.exp 2 *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
        3 * u / Real.log 2) := by
    unfold fullULogUPrimeError
    rw [huEq]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ primeCountingConstant_pos.le
    exact add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogTerm (Real.exp_pos _).le) (by
        calc
          3 * u / Real.log u = 3 * (u / Real.log u) := by ring
          _ ≤ 3 * (u / Real.log 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num)
          _ = 3 * u / Real.log 2 := by ring)
  have hprimeNonneg : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R H :=
    (primeRankinSum_nonneg R (rankinDelta H R)).trans
      (primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU hRtwo
        (by rw [huEq]; linarith) huSqrt')
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget
  change tauEulerLoss 1 (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
        fullULogUPrimeError R H :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by simpa using hloss) hprimeNonneg
    _ ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
        (primeCountingConstant *
          (Real.exp 2 *
              (log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
            3 * u / Real.log 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le)
    _ = _ := by dsimp only [u]; ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant_pos
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant_pos :
    0 < fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hinside : 0 < Real.exp 2 *
      (1 + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) + 3 / Real.log 2 := by
    apply add_pos
    · apply mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (Real.log 2))]
    · exact div_pos (by norm_num) hlogTwo
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos)
    primeCountingConstant_pos) hinside

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget_le_G
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget_le_G
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x ≤
        fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant * scaleG (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2oG : log2 =o[atTop] scaleG :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.trans scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG
  have hL2bound := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (hL2oG.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  have hGone := (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [hL2bound, hGone,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_cast_le_scaleG J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hL2bound hGone huG hL2 hL hA
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, one_mul] at hL2bound
  have hconst : Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤
      (Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    apply le_mul_of_one_le_right
    · positivity
    · exact hGone
  have hlogPart : log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤
      (1 + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have huPart : 3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤
      (3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤
          (3 * scaleG (x : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huG (by norm_num)) hlogTwo.le
      _ = (3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
      primeCountingConstant :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le)
      primeCountingConstant_pos.le
  calc
    ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) * primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
          3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2) ≤
      ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) * primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            ((1 + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) +
          (3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogPart (Real.exp_pos _).le) huPart)
        hcoef
    _ = ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) * primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 * (1 + Real.log 2 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
          3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTail_le_smoothRate
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTail_le_smoothRate
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
          (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) x ≤
        Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T)
proof:
:= by
  let C := fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant
  have hphase :=
    (tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_natCast_div_scaleG_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop
      (C + 1 / c₀ + 2)
  have herrorOne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x ≤ 1 :=
    (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀ hC₀).eventually
      (Iic_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hVleGReal := scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hVleG := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hVleGReal
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ 2,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailRank_le_sqrt J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError_le_budget J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget_le_G J hJ,
      eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error hc₀ hC₀,
      hphase, herrorOne, hVleG,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x hrange huTwo huSqrt hEuler hbudget hsmooth hphase herrorOne hVleG hcore
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  let R := y ^ J
  let H := fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J R x
  let u : ℝ := fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ)
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hV.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, one_mul] at hVleG
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hRtwo : 2 ≤ R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    exact (show 2 ≤ y by omega).trans (one_le_pow_rank hJ (by omega))
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have huEq : rankinU H R = u := by
    simpa [H, R, u] using rankinU_fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
      (show 1 < y ^ J by omega)
  have hu : 1 < rankinU H R := by
    rw [huEq]
    change (1 : ℝ) < (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) by omega)
  have huSqrt' : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [huEq]
    simpa [u, R] using huSqrt y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hfull := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    (j := 1) (R := R) (H := H) (X := x) (by norm_num) hH hRtwo hu huSqrt'
  have htail : finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H x ≤
      Real.exp (-u * Real.log u + fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x) := by
    rw [finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_tau_one]
    calc
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail 1 R H x ≤
          Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
            fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError J R x) := by
        simpa [fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError, H, R] using hfull
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-u * Real.log u +
          fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [huEq]
        linarith [hEuler y T hcutoff hwindow]
  have hcompNonneg : 0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError
    positivity
  have herrorTerm : fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
      scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
          1 * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right herrorOne hV.le
      _ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by simpa using hVleG
  have hGpart : scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
    calc
      scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤
          scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1
      _ = scaleG (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne']
  have hsmoothBound : fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T ≤
      (1 / c₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    have hs := hsmooth T hwindow
    calc
      fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := hs
      _ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) / c₀ + scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add hGpart herrorTerm
      _ = (1 / c₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring
  have hphaseMul : (C + 1 / c₀ + 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
      u * Real.log u := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hG).mp (by simpa [u] using hphase)
  have hEulerG : fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x ≤
      C * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by simpa [C] using hbudget
  have hexponent : -u * Real.log u + fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x ≤
      -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T := by
    nlinarith [fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant_pos.le]
  exact htail.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_log_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      Real.log (fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget J C₀ x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hrange hV hL2 hL hA
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by omega
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hsqrtL2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  let Y := y ^ J
  let u := fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ)
  let Q := fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J Y x
  let K := fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff J Y x
  have hYpos : 0 < Y := by dsimp only [Y]; exact Nat.pow_pos hyPos
  have hQpos : 0 < Q := by
    unfold Q fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
    exact Nat.pow_pos hYpos
  have hKpos : 0 < K := by unfold K fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff; omega
  have hKle : K ≤ 2 * Q := by
    unfold K fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff
    omega
  have hlogK : Real.log (K : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 + (u : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
    have hcast : (K : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q := by exact_mod_cast hKle
    calc
      Real.log (K : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (Q : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hKpos) hcast
      _ = Real.log 2 + Real.log (Q : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
          (by exact_mod_cast hQpos.ne')]
      _ = Real.log 2 + (u : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
        unfold Q fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
        rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hlogY : Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * T := by
    unfold Y
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_natCutoff_le_T hyPos hcutoff)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hu : (u : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) /
      ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
    unfold u fixedLowRankTailRank fixedLowRankTailRankScale
    exact Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hden : 0 < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    positivity
  have hlogY0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast
    (show 1 ≤ Y by omega))
  have huLog : (u : ℝ) * Real.log Y ≤
      (C₀ + 1) * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
    calc
      (u : ℝ) * Real.log Y ≤
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) /
            ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) *
              Real.log Y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu hlogY0
      _ ≤ (scaleV (x : ℝ) /
            ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) *
              ((J : ℝ) * T) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogY (div_nonneg hV.le hden.le)
      _ ≤ (scaleV (x : ℝ) /
            ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) *
              ((J : ℝ) * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
          (div_nonneg hV.le hden.le)
      _ = (C₀ / Real.sqrt J) *
          (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        have hGV := scaleG_mul_scaleV hG.ne'
        have hJr : (0 : ℝ) < (J : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
        rw [← hGV]
        field_simp [hJr.ne', (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hJr).ne', hsqrtL2.ne']
      _ ≤ (C₀ + 1) *
          (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (div_nonneg hL.le hsqrtL2.le)
        have hsqrtOne : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := by
          calc
            1 = Real.sqrt 1 := by norm_num
            _ ≤ Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by
              exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega))
        have : C₀ / Real.sqrt J ≤ C₀ :=
          div_le_self hC₀ hsqrtOne
        linarith
  have hlogH : Real.log (fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J Y x : ℝ) =
      (J : ℝ) * Real.log K := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  rw [hlogH]
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
  calc
    (J : ℝ) * Real.log K ≤ (J : ℝ) *
        (Real.log 2 + (u : ℝ) * Real.log Y) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogK (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (J : ℝ) *
        (Real.log 2 + (C₀ + 1) *
          (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl huLog) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget_div_scaleL_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget_div_scaleL_zero
    (J : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget J C₀ x / scaleL (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  let b : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1)
  have hL : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ scaleL (x : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hS : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) atTop atTop :=
    (Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log2_atTop).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have ha : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ a / scaleL (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hL
  have hb : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ b / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hS
  have hab := ha.add hb
  have hab' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      a / scaleL (x : ℝ) + b / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa only [zero_add] using hab
  apply hab'.congr'
  filter_upwards [
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hLpos hL2
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
  dsimp only [a, b]
  field_simp [hLpos.ne', (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_two_mul_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le
statement:
theorem eventually_two_mul_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      2 * fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  have hratio :=
    tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget_div_scaleL_zero J C₀
  have hhalf : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget J C₀ x / scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    (hratio.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2))).mono
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hlogTwo : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
    ((tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (2 * Real.log 2)).mono fun x hx ↦ by
          change 2 * Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) at hx
          linarith
  filter_upwards [eventually_log_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le_budget
      J hJ hc₀ hC₀, hhalf, hlogTwo,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos]
      with x hlogH hhalf hlogTwo hL
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  let H := fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff
    positivity
  have hbudget : fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget J C₀ x ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf hL.le
    field_simp [hL.ne'] at this
    linarith
  have hlogTwoH : Real.log (2 * (H : ℝ)) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (by exact_mod_cast hHpos.ne')]
    have hlogH' := hlogH y T hcutoff hwindow
    linarith
  have hcast : (2 * H : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by
    have hleft : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * H := by positivity
    have hright : (0 : ℝ) < x := by
      have hxone : (1 : ℝ) < x :=
        (Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg x)).mp
          (by simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hL)
      positivity
    have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogTwoH
    rw [Real.exp_log hleft, scaleL_eq, Real.exp_log hright] at hexp
    exact_mod_cast hexp
  exact_mod_cast hcast

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogGap_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogGap_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T W,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      x / fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x ≤ W → W ≤ x →
      scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W ≤
        fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_two_mul_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le
      J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_log_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le_budget J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos]
      with x htwoH hlogH hL
  intro y T W hcutoff hwindow hWlow _hWhigh
  let H := fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff
    positivity
  have hquotTwo : 2 ≤ x / H := by
    apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hHpos).2
    simpa only [H] using htwoH y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hWlowH : x / H ≤ W := by simpa only [H] using hWlow
  have hWpos : 0 < W := by omega
  have hxlt : x < (x / H + 1) * H := by
    calc
      x = H * (x / H) + x % H := (Nat.div_add_mod x H).symm
      _ < H * (x / H) + H := Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mod_lt x hHpos) _
      _ = (x / H + 1) * H := by ring
  have hcoef : x / H + 1 ≤ 2 * (x / H) := by omega
  have hxle : x ≤ 2 * W * H := by
    have hfirst : (x / H + 1) * H ≤ (2 * (x / H)) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H hcoef
    have hsecond : (2 * (x / H)) * H ≤ (2 * W) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hWlowH)
    omega
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by
    have hxone : (1 : ℝ) < x :=
      (Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg x)).mp
        (by simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hL)
    positivity
  have hWreal : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hWpos
  have hHreal : (0 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast hHpos
  have hxcast : (x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hxle
  have hlogAmbient : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [scaleL_eq] using Real.log_le_log hxpos hxcast
  have hgap : scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W ≤
      Real.log 2 + Real.log H := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne')
      hHreal.ne', Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne']
      at hlogAmbient
    linarith
  have hlogH' := hlogH y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hlogH'' : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    simpa only [H] using hlogH'
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
  exact hgap.trans (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget_div_scaleV_sq_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget_div_scaleV_sq_zero
    (J : ℕ) (C₀ : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
        scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := Real.log 2 + (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  let b : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1)
  have hV2 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop atTop := by
    have hmul := tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.atTop_mul_atTop₀ tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
    simpa only [pow_two] using hmul
  have ha : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ a / scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2)
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hV2
  have hASmall : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_log2.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hb : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      b * (scaleA (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hASmall
  have hsum := ha.add hb
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      a / scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2 +
        b * (scaleA (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hL hA hL2 hV
  have hV2eq := scaleV_sq_eq_scaleL_div_scaleA hL hA
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
    fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
  dsimp only [a, b]
  rw [hV2eq]
  field_simp [hL.ne', hA.ne', (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne', hV.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hquot : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
        scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / c₀) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_div] using
      (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget_div_scaleV_sq_zero J C₀).div_const c₀
  have hquot' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
        (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply hquot.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  have hsum := ((tendsto_variableCutoffSmoothError_zero hc₀).add
      (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀ hC₀)).add hquot'
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x +
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x +
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
        (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSRange
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSRange
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound x y
        (fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x)
        (Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant
  have hC : 0 ≤ C :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget hc₀ hC₀ hC,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogGap_le_budget J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_two_mul_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hrange hdelta hpred hgap hsmooth htwo hL hA hV
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  let H := fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff
    positivity
  have hquotTwo : 2 ≤ x / H := by
    apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hHpos).2
    simpa only [H] using htwo y T hcutoff hwindow
  intro W hWlow hWhigh
  have hWlowH : x / H ≤ W := by simpa only [H] using hWlow
  have hWpos : 0 < W := by omega
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent_growingCutoff
    (X := W) (Y := y) (c := 1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)
      hWpos hrangeData.1 (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hslack := variableCutoff_slack_mul_scaleL_div_T_le hc₀ hL hA hwindow
  have hcancel := variableCutoffDelta_mul_scaleL hL.le hA.le
    (show T ≠ 0 by
      exact ((mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1).ne')
  have hpredBound := hpred y T W hcutoff hwindow
  have hEuler : smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpredBound
      (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  have hgapBound := hgap y T W hcutoff hwindow
    (by simpa only [H] using hWlow) hWhigh
  have hgapMul : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) ≤
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgapBound hdeltaData.1.le
  have hvariableIdentity :
      variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        (variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x := by
    unfold variableCutoffSmoothError
    dsimp only [C]
    field_simp [hV.ne']
  have hbase : fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
        (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
        variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedBFPSAbelExponent
    calc
      -(1 - (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)) * Real.log W +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C =
        -(variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * scaleL (x : ℝ)) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) := by ring
      _ = -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) / T +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) := by
        rw [hcancel]
        ring
      _ ≤ -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          ((variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
              fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x) +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
        linarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← hvariableIdentity]
  have hdeltaWindow := variableCutoffDelta_le_window_bound hc₀ hA.le hG hwindow
  have hdeltaV : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤
      1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤
          scaleA (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := hdeltaWindow
      _ = 1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
        have hAV := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
        field_simp [hc₀.ne', hA.ne', hG.ne', hV.ne']
        nlinarith
  have hbudget0 : 0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
      fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
    positivity
  have hdeltaBudget : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x ≤
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
        (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeltaV hbudget0
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x ≤
        (1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := this
      _ = fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
          (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by ring
  have hsmoothData := hsmooth T hwindow
  have herrorIdentity :
      (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2)) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    field_simp [hc₀.ne', hV.ne']
  have hexponent : fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
        (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
        fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError
    rw [herrorIdentity]
    calc
      fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
        -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := hbase
      _ ≤ -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
        nlinarith [hdeltaBudget]
      _ ≤ -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
              (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
        have hsmoothNeg : -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤
            -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
              fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
          calc
            -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T =
                -(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
                    fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                      scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
                  fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                    scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
            _ ≤ -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
                  fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                    scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
              add_le_add_left (neg_le_neg hsmoothData) _
        calc
          -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
              variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
              fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) =
            -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
              (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
                fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                  (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by ring
          _ ≤ (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
                fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
              (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
                fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                  (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) :=
            by nlinarith [hsmoothNeg]
          _ = _ := by ring
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent) (Nat.cast_nonneg W)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralLowError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError_zero
      (C₀ := C₀) J hc₀ hC₀).max
    (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0))
  have hmax' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      max (fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x) 0)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa using hmax
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 2 + 1) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hoverheadModel := hconst.add tendsto_fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_div_scaleV_zero
  have hoverhead : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) /
        scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        (Real.log 2 + 1) / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
        atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa only [zero_add] using hoverheadModel
    apply hmodel.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
    field_simp [hV.ne']
    ring
  have hsum := hmax'.add hoverhead
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    max (fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x) 0 +
      (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) /
        scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneral_lowRank_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneral_lowRank_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
          (fixedRankGeneralLowError J c₀ C₀) x T
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSRange
      J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_split_parameters J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTail_le_smoothRate J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hsharp hparams htail hrange hV
  intro h y T _hh _hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hparamsData := hparams y T hcutoff hwindow
  rcases hparamsData with ⟨hx, hy, hK, hYK, hKJ⟩
  have hyThree := (hrange y T hcutoff hwindow).1
  let ρ := fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x
  let B : ℝ := Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
    ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ))
  have hfinite := fixedLowRankShiftedCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
    (X := x) (h := h) (y := y) (Y := y ^ J) (J := J)
    (H := fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x)
    (K := fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff J (y ^ J) x) (B := B)
    hx hy hK hYK hKJ (Real.exp_pos _).le (by
      simpa only [B, ρ] using hsharp y T hcutoff hwindow)
  rw [fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff_sub_one] at hfinite
  have hρmax : ρ ≤ max ρ 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hmaxNonneg : 0 ≤ max ρ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hB : B ≤ Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
      max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold B
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hρmax hV.le)
  have htail' : finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
      (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) x ≤
      Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
        max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    exact (htail y T hcutoff hwindow).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
      have : 0 ≤ max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_nonneg hmaxNonneg hV.le
      linarith))
  have hsum : B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
      (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) x ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
        max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by linarith
  have hyInv : (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
    (inv_le_one₀ (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < y by omega))).2
      (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ y by omega))
  have hmass : Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by gcongr)
  have hcombined :
      (x : ℝ) *
          (B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
            (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) x) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        (x : ℝ) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
            max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) := by
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (Nat.cast_nonneg x))
      hmass (Real.exp_pos _).le
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le))
  have hmain := hfinite.trans hcombined
  have hoverhead :
      (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) /
          scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1 :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
  have hsmoothMajorant : fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T ≤
      fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T := min_le_left _ _
  unfold fixedRankGeneralMajorant fixedRankGeneralLowError
  calc
    (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
            max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) := hmain
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          (max ρ 0 +
            (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) /
              scaleV (x : ℝ)) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [add_mul, hoverhead]
      let A := -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
        max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)
      let M := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1
      calc
        (x : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp M =
            (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (Real.log 2) * Real.exp A) * Real.exp M := by
          rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
        _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (Real.log 2 + A) * Real.exp M := by
          rw [Real.exp_add (Real.log 2) A]
        _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp ((Real.log 2 + A) + M) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add (Real.log 2 + A) M]
          ring
        _ = _ := by
          dsimp only [A, M]
          congr 2
          ring
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T +
          (max ρ 0 +
            (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) /
              scaleV (x : ℝ)) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg x)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralCoreError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralCoreError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralCoreError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hright := (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralHighError_zero J).max
    (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError_zero J)
  have hall := (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowError_zero J hc₀ hC₀).max hright
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    max (fixedRankGeneralLowError J c₀ C₀ x)
      (max (fixedRankGeneralHighError J x)
        (fixedRankGeneralOffDiagonalError J x))) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa using hall

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_add_log_three_div_scaleV_zero
    (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralCoreError_zero J hc₀ hC₀)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralMajorant_mono_error
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralMajorant_mono_error
    {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} {e₁ e₂ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hV : 0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ)) (he : e₁ x ≤ e₂ x) :
    fixedRankGeneralMajorant J e₁ x T ≤
      fixedRankGeneralMajorant J e₂ x T
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralMajorant
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hV)))
    (Nat.cast_nonneg x)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralEstimate_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralEstimate_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    FixedRankGeneralEstimate J c₀ C₀
      (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError_zero J hc₀ hC₀, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [fixedRankGeneral_lowRank_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      fixedRankGeneral_highRank_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      fixedRankGeneral_offDiagonal_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hlow hhigh hoff hV
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  let E := fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
    (fixedRankGeneralCoreError J c₀ C₀) x T
  have hlow' : (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤ E := by
    exact (hlow h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow).trans
      (fixedRankGeneralMajorant_mono_error hV.le (le_max_left _ _))
  have hhigh' : (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤ E := by
    exact (hhigh h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow).trans
      (fixedRankGeneralMajorant_mono_error hV.le
        ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)))
  have hoff' : (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) ≤ E := by
    exact (hoff h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow).trans
      (fixedRankGeneralMajorant_mono_error hV.le
        ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)))
  have hcount := fixedRankGeneral_count_le_diagonal_add_three
    hlow' hhigh' hoff'
  calc
    (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) + 3 * E := hcount
    _ = (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) +
        fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
          (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) x T := by
      dsimp only [E]
      rw [three_mul_fixedRankGeneralMajorant_eq hV]
      rfl

name: RankAmplification.theorem10_13_unconditional
statement:
theorem theorem10_13_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    FixedRankGeneralEstimate J c₀ C₀
      (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀)
proof:
:=
  fixedRankGeneralEstimate_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀

name: RankAmplification.divisors_eq_filter_range_of_le
statement:
private theorem divisors_eq_filter_range_of_le {n N : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hnN : n ≤ N) :
    n.divisors = {d ∈ range N.succ | d ∣ n}
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp only [Nat.mem_divisors, mem_filter, mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hd, -⟩
    exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr ((Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hd).trans hnN), hd⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, hd⟩
    exact ⟨hd, hn⟩

name: RankAmplification.sum_log_eq_mangoldtFloorSum
statement:
theorem sum_log_eq_mangoldtFloorSum (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, Real.log n) = mangoldtFloorSum N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, Real.log n) =
        ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, vonMangoldt d := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      exact ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_sum.symm
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, ∑ d ∈ range N.succ, if d ∣ n then vonMangoldt d else 0 := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := (mem_Ioc.mp hn).1.ne'
      have hnN : n ≤ N := (mem_Ioc.mp hn).2
      rw [divisors_eq_filter_range_of_le hn0 hnN, sum_filter]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ range N.succ, ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, if d ∣ n then vonMangoldt d else 0 := by
      rw [sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ range N.succ,
        ((#{n ∈ Ioc 0 N | d ∣ n} : ℕ) : ℝ) * vonMangoldt d := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [← sum_filter]
      simp
    _ = ∑ d ∈ range N.succ, (N / d : ℕ) * vonMangoldt d := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div]
    _ = mangoldtFloorSum N := by
      rw [mangoldtFloorSum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_log_Ioc_eq_log_factorial
statement:
theorem sum_log_Ioc_eq_log_factorial (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, Real.log n) = Real.log N.factorial
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
      rw [← insert_Ioc_right_eq_Ioc_add_one (Nat.zero_le N), sum_insert]
      · rw [ih, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
        rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      · simp

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtFloorSum_eq_log_factorial
statement:
theorem mangoldtFloorSum_eq_log_factorial (N : ℕ) :
    mangoldtFloorSum N = Real.log N.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_log_eq_mangoldtFloorSum, sum_log_Ioc_eq_log_factorial]

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtFloorSum_eq_sum_Ioc
statement:
theorem mangoldtFloorSum_eq_sum_Ioc (N : ℕ) :
    mangoldtFloorSum N = ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N, vonMangoldt d * (N / d : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hset : range N.succ = insert 0 (Ioc 0 N) := by
    ext d
    simp only [mem_range, mem_insert, mem_Ioc]
    omega
  rw [mangoldtFloorSum, hset, sum_insert (by simp)]
  simp

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtReciprocalTerm_le_floorTerm_add_error
statement:
theorem mangoldtReciprocalTerm_le_floorTerm_add_error
    {N d : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hd : 0 < d) :
    vonMangoldt d / d ≤
      vonMangoldt d * (N / d : ℕ) / N + vonMangoldt d / N
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : ⌊(N : ℝ) / d⌋₊ = N / d := Nat.floor_div_eq_div N d
  have hquot : (N : ℝ) / d < ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
    simpa only [hfloor] using Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((N : ℝ) / d)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ vonMangoldt d / (N : ℝ) :=
    div_nonneg vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N)
  calc
    vonMangoldt d / d =
        (vonMangoldt d / N) * ((N : ℝ) / d) := by
      field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN.ne', Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne']
    _ ≤ (vonMangoldt d / N) * (((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquot.le hnonneg
    _ = vonMangoldt d * (N / d : ℕ) / N + vonMangoldt d / N := by ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_vonMangoldt_Ioc_eq_psi
statement:
theorem sum_vonMangoldt_Ioc_eq_psi (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N, vonMangoldt d) = Chebyshev.psi N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Chebyshev.psi, Nat.floor_natCast]

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_logFactorial_add_psi
statement:
theorem mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_logFactorial_add_psi
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    mangoldtReciprocalSum N ≤
      Real.log N.factorial / N + Chebyshev.psi N / N
proof:
:= by
  rw [mangoldtReciprocalSum]
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N, vonMangoldt d / d) ≤
        ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N,
          (vonMangoldt d * (N / d : ℕ) / N + vonMangoldt d / N) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      exact mangoldtReciprocalTerm_le_floorTerm_add_error hN (mem_Ioc.mp hd).1
    _ = (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N, vonMangoldt d * (N / d : ℕ)) / N +
          (∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N, vonMangoldt d) / N := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_div, sum_div]
    _ = Real.log N.factorial / N + Chebyshev.psi N / N := by
      rw [← mangoldtFloorSum_eq_sum_Ioc, mangoldtFloorSum_eq_log_factorial,
        sum_vonMangoldt_Ioc_eq_psi]

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_log_add_constant
statement:
theorem mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_log_add_constant
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    mangoldtReciprocalSum N ≤ Real.log N + (Real.log 4 + 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hNreal : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hfactPos : 0 < (N.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hfact : Real.log N.factorial ≤ Real.log ((N : ℝ) ^ N) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log hfactPos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow N)
  have hfactNorm : Real.log N.factorial / N ≤ Real.log N := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hNreal).2
    calc
      Real.log N.factorial ≤ Real.log ((N : ℝ) ^ N) := hfact
      _ = (N : ℝ) * Real.log N := Real.log_pow N N
      _ = Real.log N * N := by ring
  have hpsi : Chebyshev.psi N / N ≤ Real.log 4 + 4 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hNreal).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self hNreal.le
  exact (mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_logFactorial_add_psi hN).trans <| by linarith

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtFloorTerm_div_le_reciprocalTerm
statement:
theorem mangoldtFloorTerm_div_le_reciprocalTerm
    {N d : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hd : 0 < d) :
    vonMangoldt d * (N / d : ℕ) / N ≤ vonMangoldt d / d
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : ⌊(N : ℝ) / d⌋₊ = N / d := Nat.floor_div_eq_div N d
  have hquot : (((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (N : ℝ) / d := by
    rw [← hfloor]
    exact Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ vonMangoldt d / (N : ℝ) :=
    div_nonneg vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N)
  calc
    vonMangoldt d * (N / d : ℕ) / N =
        (vonMangoldt d / N) * ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ (vonMangoldt d / N) * ((N : ℝ) / d) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquot hnonneg
    _ = vonMangoldt d / d := by
      field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN.ne', Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne']

name: RankAmplification.logFactorial_div_le_mangoldtReciprocalSum
statement:
theorem logFactorial_div_le_mangoldtReciprocalSum
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    Real.log N.factorial / N ≤ mangoldtReciprocalSum N
proof:
:= by
  rw [mangoldtReciprocalSum, ← mangoldtFloorSum_eq_log_factorial,
    mangoldtFloorSum_eq_sum_Ioc, sum_div]
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro d hd
  exact mangoldtFloorTerm_div_le_reciprocalTerm hN (mem_Ioc.mp hd).1

name: RankAmplification.log_sub_one_le_logFactorial_div
statement:
theorem log_sub_one_le_logFactorial_div {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    Real.log N - 1 ≤ Real.log N.factorial / N
proof:
:= by
  have hNreal : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hlogN : 0 ≤ Real.log (N : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hN)
  have hlogTwoPi : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.pi) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hstirling := Stirling.le_log_factorial_stirling hN.ne'
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hNreal).2
  have hmain : (N : ℝ) * Real.log N - N ≤ Real.log N.factorial := by
    linarith
  calc
    (Real.log N - 1) * N = (N : ℝ) * Real.log N - N := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.log N.factorial := hmain

name: RankAmplification.log_sub_one_le_mangoldtReciprocalSum
statement:
theorem log_sub_one_le_mangoldtReciprocalSum {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    Real.log N - 1 ≤ mangoldtReciprocalSum N
proof:
:=
  (log_sub_one_le_logFactorial_div hN).trans
    (logFactorial_div_le_mangoldtReciprocalSum hN)

name: RankAmplification.one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant
statement: theorem one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant : 1 ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have : 0 ≤ Real.log (4 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.abs_mangoldtReciprocalSum_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_mangoldtReciprocalSum_sub_log_le
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    |mangoldtReciprocalSum N - Real.log N| ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have hlower := log_sub_one_le_mangoldtReciprocalSum hN
    have hC := one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant
    linarith
  · simpa [sharpMangoldtMertensConstant, sub_le_iff_le_add, add_comm] using
      mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_log_add_constant hN

name: RankAmplification.primeLogReciprocalSum_le_log_add_sharpConstant
statement:
theorem primeLogReciprocalSum_le_log_add_sharpConstant
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    primeLogReciprocalSum N ≤ Real.log N + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : Nat.primesLE N ⊆ Ioc 0 N := by
    intro p hp
    exact mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨(Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).pos,
      Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hp⟩
  calc
    primeLogReciprocalSum N =
        ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE N, vonMangoldt p / p := by
      rw [primeLogReciprocalSum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime
        (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)]
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 N, vonMangoldt d / d := by
      apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro d hd hnot
      exact div_nonneg vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
    _ = mangoldtReciprocalSum N := rfl
    _ ≤ Real.log N + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant := by
      simpa [sharpMangoldtMertensConstant] using
        mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_log_add_constant hN

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtRankinMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem mangoldtRankinMajorant_nonneg (R : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ mangoldtRankinMajorant R δ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mangoldtRankinMajorant]
  apply sum_nonneg
  intro n hn
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp
  exact mul_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
      (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n)))
    (div_nonneg vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_mangoldtRankinMajorant
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_mangoldtRankinMajorant
    {R : ℕ} (δ : ℝ) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤ mangoldtRankinMajorant R δ
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : Nat.primesLE R ⊆ Icc 0 R := by
    intro p hp
    exact mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.zero_le p, Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hp⟩
  rw [primeRankinSum, mangoldtRankinMajorant]
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ)) =
        ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
          ((p : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log p) * (vonMangoldt p / p) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp
      have hpPos : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
      have hlog : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
        (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_lt)).ne'
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hpPrime]
      rw [show -1 + δ = δ - 1 by ring, Real.rpow_sub_one hpPos.ne']
      field_simp
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Icc 0 R,
          ((n : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log n) * (vonMangoldt n / n) := by
      apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro n hn hnot
      rcases n with _ | n
      · simp
      exact mul_nonneg
        (div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
          (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n)))
        (div_nonneg vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: RankAmplification.sum_mangoldtReciprocal_Icc
statement:
private theorem sum_mangoldtReciprocal_Icc (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Icc 0 N, vonMangoldt n / n) = mangoldtReciprocalSum N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_sum_Ioc_eq_sum_Icc (f := fun n ↦ vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ)) (Nat.zero_le N)]
  simp [mangoldtReciprocalSum]

name: RankAmplification.integrableOn_deriv_rpow_div_log
statement:
theorem integrableOn_deriv_rpow_div_log (δ R : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (deriv fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ δ / Real.log t) (Set.Icc 2 R) volume
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ContinuousWithinAt.congr
    (f := fun x : ℝ ↦
      x ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log x - 1) / Real.log x ^ 2)
    (g := deriv fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) ?_ (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.log_pos (by linarith [ht.1])).ne'
    have hrpow : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (δ - 1)) t :=
      continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl ht0)
    have hnum : ContinuousAt
        (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log x - 1)) t := by
      fun_prop
    have hden : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.log x ^ 2) t :=
      (Real.continuousAt_log ht0).pow 2
    have hden0 : Real.log t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hlog
    exact (hnum.div hden hden0).continuousWithinAt
  · exact deriv_rpow_div_log (by linarith [hx.1])
  · exact deriv_rpow_div_log (by linarith [ht.1])

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtRankinMajorant_eq_abel
statement:
theorem mangoldtRankinMajorant_eq_abel
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    mangoldtRankinMajorant R δ =
      ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) * mangoldtReciprocalSum R -
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
            mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ vonMangoldt n / n
  rw [mangoldtRankinMajorant]
  change (∑ n ∈ Icc 0 R, ((n : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log n) * a n) = _
  nth_rewrite 1 [← Nat.floor_natCast (R := ℝ) R]
  rw [sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₁ (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ δ / Real.log t) a
      (by simp [a]) (by simp [a]) R,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (mod_cast hR)]
  · rw [Nat.floor_natCast, sum_mangoldtReciprocal_Icc]
    apply congrArg₂ (· - ·) rfl
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    change deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
        (∑ k ∈ Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, vonMangoldt k / k) = _
    rw [sum_mangoldtReciprocal_Icc]
  · intro t ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.log_pos (by linarith [ht.1])).ne'
    exact ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl ht0)).div
      (Real.hasDerivAt_log ht0) hlog).differentiableAt
  · exact integrableOn_deriv_rpow_div_log δ R

name: RankAmplification.abs_log_floor_sub_log_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_log_floor_sub_log_le_one {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    |Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) - Real.log t| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfloorPos : 0 < ⌊t⌋₊ := Nat.floor_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hfloorRealPos : 0 < (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hfloorPos
  have hfloorLe : (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ t := Nat.floor_le (by linarith)
  have hlogLe : Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log t :=
    Real.log_le_log hfloorRealPos hfloorLe
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hlogLe)]
  have htLt : t < (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one t
  have hfloorOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊t⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast hfloorPos
  have htTwoFloor : t ≤ 2 * (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlogUpper : Real.log t ≤ Real.log (2 * (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by linarith) htTwoFloor
  have hlogMul : Real.log (2 * (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ)) =
      Real.log 2 + Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hfloorRealPos.ne']
  have hlogTwo : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)]
  rw [hlogMul] at hlogUpper
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.abs_mangoldtReciprocalSum_floor_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_mangoldtReciprocalSum_floor_sub_log_le
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    |mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t| ≤
      sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfloorPos : 0 < ⌊t⌋₊ := Nat.floor_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  calc
    |mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t| =
        |(mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ)) +
          (Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) - Real.log t)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ)| +
          |Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) - Real.log t| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := add_le_add
      (abs_mangoldtReciprocalSum_sub_log_le hfloorPos)
      (abs_log_floor_sub_log_le_one ht)

name: RankAmplification.differentiableAt_rpow_div_log
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_rpow_div_log {δ t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans ht).ne'
  have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos ht).ne'
  exact ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl ht0)).div
    (Real.hasDerivAt_log ht0) hlog).differentiableAt

name: RankAmplification.intervalIntegrable_deriv_rpow_div_log
proof:
:= by
  have hright : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, 1 < t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at ht
    rcases ht with ht | ht <;> linarith
  refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousWithinAt.congr
    (f := fun x : ℝ ↦
      x ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log x - 1) / Real.log x ^ 2)
    (g := deriv fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) ?_ (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · have ht1 := hright t ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans ht1).ne'
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos ht1).ne'
    have hrpow : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (δ - 1)) t :=
      continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl ht0)
    have hnum : ContinuousAt
        (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log x - 1)) t := by
      fun_prop
    have hden : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.log x ^ 2) t :=
      (Real.continuousAt_log ht0).pow 2
    exact (hnum.div hden (pow_ne_zero 2 hlog)).continuousWithinAt
  · exact deriv_rpow_div_log (hright x hx)
  · exact deriv_rpow_div_log (hright t ht)

name: RankAmplification.integral_deriv_rpow_div_log_eq_sub
statement:
theorem integral_deriv_rpow_div_log_eq_sub {δ a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 1 < b) :
    (∫ t in a..b, deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t) =
      b ^ δ / Real.log b - a ^ δ / Real.log a
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub
  · intro t ht
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at ht
    exact differentiableAt_rpow_div_log (by rcases ht with ht | ht <;> linarith)
  · exact intervalIntegrable_deriv_rpow_div_log ha hb

name: RankAmplification.deriv_rpow_div_log_nonpos_before_turn
statement:
theorem deriv_rpow_div_log_nonpos_before_turn
    {δ t : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (ht : 1 < t)
    (hturn : t ≤ Real.exp (1 / δ)) :
    deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_rpow_div_log ht]
  have hlog : Real.log t ≤ 1 / δ := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (zero_lt_one.trans ht) hturn
    simpa using this
  have hlinear : δ * Real.log t - 1 ≤ 0 := by
    apply sub_nonpos.mpr
    simpa [mul_comm] using (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mp hlog
  exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
    (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_lt_one.trans ht).le _) hlinear)
    (sq_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.deriv_rpow_div_log_nonneg_after_turn
statement:
theorem deriv_rpow_div_log_nonneg_after_turn
    {δ t : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (ht : 1 < t)
    (hturn : Real.exp (1 / δ) ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_rpow_div_log ht]
  have hlog : 1 / δ ≤ Real.log t := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos (1 / δ)) hturn
    simpa using this
  have hlinear : 0 ≤ δ * Real.log t - 1 := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    simpa [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp hlog
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_lt_one.trans ht).le _) hlinear)
    (sq_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.integral_abs_deriv_rpow_div_log_le_endpoints
statement:
theorem integral_abs_deriv_rpow_div_log_le_endpoints
    {δ R : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
      |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 + R ^ δ / Real.log R
proof:
:= by
  let T : ℝ := Real.exp (1 / δ)
  have hTOne : 1 < T := by
    change 1 < Real.exp (1 / δ)
    rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
    positivity
  have hROne : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hfTwo : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 :=
    div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)).le
  have hfR : 0 ≤ R ^ δ / Real.log R :=
    div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (Real.log_pos hROne).le
  by_cases hTTwo : T ≤ 2
  · have habseq :
        (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|) =
          ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
            deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR] at ht
      change |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| = _
      rw [abs_of_nonneg]
      exact deriv_rpow_div_log_nonneg_after_turn hδ (by linarith [ht.1])
        (hTTwo.trans ht.1)
    rw [habseq, integral_deriv_rpow_div_log_eq_sub (by norm_num) hROne]
    linarith
  · have hTwoT : 2 < T := lt_of_not_ge hTTwo
    by_cases hRT : R ≤ T
    · have habseq :
          (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
            |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|) =
            ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
              -deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR] at ht
        change |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| = _
        rw [abs_of_nonpos]
        exact deriv_rpow_div_log_nonpos_before_turn hδ (by linarith [ht.1])
          (ht.2.trans hRT)
      rw [habseq, intervalIntegral.integral_neg,
        integral_deriv_rpow_div_log_eq_sub (by norm_num) hROne]
      linarith
    · have hTR : T < R := lt_of_not_ge hRT
      have hintAbsTwoT : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun t : ℝ ↦ |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|)
          volume 2 T := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          (intervalIntegrable_deriv_rpow_div_log (δ := δ) (by norm_num) hTOne).norm
      have hintAbsTR : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun t : ℝ ↦ |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|)
          volume T R := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          (intervalIntegrable_deriv_rpow_div_log (δ := δ) hTOne hROne).norm
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hintAbsTwoT hintAbsTR]
      have hleft :
          (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..T,
            |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|) =
            -∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..T,
              deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTwoT.le] at ht
        change |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| = _
        rw [abs_of_nonpos]
        exact deriv_rpow_div_log_nonpos_before_turn hδ (by linarith [ht.1]) ht.2
      have hright :
          (∫ t in T..R,
            |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|) =
            ∫ t in T..R,
              deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTR.le] at ht
        change |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| = _
        rw [abs_of_nonneg]
        exact deriv_rpow_div_log_nonneg_after_turn hδ (by linarith [ht.1]) ht.1
      rw [hleft, hright,
        integral_deriv_rpow_div_log_eq_sub (by norm_num) hTOne,
        integral_deriv_rpow_div_log_eq_sub hTOne hROne]
      have hfT : 0 ≤ T ^ δ / Real.log T :=
        div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hTOne.le) _)
          (Real.log_pos hTOne).le
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.deriv_rpow_div_log_mul_log
statement:
theorem deriv_rpow_div_log_mul_log {δ t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) :
    deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t * Real.log t =
      δ * t ^ (δ - 1) - t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_rpow_div_log ht]
  have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos ht).ne'
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.rpowLogWeight_mainTerm_eq
statement:
theorem rpowLogWeight_mainTerm_eq
    {δ R : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    (R ^ δ / Real.log R) * Real.log R -
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t * Real.log t =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ + rankinLogIntegral δ R
proof:
:= by
  have hROne : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hlogR : Real.log R ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos hROne).ne'
  have hpowInt : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ δ * t ^ (δ - 1)) volume 2 R := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR] at ht
    exact continuousAt_const.mul <|
      continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl <| by
        simpa only [id_eq] using (show t ≠ 0 by linarith [ht.1]))
  have hkernelInt : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) volume 2 R :=
    intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (by norm_num) hR
  have hintCongr :
      (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
        deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t * Real.log t) =
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          (δ * t ^ (δ - 1) - t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR] at ht
    exact deriv_rpow_div_log_mul_log (by linarith [ht.1])
  rw [hintCongr, intervalIntegral.integral_sub hpowInt hkernelInt,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith))]
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  have hδne : δ ≠ 0 := hδ.ne'
  have hboundary : (R ^ δ / Real.log R) * Real.log R = R ^ δ := by
    field_simp
  rw [hboundary]
  ring_nf
  field_simp [hδne]
  norm_num

name: RankAmplification.intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_mangoldtFloor
statement:
private theorem intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_mangoldtFloor
    {δ R : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
        mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊) volume 2 R
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hR]
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ vonMangoldt n / n
  have hint := integrableOn_mul_sum_Icc (c := a) (m := 0) (a := (2 : ℝ))
    (b := R) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    (integrableOn_deriv_rpow_div_log δ R)
  refine hint.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Icc
  intro t ht
  change deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
      (∑ k ∈ Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, vonMangoldt k / k) =
    deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
      mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊
  rw [sum_mangoldtReciprocal_Icc]

name: RankAmplification.intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_log
statement:
private theorem intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_log
    {δ R : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t * Real.log t)
      volume 2 R
proof:
:= by
  have hd := intervalIntegrable_deriv_rpow_div_log (δ := δ) (a := (2 : ℝ))
    (b := R) (by norm_num) (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR)
  apply hd.mul_continuousOn
  intro t ht
  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR] at ht
  exact (Real.continuousAt_log (by linarith [ht.1])).continuousWithinAt

name: RankAmplification.intervalIntegrable_weightedMertensError
statement:
private theorem intervalIntegrable_weightedMertensError
    {δ R : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
        (mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t)) volume 2 R
proof:
:= by
  have hA := intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_mangoldtFloor (δ := δ) hR
  have hlog := intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_log (δ := δ) hR
  convert hA.sub hlog using 1
  ext t
  ring

name: RankAmplification.mangoldtRankinMajorant_sub_mainTerm_eq_error
statement:
theorem mangoldtRankinMajorant_sub_mainTerm_eq_error
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    mangoldtRankinMajorant R δ -
        (((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) * Real.log R -
          ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
            deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t * Real.log t) =
      ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) *
          (mangoldtReciprocalSum R - Real.log R) -
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
            (mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_mangoldtFloor (δ := δ) (R := (R : ℝ))
    (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  have hlog := intervalIntegrable_deriv_mul_log (δ := δ) (R := (R : ℝ))
    (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  rw [mangoldtRankinMajorant_eq_abel hR]
  have hsplit :
      (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
        deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
          (mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t)) =
        (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
            mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊) -
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t * Real.log t := by
    rw [show (fun t : ℝ ↦ deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
        (mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t)) =
      (fun t : ℝ ↦
        deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
            mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ -
          deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t * Real.log t) by
        funext t; ring]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub hA hlog
  rw [hsplit]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ + rankinLogIntegral δ R +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 + 2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R))
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℝ := sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1
  let fR : ℝ := (R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R
  let fTwo : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2
  let err : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
      (mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t)
