  have hRreal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hR
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by
    dsimp [D]
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have hfR : 0 ≤ fR := by
    dsimp [fR]
    exact div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
      (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega))).le
  have hfTwo : 0 ≤ fTwo := by
    dsimp [fTwo]
    positivity
  have hEndpoint :
      |mangoldtReciprocalSum R - Real.log R| ≤ D := by
    dsimp [D]
    exact (abs_mangoldtReciprocalSum_sub_log_le (by omega : 0 < R)).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one)
  have hErrInt := intervalIntegrable_weightedMertensError (δ := δ) hRreal
  have hDerivAbs : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|)
      volume 2 R := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (intervalIntegrable_deriv_rpow_div_log (δ := δ) (by norm_num)
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hRreal)).norm
  have hPointwise (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (2 : ℝ) (R : ℝ)) :
      |err t| ≤ D * |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| := by
    have hEt := abs_mangoldtReciprocalSum_floor_sub_log_le ht.1
    change |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t *
      (mangoldtReciprocalSum ⌊t⌋₊ - Real.log t)| ≤ _
    rw [abs_mul]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t)]
  have hIntegralAbs :
      |∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, err t| ≤
        D * ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| := by
    calc
      |∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, err t| ≤ ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, |err t| :=
        intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hRreal
      _ ≤ ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          D * |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hRreal hErrInt.abs
          (hDerivAbs.const_mul D)
        exact hPointwise
      _ = D * ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| :=
        by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hVariation :
      (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
        |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t|) ≤ fTwo + fR := by
    simpa [fTwo, fR] using
      integral_abs_deriv_rpow_div_log_le_endpoints hδ hRreal
  have hErrorUpper :
      fR * (mangoldtReciprocalSum R - Real.log R) -
          ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, err t ≤ D * (fTwo + 2 * fR) := by
    have hboundary :
        fR * (mangoldtReciprocalSum R - Real.log R) ≤ fR * D := by
      calc
        fR * (mangoldtReciprocalSum R - Real.log R) ≤
            fR * |mangoldtReciprocalSum R - Real.log R| := by
          gcongr
          exact le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ fR * D := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEndpoint hfR
    have hintegral :
        -(∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, err t) ≤ D * (fTwo + fR) := by
      calc
        -(∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, err t) ≤ |∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, err t| :=
          neg_le_abs _
        _ ≤ D * ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
            |deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t| := hIntegralAbs
        _ ≤ D * (fTwo + fR) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hVariation hD
    linarith
  have hmajorant := primeRankinSum_le_mangoldtRankinMajorant (R := R) δ
  have hdecomp := mangoldtRankinMajorant_sub_mainTerm_eq_error (R := R)
    (δ := δ) hR
  have hmain := rpowLogWeight_mainTerm_eq hδ hRreal
  dsimp [err] at hErrorUpper
  dsimp [fR, fTwo, D] at hErrorUpper ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_le_endpoint_mul_loglog
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_le_endpoint_mul_loglog
    {δ B : ℝ} (hB : 2 ≤ B) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    rankinLogIntegral δ B ≤
      B ^ δ * (Real.log (Real.log B) - Real.log (Real.log 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hBone : (1 : ℝ) < B := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hB
  have hBpos : 0 < B := zero_lt_one.trans hBone
  have hleft := intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := δ) (by norm_num) hB
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦
      B ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t)) volume 2 B := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hB] at ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos (by linarith [ht.1])).ne'
    exact continuousAt_const.mul <|
      (continuousAt_id.inv₀ htpos.ne').div (Real.continuousAt_log htpos.ne') hlog
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  calc
    (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..B, B ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hB hleft hright
      intro t ht
      have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [ht.1]
      have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos (by linarith [ht.1])
      have htpow : t ^ δ ≤ B ^ δ :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow htpos.le ht.2 hδ
      have hq : 0 ≤ t⁻¹ / Real.log t :=
        div_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr htpos.le) hlogpos.le
      calc
        t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t = t ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub_one htpos.ne']
          field_simp
        _ ≤ B ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htpow hq
    _ = B ^ δ *
        (Real.log (Real.log B) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_inv_div_log (by norm_num) hBone]

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_tail_le_parameter
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_tail_le_parameter
    {δ A B q : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hA : 1 < A) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqA : q ≤ δ * Real.log A) :
    (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
      (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * (B ^ δ / Real.log B)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ t ^ δ / Real.log t
  let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    t ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log t - 1) / Real.log t ^ 2
  have hleft := intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := δ) hA hAB
  have hg'int : IntervalIntegrable g' volume A B := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hAB] at ht
    have htone : 1 < t := hA.trans_le ht.1
    have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos htone).ne'
    dsimp [g']
    exact ((continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl htpos.ne')).mul
      (continuousAt_const.mul (Real.continuousAt_log htpos.ne') |>.sub continuousAt_const)).div
        ((Real.continuousAt_log htpos.ne').pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hlog)
  have hcoeff : 0 < q / (δ * (q - 1)) := by positivity
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t ↦ (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * g' t) volume A B :=
    hg'int.const_mul _
  have hmono : (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
      ∫ t in A..B, (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * g' t := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hAB hleft hright
    intro t ht
    have htone : 1 < t := hA.trans_le ht.1
    have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
    have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos htone
    have hlogle : Real.log A ≤ Real.log t :=
      Real.log_le_log (zero_lt_one.trans hA) ht.1
    have hqt : q ≤ δ * Real.log t :=
      hqA.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogle hδ.le)
    have hpowpos : 0 < t ^ (δ - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos htpos _
    dsimp [g']
    have hden : 0 < δ * (q - 1) := mul_pos hδ (sub_pos.mpr hq)
    have hcore : Real.log t ≤
        (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * (δ * Real.log t - 1) := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).2
      nlinarith
    have hscale : 0 ≤ t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t ^ 2 :=
      div_nonneg hpowpos.le (sq_nonneg _)
    calc
      t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t =
          (t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t ^ 2) * Real.log t := by
        field_simp [hlogpos.ne']
      _ ≤ (t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t ^ 2) *
          ((q / (δ * (q - 1))) * (δ * Real.log t - 1)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcore hscale
      _ = (q / (δ * (q - 1))) *
          (t ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log t - 1) / Real.log t ^ 2) := by ring
  have hfund : (∫ t in A..B, g' t) = g B - g A := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hAB] at ht
      have htone : 1 < t := hA.trans_le ht.1
      have hdiffer := differentiableAt_rpow_div_log (δ := δ) htone
      dsimp [g, g']
      rw [← deriv_rpow_div_log htone]
      exact hdiffer.hasDerivAt
    · exact hg'int
  have hgA : 0 ≤ g A := by
    dsimp [g]
    exact div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hA.le) _)
      (Real.log_pos hA).le
  calc
    (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        ∫ t in A..B, (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * g' t := hmono
    _ = (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * (g B - g A) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hfund]
    _ ≤ (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * g B := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_self _ hgA) hcoeff.le
    _ = (q / (δ * (q - 1))) * (B ^ δ / Real.log B) := rfl

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_le_sqrt_split
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_le_sqrt_split
    {δ R : ℝ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log R) :
    rankinLogIntegral δ R ≤
      (Real.sqrt R) ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt R)) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ := Real.sqrt R
  let q : ℝ := δ * Real.log R / 2
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hROne : 1 < R := by linarith
  have hA2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ A := by
    dsimp [A]
    have hsquare : (Real.sqrt R) ^ 2 = R := Real.sq_sqrt hRpos.le
    have hsnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt R := Real.sqrt_nonneg R
    nlinarith
  have hAOne : 1 < A := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hA2
  have hAR : A ≤ R := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_self_iff.mpr (Or.inr hROne.le)
  have hlogA : Real.log A = Real.log R / 2 := by
    dsimp [A]
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hRpos.le]
  have hq : 1 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    linarith
  have hqA : q ≤ δ * Real.log A := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [hlogA]
    ring_nf
    exact le_rfl
  have hlow := rankinLogIntegral_le_endpoint_mul_loglog hA2 hδ.le
  have htail := rankinLogIntegral_tail_le_parameter hδ hAOne hAR hq hqA
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hROne
  have hphaseDen : 0 < δ * Real.log R - 2 := by linarith
  have htail' :
      (∫ t in A..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2) := by
    apply htail.trans_eq
    dsimp [q]
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hlogR.ne', hphaseDen.ne']
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  calc
    (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) =
        (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..A, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) +
          ∫ t in A..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t := by
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (by norm_num) hA2)
        (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel hAOne hAR)).symm
    _ ≤ A ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log A) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2) := add_le_add hlow htail'
    _ = (Real.sqrt R) ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt R)) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2) := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens_sqrtSplit
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens_sqrtSplit
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log R) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ +
        ((Real.sqrt R) ^ δ *
            (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt R)) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2)) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
            2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R))
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens (R := R) (δ := δ) (by omega) hδ
  have hintegral := rankinLogIntegral_le_sqrt_split
    (R := (R : ℝ)) (δ := δ) (by exact_mod_cast hR) hδ hphase
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.neg_log_one_sub_le_self_add_quadratic
statement:
theorem neg_log_one_sub_le_self_add_quadratic
    {q ρ : ℝ} (hqρ : q ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) :
    -Real.log (1 - q) ≤ q + q ^ 2 / (1 - ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 : q < 1 := hqρ.trans_lt hρ1
  have hdenq : 0 < 1 - q := sub_pos.mpr hq1
  have hdenρ : 0 < 1 - ρ := sub_pos.mpr hρ1
  calc
    -Real.log (1 - q) ≤ q / (1 - q) := neg_log_one_sub_le_div hq1
    _ = q + q ^ 2 / (1 - q) := by
      field_simp [hdenq.ne']
      ring
    _ ≤ q + q ^ 2 / (1 - ρ) := by
      exact add_le_add le_rfl <| (div_le_div_iff₀ hdenq hdenρ).2 <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hqρ 1) (sq_nonneg q)

name: RankAmplification.sum_rankinEulerRatio_sq_le_three
statement:
theorem sum_rankinEulerRatio_sq_le_three
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ^ 2) ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ Nat.primesLE R) :
      rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ^ 2 ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt.le
    rw [rankinEulerRatio, ← Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg p)]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hp1
    norm_num
    linarith
  have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
    summable_naturalPSeries (by norm_num)
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
      hsum.sum_le_tsum (Nat.primesLE R) (fun n _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) _)
    _ = naturalPSeries (3 / 2) := rfl
    _ ≤ 3 := by
      have h := naturalPSeries_le (3 / 2) (by norm_num)
      norm_num at h ⊢
      exact h

name: RankAmplification.sharpEulerQuadraticConstant_pos
statement: theorem sharpEulerQuadraticConstant_pos : 0 < sharpEulerQuadraticConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [sharpEulerQuadraticConstant]
  exact div_pos (by norm_num) (sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.log_softenedMertensProduct_le_primeRankinSum_add_quadraticConstant
statement:
theorem log_softenedMertensProduct_le_primeRankinSum_add_quadraticConstant
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    Real.log (softenedMertensProduct R (1 - δ)) ≤
      primeRankinSum R δ + sharpEulerQuadraticConstant
proof:
:= by
  let ρ : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ))
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := by linarith
  have hρ1 : ρ < 1 := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hP : ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, 1 < p := fun p hp ↦
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt
  have hlocal (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ Nat.primesLE R) :
      -Real.log (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ)) ≤
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) +
          rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ^ 2 / (1 - ρ) := by
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast Nat.two_le_of_mem_primesLE hp
    have hqρ : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ≤ ρ := by
      rw [rankinEulerRatio]
      calc
        (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hp2 (by linarith)
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        _ = ρ := rfl
    exact neg_log_one_sub_le_self_add_quadratic hqρ hρ1
  rw [softenedMertensProduct_eq_rankinEulerMajorant,
    log_rankinEulerMajorant hP hs]
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, -Real.log (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ))) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
          (rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) +
            rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ^ 2 / (1 - ρ)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hlocal
    _ = primeRankinSum R δ +
        (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ^ 2) / (1 - ρ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div, primeRankinSum]
      simp_rw [rankinEulerRatio]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring_nf
    _ ≤ primeRankinSum R δ + 3 / (1 - ρ) := by
      exact add_le_add le_rfl <| div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (sum_rankinEulerRatio_sq_le_three hδ) (sub_pos.mpr hρ1).le
    _ = primeRankinSum R δ + sharpEulerQuadraticConstant := by
      rfl

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR
statement:
theorem hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR
    {R H : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) :
    hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log R =
      Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))
proof:
:= by
  have hlogR : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).ne'
  rw [hildebrandSaddleShift]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.rpow_hildebrandSaddleShift_eq_u_mul_logU
statement:
theorem rpow_hildebrandSaddleShift_eq_u_mul_logU
    {R H : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) :
    (R : ℝ) ^ hildebrandSaddleShift H R =
      rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)
proof:
:= by
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlogR : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).ne'
  have hu0 : 0 < rankinU H R := zero_lt_one.trans hu
  have hlogU : 0 < Real.log (rankinU H R) := Real.log_pos hu
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hRpos, hildebrandSaddleShift]
  have hexponent :
      Real.log (R : ℝ) *
          ((Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))) /
            Real.log R) =
        Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R)) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hexponent, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hu0, Real.exp_log hlogU]

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandSaddle_tail_le_rankinU
statement:
theorem hildebrandSaddle_tail_le_rankinU
    {R H : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (hu : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ rankinU H R) :
    (R : ℝ) ^ hildebrandSaddleShift H R /
        (hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log R - 2) ≤
      rankinU H R
proof:
:= by
  have huExp : Real.exp 2 ≤ Real.log (rankinU H R) :=
    le_log_of_exp_le hu
  have hloglogU : 2 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R)) :=
    le_log_of_exp_le huExp
  have huOne : 1 < rankinU H R := by
    have hexpTwoPos : 0 < Real.exp 2 := Real.exp_pos 2
    have honeExpExp : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 2) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact hexpTwoPos
    exact honeExpExp.trans_le hu
  have hlogU : 0 < Real.log (rankinU H R) := Real.log_pos huOne
  have hden : 0 <
      Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R)) - 2 := by
    linarith
  rw [rpow_hildebrandSaddleShift_eq_u_mul_logU hR huOne,
    hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR hR]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ rankinU H R := (zero_lt_one.trans huOne).le
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.log_softenedMertensProduct_le_rankinU_add_sharpRemainder
statement:
theorem log_softenedMertensProduct_le_rankinU_add_sharpRemainder
    {R H : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hδ : hildebrandSaddleShift H R ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hu : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ rankinU H R) :
    Real.log
        (softenedMertensProduct R (1 - hildebrandSaddleShift H R)) ≤
      rankinU H R + sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder R H
proof:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ := hildebrandSaddleShift H R
  have hRone : 1 < R := by omega
  have huExp : Real.exp 2 ≤ Real.log (rankinU H R) := le_log_of_exp_le hu
  have hloglogU : 2 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R)) :=
    le_log_of_exp_le huExp
  have hexpTwo : 3 ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 : ℝ)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log R := by
    change 4 ≤ hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log R
    rw [hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR hRone]
    linarith
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hRone)
    change 0 < hildebrandSaddleShift H R
    rw [hildebrandSaddleShift]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) hlogR
  have hδ' : δ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    change hildebrandSaddleShift H R ≤ 1 / 4
    exact hδ
  have heuler :=
    log_softenedMertensProduct_le_primeRankinSum_add_quadraticConstant
      (R := R) (δ := δ) hδ'
  have hprime := primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens_sqrtSplit
    (R := R) (δ := δ) hR hδpos hphase
  have htail := hildebrandSaddle_tail_le_rankinU (R := R) (H := H) hRone hu
  have hδeq : δ = hildebrandSaddleShift H R := rfl
  rw [hδeq] at heuler hprime
  rw [sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.section4MertensFactor_nonneg
statement:
theorem section4MertensFactor_nonneg (P : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ section4MertensFactor P
proof:
:= by
  unfold section4MertensFactor
  by_cases hP : P = 0
  · simp [hP, (Real.exp_pos (4 * Real.log 4)).le]
  · exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le
      (add_nonneg zero_le_one (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hP))))

name: RankAmplification.finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_endpoint
statement:
theorem finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_endpoint
    {p X P : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hpP : p ≤ P) :
    finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X ≤
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * section4MertensFactor P
proof:
:= by
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p by omega)
  have hlog : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (P : ℝ) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log hpPos (by exact_mod_cast hpP)
  calc
    finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X ≤
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log p)) :=
      finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_log p X hp
    _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * section4MertensFactor P := by
      unfold section4MertensFactor
      gcongr

name: RankAmplification.smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_endpoint_sq
statement:
theorem smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_endpoint_sq
    {p X P : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hpP : p ≤ P) :
    smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum p X ≤
      (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) * (section4MertensFactor P) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hfiniteNonneg : 0 ≤ finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X := by
    unfold finiteProviderReciprocalSum
    positivity
  have hendNonneg : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * section4MertensFactor P :=
    mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg p)) (section4MertensFactor_nonneg P)
  have hsquare : (finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X) ^ 2 ≤
      ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ * section4MertensFactor P) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_endpoint (X := X) hp hpP]
  calc
    smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum p X ≤
        (finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X) ^ 2 :=
      smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_sq p X
    _ ≤ ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ * section4MertensFactor P) ^ 2 := hsquare
    _ = (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) * (section4MertensFactor P) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow]

name: RankAmplification.section4ReciprocalSum_le
statement:
theorem section4ReciprocalSum_le {x y : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    section4ReciprocalSum x y ≤
      (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  calc
    section4ReciprocalSum x y ≤
        (x : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y,
          ((((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
            (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2) := by
      unfold section4ReciprocalSum
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpData := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hp
      exact smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_endpoint_sq
        (by omega) hpData.2.1
    _ = (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
        ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      have hsum :
          (∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y,
            (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
              (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2) =
            (∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) *
              (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [hsum]
      ring
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
        (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv (by omega)
          (section5_y_le_sqrt_ambient hxy))
      exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg x) hfactor

name: RankAmplification.nonsquare_outer_sum_eq_section4_add_B4
statement:
theorem nonsquare_outer_sum_eq_section4_add_B4 (x y : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
      smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)) =
      section4ReciprocalSum x y + smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y
proof:
:= by
  simpa [section4ReciprocalSum, section5PrimeRange, section5Ambient,
    section5LocalCutoff] using sum_smoothProviderPairMajorant_eq_reciprocal_add_B4 x y

name: RankAmplification.nonsquare_outer_sum_le
statement:
theorem nonsquare_outer_sum_le {x y : ℕ} {saving : ℝ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hRankin : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving) :
    (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
      smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) +
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsquare_outer_sum_eq_section4_add_B4]
  simpa only [add_assoc] using
    add_le_add (section4ReciprocalSum_le hy hxy)
      (smoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_exp_add_upper (by omega) hxy hRankin)

name: RankAmplification.theorem1_6_with_section5_rankin
statement:
theorem theorem1_6_with_section5_rankin {x h y : ℕ} {saving : ℝ}
    (hodd : Odd h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hRankin : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
        ((x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
          2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) +
          2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine (theorem1_6_exact_finite_expanded hodd (by omega) hhy).trans ?_
  have houter := nonsquare_outer_sum_le hy hxy hRankin
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.prod_eulerFactor_eq_div
statement:
theorem prod_eulerFactor_eq_div (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime) :
    (∏ p ∈ s, (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹)) = (eulerNumerator s : ℚ) / eulerDenominator s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [eulerNumerator, eulerDenominator, Nat.cast_prod, Nat.cast_prod]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ s, (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹)) =
        ∏ p ∈ s, ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hpprime := hs p hp
      have hpQ : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hpprime.ne_zero
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hpprime.one_le]
      field_simp [hpQ]
      norm_num
    _ = (∏ p ∈ s, ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) / ∏ p ∈ s, (p : ℚ) :=
      Finset.prod_div_distrib (s := s) _ _

name: RankAmplification.euler_products_cross_eq_of_totient_cross_eq
statement:
theorem euler_products_cross_eq_of_totient_cross_eq {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hcross : a.totient * b = b.totient * a) :
    eulerNumerator (primeSupport a) * eulerDenominator (primeSupport b) =
      eulerNumerator (primeSupport b) * eulerDenominator (primeSupport a)
proof:
:= by
  have hcrossQ : (a.totient : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (b.totient : ℚ) * (a : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcross
  have hratio : (a.totient : ℚ) / a = (b.totient : ℚ) / b :=
    (div_eq_div_iff (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr ha) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hb)).mpr hcrossQ
  rw [Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors, Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr ha),
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hb)] at hratio
  have hprimeA : ∀ p ∈ primeSupport a, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  have hprimeB : ∀ p ∈ primeSupport b, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  rw [prod_eulerFactor_eq_div (primeSupport a) hprimeA,
    prod_eulerFactor_eq_div (primeSupport b) hprimeB] at hratio
  have hdenA : eulerDenominator (primeSupport a) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eulerDenominator]
    exact (Finset.prod_pos fun p hp ↦ (hprimeA p hp).pos).ne'
  have hdenB : eulerDenominator (primeSupport b) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eulerDenominator]
    exact (Finset.prod_pos fun p hp ↦ (hprimeB p hp).pos).ne'
  have hcrossQ' :=
    (div_eq_div_iff (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hdenA) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hdenB)).mp hratio
  exact_mod_cast hcrossQ'

name: RankAmplification.max_mem_both_of_euler_products_cross_eq
statement:
theorem max_mem_both_of_euler_products_cross_eq (S T : Finset ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ q ∈ S, q.Prime) (hT : ∀ q ∈ T, q.Prime) (hne : (S ∪ T).Nonempty)
    (hcross : eulerNumerator S * eulerDenominator T =
      eulerNumerator T * eulerDenominator S) :
    let P
proof:
:= (S ∪ T).max' hne
    P ∈ S ∧ P ∈ T := by
  classical
  let P := (S ∪ T).max' hne
  have hPmem : P ∈ S ∪ T := by
    exact Finset.max'_mem (S ∪ T) hne
  have hPprime : P.Prime := by
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hPmem with hPS | hPT
    · exact hS P hPS
    · exact hT P hPT
  have hSle : ∀ q ∈ S, q ≤ P := by
    intro q hq
    exact (S ∪ T).le_max' q (Finset.mem_union_left T hq)
  have hTle : ∀ q ∈ T, q ≤ P := by
    intro q hq
    exact (S ∪ T).le_max' q (Finset.mem_union_right S hq)
  have one_sided_impossible (A B : Finset ℕ) (hA : ∀ q ∈ A, q.Prime)
      (hB : ∀ q ∈ B, q.Prime) (hAle : ∀ q ∈ A, q ≤ P)
      (heq : eulerNumerator A * eulerDenominator B =
        eulerNumerator B * eulerDenominator A)
      (hPA : P ∈ A) (hPB : P ∉ B) : False := by
    have hPdenA : P ∣ eulerDenominator A := by
      rw [eulerDenominator]
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem id hPA
    have hPright : P ∣ eulerNumerator B * eulerDenominator A :=
      dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hPdenA _
    have hPleft : P ∣ eulerNumerator A * eulerDenominator B := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hPright
    rcases hPprime.dvd_mul.mp hPleft with hPnumA | hPdenB
    · rw [eulerNumerator] at hPnumA
      obtain ⟨q, hqA, hPpred⟩ :=
        exists_mem_dvd_finset_prod_of_prime hPprime A (fun q ↦ q - 1) hPnumA
      have hqprime := hA q hqA
      have hpredpos : 0 < q - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hqprime.one_lt
      have hPle : P ≤ q - 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd hpredpos hPpred
      have hqle := hAle q hqA
      omega
    · rw [eulerDenominator] at hPdenB
      obtain ⟨q, hqB, hPq⟩ :=
        exists_mem_dvd_finset_prod_of_prime hPprime B id hPdenB
      have hqprime := hB q hqB
      have hPeq : P = q := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hPprime hqprime).mp hPq
      exact hPB (hPeq ▸ hqB)
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hPmem with hPS | hPT
  · refine ⟨hPS, ?_⟩
    by_contra hPnotT
    exact one_sided_impossible S T hS hT hSle hcross hPS hPnotT
  · refine ⟨?_, hPT⟩
    by_contra hPnotS
    exact one_sided_impossible T S hT hS hTle hcross.symm hPT hPnotS

name: RankAmplification.primeFinset_eq_of_euler_products_cross_eq
statement:
theorem primeFinset_eq_of_euler_products_cross_eq (S T : Finset ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ q ∈ S, q.Prime) (hT : ∀ q ∈ T, q.Prime)
    (hcross : eulerNumerator S * eulerDenominator T =
      eulerNumerator T * eulerDenominator S) :
    S = T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hcard : S.card + T.card using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing S T with
  | h k ih =>
      by_cases hne : (S ∪ T).Nonempty
      · let P := (S ∪ T).max' hne
        have hPboth : P ∈ S ∧ P ∈ T :=
          max_mem_both_of_euler_products_cross_eq S T hS hT hne hcross
        have hPS := hPboth.1
        have hPT := hPboth.2
        have hnumS : eulerNumerator S = eulerNumerator (S.erase P) * (P - 1) := by
          rw [eulerNumerator, eulerNumerator]
          exact (Finset.prod_erase_mul S (fun q ↦ q - 1) hPS).symm
        have hnumT : eulerNumerator T = eulerNumerator (T.erase P) * (P - 1) := by
          rw [eulerNumerator, eulerNumerator]
          exact (Finset.prod_erase_mul T (fun q ↦ q - 1) hPT).symm
        have hdenS : eulerDenominator S = eulerDenominator (S.erase P) * P := by
          rw [eulerDenominator, eulerDenominator]
          exact (Finset.prod_erase_mul S id hPS).symm
        have hdenT : eulerDenominator T = eulerDenominator (T.erase P) * P := by
          rw [eulerDenominator, eulerDenominator]
          exact (Finset.prod_erase_mul T id hPT).symm
        have hPprime := hS P hPS
        have hfactor : (P - 1) * P ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt hPprime.one_lt) hPprime.ne_zero
        have hcrossErase :
            eulerNumerator (S.erase P) * eulerDenominator (T.erase P) =
              eulerNumerator (T.erase P) * eulerDenominator (S.erase P) := by
          apply (mul_right_inj' hfactor).mp
          calc
            (P - 1) * P *
                (eulerNumerator (S.erase P) * eulerDenominator (T.erase P)) =
                eulerNumerator S * eulerDenominator T := by
                  rw [hnumS, hdenT]
                  ac_rfl
            _ = eulerNumerator T * eulerDenominator S := hcross
            _ = (P - 1) * P *
                (eulerNumerator (T.erase P) * eulerDenominator (S.erase P)) := by
                  rw [hnumT, hdenS]
                  ac_rfl
        have hSerase : ∀ q ∈ S.erase P, q.Prime := by
          intro q hq
          exact hS q (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hq)
        have hTerase : ∀ q ∈ T.erase P, q.Prime := by
          intro q hq
          exact hT q (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hq)
        have hlt : (S.erase P).card + (T.erase P).card < k := by
          have hScard : 0 < S.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨P, hPS⟩
          have hTcard : 0 < T.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨P, hPT⟩
          rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hPS, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hPT, ← hcard]
          omega
        have herase := ih _ hlt (S.erase P) (T.erase P) hSerase hTerase hcrossErase rfl
        calc
          S = insert P (S.erase P) := (Finset.insert_erase hPS).symm
          _ = insert P (T.erase P) := by rw [herase]
          _ = T := Finset.insert_erase hPT
      · have hempty : S ∪ T = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne
        have hSempty : S = ∅ := by
          apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
          intro q hq
          have : q ∈ S ∪ T := Finset.mem_union_left T hq
          rw [hempty] at this
          exact Finset.notMem_empty q this
        have hTempty : T = ∅ := by
          apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
          intro q hq
          have : q ∈ S ∪ T := Finset.mem_union_right S hq
          rw [hempty] at this
          exact Finset.notMem_empty q this
        exact hSempty.trans hTempty.symm

name: RankAmplification.primeSupport_eq_of_totient_cross_eq
statement:
theorem primeSupport_eq_of_totient_cross_eq {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hcross : a.totient * b = b.totient * a) :
    primeSupport a = primeSupport b
proof:
:= by
  apply primeFinset_eq_of_euler_products_cross_eq
  · intro q hq
    exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  · intro q hq
    exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  · exact euler_products_cross_eq_of_totient_cross_eq ha hb hcross

name: RankAmplification.normalizedA_coprime_normalizedB
statement:
theorem normalizedA_coprime_normalizedB {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (hm₁ : 0 < m₁) (_hm₂ : 0 < m₂) :
    (normalizedA m₁ m₂).Coprime (normalizedB m₁ m₂)
proof:
:= by
  have htot₁ : 0 < m₁.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hm₁
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd m₁.totient m₂.totient :=
    Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ htot₁
  exact (Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hg).symm

name: RankAmplification.exists_normalized_common_multiplier
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_common_multiplier {m₁ m₂ k₁ k₂ : ℕ}
    (hm₁ : 0 < m₁) (hm₂ : 0 < m₂)
    (hbalance : k₁ * m₁.totient = k₂ * m₂.totient) :
    ∃ c, k₁ = normalizedA m₁ m₂ * c ∧
      k₂ = normalizedB m₁ m₂ * c
proof:
:= by
  let g := Nat.gcd m₁.totient m₂.totient
  let a := normalizedA m₁ m₂
  let b := normalizedB m₁ m₂
  have htot₁ : 0 < m₁.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hm₁
  have htot₂ : 0 < m₂.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hm₂
  have hg : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ htot₁
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.gcd_le_right _ htot₂) hg
  have hb : 0 < b := by
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.gcd_le_left _ htot₁) hg
  have htot₁_eq : m₁.totient = b * g := by
    exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m₁.totient m₂.totient)).symm
  have htot₂_eq : m₂.totient = a * g := by
    exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right m₁.totient m₂.totient)).symm
  have hab : a.Coprime b := normalizedA_coprime_normalizedB hm₁ hm₂
  have hprimitive : k₁ * b = k₂ * a := by
    apply (mul_right_inj' hg.ne').mp
    calc
      g * (k₁ * b) = k₁ * m₁.totient := by rw [htot₁_eq]; ac_rfl
      _ = k₂ * m₂.totient := hbalance
      _ = g * (k₂ * a) := by rw [htot₂_eq]; ac_rfl
  have hak₁ : a ∣ k₁ := by
    apply hab.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    exact ⟨k₂, hprimitive.trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩
  let c := k₁ / a
  have hk₁ : k₁ = a * c := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel hak₁).symm
  have hk₂ : k₂ = b * c := by
    apply (mul_right_inj' ha.ne').mp
    calc
      a * k₂ = k₂ * a := Nat.mul_comm _ _
      _ = k₁ * b := hprimitive.symm
      _ = a * (b * c) := by rw [hk₁]; ac_rfl
  exact ⟨c, hk₁, hk₂⟩

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.m1_pos
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.m1_pos {h n p : ℕ} (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) :
    0 < s.m1
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  intro hm
  apply s.q1_not_dvd_m1
  rw [hm]
  exact dvd_zero s.q1

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.m2_pos
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.m2_pos {h n p : ℕ} (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) :
    0 < s.m2
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  intro hm
  apply s.q2_not_dvd_m2
  rw [hm]
  exact dvd_zero s.q2

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.exists_normalized_common_multiplier
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.exists_normalized_common_multiplier {h n p : ℕ}
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) :
    ∃ c, s.k1 = normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * c ∧
      s.k2 = normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 * c
proof:
:=
  RankAmplification.exists_normalized_common_multiplier s.m1_pos s.m2_pos s.balance

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier {h n p : ℕ}
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) :
    ∃ c, 0 < c ∧ s.k1 = normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * c ∧
      s.k2 = normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 * c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hk₁, hk₂⟩ := s.exists_normalized_common_multiplier
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    by_contra hc
    have hc₀ : c = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hc
    rw [hc₀, Nat.mul_zero] at hk₁
    exact s.k1_pos.ne' hk₁
  exact ⟨c, hc, hk₁, hk₂⟩

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.normalized_shift_equation
proof:
:= by
  calc
    s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) + h =
        s.m1 * s.q1 + h := by rw [s.q1_eq, hk₁]; ring
    _ = n + h := congrArg (fun x : ℕ ↦ x + h) s.n_eq.symm
    _ = s.m2 * s.q2 := s.shifted_eq
    _ = s.m2 * (normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) := by
      rw [s.q2_eq, hk₂]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.totient_cross_eq_of_normalized_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  let g := Nat.gcd m₁.totient m₂.totient
  have htot₁ : m₁.totient = normalizedB m₁ m₂ * g := by
    exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m₁.totient m₂.totient)).symm
  have htot₂ : m₂.totient = normalizedA m₁ m₂ * g := by
    exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right m₁.totient m₂.totient)).symm
  calc
    m₁.totient * m₂ = (m₂ * normalizedB m₁ m₂) * g := by
      rw [htot₁]
      ac_rfl
    _ = (m₁ * normalizedA m₁ m₂) * g := by rw [hdiag]
    _ = m₂.totient * m₁ := by rw [htot₂]; ac_rfl

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.normalized_slopes_ne
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.normalized_slopes_ne {h n p : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) :
    s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 ≠ s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiag
  obtain ⟨c, _hc, hk₁, hk₂⟩ := s.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
  have hshift := s.normalized_shift_equation hk₁ hk₂
  have hshiftExpanded :
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + (s.m1 + h) =
        (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + s.m2 := by
    calc
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + (s.m1 + h) =
          s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) + h := by ring
      _ = s.m2 * (normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) := hshift
      _ = (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + s.m2 := by ring
  rw [hdiag] at hshiftExpanded
  have hm₂eq : s.m2 = s.m1 + h := (Nat.add_left_cancel hshiftExpanded).symm
  have htotcross := totient_cross_eq_of_normalized_diagonal hdiag
  have hsupport : primeSupport s.m1 = primeSupport s.m2 :=
    primeSupport_eq_of_totient_cross_eq s.m1_pos.ne' s.m2_pos.ne' htotcross
  apply not_isSameSupportIndex_of_odd hodd
  refine ⟨s.m1_pos, ?_⟩
  rw [← hm₂eq]
  exact hsupport

name: RankAmplification.affine_parameter_unique
statement:
theorem affine_parameter_unique {A B L R C D : ℕ} (hAB : A ≠ B)
    (hC : A * C + L = B * C + R) (hD : A * D + L = B * D + R) :
    C = D
proof:
:= by
  have hCℤ : (A : ℤ) * C + L = (B : ℤ) * C + R := by exact_mod_cast hC
  have hDℤ : (A : ℤ) * D + L = (B : ℤ) * D + R := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hproduct : ((A : ℤ) - B) * ((C : ℤ) - D) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((A : ℤ) - B) * ((C : ℤ) - D) =
          ((A : ℤ) * C + L - ((B : ℤ) * C + R)) -
            ((A : ℤ) * D + L - ((B : ℤ) * D + R)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hCℤ, hDℤ]; ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hproduct with hcoeff | hparam
  · have hcast : (A : ℤ) = B := sub_eq_zero.mp hcoeff
    have : A = B := by exact_mod_cast hcast
    exact (hAB this).elim
  · have hcast : (C : ℤ) = D := sub_eq_zero.mp hparam
    exact_mod_cast hcast

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.n_eq_of_same_cofactors
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.n_eq_of_same_cofactors {h n p n' p' : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (t : LargePrimeSkeleton h n' p')
    (hm₁ : s.m1 = t.m1) (hm₂ : s.m2 = t.m2) :
    n = n'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, _hc, hsk₁, hsk₂⟩ := s.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
  obtain ⟨d, _hd, htk₁, htk₂⟩ := t.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
  let C := c * p
  let D := d * p'
  have hsShift := s.normalized_shift_equation hsk₁ hsk₂
  have htShift := t.normalized_shift_equation htk₁ htk₂
  have hsLinear :
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * C + (s.m1 + h) =
        (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * C + s.m2 := by
    calc
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * C + (s.m1 + h) =
          s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) + h := by
            simp only [C]
            ring
      _ = s.m2 * (normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) := hsShift
      _ = (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * C + s.m2 := by
        simp only [C]
        ring
  have htLinear :
      (t.m1 * normalizedA t.m1 t.m2) * D + (t.m1 + h) =
        (t.m2 * normalizedB t.m1 t.m2) * D + t.m2 := by
    calc
      (t.m1 * normalizedA t.m1 t.m2) * D + (t.m1 + h) =
          t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * (d * p') + 1) + h := by
            simp only [D]
            ring
      _ = t.m2 * (normalizedB t.m1 t.m2 * (d * p') + 1) := htShift
      _ = (t.m2 * normalizedB t.m1 t.m2) * D + t.m2 := by
        simp only [D]
        ring
  have htLinear' :
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * D + (s.m1 + h) =
        (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * D + s.m2 := by
    simpa only [hm₁, hm₂] using htLinear
  have hCD : C = D := affine_parameter_unique (s.normalized_slopes_ne hodd) hsLinear htLinear'
  have hnS : n = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * C + 1) := by
    calc
      n = s.m1 * s.q1 := s.n_eq
      _ = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * C + 1) := by
        rw [s.q1_eq, hsk₁]
        simp only [C]
        ring
  have hnT : n' = t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * D + 1) := by
    calc
      n' = t.m1 * t.q1 := t.n_eq
      _ = t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * D + 1) := by
        rw [t.q1_eq, htk₁]
        simp only [D]
        ring
  calc
    n = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * C + 1) := hnS
    _ = s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * D + 1) := by rw [hCD]
    _ = t.m1 * (normalizedA t.m1 t.m2 * D + 1) := by rw [hm₁, hm₂]
    _ = n' := hnT.symm

name: RankAmplification.fixedCofactorSkeletonNumbers_subsingleton
statement:
theorem fixedCofactorSkeletonNumbers_subsingleton {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) :
    (fixedCofactorSkeletonNumbers h m₁ m₂).Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn n' hn'
  obtain ⟨p, s, hs₁, hs₂⟩ := hn
  obtain ⟨p', t, ht₁, ht₂⟩ := hn'
  apply s.n_eq_of_same_cofactors hodd t
  · exact hs₁.trans ht₁.symm
  · exact hs₂.trans ht₂.symm

name: RankAmplification.cofactorPair_injective_on_skeletonNumbers
statement:
theorem cofactorPair_injective_on_skeletonNumbers {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (x : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (x : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h x.1 (provider x)) :
    Function.Injective (fun x ↦ ((skeleton x).m1, (skeleton x).m2))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hpair
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (skeleton x).n_eq_of_same_cofactors hodd (skeleton y)
  · exact congrArg Prod.fst hpair
  · exact congrArg Prod.snd hpair

name: RankAmplification.card_cofactorPair_image_eq
statement:
theorem card_cofactorPair_image_eq {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (x : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (x : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h x.1 (provider x)) :
    (S.attach.image (fun x ↦ ((skeleton x).m1, (skeleton x).m2))).card = S.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _
    (cofactorPair_injective_on_skeletonNumbers hodd S provider skeleton)]
  exact Finset.card_attach

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSupplierTailSum_le_friable
statement:
theorem fixedRankSupplierTailSum_le_friable

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x
proof:
:= by
  let Cslot : ℝ := (Real.log 2)⁻¹ + 2
  let Cblock : ℝ := Real.log 2 + J + 2
  let C : ℝ := max (max Cslot Cblock) (J : ℝ)
  have hLlarge := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop (max C 1)
  have hL2large := (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [hLlarge, hL2large] with x hLlarge hL2large
  change max C 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) at hLlarge
  change 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) at hL2large
  have hLone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_right C 1).trans hLlarge
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans_le hLone
  have hJ : (J : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_right (max Cslot Cblock) (J : ℝ)).trans
      ((le_max_left C 1).trans hLlarge)
  have hx : 0 < x := by
    by_contra hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hx
    subst x
    simp [scaleL] at hL
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoX : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) =
      Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'), scaleL]
  have hslotLog := natLogTwo_cast_le_log_div (n := 2 * x) (by positivity)
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hslotLog
  have hCslot : Cslot ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_left Cslot Cblock).trans
      ((le_max_left (max Cslot Cblock) (J : ℝ)).trans
        ((le_max_left C 1).trans hLlarge))
  have hslot : (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    unfold fixedRankSupplierSlotBound movingSupplierSlotBound
    push_cast
    rw [hlogTwoX] at hslotLog
    have hupper : (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
        Cslot * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
            (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 + 1 :=
          by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hslotLog 1
        _ = (Real.log 2)⁻¹ * scaleL (x : ℝ) + 2 := by
          field_simp [hlogTwoPos.ne']
          ring
        _ ≤ Cslot * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [Cslot]
          rw [add_mul]
          have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
            simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLone (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
          exact add_le_add le_rfl htwo
    calc
      (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
          Cslot * scaleL (x : ℝ) := hupper
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCslot hL.le
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hCblock : Cblock ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_right Cslot Cblock).trans
      ((le_max_left (max Cslot Cblock) (J : ℝ)).trans
        ((le_max_left C 1).trans hLlarge))
  have hblock : (elementarySupplierBlockScale J x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hharm := harmonic_le_one_add_log (2 * x)
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hharm
    rw [hlogTwoX] at hharm
    unfold elementarySupplierBlockScale
    push_cast
    calc
      ((harmonic (2 * x) : ℚ) : ℝ) + J ≤
          (1 + (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) + J :=
        add_le_add hharm le_rfl
      _ ≤ Cblock * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        have hc : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log 2 + (J : ℝ) := by positivity
        calc
          (1 + (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) + (J : ℝ) =
              scaleL (x : ℝ) + (1 + Real.log 2 + J) := by ring
          _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) +
              (1 + Real.log 2 + J) * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
            add_le_add le_rfl (le_mul_of_one_le_right hc hLone)
          _ = Cblock * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
            dsimp [Cblock]
            ring
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCblock hL.le
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
  exact ⟨hL, hL2large, hJ, hslot, hblock⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_partition_factor_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRank_partition_factor_le_exp
    {J x : ℕ} (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x) :
    (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hpart : (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) ^ J := by
    exact_mod_cast labelledPartitionCount_le_self_pow J
  calc
    (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) ^ J := hpart
    _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ J :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) h.rank_le_scaleL _
    _ = Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_block_power_factor_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRank_block_power_factor_le_exp
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x) :
    (elementarySupplierBlockScale J x : ℝ) ^ J ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) ≤ elementarySupplierBlockScale J x := by
    exact_mod_cast (zero_le_one.trans (elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le hJ))
  calc
    (elementarySupplierBlockScale J x : ℝ) ^ J ≤
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ J :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hscale h.block_le_scaleL_sq _
    _ = Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_massPrefactor_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRank_massPrefactor_le_exp
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x) :
    ((((labelledPartitionCount J : ℚ) *
      elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ J : ℚ) : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x)
proof:
:= by
  push_cast
  calc
    (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) *
        (elementarySupplierBlockScale J x : ℝ) ^ J ≤
        Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul (fixedRank_partition_factor_le_exp h)
        (fixedRank_block_power_factor_le_exp hJ h)
        (pow_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast
          (zero_le_one.trans (elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le hJ))) _)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      unfold fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent
      congr 1
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_occurrenceCount_le_slotBound
statement:
theorem fixedRank_occurrenceCount_le_slotBound
    {J y Y x N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * x))
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ≤ fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x
proof:
:= by
  have hpowY := cutoffSucc_pow_admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount_le P x N
    (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).1))
  have hbase : 2 ≤ y + 1 := by omega
  have hpowTwo : 2 ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ≤ 2 * x := by
    calc
      2 ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ≤
          (y + 1) ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_left hbase _
      _ ≤ N := hpowY
      _ ≤ 2 * x := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).2
  exact (Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num) hpowTwo).trans
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_pointwisePrefactor_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRank_pointwisePrefactor_le_exp
    {J y Y x N : ℕ} (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * x))
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    ((labelledPartitionCount J *
      admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ^ J : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x)
proof:
:= by
  have hoccNat := fixedRank_occurrenceCount_le_slotBound hy hN P
  have hoccCast : (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x := by
    exact_mod_cast hoccNat
  have hocc : (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    hoccCast.trans h.slot_le_scaleL_sq
  have hoccPow : (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ^ J ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ^ J ≤
          (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ J :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hocc _
      _ = Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  push_cast
  calc
    (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) *
        (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ^ J ≤
        Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul (fixedRank_partition_factor_le_exp h) hoccPow
        (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      unfold fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent
      congr 1
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_supplierMass_le_localExponent
statement:
theorem fixedRank_supplierMass_le_localExponent
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
        (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hq := section10_lemma10_9_blockMass P
    (elementary_hasPartitionDescriptorMassBound P x)
  calc
    (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
        ((((labelledPartitionCount J : ℚ) *
          elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ J /
            (totalDemandProduct P : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) := by
      exact_mod_cast hq
    _ = ((((labelledPartitionCount J : ℚ) *
          elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ J : ℚ) : ℝ)) *
            (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      push_cast
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
          (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (fixedRank_massPrefactor_le_exp hJ h)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_supplierSupNorm_le_localExponent
statement:
theorem fixedRank_supplierSupNorm_le_localExponent
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    supplierSupNorm P x (2 * x) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x)
proof:
:= by
  apply supplierSupNorm_le_of_pointwise P (Real.exp_pos _).le
  intro N hN
  have hpoint := section10_lemma10_9_pointwise P x N (by
    have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).1
    omega)
  have hcast : (supplierDivisorWeight P x N : ℝ) ≤
      ((labelledPartitionCount J *
        admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ^ J : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpoint
  exact hcast.trans (fixedRank_pointwisePrefactor_le_exp h hy hN P)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq
statement:
theorem fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq (J x : ℕ) :
    fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) x =
      2 * x * fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum J x +
        4 * x * fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum J x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum
    fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro P hP
    ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankNatY_inv_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRankNatY_inv_le_exp {J x : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x) :
    ((fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      Real.exp (-fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < fixedRankNatY J x := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy
  have hfloor : fixedRankY J (x : ℝ) < (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hone : (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) + 1 ≤
      2 * fixedRankNatY J x := by
    exact_mod_cast (show fixedRankNatY J x + 1 ≤
      2 * fixedRankNatY J x by omega)
  have hexp : Real.exp (fixedRankT J (x : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * fixedRankNatY J x := by
    rw [← fixedRankY]
    exact hfloor.le.trans hone
  have hinv : ((fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      2 / Real.exp (fixedRankT J (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).2
    calc
      (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ * Real.exp (fixedRankT J (x : ℝ)) ≤
          (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ *
            (2 * fixedRankNatY J x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (inv_nonneg.mpr hypos.le)
      _ = 2 := by field_simp
  convert hinv using 1
  rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRank_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x)
    (hyY : fixedRankNatY J x ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤
      Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤
        ((fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ J :=
      sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_inv_pow
        (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy) hyY
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (-fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2)) ^ J :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        (fixedRankNatY_inv_le_exp hy) _
    _ = Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      calc
        (J : ℝ) * (-fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) =
            -((J : ℝ) * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ)) +
              (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by ring
        _ = -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
            (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
          rw [nat_mul_fixedRankT hJ]
          ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum_le
statement:
theorem fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum_le
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x)
    (hyY : fixedRankNatY J x ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
    (hscale : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x) :
    fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum J x ≤
      Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
          (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  let a := fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x
  calc
    fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum J x ≤
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J (fixedRankNatY J x)
            (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
          (Real.exp a * (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro P hP
      have hleft : 0 ≤ (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast supplierReciprocalMass_nonneg P x
      have hright : 0 ≤ Real.exp a * (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      exact (sq_le_sq₀ hleft hright).2
        (fixedRank_supplierMass_le_localExponent hJ hscale P)
    _ = Real.exp (a + a) *
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J (fixedRankNatY J x)
            (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
          ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro P hP
      rw [mul_pow, pow_two (Real.exp a), ← Real.exp_add]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (a + a) *
        Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
          (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (fixedRank_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp hJ hy hyY)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        2 * fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x +
          (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      dsimp [a]
      congr 1
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum_le
statement:
theorem fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum_le
    {J x : ℕ} (hscale : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hy : 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x) :
    fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum J x ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
        fixedRankSupplierTailSum J x
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum, fixedRankSupplierTailSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro P hP
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (fixedRank_supplierSupNorm_le_localExponent hscale hy P) (by
      exact_mod_cast supplierReciprocalTail_nonneg P x x.sqrt)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankSupplierMassTailError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankSupplierMassTailError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankSupplierMassTailError J ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (ρ x) 0) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using hρ.max (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0))
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hscaled : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (6 * (J : ℝ)) *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hlog.const_mul (6 * (J : ℝ))
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hquot := hscaled.add hconst
  have hsum : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (ρ x) 0 +
      (6 * (J : ℝ) * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
        ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6) /
          scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hmax.add hquot
  refine hsum.congr' ?_
  have hVne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, scaleV (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (eventually_scaleV_nat_pos.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.ne')
  filter_upwards [hVne] with x hVne
  unfold fixedRankSupplierMassTailError fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent
  field_simp [hVne]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le_common
statement:
theorem fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le_common
    {J x : ℕ} { ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hadm : FixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J x)
    (hscale : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ))
    (hfriable : finitePowerEncodingFactor J (fixedRankNatY J x)
          (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (fixedRankSupplierTailCode J x) ((2 * x) ^ J) ≤
      Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))) :
    fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) x ≤
      6 * x * Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x :=
    (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3).trans hadm.three_le_y
  have hxThree : 3 ≤ x :=
    hadm.three_le_y.trans (hadm.y_le_upper.trans hadm.upper_le_x)
  have hx : 0 < x := by omega
  have hY : fixedRankNatUpperY J x ≤ 2 * x :=
    hadm.upper_le_x.trans (by omega)
  have htail : fixedRankSupplierTailSum J x ≤
      Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    (fixedRankSupplierTailSum_le_friable (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy) hx hY).trans
      hfriable
  have hweighted := fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum_le hscale hy
  have hweightedExp : fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum J x ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x -
        Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
          ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum J x ≤
          Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
            fixedRankSupplierTailSum J x := hweighted
      _ ≤ Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
            ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
  have hmass := fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum_le hJ hy
    hadm.y_le_upper hscale
  have hlocal0 : 0 ≤ fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent J x := by
    unfold fixedRankSupplierLocalExponent
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (zero_le_one.trans hscale.log2_ge_one)
  have hfloor0 : 0 ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  have hρ : ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
      max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hV.le
  have hmassCommon : fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum J x ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x) := by
    refine hmass.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    unfold fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hV.le)
  have htailCommon : fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum J x ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x) := by
    refine hweightedExp.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    unfold fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent
    linarith
  rw [fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq]
  calc
    2 * x * fixedRankSupplierMassSquareSum J x +
        4 * x * fixedRankSupplierWeightedTailSum J x ≤
        2 * x * Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x) +
          4 * x * Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmassCommon (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htailCommon (by positivity))
    _ = 6 * x * Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.six_mul_fixedRankSupplierCommon_eq_majorant
statement:
theorem six_mul_fixedRankSupplierCommon_eq_majorant
    {J x : ℕ} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ)) :
    6 * x * Real.exp (fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x) =
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankSupplierMassTailError J ρ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hVne : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hV.ne'
  have hexponent :
      -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankSupplierMassTailError J ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent J ρ x + Real.log 6 := by
    unfold fixedRankSupplierMassTailError fixedRankSupplierCommonExponent
    field_simp [hVne]
    ring
  unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant
  rw [hexponent, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_weightedFriableTail
statement:
theorem fixedRankSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_weightedFriableTail
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (htail : FixedRankWeightedFriableTailEndpoint J ρ) :
    FixedRankSupplierMassTailHypothesis J
      (fixedRankSupplierMassTailError J ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankSupplierMassTailError_zero J htail.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ,
      eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos,
      htail.2] with x hadm hscale hV htail
  exact (fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le_common hJ hadm hscale hV htail).trans_eq
    (six_mul_fixedRankSupplierCommon_eq_majorant hV)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ_lt
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ_lt {Y base i K : ℕ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hiK : i + 1 ≤ K)
    (hK : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) :
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell {X Y base i p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i ↔
      p.Prime ∧ p ≤ X ∧
        IsSmooth (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) (p - 1) ∧
        bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) < largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [bfpsGeometricPrimeShell]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricPrimeShell_disjoint
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricPrimeShell_disjoint {X Y base i j K : ℕ}
    (hij : i < j) (hjK : j < K)
    (hK : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) :
    Disjoint (bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i)
      (bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro p hpi hpj
  have hiData := mem_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell.mp hpi
  have hjData := mem_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell.mp hpj
  have hjLower : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (j + 1) :=
    one_le_bfpsGeometricEndpoint_of_le (by omega) hK
  have hqUpper : largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) ≤
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base j := by
    exact predecessorShellPrime_le hjLower hpj
  have hend : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base j ≤
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) :=
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega)
  omega

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_terminal_add_shells
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_terminal_add_shells
    (X Y base K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) :
    (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card =
      (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)).card +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, (bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero => simp
  | succ K ih =>
      have hKprev : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K :=
        one_le_bfpsGeometricEndpoint_of_le (Nat.le_succ K) hK
      have hstep := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_add_shell
        (X := X)
        (lo := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1))
        (hi := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
        hK (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (Nat.le_succ K))
      rw [ih hKprev, hstep, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      simp only [bfpsGeometricPrimeShell]
      omega

name: RankAmplification.bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum
statement:
theorem bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum
    (X Y lo : ℕ) :
    bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X Y lo ≤
      finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum Y (X / (lo + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X Y lo,
        (m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) =
        ∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X Y lo, totientWeight m := by
      rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet Y (X / (lo + 1)), totientWeight m := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro m hm
        have hmData := mem_bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet.mp hm
        exact mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr ⟨by omega, hmData.2.1, hmData.2.2⟩
      · intro m _ _
        unfold totientWeight
        positivity

name: RankAmplification.bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finiteMajorant
statement:
theorem bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finiteMajorant (X Y lo : ℕ) :
    bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X Y lo ≤
      bfpsFiniteTotientWeightMajorant X Y lo
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum X Y lo).trans
    (finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le Y (X / (lo + 1)))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_logMajorant

theorem bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_logMajorant
    {X Y lo : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X Y lo ≤

    (finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_log hY)

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_le_finiteSmoothCount
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_le_finiteSmoothCount (X Y : ℕ) :
    (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card ≤ finiteSmoothCount Y X
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteSmoothCount
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun p ↦ p - 1)
  · intro p hp
    have hpData := mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hp
    exact mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr
      ⟨Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hpData.1.one_lt,
        (Nat.sub_le p 1).trans hpData.2.1, hpData.2.2⟩
  · intro p hp q hq hpq
    have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hp).1
    have hqPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hq).1
    change p - 1 = q - 1 at hpq
    calc
      p = (p - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hpPrime.one_le).symm
      _ = (q - 1) + 1 := congrArg (fun n ↦ n + 1) hpq
      _ = q := Nat.sub_add_cancel hqPrime.one_le

name: RankAmplification.card_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell_cast_le_finiteMajorant
statement:
theorem card_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell_cast_le_finiteMajorant
    {X Y base i K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hiK : i < K)
    (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
        bfpsFiniteTotientWeightMajorant X
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hterminal : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K := by omega
  have hlo : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) :=
    one_le_bfpsGeometricEndpoint_of_le (by omega) hterminal
  have hlohi : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) <
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ_lt hbase (by omega) hterminal
  have hhi : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
    hK.trans (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega))
  exact card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_majorant
    hlo hlohi hhi hC hsieve hasBFPSWeightedSmoothMultiplierBound_finite

name: RankAmplification.card_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell_cast_le_logMajorant
statement:
theorem card_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell_cast_le_logMajorant
    {X Y base i K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hiK : i < K)
    (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
        bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant X
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hterminal : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K := by omega
  have hlo : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) :=
    one_le_bfpsGeometricEndpoint_of_le (by omega) hterminal
  have hlohi : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) <
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ_lt hbase (by omega) hterminal
  have hhi : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
    hK.trans (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega))
  calc
    ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) ≤
        1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
          bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
            (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1)) :=
      card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_weighted hlo hlohi hhi hsieve
    _ ≤ 1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
        bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1)) := by
      exact add_le_add (le_refl 1) <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_logMajorant hhi)
          (mul_nonneg hC (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg _))

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_geometricFiniteMajorant
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_geometricFiniteMajorant
    {X Y base K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) ≤
      (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) + K +
        C * bfpsGeometricFiniteMajorantSum X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  have hterminal : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K := by omega
  have hdecomp := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_terminal_add_shells X Y base K hterminal
  have hdecompReal : ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) =
      ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)).card : ℝ) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hdecomp
  rw [hdecompReal]
  calc
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)).card : ℝ) +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) ≤
        (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
            (1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
              bfpsFiniteTotientWeightMajorant X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1))) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact_mod_cast card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_le_finiteSmoothCount X
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
      · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        exact card_bfpsGeometricPrimeShell_cast_le_finiteMajorant
          hbase (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hK hC hsieve
    _ = (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) + K +
        C * bfpsGeometricFiniteMajorantSum X Y base K := by
      rw [bfpsGeometricFiniteMajorantSum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_geometricLogMajorant
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_geometricLogMajorant
    {X Y base K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) ≤

proof:

  have hdecomp := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_terminal_add_shells X Y base K hterminal
  have hdecompReal : ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) =

        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) := by

          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) ≤
        (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
            (1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *

    _ = (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) + K +

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_hildebrandBound
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_hildebrandBound
    {X Y base K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    {bound : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C)
    (hHildebrand : HasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound bound) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) ≤
      K + C * bound X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  have hglobal := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_geometricLogMajorant
    (X := X) hbase hK (by positivity : 0 ≤ C) hsieve
  have hmass := hHildebrand X Y base K hbase hK
  have hcount : 0 ≤ (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_nonneg _
  calc
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) ≤
        (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) + K +
          C * bfpsGeometricLogMajorantSum X Y base K := hglobal
    _ ≤ K + C *
        ((finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) +
          bfpsGeometricLogMajorantSum X Y base K) := by
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ K + C * bound X Y base K := by
      exact add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass (by positivity)) K
