name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.twoSelberg_minimizingWeight_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoSelberg_minimizingWeight_two (m R : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
      (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm) 2 = -1
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm
  have hcoord := SelbergFundamental.diagonalCoordinate_minimizingWeight
    s (l := 2) (by
      change 2 ∣ primeProduct 2
      simp)
  change (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      if 2 ∣ d then s.nu d * SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s d else 0) =
        SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s 2 at hcoord
  have hdiv : s.prodPrimes.divisors = {1, 2} := by
    change (primeProduct 2).divisors = {1, 2}
    rw [primeProduct_two]
    decide
  rw [hdiv] at hcoord
  norm_num at hcoord
  rw [show s.nu 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) by
    exact twoSelberg_nu_two m R hm] at hcoord
  have hmem : 2 ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s := by
    change 2 ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors
      (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm)
    rw [twoSelberg_truncatedDivisors]
    simp
  rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_pos hmem] at hcoord
  change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s 2 =
    (μ 2 : ℝ) * s.selbergTerms 2 /
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s at hcoord
  rw [show (μ 2 : ℝ) = -1 by
      exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_prime Nat.prime_two,
    show s.selbergTerms 2 = 1 by exact twoSelberg_selbergTerms_two m R hm,
    show SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s = 2 by
      exact twoSelberg_truncatedMass m R hm] at hcoord
  linarith

statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoSelberg_remainderMajorant (m R : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant m R 2 hm = 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant
  change (∑ d ∈ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm).prodPrimes.divisors,
      if (d : ℝ) ≤ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm).level then
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
              (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm)) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
      else 0) = 3
  rw [show (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm).prodPrimes.divisors = {1, 2} by
    change (primeProduct 2).divisors = {1, 2}
    rw [primeProduct_two]
    decide]
  have hprimeFactors : (2 : ℕ).primeFactors = {2} := by
    simpa using Nat.primeFactors_prime_pow (p := 2) (k := 1) (by norm_num) Nat.prime_two
  simp [twoSelberg_lambdaSquared_one, twoSelberg_lambdaSquared_two, hprimeFactors]
  norm_num

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.twoSelberg_rem_two
statement:

      -((R % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  change (boundingSieve m R 2 hm).rem 2 = -((R % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2
  rw [boundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction hm (by norm_num)
    Nat.prime_two.squarefree, residueExcessCount_two_of_even hm,
    shiftedBadResidueCount_prime Nat.prime_two,
    if_pos (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)]
  norm_num

proof:

  have hmod : R % 2 = 0 ∨ R % 2 = 1 := by
    have := Nat.mod_lt R (by norm_num : 0 < 2)

  rcases hmod with hmod | hmod
  · simp [hmod]
  · rw [hmod]
    norm_num [abs_of_nonpos]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.twoSelberg_levelRestrictedRemainder_le
statement:
theorem twoSelberg_levelRestrictedRemainder_le (m R : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :

      (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2
proof:

  rw [show (minimizingSelbergSieve m R 2 hm).prodPrimes.divisors = {1, 2} by
    change (primeProduct 2).divisors = {1, 2}
    rw [primeProduct_two]
    decide]
  rw [Finset.sum_insert (by norm_num : 1 ∉ ({2} : Finset ℕ)),
    Finset.sum_singleton]
  rw [if_pos (by norm_num [twoSelberg_level]),
    if_pos (by norm_num [twoSelberg_level]),
    twoSelberg_lambdaSquared_one, twoSelberg_lambdaSquared_two,
    twoSelberg_rem_one]
  simp only [abs_zero, abs_one, abs_neg, zero_add, one_mul]
  exact abs_twoSelberg_rem_two_le m R hm

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_chain_offDiagonal_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRank_chain_offDiagonal_unconditional
    {Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY Q x →
      ((totientChainCount x r h -
          firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant Q (fixedRankClosedError Q) x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [fixedRank_theorem10_14_unconditional hQ] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hchainNat := chain_offDiagonal_cardinality_le_pair_offDiagonal_cardinality
    (x := x) (r := r) (h := h) (Y := fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) hr
  have hchainCast :
      ((totientChainCount x r h -
          firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((shiftedEqualTotientCount x h -
          aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hchainNat
  have hdiag : aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) ≤
      shiftedEqualTotientCount x h :=
    Finset.card_le_card
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
        (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x))
  have hpair := hx h hh hhy
  have hpairOff :
      ((shiftedEqualTotientCount x h -
          aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant Q (fixedRankClosedError Q) x := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hdiag]
    linarith
  exact hchainCast.trans hpairOff

proof:

theorem moving_chain_offDiagonal_unconditional
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ movingNatY x →
      ((totientChainCount x r h -
          firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (movingNatZ x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant
          (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
            movingClosedTransferError) x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [moving_theorem10_25_unconditional] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hchainNat := chain_offDiagonal_cardinality_le_pair_offDiagonal_cardinality
    (x := x) (r := r) (h := h) (Y := movingNatZ x) hr
  have hchainCast :
      ((totientChainCount x r h -
          firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (movingNatZ x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((shiftedEqualTotientCount x h -
          aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hchainNat
  have hdiag : aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) ≤
      shiftedEqualTotientCount x h :=
    Finset.card_le_card
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_shiftedEqualTotientSet x h (movingNatZ x))
  have hpair := hx h hh hhy
  have hpairOff :
      ((shiftedEqualTotientCount x h -
          aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant
          (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
            movingClosedTransferError) x := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hdiag]
    linarith
  exact hchainCast.trans hpairOff

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_cast_le_divisorWeighted
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_cast_le_divisorWeighted (R X : ℕ) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R X : ℝ) ≤ finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSmoothCount, finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
  calc
    ((finiteSmoothSet R X).card : ℝ) =
        ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (1 : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (m.divisors.card : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm).1)
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr
        ⟨1, Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨one_dvd m, hm0⟩⟩

      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 2) :

name: RankAmplification.log_finiteSmoothCount_div_le_full_paper_error
statement:
theorem log_finiteSmoothCount_div_le_full_paper_error {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    Real.log ((finiteSmoothCount R X : ℝ) / X) ≤
      -rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X
proof:
:= by
  have hXreal : 0 < (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hX
  have hbound := finiteSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error hX hR hu huSqrt
  have hdiv : (finiteSmoothCount R X : ℝ) / X ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
        fullPaperDivisorError R X) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hXreal).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hbound
  have hdivpos : 0 < (finiteSmoothCount R X : ℝ) / X := by
    exact div_pos (by exact_mod_cast finiteSmoothCount_pos (R := R) hX) hXreal
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log hdivpos hdiv

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.badResidueSet_card_le_one
statement:
theorem badResidueSet_card_le_one {d : ℕ} (hcop : P.step.Coprime d) :
    (P.badResidueSet d).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro x hx y hy
  have hxDiv := P.mem_badResidueSet.mp hx
  have hyDiv := P.mem_badResidueSet.mp hy
  have hxZero : (P.base : ZMod d) + P.step * x.val = 0 := by
    have hzero : ((P.value x : ℕ) : ZMod d) = 0 :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff (P.value x) d).mpr hxDiv
    simpa [value] using hzero
  have hyZero : (P.base : ZMod d) + P.step * y.val = 0 := by
    have hzero : ((P.value y : ℕ) : ZMod d) = 0 :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff (P.value y) d).mpr hyDiv
    simpa [value] using hzero
  have hstepUnit : IsUnit (P.step : ZMod d) :=
    (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime P.step d).mpr hcop
  have hxy : (x.val : ZMod d) = y.val := by
    rw [← hstepUnit.mul_left_inj]
    linear_combination hxZero - hyZero
  apply Fin.ext
  have hmod : x.val ≡ y.val [MOD d] := by
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
    exact hxy
  simpa only [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt y.isLt] using hmod

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.badResidueSet_nonempty
statement:
theorem badResidueSet_nonempty {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hcop : P.step.Coprime d) : (P.badResidueSet d).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero d := ⟨hd.ne'⟩
  have hstepUnit : IsUnit (P.step : ZMod d) :=
    (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime P.step d).mpr hcop
  let root : ZMod d := -(P.step : ZMod d)⁻¹ * P.base
  let t : Fin d := (ZMod.finEquiv d).symm root
  refine ⟨t, P.mem_badResidueSet.mpr ?_⟩
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
  have ht : (t.val : ZMod d) = root := by
    have hfin : (ZMod.finEquiv d) t = (t.val : ZMod d) := by
      cases d with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 t
      | succ d =>
          change t = (t.val : ZMod (d + 1))
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n := d + 1) t).symm
    calc
      (t.val : ZMod d) = (ZMod.finEquiv d) t := hfin.symm
      _ = root := (ZMod.finEquiv d).apply_symm_apply root
  rw [show ((P.value t : ℕ) : ZMod d) =
      (P.base : ZMod d) + P.step * t.val by simp [value]]
  rw [ht]
  simp only [root]
  calc
    (P.base : ZMod d) + P.step * (-(P.step : ZMod d)⁻¹ * P.base) =
        P.base - ((P.step : ZMod d) * (P.step : ZMod d)⁻¹) * P.base := by ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [ZMod.mul_inv_of_unit _ hstepUnit]; ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.badResidueCount_eq_one
statement:
theorem badResidueCount_eq_one {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hcop : P.step.Coprime d) : P.badResidueCount d = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · exact P.badResidueSet_card_le_one hcop
  · exact (P.badResidueSet_nonempty hd hcop).card_pos

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.mem_divisibleParameterSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_divisibleParameterSet {R d t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ P.divisibleParameterSet R d ↔ t < R ∧ d ∣ P.value t
proof:
:= by
  simp [divisibleParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.mem_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} {a : Fin d} {t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ P.parameterResidueFiber R d a ↔ t < R ∧ t ≡ a.val [MOD d]
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameterResidueFiber]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.card_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
theorem card_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (a : Fin d) :
    (P.parameterResidueFiber R d a).card =
      R / d + if a.val < R % d then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterResidueFiber, ← Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  simpa only [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt] using Nat.count_modEq_card R hd a.val

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.residueExcessCount_le_one
statement:
theorem residueExcessCount_le_one {R d : ℕ} (hcop : P.step.Coprime d) :
    P.residueExcessCount R d ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (P.badResidueSet_card_le_one hcop)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    P.divisibleParameterSet R d =
      (P.badResidueSet d).biUnion (P.parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_divisibleParameterSet, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨htR, htDiv⟩
    let a : Fin d := ⟨t % d, Nat.mod_lt t hd⟩
    have hta : t ≡ a.val [MOD d] := (Nat.mod_modEq t d).symm
    have hvalue := P.value_modEq hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ P.value a.val :=
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.symm.trans htDiv.modEq_zero_nat)
    exact ⟨a, P.mem_badResidueSet.mpr haDiv,
      P.mem_parameterResidueFiber.mpr ⟨htR, hta⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, haRoot, hta⟩
    have htaData := P.mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ P.value a := P.mem_badResidueSet.mp haRoot
    have hvalue := P.value_modEq htaData.2
    exact ⟨htaData.1,
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.trans haDiv.modEq_zero_nat)⟩

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint (R d : ℕ) :
    ((P.badResidueSet d : Finset (Fin d)) : Set (Fin d)).PairwiseDisjoint
      (P.parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ha b _hb hab
  change Disjoint (P.parameterResidueFiber R d a)
    (P.parameterResidueFiber R d b)
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro t hta htb
  have hat := (P.mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta).2
  have hbt := (P.mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp htb).2
  apply hab
  apply Fin.ext
  have habMod : a.val ≡ b.val [MOD d] := hat.symm.trans hbt
  simpa only [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.isLt] using habMod

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_eq {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hcop : P.step.Coprime d) :
    (P.divisibleParameterSet R d).card =
      R / d + P.residueExcessCount R d
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion hd,
    Finset.card_biUnion (P.parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint R d)]
  simp_rw [P.card_parameterResidueFiber hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hcard : (P.badResidueSet d).card = 1 :=
    P.badResidueCount_eq_one hd hcop
  have hsum : (∑ x ∈ P.badResidueSet d,
      if x.val < R % d then 1 else 0) = P.residueExcessCount R d := by
    rw [residueExcessCount, Finset.card_filter]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_nat]
  rw [hcard, hsum, one_mul]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.mem_activePrimeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_activePrimeSet {z p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ P.activePrimeSet z ↔ p.Prime ∧ p ≤ z ∧ ¬p ∣ P.step

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.activePrimeProduct_squarefree
statement:
theorem activePrimeProduct_squarefree (z : ℕ) :
    Squarefree (P.activePrimeProduct z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [activePrimeProduct]
  refine Finset.squarefree_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime (fun p hp q hq hpq ↦ ?_)
    (fun p hp ↦ (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1.squarefree)
  simp only [← coprime_iff_isRelPrime]
  exact (coprime_primes (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1
    (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hq).1).mpr hpq

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.step_coprime_activePrimeProduct
statement:
theorem step_coprime_activePrimeProduct (z : ℕ) :
    P.step.Coprime (P.activePrimeProduct z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [activePrimeProduct, Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff]
  intro p hp
  have hpData := P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp
  exact (hpData.1.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hpData.2.2).symm

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.step_coprime_of_dvd_activePrimeProduct
statement:
theorem step_coprime_of_dvd_activePrimeProduct {z d : ℕ}

:=
  (P.step_coprime_activePrimeProduct z).coprime_dvd_right hd

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.sieveDensity_apply_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sieveDensity_apply_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.sieveDensity_eq_inv
statement:
theorem sieveDensity_eq_inv {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hsq : Squarefree d) :

proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.boundingSieve_multSum
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_multSum (R z d : ℕ) :
    (P.boundingSieve R z).multSum d = (P.divisibleParameterSet R d).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [BoundingSieve.multSum, boundingSieve, support, valueEmbedding,
    divisibleParameterSet]
  rw [Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.boundingSieve_rem
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_rem {R z d : ℕ} :
    (P.boundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (P.divisibleParameterSet R d).card - P.sieveDensity d * R
proof:
:= by
  rw [BoundingSieve.rem, P.boundingSieve_multSum]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.boundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
    {R z d : ℕ} (hdDvd : d ∣ P.activePrimeProduct z) :
    (P.boundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (P.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) - (R % d : ℕ) / d
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero (P.boundingSieve R z).prodPrimes_ne_zero hdDvd)
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdDvd (P.activePrimeProduct_squarefree z)
  rw [P.boundingSieve_rem, P.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq hd0
    (P.step_coprime_of_dvd_activePrimeProduct hdDvd), P.sieveDensity_eq_inv hd0.ne' hsq]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_add]
  have hR : (R : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) + (R % d : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_add_div R d).symm.trans (by omega)
  rw [hR]
  have hdCast : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd0.ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.boundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction hdDvd]
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero (P.boundingSieve R z).prodPrimes_ne_zero hdDvd)
  have hcop := P.step_coprime_of_dvd_activePrimeProduct hdDvd
  have hexcess : (P.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast P.residueExcessCount_le_one hcop
  have hfrac : (((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one (by exact_mod_cast hd0)]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_lt R hd0).le
  have hexcess0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P.residueExcessCount R d := by positivity
  have hfrac0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d := by positivity
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.mem_siftedParameterSet

theorem mem_siftedParameterSet {R z t : ℕ} :

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.boundingSieve_siftedSum

proof:

    siftedParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.mem_primeParameterSet
statement:

proof:

  simp [primeParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.primeParameterSet_subset_siftedParameterSet
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  have htData := P.mem_primeParameterSet.mp ht
  apply P.mem_siftedParameterSet.mpr
  refine ⟨htData.1, ?_⟩
  rw [Progression.activePrimeProduct, Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff]
  intro p hpMem
  have hpData := P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpMem
  exact hpData.1.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr fun hpDiv ↦ by
    have hpEq : p = P.value t :=
      (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpData.1 htData.2).mp hpDiv
    have hzlt : z < p := by simpa [hpEq] using hlarge t htData.1
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hpData.2.1) hzlt

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.primeParameterCount_le_siftedSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.boundingSieve_siftedSum]
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card
    (P.primeParameterSet_subset_siftedParameterSet hlarge)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.minimizingSieve_totalMass
statement:

proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.localSieveProduct_pos
statement: theorem localSieveProduct_pos (z : ℕ) : 0 < P.localSieveProduct z
proof:
:= by
  unfold localSieveProduct
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun p hp ↦
    BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensFactor_pos (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.levelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant
statement:
theorem levelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant (R z : ℕ) :
    SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder (P.minimizingSieve R z) ≤
      P.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  change SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder s ≤
    P.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z
  unfold SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder
  change (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          |s.rem d|
      else 0) ≤
    ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d|
      else 0
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro d hdMem
  by_cases hlevel : (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level
  · rw [if_pos hlevel, if_pos hlevel]
    have hdDvd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdMem
    have hrem : |s.rem d| ≤ 1 := by
      exact P.abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_one hdDvd
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrem (abs_nonneg _)
  · rw [if_neg hlevel, if_neg hlevel]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.progressionSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
statement:
theorem progressionSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Cmass Crem : ℝ}
    (hmass : TruncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Cmass)
    (hrem : CombinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Crem) :
    ProgressionSelbergUpperBound cutoff (Cmass + Crem)
proof:
:= by
  intro P R hR
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R (cutoff R)
  have hfinite := SelbergFundamental.siftedSum_le_minimizing_main_add_error s
  have herrEq :=
    SelbergFundamental.errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_levelRestrictedRemainder s
  have hlevel := P.levelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant R (cutoff R)
  have hmass' := hmass P R hR
  have hrem' := hrem P R hR
  have hsMass : s.totalMass = (R : ℝ) := rfl
  change s.siftedSum ≤
    (Cmass + Crem) * R * P.localSieveProduct (cutoff R)
  calc
    s.siftedSum ≤ (R : ℝ) *
        (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s)⁻¹ +
        s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s)) := by
      rw [hsMass] at hfinite
      exact hfinite
    _ = (R : ℝ) * (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s)⁻¹ +
        SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder s := by rw [herrEq]
    _ ≤ (R : ℝ) * (Cmass * P.localSieveProduct (cutoff R)) +
        Crem * R * P.localSieveProduct (cutoff R) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass' (by positivity))
        (hlevel.trans hrem')
    _ = (Cmass + Crem) * R * P.localSieveProduct (cutoff R) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.localSieveProduct_eq_directMertens_mul_correction
statement:
theorem localSieveProduct_eq_directMertens_mul_correction
    (P : Progression) (z : ℕ) :
    P.localSieveProduct z =
      BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct z *
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z,
          BFPSTwoAffine.multiplierCorrectionFactor P.step p
proof:
:= by
  unfold Progression.localSieveProduct Progression.activePrimeSet
    BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct
  rw [Finset.prod_filter, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp
  by_cases hpd : p ∣ P.step
  · simp only [hpd, not_true_eq_false, if_false,
      BFPSTwoAffine.multiplierCorrectionFactor, if_true]
    field_simp [(BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensFactor_pos hpPrime).ne']
  · simp [hpd, BFPSTwoAffine.multiplierCorrectionFactor]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_mul_totientWeight
statement:
theorem localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_mul_totientWeight
    (P : Progression) (z : ℕ) :
    P.localSieveProduct z ≤
      BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct z * totientWeight P.step
proof:
:= by
  rw [localSieveProduct_eq_directMertens_mul_correction]
  rw [totientWeight_eq_eulerWeight P.step_pos.ne']
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (BFPSTwoAffine.correctionProduct_le_totientEulerWeight P.step_pos.ne')
    (BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_pos z).le

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_mul_totient_ratio
statement:
theorem localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_mul_totient_ratio
    (P : Progression) (z : ℕ) :
    P.localSieveProduct z ≤
      BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct z *
        ((P.step : ℝ) / (P.step.totient : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [totientWeight] using
    localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_mul_totientWeight P z

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicProgression_step
statement:

proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicProgression_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dyadicProgression_base {D a j : ℕ} {hD : 0 < D} {hcop : D.Coprime a} :
    (dyadicProgression D a j hD hcop).base = dyadicBase D a j
proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.residuePrimeIntervalSet_reducedResidue
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalSet_reducedResidue (D a L U : ℕ) :
    residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U =
      residuePrimeIntervalSet D (reducedResidue D a) L U
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  simp only [mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet]
  have hmod : a % D ≡ a [MOD D] := Nat.mod_modEq a D
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hU, hp, hqa⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hU, hp, hqa.trans hmod.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hL, hU, hp, hqb⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hU, hp, hqb.trans hmod⟩

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadic_parameter_data
statement:
private theorem dyadic_parameter_data
    {D a j q : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hcop : D.Coprime a)
    (hq : q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet D a
      (dyadicLength j * D) (2 * dyadicLength j * D)) :
    ∃ t < dyadicLength j,
      (dyadicProgression D a j hD hcop).value t = q
proof:
:= by
  let N := dyadicLength j
  let b := reducedResidue D a
  let k := q / D
  let K := dyadicStartIndex D a j
  have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
  change N * D < q ∧ q ≤ 2 * N * D ∧ q.Prime ∧ q ≡ a [MOD D] at hqData
  have hbLt : b < D := by
    exact Nat.mod_lt a hD
  have hmod : q % D = b := hqData.2.2.2
  have hqEq : q = b + D * k := by
    calc
      q = q % D + D * (q / D) := (Nat.mod_add_div q D).symm
      _ = b + D * k := by rw [hmod]
  have hkLower : N ≤ k := by
    apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hD).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hqData.1.le
  have hkUpper : k ≤ 2 * N := by
    apply Nat.div_le_of_le_mul
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hqData.2.1
  by_cases hbZero : b = 0
  · have hkLower' : N + 1 ≤ k := by
      have hne : k ≠ N := by
        intro hk
        have hqEndpoint : q = N * D := by
          calc
            q = b + D * k := hqEq
            _ = N * D := by rw [hbZero, hk]; ring
        omega
      omega
    let t := k - (N + 1)
    have ht : t < N := by omega
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    have hK : K = N + 1 := by
      simp [K, dyadicStartIndex, N, b, hbZero]
    have hKt : K + t = k := by
      rw [hK]
      exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hkLower'
    change dyadicBase D a j + D * t = q
    change b + D * K + D * t = q
    calc
      b + D * K + D * t = b + D * (K + t) := by ring
      _ = b + D * k := by rw [hKt]
      _ = q := hqEq.symm
  · have hbPos : 0 < b := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hbZero
    have hkUpper' : k < 2 * N := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hk : k = 2 * N := by omega
      have hqForm : q = b + D * (2 * N) := by
        calc
          q = b + D * k := hqEq
          _ = b + D * (2 * N) := by rw [hk]
      have hstrict : 2 * N * D < q := by
        calc
          2 * N * D = D * (2 * N) := by ring
          _ < b + D * (2 * N) := by omega
          _ = q := hqForm.symm
      omega
    let t := k - N
    have ht : t < N := by omega
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    have hK : K = N := by
      simp [K, dyadicStartIndex, N, b, hbZero]
    have hKt : K + t = k := by
      rw [hK]
      exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hkLower
    change dyadicBase D a j + D * t = q
    change b + D * K + D * t = q
    calc
      b + D * K + D * t = b + D * (K + t) := by ring
      _ = b + D * k := by rw [hKt]
      _ = q := hqEq.symm

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_primeParameterSet
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_primeParameterSet
    {D a j : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hcop : D.Coprime a) :
    residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (dyadicLength j * D)
        (2 * dyadicLength j * D) ≤
      ((dyadicProgression D a j hD hcop).primeParameterSet
        (dyadicLength j)).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold residuePrimeIntervalCount
  let P := dyadicProgression D a j hD hcop
  let source := residuePrimeIntervalSet D a
    (dyadicLength j * D) (2 * dyadicLength j * D)
  classical
  let parameter (q : ℕ) : ℕ :=
    if hq : q ∈ source then
      Classical.choose (dyadic_parameter_data hD hcop hq)
    else 0
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn parameter ?_ ?_
  · intro q hq
    have hqFin : q ∈ source := hq
    have hdata := Classical.choose_spec (dyadic_parameter_data hD hcop hqFin)
    have hparam : parameter q =
        Classical.choose (dyadic_parameter_data hD hcop hqFin) := by
      simp only [parameter]
      rw [dif_pos hqFin]
    apply P.mem_primeParameterSet.mpr
    rw [hparam]
    refine ⟨hdata.1, ?_⟩
    rw [hdata.2]
    exact (mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hqFin).2.2.1
  · intro q hq r hr heq
    have hqFin : q ∈ source := hq
    have hrFin : r ∈ source := hr
    have hqData := Classical.choose_spec (dyadic_parameter_data hD hcop hqFin)
    have hrData := Classical.choose_spec (dyadic_parameter_data hD hcop hrFin)
    have hqParam : parameter q =
        Classical.choose (dyadic_parameter_data hD hcop hqFin) := by
      simp only [parameter]
      rw [dif_pos hqFin]
    have hrParam : parameter r =
        Classical.choose (dyadic_parameter_data hD hcop hrFin) := by
      simp only [parameter]
      rw [dif_pos hrFin]
    calc
      q = P.value (parameter q) := by rw [hqParam]; exact hqData.2.symm
      _ = P.value (parameter r) := congrArg P.value heq
      _ = r := by rw [hrParam]; exact hrData.2

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.residuePrimeIntervalSet_eq_empty_of_not_coprime
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalSet_eq_empty_of_not_coprime
    {D a j : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hcop : ¬D.Coprime a) :
    residuePrimeIntervalSet D a (dyadicLength j * D)
      (2 * dyadicLength j * D) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro q hq
  have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
  let g := Nat.gcd D a
  have hgD : g ∣ D := Nat.gcd_dvd_left D a
  have hga : g ∣ a := Nat.gcd_dvd_right D a
  have hg1 : g ≠ 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, g] using hcop
  have hgq : g ∣ q :=
    (hqData.2.2.2.dvd_iff hgD).mpr hga
  have hgEq : g = q := (Nat.dvd_prime hqData.2.2.1).mp hgq |>.resolve_left hg1
  have hgLe : g ≤ D := Nat.le_of_dvd hD hgD
  have hNPos : 0 < dyadicLength j := by
    exact pow_pos (by norm_num) j
  have hDle : D ≤ dyadicLength j * D := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right D hNPos
  have hqLe : q ≤ D := hgEq ▸ hgLe
  omega

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.residuePrimeIntervalCount_eq_zero_of_not_coprime
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalCount_eq_zero_of_not_coprime
    {D a j : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hcop : ¬D.Coprime a) :
    residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (dyadicLength j * D)
      (2 * dyadicLength j * D) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalCount,
    residuePrimeIntervalSet_eq_empty_of_not_coprime hD hcop]
  simp

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicProgression_value_gt_lower
statement:
theorem dyadicProgression_value_gt_lower
    {D a j : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hcop : D.Coprime a) (t : ℕ) :
    dyadicLength j * D < (dyadicProgression D a j hD hcop).value t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : reducedResidue D a = 0
  · simp [Progression.value, dyadicProgression, dyadicBase,
      dyadicStartIndex, hb]
    nlinarith
  · have hbPos : 0 < reducedResidue D a := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb
    simp [Progression.value, dyadicProgression, dyadicBase,
      dyadicStartIndex, hb]
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_dyadicLength
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_dyadicLength (D a j : ℕ) :
    residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (dyadicLength j * D)
      (2 * dyadicLength j * D) ≤ dyadicLength j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hD : D = 0
  · subst D
    simp [residuePrimeIntervalCount, residuePrimeIntervalSet]
  · have hDPos : 0 < D := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hD
    by_cases hcop : D.Coprime a
    · calc
        residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (dyadicLength j * D)
            (2 * dyadicLength j * D) ≤
            ((dyadicProgression D a j hDPos hcop).primeParameterSet
              (dyadicLength j)).card :=
          residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_primeParameterSet hDPos hcop
        _ ≤ (Finset.range (dyadicLength j)).card := by
          apply Finset.card_le_card
          exact Finset.filter_subset _ _
        _ = dyadicLength j := Finset.card_range _
    · rw [residuePrimeIntervalCount_eq_zero_of_not_coprime hDPos hcop]
      exact Nat.zero_le _

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_elementary
statement:
theorem dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_elementary (D a J : ℕ) :
    DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis (J : ℝ) D a J
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  have hjData := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj
  have hjPos : 0 < j := by omega
  have hN := residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_dyadicLength D a j
  have hendpoint : 2 ^ (j + 1) * D = 2 * dyadicLength j * D := by
    unfold dyadicLength
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [hendpoint]
  rw [show 2 ^ j = dyadicLength j by rfl]
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ j = (dyadicLength j : ℝ) by
    norm_num [dyadicLength]]
  change (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (dyadicLength j * D)
      (2 * dyadicLength j * D) : ℝ) ≤
    (J : ℝ) * ((dyadicLength j : ℝ) * D) /
      ((D.totient : ℝ) * j)
  have hcount :
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (dyadicLength j * D)
        (2 * dyadicLength j * D) : ℝ) ≤ dyadicLength j := by
    exact_mod_cast hN
  by_cases hD : D = 0
  · subst D
    simp [residuePrimeIntervalCount, residuePrimeIntervalSet]
  · have hDPos : 0 < D := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hD
    have hphiPos : (0 : ℝ) < D.totient := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hDPos
    have hjRealPos : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hjPos
    have hden : 0 < (D.totient : ℝ) * j := mul_pos hphiPos hjRealPos
    refine hcount.trans ?_
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr
    have hphiD : (D.totient : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le D
    have hjJ : (j : ℝ) ≤ J := by exact_mod_cast hjData.2
    have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dyadicLength j := by positivity
    have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by positivity
    calc
      (dyadicLength j : ℝ) * ((D.totient : ℝ) * j) =
          (dyadicLength j : ℝ) * D.totient * j := by ring
      _ ≤ (dyadicLength j : ℝ) * D * j := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hphiD hN0) hjRealPos.le
      _ ≤ (dyadicLength j : ℝ) * D * J := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hjJ (mul_nonneg hN0 hD0)
      _ = (J : ℝ) * ((dyadicLength j : ℝ) * D) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicDirectMertensUpperBound_id
statement:
theorem dyadicDirectMertensUpperBound_id (J : ℕ) :
    DyadicDirectMertensUpperBound id (Real.log 2)⁻¹ J
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  have hjData := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj
  have hjPos : 0 < j := by omega
  have hN3 : 3 ≤ dyadicLength j := by
    have hpow : 2 ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ j := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hjData.1
    change 3 ≤ 2 ^ j
    norm_num at hpow ⊢
    omega
  have hM := BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProductUpperBound_id
    (dyadicLength j) hN3
  change BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct (dyadicLength j) ≤
    (Real.log 2)⁻¹ / j
  calc
    BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct (dyadicLength j) ≤
        1 / Real.log (dyadicLength j) := by simpa using hM
    _ = 1 / ((j : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      congr 2
      rw [show (dyadicLength j : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ j by
        norm_num [dyadicLength], Real.log_pow]
    _ = (Real.log 2)⁻¹ / j := by
      have hjNe : (j : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hlogNe : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
        ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicCutoffBelowInterval_id
statement:
theorem dyadicCutoffBelowInterval_id {D J : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    DyadicCutoffBelowInterval id D J
proof:
:= by
  intro j _hj
  change dyadicLength j ≤ dyadicLength j * D
  exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (dyadicLength j) hD

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_of_progressionSelberg
statement:
theorem dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_of_progressionSelberg
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Csieve Cmertens : ℝ} {D a J : ℕ}
    (hCsieve : 0 ≤ Csieve) (hCmertens : 0 ≤ Cmertens)
    (hsieve : ProgressionSelbergUpperBound cutoff Csieve)
    (hmertens : DyadicDirectMertensUpperBound cutoff Cmertens J)
    (hcutoff : DyadicCutoffBelowInterval cutoff D J) :
    DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis (Csieve * Cmertens) D a J
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  have hjData := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj
  have hjPos : 0 < j := by omega
  let N := dyadicLength j
  have hN3 : 3 ≤ N := by
    have hpow : 2 ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ j := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hjData.1
    change 3 ≤ 2 ^ j
    norm_num at hpow ⊢
    omega
  have hendpoint : 2 ^ (j + 1) * D = 2 * N * D := by
    dsimp only [N, dyadicLength]
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [hendpoint]
  rw [show 2 ^ j = N by rfl]
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ j = (N : ℝ) by
    dsimp only [N, dyadicLength]
    norm_num]
  change (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (N * D) (2 * N * D) : ℝ) ≤
    (Csieve * Cmertens) * ((N : ℝ) * D) /
      ((D.totient : ℝ) * j)
  by_cases hD : D = 0
  · subst D
    simp [residuePrimeIntervalCount, residuePrimeIntervalSet]
  · have hDPos : 0 < D := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hD
    by_cases hcop : D.Coprime a
    · let P := dyadicProgression D a j hDPos hcop
      have hcountNat :=
        residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_primeParameterSet (j := j) hDPos hcop
      have hcount :
          (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (N * D) (2 * N * D) : ℝ) ≤
            ((P.primeParameterSet N).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hcountNat
      have hlarge : ∀ t < N, cutoff N < P.value t := by
        intro t ht
        exact (hcutoff j hj).trans_lt
          (dyadicProgression_value_gt_lower hDPos hcop t)
      have hprimeSift := P.primeParameterCount_le_siftedSum hlarge
      have hsieve' := hsieve P N hN3
      have hlocal := localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_mul_totient_ratio
        P (cutoff N)
      have hmertens' := hmertens j hj
      have hphiPos : (0 : ℝ) < D.totient := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hDPos
      have hjRealPos : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hjPos
      have hratio0 : 0 ≤ (D : ℝ) / D.totient := by positivity
      calc
        (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (N * D) (2 * N * D) : ℝ) ≤
            ((P.primeParameterSet N).card : ℝ) := hcount
        _ ≤ (P.boundingSieve N (cutoff N)).siftedSum := hprimeSift
        _ ≤ Csieve * N * P.localSieveProduct (cutoff N) := hsieve'
        _ ≤ Csieve * N *
              (BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct (cutoff N) *
                ((D : ℝ) / D.totient)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlocal
            (mul_nonneg hCsieve (by positivity))
        _ ≤ Csieve * N *
              ((Cmertens / (j : ℝ)) * ((D : ℝ) / D.totient)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmertens' hratio0)
            (mul_nonneg hCsieve (by positivity))
        _ = (Csieve * Cmertens) * ((N : ℝ) * D) /
              ((D.totient : ℝ) * j) := by field_simp
    · rw [residuePrimeIntervalCount_eq_zero_of_not_coprime hDPos hcop]
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_zero]
      have hND0 : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) * D :=
        mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) (Nat.cast_nonneg D)
      have hden0 : 0 ≤ (D.totient : ℝ) * j :=
        mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg D.totient) (Nat.cast_nonneg j)
      exact div_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCsieve hCmertens) hND0)
        hden0

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_of_identity_terminalEstimates
statement:
theorem dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_of_identity_terminalEstimates
    {Cmass Crem : ℝ} {D a J : ℕ}
    (hCmass : 0 ≤ Cmass) (hCrem : 0 ≤ Crem) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hmass : TruncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound id Cmass)
    (hrem : CombinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound id Crem) :
    DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis
      ((Cmass + Crem) * (Real.log 2)⁻¹) D a J
proof:
:= by
  apply dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_of_progressionSelberg
    (hCsieve := add_nonneg hCmass hCrem)
    (hCmertens := inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)).le)
    (progressionSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder hmass hrem)
    (dyadicDirectMertensUpperBound_id J)
    (dyadicCutoffBelowInterval_id hD)

name: RankAmplification.predecessor_prime_rpow_le_pred
statement:
theorem predecessor_prime_rpow_le_pred
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤ (p - 1 : ℕ) ^ (-c)
proof:
:= by
  have hpredPos : (0 : ℝ) < (p - 1 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hp.one_lt
  have hpredLe : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ p := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le p 1
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hpredPos hpredLe (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_finiteSmoothRpowSum
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_finiteSmoothRpowSum
    {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c ≤
      finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) Y X (-c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := smoothPredecessorPrimeEmbedding X Y
  let A : Finset {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet Y X} := Finset.univ.map e
  calc
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c =
        ∑ p : {p : ℕ // p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y},
          (p.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      rw [smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum, ← Finset.sum_attach,
        Finset.attach_eq_univ]
    _ ≤ ∑ p : {p : ℕ // p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y},
        ((e p).1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦
        predecessor_prime_rpow_le_pred
          (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime p.2) hc
    _ = ∑ m ∈ A, (m.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      change (∑ p : {p : ℕ // p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y},
          ((e p).1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)) =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.map e, (m.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)
      rw [Finset.sum_map]
    _ ≤ ∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet Y X},
        (m.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
        (fun m _ _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m.1) _)
    _ = finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) Y X (-c) := by
      symm
      rw [finiteSmoothRpowSum, ← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
      simp only [one_mul]

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_softenedMertensProduct
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_softenedMertensProduct
    {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c ≤ softenedMertensProduct Y c
proof:
:= by
  exact (smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_finiteSmoothRpowSum hc.le).trans
    (finiteSmoothRankinSum_le_softenedMertensProduct hc)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_cast_le_directSmoothPredecessor
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_cast_le_directSmoothPredecessor
    {X Y : ℕ} {c₀ c : ℝ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hc : c₀ ≤ c) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (directSmoothPredecessorExponent X Y c₀ c)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := smoothTotientCount_le_exp_saving
    (X := X) (Y := Y) hX hc₀ hc
  have hprime := smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_softenedMertensProduct
    (X := X) (Y := Y) (c := c) (hc₀.trans_le hc)
  unfold directSmoothPredecessorExponent
  exact hbase.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr <| add_le_add_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
        (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos hc₀).le) _)
    (by positivity)

    (x X : ℕ) :

        (movingNatZ x) (movingNatJ x)

    boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
    {x X H K : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
    (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 1 ≤ movingNatY x) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hYK : movingNatZ x ^ movingNatJ x ≤ K)
    (hKJ : K ^ movingNatJ x ≤ H)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsharp : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X (movingNatY x) H B) :
    (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        (B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatZ x) (K - 1) X) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X +
            (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingLowRankCensusCount_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount]
  exact boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
    hX hy hK hYK hKJ hB hsharp

name: RankAmplification.badLinearPredecessorProduct_pos
statement:
theorem badLinearPredecessorProduct_pos (N y : ℕ) :
    0 < badLinearPredecessorProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  unfold badLinearPredecessorProduct
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun q hq ↦ by
    have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors
      (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1).1
    exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hqPrime.one_lt

name: RankAmplification.badLinearPredecessorProduct_isSmooth
statement:
theorem badLinearPredecessorProduct_isSmooth
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J) :
    IsSmooth Y (badLinearPredecessorProduct N y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold badLinearPredecessorProduct
  exact isSmooth_finset_prod (badLinearPrimeSet N y) (fun q ↦ q - 1) fun q hq ↦ by
    have hqData := mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq
    have hcandidate := linearBadSource_mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet
      hy hN hqData.1 hqData.2
    exact (mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp hcandidate).2.2.2.2.1

name: RankAmplification.badLinearPredecessorProduct_le_pow
statement:
theorem badLinearPredecessorProduct_le_pow
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J) :
    badLinearPredecessorProduct N y ≤ X ^ J
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (badLinearPrimeSet N y).card ≤ J := by
    have hsubset : badLinearPrimeSet N y ⊆ badLocalPrimeSet N y := by
      intro q hq
      exact (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsubset).trans
      (card_badLocalPrimeSet_lt_rankThreshold
        (by
          have hNdata := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
          omega)
        hy (mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN).2.2.2).le
  calc
    badLinearPredecessorProduct N y ≤
        ∏ _q ∈ badLinearPrimeSet N y, X := by
      unfold badLinearPredecessorProduct
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod (s := badLinearPrimeSet N y)
      · intro q hq
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      · intro q hq
        have hqData := mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq
        have hcandidate := linearBadSource_mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet
          hy hN hqData.1 hqData.2
        exact (Nat.sub_le q 1).trans
          (mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp hcandidate).2.1
    _ = X ^ (badLinearPrimeSet N y).card := by simp
    _ ≤ X ^ J := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hX hcard

name: RankAmplification.badPowerPrimeSet_subset_largeTotientSupport
statement:
theorem badPowerPrimeSet_subset_largeTotientSupport
    {N y : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    badPowerPrimeSet N y ⊆ (primeSupport N.totient).filter (y < ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hqData := mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq
  have hqSupport := (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hqData.1).1
  have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqSupport
  have hqDvd := badLocalBase_dvd_totient_of_two_le hN hqData.1 hqData.2
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mem_primeFactors]
  exact ⟨⟨hqPrime, hqDvd,
    (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hN)).ne'⟩,
      badLocalBase_gt hy hqData.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.sum_badPower_exponent_pred_le_largePrimeRank
statement:
theorem sum_badPower_exponent_pred_le_largePrimeRank
    {N y : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, (N.factorization q - 1)) ≤
      largePrimeRank y N.totient
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, (N.factorization q - 1)) ≤
        ∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, N.totient.factorization q := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum (s := badPowerPrimeSet N y)
      intro q hq
      exact sourceExponent_pred_le_totient_factorization hN
        (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp (mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq).1).1
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ (primeSupport N.totient).filter (y < ·),
        N.totient.factorization q := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset
        (badPowerPrimeSet_subset_largeTotientSupport hN hy)
    _ = largePrimeRank y N.totient := rfl

name: RankAmplification.badPowerExponentSum_eq_pred_add_card
statement:
theorem badPowerExponentSum_eq_pred_add_card (N y : ℕ) :
    badPowerExponentSum N y =
      (∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, (N.factorization q - 1)) +
        (badPowerPrimeSet N y).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold badPowerExponentSum
  calc
    (∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, N.factorization q) =
        ∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y,
          ((N.factorization q - 1) + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro q hq
      have htwo := (mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq).2
      omega
    _ = (∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, (N.factorization q - 1)) +
        ∑ _q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = (∑ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, (N.factorization q - 1)) +
        (badPowerPrimeSet N y).card := by simp

name: RankAmplification.badPowerExponentSum_lt_two_mul_rank
statement:
theorem badPowerExponentSum_lt_two_mul_rank
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J) :
    badPowerExponentSum N y < 2 * J
proof:
:= by
  have hNdata := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  have hNne : N ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hpred := sum_badPower_exponent_pred_le_largePrimeRank hNne hy
  have hcard : (badPowerPrimeSet N y).card < J := by
    have hsubset : badPowerPrimeSet N y ⊆ badLocalPrimeSet N y := by
      intro q hq
      exact (mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq).1
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsubset).trans_lt
      (card_badLocalPrimeSet_lt_rankThreshold hNne hy hNdata.2.2.2)
  rw [badPowerExponentSum_eq_pred_add_card]
  omega

name: RankAmplification.badPowerProduct_le_upper_pow_two_rank
statement:
theorem badPowerProduct_le_upper_pow_two_rank
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J) :
    badPowerProduct N y ≤ Y ^ (2 * J)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := badPowerExponentSum_lt_two_mul_rank hy hN
  calc
    badPowerProduct N y ≤
        ∏ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y, Y ^ N.factorization q := by
      unfold badPowerProduct
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod (s := badPowerPrimeSet N y)
      · intro q hq
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      · intro q hq
        have hqData := mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq
        exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left
          ((fixedBadLocalSourceBounds_of_mem
            (by
              have hNdata := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
              omega)
            hy (mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN).2.2.1
            (mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN).2.2.2 hqData.1).repeated_source_le_upper
              hqData.2)
          _
    _ = Y ^ badPowerExponentSum N y := by
      rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
      rfl
    _ ≤ Y ^ (2 * J) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hY hsum.le

name: RankAmplification.badLinearProduct_le_two_pow_mul_predecessor
statement:
theorem badLinearProduct_le_two_pow_mul_predecessor
    {N y J : ℕ}
    (hcard : (badLinearPrimeSet N y).card < J) :
    badLinearProduct N y ≤ 2 ^ J * badLinearPredecessorProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    badLinearProduct N y ≤
        ∏ q ∈ badLinearPrimeSet N y, 2 * (q - 1) := by
      unfold badLinearProduct
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod (s := badLinearPrimeSet N y)
      · intro q hq
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      · intro q hq
        have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors
          (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1).1
        have hqTwo : 2 ≤ q := hqPrime.two_le
        omega
    _ = 2 ^ (badLinearPrimeSet N y).card *
        badLinearPredecessorProduct N y := by
      rw [badLinearPredecessorProduct, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      simp
    _ ≤ 2 ^ J * badLinearPredecessorProduct N y := by
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hcard.le)

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_pos
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_pos
    {X y Y J : ℕ}
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    0 < boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode d
proof:
:=
  badLinearPredecessorProduct_pos _ _

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_isSmooth
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_isSmooth
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    IsSmooth Y (boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode d)
proof:
:=
  badLinearPredecessorProduct_isSmooth hy
    (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem d)

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_le_pow
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_le_pow
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode d ≤ X ^ J
proof:
:=
  badLinearPredecessorProduct_le_pow hX hy
    (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem d)

name: RankAmplification.badSource_le_scale_mul_linearPredecessorCode
statement:
theorem badSource_le_scale_mul_linearPredecessorCode
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    d.1 ≤ (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode d
proof:
:= by
  let N := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d
  have hN := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem d
  have hcard : (badLinearPrimeSet N y).card < J := by
    have hsubset : badLinearPrimeSet N y ⊆ badLocalPrimeSet N y := by
      intro q hq
      exact (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsubset).trans_lt
      (card_badLocalPrimeSet_lt_rankThreshold
        (by
          have hNdata := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
          omega)
        hy (mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN).2.2.2)
  have hlinear := badLinearProduct_le_two_pow_mul_predecessor hcard
  have hpower := badPowerProduct_le_upper_pow_two_rank hy hY hN
  rw [← badLocalProduct_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d,
    badLocalProduct_eq_badLinearProduct_mul_badPowerProduct]
  calc
    badLinearProduct N y * badPowerProduct N y ≤
        (2 ^ J * badLinearPredecessorProduct N y) * Y ^ (2 * J) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hlinear hpower
    _ = (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode d := by
      unfold boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode N
      ring

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_mem_tail
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_mem_tail
    {X y Y J H Hcode : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J})
    (hd : H < d.1) :
    boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode d ∈
      finiteSmoothTailSet Y Hcode (X ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_finiteSmoothTailSet]
  refine ⟨?_, boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_le_pow hX hy d,
    boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_isSmooth hy d⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have hcode : boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode d ≤ Hcode := Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hsize := badSource_le_scale_mul_linearPredecessorCode hy hY d
  have : d.1 ≤ H := hsize.trans <|
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) hcode).trans hthreshold
  omega

name: RankAmplification.paddedFinsetTuple_pos
statement:
theorem paddedFinsetTuple_pos
    { α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Finset α) (v : α → ℕ) (J : ℕ) (hcard : s.card ≤ J)
    (hv : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 < v a) (i : Fin J) :
    0 < paddedFinsetTuple s v J hcard i
proof:
:= by
  unfold paddedFinsetTuple
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact hv _ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) ⟨i.1, hi⟩).2
  · norm_num

name: RankAmplification.paddedFinsetTuple_le
statement:
theorem paddedFinsetTuple_le
    { α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Finset α) (v : α → ℕ) (J X : ℕ) (hcard : s.card ≤ J)
    (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hv : ∀ a ∈ s, v a ≤ X) (i : Fin J) :
    paddedFinsetTuple s v J hcard i ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  unfold paddedFinsetTuple
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact hv _ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) ⟨i.1, hi⟩).2
  · exact hX

name: RankAmplification.prod_paddedFinsetTuple
statement:
theorem prod_paddedFinsetTuple
    { α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Finset α) (v : α → ℕ) (J : ℕ) (hcard : s.card ≤ J) :
    (∏ i, paddedFinsetTuple s v J hcard i) = ∏ a ∈ s, v a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrange : Finset.range s.card ⊆ Finset.range J :=
    Finset.range_mono hcard
  rw [Finset.prod_fin_eq_prod_range]
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ if hi : i < J then
    paddedFinsetTuple s v J hcard ⟨i, hi⟩ else 1
  change (∏ i ∈ Finset.range J, f i) = ∏ a ∈ s, v a
  rw [← Finset.prod_subset hrange]
  · calc
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range s.card, f i) =
          ∏ i ∈ Finset.range s.card,
            if hi : i < s.card then
              v ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) ⟨i, hi⟩).1 else 1 := by
            apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            have hiCard : i < s.card := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
            have hiJ : i < J := hiCard.trans_le hcard
            simp [f, paddedFinsetTuple, hiJ, hiCard]
      _ = ∏ i : Fin s.card, v ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).1 := by
        rw [← Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range]
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        simp
      _ = ∏ a : {a // a ∈ s}, v a.1 := by
        exact (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).toEquiv.prod_comp
          (fun a : {a // a ∈ s} ↦ v a.1)
      _ = ∏ a ∈ s, v a := Finset.prod_attach s v
  · intro i hiJ hiCard
    have hiJ' : i < J := Finset.mem_range.mp hiJ
    have hnot : ¬ i < s.card := by
      simpa only [Finset.mem_range] using hiCard
    simp [f, paddedFinsetTuple, hiJ', hnot]

name: RankAmplification.paddedFinsetTuple_injective
statement:
theorem paddedFinsetTuple_injective
    { α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {v : α → ℕ} {J : ℕ}
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (hvTwo : ∀ a, 2 ≤ v a) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun s : {s : Finset α // s.card ≤ J} ↦
        paddedFinsetTuple s.1 v J s.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t htuple
  have hcard : s.1.card = t.1.card := by
    apply Nat.le_antisymm
    · by_contra hnot
      have hlt : t.1.card < s.1.card := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
      let i : Fin J := ⟨t.1.card, hlt.trans_le s.2⟩
      have heq := congrFun htuple i
      have hleft : i.1 < s.1.card := hlt
      have hright : ¬ i.1 < t.1.card := Nat.lt_irrefl _
      simp only [paddedFinsetTuple, dif_pos hleft, dif_neg hright] at heq
      have htwo := hvTwo ((s.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) ⟨i.1, hleft⟩).1
      omega
    · by_contra hnot
      have hlt : s.1.card < t.1.card := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
      let i : Fin J := ⟨s.1.card, hlt.trans_le t.2⟩
      have heq := congrFun htuple i
      have hleft : ¬ i.1 < s.1.card := Nat.lt_irrefl _
      have hright : i.1 < t.1.card := hlt
      simp only [paddedFinsetTuple, dif_neg hleft, dif_pos hright] at heq
      have htwo := hvTwo ((t.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) ⟨i.1, hright⟩).1
      omega
  have henum : ∀ i : Fin s.1.card,
      ((s.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).1 =
        ((t.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).1 := by
    intro i
    have hiJ : i.1 < J := i.2.trans_le s.2
    let k : Fin J := ⟨i.1, hiJ⟩
    have heq := congrFun htuple k
    have hslt : k.1 < s.1.card := i.2
    have htlt : k.1 < t.1.card := by simpa [hcard] using i.2
    simp only [paddedFinsetTuple, dif_pos hslt, dif_pos htlt] at heq
    have hfin : (⟨k.1, htlt⟩ : Fin t.1.card) = Fin.cast hcard i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [hfin] at heq
    exact hv heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finset.ext
  intro a
  constructor
  · intro ha
    let i : Fin s.1.card :=
      (s.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨a, ha⟩
    have hi := henum i
    have his : ((s.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).1 = a := by
      simp [i]
    have hit : ((t.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).1 ∈ t.1 :=
      ((t.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).2
    have hta : ((t.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).1 = a :=
      hi.symm.trans his
    rw [hta] at hit
    exact hit
  · intro ha
    let i : Fin t.1.card :=
      (t.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨a, ha⟩
    let j : Fin s.1.card := Fin.cast hcard.symm i
    have hj := henum j
    have hcast : Fin.cast hcard j = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have hit : ((t.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).1 = a := by
      simp [i]
    have hjs : ((s.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).1 ∈ s.1 :=
      ((s.1.orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).2
    rw [hcast, hit] at hj
    simpa [hj] using hjs

name: RankAmplification.paddedFinsetTuple_eq_of_local
statement:
theorem paddedFinsetTuple_eq_of_local
    { α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {v : α → ℕ} {J : ℕ}
    {s t : Finset α} (hs : s.card ≤ J) (ht : t.card ≤ J)
    (hvs : ∀ a ∈ s, 2 ≤ v a) (hvt : ∀ a ∈ t, 2 ≤ v a)
    (hvinj : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, v a = v b → a = b)
    (htuple : paddedFinsetTuple s v J hs = paddedFinsetTuple t v J ht) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : s.card = t.card := by
    apply Nat.le_antisymm
    · by_contra hnot
      have hlt : t.card < s.card := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
      let i : Fin J := ⟨t.card, hlt.trans_le hs⟩
      have heq := congrFun htuple i
      have hleft : i.1 < s.card := hlt
      have hright : ¬ i.1 < t.card := Nat.lt_irrefl _
      simp only [paddedFinsetTuple, dif_pos hleft, dif_neg hright] at heq
      have htwo := hvs _ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) ⟨i.1, hleft⟩).2
      omega
    · by_contra hnot
      have hlt : s.card < t.card := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
      let i : Fin J := ⟨s.card, hlt.trans_le ht⟩
      have heq := congrFun htuple i
      have hleft : ¬ i.1 < s.card := Nat.lt_irrefl _
      have hright : i.1 < t.card := hlt
      simp only [paddedFinsetTuple, dif_neg hleft, dif_pos hright] at heq
      have htwo := hvt _ ((t.orderIsoOfFin rfl) ⟨i.1, hright⟩).2
      omega
  have henum : ∀ i : Fin s.card,
      ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).1 =
        ((t.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).1 := by
    intro i
    have hiJ : i.1 < J := i.2.trans_le hs
    let k : Fin J := ⟨i.1, hiJ⟩
    have heq := congrFun htuple k
    have hslt : k.1 < s.card := i.2
    have htlt : k.1 < t.card := by simpa [hcard] using i.2
    simp only [paddedFinsetTuple, dif_pos hslt, dif_pos htlt] at heq
    have hfin : (⟨k.1, htlt⟩ : Fin t.card) = Fin.cast hcard i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [hfin] at heq
    exact hvinj _ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).2 _
      ((t.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).2 heq
  apply Finset.ext
  intro a
  constructor
  · intro ha
    let i : Fin s.card := (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨a, ha⟩
    have hi := henum i
    have his : ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).1 = a := by simp [i]
    have hit : ((t.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).1 ∈ t :=
      ((t.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).2
    have hta : ((t.orderIsoOfFin rfl) (Fin.cast hcard i)).1 = a :=
      hi.symm.trans his
    rwa [hta] at hit
  · intro ha
    let i : Fin t.card := (t.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨a, ha⟩
    let j : Fin s.card := Fin.cast hcard.symm i
    have hj := henum j
    have hcast : Fin.cast hcard j = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    have hit : ((t.orderIsoOfFin rfl) i).1 = a := by simp [i]
    have hjs : ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).1 ∈ s :=
      ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).2
    rw [hcast, hit] at hj
    simpa [hj] using hjs

name: RankAmplification.representative_badLinearPrimeSet_card_le
statement:
theorem representative_badLinearPrimeSet_card_le
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    (badLinearPrimeSet (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y).card ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  let N := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d
  have hN := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem d
  have hsubset : badLinearPrimeSet N y ⊆ badLocalPrimeSet N y := by
    intro q hq
    exact (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1
  exact (Finset.card_le_card hsubset).trans
    (card_badLocalPrimeSet_lt_rankThreshold
      (by
        have hNdata := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
        omega)
      hy (mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN).2.2.2).le

name: RankAmplification.lowRankPowerAtomWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem lowRankPowerAtomWeight_nonneg
    {y Y J : ℕ} (a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J) :
    0 ≤ lowRankPowerAtomWeight a
proof:
