name: RankAmplification.prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode
statement:
theorem prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    (∏ a ∈ boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy d, lowRankPowerAtomValue a) =
      badPowerProduct (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode
  rw [Finset.prod_map]
  simp only [lowRankPowerAtomValue]
  change (∏ q ∈ (badPowerPrimeSet
      (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y).attach,
      q.1 ^ ((boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d).factorization q.1 - 2 + 2)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∏ q ∈ (badPowerPrimeSet
        (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y).attach,
        q.1 ^ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d).factorization q.1 := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro q hq
      have htwo := (mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp q.2).2
      congr 1
      omega
    _ = ∏ q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet
        (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y,
        q ^ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d).factorization q := by
      exact Finset.prod_attach
        (badPowerPrimeSet (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y)
        (fun q ↦ q ^ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d).factorization q)
    _ = badPowerProduct (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y := rfl

name: RankAmplification.prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomWeight
statement:
theorem prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomWeight
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    (∏ a ∈ boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy d, lowRankPowerAtomWeight a) =
      (badPowerProduct (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowRankPowerAtomWeight
  rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib, ← Nat.cast_prod,
    prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy d]

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankFibreEncoding_injective
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankFibreEncoding_injective
    {X y Y J m : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 2 ≤ y) :
    Function.Injective
      (boundedLowRankFibreEncoding (X := X) (Y := Y) (J := J)
        (m := m) hX
          (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 2) hy)))
proof:
:= by
  intro d e hde
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  let Nd := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d.1
  let Ne := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative e.1
  let Sd := badLinearPrimeSet Nd y
  let Se := badLinearPrimeSet Ne y
  have hSd : Sd.card ≤ J := representative_badLinearPrimeSet_card_le hy1 d.1
  have hSe : Se.card ≤ J := representative_badLinearPrimeSet_card_le hy1 e.1
  have htuple : paddedFinsetTuple Sd (fun q ↦ q - 1) J hSd =
      paddedFinsetTuple Se (fun q ↦ q - 1) J hSe := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.1.1) hde
    have hnat := congrArg
      (fun f : Fin J → Fin (X + 1) ↦ fun i ↦ (f i : ℕ)) h
    simpa [boundedLowRankFibreEncoding,
      boundedLowRankFibrePredecessorTuple,
      boundedLowRankPositivePredecessorTuple,
      paddedPositiveProductTuple, Nd, Ne, Sd, Se] using hnat
  have hsets : Sd = Se := by
    refine paddedFinsetTuple_eq_of_local (v := fun q : ℕ ↦ q - 1)
      hSd hSe ?_ ?_ ?_ htuple
    · intro q hq
      have hgt := badLocalBase_gt hy1
        (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1
      omega
    · intro q hq
      have hgt := badLocalBase_gt hy1
        (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1
      omega
    · intro q hq r hr hqr
      have hqgt := badLocalBase_gt hy1
        (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).1
      have hrgt := badLocalBase_gt hy1
        (mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hr).1
      omega
  have hpowerCode : boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy1 d.1 =
      boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy1 e.1 := by
    simpa [boundedLowRankFibreEncoding] using congrArg Prod.snd hde
  have hlinear : badLinearProduct Nd y = badLinearProduct Ne y := by
    simp only [badLinearProduct]
    change (∏ q ∈ Sd, q) = ∏ q ∈ Se, q
    rw [hsets]
  have hpower : badPowerProduct Nd y = badPowerProduct Ne y := by
    calc
      badPowerProduct Nd y =
          ∏ a ∈ boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy1 d.1,
            lowRankPowerAtomValue a := by
        simpa [Nd] using (prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy1 d.1).symm
      _ = ∏ a ∈ boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy1 e.1,
            lowRankPowerAtomValue a := by rw [hpowerCode]
      _ = badPowerProduct Ne y := by
        simpa [Ne] using prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy1 e.1
  have hvalue : d.1.1 = e.1.1 := by
    calc
      d.1.1 = badLocalProduct Nd y := by
        simpa [Nd] using
          (badLocalProduct_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d.1).symm
      _ = badLinearProduct Nd y * badPowerProduct Nd y :=
        badLocalProduct_eq_badLinearProduct_mul_badPowerProduct Nd y
      _ = badLinearProduct Ne y * badPowerProduct Ne y := by
        rw [hlinear, hpower]
      _ = badLocalProduct Ne y :=
        (badLocalProduct_eq_badLinearProduct_mul_badPowerProduct Ne y).symm
      _ = e.1.1 := by
        simpa [Ne] using
          badLocalProduct_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative e.1
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hvalue

name: RankAmplification.badLinearPredecessorProduct_le_badLinearProduct
statement:
theorem badLinearPredecessorProduct_le_badLinearProduct (N y : ℕ) :
    badLinearPredecessorProduct N y ≤ badLinearProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  unfold badLinearPredecessorProduct badLinearProduct
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod (s := badLinearPrimeSet N y)
  · intro q hq
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  · intro q hq
    exact Nat.sub_le q 1

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankFibre_reciprocal_le
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankFibre_reciprocal_le
    {X y Y J m : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m) :
    1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ) ≤
      1 / (m : ℝ) *
        ∏ a ∈ boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy d.1,
          lowRankPowerAtomWeight a
proof:
:= by
  let N := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d.1
  have hmPosNat : 0 < m := by
    rw [← d.2]
    exact boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_pos d.1
  have hmLinearNat : m ≤ badLinearProduct N y := by
    rw [← d.2]
    exact badLinearPredecessorProduct_le_badLinearProduct N y
  have hmPos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hmPosNat
  have hmLinear : (m : ℝ) ≤ badLinearProduct N y := by
    exact_mod_cast hmLinearNat
  have hinv : (badLinearProduct N y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hmPos hmLinear
  have hpowerNonneg : 0 ≤ (badPowerProduct N y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
  calc
    1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ) = (badLocalProduct N y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [one_div]
      simpa [N] using congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹)
        (badLocalProduct_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d.1).symm
    _ =
        (badLinearProduct N y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (badPowerProduct N y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [badLocalProduct_eq_badLinearProduct_mul_badPowerProduct,
        Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev]
      ring
    _ ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹ * (badPowerProduct N y : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hinv hpowerNonneg
    _ = 1 / (m : ℝ) *
        ∏ a ∈ boundedLowRankPowerAtomCode hy d.1,
          lowRankPowerAtomWeight a := by
      rw [prod_boundedLowRankPowerAtomWeight hy d.1]
      simp only [one_div]
      rfl

name: RankAmplification.sum_lowRankPowerAtomWeight
statement:
theorem sum_lowRankPowerAtomWeight (y Y J : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J, lowRankPowerAtomWeight a) =
      fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  unfold fixedPowerBadSourceMass powerSourceLocalMass powerExponentReciprocalMass
  calc
    (∑ q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y},
        ∑ e : Fin J, lowRankPowerAtomWeight (q, e)) =
        ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y,
          ∑ e : Fin J, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e.1 + 2) := by
      simpa [lowRankPowerAtomWeight, lowRankPowerAtomValue,
        Nat.cast_pow, inv_pow] using
        (Finset.sum_attach (powerSourcePrimeSet y Y)
          (fun q ↦ ∑ e : Fin J, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e.1 + 2)))
    _ = ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y,
        ∑ e ∈ Finset.range J, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e + 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro q hq
      simpa using Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (n := J) (fun e : ℕ ↦ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e + 2))

name: RankAmplification.lowRankPowerAtomEulerProduct_le_exp_inv
statement:
theorem lowRankPowerAtomEulerProduct_le_exp_inv
    {y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    (∏ a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J, (1 + lowRankPowerAtomWeight a)) ≤
      Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∏ a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J, (1 + lowRankPowerAtomWeight a)) ≤
        Real.exp (∑ a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J,
          lowRankPowerAtomWeight a) := by
      exact Real.prod_one_add_le_exp_sum Finset.univ
        lowRankPowerAtomWeight_nonneg
    _ = Real.exp (fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J) := by
      rw [sum_lowRankPowerAtomWeight]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (fixedPowerBadSourceMass_le_inv hy)

name: RankAmplification.lowRankFibreCodeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem lowRankFibreCodeWeight_nonneg
    {X y Y J m : ℕ} (c : LowRankFibreCode X y Y J m) :
    0 ≤ lowRankFibreCodeWeight c
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowRankFibreCodeWeight
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    (Finset.prod_nonneg fun a ha ↦ lowRankPowerAtomWeight_nonneg a)

name: RankAmplification.sum_lowRankFibreCodeWeight
statement:
theorem sum_lowRankFibreCodeWeight
    {X y Y J m : ℕ} :
    (∑ c : LowRankFibreCode X y Y J m, lowRankFibreCodeWeight c) =
      (Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J X m) : ℝ) *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) *
          ∏ a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J, (1 + lowRankPowerAtomWeight a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold lowRankFibreCodeWeight
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [← Finset.powerset_univ]
  rw [Finset.prod_one_add]

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankSourceFibre_reciprocal_sum_le
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankSourceFibre_reciprocal_sum_le
    {X y Y J m : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 2 ≤ y) :
    (∑ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m, 1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  let encode : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m →
      LowRankFibreCode X y Y J m := boundedLowRankFibreEncoding hX hy1
  have hencode : Function.Injective encode := by
    exact boundedLowRankFibreEncoding_injective hX hy
  have hentry : ∀ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m,
      1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ) ≤ lowRankFibreCodeWeight (encode d) := by
    intro d
    simpa [encode, lowRankFibreCodeWeight, boundedLowRankFibreEncoding] using
      boundedLowRankFibre_reciprocal_le hy1 d
  have hcodeSum :
      (∑ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m,
          lowRankFibreCodeWeight (encode d)) ≤
        ∑ c : LowRankFibreCode X y Y J m, lowRankFibreCodeWeight c := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_image]
    · exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
        (fun c hc hnot ↦ lowRankFibreCodeWeight_nonneg c)
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact hencode hab
  calc
    (∑ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m, 1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m,
          lowRankFibreCodeWeight (encode d) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun d hd ↦ hentry d
    _ ≤ ∑ c : LowRankFibreCode X y Y J m,
        lowRankFibreCodeWeight c := hcodeSum
    _ = (Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J X m) : ℝ) *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) *
          ∏ a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J, (1 + lowRankPowerAtomWeight a)) :=
      sum_lowRankFibreCodeWeight
    _ ≤ (orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) *
          ∏ a : LowRankPowerAtom y Y J, (1 + lowRankPowerAtomWeight a)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      · exact_mod_cast positiveProductTuple_card_le_orderedDivisorCount J X m
      · exact mul_nonneg (by positivity)
          (Finset.prod_nonneg fun a ha ↦ by
            exact add_nonneg zero_le_one (lowRankPowerAtomWeight_nonneg a))
    _ ≤ (orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) * Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (lowRankPowerAtomEulerProduct_le_exp_inv (by omega)) (by positivity)
      · positivity
    _ = Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m) := by
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal_of_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal_of_mem
    {X y Y J d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J) :
    boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J d =
      boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode ⟨d, hd⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal, hd]

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankTotalCodeFibre_sum_le
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankTotalCodeFibre_sum_le
    {X y Y J m : ℕ} :
    (∑ d ∈ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J).filter
        (fun n ↦ boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J n = m),
        1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      ∑ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m, 1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J).filter
    (fun n ↦ boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J n = m)
  let encode := boundedLowRankSourceFibreEmbedding (X := X) (y := y)
    (Y := Y) (J := J) (m := m)
  have hencode : Function.Injective encode := encode.injective
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J).filter
        (fun n ↦ boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J n = m),
        1 / (d : ℝ)) = ∑ d ∈ S.attach, 1 / (d.1 : ℝ) := by
      exact (Finset.sum_attach S (fun d : ℕ ↦ 1 / (d : ℝ))).symm
    _ = ∑ d ∈ S.attach.image encode, 1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image]
      · rfl
      · intro a ha b hb hab
        exact hencode hab
    _ ≤ ∑ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m,
        1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
        (fun d hd hnot ↦ by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.hasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound_bounded
statement:
theorem hasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound_bounded
    {X y Y J H Hcode : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    HasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound
      (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J)
      (boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J)
      J Y H Hcode (X ^ J) (Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  constructor
  · intro d hd
    have hdOuter := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    have hdD := hdOuter.1
    let d' : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J} :=
      ⟨d, hdD⟩
    have hmem := boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCode_mem_tail
      hX hy1 hY hthreshold d' hdOuter.2
    simpa [boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal, hdD, d'] using hmem
  · intro m hm
    let S := ((boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J).filter (H < ·)).filter
      (fun d ↦ boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J d = m)
    let F := (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J).filter
      (fun d ↦ boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J d = m)
    have hsubset : S ⊆ F := by
      intro d hd
      have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hdData.1).1, hdData.2⟩
    calc
      (∑ d ∈ ((boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J).filter (H < ·)).filter
          (fun d ↦ boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J d = m),
          1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
          ∑ d ∈ F, 1 / (d : ℝ) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
          (fun d hd hnot ↦ by positivity)
      _ ≤ ∑ d : BoundedLowRankSourceFibre X y Y J m,
          1 / (d.1.1 : ℝ) := by
        exact boundedLowRankTotalCodeFibre_sum_le
      _ ≤ Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m) :=
        boundedLowRankSourceFibre_reciprocal_sum_le hX hy

name: RankAmplification.boundedLowRankBadSourceTail_le_finiteTau
statement:
theorem boundedLowRankBadSourceTail_le_finiteTau
    {X y Y J H Hcode : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (∑ d ∈ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J).filter (H < ·),
        1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  exact section10_lemma10_21_weightedEncoding
    (D := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J)
    (code := boundedLowRankLinearPredecessorCodeTotal X y Y J)
    (J := J) (Z := Y) (H := H) (Hcode := Hcode) (X := X ^ J)
    (hasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound_bounded hX hy hY hthreshold)

name: RankAmplification.largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_finiteTau
statement:
theorem largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_finiteTau
    {X y Y J H Hcode : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J) *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := boundedLowRankBadSourceTail_le_finiteTau
    (X := X) (y := y) (Y := Y) (J := J) (H := H) (Hcode := Hcode)
    (by omega) hy hY hthreshold
  have htail' : largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H ≤
      Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J) := by
    simpa [largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass,
      largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet, one_div] using htail
  have hlinearNonneg : 0 ≤ fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X := by
    have hmass : 0 ≤ fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J := by
      unfold fixedLinearBadSourceMass
      positivity
    exact hmass.trans (fixedLinearBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev hX)
  have hexp : Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_add_of_nonneg_left hlinearNonneg)
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H :=
      largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_mass
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) *
        (Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail' (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) *
        (Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) *
          finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp
          (by
            unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
            positivity)
      · positivity
    _ = (X : ℝ) * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J) *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      ring

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_weightedCompression
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_weightedCompression
    {X y Y J H Hcode : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
    (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hsharp : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y H B) :
    (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        (B + finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J)) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hreindexNat := boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_le_smoothTotientSum
    (X := X) (y := y) (Y := Y) (J := J) (by omega : 1 ≤ y)
  have hreindex : (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hreindexNat
  calc
    (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J,
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) := hreindex
    _ = (∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) +
        ∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) :=
      sum_badSources_eq_small_add_large X y Y J H
        (fun d ↦ (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ))
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * B *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        (X : ℝ) * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      add_le_add
        (smallBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_chebyshev hX (by omega) hB hsharp)
        (largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_finiteTau hX hy hY hthreshold)
    _ = (X : ℝ) *
        (B + finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode (X ^ J)) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      ring

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_weightedCompression
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_weightedCompression
    {x X H Hcode : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
    (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 2 ≤ movingNatY x) (hY : 0 < movingNatZ x)
    (hthreshold :
      (2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) * Hcode ≤ H)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsharp : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X (movingNatY x) H B) :
    (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        (B + finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          Hcode (X ^ movingNatJ x)) *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingLowRankCensusCount_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount]
  exact boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_weightedCompression
    hX hy hY hthreshold hB hsharp

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_mono_upper
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_mono_upper
    {j R H X₁ X₂ : ℕ} (hX : X₁ ≤ X₂) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X₁ ≤
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro m hm
    rw [mem_finiteSmoothTailSet] at hm ⊢
    exact ⟨hm.1, hm.2.1.trans hX, hm.2.2⟩
  · intro m hm hnot
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.one_le_slotEncodingFactor
statement:
theorem one_le_slotEncodingFactor {J M : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    1 ≤ slotEncodingFactor J M
proof:
:= by
  unfold slotEncodingFactor
  have htwoPow : 0 < 2 ^ J := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hleft : 0 < (J + 1) * 2 ^ J := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) htwoPow
  have hright : 0 < (J + 1) ^ J * (J * M + 1) ^ J :=
    Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos (by omega) _) (pow_pos (by omega) _)
  exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.mul_pos hleft hright))

name: RankAmplification.one_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor
statement:
theorem one_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor
    {J y M : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor J y M
proof:
:= by
  have hslotNat := one_le_slotEncodingFactor (J := J) (M := M) hJ
  have hslot : (1 : ℝ) ≤ slotEncodingFactor J M := by exact_mod_cast hslotNat
  have hexp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) := by
    exact Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  unfold finitePowerEncodingFactor
  calc
    (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by ring
    _ ≤ (slotEncodingFactor J M : ℝ) * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) :=
      mul_le_mul hslot hexp zero_le_one (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRank_finiteTau_le_endpoint_exp
statement:
theorem movingLowRank_finiteTau_le_endpoint_exp
    {x X : ℕ} (hX : X ≤ 2 * x)
    (hscale : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x)
    (hsaddle : HasMovingSaddleMargins (x : ℝ))
    (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
    (hZ : 1 < movingNatZ x) (hy : 0 < movingNatY x)
    (hvThree : 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ))
    (huSqrt : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x))
    (hKL : Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
        (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
      Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hj : 0 < movingNatJ x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hscale.rank_ge_two
  have hpow : X ^ movingNatJ x ≤ (2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_left hX _
  have hmono := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_mono_upper
    (j := movingNatJ x) (R := movingNatZ x)
    (H := movingSourceTailCode x) hpow
  have hfactor := one_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor
    (J := movingNatJ x) (y := movingNatY x)
    (M := movingSupplierSlotBound x) hj
  have htail0 : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
      (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x)
        ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  have hfull := moving_friableProduct_le_endpoint_exp hscale hsaddle heta hZ hy
    hvThree huSqrt hKL
  calc
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
        (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) := hmono
    _ = 1 * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) := by ring
    _ ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
          (movingSupplierSlotBound x) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfactor htail0
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := hfull
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_mono
statement:
theorem fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_mono
    {X W : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hXW : X ≤ W) :
    fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X ≤ fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound W
proof:
:= by
  have hXone : (1 : ℝ) < X := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < X by omega)
  have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X := lt_trans zero_lt_one hXone
  have hcast : (X : ℝ) ≤ W := by exact_mod_cast hXW
  have hlogXpos : 0 < Real.log (X : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hXone
  have hlogLe : Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (W : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_le_log hXpos hcast
  have hloglogLe : Real.log (Real.log (X : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.log (Real.log (W : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_le_log hlogXpos hlogLe
  unfold fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_le
    {x : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) ≤
      Real.log 4 *
        (Real.log 2 + log2 (x : ℝ) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
          (Real.log 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hxOne : (1 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < x by omega)
  have hxPos : (0 : ℝ) < x := lt_trans zero_lt_one hxOne
  have hlogxPos : 0 < Real.log (x : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hxOne
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoLe : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hinner : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hxPos.ne']
    linarith
  have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_pos (by nlinarith)
  have houter : Real.log (Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ))) ≤
      Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      Real.log (Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ))) ≤
          Real.log (2 * Real.log (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hinnerPos hinner
      _ = Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hlogxPos.ne']
  unfold fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound
  push_cast
  rw [log2_eq]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_div_etaR_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := Real.log 2 - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹
  have hL2 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ C / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 4 * (C / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul (hconst.add hL2) :
        Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 4 *
          (C / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
            log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)))
          atTop (nhds (Real.log 4 * (0 + 0))))
  refine squeeze_zero'
    (g := fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 4 * (C / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
      log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) ?_ ?_ hupper
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨2, fun x hx ↦ hx⟩] with x heta hx
    have hmass : 0 ≤ fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) := by
      have hsource : 0 ≤ fixedLinearBadSourceMass (2 * x) 1 1 1 := by
        unfold fixedLinearBadSourceMass
        positivity
      exact hsource.trans (fixedLinearBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev (by omega))
    exact div_nonneg hmass heta.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨2, fun x hx ↦ hx⟩] with x heta hx
    have hnum := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_le hx
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum heta.le
    have hid :
        Real.log 4 *
            (Real.log 2 + log2 (x : ℝ) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
              (Real.log 2)⁻¹) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
          Real.log 4 * (C / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
            log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [C]
      field_simp [heta.ne']
      ring
    calc
      fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≤
          Real.log 4 *
            (Real.log 2 + log2 (x : ℝ) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
              (Real.log 2)⁻¹) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := hdiv
      _ = Real.log 4 * (C / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := hid

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingNatY_inv_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingNatY_inv_div_etaR_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹ / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hyCast : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ (movingNatY x : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp tendsto_movingNatY_atTop
  have hyInv := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hyCast
  have hetaInv := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hprod := hyInv.mul hetaInv
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹ * (movingEtaR (x : ℝ))⁻¹)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, zero_mul] using hprod
  apply hzero.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSharpLowRankOverhead_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSharpLowRankOverhead_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) +
        (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hlinear := tendsto_fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_div_etaR_zero
  have hy := tendsto_movingNatY_inv_div_etaR_zero
  have hsum := (hconst.add hlinear).add hy
  have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹ / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hmodel.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x heta
  field_simp [heta.ne']

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSharpLowRankCompressionError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSharpLowRankCompressionError_zero
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (movingSharpLowRankCompressionError ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using
      hρ.max tendsto_movingSupplierSection10Error_zero
  have hsum := hmax.add tendsto_movingSharpLowRankOverhead_zero
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x) +
    (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) +
      (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCompressionHypothesis_of_sharpLowerY
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCompressionHypothesis_of_sharpLowerY
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hBFPS : MovingSharpLowerYQuotientRangeHypothesis ρ) :
    MovingLowRankCompressionHypothesis (movingSharpLowRankCompressionError ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingSharpLowRankCompressionError_zero hBFPS.1, ?_⟩
  have hsaddle : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, HasMovingSaddleMargins (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_hasMovingSaddleMargins
  have hVthree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_three_le_movingVsrc
  have hKpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_movingK_pos
  have hKL : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_log_three_add_movingK_le_scaleL
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSupplierScaleBounds,
      eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility, eventually_two_le_movingNatZ,
      eventually_movingSourceRank_le_sqrt_natZ, hsaddle, hVthree, hKpos, hKL,
      heta, hBFPS.2] with
      x hscale hadm hZ huSqrt hsaddle hVthree hK hKL heta hsharp
  intro X hxX hX
  have hxtwo : 2 ≤ x := by
    exact (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3).trans
      (hadm.three_le_y.trans (hadm.y_le_Z.trans hadm.Z_le_x))
  have hx : 0 < x := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hxtwo
  have hXtwo : 2 ≤ X := hxtwo.trans hxX
  have hy : 2 ≤ movingNatY x := (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3).trans hadm.three_le_y
  have hyPos : 0 < movingNatY x := by omega
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x := by omega
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hthreshold :
      (2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) *
          movingSourceTailCode x ≤ x.sqrt :=
    movingSourceTailCode_threshold hx hK hV0
  have hfinite := movingLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_weightedCompression
    (x := x) (X := X) (H := x.sqrt) (Hcode := movingSourceTailCode x)
    hXtwo hy hZpos hthreshold
    (Real.exp_pos (-movingK (x : ℝ) + ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))).le
    (hsharp X hxX hX)
  have htail := movingLowRank_finiteTau_le_endpoint_exp hX hscale hsaddle heta
    (show 1 < movingNatZ x by omega) hyPos hVthree huSqrt hKL
  let M : ℝ := max (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x)
  let A : ℝ := -movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)
  let Cx : ℝ := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹
  let C₂ : ℝ := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) +
    (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hB : Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
      ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp A := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    dsimp [A, M]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left
      (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x)) heta.le
    linarith
  have htail' : finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
      (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤ Real.exp A := by
    refine htail.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    dsimp [A, M]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right
      (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x)) heta.le
    linarith
  have hsum : Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
        ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) +
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
        (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤ 2 * Real.exp A := by
    linarith
  have hC : Cx ≤ C₂ := by
    dsimp [Cx, C₂]
    have hmono := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_mono hXtwo hX
    linarith
  have hmain : (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ := by
    calc
      (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
          (X : ℝ) *
            (Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) +
              finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
                (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x)) * Real.exp Cx := by
        simpa [Cx] using hfinite
      _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp Cx := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (Nat.cast_nonneg X))
          (Real.exp_pos Cx).le
      _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hC)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos A).le))
  have herrorEq :
      -movingK (x : ℝ) + movingSharpLowRankCompressionError ρ x *
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ) = A + (Real.log 2 + C₂) := by
    unfold movingSharpLowRankCompressionError
    dsimp [A, M, C₂]
    field_simp [heta.ne']
    ring
  have hexp : 2 * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂ =
      Real.exp (A + (Real.log 2 + C₂)) := by
    have htwo : Real.exp (Real.log 2) = (2 : ℝ) :=
      Real.exp_log (by norm_num)
    calc
      2 * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂ =
          Real.exp (Real.log 2) * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂ := by rw [htwo]
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 + A) * Real.exp C₂ := by
        exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ z * Real.exp C₂)
          (Real.exp_add (Real.log 2) A).symm
      _ = Real.exp ((Real.log 2 + A) + C₂) := by
        exact (Real.exp_add (Real.log 2 + A) C₂).symm
      _ = Real.exp (A + (Real.log 2 + C₂)) := by
        congr 1
        ring
  calc
    (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ := hmain
    _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-movingK (x : ℝ) + movingSharpLowRankCompressionError ρ x *
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [herrorEq]
      calc
        (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ =
            (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂) := by ring
        _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (A + (Real.log 2 + C₂)) := by
          rw [hexp]

name: RankAmplification.movingE_div_scaleA_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingE_div_scaleA_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ movingE x / scaleA x) =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hinvSqrt : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (Real.sqrt (scaleA x))⁻¹)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
      (Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleA_atTop)
  have hnumerator : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) - movingEta x)
      atTop (nhds (1 / 2)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub tendsto_movingEta_zero)
  have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - movingEta x) * (Real.sqrt (scaleA x))⁻¹)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hnumerator.mul hinvSqrt
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (movingE x / scaleA x) / movingEtaR x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply hmodel.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
    have hA := hcore.2.2.1
    have hR := hcore.2.2.2.1
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (scaleA x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hA).ne'
    unfold movingE movingEtaR movingEta
    rw [inv_eq_one_div]
    field_simp [hA.ne', hR.ne', hsqrt]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hA.le]
    ring
  refine isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ hratio
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
  intro hzero
  exact ((mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).ne' hzero).elim

name: RankAmplification.movingSlackBFPSDelta_mul_movingT
statement:
theorem movingSlackBFPSDelta_mul_movingT
    (slack : ℝ) {x : ℕ} (hT : movingT (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :

name: RankAmplification.movingSlackBFPSDelta_mul_half_scaleL
statement:
theorem movingSlackBFPSDelta_mul_half_scaleL

    (hE : movingE (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :
    movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2) =
      movingE (x : ℝ) - slack * (movingE (x : ℝ) / scaleA (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingSlackBFPSDelta, movingT]
  field_simp [hL, hA, hE]

name: RankAmplification.half_le_movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent
statement:

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent_pos

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSharpBFPSDelta_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSharpBFPSDelta_zero :
    Tendsto movingSharpBFPSDelta atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoefficient : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ 2 * (1 / 2 - movingEta t))
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    convert tendsto_const_nhds.mul
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub tendsto_movingEta_zero) using 1
    norm_num
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ 2 * movingE t / scaleL t)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hproduct := hcoefficient.mul tendsto_movingR_div_scaleL_zero
    convert hproduct using 1
    · ext t
      unfold movingE
      ring
    · norm_num
  exact hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSlackBFPSDelta_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSlackBFPSDelta_zero (slack : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (movingSlackBFPSDelta slack) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) / movingT (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply tendsto_movingSharpBFPSDelta_zero.congr'
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
    have hL := hcore.1
    have hA := hcore.2.2.1
    have hE := hcore.2.2.2.2.2.1
    rw [movingSharpBFPSDelta, movingT]
    field_simp [hL.ne', hA.ne', hE.ne']
  have hsecond : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      slack / movingT (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (tendsto_movingT_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hsub := hfirst.sub hsecond
  have hsub' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) / movingT (x : ℝ) -
        slack / movingT (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hsub
  apply hsub'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  unfold movingSlackBFPSDelta
  ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSharpBFPSDelta_pos
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSharpBFPSDelta_pos :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingSharpBFPSDelta x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSharpBFPSDelta_le_half
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSharpBFPSDelta_le_half :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, movingSharpBFPSDelta x ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, movingSharpBFPSDelta x < (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_order.1 tendsto_movingSharpBFPSDelta_zero).2 _ (by norm_num)
  exact hlt.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent_eq :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x = 1 - movingSharpBFPSDelta x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSharpBFPSDelta_le_half] with x hx
  rw [movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent, max_eq_right]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_half_scaleL
statement:
theorem movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_half_scaleL

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_movingT

theorem movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_movingT
    {x : ℕ} (hL : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≠ 0)

name: RankAmplification.log_movingNatY_le_movingT
statement:
theorem log_movingNatY_le_movingT
    {x : ℕ} (hy : 0 < movingNatY x) :
    Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ) ≤ movingT (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hyReal : (0 : ℝ) < movingNatY x := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hyReal (movingNatY_cast_le_movingY x)
  simpa only [movingY, Real.log_exp] using hlog

name: RankAmplification.movingT_sub_log_two_le_log_movingNatY
statement:
theorem movingT_sub_log_two_le_log_movingNatY
    {x : ℕ} (hhalf : movingY (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (movingNatY x : ℝ)) :
    movingT (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : 0 < movingY (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
    div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hleft hhalf
  rw [movingY] at hlog
  rw [Real.log_div (Real.exp_pos _).ne' (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
    Real.log_exp] at hlog
  exact hlog

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpBFPS_natY_phase_bounds
statement:
theorem movingSharpBFPS_natY_phase_bounds
    {x : ℕ} (hy : 0 < movingNatY x)
    (hhalf : movingY (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (movingNatY x : ℝ))
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ movingSharpBFPSDelta x)
    (hL : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) (hE : movingE (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :
    scaleA (x : ℝ) - movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log 2 ≤
        movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ) ∧
      movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ) ≤
        scaleA (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (movingT_sub_log_two_le_log_movingNatY hhalf) hdelta
  have hupper := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (log_movingNatY_le_movingT hy) hdelta
  have hphase := movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_movingT hL hE
  constructor
  · calc
      scaleA (x : ℝ) - movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log 2 =
          movingSharpBFPSDelta x *
            (movingT (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) := by rw [← hphase]; ring
      _ ≤ movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ) := hlower
  · exact hupper.trans_eq hphase

name: RankAmplification.movingSlackBFPS_natY_phase_bounds
statement:
theorem movingSlackBFPS_natY_phase_bounds
    (slack : ℝ) {x : ℕ} (hy : 0 < movingNatY x)
    (hhalf : movingY (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (movingNatY x : ℝ))
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x)
    (hT : movingT (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :
    scaleA (x : ℝ) - slack -
        movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * Real.log 2 ≤
      movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ) ∧
    movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleA (x : ℝ) - slack
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (movingT_sub_log_two_le_log_movingNatY hhalf) hdelta
  have hupper := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (log_movingNatY_le_movingT hy) hdelta
  have hphase := movingSlackBFPSDelta_mul_movingT slack hT
  constructor
  · calc
      scaleA (x : ℝ) - slack -
          movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * Real.log 2 =
        movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x *
          (movingT (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) := by rw [← hphase]; ring
      _ ≤ movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * Real.log (movingNatY x : ℝ) := hlower
  · exact hupper.trans_eq hphase

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div
    (Y : ℕ) :
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) / Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.log 2 Y : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.log_mono_right (Nat.div_le_self Y 3)
    _ ≤ Real.logb 2 Y := Real.natLog_le_logb Y 2
    _ = Real.log (Y : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.moving_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le
statement:
theorem moving_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le
    {x : ℕ} (hy : 0 < movingNatY x) :
    (bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x) : ℝ) ≤
      movingT (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcount := bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div (movingNatY x)
  have hlog := log_movingNatY_le_movingT hy
  exact hcount.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)).le)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingBFPSCrossingU_atTop
statement:

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_log_movingBFPSCrossingU_atTop

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_log_error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_log_error_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) - log3 x + Real.log 2)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
  unfold movingBFPSCrossingU
  rw [Real.log_div hL2.ne' (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  simp only [log3_eq]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_loglog_error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_loglog_error_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦
      Real.log (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x)) - log4 x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst := tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_log_error_zero
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) - log3 x)
      atTop (nhds (-Real.log 2)) := by
    have h := hfirst.sub (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Real.log 2) atTop (nhds (Real.log 2)))
    have hraw : Tendsto (fun x ↦
        (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) - log3 x + Real.log 2) - Real.log 2)
        atTop (nhds (-Real.log 2)) := by simpa only [zero_sub] using h
    apply hraw.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  have hsmall : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) - log3 x) / log3 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := hdiff.div_atTop tendsto_log3_atTop
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) / log3 x)
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have h := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 1)).add hsmall
    have h' : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (1 : ℝ) +
        (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) - log3 x) / log3 x)
        atTop (nhds 1) := by simpa only [add_zero] using h
    apply h'.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_log3_pos] with x hL3
    field_simp [hL3.ne']
    ring
  have hlogRatio : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log
      (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) / log3 x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := (Real.continuousAt_log (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).tendsto.comp hratio
    change Tendsto (Real.log ∘ (fun x ↦
      Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) / log3 x)) atTop (nhds 0)
    simpa only [Real.log_one] using h
  apply hlogRatio.congr'
  filter_upwards [tendsto_log_movingBFPSCrossingU_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      eventually_log3_pos] with x hu hL3
  rw [Real.log_div hu.ne' hL3.ne']
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_bracket_sub_scaleA_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_bracket_sub_scaleA_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) +
      Real.log (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x)) - scaleA x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_log_error_zero.add
    tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_loglog_error_zero
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) - log3 x + Real.log 2) +
        (Real.log (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x)) - log4 x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa only [add_zero] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [scaleA_eq]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingBFPSCrossing_scaled_error_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingBFPSCrossing_scaled_error_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ movingBFPSCrossingU x *
      (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x) +
        Real.log (Real.log (movingBFPSCrossingU x)) - scaleA x))
      =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hu : movingBFPSCrossingU =o[atTop] movingEtaR := by
    have h := log2_isLittleO_etaR.const_mul_left (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    apply h.congr'
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      unfold movingBFPSCrossingU
      ring
    · exact EventuallyEq.rfl
  have hbracket :=
    tendsto_movingBFPSCrossing_bracket_sub_scaleA_zero.isBigO_one ℝ
  simpa only [mul_one] using hu.mul_isBigO hbracket

name: RankAmplification.exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two
statement:
theorem exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two
    {x : ℝ} (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hL3 : 0 < log3 x) :
    Real.exp (scaleA x) = log2 x * log3 x / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleA_eq, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_add,
    show Real.exp (log3 x) = log2 x by
      simpa only [log3_eq] using Real.exp_log hL2,
    show Real.exp (log4 x) = log3 x by
      simpa only [log4_eq] using Real.exp_log hL3,
    Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

name: RankAmplification.exp_scaleA_sub_slack_eq
statement:
theorem exp_scaleA_sub_slack_eq
    (slack : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hL3 : 0 < log3 x) :
    Real.exp (scaleA x - slack) =
      (log2 x * log3 x / 2) / Real.exp slack
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_sub, exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3]

name: RankAmplification.half_scaleL_le_log_two_add_log_nat_sqrt
statement:
theorem half_scaleL_le_log_two_add_log_nat_sqrt
    {x : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log (x.sqrt : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hsPosNat : 0 < x.sqrt := Nat.sqrt_pos.2 hxPos
  have hsPos : (0 : ℝ) < x.sqrt := by exact_mod_cast hsPosNat
  have hsqrtCast : Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x.sqrt : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) ≤ (x.sqrt : ℝ) + 1 :=
        Real.real_sqrt_le_nat_sqrt_succ
      _ ≤ 2 * (x.sqrt : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show x.sqrt + 1 ≤ 2 * x.sqrt by omega)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)) hsqrtCast
  rw [Real.log_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg x),
    Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hsPos.ne'] at hlog
  simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hlog

name: RankAmplification.half_scaleL_le_log_two_add_log_of_nat_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem half_scaleL_le_log_two_add_log_of_nat_sqrt_le
    {x W : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hW : x.sqrt ≤ W) :
    scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log (W : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsPosNat : 0 < x.sqrt := Nat.sqrt_pos.2 (by omega : 0 < x)
  have hWPos : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hsPosNat.trans_le hW
  have hlogMono : Real.log (x.sqrt : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (W : ℝ) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hsPosNat) (by exact_mod_cast hW)
  linarith [half_scaleL_le_log_two_add_log_nat_sqrt hx]

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpBFPS_outerExponent_le
statement:
theorem movingSharpBFPS_outerExponent_le
    {x W : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hW : x.sqrt ≤ W)
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ movingSharpBFPSDelta x)
    (hL : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :
    -movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log (W : ℝ) ≤
      -movingE (x : ℝ) + movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := half_scaleL_le_log_two_add_log_of_nat_sqrt_le hx hW
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hdelta
  rw [movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_half_scaleL hL] at hmul
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSharpBFPSAbelError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSharpBFPSAbelError_zero
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (movingSharpBFPSAbelError ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max 0 (ρ x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hzero : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [max_self] using hzero.max hρ
  have hfirst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) * max 0 (ρ x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by

  have hconstant : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦

      atTop (nhds 0) := by

    convert hproduct using 1
    · ext x

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpBFPSTruncatedExponent_le_of_abel
statement:
theorem movingSharpBFPSTruncatedExponent_le_of_abel
    {x W : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hW : x.sqrt ≤ W) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ movingSharpBFPSDelta x)
    (hL : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
    (hclamp : movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x =
      1 - movingSharpBFPSDelta x)
    (habel : fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W (movingNatY x)
        (movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x) C ≤
      max 0 (ρ x) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :
    fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent W (movingNatY x)
        (movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x) C ≤
      -movingE (x : ℝ) +
        movingSharpBFPSAbelError ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmajorant : fixedBFPSTruncatedPredecessorMajorant W (movingNatY x)
      (movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x) C ≤
        max 0 (ρ x) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    (fixedBFPSTruncatedPredecessorMajorant_le_abel W (movingNatY x)
      (movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x) hC).trans habel
  have hweighted := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmajorant
    (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  have houter := movingSharpBFPS_outerExponent_le hx hW hdelta hL
  have herrorIdentity :
      movingSharpBFPSAbelError ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
        smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) * max 0 (ρ x) *
            movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log 2 := by
    unfold movingSharpBFPSAbelError
    field_simp [heta.ne']
  calc
    fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent W (movingNatY x)
          (movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x) C =
        -movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log (W : ℝ) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSTruncatedPredecessorMajorant W (movingNatY x)
              (movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x) C := by
      unfold fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent
      rw [hclamp]
      ring
    _ ≤ (-movingE (x : ℝ) + movingSharpBFPSDelta x * Real.log 2) +
        smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
          (max 0 (ρ x) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :=
      add_le_add houter hweighted
    _ = -movingE (x : ℝ) +
        movingSharpBFPSAbelError ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [herrorIdentity]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.movingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis_of_abelPredecessorEndpoint
statement:
theorem movingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis_of_abelPredecessorEndpoint
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C)
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hendpoint : MovingSharpBFPSAbelPredecessorEndpoint C ρ) :
    MovingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis (movingSharpBFPSAbelError ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingSharpBFPSAbelError_zero hendpoint.1, ?_⟩
  have hcore : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) ∧
      0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1, mul_pos hx.2.2.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2.1⟩
  filter_upwards [hendpoint.2, eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility,
      eventually_movingSharpBFPSDelta_pos,
      eventually_movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent_eq, hcore] with
      x habel hadm hdelta hclamp hcore

  have hxTwo : 2 ≤ x := (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3).trans
    (hadm.three_le_y.trans (hadm.y_le_Z.trans hadm.Z_le_x))
  have hWpos : 0 < W :=
    (Nat.sqrt_pos.2 (by omega : 0 < x)).trans_le hW
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent
    (X := W) (Y := movingNatY x)

    hWpos hadm.three_le_y (movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent_pos x)
    (half_le_movingSharpBFPSClampedExponent x) hC hsieve

    (x := x) (W := W) (C := C) (ρ := ρ) hxTwo hW hC hdelta.le
    hcore.1.ne' hcore.2 hclamp (habel W hW hWupper)
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent) (Nat.cast_nonneg W)

statement:

    (slack : ℝ) {x W : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {rho : ℕ → ℝ}

proof:

    (fixedBFPSTruncatedPredecessorMajorant_le_abel W (movingNatY x)
      (movingSlackBFPSClampedExponent slack x) hC).trans habel
  have hweighted := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmajorant
    (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  have houter := movingSlackBFPS_outerExponent_le slack hx hW hdelta
    hL hA hE
  have herrorIdentity :
      movingSlackBFPSAbelError slack rho x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =

          slack * (movingE (x : ℝ) / scaleA (x : ℝ)) +
            movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * Real.log 2) +

      add_le_add houter hweighted

        movingSlackBFPSAbelError slack rho x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by

    scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.symm.isBigO.trans_isLittleO
      scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_log2
  have hleft : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log3 x / Real.sqrt (log2 x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := hlog3Little.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hlog2Little : log2 =o[atTop] (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x)) := by
    have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num)).comp_tendsto tendsto_scaleL_atTop
    apply h.congr'
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      rfl
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [Function.comp_apply, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hright : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 x / Real.sqrt (scaleL x))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hlog2Little.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hprod := hleft.mul hright
  have hprod' : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (log3 x / Real.sqrt (log2 x)) *
        (log2 x / Real.sqrt (scaleL x))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using hprod
  apply hprod'.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hL2
  rw [movingR_div_scaleL_eq_sqrt_div hL hL2,
    Real.sqrt_div hL2.le]
  have hsL : Real.sqrt (scaleL x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL).ne'
  have hsL2 : Real.sqrt (log2 x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne'
  field_simp [hsL, hsL2]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_log3_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_log3_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingSharpBFPSDelta x * log3 (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoefficient : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ 2 * (1 / 2 - movingEta t))
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    convert tendsto_const_nhds.mul
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub tendsto_movingEta_zero) using 1
    norm_num
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦
      (2 * (1 / 2 - movingEta t)) *
        (movingR t / scaleL t * log3 t)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      hcoefficient.mul tendsto_movingR_div_scaleL_mul_log3_zero
  have hnat := hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  apply hnat.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  unfold movingSharpBFPSDelta movingE
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalSlackBFPSDelta_mul_log3_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalSlackBFPSDelta_mul_log3_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x * log3 (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine squeeze_zero' (f := fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x * log3 (x : ℝ))
    (g := fun x : ℕ ↦ movingSharpBFPSDelta x * log3 (x : ℝ)) ?_ ?_
    tendsto_movingSharpBFPSDelta_mul_log3_zero
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingSlackBFPSDelta_pos movingBFPSGlobalSlack,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos]
      with x hδ hL3
    positivity
  · filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_moving_core_positive,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos]
      with x hcore hL3
    have hT : 0 < movingT (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    have hquot : scaleA (x : ℝ) / movingT (x : ℝ) =
        movingSharpBFPSDelta x := by
      rw [movingSharpBFPSDelta, movingT]
      field_simp [hcore.1.ne', hcore.2.2.1.ne', hcore.2.2.2.2.2.1.ne']
      simpa only [one_div] using
        (div_mul_cancel_left₀ hcore.2.2.1.ne' (scaleL (x : ℝ)))
    have hδle : movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x ≤
        movingSharpBFPSDelta x := by
      rw [← hquot]
      unfold movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack
      exact (div_le_div_iff₀ hT hT).2 (by nlinarith)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδle hL3.le

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_scaleA
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_scaleA :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack))
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x * Real.log 2)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using
      (tendsto_movingSlackBFPSDelta_zero movingBFPSGlobalSlack).mul
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2)
          atTop (nhds (Real.log 2)))
  have hlower : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      -movingBFPSGlobalSlack -
        movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x * Real.log 2)
      atTop (nhds (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ -movingBFPSGlobalSlack)
        atTop (nhds (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack))).sub hfloor
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ -movingBFPSGlobalSlack)
      atTop (nhds (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack)) := tendsto_const_nhds
  apply hlower.squeeze' hupper
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingNatY_pos,
      eventually_movingY_half_le_natY,
      eventually_movingSlackBFPSDelta_pos movingBFPSGlobalSlack,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hy hhalf hδ hcore
    have hp := movingSlackBFPS_natY_phase_bounds movingBFPSGlobalSlack
      hy hhalf hδ.le hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.ne'
    unfold movingGlobalBFPSPhase
    linarith
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingNatY_pos,
      eventually_movingY_half_le_natY,
      eventually_movingSlackBFPSDelta_pos movingBFPSGlobalSlack,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hy hhalf hδ hcore
    have hp := movingSlackBFPS_natY_phase_bounds movingBFPSGlobalSlack
      hy hhalf hδ.le hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.ne'
    unfold movingGlobalBFPSPhase
    linarith

proof:

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_div_scaleA_one
statement:

  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      1 + (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) / scaleA (x : ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_two_div_log3_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_two_div_log3_one :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - 2) / log3 (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hAlog3 := tendsto_scaleA_div_log3_one.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hproduct := tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_div_scaleA_one.mul hAlog3
  have htwo : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ (2 : ℝ) / log3 (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (tendsto_log3_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hdiff := hproduct.sub htwo
  have hdiff' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / scaleA (x : ℝ) *
          (scaleA (x : ℝ) / log3 (x : ℝ)) -
        2 / log3 (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, one_mul, sub_zero] using hdiff
  apply hdiff'.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hA
  rw [div_mul_div_cancel₀ hA.ne']
  ring

  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNatY_pos, eventually_movingY_half_le_natY,

    hy hhalf hδ.le hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.ne').2

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_mul_sqrt_log3_isLittleO_sqrt_log2
statement:
theorem scaleA_mul_sqrt_log3_isLittleO_sqrt_log2 :
    (fun x ↦ scaleA x * Real.sqrt (log3 x)) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x))
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : (fun x ↦ log3 x ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (3 / 2 : ℝ)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).comp_tendsto tendsto_log2_atTop
    apply h.congr'
    · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, log3_eq]
    · exact EventuallyEq.rfl
  have hprod := scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.isBigO.mul
    (isBigO_refl (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log3 x)) atTop)
  have hleft : (fun x ↦ scaleA x * Real.sqrt (log3 x)) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ log3 x ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    apply hprod.congr' EventuallyEq.rfl
    filter_upwards [eventually_log3_pos] with x hL3
    calc
      log3 x * Real.sqrt (log3 x) =
          log3 x ^ (1 : ℝ) * log3 x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_one, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      _ = log3 x ^ ((1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) := (Real.rpow_add hL3 _ _).symm
      _ = log3 x ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have hright : (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) =ᶠ[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x)) := by
    filter_upwards [] with x
    simp only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact (hleft.trans_isLittleO hlog).congr' EventuallyEq.rfl hright

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleA_mul_sqrt_log3_div_sqrt_log2_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_scaleA_mul_sqrt_log3_div_sqrt_log2_zero :

      scaleA x * Real.sqrt (log3 x) / Real.sqrt (log2 x))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_middle_div_log2_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_middle_div_log2_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2) *
        Real.log (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2)) / log2 (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmodel := tendsto_scaleA_mul_sqrt_log3_div_sqrt_log2_zero.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  refine squeeze_zero' (g := fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) /
        Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) ?_ ?_ hmodel
  · filter_upwards [tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 4,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hP hL2
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith))) hL2.le
  · filter_upwards [tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 4,
      eventually_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_le_scaleA_sub_slack,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos]
      with x hP hPupper hcore hL3
    have hL2 := hcore.2.1
    have hA := hcore.2.2.1
    have hPA : movingGlobalBFPSPhase x ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
      unfold movingBFPSGlobalSlack at hPupper
      linarith
    have hexp : Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ))) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_half]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hPA (by norm_num))
    have hlog : Real.log (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2) ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
      have hz : 0 < movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2 := by positivity
      have hbasic := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hz
      nlinarith
    have hmiddle : Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2) *
        Real.log (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ))) * scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul hexp hlog (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith))
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hexpA := exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ))) ≤
        Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hexpA]
      calc
        Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤
            Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ)) := by
          apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
          nlinarith [mul_pos hL2 hL3]
        _ = Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) :=
          Real.sqrt_mul hL2.le _
    have hnum := hmiddle.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrt hA.le)
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hL2.le
    have hsL2 : Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne'
    calc
      (Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2) *
          Real.log (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2)) / log2 (x : ℝ) ≤
        (Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) *
          scaleA (x : ℝ)) / log2 (x : ℝ) := hdiv
      _ = scaleA (x : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) /
          Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hsL2, hL2.ne']
        ring_nf
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_exp_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_scaleA
statement:
theorem tendsto_exp_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_scaleA :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
