      (nhds (Real.exp (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack)))
proof:
:=
  Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
    tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_scaleA

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_tail_div_log2
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_tail_div_log2 :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x) /
        (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - 2)) / log2 (x : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (Real.exp (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := tendsto_exp_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_scaleA.mul
    tendsto_log3_div_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_two_one
  have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) *
        (log3 (x : ℝ) / (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - 2)) / 2) atTop
      (nhds (Real.exp (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack) / 2)) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using hprod.div_const 2
  apply hmodel.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_moving_core_positive,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos,
      tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 2] with
      x hcore hL3 hP
  have hL2 := hcore.2.1
  have hexpA := exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3
  have hexpSplit : Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x) =
      Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) *
        Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexpSplit, hexpA]
  field_simp [hL2.ne', hL3.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hP).ne']

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_endpoint_div_log2_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_endpoint_div_log2_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x *
        Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x) / 2) / log2 (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hproduct := tendsto_movingGlobalSlackBFPSDelta_mul_log3_zero.mul
    tendsto_exp_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_sub_scaleA
  have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x * log3 (x : ℝ)) *
        Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) / 4)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul, zero_div] using
      hproduct.div_const 4
  apply hmodel.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_moving_core_positive,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos]
      with x hcore hL3
  have hL2 := hcore.2.1
  have hexpA := exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3
  have hexpSplit : Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x) =
      Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) *
        Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexpSplit, hexpA]
  field_simp [hL2.ne', hL3.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder_div_log2
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder_div_log2 :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder x / log2 (x : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (Real.exp (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hconstant : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingGlobalBFPSSharpEulerConstant / log2 (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hendpoint : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
        ((movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x *
          Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x) / 2) / log2 (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      tendsto_const_nhds.mul tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_endpoint_div_log2_zero
  have hsum := ((hconstant.add tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_middle_div_log2_zero).add
    tendsto_movingGlobalBFPS_tail_div_log2).add hendpoint
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingGlobalBFPSSharpEulerConstant / log2 (x : ℝ) +
        (Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2) *
          Real.log (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x / 2)) / log2 (x : ℝ) +
        (Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x) /
          (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x - 2)) / log2 (x : ℝ) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          ((movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x *
            Real.exp (movingGlobalBFPSPhase x) / 2) / log2 (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds (Real.exp (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack) / 2)) := by
    simpa only [zero_add, add_zero] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
  unfold movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder
    fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent movingGlobalBFPSSharpEulerConstant
    movingGlobalBFPSPhase
  dsimp only
  field_simp [hL2.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder_le_eighth_log2
statement:
theorem eventually_movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder_le_eighth_log2 :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder x ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) / 8
proof:
:= by
  have hlimit : Real.exp (-movingBFPSGlobalSlack) / 2 < (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    have hexp : (129 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 128 := by
      nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (128 : ℝ)]
    have hinv : (Real.exp 128)⁻¹ ≤ (129 : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ (Real.exp_pos 128) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 129)).2 hexp
    unfold movingBFPSGlobalSlack
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    norm_num at hinv ⊢
    linarith
  have hratio : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder x / log2 (x : ℝ) < (1 / 8 : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_order.1 tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder_div_log2).2
      _ hlimit
  filter_upwards [hratio,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hx hL2
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using ((div_lt_iff₀ hL2).mp hx).le

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget_div_etaR_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget x / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hT := tendsto_movingT_div_etaR_zero.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hmoderate : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (2 * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant / Real.log 2) *
        (movingT (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hT
  have hsharp := tendsto_log2_cube_mul_scaleL_eighth_div_etaR_zero.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hsharp' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (3 / Real.log 2) *
        ((log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ)) /
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hsharp
  have hsum := hmoderate.add hsharp'
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (2 * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant / Real.log 2) *
          (movingT (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) +
        (3 / Real.log 2) *
          ((log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ)) /
            movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  unfold movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget
  ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelope_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelope_le_budget :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope (movingNatY x)
          (movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x) ≤
        movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget x
proof:
:= by
  have hquarter : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    have hlt := (tendsto_order.1
      (tendsto_movingSlackBFPSDelta_zero movingBFPSGlobalSlack)).2
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
    exact hlt.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hlogSix : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x * Real.log 6 ≤ 2 := by
    have hprod : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x * Real.log 6)
        atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [zero_mul] using
        (tendsto_movingSlackBFPSDelta_zero movingBFPSGlobalSlack).mul
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Real.log 6)
            atTop (nhds (Real.log 6)))
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 hprod).2 2 (by norm_num)).mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hTlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, Real.log 2 ≤ movingT (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_movingT_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 2)
  have hAlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingBFPSGlobalSlack ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        movingBFPSGlobalSlack
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility,
      eventually_movingSlackBFPSDelta_pos movingBFPSGlobalSlack,
      hquarter, hlogSix,
      eventually_movingGlobalBFPSPhase_le_scaleA_sub_slack,
      eventually_movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder_le_eighth_log2,
      hTlarge, hAlarge,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_scaleA_le_log2] with
      x hadm hδ hquarter hlogSix hphase hB hTlarge hAlarge hcore hL3 hAL2
  let δ := movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x
  let U := scaleA (x : ℝ) - movingBFPSGlobalSlack
  let B := movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder x
  have hscalar : bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope (movingNatY x) δ ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x))) +
        (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * U * Real.exp U * Real.exp B := by
    apply bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_phaseScalar hadm.three_le_y hδ
      hquarter hlogSix
    · simpa only [δ, U, movingGlobalBFPSPhase] using hphase
    · intro i hi hhigh
      have hHY : bfpsGeometricEndpoint (movingNatY x) 2 i ≤ movingNatY x :=
        Nat.div_le_self _ _
      have hglobal := fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global
        hhigh.1 hHY hδ hquarter hhigh.2
      unfold B movingGlobalBFPSSharpRemainder
      exact sub_le_sub_right hglobal _
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hcount := moving_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le
    (show 0 < movingNatY x from
      (by exact (by norm_num : 0 < 3).trans_le hadm.three_le_y))
  have hlogCount : Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x)) ≤
      (bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x) : ℝ) := by
    by_cases hK : bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x) = 0
    · have hKcast : ((bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x) : ℕ) : ℝ) = 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast hK
      rw [hKcast]
      simp
    · have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hK
      linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hKpos]
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ movingT (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hlogTwo).2 (by simpa [one_mul] using hTlarge)
  have hmoderate : fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
        (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x))) ≤
      (2 * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant / Real.log 2) * movingT (x : ℝ) := by
    have hinside : 1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x)) ≤
        2 * (movingT (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2) := by linarith
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinside
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant_nonneg
    calc
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (movingNatY x))) ≤
        fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (2 * (movingT (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2)) := hmul
      _ = (2 * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant / Real.log 2) *
          movingT (x : ℝ) := by ring
  have hL := hcore.1
  have hL2 := hcore.2.1
  have hA := hcore.2.2.1
  have hL3L2 : log3 (x : ℝ) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hL2]
  have hU0 : 0 ≤ U := by
    change 0 ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) - movingBFPSGlobalSlack
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr hAlarge
  have hUA : U ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [U, movingBFPSGlobalSlack]
    linarith
  have hUL2 : U ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := hUA.trans hAL2
  have hexpU : Real.exp U ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) := by
    have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hUA
    rw [exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3] at he
    nlinarith [mul_pos hL2 hL3]
  have hBexp : Real.exp B ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (show B ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) / 8 by
      simpa only [B] using hB)
    have hid : Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ) / 8) =
        scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hL]
      congr 1
      simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
      ring
    exact he.trans_eq hid
  have hpoly : U * Real.exp U ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    have hL2L3 : log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have := mul_le_mul hUL2 (hexpU.trans hL2L3)
      (Real.exp_pos U).le hL2.le
    nlinarith
  have hcoef : (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) ≤ 3 / Real.log 2 := by
    have hden : Real.log 2 ≤ 4 * Real.log 2 := by nlinarith
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hlogTwo hden
  have hsharp : (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * U * Real.exp U * Real.exp B ≤
      (3 / Real.log 2) *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * U * Real.exp U * Real.exp B =
          (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * (U * Real.exp U) * Real.exp B := by ring
      _ ≤ (3 / Real.log 2) * (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3) *
          scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hcoef hpoly (by positivity) (by positivity))
          hBexp (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
      _ = (3 / Real.log 2) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ)) := by ring
  unfold movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget
  exact hscalar.trans (add_le_add hmoderate hsharp)

name: RankAmplification.movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeCoreAsymptotic
statement:
theorem movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeCoreAsymptotic :
    MovingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeCoreAsymptotic movingBFPSGlobalSlack
proof:
:= by
  unfold MovingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeCoreAsymptotic
  refine squeeze_zero'
    (f := fun x : ℕ ↦
      bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope (movingNatY x)
        (movingSlackBFPSDelta movingBFPSGlobalSlack x) /
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
    (g := fun x : ℕ ↦

    tendsto_movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget_div_etaR_zero
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with
      x heta
    exact div_nonneg (bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_nonneg _ _) heta.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingGlobalBFPSPhaseEnvelope_le_budget,
      eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x henv heta
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right henv heta.le

name: RankAmplification.movingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeAsymptotic_of_core
statement:
theorem movingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeAsymptotic_of_core
    (slack C : ℝ) (hcore : MovingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeCoreAsymptotic slack) :
    MovingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeAsymptotic slack C
proof:
:= by
  have hconstant : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hscaled : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      C * (bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope (movingNatY x)
        (movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ C) atTop (nhds C) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hc.mul hcore
  have hsum := hconstant.add hscaled
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        C * (bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope (movingNatY x)
          (movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  unfold MovingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeAsymptotic
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  unfold movingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeMajorant
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingSlackBFPSAbelPredecessorEndpoint_of_phaseEnvelope
statement:
theorem movingSlackBFPSAbelPredecessorEndpoint_of_phaseEnvelope
    {slack C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (henvelope : MovingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeAsymptotic slack C) :
    MovingSlackBFPSAbelPredecessorEndpoint slack C
      (fun x ↦ movingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeMajorant slack C x /
        movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨henvelope, ?_⟩
  have hbase : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x * Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have hlt : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
        movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x < (Real.log 2)⁻¹ :=
      (tendsto_order.1 (tendsto_movingSlackBFPSDelta_zero slack)).2 _
        (inv_pos.mpr (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)))
    filter_upwards [hlt] with x hx
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hx hlog
    simpa [inv_mul_cancel₀ hlog.ne'] using this.le
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      (eventually_moving_core_positive.mono fun _ hx ↦
        mul_pos hx.2.2.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2.1)
  have hquarter : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    have hlt : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
        movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x < (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
      (tendsto_order.1 (tendsto_movingSlackBFPSDelta_zero slack)).2 _ (by norm_num)
    exact hlt.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility,
      eventually_movingSlackBFPSDelta_pos slack,
      hquarter, hbase, heta,
      eventually_movingSlackBFPSClampedExponent_eq slack] with
      x hadm hdelta hquarter hbase heta hclamp
  intro W hW hWupper
  rw [hclamp]
  have hfinite := fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_phaseEnvelope
    (X := W) (Y := movingNatY x) (δ := movingSlackBFPSDelta slack x)
    (C := C) hadm.three_le_y hdelta hquarter hbase hC
  have hmajorantNonneg := movingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeMajorant_nonneg slack hC x
  have hratioNonneg : 0 ≤ movingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeMajorant slack C x /
      movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := div_nonneg hmajorantNonneg heta.le
  rw [max_eq_right hratioNonneg]
  exact hfinite.trans_eq <| by
    unfold movingSlackBFPSPhaseEnvelopeMajorant
    field_simp [heta.ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_sqrt_scaleL_le_movingEtaR
statement:
theorem eventually_sqrt_scaleL_le_movingEtaR :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, Real.sqrt (scaleL x) ≤ movingEtaR x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive, eventually_scaleA_le_log2] with x hcore hAL2
  have hsqrtA : Real.sqrt (scaleA x) ≤ Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hAL2
  have hsqrtApos : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleA x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hcore.2.2.1
  unfold movingEtaR movingEta movingR
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul hcore.1.le]
  calc
    Real.sqrt (scaleL x) ≤
        (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (log2 x)) / Real.sqrt (scaleA x) := by
      refine (le_div_iff₀ hsqrtApos).mpr ?_
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrtA (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ = (Real.sqrt (scaleA x))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (log2 x)) := by
      rw [div_eq_inv_mul]

proof:

  refine IsBigO.of_bound 1 ?_

  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x :=
    mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h1, Real.norm_of_nonneg h2, one_mul]

name: RankAmplification.log2_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2
statement:
theorem log2_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2 :
    log2 =o[atTop] fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)
proof:
:= by
  refine isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hL2
    intro hzero
    exact absurd hzero (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)))
  · refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ log2_sq_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
      exact div_nonneg hL2.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_one_le_log2] with x hL hL2
      have hL2pos : 0 < log2 x := by linarith
      have hsqrtL : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL
      have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (log2 x) := by
        rw [show (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 by simp]
        exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hL2
      have hroot : Real.sqrt (log2 x) ≤ log2 x := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hL2pos.le]
      have hnum : log2 x * Real.sqrt (log2 x) ≤ log2 x ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [Real.sqrt_div hL.le, div_div_eq_mul_div]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hsqrtL.le

  have hmain : (0 : ℝ) ≤ movingTMain x := by

  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hroot, Real.norm_of_nonneg hmain, one_mul]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingLogBell_le
statement:
theorem eventually_movingLogBell_le :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, movingLogBell x ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_two_le_movingJ, eventually_movingJ_le_scaleL,
    eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hJ hJL hL hL2
  have hJpos : 0 < movingJ x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hJ
  have hJone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hJpos
  have hlogJ : Real.log (movingJ x : ℝ) ≤ log2 x := by
    rw [log2_eq]
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hJL
  have hcount : (labelledPartitionCount (movingJ x) : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ (movingJ x) := by
    exact_mod_cast labelledPartitionCount_le_self_pow (movingJ x)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (labelledPartitionCount (movingJ x)) with h0 | hpos
  · have : movingLogBell x = 0 := by
      rw [movingLogBell, h0]
      simp
    rw [this]
    exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) hL2.le
  · have hposR : (0 : ℝ) < (labelledPartitionCount (movingJ x) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    calc
      movingLogBell x ≤ Real.log ((movingJ x : ℝ) ^ (movingJ x)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hposR hcount
      _ = (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log (movingJ x : ℝ) := by rw [Real.log_pow]
      _ ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogJ (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_log2_three_mul_atTop

name: RankAmplification.eventually_one_add_log2_three_mul_le
statement:
theorem eventually_one_add_log2_three_mul_le :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 0 ≤ log2 (3 * x) ∧ 1 + log2 (3 * x) ≤ 2 * log2 x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ),
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 3 + Real.exp 1),
    tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with x hx hL hL2
  have hlog3 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hexp1 : (1 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
    linarith
  have hLpos : 0 < scaleL x := by linarith
  have hsplit : Real.log (3 * x) = Real.log 3 + scaleL x := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by linarith : x ≠ 0), scaleL]
  have hinner : Real.log 3 + scaleL x ≤ 2 * scaleL x := by linarith
  have hinnerPos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 3 + scaleL x := by linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log 3 + scaleL x := by linarith
  constructor
  · rw [log2_eq, hsplit]
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 3 + scaleL x := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
      linarith
    exact Real.log_nonneg this
  · have hmono : log2 (3 * x) ≤ Real.log 2 + log2 x := by
      rw [log2_eq, hsplit, log2_eq]
      calc
        Real.log (Real.log 3 + scaleL x) ≤ Real.log (2 * scaleL x) :=
          Real.log_le_log hinnerPos hinner
        _ = Real.log 2 + Real.log (scaleL x) :=
          Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hLpos.ne'
        _ = Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log x) := by rw [scaleL]
    have hlog2lt : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
      linarith
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingBlockMass_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_movingBlockMass_bounds {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ movingBlockMass C x ∧ movingBlockMass C x ≤ scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  have h2Jy : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ 2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_movingJ_div_movingY_zero.const_mul (2 : ℝ)
    simpa only [mul_zero, mul_div_assoc] using h
  have hexpTendsto : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x))
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have h := (Real.continuous_exp.tendsto 0).comp h2Jy
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.exp_zero] using h
  have hexpTwo : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.exp (2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x) ≤ 2 :=
    hexpTendsto.eventually_le_const (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have hlower : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ C * (1 + log2 (3 * x)) :=
    ((tendsto_atTop_add_const_left atTop 1
      tendsto_log2_three_mul_atTop).const_mul_atTop hC).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  have hL2small := log2_isLittleO_scaleL.bound
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (8 * C) by positivity)
  have hJsmall := movingJ_cast_isLittleO_scaleL.bound
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * C) by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hexpTwo, hlower, hL2small, hJsmall,
    eventually_one_add_log2_three_mul_le, eventually_scaleL_pos,
    eventually_log2_pos] with
      x hexp hone hL2 hJ hlog3 hL hL2pos
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2pos.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hL2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _), Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hJ
  have hexpPos : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = Real.exp 0 := (Real.exp_zero).symm
      _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        (div_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have hbracketNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + log2 (3 * x) := by linarith [hlog3.1]
  have hJnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  constructor
  · have hprod : C * (1 + log2 (3 * x)) ≤
        C * ((1 + log2 (3 * x)) * Real.exp (2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC.le
      nlinarith
    have : C * ((1 + log2 (3 * x)) * Real.exp (2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x)) ≤
        movingBlockMass C x := by
      unfold movingBlockMass
      nlinarith
    linarith
  · have hfactor : (1 + log2 (3 * x)) * Real.exp (2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x) ≤
        (2 * log2 x) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul hlog3.2 hexp (Real.exp_pos _).le (by linarith [hL2pos.le])
    have hstep : movingBlockMass C x ≤ C * (4 * log2 x + (movingJ x : ℝ)) := by
      unfold movingBlockMass
      nlinarith
    have hL2bound : 4 * C * log2 x ≤ scaleL x / 2 := by
      calc
        4 * C * log2 x ≤ 4 * C * (1 / (8 * C) * scaleL x) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL2 (by positivity)
        _ = scaleL x / 2 := by field_simp; ring
    have hJbound : C * (movingJ x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL x / 2 := by
      calc
        C * (movingJ x : ℝ) ≤ C * (1 / (2 * C) * scaleL x) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJ hC.le
        _ = scaleL x / 2 := by field_simp
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingLogBlockMass_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_movingLogBlockMass_bounds {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      0 ≤ movingLogBlockMass C x ∧ movingLogBlockMass C x ≤ log2 x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingBlockMass_bounds hC, eventually_scaleL_pos] with
      x hbounds hL
  refine ⟨Real.log_nonneg hbounds.1, ?_⟩
  have hle : movingBlockMass C x ≤ Real.log x := by
    have := hbounds.2
    rwa [scaleL] at this
  rw [movingLogBlockMass, log2_eq]
  exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith [hbounds.1]) hle

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_one_add_scaleL_div_movingT_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_log_one_add_scaleL_div_movingT_bounds :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      0 ≤ Real.log (1 + scaleL x / movingT x) ∧
        Real.log (1 + scaleL x / movingT x) ≤ 2 * log2 x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive,
    tendsto_movingT_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with x hcore hT hL
  have hTpos : 0 < movingT x := hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hLpos : 0 < scaleL x := by linarith
  have hquot : scaleL x / movingT x ≤ scaleL x := div_le_self hLpos.le hT
  have hquotNonneg : 0 ≤ scaleL x / movingT x := div_nonneg hLpos.le hTpos.le
  refine ⟨Real.log_nonneg (by linarith), ?_⟩
  have hub : 1 + scaleL x / movingT x ≤ scaleL x ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  calc
    Real.log (1 + scaleL x / movingT x) ≤ Real.log (scaleL x ^ 2) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hub
    _ = 2 * log2 x := by
      rw [Real.log_pow, log2_eq, scaleL]
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log2_three_mul_movingJ_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_log2_three_mul_movingJ_bounds :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      0 ≤ log2 (3 * (movingJ x : ℝ)) ∧
        log2 (3 * (movingJ x : ℝ)) ≤ log2 x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_two_le_movingJ, eventually_three_mul_movingJ_le_scaleL,
    eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hJ hJL hL
  have hJtwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hexpOne : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    linarith
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlogOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (3 * (movingJ x : ℝ)) :=
    (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).mpr hexpOne
  refine ⟨by rw [log2_eq]; exact Real.log_nonneg hlogOne, ?_⟩
  have hlogLe : Real.log (3 * (movingJ x : ℝ)) ≤ scaleL x := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos
    linarith
  rw [log2_eq, log2_eq, ← scaleL]
  exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hlogLe

name: RankAmplification.eventually_ledger_log_argument_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_ledger_log_argument_bounds {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.log (2 * C) ≤
          Real.log (C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
            (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x)) ∧
        Real.log (C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
            (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x)) ≤ 3 * log2 x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_two_le_movingJ, eventually_movingJ_le_scaleL,
    eventually_moving_core_positive, tendsto_movingT_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (3 * C),
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with
      x hJ hJL hcore hT hLC hLone
  have hJtwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hTpos : 0 < movingT x := hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hLpos : 0 < scaleL x := by linarith
  have hquot : scaleL x / movingT x ≤ scaleL x := div_le_self hLpos.le hT
  have hquotNonneg : 0 ≤ scaleL x / movingT x := div_nonneg hLpos.le hTpos.le
  have hbracket : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x := by linarith
  have hbracketUpper : 1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x ≤ 3 * scaleL x := by
    linarith
  have hargPos : (0 : ℝ) < C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
      (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x) := by positivity
  have hCJnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C * (movingJ x : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg hC.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hlow : 2 * C ≤ C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
      (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x) := by
    have h1 : C * 2 ≤ C * (movingJ x : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJtwo hC.le
    have h2 : C * (movingJ x : ℝ) * 1 ≤
        C * (movingJ x : ℝ) * (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracket hCJnonneg
    linarith
  have hhigh : C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
      (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x) ≤ scaleL x ^ 3 := by
    have hCJ : C * (movingJ x : ℝ) ≤ C * scaleL x :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJL hC.le
    have hstep : C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
        (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x) ≤
        (C * scaleL x) * (3 * scaleL x) :=
      mul_le_mul hCJ hbracketUpper (by linarith) (mul_nonneg hC.le hLpos.le)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLC (sq_nonneg (scaleL x))]
  refine ⟨Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hlow, ?_⟩
  calc
    Real.log (C * (movingJ x : ℝ) * (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x)) ≤
        Real.log (scaleL x ^ 3) := Real.log_le_log hargPos hhigh
    _ = 3 * log2 x := by
      rw [Real.log_pow, log2_eq, scaleL]
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingJ_sq_mul_log2_three_movingJ_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingJ_sq_mul_log2_three_movingJ_div_etaR_zero :

proof:

  · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_three_mul_movingJ_bounds,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hb hcore
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hb.1)
      (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_three_mul_movingJ_bounds,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hb hcore
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_ledger_log_term_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_ledger_log_term_div_etaR_zero {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ 3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
      Real.log (C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
        (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x)) / movingEtaR x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingEtaR x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    movingJ_cast_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hlow : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log (2 * C) / movingEtaR x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := hJ.const_mul (3 * Real.log (2 * C))
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    refine h.congr ?_
    intro x
    ring
  have hhigh : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 9 * ((movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x) / movingEtaR x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_movingJ_mul_log2_div_etaR_zero.const_mul (9 : ℝ)
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    refine h.congr ?_
    intro x
    ring
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hlow hhigh ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ledger_log_argument_bounds hC,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hb hcore
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) := by positivity
    nlinarith [hb.1]
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ledger_log_argument_bounds hC,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hb hcore
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le
    have hJnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) := by positivity
    nlinarith [hb.2]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingC_mul_movingJ_div_movingY_div_etaR_zero

theorem tendsto_movingC_mul_movingJ_div_movingY_div_etaR_zero {C : ℝ} :

proof:

    exact h

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_17_ledger_group_two
statement:
theorem proposition10_17_ledger_group_two {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) :

      ((movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 + (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (3 * (movingJ x : ℝ)) +
        3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
          Real.log (C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
            (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x)) +
        C * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x) / movingEtaR x) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((movingJ_sq_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.add
    tendsto_movingJ_sq_mul_log2_three_movingJ_div_etaR_zero).add
      (tendsto_ledger_log_term_div_etaR_zero hC)).add
        (tendsto_movingC_mul_movingJ_div_movingY_div_etaR_zero (C := C))
  simpa only [add_div, add_zero] using h

name: RankAmplification.log_three_mul_movingZ
statement:
theorem log_three_mul_movingZ (x : ℝ) :
    Real.log (3 * movingZ x) = Real.log 3 + movingK x
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : movingZ x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [movingZ_eq_exp]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hZ, log_movingZ]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log2_three_mul_movingZ_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_log2_three_mul_movingZ_bounds :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      0 ≤ log2 (3 * movingZ x) ∧ log2 (3 * movingZ x) ≤ log2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hKsmall := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  filter_upwards [hKsmall, eventually_movingK_pos,
    tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1, eventually_scaleL_pos,
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 3)] with
      x hK hKpos hKone hL hL3
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hKpos.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hK
  have hlog3 : 0 ≤ Real.log 3 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hinner : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 3 + movingK x := by linarith
  have hLx : scaleL x = Real.log x := rfl
  have hinnerLe : Real.log 3 + movingK x ≤ Real.log x := by
    rw [← hLx]
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [log2_eq, log_three_mul_movingZ]
    exact Real.log_nonneg hinner
  · rw [log2_eq, log_three_mul_movingZ, log2_eq]
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hinnerLe

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingJ_mul_log2_three_movingZ_div_etaR_zero
statement:

    Tendsto (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 (3 * movingZ x) / movingEtaR x)

proof:
:= by

  · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_three_mul_movingZ_bounds,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hb hcore
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hb.1)
      (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_three_mul_movingZ_bounds,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hb hcore
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingJ_mul_vsrc_div_log_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingJ_mul_vsrc_div_log_div_etaR_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (movingJ x : ℝ) * (movingVsrc x / Real.log (movingVsrc x)) / movingEtaR x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ movingJ_mul_movingVsrc_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  · filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_movingVsrc,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hv hcore
    have hlogv : 0 < Real.log (movingVsrc x) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (div_nonneg (by linarith) hlogv.le))
      (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_movingVsrc,
      eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hv hcore
    have hexpLt : Real.exp 1 ≤ movingVsrc x := by
      have hd := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      linarith
    have hlogv : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (movingVsrc x) :=
      (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by linarith)).mpr hexpLt
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (div_le_self (by linarith) hlogv)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_17_ledger_group_three

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleUpperError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleUpperError_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (movingSaddleUpperError c) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  set D : ℝ := 8 + 4 * (1 + c) with hD
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by positivity
  have hlogR : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ log2 x / movingR x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_movingR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hconstR : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.log D / movingR x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_movingR_atTop
  have hsumR : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ (Real.log D + log2 x) / movingR x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := hconstR.add hlogR
    rw [add_zero] at h
    refine h.congr ?_
    intro x
    rw [add_div]
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ (hsumR.comp hnat)
  · filter_upwards [hnat.eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hL hcore
    have hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
    have hargOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith
    exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hargOne) hR.le
  · filter_upwards [hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive,
      hnat.eventually (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1),
      hnat.eventually eventually_movingR_le_scaleL] with x hcore hLone hRL
    have hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
    have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
    have hargPos : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith
    have hargLe : 4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ≤ D * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [hD]
      nlinarith
    have hlogLe : Real.log (4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ))) ≤
        Real.log D + log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        Real.log (4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ))) ≤
            Real.log (D * scaleL (x : ℝ)) := Real.log_le_log hargPos hargLe
        _ = Real.log D + Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := Real.log_mul hDpos.ne' hL.ne'
        _ = Real.log D + log2 (x : ℝ) := by rw [log2_eq, scaleL]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogLe hR.le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_c_mul_movingR_le_scaleL
statement:
theorem eventually_c_mul_movingR_le_scaleL {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, c * movingR x ≤ scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
    log2_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / c ^ 2 by positivity)] with
      x hL hL2 hb
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hb
  have hRsq : movingR x ^ 2 = scaleL x * log2 x := movingR_sq hL.le hL2.le
  have hR : 0 < movingR x := movingR_pos hL hL2
  have hcsq : c ^ 2 * (movingR x) ^ 2 ≤ scaleL x ^ 2 := by
    rw [hRsq]
    have hstep : c ^ 2 * (scaleL x * log2 x) ≤ c ^ 2 * (scaleL x * (1 / c ^ 2 * scaleL x)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hL.le
    have hclear : c ^ 2 * (scaleL x * (1 / c ^ 2 * scaleL x)) = scaleL x ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
    linarith [hstep, hclear]
  nlinarith [mul_pos hc hR]

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_counting
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_counting {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSaddleUpperError c x * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive,
    hnat.eventually (eventually_c_mul_movingR_le_scaleL hc),
    eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hcore hcR hxpos
  have hRpos : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hLpos : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hxR : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hxpos
  have hcRnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c * movingR (x : ℝ) := (mul_pos hc hRpos).le
  have hexpOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ))
    linarith
  have hZle : ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold movingSaddleCutoff
    exact Nat.floor_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hZlt : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) < ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
    unfold movingSaddleCutoff
    exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hZone : 1 ≤ movingSaddleCutoff c x := by
    unfold movingSaddleCutoff
    exact Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hexpOne)
  have hZposR : (0 : ℝ) < ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hZone
  have hZoneR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hZone
  have hexpLex : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by
    have hstep : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hcR
    rwa [scaleL, Real.exp_log hxR] at hstep
  have hZx : movingSaddleCutoff c x ≤ x := by
    unfold movingSaddleCutoff
    have hle : ⌊Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ))⌋₊ ≤ ⌊((x : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊ :=
      Nat.floor_mono hexpLex
    simpa using hle
  have hlogZ : Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    have hstep := Real.log_le_log hZposR hZle
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at hstep
  have hlog2le : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hamb : ((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      2 * (x : ℝ) * ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    push_cast
    ring
  have hlogAmb : 1 + Real.log ((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [hamb, Real.log_mul (by positivity) hZposR.ne',
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hxR.ne']
    have hLx : Real.log (x : ℝ) = scaleL (x : ℝ) := rfl
    rw [hLx]
    linarith
  have hinv : ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(c * movingR (x : ℝ))) := by
    have hexpPos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hle : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    have hdiv : (2 : ℝ) / (2 * ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        2 / Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hexpPos hle
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    calc
      ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ =
          (2 : ℝ) / (2 * ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp
      _ ≤ 2 / Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := hdiv
      _ = 2 * (Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)))⁻¹ := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hargPos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hsad : movingSaddleExponent c ≤ c := by
    unfold movingSaddleExponent
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hupper := smoothMultiplierB4Upper_le (show 0 < movingSaddleCutoff c x from hZone) hZx
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log ((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := hupper
    _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ)) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-(c * movingR (x : ℝ)))) := by
      refine mul_le_mul ?_ hinv (by positivity) ?_
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogAmb (by positivity)
      · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by positivity
        exact mul_nonneg this hargPos.le
    _ = (4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ))) *
          ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(c * movingR (x : ℝ)))) := by ring
    _ ≤ (4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ))) *
          ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c * movingR (x : ℝ)))) := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by linarith)
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hxR.le
      refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
      nlinarith
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSaddleUpperError c x * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
      have herr : movingSaddleUpperError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) =
          Real.log (4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ))) := by
        unfold movingSaddleUpperError
        exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hRpos.ne'
      rw [herr, show -(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
          Real.log (4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ))) =
          -(movingSaddleExponent c * movingR (x : ℝ)) +
            Real.log (4 * (2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ))) from by ring,
        Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by linarith)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleOptimumError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleOptimumError_zero :
    Tendsto movingSaddleOptimumError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  have hK : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingK (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (1 / 2)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using tendsto_movingK_div_R_half.comp hnat
  have hfirst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ 1 / 2 - movingK (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (1 / 2))).sub hK
  have heta : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingEta (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using tendsto_movingEta_zero.comp hnat
  have hsecond : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate (fun _ ↦ 0) x * movingEta (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using movingB4Estimate_unconditional.1.mul heta
  have h := hfirst.add hsecond
  rw [add_zero] at h
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro x
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_counting_at_optimum
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_counting_at_optimum :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSaddleOptimumError x * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [movingB4Estimate_unconditional.2,
    hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hbound hcore
  have hRpos : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hRne : movingR (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hRpos.ne'
  refine hbound.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have hexpEq : -movingK (x : ℝ) +
      movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate (fun _ ↦ 0) x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
      -(movingSaddleExponent (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSaddleOptimumError x * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold movingSaddleOptimumError movingEtaR
    rw [show movingSaddleExponent (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 / 2 from by
      norm_num [movingSaddleExponent]]
    field_simp
    ring
  unfold movingExponentialMajorant
  rw [hexpEq]

name: RankAmplification.log2_pow_four_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL
statement:
theorem log2_pow_four_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL :
    (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ 4) =o[atTop] (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x))
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :=
    (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (4 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).comp_tendsto
      tendsto_scaleL_atTop
  apply hbase.congr'
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hL
    simp [Function.comp_apply, log2, scaleL]
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hL
    simp [Function.comp_apply, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]

name: RankAmplification.log2_cube_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2
statement:
theorem log2_cube_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2 :
    (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ 3) =o[atTop] fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)
proof:
:= by
  refine isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hL2
    intro hzero
    exact absurd hzero (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)))
  · refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ log2_pow_four_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
      exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_one_le_log2] with x hL hL2
      have hL2pos : 0 < log2 x := by linarith
      have hsqrtL : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL
      have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (log2 x) := by
        rw [show (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 by simp]
        exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hL2
      have hroot : Real.sqrt (log2 x) ≤ log2 x := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hL2pos.le]
      have hnum : log2 x ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (log2 x) ≤ log2 x ^ 4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hroot
          (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ log2 x ^ 3 by positivity)]
      rw [Real.sqrt_div hL.le, div_div_eq_mul_div]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hsqrtL.le

name: RankAmplification.log2_cube_isLittleO_movingT
statement:
theorem log2_cube_isLittleO_movingT :
    (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ 3) =o[atTop] movingT
proof:
:=
  (log2_cube_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2.trans_isBigO
    sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_isBigO_movingTMain).trans_isBigO
      movingT_isEquivalent_main.isBigO_symm

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isLittleO_movingT
statement:
theorem movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isLittleO_movingT :

proof:
:=
  movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isBigO_cube.trans_isLittleO log2_cube_isLittleO_movingT

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingT_le_dependencyError_mul_etaR
statement:
theorem eventually_movingT_le_dependencyError_mul_etaR {C C' : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hC' : 0 < C') :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      movingT x ≤
        movingDependencyError C movingLogBell (movingLogBlockMass C') x *
          movingEtaR x
proof:
:= by
  have hCJ : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ C * (movingJ x : ℝ) :=
    (((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp
      tendsto_movingJ_atTop).const_mul_atTop hC).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive, eventually_two_le_movingJ,
    eventually_movingLogBlockMass_bounds hC',
    eventually_log_one_add_scaleL_div_movingT_bounds,
    eventually_log2_three_mul_movingJ_bounds,
    eventually_log2_three_mul_movingZ_bounds,
    eventually_three_le_movingVsrc, eventually_movingK_pos, hCJ] with
      x hcore hJ hmass hlog1 hlogJ hlogZ hv hK hCJx
  have hetaR : 0 < movingEtaR x := mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hetaL : 0 < movingEtaL x := mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.1
  have hJ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hTpos : 0 < movingT x := hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hY : 0 < movingY x := by
    rw [movingY_eq_exp]
    exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hquotNonneg : 0 ≤ scaleL x / movingT x := div_nonneg hcore.1.le hTpos.le
  have hbracket : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x := by linarith
  have hP1 : movingT x / movingEtaR x ≤
      (movingT x + movingLogBell x + (movingJ x : ℝ) * movingLogBlockMass C' x +
        (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + scaleL x / movingT x)) / movingEtaR x := by
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ hetaR.le
    have h1 := movingLogBell_nonneg x
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * movingLogBlockMass C' x := mul_nonneg hJ0 hmass.1
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + scaleL x / movingT x) :=
      mul_nonneg hJ0 hlog1.1
    linarith
  have hargOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
      (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hCJx hbracket zero_le_one
      (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C * (movingJ x : ℝ))
    linarith
  have hP2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 +
      (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (3 * (movingJ x : ℝ)) +
      3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log (C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
        (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x)) +
      C * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x) / movingEtaR x := by
    refine div_nonneg ?_ hetaR.le
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (3 * (movingJ x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hlogJ.1
    have h2 : 0 ≤ 3 * (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log (C * (movingJ x : ℝ) *
        (1 + (movingJ x : ℝ) + scaleL x / movingT x)) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Real.log_nonneg hargOne)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ C * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC.le hJ0) hY.le
    linarith [sq_nonneg ((movingJ x : ℝ))]
  have hlogv : 0 < Real.log (movingVsrc x) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hP3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingEtaR x *
      (log2 (3 * movingZ x) + movingVsrc x / Real.log (movingVsrc x)) := by
    refine mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hJ0 hetaR.le) ?_
    have hvq : 0 ≤ movingVsrc x / Real.log (movingVsrc x) :=
      div_nonneg (by linarith) hlogv.le
    linarith [hlogZ.1]
  have hP4 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * movingK x / movingEtaL x :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hJ0 hK.le) hetaL.le
  have hsum : movingT x / movingEtaR x ≤
      movingDependencyError C movingLogBell (movingLogBlockMass C') x := by
    unfold movingDependencyError
    linarith
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hetaR).mp hsum

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_17_log_encoding_le
statement:
theorem proposition10_17_log_encoding_le {C C' : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hC' : 0 < C') :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
          (movingSupplierSlotBound x)) ≤
        movingDependencyError C movingLogBell (movingLogBlockMass C') (x : ℝ) *
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  have hsmall := movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isLittleO_movingT.bound
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 12 by norm_num)
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSupplierScaleBounds,
    eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility,
    hnat.eventually (eventually_movingT_le_dependencyError_mul_etaR hC hC'),
    hnat.eventually hsmall, hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x hscale hadm hdep hbound hcore
  have hy : 0 < movingNatY x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hadm.three_le_y
  have hJpos : 0 < movingNatJ x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hscale.rank_ge_two
  have hFone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
      (movingSupplierSlotBound x) := one_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor hJpos
  have hFle := moving_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_combinatorialExponent hscale hy
  have hlogF : Real.log (finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
      (movingSupplierSlotBound x)) ≤ movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x := by
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hFle
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at h
  have hL2pos : 0 < log2 (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.1
  have hTpos : 0 < movingT (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hL2pos.le),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hTpos.le] at hbound
  have hcomb : movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x ≤ movingT (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent movingNatJ
    linarith
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.mem_exactRankShiftedSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_exactRankShiftedSet {x h y r n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ exactRankShiftedSet x h y r ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧ largePrimeRank y n.totient = r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [exactRankShiftedSet]

name: RankAmplification.mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet {x h y R n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y R ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧ R ≤ largePrimeRank y n.totient
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [atLeastRankShiftedSet]

name: RankAmplification.mem_belowRankShiftedSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_belowRankShiftedSet {x h y R n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ belowRankShiftedSet x h y R ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧ largePrimeRank y n.totient < R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hn
    have hrlt : r < R := Finset.mem_range.mp hr
    have hnData := mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mp hnr
    exact ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.symm ▸ hrlt⟩
  · rintro ⟨hn, hrank⟩
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨largePrimeRank y n.totient, Finset.mem_range.mpr hrank,
      mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mpr ⟨hn, rfl⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.mem_intermediateRankShiftedSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_intermediateRankShiftedSet {x h y J n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ intermediateRankShiftedSet x h y J ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧
        1 ≤ largePrimeRank y n.totient ∧ largePrimeRank y n.totient < J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hnr⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hn
    have hrData := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hr
    have hnData := mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mp hnr
    refine ⟨hnData.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hnData.2] using hrData.1
    · simpa only [hnData.2] using hrData.2
  · rintro ⟨hn, hrankOne, hrankJ⟩
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨largePrimeRank y n.totient, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hrankOne, hrankJ⟩,
      mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mpr ⟨hn, rfl⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_subset_shiftedEqualTotientSet
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_subset_shiftedEqualTotientSet (x h y r : ℕ) :
    exactRankShiftedSet x h y r ⊆ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
proof:

name: RankAmplification.atLeastRankShiftedSet_subset_shiftedEqualTotientSet
statement:

name: RankAmplification.largePrimeRank_anti_cutoff
statement:
theorem largePrimeRank_anti_cutoff {y Y n : ℕ} (hyY : y ≤ Y) :
    largePrimeRank Y n ≤ largePrimeRank y n
proof:
:= by
  rw [largePrimeRank, largePrimeRank]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro p hp
    have hpData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpData.1, hyY.trans_lt hpData.2⟩
  · intro p _ _
    exact Nat.zero_le _

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_disjoint
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_disjoint {x h y r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    Disjoint (exactRankShiftedSet x h y r) (exactRankShiftedSet x h y s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hnr hns
  have hrankR := (mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mp hnr).2
  have hrankS := (mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mp hns).2
  exact hrs (hrankR.symm.trans hrankS)

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_pairwiseDisjoint (x h y : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (s : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint fun r ↦ exactRankShiftedSet x h y r
proof:
:= by
  intro r _ t _ hrt
  exact exactRankShiftedSet_disjoint hrt

name: RankAmplification.belowRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet
statement:
theorem belowRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet (x h y R : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (belowRankShiftedSet x h y R) (atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hbelow hatLeast
  have hlt := (mem_belowRankShiftedSet.mp hbelow).2
  have hle := (mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mp hatLeast).2
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hle) hlt

name: RankAmplification.belowRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet
statement:
theorem belowRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet (x h y R : ℕ) :
    belowRankShiftedSet x h y R ∪ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y R =
      shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Finset.mem_union, mem_belowRankShiftedSet, mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hn, _⟩ | ⟨hn, _⟩)
    · exact hn
    · exact hn
  · intro hn
    rcases lt_or_ge (largePrimeRank y n.totient) R with hrank | hrank
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hn, hrank⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hn, hrank⟩

name: RankAmplification.belowRankShiftedSet_card_eq_sum
statement:
theorem belowRankShiftedSet_card_eq_sum (x h y R : ℕ) :
    (belowRankShiftedSet x h y R).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R, exactRankShiftedCount x h y r
proof:
:= by
  rw [belowRankShiftedSet,
    Finset.card_biUnion (exactRankShiftedSet_pairwiseDisjoint x h y (Finset.range R))]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_sum_exactRank_add_atLeastRank
statement:
theorem shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_sum_exactRank_add_atLeastRank (x h y R : ℕ) :
    shiftedEqualTotientCount x h =
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.range R, exactRankShiftedCount x h y r) +
        atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y R
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedEqualTotientCount, ← belowRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y R,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
      (belowRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y R),
    belowRankShiftedSet_card_eq_sum, atLeastRankShiftedCount]

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_mono_size
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_mono_size {W X h y r : ℕ} (hWX : W ≤ X) :

  have hnData := mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mp hn
  have hbase := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hnData.1
