  apply mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mpr
  exact ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2 ▸ hRr⟩

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedCount_le_atLeastRankShiftedCount
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedCount_le_atLeastRankShiftedCount {x h y R r : ℕ} (hRr : R ≤ r) :
    exactRankShiftedCount x h y r ≤ atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y R
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_le_card (exactRankShiftedSet_subset_atLeastRankShiftedSet hRr)

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_zero
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_zero (x h y : ℕ) :
    exactRankShiftedSet x h y 0 = smoothShiftedSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [mem_exactRankShiftedSet, mem_smoothShiftedSet_iff_rank_zero]

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedCount_zero
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedCount_zero (x h y : ℕ) :
    exactRankShiftedCount x h y 0 = smoothShiftedCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  rw [exactRankShiftedCount, exactRankShiftedSet_zero, smoothShiftedCount]

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_zero_mono_cutoff
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_zero_mono_cutoff {x h y Y : ℕ} (hyY : y ≤ Y) :
    exactRankShiftedSet x h y 0 ⊆ exactRankShiftedSet x h Y 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [exactRankShiftedSet_zero, exactRankShiftedSet_zero]
  intro n hn
  have hnData := mem_smoothShiftedSet.mp hn
  exact mem_smoothShiftedSet.mpr
    ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.1, hnData.2.2.1, hnData.2.2.2.mono hyY⟩

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedCount_zero_mono_cutoff
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedCount_zero_mono_cutoff {x h y Y : ℕ} (hyY : y ≤ Y) :
    exactRankShiftedCount x h y 0 ≤ exactRankShiftedCount x h Y 0
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_le_card (exactRankShiftedSet_zero_mono_cutoff hyY)

name: RankAmplification.atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet
statement:
theorem atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y 1 = nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet, mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn, hrank⟩
    have hnData := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hn
    refine ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.1, hnData.2.2, ?_⟩
    have hnpos : 0 < n := zero_lt_one.trans_le hnData.1
    have hnotSmooth : ¬IsSmooth y n.totient := by
      intro hsmooth
      have hzero := (largePrimeRank_totient_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth hnpos).mpr hsmooth
      omega
    have htotient : n.totient ≠ 0 := (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hnpos).ne'
    have hnotle : ¬largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ y := by
      intro hle
      exact hnotSmooth ((isSmooth_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le hy htotient).mpr hle)
    exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnotle
  · rintro ⟨hn, hnx, heq, hlpf⟩
    have hnpos : 0 < n := zero_lt_one.trans_le hn
    refine ⟨mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mpr ⟨hn, hnx, heq⟩, ?_⟩
    have hrankNe : largePrimeRank y n.totient ≠ 0 := by
      intro hrank
      have hsmooth := (largePrimeRank_totient_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth hnpos).mp hrank
      exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hsmooth.largestPrimeFactor_le hy)) hlpf
    omega

name: RankAmplification.atLeastRankShiftedCount_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedCount
statement:
theorem atLeastRankShiftedCount_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedCount {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y 1 = nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  rw [atLeastRankShiftedCount, atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy,
    nonsmoothShiftedCount]

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet
proof:
:= by
  rw [← atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy]
  exact exactRankShiftedSet_subset_atLeastRankShiftedSet hr

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedCount_le_nonsmoothShiftedCount
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_le_card (exactRankShiftedSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy hr)

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet_succ
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet_succ (x h y R : ℕ) :
    exactRankShiftedSet x h y R ∪ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y (R + 1) =
      atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y R
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Finset.mem_union, mem_exactRankShiftedSet, mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet,
    mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hn, hrank⟩ | ⟨hn, hrank⟩)
    · exact ⟨hn, hrank ▸ le_rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨hn, (Nat.le_add_right R 1).trans hrank⟩
  · rintro ⟨hn, hrank⟩
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hrank with heq | hlt
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hn, heq.symm⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hn, hlt⟩

name: RankAmplification.exactRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet_succ
statement:
theorem exactRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet_succ (x h y R : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (exactRankShiftedSet x h y R) (atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y (R + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hexact hatLeast
  have heq := (mem_exactRankShiftedSet.mp hexact).2
  have hle := (mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mp hatLeast).2
  rw [heq] at hle
  omega

name: RankAmplification.atLeastRankShiftedCount_eq_exactRank_add_succ
statement:
theorem atLeastRankShiftedCount_eq_exactRank_add_succ (x h y R : ℕ) :
    atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y R =
      exactRankShiftedCount x h y R + atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y (R + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [atLeastRankShiftedCount,
    ← exactRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet_succ x h y R,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
      (exactRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet_succ x h y R),
    exactRankShiftedCount, atLeastRankShiftedCount]

name: RankAmplification.intermediateRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet
statement:
theorem intermediateRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet (x h y J : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (intermediateRankShiftedSet x h y J) (atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hintermediate hatLeast
  have hlt := (mem_intermediateRankShiftedSet.mp hintermediate).2.2
  have hle := (mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mp hatLeast).2
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hle) hlt

name: RankAmplification.intermediateRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet_eq_nonsmooth
statement:
theorem intermediateRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet_eq_nonsmooth
    {x h y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) :
    intermediateRankShiftedSet x h y J ∪ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y J =
      nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro (hintermediate | hatLeast)
    · have hData := mem_intermediateRankShiftedSet.mp hintermediate
      have hOne : n ∈ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y 1 :=
        mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mpr ⟨hData.1, hData.2.1⟩
      rwa [atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy] at hOne
    · have hData := mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mp hatLeast
      have hOne : n ∈ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y 1 :=
        mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mpr ⟨hData.1, hJ.trans hData.2⟩
      rwa [atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy] at hOne
  · intro hnonsmooth
    have hOne : n ∈ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y 1 := by
      rwa [atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy]
    have hData := mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mp hOne
    rcases lt_or_ge (largePrimeRank y n.totient) J with hlt | hle
    · exact Or.inl (mem_intermediateRankShiftedSet.mpr ⟨hData.1, hData.2, hlt⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mpr ⟨hData.1, hle⟩)

name: RankAmplification.intermediateRankShiftedSet_card_eq_sum
statement:
theorem intermediateRankShiftedSet_card_eq_sum (x h y J : ℕ) :
    (intermediateRankShiftedSet x h y J).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico 1 J, exactRankShiftedCount x h y r
proof:
:= by
  rw [intermediateRankShiftedSet,
    Finset.card_biUnion (exactRankShiftedSet_pairwiseDisjoint x h y (Finset.Ico 1 J))]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_sum_exactRank_add_atLeastRank
statement:
theorem nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_sum_exactRank_add_atLeastRank
    {x h y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) :
    nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y =
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico 1 J, exactRankShiftedCount x h y r) +
        atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y J
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsmoothShiftedCount,
    ← intermediateRankShiftedSet_union_atLeastRankShiftedSet_eq_nonsmooth hy hJ,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
      (intermediateRankShiftedSet_disjoint_atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y J),
    intermediateRankShiftedSet_card_eq_sum, atLeastRankShiftedCount]

name: RankAmplification.shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_smooth_add_sum_exactRank_add_atLeastRank
statement:
theorem shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_smooth_add_sum_exactRank_add_atLeastRank
    {x h y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) :
    shiftedEqualTotientCount x h = smoothShiftedCount x h y +
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico 1 J, exactRankShiftedCount x h y r) +
        atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y J
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_smooth_add_nonsmooth hy,
    nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_sum_exactRank_add_atLeastRank hy hJ, Nat.add_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.one_le_largePrimeRank_totient
proof:
:= by
  have hm₁pos : 0 < s.m1 := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hm₁
    apply s.q1_not_dvd_m1
    rw [hm₁]
    exact dvd_zero s.q1
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    rw [s.n_eq]
    exact mul_pos hm₁pos s.q1_prime.pos
  have htotient : n.totient ≠ 0 := (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hnpos).ne'
  have htotientEq : n.totient = s.m1.totient * (s.q1 - 1) :=
    totient_eq_cofactor_mul_pred s.q1_prime s.n_eq s.q1_not_dvd_m1
  have hqpred : s.q1 - 1 = s.k1 * p := by
    rw [s.q1_eq]
    omega
  have hpdiv : p ∣ n.totient := by
    refine ⟨s.m1.totient * s.k1, ?_⟩
    rw [htotientEq, hqpred]
    ac_rfl
  have hpsupport : p ∈ primeSupport n.totient :=
    Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hpdiv, htotient⟩
  have hpfilter : p ∈ (primeSupport n.totient).filter (y < ·) :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpsupport, hyp⟩
  have hfactorPos : 0 < n.totient.factorization p :=
    hp.factorization_pos_of_dvd htotient hpdiv
  have hfactorLe : n.totient.factorization p ≤ largePrimeRank y n.totient := by
    rw [largePrimeRank]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hpfilter
  omega

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.totient_eq_shifted_totient
proof:
:= by
  have htotient₁ : n.totient = s.m1.totient * (s.q1 - 1) :=
    totient_eq_cofactor_mul_pred s.q1_prime s.n_eq s.q1_not_dvd_m1
  have htotient₂ : (n + h).totient = s.m2.totient * (s.q2 - 1) :=
    totient_eq_cofactor_mul_pred s.q2_prime s.shifted_eq s.q2_not_dvd_m2
  have hq₁pred : s.q1 - 1 = s.k1 * p := by
    rw [s.q1_eq]
    omega
  have hq₂pred : s.q2 - 1 = s.k2 * p := by
    rw [s.q2_eq]
    omega
  calc
    n.totient = s.m1.totient * (s.q1 - 1) := htotient₁
    _ = s.m1.totient * (s.k1 * p) := by rw [hq₁pred]
    _ = p * (s.k1 * s.m1.totient) := by ac_rfl
    _ = p * (s.k2 * s.m2.totient) := by rw [s.balance]
    _ = s.m2.totient * (s.k2 * p) := by ac_rfl
    _ = s.m2.totient * (s.q2 - 1) := by rw [hq₂pred]
    _ = (n + h).totient := htotient₂.symm

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet_one
proof:
:= by
  have hm₁pos : 0 < s.m1 := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro hm₁
    apply s.q1_not_dvd_m1
    rw [hm₁]
    exact dvd_zero s.q1
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    rw [s.n_eq]
    exact mul_pos hm₁pos s.q1_prime.pos
  apply mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mpr
    ⟨hnpos, hnx, s.totient_eq_shifted_totient⟩, ?_⟩
  exact s.one_le_largePrimeRank_totient hp hyp

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankY_le_natY_add_one
statement:
theorem fixedRankY_le_natY_add_one (J x : ℕ) :
    fixedRankY J (x : ℝ) ≤ (fixedRankNatY J x + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [fixedRankNatY, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
    (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (fixedRankY J (x : ℝ))).le

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_hasExponentialCutoffScale
statement:
theorem fixedRank_hasExponentialCutoffScale (J x : ℕ) :
    HasExponentialCutoffScale (fixedRankNatY J x)
      (fixedRankT J (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasExponentialCutoffScale
  simpa only [fixedRankY] using fixedRankY_le_natY_add_one J x

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankUpperExponent_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem fixedRankUpperExponent_isLittleO_scaleL (J : ℕ) :
    (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:=
  scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL.const_mul_left (Real.sqrt J)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankUpperExponent_le_scaleL
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankUpperExponent_le_scaleL (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, Real.sqrt J * scaleG x ≤ scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := (fixedRankUpperExponent_isLittleO_scaleL J).bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hx hL
  calc
    Real.sqrt J * scaleG x ≤ ‖Real.sqrt J * scaleG x‖ :=
      Real.le_norm_self _
    _ ≤ ‖scaleL x‖ := by simpa using hx
    _ = scaleL x := Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankUpperY_le_id
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankUpperY_le_id (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, fixedRankUpperY J x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  have hxone : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ x := eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankUpperExponent_le_scaleL J, hxone] with x hexp hx
  by_cases hJ : J = 0
  · subst J
    simp only [fixedRankUpperY, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero]
    exact hx
  · have hJpos : 0 < J := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hJ
    calc
      fixedRankUpperY J x = Real.exp (Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) :=
        fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG x hJpos
      _ ≤ Real.exp (scaleL x) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp
      _ = x := Real.exp_log (zero_lt_one.trans_le hx)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_id
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_id (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, fixedRankNatUpperY J x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  have hreal := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankUpperY_le_id J)
  filter_upwards [hreal] with x hx
  have hfloor : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.floor_le (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le
  exact_mod_cast hfloor.trans hx

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, FixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankNatY_le_upperY J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_id J] with x hy hyY hYx
  exact ⟨hJ, hy, hyY, hYx, fixedRank_hasExponentialCutoffScale J x⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankNatY_le_id
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankNatY_le_id (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, fixedRankNatY J x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ] with x hx
  exact hx.y_le_upper.trans hx.upper_le_x

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_two_mul (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, fixedRankNatUpperY J x ≤ 2 * x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_id J] with x hx
  exact hx.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left x (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.FixedRankNaturalAdmissibility.shift_le_ranges
statement:
theorem FixedRankNaturalAdmissibility.shift_le_ranges
    {J x h : ℕ} (hadmissible : FixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J x)
    (hh : h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x) :
    h ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x ∧ h ≤ x
proof:
:=
  ⟨hh.trans hadmissible.y_le_upper,
    hh.trans (hadmissible.y_le_upper.trans hadmissible.upper_le_x)⟩

name: RankAmplification.totientRankinWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem totientRankinWeight_nonneg (s : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ totientRankinWeight s m
proof:
:= by
  unfold totientRankinWeight totientWeight
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_nonneg (R M : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M s
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun m _ ↦ totientRankinWeight_nonneg s m

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientWeightCoefficient_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smoothTotientWeightCoefficient_zero (R : ℕ) :
    smoothTotientWeightCoefficient R 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [smoothTotientWeightCoefficient]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_eq_sum_Icc_coefficient
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_eq_sum_Icc_coefficient (R M : ℕ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R M =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 M, smoothTotientWeightCoefficient R n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum finiteSmoothSet
  simp only [smoothTotientWeightCoefficient]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  congr 1
  ext n
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.zero_le, true_and]
  tauto

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_eq_coefficient
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_eq_coefficient
    (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M c =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 M,
        (n : ℝ) ^ (-c) * smoothTotientWeightCoefficient R n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum totientRankinWeight finiteSmoothSet
  simp only [smoothTotientWeightCoefficient]
  simp_rw [mul_ite, mul_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr
  · ext n
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.zero_le, true_and]
    tauto
  · intro n hn
    ring

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_eq_abel
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_eq_abel
    (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M c =
      (M : ℝ) ^ (-c) * finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R M +
        c * ∫ t in Set.Ioc (1 : ℝ) M,
          t ^ (-c - 1) * finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R ⌊t⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := smoothTotientWeightCoefficient R
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ t ^ (-c)
  have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by simp [a]
  have hdiff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) M, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t := by
    intro t ht
    dsimp [f]
    exact (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const
      (Or.inl (by linarith [ht.1]))).differentiableAt
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : deriv f t = (-c) * t ^ (-c - 1) := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [Real.deriv_rpow_const]
  have hderivFun : deriv f = fun t ↦ (-c) * t ^ (-c - 1) := funext hderiv
  have hint : IntegrableOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) M) := by
    rw [hderivFun]
    refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc (fun t ht ↦ ?_)
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    exact (continuousAt_const.mul
      (continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl ht0))).continuousWithinAt
  have habel := sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₀' a ha0 M hdiff hint
  have hpartial (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, a n =
      finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R N := by
    symm
    exact finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_eq_sum_Icc_coefficient R N
  rw [finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_eq_coefficient, habel]
  simp_rw [hpartial, hderiv]
  simp_rw [mul_assoc]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinAbelExpression_eq
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinAbelExpression_eq
    (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinAbelExpression R M c =
      finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M c
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_mertens_mul_smoothRankin

theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_mertens_mul_smoothRankin
    (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M c ≤
      mertensProduct R * finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) R M (-c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum finiteSmoothRpowSum totientRankinWeight

    (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) _)

name: RankAmplification.smoothCountCoefficient_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smoothCountCoefficient_zero (R : ℕ) :

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_cast_eq_sum_Icc_coefficient
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_cast_eq_sum_Icc_coefficient (R M : ℕ) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R M : ℝ) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 M, smoothCountCoefficient R n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (finiteSmoothCount R M : ℝ) =
        ∑ n ∈ finiteSmoothSet R M, (1 : ℝ) := by
      simp [finiteSmoothCount]
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 M, smoothCountCoefficient R n := by
      unfold finiteSmoothSet
      simp only [smoothCountCoefficient]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr
      · ext n
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.zero_le, true_and]
        tauto
      · intro n hn
        rfl

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothRpowSum_one_eq_coefficient
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothRpowSum_one_eq_coefficient
    (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) R M (-c) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 M,
        (n : ℝ) ^ (-c) * smoothCountCoefficient R n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteSmoothRpowSum finiteSmoothSet
  simp only [smoothCountCoefficient, one_mul]
  simp_rw [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr
  · ext n
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.zero_le, true_and]
    tauto
  · intro n hn
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothRpowSum_one_eq_abel
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothRpowSum_one_eq_abel
    (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) R M (-c) =
      (M : ℝ) ^ (-c) * finiteSmoothCount R M +
        c * ∫ t in Set.Ioc (1 : ℝ) M,
          t ^ (-c - 1) * finiteSmoothCount R ⌊t⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := smoothCountCoefficient R
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ t ^ (-c)
  have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by simp [a]
  have hdiff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) M, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t := by
    intro t ht
    dsimp [f]
    exact (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const
      (Or.inl (by linarith [ht.1]))).differentiableAt
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : deriv f t = (-c) * t ^ (-c - 1) := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [Real.deriv_rpow_const]
  have hderivFun : deriv f = fun t ↦ (-c) * t ^ (-c - 1) := funext hderiv
  have hint : IntegrableOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) M) := by
    rw [hderivFun]
    refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc (fun t ht ↦ ?_)
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    exact (continuousAt_const.mul
      (continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl ht0))).continuousWithinAt
  have habel := sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₀' a ha0 M hdiff hint
  have hpartial (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, a n =
      (finiteSmoothCount R N : ℝ) := by
    symm
    exact finiteSmoothCount_cast_eq_sum_Icc_coefficient R N
  rw [finiteSmoothRpowSum_one_eq_coefficient, habel]
  simp_rw [hpartial, hderiv]
  simp_rw [mul_assoc]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_mertens_mul_moderateSplit
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_mertens_mul_moderateSplit
    (R M : ℕ) :

proof:

        mertensProduct R * finiteSmoothCount R M :=
      finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le R M
    _ ≤ mertensProduct R *
        ((M : ℝ) * hildebrandModerateSplitDensity R M) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandModerateSplit R M)
        (mertensProduct_pos R).le

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothRankinAbelExpression_eq
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothRankinAbelExpression_eq (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :

proof:

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothRankinAbelExpression_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothRankinAbelExpression_nonneg (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_mertens_mul_abel
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_mertens_mul_abel
    (R M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M c ≤
      mertensProduct R *
        ((M : ℝ) ^ (-c) * finiteSmoothCount R M +
          c * ∫ t in Set.Ioc (1 : ℝ) M,
            t ^ (-c - 1) * finiteSmoothCount R ⌊t⌋₊)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M c ≤
        mertensProduct R * finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) R M (-c) :=
      finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_mertens_mul_smoothRankin R M c
    _ = mertensProduct R *
        ((M : ℝ) ^ (-c) * finiteSmoothCount R M +
          c * ∫ t in Set.Ioc (1 : ℝ) M,
            t ^ (-c - 1) * finiteSmoothCount R ⌊t⌋₊) := by
      rw [finiteSmoothRpowSum_one_eq_abel]

proof:

name: RankAmplification.totientRankinWeight_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totientRankinWeight_one (s : ℝ) :
    totientRankinWeight s 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [totientRankinWeight, totientWeight]

name: RankAmplification.totientRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem totientRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime {m n : ℕ}
    (h : Nat.Coprime m n) (s : ℝ) :
    totientRankinWeight s (m * n) =
      totientRankinWeight s m * totientRankinWeight s n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    have hn : n = 1 := by simpa using h
    subst n
    simp [totientRankinWeight, totientWeight]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    have hmOne : m = 1 := by simpa [Nat.coprime_comm] using h
    subst m
    simp [totientRankinWeight, totientWeight]
  have hphiM : (m.totient : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)).ne'
  have hphiN : (n.totient : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)).ne'
  rw [totientRankinWeight, totientRankinWeight, totientRankinWeight,
    totientWeight, totientWeight, totientWeight, Nat.totient_mul h,
    Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul,
    Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.totientWeight_prime_pow_succ
statement:
theorem totientWeight_prime_pow_succ {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (a : ℕ) :
    totientWeight (p ^ (a + 1)) = (p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpSub : p - 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hp.one_lt)
  have hpPow : (p : ℝ) ^ a ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero)
  rw [totientWeight, Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ hp]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [pow_succ, Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
  field_simp [hpPow]

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_totientRankinWeight_prime_pow
statement:
theorem hasSum_totientRankinWeight_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasSum (fun a : ℕ ↦ totientRankinWeight s (p ^ a))
      (totientRankinLocalFactor p s)
proof:
:= by
  let q : ℝ := rankinEulerRatio p s
  have hqpos : 0 < q := rankinEulerRatio_pos hp.pos s
  have hqlt : q < 1 := rankinEulerRatio_lt_one hp.one_lt hs
  have hgeom : HasSum (fun a : ℕ ↦ q ^ a) (1 - q)⁻¹ :=
    hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hqpos.le hqlt
  have htail : HasSum (fun a : ℕ ↦
      ((p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) * q * q ^ a)
      (((p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) * q * (1 - q)⁻¹) :=
    hgeom.mul_left (((p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) * q)
  rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1]
  have hfun : (fun a : ℕ ↦ totientRankinWeight s (p ^ (a + 1))) =
      (fun a : ℕ ↦ ((p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) * q * q ^ a) := by
    funext a
    rw [totientRankinWeight, totientWeight_prime_pow_succ hp, Nat.cast_pow,
      ← Real.rpow_pow_comm (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (-s) (a + 1), pow_succ]
    change ((p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) * (q ^ a * q) =
      ((p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) * q * q ^ a
    ring
  have htarget :
      totientRankinLocalFactor p s -
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 1, totientRankinWeight s (p ^ i) =
        ((p : ℝ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) * q * (1 - q)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, totientRankinWeight_one]
    unfold totientRankinLocalFactor
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  rw [htarget]
  exact htail

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_totientRankinWeight_smooth
statement:
theorem hasSum_totientRankinWeight_smooth (R : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasSum (fun m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ totientRankinWeight s m)
      (smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R s)
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime →
      Summable (fun a : ℕ ↦ ‖totientRankinWeight s (p ^ a)‖) := by
    intro p hp
    have hsum := hasSum_totientRankinWeight_prime_pow hp hs
    apply hsum.summable.norm.congr
    intro a
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (totientRankinWeight_nonneg s _)]
  have heuler := EulerProduct.summable_and_hasSum_smoothNumbers_prod_primesBelow_tsum
    (f := totientRankinWeight s) (totientRankinWeight_one s)
      (fun {_m _n} h ↦ totientRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime h s) hlocal (R + 1)
  have hprod :
      (∏ p ∈ (R + 1).primesBelow,
        ∑' a : ℕ, totientRankinWeight s (p ^ a)) =
        smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R s := by
    rw [smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct]
    change (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
      ∑' a : ℕ, totientRankinWeight s (p ^ a)) =
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, totientRankinLocalFactor p s
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    exact (hasSum_totientRankinWeight_prime_pow
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) hs).tsum_eq
  exact hprod ▸ heuler.2

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct
    {R X : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, totientRankinWeight s m) ≤
      smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R s
proof:
:= by
  let e : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X} ↪ (R + 1).smoothNumbers :=
    { toFun := fun m ↦
        ⟨m.1, isSmooth_iff_mem_smoothNumbers_succ.mp
          (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp m.2).2.2⟩
      inj' := fun a b hab ↦ Subtype.ext <|
        congrArg (fun z : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ (z : ℕ)) hab }
  let A : Finset ((R + 1).smoothNumbers) := Finset.univ.map e
  have hsmooth := hasSum_totientRankinWeight_smooth R hs
  have hle : (∑ m ∈ A, totientRankinWeight s m) ≤
      smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R s := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ A, totientRankinWeight s m) ≤
          ∑' m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers, totientRankinWeight s m :=
        hsmooth.summable.sum_le_tsum A
          (fun m _ ↦ totientRankinWeight_nonneg s m)
      _ = smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R s := hsmooth.tsum_eq
  have hfinite :
      (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, totientRankinWeight s m) =
        ∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, totientRankinWeight s m := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
  have hmap :
      (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, totientRankinWeight s m) =
        ∑ m ∈ A, totientRankinWeight s m := by
    change (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, totientRankinWeight s m) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.map e, totientRankinWeight s m
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m _
    rfl
  rw [hfinite, hmap]
  exact hle

name: RankAmplification.totientRankinLocalFactor_eq
statement:
theorem totientRankinLocalFactor_eq {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    totientRankinLocalFactor p s =
      (1 - rankinEulerRatio p s)⁻¹ *
        (1 + rankinEulerRatio p s / (p - 1 : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  have hpSub : (p : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt))
  have hq : rankinEulerRatio p s ≠ 1 :=
    (rankinEulerRatio_lt_one hp.one_lt hs).ne
  have hpCast : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) - 1 := by
    norm_num [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
  unfold totientRankinLocalFactor
  rw [hpCast]
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_eq
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_eq
    (R : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R s =
      softenedMertensProduct R s * totientRankinCorrectionProduct R s
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct, softenedMertensProduct,
    totientRankinCorrectionProduct, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  exact totientRankinLocalFactor_eq (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) hs

name: RankAmplification.totientRankinCorrectionConstant_pos
statement:
theorem totientRankinCorrectionConstant_pos :
    0 < totientRankinCorrectionConstant
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [totientRankinCorrectionConstant]

name: RankAmplification.rankinEulerRatio_div_pred_le_pseries
statement:
theorem rankinEulerRatio_div_pred_le_pseries
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {δ : ℝ}
    (_hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ) ≤
      2 * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hpReal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hpredPos : (0 : ℝ) < (p - 1 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hp.one_lt
  have hq : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
    unfold rankinEulerRatio
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hpredInv : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    have hhalfPos : 0 < (p : ℝ) / 2 := div_pos hpPos (by norm_num)
    have hhalf : (p : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (p - 1 : ℕ) := by
      have hpPred : (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (p - 1 : ℕ) := by
        have hpPredNat : 1 ≤ p - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hp.one_lt
        have hpBound : p ≤ 2 * (p - 1) := by
          calc
            p = (p - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hp.one_le).symm
            _ ≤ (p - 1) + (p - 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left hpPredNat _
            _ = 2 * (p - 1) := by omega
        exact_mod_cast hpBound
      linarith
    calc
      ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ ((p : ℝ) / 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hhalfPos hhalf
      _ = 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  calc
    rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
        (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) * (2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul hq hpredInv (inv_nonneg.mpr hpredPos.le)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg hpPos.le _)
    _ = 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [show (p : ℝ)⁻¹ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) by
        simpa using (Real.rpow_neg_one (p : ℝ)).symm]
      calc
        (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) * (2 * (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) =
            2 * ((p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ = 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ) + (-1 : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_add hpPos]
        _ = 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ)) := by norm_num

name: RankAmplification.sum_rankinEulerRatio_div_pred_le_correctionConstant
statement:
theorem sum_rankinEulerRatio_div_pred_le_correctionConstant
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
      rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) ≤
        totientRankinCorrectionConstant
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ (-(7 / 4 : ℝ))
  have hsummable : Summable f := by
    exact (summable_naturalPSeries (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 7 / 4)).mul_left 2
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, f p := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      exact rankinEulerRatio_div_pred_le_pseries
        (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) hδ0 hδquarter
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, f n :=
      hsummable.sum_le_tsum _ (fun n _ ↦ by positivity)
    _ = 2 * naturalPSeries (7 / 4) := by
      rw [naturalPSeries, tsum_mul_left]
    _ ≤ 2 * (1 + 1 / ((7 / 4 : ℝ) - 1)) := by
      gcongr
      exact naturalPSeries_le (7 / 4) (by norm_num)
    _ = totientRankinCorrectionConstant := by
      norm_num [totientRankinCorrectionConstant]

name: RankAmplification.totientRankinCorrectionProduct_le_exp
statement:
theorem totientRankinCorrectionProduct_le_exp
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    totientRankinCorrectionProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp totientRankinCorrectionConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [totientRankinCorrectionProduct]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        (1 + rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ))) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
          Real.exp (rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hp
        have hterm : 0 ≤ rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ) := by
          exact div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _)
            (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        linarith
      · intro p _hp
        simpa [add_comm] using
          (Real.add_one_le_exp (rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)))
    _ = Real.exp (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (p - 1 : ℕ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_sum]
    _ ≤ Real.exp totientRankinCorrectionConstant :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        (sum_rankinEulerRatio_div_pred_le_correctionConstant hδ0 hδquarter)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharp
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharp
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp (primeRankinSum R δ + sharpEulerQuadraticConstant +
        totientRankinCorrectionConstant)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := by linarith
  have hsoft : softenedMertensProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp (primeRankinSum R δ + sharpEulerQuadraticConstant) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (softenedMertensProduct_pos R hs)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      (log_softenedMertensProduct_le_primeRankinSum_add_quadraticConstant
        hδquarter)
  rw [smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_eq R hs]
  have hcorrNonneg : 0 ≤ totientRankinCorrectionProduct R (1 - δ) := by
    unfold totientRankinCorrectionProduct
    apply Finset.prod_nonneg
    intro p hp
    have hpPred : 0 ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hq : 0 ≤ rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _
    positivity
  calc
    softenedMertensProduct R (1 - δ) *
          totientRankinCorrectionProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
        Real.exp (primeRankinSum R δ + sharpEulerQuadraticConstant) *
          Real.exp totientRankinCorrectionConstant := by
      exact mul_le_mul hsoft
        (totientRankinCorrectionProduct_le_exp hδ0 hδquarter)
        hcorrNonneg (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp (primeRankinSum R δ + sharpEulerQuadraticConstant +
        totientRankinCorrectionConstant) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_shiftedEulerProduct
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_shiftedEulerProduct
    {R M : ℕ} { δ η : ℝ} (hηδ : η ≤ δ)
    (hηone : η < 1) :
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M (1 - δ) ≤
      (M : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) *
        smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - η)
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : 0 ≤ δ - η := sub_nonneg.mpr hηδ
  have hs : 0 < 1 - η := sub_pos.mpr hηone
  unfold finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R M, totientRankinWeight (1 - δ) m) ≤
        ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R M,
          (M : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) * totientRankinWeight (1 - η) m := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      have hmData := mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm
      have hmPos : 0 < m := hmData.1
      have hmLe : (m : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hmData.2.1
      have hmPow : (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) ≤ (M : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg m) hmLe hshift
      rw [totientRankinWeight, totientRankinWeight]
      have hweight : 0 ≤ totientWeight m := by
        unfold totientWeight
        positivity
      have hmReal : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmPos
      calc
        totientWeight m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) =
            totientWeight m *
              ((m : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - η))) := by
          congr 1
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hmReal]
          congr 1
          ring
        _ = (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) *
              (totientWeight m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - η))) := by ring
        _ ≤ (M : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) *
              (totientWeight m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - η))) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmPow
            (mul_nonneg hweight (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) _))
    _ = (M : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) *
          ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R M, totientRankinWeight (1 - η) m := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (M : ℝ) ^ (δ - η) *
          smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - η) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct hs)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg M) _)

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandSaddleShift_pos_of_large_u
statement:
theorem hildebrandSaddleShift_pos_of_large_u
    {R M : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ rankinU M R) :
    0 < hildebrandSaddleShift M R
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : 1 < R := by omega
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hRone)
  have huOne : 1 < rankinU M R := by
    have hone : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 2) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact Real.exp_pos 2
    exact hone.trans_le hu
  have hlogU : 0 < Real.log (rankinU M R) := Real.log_pos huOne
  have hloglogU : 0 < Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R)) := by
    have : 1 < Real.log (rankinU M R) := by
      have honeExpTwo : 1 < Real.exp 2 := by
        rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
        norm_num
      exact honeExpTwo.trans_le (le_log_of_exp_le hu)
    exact Real.log_pos this
  rw [hildebrandSaddleShift]
  exact div_pos (add_pos hlogU hloglogU) hlogR

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_hildebrandSaddle
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_hildebrandSaddle
    {R M : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hδ : hildebrandSaddleShift M R ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hu : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ rankinU M R) :
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R
        (1 - hildebrandSaddleShift M R) ≤
      Real.exp (rankinU M R + sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder R M +
        totientRankinCorrectionConstant)
proof:
:= by
  let η := hildebrandSaddleShift M R
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by
    exact hildebrandSaddleShift_pos_of_large_u (by omega) hu
  have hηquarter : η ≤ 1 / 4 := hδ
  have hs : 0 < 1 - η := by linarith
  have hlog := log_softenedMertensProduct_le_rankinU_add_sharpRemainder
    hR hδ hu
  have hsoft : softenedMertensProduct R (1 - η) ≤
      Real.exp (rankinU M R + sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder R M) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (softenedMertensProduct_pos R hs)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
  have hcorr := totientRankinCorrectionProduct_le_exp
    (R := R) (δ := η) hηpos.le hηquarter
  have hcorrNonneg : 0 ≤ totientRankinCorrectionProduct R (1 - η) := by
    unfold totientRankinCorrectionProduct
    apply Finset.prod_nonneg
    intro p hp
    have hpPred : 0 ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hq : 0 ≤ rankinEulerRatio p (1 - η) :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _
    positivity
  rw [smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_eq R hs]
  calc
    softenedMertensProduct R (1 - η) *
          totientRankinCorrectionProduct R (1 - η) ≤
        Real.exp (rankinU M R + sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder R M) *
          Real.exp totientRankinCorrectionConstant := by
      exact mul_le_mul hsoft hcorr hcorrNonneg (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp (rankinU M R + sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder R M +
        totientRankinCorrectionConstant) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_sharpAdaptive
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_sharpAdaptive
    {R M : ℕ} { δ : ℝ}
    (hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime R M)
    (hshift : hildebrandSaddleShift M R ≤ δ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp (δ * Real.log M - dickmanSaddlePhase (rankinU M R) +
        sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder R M +
          totientRankinCorrectionConstant)
proof:
:= by
  have hRfour : 4 ≤ R := hsharp.2.1
  have hRone : 1 < R := by omega
  have hηone : hildebrandSaddleShift M R < 1 :=
    hsharp.2.2.1.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hbase := finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_shiftedEulerProduct
    (R := R) (M := M) hshift hηone
  have heuler := smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_hildebrandSaddle
    hsharp.2.1 hsharp.2.2.1 hsharp.2.2.2
  have hpowNonneg : 0 ≤ (M : ℝ) ^
      (δ - hildebrandSaddleShift M R) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg M) _
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heuler hpowNonneg
  refine hbase.trans (hmul.trans_eq ?_)
  have hMreal : 0 < (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsharp.1
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hMreal, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  have hsaddle := hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH
    (R := R) (H := M) hRone
  unfold dickmanSaddlePhase
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_le_loglog_add_two
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_le_loglog_add_two
    {R δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hphase : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    rankinLogIntegral δ R ≤
      Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 2
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R :=
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le hR
  have hRpos : 0 < R := zero_lt_one.trans hRone
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hleft := intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := δ) (by norm_num) hR
  have hinv : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹) volume 2 R := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (fun t ht ↦ ?_)
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR] at ht
    apply (continuousAt_id.inv₀ ?_).continuousWithinAt
    simpa only [id_eq] using
      (ne_of_gt ((by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le ht.1))
  have hlogKernel : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ / Real.log t)
      volume 2 R := by
    simpa only [zero_sub, Real.rpow_neg_one] using
      (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := 0) (by norm_num) hR)
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ / Real.log t + 2 * δ * t⁻¹) volume 2 R :=
    hlogKernel.add (hinv.const_mul (2 * δ))
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  calc
    (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, t⁻¹ / Real.log t + 2 * δ * t⁻¹ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hR hleft hright
      intro t ht
      have htone : 1 < t :=
        (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le ht.1
      have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
      have hlogt : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos htone
      have hlogle : Real.log t ≤ Real.log R :=
        Real.log_le_log htpos ht.2
      have hz0 : 0 ≤ δ * Real.log t := mul_nonneg hδ0 hlogt.le
      have hz1 : δ * Real.log t ≤ 1 :=
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogle hδ0).trans hphase
      have hzabs : |δ * Real.log t| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hz0]
        exact hz1
      have hexp : Real.exp (δ * Real.log t) ≤ 1 + 2 * (δ * Real.log t) := by
        have h := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_le hzabs
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.exp (δ * Real.log t) - 1 :=
          sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.one_le_exp hz0)
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg, abs_of_nonneg hz0] at h
        linarith
      have hrpow : t ^ δ ≤ 1 + 2 * (δ * Real.log t) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos htpos]
        simpa only [mul_comm] using hexp
      have hscale : 0 ≤ t⁻¹ / Real.log t :=
        div_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr htpos.le) hlogt.le
      calc
        t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t =
            t ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub_one htpos.ne']
          field_simp
        _ ≤ (1 + 2 * (δ * Real.log t)) *
            (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrpow hscale
        _ = t⁻¹ / Real.log t + 2 * δ * t⁻¹ := by
          field_simp [hlogt.ne']
    _ = (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          2 * δ * Real.log (R / 2) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hlogKernel (hinv.const_mul (2 * δ)),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_inv_div_log (by norm_num) hRone,
        integral_inv_of_pos (by norm_num) hRpos]
    _ ≤ Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 2 := by
      have hlogDiv : Real.log (R / 2) ≤ Real.log R := by
        have hdivPos : 0 < R / 2 := div_pos hRpos (by norm_num)
        apply Real.log_le_log hdivPos
        linarith
      have herror : 2 * δ * Real.log (R / 2) ≤ 2 := by
        calc
          2 * δ * Real.log (R / 2) ≤ 2 * δ * Real.log R := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogDiv (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hδ0)
          _ ≤ 2 := by linarith
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.exp_le_one_add_exp_four_mul
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_exp_four_mul
    {z : ℝ} (hz0 : 0 ≤ z) (hz4 : z ≤ 4) :
    Real.exp z ≤ 1 + Real.exp 4 * z
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : IntervalIntegrable Real.exp volume 0 z :=
    Real.continuous_exp.intervalIntegrable 0 z
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Real.exp 4) volume 0 z :=
    continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 z
  have hint : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..z, Real.exp t) ≤
      ∫ _t in (0 : ℝ)..z, Real.exp 4 := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hz0 hleft hright
    intro t ht
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (ht.2.trans hz4)
  rw [integral_exp] at hint
  simp only [Real.exp_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero] at hint
  change Real.exp z - 1 ≤ z * Real.exp 4 at hint
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_le_loglog_add_fourExp
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_le_loglog_add_fourExp
    {R δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hphase : δ * Real.log R ≤ 4) :
    rankinLogIntegral δ R ≤
      Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 4 * Real.exp 4
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R :=
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le hR
  have hRpos : 0 < R := zero_lt_one.trans hRone
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hleft := intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := δ) (by norm_num) hR
  have hinv : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹) volume 2 R := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (fun t ht ↦ ?_)
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR] at ht
    apply (continuousAt_id.inv₀ ?_).continuousWithinAt
    simpa only [id_eq] using
      (ne_of_gt ((by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le ht.1))
  have hlogKernel : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ / Real.log t)
      volume 2 R := by
    simpa only [zero_sub, Real.rpow_neg_one] using
      (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := 0) (by norm_num) hR)
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ / Real.log t + Real.exp 4 * δ * t⁻¹) volume 2 R :=
    hlogKernel.add (hinv.const_mul (Real.exp 4 * δ))
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  calc
    (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          t⁻¹ / Real.log t + Real.exp 4 * δ * t⁻¹ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hR hleft hright
      intro t ht
      have htone : 1 < t :=
        (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le ht.1
      have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
      have hlogt : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos htone
      have hlogle : Real.log t ≤ Real.log R :=
        Real.log_le_log htpos ht.2
      have hz0 : 0 ≤ δ * Real.log t := mul_nonneg hδ0 hlogt.le
      have hz4 : δ * Real.log t ≤ 4 :=
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogle hδ0).trans hphase
      have hexp : Real.exp (δ * Real.log t) ≤
          1 + Real.exp 4 * (δ * Real.log t) :=
        exp_le_one_add_exp_four_mul hz0 hz4
      have hrpow : t ^ δ ≤ 1 + Real.exp 4 * (δ * Real.log t) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos htpos]
        simpa only [mul_comm] using hexp
      have hscale : 0 ≤ t⁻¹ / Real.log t :=
        div_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr htpos.le) hlogt.le
      calc
        t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t =
            t ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub_one htpos.ne']
          field_simp
        _ ≤ (1 + Real.exp 4 * (δ * Real.log t)) *
            (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrpow hscale
        _ = t⁻¹ / Real.log t + Real.exp 4 * δ * t⁻¹ := by
          field_simp [hlogt.ne']
    _ = (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          Real.exp 4 * δ * Real.log (R / 2) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hlogKernel
          (hinv.const_mul (Real.exp 4 * δ)),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_inv_div_log (by norm_num) hRone,
        integral_inv_of_pos (by norm_num) hRpos]
    _ ≤ Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
          4 * Real.exp 4 := by
      have hlogDiv : Real.log (R / 2) ≤ Real.log R := by
        have hdivPos : 0 < R / 2 := div_pos hRpos (by norm_num)
        apply Real.log_le_log hdivPos
        linarith
      have herror : Real.exp 4 * δ * Real.log (R / 2) ≤
          4 * Real.exp 4 := by
        have hfirst : δ * Real.log (R / 2) ≤ 4 :=
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogDiv hδ0).trans hphase
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 4]
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_segment_le_endpoint_mul_loglog
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_segment_le_endpoint_mul_loglog
    {A B δ : ℝ} (hA : 1 < A) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
      B ^ δ * (Real.log (Real.log B) - Real.log (Real.log A))
proof:
:= by
  have hB : 1 < B := hA.trans_le hAB
  have hApos : 0 < A := zero_lt_one.trans hA
  have hleft := intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := δ) hA hAB
  have hlogKernel : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ / Real.log t)
      volume A B := by
    simpa only [zero_sub, Real.rpow_neg_one] using
      (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := 0) hA hAB)
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦
      B ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t)) volume A B :=
    hlogKernel.const_mul _
  calc
    (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        ∫ t in A..B, B ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hAB hleft hright
      intro t ht
      have htone : 1 < t := hA.trans_le ht.1
      have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
      have hlogt : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos htone
      have hpow : t ^ δ ≤ B ^ δ :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow htpos.le ht.2 hδ0
      have hscale : 0 ≤ t⁻¹ / Real.log t :=
        div_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr htpos.le) hlogt.le
      calc
        t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t =
            t ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub_one htpos.ne']
          field_simp
        _ ≤ B ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hscale
    _ = B ^ δ * (Real.log (Real.log B) - Real.log (Real.log A)) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_inv_div_log hA hB]

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_le_sharp_phase_split
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_le_sharp_phase_split
    {R δ : ℝ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbasePhase : δ * Real.log 2 ≤ 1)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log R) :
    rankinLogIntegral δ R ≤
      (Real.log (1 / δ) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 2) +
        (Real.sqrt R) ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt R)) - Real.log (1 / δ)) +
        R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ := Real.exp (1 / δ)
  let S : ℝ := Real.sqrt R
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hRone : 1 < R := by linarith
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hrecip : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 / δ := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hbasePhase)
  have hA2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ A := by
    dsimp [A]
    rw [← Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hrecip
  have hAone : 1 < A := (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le hA2
  have hS2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ S := by
    dsimp [S]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hRpos.le, Real.sqrt_nonneg R]
  have hSone : 1 < S := (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le hS2
  have hlogS : Real.log S = Real.log R / 2 := by
    dsimp [S]
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hRpos.le]
  have hAS : A ≤ S := by
    have hrecipHalf : 1 / δ ≤ Real.log R / 2 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hδ).2
      nlinarith
    change Real.exp (1 / δ) ≤ Real.sqrt R
    rw [← Real.exp_log (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hRpos), Real.log_sqrt hRpos.le]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hrecipHalf
  have hSR : S ≤ R := by
    dsimp [S]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_self_iff.mpr (Or.inr (by linarith))
  have hlogA : Real.log A = 1 / δ := by simp [A]
  have hphaseA : δ * Real.log A ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hlogA]
    rw [one_div, mul_inv_cancel₀ hδ.ne']
  have hlow := rankinLogIntegral_le_loglog_add_two hA2 hδ.le hphaseA
  have hmiddle := rankinLogIntegral_segment_le_endpoint_mul_loglog
    hAone hAS hδ.le
  let q : ℝ := δ * Real.log R / 2
  have hq : 1 < q := by
    dsimp [q]
    linarith
  have hqS : q ≤ δ * Real.log S := by
    rw [hlogS]
    dsimp [q]
    ring_nf
    exact le_rfl
  have htail := rankinLogIntegral_tail_le_parameter hδ hSone hSR hq hqS
  have htail' : (∫ t in S..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
      R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2) := by
    apply htail.trans_eq
    dsimp [q]
    have hden : 0 < δ * Real.log R - 2 := by linarith
    field_simp [hδ.ne', hlogR.ne', hden.ne']
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  calc
    (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) =
        (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..A, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) +
          (∫ t in A..S, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) +
            ∫ t in S..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
          (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (by norm_num) hA2)
          (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel hAone hAS),
        intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
          (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (by norm_num) hS2)
          (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel hSone hSR)]
    _ ≤ (Real.log (Real.log A) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 2) +
          S ^ δ * (Real.log (Real.log S) - Real.log (Real.log A)) +
            R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2) :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add hlow hmiddle) htail'
    _ = (Real.log (1 / δ) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 2) +
        (Real.sqrt R) ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt R)) - Real.log (1 / δ)) +
        R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2) := by
      simp only [S, hlogA]

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant_pos
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant_pos :
    0 < fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hM : 0 < sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have hlogTwoLtOne : Real.log 2 < 1 :=
    Real.log_two_lt_d9.trans (by norm_num)
  have hnegLogLogTwo : 0 < -Real.log (Real.log 2) :=
    neg_pos.mpr (Real.log_neg hlogTwo hlogTwoLtOne)
  have hinside : 0 < 2 / Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2 := by
    positivity
  nlinarith [mul_pos hM hinside, sharpEulerQuadraticConstant_pos,
    totientRankinCorrectionConstant_pos]

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_lowPhase
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_lowPhase
    {R : ℕ} { δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ0 : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hphase : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant * Real.log R
proof:
:= by
  have hδone : δ ≤ 1 := hδquarter.trans (by norm_num)
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega)
  have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) < R := zero_lt_one.trans hRone
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hRone
  have htwoPow : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hδone
  have hRPowExp : (R : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hRpos]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hphase)
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoLe : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log R :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  have hendpoint : 2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) ≤
      2 * Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2 := by
    have hcross : (R : ℝ) ^ δ * Real.log 2 ≤
        Real.exp 1 * Real.log R :=
      mul_le_mul hRPowExp hlogTwoLe hlogTwo.le (Real.exp_pos 1).le
    have hdiv : (R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R ≤
        Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2 :=
      (div_le_div_iff₀ hlogR hlogTwo).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hcross)
    calc
      2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) ≤
          2 * (Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by norm_num)
      _ = 2 * Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2 := by ring
  have hprime := primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens hR hδ0
  have hintegral := rankinLogIntegral_le_loglog_add_two
    (R := (R : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast hR) hδ0.le hphase
  have hMnonneg : 0 ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have hlocalEndpoints :
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
          2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) ≤
        2 / Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2 :=
    add_le_add (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right htwoPow hlogTwo.le) hendpoint
  have hprimeBound : primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
        (2 + 2 + (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          (2 / Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2)) := by
    calc
      primeRankinSum R δ ≤
          (2 : ℝ) ^ δ + rankinLogIntegral δ R +
            (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
                2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R)) := hprime
      _ ≤ 2 +
          (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 2) +
            (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
              (2 / Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2) := by
        exact add_le_add (add_le_add htwoPow hintegral)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlocalEndpoints hMnonneg)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have heuler := smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharp
    (R := R) hδ0.le hδquarter
  calc
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
        Real.exp (primeRankinSum R δ + sharpEulerQuadraticConstant +
          totientRankinCorrectionConstant) := heuler
    _ ≤ Real.exp
        (Real.log (Real.log R) + fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      rw [fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant]
      linarith
    _ = Real.exp fixedBFPSLowPhaseEulerConstant * Real.log R := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hlogR]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_moderateEnvelope
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_moderateEnvelope
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ0 : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hphase : δ * Real.log R ≤ 4) :
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedBFPSModerateEulerExponent R δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hprime := primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens (R := R) hR hδ0
  have hintegral := rankinLogIntegral_le_loglog_add_fourExp
    (δ := δ) (R := (R : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast hR) hδ0.le hphase
  have hprime' : primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ +
        (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 4 * Real.exp 4) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
            2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R)) := by
    linarith
  exact (smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharp hδ0.le hδquarter).trans
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr <| by
      unfold fixedBFPSModerateEulerExponent
      linarith)

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant_pos
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant_pos :
    0 < fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoLt : Real.log 2 < 1 :=
    Real.log_two_lt_d9.trans (by norm_num)
  have hneg : 0 < -Real.log (Real.log 2) :=
    neg_pos.mpr (Real.log_neg hlogTwo hlogTwoLt)
  have hM : 0 < sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have hbase : 0 < (2 : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := div_pos (by norm_num) hlogTwo
  have hend : 0 < 2 * Real.exp 4 / Real.log 2 :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos 4)) hlogTwo
  have hprod : 0 < (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
      (2 / Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.exp 4 / Real.log 2) :=
    mul_pos hM (add_pos hbase hend)
  unfold fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 4, sharpEulerQuadraticConstant_pos,
    totientRankinCorrectionConstant_pos, hprod]

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_moderateLog
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_moderateLog
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hphase : δ * Real.log R ≤ 4) :
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log R
proof:
:= by
  have hδone : δ ≤ 1 := hδquarter.trans (by norm_num)
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega)
  have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) < R := zero_lt_one.trans hRone
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoLe : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log R :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  have htwoPow : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hδone
  have hRPow : (R : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hRpos]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hphase)
  have hendpoint : 2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) ≤
      2 * Real.exp 4 / Real.log 2 := by
    have hcross : (R : ℝ) ^ δ * Real.log 2 ≤
        Real.exp 4 * Real.log R :=
      mul_le_mul hRPow hlogTwoLe hlogTwo.le (Real.exp_pos 4).le
    have hdiv : (R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R ≤
        Real.exp 4 / Real.log 2 :=
      (div_le_div_iff₀ hlogR hlogTwo).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hcross)
    calc
      2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) ≤
          2 * (Real.exp 4 / Real.log 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by norm_num)
      _ = 2 * Real.exp 4 / Real.log 2 := by ring
  have hbase : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 ≤ 2 / Real.log 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right htwoPow hlogTwo.le
  have hexponent : fixedBFPSModerateEulerExponent R δ ≤
      Real.log (Real.log R) + fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant := by
    unfold fixedBFPSModerateEulerExponent fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant
    have hM : 0 ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
      linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
    have hsum := add_le_add hbase hendpoint
    have hMsum := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hM
    linarith
  exact (smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_moderateEnvelope
      hR hδ hδquarter hphase).trans <| by
    calc
      Real.exp (fixedBFPSModerateEulerExponent R δ) ≤
          Real.exp (Real.log (Real.log R) + fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent
      _ = Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log R := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hlogR]
        ring

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharpPhaseSplit
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharpPhaseSplit
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hbasePhase : δ * Real.log 2 ≤ 1)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log R) :
    smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hprime := primeRankinSum_le_sharpMertens (R := R) (by omega) hδ
  have hintegral := rankinLogIntegral_le_sharp_phase_split
    (R := (R : ℝ)) (δ := δ) (by exact_mod_cast hR) hδ hbasePhase hphase
  have hprime' : primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ +
        (Real.log (1 / δ) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + 2) +
        (Real.sqrt R) ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt R)) - Real.log (1 / δ)) +
        (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R - 2) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
            2 * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R)) := by
    linarith
  exact (smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharp hδ.le hδquarter).trans
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr <| by
      unfold fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent
      linarith)

name: RankAmplification.exp_div_sub_two_mono
statement:
theorem exp_div_sub_two_mono
    {z P : ℝ} (hz : 3 ≤ z) (hzP : z ≤ P) :
    Real.exp z / (z - 2) ≤ Real.exp P / (P - 2)
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℝ := P - z
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := sub_nonneg.mpr hzP
  have hzden : 0 < z - 2 := by linarith
  have hPden : 0 < P - 2 := by linarith
  have hexpLinear : 1 + d ≤ Real.exp d := by
    simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp d
  have hlinear : P - 2 ≤ Real.exp d * (z - 2) := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexpLinear hzden.le
    dsimp [d] at hd hmul ⊢
    nlinarith
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hzden hPden).2
  have hexpP : Real.exp P = Real.exp z * Real.exp d := by
    rw [show P = z + d by dsimp [d]; ring, Real.exp_add]
  rw [hexpP]
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlinear (Real.exp_pos z).le)

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global
    {Y H : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hH : 4 ≤ H) (hHY : H ≤ Y)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log H) :
    fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent H δ ≤
      fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent Y δ
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℝ := δ * Real.log H
  let P : ℝ := δ * Real.log Y
  have hHone : (1 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < H by omega)
  have hYone : (1 : ℝ) < Y := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < Y by omega)
  have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < H := zero_lt_one.trans hHone
  have hYpos : (0 : ℝ) < Y := zero_lt_one.trans hYone
  have hlogH : 0 < Real.log H := Real.log_pos hHone
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log Y := Real.log_pos hYone
  have hlogHY : Real.log H ≤ Real.log Y :=
    Real.log_le_log hHpos (by exact_mod_cast hHY)
  have hzP : z ≤ P := by
    dsimp [z, P]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogHY hδ.le
  have hzFour : 4 ≤ z := hphase
  have hδone : δ ≤ 1 := hδquarter.trans (by norm_num)
  have htwoPow : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hδone
  have hlogInv : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / δ) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    exact (one_le_div₀ hδ).2 hδone
  have hsqrtLog : Real.log (Real.sqrt H) = Real.log H / 2 := by
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hHpos.le]
  have hsqrtPow : (Real.sqrt H) ^ δ = Real.exp (z / 2) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hHpos), hsqrtLog]
    dsimp [z]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hsqrtPowLe : (Real.sqrt H) ^ δ ≤ Real.exp (P / 2) := by
    rw [hsqrtPow]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hzP (by norm_num))
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by linarith
  have hPpos : 0 < P := hzpos.trans_le hzP
  have hbracketEq :
      Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt H)) - Real.log (1 / δ) =
        Real.log (z / 2) := by
    rw [hsqrtLog, ← Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    dsimp [z]
    field_simp [hδ.ne']
  have hlogPhase : Real.log (z / 2) ≤ Real.log (P / 2) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log (div_pos hzpos (by norm_num))
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hzP (by norm_num))
  have hlogPhaseNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (z / 2) := by
    exact Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hmiddle : (Real.sqrt H) ^ δ *
        (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt H)) - Real.log (1 / δ)) ≤
      Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2) := by
    rw [hsqrtPow, hbracketEq]
    exact mul_le_mul
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hzP (by norm_num)))
      hlogPhase hlogPhaseNonneg
      (Real.exp_pos (P / 2)).le
  have hHpow : (H : ℝ) ^ δ = Real.exp z := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hHpos]
    congr 1
    dsimp [z]
    ring
  have htail : (H : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log H - 2) ≤
      Real.exp P / (P - 2) := by
    rw [hHpow]
    exact exp_div_sub_two_mono (by linarith) hzP
  have hbaseEndpoint : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 ≤ 2 / Real.log 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right htwoPow
      (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)).le
  have hHEndpoint : 2 * ((H : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log H) ≤
      δ * Real.exp P / 2 := by
    rw [hHpow]
    have hrewrite : Real.log H = z / δ := by
      dsimp [z]
      field_simp [hδ.ne']
    rw [hrewrite]
    have hexpLe : Real.exp z ≤ Real.exp P := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hzP
    have hratio : 2 * (Real.exp z / (z / δ)) =
        δ * (2 * Real.exp z / z) := by field_simp [hδ.ne', hzpos.ne']
    rw [hratio]
    have htwoDiv : 2 * Real.exp z / z ≤ Real.exp P / 2 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hzpos).2
      nlinarith [Real.exp_pos P]
    calc
      δ * (2 * Real.exp z / z) ≤ δ * (Real.exp P / 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htwoDiv hδ.le
      _ = δ * Real.exp P / 2 := by ring
  have hM : 0 ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  unfold fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent
  dsimp only [P]
  have hends := add_le_add hbaseEndpoint hHEndpoint
  have hMends := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hends hM
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_nonneg

theorem bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_nonneg
    (X Y lo : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finite

theorem bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finite

      finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum Y (X / (lo + 1)) c

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_eulerProduct
statement:

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_nonneg
