name: RankAmplification.predecessor_rpow_le_lo_mul_multiplier_rpow
statement:
theorem predecessor_rpow_le_lo_mul_multiplier_rpow
    {X lo hi p : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤
      (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (predecessorShellMultiplier p : ℝ) ^ (-c)
proof:
:= by
  have hmPos := predecessorShellMultiplier_pos hlo hp
  have hqPos := (predecessorShellPrime_prime hlo hp).pos
  have hfactor := predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one hlo hp
  have hmq : predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p ≤ p := by
    omega
  have hmqReal :
      (predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p : ℕ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hmq
  have hpMq : (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤
      (predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p : ℕ) ^ (-c) := by
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hmqReal (by linarith)
  have hqLo : (lo : ℝ) ≤ predecessorShellPrime p := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt
      (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.2)
  have hqPow : (predecessorShellPrime p : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤ (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hqLo (by linarith)
  calc
    (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤
        (predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p : ℕ) ^ (-c) := hpMq
    _ = (predecessorShellMultiplier p : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
          (predecessorShellPrime p : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_mul, Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    _ ≤ (predecessorShellMultiplier p : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqPow (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
    _ = (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
          (predecessorShellMultiplier p : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellPair_injectiveOn
statement:
theorem predecessorShellPair_injectiveOn
    {X lo hi : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) :
    Set.InjOn
      (fun p ↦ (⟨predecessorShellMultiplier p,
        predecessorShellPrime p⟩ : Σ _m : ℕ, ℕ))
      (smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq heq
  have hpMem : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi := by simpa using hp
  have hqMem : q ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi := by simpa using hq
  have hm : predecessorShellMultiplier p = predecessorShellMultiplier q :=
    congrArg Sigma.fst heq
  have hprime : predecessorShellPrime p = predecessorShellPrime q :=
    congrArg (fun z : Σ _m : ℕ, ℕ ↦ z.2) heq
  calc
    p = predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p + 1 :=
      predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one hlo hpMem
    _ = predecessorShellMultiplier q * predecessorShellPrime q + 1 := by rw [hm, hprime]
    _ = q := (predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one hlo hqMem).symm

name: RankAmplification.image_predecessorShellPair_subset_pairSet
statement:
theorem image_predecessorShellPair_subset_pairSet
    {X lo hi : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) :
    (smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).image
        (fun p ↦ (⟨predecessorShellMultiplier p,
          predecessorShellPrime p⟩ : Σ _m : ℕ, ℕ)) ⊆
      bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet X lo hi
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  apply mem_bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet.mpr
  constructor
  · exact mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet.mpr
      ⟨predecessorShellMultiplier_pos hlo hp,
        predecessorShellMultiplier_le hlo hp,
        predecessorShellMultiplier_smooth hlo hp⟩
  · exact mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mpr
      ⟨(mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.2,
        predecessorShellPrime_le hlo hp,
        predecessorShellPrime_prime hlo hp,
        (predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one hlo hp) ▸
          (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).1⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_pairSum
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_pairSum
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X lo hi c ≤
      ∑ z ∈ bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet X lo hi,
        (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (z.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let encode : ℕ → (Σ _m : ℕ, ℕ) := fun p ↦
    ⟨predecessorShellMultiplier p, predecessorShellPrime p⟩
  let S := smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi
  have hinj : Set.InjOn encode (S : Set ℕ) := by
    exact predecessorShellPair_injectiveOn hlo
  calc
    smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X lo hi c =
        ∑ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ S, (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (encode p).1 ^ (-c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      exact predecessor_rpow_le_lo_mul_multiplier_rpow hlo hp hc
    _ = ∑ z ∈ S.image encode, (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (z.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image]
      intro p hp q hq hpq
      exact hinj hp hq hpq
    _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet X lo hi,
        (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (z.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (image_predecessorShellPair_subset_pairSet hlo)
      intro z _ _
      positivity

name: RankAmplification.pairSum_eq_sum_card_affine
statement:
theorem pairSum_eq_sum_card_affine
    (X lo hi : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ z ∈ bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet X lo hi,
        (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (z.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)) =
      ∑ m ∈ bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo,
        ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet, Finset.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.weighted_affine_sum_small_multiplier_le_one
statement:
theorem weighted_affine_sum_small_multiplier_le_one
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (∑ m ∈ (bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo).filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m),
        ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsubset :
      (bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo).filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m) ⊆
        ({1} : Finset ℕ) := by
    intro m hm
    have hdata := Finset.mem_filter.mp hm
    have hmOne : m = 1 := by
      have hmPos := (mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet.mp hdata.1).1
      omega
    simp [hmOne]
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ (bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo).filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m),
        ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card) ≤
        ∑ m ∈ ({1} : Finset ℕ),
          ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
            (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro m _ _
      positivity
    _ = (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (bfpsAffinePrimeSet 1 lo hi).card := by simp
    _ ≤ 1 := by
      have hpow : (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by exact_mod_cast hlo) (by linarith)
      have hcard : ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet 1 lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one_le lo hi
      nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg lo) (-c)]

name: RankAmplification.weighted_affine_sum_small_multiplier_eq_zero
statement:
theorem weighted_affine_sum_small_multiplier_eq_zero
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hlo : 2 ≤ lo) :
    (∑ m ∈ (bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo).filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m),
        ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro m hm
  have hmData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hm
  have hmOne : m = 1 := by
    have hmPos := (mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet.mp hmData.1).1
    omega
  subst m
  have hset : bfpsAffinePrimeSet 1 lo hi = ∅ := by
    ext q
    constructor
    · intro hq
      have hqTwo := eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one hq
      have hqLo := (mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mp hq).1
      subst q
      omega
    · simp
  simp [hset]

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_weighted
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_weighted
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {c C : ℝ}
    (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hlohi : lo < hi) (hhi : 3 ≤ hi)
    (hc : 0 < c) (_hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X lo hi c ≤
      1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
        bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpair := smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_pairSum
    (X := X) (lo := lo) (hi := hi) hlo hc.le
  rw [pairSum_eq_sum_card_affine] at hpair
  let S := bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun m ↦
    ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
      (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card
  have hpartition := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m) f
  have hlarge :
      (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m), f m) ≤
        C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
          bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo c := by
    rw [bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum]
    change (∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo, f m) ≤ _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro m hm
    have hmData := mem_bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet.mp hm
    have hsieveM := hsieve m lo hi hmData.1 hlohi hhi
    dsimp [f]
    rw [totientRankinWeight, totientWeight]
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by positivity
    calc
      ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card ≤
        ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsieveM hfactor
      _ = C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
          (((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) := by ring
  have hsmall := weighted_affine_sum_small_multiplier_le_one
    (X := X) (lo := lo) (hi := hi) hlo hc.le
  change (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m), f m) ≤ 1 at hsmall
  calc
    smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X lo hi c ≤ ∑ m ∈ S, f m := hpair
    _ = (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m), f m) +
        ∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m), f m := hpartition.symm
    _ ≤ C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
          bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo c + 1 :=
      add_le_add hlarge hsmall
    _ = 1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
        bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo c := by ring

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_weighted_of_two_le
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_weighted_of_two_le
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {c C : ℝ}
    (hlo : 2 ≤ lo) (hlohi : lo < hi) (hhi : 3 ≤ hi)
    (hc : 0 < c) (_hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X lo hi c ≤
      C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
        bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpair := smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_pairSum
    (X := X) (lo := lo) (hi := hi) (by omega) hc.le
  rw [pairSum_eq_sum_card_affine] at hpair
  let S := bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun m ↦
    ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
      (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card
  have hpartition := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m) f
  have hlarge :
      (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m), f m) ≤
        C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
          bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo c := by
    rw [bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum]
    change (∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo, f m) ≤ _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro m hm
    have hmData := mem_bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet.mp hm
    have hsieveM := hsieve m lo hi hmData.1 hlohi hhi
    dsimp [f]
    rw [totientRankinWeight, totientWeight]
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by positivity
    calc
      ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card ≤
        ((lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) *
          (C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsieveM hfactor
      _ = C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
          (((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c)) := by ring
  have hsmall := weighted_affine_sum_small_multiplier_eq_zero
    (X := X) (hi := hi) (c := c) hlo
  change (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m), f m) = 0 at hsmall
  calc
    smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X lo hi c ≤ ∑ m ∈ S, f m := hpair
    _ = (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m), f m) +
        ∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m), f m := hpartition.symm
    _ = ∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m), f m := by rw [hsmall, add_zero]
    _ ≤ C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * (lo : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
        bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo c := hlarge

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_finiteTotientRankinSum
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_finiteTotientRankinSum
    {X R : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X R c ≤
      finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R X c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X R
  let imagePred : Finset ℕ := S.image (fun p ↦ p - 1)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun p : ℕ ↦ p - 1) (S : Set ℕ) := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq
    have hpPrime := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime (by simpa [S] using hp)
    have hqPrime := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime (by simpa [S] using hq)
    calc
      p = (p - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hpPrime.one_le).symm
      _ = (q - 1) + 1 := congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ n + 1) hpq
      _ = q := Nat.sub_add_cancel hqPrime.one_le
  have himage : imagePred ⊆ finiteSmoothSet R X := by
    intro m hm
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hm with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hdata := mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hp
    exact mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr
      ⟨Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hdata.1.one_lt,
        (Nat.sub_le p 1).trans hdata.2.1,
        hdata.2.2⟩
  calc
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X R c =
        ∑ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ S, ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpPrime := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime hp
      have hcast : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le p 1
      have hsubPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hpPrime.one_lt
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos
        hsubPos hcast (by linarith)
    _ = ∑ m ∈ imagePred, (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image]
      intro p hp q hq hpq
      exact hinj hp hq hpq
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg himage
      intro m _ _
      positivity
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, totientRankinWeight c m := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      have hmPos := (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm).1
      have hweight : (1 : ℝ) ≤ totientWeight m := by
        simpa only [totientWeight] using
          RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.one_le_bfpsTotientRatio hmPos
      rw [totientRankinWeight]
      have hrpow : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) := Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) _
      calc
        (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) = 1 * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by ring
        _ ≤ totientWeight m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-c) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweight hrpow
    _ = finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R X c := rfl

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_totientEuler
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_totientEuler
    {X R : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X R c ≤
      smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R c
proof:
:= by
  exact (smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_finiteTotientRankinSum
    (X := X) (R := R) hc).trans <| by
      unfold finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum
      exact finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct hc

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_eq_terminal_add_shells
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_eq_terminal_add_shells
    (X Y base K : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hK : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c =
      smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) c +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
          smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X
            (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1))
            (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) c
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero => simp
  | succ K ih =>
      have hKprev : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K :=
        one_le_bfpsGeometricEndpoint_of_le (Nat.le_succ K) hK
      have hsubset :
          smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1)) ⊆
            smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) :=
        smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_subset_of_le
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (Nat.le_succ K))
      have hstep :
          smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) c =
            smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1)) c +
              smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1))
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) c := by
        unfold smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum
        rw [← smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_sdiff_eq_shell hK]
        calc
          ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K),
              (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) =
              (∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) \
                  smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1)),
                    (p : ℝ) ^ (-c)) +
                ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X
                    (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1)), (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) :=
              (Finset.sum_sdiff hsubset).symm
          _ = (∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X
                    (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1)), (p : ℝ) ^ (-c)) +
                ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) \
                  smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (K + 1)),
                    (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) := add_comm _ _
      rw [ih hKprev, hstep, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricSharpAdaptiveMajorantSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricSharpAdaptiveMajorantSum_nonneg
    (X Y base K : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGeometricSharpAdaptiveMajorantSum X Y base K δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGeometricSharpAdaptiveMajorantSum
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  dsimp
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg _)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))
    (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum_nonneg
    (X Y base K : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum X Y base K c
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg _)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))
    (finiteSmoothTotientRankinAbelExpression_nonneg _ _ _)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum_le_sharpAdaptive
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum_le_sharpAdaptive
    {X Y base K : ℕ} { δ : ℝ}
    (hsharp : ∀ i, i < K →
      SharpHildebrandRegime
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
        (X / (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) + 1)))
    (hshift : ∀ i, i < K →
      hildebrandSaddleShift
          (X / (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) + 1))
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) ≤ δ) :
    bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum X Y base K (1 - δ) ≤
      bfpsGeometricSharpAdaptiveMajorantSum X Y base K δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum
  unfold bfpsGeometricSharpAdaptiveMajorantSum

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_geometricRankinMajorant
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_geometricRankinMajorant
    {X Y base K : ℕ} {c C : ℝ}

    (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c ≤
      smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) c +
        K + C * bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum X Y base K c
proof:
:= by
  have hterminal : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K := by omega
  rw [smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_eq_terminal_add_shells X Y base K c hterminal]
  have hterminalBound := smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_totientEuler
    (X := X) (R := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) hc
  calc
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) c +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
            smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum X
              (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1))
              (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) c ≤
        smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) c +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
            (1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
              (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) : ℝ) ^ (-c) *
                smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct
                  (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) c) := by
      apply add_le_add hterminalBound
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hiK := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      have hlo : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) :=
        one_le_bfpsGeometricEndpoint_of_le (by omega) hterminal
      have hlohi : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) <
          bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
        bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ_lt hbase (by omega) hterminal
      have hhi : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
        hK.trans (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega))
      exact (smoothPredecessorPrimeShellRpowSum_le_weighted
        hlo hlohi hhi hc hC hsieve).trans <| by
          apply add_le_add le_rfl
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (bfpsRankinWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_eulerProduct hc)
            (mul_nonneg
              (mul_nonneg hC (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg _))
              (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))
    _ = smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) c +
        K + C * bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum X Y base K c := by
      rw [bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp [Finset.mul_sum]
      ring_nf

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds {Y : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y) ∧
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y) ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  let n := Y / 3
  let K := Nat.log 2 n
  let d := 2 ^ K
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.div_pos hY (by norm_num)
  have hdPos : 0 < d := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hdLeN : d ≤ n := by
    exact Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hn.ne'
  have hthreeD : 3 * d ≤ Y := by
    have := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by norm_num : 0 < 3)).mp hdLeN
    simpa [mul_comm] using this
  have hlow : 3 ≤ Y / d := by
    exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hdPos).2 hthreeD
  have hnUpper : n < 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
    exact Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) n
  have hYlt : Y < 6 * d := by
    have hdiv : Y < 3 * (n + 1) := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using
        (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by norm_num : 0 < 3)).mp (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
    have hnSucc : n + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (K + 1) := hnUpper
    calc
      Y < 3 * (n + 1) := hdiv
      _ ≤ 3 * 2 ^ (K + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hnSucc
      _ = 6 * d := by simp [d, K, pow_succ]; ring
  have hupp : Y / d < 6 :=
    (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hdPos).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hYlt)
  change 3 ≤ Y / 2 ^ Nat.log 2 (Y / 3) ∧
    Y / 2 ^ Nat.log 2 (Y / 3) ≤ 5
  simpa [n, K, d] using And.intro hlow (by omega : Y / d ≤ 5)

name: RankAmplification.three_mul_pow_fixedShellCount_le
statement:
theorem three_mul_pow_fixedShellCount_le
    {Y : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    3 * 2 ^ bfpsFixedShellCount Y ≤ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < Y / 3 := Nat.div_pos hY (by norm_num)
  have hpow : 2 ^ Nat.log 2 (Y / 3) ≤ Y / 3 :=
    Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hn.ne'
  have := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by norm_num : 0 < 3)).mp hpow
  simpa [bfpsFixedShellCount, mul_comm] using this

name: RankAmplification.lt_six_mul_pow_fixedShellCount
statement:
theorem lt_six_mul_pow_fixedShellCount
    {Y : ℕ} (_hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    Y < 6 * 2 ^ bfpsFixedShellCount Y
proof:
:= by
  let n := Y / 3
  let K := Nat.log 2 n
  have hnUpper : n < 2 ^ (K + 1) :=
    Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) n
  have hdiv : Y < 3 * (n + 1) := by
    simpa [n, mul_comm] using
      (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by norm_num : 0 < 3)).mp
        (Nat.lt_succ_self (Y / 3))
  calc
    Y < 3 * (n + 1) := hdiv
    _ ≤ 3 * 2 ^ (K + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hnUpper
    _ = 6 * 2 ^ K := by simp [pow_succ]; ring
    _ = 6 * 2 ^ bfpsFixedShellCount Y := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_ge_distancePow
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_ge_distancePow
    {Y i : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hi : i ≤ bfpsFixedShellCount Y) :
    3 * 2 ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) ≤
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsGeometricEndpoint]
  apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)).2
  calc
    3 * 2 ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) * 2 ^ i =
        3 * 2 ^ bfpsFixedShellCount Y := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
      congr 2
      omega
    _ ≤ Y := three_mul_pow_fixedShellCount_le hY

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_lt_distancePow
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_lt_distancePow
    {Y i : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hi : i ≤ bfpsFixedShellCount Y) :
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i <
      6 * 2 ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsGeometricEndpoint]
  apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)).2
  calc
    Y < 6 * 2 ^ bfpsFixedShellCount Y :=
      lt_six_mul_pow_fixedShellCount hY
    _ = 6 * 2 ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) * 2 ^ i := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
      congr 2
      omega

name: RankAmplification.cast_distance_mul_log_two_le_log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint
statement:
theorem cast_distance_mul_log_two_le_log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint
    {Y i : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hi : i ≤ bfpsFixedShellCount Y) :
    ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i)
proof:
:= by
  have hpowNat : 2 ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) ≤
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i := by
    have h := bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_ge_distancePow hY hi
    omega
  have hpowPos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℕ) ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) := by
    positivity
  have hpowCast : ((2 ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpowNat
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hpowCast
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpowPos hpowCast
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.log_pow] using hlog

name: RankAmplification.log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_log_six_add_distance
statement:
theorem log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_log_six_add_distance
    {Y i : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hi : i ≤ bfpsFixedShellCount Y) :
    Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤
      Real.log 6 +
        ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hupperNat : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ≤
      6 * 2 ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) :=
    (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_lt_distancePow hY hi).le
  have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i := by
    have hthree : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i :=
      (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le hi)
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
  have hupper : (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i : ℝ) ≤
      6 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i) := by
    exact_mod_cast hupperNat
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hHpos hupper
  calc
    Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤
        Real.log (6 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i)) := hlog
    _ = Real.log 6 +
        ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (6 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by positivity),
        Real.log_pow]

name: RankAmplification.log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_two_mul_distance
statement:
theorem log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_two_mul_distance
    {Y i : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hi : i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hlogSix : δ * Real.log 6 ≤ 2)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i)) :
    Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤
      2 * (((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  let H : ℝ := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
  let d : ℝ := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  have hreverse : Real.log H ≤ Real.log 6 + d := by
    dsimp [H, d]
    exact log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_log_six_add_distance hY hi.le
  have hlogSixHalf : Real.log 6 ≤ Real.log H / 2 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).2
    have hscaled : δ * (Real.log 6 * 2) ≤ δ * Real.log H := by
      nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hscaled hδ
  dsimp [H, d] at hreverse ⊢
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_three_mul_succ
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_three_mul_succ
    {Y i : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hi : i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y) :
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ≤
      3 * bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1)
proof:

  have hlo : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1) :=
    (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega))

name: RankAmplification.mul_rpow_neg_one_sub_le_three_mul_rpow
statement:
theorem mul_rpow_neg_one_sub_le_three_mul_rpow
    {a b δ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≤ 3 * b)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    a * b ^ (-(1 - δ)) ≤ 3 * a ^ δ
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := 1 - δ
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; linarith
  have hc1 : c ≤ 1 := by dsimp [c]; linarith
  have hratio : a / b ≤ 3 := by
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hb).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hab)
  have hratioPow : (a / b) ^ c ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ c :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow (div_nonneg ha.le hb.le) hratio hc0
  have hthreePow : (3 : ℝ) ^ c ≤ 3 := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3) hc1
  have haSplit : a = a ^ δ * a ^ c := by
    calc
      a = a ^ (1 : ℝ) := by simp
      _ = a ^ (δ + c) := by
        congr 1
        dsimp [c]
        ring
      _ = a ^ δ * a ^ c := Real.rpow_add ha δ c
  change a * b ^ (-c) ≤ 3 * a ^ δ
  calc
    a * b ^ (-c) = a * (b ^ c)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hb.le]
    _ = (a ^ δ * a ^ c) * (b ^ c)⁻¹ :=
      congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ z * (b ^ c)⁻¹) haSplit
    _ = a ^ δ * (a ^ c / b ^ c) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    _ = a ^ δ * (a / b) ^ c := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow ha.le hb.le]
    _ ≤ a ^ δ * 3 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hratioPow.trans hthreePow)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg ha.le _)
    _ = 3 * a ^ δ := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShell_logScale_rpow_le
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShell_logScale_rpow_le
    {Y i : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hi : i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) *
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1) : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) ≤
      (3 * (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i : ℝ) ^ δ) /
        (((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let H : ℝ := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
  let L₀ : ℝ := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1)
  let d : ℝ := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  have hHnat : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i :=
    (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega))
  have hLnat : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1) :=
    (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega))
  have hH : 0 < H := by dsimp [H]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i)
  have hL : 0 < L₀ := by
    dsimp [L₀]
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1))
  have hHL : H ≤ 3 * L₀ := by
    dsimp [H, L₀]
    exact_mod_cast bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_three_mul_succ hY hi
  have hpower : H * L₀ ^ (-(1 - δ)) ≤ 3 * H ^ δ :=
    mul_rpow_neg_one_sub_le_three_mul_rpow hH hL hHL hδ0 hδ1
  have hj : 0 < bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i := by omega
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hj) hlogTwo
  have hdlog : d ≤ Real.log H := by
    dsimp [d, H]
    exact cast_distance_mul_log_two_le_log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint hY hi.le
  have hlogH : 0 < Real.log H := hd.trans_le hdlog
  have hsq : d ^ 2 ≤ (Real.log H) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  unfold bfpsLogSquaredScale AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
  change (H / (Real.log H) ^ 2) * L₀ ^ (-(1 - δ)) ≤
    (3 * H ^ δ) / d ^ 2
  calc
    (H / (Real.log H) ^ 2) * L₀ ^ (-(1 - δ)) =
        (H * L₀ ^ (-(1 - δ))) / (Real.log H) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ (3 * H ^ δ) / (Real.log H) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpower (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (3 * H ^ δ) / d ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_nonneg hH.le _))
        (sq_pos_of_pos hd) hsq

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_nonneg (Y : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  dsimp
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · have hH : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i := by
      by_cases hY : 3 ≤ Y
      · exact (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hi).le)
      · have hYlt : Y < 3 := by omega
        have hdiv : Y / 3 = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hYlt
        have hK : bfpsFixedShellCount Y = 0 := by
          simp [bfpsFixedShellCount, hdiv]
        rw [hK] at hi
        simp at hi
    have hlogH : 0 ≤ Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega))

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant_nonneg
statement:

    0 ≤ fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant

  have hlogSix : 0 ≤ Real.log 6 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShell_moderateSummand_le
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShell_moderateSummand_le
    {Y i : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hi : i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y)
    (hphase : δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤ 4) :
    let H
proof:
:= bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
    let d := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
    (3 * (H : ℝ) ^ δ / d ^ 2) *
        (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H) ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant := by
  dsimp
  let H : ℝ := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
  let d : ℝ := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  have hHnat : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i :=
    (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le hi.le)
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
  have hHone : (1 : ℝ) < H := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
  have hlogH : 0 < Real.log H := Real.log_pos hHone
  have hj : 0 < bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i := by omega
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hj) hlogTwo
  have hlogTwoLeD : Real.log 2 ≤ d := by
    dsimp [d]
    have hjOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤
        ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i by omega)
    nlinarith
  have hreverse : Real.log H ≤ Real.log 6 + d := by
    dsimp [H, d]
    exact log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_log_six_add_distance hY hi.le
  have hHpow : H ^ δ ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hH]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hphase)
  have hinv : 1 / d ≤ 1 / Real.log 2 := by
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hlogTwo hlogTwoLeD
  have hinvSq : 1 / d ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2 := by
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (sq_pos_of_pos hlogTwo)
      ((sq_le_sq₀ hlogTwo.le hd.le).2 hlogTwoLeD)
  have hfrac : (Real.log 6 + d) / d ^ 2 ≤
      1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2 := by
    have hlogSix : 0 ≤ Real.log 6 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    calc
      (Real.log 6 + d) / d ^ 2 = 1 / d + Real.log 6 / d ^ 2 := by
        field_simp [hd.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ 1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2 :=
        add_le_add hinv (by
          simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] using
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinvSq hlogSix))
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ 3 * Real.exp 4 *
      Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant := by positivity
  unfold fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant
  change (3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2) *
      (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H) ≤ _
  calc
    (3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2) *
          (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H) ≤
        (3 * Real.exp 4 / d ^ 2) *
          (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * (Real.log 6 + d)) := by
      have hpref : 3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2 ≤ 3 * Real.exp 4 / d ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hHpow (by norm_num)) (sq_nonneg _)
      have hlog : Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H ≤
          Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * (Real.log 6 + d) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreverse (Real.exp_pos _).le
      exact mul_le_mul hpref hlog (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = (3 * Real.exp 4 * Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant) *
          ((Real.log 6 + d) / d ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ (3 * Real.exp 4 * Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant) *
          (1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac hcoef

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShell_moderateSummand_le_div_distance
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShell_moderateSummand_le_div_distance
    {Y i : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hi : i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y)
    (hphase : δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤ 4) :
    let H
proof:
:= bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
    let dNat := bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i
    let d := (dNat : ℝ) * Real.log 2
    (3 * (H : ℝ) ^ δ / d ^ 2) *
        (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H) ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant / (dNat : ℝ) := by
  dsimp
  let H : ℝ := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
  let j : ℕ := bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i
  let d : ℝ := (j : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  have hHnat : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i :=
    (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le hi.le)
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
  have hHone : (1 : ℝ) < H := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
  have hjNat : 0 < j := by dsimp [j]; omega
  have hj : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hjNat
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact mul_pos hj hlogTwo
  have hreverse : Real.log H ≤ Real.log 6 + d := by
    dsimp [H, d, j]
    exact log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_log_six_add_distance hY hi.le
  have hHpow : H ^ δ ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hH]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hphase)
  have hkernel : (Real.log 6 + d) / d ^ 2 ≤
      (1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2) / (j : ℝ) := by
    have hlogSix : 0 ≤ Real.log 6 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hjOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hjNat
    have hjInv : 1 / (j : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (j : ℝ) := by
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hj (by nlinarith)
    rw [show d = (j : ℝ) * Real.log 2 by rfl]
    calc
      (Real.log 6 + (j : ℝ) * Real.log 2) /
          ((j : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2 =
        (1 / Real.log 2) / (j : ℝ) +
          (Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2) / (j : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [hj.ne', hlogTwo.ne']
            ring
      _ ≤ (1 / Real.log 2) / (j : ℝ) +
          (Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2) / (j : ℝ) := by
        apply add_le_add_right
        have hcoeff : 0 ≤ Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2 :=
          div_nonneg hlogSix (sq_nonneg _)
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hjInv hcoeff)
      _ = (1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2) /
          (j : ℝ) := by ring
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ 3 * Real.exp 4 *
      Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant := by positivity
  unfold fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant
  change (3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2) *
      (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H) ≤ _
  calc
    (3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2) *
          (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H) ≤
        (3 * Real.exp 4 / d ^ 2) *
          (Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * (Real.log 6 + d)) := by
      have hpref : 3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2 ≤ 3 * Real.exp 4 / d ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hHpow (by norm_num)) (sq_nonneg _)
      have hlog : Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H ≤
          Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * (Real.log 6 + d) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreverse (Real.exp_pos _).le
      exact mul_le_mul hpref hlog (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = (3 * Real.exp 4 * Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant) *
          ((Real.log 6 + d) / d ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ (3 * Real.exp 4 * Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant) *
          ((1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2) /
            (j : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkernel hcoef
    _ = (3 * Real.exp 4 * Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant *
          (1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log 6 / (Real.log 2) ^ 2)) /
            (j : ℝ) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_range_fixedShell_reverse_inv_eq
statement:
theorem sum_range_fixedShell_reverse_inv_eq (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, (j : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun i _hi ↦ K - i)
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    have hiK := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    omega
  · intro i₁ hi₁ i₂ hi₂ heq
    have hi₁K := Finset.mem_range.mp hi₁
    have hi₂K := Finset.mem_range.mp hi₂
    omega
  · intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
    refine ⟨K - j, Finset.mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
    · omega
    · omega
  · intro i hi
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.sum_range_fixedShell_reverse_inv_le
statement:
theorem sum_range_fixedShell_reverse_inv_le (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      1 + Real.log K
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_range_fixedShell_reverse_inv_eq]
  simpa only [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_inv,
    Rat.cast_natCast, Rat.cast_ofNat] using harmonic_le_one_add_log K

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShell_sharpSummand_le
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShell_sharpSummand_le
    {Y i : ℕ} {δ U B : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hi : i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hlogSix : δ * Real.log 6 ≤ 2)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i))
    (hU : δ * Real.log Y ≤ U)
    (hB : fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) δ - Real.log (1 / δ) ≤ B) :
    let H
proof:
:= bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
    let d := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
    (3 * (H : ℝ) ^ δ / d ^ 2) *
        Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent H δ) ≤
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B := by
  dsimp
  let H : ℝ := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
  let d : ℝ := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  let E : ℝ := fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent
    (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) δ
  have hHnat : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i :=
    (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le hi.le)
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
  have hHone : (1 : ℝ) < H := by
    dsimp [H]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
  have hlogH : 0 < Real.log H := Real.log_pos hHone
  have hj : 0 < bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i := by omega
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hj) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
  have hlogHd : Real.log H ≤ 2 * d := by
    dsimp [H, d]
    exact log_bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_le_two_mul_distance
      hY hi hδ hlogSix hphase
  have hδd : 2 ≤ δ * d := by
    have hzle : δ * Real.log H ≤ 2 * (δ * d) := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogHd hδ.le)
    nlinarith
  have hweight : 1 / d ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 / 4 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hd)).2
    have hsq : 4 ≤ (δ * d) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hrewrite : (δ * d) ^ 2 = δ ^ 2 * d ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hrewrite] at hsq
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg δ, sq_pos_of_pos hd]
  have hHYnat : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ≤ Y := by
    exact Nat.div_le_self Y (2 ^ i)
  have hlogHY : Real.log H ≤ Real.log Y := by
    have hYpos : (0 : ℝ) < Y := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Y by omega)
    exact Real.log_le_log hH (by
      dsimp [H]
      exact_mod_cast hHYnat)
  have hphaseU : δ * Real.log H ≤ U :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogHY hδ.le).trans hU
  have hHpow : H ^ δ ≤ Real.exp U := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hH]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hphaseU)
  have hE : E ≤ Real.log (1 / δ) + B := by
    dsimp [E]
    linarith
  have hexpE : Real.exp E ≤ (1 / δ) * Real.exp B := by
    calc
      Real.exp E ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (1 / δ) + B) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hE
      _ = (1 / δ) * Real.exp B := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (div_pos (by norm_num) hδ)]
  have hfirst : 3 * H ^ δ ≤ 3 * Real.exp U :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hHpow (by norm_num)
  have hpref : (3 * H ^ δ) * (1 / d ^ 2) ≤
      (3 * Real.exp U) * (δ ^ 2 / 4) :=
    mul_le_mul hfirst hweight (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hfull : ((3 * H ^ δ) * (1 / d ^ 2)) * Real.exp E ≤
      ((3 * Real.exp U) * (δ ^ 2 / 4)) * ((1 / δ) * Real.exp B) :=
    mul_le_mul hpref hexpE (Real.exp_pos E).le (by positivity)
  change (3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2) * Real.exp E ≤ _
  calc
    (3 * H ^ δ / d ^ 2) * Real.exp E =
        ((3 * H ^ δ) * (1 / d ^ 2)) * Real.exp E := by ring
    _ ≤ ((3 * Real.exp U) * (δ ^ 2 / 4)) *
          ((1 / δ) * Real.exp B) := hfull
    _ = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B := by
      field_simp [hδ.ne']

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_scalar
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_scalar
    {Y : ℕ} {δ U B : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hlogSix : δ * Real.log 6 ≤ 2)
    (hU : δ * Real.log Y ≤ U)
    (hB : ∀ i, i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y →
      4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ∧
        4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) →
      fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) δ - Real.log (1 / δ) ≤ B) :
    bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ ≤
      (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant +
        (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) *
          ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B)
proof:
:= by
  let S : ℝ := (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := by dsimp [S]; positivity
  have hM := fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant_nonneg
  unfold bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (bfpsFixedShellCount Y),
        let H := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
        let d := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
        let Q := if 4 ≤ H ∧ 4 ≤ δ * Real.log H then
            Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent H δ)
          else Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H
        (3 * (H : ℝ) ^ δ / d ^ 2) * Q) ≤
      ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range (bfpsFixedShellCount Y),
        (fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant + S) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hiK := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      dsimp only
      by_cases hphase : 4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ∧
          4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i)
      · rw [if_pos hphase]
        exact (bfpsFixedShell_sharpSummand_le hY hiK hδ hlogSix
          hphase.2 hU (hB i hiK hphase)).trans
            (le_add_of_nonneg_left hM)
      · rw [if_neg hphase]
        have hphaseLe : δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤ 4 := by
          by_cases hHfour : 4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
          · exact le_of_not_ge (fun hz ↦ hphase ⟨hHfour, hz⟩)
          · have hHnat : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i :=
              (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le hiK.le)
            have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i := by
              exact_mod_cast (show 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
            have hlogH := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hHpos
            have hHthree : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ≤ 3 := by omega
            have hHcast : (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by
              exact_mod_cast hHthree
            nlinarith
        exact (bfpsFixedShell_moderateSummand_le hY hiK hphaseLe).trans
          (le_add_of_nonneg_right hS)
    _ = (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant +
        (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * S := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const]
      simp only [Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    _ = (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant +
        (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) *
          ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B) := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_harmonicScalar
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_harmonicScalar
    {Y : ℕ} {δ U B : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hlogSix : δ * Real.log 6 ≤ 2)
    (hU : δ * Real.log Y ≤ U)
    (hB : ∀ i, i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y →
      4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ∧
        4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) →
      fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) δ - Real.log (1 / δ) ≤ B) :
    bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) +
        (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) *
          ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B)
proof:
:= by
  let K := bfpsFixedShellCount Y
  let S : ℝ := (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := by dsimp [S]; positivity
  have hM := fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant_nonneg
  unfold bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
        let H := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
        let d := ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
        let Q := if 4 ≤ H ∧ 4 ≤ δ * Real.log H then
            Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent H δ)
          else Real.exp fixedBFPSModerateEulerConstant * Real.log H
        (3 * (H : ℝ) ^ δ / d ^ 2) * Q) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
        (fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant / ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ) + S) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hiK := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      dsimp only
      by_cases hphase : 4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ∧
          4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i)
      · rw [if_pos hphase]
        exact (bfpsFixedShell_sharpSummand_le hY hiK hδ hlogSix
          hphase.2 hU (hB i hiK hphase)).trans
            (le_add_of_nonneg_left (div_nonneg hM (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))
      · rw [if_neg hphase]
        have hphaseLe : δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤ 4 := by
          by_cases hHfour : 4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
          · exact le_of_not_ge (fun hz ↦ hphase ⟨hHfour, hz⟩)
          · have hHnat : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i :=
              (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le hiK.le)
            have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i := by
              exact_mod_cast (show 0 < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i by omega)
            have hlogH := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hHpos
            have hHthree : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ≤ 3 := by omega
            have hHcast : (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by
              exact_mod_cast hHthree
            nlinarith
        exact (bfpsFixedShell_moderateSummand_le_div_distance
          hY hiK hphaseLe).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hS)
    _ = fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        (K : ℝ) * S := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const]
      simp only [Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv,
        Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant * (1 + Real.log K) +
        (K : ℝ) * S := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_range_fixedShell_reverse_inv_le K) hM) le_rfl
    _ = fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) +
        (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) *
          ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B) := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.fixed_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div
statement:
theorem fixed_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div (Y : ℕ) :
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) / Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.log 2 Y : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.log_mono_right (Nat.div_le_self Y 3)
    _ ≤ Real.logb 2 Y := Real.natLog_le_logb Y 2
    _ = Real.log (Y : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellCount_mul_delta_le_phase_div_log_two
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellCount_mul_delta_le_phase_div_log_two
    {Y : ℕ} {δ U : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hU : δ * Real.log Y ≤ U) :
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * δ ≤ U / Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  calc
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * δ ≤
        (Real.log (Y : ℝ) / Real.log 2) * δ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (fixed_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div Y) hδ
    _ = (δ * Real.log Y) / Real.log 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ U / Real.log 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hU hlogTwo.le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_phaseScalar
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_phaseScalar
    {Y : ℕ} {δ U B : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hlogSix : δ * Real.log 6 ≤ 2)
    (hU : δ * Real.log Y ≤ U)
    (hB : ∀ i, i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y →
      4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ∧
        4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) →
      fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) δ - Real.log (1 / δ) ≤ B) :
    bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) +
        (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * U * Real.exp U * Real.exp B
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_harmonicScalar
    hY hδ hδquarter hlogSix hU hB
  refine hraw.trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
  have hcount := bfpsFixedShellCount_mul_delta_le_phase_div_log_two hδ.le hU
  have htailNonneg : 0 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp U * Real.exp B := by positivity
  calc
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) *
        ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ * Real.exp U * Real.exp B) =
      ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * δ) *
        ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp U * Real.exp B) := by ring
    _ ≤ (U / Real.log 2) *
        ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp U * Real.exp B) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount htailNonneg
    _ = (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * U *
        Real.exp U * Real.exp B := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_globalScalar
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_globalScalar
    {Y : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hlogSix : δ * Real.log 6 ≤ 2) :
    bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ ≤
      (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant +
        (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) * ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ *
          Real.exp (δ * Real.log Y) *
            Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent Y δ -
              Real.log (1 / δ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_scalar hY hδ hδquarter hlogSix le_rfl
  intro i hi hphase
  have hHY : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ≤ Y :=
    Nat.div_le_self Y (2 ^ i)
  exact sub_le_sub_right
    (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global hphase.1 hHY hδ hδquarter
      hphase.2)
    _

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum_le_fixedShellPhaseEnvelope
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum_le_fixedShellPhaseEnvelope
    {X Y : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hbasePhase : δ * Real.log 2 ≤ 1) :
    bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum X Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y) (1 - δ) ≤
      bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have hiK := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  let H := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i
  let d := ((bfpsFixedShellCount Y - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  have hscale :
      bfpsLogSquaredScale H *
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1) : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) ≤
        3 * (H : ℝ) ^ δ / d ^ 2 := by
    exact bfpsFixedShell_logScale_rpow_le hY hiK hδ.le
      (hδquarter.trans (by norm_num))
  have heulerNonneg : 0 ≤ smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct H (1 - δ) := by
    exact smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hprefNonneg : 0 ≤ 3 * (H : ℝ) ^ δ / d ^ 2 := by positivity
  by_cases hphase : 4 ≤ H ∧ 4 ≤ δ * Real.log H
  · have heuler := smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharpPhaseSplit
      hphase.1 hδ hδquarter hbasePhase hphase.2
    dsimp only [H, d]
    rw [if_pos hphase]
    exact mul_le_mul hscale heuler heulerNonneg hprefNonneg
  · have hHtwo : 2 ≤ H := by
      dsimp [H]
      exact (by
        have := (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1.trans
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le hiK.le)
        omega : 2 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i)
    have hphaseLe : δ * Real.log H ≤ 4 := by
      by_cases hHfour : 4 ≤ H
      · exact le_of_not_ge (fun hz ↦ hphase ⟨hHfour, hz⟩)
      · have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < H := by
          exact_mod_cast (show 0 < H by omega)
        have hlogH : Real.log H ≤ H - 1 :=
          Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hHpos
        have hHthree : H ≤ 3 := by omega
        have hδnonneg : 0 ≤ δ := hδ.le
        have : Real.log H ≤ 2 := by
          have hcast : (H : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast hHthree
          linarith
        nlinarith
    have heuler := smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_moderateLog
      hHtwo hδ hδquarter hphaseLe
    dsimp only [H, d]
    rw [if_neg hphase]
    exact mul_le_mul hscale heuler heulerNonneg hprefNonneg

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_six_of_le_five
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_six_of_le_five
    {R : ℕ} { δ : ℝ} (hR : R ≤ 5) (hδ : δ ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤ 6
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : Nat.primesLE R ⊆ Finset.range (R + 1) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have hpLe := (Nat.mem_primesLE.mp hp).1
    omega
  have hcard : (Nat.primesLE R).card ≤ R + 1 := by
    simpa using Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  unfold primeRankinSum
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ)) ≤
        ∑ _p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_le
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hpOne (by linarith)
    _ = (Nat.primesLE R).card := by simp
    _ ≤ R + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    _ ≤ 6 := by exact_mod_cast (show R + 1 ≤ 6 by omega)

    linarith [primeRankinSum_le_six_of_le_five hR
      (hδquarter.trans (by norm_num))]

    (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant X Y (1 - δ) C ≤
      Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant +
        C * bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < 1 - δ := by linarith
  have hterminal :
      finiteSmoothTotientRankinAbelExpression
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) X (1 - δ) ≤
        Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant := by
    rw [finiteSmoothTotientRankinAbelExpression_eq]
    exact (finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct hc).trans
      (smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_terminal_le
        (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).2 hδ.le hδquarter)
  have hshell :
      bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum X Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y) (1 - δ) ≤
        bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ :=
    (bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum_le_rankin hc).trans
      (bfpsGeometricRankinMajorantSum_le_fixedShellPhaseEnvelope
        hY hδ hδquarter hbasePhase)
  unfold fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant
  exact add_le_add hterminal (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hshell hC)

statement:
theorem fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_sharpAdaptive
    {X Y : ℕ} { δ C : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsharp : ∀ i, i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y →
      SharpHildebrandRegime
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i)
        (X / (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1) + 1)))
    (hshift : ∀ i, i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y →
      hildebrandSaddleShift
          (X / (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (i + 1) + 1))
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) ≤ δ) :

      fixedBFPSSharpAdaptivePredecessorMajorant X Y δ C
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant

  rw [finiteSmoothTotientRankinAbelExpression_eq]

      finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) X (1 - δ) ≤
        Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant := by
    calc

          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) X (1 - δ) ≤
          smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct
            (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) (1 - δ) := by
        exact finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct (by linarith)
      _ ≤ Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant :=
        smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_terminal_le
          (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).2 hδ0 hδquarter

    (bfpsGeometricAbelMajorantSum_le_sharpAdaptive hsharp hshift) hC

    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (fixedBFPSTruncatedPredecessorMajorant_le_abel X Y c hC)
      (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent
    {X Y : ℕ} {c C : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent X Y c C)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := smoothTotientCount_le_exp_saving
    (X := X) (Y := Y) hX (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) hhalf
  have hprime := smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_fixedShellTruncatedMajorant
    (X := X) (Y := Y) (c := c) (C := C) hY hc hC hsieve
  unfold fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent fixedBFPSTruncatedPredecessorMajorant
  exact hbase.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr <| add_le_add_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
        (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le) _)
    (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent
    {X Y : ℕ} {c C : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (fixedBFPSAbelExponent X Y c C)
proof:
:= by
  exact (smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent
    hX hY hc hhalf hC hsieve).trans <|
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          (fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_le_abel X Y c hC))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg X)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_selbergGrowingCutoff
    {X Y : ℕ} {c κ : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hmass : BFPSTwoAffine.GrowingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound κ) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent X Y c
          (BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataSelbergGrowingCutoff hκ hmass).sieveConstant)
proof:
:= by
  let data := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataSelbergGrowingCutoff hκ hmass
  exact smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent hX hY hc hhalf
    data.sieveConstant_nonneg data.hasTwoAffineSieveBound

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_growingCutoff
    {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y)

    BFPSTwoAffine.hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_growingCutoff

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent_growingCutoff
    {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ c) :
