name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack x
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero :
    Tendsto fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun x ↦ (Real.sqrt (log3 x))⁻¹) atTop (nhds 0)
  exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
    (Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log3_atTop)

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSRateSlack_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSRateSlack_nonneg (J : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ fixedBFPSRateSlack J x
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSRateSlack
  exact add_nonneg (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg x) (norm_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSRateSlack_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSRateSlack_zero (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fixedBFPSRateSlack J) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have herr := (tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_zero J hJ).norm
  change Tendsto (fun x ↦
    fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack x + ‖fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x‖)
      atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa using tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero.add herr

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSRateSlack_mul_scaleV_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSRateSlack_mul_scaleV_isLittleO_scaleL
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    (fun x ↦ fixedBFPSRateSlack J x * scaleV x) =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:= by
  have hslack : fixedBFPSRateSlack J =O[atTop] (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) :=
    (tendsto_fixedBFPSRateSlack_zero J hJ).isBigO_one ℝ
  have hV : scaleV =o[atTop] scaleL :=
    scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG.trans scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL
  simpa only [one_mul] using hslack.mul_isLittleO hV

name: RankAmplification.half_le_fixedBFPSClampedExponent
statement:
theorem half_le_fixedBFPSClampedExponent (J x : ℕ) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x
proof:
:=
  le_max_left _ _

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSClampedExponent_pos
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSClampedExponent_pos (J x : ℕ) :
    0 < fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x
proof:
:=
  (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2).trans_le
    (half_le_fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSaddleRate_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem fixedRankSaddleRate_isLittleO_scaleL (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    fixedRankSaddleRate J =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:= by
  have hmain : (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) =o[atTop] scaleL :=
    scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL.const_mul_left (Real.sqrt J)
  have herr : (fun x ↦ fixedRankSaddleRate J x - Real.sqrt J * scaleG x)
      =o[atTop] scaleL :=
    ((fixedRankSaddleError_isLittleO_scaleV J hJ).trans
      scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG).trans scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL
  have hsum := hmain.add herr
  apply hsum.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSShiftedRate_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSShiftedRate_isLittleO_scaleL (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    fixedBFPSShiftedRate J =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := fixedRankSaddleRate_isLittleO_scaleL J hJ
  have hslack := fixedBFPSRateSlack_mul_scaleV_isLittleO_scaleL J hJ
  change (fun x ↦ fixedRankSaddleRate J x -
    fixedBFPSRateSlack J x * scaleV x) =o[atTop] scaleL
  exact hmain.sub hslack

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fixedBFPSDelta J) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hreal := (fixedBFPSShiftedRate_isLittleO_scaleL J hJ).tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    fixedBFPSShiftedRate J (x : ℝ) / scaleL (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  refine Tendsto.congr' ?_
    (hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_le_half
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_le_half (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, fixedBFPSDelta J x ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, fixedBFPSDelta J x < (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_order.1 (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero J hJ)).2 _ (by norm_num)
  exact hlt.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSClampedExponent_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSClampedExponent_eq (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x = 1 - fixedBFPSDelta J x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_le_half J hJ] with x hx
  rw [fixedBFPSClampedExponent, max_eq_right]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSDelta_mul_scaleL
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSDelta_mul_scaleL
    {J x : ℕ} (hL : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :
    fixedBFPSDelta J x * scaleL (x : ℝ) =
      fixedBFPSShiftedRate J (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedBFPSDelta, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hL]

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSaddleRate_eq_main_add_normalizedError
statement:
theorem fixedRankSaddleRate_eq_main_add_normalizedError
    {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    fixedRankSaddleRate J x =
      Real.sqrt J * scaleG x +
        fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x * scaleV x
proof:
:= by
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  unfold fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError fixedRankSaddleError
  field_simp [hV.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSRealDelta_mul_fixedRankT_eq
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSRealDelta_mul_fixedRankT_eq
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {x : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    (fixedBFPSShiftedRate J x / scaleL x) * fixedRankT J x =
      scaleA x +
        (fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x - fixedBFPSRateSlack J x) /
          Real.sqrt J
proof:
:= by
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hrate := fixedRankSaddleRate_eq_main_add_normalizedError
    (J := J) hL hA
  have hGV := scaleG_mul_scaleV hG.ne'
  have hAV := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  unfold fixedBFPSShiftedRate fixedRankT
  rw [hrate]
  field_simp [hL.ne', hG.ne', hV.ne', hsqrt.ne']
  rw [← hGV, ← hAV]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSRealDelta_mul_fixedRankT_le_scaleA_sub_base
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSRealDelta_mul_fixedRankT_le_scaleA_sub_base
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {x : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    (fixedBFPSShiftedRate J x / scaleL x) * fixedRankT J x ≤
      scaleA x - fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack x / Real.sqrt J
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedBFPSRealDelta_mul_fixedRankT_eq hJ hL hA]
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have herr : fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x ≤
      ‖fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x‖ := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (le_abs_self (fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x))
  have hnum : fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x - fixedBFPSRateSlack J x ≤
      -fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack x := by
    unfold fixedBFPSRateSlack
    linarith
  have hdiv := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hsqrt).2 hnum
  calc
    scaleA x +
        (fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x - fixedBFPSRateSlack J x) /
          Real.sqrt J ≤
      scaleA x + (-fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack x / Real.sqrt J) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl hdiv
    _ = scaleA x - fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack x / Real.sqrt J := by ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSRealPhase_sub_scaleA_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSRealPhase_sub_scaleA_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦
      (fixedBFPSShiftedRate J x / scaleL x) * fixedRankT J x - scaleA x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have herr := tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_zero J hJ
  have hslack := tendsto_fixedBFPSRateSlack_zero J hJ
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)).ne'
  have hsmall : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦
      (fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x - fixedBFPSRateSlack J x) /
        Real.sqrt J) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero, zero_div] using
      (herr.sub hslack).div_const (Real.sqrt J)
  apply hsmall.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
  rw [fixedBFPSRealDelta_mul_fixedRankT_eq hJ hL hA]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankY_half_le_natY
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankY_half_le_natY
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankY J (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hreal : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 2 ≤ fixedRankY J (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_fixedRankY_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [hreal] with x hx
  simpa only [fixedRankNatY_eq_floor] using
    (half_le_natFloor hx)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankNatY_cast_le_fixedRankY
statement:
theorem fixedRankNatY_cast_le_fixedRankY (J x : ℕ) :
    (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankY J (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.floor_le (fixedRankY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le

name: RankAmplification.log_fixedRankNatY_le_fixedRankT
statement:
theorem log_fixedRankNatY_le_fixedRankT
    {J x : ℕ} (hY : 0 < fixedRankNatY J x) :
    Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankT J (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hYreal : (0 : ℝ) < fixedRankNatY J x := by exact_mod_cast hY
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hYreal (fixedRankNatY_cast_le_fixedRankY J x)
  simpa only [fixedRankY, Real.log_exp] using hlog

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankT_sub_log_two_le_log_fixedRankNatY
statement:
theorem fixedRankT_sub_log_two_le_log_fixedRankNatY
    {J x : ℕ}
    (hhalf : fixedRankY J (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)) :
    fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : 0 < fixedRankY J (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
    div_pos (fixedRankY_pos J (x : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hleft hhalf
  rw [fixedRankY] at hlog
  rw [Real.log_div (Real.exp_pos _).ne' (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
    Real.log_exp] at hlog
  exact hlog

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSNatY_phase_bounds
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSNatY_phase_bounds
    {J x : ℕ} (hY : 0 < fixedRankNatY J x)
    (hhalf : fixedRankY J (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ))
    (hδ : 0 ≤ fixedBFPSDelta J x) :
    fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) -
        fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log 2 ≤
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) ∧
    fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (fixedRankT_sub_log_two_le_log_fixedRankNatY hhalf) hδ
  have hupper := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (log_fixedRankNatY_le_fixedRankT hY) hδ
  exact ⟨by linarith, hupper⟩

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSRealPhase_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSRealPhase_atTop
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦
      (fixedBFPSShiftedRate J x / scaleL x) * fixedRankT J x)
      atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := (tendsto_fixedBFPSRealPhase_sub_scaleA_zero J hJ).add_atTop
    tendsto_scaleA_atTop
  apply hsum.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < fixedBFPSDelta J x
proof:
:= by
  have hphase : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      1 < fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) := by
    have hnat := (tendsto_fixedBFPSRealPhase_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    have hlarge := hnat.eventually_gt_atTop 1
    filter_upwards [hlarge] with x hx
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, fixedBFPSDelta] using hx
  have hT : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_fixedRankT_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [hphase, hT] with x hphase hT
  by_contra hδ
  have hδnonpos : fixedBFPSDelta J x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hδ
  have : fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) ≤ 0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hδnonpos hT.le
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hY : 0 < fixedRankNatY J x)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ fixedBFPSDelta J x)
    (hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ)) (hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ)) :
    fixedBFPSNatPhase J x ≤
      scaleA (x : ℝ) -
        fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := log_fixedRankNatY_le_fixedRankT hY
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hδ
  have hreal := fixedBFPSRealDelta_mul_fixedRankT_le_scaleA_sub_base
    hJ hL hA
  unfold fixedBFPSNatPhase
  exact hmul.trans hreal

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_sub_scaleA_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_sub_scaleA_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) - scaleA (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hcomp := (tendsto_fixedBFPSRealPhase_sub_scaleA_zero J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    exact hcomp
  have hfloorLoss : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log 2) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero J hJ).mul
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2)
          atTop (nhds (Real.log 2)))
  have hlower : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) - scaleA (x : ℝ)) -
        fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log 2) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hreal.sub hfloorLoss
  apply hlower.squeeze' hreal
  · filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankY_half_le_natY J hJ,
      eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ] with x hhalf hY hδ
    have hb := fixedBFPSNatY_phase_bounds (J := J) (x := x)
      (by omega) hhalf hδ.le
    unfold fixedBFPSNatPhase
    linarith
  · filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankY_half_le_natY J hJ,
      eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ] with x hhalf hY hδ
    have hb := fixedBFPSNatY_phase_bounds (J := J) (x := x)
      (by omega) hhalf hδ.le
    unfold fixedBFPSNatPhase
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_atTop
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fixedBFPSNatPhase J) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := (tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_sub_scaleA_zero J hJ).add_atTop
    (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  apply hsum.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_div_log3_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_div_log3_one
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / log3 (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) / log3 (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    (tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_sub_scaleA_zero J hJ).div_atTop
      (tendsto_log3_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hA : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) / log3 (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1) :=
    (isEquivalent_iff_tendsto_one
      ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        (eventually_log3_pos.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.ne'))).mp
      (scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.comp_tendsto
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hsum := hA.add hzero
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) / log3 (x : ℝ) +
        (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - scaleA (x : ℝ)) / log3 (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 1) := by simpa only [add_zero] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_log3_pos] with x hL3
  field_simp [hL3.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq (x : ℝ) :
    fixedBFPSPhaseGap x = log2 x / Real.sqrt (log3 x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSPhaseGap fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_pos
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_pos :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 0 < fixedBFPSPhaseGap x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos, eventually_log3_pos] with x hL2 hL3
  rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
  exact div_pos hL2 (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL3)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_atTop :
    Tendsto fixedBFPSPhaseGap atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log2_atTop
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop ?_ hsqrt
  filter_upwards [tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 1] with x hL2
  have hL2pos : 0 < log2 x := zero_lt_one.trans hL2
  have hL3le : log3 x ≤ log2 x := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hL2pos]
  have hL3pos : 0 < log3 x := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    exact Real.log_pos hL2
  have hsqrtLe : Real.sqrt (log3 x) ≤ Real.sqrt (log2 x) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hL3le
  have hsqrtL2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2pos
  have hsqrtL3 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log3 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL3pos
  rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hsqrtL3).2
  calc
    Real.sqrt (log2 x) * Real.sqrt (log3 x) ≤
        Real.sqrt (log2 x) * Real.sqrt (log2 x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrtLe hsqrtL2.le
    _ = log2 x := Real.mul_self_sqrt hL2pos.le

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_mul_log3_isLittleO_sqrt_log2
statement:
theorem scaleA_mul_log3_isLittleO_sqrt_log2 :
    (fun x ↦ scaleA x * log3 x) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x))
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : (fun x ↦ log3 x ^ (2 : ℝ)) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (2 : ℝ)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).comp_tendsto tendsto_log2_atTop
    apply h.congr'
    · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x _hL2
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, log3_eq]
    · exact EventuallyEq.rfl
  have hprod := scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.isBigO.mul
    (isBigO_refl log3 atTop)
  have hleft : (fun x ↦ scaleA x * log3 x) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ log3 x ^ (2 : ℝ)) := by
    apply hprod.congr' EventuallyEq.rfl
    filter_upwards [eventually_log3_pos] with x hL3
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add hL3,
      Real.rpow_one]
  have hright : (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) =ᶠ[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x)) := by
    filter_upwards [] with x
    simp only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact (hleft.trans_isLittleO hlog).congr' EventuallyEq.rfl hright

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleA_mul_log3_div_sqrt_log2_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_scaleA_mul_log3_div_sqrt_log2_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦
      scaleA x * log3 x / Real.sqrt (log2 x)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  scaleA_mul_log3_isLittleO_sqrt_log2.tendsto_div_nhds_zero

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSShiftedRate_isBigO_scaleG
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSShiftedRate_isBigO_scaleG
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    fixedBFPSShiftedRate J =O[atTop] scaleG
proof:
:= by
  have hmain : (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) =O[atTop] scaleG :=
    isBigO_refl scaleG atTop |>.const_mul_left (Real.sqrt J)
  have herr : (fun x ↦
      fixedRankSaddleRate J x - Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) =O[atTop] scaleG :=
    ((fixedRankSaddleError_isLittleO_scaleV J hJ).trans
      scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG).isBigO
  have hsaddle : fixedRankSaddleRate J =O[atTop] scaleG := by
    have hsum := hmain.add herr
    apply hsum.congr'
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      ring
    · exact EventuallyEq.rfl
  have hslack : (fun x ↦ fixedBFPSRateSlack J x * scaleV x)
      =O[atTop] scaleG := by
    have hbounded := (tendsto_fixedBFPSRateSlack_zero J hJ).isBigO_one ℝ
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      (hbounded.mul_isLittleO scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG).isBigO
  exact hsaddle.sub hslack

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_mul_log3_sq_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_mul_log3_sq_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * log3 (x : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogSq : (fun x ↦ log3 x ^ 2) =o[atTop] scaleV := by
    have hpow : (fun x ↦ log3 x ^ (2 : ℝ)) =o[atTop] log2 := by
      have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (2 : ℝ)
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).comp_tendsto tendsto_log2_atTop
      apply h.congr'
      · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos, eventually_log3_pos] with x _hL2 hL3
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, log3_eq]
      · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, Real.rpow_one]
    have hpowNat : (fun x ↦ log3 x ^ 2) =o[atTop] log2 := by
      apply hpow.congr'
      · filter_upwards [] with x
        rw [Real.rpow_two]
      · exact EventuallyEq.rfl
    exact hpowNat.trans log2_isLittleO_scaleV
  have hprod := (fixedBFPSShiftedRate_isBigO_scaleG J hJ).mul_isLittleO hlogSq
  have hden : (fun x ↦ scaleG x * scaleV x) =ᶠ[atTop] scaleL := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
    exact scaleG_mul_scaleV (scaleG_pos hL hA).ne'
  have hlittle : (fun x ↦ fixedBFPSShiftedRate J x * log3 x ^ 2)
      =o[atTop] scaleL := hprod.congr' EventuallyEq.rfl hden
  have hreal := hlittle.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hnat := hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  apply hnat.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hL
  unfold fixedBFPSDelta
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  field_simp [hL.ne']

name: RankAmplification.fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two
statement:
theorem fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two
    {x : ℝ} (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hL3 : 0 < log3 x) :
    Real.exp (scaleA x) = log2 x * log3 x / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleA_eq, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_add,
    show Real.exp (log3 x) = log2 x by
      simpa only [log3_eq] using Real.exp_log hL2,
    show Real.exp (log4 x) = log3 x by
      simpa only [log4_eq] using Real.exp_log hL3,
    Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSNatPhase J x ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) -
        fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hY hδ hL hA
  exact fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base hJ (by omega) hδ.le hL hA

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSMiddle_div_phaseGap_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSMiddle_div_phaseGap_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2) *
        Real.log (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2)) /
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmodel := tendsto_scaleA_mul_log3_div_sqrt_log2_zero.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  refine squeeze_zero' (g := fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) /
        Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) ?_ ?_ hmodel
  · filter_upwards [tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_atTop J hJ |>.eventually_ge_atTop 4,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_pos] with x hP hgap
    exact div_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith))) hgap.le
  · filter_upwards [tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_atTop J hJ |>.eventually_ge_atTop 4,
      eventually_fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hP hPupper hL hL2 hL3 hA
    have hPA : fixedBFPSNatPhase J x ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
      have hbase := fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg (x : ℝ)
      have hsqrt : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have hquot : 0 ≤ fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J :=
        div_nonneg hbase hsqrt
      linarith
    have hexp : Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ))) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_half]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hPA (by norm_num))
    have hlog : Real.log (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2) ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
      have hz : 0 < fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2 := by positivity
      have hbasic := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hz
      nlinarith
    have hmiddle : Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2) *
        Real.log (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ))) * scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul hexp hlog (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith))
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hexpA := fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ))) ≤
        Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hexpA]
      calc
        Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤
            Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ)) := by
          apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
          nlinarith [mul_pos hL2 hL3]
        _ = Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) :=
          Real.sqrt_mul hL2.le _
    have hnum := hmiddle.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrt hA.le)
    have hgap : 0 < fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
      positivity
    have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hgap.le
    have hsL2 : Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne'
    have hsL3 : Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL3).ne'
    calc
      (Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2) *
          Real.log (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2)) /
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) ≤
        (Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) *
          scaleA (x : ℝ)) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) := hdiv
      _ = scaleA (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) /
          Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
        field_simp [hsL2, hsL3, hL2.ne']
        ring_nf
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le, Real.sq_sqrt hL3.le]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_expPhase_div_phaseGap_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_expPhase_div_phaseGap_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x)) /
        fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * log3 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_div] using
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_mul_log3_sq_zero J hJ).div_const 2
  refine squeeze_zero' (g := fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * log3 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2) ?_ ?_ hmodel
  · filter_upwards [eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_pos] with x hδ hgap
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hδ.le (Real.exp_pos _).le) hgap.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        (tendsto_log3_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1)]
      with x hδ hPupper hL2 hL3
    have hbase := fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg (x : ℝ)
    have hPA : fixedBFPSNatPhase J x ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
      have hquot : 0 ≤ fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J :=
        div_nonneg hbase (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have hexp : Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x) ≤
        Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hPA
    have hexpA := fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2
      (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL3)
    have hgap : 0 < fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
      positivity
    have hnum : fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x) ≤
        fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hδ.le
    calc
      (fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x)) /
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) ≤
        (fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ))) /
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hgap.le
      _ = fixedBFPSDelta J x * log3 (x : ℝ) *
          Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) / 2 := by
        rw [hexpA, fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
        field_simp [hL2.ne', (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL3)).ne']
      _ ≤ fixedBFPSDelta J x * log3 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
        have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (log3 (x : ℝ)) ≤ log3 (x : ℝ) :=
          Real.sqrt_le_self_iff.mpr (Or.inr hL3)
        have hcoef : 0 ≤ fixedBFPSDelta J x * log3 (x : ℝ) :=
          mul_nonneg hδ.le (zero_le_one.trans hL3)
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (by simpa only [pow_two, mul_assoc] using
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt hcoef)) (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_div_sqrt_log2_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_div_sqrt_log2_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ fixedBFPSPhaseGap x / Real.sqrt (log2 x))
      atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hlogLittle : log3 =o[atTop] log2 := by
    have h := iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO 2
    apply h.congr' <;> filter_upwards [] with x <;> rfl
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log3 x / log2 x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hlogLittle.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 < log3 x / log2 x := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos, eventually_log3_pos] with x hL2 hL3
    exact div_pos hL3 hL2
  have hwithin : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log3 x / log2 x) atTop
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) := tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hzero, hpos⟩
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (log3 x / log2 x)⁻¹) atTop atTop :=
    hwithin.inv_tendsto_nhdsGT_zero
  have hsqrt := Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp hinv
  apply hsqrt.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos, eventually_log3_pos] with x hL2 hL3
  have hsL2 : Real.sqrt (log2 x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne'
  have hsL3 : Real.sqrt (log3 x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL3).ne'
  rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [inv_div, Real.sqrt_div hL2.le]
  field_simp [hsL2, hsL3]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log3_add_two_le_fixedBFPSNatPhase
statement:
theorem eventually_log3_add_two_le_fixedBFPSNatPhase
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      log3 (x : ℝ) + 2 ≤ fixedBFPSNatPhase J x
proof:
:= by
  have herr : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      -1 ≤ fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_sub_scaleA_zero J hJ).eventually
      (Ici_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hlog4 : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 + 3 ≤ log4 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log4_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (Real.log 2 + 3)
  filter_upwards [herr, hlog4] with x herr hlog4
  simp only [scaleA_eq] at herr
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.exp_neg_le_one_sub_half
statement:
theorem exp_neg_le_one_sub_half
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.exp (-s) ≤ 1 - s / 2
proof:
:= by
  have habs : |(-s : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
    linarith
  have htaylor := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le habs
  have hupper : Real.exp (-s) - 1 + s ≤ s ^ 2 := by
    have hleabs : Real.exp (-s) - 1 + s ≤
        |Real.exp (-s) - 1 + s| := le_abs_self _
    have htaylor' : |Real.exp (-s) - 1 + s| ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      have hinside : Real.exp (-s) - 1 - (-s) =
          Real.exp (-s) - 1 + s := by ring
      rw [hinside] at htaylor
      have hsquare : (-s) ^ 2 = s ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [hsquare] at htaylor
      exact htaylor
    exact hleabs.trans htaylor'
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hs), sq_nonneg s]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSTail_le_half_log2_sub_gap
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSTail_le_half_log2_sub_gap
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x) /
          (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - 2) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 -
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)
proof:
:= by
  have hsSmall : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    have hzero : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, zero_div] using
        (tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero.comp
          (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).div_const (Real.sqrt J)
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 hzero).2 (1 / 2 : ℝ) (by norm_num)).mono
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base J hJ,
      eventually_log3_add_two_le_fixedBFPSNatPhase J hJ, hsSmall,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos]
      with x hPupper hden hsSmall hL2 hL3
  let s : ℝ := fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := div_nonneg
    (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _) hsqrt.le
  have hPA : fixedBFPSNatPhase J x ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) - s := by
    simpa only [s] using hPupper
  have hdenPos : 0 < fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - 2 := by
    linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x) ≤
      Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ) - s) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hPA
  have hexpA := fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3
  have hlinear := exp_neg_le_one_sub_half hs0 hsSmall
  calc
    Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x) /
          (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - 2) ≤
        Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ) - s) /
          (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hexp hdenPos.le
    _ ≤ Real.exp (scaleA (x : ℝ) - s) / log3 (x : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_pos _).le hL3
        (by linarith)
    _ = (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2) * Real.exp (-s) := by
      rw [show scaleA (x : ℝ) - s = scaleA (x : ℝ) + (-s) by ring,
        Real.exp_add, hexpA]
      field_simp [hL3.ne']
    _ ≤ (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2) * (1 - s / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlinear (div_nonneg hL2.le (by norm_num))
    _ = log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 -
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) := by
      dsimp [s]
      unfold fixedBFPSPhaseGap
      simp only [log2_eq]
      field_simp [hsqrt.ne']
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_eq
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_eq

          (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - 2)

    fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant fixedBFPSNatPhase

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary_div_phaseGap_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary_div_phaseGap_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary J x / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconstant : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hmiddle := tendsto_fixedBFPSMiddle_div_phaseGap_zero J hJ
  have hendpoint : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
        ((fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x)) /
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / 2)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_expPhase_div_phaseGap_zero J hJ).div_const 2
    simpa only [zero_div, mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul h
  have hsum := (hconstant.add hmiddle).add hendpoint
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) +
        (Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2) *
          Real.log (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x / 2)) /
            fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          ((fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x)) /
            fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / 2)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add, add_zero] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_pos] with x hgap
  unfold fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary
  field_simp [hgap.ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_le
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent (fixedRankNatY J x)
          (fixedBFPSDelta J x) - Real.log (1 / fixedBFPSDelta J x) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hauxRatio : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary J x / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) ≤
        1 / (8 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    have hlt := (tendsto_order.1
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary_div_phaseGap_zero J hJ)).2
        (1 / (8 * Real.sqrt J)) (by positivity)
    exact hlt.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hgapLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      8 * Real.sqrt J ≤
        fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    (tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_div_sqrt_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (8 * Real.sqrt J)
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedBFPSTail_le_half_log2_sub_gap J hJ,
      hauxRatio, hgapLarge,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_pos] with x htail haux hgapLarge hL2 hgap
  have haux' : fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary J x ≤
      fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hgap).mp haux
    calc
      fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary J x ≤
          1 / (8 * Real.sqrt J) * fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) := hmul
      _ = fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) := by ring
  have hgapSqrt : Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ≤
      fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    have hsqrtL2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
    have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hsqrtL2).mp hgapLarge
    have hden : 0 < 8 * Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := mul_pos (by norm_num) hsqrtJ
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).2
    nlinarith
  rw [fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_eq]
  calc
    fixedBFPSSharpAuxiliary J x +
        Real.exp (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x) /
          (fixedBFPSNatPhase J x - 2) ≤
      fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) +
        (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 -
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) :=
      add_le_add haux' htail
    _ ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) +
            (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 -
              fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) =
          log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 -
            fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) := by
              field_simp [hsqrtJ.ne']
              ring
        _ ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
          sub_le_sub_left hgapSqrt _

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_bfpsFixedShellCount_fixedRankNatY_le_two_log2
statement:
theorem eventually_log_bfpsFixedShellCount_fixedRankNatY_le_two_log2
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x) : ℝ) ≤
        2 * log2 (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoHalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    exact (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 0.6931471803).trans
      Real.log_two_gt_d9.le
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_scaleA_le_log2,
      (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1]
      with x hY hL hA hL2 hAL2 hL2one
  have hL2one' : 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hL2one
  have hL2L : log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    change Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hL]
  have hAL : scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := hAL2.trans hL2L
  have hGleL : scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [scaleG_eq]
    have hprod : scaleL (x : ℝ) * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤
        scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [pow_two] using
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAL hL.le)
    calc
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) * scaleA (x : ℝ)) ≤
          Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hprod
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) := by rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hL]
  have hsqrtJ : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
    exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hTleG : fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankT
    exact div_le_self (scaleG_nonneg _) hsqrtJ
  have hlogY : Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) :=
    log_fixedRankNatY_le_fixedRankT (by omega)
  have hlogY0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x by omega))
  have hdiv : Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤
      2 * Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogTwoPos).2
    have hone : 1 ≤ 2 * Real.log 2 := by linarith
    have := le_mul_of_one_le_right hlogY0 hone
    nlinarith
  have hcount : (bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x) : ℝ) ≤
      2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x) : ℝ) ≤
          Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) / Real.log 2 :=
        fixed_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div _
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.log (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ) := hdiv
      _ ≤ 2 * fixedRankT J (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogY (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTleG (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGleL (by norm_num)
  by_cases hK : bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x) = 0
  · rw [hK]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, Real.log_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hL2.le
  · have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hK
    have htwoLpos : 0 < 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := mul_pos (by norm_num) hL
    calc
      Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x) : ℝ) ≤
          Real.log (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hKpos hcount
      _ = Real.log 2 + log2 (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hL.ne']
        rfl
      _ ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
        have hlogTwoLe : Real.log 2 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by
          exact (Real.log_two_lt_d9.le.trans
            (by norm_num : (0.6931471808 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).trans hL2one'
        linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget_div_scaleV_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ (1 : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hreal := log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    refine (hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  have hmoderateInside : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (1 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have htwo : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hlog
    have hsum := hone.add htwo
    have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        1 / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
        atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
    apply hsum'.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  have hmoderate : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
        ((1 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hmoderateInside
  have hsqrt : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))
      atTop atTop :=
    (Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log2_atTop).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hdecayRaw :=
    (Real.tendsto_pow_mul_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero 8).comp hsqrt
  have hdecay : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply hdecayRaw.congr'
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
    have hp : Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ^ 8 = log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 := by
      calc
        Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ^ 8 =
            (Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ^ 2) ^ 4 := by ring
        _ = log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [hp]
  have hsharp : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hdecay
  have hsum := hmoderate.add hsharp
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          ((1 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
        (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  unfold fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget
  field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelope_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelope_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope (fixedRankNatY J x) (fixedBFPSDelta J x) ≤
        fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget x
proof:
:= by
  have hquarter : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSDelta J x ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    have hlt := (tendsto_order.1 (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero J hJ)).2
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
    exact hlt.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hlogSix : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log 6 ≤ 2 := by
    have hprod : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log 6) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [zero_mul] using
        (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero J hJ).mul
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Real.log 6)
            atTop (nhds (Real.log 6)))
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 hprod).2 2 (by norm_num)).mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ, hquarter, hlogSix,
      eventually_fixedBFPSNatPhase_le_scaleA_sub_base J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_le J hJ,
      eventually_log_bfpsFixedShellCount_fixedRankNatY_le_two_log2 J hJ,
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSNatPhase_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop 4,
      (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_scaleA_le_log2] with
      x hY hδ hquarter hlogSix hphaseUpper hB hlogCount hPfour hAone
        hL hA hL2 hL3 hAL2
  let P : ℝ := fixedBFPSNatPhase J x
  let B : ℝ := log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))
  have hscalar : bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedBFPSDelta J x) ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x))) +
        (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * P * Real.exp P * Real.exp B := by
    apply bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_phaseScalar hY hδ hquarter hlogSix
    · rfl
    · intro i hi hhigh
      have hHY : bfpsGeometricEndpoint (fixedRankNatY J x) 2 i ≤
          fixedRankNatY J x := Nat.div_le_self _ _
      have hglobal := fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global
        hhigh.1 hHY hδ hquarter hhigh.2
      exact (sub_le_sub_right hglobal _).trans (by simpa only [B] using hB)
  have hbaseNonneg : 0 ≤ fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) :=
    fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := by dsimp only [P]; linarith
  have hPA : P ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
    have hquot : 0 ≤ fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J :=
      div_nonneg hbaseNonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    dsimp only [P]
    linarith
  have hPq : P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := hPA.trans hAL2
  have hL3L2 : log3 (x : ℝ) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hL2]
  have hexpP : Real.exp P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hPA
    rw [fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3] at he
    have hprod : log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [pow_two] using
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL3L2 hL2.le)
    exact he.trans (by nlinarith)
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hexpHalf : Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.exp_half]
    have hexpLog : Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ)) = scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq] using Real.exp_log hL
    rw [hexpLog, scaleG_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hL.le
      (by simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hAone)
  have hAV : scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) = scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hexpB : Real.exp B ≤
      log2 (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
    calc
      Real.exp B = Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        dsimp only [B]
        rw [show log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) =
          log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 + (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) by ring,
          Real.exp_add]
      _ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexpHalf (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = (scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by rw [hAV]
      _ ≤ (log2 (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAL2 hV.le) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hpoly : P * Real.exp P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      P * Real.exp P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hPq hexpP (Real.exp_pos _).le hL2.le
      _ = log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
  have hsharp : (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * P * Real.exp P * Real.exp B ≤
      (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) *
          scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) := by positivity
    calc
      (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * P * Real.exp P * Real.exp B =
          (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * (P * Real.exp P) * Real.exp B := by ring
      _ ≤ (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) *
            Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly hcoef) hexpB
          (Real.exp_pos _).le
          (mul_nonneg hcoef (pow_nonneg hL2.le _))
      _ = (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) *
            scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
  have hmoderate : fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
        (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount (fixedRankNatY J x))) ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant * (1 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith)
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant_nonneg
  unfold fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget
  exact hscalar.trans (add_le_add hmoderate hsharp)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget_div_scaleV_zero (C : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hterminal : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hscaled : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      C * (fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget x / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul
      tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget_div_scaleV_zero
  have hsum := hterminal.add hscaled
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        C * (fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget x / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  unfold fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget
  field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ W : ℕ,
      fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W (fixedRankNatY J x)
          (fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x) C ≤
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x
proof:
:= by
  have hquarter : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSDelta J x ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    have hlt := (tendsto_order.1 (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero J hJ)).2
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
    exact hlt.mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hbase : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have hprod : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        fixedBFPSDelta J x * Real.log 2) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [zero_mul] using
        (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero J hJ).mul
          (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2)
            atTop (nhds (Real.log 2)))
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 hprod).2 1 (by norm_num)).mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ, hquarter, hbase,
      eventually_fixedBFPSClampedExponent_eq J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelope_le_budget J hJ] with
      x hY hδ hquarter hbase hclamp henvelope
  intro W
  rw [hclamp]
  have hfinite := fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_phaseEnvelope
    (X := W) (Y := fixedRankNatY J x) (δ := fixedBFPSDelta J x)
      (C := C) hY hδ hquarter hbase hC
  unfold fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget
  exact hfinite.trans (add_le_add le_rfl
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henvelope hC))

name: RankAmplification.log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_sqrt_mul_scaleG
statement:
theorem log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_sqrt_mul_scaleG
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hY : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x) :
    Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hY) hfloor
  rw [log_fixedRankUpperY (x : ℝ) hJ] at hlog
  exact hlog

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_fixedLowRankProductSplit_le
statement:
theorem eventually_log_fixedLowRankProductSplit_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (fixedLowRankProductSplit J x : ℝ) ≤
        (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
          scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hY hL hA hL2
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hJreal : 0 < (J : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hJreal
  have hsqrtL2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hden : 0 < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos hJreal hsqrtJ) hsqrtL2
  have hu : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
      fixedLowRankTailRankScale J (x : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hV.le hden.le)
  have hlogUpper : Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_sqrt_mul_scaleG hJ (by omega)
  have hlogUpper0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x by omega))
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hweighted : (J : ℝ) * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hmul : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedLowRankTailRankScale J (x : ℝ) *
        (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul hu hlogUpper hlogUpper0
        (div_nonneg hV.le hden.le)
    have hmulJ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul hJreal.le
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
        (J : ℝ) * (fixedLowRankTailRankScale J (x : ℝ) *
          (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) := by
            simpa only [mul_assoc] using hmulJ
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
        unfold fixedLowRankTailRankScale
        calc
          (J : ℝ) *
              (scaleV (x : ℝ) /
                ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) *
                  (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) =
            (scaleG (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
              Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
                field_simp [hJreal.ne', hsqrtJ.ne', hsqrtL2.ne']
          _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
            rw [scaleG_mul_scaleV hG.ne']
  have hcodePos : 0 < fixedLowRankTailCode J x := by
    unfold fixedLowRankTailCode
    exact pow_pos (by omega) _
  have hatomLe : (fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (fixedLowRankTailCode J x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedLowRankAtomCutoff
    exact_mod_cast (show fixedLowRankTailCode J x + 1 ≤
      2 * fixedLowRankTailCode J x by omega)
  have hatomPos : (0 : ℝ) < fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_succ (fixedLowRankTailCode J x)
  have hlogAtom : Real.log (fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log 2 +
        (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) := by
    have hmono := Real.log_le_log hatomPos hatomLe
    calc
      Real.log (fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x : ℝ) ≤
          Real.log (2 * (fixedLowRankTailCode J x : ℝ)) := hmono
      _ = Real.log 2 + Real.log (fixedLowRankTailCode J x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
        exact_mod_cast hcodePos.ne'
      _ = Real.log 2 +
          (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
            Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) := by
        unfold fixedLowRankTailCode
        rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hmulLog := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogAtom hJreal.le
  calc
    Real.log (fixedLowRankProductSplit J x : ℝ) =
        (J : ℝ) * Real.log (fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x : ℝ) := by
      unfold fixedLowRankProductSplit
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
    _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * (Real.log 2 +
        (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)) := hmulLog
    _ = (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
        (J : ℝ) * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
        scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      by linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_two_mul_fixedLowRankProductSplit_le
statement:
theorem eventually_two_mul_fixedLowRankProductSplit_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 2 * fixedLowRankProductSplit J x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrtLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      4 ≤ Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log2_atTop).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 4
  have hLLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      4 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 2) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (4 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 2))
  filter_upwards [eventually_log_fixedLowRankProductSplit_le J hJ,
      hsqrtLarge, hLLarge,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hlogH hsqrtLarge hLLarge hL hL2
  let H := fixedLowRankProductSplit J x
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedLowRankProductSplit fixedLowRankAtomCutoff
    positivity
  have hsqrtPos : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hdiv : scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le (by norm_num) hsqrtLarge
  have hlogHhalf : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
    dsimp only [H]
    calc
      Real.log (fixedLowRankProductSplit J x : ℝ) ≤
          (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
            scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := hlogH
      _ ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 :=
        by simpa only [add_comm] using
          (add_le_add_left hdiv ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2))
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
        have hsum : (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 2 ≤
            scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 := by nlinarith [hLLarge]
        have hJpart : (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 := by
          exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).le).trans hsum
        linarith
  have hlogTwoH : Real.log (2 * (H : ℝ)) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (by exact_mod_cast hHpos.ne')]
    have hsum : (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 2 ≤
        scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 := by nlinarith [hLLarge]
    have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 :=
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg J) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).le)).trans hsum
    linarith
  have hcast : (2 * H : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by
    have hleft : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * H := by positivity
    have hright : (0 : ℝ) < x := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < x := by
        exact (Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg x)).mp
          (by simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hL)
      positivity
    have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogTwoH
    rw [Real.exp_log hleft, scaleL_eq, Real.exp_log hright] at hexp
    exact_mod_cast hexp
  exact_mod_cast hcast

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedBFPSQuotientLogGap_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedBFPSQuotientLogGap_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ W : ℕ,
      x / fixedLowRankProductSplit J x ≤ W → W ≤ x →
      scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W ≤ fixedBFPSQuotientLogBudget J x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_two_mul_fixedLowRankProductSplit_le J hJ,
      eventually_log_fixedLowRankProductSplit_le J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x htwoH hlogH hL hL2
  intro W hWlow _hWhigh
  let H := fixedLowRankProductSplit J x
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedLowRankProductSplit fixedLowRankAtomCutoff
    positivity
  have hquotTwo : 2 ≤ x / H := by
    apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hHpos).2
    simpa only [H] using htwoH
  have hWlowH : x / H ≤ W := by simpa only [H] using hWlow
  have hWpos : 0 < W := by omega
  have hxlt : x < (x / H + 1) * H := by
    calc
      x = H * (x / H) + x % H := (Nat.div_add_mod x H).symm
      _ < H * (x / H) + H := Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mod_lt x hHpos) _
      _ = (x / H + 1) * H := by ring
  have hcoef : x / H + 1 ≤ 2 * (x / H) := by omega
  have hxle : x ≤ 2 * W * H := by
    have hfirst : (x / H + 1) * H ≤ (2 * (x / H)) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H hcoef
    have hsecond : (2 * (x / H)) * H ≤ (2 * W) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hWlowH)
    omega
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by
    have hxone : (1 : ℝ) < x :=
      (Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg x)).mp
        (by simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hL)
    positivity
  have hWreal : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hWpos
  have hHreal : (0 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast hHpos
  have hxcast : (x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hxle
  have hlogAmbient : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [scaleL_eq] using Real.log_le_log hxpos hxcast
  have hgap : scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W ≤
      Real.log 2 + Real.log H := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne')
      hHreal.ne', Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne'] at hlogAmbient
    linarith
  have hlogH' : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [H] using hlogH
  unfold fixedBFPSQuotientLogBudget
  exact hgap.trans (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_mul_quotientLogBudget_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_mul_quotientLogBudget_div_scaleV_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedBFPSQuotientLogBudget J x /
        scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let cJ : ℝ := Real.log 2 + (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2
  have hconstDiv : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ cJ / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * (cJ / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_zero J hJ).mul hconstDiv
  have hAGsmallRaw := scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_log2.mul_isBigO
    (isBigO_refl scaleV atTop)
  have hGsmall : scaleG =o[atTop]
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x) * scaleV x) := by
    apply hAGsmallRaw.congr'
    · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
      exact scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le (scaleG_pos hL hA).ne'
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      rfl
  have hshiftSmall : fixedBFPSShiftedRate J =o[atTop]
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x) * scaleV x) :=
    (fixedBFPSShiftedRate_isBigO_scaleG J hJ).trans_isLittleO hGsmall
  have hmainReal : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦
      fixedBFPSShiftedRate J x /
        (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * scaleV x)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hshiftSmall.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hmainNat : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x *
          (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) /
        scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hcomp := hmainReal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    apply hcomp.congr'
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hL hL2 hV
    unfold fixedBFPSDelta
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    field_simp [hL.ne', (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne', hV.ne']
  have hsum := hconst.add hmainNat
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSDelta J x * (cJ / scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
        fixedBFPSDelta J x *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) /
          scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  unfold fixedBFPSQuotientLogBudget
  dsimp only [cJ]
  field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSTruncatedRemainder_le_abel
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSTruncatedRemainder_le_abel
    {J x W : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    fixedBFPSTruncatedRemainder J C x W ≤
      fixedBFPSAbelRemainder J C x W
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSTruncatedRemainder fixedBFPSAbelRemainder
  exact add_le_add (add_le_add le_rfl le_rfl) <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (fixedBFPSTruncatedPredecessorMajorant_le_abel W (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x) hC)
      (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_eq_saddle_add_remainder
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_eq_saddle_add_remainder
    {J x W : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hL : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≠ 0)
    (hclamp : fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x = 1 - fixedBFPSDelta J x) :
    fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent W (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x) C =
      -fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
        fixedBFPSTruncatedRemainder J C x W
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel := fixedBFPSDelta_mul_scaleL (J := J) hL
  unfold fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent fixedBFPSTruncatedRemainder
  rw [hclamp]
  unfold fixedBFPSShiftedRate at hcancel
  ring_nf at hcancel ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedBFPSUnconditionalAbelError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedBFPSUnconditionalAbelError_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) (C : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fixedBFPSUnconditionalAbelError J C) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hslack : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ fixedBFPSRateSlack J (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine ((tendsto_fixedBFPSRateSlack_zero J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  have hquot :=
    tendsto_fixedBFPSDelta_mul_quotientLogBudget_div_scaleV_zero J hJ
  have hpred : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        (fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget_div_scaleV_zero C)
  have hsum := (hslack.add hquot).add hpred
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSRateSlack J (x : ℝ) +
        fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedBFPSQuotientLogBudget J x /
          scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
          (fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  unfold fixedBFPSUnconditionalAbelError
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankAbelBFPSRemainderDominance_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankAbelBFPSRemainderDominance_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    FixedRankAbelBFPSRemainderDominance J C
      (fixedBFPSUnconditionalAbelError J C)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedBFPSUnconditionalAbelError_zero J hJ C, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedBFPSDelta_pos J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSQuotientLogGap_le_budget J hJ,
      eventually_fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget J hJ hC,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hδ hgap hpred hV
  intro W hWlow hWhigh
  have hquot := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgap W hWlow hWhigh) hδ.le
  have hpred' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpred W)
    (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  unfold fixedBFPSAbelRemainder fixedBFPSUnconditionalAbelError
  calc
    fixedBFPSRateSlack J (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedBFPSDelta J x * (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) +
        smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
          fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W (fixedRankNatY J x)
            (fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x) C ≤
      fixedBFPSRateSlack J (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedBFPSQuotientLogBudget J x +
        smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
          fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add le_rfl hquot) hpred'
    _ = (fixedBFPSRateSlack J (x : ℝ) +
          fixedBFPSDelta J x * fixedBFPSQuotientLogBudget J x /
            scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x / scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
        scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
      field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankTruncatedBFPSRemainderDominance_of_abel
statement:
theorem fixedRankTruncatedBFPSRemainderDominance_of_abel
    {J : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h : FixedRankAbelBFPSRemainderDominance J C ρ) :
    FixedRankTruncatedBFPSRemainderDominance J C ρ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h.2] with x hx
  intro W hWlow hWhigh
  exact (fixedBFPSTruncatedRemainder_le_abel hC).trans
    (hx W hWlow hWhigh)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankTruncatedBFPSExponentDominance_of_remainder
statement:
theorem fixedRankTruncatedBFPSExponentDominance_of_remainder
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {C : ℝ} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h : FixedRankTruncatedBFPSRemainderDominance J C ρ) :
    FixedRankTruncatedBFPSExponentDominance J C ρ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
  have hL : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos
  filter_upwards [h.2, hL, eventually_fixedBFPSClampedExponent_eq J hJ] with
      x hx hLx hclamp
  intro W hWlow hWhigh
  rw [fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent_eq_saddle_add_remainder hLx.ne' hclamp]
  exact add_le_add le_rfl (hx W hWlow hWhigh)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeHypothesis_of_truncatedDominance
statement:
theorem fixedRankSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeHypothesis_of_truncatedDominance
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hmass : BFPSTwoAffine.GrowingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound κ)
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hdominance : FixedRankTruncatedBFPSExponentDominance J
      (BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataSelbergGrowingCutoff hκ hmass).sieveConstant ρ) :
    FixedRankSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeHypothesis J ρ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hdominance.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hdominance.2, eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ] with
      x hx hY
  intro W hWlow hWhigh
  by_cases hWzero : W = 0
  · subst W
    simp [smoothTotientCount, smoothTotientSet]
  · have hWpos : 0 < W := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hWzero
    let data := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataSelbergGrowingCutoff hκ hmass
    have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSTruncatedExponent
      (X := W) (Y := fixedRankNatY J x)
      (c := fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x) (C := data.sieveConstant)
      hWpos hY (fixedBFPSClampedExponent_pos J x)
      (half_le_fixedBFPSClampedExponent J x)
      data.sieveConstant_nonneg data.hasTwoAffineSieveBound
    exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hx W hWlow hWhigh)) (Nat.cast_nonneg W)

statement:
