name: RankAmplification.mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet {x h y n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y ↔
      n ∈ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y ∧ n ∉ aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [offDiagonalNonsmoothSet]

name: RankAmplification.mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_iff {x h y n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y ↔
      1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ x ∧ n.totient = (n + h).totient ∧
        y < largestPrimeFactor n.totient ∧ ¬IsAboveCutoffDiagonal h y n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet, mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hn, hnx, heq, hcut⟩, hnotDiagonal⟩
    refine ⟨hn, hnx, heq, hcut, ?_⟩
    intro hdiag
    apply hnotDiagonal
    exact mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mpr ⟨hn, hnx, hdiag⟩
  · rintro ⟨hn, hnx, heq, hcut, hnotDiagonal⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hn, hnx, heq, hcut⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hmem
    exact hnotDiagonal (mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mp hmem).2.2

name: RankAmplification.diagonalSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet
statement:
theorem diagonalSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet (x h y : ℕ) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h y ⊆ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y
proof:
:=
  aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet (x h y : ℕ) :
    offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y ⊆ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sdiff_subset

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_disjoint_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_disjoint_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet (x h y : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h y) (offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y)
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.disjoint_sdiff

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_union_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_union_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet (x h y : ℕ) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h y ∪ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y =
      nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset (diagonalSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y)

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount
statement:
theorem nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount
    (x h y : ℕ) :
    nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y =
      aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y + offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsmoothShiftedCount,
    ← aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_union_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_disjoint_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y),
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount, offDiagonalNonsmoothCount]

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothShiftedCount_sub_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount
statement:
theorem nonsmoothShiftedCount_sub_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount (x h y : ℕ) :
    nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y - aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y =
      offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsmoothShiftedCount, aboveCutoffDiagonalCount, offDiagonalNonsmoothCount,
    offDiagonalNonsmoothSet]
  exact (Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset
    (diagonalSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y)).symm

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmooth_cardinality_equation
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonsmooth_cardinality_equation (x h y : ℕ) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y ≤ nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y ∧
      0 ≤ nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y - aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y ∧
      nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y - aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y =
        offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y, Nat.zero_le _,
    nonsmoothShiftedCount_sub_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y⟩

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_le_nonsmoothShiftedCount
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_le_nonsmoothShiftedCount (x h y : ℕ) :
    offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y ≤ nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_le_card (offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y)

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_subset_atLeastRankShiftedSet_one
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_subset_atLeastRankShiftedSet_one
    {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y ⊆ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy]
  exact offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_subset_nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_union_offDiagonal_eq_atLeastRankShiftedSet_one
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_union_offDiagonal_eq_atLeastRankShiftedSet_one
    {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h y ∪ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y =
      atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h y ∪ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y =
        nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y :=
      aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_union_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y
    _ = atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y 1 :=
      (atLeastRankShiftedSet_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy).symm

name: RankAmplification.atLeastRankShiftedCount_one_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem atLeastRankShiftedCount_one_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonal
    {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y 1 =
      aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y + offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  rw [atLeastRankShiftedCount_one_eq_nonsmoothShiftedCount hy,
    nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount]

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_le_atLeastRankShiftedCount_one
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_le_atLeastRankShiftedCount_one
    {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y ≤ atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y 1
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_le_card (offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_subset_atLeastRankShiftedSet_one hy)

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.isAboveCutoffDiagonal_of_isDiagonal
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.isAboveCutoffDiagonal_of_isDiagonal {h n p y : ℕ}
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (hp : p.Prime) (hdiag : s.IsDiagonal)
    (hcut : y < largestPrimeFactor n.totient) :
    IsAboveCutoffDiagonal h y n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hrepresentation⟩ := s.exists_diagonalRepresentation hp hdiag hcut
  exact ⟨s.m1, r, hrepresentation⟩

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_of_isDiagonal
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_of_isDiagonal
    {x h n p y : ℕ} (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hdiag : s.IsDiagonal) (hnonsmooth : n ∈ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y) :
    n ∈ aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  have hnData := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp hnonsmooth
  apply mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mpr
  exact ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.1,
    s.isAboveCutoffDiagonal_of_isDiagonal hp hdiag hnData.2.2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.not_mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_of_isDiagonal
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.not_mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_of_isDiagonal
    {x h n p y : ℕ} (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hdiag : s.IsDiagonal) :
    n ∉ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  intro hn
  have hnData := mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet.mp hn
  exact hnData.2 (s.mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_of_isDiagonal hp hdiag hnData.1)

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.not_isDiagonal_of_mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.not_isDiagonal_of_mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet
    {x h n p y : ℕ} (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hn : n ∈ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y) :
    ¬s.IsDiagonal

:= by
  intro hdiag
  exact s.not_mem_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_of_isDiagonal hp hdiag hn

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.not_isDiagonal_of_odd
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.not_isDiagonal_of_odd {h n p : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) :

  simpa only [LargePrimeSkeleton.IsDiagonal] using s.normalized_slopes_ne hodd

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet_of_odd

theorem offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet_of_odd
    {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_eq_nonsmoothShiftedCount_of_odd

theorem offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_eq_nonsmoothShiftedCount_of_odd
    {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :

name: RankAmplification.mem_section5PrimeRange
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_section5PrimeRange {x y p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y ↔
      y < p ∧ p ≤ (section5Ambient x y).sqrt ∧ p.Prime
proof:
:= by
  simp [section5PrimeRange, squareSourcePrimeRange, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange {x y p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y ↔
      p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y ∧ p ≤ y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [section5IntermediatePrimeRange]

name: RankAmplification.mem_section5UpperPrimeRange
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_section5UpperPrimeRange {x y p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ section5UpperPrimeRange x y ↔
      p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y ∧ y ^ 2 < p
proof:
:= by
  simp [section5UpperPrimeRange]

name: RankAmplification.smoothMultiplierB4Sum_eq_intermediate_add_upper
statement:
theorem smoothMultiplierB4Sum_eq_intermediate_add_upper (x y : ℕ) :
    smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y =
      smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x y + smoothMultiplierB4Upper x y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [smoothMultiplierB4Sum, smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate,
    smoothMultiplierB4Upper, section5IntermediatePrimeRange,
    section5UpperPrimeRange, not_le] using
      (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (section5PrimeRange x y)
        (fun p ↦ p ≤ y ^ 2)
        (fun p ↦ finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p))).symm

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola (R X : ℕ) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤ (X : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X = ((smoothFactorPairSet R X).card : ℝ) :=
      (card_smoothFactorPairSet_cast_eq R X).symm
    _ ≤ ((cofactorPairSet X).card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_le (cofactorPairSet X) fun k : ℕ × ℕ ↦
        IsSmooth R (k.1 * k.2)
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log X) := card_cofactorPairSet_cast_le X

name: RankAmplification.sum_smoothProviderPairMajorant_eq_reciprocal_add_B4
statement:
theorem sum_smoothProviderPairMajorant_eq_reciprocal_add_B4 (x y : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y,
      smoothProviderPairMajorant x p (section5LocalCutoff x y p)) =
      (x : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y,
        smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) +
      smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [smoothProviderPairMajorant_eq]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5Intermediate_le
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5Intermediate_le
    {x y p : ℕ} {saving : ℝ}
    (hinput : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
      (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hinput p hp with ⟨hX, hu, huSqrt, herror, hsaving⟩
  have hpPrime : p.Prime := (mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1).2.2
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
        (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-(rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p)) / 2) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_half_u_log_u
        hX hpPrime.two_le hu huSqrt herror
    _ ≤ (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.section5LocalCutoff_cast_le
statement:
theorem section5LocalCutoff_cast_le (x y p : ℕ) :
    (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) ≤
      (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) ≤
        (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) / (p ^ 2 : ℕ) := by
      exact Nat.cast_div_le
    _ = (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.section5_y_le_sqrt_ambient
statement:
theorem section5_y_le_sqrt_ambient {x y : ℕ} (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    y ≤ (section5Ambient x y).sqrt
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_sqrt'.2
  calc
    y ^ 2 = y * y := pow_two y
    _ ≤ x * y := Nat.mul_le_mul_right y hxy
    _ ≤ 2 * (x * y) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    _ = section5Ambient x y := by simp [section5Ambient, mul_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.sum_section5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_section5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le {x y : ℕ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
      (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro p hp
        exact (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
      · intro p _ _
        positivity
    _ ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv hy (section5_y_le_sqrt_ambient hxy)

name: RankAmplification.smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le
statement:
theorem smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le {x y : ℕ} {saving : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hinput : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving) :
    smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x y ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x y ≤
        ∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
          ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving)) *
            ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      calc
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
            (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) :=
          finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5Intermediate_le hinput hp
        _ ≤ ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
            Real.exp (-saving) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x y p)
            (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving)) *
            ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving)) *
        ∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sum_section5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le hy hxy)
      positivity
    _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) := by
      have hyReal : (y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hy.ne'
      simp only [section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5LocalCutoff_le
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5LocalCutoff_le
    {x y p : ℕ} (hambient : 0 < section5Ambient x y) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
      (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
        ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hambientOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ section5Ambient x y := by
    exact_mod_cast hambient
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y) := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg hambientOne
    linarith
  by_cases hcutoff : section5LocalCutoff x y p = 0
  · calc
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
          (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) *
            (1 + Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x y p)) :=
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola p (section5LocalCutoff x y p)
      _ = 0 := by simp [hcutoff]
      _ ≤ (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
          ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  · have hcutoffPos : 0 < section5LocalCutoff x y p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcutoff
    have hcutoffLe : section5LocalCutoff x y p ≤ section5Ambient x y :=
      (Nat.div_le_self _ _)
    have hlogLe : Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
        Real.log (section5Ambient x y) := by
      apply Real.log_le_log
      · exact_mod_cast hcutoffPos
      · exact_mod_cast hcutoffLe
    calc
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
          (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) *
            (1 + Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x y p)) :=
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola p (section5LocalCutoff x y p)
      _ ≤ (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) *
          (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        linarith
      _ ≤ ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
          (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x y p) hfactor
      _ = (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
          ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_section5UpperPrimeRange_inv_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_section5UpperPrimeRange_inv_sq_le {x y : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    (∑ p ∈ section5UpperPrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
      ((y : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyP : y ^ 2 ≤ (section5Ambient x y).sqrt
  · calc
      (∑ p ∈ section5UpperPrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
          ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange (y ^ 2) (section5Ambient x y).sqrt,
            (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        · intro p hp
          have hpData := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
            (mem_section5UpperPrimeRange.mp hp).1
          have hpUpper := (mem_section5UpperPrimeRange.mp hp).2
          exact (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨hpUpper, hpData.2.1⟩,
            hpData.2.2⟩)
        · intro p _ _
          positivity
      _ ≤ ((y ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv (pow_pos hy 2) hyP
      _ = ((y : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by norm_num
  · have hempty : section5UpperPrimeRange x y = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro p hp
      have hpData := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
        (mem_section5UpperPrimeRange.mp hp).1
      have hpUpper := (mem_section5UpperPrimeRange.mp hp).2
      omega
    rw [hempty]
    simp

name: RankAmplification.smoothMultiplierB4Upper_le
statement:
theorem smoothMultiplierB4Upper_le {x y : ℕ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    smoothMultiplierB4Upper x y ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 < x := hy.trans_le hxy
  have hambient : 0 < section5Ambient x y := by
    simp only [section5Ambient]
    positivity
  have hambientOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ section5Ambient x y := by
    exact_mod_cast hambient
  have hfactor : 0 ≤
      (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) := by
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (section5Ambient x y) := Real.log_nonneg hambientOne
    positivity
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Upper x y ≤
        ∑ p ∈ section5UpperPrimeRange x y,
          ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y))) *
            ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      exact finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5LocalCutoff_le hambient
    _ = ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y))) *
        ∑ p ∈ section5UpperPrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ((section5Ambient x y : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y))) *
        ((y : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_section5UpperPrimeRange_inv_sq_le hy) hfactor
    _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      have hyReal : (y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hy.ne'
      simp only [section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.smoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_exp_add_upper
statement:
theorem smoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_exp_add_upper {x y : ℕ} {saving : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hinput : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving) :
    smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) +
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothMultiplierB4Sum_eq_intermediate_add_upper]
  exact add_le_add (smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le hy hxy hinput)
    (smoothMultiplierB4Upper_le hy hxy)

name: RankAmplification.proposition5_1_finite
statement:
theorem proposition5_1_finite {x y : ℕ} {T saving error : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hRankin : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving)
    (hAbsorb : HasSection5B4Absorption x y T saving error) :
    smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T + error)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) +
          2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      smoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_exp_add_upper hy hxy hRankin
    _ = (x : ℝ) *
        (2 * Real.exp (-saving) +
          2 * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by ring
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T + error) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAbsorb (Nat.cast_nonneg x)

name: RankAmplification.proposition5_1_uniform
statement:
theorem proposition5_1_uniform {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} {error : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (huniform : HasProposition5_1Uniformity c₀ C₀ error) :
    ∀ x y T,
      0 < y → y ≤ x →
        IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
        smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T + error x T)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y T hy hxy hcutoff hwindow
  obtain ⟨saving, hRankin, hAbsorb⟩ :=
    huniform x y T hy hxy hcutoff hwindow
  exact proposition5_1_finite hy hxy hRankin hAbsorb

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_eq_min_LA
proof:
:= by
  rw [section5SaddleExponent, scaleG_sq hL hA]

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_at_scaleG
statement:
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem section5SaddleExponent_at_scaleG {X : ℝ} (hG : scaleG X ≠ 0) :
    section5SaddleExponent X (scaleG X) = scaleG X
proof:
:= by
  unfold section5SaddleExponent
  have hquotient : scaleG X ^ 2 / scaleG X = scaleG X := by
    field_simp
  rw [hquotient, min_self]

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_le_scaleG
proof:
:= by
  unfold section5SaddleExponent
  by_cases hTG : T ≤ scaleG X
  · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans hTG
  · have hGT : scaleG X ≤ T := le_of_not_ge hTG
    have hquotient : scaleG X ^ 2 / T ≤ scaleG X := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hT).2
      nlinarith
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans hquotient

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_eq_scaleG_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hGleT : scaleG X ≤ T := by
      calc
        scaleG X = section5SaddleExponent X T := heq.symm
        _ ≤ T := min_le_left _ _
    have hGleQuotient : scaleG X ≤ scaleG X ^ 2 / T := by
      calc
        scaleG X = section5SaddleExponent X T := heq.symm
        _ ≤ scaleG X ^ 2 / T := min_le_right _ _
    have hmul : scaleG X * T ≤ scaleG X ^ 2 :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hT).mp hGleQuotient
    have hTleG : T ≤ scaleG X := by nlinarith
    exact le_antisymm hTleG hGleT
  · rintro rfl
    exact section5SaddleExponent_at_scaleG hG.ne'

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_at_mul_scaleG
statement:
theorem section5SaddleExponent_at_mul_scaleG {X lam : ℝ}
    (hG : scaleG X ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) :
    section5SaddleExponent X (lam * scaleG X) =
      scaleG X * min lam lam⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hquotient : scaleG X ^ 2 / (lam * scaleG X) = scaleG X * lam⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  rw [section5SaddleExponent, hquotient, mul_comm lam (scaleG X)]
  exact (mul_min_of_nonneg lam lam⁻¹ (scaleG_nonneg X)).symm

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_div_two_scaleG_eq_scaleV_div_two
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_div_two_mul_scaleG_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_mem_section5SaddleWindow
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc₀ (scaleG_nonneg X)
  · simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC₀ (scaleG_nonneg X)

name: RankAmplification.proposition5_1_uniform_at_scaleG
statement:
theorem proposition5_1_uniform_at_scaleG {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} {error : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (huniform : HasProposition5_1Uniformity c₀ C₀ error)
    (hc₀ : c₀ ≤ 1) (hC₀ : 1 ≤ C₀)
    {x y : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y (scaleG x)) :
    smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-scaleG x + error x (scaleG x))
proof:
:= by
  exact proposition5_1_uniform huniform x y (scaleG x) hy hxy hcutoff
    (scaleG_mem_section5SaddleWindow hc₀ hC₀)

name: RankAmplification.mem_cofactorPairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cofactorPairSet {X m₁ m₂ : ℕ} :
    (m₁, m₂) ∈ cofactorPairSet X ↔ 1 ≤ m₁ ∧ 1 ≤ m₂ ∧ m₁ * m₂ ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzEq⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hmem
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := z
    simp only [sigmaNatToPair] at hzEq
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hzEq
    have hz' := Finset.mem_sigma.mp hz
    have ha := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hz'.1
    have hb := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hz'.2
    exact ⟨ha.1, hb.1, by
      rw [mul_comm, ← Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le ha.1]
      exact hb.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hm₁, hm₂, hprod⟩
    have hm₁X : m₁ ≤ X := by
      calc
        m₁ = m₁ * 1 := (Nat.mul_one m₁).symm
        _ ≤ m₁ * m₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m₁ hm₂
        _ ≤ X := hprod
    apply Finset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨m₁, m₂⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm₁, hm₁X⟩, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm₂, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hm₁, mul_comm]
    exact hprod

name: RankAmplification.card_cofactorPairSet_eq_sum_div
statement:
theorem card_cofactorPairSet_eq_sum_div (X : ℕ) :
    (cofactorPairSet X).card = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, X / m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [cofactorPairSet, Finset.card_map, cofactorPairSigma, Finset.card_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  simp [Nat.card_Icc]

name: RankAmplification.real_harmonic_sum_le
statement:
theorem real_harmonic_sum_le (X : ℕ) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, (m : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 + Real.log X
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_natCast,
    Rat.cast_ofNat] using harmonic_le_one_add_log X

name: RankAmplification.card_cofactorPairSet_cast_le
statement:
theorem card_cofactorPairSet_cast_le (X : ℕ) :
    ((cofactorPairSet X).card : ℝ) ≤ X * (1 + Real.log X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_cofactorPairSet_eq_sum_div, Nat.cast_sum]
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, ((X / m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, (X : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      have hcast := Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := m)
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hcast
    _ = (X : ℝ) * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log X) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (real_harmonic_sum_le X) (Nat.cast_nonneg X)

name: RankAmplification.card_skeletonNumbers_le_cofactor_bound
statement:
theorem card_skeletonNumbers_le_cofactor_bound {h X : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (x : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (x : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h x.1 (provider x))
    (hsmall : ∀ x, (skeleton x).m1 * (skeleton x).m2 ≤ X) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ X * (1 + Real.log X)
proof:
:= by
  let imagePairs := S.attach.image fun x ↦ ((skeleton x).m1, (skeleton x).m2)
  have hsubset : imagePairs ⊆ cofactorPairSet X := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    exact mem_cofactorPairSet.mpr
      ⟨(skeleton x).m1_pos, (skeleton x).m2_pos, hsmall x⟩
  have hcard : imagePairs.card ≤ (cofactorPairSet X).card := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  have himage : imagePairs.card = S.card :=
    card_cofactorPair_image_eq hodd S provider skeleton
  rw [himage] at hcard
  exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcard).trans (card_cofactorPairSet_cast_le X)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.ne_zero
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q : ℚ} (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q) : q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab | hab⟩ := hq
  · have haCast : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha.ne_zero
    have hbCast : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne_zero
    exact haCast (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hab.symm |>.resolve_right hbCast)
  · have haCast : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha.ne_zero
    have hbCast : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne_zero
    have hzero : (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) = 0 := by linarith
    exact haCast (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero |>.resolve_right hbCast)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.sameSupportRationalPair_isSolution
statement:
theorem sameSupportRationalPair_isSolution
    {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution (primeSupport h)
      (sameSupportRationalPair h j).1 (sameSupportRationalPair h j).2
proof:
:= by
  have hhUnit := shift_isPrimeSupportUnit hh
  refine ⟨IsRationalSUnit.of_nat_div
      (sameSupport_right_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame) hhUnit,
    IsRationalSUnit.neg_of_nat_div
      (sameSupport_left_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame) hhUnit, ?_⟩
  unfold sameSupportRationalPair
  simp only
  have hhCast : (h : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hh.ne'
  field_simp [hhCast]
  norm_cast
  omega

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.sameSupportRationalPair_injective
statement:
theorem sameSupportRationalPair_injective {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    Function.Injective (sameSupportRationalPair h)
proof:
:= by
  intro j k hjk
  have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd hjk
  unfold sameSupportRationalPair at hsnd
  simp only at hsnd
  have hhCast : (h : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hh.ne'
  field_simp [hhCast] at hsnd
  norm_num at hsnd
  exact_mod_cast hsnd

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rationalPairIndex_sameSupportRationalPair
statement:
theorem rationalPairIndex_sameSupportRationalPair
    {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    rationalPairIndex h (sameSupportRationalPair h j) = j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rationalPairIndex
  split
  · rename_i hz
    exact sameSupportRationalPair_injective hh (Classical.choose_spec hz)
  · rename_i hz
    exact (hz ⟨j, rfl⟩).elim

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromRational
statement:
theorem isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromRational
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {U : Finset (ℚ × ℚ)}
    (hU : IsRationalSUnitEquationCarrier (primeSupport h) U) :
    IsSameSupportCarrier h (sameSupportCarrierFromRational h U)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro j
  constructor
  · intro hj
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
  · intro hsame
    rw [sameSupportCarrierFromRational, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨sameSupportRationalPair h j, ?_, ?_⟩, hsame⟩
    · exact (hU _ _).mpr (sameSupportRationalPair_isSolution hh hsame)
    · exact rationalPairIndex_sameSupportRationalPair hh

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_quantitativeRationalSUnitEquation
statement:
theorem terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_quantitativeRationalSUnitEquation
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hE : QuantitativeRationalSUnitEquationTheorem) :
    TerminalPPTSameSupportBound h
proof:
:= by
  have hprime : ∀ p ∈ primeSupport h, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hcard⟩ := hE (primeSupport h) hprime
  refine ⟨sameSupportCarrierFromRational h U,
    isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromRational hh hU, ?_⟩
  exact (card_sameSupportCarrierFromRational_le h U).trans
    (by simpa [rationalSUnitEquationBound_primeSupport] using hcard)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.rationalPrimeOrder_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.rationalPrimeOrder_eq_zero_of_not_mem
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q : ℚ} (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpS : p ∉ S) :
    rationalPrimeOrder p q = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab | hab⟩ := hq
  all_goals
    have hpa : ¬p ∣ a := by
      intro hpa
      exact hpS (ha.2 (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hpa, ha.ne_zero⟩))
    have hpb : ¬p ∣ b := by
      intro hpb
      exact hpS (hb.2 (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hpb, hb.ne_zero⟩))
    have hva : padicValRat p (a : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simp only [padicValRat.of_nat]
      exact_mod_cast padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hpa
    have hvb : padicValRat p (b : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simp only [padicValRat.of_nat]
      exact_mod_cast padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hpb
    have haCast : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha.ne_zero
    have hbCast : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne_zero
  · rw [hab, rationalPrimeOrder, padicValRat.div haCast hbCast, hva, hvb, sub_zero]
  · rw [hab, rationalPrimeOrder, padicValRat.neg,
      padicValRat.div haCast hbCast, hva, hvb, sub_zero]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.rationalPrimeNorm_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.rationalPrimeNorm_eq_one_of_not_mem
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q : ℚ} (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpS : p ∉ S) :
    rationalPrimeNorm p q = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hv : padicValRat p q = 0 := by
    simpa only [rationalPrimeOrder] using
      hq.rationalPrimeOrder_eq_zero_of_not_mem hp hpS
  simp [rationalPrimeNorm, padicNorm, hq.ne_zero, hv]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsPrimeSupportUnit.eq_prod_factorization
statement:
theorem IsPrimeSupportUnit.eq_prod_factorization
    {S : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : IsPrimeSupportUnit S n) :
    n = ∏ p ∈ S, p ^ n.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  calc
    n = n.factorization.prod (fun p e ↦ p ^ e) :=
      (Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn.ne_zero).symm
    _ = ∏ p ∈ S, p ^ n.factorization p :=
      Finsupp.prod_of_support_subset n.factorization hn.2 (fun p e ↦ p ^ e)
        (by simp)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsPrimeSupportUnit.cast_eq_prod_factorization
statement:
theorem IsPrimeSupportUnit.cast_eq_prod_factorization
    {S : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : IsPrimeSupportUnit S n) :
    (n : ℚ) = ∏ p : S, (p.1 : ℚ) ^ n.factorization p.1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (n : ℚ) = ((∏ p ∈ S, p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast IsPrimeSupportUnit.eq_prod_factorization hn
    _ = ∏ p ∈ S, (p : ℚ) ^ n.factorization p := by push_cast; rfl
    _ = ∏ p : S, (p.1 : ℚ) ^ n.factorization p.1 := by
      change (∏ p ∈ S, (p : ℚ) ^ n.factorization p) =
        ∏ p ∈ S.attach, (p.1 : ℚ) ^ n.factorization p.1
      simpa using
        (Finset.prod_attach S (fun p ↦ (p : ℚ) ^ n.factorization p)).symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rationalMonomial_exponentVector_nat_div
statement:
theorem rationalMonomial_exponentVector_nat_div
    {S : Finset ℕ} {a b : ℕ}
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    (ha : IsPrimeSupportUnit S a) (hb : IsPrimeSupportUnit S b) :
    rationalMonomial S (rationalExponentVector S ((a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ))) =
      (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have haCast : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha.ne_zero
  have hbCast : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne_zero
  have hexponent (p : S) :
      rationalExponentVector S ((a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) p =
        (a.factorization p.1 : ℤ) - b.factorization p.1 := by
    letI : Fact p.1.Prime := ⟨hS p.1 p.2⟩
    rw [rationalExponentVector, rationalPrimeOrder,
      padicValRat.div haCast hbCast, padicValRat.of_nat, padicValRat.of_nat,
      ← a.factorization_def (hS p.1 p.2),
      ← b.factorization_def (hS p.1 p.2)]
  simp only [rationalMonomial]
  calc
    (∏ p : S, (p.1 : ℚ) ^ rationalExponentVector S ((a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) p) =
        ∏ p : S, (p.1 : ℚ) ^ a.factorization p.1 /
          (p.1 : ℚ) ^ b.factorization p.1 := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p _hp
      rw [hexponent p, zpow_natCast_sub_natCast₀]
      exact_mod_cast (hS p.1 p.2).ne_zero
    _ = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib,
        ← IsPrimeSupportUnit.cast_eq_prod_factorization ha,
        ← IsPrimeSupportUnit.cast_eq_prod_factorization hb]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.exists_sign_mul_rationalMonomial
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.exists_sign_mul_rationalMonomial
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) {q : ℚ}
    (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧
      q = ε * rationalMonomial S (rationalExponentVector S q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab | hab⟩ := hq
  · refine ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [one_mul, hab]
    exact (rationalMonomial_exponentVector_nat_div hS ha hb).symm
  · refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [hab, neg_one_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [rationalMonomial_exponentVector_neg]
    exact (rationalMonomial_exponentVector_nat_div hS ha hb).symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exponentResidue49_add_mul_quotient
statement:
theorem exponentResidue49_add_mul_quotient
    {S : Finset ℕ} (e : RationalExponentVector S) (p : S) :
    ((exponentResidue49 e p : Fin 49) : ℕ) +
        49 * exponentQuotient49 e p = e p
proof:
:= by
  change (((e p).natMod 49 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 49 * (e p / 49) = e p
  rw [Int.natMod, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ (by norm_num : (49 : ℤ) ≠ 0))]
  exact Int.emod_add_mul_ediv _ _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exponentResidue49_add_quotient_mul
statement:
theorem exponentResidue49_add_quotient_mul
    {S : Finset ℕ} (e : RationalExponentVector S) (p : S) :
    ((exponentResidue49 e p : Fin 49) : ℕ) +
        exponentQuotient49 e p * 49 = e p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact exponentResidue49_add_mul_quotient e p

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rationalMonomial_eq_residue_mul_pow
statement:
theorem rationalMonomial_eq_residue_mul_pow
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    (e : RationalExponentVector S) :
    rationalMonomial S e =
      rationalResidueRepresentative49 S (exponentResidue49 e) *
        rationalMonomial S (exponentQuotient49 e) ^ 49
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalMonomial, rationalResidueRepresentative49, rationalMonomial,
    ← Finset.prod_pow, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p _hp
  have hpCast : (p.1 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hS p.1 p.2).ne_zero
  calc
    (p.1 : ℚ) ^ e p =
        (p.1 : ℚ) ^ (((exponentResidue49 e p : Fin 49) : ℕ) +
          exponentQuotient49 e p * 49 : ℤ) := by
      rw [exponentResidue49_add_quotient_mul]
    _ = (p.1 : ℚ) ^ (((exponentResidue49 e p : Fin 49) : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        (p.1 : ℚ) ^ (exponentQuotient49 e p * 49) := by
      rw [zpow_add₀ hpCast]
    _ = (p.1 : ℚ) ^ ((exponentResidue49 e p : Fin 49) : ℕ) *
        ((p.1 : ℚ) ^ exponentQuotient49 e p) ^ 49 := by
      rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_mul]
      rfl

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_signedResidueRepresentatives49_le
statement:
theorem card_signedResidueRepresentatives49_le (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (signedResidueRepresentatives49 S).card ≤ 2 * 49 ^ S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (signedResidueRepresentatives49 S).card ≤
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Bool × ExponentResidue49 S)).card := by
      exact Finset.card_image_le
    _ = 2 * 49 ^ S.card := by
      simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.exists_mem_signedResidueRepresentatives49_mul_pow
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.exists_mem_signedResidueRepresentatives49_mul_pow
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) {q : ℚ}
    (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q) :
    ∃ r ∈ signedResidueRepresentatives49 S, ∃ z : ℚ, q = r * z ^ 49
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hqε⟩ := hq.exists_sign_mul_rationalMonomial hS
  let e := rationalExponentVector S q
  let rvec := exponentResidue49 e
  let z := rationalMonomial S (exponentQuotient49 e)
  have hsplit : rationalMonomial S e =
      rationalResidueRepresentative49 S rvec * z ^ 49 := by
    exact rationalMonomial_eq_residue_mul_pow hS e
  rcases hε with rfl | rfl
  · refine ⟨signedResidueRepresentative49 S (false, rvec), ?_, z, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(false, rvec), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    · simpa [signedResidueRepresentative49, e, mul_assoc] using hqε.trans
        (congrArg (1 * ·) hsplit)
  · refine ⟨signedResidueRepresentative49 S (true, rvec), ?_, z, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(true, rvec), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    · simpa [signedResidueRepresentative49, e, mul_assoc] using hqε.trans
        (congrArg ((-1 : ℚ) * ·) hsplit)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_signedResidueCarrier49
statement:
theorem exists_signedResidueCarrier49
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) :
    ∃ R : Finset ℚ, R.card ≤ 2 * 49 ^ S.card ∧
      ∀ q : ℚ, IsRationalSUnit S q →
        ∃ r ∈ R, ∃ z : ℚ, q = r * z ^ 49
proof:
:=
  ⟨signedResidueRepresentatives49 S,
    card_signedResidueRepresentatives49_le S,
    fun _q hq ↦ hq.exists_mem_signedResidueRepresentatives49_mul_pow hS⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rationalHeight_div_le
statement:
theorem rationalHeight_div_le (q r : ℚ) :
    rationalHeight (q / r) ≤ rationalHeight q * rationalHeight r
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact (rationalHeight_mul_le q r⁻¹).trans_eq
    (congrArg (rationalHeight q * ·) (rationalHeight_inv r))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_rationalHeight_lt_two
statement:
theorem eq_one_or_neg_one_of_rationalHeight_lt_two
    {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hheight : rationalHeight q < 2) :
    q = 1 ∨ q = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalHeight_eq_max_num_den] at hheight
  have hmax : max q.num.natAbs q.den < 2 := by exact_mod_cast hheight
  have hden : q.den = 1 := by
    have hdenPos := q.den_pos
    have hdenLt : q.den < 2 := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hmax
    omega
  have hnumNe : q.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hq
  have hnumPos : 0 < q.num.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hnumNe
  have hnumLt : q.num.natAbs < 2 := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hmax
  have hnumAbs : q.num.natAbs = 1 := by omega
  have hnum : q.num = 1 ∨ q.num = -1 := by
    omega
  rw [← Rat.coe_int_num_of_den_eq_one hden]
  rcases hnum with hnum | hnum
  · left
    simp [hnum]
  · right
    simp [hnum]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.lowHeightCutoff49_sq_lt_two_pow_49
statement:
theorem lowHeightCutoff49_sq_lt_two_pow_49 :
    lowHeightCutoff49 * lowHeightCutoff49 < (2 : ℝ) ^ 49
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [lowHeightCutoff49, ← pow_add]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rationalHeight_ratio_lt_two_of_common_power49
statement:
theorem rationalHeight_ratio_lt_two_of_common_power49
    {r z₁ z₂ q₁ q₂ : ℚ}
    (hq₁ : q₁ ≠ 0) (hq₂ : q₂ ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : q₁ = r * z₁ ^ 49) (h₂ : q₂ = r * z₂ ^ 49)
    (hheight₁ : rationalHeight q₁ ≤ lowHeightCutoff49)
    (hheight₂ : rationalHeight q₂ ≤ lowHeightCutoff49) :
    rationalHeight (z₁ / z₂) < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro hr
    exact hq₁ (by simp [h₁, hr])
  have hz₁ : z₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz₁
    exact hq₁ (by simp [h₁, hz₁])
  have hz₂ : z₂ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz₂
    exact hq₂ (by simp [h₂, hz₂])
  have hpow : (z₁ / z₂) ^ 49 = q₁ / q₂ := by
    rw [h₁, h₂, div_pow]
    field_simp
  have hheightPow : rationalHeight (z₁ / z₂) ^ 49 < (2 : ℝ) ^ 49 := by
    calc
      rationalHeight (z₁ / z₂) ^ 49 = rationalHeight ((z₁ / z₂) ^ 49) :=
        (rationalHeight_pow (z₁ / z₂) 49).symm
      _ = rationalHeight (q₁ / q₂) := by rw [hpow]
      _ ≤ rationalHeight q₁ * rationalHeight q₂ := rationalHeight_div_le q₁ q₂
      _ ≤ lowHeightCutoff49 * lowHeightCutoff49 :=
        mul_le_mul hheight₁ hheight₂
          (zero_le_one.trans (one_le_rationalHeight q₂))
          (by norm_num [lowHeightCutoff49])
      _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ 49 := lowHeightCutoff49_sq_lt_two_pow_49
  exact (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀
    (zero_le_one.trans (one_le_rationalHeight (z₁ / z₂)))
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by norm_num : (49 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp hheightPow

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.power49_class_pair_eq_or_eq_neg
statement:
theorem power49_class_pair_eq_or_eq_neg
    {r z₁ z₂ q₁ q₂ : ℚ}
    (hq₁ : q₁ ≠ 0) (hq₂ : q₂ ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : q₁ = r * z₁ ^ 49) (h₂ : q₂ = r * z₂ ^ 49)
    (hheight₁ : rationalHeight q₁ ≤ lowHeightCutoff49)
    (hheight₂ : rationalHeight q₂ ≤ lowHeightCutoff49) :
    q₁ = q₂ ∨ q₁ = -q₂
proof:
:= by
  have hz₂ : z₂ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz₂
    exact hq₂ (by simp [h₂, hz₂])
  rcases eq_one_or_neg_one_of_rationalHeight_lt_two
      (div_ne_zero (by
        intro hz₁
        exact hq₁ (by simp [h₁, hz₁])) hz₂)
      (rationalHeight_ratio_lt_two_of_common_power49 hq₁ hq₂ h₁ h₂
        hheight₁ hheight₂) with hratio | hratio
  · left
    have hz : z₁ = z₂ := (div_eq_one_iff_eq hz₂).mp hratio
    subst z₁
    exact h₁.trans h₂.symm
  · right
    have hz : z₁ = -z₂ := by
      have hzMul := (div_eq_iff hz₂).mp hratio
      simpa using hzMul
    rw [h₁, h₂, hz]
    ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_rationalLowHeightBall49
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_rationalLowHeightBall49 {q : ℚ} :
    q ∈ rationalLowHeightBall49 ↔ rationalHeight q ≤ lowHeightCutoff49
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalLowHeightBall49]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_lowPowerClass49
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_lowPowerClass49 {r q : ℚ} :
    q ∈ lowPowerClass49 r ↔
      rationalHeight q ≤ lowHeightCutoff49 ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ z : ℚ, q = r * z ^ 49
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [lowPowerClass49]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_lowPowerClass49_le_two
statement:
theorem card_lowPowerClass49_le_two (r : ℚ) :
    (lowPowerClass49 r).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hempty : lowPowerClass49 r = ∅
  · simp [hempty]
  · obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
    apply (Finset.card_le_card (t := {q₀, -q₀}) ?_).trans Finset.card_le_two
    intro q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    obtain ⟨hqHeight, hqNe, z, hz⟩ := mem_lowPowerClass49.mp hq
    obtain ⟨hq₀Height, hq₀Ne, z₀, hz₀⟩ := mem_lowPowerClass49.mp hq₀
    exact power49_class_pair_eq_or_eq_neg hqNe hq₀Ne hz hz₀ hqHeight hq₀Height

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_lowPowerClassUnion49_le
statement:
theorem card_lowPowerClassUnion49_le (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (lowPowerClassUnion49 S).card ≤ 4 * 49 ^ S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (lowPowerClassUnion49 S).card ≤
        (signedResidueRepresentatives49 S).card * 2 := by
      exact Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul _ _ 2
        (fun r _hr ↦ card_lowPowerClass49_le_two r)
    _ ≤ (2 * 49 ^ S.card) * 2 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 (card_signedResidueRepresentatives49_le S)
    _ = 4 * 49 ^ S.card := by ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.mem_lowPowerClassUnion49
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.mem_lowPowerClassUnion49
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) {q : ℚ}
    (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q)
    (hheight : rationalHeight q ≤ lowHeightCutoff49) :
    q ∈ lowPowerClassUnion49 S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, hr, z, hz⟩ :=
    hq.exists_mem_signedResidueRepresentatives49_mul_pow hS
  exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨r, hr,
    mem_lowPowerClass49.mpr ⟨hheight, hq.ne_zero, z, hz⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.inv
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.inv
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q : ℚ} (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q) :
    IsRationalSUnit S q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab | hab⟩ := hq
  · refine ⟨b, a, hb, ha, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [hab]
    field_simp
  · refine ⟨b, a, hb, ha, Or.inr ?_⟩
    rw [hab]
    field_simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.mul
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.mul
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q r : ℚ}
    (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q) (hr : IsRationalSUnit S r) :
    IsRationalSUnit S (q * r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hq⟩ := hq
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hr⟩ := hr
  have hac : IsPrimeSupportUnit S (a * c) :=
    SUnitTerminal.IsPrimeSupportUnit.mul ha hc
  have hbd : IsPrimeSupportUnit S (b * d) :=
    SUnitTerminal.IsPrimeSupportUnit.mul hb hd
  rcases hq with hq | hq <;> rcases hr with hr | hr
  · refine ⟨a * c, b * d, hac, hbd, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [hq, hr]
    push_cast
    ring
  · refine ⟨a * c, b * d, hac, hbd, Or.inr ?_⟩
    rw [hq, hr]
    push_cast
    ring
  · refine ⟨a * c, b * d, hac, hbd, Or.inr ?_⟩
    rw [hq, hr]
    push_cast
    ring
  · refine ⟨a * c, b * d, hac, hbd, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [hq, hr]
    push_cast
    ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsRationalSUnit.div
statement:
theorem IsRationalSUnit.div
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q r : ℚ}
    (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q) (hr : IsRationalSUnit S r) :
    IsRationalSUnit S (q / r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact hq.mul hr.inv

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rationalEquationPairOfRatio_ratio_of_ne
statement:
theorem rationalEquationPairOfRatio_ratio_of_ne
    {q : ℚ} (hq : q + 1 ≠ 0) :
    (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).1 /
        (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).2 = q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rationalEquationPairOfRatio]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rationalEquationPairOfRatio_eq_of_solution
statement:
theorem rationalEquationPairOfRatio_eq_of_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    rationalEquationPairOfRatio (x / y) = (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := hsol.2.1.ne_zero
  have hratioAdd : x / y + 1 = 1 / y := by
    field_simp
    linarith [hsol.2.2]
  ext <;> simp [rationalEquationPairOfRatio, hratioAdd, hy]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet_le
statement:
theorem card_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet_le (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet S).card ≤ 4 * 49 ^ S.card
proof:
:=
  by
    classical
    exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (card_lowPowerClassUnion49_le S)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.height_le_of_mem_lowPowerClassUnion49
statement:
theorem height_le_of_mem_lowPowerClassUnion49
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q : ℚ} (hq : q ∈ lowPowerClassUnion49 S) :
    rationalHeight q ≤ lowHeightCutoff49
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, _hr, hqr⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hq
  exact (mem_lowPowerClass49.mp hqr).1

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet
    {S : Finset ℕ} {q : ℚ} :
    q ∈ lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet S ↔
      q ∈ lowPowerClassUnion49 S ∧
        IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S
          (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).1
          (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
statement:
theorem mem_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) {x y : ℚ} :
    (x, y) ∈ lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier S ↔
      IsLowHeightRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpair⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxy
    have hqData := mem_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet.mp hq
    have hsol := hqData.2
    have hqAdd : q + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      exact hsol.2.1.ne_zero (by
        simp [rationalEquationPairOfRatio, hzero])
    have hratio := rationalEquationPairOfRatio_ratio_of_ne hqAdd
    have hlow : IsLowHeightRationalSUnitEquationSolution S
        (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).1 (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).2 := ⟨hsol, by
      rw [hratio]
      exact height_le_of_mem_lowPowerClassUnion49 hqData.1⟩
    simpa only [hpair] using hlow
  · rintro ⟨hsol, hheight⟩
    let q := x / y
    have hqUnit : IsRationalSUnit S q := hsol.1.div hsol.2.1
    have hqUnion : q ∈ lowPowerClassUnion49 S :=
      hqUnit.mem_lowPowerClassUnion49 hS hheight
    have hpair : rationalEquationPairOfRatio q = (x, y) :=
      rationalEquationPairOfRatio_eq_of_solution hsol
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨q, mem_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet.mpr ⟨hqUnion, ?_⟩, hpair⟩
    simpa only [hpair] using hsol

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_le
statement:
theorem card_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_le (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier S).card ≤ 4 * 49 ^ S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (card_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet_le S)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
statement:
theorem exists_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) :
    ∃ U : Finset (ℚ × ℚ),
      (∀ x y, (x, y) ∈ U ↔
        IsLowHeightRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) ∧
      U.card ≤ 4 * 49 ^ S.card
proof:
:=
  ⟨lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier S,
    fun _x _y ↦ mem_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier hS,
    card_lowHeightRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_le S⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot
statement: theorem evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot : IsPrimitiveRoot evertseRho 3
proof:
:=
  IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec 3 ℚ EvertseCubicField

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_pow_three
statement: theorem evertseRho_pow_three : evertseRho ^ 3 = 1
proof:
:=
  evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot.pow_eq_one

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_ne_one
statement: theorem evertseRho_ne_one : evertseRho ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot.ne_one (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_ne_zero
statement: theorem evertseRho_ne_zero : evertseRho ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot.ne_zero (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_ne_square
statement: theorem evertseRho_ne_square : evertseRho ≠ evertseRho ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  apply evertseRho_ne_one
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ evertseRho_ne_zero
  simpa [pow_two] using heq.symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_quadratic
statement:
theorem evertseRho_quadratic :
    evertseRho ^ 2 + evertseRho + 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgeom := evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot.geom_sum_eq_zero (by norm_num)
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hgeom ⊢
  simpa [pow_two, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hgeom

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseXi_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseXi_mul_eta (x y : ℚ) :
    evertseXi x y * evertseEta x y =
      algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hrho : evertseRho ^ 2 = -evertseRho - 1 := by
    linear_combination evertseRho_quadratic
  simp only [evertseXi, evertseEta, map_add, map_mul, map_pow]
  rw [hrho]
  ring_nf
  rw [hrho]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.rational_quadratic_form_ne_zero_of_add_eq_one
statement:
theorem rational_quadratic_form_ne_zero_of_add_eq_one
    {x y : ℚ} (hxy : x + y = 1) :
    x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseXi_ne_zero_of_solution
statement:
theorem evertseXi_ne_zero_of_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseXi x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hproduct : evertseXi x y * evertseEta x y = 0 := by simp [hzero]
  rw [evertseXi_mul_eta] at hproduct
  have hform : x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2 = 0 := by
    apply (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField).injective
    simpa using hproduct
  exact (rational_quadratic_form_ne_zero_of_add_eq_one hsol.2.2) hform

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution
statement:
theorem evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseEta x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hproduct : evertseXi x y * evertseEta x y = 0 := by simp [hzero]
  rw [evertseXi_mul_eta] at hproduct
  have hform : x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2 = 0 := by
    apply (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField).injective
    simpa using hproduct
  exact (rational_quadratic_form_ne_zero_of_add_eq_one hsol.2.2) hform

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_ne_zero_of_solution
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_ne_zero_of_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseZeta x y ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  div_ne_zero (evertseXi_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
    (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseXi_sub_eta
statement:
theorem evertseXi_sub_eta (x y : ℚ) :
    evertseXi x y - evertseEta x y =
      (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evertseXi, evertseEta]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_ne_one_of_solution
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_ne_one_of_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseZeta x y ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hone
  have hxiEta : evertseXi x y = evertseEta x y :=
    (div_eq_one_iff_eq (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)).mp hone
  have hzero :
      (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) *
          algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y = 0 := by
    rw [← evertseXi_sub_eta]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hxiEta
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with hrho | hy
  · exact (sub_ne_zero.mpr evertseRho_ne_square.symm) hrho
  · apply hsol.2.1.ne_zero
    apply (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField).injective
    simpa using hy

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_mobius_cross
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_mobius_cross
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    (evertseZeta x y * evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y =
      algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x * (evertseZeta x y - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have heta := evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol
  rw [evertseZeta]
  field_simp [heta]
  simp only [evertseXi, evertseEta]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRatio_eq_mobius
statement:
theorem evertseRatio_eq_mobius
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x / y) =
      (evertseZeta x y * evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) /
        (evertseZeta x y - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_div₀]
  refine (div_eq_div_iff ?_ ?_).mpr ?_
  · exact (map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField)).mpr hsol.2.1.ne_zero
  · exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (evertseZeta_ne_one_of_solution hsol)
  · exact (evertseZeta_mobius_cross hsol).symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_mulHeight_eq_one
statement: theorem evertseRho_mulHeight_eq_one : Height.mulHeight₁ evertseRho = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := Height.mulHeight₁_pow evertseRho 3
  rw [evertseRho_pow_three, Height.mulHeight₁_one] at hpow
  exact (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (Height.mulHeight₁_nonneg evertseRho)
    (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp hpow.symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_square_mulHeight_eq_one
statement:
theorem evertseRho_square_mulHeight_eq_one :
    Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseRho ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Height.mulHeight₁_pow, evertseRho_mulHeight_eq_one, one_pow]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseCubicField_totalWeight
statement:
theorem evertseCubicField_totalWeight :
    Height.totalWeight EvertseCubicField = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [NumberField.totalWeight_eq_finrank]
  calc
    Module.finrank ℚ EvertseCubicField = Nat.totient 3 :=
      IsCyclotomicExtension.finrank EvertseCubicField
        (Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat (by norm_num))
    _ = 3 - 1 := Nat.totient_prime (by decide)
    _ = 2 := by norm_num

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_abv_eq_one
statement:
theorem evertseRho_abv_eq_one
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) : v evertseRho = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := congrArg v evertseRho_pow_three
  simp only [map_pow, map_one] at hpow
  exact (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (v.nonneg evertseRho)
    (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp hpow

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMobiusMatrix_abv_eq_one
statement:
theorem evertseMobiusMatrix_abv_eq_one
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (ji : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    v (evertseMobiusMatrix ji) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases ji with ⟨j, i⟩
  fin_cases j <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [evertseMobiusMatrix, evertseRho_abv_eq_one, map_pow]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMobiusMatrix_ne_zero
statement: theorem evertseMobiusMatrix_ne_zero : evertseMobiusMatrix ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hentry := congrFun hzero (1, 0)
  simp [evertseMobiusMatrix] at hentry

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMobiusMatrix_mulHeight_eq_one
statement:
theorem evertseMobiusMatrix_mulHeight_eq_one :
    Height.mulHeight evertseMobiusMatrix = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Height.mulHeight_eq evertseMobiusMatrix_ne_zero]
  simp_rw [evertseMobiusMatrix_abv_eq_one]
  simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMobiusMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem evertseMobiusMatrix_apply (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    (fun j ↦ ∑ i, evertseMobiusMatrix (j, i) * evertseMobiusVector z i) =
      ![z * evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho, z - 1]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [evertseMobiusMatrix, evertseMobiusVector] <;> ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMobiusVector_mulHeight
statement:
theorem evertseMobiusVector_mulHeight (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    Height.mulHeight (evertseMobiusVector z) = Height.mulHeight₁ z
proof:
:= by
  simpa [evertseMobiusVector] using (Height.mulHeight₁_eq_mulHeight z).symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRatio_mulHeight_le_four_mul_zeta
statement:
theorem evertseRatio_mulHeight_le_four_mul_zeta
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    Height.mulHeight₁ (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x / y)) ≤
      4 * Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseRatio_eq_mobius hsol, Height.mulHeight₁_div_eq_mulHeight]
  have hlinear := Height.mulHeight_linearMap_apply_le
    evertseMobiusMatrix (evertseMobiusVector (evertseZeta x y))
  rw [evertseMobiusMatrix_apply, evertseMobiusMatrix_mulHeight_eq_one,
    evertseMobiusVector_mulHeight, evertseCubicField_totalWeight] at hlinear
  norm_num at hlinear ⊢
  exact hlinear

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight
statement:
theorem one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    1 ≤ evertseNormalizedHeight z
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseNormalizedHeight, ← Real.sqrt_one]
  exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Height.one_le_mulHeight₁ z)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRatio_normalizedHeight_le_two_mul_zeta
statement:
theorem evertseRatio_normalizedHeight_le_two_mul_zeta
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseNormalizedHeight (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x / y)) ≤
      2 * evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseNormalizedHeight
  calc
    Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x / y))) ≤
        Real.sqrt (4 * Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y)) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (evertseRatio_mulHeight_le_four_mul_zeta hsol)
    _ = Real.sqrt 4 * Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y)) :=
      Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) _
    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y)) := by
      rw [show Real.sqrt (4 : ℝ) = 2 by
        calc
          Real.sqrt (4 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by norm_num
          _ = 2 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_one_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_one_mul_eta
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    (evertseZeta x y - 1) * evertseEta x y =
      (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y
proof:
:= by
  have heta := evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol
  rw [evertseZeta]
  field_simp [heta]
  rw [evertseXi_sub_eta]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_rho_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_rho_mul_eta
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho) * evertseEta x y =
      1 - evertseRho
proof:
:= by
  have heta := evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol
  rw [evertseZeta]
  field_simp [heta]
  simp only [evertseXi, evertseEta]
  have hmapAdd :
      algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x + algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y = 1 := by
    rw [← map_add, hsol.2.2, map_one]
  linear_combination (1 - evertseRho) * hmapAdd +
    algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y * evertseRho_pow_three

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_mul_eta
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2) * evertseEta x y =
      (1 - evertseRho ^ 2) * algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x
proof:
:= by
  have heta := evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol
  rw [evertseZeta]
  field_simp [heta]
  simp only [evertseXi, evertseEta]
  linear_combination
    (evertseRho * algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y) * evertseRho_pow_three

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_sq_sub_rho_abv_le_two
statement:
theorem evertseRho_sq_sub_rho_abv_le_two
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) :
    v (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    v (evertseRho ^ 2 + -evertseRho) ≤
        v (evertseRho ^ 2) + v (-evertseRho) := v.add_le _ _
    _ = 2 := by
      simp [evertseRho_abv_eq_one, map_pow]
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.one_sub_evertseRho_abv_le_two
statement:
theorem one_sub_evertseRho_abv_le_two
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) :
    v (1 - evertseRho) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    v (1 + -evertseRho) ≤ v 1 + v (-evertseRho) := v.add_le _ _
    _ = 2 := by
      simp [evertseRho_abv_eq_one]
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.one_sub_evertseRho_sq_abv_le_two
statement:
theorem one_sub_evertseRho_sq_abv_le_two
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) :
    v (1 - evertseRho ^ 2) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    v (1 + -(evertseRho ^ 2)) ≤ v 1 + v (-(evertseRho ^ 2)) := v.add_le _ _
    _ = 2 := by
      simp [evertseRho_abv_eq_one, map_pow]
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_sq_sub_rho_abv_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean
statement:
theorem evertseRho_sq_sub_rho_abv_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (hv : IsNonarchimedean v) :
    v (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    v (evertseRho ^ 2 + -evertseRho) ≤
        max (v (evertseRho ^ 2)) (v (-evertseRho)) := hv _ _
    _ = 1 := by simp [evertseRho_abv_eq_one, map_pow]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.one_sub_evertseRho_abv_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean
statement:
theorem one_sub_evertseRho_abv_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (hv : IsNonarchimedean v) :
    v (1 - evertseRho) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    v (1 + -evertseRho) ≤ max (v 1) (v (-evertseRho)) := hv _ _
    _ = 1 := by simp [evertseRho_abv_eq_one]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.one_sub_evertseRho_sq_abv_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean
statement:
theorem one_sub_evertseRho_sq_abv_le_one_of_isNonarchimedean
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (hv : IsNonarchimedean v) :
    v (1 - evertseRho ^ 2) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    v (1 + -(evertseRho ^ 2)) ≤ max (v 1) (v (-(evertseRho ^ 2))) := hv _ _
    _ = 1 := by simp [evertseRho_abv_eq_one, map_pow]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_one_abv_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_one_abv_mul_eta
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    v (evertseZeta x y - 1) * v (evertseEta x y) =
      v (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) *
        v (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg v (evertseZeta_sub_one_mul_eta hsol)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_rho_abv_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_rho_abv_mul_eta
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    v (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho) * v (evertseEta x y) =
      v (1 - evertseRho)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg v (evertseZeta_sub_rho_mul_eta hsol)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_abv_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_abv_mul_eta
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    v (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2) * v (evertseEta x y) =
      v (1 - evertseRho ^ 2) *
        v (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg v (evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_mul_eta hsol)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hbot
  have hspan : Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} = ⊥ :=
    (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective Rat.ringOfIntegersEquiv.symm.injective).mp hbot
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] at hspan
  exact hp.ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hspan)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_isPrime
statement:
theorem evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_isPrime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  letI : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).IsPrime := by
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_prime]
    · exact Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp hp
    · exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  exact Ideal.map_isPrime_of_equiv Rat.ringOfIntegersEquiv.symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRingOfIntegersAlgebraMap_injective
statement:
theorem evertseRingOfIntegersAlgebraMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap (𝓞 ℚ) (𝓞 EvertseCubicField))
proof:
:= by
  intro r s hrs
  apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
  apply (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField).injective
  have hcoe := congrArg (fun z : 𝓞 EvertseCubicField =>
    (z : EvertseCubicField)) hrs
  change algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (r : ℚ) =
    algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (s : ℚ) at hcoe
  exact hcoe

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_le_two
statement:
theorem card_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_le_two
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime p hp).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  letI : (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).IsMaximal :=
    (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_isPrime hp).isMaximal
      (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot hp)
  rw [evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime, Finset.card_map, Finset.card_attach]
  letI : NoZeroSMulDivisors (𝓞 ℚ) (𝓞 EvertseCubicField) :=
    ⟨fun {r s} hrs => by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def] at hrs
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hrs with hr | hs
      · exact Or.inl (evertseRingOfIntegersAlgebraMap_injective (by simpa using hr))
      · exact Or.inr hs⟩
  have hbound := Ideal.card_primesOverFinset_le_finrank
    (R := 𝓞 ℚ) (S := 𝓞 EvertseCubicField) (K := ℚ) (L := EvertseCubicField)
    (p := evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p)
    (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot hp)
  rw [← NumberField.totalWeight_eq_finrank,
    evertseCubicField_totalWeight] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_iff
statement:
theorem mem_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_iff
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField) :
    w ∈ evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime p hp ↔
      w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).primesOver
        (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)
proof:
:= by
  letI : (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).IsMaximal :=
    (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_isPrime hp).isMaximal
      (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot hp)
  constructor
  · intro hw
    obtain ⟨P, _hP, hPw⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hw
    change NumberField.FinitePlace.mk (evertsePrimeIdealHeightOne p hp P) = w at hPw
    rw [← hPw, NumberField.FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_mk]
    exact (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff
      (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot hp) _).mp P.2
  · intro hw
    have hwFin : w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈
        IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p)
          (𝓞 EvertseCubicField) :=
      (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff
        (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot hp) _).mpr hw
    let P : {P : Ideal (𝓞 EvertseCubicField) //
        P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p)
          (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)} :=
      ⟨w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal, hwFin⟩
    rw [evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime]
    apply Finset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨P, by simp, ?_⟩
    change NumberField.FinitePlace.mk (evertsePrimeIdealHeightOne p hp P) = w
    rw [← NumberField.FinitePlace.mk_maximalIdeal w,
      NumberField.FinitePlace.mk_eq_iff]
    apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.ext_iff.mpr
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport_le
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) :
    (evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport S hS).card ≤ 2 * S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport
  calc
    (S.attach.biUnion fun p =>
        evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime p.1 (hS p.1 p.2)).card ≤
        S.attach.card * 2 :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul _ _ 2 fun p _hp =>
        card_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_le_two p.1 (hS p.1 p.2)
    _ = 2 * S.card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport_iff
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField) :
    w ∈ evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport S hS ↔
      ∃ p ∈ S,
        w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).primesOver
          (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, _hpAttach, hwp⟩
    exact ⟨p.1, p.2, (mem_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_iff
      p.1 (hS p.1 p.2) w).mp hwp⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hpS, hwp⟩
    let ps : {p // p ∈ S} := ⟨p, hpS⟩
    refine ⟨ps, by simp, ?_⟩
    exact (mem_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_iff
      p (hS p hpS) w).mpr hwp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePrimeInteger_coe
statement:
theorem evertsePrimeInteger_coe (p : ℕ) :
    (evertsePrimeInteger p : EvertseCubicField) =
      algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (p : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField
      ((Rat.ringOfIntegersEquiv.symm (p : ℤ) : 𝓞 ℚ) : ℚ) = _
  rw [Rat.ringOfIntegersEquiv_symm_apply_coe]
  norm_num

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePrimeIdeal_map_eq_span
statement:
theorem evertsePrimeIdeal_map_eq_span (p : ℕ) :
    (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).map
        (algebraMap (𝓞 ℚ) (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)) =
      Ideal.span {evertsePrimeInteger p}
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseRationalPrimeIdeal]
  change Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 ℚ) (𝓞 EvertseCubicField))
      (Ideal.map Rat.ringOfIntegersEquiv.symm.toRingHom (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})) = _
  rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_span]
  simp [evertsePrimeInteger]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.liesOver_of_evertsePrimeInteger_mem
statement:
theorem liesOver_of_evertsePrimeInteger_mem
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : evertsePrimeInteger p ∈ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).primesOver
      (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)
proof:
:= by
  letI : (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal p).IsMaximal :=
    (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_isPrime hp).isMaximal
      (evertseRationalPrimeIdeal_ne_bot hp)
  refine ⟨w.maximalIdeal.isPrime, ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.liesOver_iff_dvd_map w.maximalIdeal.isPrime.ne_top,
    evertsePrimeIdeal_map_eq_span]
  exact Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr
    ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hw)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_prime_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_prime_eq_one_of_not_mem
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime p hp) :
    w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (p : ℚ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evertsePrimeInteger_coe]
  rw [← NumberField.FinitePlace.norm_embedding_eq w]
  rw [NumberField.FinitePlace.norm_eq_one_iff_notMem]
  intro hmem
  apply hw
  exact (mem_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_iff p hp w).mpr
    (liesOver_of_evertsePrimeInteger_mem p hp w hmem)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_rationalMonomial_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_rationalMonomial_eq_one_of_not_mem
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    (e : RationalExponentVector S)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport S hS) :
    w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (rationalMonomial S e)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalMonomial, map_prod, map_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro p _hp
  rw [map_zpow₀, map_zpow₀,
    evertseFinitePlace_prime_eq_one_of_not_mem p.1 (hS p.1 p.2) w]
  · simp
  · intro hwp
    apply hw
    exact (mem_evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport_iff S hS w).mpr
      ⟨p.1, p.2,
        (mem_evertseFinitePlacesAbovePrime_iff p.1 (hS p.1 p.2) w).mp hwp⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_rationalSUnit_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_rationalSUnit_eq_one_of_not_mem
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {q : ℚ} (hq : IsRationalSUnit S q)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport S hS) :
    w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hqeq⟩ := hq.exists_sign_mul_rationalMonomial hS
  rw [hqeq, map_mul, map_mul]
  have hεabv : w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField ε) = 1 := by
    rcases hε with rfl | rfl <;> simp
  rw [hεabv,
    evertseFinitePlace_rationalMonomial_eq_one_of_not_mem S hS _ w hw,
    one_mul]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseInfinitePlace_card_eq_one
statement:
theorem evertseInfinitePlace_card_eq_one :
    Fintype.card (NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField) = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsTotallyComplex EvertseCubicField :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isTotallyComplex EvertseCubicField
      (n := 3) (by norm_num)
  have hr : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces EvertseCubicField = 0 :=
    IsTotallyComplex.nrRealPlaces_eq_zero EvertseCubicField
  have hsig := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank
    EvertseCubicField
  have hfinrank : Module.finrank ℚ EvertseCubicField = 2 := by
    rw [← NumberField.totalWeight_eq_finrank]
    exact evertseCubicField_totalWeight
  rw [hr, zero_add, hfinrank] at hsig
  have hc : NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces EvertseCubicField = 1 := by omega
  rw [NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_eq_nrRealPlaces_add_nrComplexPlaces, hr, hc]
