name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree
statement:
theorem card_evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree :
    evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : evertseThreePrimeIdeal.IsMaximal :=
    evertseThreePrimeIdeal_isPrime.isMaximal evertseThreePrimeIdeal_ne_bot
  rw [evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree, Finset.card_map, Finset.card_attach]
  have hcoe := IsDedekindDomain.coe_primesOverFinset
    evertseThreePrimeIdeal_ne_bot (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)
  have hncard := congrArg Set.ncard hcoe
  rw [Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hncard
  rw [hncard]
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ncard_primesOver_of_prime
    3 EvertseCubicField

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces_le
statement:
theorem card_evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces_le
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) :
    (evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS).card ≤ 2 * S.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS).card ≤
        (evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport S hS).card +
          evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree.card := by
      unfold evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces
      exact Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * S.card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add
      (card_evertseFinitePlacesOverSupport_le S hS)
      (le_of_eq card_evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_evertsePlace_le
statement:
theorem card_evertsePlace_le
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) :
    Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS) ≤ 2 * S.card + 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_sum, evertseInfinitePlace_card_eq_one]
  rw [Fintype.card_coe]
  change 1 + (evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS).card ≤ 2 * S.card + 2
  have hcard := card_evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces_le S hS
  omega

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree_iff
statement:
theorem mem_evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree_iff
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField) :
    w ∈ evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree ↔
      w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ evertseThreePrimeIdeal.primesOver
        (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)
proof:
:= by
  letI : evertseThreePrimeIdeal.IsMaximal :=
    evertseThreePrimeIdeal_isPrime.isMaximal evertseThreePrimeIdeal_ne_bot
  constructor
  · intro hw
    obtain ⟨P, _hP, hPw⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hw
    change NumberField.FinitePlace.mk (evertseThreePrimeIdealHeightOne P) = w at hPw
    rw [← hPw, NumberField.FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_mk]
    exact (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff
      evertseThreePrimeIdeal_ne_bot _).mp P.2
  · intro hw
    have hwFin : w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈
        IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset evertseThreePrimeIdeal
          (𝓞 EvertseCubicField) :=
      (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff
        evertseThreePrimeIdeal_ne_bot _).mpr hw
    let P : {P : Ideal (𝓞 EvertseCubicField) //
        P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset evertseThreePrimeIdeal
          (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)} :=
      ⟨w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal, hwFin⟩
    rw [evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree]
    apply Finset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨P, by simp, ?_⟩
    change NumberField.FinitePlace.mk (evertseThreePrimeIdealHeightOne P) = w
    rw [← NumberField.FinitePlace.mk_maximalIdeal w,
      NumberField.FinitePlace.mk_eq_iff]
    apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.ext_iff.mpr
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.liesOver_three_of_rhoInteger_sub_one_mem
statement:
theorem liesOver_three_of_rhoInteger_sub_one_mem
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : evertseRhoInteger - 1 ∈ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∈ evertseThreePrimeIdeal.primesOver
      (𝓞 EvertseCubicField)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  letI : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ (0 + 1)} ℚ EvertseCubicField := by
    simpa using evertseIsCyclotomic
  let I : Ideal (𝓞 EvertseCubicField) :=
    Ideal.span {evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot.toInteger - 1}
  have hIprime : I.IsPrime := by
    exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isPrime_span_zeta_sub_one'
      3 evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot
  have hIbot : I ≠ ⊥ := by
    exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.span_zeta_sub_one_ne_bot
      3 0 evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot
  have hImax : I.IsMaximal := hIprime.isMaximal hIbot
  have hle : I ≤ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := by
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hw
  have heq : I = w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal :=
    hImax.eq_of_le w.maximalIdeal.isPrime.ne_top hle
  refine ⟨w.maximalIdeal.isPrime, ?_⟩
  have hILies : I.LiesOver evertseThreePrimeIdeal := by
    exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.liesOver_span_zeta_sub_one
      3 0 evertseRho_isPrimitiveRoot
  rw [← heq]
  exact hILies

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_rho_sub_one_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_rho_sub_one_eq_one_of_not_mem
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree) :
    w (evertseRho - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change w (((evertseRhoInteger - 1 : 𝓞 EvertseCubicField) :
    EvertseCubicField)) = 1
  rw [← NumberField.FinitePlace.norm_embedding_eq w]
  rw [NumberField.FinitePlace.norm_eq_one_iff_notMem]
  intro hmem
  apply hw
  exact (mem_evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree_iff w).mpr
    (liesOver_three_of_rhoInteger_sub_one_mem w hmem)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_one_sub_rho_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_one_sub_rho_eq_one_of_not_mem
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree) :
    w (1 - evertseRho) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 1 - evertseRho = -(evertseRho - 1) by ring,
    NumberField.FinitePlace.coe_apply, map_neg_eq_map,
    ← NumberField.FinitePlace.coe_apply,
    evertseFinitePlace_rho_sub_one_eq_one_of_not_mem w hw]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_rho_sq_sub_rho_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_rho_sq_sub_rho_eq_one_of_not_mem
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree) :
    w (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hrho : w evertseRho = 1 := evertseRho_abv_eq_one w.1
  rw [show evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho =
      evertseRho * (evertseRho - 1) by ring,
    map_mul, hrho,
    evertseFinitePlace_rho_sub_one_eq_one_of_not_mem w hw, one_mul]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_one_sub_rho_sq_eq_one_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_one_sub_rho_sq_eq_one_of_not_mem
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseFinitePlacesAboveThree) :
    w (1 - evertseRho ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 1 - evertseRho ^ 2 =
      (1 - evertseRho) * (1 + evertseRho) by ring,
    map_mul, evertseFinitePlace_one_sub_rho_eq_one_of_not_mem w hw]
  have honeplus : 1 + evertseRho = -(evertseRho ^ 2) := by
    linear_combination evertseRho_quadratic
  have hrho : w evertseRho = 1 := evertseRho_abv_eq_one w.1
  rw [honeplus, NumberField.FinitePlace.coe_apply, map_neg_eq_map, map_pow,
    ← NumberField.FinitePlace.coe_apply, hrho, one_pow, one_mul]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_eta_le_one_of_not_mem_exceptional
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_eta_le_one_of_not_mem_exceptional
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS) :
    w (evertseEta x y) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x) = 1 :=
    evertseFinitePlace_rationalSUnit_eq_one_of_not_mem S hS hsol.1 w
      (not_mem_support_of_not_mem_exceptional hw)
  have hy : w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y) = 1 :=
    evertseFinitePlace_rationalSUnit_eq_one_of_not_mem S hS hsol.2.1 w
      (not_mem_support_of_not_mem_exceptional hw)
  have hrho : w evertseRho = 1 := evertseRho_abv_eq_one w.1
  have hx' : w.1 (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x) = 1 := hx
  have hy' : w.1 (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y) = 1 := hy
  have hrho' : w.1 evertseRho = 1 := hrho
  unfold evertseEta
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  calc
    w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x +
        -(evertseRho ^ 2 * algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y)) ≤
        max (w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x))
          (w (-(evertseRho ^ 2 * algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y))) :=
      NumberField.FinitePlace.add_le w _ _
    _ = 1 := by
      change max (w.1 (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x))
        (w.1 (-(evertseRho ^ 2 * algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y))) = 1
      rw [hx', map_neg_eq_map w.1, map_mul, map_pow, hrho', hy']
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_one_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_one_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS) :
    1 ≤ w (evertseZeta x y - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hetaLe := evertseFinitePlace_eta_le_one_of_not_mem_exceptional hS hsol w hw
  have hetaPos : 0 < w (evertseEta x y) :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.pos_iff.mpr (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
  have hcoef := evertseFinitePlace_rho_sq_sub_rho_eq_one_of_not_mem w
    (not_mem_three_of_not_mem_exceptional hw)
  have hy := evertseFinitePlace_rationalSUnit_eq_one_of_not_mem S hS hsol.2.1 w
    (not_mem_support_of_not_mem_exceptional hw)
  have hid := evertseZeta_sub_one_abv_mul_eta w.1 hsol
  change w (evertseZeta x y - 1) * w (evertseEta x y) =
    w (evertseRho ^ 2 - evertseRho) *
      w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField y) at hid
  rw [hcoef, hy, one_mul] at hid
  nlinarith [w.1.nonneg (evertseZeta x y - 1)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_rho_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_rho_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS) :
    1 ≤ w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho)
proof:
:= by
  have hetaLe := evertseFinitePlace_eta_le_one_of_not_mem_exceptional hS hsol w hw
  have hetaPos : 0 < w (evertseEta x y) :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.pos_iff.mpr (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
  have hcoef := evertseFinitePlace_one_sub_rho_eq_one_of_not_mem w
    (not_mem_three_of_not_mem_exceptional hw)
  have hid := evertseZeta_sub_rho_abv_mul_eta w.1 hsol
  change w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho) * w (evertseEta x y) =
    w (1 - evertseRho) at hid
  rw [hcoef] at hid
  nlinarith [w.1.nonneg (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_rho_sq_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional
statement:
theorem evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_rho_sq_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y)
    (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (hw : w ∉ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS) :
    1 ≤ w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hetaLe := evertseFinitePlace_eta_le_one_of_not_mem_exceptional hS hsol w hw
  have hetaPos : 0 < w (evertseEta x y) :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.pos_iff.mpr (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
  have hcoef := evertseFinitePlace_one_sub_rho_sq_eq_one_of_not_mem w
    (not_mem_three_of_not_mem_exceptional hw)
  have hx := evertseFinitePlace_rationalSUnit_eq_one_of_not_mem S hS hsol.1 w
    (not_mem_support_of_not_mem_exceptional hw)
  have hid := evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_abv_mul_eta w.1 hsol
  change w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2) * w (evertseEta x y) =
    w (1 - evertseRho ^ 2) *
      w (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x) at hid
  rw [hcoef, hx, one_mul] at hid
  nlinarith [w.1.nonneg (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseLocalCloseness_eq_one_of_one_le
statement:
theorem evertseLocalCloseness_eq_one_of_one_le
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    (z root : EvertseCubicField) (h : 1 ≤ v (z - root)) :
    evertseLocalCloseness v z root = 1
