name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.min_one_eq_div_max_one
statement:
lemma min_one_eq_div_max_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    min 1 a = a / max a 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_div_iff (lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_max_left a 1)).ne').2
  rw [max_comm]
  simpa only [one_mul] using min_mul_max (1 : ℝ) a

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv
statement:
theorem evertseGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv
    {z : EvertseCubicField} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    evertseGlobalClosenessProduct z = (Height.mulHeight₁ z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (fun w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField =>
      w z).HasFiniteMulSupport :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.hasFiniteMulSupport hz
  have hmax : (fun w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField =>
      max (w z) 1).HasFiniteMulSupport :=
    hfin.max (by simpa using Function.hasFiniteMulSupport_one)
  have hposFin (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField) : 0 < w z :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.pos_iff.mpr hz
  have hposInf (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField) : 0 < w z :=
    NumberField.InfinitePlace.pos_iff.mpr hz
  rw [evertseGlobalClosenessProduct]
  simp_rw [min_one_eq_div_max_one (hposInf _), div_pow]
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  simp_rw [min_one_eq_div_max_one (hposFin _)]
  rw [finprod_div_distrib hfin hmax]
  calc
    ((∏ x : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField, x z ^ x.mult) /
          ∏ x : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
            max (x z) 1 ^ x.mult) *
        ((∏ᶠ i : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField, i z) /
          ∏ᶠ i : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField, max (i z) 1) =
        (((∏ x : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField, x z ^ x.mult) *
          ∏ᶠ i : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField, i z) /
        ((∏ x : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
            max (x z) 1 ^ x.mult) *
          ∏ᶠ i : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField, max (i z) 1)) := by
      ring
    _ = 1 / Height.mulHeight₁ z := by
      rw [NumberField.prod_abs_eq_one hz, NumberField.mulHeight₁_eq]
    _ = (Height.mulHeight₁ z)⁻¹ := one_div _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseGlobalClosenessProduct_sub_root_le
statement:
theorem evertseGlobalClosenessProduct_sub_root_le
    {z root : EvertseCubicField}
    (hzroot : z - root ≠ 0)
    (hroot : Height.mulHeight₁ root = 1) :
    evertseGlobalClosenessProduct (z - root) ≤
      4 * (Height.mulHeight₁ z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv hzroot]
  have hadd := Height.mulHeight₁_add_le (z - root) root
  rw [sub_add_cancel, hroot, evertseCubicField_totalWeight] at hadd
  norm_num at hadd
  have hquarter : Height.mulHeight₁ z / 4 ≤ Height.mulHeight₁ (z - root) := by
    linarith
  calc
    (Height.mulHeight₁ (z - root))⁻¹ ≤
        (Height.mulHeight₁ z / 4)⁻¹ := by
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2 hquarter
    _ = 4 * (Height.mulHeight₁ z)⁻¹ := by
      field_simp [Height.mulHeight₁_ne_zero]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv
    {z : EvertseCubicField} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct z =
      (evertseNormalizedHeight z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct,
    evertseGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv hz,
    evertseNormalizedHeight, Real.sqrt_inv]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_sub_root_le
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_sub_root_le
    {z root : EvertseCubicField}
    (hzroot : z - root ≠ 0)
    (hroot : Height.mulHeight₁ root = 1) :
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct (z - root) ≤
      2 * (evertseNormalizedHeight z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv hzroot]
  have hnorm : evertseNormalizedHeight z ≤
      2 * evertseNormalizedHeight (z - root) := by
    unfold evertseNormalizedHeight
    have hadd := Height.mulHeight₁_add_le (z - root) root
    rw [sub_add_cancel, hroot, evertseCubicField_totalWeight] at hadd
    norm_num at hadd
    calc
      Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ z) ≤
          Real.sqrt (4 * Height.mulHeight₁ (z - root)) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hadd
      _ = 2 * Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (z - root)) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)]
        rw [show Real.sqrt (4 : ℝ) = 2 by
          calc
            Real.sqrt (4 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by norm_num
            _ = 2 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  have hposz : 0 < evertseNormalizedHeight z :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight z)
  have hposd : 0 < evertseNormalizedHeight (z - root) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight (z - root))
  calc
    (evertseNormalizedHeight (z - root))⁻¹ ≤
        (evertseNormalizedHeight z / 2)⁻¹ := by
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2 (by linarith)
    _ = 2 * (evertseNormalizedHeight z)⁻¹ := by
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRho_square_ne_one
statement: theorem evertseRho_square_ne_one : evertseRho ^ 2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hsq
  apply evertseRho_ne_one
  calc
    evertseRho = evertseRho * evertseRho ^ 2 := by rw [hsq, mul_one]
    _ = evertseRho ^ 3 := by ring
    _ = 1 := evertseRho_pow_three

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_rho_ne_zero_of_solution
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_rho_ne_zero_of_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hid := evertseZeta_sub_rho_mul_eta hsol
  rw [hzero, zero_mul] at hid
  exact (sub_ne_zero.mpr evertseRho_ne_one.symm) hid.symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_ne_zero_of_solution
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_ne_zero_of_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hid := evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_mul_eta hsol
  rw [hzero, zero_mul] at hid
  have hcoef : 1 - evertseRho ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero.mpr evertseRho_square_ne_one.symm
  have hx : algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField x ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField).injective.ne hsol.1.ne_zero
  exact mul_ne_zero hcoef hx hid.symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseThreeRootNormalizedCloseness_le
statement:
theorem evertseThreeRootNormalizedCloseness_le
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct (evertseZeta x y - 1) *
        evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct
          (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho) *
        evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct
          (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2) ≤
      8 * (evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))⁻¹ ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_sub_root_le
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr (evertseZeta_ne_one_of_solution hsol))
    (by simp : Height.mulHeight₁ (1 : EvertseCubicField) = 1)
  have hρ := evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_sub_root_le
    (evertseZeta_sub_rho_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
    evertseRho_mulHeight_eq_one
  have hρ₂ := evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_sub_root_le
    (evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
    evertseRho_square_mulHeight_eq_one
  have hu : 0 ≤ 2 * (evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))⁻¹ := by
    have hheight : 0 < evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one
        (one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))
    positivity
  calc
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct (evertseZeta x y - 1) *
        evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct
          (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho) *
        evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct
          (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2) ≤
      (2 * (evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))⁻¹) *
        (2 * (evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))⁻¹) *
        (2 * (evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))⁻¹) := by
      have hab := mul_le_mul h₁ hρ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hu
      exact mul_le_mul hab hρ₂ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hu hu)
    _ = 8 * (evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))⁻¹ ^ 3 := by
      ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseInfinitePlace_mult_eq_two
statement:
theorem evertseInfinitePlace_mult_eq_two
    (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField) : w.mult = 2
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsTotallyComplex EvertseCubicField :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isTotallyComplex EvertseCubicField
      (n := 3) (by norm_num)
  exact NumberField.InfinitePlace.mult_isComplex
    ⟨w, IsTotallyComplex.isComplex w⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.finprod_eq_prod_exceptional_of_eq_one_outside
statement:
theorem finprod_eq_prod_exceptional_of_eq_one_outside
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (f : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField → ℝ)
    (hout : ∀ w, w ∉ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS → f w = 1) :
    ∏ᶠ w, f w = ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS, f w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset
  intro w hw
  by_contra hwexceptional
  exact hw (hout w hwexceptional)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_one_eq_exceptional
statement:
theorem finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_one_eq_exceptional
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    (∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
      min 1 (w (evertseZeta x y - 1))) =
      ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
        min 1 (w (evertseZeta x y - 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply finprod_eq_prod_exceptional_of_eq_one_outside
  intro w hw
  exact evertseLocalCloseness_eq_one_of_one_le w.1 _ _
    (evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_one_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional hS hsol w hw)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_rho_eq_exceptional
statement:
theorem finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_rho_eq_exceptional
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    (∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
      min 1 (w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho))) =
      ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
        min 1 (w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho))
proof:
:= by
  apply finprod_eq_prod_exceptional_of_eq_one_outside
  intro w hw
  exact evertseLocalCloseness_eq_one_of_one_le w.1 _ _
    (evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_rho_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional hS hsol w hw)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_rho_sq_eq_exceptional
statement:
theorem finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_rho_sq_eq_exceptional
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    (∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
      min 1 (w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2))) =
      ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
        min 1 (w (evertseZeta x y - evertseRho ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  apply finprod_eq_prod_exceptional_of_eq_one_outside
  intro w hw
  exact evertseLocalCloseness_eq_one_of_one_le w.1 _ _
    (evertseFinitePlace_zeta_sub_rho_sq_one_le_of_not_mem_exceptional hS hsol w hw)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_retained
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_retained
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    (z root : EvertseCubicField)
    (hfin : (∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
      min 1 (w (z - root))) =
      ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
        min 1 (w (z - root))) :
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct (z - root) =
      evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS z root
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct,
    evertseGlobalClosenessProduct, hfin,
    evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct]
  simp_rw [evertseInfinitePlace_mult_eq_two]
  rw [show (∏ x : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
      min 1 (x (z - root)) ^ 2) =
      (∏ x : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
        min 1 (x (z - root))) ^ 2 by
          simpa using Finset.prod_pow
            (Finset.univ : Finset (NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField)) 2
            (fun x => min 1 (x (z - root)))]
  let A := ∏ w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
    min 1 (w (z - root))
  let B := ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
    min 1 (w (z - root))
  change Real.sqrt (A ^ 2 * B) =
    A * ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
      Real.sqrt (min 1 (w (z - root)))
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg A), Real.sqrt_sq]
  · rw [Real.sqrt_prod _ (fun w _hw =>
      le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _))]
  · exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun w _hw =>
      le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRetainedThreeRootCloseness_le
statement:
theorem evertseRetainedThreeRootCloseness_le
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS (evertseZeta x y) 1 *
        evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS
          (evertseZeta x y) evertseRho *
        evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS
          (evertseZeta x y) (evertseRho ^ 2) ≤
      8 * (evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y))⁻¹ ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_retained hS
      (evertseZeta x y) 1
      (finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_one_eq_exceptional hS hsol),
    ← evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_retained hS
      (evertseZeta x y) evertseRho
      (finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_rho_eq_exceptional hS hsol),
    ← evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_retained hS
      (evertseZeta x y) (evertseRho ^ 2)
      (finprod_evertseCloseness_sub_rho_sq_eq_exceptional hS hsol)]
  exact evertseThreeRootNormalizedCloseness_le hsol

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.EvertseGammaIndex.toComposition_blocks
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toComposition_blocks {q : ℕ} (k : EvertseGammaIndex q) :
    k.toComposition.blocks = List.ofFn (fun i => (k.1 i : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.EvertseGammaIndex.toComposition_injective
statement:
theorem toComposition_injective (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (@toComposition q)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hb := congrArg Composition.blocks h
  have hf := List.ofFn_injective hb
  funext i
  apply Fin.ext
  have hi := congrFun hf i
  simpa using Nat.add_right_cancel hi

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.EvertseGammaIndex.card_le_compositions
statement:
theorem card_le_compositions (q : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (EvertseGammaIndex q) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← composition_card (2 * q)]
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ (toComposition_injective q)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.EvertseGammaIndex.card_le_seven_pow
statement:
theorem card_le_seven_pow (q : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (EvertseGammaIndex q) ≤ 7 ^ (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Fintype.card (EvertseGammaIndex q) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * q - 1) :=
      card_le_compositions q
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * q) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
    _ = 4 ^ q := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
    _ ≤ 7 ^ q := pow_le_pow_left' (by omega) q
    _ ≤ 7 ^ (q + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.le_succ q)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.EvertseGammaIndex.gamma_nonneg
statement:
theorem gamma_nonneg {q : ℕ} (k : EvertseGammaIndex q) (i : Fin q) :
    0 ≤ k.gamma i
proof:
:= by
  unfold gamma
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.EvertseGammaIndex.sum_gamma
statement:
theorem sum_gamma {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (k : EvertseGammaIndex q) :
    ∑ i, k.gamma i = (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gamma
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  have hsum : ∑ i, ((k.1 i : ℕ) : ℝ) = q := by
    exact_mod_cast k.2
  rw [hsum]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_bounded_allocation
statement:
private theorem exists_bounded_allocation {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (h : n ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, a i) :
    ∃ k : ι → ℕ, (∀ i ∈ s, k i ≤ a i) ∧ ∑ i ∈ s, k i = n
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing n with
  | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at h
      subst n
      exact ⟨fun _ => 0, by simp⟩
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      let ki := min n (a i)
      have hrem : n - ki ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, a j := by
        by_cases hn : n ≤ a i
        · simp [ki, min_eq_left hn]
        · simp only [ki, min_eq_right (Nat.le_of_not_ge hn)]
          rw [Finset.sum_insert hi] at h
          omega
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hksum⟩ := ih (n - ki) hrem
      refine ⟨Function.update k i ki, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j hj
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
        · simp [ki]
        · have hji : j ≠ i := by
            intro hji
            subst j
            exact hi hj
          simpa [Function.update, hji] using hk j hj
      · rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        have hup : ∑ j ∈ s, Function.update k i ki j = ∑ j ∈ s, k j := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          have hji : j ≠ i := by
            intro hji
            subst j
            exact hi hj
          simp [Function.update, hji]
        rw [hup, hksum]
        exact Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.min_le_left _ _)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.floor_allocation_sum_ge
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (i : Fin q) :
      (2 * q : ℝ) * alpha i ≤
        (⌊(2 * q : ℝ) * alpha i⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _).le
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_hi : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hterm i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hs
  have hleft : (2 * q : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, (⌊(2 * q : ℝ) * alpha i⌋₊ : ℝ) + q := by
    calc
      (2 * q : ℝ) = (2 * q : ℝ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * q : ℝ) * ∑ i, alpha i :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
      _ = ∑ i, (2 * q : ℝ) * alpha i := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ _ := hs
  have hcast : (q : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, (⌊(2 * q : ℝ) * alpha i⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast hcast

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.EvertseGammaIndex.exists_gamma_le
statement:
theorem EvertseGammaIndex.exists_gamma_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (alpha : Fin q → ℝ) (halpha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ alpha i)
    (hsum : 1 ≤ ∑ i, alpha i) :
    ∃ k : EvertseGammaIndex q, ∀ i, k.gamma i ≤ alpha i
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin q → ℕ := fun i => ⌊(2 * q : ℝ) * alpha i⌋₊
  have hqa : q ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, a i := by
    simpa [a] using floor_allocation_sum_ge alpha hsum
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hksum⟩ :=
    exists_bounded_allocation Finset.univ a q hqa
  have hkle (i : Fin q) : k i ≤ q := by
    calc
      k i ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ, k j := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      _ = q := hksum
  let kfin : Fin q → Fin (q + 1) := fun i => ⟨k i, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hkle i)⟩
  have hkfin_sum : ∑ i, (kfin i : ℕ) = q := by
    simpa [kfin] using hksum
  let K : EvertseGammaIndex q := ⟨kfin, hkfin_sum⟩
  refine ⟨K, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hkfloor : (k i : ℝ) ≤ (a i : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hk i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hfloor : (a i : ℝ) ≤ (2 * q : ℝ) * alpha i := by
    apply Nat.floor_le
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (halpha i)
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * q := by positivity
  change (k i : ℝ) / (2 * q : ℝ) ≤ alpha i
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using hkfloor.trans hfloor

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseLocalGamma_nonneg
statement:
theorem evertseLocalGamma_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card ι)) (i : ι) :
    0 ≤ evertseLocalGamma k i
proof:
:=
  EvertseGammaIndex.gamma_nonneg _ _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.sum_evertseLocalGamma_eq_half
statement:
theorem sum_evertseLocalGamma_eq_half {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card ι)) :
    ∑ i, evertseLocalGamma k i = (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ∑ i, evertseLocalGamma k i = ∑ j, k.gamma j by
    exact (Fintype.equivFin ι).sum_comp k.gamma]
  exact EvertseGammaIndex.sum_gamma (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance) k

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseLocalGamma_le
statement:
theorem exists_evertseLocalGamma_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (alpha : ι → ℝ) (halpha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ alpha i)
    (hsum : 1 ≤ ∑ i, alpha i) :
    ∃ k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card ι),
      ∀ i, evertseLocalGamma k i ≤ alpha i
proof:
:= by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin ι
  let alphaFin : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℝ := fun j => alpha (e.symm j)
  have hsumFin : 1 ≤ ∑ j, alphaFin j := by
    rw [show ∑ j, alphaFin j = ∑ i, alpha i by
      exact e.symm.sum_comp alpha]
    exact hsum
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := EvertseGammaIndex.exists_gamma_le
    (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance) alphaFin
    (fun j => halpha (e.symm j)) hsumFin
  refine ⟨k, fun i => ?_⟩
  simpa [evertseLocalGamma, alphaFin, e] using hk (e i)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseGammaIndex_card_le
statement:
theorem evertseGammaIndex_card_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] :
    Fintype.card (EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card ι)) ≤
      7 ^ (Fintype.card ι + 1)
proof:
:=
  EvertseGammaIndex.card_le_seven_pow _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFinitePlace_iSup_intCast_eq_one_of_gcd_eq_one
statement:
private theorem evertseFinitePlace_iSup_intCast_eq_one_of_gcd_eq_one
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (v : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField) (x : ι → ℤ)
    (hx : Finset.univ.gcd x = 1) :
    ⨆ i, v (x i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hv : IsNonarchimedean (v ·) := NumberField.FinitePlace.add_le v
  have H (n : ℤ) : v n ≤ 1 := IsNonarchimedean.apply_intCast_le_one hv
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Finset.gcd_eq_sum_mul .univ x
  apply_fun v at hf
  simp_rw [hx, Int.cast_one, map_one, Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_mul] at hf
  replace hf := hf.trans_le hv.apply_sum_univ_le
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := fun i ↦ v (x i * f i))
  rw [← hi, map_mul] at hf
  replace hf : 1 ≤ v (x i) := hf.trans <|
    mul_le_of_le_one_right (apply_nonneg v _) (H _)
  exact le_antisymm (ciSup_le (H <| x ·)) <| Finite.le_ciSup_of_le i hf

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMulHeight_intTuple_eq_max_sq
statement:
theorem evertseMulHeight_intTuple_eq_max_sq
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (x : ι → ℤ) (hx : Finset.univ.gcd x = 1) :
    Height.mulHeight (((↑) : ℤ → EvertseCubicField) ∘ x) =
      (⨆ i, |x i| : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀ : ((Int.cast : ℤ → EvertseCubicField) ∘ x) ≠ 0 := by
    contrapose! hx
    rw [Function.comp_eq_zero_iff x Int.cast_injective Int.cast_zero] at hx
    rw [hx, Finset.gcd_eq_zero_iff.mpr (by simp)]
    exact zero_ne_one
  rw [NumberField.mulHeight_eq hx₀]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  simp_rw [NumberField.InfinitePlace.map_intCast]
  rw [show (∏ v : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
      (⨆ i, ‖x i‖) ^ v.mult) = (⨆ i, |x i| : ℝ) ^ 2 by
    letI : Unique (NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField) := Classical.choice
      (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.mp evertseInfinitePlace_card_eq_one)
    rw [Fintype.prod_unique, evertseInfinitePlace_mult_eq_two]
    congr 1]
  simp [finprod_eq_one_of_forall_eq_one
    (fun v => evertseFinitePlace_iSup_intCast_eq_one_of_gcd_eq_one v x hx)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMulHeight_rat_one_eq_num_den
statement:
private theorem evertseMulHeight_rat_one_eq_num_den (q : ℚ) :
    Height.mulHeight
        ![algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField q, (1 : EvertseCubicField)] =
      Height.mulHeight
        ![(q.num : EvertseCubicField), (q.den : EvertseCubicField)]
proof:
:= by
  have hq₀ : (q.den : EvertseCubicField) ≠ 0 := mod_cast q.den_nz
  rw [← Height.mulHeight_smul_eq_mulHeight _ hq₀]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · change (q.den : EvertseCubicField) *
      algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField q = (q.num : EvertseCubicField)
    have hden : (q.den : EvertseCubicField) =
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (q.den : ℚ) := by simp
    have hnum : (q.num : EvertseCubicField) =
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (q.num : ℚ) := by simp
    rw [hden, hnum, ← map_mul, q.den_mul_eq_num]
  · simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMulHeight_algebraMap_eq_rationalHeight_sq
statement:
theorem evertseMulHeight_algebraMap_eq_rationalHeight_sq (q : ℚ) :
    Height.mulHeight₁ (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField q) =
      rationalHeight q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Height.mulHeight₁_eq_mulHeight, evertseMulHeight_rat_one_eq_num_den]
  have hgcd : (.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).gcd ![q.num, q.den] = 1 := by
    simpa [Finset.univ_fin2, Int.normalize_coe_nat, ← Int.coe_gcd q.num q.den] using
      Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp (Rat.isCoprime_num_den q)
  have hvec : (![q.num, q.den] : Fin 2 → EvertseCubicField) =
      ((Int.cast : ℤ → EvertseCubicField) ∘ ![q.num, (q.den : ℤ)]) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  rw [hvec, evertseMulHeight_intTuple_eq_max_sq ![q.num, (q.den : ℤ)] hgcd]
  rw [rationalHeight_eq_max_num_den]
  congr 1
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  · rw [Nat.cast_max]
    apply max_le
    · exact Finite.le_ciSup_of_le 0 (by simp)
    · exact Finite.le_ciSup_of_le 1 (by simp)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedHeight_algebraMap_eq_rationalHeight
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedHeight_algebraMap_eq_rationalHeight (q : ℚ) :
    evertseNormalizedHeight (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField q) =
      rationalHeight q
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseNormalizedHeight, evertseMulHeight_algebraMap_eq_rationalHeight_sq]
  exact Real.sqrt_sq (zero_le_one.trans (one_le_rationalHeight q))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseLogarithmicLoss_nonneg
statement:
theorem evertseLogarithmicLoss_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 1 < H) {f : ι → ℝ}
    (hfpos : ∀ i, 0 < f i) (hfle : ∀ i, f i ≤ 1) (i : ι) :
    0 ≤ evertseLogarithmicLoss H f i
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseLogarithmicLoss
  exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_nonpos (hfpos i).le (hfle i)))
    (Real.log_nonneg (le_of_lt hH))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.one_le_sum_evertseLogarithmicLoss
statement:
theorem one_le_sum_evertseLogarithmicLoss
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 1 < H) {f : ι → ℝ}
    (hfpos : ∀ i, 0 < f i) (hprod : ∏ i, f i ≤ H⁻¹) :
    1 ≤ ∑ i, evertseLogarithmicLoss H f i
proof:
:= by
  have hprodpos : 0 < ∏ i, f i := Finset.prod_pos fun i _hi => hfpos i
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hprodpos hprod
  rw [Real.log_inv] at hlog
  have hlogH : 0 < Real.log H := Real.log_pos hH
  unfold evertseLogarithmicLoss
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Real.log_prod]
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hlogH).2
    linarith
  · exact fun i _hi => (hfpos i).ne'

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseLogarithmicLoss_bound_iff
statement:
theorem evertseLogarithmicLoss_bound_iff
    {H f : ℝ} (hH : 1 < H) (hf : 0 < f) {g : ℝ} :
    g ≤ -Real.log f / Real.log H ↔ f ≤ H ^ (-g : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogH : 0 < Real.log H := Real.log_pos hH
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hlogH]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (Real.log_le_log_iff hf (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _)).mp
    rw [Real.log_rpow (by positivity)]
    linarith
  · intro h
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hf h
    rw [Real.log_rpow (by positivity)] at hlog
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseGamma_rpow_bound
statement:
theorem exists_evertseGamma_rpow_bound
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 1 < H) {f : ι → ℝ}
    (hfpos : ∀ i, 0 < f i) (hfle : ∀ i, f i ≤ 1)
    (hprod : ∏ i, f i ≤ H⁻¹) :
    ∃ k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card ι),
      ∀ i, f i ≤ H ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_evertseLocalGamma_le
    (evertseLogarithmicLoss H f)
    (evertseLogarithmicLoss_nonneg hH hfpos hfle)
    (one_le_sum_evertseLogarithmicLoss hH hfpos hprod)
  exact ⟨k, fun i =>
    (evertseLogarithmicLoss_bound_iff hH (hfpos i)).mp (hk i)⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.prod_evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_retained
statement:
theorem prod_evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_retained
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    (z root : EvertseCubicField) :
    ∏ v : EvertsePlace S hS, evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z root =
      evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS z root
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum_type]
  unfold evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness
    evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.prod_subtype
    (evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS) (fun _ => Iff.rfl)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.prod_evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_eq
statement:
theorem prod_evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_eq
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    ∏ v : EvertsePlace S hS, evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v z =
      evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS z 1 *
        evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS z evertseRho *
        evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct S hS z (evertseRho ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseTriplePlaceCloseness
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [prod_evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_retained,
    prod_evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_retained,
    prod_evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_retained]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_pos
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · exact lt_min (by norm_num) (AbsoluteValue.pos w.1 hne)
  · apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
    exact lt_min (by norm_num) (AbsoluteValue.pos w.1.1 hne)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_le_one
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_le_one
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z root : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z root ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · exact min_le_left _ _
  · have hnonneg : 0 ≤ min 1 (w.1.1 (z - root)) :=
      le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.1.nonneg _)
    have hsquare := Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg
    have hsnonneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg (min 1 (w.1.1 (z - root)))
    have hmin := min_le_left (1 : ℝ) (w.1.1 (z - root))
    change Real.sqrt (min 1 (w.1.1 (z - root))) ≤ 1
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_pos
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_pos
    (mul_pos (evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_pos v h1)
      (evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_pos v hr))
    (evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_pos v hr2)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_le_one
statement:
theorem evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_le_one
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v z ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_le_one v z 1
  have h2 := evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_le_one v z evertseRho
  have h3 := evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_le_one v z (evertseRho ^ 2)
  have hn1 : 0 ≤ evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z 1 := by
    rcases v with w | w
    · exact le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _)
    · exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hn2 : 0 ≤ evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z evertseRho := by
    rcases v with w | w
    · exact le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _)
    · exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hn3 : 0 ≤ evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z (evertseRho ^ 2) := by
    rcases v with w | w
    · exact le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _)
    · exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  unfold evertseTriplePlaceCloseness
  exact (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul h1 h2 hn2 (by norm_num)) h3 hn3 (by norm_num))
    |>.trans_eq (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.eight_mul_inv_cube_le_inv
statement:
private theorem eight_mul_inv_cube_le_inv {H : ℝ} (hH : 3 ≤ H) :
    8 * H⁻¹ ^ 3 ≤ H⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by linarith
  rw [inv_pow]
  rw [show 8 * (H ^ 3)⁻¹ = 8 / H ^ 3 by rw [div_eq_mul_inv],
    show H⁻¹ = 1 / H by rw [one_div]]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hHpos 3) hHpos).2
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (H - 3)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedHeight_ge_three_of_high
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedHeight_ge_three_of_high
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y)
    (hhigh : lowHeightCutoff49 < rationalHeight (x / y)) :
    3 ≤ evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio := evertseRatio_normalizedHeight_le_two_mul_zeta hsol
  rw [evertseNormalizedHeight_algebraMap_eq_rationalHeight] at hratio
  have hcut : (6 : ℝ) < lowHeightCutoff49 := by
    norm_num [lowHeightCutoff49]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseGamma_for_high_solution
statement:
theorem exists_evertseGamma_for_high_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y)
    (hhigh : lowHeightCutoff49 < rationalHeight (x / y)) :
    ∃ k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)),
      ∀ v, evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (evertseZeta x y) ≤
        evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y) ^
          (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let H := evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y)
  have hH3 : 3 ≤ H := evertseNormalizedHeight_ge_three_of_high hsol hhigh
  have hH : 1 < H := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hH3
  apply exists_evertseGamma_rpow_bound hH
  · intro v
    exact evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_pos v
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr (evertseZeta_ne_one_of_solution hsol))
      (evertseZeta_sub_rho_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
      (evertseZeta_sub_rho_sq_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
  · intro v
    exact evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_le_one v _
  · rw [prod_evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_eq hS]
    exact (evertseRetainedThreeRootCloseness_le hS hsol).trans
      (eight_mul_inv_cube_le_inv hH3)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseXi_eta_cross_sub
statement:
theorem evertseXi_eta_cross_sub
    (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℚ) :
    evertseXi x₁ y₁ * evertseEta x₂ y₂ -
        evertseXi x₂ y₂ * evertseEta x₁ y₁ =
      (evertseRho - evertseRho ^ 2) *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x₁ * y₂ - x₂ * y₁)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evertseXi, evertseEta, map_sub, map_mul]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_injective_on_solutions
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_injective_on_solutions
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℚ}
    (hsol₁ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₁ y₁)
    (hsol₂ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₂ y₂)
    (hzeta : evertseZeta x₁ y₁ = evertseZeta x₂ y₂) :
    (x₁, y₁) = (x₂, y₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hcross :
      evertseXi x₁ y₁ * evertseEta x₂ y₂ =
        evertseXi x₂ y₂ * evertseEta x₁ y₁ :=
    (div_eq_div_iff (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol₁)
      (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol₂)).mp hzeta
  have hzero :
      (evertseRho - evertseRho ^ 2) *
          algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x₁ * y₂ - x₂ * y₁) = 0 := by
    rw [← evertseXi_eta_cross_sub]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hcross
  have hmap :
      algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x₁ * y₂ - x₂ * y₁) = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr evertseRho_ne_square)
  have hdet : x₁ * y₂ - x₂ * y₁ = 0 := by
    apply (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField).injective
    simpa using hmap
  have hy₁ : y₁ = 1 - x₁ := by
    linarith [hsol₁.2.2]
  have hy₂ : y₂ = 1 - x₂ := by
    linarith [hsol₂.2.2]
  have hx : x₁ = x₂ := by
    rw [hy₁, hy₂] at hdet
    nlinarith
  have hy : y₁ = y₂ := by
    linarith [hsol₁.2.2, hsol₂.2.2]
  exact Prod.ext hx hy

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_zeta_mul_eta_mul_eta
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_zeta_mul_eta_mul_eta
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℚ}
    (hsol₁ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₁ y₁)
    (hsol₂ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₂ y₂) :
    (evertseZeta x₁ y₁ - evertseZeta x₂ y₂) *
        (evertseEta x₁ y₁ * evertseEta x₂ y₂) =
      (evertseRho - evertseRho ^ 2) *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField (x₁ * y₂ - x₂ * y₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseZeta, evertseZeta]
  field_simp [evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol₁,
    evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol₂]
  convert evertseXi_eta_cross_sub x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ using 1 <;> ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseSolution_determinant_eq_sub
statement:
theorem evertseSolution_determinant_eq_sub
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℚ}
    (hsol₁ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₁ y₁)
    (hsol₂ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₂ y₂) :
    x₁ * y₂ - x₂ * y₁ = x₁ - x₂
proof:
:= by
  have hy₁ : y₁ = 1 - x₁ := by linarith [hsol₁.2.2]
  have hy₂ : y₂ = 1 - x₂ := by linarith [hsol₂.2.2]
  rw [hy₁, hy₂]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_sub_zeta_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_sub_zeta_ne_zero
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℚ}
    (hsol₁ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₁ y₁)
    (hsol₂ : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x₂ y₂)
    (hne : (x₁, y₁) ≠ (x₂, y₂)) :
    evertseZeta x₁ y₁ - evertseZeta x₂ y₂ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr fun heq =>
    hne (evertseZeta_injective_on_solutions hsol₁ hsol₂ heq)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointVandermonde_det
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointVandermonde_det (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    (evertseFourPointVandermonde z).det =
      ∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (z j - z i)
proof:
:=
  Matrix.det_vandermonde z

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointVandermonde_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointVandermonde_det_ne_zero
    {z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField} (hz : Function.Injective z) :
    (evertseFourPointVandermonde z).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseFourPointVandermonde_det]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _hi
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz.ne (Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj).ne')

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedHeight_prod_le
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedHeight_prod_le
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → EvertseCubicField) :
    evertseNormalizedHeight (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤
      ∏ i ∈ s, evertseNormalizedHeight (f i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseNormalizedHeight
  calc
    Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (∏ i ∈ s, f i)) ≤
        Real.sqrt (∏ i ∈ s, Height.mulHeight₁ (f i)) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁_prod_le s f)
    _ = ∏ i ∈ s, Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (f i)) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_prod _ (fun i _hi => Height.mulHeight₁_nonneg (f i))]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedHeight_sub_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedHeight_sub_le_two_mul
    (z w : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertseNormalizedHeight (z - w) ≤
      2 * evertseNormalizedHeight z * evertseNormalizedHeight w
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseNormalizedHeight
  have h := Height.mulHeight₁_sub_le z w
  rw [evertseCubicField_totalWeight] at h
  norm_num at h
  calc
    Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (z - w)) ≤
        Real.sqrt (4 * Height.mulHeight₁ z * Height.mulHeight₁ w) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h
    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ z) *
        Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ w) := by
      rw [show 4 * Height.mulHeight₁ z * Height.mulHeight₁ w =
        4 * (Height.mulHeight₁ z * Height.mulHeight₁ w) by ring]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4),
        Real.sqrt_mul (Height.mulHeight₁_nonneg z)]
      rw [show Real.sqrt (4 : ℝ) = 2 by
        calc
          Real.sqrt (4 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by norm_num
          _ = 2 := Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointVandermonde_normalizedHeight_le
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointVandermonde_normalizedHeight_le
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseFourPointVandermonde z).det ≤
      ∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        (2 * evertseNormalizedHeight (z j) *
          evertseNormalizedHeight (z i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseFourPointVandermonde_det]
  calc
    evertseNormalizedHeight (∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (z j - z i)) ≤
        ∏ i : Fin 4,
          evertseNormalizedHeight (∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (z j - z i)) := by
      simpa using evertseNormalizedHeight_prod_le Finset.univ
        (fun i : Fin 4 => ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (z j - z i))
    _ ≤ ∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        evertseNormalizedHeight (z j - z i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro i _hi
        exact zero_le_one.trans (one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight _)
      · intro i _hi
        exact evertseNormalizedHeight_prod_le (Finset.Ioi i) fun j => z j - z i
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro i _hi
        exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _hj =>
          zero_le_one.trans (one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight _)
      · intro i _hi
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod
        · intro j _hj
          exact zero_le_one.trans (one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight _)
        · intro j _hj
          exact evertseNormalizedHeight_sub_le_two_mul _ _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseClosestRoot_le
statement:
theorem evertseClosestRoot_le (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    (z : EvertseCubicField) (r : Fin 3) :
    evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots (evertseClosestRoot v z)) ≤
      evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots r)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ
    (fun r : Fin 3 => evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots r))
    Finset.univ_nonempty)).2 r (Finset.mem_univ r)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRawCloseness_nonneg
statement:
theorem evertseRawCloseness_nonneg (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    (z root : EvertseCubicField) :
    0 ≤ evertseRawCloseness v z root
proof:
:=
  le_min (by norm_num) (v.nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseClosestRoot_cube_le_triple
statement:
theorem evertseClosestRoot_cube_le_triple
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots (evertseClosestRoot v z)) ^ 3 ≤
      evertseRawTripleCloseness v z
proof:
:= by
  let c := evertseRawCloseness v z
    (evertseThreeRoots (evertseClosestRoot v z))
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _
  have h0 : c ≤ evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots 0) :=
    evertseClosestRoot_le _ _ _
  have h1 : c ≤ evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots 1) :=
    evertseClosestRoot_le _ _ _
  have h2 : c ≤ evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots 2) :=
    evertseClosestRoot_le _ _ _
  unfold evertseRawTripleCloseness
  change c ^ 3 ≤ _
  rw [pow_succ, pow_two]
  have hp : c * c ≤
      evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots 0) *
        evertseRawCloseness v z (evertseThreeRoots 1) :=
    mul_le_mul h0 h1 hc0 (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)
  exact mul_le_mul hp h2 hc0
    (mul_nonneg (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)
      (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseRawCloseness_sub_le_add
statement:
theorem evertseRawCloseness_sub_le_add
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    (z w root : EvertseCubicField) :
    min 1 (v (z - w)) ≤
      evertseRawCloseness v z root + evertseRawCloseness v w root
proof:
:= by
  have htri : v (z - w) ≤ v (z - root) + v (w - root) := by
    calc
      v (z - w) = v ((z - root) + (root - w)) := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ v (z - root) + v (root - w) := v.add_le _ _
      _ = v (z - root) + v (w - root) := by
        congr 1
        rw [show root - w = -(w - root) by ring, map_neg_eq_map]
  by_cases hz : 1 ≤ v (z - root)
  · have hone : 1 ≤
        evertseRawCloseness v z root + evertseRawCloseness v w root := by
      rw [evertseRawCloseness, min_eq_left hz]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)
    exact (min_le_left _ _).trans hone
  · have hz' : v (z - root) ≤ 1 := le_of_not_ge hz
    by_cases hw : 1 ≤ v (w - root)
    · have hone : 1 ≤
          evertseRawCloseness v z root + evertseRawCloseness v w root := by
        change 1 ≤ min 1 (v (z - root)) + min 1 (v (w - root))
        rw [min_eq_left hw]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)
      exact (min_le_left _ _).trans hone
    · have hw' : v (w - root) ≤ 1 := le_of_not_ge hw
      rw [evertseRawCloseness, min_eq_right hz',
        evertseRawCloseness, min_eq_right hw']
      exact (min_le_right _ _).trans htri

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_pair_evertseRawVandermonde_local
statement:
theorem exists_pair_evertseRawVandermonde_local
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ)
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    ∃ i j : Fin 4, i ≠ j ∧
      min 1 (v (z i - z j)) ^ 3 ≤
        8 * max (evertseRawTripleCloseness v (z i))
          (evertseRawTripleCloseness v (z j))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hroot⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt
    (fun i : Fin 4 => evertseClosestRoot v (z i)) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨i, j, hij, ?_⟩
  let ci := evertseRawCloseness v (z i)
    (evertseThreeRoots (evertseClosestRoot v (z i)))
  let cj := evertseRawCloseness v (z j)
    (evertseThreeRoots (evertseClosestRoot v (z j)))
  have hdiff : min 1 (v (z i - z j)) ≤ ci + cj := by
    simpa [ci, cj, hroot] using evertseRawCloseness_sub_le_add
      v (z i) (z j) (evertseThreeRoots (evertseClosestRoot v (z i)))
  have hci0 : 0 ≤ ci := evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _
  have hcj0 : 0 ≤ cj := evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _
  have hdiff0 : 0 ≤ min 1 (v (z i - z j)) :=
    le_min (by norm_num) (v.nonneg _)
  have hsum : ci + cj ≤ 2 * max ci cj := by
    calc
      ci + cj ≤ max ci cj + max ci cj :=
        add_le_add (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      _ = 2 * max ci cj := by ring
  have hcub : min 1 (v (z i - z j)) ^ 3 ≤ 8 * (max ci cj) ^ 3 := by
    have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ hdiff0 (hdiff.trans hsum) 3
    calc
      min 1 (v (z i - z j)) ^ 3 ≤ (2 * max ci cj) ^ 3 := hh
      _ = 8 * (max ci cj) ^ 3 := by ring
  have hmaxcube : (max ci cj) ^ 3 ≤
      max (evertseRawTripleCloseness v (z i))
        (evertseRawTripleCloseness v (z j)) := by
    by_cases h : ci ≤ cj
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      exact (evertseClosestRoot_cube_le_triple v (z j)).trans
        (le_max_right _ _)
    · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge h)]
      exact (evertseClosestRoot_cube_le_triple v (z i)).trans
        (le_max_left _ _)
  exact hcub.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmaxcube (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_infinite_eq_raw
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_infinite_eq_raw
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (z root : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness (S := S) (hS := hS) (Sum.inl w) z root =
      evertseRawCloseness w.1 z root
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (w : {w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField //
      w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS})
    (z root : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness (S := S) (hS := hS)
        (Sum.inr w) z root ^ 2 = evertseRawCloseness w.1.1 z root
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness evertseRawCloseness
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.1.nonneg _))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_infinite_eq_raw
statement:
theorem evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_infinite_eq_raw
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField)
    (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertseTriplePlaceCloseness (S := S) (hS := hS) (Sum.inl w) z =
      evertseRawTripleCloseness w.1 z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw
statement:
theorem evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (w : {w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField //
      w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS})
    (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertseTriplePlaceCloseness (S := S) (hS := hS) (Sum.inr w) z ^ 2 =
      evertseRawTripleCloseness w.1.1 z
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseTriplePlaceCloseness evertseRawTripleCloseness
  rw [show evertseThreeRoots 0 = 1 by simp [evertseThreeRoots],
    show evertseThreeRoots 1 = evertseRho by simp [evertseThreeRoots],
    show evertseThreeRoots 2 = evertseRho ^ 2 by simp [evertseThreeRoots]]
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw,
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw,
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z root : EvertseCubicField) :
    0 ≤ evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z root
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · exact le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _)
  · exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_nonneg
statement:
theorem evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_nonneg
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z : EvertseCubicField) :
    0 ≤ evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v z
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseTriplePlaceCloseness
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)
      (evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg _ _ _))
    (evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.max_sq_eq_max_sq_of_nonneg
statement:
private theorem max_sq_eq_max_sq_of_nonneg
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    max a b ^ 2 = max (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a ≤ b
  · have hs : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha h 2
    rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right hs]
  · have h' : b ≤ a := le_of_not_ge h
    have hs : b ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hb h' 2
    rw [max_eq_left h', max_eq_left hs]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_pair_evertsePlaceVandermonde_local
statement:
theorem exists_pair_evertsePlaceVandermonde_local
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    ∃ i j : Fin 4, i ≠ j ∧
      evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v (z i) (z j) ^ 3 ≤
        8 * max (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z i))
          (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z j))
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · simpa [evertseRawCloseness,
      evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_infinite_eq_raw,
      evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_infinite_eq_raw] using
      exists_pair_evertseRawVandermonde_local w.1 z
  · obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hraw⟩ :=
      exists_pair_evertseRawVandermonde_local w.1.1 z
    refine ⟨i, j, hij, ?_⟩
    let d := evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness (Sum.inr w) (z i) (z j)
    let ti := evertseTriplePlaceCloseness (Sum.inr w) (z i)
    let tj := evertseTriplePlaceCloseness (Sum.inr w) (z j)
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg _ _ _
    have hti0 : 0 ≤ ti := evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_nonneg _ _
    have htj0 : 0 ≤ tj := evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_nonneg _ _
    have hd2 : d ^ 2 = evertseRawCloseness w.1.1 (z i) (z j) :=
      evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw w _ _
    have hti2 : ti ^ 2 = evertseRawTripleCloseness w.1.1 (z i) :=
      evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw w _
    have htj2 : tj ^ 2 = evertseRawTripleCloseness w.1.1 (z j) :=
      evertseTriplePlaceCloseness_finite_sq_eq_raw w _
    have hmax2 : max ti tj ^ 2 =
        max (evertseRawTripleCloseness w.1.1 (z i))
          (evertseRawTripleCloseness w.1.1 (z j)) := by
      rw [max_sq_eq_max_sq_of_nonneg hti0 htj0, hti2, htj2]
    change d ^ 3 ≤ 8 * max ti tj
    have hsquare : (d ^ 3) ^ 2 ≤ (8 * max ti tj) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, show 3 * 2 = 6 by norm_num,
        show d ^ 6 = (d ^ 2) ^ 3 by ring, hd2]
      rw [mul_pow, hmax2]
      exact hraw.trans (by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (8 : ℝ) ≤ 8 ^ 2)
        have hrawi : 0 ≤ evertseRawTripleCloseness w.1.1 (z i) := by
          unfold evertseRawTripleCloseness
          exact mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)
              (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _))
            (evertseRawCloseness_nonneg _ _ _)
        exact hrawi.trans (le_max_left _ _))
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ d ^ 3)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 8 * max ti tj)).mp hsquare

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_evertseFourPair
statement: theorem card_evertseFourPair : Fintype.card EvertseFourPair = 6
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_symm
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_symm
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z w : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z w =
      evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v w z
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with v | v
  · change min 1 (v.1 (z - w)) = min 1 (v.1 (w - z))
    have habv : v.1 (z - w) = v.1 (w - z) := by
      rw [show z - w = -(w - z) by ring, map_neg_eq_map]
    rw [habv]
  · change Real.sqrt (min 1 (v.1.1 (z - w))) =
      Real.sqrt (min 1 (v.1.1 (w - z)))
    have habv : v.1.1 (z - w) = v.1.1 (w - z) := by
      rw [show z - w = -(w - z) by ring, map_neg_eq_map]
    rw [habv]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseFourPair_local
statement:
theorem exists_evertseFourPair_local
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    ∃ p : EvertseFourPair,
      evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v (z p.1.1) (z p.1.2) ^ 3 ≤
        8 * max (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z p.1.1))
          (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z p.1.2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_pair_evertsePlaceVandermonde_local v z
  by_cases hlt : i < j
  · exact ⟨⟨(i, j), hlt⟩, hbound⟩
  · have hjlt : j < i := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hlt) hij.symm
    refine ⟨⟨(j, i), hjlt⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_symm, max_comm] using hbound

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseLocalFourPair_bound
statement:
theorem evertseLocalFourPair_bound
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v
        (z (evertseLocalFourPair v z).1.1)
        (z (evertseLocalFourPair v z).1.2) ^ 3 ≤
      8 * max
        (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z (evertseLocalFourPair v z).1.1))
        (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z (evertseLocalFourPair v z).1.2))
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_evertseFourPair_local v z)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_evertseFourPairPlaceSet
proof:
:= by
  simp [evertseFourPairPlaceSet]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPairPlaceSet_disjoint
statement:
theorem evertseFourPairPlaceSet_disjoint
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    {z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField} {p q : EvertseFourPair} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    Disjoint (evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p)
      (evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hvp hvq
  exact hpq ((mem_evertseFourPairPlaceSet.mp hvp).symm.trans
    (mem_evertseFourPairPlaceSet.mp hvq))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.sum_evertseFourPairPlaceSet
statement:
theorem sum_evertseFourPairPlaceSet
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) (f : EvertsePlace S hS → ℝ) :
    ∑ p : EvertseFourPair, ∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet z p, f v =
      ∑ v, f v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∑ p : EvertseFourPair, ∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet z p, f v =
        ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset EvertseFourPair),
          ∑ v ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (EvertsePlace S hS)),
            if evertseLocalFourPair v z = p then f v else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _hp
      rw [evertseFourPairPlaceSet, Finset.sum_filter]
    _ = ∑ v ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (EvertsePlace S hS)),
        ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset EvertseFourPair),
          if evertseLocalFourPair v z = p then f v else 0 :=
      Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ v, f v := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro v _hv
      simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseFourPair_gamma_mass
statement:
theorem exists_evertseFourPair_gamma_mass
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField)
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS))) :
    ∃ p : EvertseFourPair, (1 : ℝ) / 12 ≤
      ∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet z p, evertseLocalGamma k v
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hsum :
      ∑ p : EvertseFourPair,
          ∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet z p, evertseLocalGamma k v <
        6 * ((1 : ℝ) / 12) := by
    calc
      _ < ∑ _p : EvertseFourPair, ((1 : ℝ) / 12) :=
        Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun p _hp => (h p).le)
          ⟨⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩, by simp, h ⟨(0, 1), by decide⟩⟩
      _ = 6 * ((1 : ℝ) / 12) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, card_evertseFourPair]
        norm_num
  rw [sum_evertseFourPairPlaceSet,
    sum_evertseLocalGamma_eq_half] at hsum
  norm_num at hsum

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPair_product_bound_of_triple
statement:
theorem evertseFourPair_product_bound_of_triple
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField)
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)))
    (p : EvertseFourPair) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hlocal : ∀ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p,
      max (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z p.1.1))
          (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z p.1.2)) ≤
        H ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)) :
    (∏ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p,
        evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v (z p.1.1) (z p.1.2)) ^ 3 ≤
      8 ^ (evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p).card *
        H ^ (-∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p,
          evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let T := evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p
  have hpoint : ∀ v ∈ T,
      evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v (z p.1.1) (z p.1.2) ^ 3 ≤
        8 * H ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ) := by
    intro v hv
    have hsel : evertseLocalFourPair v z = p :=
      mem_evertseFourPairPlaceSet.mp hv
    have hb := evertseLocalFourPair_bound v z
    rw [hsel] at hb
    exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlocal v hv) (by norm_num))
  calc
    (∏ v ∈ T, evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v
        (z p.1.1) (z p.1.2)) ^ 3 =
        ∏ v ∈ T, evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v
          (z p.1.1) (z p.1.2) ^ 3 := by
      rw [Finset.prod_pow]
    _ ≤ ∏ v ∈ T, (8 * H ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro v _hv
        exact pow_nonneg (evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg _ _ _) 3
      · exact hpoint
    _ = 8 ^ T.card * H ^ (-∑ v ∈ T, evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const]
      rw [← Real.rpow_sum_of_pos hH
        (fun v => (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)) T]
      congr 2
      rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseMaxTriple_le_commonHeight
statement:
theorem evertseMaxTriple_le_commonHeight
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField)
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)))
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hheight : ∀ i, H ≤ evertseNormalizedHeight (z i))
    (hgamma : ∀ i v, evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z i) ≤
      evertseNormalizedHeight (z i) ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ))
    (p : EvertseFourPair) (v : EvertsePlace S hS) :
    max (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z p.1.1))
        (evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z p.1.2)) ≤
      H ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply max_le
  · exact (hgamma p.1.1 v).trans
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hH (hheight p.1.1)
        (neg_nonpos.mpr (evertseLocalGamma_nonneg k v)))
  · exact (hgamma p.1.2 v).trans
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hH (hheight p.1.2)
        (neg_nonpos.mpr (evertseLocalGamma_nonneg k v)))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseFourPair_product_bound_of_fixedGamma
statement:
theorem exists_evertseFourPair_product_bound_of_fixedGamma
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField)
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)))
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hheight : ∀ i, H ≤ evertseNormalizedHeight (z i))
    (hgamma : ∀ i v, evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z i) ≤
      evertseNormalizedHeight (z i) ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)) :
    ∃ p : EvertseFourPair,
      (1 : ℝ) / 12 ≤ ∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet
          (S := S) (hS := hS) z p, evertseLocalGamma k v ∧
      (∏ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p,
          evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v (z p.1.1) (z p.1.2)) ^ 3 ≤
        8 ^ (evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p).card *
          H ^ (-∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet
              (S := S) (hS := hS) z p,
            evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_evertseFourPair_gamma_mass z k
  refine ⟨p, hp, evertseFourPair_product_bound_of_triple z k p hH ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  exact evertseMaxTriple_le_commonHeight z k hH hheight hgamma p v

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.finprod_evertseCloseness_le_exceptional
statement:
theorem finprod_evertseCloseness_le_exceptional
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {d : EvertseCubicField} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField, min 1 (w d)) ≤
      ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS, min 1 (w d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField → ℝ :=
    fun w => min 1 (w d)
  have habv : (fun w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField =>
      w d).HasFiniteMulSupport :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.hasFiniteMulSupport hd
  have hf : f.HasFiniteMulSupport := by
    apply habv.subset
    intro w hw
    simp only [Function.mem_mulSupport] at hw ⊢
    intro hone
    apply hw
    dsimp [f]
    rw [hone]
    norm_num
  let T := hf.toFinset ∪ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS
  change finprod f ≤ ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS, f w
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset f (s := T) (by
    intro w hw
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (hf.mem_toFinset.mpr hw))]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_le_one
  · exact Finset.subset_union_right
  · intro w _hw
    exact le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _)
  · intro _w _hw _hwExceptional
    exact min_le_left _ _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_le_retained
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_le_retained
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {d : EvertseCubicField} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct d ≤
      (∏ w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField, min 1 (w d)) *
        ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
          Real.sqrt (min 1 (w d))
proof:
:= by
  have hfin := finprod_evertseCloseness_le_exceptional S hS hd
  unfold evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct evertseGlobalClosenessProduct
  simp_rw [evertseInfinitePlace_mult_eq_two]
  let A := ∏ w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField, min 1 (w d)
  let B := ∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField, min 1 (w d)
  let C := ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS, min 1 (w d)
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := Finset.prod_nonneg fun w _hw =>
    le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _)
  have hprodInf :
      (∏ w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
          min 1 (w d) ^ 2) = A ^ 2 := by
    simpa [A] using Finset.prod_pow
      (Finset.univ : Finset (NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField)) 2
      (fun w => min 1 (w d))
  rw [hprodInf]
  change Real.sqrt (A ^ 2 * B) ≤ A *
    ∏ w ∈ evertseExceptionalFinitePlaces S hS,
      Real.sqrt (min 1 (w d))
  calc
    Real.sqrt (A ^ 2 * B) ≤ Real.sqrt (A ^ 2 * C) :=
      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfin (sq_nonneg A))
    _ = A * Real.sqrt C := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg A), Real.sqrt_sq hA0]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_prod _
        (fun w _hw => le_min (by norm_num) (w.1.nonneg _))]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_le_partialPlaces
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_le_partialPlaces
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    {d : EvertseCubicField} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (T : Finset (EvertsePlace S hS)) :
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct d ≤
      ∏ v ∈ T, evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v d 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct d ≤
        ∏ v : EvertsePlace S hS,
          evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v d 0 := by
      rw [prod_evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_retained]
      simpa [evertseRetainedNormalizedClosenessProduct] using
        evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_le_retained S hS hd
    _ ≤ ∏ v ∈ T, evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v d 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_le_one (Finset.subset_univ T)
      · intro v _hv
        exact evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_nonneg _ _ _
      · intro v _hv _hvT
        exact evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_le_one _ _ _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedHeight_sub_inv_le_partialPlaces
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedHeight_sub_inv_le_partialPlaces
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    {z w : EvertseCubicField} (hzw : z - w ≠ 0)
    (T : Finset (EvertsePlace S hS)) :
    (evertseNormalizedHeight (z - w))⁻¹ ≤
      ∏ v ∈ T, evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_eq_height_inv hzw]
  have h := evertseNormalizedGlobalClosenessProduct_le_partialPlaces
    (S := S) (hS := hS) hzw T
  simpa [evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness] using h

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseFourPair_gap_kernel
statement:
theorem exists_evertseFourPair_gap_kernel
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) (hzinj : Function.Injective z)
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)))
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hheight : ∀ i, H ≤ evertseNormalizedHeight (z i))
    (hgamma : ∀ i v, evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z i) ≤
      evertseNormalizedHeight (z i) ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)) :
    ∃ p : EvertseFourPair,
      (1 : ℝ) / 12 ≤ ∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet
          (S := S) (hS := hS) z p, evertseLocalGamma k v ∧
      (evertseNormalizedHeight (z p.1.1 - z p.1.2))⁻¹ ^ 3 ≤
        8 ^ (evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p).card *
          H ^ (-∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet
              (S := S) (hS := hS) z p,
            evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hmass, hupper⟩ :=
    exists_evertseFourPair_product_bound_of_fixedGamma z k hH hheight hgamma
  refine ⟨p, hmass, ?_⟩
  let T := evertseFourPairPlaceSet (S := S) (hS := hS) z p
  have hpne : z p.1.1 - z p.1.2 ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero.mpr (hzinj.ne p.2.ne)
  have hlower := evertseNormalizedHeight_sub_inv_le_partialPlaces hpne T
  exact (pow_le_pow_left₀
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans (one_le_evertseNormalizedHeight _)))
    hlower 3).trans hupper

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.exists_evertseFourPair_gap_kernel_uniform
statement:
theorem exists_evertseFourPair_gap_kernel_uniform
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) (hzinj : Function.Injective z)
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)))
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hheight : ∀ i, H ≤ evertseNormalizedHeight (z i))
    (hgamma : ∀ i v, evertseTriplePlaceCloseness v (z i) ≤
      evertseNormalizedHeight (z i) ^ (-evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ)) :
    ∃ p : EvertseFourPair,
      (evertseNormalizedHeight (z p.1.1 - z p.1.2))⁻¹ ^ 3 ≤
        8 ^ (2 * S.card + 2) * H ^ (-(1 / 12 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hmass, hgap⟩ := exists_evertseFourPair_gap_kernel z hzinj k
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hH) hheight hgamma
  refine ⟨p, hgap.trans ?_⟩
  have hcard : (evertseFourPairPlaceSet
      (S := S) (hS := hS) z p).card ≤ 2 * S.card + 2 :=
    (Finset.card_le_univ _).trans (card_evertsePlace_le S hS)
  have hp8 : (8 : ℝ) ^ (evertseFourPairPlaceSet
      (S := S) (hS := hS) z p).card ≤ 8 ^ (2 * S.card + 2) :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hcard
  have hrpow : H ^ (-∑ v ∈ evertseFourPairPlaceSet
        (S := S) (hS := hS) z p, evertseLocalGamma k v : ℝ) ≤
      H ^ (-(1 / 12 : ℝ)) := by
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hH
    linarith
  exact mul_le_mul hp8 hrpow
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hH) _)
    (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPair_endpointProduct_eq_cubeProduct
statement:
theorem evertseFourPair_endpointProduct_eq_cubeProduct
    (e : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    (∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (e j * e i)) =
      ∏ i : Fin 4, e i ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)) = {0, 1, 2, 3} := by
    decide
  have h0 : Finset.Ioi (0 : Fin 4) = {1, 2, 3} := by decide
  have h1 : Finset.Ioi (1 : Fin 4) = {2, 3} := by decide
  have h2 : Finset.Ioi (2 : Fin 4) = {3} := by decide
  have h3 : Finset.Ioi (3 : Fin 4) = ∅ := by decide
  rw [hu]
  simp [h0, h1, h2, h3]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointVandermonde_mul_eta_cubes
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointVandermonde_mul_eta_cubes
    {S : Finset ℕ} (x y : Fin 4 → ℚ)
    (hsol : ∀ i, IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S (x i) (y i)) :
    (evertseFourPointVandermonde
        (fun i => evertseZeta (x i) (y i))).det *
        (∏ i : Fin 4, evertseEta (x i) (y i) ^ 3) =
      (evertseRho - evertseRho ^ 2) ^ 6 *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField
          (∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (x j - x i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseFourPointVandermonde_det]
  rw [show (∏ i : Fin 4, evertseEta (x i) (y i) ^ 3) =
      ∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        (evertseEta (x j) (y j) * evertseEta (x i) (y i)) by
    exact (evertseFourPair_endpointProduct_eq_cubeProduct
      (fun i => evertseEta (x i) (y i))).symm]
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  simp_rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  simp_rw [evertseZeta_sub_zeta_mul_eta_mul_eta (hsol _) (hsol _)]
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  simp_rw [map_prod]
  congr 1
  · have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)) = {0, 1, 2, 3} := by
      decide
    rw [hu]
    simp
    ring
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j _hj
    rw [evertseSolution_determinant_eq_sub (hsol j) (hsol i)]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det
    (x y : Fin 4 → ℚ) :
    (evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde x y).det =
      (evertseRho - evertseRho ^ 2) ^ 6 *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField
          (∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
            (x j * y i - x i * y j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde,
    Matrix.det_projVandermonde]
  simp_rw [evertseXi_eta_cross_sub]
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  simp_rw [map_prod]
  congr 1
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)) = {0, 1, 2, 3} := by
    decide
  rw [hu]
  simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det_of_solutions
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det_of_solutions
    {S : Finset ℕ} (x y : Fin 4 → ℚ)
    (hsol : ∀ i, IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S (x i) (y i)) :
    (evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde x y).det =
      (evertseRho - evertseRho ^ 2) ^ 6 *
        algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField
          (∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (x j - x i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det]
  congr 2
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  exact evertseSolution_determinant_eq_sub (hsol j) (hsol i)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det_ne_zero
    {S : Finset ℕ} (x y : Fin 4 → ℚ)
    (hsol : ∀ i, IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S (x i) (y i))
    (hx : Function.Injective x) :
    (evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde x y).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det_of_solutions x y hsol]
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · exact pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr evertseRho_ne_square)
  · apply (map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℚ EvertseCubicField)).2
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i _hi
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro j hj
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hx.ne (Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hj).ne')

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_evertseRationalHeightBall
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_evertseRationalHeightBall {B : ℝ} {q : ℚ} :
    q ∈ evertseRationalHeightBall B ↔ rationalHeight q ≤ B
