:= by
  simp [evertseRationalHeightBall]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_boundedRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {B : ℝ} {x y : ℚ} :
    (x, y) ∈ boundedRationalSUnitEquationCarrier S B ↔
      IsBoundedRationalSUnitEquationSolution S B x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpair⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxy
    change q ∈ (evertseRationalHeightBall B).filter (fun q =>
      IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S
        (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).1
        (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).2) at hq
    obtain ⟨hqB, hsol⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
    have hqAdd : q + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      exact hsol.2.1.ne_zero (by simp [rationalEquationPairOfRatio, hz])
    have hratio := rationalEquationPairOfRatio_ratio_of_ne hqAdd
    have hbounded : IsBoundedRationalSUnitEquationSolution S B
        (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).1
        (rationalEquationPairOfRatio q).2 :=
      ⟨hsol, by
        rw [hratio]
        exact mem_evertseRationalHeightBall.mp hqB⟩
    simpa only [hpair] using hbounded
  · rintro ⟨hsol, hB⟩
    let q := x / y
    have hpair : rationalEquationPairOfRatio q = (x, y) :=
      rationalEquationPairOfRatio_eq_of_solution hsol
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨q, show q ∈ boundedRationalSUnitEquationRatioSet S B from
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨mem_evertseRationalHeightBall.mpr hB, ?_⟩, hpair⟩
    simpa only [hpair] using hsol

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {B : ℝ} {x y : ℚ} :
    (x, y) ∈ boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier S B ↔
      IsHighRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y ∧
        rationalHeight (x / y) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier, Finset.mem_filter,
    mem_boundedRationalSUnitEquationCarrier]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hsol, hB⟩, hhigh⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hsol, hhigh⟩, hB⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hsol, hhigh⟩, hB⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hsol, hB⟩, hhigh⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.mem_boundedEvertseGammaCarrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_boundedEvertseGammaCarrier
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime} {B : ℝ}
    {k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS))}
    {x y : ℚ} :
    (x, y) ∈ boundedEvertseGammaCarrier hS B k ↔
      IsInEvertseGamma hS k x y ∧ rationalHeight (x / y) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [boundedEvertseGammaCarrier, Finset.mem_filter,
    mem_boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨_hhigh, hB⟩, hgamma⟩
    exact ⟨hgamma, hB⟩
  · rintro ⟨hgamma, hB⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hgamma.1, hB⟩, hgamma⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsHighRationalSUnitEquationSolution.exists_evertseGamma
statement:
theorem IsHighRationalSUnitEquationSolution.exists_evertseGamma
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime)
    {x y : ℚ} (hhigh : IsHighRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    ∃ k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)),
      IsInEvertseGamma hS k x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
    exists_evertseGamma_for_high_solution hS hhigh.1 hhigh.2
  exact ⟨k, hhigh, hk⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_subset_gammaUnion
statement:
theorem boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_subset_gammaUnion
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) (B : ℝ) :
    boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier S B ⊆
      Finset.univ.biUnion (boundedEvertseGammaCarrier hS B)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨hhigh, hB⟩ :=
    mem_boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier.mp hz
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hhigh.exists_evertseGamma hS
  exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ _,
    mem_boundedEvertseGammaCarrier.mpr ⟨hk, hB⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.card_boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_le_sum_gamma
statement:
theorem card_boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_le_sum_gamma
    {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) (B : ℝ) :
    (boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier S B).card ≤
      ∑ k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)),
        (boundedEvertseGammaCarrier hS B k).card
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finset.card_le_card
    (boundedHighRationalSUnitEquationCarrier_subset_gammaUnion hS B)).trans
    Finset.card_biUnion_le

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointMinHeight_le
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointMinHeight_le
    (z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) (i : Fin 4) :
    evertseFourPointMinHeight z ≤ evertseNormalizedHeight (z i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ
    (fun i => evertseNormalizedHeight (z i)) Finset.univ_nonempty)).2 i
    (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointMinHeight_ge_three_of_high
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointMinHeight_ge_three_of_high
    {S : Finset ℕ} (u : Fin 4 → ℚ × ℚ)
    (hu : ∀ i, IsHighRationalSUnitEquationSolution S (u i).1 (u i).2) :
    3 ≤ evertseFourPointMinHeight
      (fun i => evertseZeta (u i).1 (u i).2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseFourPointMinHeight
  exact evertseNormalizedHeight_ge_three_of_high
    (hu (evertseFourPointMinHeightIndex
      fun i => evertseZeta (u i).1 (u i).2)).1
    (hu (evertseFourPointMinHeightIndex
      fun i => evertseZeta (u i).1 (u i).2)).2

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseZeta_injective_of_pair_injective
statement:
theorem evertseZeta_injective_of_pair_injective
    {S : Finset ℕ} (u : Fin 4 → ℚ × ℚ)
    (hu : ∀ i, IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S (u i).1 (u i).2)
    (hinj : Function.Injective u) :
    Function.Injective (fun i => evertseZeta (u i).1 (u i).2)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hz
  apply hinj
  exact evertseZeta_injective_on_solutions (hu i) (hu j) hz

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFirstCoordinate_injective_of_pair_injective
statement:
theorem evertseFirstCoordinate_injective_of_pair_injective
    {S : Finset ℕ} (u : Fin 4 → ℚ × ℚ)
    (hu : ∀ i, IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S (u i).1 (u i).2)
    (hinj : Function.Injective u) :
    Function.Injective (fun i => (u i).1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hx
  apply hinj
  apply Prod.ext hx
  linarith [(hu i).2.2, (hu j).2.2]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsInEvertseGamma.exists_fourPoint_gap
statement:
theorem IsInEvertseGamma.exists_fourPoint_gap
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)))
    (u : Fin 4 → ℚ × ℚ) (hinj : Function.Injective u)
    (hu : ∀ i, IsInEvertseGamma hS k (u i).1 (u i).2) :
    ∃ p : EvertseFourPair,
      (evertseNormalizedHeight
          (evertseZeta (u p.1.1).1 (u p.1.1).2 -
            evertseZeta (u p.1.2).1 (u p.1.2).2))⁻¹ ^ 3 ≤
        8 ^ (2 * S.card + 2) *
          evertseFourPointMinHeight
            (fun i => evertseZeta (u i).1 (u i).2) ^ (-(1 / 12 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let z : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField :=
    fun i => evertseZeta (u i).1 (u i).2
  apply exists_evertseFourPair_gap_kernel_uniform z
    (evertseZeta_injective_of_pair_injective u
      (fun i => (hu i).1.1) hinj) k
  · exact (by
      linarith [evertseFourPointMinHeight_ge_three_of_high u
        (fun i => (hu i).1)] : 1 ≤ evertseFourPointMinHeight z)
  · exact evertseFourPointMinHeight_le z
  · intro i v
    exact (hu i).2 v

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.IsInEvertseGamma.projectiveVandermonde_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsInEvertseGamma.projectiveVandermonde_det_ne_zero
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (k : EvertseGammaIndex (Fintype.card (EvertsePlace S hS)))
    (u : Fin 4 → ℚ × ℚ) (hinj : Function.Injective u)
    (hu : ∀ i, IsInEvertseGamma hS k (u i).1 (u i).2) :
    (evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde
      (fun i => (u i).1) (fun i => (u i).2)).det ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_det_ne_zero _ _
    (fun i => (hu i).1.1)
    (evertseFirstCoordinate_injective_of_pair_injective u
      (fun i => (hu i).1.1) hinj)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseProjectiveVandermonde_entry_eq_eta_cube_mul_zeta_pow
statement:
theorem evertseProjectiveVandermonde_entry_eq_eta_cube_mul_zeta_pow
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) (j : Fin 4) :
    evertseXi x y ^ j.1 * evertseEta x y ^ j.rev.1 =
      evertseEta x y ^ 3 * evertseZeta x y ^ j.1
proof:
:= by
  have heta := evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol
  rw [evertseZeta, div_pow, ← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ heta)).2
  rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, j.rev_add_cast]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_eq_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde_eq_diagonal_mul
    {S : Finset ℕ} (x y : Fin 4 → ℚ)
    (hsol : ∀ i, IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S (x i) (y i)) :
    evertseFourPointProjectiveVandermonde x y =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => evertseEta (x i) (y i) ^ 3) *
        evertseFourPointVandermonde (fun i => evertseZeta (x i) (y i))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change evertseXi (x i) (y i) ^ j.1 * evertseEta (x i) (y i) ^ j.rev.1 =
    ∑ a, Matrix.diagonal (fun i => evertseEta (x i) (y i) ^ 3) i a *
      evertseZeta (x a) (y a) ^ j.1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
    exact evertseProjectiveVandermonde_entry_eq_eta_cube_mul_zeta_pow
      (hsol i) j
  · intro b _hb hbi
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ hbi.symm]
    simp
  · intro hi
    exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseNormalizedHeight_eq_sqrt_pairHeight
statement:
theorem evertseNormalizedHeight_eq_sqrt_pairHeight (x y : ℚ) :
    evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y) =
      Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight
        ![evertseXi x y, evertseEta x y])
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseNormalizedHeight, evertseZeta,
    Height.mulHeight₁_div_eq_mulHeight]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePair_abv_iSup
statement:
theorem evertsePair_abv_iSup
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (X E : EvertseCubicField) :
    (⨆ i : Fin 2, v (![X, E] i)) = v X ⊔ v E
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  · apply max_le
    · exact Finite.le_ciSup (fun i : Fin 2 ↦ v (![X, E] i)) 0
    · exact Finite.le_ciSup (fun i : Fin 2 ↦ v (![X, E] i)) 1

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseCubicVeronese_abv_iSup
statement:
theorem evertseCubicVeronese_abv_iSup
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (X E : EvertseCubicField) :
    (⨆ j : Fin 4, v (evertseCubicVeronese X E j)) =
      (v X ⊔ v E) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ciSup_le
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [evertseCubicVeronese, map_mul, map_pow]
    · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (v.nonneg E) (le_max_right _ _) 3
    · calc
        v X * v E ^ 2 ≤ (v X ⊔ v E) * (v X ⊔ v E) ^ 2 := by
          exact mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _)
            (pow_le_pow_left₀ (v.nonneg E) (le_max_right _ _) 2)
            (sq_nonneg _)
            ((v.nonneg X).trans (le_max_left _ _))
        _ = (v X ⊔ v E) ^ 3 := by ring
    · calc
        v X ^ 2 * v E ≤ (v X ⊔ v E) ^ 2 * (v X ⊔ v E) := by
          exact mul_le_mul
            (pow_le_pow_left₀ (v.nonneg X) (le_max_left _ _) 2)
            (le_max_right _ _) (v.nonneg E) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (v X ⊔ v E) ^ 3 := by ring
    · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (v.nonneg X) (le_max_left _ _) 3
  · rcases le_total (v X) (v E) with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      have hz := Finite.le_ciSup
        (fun j : Fin 4 ↦ v (evertseCubicVeronese X E j)) (0 : Fin 4)
      simpa [evertseCubicVeronese, map_mul, map_pow] using hz
    · rw [max_eq_left h]
      have hz := Finite.le_ciSup
        (fun j : Fin 4 ↦ v (evertseCubicVeronese X E j)) (3 : Fin 4)
      simpa [evertseCubicVeronese, map_mul, map_pow] using hz

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseCubicVeronese_abv_iSup_eq_pair_pow_iSup
statement:
theorem evertseCubicVeronese_abv_iSup_eq_pair_pow_iSup
    (v : AbsoluteValue EvertseCubicField ℝ) (X E : EvertseCubicField) :
    (⨆ j : Fin 4, v (evertseCubicVeronese X E j)) =
      ⨆ i : Fin 2, v ((![X, E] ^ 3) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseCubicVeronese_abv_iSup]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply, map_pow]
  rw [← Real.iSup_pow (fun i : Fin 2 ↦ v.nonneg (![X, E] i))]
  rw [evertsePair_abv_iSup]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseCubicVeronese_mulHeight
statement:
theorem evertseCubicVeronese_mulHeight
    (X E : EvertseCubicField) (hE : E ≠ 0) :
    Height.mulHeight (evertseCubicVeronese X E) =
      Height.mulHeight ![X, E] ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hv : evertseCubicVeronese X E ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h (0 : Fin 4)
    simp [evertseCubicVeronese, hE] at h0
  have hp : (![X, E] : Fin 2 → EvertseCubicField) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 := congrFun h (1 : Fin 2)
    simp [hE] at h1
  have hp3 : ((![X, E] : Fin 2 → EvertseCubicField) ^ 3) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ hp
  calc
    Height.mulHeight (evertseCubicVeronese X E) =
        Height.mulHeight ((![X, E] : Fin 2 → EvertseCubicField) ^ 3) := by
      rw [Height.mulHeight_eq hv, Height.mulHeight_eq hp3]
      simp_rw [evertseCubicVeronese_abv_iSup_eq_pair_pow_iSup]
    _ = Height.mulHeight ![X, E] ^ 3 := Height.mulHeight_pow _ _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseCubicVeronese_solution_mulHeight
statement:
theorem evertseCubicVeronese_solution_mulHeight
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    Height.mulHeight
        (evertseCubicVeronese (evertseXi x y) (evertseEta x y)) =
      evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y) ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseCubicVeronese_mulHeight _ _
      (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol),
    ← Height.mulHeight₁_div_eq_mulHeight]
  change Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y) ^ 3 =
    evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y) ^ 6
  rw [evertseNormalizedHeight]
  calc
    Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y) ^ 3 =
        (Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y)) ^ 2) ^ 3 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁_nonneg _)]
    _ = Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight₁ (evertseZeta x y)) ^ 6 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.finprod_sqrt_eq_sqrt_finprod_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem finprod_sqrt_eq_sqrt_finprod_of_nonneg
    {f : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField → ℝ}
    (hf : f.HasFiniteMulSupport) (hf0 : ∀ w, 0 ≤ f w) :
    (∏ᶠ w, Real.sqrt (f w)) = Real.sqrt (∏ᶠ w, f w)
proof:
:= by
  let T := hf.toFinset
  have hs : (fun w ↦ Real.sqrt (f w)).HasFiniteMulSupport := by
    change (Real.sqrt ∘ f).HasFiniteMulSupport
    exact hf.comp Real.sqrt_one
  rw [finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ (s := T) (by
      intro w hw
      change w ∈ hf.toFinset
      apply hf.mem_toFinset.mpr
      intro hone
      apply hw
      simp [hone]),
    finprod_eq_prod_of_mulSupport_subset _ (s := T) (by
      intro w hw
      exact hf.mem_toFinset.mpr hw)]
  exact (Real.sqrt_prod T (fun w _hw ↦ hf0 w)).symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm_eq_sqrt_mulHeight
statement:
theorem evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm_eq_sqrt_mulHeight
    (X E : EvertseCubicField) (hX : X ≠ 0) (hE : E ≠ 0) :
    evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm X E =
      Real.sqrt (Height.mulHeight ![X, E])
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (![X, E] : Fin 2 → EvertseCubicField) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 := congrFun h (1 : Fin 2)
    simp [hE] at h1
  have hXfin : (fun w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField ↦
      w X).HasFiniteMulSupport :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.hasFiniteMulSupport hX
  have hEfin : (fun w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField ↦
      w E).HasFiniteMulSupport :=
    NumberField.FinitePlace.hasFiniteMulSupport hE
  have hmax : (fun w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField ↦
      max (w X) (w E)).HasFiniteMulSupport := hXfin.max hEfin
  rw [NumberField.mulHeight_eq hp]
  have Hinf (w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField) :
      (⨆ i : Fin 2, w (![X, E] i)) = max (w X) (w E) :=
    evertsePair_abv_iSup w.1 X E
  have Hfin (w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField) :
      (⨆ i : Fin 2, w (![X, E] i)) = max (w X) (w E) :=
    evertsePair_abv_iSup w.1 X E
  simp_rw [Hinf, Hfin]
  simp_rw [evertseInfinitePlace_mult_eq_two]
  let A := ∏ w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
    max (w X) (w E)
  let B := ∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
    max (w X) (w E)
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := Finset.prod_nonneg fun w _hw ↦
    (w.1.nonneg X).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have harch :
      (∏ w : NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
        max (w X) (w E) ^ 2) = A ^ 2 := by
    simpa [A] using Finset.prod_pow
      (Finset.univ : Finset (NumberField.InfinitePlace EvertseCubicField)) 2
      (fun w ↦ max (w X) (w E))
  have hfin :
      (∏ᶠ w : NumberField.FinitePlace EvertseCubicField,
        Real.sqrt (max (w X) (w E))) = Real.sqrt B := by
    simpa [B] using finprod_sqrt_eq_sqrt_finprod_of_nonneg hmax
      (fun w ↦ (w.1.nonneg X).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  unfold evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm
    evertseInfiniteProjectiveNorm evertseFiniteProjectiveNorm
  rw [harch, hfin]
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg A), Real.sqrt_sq hA0]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm_solution
statement:
theorem evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm_solution
    {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℚ}
    (hsol : IsRationalSUnitEquationSolution S x y) :
    evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm
        (evertseXi x y) (evertseEta x y) =
      evertseNormalizedHeight (evertseZeta x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertseGlobalNormalizedProjectiveNorm_eq_sqrt_mulHeight _ _
    (evertseXi_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)
    (evertseEta_ne_zero_of_solution hsol)]
  exact (evertseNormalizedHeight_eq_sqrt_pairHeight x y).symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (a : EvertseCubicField) :
    0 ≤ evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · exact w.1.nonneg _
  · exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_one
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w <;> simp [evertsePlaceScalarNorm]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (a b : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (a * b) =
      evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a * evertsePlaceScalarNorm v b
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · simp [evertsePlaceScalarNorm, map_mul]
  · simp only [evertsePlaceScalarNorm, map_mul]
    exact Real.sqrt_mul (w.1.1.nonneg a) _

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pow
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pow
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (a : EvertseCubicField) (n : ℕ) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (a ^ n) = evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [evertsePlaceScalarNorm_one]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul, ih, pow_succ]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_neg
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_neg
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (a : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (-a) = evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · exact map_neg_eq_map w.1 a
  · simp [evertsePlaceScalarNorm]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_inv
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_inv
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (a : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a⁻¹ = (evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · simp [evertsePlaceScalarNorm, map_inv₀]
  · simp [evertsePlaceScalarNorm, map_inv₀, Real.sqrt_inv]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_div
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_div
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (a b : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (a / b) =
      evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a / evertsePlaceScalarNorm v b
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul,
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pos
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pos
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) {a : EvertseCubicField} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    0 < evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · exact AbsoluteValue.pos w.1 ha
  · exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (AbsoluteValue.pos w.1.1 ha)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_add_le
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (a b : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (a + b) ≤
      evertsePlaceScalarNorm v a + evertsePlaceScalarNorm v b
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · exact w.1.add_le _ _
  · have hadd := NumberField.FinitePlace.add_le w.1 a b
    simp only [evertsePlaceScalarNorm]
    calc
      Real.sqrt (w.1 (a + b)) ≤
          Real.sqrt (max (w.1 a) (w.1 b)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hadd
      _ = max (Real.sqrt (w.1 a)) (Real.sqrt (w.1 b)) := by
        rcases le_total (w.1 a) (w.1 b) with h | h
        · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h)]
        · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h)]
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (w.1 a) + Real.sqrt (w.1 b) := by
        exact max_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
          (le_add_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_min_scalarNorm
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_min_scalarNorm
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (z root : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v z root =
      min 1 (evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (z - root))
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with w | w
  · rfl
  · change Real.sqrt (min 1 (w.1.1 (z - root))) =
      min 1 (Real.sqrt (w.1.1 (z - root)))
    let a := w.1.1 (z - root)
    change Real.sqrt (min 1 a) = min 1 (Real.sqrt a)
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := w.1.1.nonneg _
    by_cases h : a ≤ 1
    · rw [min_eq_right h, min_eq_right]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr h
    · have h1 : 1 ≤ a := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h)
      rw [min_eq_left h1, Real.sqrt_one, min_eq_left]
      exact Real.one_le_sqrt.mpr h1

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_nonneg
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_nonneg
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (X E : EvertseCubicField) :
    0 ≤ evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X E
proof:
:=
  (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg v X).trans (le_max_left _ _)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_pos_right
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_pos_right
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (X : EvertseCubicField)
    {E : EvertseCubicField} (hE : E ≠ 0) :
    0 < evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X E
proof:
:=
  (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pos v hE).trans_le (le_max_right _ _)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_smul
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_smul
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (c X E : EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v (c * X) (c * E) =
      evertsePlaceScalarNorm v c * evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X E
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm
  rw [evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul]
  exact (mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg v c)).symm

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_eq_eta_mul_affine
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_eq_eta_mul_affine
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (X : EvertseCubicField)
    {E : EvertseCubicField} (hE : E ≠ 0) :
    evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X E =
      evertsePlaceScalarNorm v E *
        max (evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X / E)) 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X E =
        evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v (E * (X / E)) (E * 1) := by
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hE, mul_one]
    _ = evertsePlaceScalarNorm v E *
        evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v (X / E) 1 :=
      evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_smul v E (X / E) 1
    _ = _ := by
      rw [evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_one]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_monomial_le_projectiveNorm_pow
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_monomial_le_projectiveNorm_pow
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (X E : EvertseCubicField) (a b : ℕ) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X ^ a * E ^ b) ≤
      evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X E ^ (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pow,
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pow, pow_add]
  exact mul_le_mul
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg v X)
      (le_max_left _ _) a)
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg v E)
      (le_max_right _ _) b)
    (pow_nonneg (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg v E) b)
    (pow_nonneg (evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_nonneg v X E) a)

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_cubicVeronese_le
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_cubicVeronese_le
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (X E : EvertseCubicField) (j : Fin 4) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (evertseCubicVeronese X E j) ≤
      evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X E ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold evertseCubicVeronese
  convert evertsePlaceScalarNorm_monomial_le_projectiveNorm_pow
    v X E j.1 j.rev.1 using 1
  rw [j.add_rev_cast]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance_le_two
proof:
:= by
  have hn₁pos : 0 < evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₁ E₁ :=
    evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_pos_right v X₁ hE₁
  have hn₂pos : 0 < evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₂ E₂ :=
    evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_pos_right v X₂ hE₂
  rw [evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance,
    div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hn₁pos hn₂pos)]
  calc
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X₁ * E₂ - X₂ * E₁) ≤
        evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X₁ * E₂) +
          evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X₂ * E₁) := by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_neg] using
        evertsePlaceScalarNorm_add_le v (X₁ * E₂) (-(X₂ * E₁))
    _ = evertsePlaceScalarNorm v X₁ * evertsePlaceScalarNorm v E₂ +
        evertsePlaceScalarNorm v X₂ * evertsePlaceScalarNorm v E₁ := by
      rw [evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul]
    _ ≤ evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₁ E₁ *
          evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₂ E₂ +
        evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₂ E₂ *
          evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₁ E₁ := by
      apply _root_.add_le_add
      · exact mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
          (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg v E₂)
          (evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_nonneg v X₁ E₁)
      · exact mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
          (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg v E₁)
          (evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_nonneg v X₂ E₂)
    _ = 2 * (evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₁ E₁ *
        evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v X₂ E₂) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseProjectiveCross_eq_denominators_mul_affine_sub
statement:
theorem evertseProjectiveCross_eq_denominators_mul_affine_sub
    (X₁ E₁ X₂ E₂ : EvertseCubicField)
    (hE₁ : E₁ ≠ 0) (hE₂ : E₂ ≠ 0) :
    X₁ * E₂ - X₂ * E₁ =
      (E₁ * E₂) * (X₁ / E₁ - X₂ / E₂)
proof:
:= by
  field_simp [hE₁, hE₂]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance_eq_affine
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance_eq_affine
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS)
    {X₁ E₁ X₂ E₂ : EvertseCubicField}
    (hE₁ : E₁ ≠ 0) (hE₂ : E₂ ≠ 0) :
    evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance v X₁ E₁ X₂ E₂ =
      evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X₁ / E₁ - X₂ / E₂) /
        (max (evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X₁ / E₁)) 1 *
          max (evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (X₂ / E₂)) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance,
    evertseProjectiveCross_eq_denominators_mul_affine_sub _ _ _ _ hE₁ hE₂,
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul,
    evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_eq_eta_mul_affine v X₁ hE₁,
    evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm_eq_eta_mul_affine v X₂ hE₂]
  have hn₁ := (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pos v hE₁).ne'
  have hn₂ := (evertsePlaceScalarNorm_pos v hE₂).ne'
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.div_max_mul_max_le_two_mul_min
statement:
theorem div_max_mul_max_le_two_mul_min
    {a b d : ℝ} (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd : d ≤ a + b) :
    d / (max a 1 * max b 1) ≤ 2 * min 1 d
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 1 ≤ max a 1 := le_max_right _ _
  have hB : 1 ≤ max b 1 := le_max_right _ _
  have hden : 0 < max a 1 * max b 1 := mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  by_cases hd1 : d ≤ 1
  · rw [min_eq_right hd1]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    have hden1 : 1 ≤ max a 1 * max b 1 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hA) (sub_nonneg.mpr hB)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hd0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hden1)]
  · have h1d : 1 ≤ d := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hd1)
    rw [min_eq_left h1d]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    have haA : a ≤ max a 1 := le_max_left _ _
    have hbB : b ≤ max b 1 := le_max_left _ _
    have hprod : 0 ≤ (max a 1 - 1) * (max b 1 - 1) :=
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hA) (sub_nonneg.mpr hB)
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance_le_two_mul_closeness
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance_le_two_mul_closeness
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS)
    {X₁ E₁ X₂ E₂ : EvertseCubicField}
    (hE₁ : E₁ ≠ 0) (hE₂ : E₂ ≠ 0) :
    evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance v X₁ E₁ X₂ E₂ ≤
      2 * evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness v (X₁ / E₁) (X₂ / E₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance_eq_affine v hE₁ hE₂,
    evertsePlaceNormalizedCloseness_eq_min_scalarNorm]
  apply div_max_mul_max_le_two_mul_min
  · exact evertsePlaceScalarNorm_nonneg _ _
  · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_neg] using
      evertsePlaceScalarNorm_add_le v (X₁ / E₁) (-(X₂ / E₂))

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertsePlaceScalarNorm_prod
statement:
theorem evertsePlaceScalarNorm_prod
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I]
    (T : Finset I) (f : I → EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (∏ i ∈ T, f i) =
      ∏ i ∈ T, evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction T using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [evertsePlaceScalarNorm_one]
  | @insert a T ha ih => simp [ha, evertsePlaceScalarNorm_mul, ih]

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseFourPair_endpointProduct_real
statement:
theorem evertseFourPair_endpointProduct_real (e : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (e j * e i)) =
      ∏ i : Fin 4, e i ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4)) = {0, 1, 2, 3} := by decide
  have h0 : Finset.Ioi (0 : Fin 4) = {1, 2, 3} := by decide
  have h1 : Finset.Ioi (1 : Fin 4) = {2, 3} := by decide
  have h2 : Finset.Ioi (2 : Fin 4) = {3} := by decide
  have h3 : Finset.Ioi (3 : Fin 4) = ∅ := by decide
  rw [hu]
  simp [h0, h1, h2, h3]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.SUnitQuantitative.evertseProjVandermonde_normalizedDet_eq_distanceProduct
statement:
theorem evertseProjVandermonde_normalizedDet_eq_distanceProduct
    {S : Finset ℕ} {hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime}
    (v : EvertsePlace S hS) (X E : Fin 4 → EvertseCubicField) :
    evertsePlaceScalarNorm v (Matrix.projVandermonde X E).det /
        (∏ i : Fin 4, evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v (X i) (E i) ^ 3) =
      ∏ i : Fin 4, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i,
        evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance v (X j) (E j) (X i) (E i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_projVandermonde]
  rw [evertsePlaceScalarNorm_prod]
  simp_rw [evertsePlaceScalarNorm_prod]
  simp_rw [evertsePlaceProjectiveDistance]
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  congr 1
  exact (evertseFourPair_endpointProduct_real
    (fun i ↦ evertsePlaceProjectiveNorm v (X i) (E i))).symm

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankT_pos
statement:
theorem fixedRankT_pos {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hG : 0 < scaleG x) :
    0 < fixedRankT J x
proof:
:=
  div_pos hG (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))

name: RankAmplification.sqrt_mul_fixedRankT
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_fixedRankT {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Real.sqrt J * fixedRankT J x = scaleG x
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedRankT]
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)))

name: RankAmplification.nat_mul_fixedRankT
statement:
theorem nat_mul_fixedRankT {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    J * fixedRankT J x = Real.sqrt J * scaleG x
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt (J : ℝ)) ^ 2 = J := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  calc
    J * fixedRankT J x = (Real.sqrt (J : ℝ)) ^ 2 * fixedRankT J x :=
      congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ z * fixedRankT J x) hsq.symm
    _ = Real.sqrt J * scaleG x := by
      rw [fixedRankT]
      field_simp [hsqrt]

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleExponent_le_half
statement:
theorem movingSaddleExponent_le_half {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    movingSaddleExponent c ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingSaddleExponent
  by_cases h : c ≤ 1 / 2
  · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans h
  · have hhalf : 1 / 2 < c := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hinv : 1 / (4 * c) < 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * c) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      nlinarith
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans hinv.le

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_iff
statement:
theorem movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_iff {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    movingSaddleExponent c = 1 / 2 ↔ c = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hle : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ movingSaddleExponent c := heq.ge
    have hcLower : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ c := hle.trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hinvLower : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (4 * c) := hle.trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hcUpper : c ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * c)] at hinvLower
      nlinarith
    exact le_antisymm hcUpper hcLower
  · intro hcEq
    subst c
    norm_num [movingSaddleExponent]

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleExponent_lt_half
statement:
theorem movingSaddleExponent_lt_half {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hne : c ≠ 1 / 2) :
    movingSaddleExponent c < 1 / 2
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (movingSaddleExponent_le_half hc)
    (Ne.symm (fun h ↦ hne ((movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_iff hc).mp h.symm)))

name: RankAmplification.FixedRankTailData.toReducedData
statement:
theorem FixedRankTailData.toReducedData
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow ρsupplier : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankTailData J ρlow ρsupplier) :
    FixedRankReducedData J ρlow
      (fixedRankSupplierMassTailError J ρsupplier) where
  rank_pos
proof:
:= data.rank_pos
  lowRank := data.lowRank
  supplierMassTail :=
    fixedRankSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_weightedFriableTail
      data.rank_pos data.supplierTail

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankTailReducedError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankTailReducedError_zero
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow ρsupplier : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankTailData J ρlow ρsupplier) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankTailReducedError J ρlow ρsupplier)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_fixedRankReducedError_zero data.toReducedData

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_theorem10_14_of_tailData
statement:
theorem fixedRank_theorem10_14_of_tailData
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow ρsupplier : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankTailData J ρlow ρsupplier) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
            (fixedRankTailReducedError J ρlow ρsupplier) x
proof:
:=
  fixedRank_theorem10_14_of_reducedData data.toReducedData

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_tailData
statement:
theorem fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_tailData
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow ρsupplier : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankTailData J ρlow ρsupplier) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x → Odd h →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
          (fixedRankTailReducedError J ρlow ρsupplier) x
proof:
:=
  fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_reducedData data.toReducedData

name: RankAmplification.isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit {p} n ↔ ∃ i : ℕ, n = p ^ i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hsub⟩
    refine ⟨n.primeFactorsList.length, Nat.eq_prime_pow_of_unique_prime_dvd hpos.ne' ?_⟩
    intro d hd hdn
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hsub (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hd, hdn, hpos.ne'⟩))
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨pow_pos hp.pos i, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    have hqp : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
    have hqd : q ∣ p ^ i := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr
      ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hqp hp).mp (hqp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hqd))

name: RankAmplification.primeSupport_prime_pow
statement:
theorem primeSupport_prime_pow {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) :
    primeSupport (p ^ a) = {p}
proof:
:=
  Nat.primeFactors_prime_pow ha.ne' hp

name: RankAmplification.prime_pow_add_one_ne_prime_pow
statement:
theorem prime_pow_add_one_ne_prime_pow {p d e : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hd : 0 < d) :
    p ^ d + 1 ≠ p ^ e
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hp2 := hp.two_le
  have hpd : p ∣ p ^ d := dvd_pow_self p hd.ne'
  have hple : 1 ≤ p ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hp.pos
  have he : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, pow_zero] at heq
    have hple2 : p ≤ p ^ d := Nat.le_self_pow hd.ne' p
    omega
  have hpe : p ∣ p ^ d + 1 := by
    rw [heq]
    exact dvd_pow_self p he
  have hone : p ∣ 1 := by
    have hsub := Nat.dvd_sub hpe hpd
    simpa using hsub
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.one_pos hone
  omega

name: RankAmplification.eq_of_prime_pow_add_prime_pow_eq_prime_pow
statement:
theorem eq_of_prime_pow_add_prime_pow_eq_prime_pow {p a i j : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a)
    (heq : p ^ i + p ^ a = p ^ j) : p = 2 ∧ i = a ∧ j = a + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hppos : 0 < p := hp.pos
  have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
  rcases lt_trichotomy i a with hlt | hia | hgt
  · exfalso
    have hdvd : p ^ i ∣ p ^ j := by
      rw [← heq]
      exact dvd_add dvd_rfl (pow_dvd_pow p hlt.le)
    have _hij : i ≤ j := (Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right hp1).mp hdvd
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, a = i + d := ⟨a - i, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ : ∃ e, j = i + e := ⟨j - i, by omega⟩
    simp only [pow_add] at heq
    have h2 : p ^ i * (p ^ d + 1) = p ^ i * p ^ e := by
      calc p ^ i * (p ^ d + 1) = p ^ i + p ^ i * p ^ d := by ring
        _ = p ^ i * p ^ e := heq
    exact prime_pow_add_one_ne_prime_pow hp (by omega)
      (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (pow_pos hppos i) h2)
  · rw [hia] at heq
    have hdvd : p ^ a ∣ p ^ j := by
      rw [← heq]
      exact dvd_add dvd_rfl dvd_rfl
    have _haj : a ≤ j := (Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right hp1).mp hdvd
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ : ∃ e, j = a + e := ⟨j - a, by omega⟩
    rw [pow_add] at heq
    have h2 : p ^ a * 2 = p ^ a * p ^ e := by
      calc p ^ a * 2 = p ^ a + p ^ a := by ring
        _ = p ^ a * p ^ e := heq
    have h3 : (2 : ℕ) = p ^ e := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (pow_pos hppos a) h2
    have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, pow_zero] at h3
      exact absurd h3 (by norm_num)
    have hpdvd : p ∣ 2 := by
      rw [h3]
      exact dvd_pow_self p he0
    have hp2 : p = 2 := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).mp hpdvd
    subst hp2
    have he1 : e = 1 :=
      Nat.pow_right_injective (le_refl 2) (h3.symm.trans (pow_one 2).symm)
    exact ⟨rfl, hia, by omega⟩
  · exfalso
    have hdvd : p ^ a ∣ p ^ j := by
      rw [← heq]
      exact dvd_add (pow_dvd_pow p hgt.le) dvd_rfl
    have _haj : a ≤ j := (Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right hp1).mp hdvd
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, i = a + d := ⟨i - a, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ : ∃ e, j = a + e := ⟨j - a, by omega⟩
    simp only [pow_add] at heq
    have h2 : p ^ a * (p ^ d + 1) = p ^ a * p ^ e := by
      calc p ^ a * (p ^ d + 1) = p ^ a * p ^ d + p ^ a := by ring
        _ = p ^ a * p ^ e := heq
    exact prime_pow_add_one_ne_prime_pow hp (by omega)
      (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (pow_pos hppos a) h2)

name: RankAmplification.isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_two
statement:
theorem isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_two {a : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport (2 ^ a)) (2 ^ a) {(2 ^ a, 2 ^ (a + 1))}
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : primeSupport (2 ^ a) = {2} := primeSupport_prime_pow Nat.prime_two ha
  intro u v
  rw [hsupp]
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at hmem
    obtain ⟨hu, hv⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨(isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff Nat.prime_two).mpr ⟨a, hu⟩,
      (isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff Nat.prime_two).mpr ⟨a + 1, hv⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hu, hv, pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
  · rintro ⟨hu, hv, huv⟩
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff Nat.prime_two).mp hu
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff Nat.prime_two).mp hv
    obtain ⟨-, hia, hja⟩ := eq_of_prime_pow_add_prime_pow_eq_prime_pow Nat.prime_two ha huv
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨by rw [hia], by rw [hja]⟩

name: RankAmplification.isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_odd
statement:
theorem isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_odd {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport (p ^ a)) (p ^ a) ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : primeSupport (p ^ a) = {p} := primeSupport_prime_pow hp ha
  intro u v
  rw [hsupp]
  simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, false_iff]
  rintro ⟨hu, hv, huv⟩
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff hp).mp hu
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (isPrimeSupportUnit_singleton_iff hp).mp hv
  exact hp2 (eq_of_prime_pow_add_prime_pow_eq_prime_pow hp ha huv).1

name: RankAmplification.exists_isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_card_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_card_le_one {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport (p ^ a)) (p ^ a) U ∧ U.card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp2 : p = 2
  · subst hp2
    exact ⟨{(2 ^ a, 2 ^ (a + 1))}, isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_two ha, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨∅, isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_odd hp hp2 ha, by simp⟩

name: RankAmplification.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_prime_pow
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_prime_pow {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness (p ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, -⟩ := exists_isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_card_le_one hp ha
  exact ⟨U, hU⟩

name: RankAmplification.terminalPPTSameSupportBound_prime_pow
statement:
theorem terminalPPTSameSupportBound_prime_pow {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : 0 < a) :
    TerminalPPTSameSupportBound (p ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hcard⟩ := exists_isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_card_le_one hp ha
  refine ⟨sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit (p ^ a) U,
    isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit (pow_pos hp.pos a) hU, ?_⟩
  have h1 : (sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit (p ^ a) U).card ≤ 1 :=
    le_trans (card_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit_le _ _) hcard
  have h2 : 1 ≤ pptSameSupportBound (p ^ a) := by
    unfold pptSameSupportBound
    refine Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ?_
    positivity
  exact le_trans h1 h2

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportIndices_two_pow
statement:
theorem sameSupportIndices_two_pow {a j : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    IsSameSupportIndex (2 ^ a) j ↔ j = 2 ^ a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsame
    have hpos : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ a := pow_pos (by norm_num) a
    have hsol := sameSupport_isSUnitAffineSolution hpos hsame
    have hmem := (isSUnitAffineCarrier_prime_pow_two ha j (j + 2 ^ a)).mpr hsol
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at hmem
    exact hmem.1
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨Nat.one_le_pow a 2 (by norm_num), ?_⟩
    have hsum : (2 : ℕ) ^ a + 2 ^ a = 2 ^ (a + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
    rw [primeSupport_prime_pow Nat.prime_two ha, hsum,
      primeSupport_prime_pow Nat.prime_two (Nat.succ_pos a)]

name: RankAmplification.mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet {D a L U q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U ↔
      L < q ∧ q ≤ U ∧ q.Prime ∧ q ≡ a [MOD D]
proof:
:= by
  simp [residuePrimeIntervalSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_nonneg (D a L U : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun q _ ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg q)

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalSet_union
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalSet_union {D a L M U : ℕ} (hLM : L ≤ M) (hMU : M ≤ U) :
    residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L M ∪ residuePrimeIntervalSet D a M U =
      residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  simp only [mem_union, mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (hq | hq)
    · exact ⟨hq.1, hq.2.1.trans hMU, hq.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨hLM.trans_lt hq.1, hq.2⟩
  · intro hq
    by_cases hqM : q ≤ M
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hq.1, hqM, hq.2.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨lt_of_not_ge hqM, hq.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalSet_disjoint
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalSet_disjoint {D a L M U : ℕ} :
    Disjoint (residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L M) (residuePrimeIntervalSet D a M U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro q hqLeft hqRight
  have hleft := (mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hqLeft).2.1
  have hright := (mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hqRight).1
  omega

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_consecutive
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_consecutive {D a L M U : ℕ}
    (hLM : L ≤ M) (hMU : M ≤ U) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U =
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L M +
        residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a M U
proof:
:= by
  simp only [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum]
  rw [← residuePrimeIntervalSet_union hLM hMU,
    Finset.sum_union residuePrimeIntervalSet_disjoint]

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv {D a L U : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U ≤
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L U : ℝ) * (L : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum, residuePrimeIntervalCount]
  calc
    (∑ q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U, (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ _q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U, (L : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro q hq
      have hLq : L ≤ q := (mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq).1.le
      have hLReal : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hL
      have hqReal : (0 : ℝ) < q := hLReal.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hLq)
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ hqReal hLReal).2 (by exact_mod_cast hLq)
    _ = ((residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U).card : ℝ) * (L : ℝ)⁻¹ := by simp

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_div_add_one
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_div_add_one {D a L U : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L U ≤ U / D + 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L U ≤
        ((Finset.range (U + 1)).filter fun q ↦ q ≡ a [MOD D]).card := by
      apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro q hq
      have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le hqData.2.1, hqData.2.2.2⟩
    _ = Nat.count (· ≡ a [MOD D]) (U + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
    _ ≤ U / D + 1 := count_modEq_le_div_add_one U a D hD

name: RankAmplification.finsetIndicator_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsetIndicator_apply {S : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} :
    finsetIndicator S n = if n ∈ S then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.sum_finsetIndicator_range
statement:
theorem sum_finsetIndicator_range (S : Finset ℕ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, finsetIndicator S n =
      ((S.filter fun n ↦ n < N).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsets : Finset.range N ∩ S = S.filter fun n ↦ n < N := by
    ext n
    simp [and_comm]
  simp [finsetIndicator, hsets]

name: RankAmplification.finset_reciprocal_sum_eq_boundary_add_prefix
statement:
theorem finset_reciprocal_sum_eq_boundary_add_prefix {S : Finset ℕ} {L U : ℕ}
    (hLU : L < U) (hS : S ⊆ Finset.Ioc L U) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      (S.card : ℝ) * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc L (U - 1),
          ((S.filter fun n ↦ n ≤ m).card : ℝ) /
            ((m : ℝ) * (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : (Finset.Ioc L U).filter (· ∈ S) = S := by
    ext n
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc]
    constructor
    · exact fun hn ↦ hn.2
    · intro hn
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hS hn), hn⟩
  have hleft :
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc L U, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * finsetIndicator S n =
        ∑ n ∈ S, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc L U, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * finsetIndicator S n) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc L U, if n ∈ S then (n : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro n _hn
        simp [finsetIndicator]
      _ = ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Ioc L U).filter (· ∈ S), (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      _ = ∑ n ∈ S, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by rw [hfilter]
  have hfilterUpper : S.filter (fun n ↦ n < U + 1) = S := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro n hn
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hS hn)).2
  have hfilterLower : S.filter (fun n ↦ n < L + 1) = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hn
    have hnLower := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hS hn.1)).1
    omega
  have hprefix (m : ℕ) :
      S.filter (fun n ↦ n < m + 1) = S.filter fun n ↦ n ≤ m := by
    ext n
    simp
  have habel := Finset.sum_Ioc_by_parts
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹) (finsetIndicator S) hLU
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at habel
  simp_rw [sum_finsetIndicator_range] at habel
  rw [hfilterUpper, hfilterLower] at habel
  simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at habel
  simp_rw [hprefix] at habel
  rw [hleft] at habel
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ S, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) =
        (U : ℝ)⁻¹ * (S.card : ℝ) -
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc L (U - 1),
            (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ - (m : ℝ)⁻¹) *
              ((S.filter fun n ↦ n ≤ m).card : ℝ) := habel
    _ = (S.card : ℝ) * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc L (U - 1),
          ((S.filter fun n ↦ n ≤ m).card : ℝ) /
            ((m : ℝ) * (m + 1)) := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      rw [mul_comm (U : ℝ)⁻¹ (S.card : ℝ)]
      apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ (S.card : ℝ) * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ + z)
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      have hmPos : 0 < m := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le L)
        (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hm).1
      have hmReal : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hmSuccReal : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      field_simp
      ring

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_eq_boundary_add_prefix
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_eq_boundary_add_prefix {D a L U : ℕ}
    (hLU : L < U) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U =
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L U : ℝ) * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc L (U - 1),
          (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L m : ℝ) /
            ((m : ℝ) * (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum,
    finset_reciprocal_sum_eq_boundary_add_prefix
      (S := residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U) hLU (Finset.filter_subset _ _)]
  simp only [residuePrimeIntervalCount]
  apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦
    ((residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U).card : ℝ) * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ + z)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  have hmU : m ≤ U := by
    have hmTop := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hm).2
    omega
  have hfilter :
      (residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L U).filter (fun n ↦ n ≤ m) =
        residuePrimeIntervalSet D a L m := by
    ext q
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hq, hqm⟩
      exact ⟨hq.1, hqm, hq.2.2⟩
    · intro hq
      exact ⟨⟨hq.1, hq.2.1.trans hmU, hq.2.2⟩, hq.2.1⟩
  rw [hfilter]

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_of_prefix_bound
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_of_prefix_bound {D a L U : ℕ}
    (hLU : L < U) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc (L + 1) U,
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L m : ℝ) ≤ B m) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U ≤
      B U * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc L (U - 1), B m / ((m : ℝ) * (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_eq_boundary_add_prefix hLU]
  apply add_le_add
  · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (hB U (by simp [Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hLU]))
    positivity
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro m hm
    have hmRange : m ∈ Finset.Icc (L + 1) U := by
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      have hmData := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hm
      omega
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB m hmRange) (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le
statement:
theorem dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le {C : ℝ} {D a J j : ℕ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (hBT : DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis C D a J)
    (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J) :
    dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D a j ≤
      C / ((D.totient : ℝ) * (j : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hjPos : 0 < j := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1
  have hscale : 0 < 2 ^ j * D := mul_pos (pow_pos (by norm_num) _) hD
  have hcount := hBT j hj
  calc
    dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D a j ≤
        (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a (2 ^ j * D) (2 ^ (j + 1) * D) : ℝ) *
          (2 ^ j * D : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      by simpa only [dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow,
          Nat.cast_ofNat] using
        (residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv
          (D := D) (a := a) (U := 2 ^ (j + 1) * D) hscale)
    _ ≤ (C * (2 ^ j * D : ℝ) / ((D.totient : ℝ) * j)) *
          (2 ^ j * D : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount (by positivity)
    _ = C / ((D.totient : ℝ) * (j : ℝ)) := by
      have hscaleReal : (2 ^ j * D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hscale.ne'
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_dyadic_decomposition
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_dyadic_decomposition {D a J : ℕ}
    (hJ : 2 ≤ J) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (2 ^ (J + 1) * D) =
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (4 * D) +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D a j
proof:
:= by
  induction J, hJ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
      have hconcat := residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_consecutive
        (D := D) (a := a) (L := 0) (M := 4 * D) (U := 8 * D)
        (by omega) (by omega)
      simpa [dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum] using hconcat
  | succ J hJ ih =>
      have hcutoff : 2 ^ (J + 1) * D ≤ 2 ^ (J + 2) * D := by
        calc
          2 ^ (J + 1) * D ≤ (2 ^ (J + 1) * 2) * D :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right D (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by norm_num))
          _ = 2 ^ (J + 2) * D := by
            conv_rhs => rw [show J + 2 = (J + 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      calc
        residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (2 ^ (J + 1 + 1) * D) =
            residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (2 ^ (J + 1) * D) +
              residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a (2 ^ (J + 1) * D)
                (2 ^ (J + 2) * D) := by
          simpa only [show J + 1 + 1 = J + 2 by omega] using
            residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_consecutive
              (D := D) (a := a) (L := 0) (M := 2 ^ (J + 1) * D)
              (U := 2 ^ (J + 2) * D) (by omega) hcutoff
        _ = residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (4 * D) +
              (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D a j) +
              dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D a (J + 1) := by
          rw [ih]
          simp only [dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum]
        _ = residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (4 * D) +
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (J + 1), dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D a j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
          ring

name: RankAmplification.modulus_lt_prime_of_modEq_one
statement:
theorem modulus_lt_prime_of_modEq_one {D q : ℕ} (_hD : 0 < D) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hmod : q ≡ 1 [MOD D]) : D < q
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : D ∣ q - 1 :=
    (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hq.one_le).mp hmod.symm
  have hqSubPos : 0 < q - 1 := by
    have hqTwo := hq.two_le
    omega
  have hDle : D ≤ q - 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd hqSubPos hdiv
  omega

name: RankAmplification.initialResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv
statement:
theorem initialResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv {D U : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 U ≤
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D 1 0 U : ℝ) * (D : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum, residuePrimeIntervalCount]
  calc
    (∑ q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet D 1 0 U, (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ _q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet D 1 0 U, (D : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro q hq
      have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
      have hDq : D ≤ q :=
        (modulus_lt_prime_of_modEq_one hD hqData.2.2.1 hqData.2.2.2).le
      have hDReal : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
      have hqReal : (0 : ℝ) < q := hDReal.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hDq)
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ hqReal hDReal).2 (by exact_mod_cast hDq)
    _ = ((residuePrimeIntervalSet D 1 0 U).card : ℝ) * (D : ℝ)⁻¹ := by simp

name: RankAmplification.initialResiduePrimeCount_le_five
statement:
theorem initialResiduePrimeCount_le_five {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    residuePrimeIntervalCount D 1 0 (4 * D) ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  calc
    residuePrimeIntervalCount D 1 0 (4 * D) ≤ (4 * D) / D + 1 :=
      residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_div_add_one hD
    _ = 5 := by simp [hD.ne']

name: RankAmplification.initialResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le_five_mul_totient_inv
statement:
theorem initialResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le_five_mul_totient_inv {D : ℕ}
    (hD : 0 < D) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 (4 * D) ≤
      5 * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (residuePrimeIntervalCount D 1 0 (4 * D) : ℝ) ≤ 5 := by
    exact_mod_cast initialResiduePrimeCount_le_five hD
  have hphiPos : (0 : ℝ) < D.totient := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hD
  have hDPos : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hphiD : (D.totient : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le D
  calc
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 (4 * D) ≤
        (residuePrimeIntervalCount D 1 0 (4 * D) : ℝ) * (D : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      initialResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv hD
    _ ≤ 5 * (D : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by positivity)
    _ ≤ 5 * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((inv_le_inv₀ hDPos hphiPos).2 hphiD) (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.sum_Icc_two_natCast_inv_le_one_add_log
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_two_natCast_inv_le_one_add_log (J : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, (j : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 1 + Real.log J
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, (j : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 J, (j : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro j hj
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj ⊢
        omega
      · intro j _hj _hjNot
        positivity
    _ = (harmonic J : ℝ) := by
      simp only [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_inv, Rat.cast_natCast]
    _ ≤ 1 + Real.log J := harmonic_le_one_add_log J

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_endpoint
statement:
theorem residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_endpoint {C : ℝ} {D J : ℕ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 < D) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (hBT : DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis C D 1 J) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 (2 ^ (J + 1) * D) ≤
      (5 + C * (1 + Real.log J)) * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_dyadic_decomposition hJ]
  calc
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 (4 * D) +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D 1 j ≤
        5 * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J,
            C / ((D.totient : ℝ) * (j : ℝ)) := by
      apply add_le_add (initialResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le_five_mul_totient_inv hD)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      exact dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum_le hD hBT hj
    _ = (5 + C * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, (j : ℝ)⁻¹)) *
        (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      have hphi : (D.totient : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hD).ne'
      have hsum :
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, C / ((D.totient : ℝ) * (j : ℝ))) =
            C * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, (j : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hj0 : (j : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
          have : 0 < j := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1
          exact_mod_cast this.ne'
        field_simp
      rw [hsum]
      ring
    _ ≤ (5 + C * (1 + Real.log J)) * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
      exact add_le_add le_rfl
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_Icc_two_natCast_inv_le_one_add_log J) hC)

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_mono_upper
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_mono_upper {D a L U V : ℕ} (hUV : U ≤ V) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U ≤
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L V
proof:
:= by
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum, residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro q hq
    have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
    exact mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mpr
      ⟨hqData.1, hqData.2.1.trans hUV, hqData.2.2⟩
  · intro q _hq _hqNot
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT
statement:
theorem residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT {C : ℝ} {D J X : ℕ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 < D) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (hX : X ≤ 2 ^ (J + 1) * D)
    (hBT : DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis C D 1 J) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 X ≤
      (5 + C * (1 + Real.log J)) * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact (residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_mono_upper hX).trans
    (residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_endpoint hC hD hJ hBT)

name: RankAmplification.two_le_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth
statement:
theorem two_le_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth {X : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) :
    2 ≤ reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth]
  have hlog : 0 < Nat.log 2 X := Nat.log_pos (by norm_num) hX
  omega

name: RankAmplification.le_dyadic_cutoff_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth
statement:
theorem le_dyadic_cutoff_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth {D X : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    X ≤ 2 ^ (reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X + 1) * D
proof:
:= by
  change X ≤ 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 X + 1 + 1) * D
  have hfirst : X ≤ 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 X + 1) :=
    (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) X).le
  calc
    X ≤ 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 X + 1) := hfirst
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 X + 1 + 1) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 X + 1 + 1) * D :=
      Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hD

name: RankAmplification.log_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth_le_log_one_add_logb
statement:
theorem log_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth_le_log_one_add_logb {X : ℕ} :
    Real.log (reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X) ≤
      Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 X)
proof:
:= by
  have hdepth : (reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X : ℝ) ≤
      1 + Real.logb 2 X := by
    rw [reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hlog : (Nat.log 2 X : ℝ) ≤ Real.logb 2 X :=
      Real.natLog_le_logb X 2
    simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hlog 1
  have hdepthPos : (0 : ℝ) < reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X by
      simp [reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth])
  exact Real.log_le_log hdepthPos hdepth

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_canonical
statement:
theorem residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_canonical {C : ℝ} {D X : ℕ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 < D) (hX : 2 ≤ X)
    (hBT : DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis C D 1
      (reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X)) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 X ≤
      (5 + C * (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 X))) *
        (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT
    hC hD (two_le_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth hX)
    (le_dyadic_cutoff_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth hD) hBT
  refine hbase.trans ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  apply add_le_add le_rfl
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC
  exact add_le_add le_rfl log_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth_le_log_one_add_logb

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalSet_one_eq_empty_of_upper_lt_modulus
proof:

  have hD : 0 < D := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le X) hXD
  have hDq := modulus_lt_prime_of_modEq_one hD hqData.2.2.1 hqData.2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_one_eq_zero_of_upper_lt_modulus

theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_one_eq_zero_of_upper_lt_modulus {D X : ℕ}

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankT_isSection5SaddleWindow

theorem fixedRankT_isSection5SaddleWindow (J : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    IsSection5SaddleWindow ((Real.sqrt J)⁻¹) ((Real.sqrt J)⁻¹) x (fixedRankT J x)
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.isSection5SaddleWindow_mul_scaleG

theorem isSection5SaddleWindow_mul_scaleG {c₀ C₀ lam x : ℝ} (hlow : c₀ ≤ lam)

    IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x (lam * scaleG x)

  ⟨mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlow (scaleG_nonneg x),
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhigh (scaleG_nonneg x)⟩

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_3_upperY_pow_lt_rpow_window
statement:
theorem lemma10_3_upperY_pow_lt_rpow_window {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ T : ℝ, IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
        windowUpperY J T ^ (J + 1) < x ^ (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hc := tendsto_scaleV_div_sqrt_log2_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop
    (2 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((J : ℝ) + 1) * C₀)
  filter_upwards [hc, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hcx hL hA hL2 hx
  intro T hT
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcx hG
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, scaleV_mul_scaleG hG.ne'] at hmul
  have hTle : T ≤ C₀ * scaleG x := hT.2
  have hcoef : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((J : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTle hcoef
  have hkey : ((J : ℝ) + 1) * ((J : ℝ) * T)
      < scaleL x * (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ))) := by
    have hrhs : scaleL x * (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ)))
        = scaleL x / Real.sqrt (log2 x) / (2 * (J : ℝ)) := by
      unfold fixedRankEpsilon
      ring
    rw [hrhs, lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (J : ℝ))]
    nlinarith [hmul, hstep]
  calc
    windowUpperY J T ^ (J + 1)
        = Real.exp (((J : ℝ) + 1) * ((J : ℝ) * T)) := by
          rw [windowUpperY, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
    _ < Real.exp (scaleL x * (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ)))) := Real.exp_lt_exp.2 hkey
    _ = x ^ (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ))) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < x)]
          rfl

name: RankAmplification.windowEpsRankRatio_eq
statement:
theorem windowEpsRankRatio_eq {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {T x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    windowEpsRankRatio J T x = scaleL x / (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * T))
proof:
:= by
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  unfold windowEpsRankRatio fixedRankEpsilon
  rw [Real.log_rpow hx, log_windowUpperY]
  simp only [scaleL_eq]
  field_simp

    windowHalfRankRatio J T x = scaleL x / (2 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * T))

:= by

  unfold windowHalfRankRatio

name: RankAmplification.windowEpsRankRatio_lower
statement:
theorem windowEpsRankRatio_lower {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ T x : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x)
    (hT : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T) :
    scaleV x / (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀)) ≤ windowEpsRankRatio J T x
proof:
:= by
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hT.1
  have hC₀ : 0 < C₀ := by
    have h := hT.1.trans hT.2
    nlinarith [hG]
  have hLeq : scaleL x = scaleV x * scaleG x := (scaleV_mul_scaleG hG.ne').symm
  rw [windowEpsRankRatio_eq hJ hx hL2 hTpos.ne',
    div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), hLeq]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT.2
    (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleV x * (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * (J : ℝ) ^ 2))]

name: RankAmplification.windowHalfRankRatio_lower
statement:
theorem windowHalfRankRatio_lower {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ T x : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x)
    (hT : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T) :
    scaleV x / (2 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀)) ≤ windowHalfRankRatio J T x
proof:
:= by
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hT.1
  have hC₀ : 0 < C₀ := by
    have h := hT.1.trans hT.2
    nlinarith [hG]
  have hLeq : scaleL x = scaleV x * scaleG x := (scaleV_mul_scaleG hG.ne').symm
  rw [windowHalfRankRatio_eq hJ hx hTpos.ne',
    div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), hLeq]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT.2
    (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleV x * (2 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2))]

name: RankAmplification.le_mul_log_div_scaleG_of_lowerBounds
statement:
theorem le_mul_log_div_scaleG_of_lowerBounds {x u w ψ M : ℝ} (hG : 0 < scaleG x)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hwu : w ≤ u) (hψ : 0 ≤ ψ) (hψu : ψ ≤ Real.log u)
    (hM : M ≤ w * ψ / scaleG x) :
    M ≤ u * Real.log u / scaleG x
proof:
:= by
  refine hM.trans ?_
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := hw.trans hwu
  have hprod : w * ψ ≤ u * Real.log u :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hwu hψ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hψu hu)
  gcongr

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_3_epsRatio_omega_scaleG_window
statement:
theorem lemma10_3_epsRatio_omega_scaleG_window {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (M : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ T : ℝ, IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
        M ≤ windowEpsRankRatio J T x * Real.log (windowEpsRankRatio J T x) / scaleG x
proof:
:= by
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hconst : (0 : ℝ) < (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀ := by positivity
  have hbase : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleA x / (8 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀))) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_sqrt_log2_div_scaleA_atTop.atTop_div_const (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hbase.eventually_ge_atTop M, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
    eventually_log2_pos, eventually_log_scaleV_ge,
    eventually_log3_le_const_mul_log2 (c := 1 / 8) (by norm_num),
    tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * Real.log ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀)),
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hMx hL hA hL2 hlogV hlog3 hbig hx
  intro T hT
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hwpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleV x / (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀)) :=
    div_pos hV (by positivity)
  have hle := windowEpsRankRatio_lower hJ hc₀ (by linarith) hL hA hL2 hT
  have hlogw : log2 x / 8
      ≤ Real.log (scaleV x / (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀))) := by
    rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' (by positivity), Real.log_mul hs.ne' hconst.ne',
      Real.log_sqrt hL2.le, ← log3_eq]
    linarith
  have hident : Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleA x / (8 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀))
      = scaleV x / (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀)) * (log2 x / 8) / scaleG x := by
    have hAV : scaleA x * scaleV x = scaleG x := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
    set s := Real.sqrt (log2 x) with hsdef
    have hs' : (0 : ℝ) < s := hs
    have hsq : s ^ 2 = log2 x := Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le
    rw [← hsq, ← hAV]
    field_simp
  refine le_mul_log_div_scaleG_of_lowerBounds (ψ := log2 x / 8) hG hwpos.le hle
    (by linarith) (hlogw.trans (Real.log_le_log hwpos hle)) ?_
  rw [← hident]
  exact hMx

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_3_halfRatio_omega_scaleG_window
statement:
theorem lemma10_3_halfRatio_omega_scaleG_window {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (M : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ T : ℝ, IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
        M ≤ windowHalfRankRatio J T x * Real.log (windowHalfRankRatio J T x) / scaleG x
proof:
:= by
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hconst : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀) := by positivity
  have hbase : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ log2 x / scaleA x / (16 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀))) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_log2_div_scaleA_atTop.atTop_div_const (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hbase.eventually_ge_atTop M, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
    eventually_log2_pos, eventually_log_scaleV_ge,
    eventually_log3_le_const_mul_log2 (c := 1 / 8) (by norm_num),
    tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * Real.log (2 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀))),
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hMx hL hA hL2 hlogV hlog3 hbig hx
  intro T hT
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hwpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleV x / (2 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀)) := div_pos hV hconst
  have hle := windowHalfRankRatio_lower hJ hc₀ (by linarith) hL hA hT
  have hlogw : log2 x / 8 ≤ Real.log (scaleV x / (2 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀))) := by
    rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' hconst.ne']
    linarith
  have hident : log2 x / scaleA x / (16 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀))
      = scaleV x / (2 * ((J : ℝ) ^ 2 * C₀)) * (log2 x / 8) / scaleG x := by
    have hAV : scaleA x * scaleV x = scaleG x := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
    rw [← hAV]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine le_mul_log_div_scaleG_of_lowerBounds (ψ := log2 x / 8) hG hwpos.le hle
    (by linarith) (hlogw.trans (Real.log_le_log hwpos hle)) ?_
  rw [← hident]
  exact hMx

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_windowEpsRankRatio_mul_log_div_scaleG_atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop.2 fun M ↦ ?_
  filter_upwards [lemma10_3_epsRatio_omega_scaleG_window hJ hc₀ hC₀ M, hT] with x hx hwin

name: RankAmplification.mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber

    {X y Y J d N : ℕ} :
    N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber X y Y J d ↔
      N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J ∧
        badLocalProduct N y = d
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.card_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber_le
statement:
theorem card_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber_le
    {X y Y J d : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber X y Y J d).card ≤
      smoothTotientCount (X / d) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe, smoothTotientCount, ← Fintype.card_coe]
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_embedding
    (boundedTotientLowRankGoodCofactorEmbedding X y Y J d hy)

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_eq_sum_badSourceFibers
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_eq_sum_badSourceFibers
    (X y Y J : ℕ) :
    boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J =
      ∑ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J,
        (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber X y Y J d).card
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun N ↦ badLocalProduct N y
  have hmaps : (boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J : Set ℕ).MapsTo f
      (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J : Set ℕ) := by
    intro N hN
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
  simpa [boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount,
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet,
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber, f] using
      Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_le_smoothTotientSum
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_le_smoothTotientSum
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J ≤
      ∑ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J,
        smoothTotientCount (X / d) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_eq_sum_badSourceFibers]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun d _ ↦
    card_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceFiber_le hy

    {X y Y J H d : ℕ} :
    d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H ↔
      d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J ∧ d ≤ H
proof:

name: RankAmplification.mem_largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet
statement:

    {X y Y J H d : ℕ} :

proof:
