name: RankAmplification.sum_badSources_eq_small_add_large
statement:
theorem sum_badSources_eq_small_add_large
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (X y Y J H : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    (∑ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J, F d) =
      (∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H, F d) +
        ∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H, F d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet,
    largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet, not_le] using
      (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
        (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J) (fun d ↦ d ≤ H) F).symm

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_size
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_size (W y : ℕ) :
    smoothTotientCount W y ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothTotientCount]
  calc
    (smoothTotientSet W y).card ≤ (Finset.Icc 1 W).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card fun _ hm ↦
        Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
          ⟨(mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hm).1,
            (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hm).2.1⟩
    _ = W := by simp [Nat.card_Icc]

name: RankAmplification.smallBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le
statement:
theorem smallBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le
    {X y Y J H : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsharp : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y H B) :
    (∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * B * boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * B * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    intro d hd
    have hdData := mem_smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp hd
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hdEq⟩ := mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp hdData.1
    have hdpos : 0 < d := by
      rw [← hdEq]
      exact badLocalProduct_pos N y
    have hlow : X / H ≤ X / d := Nat.div_le_div_left hdData.2 hdpos
    have hupp : X / d ≤ X := Nat.div_le_self X d
    have hBFPS := hsharp (X / d) hlow hupp
    have hcast : ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := d))
    calc
      (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) * B := hBFPS
      _ ≤ ((X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹) * B := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast hB
      _ = (X : ℝ) * B * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by ring
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
          (X : ℝ) * B * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = (X : ℝ) * B *
        (∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
          (d : ℝ)⁻¹) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * B * boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · unfold boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
          (fun d _ _ ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
      · exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) (by
          exact hB)

name: RankAmplification.sum_powerset_meeting_le_sum_mul_prod_one_add
statement:
theorem sum_powerset_meeting_le_sum_mul_prod_one_add
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (A : Finset α) (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a) :
    (∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset.filter
        (fun s ↦ (s ∩ A).Nonempty), ∏ a ∈ s, w a) ≤
      (∑ a ∈ A, w a) * ∏ a : α, (1 + w a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset.filter
    (fun s ↦ (s ∩ A).Nonempty)
  let chosen : {s : Finset α // s ∈ F} → α := fun s ↦
    Classical.choose (Finset.nonempty_def.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp s.2).2)
  have hchosen_mem (s : {s : Finset α // s ∈ F}) : chosen s ∈ s.1 ∩ A :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Finset.nonempty_def.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp s.2).2)
  let encode : {s : Finset α // s ∈ F} → α × Finset α := fun s ↦
    (chosen s, s.1.erase (chosen s))
  have hencode_inj : Function.Injective encode := by
    intro s t hst
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hfirst : chosen s = chosen t := congrArg Prod.fst hst
    have hsecond : s.1.erase (chosen s) = t.1.erase (chosen t) :=
      congrArg Prod.snd hst
    have hsecond' : s.1.erase (chosen t) = t.1.erase (chosen t) := by
      simpa [hfirst] using hsecond
    calc
      s.1 = insert (chosen s) (s.1.erase (chosen s)) :=
        (Finset.insert_erase (Finset.mem_inter.mp (hchosen_mem s)).1).symm
      _ = insert (chosen t) (s.1.erase (chosen t)) := by rw [hfirst]
      _ = insert (chosen t) (t.1.erase (chosen t)) := by rw [hsecond']
      _ = t.1 := Finset.insert_erase (Finset.mem_inter.mp (hchosen_mem t)).1
  let target := A.product (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset
  have himage : F.attach.image encode ⊆ target := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    apply Finset.mem_product.mpr
    refine ⟨(Finset.mem_inter.mp (hchosen_mem s)).2, Finset.mem_powerset.mpr ?_⟩
    exact Finset.subset_univ _
  calc
    (∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset.filter
        (fun s ↦ (s ∩ A).Nonempty), ∏ a ∈ s, w a) =
        ∑ s ∈ F.attach, w (chosen s) * ∏ a ∈ s.1.erase (chosen s), w a := by
      calc
        (∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset.filter
            (fun s ↦ (s ∩ A).Nonempty), ∏ a ∈ s, w a) =
            ∑ s ∈ F.attach, ∏ a ∈ s.1, w a := by
          exact (Finset.sum_attach F
            (fun s : Finset α ↦ ∏ a ∈ s, w a)).symm
        _ = ∑ s ∈ F.attach,
            w (chosen s) * ∏ a ∈ s.1.erase (chosen s), w a := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro s hs
          exact (Finset.mul_prod_erase s.1 w
            (Finset.mem_inter.mp (hchosen_mem s)).1).symm
    _ = ∑ p ∈ F.attach.image encode,
        w p.1 * ∏ a ∈ p.2, w a := by
      simpa [encode] using
        (Finset.sum_image (s := F.attach)
          (f := fun p : α × Finset α ↦ w p.1 * ∏ a ∈ p.2, w a)
          hencode_inj.injOn).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ target, w p.1 * ∏ a ∈ p.2, w a := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg himage fun p hp hnot ↦ by
        exact mul_nonneg (hw p.1) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun a ha ↦ hw a)
    _ = (∑ a ∈ A, w a) *
        (∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset, ∏ a ∈ s, w a) := by
      unfold target
      calc
        (∑ p ∈ A.product (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset,
            w p.1 * ∏ a ∈ p.2, w a) =
            ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset,
              w a * ∏ b ∈ s, w b := by
          exact Finset.sum_product A (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset _
        _ = (∑ a ∈ A, w a) *
            (∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset, ∏ b ∈ s, w b) :=
          (Finset.sum_mul_sum A (Finset.univ : Finset α).powerset
            w (fun s ↦ ∏ b ∈ s, w b)).symm
    _ = (∑ a ∈ A, w a) * ∏ a : α, (1 + w a) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_one_add]

name: RankAmplification.mem_fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet_inl
statement:

name: RankAmplification.not_mem_fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem not_mem_fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet_inr
    {X y Y J K : ℕ}
    {q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y} × Fin J} :
    (Sum.inr q : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J) ∉
        fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K
proof:
:= by
  simp [fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet]

name: RankAmplification.sum_fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomWeight
statement:
theorem sum_fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomWeight
    (X y Y J K : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K,
        fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) =
      fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet X y Y J
  calc
    (∑ a ∈ fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K,
        fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) =
        ∑ q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ S},
          if K < q.1 then (q.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 := by
      unfold fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      simp [fixedBadSourceAtomWeight, fixedBadSourceAtomValue, S]
    _ = ∑ q ∈ S, if K < q then (q : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 := by
      simpa only [Finset.univ_eq_attach] using
        (Finset.sum_attach S
          (fun q ↦ if K < q then (q : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0))
    _ = fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K := by
      unfold fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_nonneg
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J) :
    0 ≤ fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBadSourceAtomWeight
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.badLocalSourceAtom_value_le_or_mem_largeLinear
statement:
theorem badLocalSourceAtom_value_le_or_mem_largeLinear
    {X y Y J N K : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K)
    (q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y}) :
    fixedBadSourceAtomValue (badLocalSourceAtom hy hN q) ≤ K ∨
      badLocalSourceAtom hy hN q ∈
        fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : N.factorization q.1 = 1
  · by_cases hqK : K < q.1
    · right
      simp [badLocalSourceAtom, he,
        fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet, hqK]
    · left
      simp [badLocalSourceAtom, he, fixedBadSourceAtomValue]
      omega
  · left
    have hePos := factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport
      (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp q.2).1
    have heTwo : 2 ≤ N.factorization q.1 := by omega
    exact (fixedBadSourceAtomValue_badLocalSourceAtom hy hN q).trans_le <|
      (repeatedBadSourcePrimePower_le hy hN q.2 heTwo).trans hYK

name: RankAmplification.mem_badLocalSourceAtomCode_value_le_or_mem_largeLinear
statement:
theorem mem_badLocalSourceAtomCode_value_le_or_mem_largeLinear
    {X y Y J N K : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K) {a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J}
    (ha : a ∈ badLocalSourceAtomCode hy hN) :
    fixedBadSourceAtomValue a ≤ K ∨
      a ∈ fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K
proof:
:= by
  rw [badLocalSourceAtomCode] at ha
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp ha
  exact badLocalSourceAtom_value_le_or_mem_largeLinear hy hN hYK q

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_meets_largeLinear
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_meets_largeLinear
    {X y Y J H K : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K) (hKJ : K ^ J ≤ H)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J})
    (hd : H < d.1) :
    ((boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d) ∩
      fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hempty
  rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hempty
  have hvalue : ∀ a ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d,
      fixedBadSourceAtomValue a ≤ K := by
    intro a ha
    have ha' : a ∈ badLocalSourceAtomCode hy
        (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem d) := by
      simpa [boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode] using ha
    rcases mem_badLocalSourceAtomCode_value_le_or_mem_largeLinear hy
        (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem d) hYK ha' with hle | hlarge
    · exact hle
    · have hinter : a ∈ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d) ∩
          fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K :=
        Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨ha, hlarge⟩
      rw [hempty] at hinter
      simp at hinter
  have hcard : (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d).card ≤ J :=
    (card_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_lt hy d).le
  have hdle : d.1 ≤ H := by
    calc
      d.1 = ∏ a ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d,
          fixedBadSourceAtomValue a :=
        (prod_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d).symm
      _ ≤ ∏ _a ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d, K := by
        exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
          (fun a ha ↦ hvalue a ha)
      _ = K ^ (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d).card := by simp
      _ ≤ K ^ J := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hK) hcard
      _ ≤ H := hKJ
  omega

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadSourceAtomEulerProduct_le_chebyshev
statement:
theorem fixedBadSourceAtomEulerProduct_le_chebyshev
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
        (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a)) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
        (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a)) ≤
        Real.exp (∑ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
          fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) :=
      Real.prod_one_add_le_exp_sum Finset.univ
        fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_nonneg
    _ = Real.exp (fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J +
        fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J) := by
      rw [sum_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact add_le_add (fixedLinearBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev hX)
        (fixedPowerBadSourceMass_le_inv (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy))

name: RankAmplification.largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_linearTail_mul_euler
statement:
theorem largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_linearTail_mul_euler
    {X y Y J H K : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K) (hKJ : K ^ J ≤ H) :
    largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H ≤
      fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K *
        ∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
          (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H
  let A := fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomSet X y Y J K
  let lift : {d : ℕ // d ∈ D} ↪
      {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J} :=
    { toFun := fun d ↦
        ⟨d.1, (mem_largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp d.2).1⟩
      inj' := fun d e h ↦ Subtype.ext <|
        congrArg (fun z : {d : ℕ // d ∈
          boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J} ↦ z.1) h }
  let code : {d : ℕ // d ∈ D} →
      Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J) := fun d ↦
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy (lift d)
  let w : Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J) → ℝ := fun s ↦
    ∏ a ∈ s, fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a
  have hcodeInj : Function.Injective code := by
    intro d e hde
    have hlift : lift d = lift e :=
      boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_injective hy hde
    exact lift.injective hlift
  have hmeet (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ D}) : (code d ∩ A).Nonempty := by
    apply boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_meets_largeLinear
      hy hK hYK hKJ (lift d)
    exact (mem_largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp d.2).2
  have himage : D.attach.image code ⊆
      (Finset.univ : Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J)).powerset.filter
        (fun s ↦ (s ∩ A).Nonempty) := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (Finset.subset_univ _), hmeet d⟩
  calc
    largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H =
        ∑ d ∈ D.attach, (d.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      unfold largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass D
      exact (Finset.sum_attach _ _).symm
    _ = ∑ d ∈ D.attach, w (code d) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      unfold w code
      simpa [lift] using
        (prod_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_code hy (lift d)).symm
    _ = ∑ s ∈ D.attach.image code, w s := by
      exact (Finset.sum_image hcodeInj.injOn).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ :
        Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J)).powerset.filter
          (fun s ↦ (s ∩ A).Nonempty), w s := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg himage fun s _ _ ↦ by
        unfold w
        exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun a _ ↦ fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_nonneg a
    _ ≤ (∑ a ∈ A, fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) *
        ∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
          (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) := by
      exact sum_powerset_meeting_le_sum_mul_prod_one_add A
        fixedBadSourceAtomWeight fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_nonneg
    _ = fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K *
        ∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
          (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) := by
      rw [sum_fixedLargeLinearBadSourceAtomWeight]

name: RankAmplification.largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev
statement:
theorem largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev
    {X y Y J H K : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K) (hKJ : K ^ J ≤ H) :
    largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H ≤
      fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine (largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_linearTail_mul_euler
    hy hK hYK hKJ).trans ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (fixedBadSourceAtomEulerProduct_le_chebyshev hX hy)
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass_le_smoothReciprocalTail
statement:
theorem fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass_le_smoothReciprocalTail
    {X y Y J K : ℕ} :
    fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K ≤
      finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q := (fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet X y Y J).filter (K < ·)
  let pred : ℕ → ℕ := fun q ↦ q - 1
  have hinj : Set.InjOn pred Q := by
    intro q hq r hr hqr
    have hqPrime := (mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1).1
    have hrPrime := (mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1).1
    have hqOne : 1 < q := hqPrime.one_lt
    have hrOne : 1 < r := hrPrime.one_lt
    change q - 1 = r - 1 at hqr
    omega
  have hsubset : Q.image pred ⊆ finiteSmoothTailSet Y (K - 1) X := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    have hqFilter := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
    have hqData := mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp hqFilter.1
    apply mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hqData.2.2.2.2.1⟩
    · dsimp [pred]
      have := hqData.1.one_lt
      have hKq := hqFilter.2
      omega
    · dsimp [pred]
      exact (Nat.sub_le q 1).trans hqData.2.1
  calc
    fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K =
        ∑ q ∈ Q, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ Q, ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro q hq
      have hqPrime := (mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1).1
      have hqPos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hqPrime.pos
      have hpredNat : 0 < q - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hqPrime.one_lt
      have hpredPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_pos.mpr hpredNat
      have hpredLe : (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (q : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.sub_le q 1)
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ hqPos hpredPos).2 hpredLe
    _ = ∑ r ∈ Q.image pred, (r : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      symm
      simpa [pred] using
        (Finset.sum_image (s := Q) (f := fun r : ℕ ↦ (r : ℝ)⁻¹) hinj)
    _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Y (K - 1) X, (r : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
        (fun r _ _ ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg r))
    _ = finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X := rfl

name: RankAmplification.smallBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_chebyshev
statement:
theorem smallBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_chebyshev
    {X y Y J H : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hsharp : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y H B) :
    (∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * B *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine (smallBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le hB hsharp).trans ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev hX hy)
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) hB)

name: RankAmplification.largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_mass
statement:
theorem largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_mass
    {X y Y J H : ℕ} :
    (∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    intro d hd
    have hdFull := (mem_largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp hd).1
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hdEq⟩ :=
      mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp hdFull
    have hdpos : 0 < d := by
      rw [← hdEq]
      exact badLocalProduct_pos N y
    calc
      (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size (X / d) y
      _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
          (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := d))
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
          (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = (X : ℝ) * largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H := by
      unfold largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_smoothTail
statement:
theorem largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_smoothTail
    {X y Y J H K : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K) (hKJ : K ^ J ≤ H) :
    (∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J H :=
      largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_mass
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) *
        (fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass X y Y J K *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev
          hX hy hK hYK hKJ) (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      have htail := fixedLinearBadSourceTailMass_le_smoothReciprocalTail
        (X := X) (y := y) (Y := Y) (J := J) (K := K)
      have hX0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ X := Nat.cast_nonneg X
      have hexp0 : 0 ≤ Real.exp
          (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htail hexp0]

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
    {X y Y J H K : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
    (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K) (hKJ : K ^ J ≤ H)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hsharp : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y H B) :
    (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        (B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hreindexNat := boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_le_smoothTotientSum
    (X := X) (y := y) (Y := Y) (J := J) hy
  have hreindex : (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hreindexNat
  calc
    (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J,
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) := hreindex
    _ = (∑ d ∈ smallBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ)) +
        ∑ d ∈ largeBoundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J H,
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ) :=
      sum_badSources_eq_small_add_large X y Y J H
        (fun d ↦ (smoothTotientCount (X / d) y : ℝ))
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * B *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        (X : ℝ) * finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      add_le_add
        (smallBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_chebyshev hX hy hB hsharp)
        (largeBadSourceSmoothTotientSum_le_smoothTail hX hy hK hYK hKJ)
    _ = (X : ℝ) *
        (B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
    (X h y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedLowRankShiftedCount X h y Y J ≤
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedLowRankShiftedCount boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
  exact Finset.card_le_card
    (fixedLowRankShiftedSet_subset_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X h y Y J)

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankShiftedCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankShiftedCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
    {X h y Y J H K : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
    (hX : 2 ≤ X) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hYK : Y ^ J ≤ K) (hKJ : K ^ J ≤ H)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hsharp : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y H B) :
    (fixedLowRankShiftedCount X h y Y J : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        (B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail Y (K - 1) X) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : (fixedLowRankShiftedCount X h y Y J : ℝ) ≤
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J := by
    exact_mod_cast fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
      X h y Y J
  exact hcount.trans <|
    boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
      hX hy hK hYK hKJ hB hsharp

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_log2
statement:
theorem scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_log2 :
    scaleA =o[atTop] (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x))
proof:
:= by
  have hlogBase :=
    (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)).comp_tendsto
      tendsto_log2_atTop
  have hlog3 : log3 =o[atTop] (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x)) := by
    apply hlogBase.congr'
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      rfl
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [Function.comp_apply, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.isBigO.trans_isLittleO hlog3

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_sqrt_log2_div_scaleA_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_sqrt_log2_div_scaleA_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleA x) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ scaleA x / Real.sqrt (log2 x)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_log2.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 < scaleA x / Real.sqrt (log2 x) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hA hL2
    exact div_pos hA (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2)
  have hwithin : Tendsto (fun x ↦ scaleA x / Real.sqrt (log2 x)) atTop
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hzero, hpos⟩
  have hinv := hwithin.inv_tendsto_nhdsGT_zero
  apply hinv.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hA hL2
  change (scaleA x / Real.sqrt (log2 x))⁻¹ =
    Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleA x
  rw [inv_div]

name: RankAmplification.sqrt_log2_isBigO_log2
statement:
theorem sqrt_log2_isBigO_log2 :
    (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x)) =O[atTop] log2
proof:
:= by
  apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
  filter_upwards [tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hL2
  have hsqrt0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hL20 : 0 ≤ log2 x := zero_le_one.trans hL2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hsqrt0, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL20, one_mul]
  exact Real.sqrt_le_self_iff.mpr (Or.inr hL2)

name: RankAmplification.sqrt_log2_isLittleO_scaleV
statement:
theorem sqrt_log2_isLittleO_scaleV :
    (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x)) =o[atTop] scaleV
proof:
:=
  sqrt_log2_isBigO_log2.trans_isLittleO log2_isLittleO_scaleV

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleV_div_sqrt_log2_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_scaleV_div_sqrt_log2_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ scaleV x / Real.sqrt (log2 x)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleV x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    sqrt_log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleV x := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos, eventually_scaleL_pos,
      eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL2 hL hA
    exact div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2)
      (scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA))
  have hwithin : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleV x) atTop
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hzero, hpos⟩
  have hinv := hwithin.inv_tendsto_nhdsGT_zero
  apply hinv.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos, eventually_scaleL_pos,
      eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL2 hL hA
  change (Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleV x)⁻¹ =
    scaleV x / Real.sqrt (log2 x)
  rw [inv_div]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankScale_atTop
statement:

    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :

proof:
:= by

    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
  have h := tendsto_scaleV_div_sqrt_log2_atTop.atTop_div_const hC
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
  unfold fixedLowRankTailRankScale

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_log_fixedLowRankTailRankScale_div_half_log2_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_fixedLowRankTailRankScale_div_half_log2_one
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRankScale J x) /
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x)) atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogA : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (scaleA x) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log_scaleA_isLittleO_log2.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hlog3Little : log3 =o[atTop] log2 := by
    have h := iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO 2
    apply h.congr' <;> filter_upwards [] with x <;> rfl
  have hlog3 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log3 x / log2 x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hlog3Little.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  let C : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (2 * Real.log C) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_log2_atTop
  have hmodel : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (1 : ℝ) - Real.log (scaleA x) / log2 x -
        (2 * Real.log C) / log2 x - log3 x / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using
      (((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
        atTop (nhds 1)).sub hlogA).sub hconst).sub hlog3
  apply hmodel.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hA hL2
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrtL2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hlogV := two_mul_log_scaleV hL hA
  unfold fixedLowRankTailRankScale
  rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' (mul_pos hC hsqrtL2).ne',
    Real.log_mul hC.ne' hsqrtL2.ne', Real.log_sqrt hL2.le]
  rw [log3_eq]
  field_simp [hL2.ne']
  nlinarith [hlogV]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_div_scaleG_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_div_scaleG_atTop
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦
      fixedLowRankTailRankScale J x *
        Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRankScale J x) / scaleG x)
      atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
  have hfirst :=
    tendsto_log_fixedLowRankTailRankScale_div_half_log2_one J hJ
  have hsecond : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (1 / (2 * C) : ℝ) *
        (Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleA x)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_sqrt_log2_div_scaleA_atTop.const_mul_atTop (by positivity)
  have hproduct := hfirst.pos_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hsecond
  apply hproduct.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hA hL2
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrtL2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hsqrtSq : Real.sqrt (log2 x) ^ 2 = log2 x :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le
  set c : ℝ := (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J
  set l : ℝ := log2 x
  set a : ℝ := scaleA x
  set g : ℝ := scaleG x
  set v : ℝ := scaleV x
  set s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (log2 x)
  change
    Real.log (v / (c * s)) / ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * l) *
        (1 / (2 * c) * (s / a)) =
      (v / (c * s)) * Real.log (v / (c * s)) / g
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact hC.ne'
  have hl : l ≠ 0 := by simpa [l] using hL2.ne'
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by simpa [a] using hA.ne'
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := by simpa [g] using hG.ne'
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by simpa [v] using hV.ne'
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := by simpa [s] using hsqrtL2.ne'
  have hav : a * v = g := by simpa [a, v, g] using hAG
  have hss : s ^ 2 = l := by simpa [s, l] using hsqrtSq
  field_simp [hc, hl, ha, hg, hv, hs]
  rw [hss, ← hav]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_cast_isEquivalent
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_cast_isEquivalent
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    (fun x ↦

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_nat_div_scaleG_atTop
statement:

statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_tau_one (R H X : ℕ) :

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_sqrt_upperY
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_sqrt_upperY
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.sqrt (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hC : 0 < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J :=
    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) hsqrtJ
  have hden : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      1 ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((((Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log2_atTop).const_mul_atTop hC).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1)
  have hpolyReal :=
    (isLittleO_pow_exp_pos_mul_atTop 2 hsqrtJ).bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  have hpoly : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ‖scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2‖ ≤
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          ‖Real.exp (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))‖ :=
    ((tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually hpolyReal)
  have hAlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [hden, hpoly, hAlarge,
      eventually_fixedRankUpperY_half_le_natUpperY J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hden hpoly hAlarge hYlower hL hA hL2
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hdenpos : 0 < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    zero_lt_one.trans_le hden
  have huModel : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
      fixedLowRankTailRankScale J (x : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hV.le hdenpos.le)
  have hmodelV : fixedLowRankTailRankScale J (x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedLowRankTailRankScale
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdenpos).2
    nlinarith
  have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hVG : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have huG : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
      scaleG (x : ℝ) := huModel.trans (hmodelV.trans hVG)
  have hpoly' : 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      Real.exp (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le] at hpoly
    nlinarith
  rw [fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG (x : ℝ) hJ] at hYlower
  have hGsq : scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hG.le).mpr huG |>.trans hGsq

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_fixedLowRankRankinError
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_fixedLowRankRankinError
    {J x : ℕ}
    (hY : 2 ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
    (hu : 1 < fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ))
    (huSqrt : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
        (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) x ≤
      Real.exp
        (-(fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
            Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) +
          tauEulerLoss 1
              (1 - rankinDelta (fixedLowRankTailCode J x)
                (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) *
            fullULogUPrimeError (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
              (fixedLowRankTailCode J x))
proof:
:= by
  have hYone : 1 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hY
  have hcode : 0 < fixedLowRankTailCode J x := by
    unfold fixedLowRankTailCode
    exact pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hYone) _
  rw [finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_tau_one]
  have hfull := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    (j := 1) (R := fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
    (H := fixedLowRankTailCode J x) (X := x)
    (by norm_num) hcode hY
    (by rw [rankinU_fixedLowRankTailCode hYone]; exact_mod_cast hu)
    (by rw [rankinU_fixedLowRankTailCode hYone]; exact huSqrt)
  rw [rankinU_fixedLowRankTailCode hYone] at hfull
  exact hfull

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRank_loglog_upperY_le_log2
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRank_loglog_upperY_le_log2
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (Real.log
          (3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ))) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hendpoint := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankUpperEndpoint_log2_le_log2 J hJ)
  filter_upwards [hendpoint, eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ]
      with x hendpoint hY
  have hmodelPos : 0 < fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
    fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)
  have hmodelOne : 1 ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG (x : ℝ) hJ]
    exact Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (scaleG_nonneg _))
  have hfloor : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le hmodelPos.le
  have harg : 3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hmodelSelf : fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_two]
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hmodelPos.le hmodelOne
    have : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      hfloor.trans hmodelSelf
    gcongr
  have hleftPos : 0 < Real.log
      (3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x by omega))
  have hinner := Real.log_le_log (by positivity :
      (0 : ℝ) < 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x) harg
  have houter : Real.log (Real.log
      (3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ))) ≤
      log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    unfold log2 iteratedLog
    exact Real.log_le_log hleftPos hinner
  exact houter.trans hendpoint

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankTailEulerError_le_budget
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankTailEulerError_le_budget
    {J x : ℕ}
    (hY : 2 ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
    (hu : 2 ≤ fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ))
    (huSqrt : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (fixedRankNatUpperY J x))
    (hloglog : Real.log (Real.log
        (3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ))) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ)) :
    tauEulerLoss 1
          (1 - rankinDelta (fixedLowRankTailCode J x)
            (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) *
        fullULogUPrimeError (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) ≤
      fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget J x
proof:
:= by
  have hYone : 1 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hY
  have huEq := rankinU_fixedLowRankTailCode (J := J) (x := x) hYone
  have huReal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hu
  have huPos : (0 : ℝ) < fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hdeltaHalf : rankinDelta (fixedLowRankTailCode J x)
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hYone (by rw [huEq]; positivity)
      (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt)
  have hloss := tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss (j := 1) hdeltaHalf
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogu : Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) huReal
  have huDiv : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) /
      Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
        (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left huPos.le hlogTwoPos hlogu
  have hlogTerm : Real.log (Real.log
        (3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ))) -
      Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ := by
    have hneg : -Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
        ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ :=
      by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using neg_le_abs (Real.log (Real.log 2))
    linarith
  have hprime : fullULogUPrimeError (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
      (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) ≤
      primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
          3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2) := by
    rw [fullULogUPrimeError, huEq]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ primeCountingConstant_pos.le
    exact add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogTerm (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      (by
        calc
          3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) /
                Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) =
              3 * ((fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) /
                Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)) := by ring
          _ ≤ 3 * ((fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num)
          _ = 3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := by ring)
  have hprimeNonneg : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) := by
    exact (primeRankinSum_nonneg (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
      (rankinDelta (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) (fixedRankNatUpperY J x))).trans
        (primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU (R := fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (X := fixedLowRankTailCode J x) hY
          (by rw [huEq]; exact_mod_cast (show 1 <
            fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) by omega))
          (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt))
  calc
    tauEulerLoss 1
          (1 - rankinDelta (fixedLowRankTailCode J x)
            (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) *
        fullULogUPrimeError (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) ≤
        ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
          fullULogUPrimeError (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
            (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by simpa using hloss) hprimeNonneg
    _ ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
        (primeCountingConstant *
          (Real.exp 2 *
              (log2 (x : ℝ) + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
            3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le)
    _ = fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget J x := by
      unfold fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant_pos
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant_pos :
    0 < fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hfirst : 0 < (1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss :=
    mul_pos (by norm_num) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos
  have hinside : 0 < Real.exp 2 * (1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
      3 / Real.log 2 :=
    add_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by positivity))
      (div_pos (by norm_num) hlogTwo)
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos hfirst primeCountingConstant_pos) hinside

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_cast_le_scaleG
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_cast_le_scaleG
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hC : 0 < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J :=
    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) hsqrtJ
  have hden : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      1 ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((((Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_log2_atTop).const_mul_atTop hC).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1)
  have hAlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [hden, hAlarge,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hden hAlarge hL hA hL2
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hdenpos : 0 < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J * Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    zero_lt_one.trans_le hden
  have huModel : (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤
      fixedLowRankTailRankScale J (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hV.le hdenpos.le)
  have hmodelV : fixedLowRankTailRankScale J (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedLowRankTailRankScale
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdenpos).2
    nlinarith
  have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hVG : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  exact huModel.trans (hmodelV.trans hVG)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget_le_const_mul_scaleG
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget_le_const_mul_scaleG
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget J x ≤
        fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant * scaleG (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2oG : log2 =o[atTop] scaleG :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.trans scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG
  have hL2boundReal := hL2oG.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hL2bound := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hL2boundReal
  have hGone := (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [hL2bound, hGone,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_cast_le_scaleG J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hL2bound hGone huG hL2 hL hA
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, one_mul] at hL2bound
  have habsG : ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ ≤
      ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    le_mul_of_one_le_right (norm_nonneg _) hGone
  have hlogPart : log2 (x : ℝ) + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ ≤
      (1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have huPart : 3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤
      (3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogTwo).2
    field_simp [hlogTwo.ne']
    nlinarith
  have hinside : Real.exp 2 *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
      3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤
        (Real.exp 2 * (1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
          3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.exp 2 *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
          3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤
          Real.exp 2 *
              ((1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) +
            (3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogPart (Real.exp_pos _).le) huPart
      _ = (Real.exp 2 * (1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
          3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring
  unfold fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant
  have hcoeff : 0 ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
      primeCountingConstant :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le)
      primeCountingConstant_pos.le
  calc
    ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) * primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
          3 * (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2) ≤
      ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) * primeCountingConstant *
        ((Real.exp 2 * (1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
          3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinside hcoeff
    _ = ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) * primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 * (1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) +
          3 / Real.log 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankTailEulerError_le_half_phase
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankTailEulerError_le_half_phase
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      tauEulerLoss 1
            (1 - rankinDelta (fixedLowRankTailCode J x)
              (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) *
          fullULogUPrimeError (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
            (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) ≤
        ((fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hphase :=
    (tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_natCast_div_scaleG_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop
      (2 * fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant)
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ 2,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_sqrt_upperY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRank_loglog_upperY_le_log2 J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailEulerBudget_le_const_mul_scaleG J hJ,
      hphase,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hY hu huSqrt hloglog hbudgetG hphase hL hA
  have herror := fixedLowRankTailEulerError_le_budget
    (J := J) (x := x) (by omega) hu huSqrt hloglog
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hphaseMul :
      2 * fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
        (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hG).mp hphase
  nlinarith [fixedLowRankTailEulerConstant_pos.le]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_phase
statement:
theorem eventually_finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_phase
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) x ≤
        Real.exp (-((fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ 2,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_sqrt_upperY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailEulerError_le_half_phase J hJ]
      with x hY hu huSqrt herror
  have hRankin := finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_fixedLowRankRankinError
    (J := J) (x := x) (by omega) (by omega) huSqrt
  exact hRankin.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))

name: RankAmplification.eventually_finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_fixedRankSaddle
statement:
theorem eventually_finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_fixedRankSaddle
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) x ≤
        Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsaddleError := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankSaddleError_norm_le J hJ (c := 1) (by norm_num))
  have hphase :=
    (tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_natCast_div_scaleG_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop
      (2 * (Real.sqrt J + 1))
  filter_upwards [eventually_finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_phase J hJ,
      hsaddleError, hphase,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_cast_le_scaleG J hJ,
      (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x htail hsaddleError hphase huG hAone hL hA
  change 1 ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) at hAone
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hVG : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by nlinarith
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hV.le] at hsaddleError
  simp only [one_mul] at hsaddleError
  have hsaddle : fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) ≤
      (Real.sqrt J + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    have herr : fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) -
        Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
      (Real.le_norm_self _).trans hsaddleError
    nlinarith
  have hphaseMul : 2 * (Real.sqrt J + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
      (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hG).mp hphase
  exact htail.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith))

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_div_scaleV_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2 := log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hconst₁ : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log (Real.log 2) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hconst₂ : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 2)⁻¹ / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hsum := (hL2.sub hconst₁).add hconst₂
  have hscaled := (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Real.log 4) atTop (nhds (Real.log 4))).mul hsum
  have hmodel : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 4 *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) -
          Real.log (Real.log 2) / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          (Real.log 2)⁻¹ / scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, sub_self, zero_add, mul_zero] using hscaled
  apply hmodel.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  unfold fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound
  change
    Real.log 4 *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) -
          Real.log (Real.log 2) / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          (Real.log 2)⁻¹ / scaleV (x : ℝ)) =
      Real.log 4 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (x : ℝ)) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
          (Real.log 2)⁻¹) / scaleV (x : ℝ)
  rw [log2_eq]
  field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankNatY_inv_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankNatY_inv_div_scaleV_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hyCast : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ))
      atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp
      (tendsto_fixedRankNatY_atTop J hJ)
  have hyInv := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hyCast
  have hVInv := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hprod := hyInv.mul hVInv
  have hprodZero : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      ((fun r : ℝ ↦ r⁻¹) ∘ (fun x : ℕ ↦ (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ))) x *
        ((fun r : ℝ ↦ r⁻¹) ∘ (fun x : ℕ ↦ scaleV (x : ℝ))) x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using hprod
  apply hprodZero.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedLowRankCompressionOverhead_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedLowRankCompressionOverhead_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
        (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hlinear := tendsto_fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_div_scaleV_zero
  have hy := tendsto_fixedRankNatY_inv_div_scaleV_zero J hJ
  have hsum := (hconst.add hlinear).add hy
  have hsumZero : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsumZero.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedLowRankCompressionError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedLowRankCompressionError_zero
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fixedLowRankCompressionError J ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := hρ.max (tendsto_const_nhds :
    Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0))
  have hmaxZero : Tendsto (fun x ↦ max (ρ x) 0) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hmax
  have hsum := hmaxZero.add (tendsto_fixedLowRankCompressionOverhead_zero J hJ)
  change Tendsto (fun x ↦ max (ρ x) 0 +
    (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
      (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRank_split_parameters
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRank_split_parameters
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 ≤ x ∧ 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x ∧
      1 ≤ fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x ∧
      fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ J ≤ fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x ∧
      fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x ^ J ≤ fixedLowRankProductSplit J x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2,
      eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
      eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ J]
      with x hx hy hY huJ
  have hpow : fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ J ≤
      fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) huJ
  refine ⟨hx, by omega, by simp [fixedLowRankAtomCutoff], ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ J ≤
          fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) := hpow
      _ = fixedLowRankTailCode J x := rfl
      _ ≤ fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x := by
        simp [fixedLowRankAtomCutoff]
  · exact le_rfl

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankLowRankSmoothRateHypothesis_of_sharpBFPS
statement:
theorem fixedRankLowRankSmoothRateHypothesis_of_sharpBFPS
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hsharp : FixedRankSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeHypothesis J ρ) :
    FixedRankLowRankSmoothRateHypothesis J
      (fixedLowRankCompressionError J ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedLowRankCompressionError_zero hJ hsharp.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hsharp.2, eventually_fixedLowRank_split_parameters J hJ,
      eventually_finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_fixedRankSaddle J hJ,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos]
      with x hsharpX hparams htail hV
  intro h _hh _hhy
  rcases hparams with ⟨hx, hy, hK, hYK, hKJ⟩
  let B : ℝ := Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
    ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
  have hfinite := fixedLowRankShiftedCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
    (X := x) (h := h) (y := fixedRankNatY J x)
    (Y := fixedRankNatUpperY J x) (J := J)
    (H := fixedLowRankProductSplit J x)
    (K := fixedLowRankAtomCutoff J x) (B := B)
    hx hy hK hYK hKJ (Real.exp_pos _).le (by simpa [B] using hsharpX)
  rw [fixedLowRankAtomCutoff_sub_one] at hfinite
  have hρmax : ρ x ≤ max (ρ x) 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hmaxNonneg : 0 ≤ max (ρ x) 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hB : B ≤ Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
      max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold B
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hρmax hV.le)
  have htail' : finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
      (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) x ≤
      Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
        max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    exact htail.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
      have : 0 ≤ max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_nonneg hmaxNonneg hV.le
      linarith))
  have hsum : B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
      (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) x ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
        max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    linarith
  have hcombined :
      (x : ℝ) *
          (B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
            (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) x) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
            (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        (x : ℝ) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
            max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
            (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    have hright := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum
      (Real.exp_pos (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
        (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹)).le
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hright (Nat.cast_nonneg x))
  have hmain : (paperFixedLowRankShiftedCount J x h : ℝ) ≤
      (x : ℝ) *
        (2 * Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
          max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
        Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
          (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    unfold paperFixedLowRankShiftedCount
    exact hfinite.trans hcombined
  calc
    (paperFixedLowRankShiftedCount J x h : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
            max (ρ x) 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
          Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
            (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) := hmain
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) +
          fixedLowRankCompressionError J ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hoverhead :
          (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
              (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹) /
                scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
            Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x +
              (fixedRankNatY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
      rw [fixedLowRankCompressionError, add_mul, hoverhead]
      have htwo : (2 : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 2) :=
        (Real.exp_log (by norm_num)).symm
      nth_rewrite 1 [htwo]
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_9
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_9
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) {T : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hscale : HasExponentialCutoffScale y T) :
    supplierReciprocalMass P x ≤
        ∑ π : LabelPartition J, partitionDescriptorMass P x π ∧
      supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
        labelledPartitionCount J *
          max 1 (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N) ^ J ∧
      (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * x) / T
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨supplierReciprocalMass_le_partitionDescriptorMass P x,
    supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_maxOccurrenceCount_pow P x N hN.ne',
    occurrenceCount_le_log_two_mul_div_scale P x N hN hNx hT hscale⟩

    (hblock : HasPartitionDescriptorMassBound P x L) :
    supplierReciprocalMass P x ≤
      (labelledPartitionCount J : ℚ) * L ^ J / (totalDemandProduct P : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    supplierReciprocalMass P x ≤
        ∑ π : LabelPartition J, partitionDescriptorMass P x π :=
      supplierReciprocalMass_le_partitionDescriptorMass P x
    _ ≤ ∑ _π : LabelPartition J,
        L ^ J / (totalDemandProduct P : ℚ) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun π hπ ↦ hblock π
    _ = (labelledPartitionCount J : ℚ) * L ^ J /
        (totalDemandProduct P : ℚ) := by
      simp only [labelledPartitionCount, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
        nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_21_finiteEncoding
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_21_finiteEncoding

    (hcode : ∀ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·),
      code d ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Z Hcode X)
    (hdenominator : ∀ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·), code d ≤ d)
    (hfibre : ∀ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Z Hcode X,
      ((D.filter (H < ·)).filter fun d ↦ code d = m).card ≤
        C * orderedDivisorCount J m) :
    (∑ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·), 1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      C * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Z Hcode X
proof:
:= by
  exact finite_reciprocal_sum_le_tau_smooth_tail
    (D.filter (H < ·)) code id J Z Hcode X C hcode hdenominator hfibre

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_21_weightedEncoding
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_21_weightedEncoding
    (D : Finset ℕ) (code : ℕ → ℕ) (J Z H Hcode X : ℕ) {E : ℝ}
    (hencoding : HasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound D code J Z H Hcode X E) :
    (∑ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·), 1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      E * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Z Hcode X
proof:
:= by
  let S := D.filter (H < ·)
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·), 1 / (d : ℝ)) =
        ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Z Hcode X,
          ∑ d ∈ S.filter (fun d ↦ code d = m), 1 / (d : ℝ) := by
      symm
      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (fun d hd ↦ hencoding.1 d hd) (fun d ↦ 1 / (d : ℝ))
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Z Hcode X,
        E * ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm ↦ hencoding.2 m hm
    _ = E * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Z Hcode X := by
      unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.localTotientFactor_eq_totient_pow
statement:
theorem localTotientFactor_eq_totient_pow {d q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ primeSupport d) :
    localTotientFactor d q = (q ^ d.factorization q).totient
proof:
:= by
  have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  have hdvd : q ∣ d := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hq).2.2
  have hpos : 0 < d.factorization q := hqPrime.factorization_pos_of_dvd hd hdvd
  rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow hqPrime hpos]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.IsLowRankSourceFamily.largestPrimeFactor_totient_le
proof:
:= by
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := (h.pos d hd).ne'
  rw [largestPrimeFactor, max_le_iff]
  refine ⟨hZ, Finset.sup_le ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  have hpDvd : p ∣ d.totient := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  rw [totient_eq_prod_localTotientFactor hdne] at hpDvd
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ :=
    (hpPrime.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff fun q ↦ localTotientFactor d q).mp hpDvd
  exact (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hpPrime
    (localTotientFactor_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq)).ne' hpq).trans
      (h.localTotientSmooth d hd q hq)

name: RankAmplification.IsLowRankSourceFamily.le_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := (h.pos d hd).ne'
  have hbase : 1 ≤ 2 * x := by omega
  calc
    d = ∏ q ∈ primeSupport d, q ^ d.factorization q :=
      (prod_localPrimePower_eq_self hdne).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ _q ∈ primeSupport d, 2 * x := by
      refine Finset.prod_le_prod (fun q _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) ?_
      intro q hq
      exact h.localPowerLe d hd q hq
    _ = (2 * x) ^ (primeSupport d).card := by
      simp [Finset.prod_const]
    _ ≤ (2 * x) ^ J :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (h.card_primeSupport_lt hy hd).le

name: RankAmplification.IsLowRankSourceFamily.subset_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet
statement:
theorem IsLowRankSourceFamily.subset_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet
    {D : Finset ℕ} {x y Z J X : ℕ}
    (h : IsLowRankSourceFamily D x y Z J) (hZ : 1 ≤ Z) (hmax : ∀ d ∈ D, d ≤ X) :
    D ⊆ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Z J
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet]
  exact ⟨d, h.mem_census hZ hd (hmax d hd), h.badLocalProduct_eq_self hd⟩

name: RankAmplification.largestPrimeFactor_le_of_dvd
statement:
theorem largestPrimeFactor_le_of_dvd {a b : ℕ} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : a ∣ b) :

proof:
:= by

  intro p hp
  exact prime_le_largestPrimeFactor (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp) hb

name: RankAmplification.localTotientFactor_badLocalProduct

name: RankAmplification.isLowRankSourceFamily_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet
statement:
theorem isLowRankSourceFamily_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet
    {X x y Y J : ℕ} (hX : X ≤ 2 * x) :
    IsLowRankSourceFamily (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J) x y Y J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hbase : ∀ d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J,
      ∃ N, N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J ∧ badLocalProduct N y = d :=
    fun d hd ↦ mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp hd
  refine ⟨fun d hd ↦ ?_, fun d hd q hq ↦ ?_, fun d hd q hq ↦ ?_, fun d hd q hq ↦ ?_,
    fun d hd ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨N, _, rfl⟩ := hbase d hd
    exact badLocalProduct_pos N y
  · obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hbase d hd
    have hNData := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
    have hNpos : 0 < N := hNData.1
    have hqBad : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y := by
      rwa [primeSupport_badLocalProduct] at hq
    have hfac : (badLocalProduct N y).factorization q = N.factorization q := by
      simp [factorization_badLocalProduct, hqBad]
    rw [hfac]
    exact ((Nat.le_of_dvd hNpos (Nat.ordProj_dvd N q)).trans hNData.2.1).trans hX
  · obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hbase d hd
    have hNData := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
    have hNpos : 0 < N := hNData.1
    have hqBad : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y := by
      rwa [primeSupport_badLocalProduct] at hq
    rw [localTotientFactor_badLocalProduct hqBad]
    have hphi : N.totient ≠ 0 := (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hNpos).ne'
    exact (largestPrimeFactor_le_of_dvd hphi
      (localTotientFactor_dvd_totient hNpos.ne' (badLocalPrimeSet_subset N y hqBad))).trans
      hNData.2.2.1
  · obtain ⟨N, _, rfl⟩ := hbase d hd
    have hqBad : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y := by
      rwa [primeSupport_badLocalProduct] at hq
    rw [localTotientFactor_badLocalProduct hqBad]
    exact (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hqBad).2
  · obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hbase d hd
    have hNData := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
    have hNpos : 0 < N := hNData.1
    have hdpos : 0 < badLocalProduct N y := badLocalProduct_pos N y
    rw [← totient_eq_prod_localTotientFactor hdpos.ne']
    have hdvd : (badLocalProduct N y).totient ∣ N.totient :=
      Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd (badLocalProduct_dvd hNpos.ne')
    have hphi : N.totient ≠ 0 := (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hNpos).ne'
    have hphid : (badLocalProduct N y).totient ≠ 0 :=
      (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hdpos).ne'
    exact (largePrimeRank_le_of_dvd hphid hphi hdvd).trans_lt hNData.2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.primeSupport_ten

proof:

  show (∏ q ∈ (11 : ℕ).primeFactors, localTotientFactor 11 q) = 10

name: RankAmplification.isLowRankSourceFamily_singleton_eleven
statement:
theorem isLowRankSourceFamily_singleton_eleven :
    IsLowRankSourceFamily {11} 10 2 5 3
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ d ∈ ({11} : Finset ℕ), d = 11 := by
    intro d hd
    simpa using hd
  have hsupport : primeSupport 11 = {11} :=
    Nat.Prime.primeFactors (by decide : Nat.Prime 11)
  have hq : ∀ q ∈ primeSupport 11, q = 11 := by
    intro q hqmem
    rw [hsupport] at hqmem
    simpa using hqmem
  refine ⟨fun d hd ↦ ?_, fun d hd q hqmem ↦ ?_, fun d hd q hqmem ↦ ?_,
    fun d hd q hqmem ↦ ?_, fun d hd ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [hmem d hd]; norm_num
  · rw [hmem d hd] at hqmem ⊢
    rw [hq q hqmem, factorization_eleven_self]
    norm_num
  · rw [hmem d hd] at hqmem ⊢
    rw [hq q hqmem, localTotientFactor_eleven, largestPrimeFactor_ten]
  · rw [hmem d hd] at hqmem ⊢
    rw [hq q hqmem, localTotientFactor_eleven, largestPrimeFactor_ten]
    norm_num
  · rw [hmem d hd, prod_localTotientFactor_eleven, largePrimeRank_two_ten]
    norm_num

name: RankAmplification.HasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound.mono
statement:
theorem HasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound.mono
    {D D' : Finset ℕ} {code : ℕ → ℕ} {J Z H Hcode X : ℕ} {E : ℝ}
    (h : HasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound D' code J Z H Hcode X E)
    (hsub : D ⊆ D') :
    HasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound D code J Z H Hcode X E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : D.filter (H < ·) ⊆ D'.filter (H < ·) := by
    intro d hd
    have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hsub hdData.1, hdData.2⟩
  refine ⟨fun d hd ↦ h.1 d (hfilter hd), fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  refine le_trans ?_ (h.2 m hm)
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun d _ _ ↦ by positivity)
  intro d hd
  have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hfilter hdData.1, hdData.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily
    {D : Finset ℕ} {x y Z J X H Hcode : ℕ}
    (h : IsLowRankSourceFamily D x y Z J)
    (hX : 0 < X) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hmax : ∀ d ∈ D, d ≤ X)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Z ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (∑ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·), 1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Z Hcode (X ^ J)
proof:

    (hasWeightedLowRankSourceFibreBound_of_isLowRankSourceFamily h hX hy hZ hmax hthreshold)

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily_paperScale
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily_paperScale
    {D : Finset ℕ} {x y Z J H Hcode : ℕ}
    (h : IsLowRankSourceFamily D x y Z J)
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hZ : 0 < Z)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Z ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (∑ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·), 1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Z Hcode (((2 * x) ^ J) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  have hXpos : 0 < (2 * x) ^ J := pow_pos (by omega) J
  exact section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily h hXpos hy hZ
    (fun d hd ↦ h.le_pow hy1 hx hd) hthreshold

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily_paperConstant
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily_paperConstant
    {D : Finset ℕ} {x y Z J H Hcode : ℕ}
    (h : IsLowRankSourceFamily D x y Z J)
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hZ : 0 < Z) (hJ : 1 ≤ J)
    (hthreshold : (2 ^ J * Z ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (∑ d ∈ D.filter (H < ·), 1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Z Hcode (((2 * x) ^ J) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < (y : ℝ) := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
    linarith
  have hconst : Real.exp (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) := by
    refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
    rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hypos]
    exact_mod_cast hJ
  have htail : (0 : ℝ) ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Z Hcode (((2 * x) ^ J) ^ J) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  exact (section10_lemma10_21_generalFamily_paperScale h hx hy hZ hthreshold).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hconst htail)

name: RankAmplification.IsSmooth.of_dvd
statement:

    IsSmooth R m
proof:
:= by
