name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalSum_le_mertensProduct
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalSum_le_mertensProduct (R X : ℕ) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalSum R X ≤ mertensProduct R
proof:
:= by
  let e : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X} ↪ (R + 1).smoothNumbers :=
    { toFun := fun m ↦
        ⟨m.1, isSmooth_iff_mem_smoothNumbers_succ.mp
          (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp m.2).2.2⟩
      inj' := fun a b hab ↦ Subtype.ext <|
        congrArg (fun z : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ (z : ℕ)) hab }
  let A : Finset ((R + 1).smoothNumbers) := Finset.univ.map e
  have hsmooth := (summable_and_hasSum_smooth_reciprocals R).2
  have hle : (∑ m ∈ A, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤ mertensProduct R := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ A, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤
          ∑' m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
        hsmooth.summable.sum_le_tsum A (fun m _ ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg m.1))
      _ = mertensProduct R := hsmooth.tsum_eq
  have hfinite : finiteSmoothReciprocalSum R X =
      ∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [finiteSmoothReciprocalSum, ← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
  have hmap :
      (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) =
        ∑ m ∈ A, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    change (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.map e, ((m.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m _
    rfl
  rw [hfinite, hmap]
  exact hle

name: RankAmplification.finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le
statement:
theorem finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le (p X : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * finiteSmoothReciprocalSum p X
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteProviderReciprocalSum finiteSmoothReciprocalSum
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ finiteSmoothSet p X, ((k * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ finiteSmoothSet p X, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (k : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      have hkpos : 0 < k := (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hk).1
      have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (k * p : ℕ) := by positivity
      calc
        (((k * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ (((k * p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
          exact inv_anti₀ hden (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (k * p) 1)
        _ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (k : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          norm_num [mul_inv_rev, mul_comm]
    _ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ finiteSmoothSet p X, (k : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_mertensProduct
statement:
theorem finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_mertensProduct (p X : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * mertensProduct p
proof:
:= by
  exact (finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le p X hp).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (finiteSmoothReciprocalSum_le_mertensProduct p X)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg p)))

name: RankAmplification.finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_log
statement:
theorem finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_log (p X : ℕ) (hp : 3 ≤ p) :
    finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X ≤
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log p))
proof:
:= by
  exact (finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_mertensProduct p X (by omega)).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mertensProduct_le_log p hp)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg p)))

name: RankAmplification.smoothFactorPairSet_subset_product
statement:
theorem smoothFactorPairSet_subset_product (R X : ℕ) :
    smoothFactorPairSet R X ⊆ finiteSmoothSet R X ×ˢ finiteSmoothSet R X
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨hk₁, hk₂, hkprod, hsmooth⟩ := mem_smoothFactorPairSet.mp hk
  have hk₁le : k.1 ≤ X := by
    calc
      k.1 = k.1 * 1 := (Nat.mul_one k.1).symm
      _ ≤ k.1 * k.2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k.1 hk₂
      _ ≤ X := hkprod
  have hk₂le : k.2 ≤ X := by
    calc
      k.2 = 1 * k.2 := (Nat.one_mul k.2).symm
      _ ≤ k.1 * k.2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k.2 hk₁
      _ ≤ X := hkprod
  have hsmooth₁ : IsSmooth R k.1 :=
    hsmooth.of_dvd (dvd_mul_right k.1 k.2) (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hk₁)
  have hsmooth₂ : IsSmooth R k.2 :=
    hsmooth.of_dvd (dvd_mul_left k.2 k.1) (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hk₂)
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
    ⟨mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr ⟨hk₁, hk₁le, hsmooth₁⟩,
      mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr ⟨hk₂, hk₂le, hsmooth₂⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_sq
statement:
theorem smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_sq (p X : ℕ) :
    smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum p X ≤ (finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let term : ℕ × ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦
    (((k.1 * p + 1) * (k.2 * p + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hnonneg : ∀ k ∈ finiteSmoothSet p X ×ˢ finiteSmoothSet p X, 0 ≤ term k := by
    intro k _
    exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  calc
    smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum p X =
        ∑ k ∈ smoothFactorPairSet p X, term k := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ finiteSmoothSet p X ×ˢ finiteSmoothSet p X, term k :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (smoothFactorPairSet_subset_product p X)
        (fun k hk _ ↦ hnonneg k hk)
    _ = (finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_product, finiteProviderReciprocalSum, pow_two]
      simp only [term, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k₁ hk₁
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k₂ hk₂
      rw [mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.smoothProviderPairMajorant_eq
statement:
theorem smoothProviderPairMajorant_eq (x p X : ℕ) :
    smoothProviderPairMajorant x p X =
      (x : ℝ) * smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum p X +
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p X
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothProviderPairMajorant, smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum,
    ← card_smoothFactorPairSet_cast_eq]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    norm_num
  · simp

name: RankAmplification.smoothProviderPairMajorant_le
statement:
theorem smoothProviderPairMajorant_le (x p X : ℕ) :
    smoothProviderPairMajorant x p X ≤
      (x : ℝ) * (finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X) ^ 2 +
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p X
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothProviderPairMajorant_eq]
  simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_sq p X)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg x)) (finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p X)

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.provider_product_eq
statement:
theorem provider_product_eq :
    s.q1 * s.q2 = (s.k1 * p + 1) * (s.k2 * p + 1)
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.cofactor_provider_factorization
statement:
theorem cofactor_provider_factorization :
    n * (n + h) = (s.m1 * s.m2) * (s.q1 * s.q2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    n * (n + h) = (s.m1 * s.q1) * (s.m2 * s.q2) :=
      congrArg₂ (· * ·) s.n_eq s.shifted_eq
    _ = (s.m1 * s.m2) * (s.q1 * s.q2) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.provider_product_le_two_mul_xy
statement:
theorem provider_product_le_two_mul_xy {x y : ℕ} (hnx : n ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) (hlarge : x / y < s.m1 * s.m2) :
    s.q1 * s.q2 ≤ 2 * x * y
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    rw [s.n_eq]
    exact Nat.mul_pos s.m1_pos s.q1_prime.pos
  have hx : 0 < x := hn.trans_le hnx
  have hxlt : x < y * (s.m1 * s.m2) := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hy).mp hlarge
  have hnshift : n + h ≤ 2 * x := by
    have hhx : h ≤ x := hhy.trans hxy
    omega
  have hupper : n * (n + h) ≤ x * (2 * x) := Nat.mul_le_mul hnx hnshift
  by_contra hnot
  have hq : 2 * x * y < s.q1 * s.q2 := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hleft : x * (2 * x) < (s.m1 * s.m2) * (2 * x * y) := by
    calc
      x * (2 * x) = (2 * x) * x := by ring
      _ < (2 * x) * (y * (s.m1 * s.m2)) :=
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hxlt (by omega)
      _ = (s.m1 * s.m2) * (2 * x * y) := by ring
  have hright : (s.m1 * s.m2) * (2 * x * y) <
      (s.m1 * s.m2) * (s.q1 * s.q2) :=
    Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq (Nat.mul_pos s.m1_pos s.m2_pos)
  have hcontra : n * (n + h) < (s.m1 * s.m2) * (s.q1 * s.q2) :=
    hupper.trans_lt (hleft.trans hright)
  rw [← s.cofactor_provider_factorization] at hcontra
  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ hcontra)

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.multiplier_product_le_large_cofactor_cutoff
statement:
theorem multiplier_product_le_large_cofactor_cutoff {x y : ℕ} (hnx : n ≤ x)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hy : 0 < y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hlarge : x / y < s.m1 * s.m2) :
    s.k1 * s.k2 ≤ (2 * x * y) / p ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply multiplier_product_le_div_sq hp
  rw [← s.provider_product_eq]
  exact s.provider_product_le_two_mul_xy hnx hy hhy hxy hlarge

    (hp : 0 < p) (hy : 0 < y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hlarge : x / y < s.m1 * s.m2) :
    (s.k1, s.k2) ∈ smoothFactorPairSet p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:

  exact mem_smoothFactorPairSet.mpr
    ⟨s.k1_pos, s.k2_pos,

    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hBFPS : MovingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis ρ) :

proof:

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRank_finiteTau_le_sharpEndpointExp
statement:
theorem movingLowRank_finiteTau_le_sharpEndpointExp
    {x X : ℕ} (hX : X ≤ 2 * x)
    (hscale : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x)
    (hsaddle : HasMovingSaddleMargins (x : ℝ))
    (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
    (hZ : 1 < movingNatZ x) (hy : 0 < movingNatY x)
    (hvThree : 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ))
    (huSqrt : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x))
    (hKL : Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
        (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
      Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hj : 0 < movingNatJ x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hscale.rank_ge_two
  have hpow : X ^ movingNatJ x ≤ (2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_left hX _
  have hmono := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_mono_upper
    (j := movingNatJ x) (R := movingNatZ x)
    (H := movingSourceTailCode x) hpow
  have hfactor := one_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor
    (J := movingNatJ x) (y := movingNatY x)
    (M := movingSupplierSlotBound x) hj
  have htail0 : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
      (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x)
        ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  have hfull := moving_friableProduct_le_endpoint_exp hscale hsaddle heta hZ hy
    hvThree huSqrt hKL
  calc
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
        (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) := hmono
    _ = 1 * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) := by ring
    _ ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
          (movingSupplierSlotBound x) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfactor htail0
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := hfull

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSharpMarginLowRankError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSharpMarginLowRankError_zero
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (movingSharpMarginLowRankError ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingSupplierSection10Error x - 1)
      atTop (nhds (-1)) := by
    simpa using tendsto_movingSupplierSection10Error_zero.sub_const 1
  have hmax : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x - 1))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hcombined := hρ.max hsupp
    have hval : max (0 : ℝ) (-1) = 0 := by norm_num
    rw [hval] at hcombined
    exact hcombined
  have hsum := hmax.add tendsto_movingSharpLowRankOverhead_zero
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    max (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x - 1) +
      (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) +
        (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCensus_le_sharpMarginExp
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCensus_le_sharpMarginExp
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hBFPS : MovingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis ρ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ X, x ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * x →
      (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
            movingSharpMarginLowRankError ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsaddle : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, HasMovingSaddleMargins (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_hasMovingSaddleMargins
  have hVthree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_three_le_movingVsrc
  have hKpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_movingK_pos
  have hKL : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_log_three_add_movingK_le_scaleL
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSupplierScaleBounds,
      eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility, eventually_two_le_movingNatZ,
      eventually_movingSourceRank_le_sqrt_natZ, hsaddle, hVthree, hKpos, hKL,
      heta, eventually_movingK_add_etaR_le_movingE,
      movingSharpLowerYQuotientRange_at_movingE hBFPS] with
      x hscale hadm hZ huSqrt hsaddle hVthree hK hKL heta hKE hsharp
  intro X hxX hX
  have hxtwo : 2 ≤ x := by
    exact (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3).trans
      (hadm.three_le_y.trans (hadm.y_le_Z.trans hadm.Z_le_x))
  have hx : 0 < x := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hxtwo
  have hXtwo : 2 ≤ X := hxtwo.trans hxX
  have hy : 2 ≤ movingNatY x := (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3).trans hadm.three_le_y
  have hyPos : 0 < movingNatY x := by omega
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x := by omega
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hthreshold :
      (2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) *
          movingSourceTailCode x ≤ x.sqrt :=
    movingSourceTailCode_threshold hx hK hV0
  have hfinite := movingLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_weightedCompression
    (x := x) (X := X) (H := x.sqrt) (Hcode := movingSourceTailCode x)
    hXtwo hy hZpos hthreshold
    (Real.exp_pos (-movingE (x : ℝ) + ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))).le
    (hsharp X hxX hX)
  have htail := movingLowRank_finiteTau_le_sharpEndpointExp hX hscale hsaddle heta
    (show 1 < movingNatZ x by omega) hyPos hVthree huSqrt hKL
  set M : ℝ := max (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x - 1) with hM
  set A : ℝ := -movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) with hA
  set Cx : ℝ := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹ with hCx
  set C₂ : ℝ := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) + (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹ with hC₂
  have hB : Real.exp (-movingE (x : ℝ) +
      ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp A := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (le_max_left (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x - 1)) heta.le
    rw [← hM] at hmul
    linarith
  have htail' : finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
      (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤ Real.exp A := by
    refine htail.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (le_max_right (ρ x) (movingSupplierSection10Error x - 1)) heta.le
    rw [← hM] at hmul
    have hexpand : (movingSupplierSection10Error x - 1) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
      ring
    linarith
  have hsum : Real.exp (-movingE (x : ℝ) +
        ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) +
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
        (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x) ≤ 2 * Real.exp A := by
    linarith
  have hC : Cx ≤ C₂ := by
    rw [hCx, hC₂]
    have hmono := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_mono hXtwo hX
    linarith
  have hmain : (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ := by
    calc
      (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
          (X : ℝ) *
            (Real.exp (-movingE (x : ℝ) + ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) +
              finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
                (movingSourceTailCode x) (X ^ movingNatJ x)) * Real.exp Cx := by
        simpa [hCx] using hfinite
      _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp Cx := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (Nat.cast_nonneg X))
          (Real.exp_pos Cx).le
      _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hC)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos A).le))
  have herrorEq :
      -movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSharpMarginLowRankError ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
        A + (Real.log 2 + C₂) := by
    unfold movingSharpMarginLowRankError
    rw [hA, hC₂, ← hM]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hexp : 2 * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂ =
      Real.exp (A + (Real.log 2 + C₂)) := by
    have htwo : Real.exp (Real.log 2) = (2 : ℝ) :=
      Real.exp_log (by norm_num)
    calc
      2 * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂ =
          Real.exp (Real.log 2) * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂ := by rw [htwo]
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log 2 + A) * Real.exp C₂ := by
        exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ z * Real.exp C₂)
          (Real.exp_add (Real.log 2) A).symm
      _ = Real.exp ((Real.log 2 + A) + C₂) := by
        exact (Real.exp_add (Real.log 2 + A) C₂).symm
      _ = Real.exp (A + (Real.log 2 + C₂)) := by
        congr 1
        ring
  calc
    (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ := hmain
    _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSharpMarginLowRankError ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [herrorEq]
      calc
        (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp C₂ =
            (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A * Real.exp C₂) := by ring
        _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (A + (Real.log 2 + C₂)) := by
          rw [hexp]

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCensus_le_absoluteMarginExp
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCensus_le_absoluteMarginExp
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hBFPS : MovingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis ρ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c < 1) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ X, x ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * x →
      (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-movingK (x : ℝ) - c * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSharpMarginLowRankError ρ x < 1 - c := by
    have hzero := tendsto_movingSharpMarginLowRankError_zero hBFPS.1
    exact (tendsto_order.1 hzero).2 _ (by linarith)
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [movingLowRankCensus_le_sharpMarginExp hBFPS, hsmall, heta] with
      x hx hsmall heta
  intro X hxX hX
  refine (hx X hxX hX).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall.le heta.le]

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCensus_le_halfMarginExp_unconditional
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCensus_le_halfMarginExp_unconditional :

theorem exists_absolute_margin_movingLowRankCompression :

name: RankAmplification.moving_proposition10_23_shifted_absoluteMargin
statement:
theorem moving_proposition10_23_shifted_absoluteMargin :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h,
        (movingLowRankShiftedCount x h : ℝ) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
            (-movingK (x : ℝ) - c * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.mem_largeCofactorCodeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_largeCofactorCodeSet {x y P : ℕ} {c : ProviderCode} :
    c ∈ largeCofactorCodeSet x y P ↔
      y < c.p ∧ c.p ≤ P ∧
        (c.k1, c.k2) ∈ smoothFactorPairSet c.p ((2 * x * y) / c.p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hc
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzc⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hc
    obtain ⟨p, k₁, k₂⟩ := z
    have hzData := Finset.mem_sigma.mp hz
    have hpData := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hzData.1
    cases hzc
    exact ⟨hpData.1, hpData.2, hzData.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hyp, hpP, hk⟩
    apply Finset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨c.p, (c.k1, c.k2)⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨hyp, hpP⟩, hk⟩

name: RankAmplification.sum_largeCofactorCodeSet_eq
statement:
theorem sum_largeCofactorCodeSet_eq (x y P : ℕ) :
    (∑ c ∈ largeCofactorCodeSet x y P,
        ((x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1)) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc y P,
        smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeCofactorCodeSet, Finset.sum_map, Finset.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  simp [smoothProviderPairMajorant, ProviderCode.denominator, sigmaToProviderCode]

name: RankAmplification.card_eq_sum_providerCode_fibers
statement:
theorem card_eq_sum_providerCode_fibers {h : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n)) :
    S.card = ∑ c ∈ providerCodeImage S provider skeleton,
      (S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card
proof:
:= by
  let f := providerCodeOf provider skeleton
  have hmaps : (S.attach : Set {n // n ∈ S}).MapsTo f
      (providerCodeImage S provider skeleton : Set ProviderCode) := by
    intro n hn
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
  simpa [providerCodeImage, f] using Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps

name: RankAmplification.providerCode_fiber_card_le
statement:
theorem providerCode_fiber_card_le {x h : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hph : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, h < provider n)
    (c : ProviderCode) :
    (S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card ≤
      x / c.denominator + 1
proof:
:= by
  let F := S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c
  by_cases hF : F = ∅
  · simp [F, hF]
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hF
    have haData := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
    have haCode : providerCodeOf provider skeleton a = c := haData.2
    have hpEq : provider a = c.p := congrArg ProviderCode.p haCode
    have hk1Eq : (skeleton a).k1 = c.k1 := congrArg ProviderCode.k1 haCode
    have hk2Eq : (skeleton a).k2 = c.k2 := congrArg ProviderCode.k2 haCode
    have hq1 : (c.k1 * c.p + 1).Prime := by
      rw [← hpEq, ← hk1Eq, ← (skeleton a).q1_eq]
      exact (skeleton a).q1_prime
    have hq2 : (c.k2 * c.p + 1).Prime := by
      rw [← hpEq, ← hk2Eq, ← (skeleton a).q2_eq]
      exact (skeleton a).q2_prime
    have hk1pos : 0 < c.k1 := by simpa [← hk1Eq] using (skeleton a).k1_pos
    have hpc : h < c.p := by simpa [← hpEq] using hph a
    have hcq1 : c.p < c.k1 * c.p + 1 := by
      calc
        c.p = 1 * c.p := (Nat.one_mul c.p).symm
        _ ≤ c.k1 * c.p := Nat.mul_le_mul_right c.p hk1pos
        _ < c.k1 * c.p + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
    have hlarge : ∀ r : ℕ, r.Prime → r ∣ c.k1 * c.p + 1 → h < r := by
      intro r hr hrd
      have hre : r = c.k1 * c.p + 1 := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hr hq1).mp hrd
      rw [hre]
      exact hpc.trans hcq1
    have hsubset : F.map subtypeNatEmbedding ⊆
        shiftedDivisibilitySet x h (c.k1 * c.p + 1) (c.k2 * c.p + 1) := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hn
      have hbCode : providerCodeOf provider skeleton b = c := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
      have hpEq' : provider b = c.p := congrArg ProviderCode.p hbCode
      have hk1Eq' : (skeleton b).k1 = c.k1 := congrArg ProviderCode.k1 hbCode
      have hk2Eq' : (skeleton b).k2 = c.k2 := congrArg ProviderCode.k2 hbCode
      have hbpos : 0 < b.1 := by
        rw [(skeleton b).n_eq]
        exact Nat.mul_pos (skeleton b).m1_pos (skeleton b).q1_prime.pos
      apply mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet.mpr
      refine ⟨hbpos, hnx b, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hpEq', ← hk1Eq', ← (skeleton b).q1_eq]
        exact (skeleton b).q1_dvd
      · rw [← hpEq', ← hk2Eq', ← (skeleton b).q2_eq]
        exact (skeleton b).q2_dvd
    have hcardMap : (F.map subtypeNatEmbedding).card ≤
        (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h (c.k1 * c.p + 1) (c.k2 * c.p + 1)).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    have hresidue := shiftedDivisibilitySet_card_le (x := x) hh hq1.pos hq2.pos hlarge
    simpa [F, ProviderCode.denominator] using hcardMap.trans hresidue

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.provider_le_sqrt_two_mul_xy
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.provider_le_sqrt_two_mul_xy {h n p x y : ℕ}
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (hnx : n ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y) (hhy : h ≤ y)
    (hxy : y ≤ x) (hlarge : x / y < s.m1 * s.m2) :
    p ≤ (2 * x * y).sqrt
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_sqrt'.2
  have hpq1 : p ≤ s.q1 := by
    rw [s.q1_eq]
    calc
      p = 1 * p := (Nat.one_mul p).symm
      _ ≤ s.k1 * p := Nat.mul_le_mul_right p s.k1_pos
      _ ≤ s.k1 * p + 1 := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hpq2 : p ≤ s.q2 := by
    rw [s.q2_eq]
    calc
      p = 1 * p := (Nat.one_mul p).symm
      _ ≤ s.k2 * p := Nat.mul_le_mul_right p s.k2_pos
      _ ≤ s.k2 * p + 1 := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  calc
    p ^ 2 = p * p := pow_two p
    _ ≤ s.q1 * s.q2 := Nat.mul_le_mul hpq1 hpq2
    _ ≤ 2 * x * y := s.provider_product_le_two_mul_xy hnx hy hhy hxy hlarge

name: RankAmplification.providerCodeImage_subset_largeCofactorCodeSet
statement:
theorem providerCodeImage_subset_largeCofactorCodeSet {x h y : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x)
    (hp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, (provider n).Prime)
    (hyp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, y < provider n)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hlarge : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, x / y < (skeleton n).m1 * (skeleton n).m2) :
    providerCodeImage S provider skeleton ⊆
      largeCofactorCodeSet x y (2 * x * y).sqrt
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
  let s := skeleton n
  apply mem_largeCofactorCodeSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hyp n, s.provider_le_sqrt_two_mul_xy (hnx n) hy hhy hxy (hlarge n), ?_⟩
  exact s.multiplier_pair_mem_large_cofactor_set (hnx n) (hp n).pos hy hhy hxy (hlarge n)

name: RankAmplification.card_largeCofactorSkeletonFamily_le
statement:
theorem card_largeCofactorSkeletonFamily_le {x h y : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x)
    (hp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, (provider n).Prime)
    (hyp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, y < provider n)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hlarge : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S},
      x / y < (skeleton n).m1 * (skeleton n).m2) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
        smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let C := providerCodeImage S provider skeleton
  have hcodeSubset : C ⊆ largeCofactorCodeSet x y (2 * x * y).sqrt :=
    providerCodeImage_subset_largeCofactorCodeSet S provider skeleton hnx hp hyp hy hhy hxy hlarge
  have hfibre (c : ProviderCode) :
      ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1 := by
    have hnat := providerCode_fiber_card_le S provider skeleton hnx hh
      (fun n ↦ hhy.trans_lt (hyp n)) c
    have hcast :
        ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((x / c.denominator + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hnat
    calc
      ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((x / c.denominator + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hcast
      _ = ((x / c.denominator : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1 := by
        simpa [add_comm] using
          add_le_add_right (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := x) (n := c.denominator)) 1
  calc
    (S.card : ℝ) = ∑ c ∈ C,
        ((S.attach.filter fun n ↦ providerCodeOf provider skeleton n = c).card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast card_eq_sum_providerCode_fibers S provider skeleton
    _ ≤ ∑ c ∈ C, ((x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun c hc ↦ hfibre c
    _ ≤ ∑ c ∈ largeCofactorCodeSet x y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
        ((x : ℝ) / c.denominator + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hcodeSubset
      intro c hc _
      positivity
    _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
        smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2) :=
      sum_largeCofactorCodeSet_eq x y _

name: RankAmplification.exists_rank_with_sqrt_gt
statement:
theorem exists_rank_with_sqrt_gt (B : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ B < Real.sqrt J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (B ^ 2) 0)
  have hJreal : max (B ^ 2) 0 < (J : ℝ) := hJ
  have hJposReal : (0 : ℝ) < J := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hJreal
  have hJpos : 0 < J := by exact_mod_cast hJposReal
  refine ⟨J, hJpos, ?_⟩
  by_cases hB : B < 0
  · exact hB.trans_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  · have hBnonneg : 0 ≤ B := le_of_not_gt hB
    have hBsq : B ^ 2 < (J : ℝ) :=
      (le_max_left (B ^ 2) 0).trans_lt hJreal
    have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (J : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (J : ℝ) :=
      Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg J)
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (J : ℝ)]

name: RankAmplification.movingNatZ_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg_K
statement:
theorem movingNatZ_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg_K
    {x : ℕ} (hZ : 2 ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ)) :
    ((movingNatZ x : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := movingZ_half_le_natZ hZ
  have hNatZpos : (0 : ℝ) < movingNatZ x := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
    exact this.trans_le hlower
  have hmodel : 2 * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) =
      (movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [movingZ, Real.exp_neg]
    field_simp
  rw [hmodel]
  exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hlower

      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2

        4 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNatZ_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg_K] with x hx
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (show 0 ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) by positivity)]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_two_add_two_K_le_scaleL
statement:
theorem eventually_log_two_add_two_K_le_scaleL :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 + 2 * movingK x ≤ scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  have hKbound := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  have hLlarge := tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2)
  filter_upwards [hKbound, hLlarge, eventually_scaleL_pos,
    tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hK hlarge hL hKpos
  have hKle : movingK x ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * scaleL x := by
    calc
      movingK x ≤ ‖movingK x‖ := Real.le_norm_self _
      _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖scaleL x‖ := by simpa using hK
      _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * scaleL x := by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le]
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_sqrt_two_mul_le_mul_exp_neg_K_real
statement:
theorem eventually_sqrt_two_mul_le_mul_exp_neg_K_real :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.sqrt (2 * x) ≤ x * Real.exp (-movingK x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_log_two_add_two_K_le_scaleL,
    (eventually_gt_atTop 0 : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 0 < x)] with x hexp hx
  have hlog : Real.log 2 + Real.log x ≤
      2 * Real.log x - 2 * movingK x := by
    rw [scaleL_eq] at hexp
    linarith
  have hsquare : (Real.sqrt (2 * x)) ^ 2 ≤
      (x * Real.exp (-movingK x)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    calc
      2 * x = Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log x) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num), Real.exp_log hx]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log x - 2 * movingK x) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
      _ = (x * Real.exp (-movingK x)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [show 2 * Real.log x - 2 * movingK x =
          (Real.log x - movingK x) + (Real.log x - movingK x) by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hx, Real.exp_neg,
          div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * x))
    (mul_nonneg hx.le (Real.exp_pos _).le)).mp hsquare

name: RankAmplification.eventually_two_mul_sqrt_two_mul_le
statement:
theorem eventually_two_mul_sqrt_two_mul_le :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hreal := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_sqrt_two_mul_le_mul_exp_neg_K_real
  filter_upwards [hreal] with x hx
  have hnat : ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt
      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by norm_num
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingElementaryCutoffError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingElementaryCutoffError_zero :
    Tendsto movingElementaryCutoffError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingElementaryCutoffError
  exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingElementaryCutoffError_identity
statement:
theorem eventually_movingElementaryCutoffError_identity :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingElementaryCutoffError x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) = Real.log 6
proof:
:= by
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [heta] with x hx
  unfold movingElementaryCutoffError
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx.ne'

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingElementaryOffDiagonal_le_majorant
statement:
theorem eventually_movingElementaryOffDiagonal_le_majorant :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * (x : ℝ) * ((movingNatZ x : ℝ))⁻¹ +
          2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryCutoffError x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_two_mul_x_mul_movingNatZ_inv_le,
    eventually_two_mul_sqrt_two_mul_le,
    eventually_movingElementaryCutoffError_identity] with x hfirst hsqrt herr
  have hsum : 2 * (x : ℝ) * ((movingNatZ x : ℝ))⁻¹ +
      2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      6 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) := by
    linarith
  calc
    2 * (x : ℝ) * ((movingNatZ x : ℝ))⁻¹ +
          2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
        6 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) := hsum
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryCutoffError x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant
      rw [herr, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.smallCofactorLogTerm_le
statement:
theorem smallCofactorLogTerm_le
    {x Z : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hZ : 0 < Z) :
    ((x / Z : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (x / Z : ℕ)) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : x / Z = 0
  · have hlogx : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      exact Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hx)
    have hright : 0 ≤ (x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by positivity
    simpa only [hq, Nat.cast_zero, Real.log_zero, add_zero, zero_mul] using hright
  · have hqpos : 0 < x / Z := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hq
    have hqx : x / Z ≤ x := Nat.div_le_self x Z
    have hlog : Real.log (x / Z : ℕ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      unfold scaleL
      apply Real.log_le_log
      · exact_mod_cast hqpos
      · exact_mod_cast hqx
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (x / Z : ℕ) := by
      have : 0 ≤ Real.log (x / Z : ℕ) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hqpos)
      linarith
    have hcast : ((x / Z : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
        (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := x) (n := Z))
    calc
      ((x / Z : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (x / Z : ℕ)) ≤
          ((x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ)⁻¹) *
            (1 + Real.log (x / Z : ℕ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast hfactor
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
        gcongr

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSmallCofactorError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSmallCofactorError_zero :
    Tendsto movingSmallCofactorError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 4 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    (log2_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 4 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hconst.add hlog
  unfold movingSmallCofactorError
  have hLone : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  apply squeeze_zero'
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      hLone] with x heta hL
    exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith)) heta.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      hLone] with x heta hL
    have harg : 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≤ 4 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    have hlogLe : Real.log (2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) ≤
        Real.log 4 + log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        Real.log (2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) ≤
            Real.log (4 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
          Real.log_le_log (by nlinarith) harg
        _ = Real.log 4 + log2 (x : ℝ) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num)
            (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL)), log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
    calc
      Real.log (2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≤
          (Real.log 4 + log2 (x : ℝ)) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogLe heta.le
      _ = Real.log 4 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by ring
  · exact hupper

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSmallCofactorError_identity
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSmallCofactorError_identity :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSmallCofactorError x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
        Real.log (2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x heta
  unfold movingSmallCofactorError
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta.ne'

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSmallCofactorTerm_le_majorant
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSmallCofactorTerm_le_majorant :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ((x / movingNatZ x : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (1 + Real.log (x / movingNatZ x : ℕ)) ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant movingSmallCofactorError x
proof:
:= by
  have hLnonneg : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility,
    eventually_movingNatZ_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg_K,
    eventually_movingSmallCofactorError_identity,
    hLnonneg] with x hadmissible hinv herr hL
  have hxone : 1 ≤ x := by
    exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
        (hadmissible.y_le_Z.trans hadmissible.Z_le_x)
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x := by
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_Z
  have hfinite := smallCofactorLogTerm_le
    (x := x) (Z := movingNatZ x) hxone hZpos
  calc
    ((x / movingNatZ x : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (1 + Real.log (x / movingNatZ x : ℕ)) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * (movingNatZ x : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hfinite
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ))) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
      gcongr
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant movingSmallCofactorError x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant
      rw [herr, Real.exp_add,
        Real.exp_log (by nlinarith : 0 < 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingElementaryTransferError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingElementaryTransferError_zero :
    Tendsto movingElementaryTransferError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      max (movingElementaryCutoffError x) (movingSmallCofactorError x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using
      tendsto_movingElementaryCutoffError_zero.max
        tendsto_movingSmallCofactorError_zero
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  unfold movingElementaryTransferError
  simpa only [zero_add] using hmax.add hconst

name: RankAmplification.sum_two_movingExponentialMajorant_le_elementaryTransfer
statement:
theorem sum_two_movingExponentialMajorant_le_elementaryTransfer
    {x : ℕ} (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :
    movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryCutoffError x +
        movingExponentialMajorant movingSmallCofactorError x ≤
      movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x
proof:
:= by
  let M := max (movingElementaryCutoffError x) (movingSmallCofactorError x)
  have hcut : movingElementaryCutoffError x ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have hsmall : movingSmallCofactorError x ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hmono (e : ℝ) (he : e ≤ M) :
      movingExponentialMajorant (fun _ ↦ e) x ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold movingExponentialMajorant
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
        simpa using add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he heta.le)
          (-movingK (x : ℝ))))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
  have hcut' : movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryCutoffError x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :=
    hmono _ hcut
  have hsmall' : movingExponentialMajorant movingSmallCofactorError x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :=
    hmono _ hsmall
  calc
    movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryCutoffError x +
        movingExponentialMajorant movingSmallCofactorError x ≤
        2 * ((x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) := by
      linarith
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError M
      rw [show (max (movingElementaryCutoffError x) (movingSmallCofactorError x) +
          Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
          max (movingElementaryCutoffError x) (movingSmallCofactorError x) *
            movingEtaR (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 by
        rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta.ne']]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [show -movingK (x : ℝ) +
            (max (movingElementaryCutoffError x) (movingSmallCofactorError x) *
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) =
            (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
              max (movingElementaryCutoffError x) (movingSmallCofactorError x) *
                movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) + Real.log 2 by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant_le_elementary_add_outer
statement:
theorem eventually_movingOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant_le_elementary_add_outer :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant x ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x +
          ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange (movingNatZ x)
              (2 * x * movingNatZ x).sqrt,
            smoothProviderPairMajorant x p
              ((2 * x * movingNatZ x) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingElementaryOffDiagonal_le_majorant,
    eventually_movingSmallCofactorTerm_le_majorant,
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x helem hsmall heta
  have hcombine := sum_two_movingExponentialMajorant_le_elementaryTransfer
    (x := x) heta
  unfold movingOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant nonsquareSkeletonMajorant
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.exists_mem_dvd_finset_prod_of_prime
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      exact (hp.not_dvd_one (by simpa using h)).elim
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha] at h
      rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp h with hfa | hrest
      · exact ⟨a, Finset.mem_insert_self a s, hfa⟩
      · obtain ⟨b, hbs, hfb⟩ := ih hrest
        exact ⟨b, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hbs, hfb⟩

name: RankAmplification.prime_le_largestPrimeFactor
statement:
theorem prime_le_largestPrimeFactor {q m : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hqm : q ∣ m) :
    q ≤ largestPrimeFactor m
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : q ∈ m.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hq, hqm, hm⟩
  have hsup : q ≤ m.primeFactors.sup id := by
    simpa using (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem)
  exact hsup.trans (Nat.le_max_right 1 _)

name: RankAmplification.largestPrimeFactor_mem_primeFactors
statement:
theorem largestPrimeFactor_mem_primeFactors {m : ℕ} (hlarge : 1 < largestPrimeFactor m) :
    largestPrimeFactor m ∈ m.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  have hsup : 1 < m.primeFactors.sup id := by
    rw [largestPrimeFactor] at hlarge
    simpa only [lt_max_iff, lt_self_iff_false, false_or] using hlarge
  have hnonempty : m.primeFactors.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hempty
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hempty] at hsup
    simp at hsup
  obtain ⟨q, hqmem, hqeq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup m.primeFactors hnonempty id
  rw [largestPrimeFactor, Nat.max_eq_right hsup.le, hqeq]
  exact hqmem

name: RankAmplification.largestPrimeFactor_prime
statement:
theorem largestPrimeFactor_prime {m : ℕ} (hlarge : 1 < largestPrimeFactor m) :
    (largestPrimeFactor m).Prime
proof:
:=
  Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (largestPrimeFactor_mem_primeFactors hlarge)

name: RankAmplification.largestPrimeFactor_dvd
statement:
theorem largestPrimeFactor_dvd {m : ℕ} (hlarge : 1 < largestPrimeFactor m) :
    largestPrimeFactor m ∣ m
proof:
:=
  Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors (largestPrimeFactor_mem_primeFactors hlarge)

name: RankAmplification.largestPrimeFactor_le_of_isSmooth
statement:
theorem largestPrimeFactor_le_of_isSmooth {y m : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hm : IsSmooth y m) :
    largestPrimeFactor m ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [largestPrimeFactor, Nat.max_le]
  exact ⟨hy, Finset.sup_le fun q hq ↦ hm.2 q hq⟩

name: RankAmplification.prime_lt_of_dvd_pred
statement:
theorem prime_lt_of_dvd_pred {p q : ℕ} (_hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (h : p ∣ q - 1) :
    p < q
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : 0 < q - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq.one_lt
  have hle : p ≤ q - 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd hpred h
  omega

name: RankAmplification.exists_pos_mul_add_one_eq_of_dvd_pred
statement:
theorem exists_pos_mul_add_one_eq_of_dvd_pred {p q : ℕ} (_hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (h : p ∣ q - 1) : ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ q = k * p + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hknot
    have hkzero : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hknot
    subst k
    simp only [mul_zero] at hk
    have : q ≤ 1 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.mp hk
    exact (not_le_of_gt hq.one_lt) this
  refine ⟨k, hkpos, ?_⟩
  calc
    q = (q - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hq.one_le).symm
    _ = p * k + 1 := by rw [hk]
    _ = k * p + 1 := by rw [mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.prime_dvd_totient_of_sq_dvd
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_totient_of_sq_dvd {q N : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hqsq : q ^ 2 ∣ N) :
    q ∣ N.totient
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : q ∣ (q ^ 2).totient := by
    rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow hq (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℕ))]
    simp
  exact hlocal.trans (Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hqsq)

name: RankAmplification.exists_cofactor_of_prime_dvd_not_dvd_totient
statement:
theorem exists_cofactor_of_prime_dvd_not_dvd_totient {q N : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime)
    (hqdvd : q ∣ N) (hqtot : ¬q ∣ N.totient) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, N = m * q ∧ ¬q ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨N / q, (Nat.div_mul_cancel hqdvd).symm, ?_⟩
  intro hqcofactor
  apply hqtot
  apply prime_dvd_totient_of_sq_dvd hq
  have hsq : q * q ∣ (N / q) * q := Nat.mul_dvd_mul hqcofactor (dvd_refl q)
  rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hqdvd] at hsq
  simpa only [pow_two] using hsq

name: RankAmplification.totient_eq_cofactor_mul_pred
statement:
theorem totient_eq_cofactor_mul_pred {N m q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hN : N = m * q)
    (hqcofactor : ¬q ∣ m) : N.totient = m.totient * (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoprime : m.Coprime q := (hq.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hqcofactor).symm
  rw [hN, Nat.totient_mul hcoprime, Nat.totient_prime hq]

name: RankAmplification.exists_prime_provider_of_dvd_totient
statement:
theorem exists_prime_provider_of_dvd_totient {N p : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hptot : p ∣ N.totient) (hp_sq : ¬p ^ 2 ∣ N) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ N ∧ p ∣ q - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hN).ne'
  rw [Nat.totient_eq_prod_factorization hN0] at hptot
  change p ∣ ∏ q ∈ N.factorization.support,
    q ^ (N.factorization q - 1) * (q - 1) at hptot
  obtain ⟨q, hqN, hpq⟩ :=
    exists_mem_dvd_finset_prod_of_prime hp N.factorization.support
      (fun q ↦ q ^ (N.factorization q - 1) * (q - 1)) hptot
  have hq : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqN
  have hqdvd : q ∣ N := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hqN
  rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hpq with hp_pow | hp_pred
  · have hpdq : p ∣ q := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hp_pow
    have hp_eq_q : p = q := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq).mp hpdq
    subst q
    have hpred_pos : 0 < N.factorization p - 1 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hzero : N.factorization p - 1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hnot
      rw [hzero, pow_zero] at hp_pow
      exact hp.not_dvd_one hp_pow
    have htwo : 2 ≤ N.factorization p := Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt.mp hpred_pos
    exact False.elim (hp_sq ((hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hN0).2 htwo))
  · exact ⟨q, hq, hqdvd, hp_pred⟩

name: RankAmplification.exists_largePrimeSkeleton_of_maximal_prime
statement:
theorem exists_largePrimeSkeleton_of_maximal_prime {h n M p : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hphi1 : n.totient = M) (hphi2 : (n + h).totient = M) (hpM : p ∣ M)
    (hmax : ∀ {q : ℕ}, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ≤ p) (hph : h < p)
    (hpsq : ¬p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)) : Nonempty (LargePrimeSkeleton h n p)
proof:
:= by
  have hnshift : 1 ≤ n + h := by omega
  have hp_phi1 : p ∣ n.totient := by rw [hphi1]; exact hpM
  have hp_phi2 : p ∣ (n + h).totient := by rw [hphi2]; exact hpM
  have hp_sq1 : ¬p ^ 2 ∣ n := by
    intro hdvd
    exact hpsq (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hdvd (n + h))
  have hp_sq2 : ¬p ^ 2 ∣ n + h := by
    intro hdvd
    exact hpsq (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hdvd n)
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hq1n, hpq1⟩ :=
    exists_prime_provider_of_dvd_totient hn hp hp_phi1 hp_sq1
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, hq2n, hpq2⟩ :=
    exists_prime_provider_of_dvd_totient hnshift hp hp_phi2 hp_sq2
  have hp_lt_q1 : p < q1 := prime_lt_of_dvd_pred hp hq1 hpq1
  have hp_lt_q2 : p < q2 := prime_lt_of_dvd_pred hp hq2 hpq2
  have hq1_ne_q2 : q1 ≠ q2 := by
    intro heq
    have hq1shift : q1 ∣ n + h := by simpa [heq] using hq2n
    have hq1h : q1 ∣ h := by
      have hsub : q1 ∣ (n + h) - n := Nat.dvd_sub hq1shift hq1n
      simpa using hsub
    have hq1le : q1 ≤ h := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hq1h
    omega
  have hq1M : ¬q1 ∣ M := by
    intro hdvd
    exact (not_le_of_gt hp_lt_q1) (hmax hq1 hdvd)
  have hq2M : ¬q2 ∣ M := by
    intro hdvd
    exact (not_le_of_gt hp_lt_q2) (hmax hq2 hdvd)
  have hq1phi : ¬q1 ∣ n.totient := by
    intro hdvd
    exact hq1M (hphi1 ▸ hdvd)
  have hq2phi : ¬q2 ∣ (n + h).totient := by
    intro hdvd
    exact hq2M (hphi2 ▸ hdvd)
  obtain ⟨m1, hn_eq, hq1m1⟩ :=
    exists_cofactor_of_prime_dvd_not_dvd_totient hq1 hq1n hq1phi
  obtain ⟨m2, hnshift_eq, hq2m2⟩ :=
    exists_cofactor_of_prime_dvd_not_dvd_totient hq2 hq2n hq2phi
  obtain ⟨k1, hk1pos, hq1_eq⟩ := exists_pos_mul_add_one_eq_of_dvd_pred hp hq1 hpq1
  obtain ⟨k2, hk2pos, hq2_eq⟩ := exists_pos_mul_add_one_eq_of_dvd_pred hp hq2 hpq2
  have htot1 : M = m1.totient * (k1 * p) := by
    calc
      M = n.totient := hphi1.symm
      _ = m1.totient * (q1 - 1) := totient_eq_cofactor_mul_pred hq1 hn_eq hq1m1
      _ = m1.totient * (k1 * p) := by rw [hq1_eq]; simp
  have htot2 : M = m2.totient * (k2 * p) := by
    calc
      M = (n + h).totient := hphi2.symm
      _ = m2.totient * (q2 - 1) := totient_eq_cofactor_mul_pred hq2 hnshift_eq hq2m2
      _ = m2.totient * (k2 * p) := by rw [hq2_eq]; simp
  have hbalance : k1 * m1.totient = k2 * m2.totient := by
    apply (mul_right_inj' hp.ne_zero).mp
    calc
      p * (k1 * m1.totient) = m1.totient * (k1 * p) := by ac_rfl
      _ = M := htot1.symm
      _ = m2.totient * (k2 * p) := htot2
      _ = p * (k2 * m2.totient) := by ac_rfl
  have hsmooth : IsSmooth p (k1 * k2) := by
    refine ⟨mul_ne_zero hk1pos.ne' hk2pos.ne', ?_⟩
    intro r hrmem
    have hr : r.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hrmem
    have hrdvd : r ∣ k1 * k2 := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hrmem
    rcases hr.dvd_mul.mp hrdvd with hrk1 | hrk2
    · apply hmax hr
      rw [htot1]
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hrk1 p) m1.totient
    · apply hmax hr
      rw [htot2]
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hrk2 p) m2.totient
  exact ⟨{
    q1 := q1
    q2 := q2
    k1 := k1
    k2 := k2
    m1 := m1
    m2 := m2
    q1_prime := hq1
    q2_prime := hq2
    k1_pos := hk1pos
    k2_pos := hk2pos
    q1_eq := hq1_eq
    q2_eq := hq2_eq
    q1_dvd := hq1n
    q2_dvd := hq2n
    n_eq := hn_eq
    shifted_eq := hnshift_eq
    q1_not_dvd_m1 := hq1m1
    q2_not_dvd_m2 := hq2m2
    balance := hbalance
    multipliers_smooth := hsmooth
    multipliers_lpf_le := largestPrimeFactor_le_of_isSmooth hp.one_le hsmooth
    providers_ne := hq1_ne_q2
  }⟩

name: RankAmplification.exists_largePrimeSkeleton
statement:
theorem exists_largePrimeSkeleton {h n M p : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (hphi1 : n.totient = M) (hphi2 : (n + h).totient = M)
    (hpdef : p = largestPrimeFactor M) (hph : h < p)
    (hpsq : ¬p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)) : Nonempty (LargePrimeSkeleton h n p)
proof:
:= by
  have hpgt1 : 1 < p := lt_of_le_of_lt hh hph
  have hlarge : 1 < largestPrimeFactor M := by simpa [hpdef] using hpgt1
  have hp : p.Prime := by
    rw [hpdef]
    exact largestPrimeFactor_prime hlarge
  have hpM : p ∣ M := by
    rw [hpdef]
    exact largestPrimeFactor_dvd hlarge
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by
    rw [← hphi1]
    exact Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn)
  have hmax : ∀ {q : ℕ}, q.Prime → q ∣ M → q ≤ p := by
    intro q hq hqM
    rw [hpdef]
    exact prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hq hMpos.ne' hqM
  exact exists_largePrimeSkeleton_of_maximal_prime hn hh hp hphi1 hphi2 hpM hmax hph hpsq

name: RankAmplification.section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos
statement:
theorem section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos {x Z p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x Z) : 0 < Z
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hppos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hple : p ≤ Z ^ 2 := hpData.2
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos Z with hZ | hZ
  · subst hZ
    simp at hple
    omega
  · exact hZ

name: RankAmplification.section5LocalCutoff_ge_three_of_cube
statement:
theorem section5LocalCutoff_ge_three_of_cube {x Z p : ℕ}
    (hcube : 3 * Z ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x Z) :
    3 ≤ section5LocalCutoff x Z p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos hp
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hpSq : p ^ 2 ≤ Z ^ 4 := by
    calc
      p ^ 2 ≤ (Z ^ 2) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hpData.2 2
      _ = Z ^ 4 := by ring
  have hthree : 3 * p ^ 2 ≤ section5Ambient x Z := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    have hmul : 3 * Z ^ 4 < 2 * x * Z := by
      calc
        3 * Z ^ 4 = (3 * Z ^ 3) * Z := by ring
        _ < (2 * x) * Z := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcube hZpos
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hpSq).trans hmul.le
  exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (pow_pos hpPos 2)).2 hthree

name: RankAmplification.log_ambient_div_two_sq_eq
statement:
theorem log_ambient_div_two_sq_eq {x Z p : ℕ}
    (hx : 0 < x) (hZ : 0 < Z) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Real.log ((section5Ambient x Z : ℝ) / ((2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) - 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hxR : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hZR : (0 : ℝ) < (Z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hZ
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hW : ((section5Ambient x Z : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * ((x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ)) := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    push_cast
    ring
  have hd : ((2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by push_cast; ring
  have e1 : Real.log (2 * ((x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ))) =
      Real.log 2 + Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_mul hxR.ne' hZR.ne']
    ring
  have e2 : Real.log (2 * (p : ℝ) ^ 2) = Real.log 2 + 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hW, hd, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (by positivity)) (ne_of_gt (by positivity)), e1, e2]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.log_section5LocalCutoff_lower
statement:
theorem log_section5LocalCutoff_lower {x Z p : ℕ}
    (hcube : 3 * Z ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x Z) :
    Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) - 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log ((section5LocalCutoff x Z p : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos hp
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hdPos : 0 < p ^ 2 := pow_pos hpPos 2
  have hdW : p ^ 2 ≤ section5Ambient x Z := Nat.le_sqrt'.mp hpRange.2.1
  have hhalf := half_real_div_le_nat_div hdPos hdW
  have hWpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((section5Ambient x Z : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hdPos.trans_le hdW
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos (by norm_num) hdPos
  have hhalfPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((section5Ambient x Z : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((2 * p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    div_pos hWpos hdR
  have hlogHalf := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hhalf
  rw [log_ambient_div_two_sq_eq hxPos hZpos hpPos] at hlogHalf
  simpa [section5LocalCutoff] using hlogHalf

name: RankAmplification.log_section5LocalCutoff_upper
statement:
theorem log_section5LocalCutoff_upper {x Z p : ℕ}
    (hXpos : 0 < section5LocalCutoff x Z p)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x Z) :
    Real.log ((section5LocalCutoff x Z p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log 2 + Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) - 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos hp
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by
    by_contra hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by omega
    rw [hx0] at hXpos
    simp [section5LocalCutoff, section5Ambient] at hXpos
  have hXcast : ((section5LocalCutoff x Z p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((section5Ambient x Z : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
    section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x Z p
  have hXposR : (0 : ℝ) < ((section5LocalCutoff x Z p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hXpos
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hXposR hXcast
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpPos
  have hxR : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hxPos
  have hZR : (0 : ℝ) < (Z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hZpos
  have hW : ((section5Ambient x Z : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * ((x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ)) := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    push_cast
    ring
  have e1 : Real.log (2 * ((x : ℝ) * (Z : ℝ))) =
      Real.log 2 + Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_mul hxR.ne' hZR.ne']
    ring
  have e2 : Real.log (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ = -(2 * Real.log (p : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hW, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (by positivity)) (ne_of_gt (by positivity)), e1, e2] at hlog
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSaddleCutoffFacts
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSaddleCutoffFacts {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, MovingSaddleCutoffFacts c x
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  have hkappa : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, Real.log 4 ≤ c * movingR x :=
    (tendsto_movingR_atTop.const_mul_atTop hc).eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 3 * (c * movingR x) ≤ scaleL x / 2 := by
    have hb := movingR_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (6 * c) by positivity)
    filter_upwards [hb, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x h hL hcore
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hcore.2.2.2.1.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at h
    have hR : 0 < movingR x := hcore.2.2.2.1
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * c by positivity)
    have hclear : 3 * c * (1 / (6 * c) * scaleL x) = scaleL x / 2 := by
      field_simp
      norm_num
    nlinarith
  filter_upwards [hnat.eventually hkappa, hnat.eventually hsmall,
    eventually_ge_atTop 4] with x hk hs hx4
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hxR : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hxPos
  have hx4R : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx4
  have hLx : scaleL (x : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) := rfl
  have hlog4 : 0 < Real.log 4 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hZdef : movingSaddleCutoff c x = ⌊Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ))⌋₊ := rfl
  have hexp4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
    have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hk
    rwa [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)] at this
  have hZle : ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hZdef]
    exact Nat.floor_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hZlt : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) < ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
    rw [hZdef]
    exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hZfour : 4 ≤ movingSaddleCutoff c x := by
    rw [hZdef]
    exact Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hexp4)
  have hZposR : (0 : ℝ) < ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have : (0 : ℕ) < movingSaddleCutoff c x := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hZoneR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have : (1 : ℕ) ≤ movingSaddleCutoff c x := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hlogLe : Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_le_log hZposR hZle
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hlogGe : c * movingR (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hdouble : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ≤
        2 * ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hdouble
    rw [Real.log_exp, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hZposR.ne'] at h
    linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.exp (3 * (c * movingR (x : ℝ))) ≤ Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hs
    rwa [hLx, Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log hxR] at h
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) ^ 2 = (x : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hxR.le
  have hs2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) := by
    have h4 : Real.sqrt 4 = 2 := by
      rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num]
      exact Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
    rw [← h4]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hx4R
  have hcube : 3 * movingSaddleCutoff c x ^ 3 < 2 * x := by
    have hZcube : (3 : ℝ) * ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 <
        2 * (x : ℝ) := by
      have hexpCube : Real.exp (3 * (c * movingR (x : ℝ))) =
          Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ^ 3 := by
        rw [show (3 : ℝ) * (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) =
          c * movingR (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ) + c * movingR (x : ℝ) by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
        ring
      have hpow : ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤
          Real.exp (3 * (c * movingR (x : ℝ))) := by
        rw [hexpCube]
        gcongr
      have hZ3 : (3 : ℝ) * ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤
          3 * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) := by
        have := hpow.trans hsqrt
        linarith
      have hfin : 3 * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [hsq, hs2]
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast hZcube
  have hZx : movingSaddleCutoff c x ≤ x := by
    have hexpLe : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by
      have hmono : Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
        refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
        linarith
      rwa [hLx, Real.exp_log hxR] at hmono
    have hfloor : ⌊Real.exp (c * movingR (x : ℝ))⌋₊ ≤ ⌊((x : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊ :=
      Nat.floor_mono hexpLe
    rw [hZdef]
    simpa using hfloor
  exact ⟨by omega, hcube, hZx, hlogLe, hlogGe⟩

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleUMinus_le_rankinU
statement:
theorem movingSaddleUMinus_le_rankinU {c : ℝ} {x p : ℕ}
    (hfacts : MovingSaddleCutoffFacts c x)
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingSaddleCutoff c x)) :
    movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ) ≤
      rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hcube, _, hlogLe, _⟩ := hfacts
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hZpos : 0 < movingSaddleCutoff c x := section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos hp
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hlogpTwo : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast hpData.2
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
    rw [Real.log_pow] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have hlogp : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) := by
    linarith
  have hlogX := log_section5LocalCutoff_lower hcube hp
  have hlow : scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log ((section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hLx : scaleL (x : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) := rfl
    rw [hLx]
    linarith
  unfold movingSaddleUMinus rankinU
  have hfirst : (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) /
      (2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) / Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hlogpPos hlogp
  exact hfirst.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlow hlogpPos.le)

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleUPlus_eq
statement:
theorem movingSaddleUPlus_eq {c x : ℝ}
    (hk : movingSaddleLogCutoff c x - Real.log 2 ≠ 0) :
    movingSaddleUPlus c x =
      (scaleL x + movingSaddleLogCutoff c x + Real.log 2) /
        (movingSaddleLogCutoff c x - Real.log 2) - 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingSaddleUPlus
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_le_movingSaddleUPlus
statement:
theorem rankinU_le_movingSaddleUPlus {c : ℝ} {x p : ℕ}
    (hfacts : MovingSaddleCutoffFacts c x)
    (hkgt : Real.log 2 < movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingSaddleCutoff c x)) :
    rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p ≤
      movingSaddleUPlus c (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hcube, _, hlogLe, hlogGe⟩ := hfacts
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hZpos : 0 < movingSaddleCutoff c x := section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos hp
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hXpos : 0 < section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p := by
    have := section5LocalCutoff_ge_three_of_cube hcube hp
    omega
  have hlogXupper := log_section5LocalCutoff_upper hXpos hp
  have hlogpLower : movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hZp : ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpRange.1.le
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hZpos) hZp
    linarith
  have hdenPos : 0 < movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have hlogX : Real.log ((section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 -
        2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hLx : scaleL (x : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) := rfl
    rw [hLx]
    linarith
  unfold rankinU
  rw [movingSaddleUPlus_eq hdenPos.ne']
  have hfirst : Real.log ((section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p : ℕ) : ℝ) /
      Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
        Real.log (p : ℝ) - 2 := by
    rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, div_add' _ _ _ hlogpPos.ne']
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hlogpPos.le
  have hsecond : (scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
      Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
        (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hdenPos hlogpLower
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleLogCutoff_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleLogCutoff_atTop {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (movingSaddleLogCutoff c) atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  tendsto_movingR_atTop.const_mul_atTop hc

name: RankAmplification.movingR_eq_sqrtRatio_mul_log2
statement:
theorem movingR_eq_sqrtRatio_mul_log2 {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) :
    movingR x = Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) * log2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)
  have h := (div_eq_iff hr.ne').mp (movingR_div_sqrt_div_eq_log2 hL hL2)
  rw [h]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleUMinus_eq
statement:
theorem movingSaddleUMinus_eq {c x : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) :
    movingSaddleUMinus c x = Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) / (2 * c) - 3 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hR := movingR_pos hL hL2
  have hid := scaleL_div_movingR_eq_sqrt_div hL hL2
  unfold movingSaddleUMinus movingSaddleLogCutoff
  rw [← hid]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.log_sqrtRatio_eq
statement:
theorem log_sqrtRatio_eq {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) :
    Real.log (Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) = (log2 x - log3 x) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.log_sqrt (div_nonneg hL.le hL2.le), Real.log_div hL.ne' hL2.ne']
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_atTop {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (movingSaddleUMinus c) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hr := tendsto_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_atTop
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) / (2 * c)) atTop atTop := by
    have h := hr.const_mul_atTop (show (0 : ℝ) < (2 * c)⁻¹ by positivity)
    refine h.congr ?_
    intro x
    ring
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) / (2 * c) + -(3 / 2))
      atTop atTop := Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (-(3 / 2)) h1
  refine h2.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hL2
  rw [movingSaddleUMinus_eq hc hL hL2]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_div_sqrtRatio
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_div_sqrtRatio {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingSaddleUMinus c x / Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x))
      atTop (nhds (1 / (2 * c)))
proof:
:= by
  have hr := tendsto_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_atTop
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (3 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop (hr.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2))
  have hmain :
      Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ 1 / (2 * c) - (3 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)))
        atTop (nhds (1 / (2 * c))) := by
    have h := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ 1 / (2 * c)) atTop
      (nhds (1 / (2 * c)))).sub hzero
    simpa using h
  refine hmain.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hL2
  have hrpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)
  rw [movingSaddleUMinus_eq hc hL hL2]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_log_movingSaddleUMinus_div_log2
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_movingSaddleUMinus_div_log2 {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c x) / log2 x) atTop (nhds (1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hlogq : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c x /
      Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x))) atTop (nhds (Real.log (1 / (2 * c)))) :=
    (tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_div_sqrtRatio hc).log
      (ne_of_gt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * c)))
  have hterm1 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c x /
      Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) / log2 x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hlogq.div_atTop tendsto_log2_atTop
  have hterm2 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log3 x / (2 * log2 x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := log3_isLittleO_log2.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    have h2 := h.div_const 2
    rw [zero_div] at h2
    refine h2.congr ?_
    intro x
    rw [div_div]
    ring_nf
  have hsum := ((hterm1.add
    (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (1 / 2)))).sub
      hterm2)
  rw [zero_add, sub_zero] at hsum
  refine hsum.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
    (tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_atTop hc).eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hL hL2 hu
  have hrpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)
  rw [Real.log_div hu.ne' hrpos.ne', log_sqrtRatio_eq hL hL2]
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleSaving_div_movingR
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleSaving_div_movingR {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingSaddleUMinus c x * Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c x) / movingR x)
      atTop (nhds (1 / (4 * c)))
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := (tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_div_sqrtRatio hc).mul
    (tendsto_log_movingSaddleUMinus_div_log2 hc)
  have hval : (1 / (2 * c)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 / (4 * c) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hval] at hprod
  refine hprod.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hL2
  have hrpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)
  rw [movingR_eq_sqrtRatio_mul_log2 hL hL2]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSaddleUPlusFacts
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSaddleUPlusFacts {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 < movingSaddleLogCutoff c x ∧
        1 ≤ movingSaddleUPlus c x ∧
          movingSaddleUPlus c x ≤ (4 / c) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) ∧
            Real.log (movingSaddleUPlus c x) ≤
              (movingSaddleLogCutoff c x - Real.log 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hkappa := tendsto_movingSaddleLogCutoff_atTop hc
  have hA : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 2 * Real.log 2 ≤ movingSaddleLogCutoff c x :=
    hkappa.eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hconst : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      2 * (2 * Real.log (4 / c) + Real.log 2) ≤ movingSaddleLogCutoff c x :=
    hkappa.eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hB : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c x ≤ scaleL x := by
    have hb := movingR_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * c) by positivity)
    filter_upwards [hb, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x h hL hcore
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hcore.2.2.2.1.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at h
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * c by positivity)
    have hclear : 2 * c * (1 / (2 * c) * scaleL x) = scaleL x := by
      field_simp
    unfold movingSaddleLogCutoff
    nlinarith
  have hD : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 2 * log2 x ≤ movingSaddleLogCutoff c x := by
    have hb := log2_isLittleO_movingR.bound (show (0 : ℝ) < c / 2 by positivity)
    filter_upwards [hb, eventually_log2_pos, eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x h hL2 hcore
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hcore.2.2.2.1.le] at h
    unfold movingSaddleLogCutoff
    nlinarith
  filter_upwards [hA, hB, hD, hconst, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
    eventually_log3_pos, eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x hA hB hD hconst hL hL2 hL3 hcore
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hkpos : 0 < movingSaddleLogCutoff c x := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < movingSaddleLogCutoff c x - Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have hR : 0 < movingR x := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hrpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)
  have hone : 1 ≤ movingSaddleUPlus c x := by
    unfold movingSaddleUPlus
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
    linarith
  have hupper : movingSaddleUPlus c x ≤ (4 / c) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := by
    have hnumLe : scaleL x - movingSaddleLogCutoff c x + 3 * Real.log 2 ≤ 2 * scaleL x := by
      linarith
    have hdenLower : movingSaddleLogCutoff c x / 2 ≤ movingSaddleLogCutoff c x - Real.log 2 := by
      linarith
    have hstep : movingSaddleUPlus c x ≤ 4 * (scaleL x / movingSaddleLogCutoff c x) := by
      unfold movingSaddleUPlus
      calc
        (scaleL x - movingSaddleLogCutoff c x + 3 * Real.log 2) /
            (movingSaddleLogCutoff c x - Real.log 2) ≤
            (2 * scaleL x) / (movingSaddleLogCutoff c x - Real.log 2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnumLe hden.le
        _ ≤ (2 * scaleL x) / (movingSaddleLogCutoff c x / 2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity) hdenLower
        _ = 4 * (scaleL x / movingSaddleLogCutoff c x) := by
          field_simp
          ring
    have hid : scaleL x / movingR x = Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) :=
      scaleL_div_movingR_eq_sqrt_div hL hL2
    have hrewrite : 4 * (scaleL x / movingSaddleLogCutoff c x) =
        (4 / c) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := by
      rw [← hid]
      unfold movingSaddleLogCutoff
      field_simp
    rw [← hrewrite]
    exact hstep
  refine ⟨by linarith, hone, hupper, ?_⟩
  have hlogUp : Real.log (movingSaddleUPlus c x) ≤
      Real.log ((4 / c) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hupper
  have hsplit : Real.log ((4 / c) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) =
      Real.log (4 / c) + (log2 x - log3 x) / 2 := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) hrpos.ne', log_sqrtRatio_eq hL hL2]
  rw [hsplit] at hlogUp
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleRankinBound_div_movingR
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleRankinBound_div_movingR {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingSaddleRankinBound c x / movingR x) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c x) atTop atTop := by
    have h := (tendsto_movingSaddleLogCutoff_atTop hc).const_mul_atTop
      (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
    exact Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_left atTop (Real.log 3) h
  have hgO : (fun x ↦ Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c x) =O[atTop] movingR := by
    refine IsBigO.of_bound (Real.log 3 + 2 * c) ?_
    filter_upwards [tendsto_movingR_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hR
    have hlog3 : 0 < Real.log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hkpos : 0 ≤ movingSaddleLogCutoff c x := by
