      unfold movingSaddleLogCutoff
      nlinarith
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith), Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    unfold movingSaddleLogCutoff
    nlinarith
  have hlittle : (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c x)) =o[atTop]
      movingR := by
    have h := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.comp_tendsto hg
    have h' : (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c x)) =o[atTop]
        (fun x ↦ Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c x) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using h
    exact h'.trans_isBigO hgO
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c x) / movingR x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := hlittle.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| / movingR x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_movingR_atTop
  have h3 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingSaddleUPlus c x / movingR x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hsmall : (fun x ↦ (4 / c) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) =o[atTop] movingR :=
      sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_isLittleO_movingR.const_mul_left (4 / c)
    have hzero := hsmall.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ hzero
    · filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleUPlusFacts hc,
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hfacts hcore
      exact div_nonneg (by linarith [hfacts.2.1]) hcore.2.2.2.1.le
    · filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleUPlusFacts hc,
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hfacts hcore
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hfacts.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1.le
  have hcomb := ((((h1.add h2).const_mul (Real.exp 2)).add (h3.const_mul 3)).const_mul
    (divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant))
  simp only [add_zero, mul_zero] at hcomb
  refine hcomb.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
  have hR : 0 < movingR x := hcore.2.2.2.1
  unfold movingSaddleRankinBound
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.exp_log_two_add
statement: theorem exp_log_two_add (t : ℝ) : Real.exp (Real.log 2 + t) = 2 * Real.exp t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

name: RankAmplification.log_prime_le_two_movingSaddleLogCutoff
statement:
theorem log_prime_le_two_movingSaddleLogCutoff {c : ℝ} {x p : ℕ}
    (hfacts : MovingSaddleCutoffFacts c x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingSaddleCutoff c x)) :
    Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hlogLe, _⟩ := hfacts
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2
  have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
  rw [Real.log_pow] at h
  push_cast at h
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleLogCutoff_sub_log_two_le_log_prime
statement:
theorem movingSaddleLogCutoff_sub_log_two_le_log_prime {c : ℝ} {x p : ℕ}
    (hfacts : MovingSaddleCutoffFacts c x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingSaddleCutoff c x)) :
    movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hlogGe⟩ := hfacts
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hZpos : 0 < movingSaddleCutoff c x := section5IntermediatePrimeRange_cutoff_pos hp
  have hZp : ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpRange.1.le
  have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hZpos) hZp
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_pointwise
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_pointwise {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingSaddleCutoff c x),
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p
          (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) ≤
        ((section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-(movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ) *
              Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ))) +
            movingSaddleRankinBound c (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleCutoffFacts hc,
    hnat.eventually (eventually_movingSaddleUPlusFacts hc),
    hnat.eventually ((tendsto_movingSaddleUMinus_atTop hc).eventually_ge_atTop 3),
    hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x hfacts hplus humin3 hcore
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hkgt, honePlus, _, hlogPlus⟩ := hplus
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hkpos : 0 < movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hnumMinus : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) by
      linarith)).mp humin3
    have : (3 : ℝ) * (2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) ≤
        scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) := by
      simpa [movingSaddleUMinus] using h
    linarith
  have hnumPlus : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
    have := hcore.1
    linarith
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  have hpTwo : 2 ≤ p := hpRange.2.2.two_le
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpPos
  have hX3 := section5LocalCutoff_ge_three_of_cube hfacts.2.1 hp
  have hXpos : 0 < section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p := by omega
  have hu := movingSaddleUMinus_le_rankinU hfacts hnumMinus hp
  have hu3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p :=
    humin3.trans hu
  have hu1 : (1 : ℝ) < rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p := by
    linarith
  have huP := rankinU_le_movingSaddleUPlus hfacts hkgt hnumPlus hp
  have hlogpLower := movingSaddleLogCutoff_sub_log_two_le_log_prime hfacts hp
  have hlogpUpper := log_prime_le_two_movingSaddleLogCutoff hfacts hp
  have husqrt : rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p ≤
      Real.sqrt p := by
    have hplusPos : (0 : ℝ) < movingSaddleUPlus c (x : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hexpPlus : movingSaddleUPlus c (x : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp ((movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log hplusPos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogPlus
    have hsqrtp : Real.exp ((movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt p := by
      calc
        Real.exp ((movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2) ≤
            Real.exp (Real.log (p : ℝ) / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = Real.sqrt p := by rw [Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log hpR]
    exact huP.trans (hexpPlus.trans hsqrtp)
  have hlogu : (1 : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) := by
    have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p :=
      Real.exp_one_lt_three.le.trans hu3
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hexp
    simpa using this
  have hinner : Real.exp 2 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
      3 * rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p /
        Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) ≤
      Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) +
        |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) + 3 * movingSaddleUPlus c (x : ℝ) := by
    have hlog3p : Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ)) = Real.log 3 + Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hpR.ne'
    have hlog3ppos : 0 < Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ)) := by
      refine Real.log_pos ?_
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpTwo
      linarith
    have hA1 : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
        Real.log (Real.log 3 + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) := by
      refine Real.log_le_log hlog3ppos ?_
      rw [hlog3p]
      linarith
    have hA2 : -Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| :=
      neg_le_abs (Real.log (Real.log 2))
    have hA3 : 3 * rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p /
        Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) ≤
        3 * movingSaddleUPlus c (x : ℝ) := by
      have hself : rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p /
          Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        nlinarith
      have hstep : rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p /
          Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) ≤
          movingSaddleUPlus c (x : ℝ) := hself.trans huP
      calc
        3 * rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p /
            Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) =
            3 * (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p /
              Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p)) := by
          ring
        _ ≤ 3 * movingSaddleUPlus c (x : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hexp2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp 2 := Real.exp_pos 2
    nlinarith [hA1, hA2, hA3, hexp2]
  have herr : fullPaperDivisorError p (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) ≤
      movingSaddleRankinBound c (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fullPaperDivisorError fullULogUPrimeError movingSaddleRankinBound
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner
      (mul_nonneg divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le primeCountingConstant_pos.le)
  have hmono : movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ) * Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ)) ≤
      rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p *
        Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) := by
    have hlogMinus : 0 ≤ Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ)) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have hlogMono : Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hu
    exact mul_le_mul hu hlogMono hlogMinus (by linarith)
  have hbase := finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error hXpos hpTwo hu1 husqrt
  refine hbase.trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
  have hneg : -rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p *
      Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p) =
      -(rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p *
        Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) p)) := by
    ring
  rw [hneg]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_sum_le
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_sum_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-(movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ) *
              Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ))) +
            movingSaddleRankinBound c (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_pointwise hc,
    eventually_movingSaddleCutoffFacts hc] with x hpoint hfacts
  obtain ⟨hZtwo, _, hZx, _, _⟩ := hfacts
  have hZpos : 0 < movingSaddleCutoff c x := by omega
  set S : ℝ := Real.exp (-(movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ) *
    Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ))) + movingSaddleRankinBound c (x : ℝ)) with hS
  have hSpos : 0 < S := Real.exp_pos _
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingSaddleCutoff c x),
          (((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) * S) *
            (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro p hp
      calc
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p
            (section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) ≤
            ((section5LocalCutoff x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p : ℕ) : ℝ) * S := hpoint p hp
        _ ≤ (((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹) * S :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) p) hSpos.le
        _ = (((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) * S) *
              (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = (((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) * S) *
        ∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingSaddleCutoff c x),
          (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) * S) *
        ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sum_section5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le hZpos hZx) ?_
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((section5Ambient x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Nat.cast_nonneg _
      positivity
    _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) * S := by
      have hZne : ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast hZpos.ne'
      simp only [section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleIntermediateError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleIntermediateError_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (movingSaddleIntermediateError c) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  have hRat : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingR (x : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_movingR_atTop.comp hnat
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hRat
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingSaddleRankinBound c (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    (tendsto_movingSaddleRankinBound_div_movingR hc).comp hnat
  have h3 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ) *
      Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ)) / movingR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (1 / (4 * c))) :=
    (tendsto_movingSaddleSaving_div_movingR hc).comp hnat
  have hsum := (h1.add h2).add
    ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (1 / (4 * c) : ℝ)) atTop
      (nhds (1 / (4 * c)))).sub h3)
  simp only [add_zero, sub_self] at hsum
  refine hsum.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
  have hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
  unfold movingSaddleIntermediateError
  rw [add_div]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_le
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c)) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSaddleIntermediateError c x * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_sum_le hc,
    hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hsum hcore
  have hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
  refine hsum.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have hexp : -(1 / (4 * c)) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
      movingSaddleIntermediateError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) =
      Real.log 2 + (-(movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ) *
        Real.log (movingSaddleUMinus c (x : ℝ))) + movingSaddleRankinBound c (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold movingSaddleIntermediateError
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexp, exp_log_two_add]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleTransferError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleTransferError_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (movingSaddleTransferError c) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  have hRat : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingR (x : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_movingR_atTop.comp hnat
  have hmax := (tendsto_movingSaddleIntermediateError_zero hc).max
    (tendsto_movingSaddleUpperError_zero hc)
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hRat
  have hsum := hmax.add hlog
  simp only [max_self, add_zero] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_transfer_counting
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_transfer_counting {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingTransferExponent c (x : ℝ)) +
          movingSaddleTransferError c x * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleIntermediate_le hc, proposition10_27_counting hc,
    hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hint hup hcore
  have hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hxR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg x
  set M : ℝ := max (movingSaddleIntermediateError c x) (movingSaddleUpperError c x) with hM
  have hsadRight : movingSaddleExponent c ≤ 1 / (4 * c) := min_le_right _ _
  have h1 : smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) + M * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
    refine hint.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) hxR)
    have hle1 : -(1 / (4 * c)) * movingR (x : ℝ) ≤
        -(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    have hle2 : movingSaddleIntermediateError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) ≤ M * movingR (x : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hR.le
    linarith
  have h2 : smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) + M * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
    refine hup.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) hxR)
    have hle2 : movingSaddleUpperError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) ≤ M * movingR (x : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hR.le
    linarith
  have hrhs : (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingTransferExponent c (x : ℝ)) +
      movingSaddleTransferError c x * movingR (x : ℝ)) =
      2 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
        M * movingR (x : ℝ))) := by
    have hexp : -(movingTransferExponent c (x : ℝ)) +
        movingSaddleTransferError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) =
        Real.log 2 + (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) + M * movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [movingTransferExponent_eq_profile_mul_movingR]
      unfold movingSaddleTransferError
      rw [← hM]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hexp, exp_log_two_add]
    ring
  rw [smoothMultiplierB4Sum_eq_intermediate_add_upper, hrhs]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_transfer_estimate
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_transfer_estimate {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
        smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c + ε x) * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x ↦ -movingSaddleTransferError c x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using (tendsto_movingSaddleTransferError_zero hc).neg
  · filter_upwards [proposition10_27_transfer_counting hc] with x hx
    refine hx.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    have harg : -(movingTransferExponent c (x : ℝ)) +
        movingSaddleTransferError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) =
        -(movingSaddleExponent c + -movingSaddleTransferError c x) * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [movingTransferExponent_eq_profile_mul_movingR]
      ring
    rw [harg]

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddle_div_cutoff_le
statement:
theorem movingSaddle_div_cutoff_le {c : ℝ} {x : ℕ} (hfacts : MovingSaddleCutoffFacts c x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    t / ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      2 * t * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hZ2, -, -, -, hlogGe⟩ := hfacts
  have hZrPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < movingSaddleCutoff c x := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hexpZ : Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤
      ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogGe
    rwa [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), Real.exp_log hZrPos] at h
  have hEE : Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) *
      Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    simp
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hZrPos]
  have hstep : 2 * t * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) *
      (Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) / 2) ≤
      2 * t * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) *
        ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexpZ (by positivity)
  have heq : 2 * t * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) *
      (Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) / 2) = t := by
    rw [show 2 * t * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) *
      (Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) / 2) =
      t * (Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) *
        Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) by ring, hEE, mul_one]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSaddleElementaryTerms_le
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSaddleElementaryTerms_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingSaddleElementaryTerms c x ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) +
          (Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleCutoffFacts hc,
    hnat.eventually (eventually_c_mul_movingR_le_scaleL (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 * c by linarith)),
    hnat.eventually (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 2),
    hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive,
    eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hfacts h2c hL2 hcore hxpos
  have hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hxR : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hxpos
  have hkappa : movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) = c * movingR (x : ℝ) := rfl
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [hkappa]
    positivity
  have h2k : 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [hkappa]
    nlinarith
  have hZrPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < movingSaddleCutoff c x := by have := hfacts.1; omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hZrOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have : 1 ≤ movingSaddleCutoff c x := by have := hfacts.1; omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hlogZ0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hZrOne
  have hlogZk : Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) := hfacts.2.2.2.1
  have hLx : scaleL (x : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) := rfl
  have hlogx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (x : ℝ) := by rw [← hLx]; linarith
  
  have hT1 := movingSaddle_div_cutoff_le hfacts (t := (x : ℝ)) hxR.le
  have hT3 := movingSaddle_div_cutoff_le hfacts
    (t := (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ)) (mul_nonneg hxR.le hlogx)
  have hT4 := movingSaddle_div_cutoff_le hfacts
    (t := (x : ℝ) * Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) (by positivity)
  
  have hexpk : Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) := by
    have hhalf : movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 := by linarith
    have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hhalf
    have hLx : scaleL (x : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) := rfl
    rwa [hLx, Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log hxR] at h
  have hEE : Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    simp
  have hT2 : Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) := by
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) = (x : ℝ) :=
      Real.mul_self_sqrt hxR.le
    have hstep : Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexpk (Real.sqrt_nonneg (x : ℝ))
      linarith [hsq]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hstep
      (Real.exp_pos (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)))).le
    calc
      Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) = Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, hEE, mul_one]
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) := hmul
  
  have hsquare : (x : ℝ) * Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      (x : ℝ) * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have : Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
        movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [hxR]
  have hexpPos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hcoll : movingSaddleElementaryTerms c x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) *
        (3 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have h4 : 2 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.log ((movingSaddleCutoff c x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) ≤
        2 * ((x : ℝ) * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsquare (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hexpPos.le
    unfold movingSaddleElementaryTerms
    rw [hLx]
    linarith [hT1, hT2, hT3, hT4, h4]
  refine hcoll.trans ?_
  have hLpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleL (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hquad : 3 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      5 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hL2, hk0, h2k,
      mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) by linarith)
        (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + 2 * movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) by linarith),
      mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 2 by linarith)
        (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) by linarith)]
  have h5L : (0 : ℝ) < 5 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hlogid : Real.log (5 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) = Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (by nlinarith : (0 : ℝ) < scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2)),
      Real.log_pow, log2_eq, scaleL]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hexpid : (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) +
      (Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ))) =
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) * (5 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← hlogid, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log h5L]
    ring
  rw [hexpid]
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ))) := by positivity
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquad hnn

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleDisplayError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleDisplayError_zero {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (movingSaddleDisplayError c) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  have hRat : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingR (x : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_movingR_atTop.comp hnat
  have hlog2 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_movingR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp hnat
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 5 / movingR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hRat
  have hsecond : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ (Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) / movingR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := hconst.add (hlog2.const_mul 2)
    simp only [add_zero, mul_zero] at h
    refine h.congr ?_
    intro x
    rw [add_div]
    ring
  have hthird : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log (2 * paperTheorem16LogSqConstant) / movingR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hRat
  have hsum := ((tendsto_movingSaddleTransferError_zero hc).max hsecond).add hthird
  simp only [max_self, add_zero] at hsum
  exact hsum

name: RankAmplification.eventually_proposition10_27_transfer_display
statement:
theorem eventually_proposition10_27_transfer_display {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
          movingSaddleDisplayError c x * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSaddleElementaryTerms_le hc,
    proposition10_27_transfer_counting hc,
    hnat.eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with x helem hB4 hcore
  have hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hxR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg x
  set M : ℝ := max (movingSaddleTransferError c x)
    ((Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) / movingR (x : ℝ)) with hM
  set P : ℝ := -(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) + M * movingR (x : ℝ) with hP
  have hmin : movingSaddleExponent c ≤ c := min_le_left _ _
  have h1 : movingSaddleElementaryTerms c x ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp P := by
    refine helem.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) hxR)
    have hcbound : -(movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ)) ≤
        -(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
      have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmin hR.le
      have hkappa : movingSaddleLogCutoff c (x : ℝ) = c * movingR (x : ℝ) := rfl
      rw [hkappa]
      linarith
    have herr : Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ M * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
      have hle : (Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) / movingR (x : ℝ) ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
      have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hR.le
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hR.ne'] at hstep
    rw [hP]
    linarith
  have h2 : smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp P := by
    refine hB4.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) hxR)
    rw [movingTransferExponent_eq_profile_mul_movingR, hP]
    have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left (movingSaddleTransferError c x)
      ((Real.log 5 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) / movingR (x : ℝ))) hR.le
    rw [← hM] at hstep
    linarith
  have hdisp : paperTransferDisplay x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) =
      movingSaddleElementaryTerms c x + smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) := by
    unfold paperTransferDisplay movingSaddleElementaryTerms
    ring
  have hC : (5 : ℝ) ≤ paperTheorem16LogSqConstant := five_le_paperTheorem16LogSqConstant
  have hsum : paperTransferDisplay x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
      2 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp P) := by
    rw [hdisp]
    linarith
  have hfin : paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
      (2 * paperTheorem16LogSqConstant) * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp P) := by
    have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant)
    linarith
  have hrhs : movingSaddleDisplayError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) =
      M * movingR (x : ℝ) + Real.log (2 * paperTheorem16LogSqConstant) := by
    unfold movingSaddleDisplayError
    rw [← hM, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hR.ne']
  have hkey : (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
      movingSaddleDisplayError c x * movingR (x : ℝ)) =
      (2 * paperTheorem16LogSqConstant) * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp P) := by
    rw [hrhs]
    have hsplit : -(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
        (M * movingR (x : ℝ) + Real.log (2 * paperTheorem16LogSqConstant)) =
        P + Real.log (2 * paperTheorem16LogSqConstant) := by
      rw [hP]; ring
    rw [hsplit, Real.exp_add,
      Real.exp_log (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * paperTheorem16LogSqConstant)]
    ring
  rw [hkey]
  exact hfin

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_transfer_display_estimate
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_transfer_display_estimate {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
        paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x (movingSaddleCutoff c x) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c + ε x) * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x ↦ -movingSaddleDisplayError c x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using (tendsto_movingSaddleDisplayError_zero hc).neg
  · filter_upwards [eventually_proposition10_27_transfer_display hc] with x hx
    refine hx.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    have harg : -(movingSaddleExponent c) * movingR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSaddleDisplayError c x * movingR (x : ℝ) =
        -(movingSaddleExponent c + -movingSaddleDisplayError c x) * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
      ring
    rw [harg]

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_transfer_display_at_optimum
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_transfer_display_at_optimum :
    (∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → movingSaddleExponent c ≤ 1 / 2) ∧
      ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
          paperTheorem16LogSqConstant *
              paperTransferDisplay x (movingSaddleCutoff (1 / 2) x) ≤
            (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 + ε x) * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun c hc ↦ movingSaddleExponent_le_half hc, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ :=
    proposition10_27_transfer_display_estimate (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbound] with x hx
  have hhalf : movingSaddleExponent (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 / 2 := by
    unfold movingSaddleExponent
    norm_num
  rwa [hhalf] at hx

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_nonsmooth_count_estimate
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_nonsmooth_count_estimate {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h : ℕ, Odd h → h ≤ movingSaddleCutoff c x →
        (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℝ) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c + ε x) * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ := proposition10_27_transfer_display_estimate hc
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_movingSaddleCutoffFacts hc] with x hx hfacts
  intro h hodd hhZ
  exact (theorem1_6_paper_transfer_unconditional hodd hfacts.1 hhZ hfacts.2.2.1).trans hx

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_transfer_error_estimate
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_transfer_error_estimate {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h : ℕ, Odd h → h ≤ movingSaddleCutoff c x →
        ((nonsmoothShiftedCount x h (movingSaddleCutoff c x) -
            aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingSaddleCutoff c x) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(movingSaddleExponent c + ε x) * movingR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ := proposition10_27_nonsmooth_count_estimate hc
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbound] with x hx
  intro h hodd hhZ
  rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd, Nat.sub_zero]
  exact hx h hodd hhZ

name: RankAmplification.smallCofactorSkeletonSet_subset
statement:
theorem smallCofactorSkeletonSet_subset {h X : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n)) :
    smallCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn

name: RankAmplification.largeCofactorSkeletonSet_subset
statement:
theorem largeCofactorSkeletonSet_subset {h X : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n)) :

name: RankAmplification.small_union_large_eq
statement:
theorem small_union_large_eq {h X : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n)) :
    smallCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X ∪
      largeCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X = S
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  by_cases hn : n ∈ S
  · by_cases hsmall : skeletonCofactorProduct S provider skeleton n ≤ X
    · simp [hn, hsmall, Nat.not_lt_of_ge hsmall]
    · have hlarge : X < skeletonCofactorProduct S provider skeleton n :=
        Nat.lt_of_not_ge hsmall
      simp [hn, hsmall, hlarge]
  · simp [hn]

name: RankAmplification.small_disjoint_large
statement:
theorem small_disjoint_large {h X : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n)) :
    Disjoint (smallCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X)
      (largeCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hnSmall hnLarge
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (mem_smallCofactorSkeletonSet.mp hnSmall).2)
    (mem_largeCofactorSkeletonSet.mp hnLarge).2

name: RankAmplification.card_eq_small_add_large
statement:
theorem card_eq_small_add_large {h X : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n)) :
    S.card = (smallCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X).card +
      (largeCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (small_disjoint_large S provider skeleton),
    small_union_large_eq S provider skeleton]

name: RankAmplification.card_smallCofactorSkeletonSet_le
statement:
theorem card_smallCofactorSkeletonSet_le {h X : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n)) :
    ((smallCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X).card : ℝ) ≤
      X * (1 + Real.log X)
proof:
:= by
  let T := smallCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton X
  have hTS : T ⊆ S := smallCofactorSkeletonSet_subset S provider skeleton
  let providerT := restrictProvider hTS provider
  let skeletonT := restrictSkeleton hTS provider skeleton
  apply card_skeletonNumbers_le_cofactor_bound hodd T providerT skeletonT
  intro n
  have hnSmall := mem_smallCofactorSkeletonSet.mp n.2
  have hprod := hnSmall.2
  rw [skeletonCofactorProduct_of_mem hnSmall.1] at hprod
  simpa [T, providerT, skeletonT, restrictSkeleton, restrictFinsetIndex] using hprod

name: RankAmplification.card_largeCofactorSkeletonSet_le
statement:
theorem card_largeCofactorSkeletonSet_le {x h y : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ)
    (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x)
    (hp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, (provider n).Prime)
    (hyp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, y < provider n)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    ((largeCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton (x / y)).card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
        smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let T := largeCofactorSkeletonSet S provider skeleton (x / y)
  have hTS : T ⊆ S := largeCofactorSkeletonSet_subset S provider skeleton
  let providerT := restrictProvider hTS provider
  let skeletonT := restrictSkeleton hTS provider skeleton
  apply card_largeCofactorSkeletonFamily_le T providerT skeletonT
  · intro n
    exact hnx (restrictFinsetIndex hTS n)
  · intro n
    exact hp (restrictFinsetIndex hTS n)
  · intro n
    exact hyp (restrictFinsetIndex hTS n)
  · exact hy
  · exact hh
  · exact hhy
  · exact hxy
  · intro n
    have hnLarge := mem_largeCofactorSkeletonSet.mp n.2
    have hprod := hnLarge.2
    rw [skeletonCofactorProduct_of_mem hnLarge.1] at hprod
    simpa [T, providerT, skeletonT, restrictSkeleton, restrictFinsetIndex] using hprod

name: RankAmplification.card_skeletonFamily_le_small_add_large
statement:
theorem card_skeletonFamily_le_small_add_large {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (provider : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → ℕ)
    (skeleton : (n : {n // n ∈ S}) → LargePrimeSkeleton h n.1 (provider n))
    (hnx : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, n.1 ≤ x)
    (hp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, (provider n).Prime)
    (hyp : ∀ n : {n // n ∈ S}, y < provider n)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤
      (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
          smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_eq_small_add_large S provider skeleton, Nat.cast_add]
  exact add_le_add
    (card_smallCofactorSkeletonSet_le hodd S provider skeleton)
    (card_largeCofactorSkeletonSet_le S provider skeleton hnx hp hyp hy hh hhy hxy)

name: RankAmplification.mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet {X Y p : ℕ} :

      p.Prime ∧ p ≤ X ∧ IsSmooth Y (p - 1)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotient_mem_factoredNumbers
statement:
theorem smoothTotient_mem_factoredNumbers {X Y n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y) :
    n ∈ Nat.factoredNumbers (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mem_factoredNumbers']
  intro p hp hpn
  have hnData := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn
  apply mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hp, ?_, prime_pred_smooth_of_totient_smooth hp hpn hnData.2.2⟩
  exact (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpn).trans hnData.2.1

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_smoothPredecessor_factored
statement:
theorem hasSum_smoothPredecessor_factored (X Y : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    HasSum
      (fun n : Nat.factoredNumbers (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y) ↦
        (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c))
      (smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c)
proof:
:= by
  have heuler :=
    EulerProduct.summable_and_hasSum_factoredNumbers_prod_filter_prime_geometric
      (f := reciprocalRpowMonoidHom c)
      (fun {_p} hp ↦ norm_reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_prime_lt_one hc hp)
      (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y)
  have hfilter : (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).filter Nat.Prime =
      smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro p hp
    exact smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime hp
  simpa [smoothPredecessorEulerProduct, rankinEulerMajorant, rankinEulerRatio,
    hfilter, reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_apply] using heuler.2

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct
statement:
theorem smoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct (X Y : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    smoothTotientRankinSum X Y c ≤ smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c
proof:
:= by
  let e : {n : ℕ // n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y} ↪
      Nat.factoredNumbers (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y) :=
    { toFun := fun n ↦ ⟨n.1, smoothTotient_mem_factoredNumbers n.2⟩
      inj' := fun a b hab ↦ Subtype.ext <|
        congrArg (fun z : Nat.factoredNumbers (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y) ↦ z.1) hab }
  let A : Finset (Nat.factoredNumbers (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y)) :=
    Finset.univ.map e
  have hs := hasSum_smoothPredecessor_factored X Y hc
  have hle : (∑ n ∈ A, (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)) ≤ smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c := by
    calc
      (∑ n ∈ A, (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)) ≤
          ∑' n : Nat.factoredNumbers (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y),
            (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) :=
        hs.summable.sum_le_tsum A
          (fun n _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n.1) _)
      _ = smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c := hs.tsum_eq
  have hfinite : smoothTotientRankinSum X Y c =
      ∑ n : {n : ℕ // n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y}, (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
    rw [smoothTotientRankinSum, ← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
  have hmap :
      (∑ n : {n : ℕ // n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y}, (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)) =
        ∑ n ∈ A, (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
    change (∑ n : {n : ℕ // n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y}, (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.map e, (n.1 : ℝ) ^ (-c)
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _
    rfl
  rw [hfinite, hmap]
  exact hle

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_rankinEuler
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_rankinEuler {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) ^ c * smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothTotientCount]
  calc
    ((smoothTotientSet X Y).card : ℝ) =
        ∑ n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y, (1 : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y, (X : ℝ) ^ c * (n : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      have hnData := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn
      have hnpos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (zero_lt_one.trans_le hnData.1)
      have hnX : (n : ℝ) ≤ X := by exact_mod_cast hnData.2.1
      have hpow : (n : ℝ) ^ c ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ c :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow hnpos.le hnX hc.le
      have hcancel : (n : ℝ) ^ c * (n : ℝ) ^ (-c) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hnpos]
        simp
      calc
        (1 : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) ^ c * (n : ℝ) ^ (-c) := hcancel.symm
        _ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ c * (n : ℝ) ^ (-c) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hnpos.le _)
    _ = (X : ℝ) ^ c * smoothTotientRankinSum X Y c := by
      rw [smoothTotientRankinSum, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ c * smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (smoothTotientRankinSum_le_eulerProduct X Y hc)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) _)

name: RankAmplification.log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct
statement:
theorem log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Real.log (smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c) =
      ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y,
        -Real.log (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-c))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y, 1 < p := by
    intro p hp
    exact (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime hp).one_lt
  simpa [smoothPredecessorEulerProduct, rankinEulerRatio] using
    (log_rankinEulerMajorant (P := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y) (j := 1) hp hc)

name: RankAmplification.log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le
statement:
theorem log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Real.log (smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y,
        (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) / (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-c))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y, 1 < p := by
    intro p hp
    exact (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime hp).one_lt
  simpa [smoothPredecessorEulerProduct, rankinEulerRatio] using
    (log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_sum
      (P := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y) (j := 1) hp hc)

name: RankAmplification.inverse_one_sub_le_exp_mul_inverse_one_sub
statement:
theorem inverse_one_sub_le_exp_mul_inverse_one_sub {a b t : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (ha : a ≤ 1 / 2) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hdiff : a - b ≤ a * t) :
    (1 - a)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (2 * a * t) * (1 - b)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := hb.trans hba
  have hda : 0 < 1 - a := by linarith
  have hdb : 0 < 1 - b := by linarith
  have hat : 0 ≤ a * t := mul_nonneg ha0 ht
  have hscale : 1 ≤ 2 * (1 - a) := by linarith
  have hquot : (a - b) / (1 - a) ≤ 2 * a * t := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hda).2
    calc
      a - b ≤ a * t := hdiff
      _ ≤ (2 * a * t) * (1 - a) := by
        have hscale0 : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 - a) - 1 := sub_nonneg.mpr hscale
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hat hscale0]
  have hratio : (1 - b) / (1 - a) ≤ Real.exp (2 * a * t) := by
    calc
      (1 - b) / (1 - a) = 1 + (a - b) / (1 - a) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      _ ≤ 1 + 2 * a * t := add_le_add le_rfl hquot
      _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * a * t) := by simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * a * t)
  calc
    (1 - a)⁻¹ = ((1 - b) / (1 - a)) * (1 - b)⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
    _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * a * t) * (1 - b)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio (inv_nonneg.mpr hdb.le)

name: RankAmplification.mertensFactor_le_softenedFactor
statement:
theorem mertensFactor_le_softenedFactor {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ ≤
      Real.exp (2 * δ * (Real.log p / p)) *
        (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 + δ)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℝ := p
  let a : ℝ := P⁻¹
  let b : ℝ := P ^ (-(1 + δ))
  let t : ℝ := δ * Real.log P
  have hP1 : 1 < P := by
    change (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have hP0 : 0 < P := zero_lt_one.trans hP1
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := Real.rpow_nonneg hP0.le _
  have hba : b ≤ a := by
    rw [show a = P ^ (-1 : ℝ) by simp [a, Real.rpow_neg_one]]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hP1.le (by linarith)
  have ha : a ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hP2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ P := by
      change (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)
      exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    simpa [a, one_div] using (inv_le_inv₀ hP0 zero_lt_two).2 hP2
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := mul_nonneg hδ (Real.log_nonneg hP1.le)
  have hbform : b = a * Real.exp (-t) := by
    dsimp only [a, b, t]
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hP0]
    rw [show P⁻¹ = Real.exp (-Real.log P) by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hP0]]
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hone : 1 - Real.exp (-t) ≤ t := by
    linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (-t)]
  have hdiff : a - b ≤ a * t := by
    rw [hbform]
    calc
      a - a * Real.exp (-t) = a * (1 - Real.exp (-t)) := by ring
      _ ≤ a * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hone (inv_nonneg.mpr hP0.le)
  have hmain := inverse_one_sub_le_exp_mul_inverse_one_sub hb hba ha ht hdiff
  have hexp : 2 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (δ * Real.log p) =
      2 * δ * (Real.log p * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) := by ring
  simp only [a, b, t, P] at hmain
  rw [hexp] at hmain
  simpa only [a, b, t, P, div_eq_mul_inv] using hmain

name: RankAmplification.mertensProduct_le_exp_mul_softened
statement:
theorem mertensProduct_le_exp_mul_softened (R : ℕ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    mertensProduct R ≤
      Real.exp (2 * δ * primeLogReciprocalSum R) * softenedMertensProduct R (1 + δ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertensProduct softenedMertensProduct
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
          (Real.exp (2 * δ * (Real.log p / p)) *
            (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 + δ)))⁻¹) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hp
        have pp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp
        exact le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr (sub_pos.mpr
          (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast pp.one_lt))))
      · intro p hp
        exact mertensFactor_le_softenedFactor (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) hδ
    _ = Real.exp (2 * δ * primeLogReciprocalSum R) *
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 + δ)))⁻¹ := by
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← Real.exp_sum]
      simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, primeLogReciprocalSum]

name: RankAmplification.mertens_correction_le
statement:
theorem mertens_correction_le {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    2 * (Real.log R)⁻¹ * primeLogReciprocalSum R ≤ 4 * Real.log 4
proof:
:= by
  have hR2 : 2 ≤ R := hR.trans' (by norm_num)
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlog : 1 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := by
    apply (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hRpos).2
    exact Real.exp_one_lt_three.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  have hlog0 : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans hlog
  have hlog4 : 0 ≤ Real.log (4 : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hprime := primeLogReciprocalSum_le hR2
  calc
    2 * (Real.log R)⁻¹ * primeLogReciprocalSum R ≤
        2 * (Real.log R)⁻¹ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (inv_nonneg.mpr hlog0.le))
    _ = 2 * Real.log 4 * ((1 + Real.log R) / Real.log R) := by
      field_simp
    _ ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * 2 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hlog4)
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hlog0).2
      nlinarith
    _ = 4 * Real.log 4 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.mertensProduct_le_log
statement:
theorem mertensProduct_le_log (R : ℕ) (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    mertensProduct R ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log R)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR)
  have hδ : 0 ≤ (Real.log (R : ℝ))⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hlog.le
  calc
    mertensProduct R ≤
        Real.exp (2 * (Real.log R)⁻¹ * primeLogReciprocalSum R) *
          softenedMertensProduct R (1 + (Real.log R)⁻¹) :=
      mertensProduct_le_exp_mul_softened R hδ
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          softenedMertensProduct R (1 + (Real.log R)⁻¹) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mertens_correction_le hR))
      rw [← smoothRpowTsum_eq_softenedMertensProduct R (by positivity)]
      exact tsum_nonneg fun n ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n.1) _
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          (1 + 1 / ((1 + (Real.log R)⁻¹) - 1)) := by
      gcongr
      exact softenedMertensProduct_le R _ (by simp [hlog])
    _ = Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log R) := by
      rw [show (1 + (Real.log R)⁻¹) - 1 = (Real.log R)⁻¹ by ring,
        one_div, inv_inv]

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_mul_gammaTarget_of_four_budgets
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_mul_gammaTarget_of_four_budgets
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ : ℝ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hθ : θ₀ + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃ ≤ 1)
    (hhalf : (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * (θ₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y))
    (hsmall : bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (θ₁ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y))
    (hrepeated : bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (θ₂ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y))
    (hlarge : bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (θ₃ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := smoothTotientCount_cast_le_half_add_mangoldt (Y := Y) hX
  rw [smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_contributions] at hrec
  rw [add_div, add_div] at hrec
  have hsum :
      (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) +
          bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
          bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
          bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        γ * ((θ₀ + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) := by
    calc
      (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) +
            bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          γ * (θ₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) + γ * (θ₁ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) +
            γ * (θ₂ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) + γ * (θ₃ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hhalf hsmall) hrepeated) hlarge
      _ = γ * ((θ₀ + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) := by ring
  have htarget :
      γ * ((θ₀ + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) ≤
        γ * (1 * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ (bfpsGammaTarget_nonneg ξ X Y)) hγ
  exact hrec.trans <| by linarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_le_of_gap
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_le_of_gap
    {ξ a : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)
    (hmem : ∀ d ∈ S, d ≤ X ∧ 1 < bfpsU (X / d) Y ∧
      1 < Real.log (bfpsU (X / d) Y) ∧ 1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (X / d) Y) ∧
      bfpsU (X / d) Y ≤ bfpsU X Y ∧ bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / d) Y ≤ a) :
    bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y S ≤
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
        Real.exp (a * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (a * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) := by
    have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_nonneg ha hslope)
    rwa [Real.exp_zero] at h
  unfold bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope monotoneEnvelope
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro d _hdRange
  by_cases hdS : d ∈ S
  · rw [if_pos hdS]
    obtain ⟨-, hv, hlogv, hlog2v, hvu, hgap⟩ := hmem d hdS
    exact bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap hv hlogv hlog2v hvu hgap hslope
  · rw [if_neg hdS]
    exact mul_nonneg (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _) (zero_le_one.trans hone)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_eq_gammaInnerDecayEnvelope
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_eq_gammaInnerDecayEnvelope
    (ξ : ℝ) (X Y k : ℕ) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k =
      bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_le_of_gap
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_le_of_gap
    {ξ a : ℝ} {X Y k : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)
    (hmem : ∀ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k, p ≤ X ∧ 1 < bfpsU (X / p) Y ∧
      1 < Real.log (bfpsU (X / p) Y) ∧ 1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (X / p) Y) ∧
      bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤ bfpsU X Y ∧ bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤ a) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k ≤
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
        Real.exp (a * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_eq_gammaInnerDecayEnvelope]
  exact bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_le_of_gap ha hslope hmem

name: RankAmplification.bfpsCast_nat_div_two_le_half
statement: theorem bfpsCast_nat_div_two_le_half (X : ℕ) : ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : (X / 2 : ℕ) * 2 ≤ X := Nat.div_mul_le_self X 2
  have h' : ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ≤ (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_half_le_gamma_gammaTarget
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_half_le_gamma_gammaTarget
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ : ℝ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) (hY : 2 ≤ Y) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hv : 1 < bfpsU (X / 2) Y)
    (hlogv : 1 < Real.log (bfpsU (X / 2) Y))
    (hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (X / 2) Y))
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)
    (hsmallgap : Real.exp (Real.log (4 : ℝ) / Real.log (Y : ℝ) *
        (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) ≤ 3 / 2)
    (hinner : (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / 2) Y))) :
    (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hYone : 1 < Y := by omega
  have hTwoX : 2 ≤ X := by omega
  have hvu : bfpsU (X / 2) Y ≤ bfpsU X Y :=
    rankinU_nat_div_le hYone (by norm_num) hTwoX
  have hgap : bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / 2) Y ≤ Real.log (4 : ℝ) / Real.log (Y : ℝ) := by
    have h := rankinU_sub_nat_div_le (X := X) (Y := Y) (d := 2) hYone (by norm_num) hTwoX
    have hfour : (2 : ℝ) * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rwa [hfour] at h
  have hdecay :
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / 2) Y) ≤
        bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
          Real.exp (Real.log (4 : ℝ) / Real.log (Y : ℝ) *
            (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) :=
    bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap hv hlogv hlog2v hvu hgap hslope
  have hdecay' :
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / 2) Y) ≤
        bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) * (3 / 2) :=
    hdecay.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmallgap (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _))
  calc
    (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) ≤
        γ * (((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / 2) Y)) := hinner
    _ ≤ γ * ((X : ℝ) / 2 * (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) * (3 / 2))) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hγ
        refine mul_le_mul (bfpsCast_nat_div_two_le_half X) hdecay'
          (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _) ?_
        positivity
    _ = γ * ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) := by
        unfold bfpsGammaTarget
        ring

name: RankAmplification.largePrimeRank_antitone_cutoff
statement:
theorem largePrimeRank_antitone_cutoff {y y' : ℕ} (hy : y ≤ y') (n : ℕ) :
    largePrimeRank y' n ≤ largePrimeRank y n
proof:
:= by
  unfold largePrimeRank
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset ?_
  intro p hp
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hp ⊢
  exact ⟨hp.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hy hp.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet_subset_of_le
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN
  rw [mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet] at hN ⊢
  exact ⟨hN.1, hN.2.1, hN.2.2.1.trans hY,
    lt_of_le_of_lt (largePrimeRank_antitone_cutoff hy _) hN.2.2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_mono
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_mono {X y y' Y Y' J : ℕ}
    (hy : y ≤ y') (hY : Y ≤ Y') :
    boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y Y J ≤
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y' Y' J
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet_subset_of_le hy hY)

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_le_sharpCutoff
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_le_sharpCutoff
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (J X : ℕ) (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y (y ^ J) J ≤
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J
proof:
:=
  boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_mono le_rfl
    (pow_le_natFloor_exp_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff J hcutoff)

name: RankAmplification.sharpCutoffGap_example
statement:
theorem sharpCutoffGap_example :
    IsSection5ExponentialCutoff 2 (Real.log (5 / 2)) ∧
      (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 : ℕ) < ⌊Real.exp (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (5 / 2))⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : Real.exp (Real.log (5 / 2)) = 5 / 2 :=
    Real.exp_log (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hexp]; norm_num
  · rw [hexp]; norm_num
  · have hpow : Real.exp (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (5 / 2)) = (5 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, hexp]
    rw [hpow]
    have hle : ((5 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by norm_num
    have := Nat.le_floor hle
    omega

name: RankAmplification.mem_paperLowRankCensusSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_paperLowRankCensusSet {X : ℕ} {y Y : ℝ} {J N : ℕ} :
    N ∈ paperLowRankCensusSet X y Y J ↔
      1 ≤ N ∧ N ≤ X ∧ (largestPrimeFactor N.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧
        realLargePrimeRank y N.totient < J
proof:
:= by
  simp only [paperLowRankCensusSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.isSection5ExponentialCutoff_natFloor_exp
statement:
theorem isSection5ExponentialCutoff_natFloor_exp (T : ℝ) :
    IsSection5ExponentialCutoff ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T
proof:
:=
  ⟨Nat.floor_le (Real.exp_nonneg T), Nat.lt_floor_add_one _⟩

name: RankAmplification.lt_iff_exp_lt_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hp : (y : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    linarith [hcutoff.2]
  · intro h
    have hp : (y : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hcutoff.1 h
    exact_mod_cast hp

name: RankAmplification.le_natFloor_exp_iff
statement:
theorem le_natFloor_exp_iff (J : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    n ≤ ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ ↔ (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_floor_iff (Real.exp_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.realLargePrimeRank_eq_largePrimeRank
proof:
:= by
  unfold realLargePrimeRank largePrimeRank
  refine Finset.sum_congr (Finset.filter_congr ?_) fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  intro p _
  exact (lt_iff_exp_lt_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff hcutoff p).symm

name: RankAmplification.paperLowRankCensusSet_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet
statement:
theorem paperLowRankCensusSet_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) (X J : ℕ) :
    paperLowRankCensusSet X (Real.exp T) (Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)) J =
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J
proof:
:= by
  ext N
  rw [mem_paperLowRankCensusSet, mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet,
    le_natFloor_exp_iff, realLargePrimeRank_eq_largePrimeRank hcutoff]

name: RankAmplification.paperLowRankCensusCount_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
statement:
theorem paperLowRankCensusCount_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) (X J : ℕ) :
    paperLowRankCensusCount X (Real.exp T) (Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)) J =
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J
proof:
:= by
  unfold paperLowRankCensusCount boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
  rw [paperLowRankCensusSet_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet hcutoff]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError_zero J hc₀
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ + 1 by linarith)
  have hsum := hbase.add (tendsto_sharpCutoffRateError_zero hc₀ hC₀)
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError J c₀ (C₀ + 1) x +
      sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀ x) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa using hsum

name: RankAmplification.eventually_lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffCensus_unconditional
statement:
theorem eventually_lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffCensus_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (y : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (X : ℕ),
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      x ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * x →
      (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hC₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ + 1 := by linarith
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowCensus_upTo_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₁,
      eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hcensus hsmooth hG hV
  intro y T X hcutoff hwindow hxX hX2
  have hmono : boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J ≤
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) J :=
    boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_mono
      (le_sharpCutoffCeil_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff hcutoff le_rfl)
      (natFloor_exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil_pow J T)
  have hmonoReal :
      (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) ≤
        (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X (sharpCutoffCeil T)
          (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) J : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmono
  have hmain := hcensus (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffLog T) X
    (isSection5ExponentialCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil T)
    (isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hG hwindow) hxX hX2
  refine (hmonoReal.trans hmain).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
  have hrate := hsmooth T hwindow
  simp only [lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError, add_mul]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_paperLowRankCompression_unconditional
statement:
theorem eventually_paperLowRankCompression_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (T : ℝ) (X : ℕ),
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      x ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * x →
      (paperLowRankCensusCount X (Real.exp T) (Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)) J : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffCensus_unconditional
    J hJ hc₀ hC₀] with x hx
  intro T X hwindow hxX hX2
  have hcutoff := isSection5ExponentialCutoff_natFloor_exp T
  rw [paperLowRankCensusCount_eq_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount hcutoff]
  exact hx ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T X hcutoff hwindow hxX hX2

name: RankAmplification.lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffHypothesis_unconditional
statement:
theorem lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffHypothesis_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    LowRankCompressionSharpCutoffHypothesis J c₀ C₀
      (lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError J c₀ C₀)
proof:
:=
  ⟨tendsto_lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError_zero J hc₀ hC₀,
    eventually_paperLowRankCompression_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_sharpCutoffMajorant
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_sharpCutoffMajorant
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (h y : ℕ) (T : ℝ),
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_lowRankCompressionSharpCutoffCensus_unconditional
    J hJ hc₀ hC₀, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hcensus hx
  intro h y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hcount :
      (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) ≤
        (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount x y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
      x h y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J
  exact hcount.trans (hcensus y T x hcutoff hwindow le_rfl (by omega))

name: RankAmplification.card_largePrimeOccurrence
statement:
theorem card_largePrimeOccurrence (y M : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (LargePrimeOccurrence y M) = largePrimeRank y M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, largePrimeRank]
  exact Finset.sum_attach _ _

name: RankAmplification.firstLargePrimeValue_mem
statement:
theorem firstLargePrimeValue_mem {J y M : ℕ} (hJ : J ≤ largePrimeRank y M)
    (i : Fin J) :
    firstLargePrimeValue hJ i ∈ (primeSupport M).filter (y < ·)
proof:
:=
  (firstLargePrimeOccurrences hJ i).1.2

name: RankAmplification.firstLargePrimeValue_prime
statement:
theorem firstLargePrimeValue_prime {J y M : ℕ} (hJ : J ≤ largePrimeRank y M)
    (i : Fin J) : Nat.Prime (firstLargePrimeValue hJ i)
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp (firstLargePrimeValue_mem hJ i)).1

name: RankAmplification.firstLargePrimeValue_gt
statement:
theorem firstLargePrimeValue_gt {J y M : ℕ} (hJ : J ≤ largePrimeRank y M)
    (i : Fin J) : y < firstLargePrimeValue hJ i
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_filter.mp (firstLargePrimeValue_mem hJ i)).2

name: RankAmplification.firstLargePrimeValue_dvd
statement:
theorem firstLargePrimeValue_dvd {J y M : ℕ} (hJ : J ≤ largePrimeRank y M)
    (i : Fin J) : firstLargePrimeValue hJ i ∣ M
proof:
:=
  Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp (firstLargePrimeValue_mem hJ i)).1

name: RankAmplification.firstLargePrimeDemands_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLargePrimeDemands_value {J y Y M : ℕ}
    (hJ : J ≤ largePrimeRank y M) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (hY : largestPrimeFactor M ≤ Y) (i : Fin J) :
    (firstLargePrimeDemands hJ hM hY).value i = firstLargePrimeValue hJ i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.card_firstLargePrimeValue_fiber_le_factorization
statement:
theorem card_firstLargePrimeValue_fiber_le_factorization {J y M : ℕ}
    (hJ : J ≤ largePrimeRank y M) (p : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin J ↦ firstLargePrimeValue hJ i = p)).card ≤
      M.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hne :
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin J ↦ firstLargePrimeValue hJ i = p)).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
    have hp : p ∈ (primeSupport M).filter (y < ·) := by
      have hip := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
      rw [← hip]
      exact firstLargePrimeValue_mem hJ i
    let e := (firstLargePrimeLabelsAtEmbedding hJ p).trans
      (largePrimeOccurrenceFiberEquiv hp).toEmbedding
    have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_embedding e
    rw [← Fintype.card_coe]
    simpa only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.card_fin] using hcard
  · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne]
    simp

name: RankAmplification.totalDemandProduct_firstLargePrimeDemands_dvd
statement:
theorem totalDemandProduct_firstLargePrimeDemands_dvd {J y Y M : ℕ}
    (hJ : J ≤ largePrimeRank y M) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (hY : largestPrimeFactor M ≤ Y) :
    totalDemandProduct (firstLargePrimeDemands hJ hM hY) ∣ M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold totalDemandProduct blockDemandProduct
  apply (Nat.factorization_prime_le_iff_dvd
    (blockDemandProduct_pos (firstLargePrimeDemands hJ hM hY) Finset.univ).ne' hM).mp
  intro p hp
  change (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ, (firstLargePrimeDemands hJ hM hY).value i).factorization p ≤
    M.factorization p
  rw [Nat.factorization_prod_apply]
  · calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ,
          ((firstLargePrimeDemands hJ hM hY).value i).factorization p) =
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin J ↦
            firstLargePrimeValue hJ i = p)).card := by
        rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        change (firstLargePrimeValue hJ i).factorization p =
          if firstLargePrimeValue hJ i = p then 1 else 0
        rw [(firstLargePrimeValue_prime hJ i).factorization]
        simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
      _ ≤ M.factorization p := card_firstLargePrimeValue_fiber_le_factorization hJ p
  · intro i hi
    exact (firstLargePrimeValue_prime hJ i).ne_zero

name: RankAmplification.mem_labelSourceBlock
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_labelSourceBlock {J : ℕ} {source : Fin J → ℕ} {i k : Fin J} :
    k ∈ labelSourceBlock source i ↔ source k = source i
proof:
:= by
  simp [labelSourceBlock]

name: RankAmplification.self_mem_labelSourceBlock
statement:
theorem self_mem_labelSourceBlock {J : ℕ} (source : Fin J → ℕ) (i : Fin J) :
    i ∈ labelSourceBlock source i
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: RankAmplification.labelSourceBlock_eq_of_source_eq
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.representative_mem
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (A.partition.block_nonempty B)

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.block_eq_sourceBlock_representative
statement:
theorem block_eq_sourceBlock_representative {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (B : A.partition.Block) :
    B.1 = labelSourceBlock A.source (A.representative B)
proof:
:= by
  apply A.partition.eq_of_overlap B.2
  · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨A.representative B, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  · exact A.representative_mem B
  · exact self_mem_labelSourceBlock A.source (A.representative B)

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.source_eq_of_mem_block
proof:
:= by
  rw [A.block_eq_sourceBlock_representative B] at hi
  exact mem_labelSourceBlock.mp hi

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.block_eq_of_representative_source_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext

    A.block_eq_sourceBlock_representative C]
  exact labelSourceBlock_eq_of_source_eq h

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.source_pred_largestPrimeFactor_le
statement:
theorem source_pred_largestPrimeFactor_le {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (hN : N ≠ 0) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y)
    (i : Fin J) :
    largestPrimeFactor (A.source i - 1) ≤ Y
proof:
:= by
  apply largestPrimeFactor_le_of_isSmooth hY
  refine ⟨(Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (A.source_prime i).one_lt).ne', ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  have hpDvdPred : p ∣ A.source i - 1 := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  have hpredDvdPhi : A.source i - 1 ∣ N.totient :=
    prime_pred_dvd_totient (A.source_prime i) (A.source_dvd i)
  exact (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hpPrime
    (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hN)).ne'
    (hpDvdPred.trans hpredDvdPhi)).trans hphiY

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.blockSource_prime
proof:
:=
  A.source_prime (A.representative B)
