name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.descriptor_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem descriptor_base {J y Y N : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y}
    (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N) (x : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y) (B : A.partition.Block) :
    (A.descriptor x hN hNx hY hphiY B).base = A.blockSource B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hpower :
      (powerLabels P B.1 (A.source (A.representative B))).Nonempty
  · simp [descriptor, blockSource, hpower, SupplierDescriptor.base,
      PowerDescriptor.natBase]
  · simp [descriptor, blockSource, hpower, SupplierDescriptor.base,
      LinearDescriptor.natBase]

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.descriptor_selectedDivisor_eq_power
statement:
theorem descriptor_selectedDivisor_eq_power {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (x : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y) (B : A.partition.Block)
    (hpower : (powerLabels P B.1 (A.blockSource B)).Nonempty) :
    (A.descriptor x hN hNx hY hphiY B).selectedDivisor =
      A.blockSource B ^ (powerMultiplicity P B.1 (A.blockSource B) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpower' :
      (powerLabels P B.1 (A.source (A.representative B))).Nonempty := by
    simpa only [blockSource] using hpower
  simp [descriptor, blockSource, hpower', SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor,
    PowerDescriptor.natBase]

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.descriptor_selectedDivisor_eq_linear
statement:
theorem descriptor_selectedDivisor_eq_linear {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (x : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y) (B : A.partition.Block)
    (hpower : ¬(powerLabels P B.1 (A.blockSource B)).Nonempty) :
    (A.descriptor x hN hNx hY hphiY B).selectedDivisor = A.blockSource B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpower' :
      ¬(powerLabels P B.1 (A.source (A.representative B))).Nonempty := by
    simpa only [blockSource] using hpower
  simp [descriptor, blockSource, hpower', SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor,
    LinearDescriptor.natBase]

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.descriptor_selectedDivisor_dvd
statement:
theorem descriptor_selectedDivisor_dvd {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (x : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y) (B : A.partition.Block) :
    (A.descriptor x hN hNx hY hphiY B).selectedDivisor ∣ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let i := A.representative B
  have hblock : B.1 = labelSourceBlock A.source i :=
    A.block_eq_sourceBlock_representative B
  by_cases hpower : (powerLabels P B.1 (A.blockSource B)).Nonempty
  · have hpower' :
        (powerLabels P (labelSourceBlock A.source i) (A.source i)).Nonempty := by
      simpa [blockSource, i, hblock] using hpower
    have hdvd := A.power_selected_dvd i hpower'
    rw [A.descriptor_selectedDivisor_eq_power x hN hNx hY hphiY B hpower]
    simpa [blockSource, i, hblock] using hdvd
  · have hdvd := A.source_dvd i
    rw [A.descriptor_selectedDivisor_eq_linear x hN hNx hY hphiY B hpower]
    simpa [blockSource, i] using hdvd

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.systemSelectedDivisor_dvd
statement:
theorem systemSelectedDivisor_dvd {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (x : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y) :
    (A.toSupplierSystem x hN hNx hY hphiY).selectedDivisor ∣ N
proof:
:= by
  apply SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor_dvd_of_forall_descriptor_dvd
  intro B
  exact A.descriptor_selectedDivisor_dvd x hN hNx hY hphiY B

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.one_le_supplierDivisorWeight
statement:
theorem one_le_supplierDivisorWeight {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (x : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y) :
    1 ≤ supplierDivisorWeight P x N
proof:
:=
  one_le_supplierDivisorWeight_of_realization
    (A.realization x hN hNx hY hphiY) hN

name: RankAmplification.TotientSourceAllocation.occurrenceAssignment_base_eq_source
statement:
theorem occurrenceAssignment_base_eq_source {J y Y N : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (A : TotientSourceAllocation P N)
    (x : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hphiY : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y) (i : Fin J) :
    let R
proof:
:= A.realization x hN hNx hY hphiY
    ((A.toSupplierSystem x hN hNx hY hphiY).descriptor
      (R.occurrenceAssignment.source i)).base = A.source i := by
  dsimp
  change (A.descriptor x hN hNx hY hphiY
    ((A.realization x hN hNx hY hphiY).occurrenceAssignment.source i)).base = A.source i
  rw [descriptor_base]
  exact (A.source_eq_of_mem_block _
    ((A.realization x hN hNx hY hphiY).occurrenceAssignment.label_mem i)).symm

name: RankAmplification.movingHighRank_n_pos
statement:
theorem movingHighRank_n_pos {x h n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ movingHighRankShiftedSet x h) :
    0 < n
proof:

name: RankAmplification.one_le_movingHighRank_aggregateSupplierSummand
statement:

    (halloc : TotientOccurrenceAllocationHypothesis) {x h n : ℕ}
    (hadmissible : MovingNaturalAdmissibility x) (hhy : h ≤ movingNatY x)
    (hn : n ∈ movingHighRankShiftedSet x h) :

      ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
        (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
          (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (one_le_movingHighRank_canonicalSupplierProduct
    halloc hadmissible hhy hn).trans ?_
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun P : LabelledPrimeDemands
    (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x) ↦
      (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
        (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ))
  · intro P hP
    positivity
  · exact Finset.mem_univ (movingHighRankDemands hn)

name: RankAmplification.movingHighRankShiftedCount_le_supplierCorrelation_of_allocation
statement:
theorem movingHighRankShiftedCount_le_supplierCorrelation_of_allocation
    (halloc : TotientOccurrenceAllocationHypothesis) {x h : ℕ}
    (hadmissible : MovingNaturalAdmissibility x) (hhy : h ≤ movingNatY x) :
    (movingHighRankShiftedCount x h : ℝ) ≤ movingSupplierCorrelation x h
proof:
:= by
  let S := movingHighRankShiftedSet x h
  let I := Finset.Icc 1 x
  let G : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦
    ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
      (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
        (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ)
  have hsubset : S ⊆ I := by
    intro n hn
    have hnshift := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp
      (mem_movingHighRankShiftedSet.mp hn).1
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hnshift.1, hnshift.2.1⟩
  calc
    (movingHighRankShiftedCount x h : ℝ) = ∑ _n ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) := by
      simp [movingHighRankShiftedCount, S]
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ S, G n := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      exact one_le_movingHighRank_aggregateSupplierSummand
        halloc hadmissible hhy hn
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ I, G n := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro n hnI hnS
      unfold G
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun P hP ↦ by positivity
    _ = movingSupplierCorrelation x h := by
      unfold G I movingSupplierCorrelation
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: RankAmplification.log2_mul_sqrt_scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL
statement:
theorem log2_mul_sqrt_scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL :
    (fun x ↦ log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x))
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := sqrt_scaleA_isLittleO_log2.mul_isBigO
    (isBigO_refl log2 atTop)
  have hsq : (fun x ↦ log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ 2) := by
    apply hprod.congr'
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [mul_comm]
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      simp [pow_two]
  exact hsq.trans log2_sq_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL

name: RankAmplification.log2_div_scaleV_eq
statement:
theorem log2_div_scaleV_eq {x : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    log2 x / scaleV x =
      (log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) / Real.sqrt (scaleL x)
proof:
:= by
  have hLroot : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL
  have hAroot : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleA x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hA
  rw [scaleV_eq, scaleG_eq, Real.sqrt_mul hL.le]
  have hLsq : Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x) = scaleL x :=
    Real.mul_self_sqrt hL.le
  calc
    log2 x / (scaleL x / (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleA x))) =
        log2 x * (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) /
          scaleL x := by field_simp [hL.ne', hLroot.ne', hAroot.ne']
    _ = (log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) / Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := by
      apply (div_eq_div_iff hL.ne' hLroot.ne').2
      calc
        log2 x * (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) *
            Real.sqrt (scaleL x) =
            (log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) *
              (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x)) := by ring
        _ = (log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) * scaleL x := by rw [hLsq]

name: RankAmplification.log2_isLittleO_scaleV
statement: theorem log2_isLittleO_scaleV : log2 =o[atTop] scaleV
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) / Real.sqrt (scaleL x))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_mul_sqrt_scaleA_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 x / scaleV x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply hzero.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
    exact (log2_div_scaleV_eq hL hA).symm
  refine Asymptotics.isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ hratio
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
  intro hzero
  exact ((scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA)).ne' hzero).elim

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankUpperY_half_le_natUpperY
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankUpperY_half_le_natUpperY
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hreal : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 2 ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_fixedRankUpperY_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [hreal] with x hx
  exact half_le_natFloor hx

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg
statement:
theorem fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hY : 2 ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ)) :
    (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hlower : fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) := half_le_natFloor hY
  have hNatPos : (0 : ℝ) < fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    (by positivity : 0 < fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2).trans_le hlower
  have hmodel : 2 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) =
      (fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG (x : ℝ) hJ,
      show -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) =
        -(Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) by ring,
      Real.exp_neg]
    field_simp
  rw [hmodel]
  exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hlower

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hreal : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 2 ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_fixedRankUpperY_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [hreal] with x hx
  exact fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg hJ hx

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_two_add_two_fixedRankExponent_le_scaleL
statement:
theorem eventually_log_two_add_two_fixedRankExponent_le_scaleL (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 + 2 * (Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) ≤ scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  have hKbound := (fixedRankUpperExponent_isLittleO_scaleL J).bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  have hLlarge := tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2)
  filter_upwards [hKbound, hLlarge, eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hK hlarge hL
  have hKnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt J * scaleG x :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (scaleG_nonneg x)
  have hKle : Real.sqrt J * scaleG x ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * scaleL x := by
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hKnonneg, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le, one_div] at hK
    simpa using hK
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRank_sqrt_two_mul_le_mul_exp_neg
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRank_sqrt_two_mul_le_mul_exp_neg (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hreal := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_log_two_add_two_fixedRankExponent_le_scaleL J)
  filter_upwards [hreal, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hexp hxOne
  have hx : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega)
  have hlog : Real.log 2 + Real.log (x : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.log (x : ℝ) - 2 * (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [scaleL_eq] at hexp
    linarith
  have hsquare : (Real.sqrt (2 * (x : ℝ))) ^ 2 ≤
      ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num), Real.exp_log hx]
      _ ≤ Real.exp
          (2 * Real.log (x : ℝ) - 2 * (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
      _ = ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by
        rw [show 2 * Real.log (x : ℝ) -
            2 * (Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) =
          (Real.log (x : ℝ) - Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) +
            (Real.log (x : ℝ) - Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) by ring,
          show -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) =
            -(Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hx, Real.exp_neg,
          div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
  have hrealSqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp hsquare
  exact (Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt.trans_eq (by norm_num)).trans hrealSqrt

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankCutoffSquareError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankCutoffSquareError_zero :
    Tendsto fixedRankCutoffSquareError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm_le
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm J x ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankCutoffSquareError x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRank_sqrt_two_mul_le_mul_exp_neg J,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hinv hsqrt hV
  have hfirst : 2 * (x : ℝ) * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      4 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv (show 0 ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) by positivity)]
  have hsum : fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm J x ≤
      6 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm
    nlinarith
  calc
    fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm J x ≤
        6 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := hsum
    _ = fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankCutoffSquareError x := by
      unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant fixedRankCutoffSquareError
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne', Real.exp_add,
        Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankSmallCofactorError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankSmallCofactorError_zero :
    Tendsto fixedRankSmallCofactorError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 4 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 4 / scaleV (x : ℝ) + log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hconst.add hlog
  unfold fixedRankSmallCofactorError
  have hLone : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  apply squeeze_zero'
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, hLone] with x hV hL
    exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith)) hV.le
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, hLone] with x hV hL
    have harg : 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≤ 4 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    have hlogLe : Real.log (2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) ≤
        Real.log 4 + log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        Real.log (2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) ≤
            Real.log (4 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
          Real.log_le_log (by nlinarith) harg
        _ = Real.log 4 + log2 (x : ℝ) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num)
            (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL)), log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
    calc
      Real.log (2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) / scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
          (Real.log 4 + log2 (x : ℝ)) / scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogLe hV.le
      _ = Real.log 4 / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
  · exact hupper

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankSmallCofactorTerm_le
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankSmallCofactorTerm_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankSmallCofactorTerm J x ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankSmallCofactorError x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg J hJ,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos,
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 0] with
      x hadmissible hinv hV hL
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hL
  have hxOne : 1 ≤ x := by
    exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
        (hadmissible.y_le_upper.trans hadmissible.upper_le_x)
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_upper
  have hfinite := smallCofactorLogTerm_le
    (x := x) (Z := fixedRankNatUpperY J x) hxOne hYpos
  calc
    fixedRankSmallCofactorTerm J x ≤
        (x : ℝ) * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hfinite
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by gcongr
    _ = fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankSmallCofactorError x := by
      unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant fixedRankSmallCofactorError
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne', Real.exp_add,
        Real.exp_log (by nlinarith : 0 < 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.section5_endpoint_log_bound_of_le
statement:
theorem section5_endpoint_log_bound_of_le
    {x y : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    1 + Real.log ((section5Ambient x y).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hambPos : 0 < section5Ambient x y := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
    positivity
  have hendPos : 0 < (section5Ambient x y).sqrt := Nat.sqrt_pos.2 hambPos
  have hambLe : (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hambLeNat : section5Ambient x y ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 := by
      unfold section5Ambient
      calc
        2 * x * y ≤ 2 * x * x := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * x) hxy
        _ = 2 * x ^ 2 := by ring
    exact_mod_cast hambLeNat
  have hendLe : ((section5Ambient x y).sqrt : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    section5Ambient_sqrt_cast_le_ambient.trans hambLe
  have hlogEnd : Real.log ((section5Ambient x y).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hendPos) hendLe
  have hlogModel : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      Real.log 2 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast (show x ≠ 0 by omega))),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    norm_num
  have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  rw [hlogModel] at hlogEnd
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankReciprocalError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankReciprocalError_zero :
    Tendsto fixedRankReciprocalError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (Real.log 2 + 8 * Real.log 4) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) /
        scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have htwo : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
        atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
    have hsum := htwo.add tendsto_fixedRankSmallCofactorError_zero
    have hLnat : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos
    have heq : (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankSmallCofactorError x) =ᶠ[atTop]
        (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) /
          scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hLnat] with x hL
      unfold fixedRankSmallCofactorError
      rw [← add_div]
      congr 1
      rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
        (by nlinarith : 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0)]
      congr 1
      ring
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum.congr' heq
  have hscaled := hlog.const_mul 2
  have hsum := hconst.add hscaled
  have heq : (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 2 + 8 * Real.log 4) / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        2 * (Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) /
          scaleV (x : ℝ))) =ᶠ[atTop] fixedRankReciprocalError := by
    filter_upwards [] with x
    unfold fixedRankReciprocalError
    ring
  simpa only [zero_add, mul_zero] using hsum.congr' heq

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankReciprocalTerm_le
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankReciprocalTerm_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankReciprocalTerm J x ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankReciprocalError x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg J hJ,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos,
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 0] with
      x hadmissible hinv hV hL
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hL
  have hxOne : 1 ≤ x := by
    exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
        (hadmissible.y_le_upper.trans hadmissible.upper_le_x)
  have hYtwo : 2 ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3).trans
      (hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_upper)
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x := by omega
  have hsec := section4ReciprocalSum_le hYtwo hadmissible.upper_le_x
  have hendpoint := section5_endpoint_log_bound_of_le
    hxOne hYpos hadmissible.upper_le_x
  have hfactorPos : 0 < section4MertensFactor
      (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)).sqrt := by
    unfold section4MertensFactor
    have hlogNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log
        ((section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)).sqrt : ℝ) := by
      exact Real.log_nonneg (by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤
            (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)).sqrt by
          exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt
            (Nat.sqrt_pos.2 (by unfold section5Ambient; positivity)))))
    exact mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by linarith)
  have hfactor : section4MertensFactor
      (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)).sqrt ≤
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) := by
    unfold section4MertensFactor
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hendpoint (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hfactorSq :
      (section4MertensFactor
        (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)).sqrt) ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
        (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hfactor, hfactorPos.le,
      show 0 ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
        (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) by positivity]
  have hbound : fixedRankReciprocalTerm J x ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) *
        (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      fixedRankReciprocalTerm J x ≤
          (x : ℝ) *
            (section4MertensFactor
              (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)).sqrt) ^ 2 *
            (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ := hsec
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 *
          (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ := by gcongr
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by ring
  calc
    fixedRankReciprocalTerm J x ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := hbound
    _ = fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankReciprocalError x := by
      unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant fixedRankReciprocalError
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne']
      rw [show -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
          (Real.log 2 + 8 * Real.log 4 +
            2 * Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) =
          -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 +
            2 * (4 * Real.log 4 +
              Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) by ring,
        Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add,
        Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      have harg : 0 < 4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by positivity
      have hexp : Real.exp (2 * (4 * Real.log 4 +
          Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))))) =
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          Real.exp (2 * (4 * Real.log 4 +
              Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))))) =
              Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4 +
                Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 :=
            Real.exp_nat_mul _ 2
          _ = (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
              (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log harg]
      rw [hexp]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError_zero :
    Tendsto fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by

    tendsto_fixedRankSmallCofactorError_zero
    tendsto_fixedRankReciprocalError_zero
    tendsto_fixedRankCutoffSquareError_zero

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankFiniteMajorant_le_elementary_add_B4
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankFiniteMajorant_le_elementary_add_B4
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant J x ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x +
          smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm_le J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankSmallCofactorTerm_le J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankReciprocalTerm_le J hJ,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hcut hsmall hrec hV
  have hcombine := sum_three_fixedRankExponentialMajorant_le_combined
    (J := J) (x := x)
    (εlow := fixedRankSmallCofactorError)
    (εhigh := fixedRankReciprocalError)
    (εoff := fixedRankCutoffSquareError) hV
  rw [fixedRankOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant_eq]
  change fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm J x + fixedRankSmallCofactorTerm J x +
      fixedRankReciprocalTerm J x +
        smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤ _
  have hthree : fixedRankCutoffSquareTerm J x +
      fixedRankSmallCofactorTerm J x + fixedRankReciprocalTerm J x ≤
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x := by
    exact (add_le_add (add_le_add hcut hsmall) hrec).trans hcombine
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankOffDiagonalError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankOffDiagonalError_zero
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankOffDiagonalError ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      max (fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x) (ρ x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using
      tendsto_fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError_zero.max hρ
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  unfold fixedRankOffDiagonalError
  simpa only [zero_add] using hmax.add hconst

name: RankAmplification.sum_two_fixedRankExponentialMajorants_le_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_two_fixedRankExponentialMajorants_le_offDiagonal
    {J x : ℕ} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ)) :
    fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J ρ x ≤
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankOffDiagonalError ρ) x
proof:
:= by
  let M := max (fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x) (ρ x)
  have helem : fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have hρM : ρ x ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hmono (e : ℝ) (he : e ≤ M) :
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + e * scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hV.le
    linarith
  have helem' : fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
      fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant
    exact hmono _ helem
  have hρ' : fixedRankExponentialMajorant J ρ x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant
    exact hmono _ hρM
  calc
    fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J ρ x ≤
        2 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + M * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
      linarith
    _ = fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankOffDiagonalError ρ) x := by
      unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant fixedRankOffDiagonalError M
      rw [show (max (fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x) (ρ x) +
          Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
          max (fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x) (ρ x) *
            scaleV (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 by
        rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne']]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [show -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
            (max (fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x) (ρ x) *
              scaleV (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) =
            (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
              max (fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x) (ρ x) *
                scaleV (x : ℝ)) + Real.log 2 by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis_of_B4Estimate
statement:
theorem fixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis_of_B4Estimate
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hB4 : FixedRankB4Estimate J ρ) :
    FixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis J (fixedRankOffDiagonalError ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankOffDiagonalError_zero hB4.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankFiniteMajorant_le_elementary_add_B4 J hJ,
    hB4.2, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hadmissible hfinite hB4x hV
  intro h hh hhy
  have hhY : h ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    hhy.trans hadmissible.y_le_upper
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_upper
  calc
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant J x :=
      fixedRank_offDiagonal_le_finiteMajorant (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hh) hhY hYpos
    _ ≤ fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x +
        smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) := hfinite
    _ ≤ fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankElementaryOffDiagonalError x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J ρ x := add_le_add le_rfl hB4x
    _ ≤ fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankOffDiagonalError ρ) x :=
      sum_two_fixedRankExponentialMajorants_le_offDiagonal hV

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankB4UpperError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankB4UpperError_zero :
    Tendsto fixedRankB4UpperError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 8 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hsum := hconst.add tendsto_fixedRankSmallCofactorError_zero
  have hLnat : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos
  have heq : (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 8 / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
      fixedRankSmallCofactorError x) =ᶠ[atTop] fixedRankB4UpperError := by
    filter_upwards [hLnat] with x hL
    unfold fixedRankSmallCofactorError fixedRankB4UpperError
    rw [← add_div]
    congr 1
    rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (8 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (by nlinarith : 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0)]
    congr 1
    ring
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum.congr' heq

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4Upper_le
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4Upper_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankB4UpperError x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankNatUpperY_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg J hJ,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos,
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 0] with
      x hadmissible hinv hV hL
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hL
  have hxOne : 1 ≤ x := by
    exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
        (hadmissible.y_le_upper.trans hadmissible.upper_le_x)
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_upper
  have hupper := smoothMultiplierB4Upper_le hYpos hadmissible.upper_le_x
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log
      (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) := by
    have hambOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) by
        unfold section5Ambient
        positivity)
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hambOne]
  have hambLog : 1 + Real.log
      (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) ≤
      4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hambPos : (0 : ℝ) < section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) by
        unfold section5Ambient
        positivity)
    have hambLe : (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast (show section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤
          2 * x ^ 2 by
        unfold section5Ambient
        calc
          2 * x * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ≤ 2 * x * x :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * x) hadmissible.upper_le_x
          _ = 2 * x ^ 2 := by ring)
    have hlogAmbient := Real.log_le_log hambPos hambLe
    have hmodel : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) =
        Real.log 2 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
        (pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast (show x ≠ 0 by omega))),
        Real.log_pow, scaleL]
      norm_num
    rw [hmodel] at hlogAmbient
    have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
      norm_num at h ⊢
      exact h
    nlinarith
  have hbound : smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤
      16 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) *
        (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) *
            (1 + Real.log
              (section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ)) *
            (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ)⁻¹ := hupper
      _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) := by gcongr
      _ = 16 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by ring
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤
        16 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ)) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hbound
    _ = fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankB4UpperError x := by
      unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant fixedRankB4UpperError
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne', Real.exp_add,
        Real.exp_log (by nlinarith : 0 < 16 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankB4Error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankB4Error_zero :
    Tendsto fixedRankB4Error atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_fixedRankCombinedError_zero tendsto_const_nhds
    tendsto_fixedRankB4UpperError_zero tendsto_const_nhds

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankB4Estimate_of_intermediateRankin
statement:
theorem fixedRankB4Estimate_of_intermediateRankin
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hRankin : FixedRankIntermediateRankinHypothesis J) :
    FixedRankB4Estimate J fixedRankB4Error
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankB4Error_zero, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ, hRankin,
    eventually_fixedRankB4Upper_le J hJ,
    tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 2),
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hadmissible hRankinX hupper hVlog hV
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_upper
  have hmid := smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le hYpos
    hadmissible.upper_le_x hRankinX
  have hexpV : 2 * Real.exp (-scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      2 * Real.exp (-scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≤
          2 * Real.exp (-Real.log 2) := by gcongr
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
        norm_num
  have hmidFinal : smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x := by
    calc
      smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
            (-(Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + scaleV (x : ℝ))) := hmid
      _ = ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) *
            (2 * Real.exp (-scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
        rw [show -(Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + scaleV (x : ℝ)) =
          -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + -scaleV (x : ℝ) by ring,
          Real.exp_add]
        ring
      _ ≤ ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ))) * 1 := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexpV (by positivity)
      _ = fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x := by
        simp [fixedRankExponentialMajorant]
  rw [smoothMultiplierB4Sum_eq_intermediate_add_upper]
  have hcombine := sum_three_fixedRankExponentialMajorant_le_combined
    (J := J) (x := x) (εlow := fun _ ↦ 0)
    (εhigh := fixedRankB4UpperError) (εoff := fun _ ↦ 0) hV
  have hzero : 0 ≤ fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x :=
    fixedRankExponentialMajorant_nonneg J (fun _ ↦ 0) x
  have hmajorants : fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x +
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankB4UpperError x ≤
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankB4Error x := by
    change fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankB4UpperError x ≤
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
        (fixedRankCombinedError (fun _ ↦ 0) fixedRankB4UpperError (fun _ ↦ 0)) x
    have hpad : fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x +
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankB4UpperError x ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fun _ ↦ 0) x +
            fixedRankExponentialMajorant J fixedRankB4UpperError x := by
      linarith
    exact hpad.trans hcombine
  exact (add_le_add hmidFinal hupper).trans hmajorants

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis_of_intermediateRankin
statement:
theorem fixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis_of_intermediateRankin
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hRankin : FixedRankIntermediateRankinHypothesis J) :
    FixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis J
      (fixedRankOffDiagonalError fixedRankB4Error)
proof:
:=
  fixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis_of_B4Estimate hJ
    (fixedRankB4Estimate_of_intermediateRankin hJ hRankin)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :

proof:

    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankB4K_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem fixedRankB4K_isLittleO_scaleL (J : ℕ) :
    fixedRankB4K J =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:

  change (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) =o[atTop] scaleL
  exact fixedRankUpperExponent_isLittleO_scaleL J

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_eighth_scaleL
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_eighth_scaleL (J : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, fixedRankB4K J x ≤ scaleL x / 8
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := (fixedRankB4K_isLittleO_scaleL J).bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8)
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hx hL
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hx
  have := (Real.le_norm_self _).trans hx
  norm_num at this ⊢
