name: RankAmplification.log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_fixedRankB4K
statement:
theorem log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_fixedRankB4K
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hY : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x) :
    Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hY) hfloor
  simpa only [fixedRankB4K, log_fixedRankUpperY (x : ℝ) hJ] using hlog

name: RankAmplification.eventually_three_fixedRankNatUpperY_cube_lt_two_x
statement:
theorem eventually_three_fixedRankNatUpperY_cube_lt_two_x
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 3 < 2 * x
proof:
:= by
  have hK := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_eighth_scaleL J)
  have hLlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      8 * Real.log 3 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hxpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 2 ≤ x := eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [hK, hLlarge, hxpos] with x hKx hLlargeX hx
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hlogExp : Real.log 3 + 3 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) <
      scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have hYle : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
        Nat.floor_le (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le
      _ = Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG (x : ℝ) hJ]
        rfl
  have hreal : 3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ^ 3 < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤
          3 * (Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ))) ^ 3 := by gcongr
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log 3 + 3 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3),
          ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        norm_num
      _ < Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlogExp
      _ = (x : ℝ) := Real.exp_log (by
        exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega))
      _ < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
        have hxReal : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega)
        linarith
  exact_mod_cast hreal

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three
statement:
theorem fixedRankB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three
    {J x p : ℕ}
    (hcube : 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) :
    3 ≤ section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x := by
    by_contra hY
    have hY0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hY
    rw [hY0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    omega
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hpSq : p ^ 2 ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 4 := by
    calc
      p ^ 2 ≤ (fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_left hpData.2 2
      _ = fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 4 := by ring
  have hthree : 3 * p ^ 2 ≤ section5Ambient x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    have hmul : 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 4 <
        2 * x * fixedRankNatUpperY J x := by
      calc
        3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 4 =
            (3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 3) * fixedRankNatUpperY J x := by ring
        _ < (2 * x) * fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcube hYpos
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hpSq).trans hmul.le
  exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (pow_pos hpPos 2)).2 hthree

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_finite_domain
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_finite_domain
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        0 < section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p ∧ 3 ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_fixedRankNatUpperY_cube_lt_two_x J hJ,
    eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ] with x hcube hYthree
  intro p hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  exact ⟨(by
    have hthree := fixedRankB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three hcube hp
    omega), by omega⟩

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_div_fixedRankB4K_eq_scaleV_div_sqrt
statement:
theorem scaleL_div_fixedRankB4K_eq_scaleV_div_sqrt
    {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) :
    scaleL x / fixedRankB4K J x = scaleV x / Real.sqrt J
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)).ne'
  unfold fixedRankB4K
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.eventually_scaleV_div_four_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus
statement:
theorem eventually_scaleV_div_four_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      scaleV x / (4 * Real.sqrt J) ≤ fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_eighth_scaleL J,
    eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hKle hL hA
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hK : 0 < fixedRankB4K J x := mul_pos hsqrt hG
  have hnum : scaleL x / 2 ≤ scaleL x - 3 * fixedRankB4K J x := by
    nlinarith
  have hratio := scaleL_div_fixedRankB4K_eq_scaleV_div_sqrt hJ hG.ne'
  calc
    scaleV x / (4 * Real.sqrt J) =
        (scaleL x / fixedRankB4K J x) / 4 := by
      rw [hratio]
      field_simp
    _ = (scaleL x / 2) / (2 * fixedRankB4K J x) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    _ ≤ (scaleL x - 3 * fixedRankB4K J x) /
        (2 * fixedRankB4K J x) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (by positivity)
    _ = fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J x := rfl

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus_atTop
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hlower : Tendsto (fun x ↦ scaleV x / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_scaleV_atTop.atTop_div_const (by positivity)
  refine Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop ?_ hlower
  exact eventually_scaleV_div_four_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J hJ

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower
statement:
theorem fixedRankB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower
    {J x p : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hcube : 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) :
    scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := fixedRankNatUpperY J x
  let W := section5Ambient x Z
  let d := p ^ 2
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hpZsq : p ≤ Z ^ 2 := by simpa [Z] using hpData.2
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := by
    by_contra hZ
    have hZ0 : Z = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hZ
    rw [hZ0] at hpZsq
    simp at hpZsq
    omega
  have hdPos : 0 < d := pow_pos hpPos 2
  have hdW : d ≤ W := Nat.le_sqrt'.mp hpRange.2.1
  have hhalf := half_real_div_le_nat_div hdPos hdW
  have hWpos : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hdPos.trans_le hdW
  have hhalfPos : (0 : ℝ) < (W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ) :=
    div_pos hWpos (by positivity)
  have hlogHalf : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ)) ≤
      Real.log (W / d : ℕ) := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hhalf
  have hlogP : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (Z : ℝ) := by
    have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ (Z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
    simpa [Real.log_pow, hZpos.ne'] using h
  have hlogZK : Real.log (Z : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa [Z] using log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_fixedRankB4K hJ hZpos
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by
    have := hcube
    omega
  have hmodel : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ)) =
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) - 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hneW : (W : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      simp [W, section5Ambient, hxPos.ne', hZpos.ne']
    have hned : ((2 * d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [Real.log_div hneW hned]
    simp only [W, d, section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat,
      Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [Real.log_mul
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'))
      (by exact_mod_cast hZpos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
        (pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast hpPos.ne')),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    ring
  rw [hmodel] at hlogHalf
  have hlogHalf' : scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) -
      2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p : ℝ) := by
    simpa [W, d, Z, section5LocalCutoff] using hlogHalf
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankB4UFloorMinus_le_rankinU
statement:
theorem fixedRankB4UFloorMinus_le_rankinU
    {J x p : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ))
    (hcube : 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) :
    fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J (x : ℝ) ≤
      rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x := by
    by_contra hY
    have hY0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hY
    rw [hY0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    omega
  have hlogp : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast hpData.2
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
    rw [Real.log_pow] at h
    exact h.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_fixedRankB4K hJ hYpos) (by norm_num)
  have hlogX := fixedRankB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower hJ hcube hp
  unfold fixedRankB4UFloorMinus rankinU
  have hfirst : (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) /
      (2 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) /
        Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hlogpPos hlogp
  exact hfirst.trans <| div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogX hlogpPos.le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_lowerRankin
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_lowerRankin
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        0 < section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p ∧
        3 ≤ p ∧ fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J (x : ℝ) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p
proof:
:= by
  have hnum : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    have hsmall := (fixedRankB4K_isLittleO_scaleL J).bound
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
    have hnat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hsmall
    have hLnat := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
    filter_upwards [hnat, hLnat] with x hsmallX hL
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hL
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hsmallX
    have hKle := (Real.le_norm_self (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ))).trans hsmallX
    norm_num at hKle
    have hKle' : fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
        (1 / 3 : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hKle
    nlinarith
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_finite_domain J hJ,
    eventually_three_fixedRankNatUpperY_cube_lt_two_x J hJ, hnum] with
      x hdomain hcube hnumX
  intro p hp
  exact ⟨(hdomain p hp).1, (hdomain p hp).2,
    fixedRankB4UFloorMinus_le_rankinU hJ hnumX hcube hp⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_eq
statement:
theorem fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_eq
    {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hden : fixedRankB4K J x - Real.log 2 ≠ 0) :
    fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J x =
      (scaleL x + fixedRankB4K J x + Real.log 2) /
          (fixedRankB4K J x - Real.log 2) - 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankB4UFloorPlus
  field_simp [hden]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_le_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus
statement:
theorem rankinU_le_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus
    {J x p : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hKlog : Real.log 2 < fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ))
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2)
    (hYlower : fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ))
    (hcube : 3 * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) :
    rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p ≤
      fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := fixedRankNatUpperY J x
  let W := section5Ambient x Z
  let d := p ^ 2
  let X := section5LocalCutoff x Z p
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := by
    by_contra hZ
    have hZ0 : Z = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hZ
    have hpZ : p ≤ Z ^ 2 := by simpa [Z] using hpData.2
    rw [hZ0] at hpZ
    simp at hpZ
    omega
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by
    have hthree := fixedRankB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three hcube hp
    simpa [X, Z] using
      (show 0 < section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p by omega)
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hlogZlower : fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log (Z : ℝ) := by
    have hhalfPos : 0 < fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
      div_pos (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hYlower
    have hmodel : Real.log (fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2) =
        fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 := by
      rw [Real.log_div (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).ne'
        (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), log_fixedRankUpperY (x : ℝ) hJ]
      rfl
    rw [hmodel] at hlog
    simpa [Z] using hlog
  have hlogpLower : fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hZp : (Z : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpRange.1.le
    exact hlogZlower.trans (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hZpos) hZp)
  have hXcast : (X : ℝ) ≤ (W : ℝ) / d := by
    simpa [X, W, Z, d, section5LocalCutoff, div_eq_mul_inv] using
      (section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x Z p)
  have hlogX : Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((W : ℝ) / d) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hXpos) hXcast
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hmodel : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / d) =
      Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) -
        2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hWne : (W : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      simp [W, section5Ambient, hxPos.ne', hZpos.ne']
    have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [d, hpPos.ne']
    rw [Real.log_div hWne hdne]
    simp only [W, Z, d, section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat,
      Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [Real.log_mul
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'))
      (by exact_mod_cast hZpos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    ring
  have hlogZupper : Real.log (Z : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa [Z] using log_fixedRankNatUpperY_le_fixedRankB4K hJ hZpos
  rw [hmodel] at hlogX
  have hlogX' : Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 -
        2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hdenPos : 0 < fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 := sub_pos.mpr hKlog
  unfold rankinU
  rw [fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_eq hdenPos.ne']
  have hfirst : Real.log (X : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
          Real.log (p : ℝ) - 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogpPos).2
    field_simp [hlogpPos.ne']
    linarith
  have hsecond :
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
          Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
          (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hdenPos hlogpLower
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_le_four_scaleV
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_le_four_scaleV
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J x ≤ 4 * scaleV x / Real.sqrt J
proof:
:= by
  have hKlarge := (tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop
    (2 * Real.log 2)
  filter_upwards [hKlarge, eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_eighth_scaleL J,
    eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hKlargeX hKle hL hA
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hK : 0 < fixedRankB4K J x := mul_pos hsqrt hG
  have hden : fixedRankB4K J x / 2 ≤ fixedRankB4K J x - Real.log 2 := by
    linarith
  have hdenPos : 0 < fixedRankB4K J x - Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have hnumNonneg : 0 ≤ scaleL x + fixedRankB4K J x + Real.log 2 := by positivity
  have hnumLe : scaleL x + fixedRankB4K J x + Real.log 2 ≤ 2 * scaleL x := by
    have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ fixedRankB4K J x := by linarith
    nlinarith
  have hratio := scaleL_div_fixedRankB4K_eq_scaleV_div_sqrt hJ hG.ne'
  rw [fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_eq hdenPos.ne']
  calc
    (scaleL x + fixedRankB4K J x + Real.log 2) /
          (fixedRankB4K J x - Real.log 2) - 2 ≤
        (scaleL x + fixedRankB4K J x + Real.log 2) /
          (fixedRankB4K J x - Real.log 2) := by linarith
    _ ≤ (2 * scaleL x) / (fixedRankB4K J x - Real.log 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnumLe hdenPos.le
    _ ≤ (2 * scaleL x) / (fixedRankB4K J x / 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) hden
    _ = 4 * (scaleL x / fixedRankB4K J x) := by field_simp; ring
    _ = 4 * scaleV x / Real.sqrt J := by rw [hratio]; ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_four_scaleV_div_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4K
statement:
theorem eventually_four_scaleV_div_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4K
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      4 * scaleV x / Real.sqrt J ≤ fixedRankB4K J x
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hx hL hA
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrt : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hV.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le] at hx
  unfold fixedRankB4K
  have hfour : 4 * scaleV x ≤ scaleG x := by nlinarith
  have hsqrtPos : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans_le hsqrt
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hsqrtPos).2
  nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hsqrt]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_exp_quarter
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_exp_quarter
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      fixedRankB4K J x ≤ Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J x / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.comp_tendsto
    (tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ)
  have hbound := hlog.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  filter_upwards [hbound,
    (tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hx hK
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, id_eq] at hx
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hK),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hK)] at hx
  calc
    fixedRankB4K J x = Real.exp (Real.log (fixedRankB4K J x)) :=
      (Real.exp_log (zero_lt_one.trans_le hK)).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J x / 4) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p ≤
          Real.sqrt p
proof:
:= by
  have hKlog : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 < fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop _
  have hnum : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      ((tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hL hK
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hL hK
    positivity
  have hplus := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_le_four_scaleV J hJ)
  have hfour := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_four_scaleV_div_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4K J hJ)
  have hKexp := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_exp_quarter J hJ)
  have hKlarge := ((tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2)
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankUpperY_half_le_natUpperY J hJ,
    eventually_three_fixedRankNatUpperY_cube_lt_two_x J hJ, hKlog, hnum,
    hplus, hfour, hKexp, hKlarge] with
      x hYlower hcube hKlogX hnumX hplusX hfourX hKexpX hKlargeX
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hKlargeX
  intro p hp
  have hu := rankinU_le_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus hJ hKlogX hnumX
    hYlower hcube hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  have hYpos : 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x := by
    have hhalfPos : 0 < fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
      div_pos (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    exact_mod_cast hhalfPos.trans_le hYlower
  have hlogpLower : fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hhalfPos : 0 < fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
      div_pos (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hYlower
    have hmodel : Real.log (fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2) =
        fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 := by
      rw [Real.log_div (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).ne'
        (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), log_fixedRankUpperY (x : ℝ) hJ]
      rfl
    rw [hmodel] at hlog
    exact hlog.trans <| Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hYpos)
      (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.1.le)
  have hquarter : fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) / 4 ≤
      (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2 := by linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp ((fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt p := by
    calc
      Real.exp ((fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2) ≤
          Real.exp (Real.log (p : ℝ) / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = Real.sqrt p := by
        rw [Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.pos)]
  exact hu.trans <| hplusX.trans <| hfourX.trans <| hKexpX.trans <|
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hquarter).trans hexp

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV
statement:
theorem eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, log2 x ≤ 3 * Real.log (scaleV x)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := log_scaleA_isLittleO_log2.bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
    tendsto_scaleA_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1, eventually_log2_pos] with
      x hx hL hA hAone hL2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hAone),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le] at hx
  have hidentity := two_mul_log_scaleV hL hA
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankSaving_le_V_logV
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankSaving_le_V_logV
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      fixedRankB4K J x + scaleV x ≤
        scaleV x * Real.log (scaleV x) / (16 * Real.sqrt J)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (96 * (J : ℝ))
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    positivity
  have hAbound := scaleA_isLittleO_log2.bound hc
  have hlogLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      32 * Real.sqrt J ≤ Real.log (scaleV x) :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop _
  filter_upwards [hAbound, eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV,
    hlogLarge, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
    eventually_log2_pos] with x hAraw hL2log hlogLargeX hL hA hL2
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hsqrtSq : (Real.sqrt (J : ℝ)) ^ 2 = J :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hA.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le] at hAraw
  have hAle : scaleA x ≤ Real.log (scaleV x) / (32 * (J : ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [c] at hAraw
    calc
      scaleA x ≤ (1 / (96 * (J : ℝ))) * log2 x := hAraw
      _ ≤ (1 / (96 * (J : ℝ))) *
          (3 * Real.log (scaleV x)) := by gcongr
      _ = Real.log (scaleV x) / (32 * (J : ℝ)) := by field_simp; ring
  have hmain : Real.sqrt J * scaleA x + 1 ≤
      Real.log (scaleV x) / (16 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    have hfirst : Real.sqrt J * scaleA x ≤
        Real.log (scaleV x) / (32 * Real.sqrt J) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (32 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J)).2
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAle (Real.sqrt_nonneg J)
      field_simp [hsqrt.ne'] at hmul ⊢
      nlinarith
    have hsecond : 1 ≤ Real.log (scaleV x) / (32 * Real.sqrt J) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (32 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J)).2
      simpa only [one_mul] using hlogLargeX
    calc
      Real.sqrt J * scaleA x + 1 ≤
          Real.log (scaleV x) / (32 * Real.sqrt J) +
            Real.log (scaleV x) / (32 * Real.sqrt J) :=
        add_le_add hfirst hsecond
      _ = Real.log (scaleV x) / (16 * Real.sqrt J) := by ring
  have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  unfold fixedRankB4K
  calc
    Real.sqrt J * scaleG x + scaleV x =
        (Real.sqrt J * scaleA x + 1) * scaleV x := by
      rw [← hAG]
      ring
    _ ≤ (Real.log (scaleV x) / (16 * Real.sqrt J)) * scaleV x :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmain hV.le
    _ = scaleV x * Real.log (scaleV x) / (16 * Real.sqrt J) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRank_V_logV_le_half_local_saddle
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRank_V_logV_le_half_local_saddle
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
            (16 * Real.sqrt J) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU
              (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hqTop : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ scaleV x / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_scaleV_atTop.atTop_div_const (by
      have : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
      positivity)
  have hqThree := (hqTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 3
  have hlogLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * Real.log (4 * Real.sqrt J) ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_atTop).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hqFloor := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_scaleV_div_four_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J hJ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_lowerRankin J hJ,
    hqThree, hlogLarge, hqFloor, (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_scaleL_pos,
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos] with
      x hlower hqThreeX hlogLargeX hqFloorX hL hA
  intro p hp
  let q := scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)
  let u := rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hqu : q ≤ u := by
    exact hqFloorX.trans (by simpa [u] using (hlower p hp).2.2)
  have huPos : 0 < u := hqPos.trans_le hqu
  have hlogq : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤ Real.log q := by
    have hmodel : Real.log q = Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) -
        Real.log (4 * Real.sqrt J) := by
      change Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) =
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) - Real.log (4 * Real.sqrt J)
      rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' (by positivity : (4 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J ≠ 0)]
    rw [hmodel]
    linarith
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hqThreeX
  have hlogqNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log q :=
    Real.log_nonneg ((by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3).trans (by simpa [q] using hqThreeX))
  have hlogMono : Real.log q ≤ Real.log u :=
    Real.log_le_log hqPos hqu
  have hmulMono : q * Real.log q ≤ u * Real.log u :=
    mul_le_mul hqu hlogMono hlogqNonneg huPos.le
  have hqSaddle : scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
      (16 * Real.sqrt J) ≤ q * Real.log q / 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogq hqPos.le
    dsimp [q] at hmul ⊢
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
          (16 * Real.sqrt J) =
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) *
            (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2) / 2 := by field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) *
          Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) / 2 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmul (by norm_num)
  exact hqSaddle.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmulMono (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankSaving_le_half_local_saddle
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankSaving_le_half_local_saddle
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU
              (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsaving := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankSaving_le_V_logV J hJ)
  filter_upwards [hsaving,
    eventually_fixedRank_V_logV_le_half_local_saddle J hJ] with x hsaddle hlocal
  intro p hp
  exact hsaddle.trans (hlocal p hp)

name: RankAmplification.log2_three_mul_prime_le_fixedRankUpperY_sq
statement:
theorem log2_three_mul_prime_le_fixedRankUpperY_sq
    {J x p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)) :
    log2 (3 * (p : ℝ)) ≤
      log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast
    (mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1).2.2.pos
  have hYLe : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le
  have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (p : ℝ) ≤ (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        exact_mod_cast hpData.2
      _ ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have harg : 3 * (p : ℝ) ≤
      3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast
    (mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1).2.2.two_le
  have hleftOne : (1 : ℝ) < 3 * p := by nlinarith
  have hlogLeft : 0 < Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ)) := Real.log_pos hleftOne
  have hlogFirst := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 3 * p) harg
  unfold log2 iteratedLog
  exact Real.log_le_log hlogLeft hlogFirst

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankUpperEndpoint_log2_le_log2
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankUpperEndpoint_log2_le_log2
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J x ^ 2) ≤ log2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hLlarge := tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 3)
  have hKpos := (tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_eighth_scaleL J,
    hLlarge, hKpos, eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hKle hLlargeX hK hL
  have hinner : Real.log (3 * fixedRankUpperY J x ^ 2) =
      Real.log 3 + 2 * fixedRankB4K J x := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 (fixedRankUpperY_pos J x).ne'),
      Real.log_pow, log_fixedRankUpperY x hJ]
    rfl
  have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log 3 + 2 * fixedRankB4K J x := by
    have : 0 < Real.log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    positivity
  have hinnerLe : Real.log 3 + 2 * fixedRankB4K J x ≤ scaleL x := by
    nlinarith
  rw [log2_eq, hinner, log2_eq]
  simpa only [scaleL_eq] using Real.log_le_log hinnerPos hinnerLe

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_fixedRank_core
statement:
theorem eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_fixedRank_core
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        fullPaperDivisorError p
            (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) ≤
          movingB4ErrorConstant *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) +
              log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
              fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_lowerRankin J hJ
  have hupper := eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt J hJ
  have hfloorThree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      3 ≤ fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 3
  have hL2one : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  have hendpointNonneg : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have hK := ((tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
    filter_upwards [hK] with x hKx
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hKx
    rw [log2_eq]
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    have hinner : Real.log (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) =
        Real.log 3 + 2 * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
        (pow_ne_zero 2 (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).ne'),
        Real.log_pow, log_fixedRankUpperY (x : ℝ) hJ]
      rfl
    rw [hinner]
    nlinarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3)]
  have hKlog : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 < fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) :=
    ((tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop _
  have hnum : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      ((tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hL hK
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hL hK
    positivity
  filter_upwards [hlower, hupper, hfloorThree, hL2one, hendpointNonneg,
    eventually_fixedRankUpperY_half_le_natUpperY J hJ,
    eventually_three_fixedRankNatUpperY_cube_lt_two_x J hJ, hKlog, hnum] with
      x hlowerX hupperX hfloorThreeX hL2oneX hendpointX hYlower hcube
        hKlogX hnumX
  intro p hp
  let X := section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p
  let u := rankinU X p
  have huLower : fixedRankB4UFloorMinus J (x : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    simpa [u, X] using (hlowerX p hp).2.2
  have hu3 : 3 ≤ u := hfloorThreeX.trans huLower
  have huFloor : u ≤ fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa [u, X] using rankinU_le_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus hJ hKlogX hnumX
      hYlower hcube hp
  have hlogOne : 1 ≤ Real.log u := by
    have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ u := Real.exp_one_lt_three.le.trans hu3
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hexp
    simpa using this
  have huDiv : u / Real.log u ≤ fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) := by
    have hself : u / Real.log u ≤ u := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (zero_lt_one.trans_le hlogOne)).2
      nlinarith
    exact hself.trans huFloor
  have hlogP := log2_three_mul_prime_le_fixedRankUpperY_sq hp
  let S := log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
    fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ)
  have hSnonneg : 0 ≤ S := by
    dsimp only [S]
    have hplusNonneg : 0 ≤ fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) :=
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3).trans (hu3.trans huFloor)
    positivity
  have hlogTerm : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) -
      Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
      (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) * S := by
    have hbase : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) -
        Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
        log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
          |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := by
      have hlogP' : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
          log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
        simpa [log2, iteratedLog] using hlogP
      linarith [neg_le_abs (Real.log (Real.log 2))]
    have habs : |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤
        |Real.log (Real.log 2)| * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (Real.log 2))]
    have hzS : log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ S := by
      dsimp only [S]
      have hplus : 0 ≤ fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) :=
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3).trans (hu3.trans huFloor)
      linarith
    have hxS : log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ S := by
      dsimp only [S]
      have hplus : 0 ≤ fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) :=
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3).trans (hu3.trans huFloor)
      linarith
    have habsS : |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| * S :=
      habs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxS (abs_nonneg _))
    calc
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
          log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
            |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := hbase
      _ ≤ S + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| * S := add_le_add hzS habsS
      _ = (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) * S := by ring
  have huTerm : 3 * u / Real.log u ≤ 3 * S := by
    calc
      3 * u / Real.log u = 3 * (u / Real.log u) := by ring
      _ ≤ 3 * fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 3 * S := by
        dsimp only [S]
        linarith
  unfold fullPaperDivisorError fullULogUPrimeError
  have hcore : Real.exp 2 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        3 * u / Real.log u ≤
      (Real.exp 2 * (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) + 3) * S := by
    calc
      Real.exp 2 *
          (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * u / Real.log u ≤
          Real.exp 2 * ((1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) * S) + 3 * S :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogTerm (Real.exp_pos 2).le) huTerm
      _ = (Real.exp 2 * (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) + 3) * S := by ring
  have hmult := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcore
    (mul_nonneg divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le primeCountingConstant_pos.le)
  simpa [movingB4ErrorConstant, S, X, u, mul_assoc] using hmult

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_fixedRank_half_saddle
statement:
theorem eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_fixedRank_half_saddle
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x),
        fullPaperDivisorError p
            (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU
              (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlog2V : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hbound := log2_isLittleO_scaleV.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    have hnat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hbound
    filter_upwards [hnat,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos] with
        x hx hL2 hL hA
    have hV := scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hV.le] at hx
    norm_num at hx
    exact hx
  have hendpoint := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankUpperEndpoint_log2_le_log2 J hJ)
  have hplus := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankB4UFloorPlus_le_four_scaleV J hJ)
  have hreserve : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      96 * Real.sqrt J * movingB4ErrorConstant ≤
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_atTop).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop _
  filter_upwards [eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_fixedRank_core J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRank_V_logV_le_half_local_saddle J hJ,
    hlog2V, hendpoint, hplus, hreserve,
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos] with
      x herror hlocal hL2V hendpointX hplusX hreserveX hL hA
  intro p hp
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hsqrtOne : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega)
  have hplusV : fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) ≤ 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) ≤
          4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J := hplusX
      _ ≤ 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
        exact (div_le_iff₀ hsqrt).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hsum : log2 (x : ℝ) +
        log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
        fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ) ≤ 6 * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    linarith
  have hcoarse : fullPaperDivisorError p
        (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) ≤
      6 * movingB4ErrorConstant * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      fullPaperDivisorError p
          (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) ≤
          movingB4ErrorConstant *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) +
              log2 (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
              fixedRankB4UFloorPlus J (x : ℝ)) := herror p hp
      _ ≤ movingB4ErrorConstant * (6 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum movingB4ErrorConstant_nonneg
      _ = 6 * movingB4ErrorConstant * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
  have hcoarseSaddle : 6 * movingB4ErrorConstant * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
        (16 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (16 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J)).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg movingB4ErrorConstant_nonneg hV.le]
  exact hcoarse.trans <| hcoarseSaddle.trans (hlocal p hp)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankIntermediateRankinHypothesis_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankIntermediateRankinHypothesis_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    FixedRankIntermediateRankinHypothesis J
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_lowerRankin J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt J hJ,
    eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_fixedRank_half_saddle J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankSaving_le_half_local_saddle J hJ,
    ((tendsto_fixedRankB4UFloorMinus_atTop J hJ).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 3] with
      x hlower hupper herror hsaving hfloorThree
  intro p hp
  have hdomain := hlower p hp
  have huThree : 3 ≤ rankinU
      (section5LocalCutoff x (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) p) p :=
    hfloorThree.trans hdomain.2.2
  refine ⟨hdomain.1, by linarith, hupper p hp, herror p hp, ?_⟩
  simpa only [fixedRankB4K] using hsaving p hp

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_3_forward
statement:
theorem proposition9_3_forward {h Y n j r : ℕ}
    (hrep : IsDiagonalRepresentation h Y n j r) :
    n + h = (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
      n.totient = (n + h).totient ∧
      n.totient = diagonalGamma h j * r
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hrep.2.2.2.1, hrep.totient_eq, hrep.totient_eq_gamma_mul⟩

name: RankAmplification.diagonalAffinePair_leftValue
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalAffinePair_leftValue {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : 0 < j) (r : ℕ) :
    (diagonalAffinePair h j).leftValue r = diagonalA h j * r + 1
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.diagonalAffinePair_rightValue
statement:

theorem diagonalAffinePair_rightValue {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : 0 < j) (r : ℕ) :
