name: RankAmplification.mem_diagonalPrimePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_diagonalPrimePairSet {h j R r : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : 0 < j) :
    r ∈ diagonalPrimePairSet h j R ↔
      1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ R ∧ Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalB h j * r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalPrimePairSet, AffinePrimePair.mem_primePairSet]
  simp only [diagonalAffinePair_leftValue hh hj, diagonalAffinePair_rightValue hh hj]

name: RankAmplification.card_diagonalPrimeValueSet_le
statement:
theorem card_diagonalPrimeValueSet_le (x h j : ℕ) :
    (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h j).card ≤ (diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_image_le

name: RankAmplification.IsDiagonalRepresentation.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet
statement:
theorem IsDiagonalRepresentation.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet
    {x h Y n j r : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hnx : n ≤ x)
    (hrep : IsDiagonalRepresentation h Y n j r) :
    n ∈ diagonalPrimeValueSet x h j
proof:
:= by
  have hj : 0 < j := zero_lt_one.trans_le hrep.1.1
  have hA : 0 < diagonalA h j := diagonalA_pos hj
  have hrx : r ≤ x := by
    calc
      r ≤ diagonalA h j * r := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left r hA
      _ ≤ diagonalA h j * r + 1 := Nat.le_add_right _ _
      _ ≤ j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) :=
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hj
      _ = n := hrep.2.2.1.symm
      _ ≤ x := hnx
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  refine ⟨r, ?_, hrep.2.2.1.symm⟩
  exact mem_diagonalPrimePairSet hh hj |>.mpr
    ⟨hrep.2.1, hrx, hrep.2.2.2.2.1, hrep.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_diagonalPrimeValueSet
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_diagonalPrimeValueSet
    {x h Y : ℕ} {J : Finset ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ⊆ J.biUnion (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h)
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hnData := mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mp hn
  obtain ⟨j, r, hrep⟩ := hnData.2.2
  apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
  exact ⟨j, (hJ j).mpr hrep.1,
    hrep.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet hh hnData.2.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_diagonalPrimePairSet
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_diagonalPrimePairSet
    {x h Y : ℕ} {J : Finset ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y ≤
      ∑ j ∈ J, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount]
  calc
    (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y).card ≤
        (J.biUnion (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h)).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_diagonalPrimeValueSet hh hJ)
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ J, (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h j).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ J, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ card_diagonalPrimeValueSet_le x h j

name: RankAmplification.exists_diagonalAffineSieveHypothesis_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem exists_diagonalAffineSieveHypothesis_of_pointwise
    {h : ℕ} {J : Finset ℕ}
    (hpoint : ∀ j ∈ J, (diagonalAffinePair h j).HasLogSquaredPrimePairBound) :
    ∃ C, DiagonalAffineSieveHypothesis h J C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun j ↦
    if hj : j ∈ J then Classical.choose (hpoint j hj) else 0
  have hc (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ J) (R : ℕ) (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
      ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤
        c j * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R := by
    have hchosen := Classical.choose_spec (hpoint j hj)
    simpa [c, hj, diagonalPrimePairSet] using hchosen R hR
  let C : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ J, max 0 (c j)
  refine ⟨C, ?_⟩
  intro j hj R hR
  have hscale : 0 ≤ AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R := by
    unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
    positivity
  have hjmax : max 0 (c j) ≤ C := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ le_max_left 0 (c i)) hj
  calc
    ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤
        c j * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R := hc j hj R hR
    _ ≤ max 0 (c j) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right 0 (c j)) hscale
    _ ≤ C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hjmax hscale

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_5_diagonal_bound
statement:
theorem proposition9_5_diagonal_bound
    {x h Y : ℕ} {J : Finset ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hx : 3 ≤ x)
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J)
    (hsieve : DiagonalAffineSieveHypothesis h J C) :
    (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      (J.card : ℝ) * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_diagonalPrimePairSet
    (x := x) (Y := Y) hh hJ
  have hfiniteReal : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ J, ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfinite
  calc
    (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ J, ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card : ℝ) := hfiniteReal
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ J, C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj ↦ hsieve j hj x hx
    _ = (J.card : ℝ) * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by
      simp
      ring

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_5_diagonal_zero_of_odd
statement:
theorem proposition9_5_diagonal_zero_of_odd {x h Y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y = 0
proof:
:=
  aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd

name: RankAmplification.mem_offDiagonalSquareSourceSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_offDiagonalSquareSourceSet {x h y P n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y P ↔
      n ∈ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y ∧ n ∈ squareSourceSet x h y P
proof:
:= by
  simp [offDiagonalSquareSourceSet]

name: RankAmplification.mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet {x h y P n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y P ↔
      n ∈ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y ∧ n ∉ squareSourceSet x h y P
proof:
:= by
  simp [offDiagonalNonSquareSet]

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_disjoint_nonSquareSet
statement:
theorem offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_disjoint_nonSquareSet (x h y P : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y P)
      (offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hsquare hnonsquare
  exact (mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet.mp hnonsquare).2
    (mem_offDiagonalSquareSourceSet.mp hsquare).2

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_union_nonSquareSet
statement:
theorem offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_union_nonSquareSet (x h y P : ℕ) :
    offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y P ∪ offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y P =
      offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h y
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_offDiagonalSquareSourceSet,
    mem_offDiagonalNonSquareSet]
  tauto

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_eq_square_add_nonSquare
statement:
theorem offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_eq_square_add_nonSquare (x h y P : ℕ) :
    offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y =
      (offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y P).card +
        (offDiagonalNonSquareSet x h y P).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [offDiagonalNonsmoothCount,
    ← offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_union_nonSquareSet x h y P,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
      (offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_disjoint_nonSquareSet x h y P)]

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_subset_squareSourceSet
statement:
theorem offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_subset_squareSourceSet (x h y P : ℕ) :
    offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y P ⊆ squareSourceSet x h y P
proof:
:=
  Finset.inter_subset_right

name: RankAmplification.offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff
statement:
theorem offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ((offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : (offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card ≤
      (squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_subset_squareSourceSet
      x h y (2 * x).sqrt)
  have hsubsetReal : ((offDiagonalSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hsubset
  exact hsubsetReal.trans (squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff hh hhy hy)

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_6_offDiagonal_bound
statement:
theorem proposition9_6_offDiagonal_bound
    {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hE : NonSquareTransferHypothesis E)
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) + E x h y
proof:
:= by
  rw [offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_eq_square_add_nonSquare
    x h y (2 * x).sqrt, Nat.cast_add]
  exact add_le_add
    (offDiagonalSquareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff hh hhy hy)
    (hE x h y hh hhy hy)

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_6_nonsmooth_bound
statement:
theorem proposition9_6_nonsmooth_bound
    {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hE : NonSquareTransferHypothesis E)
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y : ℝ) +
        (2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) + E x h y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount,
    Nat.cast_add]
  exact add_le_add le_rfl (proposition9_6_offDiagonal_bound hE hh hhy hy)

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_6_nonsmooth_bound_of_odd
statement:
theorem proposition9_6_nonsmooth_bound_of_odd
    {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hE : NonSquareTransferHypothesis E)
    {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) + E x h y
proof:
:= by
  have hh : 0 < h := hodd.pos
  have hbound := proposition9_6_nonsmooth_bound (x := x) hE hh hhy hy
  rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: RankAmplification.corollary9_6_assembled_bound
statement:
theorem corollary9_6_assembled_bound
    {E : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hE : NonSquareTransferHypothesis E)
    {x h y : ℕ} {J : Finset ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 3 ≤ x)
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J)
    (hsieve : DiagonalAffineSieveHypothesis h J C) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      (J.card : ℝ) * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x +
        (2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) + E x h y)
proof:
:= by
  exact (proposition9_6_nonsmooth_bound hE hh hhy hy).trans
    (add_le_add (proposition9_5_diagonal_bound hh hx hJ hsieve) le_rfl)

name: RankAmplification.section9_odd_shift_collapse
statement:
theorem section9_odd_shift_collapse {x h Y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    sameSupportIndices h = ∅ ∧
      aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y = ∅ ∧
      aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y = 0 ∧
      offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h Y = nonsmoothShiftedSet x h Y ∧
      offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h Y = nonsmoothShiftedCount x h Y
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨sameSupportIndices_eq_empty_of_odd hodd,
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_eq_empty_of_odd hodd,
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd,
    offDiagonalNonsmoothSet_eq_nonsmoothShiftedSet_of_odd hodd,
    offDiagonalNonsmoothCount_eq_nonsmoothShiftedCount_of_odd hodd⟩

name: RankAmplification.movingRank_bound_of_odd
statement:
theorem movingRank_bound_of_odd
    {Y H : ℕ → ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hmove : MovingRankDiagonalHypothesis Y H ε)
    {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (hcap : ∀ᶠ x in Filter.atTop, h ≤ H x) :
    ∀ᶠ x in Filter.atTop,
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤ halfExponentMajorant ε x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hmove.2, hcap] with x hx hxCap
  have hhOne : 1 ≤ h := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hodd.pos)
  have hbound := hx h hhOne hxCap
  rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: RankAmplification.theorem1_5_consecutive
statement:
theorem theorem1_5_consecutive
    {Y H : ℕ → ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hmove : MovingRankDiagonalHypothesis Y H ε)
    (hcap : ∀ᶠ x in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ H x) :
    HasConsecutiveHalfExponentBound
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ε, hmove.1, ?_⟩
  exact movingRank_bound_of_odd hmove (by norm_num : Odd 1) hcap

name: RankAmplification.hasDerivAt_logSqReciprocalPrimitive
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_logSqReciprocalPrimitive {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    HasDerivAt logSqReciprocalPrimitive (logSqReciprocalKernel t) t
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : HasDerivAt Real.log t⁻¹ t := Real.hasDerivAt_log ht.ne'
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ Real.log s ^ 2) (2 * Real.log t * t⁻¹) t := by
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ Real.log s * Real.log s)
        (t⁻¹ * Real.log t + Real.log t * t⁻¹) t := hlog.mul hlog
    have heq : t⁻¹ * Real.log t + Real.log t * t⁻¹ = 2 * Real.log t * t⁻¹ := by ring
    rw [heq] at h
    simpa only [pow_two] using h
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ 4 * Real.log s) (4 * t⁻¹) t := hlog.const_mul 4
  have hnum : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ Real.log s ^ 2 + 4 * Real.log s + 5)
      (2 * Real.log t * t⁻¹ + 4 * t⁻¹) t := (h1.add h2).add_const 5
  have hid : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ s) 1 t := hasDerivAt_id t
  have hdiv := hnum.div hid ht.ne'
  have hres := hdiv.neg
  have hval : -(((2 * Real.log t * t⁻¹ + 4 * t⁻¹) * t
      - (Real.log t ^ 2 + 4 * Real.log t + 5) * 1) / t ^ 2)
      = logSqReciprocalKernel t := by
    unfold logSqReciprocalKernel
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hval] at hres
  exact hres

name: RankAmplification.continuousOn_logSqReciprocalKernel
statement:
theorem continuousOn_logSqReciprocalKernel {s : Set ℝ} (hs : s ⊆ {(0 : ℝ)}ᶜ) :
    ContinuousOn logSqReciprocalKernel s
proof:
:= by
  unfold logSqReciprocalKernel
  refine ContinuousOn.div ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact (continuousOn_const.add (Real.continuousOn_log.mono hs)).pow 2
  · exact continuousOn_id.pow 2
  · intro t ht
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (by simpa using hs ht)

name: RankAmplification.antitoneOn_logSqReciprocalKernel
statement:
theorem antitoneOn_logSqReciprocalKernel :
    AntitoneOn logSqReciprocalKernel (Set.Ici (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs t ht hst
  have hs1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ s := hs
  have ht1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ t := ht
  have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) < s := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hs1
  have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) < t := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos ht1
  have hlogs : 0 ≤ Real.log s := Real.log_nonneg hs1
  have hkey : (1 + Real.log t) * s ≤ (1 + Real.log s) * t := by
    have hdiv : Real.log (t / s) ≤ t / s - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div ht0.ne' hs0.ne'] at hdiv
    have h1 : s * (Real.log t - Real.log s) ≤ t - s := by
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv hs0.le
      have h3 : s * (t / s - 1) = t - s := by field_simp
      linarith [h2, h3.le, h3.ge]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst) hlogs]
  have hquot : (1 + Real.log t) / t ≤ (1 + Real.log s) / s := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ ht0 hs0]
    exact hkey
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (1 + Real.log t) / t :=
    div_nonneg (by linarith [Real.log_nonneg ht1]) ht0.le
  have hsq : ((1 + Real.log t) / t) ^ 2 ≤ ((1 + Real.log s) / s) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hquot, hnn]
  unfold logSqReciprocalKernel
  rw [← div_pow, ← div_pow]
  exact hsq

name: RankAmplification.integral_logSqReciprocalKernel
statement:
theorem integral_logSqReciprocalKernel {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ t in a..b, logSqReciprocalKernel t) =
      logSqReciprocalPrimitive b - logSqReciprocalPrimitive a
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Set.uIcc a b ⊆ {(0 : ℝ)}ᶜ := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]
    intro t ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le ha ht.1
    simpa using htpos.ne'
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun t ht ↦ ?_)
    ((continuousOn_logSqReciprocalKernel hsub).intervalIntegrable)
  refine hasDerivAt_logSqReciprocalPrimitive ?_
  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at ht
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le ha ht.1

name: RankAmplification.sum_Ioc_logSqReciprocalKernel_le_primitive
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_logSqReciprocalKernel_le_primitive {y P : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc y P, logSqReciprocalKernel n) ≤
      (Real.log y ^ 2 + 4 * Real.log y + 5) / y
proof:
:= by
  have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) < y := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hlogy : 0 ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hy1
  have hstep : -logSqReciprocalPrimitive (y : ℝ)
      = (Real.log (y : ℝ) ^ 2 + 4 * Real.log y + 5) / y := by
    unfold logSqReciprocalPrimitive
    rw [neg_neg]
  rcases lt_or_ge P y with hPy | hyP
  · rw [Finset.Ioc_eq_empty (by omega)]
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
    apply div_nonneg _ hy0.le
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.log (y : ℝ) + 2)]
  · have hanti : AntitoneOn logSqReciprocalKernel (Set.Icc (y : ℝ) (P : ℝ)) := by
      refine antitoneOn_logSqReciprocalKernel.mono ?_
      intro t ht
      exact le_trans hy1 ht.1
    have hshift : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico y P, logSqReciprocalKernel ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
        = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc y P, logSqReciprocalKernel (n : ℝ) := by
      have h := Finset.sum_Ico_add' (fun n : ℕ ↦ logSqReciprocalKernel (n : ℝ)) y P 1
      have hrange : Finset.Ico (y + 1) (P + 1) = Finset.Ioc y P := by
        ext n
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_Ioc]
        omega
      rw [hrange] at h
      exact h
    have hsum := AntitoneOn.sum_le_integral_Ico hyP hanti
    rw [hshift, integral_logSqReciprocalKernel hy0 (by exact_mod_cast hyP)] at hsum
    have hPprim : logSqReciprocalPrimitive (P : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by
      have hP0 : (0 : ℝ) < P := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < P by omega)
      have hnum : 0 ≤ (Real.log (P : ℝ) ^ 2 + 4 * Real.log P + 5) / P := by
        apply div_nonneg _ hP0.le
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.log (P : ℝ) + 2)]
      unfold logSqReciprocalPrimitive
      linarith
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.sum_Ioc_logSqReciprocalKernel_le
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_logSqReciprocalKernel_le {y P : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc y P, logSqReciprocalKernel n) ≤
      5 * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 / y
proof:
:= by
  have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hlogy : 0 ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hy1
  refine (sum_Ioc_logSqReciprocalKernel_le_primitive (P := P) hy).trans ?_
  gcongr
  nlinarith [hlogy]

name: RankAmplification.sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_one_add_log_sq_le_primitive
statement:
theorem sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_one_add_log_sq_le_primitive {y P : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, (1 + Real.log p) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
      (Real.log y ^ 2 + 4 * Real.log y + 5) / y
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, logSqReciprocalKernel p) ≤
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc y P, logSqReciprocalKernel n := by
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (squareSourcePrimeRange_subset_Ioc y P) ?_
    intro n _ _
    unfold logSqReciprocalKernel
    positivity
  exact hsub.trans (sum_Ioc_logSqReciprocalKernel_le_primitive hy)

name: RankAmplification.sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_one_add_log_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_one_add_log_sq_le {y P : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, (1 + Real.log p) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
      5 * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 / y
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, logSqReciprocalKernel p) ≤
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc y P, logSqReciprocalKernel n := by
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (squareSourcePrimeRange_subset_Ioc y P) ?_
    intro n _ _
    unfold logSqReciprocalKernel
    positivity
  exact hsub.trans (sum_Ioc_logSqReciprocalKernel_le hy)

name: RankAmplification.sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_log_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_log_sq_le {y P : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, Real.log p ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
      5 * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 / y
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum ?_) (sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_one_add_log_sq_le (P := P) hy)
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨_, _, hpprime⟩ := mem_squareSourcePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hlogp : 0 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpprime.one_lt.le)
  have hnum : Real.log (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + Real.log (p : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hlogp]
  have hinv : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnum hinv

name: RankAmplification.smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_running
statement:
theorem smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_running {p X : ℕ} (hp : 3 ≤ p) :
    smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum p X ≤
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 * ((1 + Real.log p) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogp : 0 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega))
  have hbase := finiteProviderReciprocalSum_le_log p X hp
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X := by
    unfold finiteProviderReciprocalSum
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hrhs : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log p)) :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (by linarith))
  have hsq : finiteProviderReciprocalSum p X ^ 2 ≤
      ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log p))) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hbase, hnonneg, hrhs]
  have heq : ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log p))) ^ 2
      = Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 * ((1 + Real.log p) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, inv_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  exact ((smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_sq p X).trans hsq).trans (le_of_eq heq)

name: RankAmplification.section4SharpConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem section4SharpConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ section4SharpConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold section4SharpConstant
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp
statement:
theorem section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp {x y : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (_hxy : y ≤ x) :
    section4ReciprocalSum x y ≤
      section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 / (y : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  calc
    section4ReciprocalSum x y ≤
        (x : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y,
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 * ((1 + Real.log p) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
      unfold section4ReciprocalSum
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hyp, _, _⟩ := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hp
      exact smoothProviderPairReciprocalSum_le_running (by omega)
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 *
        ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x y, ((1 + Real.log p) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 * (5 * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 / y) := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg x) hC)
      exact sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_one_add_log_sq_le hy1
    _ = section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 / (y : ℝ) := by
      unfold section4SharpConstant
      ring

name: RankAmplification.section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp'
statement:
theorem section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp' {x y : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    section4ReciprocalSum x y ≤
      section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp hy hxy

name: RankAmplification.theorem1_6_paper_finite_sharp
statement:
theorem theorem1_6_paper_finite_sharp
    {x h y : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          (section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := theorem1_6_exact_finite_expanded (x := x) hodd (by omega : 0 < y) hhy
  rw [nonsquare_outer_sum_eq_section4_add_B4] at hbase
  have hreciprocal := section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp' hy hxy
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.nonsquare_outer_sum_le_sharp
statement:
theorem nonsquare_outer_sum_le_sharp {x y : ℕ} {saving : ℝ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x)
    (hRankin : HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y saving) :
    (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x * y).sqrt,
      smoothProviderPairMajorant x p ((2 * x * y) / p ^ 2)) ≤
      section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-saving) +
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsquare_outer_sum_eq_section4_add_B4]
  simpa only [add_assoc] using
    add_le_add (section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp' hy hxy)
      (smoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_exp_add_upper (by omega) hxy hRankin)

name: RankAmplification.prime_le_source_of_dvd_localTotientFactor
proof:
:= by
  have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  unfold localTotientFactor at hpdvd
  rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hpdvd with hpPow | hpPred
  · have hpq : p ∣ q := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpPow
    exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hqPrime).mp hpq |>.le
  · have hpredPos : 0 < q - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hqPrime.one_lt
    exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hpredPos hpPred).trans (Nat.sub_le q 1)

name: RankAmplification.badLocalBase_gt
statement:
theorem badLocalBase_gt {N y q : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) : y < q
proof:
:= by
  let p := largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N q)
  have hpgt : y < p := (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).2
  have hpLarge : 1 < p := hy.trans_lt hpgt
  exact hpgt.trans_le <| prime_le_source_of_dvd_localTotientFactor
    (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1 (largestPrimeFactor_prime hpLarge)
      (largestPrimeFactor_dvd hpLarge)

name: RankAmplification.source_dvd_localTotientFactor_of_two_le
statement:
theorem source_dvd_localTotientFactor_of_two_le {N q : ℕ}
    (he : 2 ≤ N.factorization q) : q ∣ localTotientFactor N q
proof:
:= by
  unfold localTotientFactor
  exact (dvd_pow_self q (by omega : N.factorization q - 1 ≠ 0)).trans
    (dvd_mul_right _ _)

name: RankAmplification.badLocalBase_dvd_totient_of_two_le
statement:
theorem badLocalBase_dvd_totient_of_two_le {N y q : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) (he : 2 ≤ N.factorization q) :
    q ∣ N.totient
proof:
:=
  (source_dvd_localTotientFactor_of_two_le he).trans <|
    localTotientFactor_dvd_totient hN (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1

name: RankAmplification.sourceExponent_pred_le_totient_factorization
statement:
theorem sourceExponent_pred_le_totient_factorization {N q : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hq : q ∈ primeSupport N) :
    N.factorization q - 1 ≤ N.totient.factorization q
proof:
:= by
  have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  apply (hqPrime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization
    (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hN)).ne').1
  have hlocal : q ^ (N.factorization q - 1) ∣ localTotientFactor N q :=
    ⟨q - 1, by simp [localTotientFactor]⟩
  exact hlocal.trans (localTotientFactor_dvd_totient hN hq)

name: RankAmplification.sourceExponent_pred_le_largePrimeRank
statement:
theorem sourceExponent_pred_le_largePrimeRank {N y q : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) :
    N.factorization q - 1 ≤ largePrimeRank y N.totient
proof:
:= by
  have hqSupport := (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1
  have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqSupport
  by_cases he : 2 ≤ N.factorization q
  · have hphi : N.totient ≠ 0 :=
      (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hN)).ne'
    have hqTotient : q ∣ N.totient :=
      badLocalBase_dvd_totient_of_two_le hN hq he
    have hmem : q ∈ (primeSupport N.totient).filter (y < ·) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mem_primeFactors]
      exact ⟨⟨hqPrime, hqTotient, hphi⟩, badLocalBase_gt hy hq⟩
    calc
      N.factorization q - 1 ≤ N.totient.factorization q :=
        sourceExponent_pred_le_totient_factorization hN hqSupport
      _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ (primeSupport N.totient).filter (y < ·),
          N.totient.factorization p := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun p hp ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hmem
      _ = largePrimeRank y N.totient := rfl
  · omega

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadLocalSourceBounds_of_mem
statement:
theorem fixedBadLocalSourceBounds_of_mem
    {N y Y J q : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hbounded : largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y)
    (hrank : largePrimeRank y N.totient < J)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) : FixedBadLocalSourceBounds N y Y J q
proof:
:= by
  have hqSupport := (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1
  have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqSupport
  have hexpPos := factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport hqSupport
  refine ⟨hqSupport, hqPrime, badLocalBase_gt hy hq, hexpPos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hpred := sourceExponent_pred_le_largePrimeRank hN hy hq
    omega
  · intro he
    exact (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hqPrime
      (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hN)).ne'
      (badLocalBase_dvd_totient_of_two_le hN hq he)).trans hbounded

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRank_badLocalSourceBounds
proof:
:= by
  have hnData := mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn
  have hnPos : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt <|
    (mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hnData.1).1
  exact fixedBadLocalSourceBounds_of_mem hnPos.ne' hy
    hnData.2.1 hnData.2.2 hq

name: RankAmplification.mem_badLinearPrimeSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_badLinearPrimeSet {N y q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ badLinearPrimeSet N y ↔
      q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y ∧ N.factorization q = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [badLinearPrimeSet]

name: RankAmplification.mem_badPowerPrimeSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_badPowerPrimeSet {N y q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet N y ↔
      q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y ∧ 2 ≤ N.factorization q
proof:
:= by
  simp [badPowerPrimeSet]

name: RankAmplification.badLinearPrimeSet_disjoint_badPowerPrimeSet
statement:
theorem badLinearPrimeSet_disjoint_badPowerPrimeSet (N y : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (badLinearPrimeSet N y) (badPowerPrimeSet N y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro q hlin hpow
  rw [mem_badLinearPrimeSet] at hlin
  rw [mem_badPowerPrimeSet] at hpow
  omega

name: RankAmplification.badLinearPrimeSet_union_badPowerPrimeSet
statement:
theorem badLinearPrimeSet_union_badPowerPrimeSet (N y : ℕ) :
    badLinearPrimeSet N y ∪ badPowerPrimeSet N y = badLocalPrimeSet N y
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_badLinearPrimeSet, mem_badPowerPrimeSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hq, _⟩ | ⟨hq, _⟩) <;> exact hq
  · intro hq
    have hpos := factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport
      (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1
    have he : N.factorization q = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ N.factorization q := by omega
    rcases he with he | he
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hq, he⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hq, he⟩

name: RankAmplification.badLocalProduct_eq_badLinearProduct_mul_badPowerProduct
statement:
theorem badLocalProduct_eq_badLinearProduct_mul_badPowerProduct (N y : ℕ) :
    badLocalProduct N y = badLinearProduct N y * badPowerProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear : badLinearProduct N y =
      ∏ q ∈ badLinearPrimeSet N y, q ^ N.factorization q := by
    unfold badLinearProduct
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro q hq
    rw [(mem_badLinearPrimeSet.mp hq).2, pow_one]
  rw [hlinear]
  unfold badLocalProduct badPowerProduct
  rw [← Finset.prod_union (badLinearPrimeSet_disjoint_badPowerPrimeSet N y),
    badLinearPrimeSet_union_badPowerPrimeSet]

name: RankAmplification.FixedBadLocalSourceBounds.primePower_le_upper_pow
statement:
theorem FixedBadLocalSourceBounds.primePower_le_upper_pow
    {N y Y J q : ℕ} (b : FixedBadLocalSourceBounds N y Y J q)
    (he : 2 ≤ N.factorization q) : q ^ N.factorization q ≤ Y ^ J
proof:
:= by
  have hYpos : 0 < Y := by
    have := b.source_gt.trans_le (b.repeated_source_le_upper he)
    omega
  calc
    q ^ N.factorization q ≤ Y ^ N.factorization q :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_left (b.repeated_source_le_upper he) _
    _ ≤ Y ^ J := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hYpos b.exponent_le_rank

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRank_badPowerProduct_le
proof:
:= by
  have hJpos : 0 < J := by
    have hcard := fixedLowRank_badLocalPrimeSet_card_lt hy hn
    omega
  have hYpos : 0 < Y := by
    have hnData := mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn
    have htotient : n.totient ≠ 0 :=
      (Nat.totient_pos.mpr <| Nat.zero_lt_of_lt <|
        (mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hnData.1).1).ne'
    have hone := one_le_largestPrimeFactor n.totient
    omega
  have hcard : (badPowerPrimeSet n y).card ≤ J := by
    have hsubset : badPowerPrimeSet n y ⊆ badLocalPrimeSet n y := by
      intro q hq
      exact (mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq).1
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsubset).trans
      (fixedLowRank_badLocalPrimeSet_card_lt hy hn).le
  calc
    badPowerProduct n y ≤ ∏ _q ∈ badPowerPrimeSet n y, Y ^ J := by
      unfold badPowerProduct
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro q hq
        exact Nat.zero_le _
      intro q hq
      exact (fixedLowRank_badLocalSourceBounds hy hn
        (mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq).1).primePower_le_upper_pow
          (mem_badPowerPrimeSet.mp hq).2
    _ = (Y ^ J) ^ (badPowerPrimeSet n y).card := by simp
    _ ≤ (Y ^ J) ^ J := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (pow_pos hYpos J) hcard
    _ = Y ^ (J ^ 2) := by rw [← pow_mul, pow_two]

name: RankAmplification.movingSourceLogThreshold_eq
statement:
theorem movingSourceLogThreshold_eq (x : ℝ) :
    movingSourceLogThreshold x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - movingSourceLoss x
proof:
:= by
  simp [movingSourceLogThreshold, movingSourceLoss]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingEtaR_isLittleO_etaL
statement: theorem movingEtaR_isLittleO_etaL : movingEtaR =o[atTop] movingEtaL
proof:
:= by
  have h := movingR_isLittleO_scaleL.mul_isBigO (isBigO_refl movingEta atTop)
  apply h.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    simp [movingEtaR, mul_comm]
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    simp [movingEtaL, mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_mul_log_two_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingJ_mul_log_two_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2) =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall :
      (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2) =O[atTop]
        (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x) := by
    apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
    filter_upwards [eventually_two_le_movingJ, eventually_log2_pos,
        tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 2)] with x hJ hL2 hlog2
    have hJ0 : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hleft : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
      mul_nonneg hJ0 (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
    have hright : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x :=
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hL2.le
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hleft, Real.norm_of_nonneg hright, one_mul]
    calc
      (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2 hJ0
      _ ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x := by
        have hJone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ movingJ x := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ movingJ x by omega)
        nlinarith
  exact hsmall.trans_isLittleO movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_mul_log_two_isLittleO_etaL
statement:
theorem movingJ_mul_log_two_isLittleO_etaL :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2) =o[atTop] movingEtaL
proof:
:=
  movingJ_mul_log_two_isLittleO_etaR.trans movingEtaR_isLittleO_etaL

name: RankAmplification.movingSourceLoss_isLittleO_etaL
statement: theorem movingSourceLoss_isLittleO_etaL : movingSourceLoss =o[atTop] movingEtaL
proof:
:= by
  have hJK := movingJ_mul_K_isLittleO_etaL.const_mul_left 2
  have hsum := hJK.add movingJ_mul_log_two_isLittleO_etaL
  apply hsum.congr_left
  intro x
  simp [movingSourceLoss]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.log3_mul_sqrt_scaleA_isLittleO_log2
statement:
theorem log3_mul_sqrt_scaleA_isLittleO_log2 :
    (fun x ↦ log3 x * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) =o[atTop] log2
proof:
:= by
  have hbig := scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.symm.isBigO.mul
    (isBigO_refl (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) atTop)
  have hlittle := hbig.trans_isLittleO scaleA_mul_sqrt_isLittleO_log2
  apply hlittle.congr'
  · exact EventuallyEq.rfl
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log3_le_eta_mul_log2_div_two
statement:
theorem eventually_log3_le_eta_mul_log2_div_two :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop, log3 x ≤ movingEta x * log2 x / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hbound :=
    log3_mul_sqrt_scaleA_isLittleO_log2.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_log3_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
      eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hbound hL3 hL2 hA
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL3.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le] at hbound
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleA x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hA
  unfold movingEta
  have hdiv : log3 x ≤ (log2 x / 2) / Real.sqrt (scaleA x) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hsqrt).2 (by nlinarith)
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hdiv

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_mul_log2_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem scaleA_mul_log2_isLittleO_scaleL :
    (fun x ↦ scaleA x * log2 x) =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:= by
  have h := scaleA_isLittleO_log2.mul_isBigO (isBigO_refl log2 atTop)
  have hsq : (fun x ↦ scaleA x * log2 x) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ log2 x ^ 2) := by
    apply h.congr_right
    intro x
    rw [pow_two]
  exact hsq.trans
    (log2_sq_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL.trans_isBigO sqrt_scaleL_isBigO_scaleL)

name: RankAmplification.eta_mul_sqrt_ratio_sq
statement:
theorem eta_mul_sqrt_ratio_sq {x : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ scaleL x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    (movingEta x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) ^ 2 =
      scaleL x / (scaleA x * log2 x)
proof:
:= by
  have hAsq : Real.sqrt (scaleA x) ^ 2 = scaleA x := Real.sq_sqrt hA.le
  have hRsq : Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) ^ 2 = scaleL x / log2 x :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hL hL2.le)
  unfold movingEta
  rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, hAsq, hRsq]
  field_simp [hA.ne', hL2.ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_three_le_eta_mul_sqrt_ratio
statement:
theorem eventually_three_le_eta_mul_sqrt_ratio :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
      3 ≤ movingEta x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := scaleA_mul_log2_isLittleO_scaleL.bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 9)
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hbound hcore
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hcore.2.2.1.le hcore.2.1.le),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hcore.1.le] at hbound
  have hprod : 9 * (scaleA x * log2 x) ≤ scaleL x := by linarith
  have hsqrtNonneg :
      0 ≤ movingEta x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) :=
    mul_nonneg hcore.2.2.2.2.1.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hsq := eta_mul_sqrt_ratio_sq hcore.1.le hcore.2.1 hcore.2.2.1
  have hden : 0 < scaleA x * log2 x := mul_pos hcore.2.2.1 hcore.2.1
  have hsqNine : 9 ≤
      (movingEta x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsq]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hden).2 hprod
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.movingSqrtRatio_mul_K_ge_quarter_L
statement:
theorem movingSqrtRatio_mul_K_ge_quarter_L {x : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x)
    (hRatio : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ movingK x / movingR x) :
    (1 / 4 : ℝ) * scaleL x ≤
      Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) * movingK x
proof:
:= by
  have hR := movingR_pos hL hL2
  have hid := scaleL_div_movingR_eq_sqrt_div hL hL2
  have hKR : (1 / 3 : ℝ) * movingR x ≤ movingK x := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hR).mp
    simpa [mul_comm] using hRatio
  rw [← hid]
  have hL0 := hL.le
  calc
    (1 / 4 : ℝ) * scaleL x ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * scaleL x := by nlinarith
    _ = (scaleL x / movingR x) * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * movingR x) := by
      field_simp [hR.ne']
    _ ≤ (scaleL x / movingR x) * movingK x :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hKR (div_nonneg hL0 hR.le)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_hasMovingSaddleMargins
statement:
theorem eventually_hasMovingSaddleMargins :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop, HasMovingSaddleMargins x
proof:
:= by
  have hloss := movingSourceLoss_isLittleO_etaL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8)
  have hKratio := tendsto_movingK_div_R_half.eventually
    (Ici_mem_nhds (show (1 / 3 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num))
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive, eventually_movingK_pos,
      eventually_movingEta_lt (1 / 8) (by norm_num), eventually_two_le_movingJ,
      eventually_log3_le_eta_mul_log2_div_two,
      eventually_three_le_eta_mul_sqrt_ratio, hloss, hKratio] with
      x hcore hK heta hJ hlog hetaRoot hloss hKratio
  have hR := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hetaPos := hcore.2.2.2.2.1
  have hetaLPos : 0 < movingEtaL x := mul_pos hetaPos hcore.1
  have hsourceLossNonneg : 0 ≤ movingSourceLoss x := by
    unfold movingSourceLoss
    positivity
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hsourceLossNonneg,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hetaLPos.le] at hloss
  have hKle : movingK x ≤ movingK0 x :=
    movingK_le_K0 hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.le
  let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hcore.1 hcore.2.1)
  have hrK : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * scaleL x ≤ r * movingK x :=
    movingSqrtRatio_mul_K_ge_quarter_L hcore.1 hcore.2.1 hKratio
  have hlossDiv : movingSourceLoss x / movingK x ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x * r := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hK).2
    have hsmall : movingSourceLoss x ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * movingEta x * scaleL x := by
      simpa [movingEtaL, mul_assoc] using hloss
    calc
      movingSourceLoss x ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * movingEta x * scaleL x := hsmall
      _ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x * r) * movingK x := by
        have hrK0 : 0 ≤ r * movingK x := (mul_pos hr hK).le
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hetaPos.le hrK0]
  have hbase : scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) ≥
      (1 + (7 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x) * r := by
    have hcoef : 0 < 1 - 4 * movingEta x := by linarith
    have h2K : 2 * movingK x ≤ (1 - 4 * movingEta x) * movingR x := by
      unfold movingK0 at hKle
      nlinarith
    have hden : 0 < 2 * movingK x := by positivity
    have hq : scaleL x / ((1 - 4 * movingEta x) * movingR x) ≤
        scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hcore.1.le hden h2K
    have heq : scaleL x / ((1 - 4 * movingEta x) * movingR x) =
        r / (1 - 4 * movingEta x) := by
      change scaleL x / ((1 - 4 * movingEta x) * movingR x) =
        Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) / (1 - 4 * movingEta x)
      rw [← scaleL_div_movingR_eq_sqrt_div hcore.1 hcore.2.1]
      field_simp [hR.ne', hcoef.ne']
    rw [heq] at hq
    have haux : (1 + (7 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x) * r ≤
        r / (1 - 4 * movingEta x) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hcoef).2
      nlinarith [mul_pos hetaPos hr]
    exact haux.trans hq
  have hvLower : (1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r ≤ movingVsrc x := by
    rw [movingVsrc_eq_sourceLog_div, movingSourceLogThreshold_eq]
    have heq : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - movingSourceLoss x) / movingK x =
        scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) - movingSourceLoss x / movingK x := by ring
    rw [heq]
    linarith
  have hlogr : Real.log r = (log2 x - log3 x) / 2 := by
    change Real.log (Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) = (log2 x - log3 x) / 2
    rw [Real.log_sqrt (div_nonneg hcore.1.le hcore.2.1.le),
      Real.log_div hcore.1.ne' hcore.2.1.ne']
    change (log2 x - log3 x) / 2 = (log2 x - log3 x) / 2
    rfl
  have hlogLower : (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x ≤ Real.log r := by
    rw [hlogr]
    nlinarith
  have hrOne : 1 < r := by
    have hlog2pos : 0 < Real.log r := by
      have hcoefPos : 0 < (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) := by linarith
      have : 0 < (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x :=
        mul_pos hcoefPos hcore.2.1
      linarith
    exact (Real.log_pos_iff hr.le).mp hlog2pos
  have hfactorOne : 1 ≤ 1 + 3 * movingEta x := by linarith
  have hrV : r ≤ movingVsrc x :=
    (le_mul_of_one_le_left hr.le hfactorOne).trans hvLower
  have hvPos : 0 < movingVsrc x := hr.trans_le hrV
  have hlogV : Real.log r ≤ Real.log (movingVsrc x) :=
    Real.log_le_log hr hrV
  have hrL2 : r * log2 x = movingR x := by
    have h := ((div_eq_iff hr.ne').mp
      (movingR_div_sqrt_div_eq_log2 hcore.1 hcore.2.1)).symm
    simpa [mul_comm] using h
  have hsaddleCoef : (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x ≤
      ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r) *
        ((1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x) := by
    have hcoeff : (1 / 2 + movingEta x) ≤
        (1 + 3 * movingEta x) * (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos hetaPos (show 0 < 1 - 3 * movingEta x by linarith)]
    calc
      (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x =
          (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * (r * log2 x) := by rw [hrL2]
      _ ≤ ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4)) *
          (r * log2 x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (mul_nonneg hr.le hcore.2.1.le)
      _ = ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r) *
          ((1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x) := by ring
  have htargetCommon : movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤
      (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x := by
    calc
      movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤ movingK0 x + 3 * movingEtaR x :=
        add_le_add hKle le_rfl
      _ = (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x := by
        simp only [movingK0, movingEtaR]
        ring
  have hsourceMargin :
      movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤
        movingVsrc x * Real.log (movingVsrc x) := by
    have hprodLower :
        ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r) *
            ((1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x) ≤
          movingVsrc x * Real.log (movingVsrc x) := by
      have hlogLower0 : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x := by
        exact (mul_pos (by linarith) hcore.2.1).le
      exact mul_le_mul hvLower (hlogLower.trans hlogV) hlogLower0 hvPos.le
    exact htargetCommon.trans (hsaddleCoef.trans hprodLower)
  have huLower : (1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r ≤ movingUtrMinus x := by
    unfold movingUtrMinus
    have hlogTwo : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hform : (scaleL x - 3 * movingK x + Real.log 2) / (2 * movingK x) ≥
        scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) - 3 / 2 := by
      field_simp [hK.ne']
      nlinarith
    have hsubtract : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x * r := by
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hrU : r ≤ movingUtrMinus x :=
    (le_mul_of_one_le_left hr.le hfactorOne).trans huLower
  have huPos : 0 < movingUtrMinus x := hr.trans_le hrU
  have hlogU : Real.log r ≤ Real.log (movingUtrMinus x) :=
    Real.log_le_log hr hrU
  have htransferMargin :
      movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤
        movingUtrMinus x * Real.log (movingUtrMinus x) := by
    have hprodLower :
        ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r) *
            ((1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x) ≤
          movingUtrMinus x * Real.log (movingUtrMinus x) := by
      have hlogLower0 : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x := by
        have hc : 0 ≤ 1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4 := by linarith
        exact mul_nonneg hc hcore.2.1.le
      exact mul_le_mul huLower (hlogLower.trans hlogU) hlogLower0 huPos.le
    exact htargetCommon.trans (hsaddleCoef.trans hprodLower)
  exact ⟨hsourceMargin, htransferMargin⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankAnalyticData_of_reducedData
statement:
theorem fixedRankAnalyticData_of_reducedData
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow εhigh : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankReducedData J ρlow εhigh) :
    FixedRankAnalyticData J
      (fixedRankLowRankConvertedError J ρlow) εhigh
      (fixedRankOffDiagonalError fixedRankB4Error)
proof:
:= by
  exact fixedRankAnalyticData_of_smoothRate data.rank_pos data.lowRank
    (fixedRankHighRankHypothesis_of_supplierMassTail
      data.rank_pos data.supplierMassTail)
    (fixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis_unconditional J data.rank_pos)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankReducedError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankReducedError_zero
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow εhigh : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankReducedData J ρlow εhigh) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankReducedError J ρlow εhigh) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_fixedRankCombinedError_zero
    (tendsto_fixedRankLowRankConvertedError_zero
      data.rank_pos data.lowRank.1)
    data.supplierMassTail.1
    (tendsto_fixedRankOffDiagonalError_zero
      tendsto_fixedRankB4Error_zero)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_theorem10_14_of_reducedData
statement:
theorem fixedRank_theorem10_14_of_reducedData
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow εhigh : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankReducedData J ρlow εhigh) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
            (fixedRankReducedError J ρlow εhigh) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [fixedRankReducedError] using
    fixedRank_theorem10_14
      (fixedRankAnalyticData_of_reducedData data)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_reducedData
statement:
theorem fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_reducedData
    {J : ℕ} {ρlow εhigh : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : FixedRankReducedData J ρlow εhigh) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x → Odd h →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankExponentialMajorant J
          (fixedRankReducedError J ρlow εhigh) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [fixedRankReducedError] using
    fixedRank_odd_shift_bound_of_analyticData
      (fixedRankAnalyticData_of_reducedData data)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankExponentialMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedRankExponentialMajorant_nonneg (J : ℕ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ fixedRankExponentialMajorant J ε x
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.odd_bound
statement:
theorem FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.odd_bound
    {J : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (estimate : FixedRankDiagonalEstimate J ε C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x → Odd h →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        C * fixedRankExponentialMajorant J ε x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [estimate.bound] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy hodd
  simpa [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd] using hx h hh hhy

name: RankAmplification.eventually_abs_le_one_of_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem eventually_abs_le_one_of_tendsto_zero
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0)) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, |ε x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hε 1 (by norm_num)
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N, fun x hx ↦ hx⟩] with x hx
  have hdist := hN x hx
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hdist.le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_error_mul_scaleV_le_margin_scaleG
statement:
theorem eventually_error_mul_scaleV_le_margin_scaleG
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0))
    {margin : ℝ} (hmargin : 0 < margin) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ margin * scaleG (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hVreal : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      scaleV x ≤ margin * scaleG x := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      (eventually_const_mul_scaleV_le_margin_scaleG (c := 1) hmargin)
  have hVnat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hVreal
  have hpositive : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hreal : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 0 ≤ scaleV x := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
      exact (scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA)).le
    exact (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hreal
  filter_upwards [eventually_abs_le_one_of_tendsto_zero hε, hVnat, hpositive] with
      x hεone hV hVnonneg
  calc
    ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ |ε x| * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hVnonneg
    _ ≤ 1 * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hεone hVnonneg
    _ ≤ margin * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by simpa using hV

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRank_exponent_le_coefficient
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRank_exponent_le_coefficient
    {J : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0))
    {B : ℝ} (hB : B < Real.sqrt J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) + ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
        -B * scaleG (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmargin : 0 < Real.sqrt J - B := sub_pos.mpr hB
  filter_upwards [eventually_error_mul_scaleV_le_margin_scaleG hε hmargin] with x hx
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankMajorant_le_coefficient
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankMajorant_le_coefficient
    {J : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0))
    {B : ℝ} (hB : B < Real.sqrt J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankExponentialMajorant J ε x ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B * scaleG (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRank_exponent_le_coefficient hε hB] with x hx
  unfold fixedRankExponentialMajorant
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hx) (Nat.cast_nonneg x)

name: RankAmplification.FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.uniform_odd_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.uniform_odd_coefficient_bound
    {J : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ} {C B : ℝ}
    (estimate : FixedRankDiagonalEstimate J ε C)
    (hB : B < Real.sqrt J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x → Odd h →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        C * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B * scaleG (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [estimate.odd_bound,
    eventually_fixedRankMajorant_le_coefficient estimate.error_tendsto hB] with x hx hmajor
  intro h hh hhy hodd
  exact (hx h hh hhy hodd).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmajor estimate.constant_nonneg)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixed_shift_le_fixedRankNatY
statement:
theorem eventually_fixed_shift_le_fixedRankNatY
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) (h : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x
proof:
:=
  (tendsto_fixedRankNatY_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop h

name: RankAmplification.FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.fixed_odd_shift_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.fixed_odd_shift_coefficient_bound
    {J : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ} {C B : ℝ}
    (estimate : FixedRankDiagonalEstimate J ε C)
    (hB : B < Real.sqrt J) {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hodd : Odd h) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        C * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B * scaleG (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have huniform := estimate.uniform_odd_coefficient_bound hB
  filter_upwards [huniform,
    eventually_fixed_shift_le_fixedRankNatY J estimate.rank_pos h] with x hx hhy
  exact hx h hh hhy hodd

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingB4UpperError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingB4UpperError_zero :
    Tendsto movingB4UpperError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 8 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hsum := hconst.add tendsto_movingSmallCofactorError_zero
  have hLnat : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos
  have heq : (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 8 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
      movingSmallCofactorError x) =ᶠ[atTop] movingB4UpperError := by
    filter_upwards [hLnat] with x hL
    unfold movingSmallCofactorError movingB4UpperError
    rw [← add_div]
    congr 1
    rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (8 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (by nlinarith : 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0)]
    congr 1
    ring
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum.congr' heq

name: RankAmplification.eventually_section5Ambient_log_bound
statement:
theorem eventually_section5Ambient_log_bound :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) ≤
        4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with x hadmissible
  have hx : 1 ≤ x := by
    exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
        (hadmissible.y_le_Z.trans hadmissible.Z_le_x)
  have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hambPos : (0 : ℝ) < section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    have hZ : 0 < movingNatZ x :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <| hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_Z
    positivity
  have hambLeNat : section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    calc
      2 * x * movingNatZ x ≤ 2 * x * x :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * x) hadmissible.Z_le_x
      _ = 2 * x ^ 2 := by ring
  have hambLe : (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hambLeNat
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hambPos hambLe
  have hmodel : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      Real.log 2 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast (show x ≠ 0 by omega))),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    norm_num
  rw [hmodel] at hlog
  have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingB4Upper_le
statement:
theorem eventually_movingB4Upper_le :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant movingB4UpperError x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility,
    eventually_movingNatZ_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg_K,
    eventually_section5Ambient_log_bound,
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with
      x hadmissible hzinv hlog heta
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <| hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_Z
  have hupper := smoothMultiplierB4Upper_le hZpos hadmissible.Z_le_x
  have hfactorNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 +
      Real.log (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) := by
    have hambOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) by
        unfold section5Ambient
        have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <|
          hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
            (hadmissible.y_le_Z.trans hadmissible.Z_le_x)
        positivity)
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hambOne]
  have hbound : smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (movingNatZ x) ≤
      16 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) *
        (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (movingNatZ x) ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) *
            (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ)) *
            (movingNatZ x : ℝ)⁻¹ := hupper
      _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) *
          (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ)) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ))) := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ))) := by
        gcongr
      _ = 16 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by ring
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Upper x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        16 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hbound
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant movingB4UpperError x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant movingB4UpperError
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta.ne', Real.exp_add,
        Real.exp_log (by
          have hx : 1 ≤ x := by
            exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
              hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
                (hadmissible.y_le_Z.trans hadmissible.Z_le_x)
          have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
            Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hx)
          positivity : 0 < 16 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate_zero
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x ↦ max (ρ x) (movingB4UpperError x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using hρ.max tendsto_movingB4UpperError_zero
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  unfold movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate
  simpa only [zero_add] using hmax.add hconst

name: RankAmplification.sum_intermediate_upper_majorants_le
statement:
theorem sum_intermediate_upper_majorants_le
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :
    movingExponentialMajorant ρ x +
        movingExponentialMajorant movingB4UpperError x ≤
      movingExponentialMajorant (movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate ρ) x
proof:
:= by
  let M := max (ρ x) (movingB4UpperError x)
  have hmono (e : ℝ) (he : e ≤ M) :
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + e * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he heta.le
    linarith
  have hmid : movingExponentialMajorant ρ x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold movingExponentialMajorant
    exact hmono (ρ x) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hupper : movingExponentialMajorant movingB4UpperError x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold movingExponentialMajorant
    exact hmono (movingB4UpperError x) (le_max_right _ _)
  calc
    movingExponentialMajorant ρ x +
        movingExponentialMajorant movingB4UpperError x ≤
        2 * ((x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) := by
      linarith
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant (movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate ρ) x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate M
      rw [show (max (ρ x) (movingB4UpperError x) +
          Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
          max (ρ x) (movingB4UpperError x) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
            Real.log 2 by rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta.ne']]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [show -movingK (x : ℝ) +
            (max (ρ x) (movingB4UpperError x) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
              Real.log 2) =
            (-movingK (x : ℝ) + max (ρ x) (movingB4UpperError x) *
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) + Real.log 2 by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.movingB4Estimate_of_intermediateEstimate
statement:
theorem movingB4Estimate_of_intermediateEstimate
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hmid : MovingB4IntermediateEstimate ρ) :
    MovingB4Estimate (movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingB4ErrorOfIntermediate_zero hmid.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hmid.2, eventually_movingB4Upper_le,
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hmidX hupper heta
  rw [smoothMultiplierB4Sum_eq_intermediate_add_upper]
  exact (add_le_add hmidX hupper).trans <|
    sum_intermediate_upper_majorants_le (ρ := ρ) (x := x) heta

name: RankAmplification.movingUtrFloorMinus_eq
statement:
theorem movingUtrFloorMinus_eq (x : ℝ) :
    movingUtrFloorMinus x = movingUtrMinus x - Real.log 2 / (2 * movingK x)
proof:
:= by
