  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingUtrFloorMinus_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingUtrFloorMinus_atTop :
    Tendsto movingUtrFloorMinus atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log 2 / (2 * movingK x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hden : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 2 * movingK x) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_movingK_atTop.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden
  have hsum := tendsto_movingUtrMinus_atTop.atTop_add hdiff.neg
  apply hsum.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [movingUtrFloorMinus_eq]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.eventually_three_movingNatZ_cube_lt_two_x
statement:
theorem eventually_three_movingNatZ_cube_lt_two_x :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 3 * movingNatZ x ^ 3 < 2 * x
proof:
:= by
  have hreal := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_movingAdmissibility
  filter_upwards [hreal] with x hx
  have hz : (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) :=
    movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x
  have hcube : 3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ 3 < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ 3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        gcongr
      _ < 2 * (x : ℝ) := hx.three_mul_Z_cube_lt_two_mul_x
  exact_mod_cast hcube

name: RankAmplification.half_real_div_le_nat_div
statement:
theorem half_real_div_le_nat_div {W d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d ≤ W) :
    (W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ) ≤ (W / d : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 < W / d := Nat.div_pos hdW hd
  have hlt : W < d * (W / d + 1) := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ W hd
  have hqSucc : W / d + 1 ≤ 2 * (W / d) := by omega
  have hWle : (W : ℝ) ≤ (2 * d * (W / d) : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (hlt.le.trans <| by
      calc
        d * (W / d + 1) ≤ d * (2 * (W / d)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d hqSucc
        _ = 2 * d * (W / d) := by ring)
  have hdReal : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * d : ℕ) := by positivity
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hdReal).2
  norm_num at hWle ⊢
  simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hWle

name: RankAmplification.movingB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three
statement:
theorem movingB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three
    {x p : ℕ} (hcube : 3 * movingNatZ x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x)) :
    3 ≤ section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x := by
    by_contra hZ
    have hZ0 : movingNatZ x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hZ
    rw [hZ0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    omega
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hpSq : p ^ 2 ≤ movingNatZ x ^ 4 := by
    calc
      p ^ 2 ≤ (movingNatZ x ^ 2) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hpData.2 2
      _ = movingNatZ x ^ 4 := by ring
  have hthree : 3 * p ^ 2 ≤ section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    have hmul : 3 * movingNatZ x ^ 4 < 2 * x * movingNatZ x := by
      calc
        3 * movingNatZ x ^ 4 = (3 * movingNatZ x ^ 3) * movingNatZ x := by ring
        _ < (2 * x) * movingNatZ x :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcube hZpos
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hpSq).trans hmul.le
  exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (pow_pos hpPos 2)).2 hthree

name: RankAmplification.movingB4Intermediate_finite_domain
statement:
theorem movingB4Intermediate_finite_domain
    {x p : ℕ} (hZtwo : 2 ≤ movingNatZ x)
    (hcube : 3 * movingNatZ x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x)) :
    0 < section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p ∧ 3 ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  exact ⟨(by
    have := movingB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three hcube hp
    omega), (by omega)⟩

name: RankAmplification.log_movingNatZ_le_movingK
statement:
theorem log_movingNatZ_le_movingK {x : ℕ} (hZ : 0 < movingNatZ x) :
    Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ movingK (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hz := movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hZ) hz
  simpa only [log_movingZ] using hlog

name: RankAmplification.movingB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower
statement:
theorem movingB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower
    {x p : ℕ} (hcube : 3 * movingNatZ x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x)) :
    scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingK (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := movingNatZ x
  let W := section5Ambient x Z
  let d := p ^ 2
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hpZsq : p ≤ Z ^ 2 := by simpa [Z] using hpData.2
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := by
    by_contra hZ
    have hZ0 : Z = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hZ
    rw [hZ0] at hpZsq
    simp at hpZsq
    omega
  have hdPos : 0 < d := pow_pos hpPos 2
  have hdW : d ≤ W := by
    exact Nat.le_sqrt'.mp hpRange.2.1
  have hhalf := half_real_div_le_nat_div hdPos hdW
  have hWpos : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hdPos.trans_le hdW
  have hhalfPos : (0 : ℝ) < (W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ) :=
    div_pos hWpos (by positivity)
  have hlogHalf : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ)) ≤
      Real.log (W / d : ℕ) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hhalf
  have hlogP : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (Z : ℝ) := by
    have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ (Z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
    simpa [Real.log_pow, hZpos.ne'] using h
  have hlogZK : Real.log (Z : ℝ) ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    log_movingNatZ_le_movingK hZpos
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by
    have : 3 * Z ^ 3 < 2 * x := hcube
    omega
  have hmodel : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ)) =
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) - 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hW : W = 2 * x * Z := rfl
    have hneW : (W : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [W, section5Ambient, hxPos.ne', hZpos.ne']
    have hned : ((2 * d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [Real.log_div hneW hned]
    simp only [W, d, section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat,
      Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [Real.log_mul
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'))
      (by exact_mod_cast hZpos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast hpPos.ne')),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    ring
  rw [hmodel] at hlogHalf
  have hlogHalf' : scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) -
      2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p : ℝ) := by
    simpa [W, d, Z, section5LocalCutoff] using hlogHalf
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.movingUtrFloorMinus_le_rankinU
statement:
theorem movingUtrFloorMinus_le_rankinU
    {x p : ℕ} (hK : 0 < movingK (x : ℝ))
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingK (x : ℝ))
    (hcube : 3 * movingNatZ x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x)) :
    movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ) ≤
      rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x := by
    by_contra hZ
    have hZ0 : movingNatZ x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hZ
    rw [hZ0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    omega
  have hlogp : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * movingK (x : ℝ) := by
    have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
    rw [Real.log_pow] at h
    exact h.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (log_movingNatZ_le_movingK hZpos) (by norm_num)
  have hlogX := movingB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower hcube hp
  have hden : 0 < 2 * movingK (x : ℝ) := by positivity
  unfold movingUtrFloorMinus rankinU
  have hfirst : (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingK (x : ℝ)) /
      (2 * movingK (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingK (x : ℝ)) / Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hlogpPos hlogp
  exact hfirst.trans <| div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogX hlogpPos.le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingB4Intermediate_lowerRankin
statement:
theorem eventually_movingB4Intermediate_lowerRankin :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x),
      0 < section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p ∧
      3 ≤ p ∧
      movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ) ≤
        rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p
proof:
:= by
  have hKnat : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_movingK_pos
  have hnum : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingK (x : ℝ) := by
    have hsmall := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
    have hnat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hsmall
    have hLnat : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
      (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 0
    filter_upwards [hnat, hLnat, hKnat] with x hsmall hL hK
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL] at hsmall
    linarith
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_movingNatZ_cube_lt_two_x, hKnat, hnum,
    eventually_two_le_movingNatZ] with x hcube hK hnumX hZtwo
  intro p hp
  exact ⟨(movingB4Intermediate_finite_domain hZtwo hcube hp).1,
    (movingB4Intermediate_finite_domain hZtwo hcube hp).2,
    movingUtrFloorMinus_le_rankinU hK hnumX hcube hp⟩

name: RankAmplification.mul_log_sub_mul_log_le
statement:
theorem mul_log_sub_mul_log_le
    {a b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hab : b ≤ a) :
    a * Real.log a - b * Real.log b ≤ (a - b) * (Real.log a + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbpos : 0 < b := zero_lt_one.trans_le hb
  have hapos : 0 < a := hbpos.trans_le hab
  have hratio : 0 < a / b := div_pos hapos hbpos
  have hlogRatio : Real.log (a / b) ≤ a / b - 1 :=
    Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hratio
  have hmul : b * Real.log (a / b) ≤ a - b := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogRatio hbpos.le
    field_simp [hbpos.ne'] at this
    linarith
  have hlogDiv : Real.log (a / b) = Real.log a - Real.log b :=
    Real.log_div hapos.ne' hbpos.ne'
  rw [hlogDiv] at hmul
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingUtrMinus_le_plus
statement:
theorem eventually_movingUtrMinus_le_plus :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, movingUtrMinus x ≤ movingUtrPlus x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive,
    eventually_movingK_pos] with x hcore hK
  unfold movingUtrMinus movingUtrPlus
  have hL := hcore.1
  have hlogTwo : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  field_simp [hK.ne']
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_floorMinus_mul_log_ge_minus_one
statement:
theorem eventually_floorMinus_mul_log_ge_minus_one :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      movingUtrMinus x * Real.log (movingUtrMinus x) - 1 ≤
        movingUtrFloorMinus x * Real.log (movingUtrFloorMinus x)
proof:
:= by
  have hfloorTwo : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 2 ≤ movingUtrFloorMinus x :=
    tendsto_movingUtrFloorMinus_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [hfloorTwo, eventually_movingUtrMinus_le_plus,
    eventually_log_movingUtrPlus_le_half_K,
    tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 2,
    eventually_movingK_pos] with x hfloor hminusPlus hlogPlus hKtwo hK
  let a := movingUtrMinus x
  let b := movingUtrFloorMinus x
  have hb : 1 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; linarith
  have hdNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 / (2 * movingK x) := by positivity
  have hab : b ≤ a := by
    dsimp [a, b]
    linarith [movingUtrFloorMinus_eq x]
  have hcont := mul_log_sub_mul_log_le hb hab
  have hloga : Real.log a ≤ movingK x / 2 := by
    have hapos : 0 < a := (zero_lt_one.trans_le hb).trans_le hab
    have hplusPos : 0 < movingUtrPlus x := hapos.trans_le hminusPlus
    have h := (Real.log_le_log hapos hminusPlus).trans hlogPlus
    linarith
  have hdiff : a - b = Real.log 2 / (2 * movingK x) := by
    have heq : movingUtrFloorMinus x =
        movingUtrMinus x - Real.log 2 / (2 * movingK x) :=
      movingUtrFloorMinus_eq x
    change movingUtrMinus x - movingUtrFloorMinus x =
      Real.log 2 / (2 * movingK x)
    linarith only [heq]
  have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  have herr : (a - b) * (Real.log a + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hdiff]
    have hlogLower : 0 ≤ Real.log a := Real.log_nonneg (hb.trans hab)
    have hden : 0 < 2 * movingK x := by positivity
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    have hmul : Real.log 2 * (Real.log a + 1) ≤ 2 * movingK x := by
      calc
        Real.log 2 * (Real.log a + 1) ≤ 1 * (movingK x / 2 + 1) := by
          gcongr
        _ ≤ 2 * movingK x := by nlinarith
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hmul
  dsimp [a, b] at hcont ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_floorMinus_saddle_margin
statement:
theorem eventually_floorMinus_saddle_margin :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingK (x : ℝ) + 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≤
        movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ) * Real.log (movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsaddle := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_hasMovingSaddleMargins
  have hfloor := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_floorMinus_mul_log_ge_minus_one
  filter_upwards [hsaddle, hfloor,
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hsaddleX hfloorX heta
  linarith [hsaddleX.2]

name: RankAmplification.movingUtrFloorPlus_eq
statement:
theorem movingUtrFloorPlus_eq {x : ℝ} (hK : movingK x - Real.log 2 ≠ 0) :
    movingUtrFloorPlus x =
      (scaleL x + movingK x + Real.log 2) /
          (movingK x - Real.log 2) - 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingUtrFloorPlus
  field_simp [hK]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_le_movingUtrFloorPlus
statement:
theorem rankinU_le_movingUtrFloorPlus
    {x p : ℕ}
    (hKlog : Real.log 2 < movingK (x : ℝ))
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2)
    (hZlower : movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (movingNatZ x : ℝ))
    (hcube : 3 * movingNatZ x ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x)) :
    rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p ≤
      movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := movingNatZ x
  let W := section5Ambient x Z
  let d := p ^ 2
  let X := section5LocalCutoff x Z p
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hZpos : 0 < Z := by
    by_contra hZ
    have hZ0 : Z = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hZ
    have hpZ : p ≤ Z ^ 2 := by simpa [Z] using hpData.2
    rw [hZ0] at hpZ
    simp at hpZ
    omega
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by
    have hthree := movingB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three hcube hp
    simpa [X, Z] using (show 0 < section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p by omega)
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hlogZlower : movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (Z : ℝ) := by
    have hhalfPos : 0 < movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
      div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hZlower
    have hmodel : Real.log (movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2) =
        movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 := by
      rw [movingZ, Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero _) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
        Real.log_exp]
    rw [hmodel] at hlog
    simpa [Z] using hlog
  have hlogpLower : movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hZp : (Z : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpRange.1.le
    exact hlogZlower.trans (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hZpos) hZp)
  have hXcast : (X : ℝ) ≤ (W : ℝ) / d := by
    simpa [X, W, Z, d, section5LocalCutoff, div_eq_mul_inv] using
      (section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x Z p)
  have hlogX : Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((W : ℝ) / d) := by
    exact Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hXpos) hXcast
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hmodel : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / d) =
      Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (Z : ℝ) -
        2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hWne : (W : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [W, section5Ambient, hxPos.ne', hZpos.ne']
    have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [d, hpPos.ne']
    rw [Real.log_div hWne hdne]
    simp only [W, Z, d, section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [Real.log_mul
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'))
      (by exact_mod_cast hZpos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    ring
  have hlogZupper : Real.log (Z : ℝ) ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa [Z] using log_movingNatZ_le_movingK (x := x) (by simpa [Z] using hZpos)
  rw [hmodel] at hlogX
  have hlogX' : Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 -
        2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hdenPos : 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 := sub_pos.mpr hKlog
  unfold rankinU
  rw [movingUtrFloorPlus_eq hdenPos.ne']
  have hfirst : Real.log (X : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
          Real.log (p : ℝ) - 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogpPos).2
    have := hlogX'
    field_simp [hlogpPos.ne']
    linarith
  have hsecond :
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
          Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) /
          (movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hdenPos hlogpLower
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingUtrFloorPlus_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingUtrFloorPlus_atTop :
    Tendsto movingUtrFloorPlus atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hKsmall := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  have hquot := tendsto_scaleL_div_movingK_atTop
  have hquot2 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ (scaleL x / movingK x) / 2) atTop atTop :=
    by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
        hquot.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  refine Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop ?_ hquot2
  filter_upwards [hKsmall, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_movingK_pos,
    tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2)] with
      x hsmall hL hK hKlog
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hsmall
  have hden : 0 < movingK x - Real.log 2 := by
    have hlogTwo : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hnum : scaleL x / 2 ≤ scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2 := by
    have hlogTwo : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hdenLe : movingK x - Real.log 2 ≤ movingK x := sub_le_self _
    (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  unfold movingUtrFloorPlus
  have hfirst : scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) ≤
      (scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2) / movingK x := by
    simpa [div_div] using div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hK.le
  have hnumNonneg : 0 ≤ scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2 := by
    linarith
  have hsecond := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnumNonneg hden hdenLe
  calc
    scaleL x / movingK x / 2 = scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) := by ring
    _ ≤ (scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2) / movingK x := hfirst
    _ ≤ (scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2) /
        (movingK x - Real.log 2) := hsecond

name: RankAmplification.movingUtrFloorPlus_isBigO_scaleL_div_K
statement:
theorem movingUtrFloorPlus_isBigO_scaleL_div_K :
    movingUtrFloorPlus =O[atTop] (fun x ↦ scaleL x / movingK x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 4
  have hKsmall := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  filter_upwards [hKsmall, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_movingK_pos,
    tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2)] with
      x hsmall hL hK hKlog
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hsmall
  have hlogTwo : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hden : movingK x / 2 ≤ movingK x - Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have hdenPos : 0 < movingK x - Real.log 2 := by
    have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hnumNonneg : 0 ≤ scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have hnumLe : scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2 ≤ 2 * scaleL x := by
    have hKlarge : 3 * Real.log 2 ≤ movingK x + scaleL x := by linarith
    linarith
  have hbound : movingUtrFloorPlus x ≤ 4 * (scaleL x / movingK x) := by
    unfold movingUtrFloorPlus
    calc
      (scaleL x - movingK x + 3 * Real.log 2) /
          (movingK x - Real.log 2) ≤
          (2 * scaleL x) / (movingK x - Real.log 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnumLe hdenPos.le
      _ ≤ (2 * scaleL x) / (movingK x / 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) hden
      _ = 4 * (scaleL x / movingK x) := by field_simp [hK.ne']; ring
  have hplusNonneg : 0 ≤ movingUtrFloorPlus x := by
    unfold movingUtrFloorPlus
    positivity
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hplusNonneg,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hL.le hK.le)]
  exact hbound

name: RankAmplification.movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_movingK
statement:
theorem movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_movingK :
    movingUtrFloorPlus =o[atTop] movingK
proof:
:=
  (movingUtrFloorPlus_isBigO_scaleL_div_K.trans
      scaleL_div_movingK_isBigO_sqrt_ratio).trans_isLittleO
    (sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_isLittleO_movingR.trans_isBigO movingR_isBigO_movingK)

name: RankAmplification.movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_etaR :
    movingUtrFloorPlus =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:=
  (movingUtrFloorPlus_isBigO_scaleL_div_K.trans
      scaleL_div_movingK_isBigO_sqrt_ratio).trans_isLittleO
    sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.log_movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_movingK
statement:
theorem log_movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_movingK :
    (fun x ↦ Real.log (movingUtrFloorPlus x)) =o[atTop] movingK
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.comp_tendsto tendsto_movingUtrFloorPlus_atTop
  have hlog' : (fun x ↦ Real.log (movingUtrFloorPlus x)) =o[atTop]
      movingUtrFloorPlus := by simpa [Function.comp_def] using hlog
  exact hlog'.trans movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_movingK

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_movingUtrFloorPlus_le_third_K
statement:
theorem eventually_log_movingUtrFloorPlus_le_third_K :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.log (movingUtrFloorPlus x) ≤ movingK x / 3
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := log_movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_movingK.bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_movingK_pos,
    tendsto_movingUtrFloorPlus_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hbound hK hplus
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hplus), Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le] at hbound
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem eventually_movingB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x),
      rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p ≤ Real.sqrt p
proof:
:= by
  have hlogPlus := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_log_movingUtrFloorPlus_le_third_K
  have hKlog : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, Real.log 2 < movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_movingK_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop _
  have hnum : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_moving_core_positive,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_movingK_pos] with x hc hK
    exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg hc.1.le hK.le)
      (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  have hKlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      movingK (x : ℝ) / 3 ≤ (movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2 := by
    have h := (tendsto_movingK_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop (3 * Real.log 2)
    filter_upwards [h] with x hx
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hx
    linarith
  have hplusOne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_movingUtrFloorPlus_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingZ_half_le_natZ,
    eventually_three_movingNatZ_cube_lt_two_x, hlogPlus, hKlog, hnum, hKlarge,
    hplusOne] with x hZlower hcube hlogPlusX hKlogX hnumX hKlargeX hplusOneX
  intro p hp
  have hu := rankinU_le_movingUtrFloorPlus hKlogX hnumX hZlower hcube hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x := by
    by_contra hZ
    have hZ0 : movingNatZ x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hZ
    rw [hZ0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    omega
  have hlogpLower : movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hhalfPos : 0 < movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2 :=
      div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)
    have hlogZ := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hZlower
    have hmodel : Real.log (movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2) =
        movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 := by
      rw [movingZ, Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero _) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
        Real.log_exp]
    rw [hmodel] at hlogZ
    have hZp : (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpRange.1.le
    exact hlogZ.trans (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hZpos) hZp)
  have hplusPos : 0 < movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) :=
    zero_lt_one.trans_le hplusOneX
  have hplusExp : movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 3) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log hplusPos]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogPlusX
  have hexp : Real.exp ((movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt p := by
    calc
      Real.exp ((movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) / 2) ≤
          Real.exp (Real.log (p : ℝ) / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = Real.sqrt p := by rw [Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.pos)]
  exact hu.trans <| hplusExp.trans <| (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hKlargeX).trans hexp

name: RankAmplification.movingB4ErrorConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem movingB4ErrorConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ movingB4ErrorConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingB4ErrorConstant
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le primeCountingConstant_pos.le)
    (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 2).le
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|)) (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingB4RankinError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingB4RankinError_zero :
    Tendsto movingB4RankinError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := log2_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    exact h.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hZ : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_three_mul_movingZ_sq_div_etaR_tendsto_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hu : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    movingUtrFloorPlus_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hsum := (hL2.add hZ).add hu
  have hscaled := hsum.const_mul movingB4ErrorConstant
  have heq : (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingB4ErrorConstant *
      (log2 (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) =ᶠ[atTop]
      movingB4RankinError := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x heta
    unfold movingB4RankinError
    field_simp [heta.ne']
  simpa only [zero_add, mul_zero] using hscaled.congr' heq

name: RankAmplification.log2_three_mul_prime_le_movingZ_sq
statement:
theorem log2_three_mul_prime_le_movingZ_sq
    {x p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x)) :
    log2 (3 * (p : ℝ)) ≤ log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast
    (mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1).2.2.pos
  have hpLeNat : p ≤ movingNatZ x ^ 2 := hpData.2
  have hZLe : (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) :=
    movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x
  have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (p : ℝ) ≤ (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpLeNat
      _ ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have harg : 3 * (p : ℝ) ≤ 3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast
    (mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1).2.2.two_le
  have hleftOne : (1 : ℝ) < 3 * p := by nlinarith
  have hlogLeft : 0 < Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ)) := Real.log_pos hleftOne
  have hlogFirst := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 3 * p) harg
  unfold log2 iteratedLog
  exact Real.log_le_log hlogLeft hlogFirst

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_div_log_le_floorPlus
statement:
theorem rankinU_div_log_le_floorPlus
    {x p : ℕ}
    (hu3 : 3 ≤ rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p)
    (huplus : rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p ≤
      movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) :
    rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p /
        Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p) ≤
      movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let u := rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) p
  have huPos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hu3
  have hlogOne : 1 ≤ Real.log u := by
    have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ u := Real.exp_one_lt_three.le.trans hu3
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hexp
    simpa using this
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log u := zero_lt_one.trans_le hlogOne
  have hself : u / Real.log u ≤ u := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogPos).2
    nlinarith
  exact hself.trans huplus

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_moving
statement:
theorem eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_moving :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x),
      fullPaperDivisorError p (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) ≤
        movingB4RankinError x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := eventually_movingB4Intermediate_lowerRankin
  have hupper := eventually_movingB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt
  have hfloorThree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 3 ≤ movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_movingUtrFloorMinus_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 3
  have hL2one : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  have hZlogNonneg : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 ≤ log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have hK := (tendsto_movingK_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
    filter_upwards [hK] with x hKx
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hKx
    rw [log2_eq, log_three_mul_movingZ_sq]
    exact Real.log_nonneg (by
      have hlogThree : 0 < Real.log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      linarith)
  have heta := eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [hlower, hupper, hfloorThree, hL2one, hZlogNonneg, heta,
    eventually_movingZ_half_le_natZ, eventually_three_movingNatZ_cube_lt_two_x,
    (tendsto_movingK_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop (Real.log 2),
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x hlowerX hupperX hfloorThreeX hL2oneX hZnonneg hetaX hZlower hcube hKlog hcore
  intro p hp
  let X := section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p
  let u := rankinU X p
  have huLower := (hlowerX p hp).2.2
  have hu3 : 3 ≤ u := hfloorThreeX.trans huLower
  have hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
    have hKpos : 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) :=
      (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).trans hKlog
    exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg hcore.1.le hKpos.le)
      (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  have huFloor : u ≤ movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa [u, X] using rankinU_le_movingUtrFloorPlus hKlog hnum hZlower hcube hp
  have huDiv := rankinU_div_log_le_floorPlus hu3 huFloor
  have hlogP := log2_three_mul_prime_le_movingZ_sq hp
  have herrCore :
      Real.exp 2 *
          (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * u / Real.log u ≤
        (Real.exp 2 * (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) + 3) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
            movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hfloorNonneg : 0 ≤ movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) :=
      (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num).trans (hu3.trans huFloor)
    have hsumNonneg : 0 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) +
        log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) + movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) := by
      positivity
    have hlogTerm : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) -
        Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
        (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
            movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hbase : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) -
          Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
          log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := by
        have hlogP' : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
            log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
          simpa [log2, iteratedLog] using hlogP
        linarith [neg_le_abs (Real.log (Real.log 2))]
      have habs : |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤
          |Real.log (Real.log 2)| * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log (Real.log 2))]
      have hzS : log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
          log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
            movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) := by linarith
      have hxS : log2 (x : ℝ) ≤
          log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
            movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) := by linarith
      have habsS : |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤
          |Real.log (Real.log 2)| *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
              movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) :=
        habs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxS (abs_nonneg _))
      calc
        Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
            log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := hbase
        _ ≤ (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
              movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) +
            |Real.log (Real.log 2)| *
              (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
                movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := add_le_add hzS habsS
        _ = (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
              movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := by ring
    have huTerm : 3 * u / Real.log u ≤
        3 * (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
          movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        3 * u / Real.log u = 3 * (u / Real.log u) := by ring
        _ ≤ 3 * movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num)
        _ ≤ 3 * (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
            movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := by nlinarith
    calc
      Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * u / Real.log u ≤
          Real.exp 2 * ((1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
              movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ))) +
            3 * (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
              movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogTerm (Real.exp_pos 2).le) huTerm
      _ = (Real.exp 2 * (1 + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) + 3) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
            movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := by ring
  have hrhs : movingB4ErrorConstant / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) *
      (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
        movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
      movingB4ErrorConstant *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) + log2 (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ 2) +
          movingUtrFloorPlus (x : ℝ)) := by
    field_simp [hetaX.ne']
  rw [movingB4RankinError, hrhs]
  unfold fullPaperDivisorError fullULogUPrimeError
  have hmult := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herrCore
    (mul_nonneg divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le primeCountingConstant_pos.le)
  simpa [movingB4ErrorConstant, X, u, mul_assoc] using hmult

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingB4Intermediate_pointwise
statement:
theorem eventually_movingB4Intermediate_pointwise :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x),
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p
          (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) ≤
        (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := eventually_movingB4Intermediate_lowerRankin
  have hupper := eventually_movingB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt
  have herr := eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_moving
  have hsaddle := eventually_floorMinus_saddle_margin
  have hfloorThree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 3 ≤ movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_movingUtrFloorMinus_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 3
  have herrOne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, movingB4RankinError x ≤ 1 :=
    tendsto_movingB4RankinError_zero.eventually (Iic_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hetaPos := eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [hlower, hupper, herr, hsaddle, hfloorThree, herrOne, hetaPos] with
      x hlowerX hupperX herrX hsaddleX hfloorThreeX herrOneX hetaX
  intro p hp
  let X := section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p
  let u := rankinU X p
  have hdomain := hlowerX p hp
  have hX : 0 < X := by simpa [X] using hdomain.1
  have hpTwo : 2 ≤ p := (mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1).2.2.two_le
  have huLower : movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    simpa [u, X] using hdomain.2.2
  have hu3 : 3 ≤ u := hfloorThreeX.trans huLower
  have huOne : 1 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hu3
  have huSqrt : u ≤ Real.sqrt p := by simpa [u, X] using hupperX p hp
  have hlogFloor : 0 ≤ Real.log (movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlogMono : Real.log (movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log u :=
    Real.log_le_log (by linarith) huLower
  have hmulMono : movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ) *
      Real.log (movingUtrFloorMinus (x : ℝ)) ≤ u * Real.log u :=
    mul_le_mul huLower hlogMono hlogFloor (by linarith)
  have herror : fullPaperDivisorError p X ≤ movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
    have h := herrX p hp
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right herrOneX hetaX.le
    simpa [X] using h.trans hmul
  have hexponent : -u * Real.log u + fullPaperDivisorError p X ≤
      -movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [hsaddleX, hmulMono]
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p X ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-u * Real.log u + fullPaperDivisorError p X) := by
      simpa [u] using finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error
        hX hpTwo huOne huSqrt
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg X)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingB4Intermediate_sum_le
statement:
theorem eventually_movingB4Intermediate_sum_le :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingB4Intermediate_pointwise,
    eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with x hpoint hadmissible
  have hZpos : 0 < movingNatZ x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <| hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_Z
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x),
          ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) *
            Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) *
              ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      calc
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p
            (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p) ≤
            (section5LocalCutoff x (movingNatZ x) p : ℝ) *
              Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := hpoint p hp
        _ ≤ ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
              Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x (movingNatZ x) p)
            (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) *
              Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) *
                ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) *
        ∑ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (movingNatZ x),
          ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) *
        (movingNatZ x : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sum_section5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le hZpos hadmissible.Z_le_x)
        (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hZne : (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hZpos.ne'
      simp only [section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.movingB4IntermediateEstimate_zero
statement:
theorem movingB4IntermediateEstimate_zero :
    MovingB4IntermediateEstimate (fun _ ↦ 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_const_nhds, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingB4Intermediate_sum_le,
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 2)] with x hsum heta
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := hsum
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hexpEta : 2 * Real.exp (-movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
        calc
          2 * Real.exp (-movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤
              2 * Real.exp (-Real.log 2) := by
            gcongr
          _ = 1 := by rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]; norm_num
      rw [show -movingK (x : ℝ) - movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
        -movingK (x : ℝ) + -movingEtaR (x : ℝ) by ring, Real.exp_add]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg x) (Real.exp_pos (-movingK (x : ℝ))).le]
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant (fun _ ↦ 0) x := by
      simp [movingExponentialMajorant]

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_theorem10_14_two_sided
statement:
theorem fixedRank_theorem10_14_two_sided {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankClosedError J) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY J x →
        |(shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) -
            (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ)| ≤
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankClosedError J) x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankClosedError_zero hJ, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [fixedRank_theorem10_14_unconditional hJ] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hupper := hx h hh hhy
  have hlower : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) : ℝ) ≤
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount x h
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
  have hnonneg := fixedRankExponentialMajorant_nonneg J (fixedRankClosedError J) x
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RankAmplification.moving_theorem1_4_two_sided
statement:

    Tendsto (movingHalfExponentError
        (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
          movingClosedTransferError)) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ movingNatY x →
        |(shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) -
            (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ)| ≤
          halfExponentMajorant
            (movingHalfExponentError
              (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
                movingClosedTransferError)) x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨moving_theorem1_4_unconditional.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [moving_theorem1_4_unconditional.2] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hupper := hx h hh hhy
  have hlower : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) ≤
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount x h (movingNatZ x)
  have hnonneg := halfExponentMajorant_nonneg
    (movingHalfExponentError
      (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
        movingClosedTransferError)) x
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_const_mul_scaleV_le_margin_scaleG

:= by
  have hbound := (const_mul_scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG c).bound hmargin
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hx hL hA
  have hG : 0 ≤ scaleG x := (scaleG_pos hL hA).le
  have habs : c * scaleV x ≤ ‖c * scaleV x‖ := Real.le_norm_self _
  exact habs.trans (hx.trans_eq (by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hG]))

name: RankAmplification.IsSmooth.largestPrimeFactor_le

theorem IsSmooth.largestPrimeFactor_le {y n : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hn : IsSmooth y n) :

name: RankAmplification.isSmooth_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_nonneg
statement:

    0 ≤ smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun p hp ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    0 < smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀
proof:
:= by
  apply inv_pos.mpr
  exact sub_pos.mpr <| Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hc₀)

name: RankAmplification.one_sub_two_rpow_le_one_sub_prime_rpow
statement:
theorem one_sub_two_rpow_le_one_sub_prime_rpow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    {c₀ c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hc : c₀ ≤ c) :
    1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-c₀) ≤ 1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-c)
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
  have hbase : (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-c) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hp2 (by linarith)
  have hexp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-c₀) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.rankinRatio_div_one_sub_le_loss_mul
statement:
theorem rankinRatio_div_one_sub_le_loss_mul {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    {c₀ c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hc : c₀ ≤ c) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) / (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-c)) ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * (p : ℝ) ^ (-c)
proof:
:= by
  have hden0 : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-c₀) :=
    sub_pos.mpr <| Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hc₀)
  have hden := one_sub_two_rpow_le_one_sub_prime_rpow hp hc₀ hc
  have hinv : (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-c))⁻¹ ≤ (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-c₀))⁻¹ := by
    exact inv_anti₀ hden0 hden
  have hq : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) := Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, smoothPredecessorEulerLoss]
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le_loss_mul_sum
statement:
theorem log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le_loss_mul_sum {X Y : ℕ}
    {c₀ c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hc : c₀ ≤ c) :
    Real.log (smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c) ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c
proof:
:= by
  have hcpos : 0 < c := hc₀.trans_le hc
  calc
    Real.log (smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y,
          (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) / (1 - (p : ℝ) ^ (-c)) :=
      log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le hcpos
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y,
        smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      exact rankinRatio_div_one_sub_le_loss_mul
        (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime hp) hc₀ hc
    _ = smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c := by
      rw [smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum, Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_pos
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_pos {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    0 < smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothPredecessorEulerProduct, rankinEulerMajorant]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime hp
  exact pow_pos
    (inv_pos.mpr <| sub_pos.mpr <|
      Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_lt)
        (neg_lt_zero.mpr hc)) _

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le_exp_loss_mul_sum
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le_exp_loss_mul_sum {X Y : ℕ}
    {c₀ c : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hc : c₀ ≤ c) :
    smoothPredecessorEulerProduct X Y c ≤
      Real.exp (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c)
proof:
:= by
  have hcpos : 0 < c := hc₀.trans_le hc
  rw [← Real.exp_log (smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_pos hcpos)]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (log_smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le_loss_mul_sum hc₀ hc)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_rankinPrimeSum
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_rankinPrimeSum {X Y : ℕ} {c₀ c : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hc : c₀ ≤ c) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) ^ c *
        Real.exp (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c)
proof:
:= by
  exact (smoothTotientCount_le_rankinEuler (hc₀.trans_le hc)).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (smoothPredecessorEulerProduct_le_exp_loss_mul_sum hc₀ hc)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) _)

name: RankAmplification.rpow_eq_mul_exp_neg_one_sub
statement:
theorem rpow_eq_mul_exp_neg_one_sub {X : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (c : ℝ) :
    (X : ℝ) ^ c = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(1 - c) * Real.log X)
proof:
:= by
  have hXreal : (0 : ℝ) < X := by exact_mod_cast hX
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hXreal]
  have hexponent : Real.log (X : ℝ) * c =
      Real.log (X : ℝ) + (-(1 - c) * Real.log X) := by ring
  rw [hexponent, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hXreal]

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_exp_saving
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_exp_saving {X Y : ℕ} {c₀ c : ℝ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hc : c₀ ≤ c) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(1 - c) * Real.log X +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) ^ c *
          Real.exp (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c) :=
      smoothTotientCount_le_rankinPrimeSum hc₀ hc
    _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(1 - c) * Real.log X +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss c₀ * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c) := by
      rw [rpow_eq_mul_exp_neg_one_sub hX, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]

      exact Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp ih

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_nonneg
statement: theorem scaleA_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.log 2 ≤ log3 x + log4 x) : 0 ≤ scaleA x

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_nonneg
statement: theorem scaleG_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ scaleG x
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_pos
statement: theorem scaleG_pos {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) : 0 < scaleG x

:= by
  rw [scaleG_eq, Real.sqrt_pos]
  exact mul_pos hL hA

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_sq
statement:
theorem scaleG_sq {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ scaleL x) (hA : 0 ≤ scaleA x) :
    scaleG x ^ 2 = scaleL x * scaleA x
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleG_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg hL hA)]

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_mul_scaleV
statement:
theorem scaleG_mul_scaleV {x : ℝ} (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) :
    scaleG x * scaleV x = scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hG

name: RankAmplification.scaleV_mul_scaleG
statement:
theorem scaleV_mul_scaleG {x : ℝ} (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) :
    scaleV x * scaleG x = scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact scaleG_mul_scaleV hG

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_mul_scaleV
statement:
theorem scaleA_mul_scaleV {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ scaleL x) (hA : 0 ≤ scaleA x)
    (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) : scaleA x * scaleV x = scaleG x
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  have hsq := scaleG_sq hL hA
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_div_scaleV
statement:
theorem scaleG_div_scaleV {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 ≤ scaleA x)
    (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) : scaleG x / scaleV x = scaleA x
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  have hsq := scaleG_sq hL.le hA
  have hG' : 0 ≠ scaleG x := hG.symm
  field_simp [hG', ne_of_gt hL]
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_div_scaleL_eq_sqrt_div
statement:
theorem scaleG_div_scaleL_eq_sqrt_div {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x)
    (hA : 0 ≤ scaleA x) :
    scaleG x / scaleL x = Real.sqrt (scaleA x / scaleL x)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    scaleG x / scaleL x =
        (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) / scaleL x := by
          rw [scaleG_eq, Real.sqrt_mul hL.le]
    _ = Real.sqrt (scaleA x) / Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := by
      have hden : scaleL x = Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x) :=
        (Real.mul_self_sqrt hL.le).symm
      calc
        (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) / scaleL x =
            (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) /
              (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x)) :=
          congrArg (fun d : ℝ =>
            (Real.sqrt (scaleL x) * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) / d) hden
        _ = Real.sqrt (scaleA x) / Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL)]
    _ = Real.sqrt (scaleA x / scaleL x) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_div hA]

name: RankAmplification.iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO
statement:
theorem iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO (n : ℕ) :
    (iteratedLog (n + 1)) =o[atTop] (iteratedLog n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.comp_tendsto (tendsto_iteratedLog_atTop n)
  apply h.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.log4_isLittleO_log3
statement: theorem log4_isLittleO_log3 : log4 =o[atTop] log3
proof:
:= by
  have h := iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO 3
  apply h.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.const_log_two_isLittleO_log3
statement:
theorem const_log_two_isLittleO_log3 :
    (fun _ : ℝ => Real.log 2) =o[atTop] log3
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Real.isLittleO_const_log_atTop (c := Real.log 2)).comp_tendsto
    (tendsto_iteratedLog_atTop 2)
  apply h.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_isEquivalent_log3
statement: theorem scaleA_isEquivalent_log3 : scaleA ~[atTop] log3
proof:
:= by
  have herror : (fun x => log4 x - Real.log 2) =o[atTop] log3 :=
    log4_isLittleO_log3.sub const_log_two_isLittleO_log3
  have hequiv :=
    (Asymptotics.IsEquivalent.refl (u := log3) (l := atTop)).add_isLittleO herror
  apply hequiv.congr_left
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, scaleA]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.log3_isLittleO_scaleL
statement: theorem log3_isLittleO_scaleL : log3 =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:= by
  have h32 : (iteratedLog 3) =o[atTop] (iteratedLog 2) :=
    iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO 2
  have h21 : (iteratedLog 2) =o[atTop] (iteratedLog 1) :=
    iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO 1
  have h := h32.trans h21
  apply h.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.scaleA_isLittleO_scaleL
statement: theorem scaleA_isLittleO_scaleL : scaleA =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:=
  scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.isBigO.trans_isLittleO log3_isLittleO_scaleL

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleA_atTop
statement: theorem tendsto_scaleA_atTop : Tendsto scaleA atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  scaleA_isEquivalent_log3.symm.tendsto_atTop tendsto_log3_atTop

name: RankAmplification.eventually_scaleL_pos
statement: theorem eventually_scaleL_pos : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 < scaleL x

:=

name: RankAmplification.eventually_scaleA_pos

:=

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleG_atTop
statement: theorem tendsto_scaleG_atTop : Tendsto scaleG atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : Tendsto (fun x => scaleL x * scaleA x) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.atTop_mul_atTop₀ tendsto_scaleA_atTop
  change Tendsto (fun x => Real.sqrt (scaleL x * scaleA x)) atTop atTop
  exact Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp hprod

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleG_div_scaleL_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_scaleG_div_scaleL_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x => scaleG x / scaleL x) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun x => scaleA x / scaleL x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    scaleA_isLittleO_scaleL.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hsqrt : Tendsto (fun x => Real.sqrt (scaleA x / scaleL x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hratio.sqrt
  apply hsqrt.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
  exact (scaleG_div_scaleL_eq_sqrt_div hL hA.le).symm

name: RankAmplification.scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL
statement: theorem scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL : scaleG =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:= by
  refine Asymptotics.isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ tendsto_scaleG_div_scaleL_zero
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hL
  exact fun hzero => (hL.ne' hzero).elim

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_scaleV_atTop
statement: theorem tendsto_scaleV_atTop : Tendsto scaleV atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hratioPos : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 < scaleG x / scaleL x := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
    exact div_pos (scaleG_pos hL hA) hL
  have hratioWithin :
      Tendsto (fun x => scaleG x / scaleL x) atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨tendsto_scaleG_div_scaleL_zero, hratioPos⟩
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun x => (scaleG x / scaleL x)⁻¹) atTop atTop :=
    hratioWithin.inv_tendsto_nhdsGT_zero
  apply hinv.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt (scaleG_pos hL hA)]

name: RankAmplification.hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro m lo hi hm hlohi hhi
  have hraw := hC m lo hi hm hlohi hhi
  calc
    ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
        C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := hraw
    _ ≤ D * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by

          ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) :=
        mul_nonneg (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg hi)
          (div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity))

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_card
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_card {X Y : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y c ≤
      (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum
  calc
    ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y, (p : ℝ) ^ (-c) ≤
        ∑ _p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos
        (by exact_mod_cast (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_prime hp).one_le) (by linarith)
    _ = (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card := by simp

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_of_terminalSelberg
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_of_terminalSelberg
    {X Y : ℕ} (parameters : BFPSFiniteParameters X Y)
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y parameters.c ≤
      parameters.predecessorMajorant data
proof:
:= by
  exact (smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_card
    (parameters.c₀_pos.le.trans parameters.c₀_le_c)).trans
      (card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_of_terminalSelberg parameters data)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_cast_le_of_terminalSelberg
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_cast_le_of_terminalSelberg
    {X Y : ℕ} (parameters : BFPSFiniteParameters X Y)
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (parameters.exponent data)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := smoothTotientCount_le_exp_saving
    (X := X) (Y := Y) parameters.X_pos parameters.c₀_pos parameters.c₀_le_c
  have hprime := smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_of_terminalSelberg parameters data
  unfold BFPSFiniteParameters.exponent
  exact hbase.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr <| add_le_add_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
        (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos parameters.c₀_pos).le) _)
    (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_of_terminalSelberg

name: RankAmplification.movingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis_of_terminalSelberg
statement:
theorem movingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis_of_terminalSelberg
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData)
    (parameters : BFPSMovingParameterChoice movingNatY) {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hdominance : MovingBFPSLemma27iiExponentDominance data parameters ε) :
    MovingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis ε
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hdominance.1, ?_⟩
  have hxpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < x := by
    exact Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun x hx ↦ by omega⟩
  filter_upwards [hdominance.2, hxpos, eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with
      x hxdom hx hnatural
  intro W hW hWx
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_cast_le_of_terminalSelberg
    (parameters x W ((Nat.sqrt_pos.2 hx).trans_le hW) hnatural.three_le_y) data
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hxdom hx hnatural.three_le_y W hW hWx)) (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_smoothShiftedCount_le_of_movingBFPSLemma27ii
statement:
theorem eventually_smoothShiftedCount_le_of_movingBFPSLemma27ii
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hBFPS : MovingBFPSLemma27iiHypothesis ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ W, x.sqrt ≤ W → W ≤ 2 * x → ∀ h,
      (smoothShiftedCount W h (movingNatY x) : ℝ) ≤
        (W : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-movingE (x : ℝ) + ε x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hBFPS.2] with x hx
  intro W hW hWx h
  exact smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_of_smoothTotientBound (hx W hW hWx)

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCensusSet_subset_smoothTotientSet
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCensusSet_subset_smoothTotientSet
    {x X : ℕ} (hZ : 1 ≤ movingNatZ x) :
    movingLowRankCensusSet x X ⊆ smoothTotientSet X (movingNatZ x)
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN
  have hdata := mem_movingLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  apply mem_smoothTotientSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hdata.1, hdata.2.1, ?_⟩
  have htotient : N.totient ≠ 0 :=
    (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans_le hdata.1)).ne'
  exact (isSmooth_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le hZ htotient).mpr hdata.2.2.1

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCensusCount_le_smoothTotientCount
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCensusCount_le_smoothTotientCount
    {x X : ℕ} (hZ : 1 ≤ movingNatZ x) :

proof:

  exact Finset.card_le_card (movingLowRankCensusSet_subset_smoothTotientSet hZ)

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCompressionHypothesis_of_boundedValueBFPS
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCompressionHypothesis_of_boundedValueBFPS
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hBFPS : MovingBFPSBoundedValueHypothesis ε) :
    MovingLowRankCompressionHypothesis ε
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hBFPS.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hBFPS.2, eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with x hx hnatural
  intro X hxX hX
  have hZ : 1 ≤ movingNatZ x :=
    (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3).trans (hnatural.three_le_y.trans hnatural.y_le_Z)
  have hcard := movingLowRankCensusCount_le_smoothTotientCount
    (x := x) (X := X) hZ
  have hcardReal : (movingLowRankCensusCount x X : ℝ) ≤
      smoothTotientCount X (movingNatZ x) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  exact hcardReal.trans (hx X hxX hX)

name: RankAmplification.movingBFPSBoundedValueHypothesis_of_terminalSelberg
statement:
theorem movingBFPSBoundedValueHypothesis_of_terminalSelberg
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData)
    (parameters : BFPSMovingParameterChoice movingNatZ) {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hdominance : MovingBFPSLowRankExponentDominance data parameters ε) :
    MovingBFPSBoundedValueHypothesis ε
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hdominance.1, ?_⟩
  have hxpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < x := by
    exact Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun x hx ↦ by omega⟩
  filter_upwards [hdominance.2, hxpos, eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with
      x hxdom hx hnatural
  intro X hxX hX
  have hZ : 3 ≤ movingNatZ x := hnatural.three_le_y.trans hnatural.y_le_Z
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_cast_le_of_terminalSelberg
    (parameters x X (hx.trans_le hxX) hZ) data
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hxdom hx hZ X hxX hX)) (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankCompressionHypothesis_of_terminalSelberg
statement:
theorem movingLowRankCompressionHypothesis_of_terminalSelberg
    (data : BFPSTerminalSelbergData)

name: RankAmplification.natFloor_lt_iff_lt
statement:
theorem natFloor_lt_iff_lt {Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    ⌊Y⌋₊ < n ↔ Y < (n : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  Nat.floor_lt hY

name: RankAmplification.diagonalCutoff_natFloor_iff
statement:
theorem diagonalCutoff_natFloor_iff {Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (h j r : ℕ) :
    ⌊Y⌋₊ < largestPrimeFactor (diagonalGamma h j * r) ↔
      Y < (largestPrimeFactor (diagonalGamma h j * r) : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  natFloor_lt_iff_lt hY _

name: RankAmplification.isDiagonalRepresentation_natFloor_iff
statement:
theorem isDiagonalRepresentation_natFloor_iff {Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (h n j r : ℕ) :
    IsDiagonalRepresentation h ⌊Y⌋₊ n j r ↔
      (IsSameSupportIndex h j ∧
        1 ≤ r ∧
        n = j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        n + h = (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) j ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) (j + h) ∧
        Y < (largestPrimeFactor (diagonalGamma h j * r) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsDiagonalRepresentation
  rw [diagonalCutoff_natFloor_iff hY]

name: RankAmplification.isAboveCutoffDiagonal_natFloor_iff
statement:
theorem isAboveCutoffDiagonal_natFloor_iff {Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (h n : ℕ) :
    IsAboveCutoffDiagonal h ⌊Y⌋₊ n ↔
      ∃ j r, IsSameSupportIndex h j ∧
        1 ≤ r ∧
        n = j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        n + h = (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) j ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) (j + h) ∧
        Y < (largestPrimeFactor (diagonalGamma h j * r) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsAboveCutoffDiagonal
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, r, hrep⟩
    exact ⟨j, r, (isDiagonalRepresentation_natFloor_iff hY h n j r).1 hrep⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, r, hrep⟩
    exact ⟨j, r, (isDiagonalRepresentation_natFloor_iff hY h n j r).2 hrep⟩

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_natFloor_congr
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_natFloor_congr {Y Z : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z)
    (hYZ : ∀ n : ℕ, Y < (n : ℝ) ↔ Z < (n : ℝ)) (x h : ℕ) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h ⌊Y⌋₊ = aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h ⌊Z⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : ⌊Y⌋₊ = ⌊Z⌋₊ := by
    have h1 : ⌊Y⌋₊ < ⌊Z⌋₊ + 1 := by
      rw [natFloor_lt_iff_lt hY]
      refine (hYZ (⌊Z⌋₊ + 1)).2 ?_
      push_cast
      exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one Z
    have h2 : ⌊Z⌋₊ < ⌊Y⌋₊ + 1 := by
      rw [natFloor_lt_iff_lt hZ]
      refine (hYZ (⌊Y⌋₊ + 1)).1 ?_
      push_cast
      exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one Y
    omega
  rw [hfloor]

name: RankAmplification.movingHildebrandRemainderConstant_pos
statement:
theorem movingHildebrandRemainderConstant_pos :
    0 < movingHildebrandRemainderConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingHildebrandRemainderConstant
  have hD : 0 < sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have hQ := sharpEulerQuadraticConstant_pos
