name: RankAmplification.log2_pow_eleven_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem log2_pow_eleven_isLittleO_scaleL :
    (fun x : ℝ ↦ log2 x ^ 11) =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :=
    (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (11 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).comp_tendsto
      tendsto_scaleL_atTop
  apply hbase.congr'
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hL
    simp [Function.comp_apply, log2, scaleL]
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hL
    simp [Function.comp_apply, Real.rpow_one]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_1024_mul_log2_pow_eleven_le_scaleL
statement:
theorem eventually_1024_mul_log2_pow_eleven_le_scaleL :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      1024 * log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 11 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := log2_pow_eleven_isLittleO_scaleL.bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 1024)
  have hnat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hbound
  filter_upwards [hnat,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos] with
      x hx hL2 hL
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 11),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hx
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingHildebrandScaleControl
statement:
theorem eventually_movingHildebrandScaleControl :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, MovingHildebrandScaleControl x
proof:
:= by
  have hcore : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) ∧ 0 < log2 (x : ℝ) ∧ 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) ∧
        0 < movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    have h := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_moving_core_positive
    filter_upwards [h] with x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2.1, hx.2.2.1, hx.2.2.2.1⟩
  have hratioReal : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop,
      (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ movingK t / movingR t ∧
        movingK t / movingR t ≤ 1 := by
    exact tendsto_movingK_div_R_half.eventually <|
      Icc_mem_nhds (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hratio := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hratioReal
  have hKpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_movingK_pos
  have hKlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * Real.log 2 ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_movingK_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2)
  have hL2large : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 2 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  have hxpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < x :=
    Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨1, fun x hx ↦ by omega⟩
  have hZfour : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 4 ≤ movingNatZ x :=
    tendsto_movingNatZ_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 4
  filter_upwards [hcore, hratio, hKpos, hKlarge, hL2large, hxpos,
      eventually_movingZ_half_le_natZ, eventually_1024_mul_log2_pow_eleven_le_scaleL,
      hZfour] with x hcoreX hratioX hK hKlargeX hL2 hx hfloor hpow hZ4
  have hthird : movingR (x : ℝ) / 3 ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ hcoreX.2.2.2).mp hratioX.1
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h
  have hKleR : movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_one hcoreX.2.2.2).mp
    exact hratioX.2
  have hnatZpos : (0 : ℝ) < movingNatZ x := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < movingNatZ x)
  have hlogUpper : Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) := by
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hnatZpos (movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x)
    simpa only [log_movingZ] using hlog
  have hZpos : 0 < movingZ (x : ℝ) := by
    exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hhalfPos : 0 < movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2 := div_pos hZpos (by norm_num)
  have hlogLower : movingK (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2 ≤
      Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hfloor
    rw [Real.log_div hZpos.ne' (by norm_num), log_movingZ] at hlog
    exact hlog
  have hhalfK : movingK (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
    linarith
  exact ⟨hx, hcoreX.1, hL2, hcoreX.2.2.2, hK, hthird, hKleR,
    hhalfK, hlogUpper, hpow, hZ4⟩

name: RankAmplification.MovingHildebrandScaleControl.one_le_L
statement:
theorem MovingHildebrandScaleControl.one_le_L
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x) :
    1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogL : 2 ≤ Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq] using h.two_le_L2
  have hexp : Real.exp 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log h.L_pos]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlogL
  exact (Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).trans hexp

name: RankAmplification.MovingHildebrandScaleControl.log_natZ_pos
statement:
theorem MovingHildebrandScaleControl.log_natZ_pos
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x) :
    0 < Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hZone : 1 < movingNatZ x := (by norm_num : 1 < 4).trans_le h.four_le_natZ
  exact Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hZone)

name: RankAmplification.movingHildebrandU_bounds
statement:
theorem movingHildebrandU_bounds
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x) :
    Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)) ≤ movingHildebrandU x H ∧
      movingHildebrandU x H ≤
        12 * Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hxreal : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast h.x_pos
  have hHreal : (0 : ℝ) < H := hxreal.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hxH)
  have hlogR := h.log_natZ_pos
  have hlogHlower : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (H : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [scaleL_eq] using
      Real.log_le_log hxreal (by exact_mod_cast hxH : (x : ℝ) ≤ H)
  have hlogHupper : Real.log (H : ℝ) ≤ 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hcast : (H : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hH
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hHreal hcast
    have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      have hlogTwoLeOne : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := Real.log_two_lt_d9.le.trans (by norm_num)
      exact hlogTwoLeOne.trans h.one_le_L
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hxreal.ne'] at hlog
    simp only [scaleL_eq] at hlogTwo ⊢
    linarith
  have hLdivR : scaleL (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ) =
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    scaleL_div_movingR_eq_sqrt_div h.L_pos (by linarith [h.two_le_L2])
  constructor
  · rw [← hLdivR]
    calc
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ) ≤
          scaleL (x : ℝ) / movingK (x : ℝ) := by
        exact (div_le_div_iff₀ h.R_pos h.K_pos).2 <|
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.K_le_R h.L_pos.le
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
        exact (div_le_div_iff₀ h.K_pos hlogR).2 <|
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.log_natZ_le_K h.L_pos.le
      _ ≤ Real.log (H : ℝ) / Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) :=
        (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hlogR).2 hlogHlower
      _ = movingHildebrandU x H := rfl
  · have hhalfK : 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) / 2 := div_pos h.K_pos (by norm_num)
    calc
      movingHildebrandU x H =
          Real.log (H : ℝ) / Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := rfl
      _ ≤ (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) / Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) :=
        (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hlogR).2 hlogHupper
      _ ≤ (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) / (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) := by
        exact (div_le_div_iff₀ hlogR hhalfK).2 <|
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.half_K_le_log_natZ
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) h.L_pos.le)
      _ = 4 * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / movingK (x : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [h.K_pos.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ 12 * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ)) := by
        have hthird' : movingR (x : ℝ) ≤ 3 * movingK (x : ℝ) := by
          linarith [h.third_R_le_K]
        rw [show 4 * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / movingK (x : ℝ)) =
            (4 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) / movingK (x : ℝ) by ring,
          show 12 * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ)) =
            (12 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) / movingR (x : ℝ) by ring]
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ h.K_pos h.R_pos).2
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hthird'
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4) h.L_pos.le)
        nlinarith
      _ = 12 * Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [hLdivR]

name: RankAmplification.movingHildebrandU_pos
statement:
theorem movingHildebrandU_pos
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x) :
    0 < movingHildebrandU x H
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_pos]
    exact div_pos h.L_pos (by linarith [h.two_le_L2])
  exact hsqrt.trans_le (movingHildebrandU_bounds h hxH hH).1

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingHildebrandU_of_eventually_between
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingHildebrandU_of_eventually_between
    {H : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hlower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, x ≤ H x)
    (hupper : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, H x ≤ 2 * x) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingHildebrandU x (H x)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt := tendsto_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop ?_ hsqrt
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingHildebrandScaleControl, hlower, hupper] with x hc hxH hH
  exact (movingHildebrandU_bounds hc hxH hH).1

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingHildebrandU_self_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingHildebrandU_self_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingHildebrandU x x) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_movingHildebrandU_of_eventually_between
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ le_rfl)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ by omega)

name: RankAmplification.log2_isLittleO_movingR
statement: theorem log2_isLittleO_movingR : log2 =o[atTop] movingR
proof:
:= by
  have hetaR : movingEtaR =o[atTop] movingR := by
    have hratio : Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingEtaR x / movingR x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      apply tendsto_movingEta_zero.congr'
      filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
      rw [movingEtaR, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hcore.2.2.2.1.ne']
    refine isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ hratio
    filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
    exact fun hz ↦ (hcore.2.2.2.1.ne' hz).elim
  exact log2_isLittleO_etaR.trans hetaR

name: RankAmplification.eventually_192_mul_log2_le_movingR
statement:
theorem eventually_192_mul_log2_le_movingR :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 192 * log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ movingR (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := log2_isLittleO_movingR.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 192)
  have hnat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hbound
  filter_upwards [hnat,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hx hL2 hcore
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hcore.2.2.2.1.le] at hx
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_exp_exp_two_le_movingSqrtRatio
statement:
theorem eventually_exp_exp_two_le_movingSqrtRatio :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  (tendsto_sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop _

name: RankAmplification.movingHildebrandU_log_bounds
statement:
theorem movingHildebrandU_log_bounds
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x)
    (hlarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))) :
    0 < Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H) ∧
      Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H) ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H)) ≤
        Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H)
proof:
:= by
  let S := Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))
  let u := movingHildebrandU x H
  have hubounds := movingHildebrandU_bounds h hxH hH
  have huLarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ u := hlarge.trans hubounds.1
  have huOne : 1 < u := by
    have : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 2) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact Real.exp_pos 2
    exact this.trans_le huLarge
  have hloguPos : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos huOne
  have hL2one : 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by linarith [h.two_le_L2]
  have hLlarge : 12 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hp : 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 11 := one_le_pow₀ hL2one
    nlinarith [h.log2_power]
  have hRone : 1 ≤ movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    have hRsq := movingR_sq h.L_pos.le (by linarith [h.two_le_L2] :
      0 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ))
    have hprod : 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        (2 : ℝ) = 1 * 2 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul h.one_le_L h.two_le_L2 (by norm_num) h.L_pos.le
    nlinarith [h.R_pos]
  have hSleL : S ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    change Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)
    rw [← scaleL_div_movingR_eq_sqrt_div h.L_pos
      (by linarith [h.two_le_L2] : 0 < log2 (x : ℝ))]
    exact div_le_self h.L_pos.le hRone
  have huLsq : u ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      u ≤ 12 * S := hubounds.2
      _ ≤ 12 * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSleL (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [h.L_pos]
  have hlogUpper : Real.log u ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log (zero_lt_one.trans huOne) huLsq
    calc
      Real.log u ≤ Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := hlog
      _ = 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_pow]
        simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
        norm_num
  have hloglog : Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ Real.log u :=
    Real.log_le_self hloguPos.le
  exact ⟨hloguPos, hlogUpper, hloglog⟩

name: RankAmplification.moving_hildebrandSaddleShift_le_quarter
statement:
theorem moving_hildebrandSaddleShift_le_quarter
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x)
    (hlarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)))
    (hbudget : 192 * log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ movingR (x : ℝ)) :
    hildebrandSaddleShift H (movingNatZ x) ≤ 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hlogs := movingHildebrandU_log_bounds h hxH hH hlarge
  have hlogR := h.log_natZ_pos
  have hRoverSix : movingR (x : ℝ) / 6 ≤
      Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      movingR (x : ℝ) / 6 ≤ movingK (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
        linarith [h.third_R_le_K]
      _ ≤ Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := h.half_K_le_log_natZ
  rw [hildebrandSaddleShift]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogR).2
  change Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H) +
      Real.log (Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H)) ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ)
  have hnumerator : Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H) +
      Real.log (Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H)) ≤
        4 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    linarith [hlogs.2.1, hlogs.2.2]
  nlinarith [h.two_le_L2]

name: RankAmplification.sharpHildebrandRegime_movingNatZ
statement:
theorem sharpHildebrandRegime_movingNatZ
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x)
    (hlarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)))
    (hbudget : 192 * log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ movingR (x : ℝ)) :
    SharpHildebrandRegime (movingNatZ x) H
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨h.x_pos.trans_le hxH, h.four_le_natZ,
    moving_hildebrandSaddleShift_le_quarter h hxH hH hlarge hbudget,
    hlarge.trans (movingHildebrandU_bounds h hxH hH).1⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_sharpHildebrandRegime_movingNatZ
statement:
theorem eventually_sharpHildebrandRegime_movingNatZ
    {H : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hlower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, x ≤ H x)
    (hupper : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, H x ≤ 2 * x) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, SharpHildebrandRegime (movingNatZ x) (H x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingHildebrandScaleControl, hlower, hupper,
      eventually_exp_exp_two_le_movingSqrtRatio,
      eventually_192_mul_log2_le_movingR] with x hc hxH hH hlarge hbudget
  exact sharpHildebrandRegime_movingNatZ hc hxH hH hlarge hbudget

name: RankAmplification.moving_fullEulerEndpoint_le
statement:
theorem moving_fullEulerEndpoint_le
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x)
    (hlarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))) :
    (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ hildebrandSaddleShift H (movingNatZ x) /
        Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ 144
proof:
:= by
  let S := Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))
  let u := movingHildebrandU x H
  have hubounds := movingHildebrandU_bounds h hxH hH
  have hlogs := movingHildebrandU_log_bounds h hxH hH hlarge
  have huLarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ u := hlarge.trans hubounds.1
  have huOne : 1 < u := by
    have : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 2) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact Real.exp_pos 2
    exact this.trans_le huLarge
  have hmul : u * Real.log u ≤ (12 * S) * (2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    exact mul_le_mul hubounds.2 hlogs.2.1 hlogs.1.le (by positivity)
  have hSL2 : S * log2 (x : ℝ) = movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    have hL2pos : 0 < log2 (x : ℝ) := by linarith [h.two_le_L2]
    have hquot := movingR_div_sqrt_div_eq_log2 h.L_pos
      hL2pos
    have hSpos : 0 < S := by
      change 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))
      rw [Real.sqrt_pos]
      exact div_pos h.L_pos hL2pos
    have heq := (div_eq_iff hSpos.ne').mp hquot
    nlinarith
  have hnum : u * Real.log u ≤ 24 * movingR (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      u * Real.log u ≤ (12 * S) * (2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) := hmul
      _ = 24 * movingR (x : ℝ) := by rw [← hSL2]; ring
  have hRlog : movingR (x : ℝ) ≤
      6 * Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
    linarith [h.third_R_le_K, h.half_K_le_log_natZ]
  rw [rpow_hildebrandSaddleShift_eq_u_mul_logU
    ((by norm_num : 1 < 4).trans_le h.four_le_natZ) huOne]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ h.log_natZ_pos).2
  change u * Real.log u ≤ 144 * Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ)
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.moving_sqrtEulerTerm_le
statement:
theorem moving_sqrtEulerTerm_le
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x)
    (hlarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))) :
    (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ^ hildebrandSaddleShift H (movingNatZ x) *
        (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) -
          Real.log (Real.log 2)) ≤
      movingHildebrandU x H / Real.log (movingHildebrandU x H)
proof:
:= by
  let L := scaleL (x : ℝ)
  let L2 := log2 (x : ℝ)
  let S := Real.sqrt (L / L2)
  let u := movingHildebrandU x H
  let δ := hildebrandSaddleShift H (movingNatZ x)
  let a := (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ^ δ
  have hubounds := movingHildebrandU_bounds h hxH hH
  have hlogs := movingHildebrandU_log_bounds h hxH hH hlarge
  have huLarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ u := hlarge.trans hubounds.1
  have huOne : 1 < u := by
    have : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 2) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact Real.exp_pos 2
    exact this.trans_le huLarge
  have huPos : 0 < u := zero_lt_one.trans huOne
  have hloguPos : 0 < Real.log u := hlogs.1
  have hL2pos : 0 < L2 := by
    change 0 < log2 (x : ℝ)
    linarith [h.two_le_L2]
  have hL2one : 1 ≤ L2 := by
    change 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ)
    linarith [h.two_le_L2]
  have hSpos : 0 < S := by
    change 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ))
    rw [Real.sqrt_pos]
    exact div_pos h.L_pos (by linarith [h.two_le_L2])
  have hL2leL : L2 ≤ L := by
    have hexp : Real.exp L2 = L := by
      change Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ)) = scaleL (x : ℝ)
      simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
      rw [Real.exp_log]
      simpa only [scaleL_eq] using h.L_pos
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp L2
    rw [hexp] at this
    linarith
  have hRleL : movingR (x : ℝ) ≤ L := by
    have hRsq := movingR_sq h.L_pos.le hL2pos.le
    have hmul : scaleL (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) ≤
        scaleL (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL2leL h.L_pos.le
    change movingR (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)
    nlinarith [h.R_pos]
  have hlogSqrtPos : 0 < Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) := by
    have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast h.four_le_natZ)
    exact Real.log_pos ((by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2).trans_le htwo)
  have hlogSqrtLeL : Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ≤ L := by
    rw [Real.log_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    have hlogRle : Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ L :=
      h.log_natZ_le_K.trans h.K_le_R |>.trans hRleL
    have hLnonneg : 0 ≤ L := by dsimp [L]; exact h.L_pos.le
    linarith
  have houterLog :
      Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) ≤ L2 := by
    have hmono := Real.log_le_log hlogSqrtPos hlogSqrtLeL
    change Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) ≤
      log2 (x : ℝ)
    change Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) ≤
      Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)) at hmono
    simpa only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq] using hmono
  have hbracket :
      Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) -
          Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤ 2 * L2 := by
    linarith [neg_one_le_log_log_two]
  have hSsq : S ^ 2 = L / L2 := by
    dsimp [S]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg h.L_pos.le hL2pos.le)
  have h32sq : (32 * L2 ^ 5) ^ 2 ≤ S ^ 2 := by
    rw [hSsq]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hL2pos).2
    calc
      (32 * L2 ^ 5) ^ 2 * L2 = 1024 * L2 ^ 11 := by ring
      _ ≤ L := by simpa only [L, L2] using h.log2_power
  have h32 : 32 * L2 ^ 5 ≤ S := by
    exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h32sq
  have h32u : 32 * L2 ^ 5 ≤ u := h32.trans hubounds.1
  have hlogCube : Real.log u ^ 3 ≤ (2 * L2) ^ 3 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hloguPos.le hlogs.2.1 3
  have hphase : 4 * L2 ^ 2 * Real.log u ^ 3 ≤ u := by
    calc
      4 * L2 ^ 2 * Real.log u ^ 3 ≤
          4 * L2 ^ 2 * (2 * L2) ^ 3 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogCube (by positivity)
      _ = 32 * L2 ^ 5 := by ring
      _ ≤ u := h32u
  have haNonneg : 0 ≤ a := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _
  have haSq : a ^ 2 = u * Real.log u := by
    have hsquare : a ^ 2 = (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ δ := by
      dsimp [a]
      rw [pow_two, ← Real.mul_rpow (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
        Real.mul_self_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    rw [hsquare]
    simpa only [u, δ, movingHildebrandU] using rpow_hildebrandSaddleShift_eq_u_mul_logU
      ((by norm_num : 1 < 4).trans_le h.four_le_natZ) huOne
  have hscaled : a * (2 * L2) * Real.log u ≤ u := by
    have hscaledNonneg : 0 ≤ a * (2 * L2) * Real.log u := by positivity
    have hsq : (a * (2 * L2) * Real.log u) ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 := by
      rw [show (a * (2 * L2) * Real.log u) ^ 2 =
        a ^ 2 * (4 * L2 ^ 2 * Real.log u ^ 2) by ring, haSq]
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hphase huPos.le
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have haTwo : a * (2 * L2) ≤ u / Real.log u := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hloguPos).2
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hscaled
  calc
    (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ^ hildebrandSaddleShift H (movingNatZ x) *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) -
            Real.log (Real.log 2)) =
        a * (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) -
          Real.log (Real.log 2)) := rfl
    _ ≤ a * (2 * L2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracket haNonneg
    _ ≤ u / Real.log u := haTwo

name: RankAmplification.moving_sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder_le
statement:
theorem moving_sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder_le
    {x H : ℕ} (h : MovingHildebrandScaleControl x)
    (hxH : x ≤ H) (hH : H ≤ 2 * x)
    (hlarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (scaleL (x : ℝ) / log2 (x : ℝ)))
    (hbudget : 192 * log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ movingR (x : ℝ)) :
    sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder (movingNatZ x) H ≤
      movingHildebrandRemainderConstant *
        dickmanLogErrorScale (movingHildebrandU x H)
proof:
:= by
  let u := movingHildebrandU x H
  let δ := hildebrandSaddleShift H (movingNatZ x)
  let q := u / Real.log u
  let D := sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1
  let Q := sharpEulerQuadraticConstant
  have hubounds := movingHildebrandU_bounds h hxH hH
  have hlogs := movingHildebrandU_log_bounds h hxH hH hlarge
  have huLarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ u := hlarge.trans hubounds.1
  have huOne : 1 < u := by
    have : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 2) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact Real.exp_pos 2
    exact this.trans_le huLarge
  have huPos : 0 < u := zero_lt_one.trans huOne
  have hloguPos : 0 < Real.log u := hlogs.1
  have hqOne : 1 ≤ q := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hloguPos).2
    simpa only [one_mul] using Real.log_le_self huPos.le
  have hqNonneg : 0 ≤ q := zero_le_one.trans hqOne
  have hquarter : δ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    exact moving_hildebrandSaddleShift_le_quarter h hxH hH hlarge hbudget
  have hTwoPow : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ 2 := by
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      _ = 2 := by simp
  have hTwoRatio : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ ≤ 2 * q := by nlinarith
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoHalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    exact (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 0.6931471803).trans Real.log_two_gt_d9.le
  have hTwoOverLog : (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 ≤ 4 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogTwoPos).2
    nlinarith
  have hfull :
      (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ 144 := by
    exact moving_fullEulerEndpoint_le h hxH hH hlarge
  have hsqrt :
      (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) -
            Real.log (Real.log 2)) ≤ q := by
    exact moving_sqrtEulerTerm_le h hxH hH hlarge
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    dsimp [D]
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by
    exact sharpEulerQuadraticConstant_pos
  have hMertensBracket :
      (2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
          2 * ((movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ≤
        292 * q := by
    nlinarith
  have hMertens :
      D * ((2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
          2 * ((movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ δ /
            Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) ≤
        292 * D * q := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMertensBracket hD.le
    nlinarith
  have hQratio : Q ≤ Q * q := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqOne hQ.le]
  have hremainderQ : sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder (movingNatZ x) H ≤
      (3 + 292 * D + Q) * q := by
    rw [sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder]
    change (2 : ℝ) ^ δ +
        (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ^ δ *
          (Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) -
            Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        D * ((2 : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log 2 +
          2 * ((movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ δ /
            Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) + Q ≤
          (3 + 292 * D + Q) * q
    nlinarith
  have hloglogOne : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) := by
    have hlogLower : Real.exp 2 ≤ Real.log u := le_log_of_exp_le huLarge
    exact (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2).trans
      (le_log_of_exp_le hlogLower)
  have hqScale : q ≤ dickmanLogErrorScale u := by
    rw [dickmanLogErrorScale]
    calc
      q = q * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ q * Real.log (Real.log u) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hloglogOne hqNonneg
      _ = u * Real.log (Real.log u) / Real.log u := by
        dsimp [q]
        ring
  have hconstant : movingHildebrandRemainderConstant = 3 + 292 * D + Q := by
    rfl
  rw [hconstant]
  exact hremainderQ.trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqScale (by nlinarith [hD, hQ])

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSharpHildebrandRemainder_uniform_interval
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSharpHildebrandRemainder_uniform_interval :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ H, x ≤ H → H ≤ 2 * x →
      SharpHildebrandRegime (movingNatZ x) H ∧
        sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder (movingNatZ x) H ≤
          movingHildebrandRemainderConstant *
            dickmanLogErrorScale (rankinU H (movingNatZ x))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingHildebrandScaleControl,
      eventually_exp_exp_two_le_movingSqrtRatio,
      eventually_192_mul_log2_le_movingR] with x hc hlarge hbudget
  intro H hxH hH
  exact ⟨sharpHildebrandRegime_movingNatZ hc hxH hH hlarge hbudget,
    moving_sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder_le hc hxH hH hlarge hbudget⟩

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound_movingNatZ
statement:
theorem movingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound_movingNatZ
    {H : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hlower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, x ≤ H x)
    (hupper : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, H x ≤ 2 * x) :
    MovingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound movingHildebrandRemainderConstant
      movingNatZ H
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSharpHildebrandRemainder_uniform_interval,
      hlower, hupper] with x hx hxH hH
  exact hx (H x) hxH hH

name: RankAmplification.movingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound_movingNatZ_self
statement:
theorem movingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound_movingNatZ_self :
    MovingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound movingHildebrandRemainderConstant
      movingNatZ id
proof:
:= by
  apply movingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound_movingNatZ
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ le_rfl
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ by simp only [id_eq]; omega

name: RankAmplification.eventually_finiteSmoothCount_le_movingDickman_uniform_interval
statement:
theorem eventually_finiteSmoothCount_le_movingDickman_uniform_interval :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ H, x ≤ H → H ≤ 2 * x →
      (finiteSmoothCount (movingNatZ x) H : ℝ) ≤
        (H : ℝ) * dickmanSaddleUpperDensity
          movingHildebrandRemainderConstant (rankinU H (movingNatZ x))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSharpHildebrandRemainder_uniform_interval] with x hx
  intro H hxH hH
  have hdata := hx H hxH hH
  exact finiteSmoothCount_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_of_remainder hdata.1 hdata.2

name: RankAmplification.eventually_finiteSmoothCount_le_movingDickman
statement:
theorem eventually_finiteSmoothCount_le_movingDickman
    {H : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hlower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, x ≤ H x)
    (hupper : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, H x ≤ 2 * x) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (finiteSmoothCount (movingNatZ x) (H x) : ℝ) ≤
        (H x : ℝ) * dickmanSaddleUpperDensity
          movingHildebrandRemainderConstant (rankinU (H x) (movingNatZ x))
proof:
:= by
  exact eventually_finiteSmoothCount_le_dickman_of_movingSharpRemainder
    (movingSharpHildebrandRemainderBound_movingNatZ hlower hupper)

name: RankAmplification.mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet {x h d₁ d₂ n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂ ↔
      1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ x ∧ d₁ ∣ n ∧ d₂ ∣ n + h
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedDivisibilitySet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.prime_not_dvd_both_shifted
statement:
theorem prime_not_dvd_both_shifted {p n h : ℕ} (_hp : p.Prime) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hph : h < p) (hpn : p ∣ n) : ¬p ∣ n + h
proof:
:= by
  intro hpnh
  have hpd : p ∣ h := (Nat.dvd_add_iff_right hpn).mpr hpnh
  have hple : p ≤ h := Nat.le_of_dvd hh hpd
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hple) hph

name: RankAmplification.shifted_divisors_coprime
statement:
theorem shifted_divisors_coprime {d₁ d₂ n h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hlarge : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d₁ → h < p)
    (hd₁ : d₁ ∣ n) (hd₂ : d₂ ∣ n + h) : Nat.Coprime d₁ d₂
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
  intro p hp hpd₁
  exact prime_not_dvd_both_shifted hp hh (hlarge p hp hpd₁) (hpd₁.trans hd₁) ∘
    (·.trans hd₂)

name: RankAmplification.divisors_modEq
statement: theorem divisors_modEq {d a b : ℕ} (ha : d ∣ a) (hb : d ∣ b) : a ≡ b [MOD d]
proof:
:=
  ha.modEq_zero_nat.trans hb.zero_modEq_nat

name: RankAmplification.shifted_divisors_modEq
statement:
theorem shifted_divisors_modEq {d a b h : ℕ} (ha : d ∣ a + h) (hb : d ∣ b + h) :
    a ≡ b [MOD d]
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a + h ≡ b + h [MOD d] := divisors_modEq ha hb
  exact Nat.ModEq.rfl.add_right_cancel hab

name: RankAmplification.shifted_residue_modEq_product
statement:
theorem shifted_residue_modEq_product {d₁ d₂ a b h : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime d₁ d₂)
    (ha₁ : d₁ ∣ a) (ha₂ : d₂ ∣ a + h) (hb₁ : d₁ ∣ b) (hb₂ : d₂ ∣ b + h) :
    a ≡ b [MOD d₁ * d₂]
proof:
:= by
  apply (Nat.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul hcop).mp
  exact ⟨divisors_modEq ha₁ hb₁, shifted_divisors_modEq ha₂ hb₂⟩

name: RankAmplification.shifted_residue_sub_dvd_product
statement:
theorem shifted_residue_sub_dvd_product {d₁ d₂ a b h : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime d₁ d₂) (ha₁ : d₁ ∣ a) (ha₂ : d₂ ∣ a + h)
    (hb₁ : d₁ ∣ b) (hb₂ : d₂ ∣ b + h) : d₁ * d₂ ∣ b - a
proof:
:= by
  exact (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hab).mp
    (shifted_residue_modEq_product hcop ha₁ ha₂ hb₁ hb₂)

name: RankAmplification.count_modEq_le_div_add_one
statement:
theorem count_modEq_le_div_add_one (x v m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    Nat.count (· ≡ v [MOD m]) (x + 1) ≤ x / m + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.count_modEq_card (b := x + 1) (r := m) hm v, Nat.succ_div]
  by_cases hdvd : m ∣ x + 1
  · have hmod : (x + 1) % m = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mp hdvd
    simp [hdvd, hmod]
  · simp only [hdvd, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, add_le_add_iff_left]
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: RankAmplification.shiftedDivisibilitySet_card_le
statement:
theorem shiftedDivisibilitySet_card_le {x h d₁ d₂ : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd₂ : 0 < d₂)
    (hlarge : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d₁ → h < p) :
    (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card ≤ x / (d₁ * d₂) + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hempty : shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂ = ∅
  · simp [hempty]
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime d₁ d₂ :=
      shifted_divisors_coprime hh hlarge
        (mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet.mp ha).2.2.1
        (mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet.mp ha).2.2.2
    have hmul : 0 < d₁ * d₂ := Nat.mul_pos hd₁ hd₂
    calc
      (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card ≤
          ((Finset.range (x + 1)).filter fun n ↦ n ≡ a [MOD d₁ * d₂]).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro b hb
        have hbm := mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet.mp hb
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
        refine ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le hbm.2.1, ?_⟩
        exact shifted_residue_modEq_product hcop
          hbm.2.2.1
          hbm.2.2.2
          (mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet.mp ha).2.2.1
          (mem_shiftedDivisibilitySet.mp ha).2.2.2
      _ = Nat.count (· ≡ a [MOD d₁ * d₂]) (x + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
      _ ≤ x / (d₁ * d₂) + 1 := count_modEq_le_div_add_one x a (d₁ * d₂) hmul

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_nat_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_nat_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  (tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_zero J hJ).comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankLowRankConvertedError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankLowRankConvertedError_zero
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankLowRankConvertedError J ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun x ↦ ρ x -
    fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [sub_zero] using
    hρ.sub (tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_nat_zero J hJ)

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_smoothRate_exponent_eq_mainExponent
statement:
theorem fixedRank_smoothRate_exponent_eq_mainExponent
    {J x : ℕ} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hV : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :
    -fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) + ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
      -Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankLowRankConvertedError J ρ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized :
      fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        fixedRankSaddleRate J (x : ℝ) - Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError fixedRankSaddleError
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV
  unfold fixedRankLowRankConvertedError
  rw [sub_mul, hnormalized]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankLowRankHypothesis_of_smoothRate
statement:
theorem fixedRankLowRankHypothesis_of_smoothRate
    {J : ℕ} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hlow : FixedRankLowRankSmoothRateHypothesis J ρ) :
    FixedRankLowRankHypothesis J (fixedRankLowRankConvertedError J ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankLowRankConvertedError_zero hJ hlow.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hlow.2, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hlow hV
  intro h hh hhy
  rw [fixedRankExponentialMajorant,
    ← fixedRank_smoothRate_exponent_eq_mainExponent
      (J := J) (x := x) (ρ := ρ) hV.ne']
  exact hlow h hh hhy

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankAnalyticData_of_smoothRate
statement:
theorem fixedRankAnalyticData_of_smoothRate
    {J : ℕ} {ρ εhigh εoff : ℕ → ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hlow : FixedRankLowRankSmoothRateHypothesis J ρ)
    (hhigh : FixedRankHighRankHypothesis J εhigh)
    (hoff : FixedRankOffDiagonalHypothesis J εoff) :
    FixedRankAnalyticData J (fixedRankLowRankConvertedError J ρ) εhigh εoff where
  rank_pos
proof:
:= hJ
  lowRank := fixedRankLowRankHypothesis_of_smoothRate hJ hlow
  highRank := hhigh
  offDiagonal := hoff

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_div_le_budget
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_div_le_budget
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ θ : ℝ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)
    (hregular : ∀ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y,
      1 < bfpsU (X / d) Y ∧ 1 < Real.log (bfpsU (X / d) Y) ∧
        1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (X / d) Y))
    (hind : ∀ Z : ℕ, Z < X →
      (smoothTotientCount Z Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ Z Y)
    (hnum : Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
              (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) /
              Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ θ) :
    bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (θ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hYone : 1 < Y := by omega
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hYone)
  have hlogYtwo : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) := by
    refine Real.log_nonneg ?_
    have : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hY
    linarith
  have haSmall : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    div_nonneg hlogYtwo hlogY.le
  have hLpos : 0 < Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    refine Real.log_pos ?_
    have h2 : 2 ≤ X / 2 := by omega
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    linarith
  
  have hcontrib : bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      γ * ((X : ℝ) * bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) *
        (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant)) := by
    have hstep : bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y ≤ γ * bfpsSmallGammaKernel ξ X Y := by
      unfold bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution bfpsSmallGammaKernel
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
      intro d hd
      rcases eq_or_ne d 1 with rfl | hdone
      · simp [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_one]
      · have hdpos : 0 < d :=
          (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp (mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet.mp hd).1).1
        have hdlt : X / d < X := Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by omega)
        have hinner := hind (X / d) hdlt
        unfold bfpsGammaTarget at hinner
        calc
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤
              ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d *
                (γ * (((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
          _ = γ * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) *
                bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y)) := by ring
    exact hstep.trans <|
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_log (ξ := ξ) (X := X) (Y := Y) (by omega)) hγ
  
  have henv : bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) ≤
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
        Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
          (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) := by
    refine bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_le_of_gap haSmall hslope ?_
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hregular d hd
    obtain ⟨hdX, hmono, hgap⟩ := bfpsU_sub_le_of_mem_smallMangoldtSet hYone hd
    exact ⟨hdX, h1, h2, h3, hmono, hgap⟩
  
  have hCnn : 0 ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant := by
    have := one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant
    linarith
  have hpack : bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      γ * ((Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
              (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant)) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) := by
    refine hcontrib.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hγ)
    have hXnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg X
    calc
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) ≤
          (X : ℝ) * (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
              Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
                (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2))) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henv hXnn) hCnn
      _ = (Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
              (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant)) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y := by
        unfold bfpsGammaTarget
        ring
  
  calc
    bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        (γ * ((Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
                (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
              (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant)) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)) /
          Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpack hLpos.le
    _ = γ * ((Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
              (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) /
              Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) := by
      ring
    _ ≤ γ * (θ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnum (bfpsGammaTarget_nonneg ξ X Y)) hγ

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_div_le_budget
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_div_le_budget
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ θ : ℝ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hYX : Y ≤ X) (hγ : 1 ≤ γ)
    (hnum : ((X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
              (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y)) /
              Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
            θ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y)) :
    bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (θ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by omega
  have hXreal : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hX
  have hYreal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hY
  have hLpos : 0 < Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    refine Real.log_pos ?_
    have h2 : 2 ≤ X / 2 := by omega
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    linarith
  have hlogX : 0 < Real.log (X : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogQuot : 0 ≤ Real.log ((X : ℝ) / (Y : ℝ)) := by
    refine Real.log_nonneg ?_
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (Y : ℝ))]
    have : (Y : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hYX
    linarith
  have hAnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
      (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y) := by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) := by positivity
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y) := by
      apply mul_nonneg _ hlogQuot
      positivity
    linarith
  have hθg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ θ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) :=
    le_trans (div_nonneg hAnn hLpos.le) hnum
  have hexp := bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_le_explicit (X := X) (Y := Y)
    hXpos hYX (by omega)
  have hmid : bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      θ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y := by
    calc
      bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          ((X : ℝ) *
            ((X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
              (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y))) /
            Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hexp hLpos.le
      _ = (X : ℝ) *
            (((X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
              (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y)) /
              Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (θ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnum (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
      _ = θ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y := by
        unfold bfpsGammaTarget
        ring
  refine hmid.trans ?_
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ θ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y := by
    unfold bfpsGammaTarget
    have : θ * ((X : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y)) =
        (X : ℝ) * (θ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y)) := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) hθg
  exact le_mul_of_one_le_left hnn hγ

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_target_step
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_target_step
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ : ℝ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hYX : Y ≤ X) (hγ : 1 ≤ γ)
    (hθ : 3 / 4 + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃ ≤ 1)
    (hv : 1 < bfpsU (X / 2) Y) (hlogv : 1 < Real.log (bfpsU (X / 2) Y))
    (hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (X / 2) Y))
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)
    (hsmallgap : Real.exp (Real.log (4 : ℝ) / Real.log (Y : ℝ) *
        (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) ≤ 3 / 2)
    (hregular : ∀ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y,
      1 < bfpsU (X / d) Y ∧ 1 < Real.log (bfpsU (X / d) Y) ∧
        1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (X / d) Y))
    (hind : ∀ Z : ℕ, Z < X →
      (smoothTotientCount Z Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ Z Y)
    (hsmallnum : Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
              (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) /
              Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ θ₁)
    (hrepnum : ((X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
              (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y)) /
              Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
            θ₂ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y))
    (hlarge : bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (θ₃ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hγ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ γ := le_trans zero_le_one hγ
  have hhalf : (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) ≤
      γ * ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) := by
    refine smoothTotientCount_half_le_gamma_gammaTarget hX (by omega) hγ0 hv hlogv hlog2v
      hslope hsmallgap ?_
    have hstep := hind (X / 2) (Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by norm_num))
    unfold bfpsGammaTarget at hstep
    exact hstep
  exact smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_mul_gammaTarget_of_four_budgets hX hγ0 hθ hhalf
    (bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_div_le_budget hX hY hγ0 hslope hregular hind hsmallnum)
    (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_div_le_budget hX hY hYX hγ hrepnum)
    hlarge

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_of_numeric_step
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_of_numeric_step
    {ξ : ℝ} {B X Y : ℕ} {u₀ θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ : ℝ}
    (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hB4 : 4 ≤ B) (hBY : Y ≤ B)
    (hB : bfpsU B Y ≤ u₀) (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀)
    (hθ : 3 / 4 + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃ ≤ 1)
    (hhalfreg : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      1 < bfpsU (W / 2) Y ∧ 1 < Real.log (bfpsU (W / 2) Y) ∧
        1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (W / 2) Y))
    (hslope : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU W Y) + log3 (bfpsU W Y) - ξ + 2)
    (hsmallgap : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      Real.exp (Real.log (4 : ℝ) / Real.log (Y : ℝ) *
        (log2 (bfpsU W Y) + log3 (bfpsU W Y) - ξ + 2)) ≤ 3 / 2)
    (hregular : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X → ∀ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet W Y,
      1 < bfpsU (W / d) Y ∧ 1 < Real.log (bfpsU (W / d) Y) ∧
        1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU (W / d) Y))
    (hsmallnum : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      Real.exp ((Real.log (2 * (Y : ℝ)) / Real.log (Y : ℝ)) *
            (log2 (bfpsU W Y) + log3 (bfpsU W Y) - ξ + 2)) *
          (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) /
            Real.log ((W / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ θ₁)
    (hrepnum : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      ((W : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt W * Real.log W) +
            (2 * Real.log W / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((W : ℝ) / Y)) /
            Real.log ((W / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          θ₂ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y))
    (hlarge : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution W Y / Real.log ((W / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ * (θ₃ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y)) :
    ∀ W : ℕ, W ≤ X →
      (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤
        bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y
proof:
:= by
  refine smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_of_step hξ (by omega) hB hu₀ ?_
  intro W hBW hWX hind
  exact smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_target_step (by omega) hY (by omega)
    (one_le_bfpsInitialGammaConstant hu₀) hθ
    (hhalfreg W hBW hWX).1 (hhalfreg W hBW hWX).2.1 (hhalfreg W hBW hWX).2.2
    (hslope W hBW hWX) (hsmallgap W hBW hWX) (hregular W hBW hWX) hind
    (hsmallnum W hBW hWX) (hrepnum W hBW hWX) (hlarge W hBW hWX)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity_pos
statement:
theorem bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity_pos (R H : ℕ) :

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_fullRankinDensity
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_fullRankinDensity {R H : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU H R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      H * bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity R H
proof:
:= by
