name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_cutoff
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_cutoff (R H : ℕ) :
    finiteSmoothCount R H ≤ H
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSmoothCount]
  calc
    (finiteSmoothSet R H).card ≤ (Finset.Icc 1 H).card := by
      apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro m hm
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
        ⟨(mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm).1, (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm).2.1⟩
    _ = H := by simp

name: RankAmplification.bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity_nonneg (X Y base K : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity
  split_ifs
  · exact add_nonneg (bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity_pos _ _).le <|
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ (bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity_pos
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)).le
  · norm_num

name: RankAmplification.bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity_eq_rankinSum
statement:
theorem bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity_eq_rankinSum {X Y base K : ℕ}
    (h : BFPSFullRankinShellAdmissible X Y base K) :
    bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity X Y base K =
      bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
          bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
            (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity, if_pos h]

name: RankAmplification.hasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity_hybrid
statement:
theorem hasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity_hybrid :
    HasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y base K hbase hK
  refine ⟨bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity_nonneg X Y base K, ?_⟩
  by_cases hadmissible : BFPSFullRankinShellAdmissible X Y base K
  · have hterminalR : 2 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K := by omega
    have hterminal := finiteSmoothCount_le_fullRankinDensity
      hadmissible.1 hterminalR hadmissible.2.1 hadmissible.2.2.1
    have hterminalDensity :
        bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X ≤
          bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity X Y base K := by
      rw [bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity, if_pos hadmissible]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right <| Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦
        (bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity_pos (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)).le
    constructor
    · exact hterminal.trans <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hterminalDensity (by positivity)
    · intro i hiK
      have hiR : 2 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i := by
        have := hK.trans (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le
          (Y := Y) (base := base) (i := i) (j := K) (by omega))
        omega
      have hiAdmissible := hadmissible.2.2.2 i hiK
      have hiSmooth := finiteSmoothCount_le_fullRankinDensity
        hiAdmissible.1 hiR hiAdmissible.2.1 hiAdmissible.2.2
      have hiDensity :
          bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
              (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i) ≤
            bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity X Y base K := by
        rw [bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity, if_pos hadmissible]
        have hsingle := Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun j _ ↦ (bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity_pos
            (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base j)
            (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base j)).le)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr hiK)
        exact hsingle.trans <|
          le_add_of_nonneg_left (bfpsFullRankinSmoothDensity_pos _ _).le
      exact hiSmooth.trans <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hiDensity (by positivity)
  · rw [bfpsHybridUniformShellDensity, if_neg hadmissible]
    constructor
    · simpa using (show
          (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) ≤ X by
        exact_mod_cast finiteSmoothCount_le_cutoff
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X)
    · intro i hiK
      simp only [mul_one]
      exact_mod_cast finiteSmoothCount_le_cutoff
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsHildebrandLogKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsHildebrandLogKernel_nonneg (R : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsHildebrandLogKernel R
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsHildebrandLogKernel
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.one_lt_log_nat
statement:
theorem one_lt_log_nat {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    1 < Real.log R
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : Real.exp 1 < (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.exp_one_lt_three.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [← Real.exp_log hRpos] at hexp
  exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mp hexp

name: RankAmplification.bfpsHildebrandLogKernel_antitone
statement:
theorem bfpsHildebrandLogKernel_antitone {R S : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) (hRS : R ≤ S) :
    bfpsHildebrandLogKernel S ≤ bfpsHildebrandLogKernel R
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 1 < Real.log R := one_lt_log_nat hR
  have hab : Real.log R ≤ Real.log S :=
    Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hRS)
  unfold bfpsHildebrandLogKernel
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos (zero_lt_one.trans <| ha.trans_le hab))
    (sq_pos_of_pos (zero_lt_one.trans ha))).2
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ (Real.log S - Real.log R) *
      (Real.log R + Real.log S + Real.log R * Real.log S) := by
    positivity
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricEndpoint_mul_shellMultiplierCutoff_le
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricEndpoint_mul_shellMultiplierCutoff_le
    {X Y base i : ℕ} (hbase : 1 ≤ base) :
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i * bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i ≤
      base * X
proof:
:= by
  have hbasePos : 0 < base := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hbase
  have hwidth : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i ≤
      base * (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) + 1) := by
    rw [bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ]
    have hlt : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i <
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i / base + 1) * base :=
      (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hbasePos).mp
        (Nat.lt_succ_self (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i / base))
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hlt.le
  calc
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i * bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i ≤
        (base * (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) + 1)) *
          bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hwidth
    _ = base * (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i *
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) + 1)) := by
      ac_rfl
    _ ≤ base * X := by
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      exact Nat.div_mul_le_self X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) + 1)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricLogMajorantTerm_le_uniformDensity
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricLogMajorantTerm_le_uniformDensity
    {X Y base K i : ℕ} {density : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hiK : i < K)
    (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) (hdensity : 0 ≤ density)
    (hsmooth :
      (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i) : ℝ) ≤
        bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i * density) :
    bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
        bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1)) ≤
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (base : ℝ) * X * density *
        bfpsHildebrandLogKernel (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
proof:
:= by
  have hiTerminal : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K ≤
      bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
    bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega)
  have hiLower : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i := hK.trans hiTerminal
  have hproductNat := bfpsGeometricEndpoint_mul_shellMultiplierCutoff_le
    (X := X) (Y := Y) (base := base) (i := i) (by omega)
  have hproductReal :
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i : ℝ) *
          bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i ≤ (base : ℝ) * X := by
    exact_mod_cast hproductNat
  have hkernel := bfpsHildebrandLogKernel_antitone hK hiTerminal
  have hscale : 0 ≤ bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) :=
    bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg _
  have hlogFactor : 0 ≤
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
        (1 + Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)) := by
    positivity
  calc
    bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
        bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1)) =
        bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
          ((Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (1 + Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i))) *
            finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
              (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)) := by
      rw [bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant, bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff]
    _ ≤ bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
          ((Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (1 + Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i))) *
            (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i * density)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmooth hlogFactor) hscale
    _ = Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          ((bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i : ℝ) *
            bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i) * density *
          bfpsHildebrandLogKernel (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) := by
      unfold bfpsLogSquaredScale AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
        bfpsHildebrandLogKernel
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * ((base : ℝ) * X) * density *
          bfpsHildebrandLogKernel (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) := by
      gcongr
      exact bfpsHildebrandLogKernel_nonneg _
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * ((base : ℝ) * X) * density *
          bfpsHildebrandLogKernel (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) := by
      gcongr
    _ = Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (base : ℝ) * X * density *
          bfpsHildebrandLogKernel (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) := by
      ring

name: RankAmplification.hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_of_uniformDensity
statement:
theorem hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_of_uniformDensity
    {density : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hsmooth : HasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity density) :
    HasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound
      (bfpsHildebrandGeometricClosedBound density)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y base K hbase hK
  have hdata := hsmooth X Y base K hbase hK
  rw [bfpsGeometricLogMajorantSum]
  calc
    (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
            bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
              bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1)) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * density X Y base K +
          ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range K,
            Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (base : ℝ) * X *
              density X Y base K *
                bfpsHildebrandLogKernel (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) := by
      apply add_le_add hdata.2.1
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact bfpsGeometricLogMajorantTerm_le_uniformDensity
        hbase (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hK hdata.1 (hdata.2.2 i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
    _ = bfpsHildebrandGeometricClosedBound density X Y base K := by
      simp [bfpsHildebrandGeometricClosedBound]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_hybrid
statement:
theorem hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_hybrid :
    HasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound bfpsHybridHildebrandGeometricBound
proof:
:= by
  exact hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_of_uniformDensity
    hasBFPSTerminalHildebrandSmoothDensity_hybrid

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_hybridHildebrandBound
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_hybridHildebrandBound
    {X Y base K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) ≤
      K + C * bfpsHybridHildebrandGeometricBound X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  exact card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_hildebrandBound
    hbase hK hC hsieve hasBFPSHildebrandGeometricShellBound_hybrid

name: RankAmplification.mem_finiteSmoothSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_finiteSmoothSet {R X m : ℕ} :
    m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X ↔ 1 ≤ m ∧ m ≤ X ∧ IsSmooth R m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finiteSmoothSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.mem_finiteSmoothTailSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_finiteSmoothTailSet {R H X m : ℕ} :
    m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X ↔ H < m ∧ m ≤ X ∧ IsSmooth R m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finiteSmoothTailSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTailSet_subset
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTailSet_subset (R H X : ℕ) :
    finiteSmoothTailSet R H X ⊆ finiteSmoothSet R X
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [mem_finiteSmoothTailSet] at hm
  rw [mem_finiteSmoothSet]
  exact ⟨Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hm.1), hm.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.orderedDivisorCount_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderedDivisorCount_zero (n : ℕ) :
    orderedDivisorCount 0 n = if n = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedDivisorCount, ArithmeticFunction.one_apply]

name: RankAmplification.orderedDivisorCount_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderedDivisorCount_one {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    orderedDivisorCount 1 n = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedDivisorCount, ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply_ne hn]

name: RankAmplification.orderedDivisorCount_succ
statement:
theorem orderedDivisorCount_succ (j n : ℕ) :
    orderedDivisorCount (j + 1) n =
      ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, orderedDivisorCount j d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedDivisorCount, pow_succ']
  exact ArithmeticFunction.zeta_mul_apply

name: RankAmplification.orderedDivisorCount_two
statement:
theorem orderedDivisorCount_two (n : ℕ) :
    orderedDivisorCount 2 n = n.divisors.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, orderedDivisorCount_succ]
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, orderedDivisorCount 1 d) = ∑ _d ∈ n.divisors, 1 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      apply orderedDivisorCount_one
      obtain ⟨hdvd, hn⟩ := Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd
      exact ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hn hdvd
    _ = n.divisors.card := by simp

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq (R X : ℕ) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X =
      ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (m.divisors.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount, finiteTauSmoothCount]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _
  simp [orderedDivisorCount_two]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_rpow (R H X : ℕ) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H X =
      finiteSmoothTailRpowSum (fun _ => 1) R H X (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteSmoothReciprocalTail, finiteSmoothTailRpowSum, Real.rpow_neg_one]

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_rpow (j R H X : ℕ) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X =
      finiteSmoothTailRpowSum (fun m => orderedDivisorCount j m) R H X (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail, finiteSmoothTailRpowSum, Real.rpow_neg_one,
    div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothCount_eq_rpow_zero
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothCount_eq_rpow_zero (j R X : ℕ) :
    finiteTauSmoothCount j R X =
      finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m => orderedDivisorCount j m) R X 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteTauSmoothCount, finiteSmoothRpowSum]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothRpowSum_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro m hm
  exact mul_nonneg (hw m hm) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) exponent)

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTailRpowSum_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro m hm
  exact mul_nonneg (hw m hm) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) exponent)

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothWeightedCount_le_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothWeightedCount_le_rankin {w : ℕ → ℝ} {R X : ℕ} {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hw : ∀ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, 0 ≤ w m) :
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, w m) ≤
      (X : ℝ) ^ s * finiteSmoothRpowSum w R X (-s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSmoothRpowSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro m hm
  have hmData := mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm
  have hmpos : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hmData.1)
  have hmX : (m : ℝ) ≤ X := by exact_mod_cast hmData.2.1
  have hpow : (m : ℝ) ^ s ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ s :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow hmpos.le hmX hs
  have hneg : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ (-s) := Real.rpow_nonneg hmpos.le _
  have hcancel : (m : ℝ) ^ s * (m : ℝ) ^ (-s) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hmpos]
    simp
  calc
    w m = (m : ℝ) ^ s * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-s)) := by
      calc
        w m = w m * ((m : ℝ) ^ s * (m : ℝ) ^ (-s)) := by rw [hcancel, mul_one]
        _ = (m : ℝ) ^ s * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-s)) := by ring
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ s * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-s)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (mul_nonneg (hw m hm) hneg)

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothWeightedTail_le_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothWeightedTail_le_rankin {w : ℕ → ℝ} {R H X : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hw : ∀ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, 0 ≤ w m) :
    finiteSmoothTailRpowSum w R H X (-1) ≤
      (H : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * finiteSmoothRpowSum w R X (δ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSmoothTailRpowSum, finiteSmoothRpowSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X, w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X,
          (H : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      have hmData := mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mp hm
      have hHreal : 0 < (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hH
      have hHm : (H : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt hmData.1)
      have hmpos : 0 < (m : ℝ) := hHreal.trans_le hHm
      have hpow : (m : ℝ) ^ (-δ) ≤ (H : ℝ) ^ (-δ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hHreal hHm (neg_nonpos.mpr hδ)
      have hrest : 0 ≤ w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1) :=
        mul_nonneg (hw m (finiteSmoothTailSet_subset R H X hm))
          (Real.rpow_nonneg hmpos.le _)
      have hcombine :
          (m : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1) = (m : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hmpos]
        congr 1
        ring
      calc
        w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) =
            (m : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1)) := by
          calc
            w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) =
                w m * ((m : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1)) := by rw [hcombine]
            _ = (m : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (H : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hrest
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X,
        (H : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (w m * (m : ℝ) ^ (δ - 1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (finiteSmoothTailSet_subset R H X)
      intro m hm _
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg H) _)
        (mul_nonneg (hw m hm) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) _))

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin {R H X : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H X ≤
      (H : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ => 1) R X (δ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_rpow]
  exact finiteSmoothWeightedTail_le_rankin hH hδ (fun _ _ => zero_le_one)

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin {j R H X : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X ≤
      (H : ℝ) ^ (-δ) *
        finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m => orderedDivisorCount j m) R X (δ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_rpow]
  exact finiteSmoothWeightedTail_le_rankin hH hδ (fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothCount_le_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothCount_le_rankin {j R X : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    finiteTauSmoothCount j R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) ^ s *
        finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m => orderedDivisorCount j m) R X (-s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteTauSmoothCount]
  exact finiteSmoothWeightedCount_le_rankin hs (fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_mul_log
statement:
theorem rankinU_mul_log {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) :
    rankinU H R * Real.log R = Real.log H
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinU, div_mul_cancel₀]
  exact (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).ne'

name: RankAmplification.rankinDelta_mul_log
statement:
theorem rankinDelta_mul_log {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) :
    rankinDelta H R * Real.log H = rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogR : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).ne'
  rw [← rankinU_mul_log hR, rankinDelta]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.rankinDelta_nonneg
statement:
theorem rankinDelta_nonneg {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU H R) :
    0 ≤ rankinDelta H R
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinDelta]
  exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hu) (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).le

name: RankAmplification.rankinDelta_le_one
statement:
theorem rankinDelta_le_one {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (huR : rankinU H R ≤ R) (hu : 0 < rankinU H R) :
    rankinDelta H R ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinDelta, div_le_one (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR))]
  exact Real.log_le_log hu (by exact_mod_cast huR)

name: RankAmplification.rankin_cutoff_rpow
statement:
theorem rankin_cutoff_rpow {H R : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 1 < R) :
    (H : ℝ) ^ (-rankinDelta H R) =
      Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hH)]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_neg, mul_comm, rankinDelta_mul_log hR]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_chosen_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_chosen_rankin {R H X : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 1 < R) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU H R) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) *
        finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ => 1) R X (rankinDelta H R - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rankin_cutoff_rpow hH hR] using
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin (R := R) (X := X)
      hH (rankinDelta_nonneg hR hu)

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_chosen_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_chosen_rankin {j R H X : ℕ}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 1 < R) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU H R) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) *
        finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m => orderedDivisorCount j m) R X
          (rankinDelta H R - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rankin_cutoff_rpow hH hR] using
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin (j := j) (R := R) (X := X)
      hH (rankinDelta_nonneg hR hu)

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_chosen_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_chosen_rankin {R X : ℕ}
    (hR : 1 < R) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU X R) (huR : rankinU X R ≤ R) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
        finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m => orderedDivisorCount 2 m) R X
          (rankinDelta X R - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount]
  simpa only [neg_sub] using
    finiteTauSmoothCount_le_rankin (j := 2) (R := R) (X := X)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (rankinDelta_le_one hR huR (zero_lt_one.trans_le hu)))

name: RankAmplification.eulerBoxSum_eq_prod_local
statement:
theorem eulerBoxSum_eq_prod_local (P : Finset ℕ) (K : ℕ)
    (localWeight : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    eulerBoxSum P K localWeight =
      ∏ p ∈ P, ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), localWeight p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [eulerBoxSum, eulerExponentBox] using
    (Finset.prod_sum P (fun _ => Finset.range (K + 1)) localWeight).symm

name: RankAmplification.rankinEulerRatio_pos
statement:
theorem rankinEulerRatio_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (s : ℝ) :
    0 < rankinEulerRatio p s
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hp) _

name: RankAmplification.rankinEulerRatio_lt_one
statement:
theorem rankinEulerRatio_lt_one {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 < p) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    rankinEulerRatio p s < 1
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hp) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)

name: RankAmplification.finite_geometric_sum_le_inv_one_sub
statement:
theorem finite_geometric_sum_le_inv_one_sub {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), q ^ a) ≤ (1 - q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1
  calc
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), q ^ a) ≤ ∑' a : ℕ, q ^ a :=
      hsum.summable.sum_le_tsum _ (fun a _ => pow_nonneg hq0 a)
    _ = (1 - q)⁻¹ := hsum.tsum_eq

name: RankAmplification.geometricEulerBoxSum_eq_product
statement:
theorem geometricEulerBoxSum_eq_product (P : Finset ℕ) (K : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    eulerBoxSum P K (fun p a => rankinEulerRatio p s ^ a) =
      truncatedRankinEulerProduct P K 1 s
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerBoxSum_eq_prod_local, truncatedRankinEulerProduct]
  simp

name: RankAmplification.truncatedRankinEulerProduct_le_majorant
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncatedRankinEulerProduct, rankinEulerMajorant]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod
  · intro p hp
    apply pow_nonneg
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => pow_nonneg
      (rankinEulerRatio_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (hP p hp)) s).le _
  · intro p hp
    have hqpos : 0 < rankinEulerRatio p s :=
      rankinEulerRatio_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (hP p hp)) s
    have hqlt : rankinEulerRatio p s < 1 := rankinEulerRatio_lt_one (hP p hp) hs
    have hlocalNonneg :
        0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), rankinEulerRatio p s ^ a := by
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => pow_nonneg hqpos.le _
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hlocalNonneg
      (finite_geometric_sum_le_inv_one_sub hqpos.le hqlt K) j

name: RankAmplification.log_rankinEulerMajorant
statement:
theorem log_rankinEulerMajorant {P : Finset ℕ} {j : ℕ} {s : ℝ}
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 1 < p) (hs : 0 < s) :
    Real.log (rankinEulerMajorant P j s) =
      (j : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ P, -Real.log (1 - rankinEulerRatio p s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinEulerMajorant, Real.log_prod]
  · simp_rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_inv]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  · intro p hp
    have hq : rankinEulerRatio p s < 1 := rankinEulerRatio_lt_one (hP p hp) hs
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hq.ne'))

name: RankAmplification.neg_log_one_sub_le_div
statement:
theorem neg_log_one_sub_le_div {q : ℝ} (hq1 : q < 1) :
    -Real.log (1 - q) ≤ q / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - q := sub_pos.mpr hq1
  have hlog := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hden
  have hid : 1 - (1 - q)⁻¹ = -(q / (1 - q)) := by
    field_simp [hden.ne']
    ring
  rw [hid] at hlog
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_sum
statement:
theorem log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_sum {P : Finset ℕ} {j : ℕ} {s : ℝ}
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, 1 < p) (hs : 0 < s) :
    Real.log (rankinEulerMajorant P j s) ≤
      (j : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ P,
        rankinEulerRatio p s / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_rankinEulerMajorant hP hs]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg j)
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro p hp
  exact neg_log_one_sub_le_div (rankinEulerRatio_lt_one (hP p hp) hs)

name: RankAmplification.mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet {X y Y J N : ℕ} :
    N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J ↔
      1 ≤ N ∧ N ≤ X ∧ largestPrimeFactor N.totient ≤ Y ∧
        largePrimeRank y N.totient < J
proof:
:= by
  simp only [boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet, Finset.mem_filter,
    mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet]
  aesop

name: RankAmplification.mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet {X y Y J d : ℕ} :
    d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J ↔
      ∃ N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J,
        badLocalProduct N y = d
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet]

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet_subset_boundedLowRankCensusSet
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet_subset_boundedLowRankCensusSet
    (X y Y J : ℕ) :
    boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J ⊆ boundedLowRankCensusSet X y J
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hN).1

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet_subset_boundedLowRankBadSourceSet
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet_subset_boundedLowRankBadSourceSet
    (X y Y J : ℕ) :
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J ⊆ boundedLowRankBadSourceSet X y J
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp hd
  exact mem_boundedLowRankBadSourceSet.mpr
    ⟨N, boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet_subset_boundedLowRankCensusSet _ _ _ _ hN, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.largePrimeRank_le_of_dvd
statement:
theorem largePrimeRank_le_of_dvd {y a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hab : a ∣ b) : largePrimeRank y a ≤ largePrimeRank y b
proof:
:= by
  have hfac : a.factorization ≤ b.factorization :=
    (Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd ha hb).mpr hab
  have hsupp : primeSupport a ⊆ primeSupport b := Nat.primeFactors_mono hab hb
  have hfilter : (primeSupport a).filter (y < ·) ⊆
      (primeSupport b).filter (y < ·) := by
    intro p hp
    have hpData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hsupp hpData.1, hpData.2⟩
  calc
    largePrimeRank y a =
        ∑ p ∈ (primeSupport a).filter (y < ·), a.factorization p := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ (primeSupport a).filter (y < ·), b.factorization p := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ hfac p
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ (primeSupport b).filter (y < ·), b.factorization p :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hfilter
    _ = largePrimeRank y b := rfl

name: RankAmplification.mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet {X y Y J q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet X y Y J ↔
      q.Prime ∧ q ≤ X ∧ y < q ∧ y < largestPrimeFactor (q - 1) ∧
        IsSmooth Y (q - 1) ∧ largePrimeRank y (q - 1) < J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet, Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mem_primesLE]
  tauto

name: RankAmplification.localTotientFactor_eq_pred_of_factorization_eq_one
statement:
theorem localTotientFactor_eq_pred_of_factorization_eq_one
    {N q : ℕ} (he : N.factorization q = 1) :
    localTotientFactor N q = q - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [localTotientFactor, he]

name: RankAmplification.linearBadSource_mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet
statement:
theorem linearBadSource_mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet
    {X y Y J N q : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) (he : N.factorization q = 1) :
    q ∈ fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet X y Y J
proof:
:= by
  have hNData := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hNData.1
  have hqSupport := (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1
  have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqSupport
  have hqDvdN := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hqSupport
  have hqX : q ≤ X := (Nat.le_of_dvd hNpos hqDvdN).trans hNData.2.1
  have hlocalEq := localTotientFactor_eq_pred_of_factorization_eq_one he
  have hpredPos : 0 < q - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hqPrime.one_lt
  have hpredDvd : q - 1 ∣ N.totient := by
    rw [← hlocalEq]
    exact localTotientFactor_dvd_totient hNpos.ne' hqSupport
  have hphiPos : 0 < N.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hNpos
  have hpredSmooth : IsSmooth Y (q - 1) := by
    refine ⟨hpredPos.ne', ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hpDvd : p ∣ N.totient :=
      (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans hpredDvd
    exact (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hpPrime hphiPos.ne' hpDvd).trans hNData.2.2.1
  have hpredRank : largePrimeRank y (q - 1) < J :=
    (largePrimeRank_le_of_dvd hpredPos.ne' hphiPos.ne' hpredDvd).trans_lt
      hNData.2.2.2
  exact mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mpr
    ⟨hqPrime, hqX, badLocalBase_gt hy hq,
      hlocalEq ▸ (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).2, hpredSmooth, hpredRank⟩

name: RankAmplification.repeatedBadSource_mem_powerSourcePrimeSet
statement:
theorem repeatedBadSource_mem_powerSourcePrimeSet
    {X y Y J N q : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) (he : 2 ≤ N.factorization q) :
    q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y
proof:
:= by
  have hNData := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hNData.1
  have hb := fixedBadLocalSourceBounds_of_mem hNpos.ne' hy
    hNData.2.2.1 hNData.2.2.2 hq
  exact mem_powerSourcePrimeSet.mpr
    ⟨hb.source_prime, hb.source_gt, hb.repeated_source_le_upper he⟩

name: RankAmplification.badSourceExponent_le_rank
statement:
theorem badSourceExponent_le_rank
    {X y Y J N q : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) :
    N.factorization q ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  have hNData := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hNData.1
  exact (fixedBadLocalSourceBounds_of_mem hNpos.ne' hy
    hNData.2.2.1 hNData.2.2.2 hq).exponent_le_rank

name: RankAmplification.repeatedBadSourcePrimePower_le
statement:
theorem repeatedBadSourcePrimePower_le
    {X y Y J N q : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) (he : 2 ≤ N.factorization q) :
    q ^ N.factorization q ≤ Y ^ J
proof:
:= by
  have hNData := mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mp hN
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hNData.1
  let hb := fixedBadLocalSourceBounds_of_mem hNpos.ne' hy
    hNData.2.2.1 hNData.2.2.2 hq
  have hqY : q ≤ Y := hb.repeated_source_le_upper he
  have hYpos : 0 < Y := hb.source_prime.pos.trans_le hqY
  calc
    q ^ N.factorization q ≤ Y ^ N.factorization q :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_left hqY _
    _ ≤ Y ^ J := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hYpos hb.exponent_le_rank

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadLocalFactorClassification_of_mem
statement:
theorem fixedBadLocalFactorClassification_of_mem
    {X y Y J N q : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (hq : q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y) :
    FixedBadLocalFactorClassification X y Y J N q
proof:
:= by
  have hqSupport := (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).1
  have hePos := factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport hqSupport
  rcases eq_or_ne (N.factorization q) 1 with he | he
  · exact .linear he (linearBadSource_mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet hy hN hq he)
  · have heTwo : 2 ≤ N.factorization q := by omega
    exact .power heTwo (repeatedBadSource_mem_powerSourcePrimeSet hy hN hq heTwo)
      (badSourceExponent_le_rank hy hN hq)
      (repeatedBadSourcePrimePower_le hy hN hq heTwo)

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadSourceAtomBase_badLocalSourceAtom
statement:
@[simp] theorem fixedBadSourceAtomBase_badLocalSourceAtom
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y}) :
    fixedBadSourceAtomBase (badLocalSourceAtom hy hN q) = q.1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : N.factorization q.1 = 1 <;>
    simp [badLocalSourceAtom, he, fixedBadSourceAtomBase]

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadSourceAtomValue_badLocalSourceAtom
statement:
@[simp] theorem fixedBadSourceAtomValue_badLocalSourceAtom
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y}) :
    fixedBadSourceAtomValue (badLocalSourceAtom hy hN q) =
      q.1 ^ N.factorization q.1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : N.factorization q.1 = 1
  · simp [badLocalSourceAtom, he, fixedBadSourceAtomValue]
  · have hePos := factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport
      (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp q.2).1
    simp only [badLocalSourceAtom, he, ↓reduceDIte, fixedBadSourceAtomValue]
    congr 1
    omega

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadSourceAtomBase_badLocalSourceAtomEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem fixedBadSourceAtomBase_badLocalSourceAtomEmbedding
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y}) :
    fixedBadSourceAtomBase (badLocalSourceAtomEmbedding hy hN q) = q.1
proof:
:= by
  exact fixedBadSourceAtomBase_badLocalSourceAtom hy hN q

name: RankAmplification.fixedBadSourceAtomValue_badLocalSourceAtomEmbedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem fixedBadSourceAtomValue_badLocalSourceAtomEmbedding
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J)
    (q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y}) :
    fixedBadSourceAtomValue (badLocalSourceAtomEmbedding hy hN q) =
      q.1 ^ N.factorization q.1
proof:

name: RankAmplification.card_badLocalSourceAtomCode
statement:
theorem card_badLocalSourceAtomCode
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J) :
    (badLocalSourceAtomCode hy hN).card = (badLocalPrimeSet N y).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [badLocalSourceAtomCode]

name: RankAmplification.prod_badLocalSourceAtomCode
statement:
theorem prod_badLocalSourceAtomCode
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J) :
    (∏ a ∈ badLocalSourceAtomCode hy hN, fixedBadSourceAtomValue a) =
      badLocalProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold badLocalSourceAtomCode
  rw [Finset.prod_map]
  simp only [fixedBadSourceAtomValue_badLocalSourceAtomEmbedding]
  change (∏ q ∈ (badLocalPrimeSet N y).attach,
    q.1 ^ N.factorization q.1) = badLocalProduct N y
  rw [show (∏ q ∈ (badLocalPrimeSet N y).attach,
      q.1 ^ N.factorization q.1) =
      ∏ q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y, q ^ N.factorization q by
    exact Finset.prod_attach (badLocalPrimeSet N y)
      (fun q : ℕ ↦ q ^ N.factorization q)]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.card_badLocalSourceAtomCode_lt
statement:
theorem card_badLocalSourceAtomCode_lt
    {X y Y J N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hN : N ∈ boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J) :
    (badLocalSourceAtomCode hy hN).card < J
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_badLocalSourceAtomCode]
  exact badLocalPrimeSet_card_lt_of_mem_boundedLowRankCensusSet hy
    (boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet_subset_boundedLowRankCensusSet _ _ _ _ hN)

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem
    {X y Y J : ℕ}
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d ∈
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet X y Y J
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp d.2)).1

name: RankAmplification.badLocalProduct_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative
statement:
theorem badLocalProduct_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative
    {X y Y J : ℕ}
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    badLocalProduct (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative d) y = d.1
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (mem_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet.mp d.2)).2

name: RankAmplification.prod_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode
statement:
theorem prod_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    (∏ a ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d,
      fixedBadSourceAtomValue a) = d.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode,
    prod_badLocalSourceAtomCode,
    badLocalProduct_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative]

name: RankAmplification.card_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_lt
statement:
theorem card_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_lt
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d).card < J
proof:
:=
  card_badLocalSourceAtomCode_lt hy
    (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceRepresentative_mem d)

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_injective
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_injective
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    Function.Injective
      (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode
        (X := X) (Y := Y) (J := J) hy)
proof:
:= by
  intro d e hcode
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    d.1 = ∏ a ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d,
        fixedBadSourceAtomValue a :=
      (prod_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d).symm
    _ = ∏ a ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy e,
        fixedBadSourceAtomValue a := by rw [hcode]
    _ = e.1 := prod_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy e

name: RankAmplification.prod_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_code
statement:
theorem prod_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_code
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J}) :
    (∏ a ∈ boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d,
      fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) = (d.1 : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBadSourceAtomWeight
  rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  rw [← Nat.cast_prod,
    prod_boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode hy d]

name: RankAmplification.fixedPowerBadSourceMass_eq_explicit_sum
statement:
theorem fixedPowerBadSourceMass_eq_explicit_sum (y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J =
      ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y,
        ∑ e ∈ Finset.range J, ((q ^ (e + 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedPowerBadSourceMass powerSourceLocalMass powerExponentReciprocalMass
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e he
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, inv_pow]

name: RankAmplification.sum_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight
statement:
theorem sum_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight (X y Y J : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J, fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) =
      fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J + fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
  · unfold fixedLinearBadSourceMass
    simpa [fixedBadSourceAtomWeight, fixedBadSourceAtomValue] using
      (Finset.sum_attach (fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet X y Y J)
        (fun q ↦ (q : ℝ)⁻¹))
  · rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    unfold fixedPowerBadSourceMass powerSourceLocalMass powerExponentReciprocalMass
    calc
      (∑ q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y},
          ∑ e : Fin J,
            fixedBadSourceAtomWeight (Sum.inr (q, e))) =
          ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y,
            ∑ e : Fin J, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e.1 + 2) := by
        simpa [fixedBadSourceAtomWeight, fixedBadSourceAtomValue,
          Nat.cast_pow, inv_pow] using
          (Finset.sum_attach (powerSourcePrimeSet y Y)
            (fun q ↦ ∑ e : Fin J, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e.1 + 2)))
      _ = ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y,
          ∑ e ∈ Finset.range J, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e + 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro q hq
        simpa using (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
          (n := J) (fun e : ℕ ↦ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e + 2)))

name: RankAmplification.fixedPowerBadSourceMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedPowerBadSourceMass_nonneg (y Y J : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J
proof:
:=
  powerSourceLocalMass_nonneg y Y J

name: RankAmplification.fixedPowerBadSourceMass_le_inv
statement:
theorem fixedPowerBadSourceMass_le_inv {y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  powerSourceLocalMass_le_inv hy

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_atomEulerProduct
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_atomEulerProduct
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J ≤
      ∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
        (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceSet X y Y J
  let code := boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode
    (X := X) (Y := Y) (J := J) hy
  let w := fun s : Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J) ↦
    ∏ a ∈ s, fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a
  have hcodeInj : Function.Injective code :=
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceAtomCode_injective hy
  have hsubset : D.attach.image code ⊆
      (Finset.univ : Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J)).powerset := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
    exact Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (Finset.subset_univ _)
  calc
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J =
        ∑ d ∈ D.attach, (d.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      unfold boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass D
      exact (Finset.sum_attach _ _).symm
    _ = ∑ d ∈ D.attach, w (code d) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      exact (prod_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight_code hy d).symm
    _ = ∑ s ∈ D.attach.image code, w s := by
      exact (Finset.sum_image hcodeInj.injOn).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J)).powerset,
        w s := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset fun s hs hnot ↦ by
        unfold w
        apply Finset.prod_nonneg
        intro a ha
        unfold fixedBadSourceAtomWeight
        exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = ∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
        (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) := by
      simpa [w] using (Finset.prod_one_add
        (Finset.univ : Finset (FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J))
        (f := fixedBadSourceAtomWeight)).symm

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_explicitSourceSums
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_explicitSourceSums
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J ≤
      Real.exp (fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J +
        fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J ≤
        ∏ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
          (1 + fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) :=
      boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_atomEulerProduct hy
    _ ≤ Real.exp (∑ a : FixedBadSourceAtom X y Y J,
        fixedBadSourceAtomWeight a) := by
      exact Real.prod_one_add_le_exp_sum Finset.univ fun a ↦ by
        unfold fixedBadSourceAtomWeight
        positivity
    _ = Real.exp (fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J +
        fixedPowerBadSourceMass y Y J) := by
      rw [sum_fixedBadSourceAtomWeight]

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_linearMass_add_inv
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_linearMass_add_inv
    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J ≤
      Real.exp (fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_explicitSourceSums hy).trans ?_
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  exact add_le_add (le_refl _) (fixedPowerBadSourceMass_le_inv (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy))

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_of_linearBound
statement:
theorem boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_of_linearBound
    {X y Y J : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hlinear : HasFixedLinearBadSourceMassBound X y Y J B) :
    boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass X y Y J ≤
      Real.exp (B + (y : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine (boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_linearMass_add_inv hy).trans ?_
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (add_le_add hlinear (le_refl _))

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankShiftedSet_subset_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankShiftedSet_subset_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet
    (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ⊆
      boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet x y Y J
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN
  have hNData := mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hN
  have hshift := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hNData.1
  exact mem_boundedTotientLowRankCensusSet.mpr
    ⟨hshift.1, hshift.2.1, hNData.2.1, hNData.2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet_subset_primesLE
statement:
theorem fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet_subset_primesLE
    (X y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet X y Y J ⊆ Nat.primesLE X
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  exact Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr
    ⟨(mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp hq).2.1,
      (mem_fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet.mp hq).1⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedLinearBadSourceMass_le_primeReciprocalSum
statement:

    (X y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J ≤ primeReciprocalSum X
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedLinearBadSourceMass primeReciprocalSum
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (fixedLinearBadSourcePrimeSet_subset_primesLE X y Y J)
  intro q hq hnot
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.fixedLinearBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev

    {X y Y J : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) :
    fixedLinearBadSourceMass X y Y J ≤
      fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X
proof:
:= by
  exact (fixedLinearBadSourceMass_le_primeReciprocalSum X y Y J).trans

name: RankAmplification.boundedTotientLowRankBadSourceMass_le_chebyshev

name: RankAmplification.eq_prime_pow_of_primeSupport_subset_singleton
statement:
theorem eq_prime_pow_of_primeSupport_subset_singleton {n p : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hsub : primeSupport n ⊆ {p}) : ∃ k : ℕ, n = p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨n.primeFactorsList.length, ?_⟩
  apply Nat.eq_prime_pow_of_unique_prime_dvd hn.ne'
  intro d hd hdvd
  have hmem : d ∈ primeSupport n := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hd, hdvd, hn.ne'⟩
  simpa using hsub hmem

name: RankAmplification.exists_pos_pow_of_primeSupport_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem exists_pos_pow_of_primeSupport_eq_singleton {h p : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsupp : primeSupport h = {p}) : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ h = p ^ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := eq_prime_pow_of_primeSupport_subset_singleton hh (by rw [hsupp])
  refine ⟨k, ?_, hk⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk0
  · exfalso
    have hone : h = 1 := by simpa [hk0] using hk
    have : primeSupport h = ∅ := by simp [hone, primeSupport]
    rw [hsupp] at this
    exact (Finset.singleton_ne_empty p) this
  · exact hk0

name: RankAmplification.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_card_primeSupport_le_one
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_card_primeSupport_le_one
    {h : ℕ} (hcard : (primeSupport h).card ≤ 1) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos h with hh | hh
  · subst hh
    exact SUnitTerminal.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_zero
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (primeSupport h).card 1 with hzero | hone
    · 
      have hempty : primeSupport h = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
      have hone : h = 1 := by
        by_contra hne
        have h2 : 2 ≤ h := by omega
        obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd (show h ≠ 1 from hne)
        have hmem : p ∈ primeSupport h :=
          Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp.1, hp.2, hh.ne'⟩
        rw [hempty] at hmem
        exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty p)
      subst hone
      exact terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_odd ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
    · have hcardOne : (primeSupport h).card = 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcardOne
      have hpmem : p ∈ primeSupport h := by
        rw [hp]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self p
      have hpPrime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpmem
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hpow⟩ := exists_pos_pow_of_primeSupport_eq_singleton hh hp
      rw [hpow]
      exact terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_prime_pow hpPrime ha

name: RankAmplification.terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_card_primeSupport_le_one
statement:
theorem terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_card_primeSupport_le_one
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hcard : (primeSupport h).card ≤ 1) :
    TerminalPPTSameSupportBound h
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (primeSupport h).card 1 with hzero | hone
  · have hempty : primeSupport h = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
    have hone : h = 1 := by
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd (show h ≠ 1 from hne)
      have hmem : p ∈ primeSupport h :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp.1, hp.2, hh.ne'⟩
      rw [hempty] at hmem
      exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty p)
    subst hone
    exact terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_odd ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
  · have hcardOne : (primeSupport h).card = 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcardOne
    have hpmem : p ∈ primeSupport h := by
      rw [hp]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self p
    have hpPrime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpmem
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hpow⟩ := exists_pos_pow_of_primeSupport_eq_singleton hh hp
    rw [hpow]
    exact terminalPPTSameSupportBound_prime_pow hpPrime ha

name: RankAmplification.factorization_eq_of_prime_pow_shift
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_of_prime_pow_shift {h p α γ : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hlt : α < γ) (heq : p ^ α + h = p ^ γ) : h.factorization p = α
proof:
:= by
  have hppos : 0 < p := hp.pos
  have hpow : p ^ γ = p ^ α * p ^ (γ - α) := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, p ^ (γ - α) = m + 1 :=
    ⟨p ^ (γ - α) - 1, by
      have : 1 ≤ p ^ (γ - α) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hppos
      omega⟩
  have hexpand : p ^ α * (m + 1) = p ^ α * m + p ^ α := by ring
  have hfac : h = p ^ α * m := by
    rw [hm] at hpow
    omega
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    have h2 : 2 ≤ p ^ (γ - α) := by
      calc 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
        _ = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
        _ ≤ p ^ (γ - α) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hppos (by omega)
    omega
  have hnd : ¬ p ∣ m := by
    intro hdvd
    have hpdvd : p ∣ p ^ (γ - α) := dvd_pow_self p (by omega)
    rw [hm] at hpdvd
    have hone : p ∣ 1 := by
      have := Nat.dvd_sub hpdvd hdvd
      simpa using this
    exact Nat.Prime.one_lt hp |>.ne'
      (Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos hone) hp.one_lt.le)
  rw [hfac, Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hppos.ne') hmpos.ne']
  simp [hp.factorization_pow, Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hnd]

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportIndex_singleton_eq
statement:
theorem sameSupportIndex_singleton_eq {h p j : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hj : IsSameSupportIndex h j) (hjp : primeSupport j = {p}) :
    j = p ^ h.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  have hjpos : 0 < j := hj.1
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := eq_prime_pow_of_primeSupport_subset_singleton hjpos (by rw [hjp])
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := eq_prime_pow_of_primeSupport_subset_singleton
    (by omega : 0 < j + h) (by rw [← hj.2, hjp])
  have heq : p ^ α + h = p ^ γ := by rw [← hα, ← hγ]
  have hlt : α < γ := by
    have hmono : p ^ α < p ^ γ := by omega
    exact (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right hp.one_lt).mp hmono
  rw [hα, factorization_eq_of_prime_pow_shift hp hlt heq]

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportIndex_singleton_unique
statement:
theorem sameSupportIndex_singleton_unique {h p j k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hj : IsSameSupportIndex h j) (hjp : primeSupport j = {p})
    (hk : IsSameSupportIndex h k) (hkp : primeSupport k = {p}) :
    j = k
proof:
:=
  (sameSupportIndex_singleton_eq hp hh hj hjp).trans
    (sameSupportIndex_singleton_eq hp hh hk hkp).symm

name: RankAmplification.singleton_support_prime_mem_primeSupport
statement:
theorem singleton_support_prime_mem_primeSupport {h p j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hj : IsSameSupportIndex h j) (hjp : primeSupport j = {p}) :
    p ∈ primeSupport h
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : p ∈ primeSupport j := by rw [hjp]; simp
  exact primeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport hh hj hmem

name: RankAmplification.mem_rankOneSameSupportCarrier_of
statement:
theorem mem_rankOneSameSupportCarrier_of {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hj : IsSameSupportIndex h j) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hjp : primeSupport j = {p}) :
    j ∈ rankOneSameSupportCarrier h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rankOneSameSupportCarrier, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨p, singleton_support_prime_mem_primeSupport hh hj hjp, ?_⟩, hj⟩
  exact (sameSupportIndex_singleton_eq hp hh hj hjp).symm

name: RankAmplification.isSameSupportIndex_of_mem_rankOneSameSupportCarrier
statement:
theorem isSameSupportIndex_of_mem_rankOneSameSupportCarrier
    {h j : ℕ} (hj : j ∈ rankOneSameSupportCarrier h) :
    IsSameSupportIndex h j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2

name: RankAmplification.card_rankOneSameSupportCarrier_le
statement:
theorem card_rankOneSameSupportCarrier_le (h : ℕ) :
    (rankOneSameSupportCarrier h).card ≤ (primeSupport h).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans Finset.card_image_le
