name: RankAmplification.deriv_reciprocalLogKernel
statement:
theorem deriv_reciprocalLogKernel {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t * Real.log t)⁻¹) x =
      -((Real.log x + 1) / (x ^ 2 * Real.log x ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hlog : Real.log x ≠ 0 :=
    Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hd := ((hasDerivAt_id x).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_log hx0) |>.inv
    (mul_ne_zero hx0 hlog)).deriv
  simp only [Pi.inv_def, Pi.mul_def, id_eq] at hd
  rw [show deriv (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t * Real.log t)⁻¹) x =
    -((1 * Real.log x + x * x⁻¹) / (x * Real.log x) ^ 2) by
      simpa only [neg_div] using hd]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.integrableOn_theta_div_sq
statement:
theorem integrableOn_theta_div_sq (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ Chebyshev.theta t / t ^ 2) (Set.Icc 2 x) volume
proof:
:= by
  conv => arg 1; ext t; rw [Chebyshev.theta, div_eq_mul_one_div, mul_comm, sum_filter]
  refine integrableOn_mul_sum_Icc _ (by norm_num) <|
    ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 ht0
  fun_prop (disch := assumption)

name: RankAmplification.integrableOn_theta_mul_reciprocalLogDerivative
statement:
theorem integrableOn_theta_mul_reciprocalLogDerivative (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦
      Chebyshev.theta t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2))
      (Set.Icc 2 x) volume
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := Set.indicator {n : ℕ | n.Prime} (fun n ↦ Real.log n)
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦
      ((Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)) *
        ∑ k ∈ Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, c k) (Set.Icc 2 x) volume := by
    refine integrableOn_mul_sum_Icc c (by norm_num) <|
      ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
      Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.1])
    have hden : t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 ht0) (pow_ne_zero 2 hlog)
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  convert hg using 1
  funext t
  simp [c, Set.indicator_apply, sum_filter, Chebyshev.theta_eq_sum_Icc]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.primeLogReciprocalSum_eq_theta_integral
statement:
theorem primeLogReciprocalSum_eq_theta_integral {R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    primeLogReciprocalSum R =
      Chebyshev.theta R / R + ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, Chebyshev.theta t / t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := Set.indicator {n : ℕ | n.Prime} (fun n ↦ Real.log n)
  rw [primeLogReciprocalSum, Nat.primesLE_eq_filter_Icc_zero, sum_filter]
  trans ∑ n ∈ Icc 0 R, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * a n
  · apply sum_congr rfl
    intro n hn
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp [a, hp, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    · simp [a, hp]
  nth_rewrite 1 [← Nat.floor_natCast (R := ℝ) R]
  rw [sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₁ a (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹)
    (by simp [a, Nat.not_prime_zero]) (by simp [a, Nat.not_prime_one]) R,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (mod_cast hR)]
  · have int_deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, deriv (fun u : ℝ ↦ u⁻¹) t * f t =
          ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, -(f t / t ^ 2) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro t _
        change deriv (fun u : ℝ ↦ u⁻¹) t * f t = -(f t / t ^ 2)
        rw [deriv_inv]
        ring
    rw [int_deriv]
    simp [a, Set.indicator_apply, sum_filter, Chebyshev.theta_eq_sum_Icc]
    ring
  · intro t ht
    exact (hasDerivAt_inv (by linarith [ht.1])).differentiableAt
  · rw [deriv_inv']
    apply ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc
    intro t ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    exact ((continuousAt_id.pow 2).inv₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 ht0)).neg.continuousWithinAt

name: RankAmplification.primeReciprocalSum_eq_theta_integral
statement:
theorem primeReciprocalSum_eq_theta_integral {R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    primeReciprocalSum R = Chebyshev.theta R / (R * Real.log R) +
      ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
        Chebyshev.theta t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := Set.indicator {n : ℕ | n.Prime} (fun n ↦ Real.log n)
  rw [primeReciprocalSum, Nat.primesLE_eq_filter_Icc_zero, sum_filter]
  trans ∑ n ∈ Icc 0 R, ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n)⁻¹ * a n
  · apply sum_congr rfl
    intro n hn
    split_ifs with hp
    · have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := mod_cast hp.ne_zero
      have hlog : Real.log (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
        Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (mod_cast hp.pos) (mod_cast hp.ne_one)
      rw [show a n = Real.log n by simp [a, hp]]
      field_simp
    · simp [a, hp]
  nth_rewrite 1 [← Nat.floor_natCast (R := ℝ) R]
  rw [sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₁ a
    (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ (t * Real.log t)⁻¹)
    (by simp [a, Nat.not_prime_zero]) (by simp [a, Nat.not_prime_one]) R,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (mod_cast hR)]
  · have int_deriv (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, deriv (fun u : ℝ ↦ (u * Real.log u)⁻¹) t * f t =
          ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
            -(f t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (mod_cast hR)] at ht
        change deriv (fun u : ℝ ↦ (u * Real.log u)⁻¹) t * f t =
          -(f t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2))
        rw [deriv_reciprocalLogKernel (by linarith [ht.1])]
        ring
    rw [int_deriv]
    simp [a, Set.indicator_apply, sum_filter, Chebyshev.theta_eq_sum_Icc]
    field_simp
  · intro t ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
      Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.1])
    exact ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_log ht0) |>.inv
      (mul_ne_zero ht0 hlog)).differentiableAt
  · refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ContinuousWithinAt.congr
      (f := fun u : ℝ ↦ -((Real.log u + 1) / (u ^ 2 * Real.log u ^ 2)))
      (g := deriv fun u : ℝ ↦ (u * Real.log u)⁻¹) ?_ (fun y hy ↦ ?_) ?_
    · have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
      have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
        Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.1])
      have hden : t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 ht0) (pow_ne_zero 2 hlog)
      exact ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt (by fun_prop (disch := assumption))
    · exact deriv_reciprocalLogKernel (by linarith [hy.1])
    · exact deriv_reciprocalLogKernel (by linarith [ht.1])

name: RankAmplification.primeLogReciprocalSum_le
statement:
theorem primeLogReciprocalSum_le {R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    primeLogReciprocalSum R ≤ Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeLogReciprocalSum_eq_theta_integral hR]
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hRcast : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := mod_cast hR
  have hboundary : Chebyshev.theta R / R ≤ Real.log 4 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hRpos).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x hRpos.le
  have hleft : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ Chebyshev.theta t / t ^ 2)
      volume 2 R := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hRcast]
    exact integrableOn_theta_div_sq R
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.log 4 * t⁻¹) volume 2 R := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hRcast] at ht
      linarith [ht.1]
    fun_prop
  have hintegral :
      (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, Chebyshev.theta t / t ^ 2) ≤
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, Real.log 4 * t⁻¹ := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hRcast hleft hright
    intro t ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) ht.1
    have ht2pos : 0 < t ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos htpos
    apply (div_le_iff₀ ht2pos).2
    calc
      Chebyshev.theta t ≤ Real.log 4 * t :=
        Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x htpos.le
      _ = (Real.log 4 * t⁻¹) * t ^ 2 := by field_simp
  calc
    Chebyshev.theta R / R + ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, Chebyshev.theta t / t ^ 2
        ≤ Real.log 4 + ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, Real.log 4 * t⁻¹ :=
      add_le_add hboundary hintegral
    _ = Real.log 4 + Real.log 4 * Real.log ((R : ℝ) / 2) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_inv_of_pos (by norm_num) hRpos]
    _ ≤ Real.log 4 + Real.log 4 * Real.log R := by
      have hratio : 0 < (R : ℝ) / 2 := div_pos hRpos (by norm_num)
      have hratio_le : (R : ℝ) / 2 ≤ R := by nlinarith [hRpos]
      exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.log_le_log hratio hratio_le)
        (Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 by norm_num)))
    _ = Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.primeReciprocalSum_le
statement:
theorem primeReciprocalSum_le {R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    primeReciprocalSum R ≤ Real.log 4 *
      (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeReciprocalSum_eq_theta_integral hR]
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hRlog : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hRcast : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := mod_cast hR
  have hboundary : Chebyshev.theta R / (R * Real.log R) ≤
      Real.log 4 / Real.log R := by
    have hden : 0 < (R : ℝ) * Real.log R := mul_pos hRpos hRlog
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    calc
      Chebyshev.theta R ≤ Real.log 4 * R :=
        Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x hRpos.le
      _ = (Real.log 4 / Real.log R) * (R * Real.log R) := by field_simp
  have hleft : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦
      Chebyshev.theta t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2))
      volume 2 R := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hRcast]
    exact integrableOn_theta_mul_reciprocalLogDerivative R
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ Real.log 4 *
    (t⁻¹ / Real.log t + t⁻¹ / Real.log t ^ 2)
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable g volume 2 R := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hRcast] at ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
      Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.1])
    have hlog2 : Real.log t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hlog
    dsimp [g]
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  have hintegral :
      (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
        Chebyshev.theta t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)) ≤
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, g t := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hRcast hleft hright
    intro t ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) ht.1
    have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos (by linarith [ht.1])
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2) := by positivity
    calc
      Chebyshev.theta t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2) =
          Chebyshev.theta t * ((Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (Real.log 4 * t) * ((Real.log t + 1) /
          (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x htpos.le) hcoef
      _ = g t := by
        dsimp [g]
        field_simp
  have hfirst : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ / Real.log t) volume 2 R := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hRcast] at ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
      Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.1])
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  have hsecond : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ / Real.log t ^ 2)
      volume 2 R := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hRcast] at ht
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
      Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.1])
    have hlog2 : Real.log t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hlog
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  calc
    Chebyshev.theta R / (R * Real.log R) +
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          Chebyshev.theta t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)
        ≤ Real.log 4 / Real.log R + ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, g t :=
      add_le_add hboundary hintegral
    _ = Real.log 4 / Real.log R + Real.log 4 *
        ((Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          ((Real.log 2)⁻¹ - (Real.log R)⁻¹)) := by
      dsimp [g]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add hfirst hsecond,
        integral_inv_div_log (by norm_num) hRone,
        integral_inv_div_log_sq (by norm_num) hRone]
    _ = Real.log 4 *
        (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) := by
      field_simp
      ring

name: RankAmplification.exp_le_one_add_two_mul
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_two_mul {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp x ≤ 1 + 2 * x
proof:
:= by
  have habs : |x| ≤ 1 := by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hx0] using hx1
  have h := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_le habs
  have h' : Real.exp x - 1 ≤ 2 * x :=
    (le_abs_self (Real.exp x - 1)).trans (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hx0] using h)
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.prime_rpow_neg_one_add_le
statement:
theorem prime_rpow_neg_one_add_le {p R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpR : p ≤ R)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδR : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) ≤
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * δ * (Real.log p / p)
proof:
:= by
  have hppos : 0 < (p : ℝ) := mod_cast hp.pos
  have hlogp : 0 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (mod_cast hp.one_le)
  have hlog_le : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_le_log hppos (mod_cast hpR)
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ δ * Real.log (p : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hδ0 hlogp
  have hx1 : δ * Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_le hδ0).trans hδR
  have hexp := exp_le_one_add_two_mul hx0 hx1
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hppos]
  calc
    Real.exp (Real.log p * (-1 + δ)) =
        (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * Real.exp (δ * Real.log p) := by
      rw [show Real.log (p : ℝ) * (-1 + δ) =
        -Real.log p + δ * Real.log p by ring, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg,
        Real.exp_log hppos]
    _ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 + 2 * (δ * Real.log p)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (inv_nonneg.mpr hppos.le)
    _ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * δ * (Real.log p / p) := by
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_aux
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_aux {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hδR : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      primeReciprocalSum R + 2 * δ * primeLogReciprocalSum R
proof:
:= by
  calc
    primeRankinSum R δ = ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        ((p : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * δ * (Real.log p / p)) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      exact prime_rpow_neg_one_add_le (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)
        (Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hp) hδ0 hδR
    _ = primeReciprocalSum R + 2 * δ * primeLogReciprocalSum R := by
      rw [sum_add_distrib, primeReciprocalSum, primeLogReciprocalSum,
        ← Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hδR : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      Real.log 4 *
        (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) +
      2 * δ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
        primeReciprocalSum R + 2 * δ * primeLogReciprocalSum R :=
      primeRankinSum_le_aux hδ0 hδR
    _ ≤ Real.log 4 *
          (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) +
        2 * δ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R)) := by
      exact add_le_add (primeReciprocalSum_le hR)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (primeLogReciprocalSum_le hR) (by positivity))

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_loglog_three_mul
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_loglog_three_mul {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδR : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      Real.log 4 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
          (Real.log 2)⁻¹) +
      2 * δ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R))
proof:
:= by
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hlogRpos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hRle : (R : ℝ) ≤ 3 * R := by nlinarith [hRpos]
  have hlogle : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (3 * R) :=
    Real.log_le_log hRpos hRle
  have hloglogle : Real.log (Real.log (R : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (3 * R)) :=
    Real.log_le_log hlogRpos hlogle
  calc
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
        Real.log 4 *
          (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) +
        2 * δ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R)) :=
      primeRankinSum_le hR hδ0 hδR
    _ ≤ Real.log 4 *
          (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
            (Real.log 2)⁻¹) +
        2 * δ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R)) := by
      apply add_le_add
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
      linarith
      exact le_rfl

name: RankAmplification.eventually_natLog_two_succ_le_two_mul_log
statement:
theorem eventually_natLog_two_succ_le_two_mul_log :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ((Nat.log 2 x + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log x
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log x :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [hbig, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hlog hx
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hpow : (2 : ℕ) ^ Nat.log 2 x ≤ x := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hx.ne'
  have hpowReal : (2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 x ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpow
  have hposPow : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 x := by positivity
  have hlogMono : Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 x) ≤ Real.log x :=
    Real.log_le_log hposPow hpowReal
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlogMono
  have hlog2 : (0.6931471803 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.log 2 x : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hstep : (Nat.log 2 x : ℝ) * (0.6931471803 : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.log 2 x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2.le hn
  push_cast
  nlinarith [hstep, hlogMono, hlog, hn]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_two_pow_mul_log_pow_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem eventually_two_pow_mul_log_pow_le_sqrt (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (2 : ℝ) ^ k * Real.log x ^ (k + 2) ≤ Real.sqrt x
proof:
:= by
  have hlittle :
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.log t ^ (((k : ℝ) + 2))) =o[atTop] fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop ((k : ℝ) + 2) (by norm_num)
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 ^ k := by positivity
  have hbound := hlittle.bound hc
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hbound,
      eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hx hx1
  have hxpos : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx1
  have hlogNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_nonneg hxpos
  have hxNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hrpowLog : Real.log (x : ℝ) ^ (((k : ℝ) + 2)) = Real.log x ^ (k + 2) := by
    have hcast : ((k : ℝ) + 2) = ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hrpowX : (x : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt x := (Real.sqrt_eq_rpow _).symm
  rw [hrpowLog, hrpowX, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)] at hx
  have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
  calc
    (2 : ℝ) ^ k * Real.log x ^ (k + 2) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 / 2 ^ k * Real.sqrt x) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx h2k.le
    _ = Real.sqrt x := by field_simp

name: RankAmplification.eventually_sqrt_mul_natLog_pow_le_logSquaredScale
statement:
theorem eventually_sqrt_mul_natLog_pow_le_logSquaredScale (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.sqrt x * (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log x :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [eventually_natLog_two_succ_le_two_mul_log,
      eventually_two_pow_mul_log_pow_le_sqrt k, hbig, eventually_ge_atTop 1]
      with x hlogx hpow hbigx hx1
  have hxpos : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx1
  have hxNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlogpos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log x := by linarith
  have hsq : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log x ^ 2 := by positivity
  rw [AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale, le_div_iff₀ hsq]
  have hbase : (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * Real.log x) ^ k := by
    push_cast
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by push_cast at hlogx ⊢; linarith) k
  have hkey : (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log x ^ 2 ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
    calc
      (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log x ^ 2 ≤
          (2 * Real.log x) ^ k * Real.log x ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbase hsq.le
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * Real.log x ^ (k + 2) := by
        rw [mul_pow, pow_add]
        ring
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt x := hpow
  have hsqrtNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  calc
    Real.sqrt x * (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log x ^ 2 =
        Real.sqrt x * ((((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log x ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey hsqrtNonneg
    _ = (x : ℝ) := Real.mul_self_sqrt hxNonneg

name: RankAmplification.fixedShiftDiagonalConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem fixedShiftDiagonalConstant_nonneg (h : ℕ) : 0 ≤ fixedShiftDiagonalConstant h
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedShiftDiagonalConstant
  have := growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_nonneg (primeSupport h)
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_theorem10_14_fixed_shift
statement:
theorem fixedRank_theorem10_14_fixed_shift (J h : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        fixedShiftDiagonalConstant h * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x +
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
            fixedRankClosedError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [fixedRank_theorem10_14_unconditional hJ,
      (tendsto_fixedRankNatY_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop h,
      eventually_sqrt_mul_natLog_pow_le_logSquaredScale (primeSupport h).card,
      eventually_ge_atTop 9] with x hmain hY habs hx9
  have hS := hmain h hh hY
  have hD := proposition9_5_diagonal_bound_unconditional
    (Y := fixedRankNatUpperY J x) hh hx9
  have hconst : fixedShiftDiagonalConstant h * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x =
      9 * AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet (primeSupport h) *
          ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x +
        AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by
    unfold fixedShiftDiagonalConstant
    ring
  have hmajorant : fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankClosedError J) x =
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankClosedError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := rfl
  rw [hconst, ← hmajorant]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_theorem10_14_fixed_shift_majorant
statement:
theorem fixedRank_theorem10_14_fixed_shift_majorant (J h : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        fixedShiftDiagonalConstant h * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x +
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant J (fixedRankClosedError J) x
proof:
:=
  fixedRank_theorem10_14_fixed_shift J h hJ hh

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError_zero J hc₀ hC₀).add
    (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀ hC₀)
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError
  simpa only [add_zero] using h

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBound x y
        (fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x)
        (Real.exp (-(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange J hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le hc₀ hC₀]
      with x hgap hcompare
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow W hWpos hWle hWgap
  refine (hgap y T hcutoff hwindow W hWpos hWle hWgap).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (Nat.cast_nonneg W)
  have hlower := (abs_le.mp (hcompare T hwindow)).1
  have hexpand : fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
      fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError
    ring
  rw [hexpand]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.exists_tendsto_zero_eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_zero_eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
        IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
        HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBound x y
          (fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x)
          (Real.exp (-(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) + ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀,
    tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError_zero J hc₀ hC₀,
    eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG J hc₀ hC₀⟩

name: RankAmplification.log2_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL
statement:
theorem log2_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL :
    log2 =o[atTop] (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x))
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)).comp_tendsto
      tendsto_scaleL_atTop
  apply h.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    simp [Function.comp_apply, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]

name: RankAmplification.sqrt_scaleL_isBigO_scaleG
statement:
theorem sqrt_scaleL_isBigO_scaleG :
    (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x)) =O[atTop] scaleG
proof:
:= by
  rw [isBigO_iff]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos,
    tendsto_scaleA_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hL hA
  have hprod : scaleL x ≤ scaleL x * scaleA x := by
    nlinarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (scaleL x) ≤ scaleG x := by
    rw [scaleG_eq]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hprod
  have hleft : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hright : 0 ≤ scaleG x := scaleG_nonneg x
  calc
    ‖Real.sqrt (scaleL x)‖ = Real.sqrt (scaleL x) := Real.norm_of_nonneg hleft
    _ ≤ scaleG x := hsqrt
    _ = ‖scaleG x‖ := (Real.norm_of_nonneg hright).symm
    _ = 1 * ‖scaleG x‖ := by ring

name: RankAmplification.log2_isLittleO_scaleG
statement: theorem log2_isLittleO_scaleG : log2 =o[atTop] scaleG
proof:
:=
  log2_isLittleO_sqrt_scaleL.trans_isBigO sqrt_scaleL_isBigO_scaleG

name: RankAmplification.eventually_mul_log2_le_fixedRankT
statement:
theorem eventually_mul_log2_le_fixedRankT
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {A₀ : ℝ} (hA₀ : 0 ≤ A₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, A₀ * log2 x ≤ fixedRankT J x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA₀zero : A₀ = 0
  · subst A₀
    have hT : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 0 ≤ fixedRankT J x :=
      (tendsto_fixedRankT_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop 0
    simpa using hT
  · have hA₀pos : 0 < A₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne hA₀ (Ne.symm hA₀zero)
    have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt J := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
    have hc : 0 < (Real.sqrt J)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hsqrtJ
    have hbound := (log2_isLittleO_scaleG.const_mul_left A₀).bound hc
    filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_log2_pos, eventually_scaleL_pos,
      eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hx hlog hL hA
    have hleft : 0 ≤ A₀ * log2 x := mul_nonneg hA₀ hlog.le
    have hG : 0 ≤ scaleG x := (scaleG_pos hL hA).le
    calc
      A₀ * log2 x = ‖A₀ * log2 x‖ := (Real.norm_of_nonneg hleft).symm
      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt J)⁻¹ * ‖scaleG x‖ := by simpa using hx
      _ = fixedRankT J x := by
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hG, fixedRankT, inv_mul_eq_div]

name: RankAmplification.fixedPolylogCutoff_eq_floor
statement:
@[simp] theorem fixedPolylogCutoff_eq_floor (A₀ : ℝ) (x : ℕ) :
    fixedPolylogCutoff A₀ x = ⌊(scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ A₀⌋₊
proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.eventually_polylog_real_le_fixedRankY
statement:
theorem eventually_polylog_real_le_fixedRankY
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {A₀ : ℝ} (hA₀ : 0 ≤ A₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, (scaleL x) ^ A₀ ≤ fixedRankY J x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_mul_log2_le_fixedRankT hJ hA₀,
    eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hx hL
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hL, fixedRankY]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  simpa only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq, mul_comm] using hx

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedPolylogCutoff_le_fixedRankNatY
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedPolylogCutoff_le_fixedRankNatY
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {A₀ : ℝ} (hA₀ : 0 ≤ A₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedPolylogCutoff A₀ x ≤ fixedRankNatY J x
proof:
:= by
  have hreal := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_polylog_real_le_fixedRankY hJ hA₀)
  filter_upwards [hreal] with x hx
  exact Nat.floor_mono hx

name: RankAmplification.FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.polylog_odd_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem FixedRankDiagonalEstimate.polylog_odd_coefficient_bound
    {J : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ} {C B A₀ : ℝ}
    (estimate : FixedRankDiagonalEstimate J ε C)
    (hB : B < Real.sqrt J) (hA₀ : 0 ≤ A₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedPolylogCutoff A₀ x → Odd h →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        C * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B * scaleG (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have huniform := estimate.uniform_odd_coefficient_bound hB
  filter_upwards [huniform,
    eventually_fixedPolylogCutoff_le_fixedRankNatY estimate.rank_pos hA₀] with
      x hx hpoly
  intro h hh hhrange hodd
  exact hx h hh (hhrange.trans hpoly) hodd

name: RankAmplification.InBFPSUniformTail.of_le
statement:
theorem InBFPSUniformTail.of_le {δ t s : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hts : t ≤ s)
    (hs : InBFPSUniformTail δ s X Y) : InBFPSUniformTail δ t X Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨hts.trans hs.1, hs.2.1, hts.trans hs.2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.bfpsErrorValues_subset_of_le
statement:
theorem bfpsErrorValues_subset_of_le {δ t s : ℝ} (hts : t ≤ s) :
    bfpsErrorValues δ s ⊆ bfpsErrorValues δ t
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact Set.mem_union_left _ he
  · obtain ⟨X, Y, htail, hev⟩ := he
    exact Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨X, Y, htail.of_le hts, hev⟩

name: RankAmplification.bfpsErrorValues_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem bfpsErrorValues_subset_Icc {δ t ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (h : ∀ X Y : ℕ, InBFPSUniformTail δ t X Y → bfpsNormalizedExcess X Y ≤ ε) :
    bfpsErrorValues δ t ⊆ Set.Icc 0 ε
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rcases he with he | he
  · have he0 : e = 0 := he
    exact ⟨he0.ge, he0.trans_le hε⟩
  · obtain ⟨X, Y, htail, hev⟩ := he
    subst hev
    exact ⟨bfpsNormalizedExcess_nonneg X Y, h X Y htail⟩

name: RankAmplification.bfpsErrorEnvelope_nonneg
statement: theorem bfpsErrorEnvelope_nonneg (δ t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ bfpsErrorEnvelope δ t
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsErrorEnvelope
  by_cases hb : BddAbove (bfpsErrorValues δ t)
  · exact le_csSup hb (zero_mem_bfpsErrorValues δ t)
  · rw [Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove hb]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsErrorEnvelope_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem bfpsErrorEnvelope_le_of_forall {δ t ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (h : ∀ X Y : ℕ, InBFPSUniformTail δ t X Y → bfpsNormalizedExcess X Y ≤ ε) :
    bfpsErrorEnvelope δ t ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  refine csSup_le ⟨0, zero_mem_bfpsErrorValues δ t⟩ ?_
  intro b hb
  exact (bfpsErrorValues_subset_Icc hε h hb).2

name: RankAmplification.bfpsErrorEnvelope_antitone_of_bddAbove
statement:
theorem bfpsErrorEnvelope_antitone_of_bddAbove {δ t s : ℝ} (hts : t ≤ s)
    (hbdd : BddAbove (bfpsErrorValues δ t)) :
    bfpsErrorEnvelope δ s ≤ bfpsErrorEnvelope δ t
proof:
:= by
  refine csSup_le ⟨0, zero_mem_bfpsErrorValues δ s⟩ ?_
  intro b hb
  exact le_csSup hbdd (bfpsErrorValues_subset_of_le hts hb)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_bfpsErrorEnvelope_zero_of_uniform
statement:
theorem tendsto_bfpsErrorEnvelope_zero_of_uniform
    {δ : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, t₀ ≤ t →
      ∀ X Y : ℕ, InBFPSUniformTail δ t X Y → bfpsNormalizedExcess X Y ≤ ε) :
    Tendsto (bfpsErrorEnvelope δ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ := h (ε / 2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨t₀, fun t ht ↦ ?_⟩
  have hle : bfpsErrorEnvelope δ t ≤ ε / 2 :=
    bfpsErrorEnvelope_le_of_forall (by linarith) (ht₀ t ht)
  have hge : 0 ≤ bfpsErrorEnvelope δ t := bfpsErrorEnvelope_nonneg δ t
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hge]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_of_bfpsNormalizedExcess_le
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_of_bfpsNormalizedExcess_le
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hu : 0 < bfpsU X Y)
    (h : bfpsNormalizedExcess X Y ≤ ξ) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(bfpsU X Y) * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ))
proof:
:= by
  have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < X by omega)
  have hdpos : 0 < smoothTotientDensity X Y := smoothTotientDensity_pos (Y := Y) hX
  unfold bfpsNormalizedExcess at h
  rw [max_le_iff] at h
  have hquot : Real.log (smoothTotientDensity X Y) / bfpsU X Y ≤
      ξ - log2 (bfpsU X Y) - log3 (bfpsU X Y) := by linarith [h.2]
  have hlog : Real.log (smoothTotientDensity X Y) ≤
      -(bfpsU X Y) * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) := by
    calc Real.log (smoothTotientDensity X Y)
        ≤ (ξ - log2 (bfpsU X Y) - log3 (bfpsU X Y)) * bfpsU X Y :=
          (div_le_iff₀ hu).mp hquot
      _ = -(bfpsU X Y) * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) := by ring
  have hdens : smoothTotientDensity X Y ≤
      Real.exp (-(bfpsU X Y) * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ)) :=
    (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hdpos).mp hlog
  rw [smoothTotientDensity, div_le_iff₀ hXpos] at hdens
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact hdens

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.productValue_pos
statement: theorem productValue_pos (m q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : 0 < productValue m q
proof:
:= by
  unfold productValue
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.productValue_strictMono
statement: theorem productValue_strictMono (m : ℕ) : StrictMono (productValue m)
proof:
:= by
  intro q r hqr
  have hright : m * q + 1 ≤ m * r + 1 := by
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hqr.le) 1
  calc
    productValue m q = q * (m * q + 1) := rfl
    _ < r * (m * q + 1) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hqr (by omega)
    _ ≤ r * (m * r + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left r hright
    _ = productValue m r := rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedProductValue_strictMono
statement: theorem shiftedProductValue_strictMono (m : ℕ) : StrictMono (shiftedProductValue m)
proof:
:= by
  intro t u htu
  exact productValue_strictMono m (Nat.add_lt_add_right htu 1)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_selbergSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_selbergSupport {m R N : ℕ} :
    N ∈ selbergSupport m R ↔ ∃ t < R, shiftedProductValue m t = N
proof:
:= by
  simp [selbergSupport, shiftedProductEmbedding]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_shiftedBadResidueSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_shiftedBadResidueSet {m d : ℕ} {t : Fin d} :
    t ∈ shiftedBadResidueSet m d ↔ d ∣ shiftedProductValue m t
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedBadResidueSet]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd (m d t : ℕ) :
    shiftedProductMod m d t = 0 ↔ d ∣ shiftedProductValue m t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [shiftedProductMod, shiftedProductValue, productValue,
    Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_badResidueSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_badResidueSet_iff {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {q : ZMod p} :
    q ∈ badResidueSet m p hp ↔ q * ((m : ZMod p) * q + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  simp [badResidueSet, AffinePrimePair.mem_affineRootSet]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.zero_disjoint_affineRootSet
statement:
theorem zero_disjoint_affineRootSet {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    Disjoint ({0} : Finset (ZMod p)) (AffinePrimePair.affineRootSet p m hp)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro q hqZero hqRoot
  have hq : q = 0 := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hqZero
  subst q
  have hroot := (AffinePrimePair.mem_affineRootSet hp).mp hqRoot
  norm_num at hroot

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.affineRootSet_eq_empty_of_prime_dvd
statement:
theorem affineRootSet_eq_empty_of_prime_dvd {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpm : p ∣ m) :
    AffinePrimePair.affineRootSet p m hp = ∅
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  intro q hq
  have hroot := (AffinePrimePair.mem_affineRootSet hp).mp hq
  have hmzero : (m : ZMod p) = 0 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff m p).mpr hpm
  rw [hmzero, zero_mul, zero_add] at hroot
  exact one_ne_zero hroot

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_affineRootSet_eq_one_of_prime_not_dvd
statement:
theorem card_affineRootSet_eq_one_of_prime_not_dvd {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpm : ¬p ∣ m) :
    (AffinePrimePair.affineRootSet p m hp).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hm : (m : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hmzero
    exact hpm ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff m p).mp hmzero)
  let q : ZMod p := -(m : ZMod p)⁻¹
  have hq : q ∈ AffinePrimePair.affineRootSet p m hp := by
    rw [AffinePrimePair.mem_affineRootSet hp]
    simp only [q, mul_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ hm]
    ring
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (AffinePrimePair.card_affineRootSet_le_one hp)
  exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨q, hq⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_badResidueSet
statement:
theorem card_badResidueSet {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (badResidueSet m p hp).card = if p ∣ m then 1 else 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [badResidueSet,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (zero_disjoint_affineRootSet hp)]
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · rw [if_pos hpm, affineRootSet_eq_empty_of_prime_dvd hp hpm]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hpm, card_affineRootSet_eq_one_of_prime_not_dvd hp hpm]
    simp

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    shiftedBadResidueCount m p = (badResidueSet m p hp).card
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  let e : Fin p ≃ ZMod p :=
    (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv.trans (Equiv.addRight 1)
  have he (t : Fin p) :
      t ∈ shiftedBadResidueSet m p ↔ e t ∈ badResidueSet m p hp := by
    rw [mem_shiftedBadResidueSet, mem_badResidueSet_iff hp,
      ← shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd m p t]
    have hfin : (ZMod.finEquiv p) t = (t.val : ZMod p) := by
      cases p with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 t
      | succ p =>
          change t = (t.val : ZMod (p + 1))
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n := p + 1) t).symm
    have hfin' : (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv t = (t.val : ZMod p) := hfin
    simp only [e, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight]
    rw [hfin']
    rfl
  have rootEquiv :
      {t // t ∈ shiftedBadResidueSet m p} ≃
        {q // q ∈ badResidueSet m p hp} :=
    e.subtypeEquiv he
  calc
    shiftedBadResidueCount m p =
        Fintype.card {t // t ∈ shiftedBadResidueSet m p} := by
      rw [shiftedBadResidueCount, Fintype.card_coe]
    _ = Fintype.card {q // q ∈ badResidueSet m p hp} :=
      Fintype.card_congr rootEquiv
    _ = (badResidueSet m p hp).card := Fintype.card_coe _

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_prime
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_prime {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    shiftedBadResidueCount m p = if p ∣ m then 1 else 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card hp,
    card_badResidueSet hp]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_pos
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_pos {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    0 < shiftedBadResidueCount m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedBadResidueCount_prime hp]
  split <;> omega

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    shiftedBadResidueCount m p ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedBadResidueCount_prime hp]
  split <;> omega

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime_of_even
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpTwo : p = 2
  · subst p
    have htwoDvd : 2 ∣ m := even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm
    rw [shiftedBadResidueCount_prime Nat.prime_two, if_pos htwoDvd]
    norm_num
  · exact (shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two hp).trans_lt (by
      have hpTwoLe := hp.two_le
      omega)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedProductValue_modEq
statement:
theorem shiftedProductValue_modEq {m d t u : ℕ} (htu : t ≡ u [MOD d]) :
    shiftedProductValue m t ≡ shiftedProductValue m u [MOD d]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at htu ⊢
  simp only [shiftedProductValue, productValue, Nat.cast_mul,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [htu]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_divisibleParameterSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_divisibleParameterSet {m R d t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ divisibleParameterSet m R d ↔ t < R ∧ d ∣ shiftedProductValue m t
proof:
:= by
  simp [divisibleParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} {a : Fin d} {t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ parameterResidueFiber R d a ↔ t < R ∧ t ≡ a.val [MOD d]
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameterResidueFiber]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
theorem card_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (a : Fin d) :
    (parameterResidueFiber R d a).card =
      R / d + if a.val < R % d then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterResidueFiber, ← Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  simpa only [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt] using Nat.count_modEq_card R hd a.val

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.residueExcessCount_le
statement:
theorem residueExcessCount_le (m R d : ℕ) :
    residueExcessCount m R d ≤ shiftedBadResidueCount m d
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_filter_le _ _

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion {m R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    divisibleParameterSet m R d =
      (shiftedBadResidueSet m d).biUnion (parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_divisibleParameterSet, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨htR, htDiv⟩
    let a : Fin d := ⟨t % d, Nat.mod_lt t hd⟩
    have hta : t ≡ a.val [MOD d] := (Nat.mod_modEq t d).symm
    have hvalue := shiftedProductValue_modEq (m := m) hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ shiftedProductValue m a.val :=
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.symm.trans htDiv.modEq_zero_nat)
    exact ⟨a, by simpa using haDiv,
      mem_parameterResidueFiber.mpr ⟨htR, hta⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, haRoot, hta⟩
    have htaData := mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ shiftedProductValue m a := by simpa using haRoot
    have hvalue := shiftedProductValue_modEq (m := m) htaData.2
    exact ⟨htaData.1,
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.trans haDiv.modEq_zero_nat)⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint (m R d : ℕ) :
    ((shiftedBadResidueSet m d : Finset (Fin d)) : Set (Fin d)).PairwiseDisjoint
      (parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ha b _hb hab
  change Disjoint (parameterResidueFiber R d a) (parameterResidueFiber R d b)
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro t hta htb
  have hat := (mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta).2
  have hbt := (mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp htb).2
  apply hab
  apply Fin.ext
  have habMod : a.val ≡ b.val [MOD d] := hat.symm.trans hbt
  simpa only [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.isLt] using habMod

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_eq {m R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (divisibleParameterSet m R d).card =
      shiftedBadResidueCount m d * (R / d) + residueExcessCount m R d
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion hd,
    Finset.card_biUnion (parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint m R d)]
  simp_rw [card_parameterResidueFiber hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_nat, shiftedBadResidueCount,
    residueExcessCount, Finset.card_filter]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error
    {m R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((divisibleParameterSet m R d).card : ℝ) =
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        residueExcessCount m R d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast card_divisibleParameterSet_eq hd

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.residueExcessCount_cast_le
statement:
theorem residueExcessCount_cast_le (m R d : ℕ) :
    (residueExcessCount m R d : ℝ) ≤ shiftedBadResidueCount m d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast residueExcessCount_le m R d

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.sieveDensity_isMultiplicative
statement:
theorem sieveDensity_isMultiplicative (m : ℕ) :
    (sieveDensity m).IsMultiplicative
proof:
:=
  ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors (localDensity m)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.sieveDensity_apply_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sieveDensity_apply_prime {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    sieveDensity m p = localDensity m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [sieveDensity, ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hp.ne_zero]
  simp [hp.primeFactors]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.primeProduct_squarefree
statement: theorem primeProduct_squarefree (z : ℕ) : Squarefree (primeProduct z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeProduct]
  refine Finset.squarefree_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime (fun p hp q hq hpq ↦ ?_)
    (fun p hp ↦ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).squarefree)
  simp only [← coprime_iff_isRelPrime]
  exact (coprime_primes (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hq)).mpr hpq

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.prime_dvd_primeProduct_iff
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_primeProduct_iff {z p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ primeProduct z ↔ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hpd
    rw [primeProduct, hp.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff] at hpd
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := hpd
    have hqPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hq
    have hpqEq : p = q := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hqPrime).mp hpq
    simpa [hpqEq] using hq
  · intro hpz
    exact dvd_prod_of_mem _ hpz

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.boundingSieve_multSum
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_multSum (m R z d : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    (boundingSieve m R z hm).multSum d =
      (divisibleParameterSet m R d).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [BoundingSieve.multSum, boundingSieve, selbergSupport,
    shiftedProductEmbedding, divisibleParameterSet]
  rw [Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.boundingSieve_rem
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_rem (m R z d : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    (boundingSieve m R z hm).rem d =
      (divisibleParameterSet m R d).card - sieveDensity m d * R
proof:
:= by
  rw [BoundingSieve.rem, boundingSieve_multSum]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.boundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (boundingSieve m R z hm).rem d =
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        residueExcessCount m R d - sieveDensity m d * R
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundingSieve_rem, card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error hd]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.boundingSieve_rem_prime
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_rem_prime {m R z p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (boundingSieve m R z hm).rem p =
      (residueExcessCount m R p : ℝ) -
        (shiftedBadResidueCount m p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess hm hp.pos,
    sieveDensity_apply_prime hp]
  unfold localDensity
  have hR : (R : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) * (R / p : ℕ) + (R % p : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_add_div R p).symm.trans (by omega)
  rw [hR]
  have hpCast : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.abs_boundingSieve_rem_prime_le
statement:
theorem abs_boundingSieve_rem_prime_le
    {m R z p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) :
    |(boundingSieve m R z hm).rem p| ≤ shiftedBadResidueCount m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundingSieve_rem_prime hm hp]
  have hpCast : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ (shiftedBadResidueCount m p : ℝ) := by positivity
  have he0 : 0 ≤ (residueExcessCount m R p : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hek : (residueExcessCount m R p : ℝ) ≤ shiftedBadResidueCount m p :=
    residueExcessCount_cast_le m R p
  have hfrac1 : ((R % p : ℕ) : ℝ) / p ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hpCast]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_lt R hp.pos).le
  have hterm0 : 0 ≤
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p := by positivity
  have htermk :
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p ≤
        shiftedBadResidueCount m p := by
    calc
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p =
          (shiftedBadResidueCount m p : ℝ) * (((R % p : ℕ) : ℝ) / p) := by ring
      _ ≤ (shiftedBadResidueCount m p : ℝ) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac1 hk0
      _ = shiftedBadResidueCount m p := by ring
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.coprime_primeProduct_iff
statement:
theorem coprime_primeProduct_iff {m z t : ℕ} :
    Nat.Coprime (primeProduct z) (shiftedProductValue m t) ↔
      ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, ¬p ∣ shiftedProductValue m t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcop p hpz
    have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
    have hpcop : Nat.Coprime p (shiftedProductValue m t) := by
      rw [primeProduct, Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff] at hcop
      exact hcop p hpz
    exact hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mp hpcop
  · intro hall
    rw [primeProduct, Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff]
    intro p hpz
    exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz).coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
      (hall p hpz)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_siftedParameterSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_siftedParameterSet {m R z t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ siftedParameterSet m R z ↔
      t < R ∧ Nat.Coprime (primeProduct z) (shiftedProductValue m t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [siftedParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.boundingSieve_siftedSum
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_siftedSum (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    (boundingSieve m R z hm).siftedSum = (siftedParameterSet m R z).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [BoundingSieve.siftedSum, boundingSieve, selbergSupport,
    shiftedProductEmbedding, siftedParameterSet]
  rw [Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_siftedPairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_siftedPairSet {m R z q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ siftedPairSet m R z ↔
      1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ R ∧ ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, ¬p ∣ productValue m q
proof:
:= by
  simp [siftedPairSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.siftedPairSet_eq_map
statement:
theorem siftedPairSet_eq_map (m R z : ℕ) :
    siftedPairSet m R z =
      (siftedParameterSet m R z).map AffinePrimePair.parameterShiftEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    have hqData := mem_siftedPairSet.mp hq
    have hshift : q - 1 + 1 = q := by omega
    rw [Finset.mem_map]
    refine ⟨q - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply mem_siftedParameterSet.mpr
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [coprime_primeProduct_iff]
      simpa [shiftedProductValue, hshift] using hqData.2.2
    · simp only [AffinePrimePair.parameterShiftEmbedding_apply, hshift]
  · intro hq
    rw [Finset.mem_map] at hq
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hq
    have htData := mem_siftedParameterSet.mp ht
    apply mem_siftedPairSet.mpr
    refine ⟨by change 1 ≤ t + 1; omega, by change t + 1 ≤ R; omega, ?_⟩
    rw [coprime_primeProduct_iff] at htData
    simpa [AffinePrimePair.parameterShiftEmbedding_apply,
      shiftedProductValue] using htData.2

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum
statement:
theorem card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum
    (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    ((siftedPairSet m R z).card : ℝ) =
      (boundingSieve m R z hm).siftedSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [siftedPairSet_eq_map, Finset.card_map, boundingSieve_siftedSum]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.rightValue_strictMono
statement:
theorem rightValue_strictMono {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    StrictMono fun q ↦ m * q + 1
proof:
:= by
  intro q r hqr
  exact Nat.add_lt_add_right (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hqr hm) 1

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet {m R z q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ leftSmallPrimePairSet m R z ↔
      q ∈ bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R ∧ q ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftSmallPrimePairSet]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet {m R z q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ rightSmallPrimePairSet m R z ↔
      q ∈ bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R ∧ m * q + 1 ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightSmallPrimePairSet]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le
statement:
theorem card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le (m R z : ℕ) :
    (leftSmallPrimePairSet m R z).card ≤ z + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range (z + 1)]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn id ?_ ?_
  · intro q hq
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr
      (mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet.mp hq).2)
  · intro q _hq r _hr hqr
    exact hqr

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le
statement:
theorem card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (R z : ℕ) :
    (rightSmallPrimePairSet m R z).card ≤ z + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range (z + 1)]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun q ↦ m * q + 1) ?_ ?_
  · intro q hq
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr
      (mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet.mp hq).2)
  · intro q _hq r _hr hqr
    exact (rightValue_strictMono hm).injective hqr

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt
statement:
theorem mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt
    {m R z q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R)
    (hqLarge : z < q) (hrightLarge : z < m * q + 1) :
    q ∈ siftedPairSet m R z
proof:
:= by
  have hqData := mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mp hq
  apply mem_siftedPairSet.mpr
  refine ⟨by omega, hqData.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro p hpz hpd
  have hp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
  have hple : p ≤ z := Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hpz
  rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hpd with hpLeft | hpRight
  · have heq : p = q :=
      (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hqData.2.2.1).mp hpLeft
    omega
  · have heq : p = m * q + 1 :=
      (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hqData.2.2.2).mp hpRight
    omega

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small
statement:
theorem primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small
    (m R z : ℕ) :
    bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R ⊆
      (siftedPairSet m R z ∪ leftSmallPrimePairSet m R z) ∪
        rightSmallPrimePairSet m R z
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  by_cases hleft : z < q
  · by_cases hright : z < m * q + 1
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.mpr
        (Or.inl (mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt hq hleft hright))))
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr
        (mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet.mpr ⟨hq, Nat.le_of_not_gt hright⟩))
  · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr
      (mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet.mpr ⟨hq, Nat.le_of_not_gt hleft⟩))))

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (R z : ℕ) :
    (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R).card ≤
      (siftedPairSet m R z).card + 2 * (z + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R).card ≤
        ((siftedPairSet m R z ∪ leftSmallPrimePairSet m R z) ∪
          rightSmallPrimePairSet m R z).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small m R z)
    _ ≤ (siftedPairSet m R z ∪ leftSmallPrimePairSet m R z).card +
        (rightSmallPrimePairSet m R z).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((siftedPairSet m R z).card + (leftSmallPrimePairSet m R z).card) +
        (rightSmallPrimePairSet m R z).card :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _
    _ ≤ ((siftedPairSet m R z).card + (z + 1)) + (z + 1) :=
      Nat.add_le_add
        (Nat.add_le_add_left (card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le m R z) _)
        (card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le hm R z)
    _ = (siftedPairSet m R z).card + 2 * (z + 1) := by omega

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add
    {m : ℕ} (hmPos : 0 < m) (hmEven : Even m) (R z : ℕ) :
    ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R).card : ℝ) ≤
      (boundingSieve m R z hmEven).siftedSum + (2 * (z + 1) : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add hmPos R z
  have hcast : ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 R).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((siftedPairSet m R z).card : ℝ) + ((2 * (z + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  rwa [card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum m R z hmEven] at hcast

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsAffinePrimeSet_subset_full
statement:
theorem bfpsAffinePrimeSet_subset_full (m lo hi : ℕ) :
    bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi ⊆ bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 hi
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hqData := mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mp hq
  exact mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mpr
    ⟨by omega, hqData.2.1, hqData.2.2.1, hqData.2.2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_full
statement:
theorem card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_full (m lo hi : ℕ) :
    (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card ≤ (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 hi).card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (bfpsAffinePrimeSet_subset_full m lo hi)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_of_odd
statement:
theorem eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_of_odd
    {m lo hi q : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hmOdd : Odd m)
    (hq : q ∈ bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi) : q = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hqData := mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mp hq
  rcases hqData.2.2.1.eq_two_or_odd' with hqTwo | hqOdd
  · exact hqTwo
  · have hrightEven : Even (m * q + 1) := (hmOdd.mul hqOdd).add_one
    have hrightTwo : m * q + 1 = 2 := hqData.2.2.2.even_iff.mp hrightEven
    have hprodLower : 4 ≤ m * q :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hm hqData.2.2.1.two_le
    omega

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_one_of_odd
statement:
theorem card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_one_of_odd
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hmOdd : Odd m) (lo hi : ℕ) :
    (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro q hq r hr
  rw [eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_of_odd hm hmOdd hq,
    eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_of_odd hm hmOdd hr]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_of_fundamental_and_mertens
statement:
theorem dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_of_fundamental_and_mertens
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Cfund Cmertens : ℝ} (hCfund : 0 ≤ Cfund)
    (hfund : SelbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound cutoff Cfund)
    (hmertens : MertensLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Cmertens) :
    DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff (Cfund * Cmertens)
proof:
:= by
  intro m R hm hmEven hR
  calc
    (boundingSieve m R (cutoff R) hmEven).siftedSum ≤
        Cfund * R * localSieveProduct m (cutoff R) :=
      hfund m R hm hmEven hR
    _ ≤ Cfund * R *
        (Cmertens / (Real.log R) ^ 2 * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmertens m R hm hmEven hR)
        (mul_nonneg hCfund (by positivity))
    _ = (Cfund * Cmertens) * bfpsLogSquaredScale R *
        ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by
      unfold bfpsLogSquaredScale AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
      ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.one_le_bfpsTotientRatio
statement:
theorem one_le_bfpsTotientRatio {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hm)]
  norm_num
  exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le m

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_even_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_cast_le_of_terminal
statement:
theorem card_even_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_cast_le_of_terminal
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Csieve Csmall : ℝ}
    (hCsmall : 0 ≤ Csmall)
    (hsieve : DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff Csieve)
    (hsmall : AffinePrimePair.CutoffExceptionUpperBound cutoff Csmall)
    {m lo hi : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hmEven : Even m) (hhi : 3 ≤ hi) :
    ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
      (Csieve + Csmall) * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi *
        ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 hi).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_full m lo hi
  have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ) :=
    one_le_bfpsTotientRatio (by omega)
  have hscale : 0 ≤ bfpsLogSquaredScale hi := bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg hi
  calc
    ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m 0 hi).card : ℝ) := hsubset
    _ ≤ (boundingSieve m hi (cutoff hi) hmEven).siftedSum +
        (2 * (cutoff hi + 1) : ℕ) :=
      card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add (by omega) hmEven hi (cutoff hi)
    _ ≤ Csieve * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) +
        Csmall * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi :=
      add_le_add (hsieve m hi hm hmEven hhi) (hsmall hi hhi)
    _ ≤ Csieve * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) +
        (Csmall * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi) * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by
      have hmul : Csmall * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi ≤
          (Csmall * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi) * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio (mul_nonneg hCsmall hscale))
      linarith
    _ = (Csieve + Csmall) * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi *
        ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_of_terminal
statement:
theorem hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_of_terminal
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Csieve Csmall : ℝ}
    (hCsieve : 0 ≤ Csieve) (hCsmall : 0 ≤ Csmall)
    (hsieve : DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff Csieve)
    (hsmall : AffinePrimePair.CutoffExceptionUpperBound cutoff Csmall) :
    HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound (Csieve + Csmall)
proof:
:= by
  intro m lo hi hm _hlohi hhi
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with hmEven | hmOdd
  · exact card_even_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_cast_le_of_terminal
      hCsmall hsieve hsmall hm hmEven hhi
  · have hcardNat := card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_one_of_odd hm hmOdd lo hi
    have hcard : ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hcardNat
    have hcutoffOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * (cutoff hi + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * (cutoff hi + 1))
    have hsmallOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Csmall * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi :=
      hcutoffOne.trans (hsmall hi hhi)
    have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ) :=
      one_le_bfpsTotientRatio (by omega)
    have hscale : 0 ≤ bfpsLogSquaredScale hi := bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg hi
    have hsmallWeighted : (1 : ℝ) ≤
        (Csmall * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi) * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) :=
      hsmallOne.trans (by
        simpa only [mul_one] using
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio (mul_nonneg hCsmall hscale)))
    calc
      ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := hcard
      _ ≤ (Csmall * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi) *
          ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := hsmallWeighted
      _ ≤ (Csieve + Csmall) * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi *
          ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by
        have hratioNonneg : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ) := by positivity
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hscale) hratioNonneg

name: RankAmplification.largePrimeRank_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth
statement:
theorem largePrimeRank_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth {y n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    largePrimeRank y n = 0 ↔ IsSmooth y n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hrank
    refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    by_contra hpy
    have hylt : y < p := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hpy
    have hpfilter : p ∈ (primeSupport n).filter (y < ·) := by
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, hylt⟩
    have hsum : ∑ q ∈ (primeSupport n).filter (y < ·), n.factorization q = 0 := by
      exact hrank
    have hpzero : n.factorization p = 0 := by
      have hall := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
        (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)).mp hsum
      exact hall p hpfilter
    have hpprime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hppos : 0 < n.factorization p :=
      hpprime.factorization_pos_of_dvd hn (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hppos) hpzero
  · intro hsmooth
    rw [largePrimeRank]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hpsupport, hylt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hsmooth.2 p hpsupport) hylt).elim

statement:
theorem largePrimeRank_totient_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth {y n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :

proof:
:=
  largePrimeRank_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hn).ne'

name: RankAmplification.mem_smoothShiftedSet_iff_rank_zero
statement:
theorem mem_smoothShiftedSet_iff_rank_zero {x h y n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ smoothShiftedSet x h y ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧ largePrimeRank y n.totient = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_smoothShiftedSet, mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn, hnx, heq, hsmooth⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hn, hnx, heq⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (largePrimeRank_totient_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth (zero_lt_one.trans_le hn)).mpr hsmooth
  · rintro ⟨⟨hn, hnx, heq⟩, hrank⟩
    refine ⟨hn, hnx, heq, ?_⟩
    exact (largePrimeRank_totient_eq_zero_iff_isSmooth (zero_lt_one.trans_le hn)).mp hrank

name: RankAmplification.mem_smoothShiftedSet_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le
statement:
theorem mem_smoothShiftedSet_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le {x h y n : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    n ∈ smoothShiftedSet x h y ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧ largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_smoothShiftedSet, mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn, hnx, heq, hsmooth⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hn, hnx, heq⟩, hsmooth.largestPrimeFactor_le hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hn, hnx, heq⟩, hlpf⟩
    have htotient : n.totient ≠ 0 :=
      (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans_le hn)).ne'
    exact ⟨hn, hnx, heq, (isSmooth_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le hy htotient).mpr hlpf⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothShiftedSet_subset_shiftedEqualTotientSet
statement:

    smoothShiftedSet x h y ⊆ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  rw [mem_smoothShiftedSet] at hn

  exact ⟨hn.1, hn.2.1, hn.2.2.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothShiftedSet_disjoint_nonsmoothShiftedSet
statement:
theorem smoothShiftedSet_disjoint_nonsmoothShiftedSet {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    Disjoint (smoothShiftedSet x h y) (nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hsmooth hnonsmooth
  have hsmoothData := mem_smoothShiftedSet.mp hsmooth
  have hnonsmoothData := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp hnonsmooth
  have hle := hsmoothData.2.2.2.largestPrimeFactor_le hy
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hle) hnonsmoothData.2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.smoothShiftedSet_union_nonsmoothShiftedSet
statement:
theorem smoothShiftedSet_union_nonsmoothShiftedSet {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    smoothShiftedSet x h y ∪ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y = shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
  · intro n hn
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hn with hsmooth | hnonsmooth
    · exact smoothShiftedSet_subset_shiftedEqualTotientSet x h y hsmooth
    · exact nonsmoothShiftedSet_subset x h y hnonsmooth
  · intro n hn
    have hnData := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hn
    by_cases hsmooth : IsSmooth y n.totient
    · apply Finset.mem_union_left
      exact mem_smoothShiftedSet.mpr ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.1, hnData.2.2, hsmooth⟩
    · apply Finset.mem_union_right
      rw [mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet]
      refine ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.1, hnData.2.2, ?_⟩
      have htotient : n.totient ≠ 0 :=
        (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans_le hnData.1)).ne'
      have hnotle : ¬largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ y := by
        intro hle
        exact hsmooth ((isSmooth_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le hy htotient).mpr hle)
      exact Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnotle

name: RankAmplification.shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_smooth_add_nonsmooth
statement:
theorem shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_smooth_add_nonsmooth {x h y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    shiftedEqualTotientCount x h =
      smoothShiftedCount x h y + nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedEqualTotientCount, ← smoothShiftedSet_union_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (smoothShiftedSet_disjoint_nonsmoothShiftedSet hy),
    smoothShiftedCount, nonsmoothShiftedCount]

name: RankAmplification.le_monotoneEnvelope
statement:
theorem le_monotoneEnvelope {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] (F : ℕ → α)
    {W X : ℕ} (hWX : W ≤ X) :
    F W ≤ monotoneEnvelope F X
proof:
:= by
  unfold monotoneEnvelope
  apply Finset.le_sup'
  exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hWX)

name: RankAmplification.monotone_monotoneEnvelope
statement:
theorem monotone_monotoneEnvelope {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] (F : ℕ → α) :
    Monotone (monotoneEnvelope F)
proof:
:= by
  intro W X hWX
  rw [monotoneEnvelope]
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro n hn
  apply le_monotoneEnvelope F
  have hnW : n ≤ W := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
  exact hnW.trans hWX

name: RankAmplification.monotoneEnvelope_eq_of_monotone
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [monotoneEnvelope]
    apply Finset.sup'_le
    intro W hW
    apply hF
    exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hW)
  · exact le_monotoneEnvelope F le_rfl

statement:
theorem eventually_smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_of_smoothTotientBound
    {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} (X H Y : ι → ℕ) (B : ι → ℝ)
    (hBFPS : ∀ᶠ i in l, (smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) : ℝ) ≤ B i) :
    ∀ᶠ i in l, (smoothShiftedCount (X i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ) ≤ B i
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hBFPS] with i hi
  exact smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_of_smoothTotientBound hi

name: RankAmplification.eventually_smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_of_larger_smoothTotientBound
statement:
theorem eventually_smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_of_larger_smoothTotientBound

    (hWX : ∀ᶠ i in l, W i ≤ X i)
    (hBFPS : ∀ᶠ i in l, (smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) : ℝ) ≤ B i) :
    ∀ᶠ i in l, (smoothShiftedCount (W i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ) ≤ B i
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hWX, hBFPS] with i hiX hiB
  have hcount := smoothShiftedCount_le_smoothTotientCount_of_le
    (h := H i) (y := Y i) hiX
  have hcountℝ : (smoothShiftedCount (W i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ) ≤
      smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcount
  exact hcountℝ.trans hiB

name: RankAmplification.smoothShiftedCount_isBigO_of_smoothTotientCount_isBigO
statement:
theorem smoothShiftedCount_isBigO_of_smoothTotientCount_isBigO
    {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) (X H Y : ι → ℕ) (F : ι → ℝ)
    (hBFPS : (fun i ↦ (smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) : ℝ)) =O[l] F) :
    (fun i ↦ (smoothShiftedCount (X i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ)) =O[l] F
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : (fun i ↦ (smoothShiftedCount (X i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ)) =O[l]
      fun i ↦ (smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) : ℝ) := by
    apply Asymptotics.isBigO_of_le
    intro i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ smoothShiftedCount (X i) (H i) (Y i) by positivity),
      Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) by positivity)]
    exact smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_smoothTotientCount (X i) (H i) (Y i)
  exact hdom.trans hBFPS

name: RankAmplification.smoothShiftedCount_isBigO_of_larger_smoothTotientCount_isBigO
statement:
theorem smoothShiftedCount_isBigO_of_larger_smoothTotientCount_isBigO
    {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} (W X H Y : ι → ℕ) (F : ι → ℝ)
    (hWX : ∀ᶠ i in l, W i ≤ X i)
    (hBFPS : (fun i ↦ (smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) : ℝ)) =O[l] F) :
    (fun i ↦ (smoothShiftedCount (W i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ)) =O[l] F
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : (fun i ↦ (smoothShiftedCount (W i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ)) =O[l]
      fun i ↦ (smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) : ℝ) := by
    apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound'
    filter_upwards [hWX] with i hi
    have hcount := smoothShiftedCount_le_smoothTotientCount_of_le
      (h := H i) (y := Y i) hi
    have hcountℝ : (smoothShiftedCount (W i) (H i) (Y i) : ℝ) ≤
        smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) := by
      exact_mod_cast hcount
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ smoothShiftedCount (W i) (H i) (Y i) by positivity),
      Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ smoothTotientCount (X i) (Y i) by positivity)]
    exact hcountℝ
  exact hdom.trans hBFPS
