statement:
theorem tendsto_movingOffDiagonalOuterError_zero
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (movingOffDiagonalOuterError ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x ↦ max (movingElementaryTransferError x) (ρ x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using
      tendsto_movingElementaryTransferError_zero.max hρ
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  unfold movingOffDiagonalOuterError
  simpa only [zero_add] using hmax.add hconst

name: RankAmplification.sum_elementary_outer_majorants_le
statement:
theorem sum_elementary_outer_majorants_le
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :
    movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x +
        movingExponentialMajorant ρ x ≤
      movingExponentialMajorant (movingOffDiagonalOuterError ρ) x
proof:
:= by
  let M := max (movingElementaryTransferError x) (ρ x)
  have helem : movingElementaryTransferError x ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have houter : ρ x ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hmono (e : ℝ) (he : e ≤ M) :
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + e * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
      simpa using add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he heta.le)
        (-movingK (x : ℝ)))
  have helem' : movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    exact hmono _ helem
  have houter' : movingExponentialMajorant ρ x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    exact hmono _ houter
  calc
    movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x +
        movingExponentialMajorant ρ x ≤
        2 * ((x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) := by
      linarith
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant (movingOffDiagonalOuterError ρ) x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant movingOffDiagonalOuterError M
      rw [show (max (movingElementaryTransferError x) (ρ x) +
          Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
          max (movingElementaryTransferError x) (ρ x) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
            Real.log 2 by rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta.ne']]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [show -movingK (x : ℝ) +
            (max (movingElementaryTransferError x) (ρ x) *
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) =
            (-movingK (x : ℝ) + max (movingElementaryTransferError x) (ρ x) *
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) + Real.log 2 by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.movingOffDiagonalTransferHypothesis_of_outerProviderEstimate
statement:
theorem movingOffDiagonalTransferHypothesis_of_outerProviderEstimate
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (houter : MovingOuterProviderEstimate ρ) :
    MovingOffDiagonalTransferHypothesis (movingOffDiagonalOuterError ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingOffDiagonalOuterError_zero houter.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant_le_elementary_add_outer,
    houter.2, eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with
      x hfinite houterX heta
  intro _hsaddle
  change movingOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant x ≤
    movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x +
      movingOuterProviderSum x at hfinite
  calc
    movingOffDiagonalFiniteMajorant x ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x +
          movingOuterProviderSum x := hfinite
    _ ≤ movingExponentialMajorant movingElementaryTransferError x +
        movingExponentialMajorant ρ x := add_le_add le_rfl houterX
    _ ≤ movingExponentialMajorant (movingOffDiagonalOuterError ρ) x :=
      sum_elementary_outer_majorants_le heta

name: RankAmplification.finiteTransferTerms_le_paperTransferDisplay
statement:
theorem finiteTransferTerms_le_paperTransferDisplay {x y : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
        (paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * (x : ℝ) * Real.log y ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
          smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y) ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x y
proof:
:= by
  have hC5 : (5 : ℝ) ≤ paperTheorem16LogSqConstant := five_le_paperTheorem16LogSqConstant
  have hx2 : 2 ≤ x := le_trans hy hxy
  have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) < (y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < y by omega)
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg x
  have hlogx : 0 ≤ Real.log (x : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ x by omega))
  have hquot0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ) := div_nonneg hx0 hy0.le
  
  have hT1 : 2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * ((x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) := by
    have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := mul_nonneg hx0 (inv_nonneg.mpr hy0.le)
    have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ paperTheorem16LogSqConstant by linarith) hnn
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    linarith
  
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hT2 : 2 * (((2 * x).sqrt : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) := by
    have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (((2 * x).sqrt : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have h1 : (((2 * x).sqrt : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sqrt_le' (2 * x)
    have hcast : ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * (x : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) ^ 2 = (x : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hx0
    rw [hcast] at h1
    have h2 : (((2 * x).sqrt : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [h1, hsq, hx0]
    have h3 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h2
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq hs0, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h3
    have h4 : (4 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) ≤ paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hr0
    linarith
  
  have hrhs0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hx0 hlogx) hy0.le
  have hT3 : ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * ((x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) := by
    have hCrhs : (0 : ℝ) ≤ paperTheorem16LogSqConstant *
        ((x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hrhs0
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (x / y) with hd0 | hdpos
    · rw [hd0]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
      linarith
    · have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdpos
      have hdlog : 0 ≤ Real.log ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hd1
      have hdlex : ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.div_le_self x y
      have hlogle : Real.log ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (x : ℝ) :=
        Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hdlex
      have hdle : ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ) := Nat.cast_div_le
      have step1 : ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
          ((x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) * (1 + Real.log (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul hdle (by linarith) (by linarith) hquot0
      have hguard : 1 + Real.log (x : ℝ) ≤ logGuardConstant * Real.log (x : ℝ) :=
        one_add_log_le_logGuardConstant_mul_log hx2
      have hg5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right logGuardConstant_le_five hlogx
      have step2 : ((x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) * (1 + Real.log (x : ℝ)) ≤
          ((x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) * (5 * Real.log (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hquot0
      have heq : ((x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) * (5 * Real.log (x : ℝ)) =
          5 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp
      have step3 : (5 : ℝ) * ((x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) ≤
          paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * ((x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC5 hrhs0
      linarith [step1, step2, heq.le, heq.ge, step3]
  
  have hT5 : smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y := by
    have hb := smoothMultiplierB4Sum_nonneg x y
    nlinarith [hC5, hb]
  unfold paperTransferDisplay
  have hT4 : paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * (x : ℝ) * Real.log (y : ℝ) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * ((x : ℝ) * Real.log (y : ℝ) ^ 2 / (y : ℝ)) := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  linarith [hT1, hT2, hT3, hT4.le, hT4.ge, hT5]

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_7_offDiagonal_finite_sharp
statement:
theorem proposition9_7_offDiagonal_finite_sharp
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          (section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := proposition9_6_offDiagonal_bound (x := x)
    nonSquareTransferHypothesis_canonical hh hhy (by omega : 0 < y)
  rw [nonsquareSkeletonMajorant, nonsquare_outer_sum_eq_section4_add_B4] at hbase
  have hreciprocal := section4ReciprocalSum_le_sharp' hy hxy
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_7_offDiagonal_display_unconditional
statement:
theorem proposition9_7_offDiagonal_display_unconditional
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
        (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          (paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * (x : ℝ) * Real.log y ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := proposition9_7_offDiagonal_finite_sharp hh hy hhy hxy
  have hcmp := one_add_log_sq_le_logGuardConstant_sq_mul_log_sq hy
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) ≤ section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg section4SharpConstant_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg x))
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg y))
  have hstep : section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * (x : ℝ) * Real.log y ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    calc section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹
        = (section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹) * (1 + Real.log y) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (section4SharpConstant * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹) *
            (logGuardConstant ^ 2 * Real.log y ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcmp hfac
      _ = paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * (x : ℝ) * Real.log y ^ 2 * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          unfold paperTheorem16LogSqConstant; ring
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_unconditional
statement:
theorem proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_unconditional
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x y
proof:
:=
  (proposition9_7_offDiagonal_display_unconditional hh hy hhy hxy).trans
    (finiteTransferTerms_le_paperTransferDisplay hy hxy)

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_7_second_display_unconditional
statement:
theorem proposition9_7_second_display_unconditional
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y : ℝ) +
        paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x y
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount
    x h y
  have hcast : (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) =
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y : ℝ) + (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hbound := proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_unconditional hh hy hhy hxy
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_two_sided
statement:
theorem proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_two_sided
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    |(nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) - (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y : ℝ)| ≤
      paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x y
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount
    x h y
  have hcast : (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) =
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y : ℝ) + (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hbound := proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_unconditional hh hy hhy hxy
  have hEnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rw [abs_le]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_paper_form
statement:
theorem proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_paper_form
    {x h y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y ≤ nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y ∧
      nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y - aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y =
        offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h y ∧
      |(nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) - (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h y : ℝ)| ≤
        paperTheorem16LogSqConstant * paperTransferDisplay x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨(proposition9_6_exact_cardinality_unconditional x h y).1,
    (proposition9_6_exact_cardinality_unconditional x h y).2,
    proposition9_7_transfer_diagonal_two_sided hh hy hhy hxy⟩

name: RankAmplification.mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell {X lo hi p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi ↔
      p.Prime ∧ p ≤ X ∧ IsSmooth hi (p - 1) ∧
        lo < largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [smoothPredecessorPrimeShell, Finset.mem_filter,
    mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet]
  aesop

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_sdiff_eq_shell
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_sdiff_eq_shell {X lo hi : ℕ}
    (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X hi \ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X lo =
      smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hpDiff := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp
    have hpHi := mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpDiff.1
    have hpred : p - 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hpHi.1.one_lt)
    have hnotLe : ¬largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) ≤ lo := by
      intro hle
      have hsmoothLo : IsSmooth lo (p - 1) :=
        (isSmooth_iff_largestPrimeFactor_le hlo hpred).mpr hle
      exact hpDiff.2 (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mpr
        ⟨hpHi.1, hpHi.2.1, hsmoothLo⟩)
    exact mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mpr
      ⟨hpHi.1, hpHi.2.1, hpHi.2.2, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnotLe⟩
  · intro hp
    have hpShell := mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp
    apply Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mpr
      ⟨hpShell.1, hpShell.2.1, hpShell.2.2.1⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hpLo
    have hsmoothLo := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpLo).2.2
    have hle := largestPrimeFactor_le_of_isSmooth hlo hsmoothLo
    exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hle) hpShell.2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_subset_of_le
statement:
theorem smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_subset_of_le {X lo hi : ℕ} (hlohi : lo ≤ hi) :
    smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X lo ⊆ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X hi
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hpData := mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hp
  apply mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hpData.1, hpData.2.1, hpData.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  exact (hpData.2.2.2 r hr).trans hlohi

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_add_shell
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_add_shell {X lo hi : ℕ}
    (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hlohi : lo ≤ hi) :
    (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X hi).card =
      (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X lo).card +
        (smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card
    (smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_subset_of_le (X := X) hlohi)
  rw [smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_sdiff_eq_shell hlo] at hcard
  omega

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellPrime_prime
statement:
theorem predecessorShellPrime_prime {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    (predecessorShellPrime p).Prime
proof:
:= by
  apply largestPrimeFactor_prime
  exact hlo.trans_lt (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellPrime_dvd_pred
statement:
theorem predecessorShellPrime_dvd_pred {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    predecessorShellPrime p ∣ p - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply largestPrimeFactor_dvd
  exact hlo.trans_lt (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellMultiplier_mul_prime
statement:
theorem predecessorShellMultiplier_mul_prime {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (predecessorShellPrime_dvd_pred hlo hp)

name: RankAmplification.predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one
statement:
theorem predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    p = predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [predecessorShellMultiplier_mul_prime hlo hp]
  exact (Nat.sub_add_cancel (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).1.one_le).symm

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellMultiplier_pos
statement:
theorem predecessorShellMultiplier_pos {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    0 < predecessorShellMultiplier p
proof:
:= by
  have hprodPos : 0 < p - 1 :=
    Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).1.one_lt
  rw [← predecessorShellMultiplier_mul_prime hlo hp] at hprodPos
  exact pos_of_mul_pos_left hprodPos (Nat.zero_le _)

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellMultiplier_smooth
statement:
theorem predecessorShellMultiplier_smooth {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    IsSmooth hi (predecessorShellMultiplier p)
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor := predecessorShellMultiplier_mul_prime hlo hp
  apply (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.1.of_dvd
  · exact ⟨predecessorShellPrime p, hfactor.symm⟩
  · exact (predecessorShellMultiplier_pos hlo hp).ne'

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellMultiplier_smooth_at_shellPrime
statement:
theorem predecessorShellMultiplier_smooth_at_shellPrime {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    IsSmooth (predecessorShellPrime p) (predecessorShellMultiplier p)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(predecessorShellMultiplier_pos hlo hp).ne', ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  have hrPrime : r.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr
  have hrDvdMultiplier : r ∣ predecessorShellMultiplier p :=
    Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr
  have hmultiplierDvd : predecessorShellMultiplier p ∣ p - 1 :=
    ⟨predecessorShellPrime p, (predecessorShellMultiplier_mul_prime hlo hp).symm⟩
  exact prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hrPrime
    (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).1.one_lt))
    (hrDvdMultiplier.trans hmultiplierDvd)

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellPrime_le
statement:
theorem predecessorShellPrime_le {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    predecessorShellPrime p ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  exact (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.1.2
    (predecessorShellPrime p)
    (largestPrimeFactor_mem_primeFactors
      (hlo.trans_lt (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.2))

name: RankAmplification.predecessorShellMultiplier_le
statement:
theorem predecessorShellMultiplier_le {X lo hi p : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo)
    (hp : p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi) :
    predecessorShellMultiplier p ≤ X / (lo + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega : 0 < lo + 1)]
  have hqLower : lo + 1 ≤ predecessorShellPrime p :=
    Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.2
  calc
    predecessorShellMultiplier p * (lo + 1) ≤
        predecessorShellMultiplier p * predecessorShellPrime p :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hqLower
    _ = p - 1 := predecessorShellMultiplier_mul_prime hlo hp
    _ ≤ p := Nat.sub_le p 1
    _ ≤ X := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.1

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet {m lo hi q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi ↔
      lo < q ∧ q ≤ hi ∧ q.Prime ∧ (m * q + 1).Prime
proof:
:= by
  simp [bfpsAffinePrimeSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet {X Y lo m : ℕ} :
    m ∈ bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X Y lo ↔
      1 ≤ m ∧ m ≤ X / (lo + 1) ∧ IsSmooth Y m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc,
    and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet {X lo hi : ℕ} {z : Σ _m : ℕ, ℕ} :
    z ∈ bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet X lo hi ↔
      z.1 ∈ bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo ∧
        z.2 ∈ bfpsAffinePrimeSet z.1 lo hi
proof:
:= by
  simp [bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet]

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_le_pairSet
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_le_pairSet {X lo hi : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) :
    (smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card ≤
      (bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet X lo hi).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let encode : ℕ → (Σ _m : ℕ, ℕ) := fun p ↦
    ⟨predecessorShellMultiplier p, predecessorShellPrime p⟩
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn encode
  · intro p hp
    apply mem_bfpsPredecessorShellPairSet.mpr
    constructor
    · exact mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet.mpr
        ⟨predecessorShellMultiplier_pos hlo hp,
          predecessorShellMultiplier_le hlo hp,
          predecessorShellMultiplier_smooth hlo hp⟩
    · apply mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mpr
      exact ⟨(mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).2.2.2,
        predecessorShellPrime_le hlo hp,
        predecessorShellPrime_prime hlo hp,
        (predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one hlo hp) ▸
          (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell.mp hp).1⟩
  · intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ heq
    have hm : predecessorShellMultiplier p₁ = predecessorShellMultiplier p₂ :=
      congrArg Sigma.fst heq
    have hq : predecessorShellPrime p₁ = predecessorShellPrime p₂ :=
      congrArg (fun z : Σ _m : ℕ, ℕ ↦ z.2) heq
    calc
      p₁ = predecessorShellMultiplier p₁ * predecessorShellPrime p₁ + 1 :=
        predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one hlo hp₁
      _ = predecessorShellMultiplier p₂ * predecessorShellPrime p₂ + 1 := by
        rw [hm, hq]
      _ = p₂ := (predecessor_eq_multiplier_mul_prime_add_one hlo hp₂).symm

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_le_sum_affine
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_le_sum_affine {X lo hi : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) :
    (smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card ≤
      ∑ m ∈ bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo, (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card
proof:
:= by
  exact (card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_le_pairSet hlo).trans_eq
    (Finset.card_sigma (bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo)
      (fun m ↦ bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi))

name: RankAmplification.eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one
statement:
theorem eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one {lo hi q : ℕ}
    (hq : q ∈ bfpsAffinePrimeSet 1 lo hi) : q = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hdata := mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet.mp hq
  rcases hdata.2.2.1.eq_two_or_odd' with hqTwo | hqOdd
  · exact hqTwo
  · have hsuccPrime : (q + 1).Prime := by simpa using hdata.2.2.2
    have hsuccTwo : q + 1 = 2 := hsuccPrime.even_iff.mp hqOdd.add_one
    have hqOne : q = 1 := by omega
    subst q
    exact (Nat.not_prime_one hdata.2.2.1).elim

name: RankAmplification.card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one_le
statement:
theorem card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one_le (lo hi : ℕ) :
    (bfpsAffinePrimeSet 1 lo hi).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂
  rw [eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one hq₁,
    eq_two_of_mem_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one hq₂]

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet {X Y lo m : ℕ} :
    m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X Y lo ↔
      2 ≤ m ∧ m ≤ X / (lo + 1) ∧ IsSmooth Y m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet, Finset.mem_filter,
    mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨_hmOne, hmBound, hmSmooth⟩, hmTwo⟩
    exact ⟨hmTwo, hmBound, hmSmooth⟩
  · rintro ⟨hmTwo, hmBound, hmSmooth⟩
    exact ⟨⟨by omega, hmBound, hmSmooth⟩, hmTwo⟩

name: RankAmplification.bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_nonneg (X Y lo : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X Y lo
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro m _
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.sum_card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_one_add_nontrivial
statement:
theorem sum_card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_one_add_nontrivial (X lo hi : ℕ) :
    (∑ m ∈ bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo,
      (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card) ≤
      1 + ∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo,
        (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun m ↦ (bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card
  have hsmallSubset : S.filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m) ⊆ ({1} : Finset ℕ) := by
    intro m hm
    have hmData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hm
    have hmOne : m = 1 := by
      have hmLower := (mem_bfpsSmoothMultiplierSet.mp hmData.1).1
      omega
    simp [hmOne]
  have hsmall : (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m), f m) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ ¬2 ≤ m), f m) ≤
          ∑ m ∈ ({1} : Finset ℕ), f m := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsmallSubset
        intro m _ _
        omega
      _ = f 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ 1 := card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_one_le lo hi
  have hpartition := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m) f
  change (∑ m ∈ S, f m) ≤
    1 + ∑ m ∈ S.filter (fun m ↦ 2 ≤ m), f m
  rw [← hpartition]
  omega

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_one_add_nontrivial
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_one_add_nontrivial
    {X lo hi : ℕ} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + ∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo,
        ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_le_sum_affine hlo).trans
    (sum_card_bfpsAffinePrimeSet_le_one_add_nontrivial X lo hi)
  exact_mod_cast h

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_weighted
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_weighted
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hlohi : lo < hi) (hhi : 3 ≤ hi)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
        1 + ∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo,
          ((bfpsAffinePrimeSet m lo hi).card : ℝ) :=
      card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_one_add_nontrivial hlo
    _ ≤ 1 + ∑ m ∈ bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet X hi lo,
        C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by
      apply add_le_add (le_refl 1)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      exact hsieve m lo hi
        (mem_bfpsNontrivialSmoothMultiplierSet.mp hm).1 hlohi hhi
    _ = 1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo := by
      rw [bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum, Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg
statement: theorem bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg (R : ℕ) : 0 ≤ bfpsLogSquaredScale R
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsLogSquaredScale AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_majorant
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_majorant
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {majorant : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hlohi : lo < hi) (hhi : 3 ≤ hi) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C)
    (hsmooth : HasBFPSWeightedSmoothMultiplierBound majorant) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
      1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * majorant X hi lo
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeShell X lo hi).card : ℝ) ≤
        1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum X hi lo :=
      card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_weighted hlo hlohi hhi hsieve
    _ ≤ 1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * majorant X hi lo := by
      exact add_le_add (le_refl 1) <|
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsmooth X hi lo)
          (mul_nonneg hC (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg hi))

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_sdiff_cast_le_majorant
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_sdiff_cast_le_majorant
    {X lo hi : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {majorant : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hlohi : lo < hi) (hhi : 3 ≤ hi) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C)
    (hsmooth : HasBFPSWeightedSmoothMultiplierBound majorant) :
    (((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X hi \ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X lo).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale hi * majorant X hi lo
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_sdiff_eq_shell hlo]
  exact card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_majorant
    hlo hlohi hhi hC hsieve hsmooth

name: RankAmplification.zero_mem_bfpsErrorValues
statement:
theorem zero_mem_bfpsErrorValues (δ t : ℝ) :
    0 ∈ bfpsErrorValues δ t
proof:

name: RankAmplification.bfpsNormalizedExcess_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsNormalizedExcess_nonneg (X Y : ℕ) :

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformSlackPhase_eq
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformSlackPhase_eq (u ξ : ℝ) :
    bfpsUniformSlackPhase u ξ = bfpsUniformPhase u - ξ * u
proof:

name: RankAmplification.one_mem_smoothTotientSet
statement:
theorem one_mem_smoothTotientSet {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) :
    1 ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_smoothTotientSet]
  refine ⟨le_rfl, hX, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.totient_one]
  exact ⟨one_ne_zero, fun p hp ↦ by simp at hp⟩

name: RankAmplification.one_le_smoothTotientCount
statement:
theorem one_le_smoothTotientCount {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) :
    1 ≤ smoothTotientCount X Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [smoothTotientCount]
  exact Finset.one_le_card.mpr ⟨1, one_mem_smoothTotientSet hX⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientDensity_pos
statement:
theorem smoothTotientDensity_pos {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) :
    0 < smoothTotientDensity X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothTotientDensity
  exact div_pos (by exact_mod_cast one_le_smoothTotientCount (Y := Y) hX)
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < X by omega))

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientDensity_le_one
statement:
theorem smoothTotientDensity_le_one (X Y : ℕ) :
    smoothTotientDensity X Y ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hX : X = 0
  · subst X
    simp [smoothTotientDensity]
  · have hXpos : 0 < X := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hX
    rw [smoothTotientDensity, div_le_one (by exact_mod_cast hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X)]
    exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size X Y

name: RankAmplification.log_smoothTotientDensity_nonpos
statement:
theorem log_smoothTotientDensity_nonpos (X Y : ℕ) :
    Real.log (smoothTotientDensity X Y) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hX : X = 0
  · subst X
    simp [smoothTotientDensity]
  · have hXone : 1 ≤ X := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX
    exact Real.log_nonpos (smoothTotientDensity_pos (Y := Y) hXone).le
      (smoothTotientDensity_le_one X Y)

name: RankAmplification.mem_smoothTotientMultiples
statement:
theorem mem_smoothTotientMultiples {X Y d n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ smoothTotientMultiples X Y d ↔ n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y ∧ d ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [smoothTotientMultiples]

name: RankAmplification.divisor_mem_smoothTotientSet
proof:
:= by
  have hdata := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn
  have hnpos : 0 < n := zero_lt_one.trans_le hdata.1
  have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdn hnpos
  apply mem_smoothTotientSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hdpos, (Nat.le_of_dvd hnpos hdn).trans hdata.2.1, ?_⟩
  exact hdata.2.2.of_dvd (Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hdn)
    (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hdpos).ne'

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothTotientMultiples_le
statement:
theorem card_smoothTotientMultiples_le
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (smoothTotientMultiples X Y d).card ≤ smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun n ↦ n / d
  have hmap : ∀ n ∈ smoothTotientMultiples X Y d,
      f n ∈ smoothTotientSet (X / d) Y := by
    intro n hn
    have hdata := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp
      (mem_smoothTotientMultiples.mp hn).1
    have hdn := (mem_smoothTotientMultiples.mp hn).2
    have hnpos : 0 < n := zero_lt_one.trans_le hdata.1
    have hquotPos : 0 < n / d := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hnpos hdn) hd
    apply mem_smoothTotientSet.mpr
    refine ⟨hquotPos, Nat.div_le_div_right hdata.2.1, ?_⟩
    apply hdata.2.2.of_dvd
    · exact Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hdn)
    · exact (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hquotPos).ne'
  have hinj : Set.InjOn f (smoothTotientMultiples X Y d) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have hda := (mem_smoothTotientMultiples.mp ha).2
    have hdb := (mem_smoothTotientMultiples.mp hb).2
    calc
      a = a / d * d := (Nat.div_mul_cancel hda).symm
      _ = b / d * d := by simpa only [f] using congrArg (fun n ↦ n * d) hab
      _ = b := Nat.div_mul_cancel hdb
  rw [smoothTotientCount]
  exact Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn f hmap hinj

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_nonneg
statement:
theorem smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_nonneg (X Y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun d _ ↦
    mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.divisors_eq_filter_range_succ_of_le
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp only [Nat.mem_divisors, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hd, -⟩
    exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr
      ((Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hd).trans hnX), hd⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, hd⟩
    exact ⟨hd, hn⟩

name: RankAmplification.sum_log_smoothTotientSet_le_mangoldtConvolution
statement:
theorem sum_log_smoothTotientSet_le_mangoldtConvolution (X Y : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y, Real.log n) ≤
      smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrange : smoothTotientSet X Y ⊆ Finset.range X.succ := by
    intro n hn
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr
      (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn).2.1)
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y, Real.log n) =
        ∑ n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y,
          ∑ d ∈ Finset.range X.succ,
            if d ∣ n then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := (Nat.ne_of_gt <|
        zero_lt_one.trans_le (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn).1)
      have hnX := (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn).2.1
      rw [← ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_sum,
        divisors_eq_filter_range_succ_of_le hn0 hnX, Finset.sum_filter]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ Finset.range X.succ,
        ((smoothTotientMultiples X Y d).card : ℝ) *
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d _
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      simp [smoothTotientMultiples]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y,
        ((smoothTotientMultiples X Y d).card : ℝ) *
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d := by
      symm
      apply Finset.sum_subset hrange
      intro d hdRange hdNot
      have hempty : smoothTotientMultiples X Y d = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro n hn
        exact hdNot (divisor_mem_smoothTotientSet
          (mem_smoothTotientMultiples.mp hn).1
          (mem_smoothTotientMultiples.mp hn).2)
      rw [hempty]
      simp
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y,
        (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) *
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      have hdpos := (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hd).1
      have hcard := card_smoothTotientMultiples_le
        (X := X) (Y := Y) hdpos
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (by exact_mod_cast hcard)
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
    _ = smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y := by
      unfold smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d _
      ring

name: RankAmplification.mem_smoothTotientUpperHalf
statement:
theorem mem_smoothTotientUpperHalf {X Y n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y ↔
      n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y ∧ X / 2 < n
proof:
:= by
  simp [smoothTotientUpperHalf]

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothTotientSet_le_half_add_upperHalf
statement:
theorem card_smoothTotientSet_le_half_add_upperHalf (X Y : ℕ) :
    (smoothTotientSet X Y).card ≤
      smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y + (smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let low := (smoothTotientSet X Y).filter (· ≤ X / 2)
  have hlow : low.card ≤ smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y := by
    rw [smoothTotientCount]
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro n hn
    have h := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
    have hdata := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp h.1
    exact mem_smoothTotientSet.mpr ⟨hdata.1, h.2, hdata.2.2⟩
  have hpartition : low.card + (smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y).card =
      (smoothTotientSet X Y).card := by
    have hcard := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := smoothTotientSet X Y) (p := fun n ↦ n ≤ X / 2)
    simpa only [low, smoothTotientUpperHalf, Nat.not_le] using hcard
  omega

name: RankAmplification.upperHalf_mul_log_half_le_mangoldtConvolution
statement:
theorem upperHalf_mul_log_half_le_mangoldtConvolution
    {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) :
    ((smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y).card : ℝ) *
        Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hhalfTwo : 2 ≤ X / 2 := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega : 0 < 2)).2 (by omega)
  have hhalfPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsumLower :
      ((smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y).card : ℝ) *
          Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y, Real.log n := by
    calc
      ((smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y).card : ℝ) *
          Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          ∑ _n ∈ smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y,
            Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y, Real.log n := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro n hn
        have hnHalf := (mem_smoothTotientUpperHalf.mp hn).2
        exact Real.log_le_log hhalfPos (by exact_mod_cast hnHalf.le)
  have hsubset : smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y ⊆ smoothTotientSet X Y := by
    intro n hn
    exact (mem_smoothTotientUpperHalf.mp hn).1
  have hsumSubset :
      (∑ n ∈ smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y, Real.log n) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y, Real.log n := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
    intro n hn _
    have hnOne := (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn).1
    exact Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hnOne)
  exact hsumLower.trans <| hsumSubset.trans
    (sum_log_smoothTotientSet_le_mangoldtConvolution X Y)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_cast_le_half_add_mangoldt
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_cast_le_half_add_mangoldt
    {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y +
        smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y /
          Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hhalfOne : (1 : ℝ) < ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (1 : ℕ) < X / 2 by
      apply (Nat.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (by omega : 0 < 2)).2
      omega)
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hhalfOne
  have hupper := upperHalf_mul_log_half_le_mangoldtConvolution
    (Y := Y) hX
  have hupperDiv : ((smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y).card : ℝ) ≤
      smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y /
        Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hlog).2 hupper
  have hcard := card_smoothTotientSet_le_half_add_upperHalf X Y
  have hcardReal : ((smoothTotientSet X Y).card : ℝ) ≤
      (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) +
        (smoothTotientUpperHalf X Y).card := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  rw [smoothTotientCount]
  exact hcardReal.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hupperDiv)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformRankinShift_mul_log
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformRankinShift_mul_log
    {X Y : ℕ} { ξ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ * Real.log Y =
      log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsUniformRankinShift
  have hYreal : (1 : ℝ) < (Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hY
  field_simp [(Real.log_pos hYreal).ne']

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformRankinShift_mul_logX
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformRankinShift_mul_logX
    {X Y : ℕ} { ξ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ * Real.log X =
      bfpsUniformSlackPhase (bfpsU X Y) ξ
proof:
:= by
  have hlogY : Real.log (Y : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY : (1 : ℝ) < (Y : ℝ))).ne'
  unfold bfpsUniformRankinShift bfpsUniformSlackPhase bfpsU rankinU
  field_simp [hlogY]

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSAbelExponent_uniform_eq
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSAbelExponent_uniform_eq
    {X Y : ℕ} { ξ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    fixedBFPSAbelExponent X Y (bfpsUniformRankinExponent X Y ξ)
        BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant =
      -bfpsUniformSlackPhase (bfpsU X Y) ξ +
        bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSAbelExponent bfpsUniformRankinExponent
    bfpsUniformAbelRemainder
  simp only [bfpsUniformRankinExponent]
  rw [show 1 - (1 - bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ) =
      bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ by ring,
    show -bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ * Real.log X =
      -(bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ * Real.log X) by ring,
    bfpsUniformRankinShift_mul_logX hY]

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_uniformAbel
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_uniformAbel
    {X Y : ℕ} { ξ : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hshift : 0 < bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ)
    (hquarter : bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-bfpsUniformSlackPhase (bfpsU X Y) ξ +
          bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < bfpsUniformRankinExponent X Y ξ := by
    unfold bfpsUniformRankinExponent
    linarith
  have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ bfpsUniformRankinExponent X Y ξ := by
    unfold bfpsUniformRankinExponent
    linarith
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent_growingCutoff
    (X := X) (Y := Y) (c := bfpsUniformRankinExponent X Y ξ)
    hX hY hc hhalf
  rw [fixedBFPSAbelExponent_uniform_eq (by omega : 1 < Y)] at hfinite
  exact hfinite

name: RankAmplification.bfpsNormalizedExcess_le_uniformAbelError
statement:
theorem bfpsNormalizedExcess_le_uniformAbelError
    {X Y : ℕ} { ξ : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hu : 0 < bfpsU X Y)
    (hshift : 0 < bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ)
    (hquarter : bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    bfpsNormalizedExcess X Y ≤
      max 0 (ξ + bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ / bfpsU X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hXone : 1 ≤ X := by omega
  have hXreal : (0 : ℝ) < (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hX
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_uniformAbel hX hY hshift hquarter
  have hdensity : smoothTotientDensity X Y ≤
      Real.exp (-bfpsUniformSlackPhase (bfpsU X Y) ξ +
        bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hXreal).2
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hfinite
  have hlog : Real.log (smoothTotientDensity X Y) ≤
      -bfpsUniformSlackPhase (bfpsU X Y) ξ +
        bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (smoothTotientDensity_pos (Y := Y) hXone) hdensity
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using this
  have hdiv := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hu).2 hlog
  have hraw :
      Real.log (smoothTotientDensity X Y) / bfpsU X Y +
          log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) ≤
        ξ + bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ / bfpsU X Y := by
    unfold bfpsUniformSlackPhase at hdiv
    have heq :
        (-(bfpsU X Y *
              (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ)) +
            bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ) / bfpsU X Y =
          -(log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) +
            bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ / bfpsU X Y := by
      field_simp [hu.ne']
    rw [heq] at hdiv
    linarith
  unfold bfpsNormalizedExcess
  exact max_le_max le_rfl hraw

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet {X Y d : ℕ} :
    d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y ↔ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y ∧ d ≤ Y
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet {X Y d : ℕ} :

      d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y ∧ Y < d ∧ d.minFac ≤ Y
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.mem_bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet
statement:

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_three_ranges
statement:
theorem smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_three_ranges (X Y : ℕ) :
    smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y =
      (∑ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y) +
      (∑ d ∈ bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y) +
      ∑ d ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun d ↦
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y
  have hfirst := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
    (smoothTotientSet X Y) (fun d ↦ d ≤ Y) f
  let beyond := (smoothTotientSet X Y).filter (fun d ↦ Y < d)
  have hsecond := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
    beyond (fun d ↦ d.minFac ≤ Y) f
  unfold smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution
  change (∑ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y, f d) = _
  rw [← hfirst]
  simp only [not_le]
  change (∑ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y, f d) +
      ∑ d ∈ beyond, f d = _
  rw [← hsecond]
  simp only [not_le]
  simp only [bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet, bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet,
    beyond, f]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_smoothTotientSet_eq_three_ranges
statement:
theorem sum_smoothTotientSet_eq_three_ranges
    (X Y : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y, f d) =
      (∑ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y, f d) +
      (∑ d ∈ bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y, f d) +
      ∑ d ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet X Y, f d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfirst := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
    (smoothTotientSet X Y) (fun d ↦ d ≤ Y) f
  let beyond := (smoothTotientSet X Y).filter (fun d ↦ Y < d)
  have hsecond := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
    beyond (fun d ↦ d.minFac ≤ Y) f
  rw [← hfirst]
  simp only [not_le]
  change (∑ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y, f d) +
      ∑ d ∈ beyond, f d = _
  rw [← hsecond]
  simp only [not_le]
  simp only [bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet, bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet, beyond]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.prime_of_mem_largePrimeMangoldtSet_of_vonMangoldt_ne_zero
statement:
theorem prime_of_mem_largePrimeMangoldtSet_of_vonMangoldt_ne_zero
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet X Y)
    (hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0) :
    d.Prime
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : IsPrimePow d :=
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_ne_zero_iff.mp hΛ
  rcases (isPrimePow_nat_iff d).mp hpow with ⟨p, k, hp, hk, hpk⟩
  subst d
  have hdata := mem_bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet.mp hd
  have hpLarge : Y < p := by
    simpa only [hp.pow_minFac hk.ne'] using hdata.2.2
  by_cases hkOne : k = 1
  · subst k
    simpa using hp
  · have hkTwo : 2 ≤ k := by omega
    have hpDvd : p ∣ (p ^ k).totient :=
      prime_dvd_totient_of_sq_dvd hp (pow_dvd_pow p hkTwo)
    have hpowPos : 0 < p ^ k := pow_pos hp.pos _
    have hpMem : p ∈ (p ^ k).totient.primeFactors :=
      Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
        ⟨hp, hpDvd, (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hpowPos).ne'⟩
    have hpLe : p ≤ Y := (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdata.1).2.2.2 p hpMem
    omega

name: RankAmplification.largePrimeMangoldt_mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
statement:
theorem largePrimeMangoldt_mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet X Y)
    (hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0) :
    d ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hdData := mem_bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet.mp hd
  have hdPrime := prime_of_mem_largePrimeMangoldtSet_of_vonMangoldt_ne_zero hd hΛ
  apply mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hdPrime, (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdData.1).2.1, ?_⟩
  exact prime_pred_smooth_of_totient_smooth hdPrime dvd_rfl
    (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdData.1).2.2

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_contributions
statement:
theorem smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_contributions (X Y : ℕ) :
    smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y =
      bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y +
        bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y +
          bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution,
    bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution, bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution] using
      smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_three_ranges X Y

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_nonneg (X Y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun d _ ↦
    mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (by positivity)

statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_nonneg (X Y : ℕ) :

statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_nonneg (X Y : ℕ) :

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_le_reciprocal
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_le_reciprocal
    {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) * mangoldtReciprocalSum Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution mangoldtReciprocalSum
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y,
        (X : ℝ) * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      have hdpos := (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet.mp hd).1).1
      have hcount : (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤
          (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        calc
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size (X / d) Y
          _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
            simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
              (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := d))
      calc
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y ≤
            ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount
            ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
        _ = (X : ℝ) * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
          field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega : d ≠ 0)]
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Y,
        (X : ℝ) * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro d hd
        have hdata := mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet.mp hd
        exact Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨hdata.1 |> mem_smoothTotientSet.mp |>.1, hdata.2⟩
      · intro d _ _
        exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
          (div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
    _ = (X : ℝ) *
        (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Y, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_le_log
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_le_log
    {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) * (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant)
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution_le_reciprocal hX).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (by simpa [sharpMangoldtMertensConstant] using
        mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_log_add_constant hY)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg X))

name: RankAmplification.sum_bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient_Icc (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient d) =
      Chebyshev.psi N - Chebyshev.theta N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Chebyshev.psi_sub_theta_eq_sum_not_prime, Nat.floor_natCast,
    ← Finset.add_sum_Ioc_eq_sum_Icc (f := bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient)
      (Nat.zero_le N)]
  have hzero : bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient 0 = 0 := by
    simp [bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient]
  rw [hzero, zero_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  by_cases hp : d.Prime <;> simp [bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient, hp]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_eq_abel
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_eq_abel
    {X Y : ℕ} (hYX : Y ≤ X) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail X Y =
      (X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Chebyshev.psi X - Chebyshev.theta X) -
        (Y : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Chebyshev.psi Y - Chebyshev.theta Y) +
        ∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X,
          t⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            (Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ t⁻¹
  have hYreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Y := by exact_mod_cast hY
  have hdiff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (Y : ℝ) X, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t := by
    intro t ht
    dsimp [f]
    exact differentiableAt_inv (by linarith [hYreal, ht.1])
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) : deriv f t = -t⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [deriv_inv]
    ring
  have hderivFun : deriv f = fun t : ℝ ↦ -t⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    funext t
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · subst t
      simp [f]
    · exact hderiv t ht
  have hint : IntegrableOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc (Y : ℝ) X) := by
    rw [hderivFun]
    refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ?_
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [hYreal, ht.1]
    exact ((continuousAt_id.inv₀ ht0).pow 2).neg.continuousWithinAt
  have habel := sum_mul_eq_sub_sub_integral_mul'
    (c := c) (f := f) hYX hdiff hint
  have hsum :
      bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail X Y =
        ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc Y X, f d * c d := by
    unfold bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail
    dsimp [f, c, bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient]
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    by_cases hprime : d.Prime
    · simp [hprime]
    · have hdPos : 0 < d :=
        (show 0 < Y by omega).trans (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hd).1
      have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := hdPos.ne'
      simp [hprime, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have hintEq :
      (∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X,
        deriv f t * ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, c d) =
      -(∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X,
        t⁻¹ ^ 2 * (Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊)) := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t ht
    rw [hderiv t (by linarith [ht.1]),
      show (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, c d) =
          Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊ by
        simpa [c] using sum_bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient_Icc ⌊t⌋₊]
    ring
  rw [hsum, habel, hintEq]
  simp_rw [show (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 0 X, c d) =
      Chebyshev.psi X - Chebyshev.theta X by
        simpa [c] using sum_bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient_Icc X,
    show (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 0 Y, c d) =
      Chebyshev.psi Y - Chebyshev.theta Y by
        simpa [c] using sum_bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient_Icc Y]
  dsimp [f]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_nonneg (X Y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun d _ ↦
    div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCumulative_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCumulative_nonneg (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ Chebyshev.psi N - Chebyshev.theta N
proof:
:= by
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (Chebyshev.theta_le_psi N)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCumulative_floor_le
statement:
theorem bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCumulative_floor_le
    {t X : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (htX : t ≤ X) :
    Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊ ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt t * Real.log X
proof:
:= by
  have hfloorOne : 1 ≤ ⌊t⌋₊ := (Nat.one_le_floor_iff t).mpr ht
  have hfloorPos : (0 : ℝ) < ⌊t⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < ⌊t⌋₊ by omega)
  have hfloorLe : (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ t := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hfloorX : (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ X := hfloorLe.trans htX
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt t :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hfloorLe
  have hlog : Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log X :=
    Real.log_le_log hfloorPos hfloorX
  have hlogFloor : 0 ≤ Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hfloorOne)
  have hlogX : 0 ≤ Real.log X := hlogFloor.trans hlog
  have hmul : Real.sqrt (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * Real.log (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt t * Real.log X :=
    mul_le_mul hsqrt hlog hlogFloor (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  exact (Chebyshev.psi_sub_theta_le
    (x := (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast hfloorOne)).trans <| by
      nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedMangoldtTailIntegral_le
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtTailIntegral_le
    {X Y : ℕ} (hYX : Y ≤ X) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    (∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X,
        t⁻¹ ^ 2 * (Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊)) ≤
      (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) *
        Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    t⁻¹ ^ 2 * (Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊)
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * t⁻¹
  have hYreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Y := by exact_mod_cast hY
  have hYXreal : (Y : ℝ) ≤ X := by exact_mod_cast hYX
  have hYpos : (0 : ℝ) < Y := zero_lt_one.trans_le hYreal
  have hXpos : (0 : ℝ) < X := hYpos.trans_le hYXreal
  have hkernel : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ 2)
      (Set.Icc (Y : ℝ) X) := by
    refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ?_
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [hYreal, ht.1]
    exact (continuousAt_id.inv₀ ht0).pow 2 |>.continuousWithinAt
  have hstep := integrableOn_mul_sum_Icc
    (c := c) (m := 0) (a := (Y : ℝ)) (b := (X : ℝ))
    (by positivity) hkernel
  have hF : IntegrableOn F (Set.Icc (Y : ℝ) X) := by
    apply hstep.congr_fun
    · intro t ht
      dsimp [F]
      rw [show (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, c k) =
          Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊ by
        simpa [c] using sum_bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCoefficient_Icc ⌊t⌋₊]
    · exact measurableSet_Icc
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Set.Icc (Y : ℝ) X) := by
    refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ?_
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [hYreal, ht.1]
    exact (continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.inv₀ ht0)).continuousWithinAt
  have hpoint : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X, F t ≤ G t := by
    intro t ht
    have htOne : 1 ≤ t := hYreal.trans ht.1.le
    have htPos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans_le htOne
    have hfloor := bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCumulative_floor_le htOne ht.2
    have hYt : (Y : ℝ) ≤ t := ht.1.le
    have hsqrtY : 0 < Real.sqrt (Y : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hYpos
    have hsqrtT : 0 < Real.sqrt t := Real.sqrt_pos.2 htPos
    have hsqrtLe : Real.sqrt (Y : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt t := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hYt
    have hinvSqrt : (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.sqrt (Y : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hsqrtY hsqrtLe
    have hkernelEq : t⁻¹ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt t = t⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ := by
      have hsquare := Real.sq_sqrt htPos.le
      field_simp [htPos.ne', hsqrtT.ne']
      nlinarith
    have hkernelLe : t⁻¹ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt t ≤
        t⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (Y : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      rw [hkernelEq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinvSqrt (inv_nonneg.mpr htPos.le)
    have hlogX : 0 ≤ Real.log X :=
      Real.log_nonneg (hYreal.trans hYXreal)
    have hA : 0 ≤ Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊ :=
      bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCumulative_nonneg ⌊t⌋₊
    dsimp [F, G]
    calc
      t⁻¹ ^ 2 * (Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊) ≤
          t⁻¹ ^ 2 * (2 * Real.sqrt t * Real.log X) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfloor (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = 2 * Real.log X * (t⁻¹ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt t) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.log X *
          (t⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (Y : ℝ))⁻¹) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkernelLe (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hlogX)
      _ = (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * t⁻¹ := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
  have hintegral :
      (∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X, F t) ≤
        ∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X, G t := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae
    · exact hF.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    · exact hG.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    · filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t ht
      exact hpoint t ht
  dsimp [F, G] at hintegral ⊢
  calc
    (∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X,
        t⁻¹ ^ 2 * (Chebyshev.psi ⌊t⌋₊ - Chebyshev.theta ⌊t⌋₊)) ≤
      ∫ t in Set.Ioc (Y : ℝ) X,
        (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * t⁻¹ := hintegral
    _ = (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) *
        Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hYXreal,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_inv_of_pos hYpos hXpos]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_le
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_le
    {X Y : ℕ} (hYX : Y ≤ X) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
        (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) *
          Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hXone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ X := by exact_mod_cast hY.trans hYX
  have hXbound := Chebyshev.psi_sub_theta_le (x := (X : ℝ)) hXone
  have hYnonneg := bfpsNonprimeMangoldtCumulative_nonneg Y
  have hXinv : 0 ≤ (X : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
  have hYinv : 0 ≤ (Y : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg Y)
  have hboundary :
      (X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Chebyshev.psi X - Chebyshev.theta X) -
          (Y : ℝ)⁻¹ * (Chebyshev.psi Y - Chebyshev.theta Y) ≤
        (X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) := by
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXbound hXinv
    have hy : 0 ≤ (Y : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        (Chebyshev.psi Y - Chebyshev.theta Y) :=
      mul_nonneg hYinv hYnonneg
    linarith
  rw [bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_eq_abel hYX hY]
  exact add_le_add hboundary (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtTailIntegral_le hYX hY)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_le_reciprocalTail
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_le_reciprocalTail
    {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  let S := (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y).filter
    (fun d ↦ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0)
  have hsubset : S ⊆ (Finset.Ioc Y X).filter (fun d ↦ ¬ d.Prime) := by
    intro d hd
    have hdFilter := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    have hdData := mem_bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet.mp hdFilter.1
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨hdData.2.1,
      (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdData.1).2.1⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hdPrime
    have hmin : d.minFac = d := hdPrime.minFac_eq
    rw [hmin] at hdData
    omega
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y) =
      ∑ d ∈ S,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      by_cases hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0
      · simp [hΛ]
      · have hz : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hΛ
        simp [hz]
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ S,
        (X : ℝ) * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      have hdData := mem_bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet.mp
        (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).1
      have hdPos := (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdData.1).1
      have hcount : (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤
          (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        calc
          (smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size (X / d) Y
          _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
            simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
              (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := d))
      calc
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y ≤
            ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount
            ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
        _ = (X : ℝ) * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
          field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega : d ≠ 0)]
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ioc Y X).filter (fun d ↦ ¬ d.Prime),
        (X : ℝ) * (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro d hd _
      exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
        (div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_le_explicit
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_le_explicit
    {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hYX : Y ≤ X) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        ((X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
          (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) *
            Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y))
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution_le_reciprocalTail hX).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_le hYX hY)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg X))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_le_rpowSum
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_le_rpowSum
    {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.log X * smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum X Y 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum
  let S := bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet X Y
  let P := smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun d ↦
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y
  let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun p ↦ (X : ℝ) * Real.log X * (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)
  have hsubset : S.filter (fun d ↦ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0) ⊆ P := by
    intro d hd
    exact largePrimeMangoldt_mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ S, f d) =
        ∑ d ∈ S.filter (fun d ↦ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0), f d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hdS
      by_cases hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0
      · simp [hΛ]
      · have hz : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hΛ
        simp [f, hz]
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ S.filter (fun d ↦ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0), g p := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpS := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
      have hpΛ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
      have hpPrime := prime_of_mem_largePrimeMangoldtSet_of_vonMangoldt_ne_zero hpS hpΛ
      have hpLe := (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet.mp hpS).1).2.1
      have hcount : (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤
          (X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        calc
          (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size (X / p) Y
          _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
            simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
              (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := p))
      have hlog : Real.log p ≤ Real.log X :=
        Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos) (by exact_mod_cast hpLe)
      dsimp [f, g]
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hpPrime]
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg p),
        Real.rpow_one]
      have hlogNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log p :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le)
      have hlogXNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log X :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hX)
      calc
        Real.log p * smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y ≤
            Real.log p * ((X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount hlogNonneg
        _ ≤ Real.log X * ((X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlog
            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg p)))
        _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.log X * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by ring
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ P, g p := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro p _ _
      dsimp [g]
      positivity
    _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.log X *
        (∑ p ∈ P, (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformDecay_pos
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformDecay_pos (ξ u : ℝ) :
    0 < bfpsUniformDecay ξ u
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.exp_pos _

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg (ξ u : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsUniformDecay ξ u
proof:
:=
  (bfpsUniformDecay_pos ξ u).le

name: RankAmplification.log_bfpsUniformDecay
statement:
theorem log_bfpsUniformDecay (ξ u : ℝ) :
    Real.log (bfpsUniformDecay ξ u) = -bfpsUniformSlackPhase u ξ
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsUniformDecay, Real.log_exp]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaRatio_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaRatio_nonneg (ξ : ℝ) (X Y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGammaRatio smoothTotientDensity
  exact div_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientDensity_eq_gamma_mul_decay
statement:
theorem smoothTotientDensity_eq_gamma_mul_decay (ξ : ℝ) (X Y : ℕ) :
    smoothTotientDensity X Y =
      bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Y * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGammaRatio
  field_simp [(bfpsUniformDecay_pos ξ (bfpsU X Y)).ne']

name: RankAmplification.one_le_bfpsFiniteGammaEnvelope
statement:
theorem one_le_bfpsFiniteGammaEnvelope (ξ : ℝ) (B : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ bfpsFiniteGammaEnvelope ξ B
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsFiniteGammaEnvelope
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right <| Finset.sum_nonneg fun X _ ↦
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun Y _ ↦ bfpsGammaRatio_nonneg ξ X Y

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaRatio_le_finiteEnvelope
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaRatio_le_finiteEnvelope
    {ξ : ℝ} {B X Y : ℕ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hXB : X ≤ B)
    (hY : 2 ≤ Y) (hYB : Y ≤ B) :
    bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Y ≤ bfpsFiniteGammaEnvelope ξ B
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsFiniteGammaEnvelope
  have hinner : bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Y ≤
      ∑ Z ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Z := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun Z _ ↦ bfpsGammaRatio_nonneg ξ X Z)
      (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hY, hYB⟩)
  have houter : (∑ Z ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Z) ≤
      ∑ W ∈ Finset.Icc 1 B,
        ∑ Z ∈ Finset.Icc 2 B, bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Z := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun W _ ↦ Finset.sum_nonneg fun Z _ ↦ bfpsGammaRatio_nonneg ξ W Z)
      (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hX, hXB⟩)
  exact (hinner.trans houter).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix
    {ξ : ℝ} {W X Y : ℕ} (hWX : W ≤ X) :
    bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Y ≤ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  exact le_monotoneEnvelope (fun W ↦ bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Y) hWX

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaPrefix_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaPrefix_nonneg (ξ : ℝ) (X Y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsGammaRatio_nonneg ξ 0 Y).trans
    (bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix (ξ := ξ) (X := X) (Y := Y) (Nat.zero_le X))

name: RankAmplification.monotone_bfpsGammaPrefix
statement:
theorem monotone_bfpsGammaPrefix (ξ : ℝ) (Y : ℕ) :
    Monotone (fun X ↦ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ X Y)
proof:
:=
  monotone_monotoneEnvelope _

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_gammaPrefix
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_gammaPrefix
    {ξ : ℝ} {W X Y : ℕ} (hW : 0 < W) (hWX : W ≤ X) :
    (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤
      (W : ℝ) * bfpsGammaPrefix ξ X Y *
        bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hWreal : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hW
  have hgamma := bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) hWX
  have hdecay := bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg ξ (bfpsU W Y)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgamma hdecay
  have hdensity := smoothTotientDensity_eq_gamma_mul_decay ξ W Y
  calc
    (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) = (W : ℝ) * smoothTotientDensity W Y := by
      unfold smoothTotientDensity
      field_simp
    _ = (W : ℝ) *
        (bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Y * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y)) := by
      rw [hdensity]
    _ ≤ (W : ℝ) *
        (bfpsGammaPrefix ξ X Y * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul hWreal.le
    _ = (W : ℝ) * bfpsGammaPrefix ξ X Y *
        bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformShiftedPrimeCardMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformShiftedPrimeCardMajorant_nonneg (H Y : ℕ) :

proof:

  unfold bfpsUniformShiftedPrimeCardMajorant
  have hC :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
  have hsum : 0 ≤ bfpsGeometricLogMajorantSum H Y 2
      (bfpsFixedShellCount Y) := by
    unfold bfpsGeometricLogMajorantSum
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ mul_nonneg
      (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg _)
      (by unfold bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant; positivity)
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_uniformMajorant

      bfpsUniformShiftedPrimeCardMajorant H Y
proof:
:= by
  have hterminal := (bfpsFixedShellEndpoint_bounds hY).1
  have h := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_geometricLogMajorant
    (X := H) (Y := Y) (base := 2) (K := bfpsFixedShellCount Y)
    (C := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant)
    (by norm_num) hterminal
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
    BFPSTwoAffine.hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_growingCutoff

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_disjoint

theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_disjoint
    {X Y k i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) :
    Disjoint (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k i)
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro p hpi hpj
  have hi := (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell.mp hpi).2
  have hj := (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell.mp hpj).2

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_pairwiseDisjoint (X Y k : ℕ) :
    ((bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicIndices X Y k : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k)
proof:

  intro i hi j hj hij
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hijlt | hjilt
  · exact bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_disjoint hijlt

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicUnion_eq
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicUnion_eq
    {X Y k : ℕ} :
    (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicIndices X Y k).biUnion
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k) =
      bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rcases Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hp with ⟨j, hj, hpj⟩
    exact (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell.mp hpj).1
  · intro hp
    have hpData := mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp
    have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).1
    let j := Nat.log 2 p
    have hpLower : 2 ^ j ≤ p := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hpPrime.ne_zero
    have hpUpper : p < 2 ^ (j + 1) := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) p
    have hjRange : j < Nat.log 2 X + 1 := by
      exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le <| Nat.log_mono_right
        (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).2.1
    have hjActive : j ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicIndices X Y k := by
      apply mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicIndices.mpr
      exact ⟨hjRange, hpData.2.1.trans_lt hpUpper,
        hpLower.trans_lt hpData.2.2⟩
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨j, hjActive,
      mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell.mpr ⟨hp, hpLower, hpUpper⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_eq_dyadic

theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_eq_dyadic

    Finset.sum_biUnion (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_pairwiseDisjoint X Y k)]
