name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicLogSum_le_card
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicLogSum_le_card
    {X Y k j : ℕ} :
    (∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j,
        Real.log p / p) ≤
      ((bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j).card : ℝ) *
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j,
        Real.log p / p) ≤
      ∑ _p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j,
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpData := mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell.mp hp
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hpData.1).1).1
      have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
      have hpowNat : 0 < (2 ^ j : ℕ) := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
      have hpowPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hpowNat
      have hpLower : ((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2.1
      have hpUpper : (p : ℝ) ≤ (2 ^ (j + 1) : ℕ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hpData.2.2.le
      have hlog : Real.log p ≤ Real.log ((2 ^ (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Real.log_le_log hpPos hpUpper
      have hinv : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
        simpa only [one_div] using
          one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpowPos hpLower
      have hlogNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log p :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le)
      have hlogPowNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log ((2 ^ (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by
          exact_mod_cast
            (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2)))
      unfold bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      calc
        Real.log p / p = Real.log p * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        _ ≤ Real.log ((2 ^ (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul hlog hinv (inv_nonneg.mpr hpPos.le) hlogPowNonneg
        _ = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 *
            (((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
          rw [show ((2 ^ (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) by norm_num,
            Real.log_pow]
    _ = ((bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j).card : ℝ) *
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const]
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicLogSum_le_uniformMajorant
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicLogSum_le_uniformMajorant
    {X Y k j : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    (∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j,
        Real.log p / p) ≤
      bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j *
        bfpsUniformShiftedPrimeCardMajorant
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_subset_endpoint X Y k j
  have hcardNat := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  have hcard : ((bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  have hglobal := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_uniformMajorant
    (H := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) hY
  have hweight := bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight_nonneg j
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j,
        Real.log p / p) ≤
      ((bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j).card : ℝ) *
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j :=
      bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicLogSum_le_card
    _ ≤ ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y).card : ℝ) *
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hweight
    _ ≤ bfpsUniformShiftedPrimeCardMajorant
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y *
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hglobal hweight
    _ = bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j *
        bfpsUniformShiftedPrimeCardMajorant
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_eq_exp
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_eq_exp
    {Y k : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant Y k =
      Real.exp (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleExponent Y k)
proof:
:= by
  let M := Y ^ (k + 1)
  let δ := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift Y k
  have hlowerPos : (0 : ℝ) < ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlogLower : Real.log (((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      (k : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hδY : δ * Real.log Y =
      Real.log (k + 1 : ℕ) + Real.log (Real.log (k + 1 : ℕ)) := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift_mul_log hY
  have hδM : δ * Real.log M =
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (Real.log (k + 1 : ℕ) + Real.log (Real.log (k + 1 : ℕ))) := by
    dsimp [δ, M, bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift]
    rw [hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH hY, rankinU_nat_pow hY]
  unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleExponent
  dsimp only [M, δ]
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hlowerPos, ← Real.exp_add,
    rankinU_nat_pow hY, dickmanSaddlePhase, hlogLower]
  apply congrArg Real.exp
  dsimp [δ, M] at hδY hδM ⊢
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeLocalRankinMajorant_le_saddle
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeLocalRankinMajorant_le_saddle
    {X Y k : ℕ}
    (hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime Y (Y ^ (k + 1))) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeLocalRankinMajorant X Y k
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift Y k) ≤
      bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant Y k
proof:
:= by
  let M := Y ^ (k + 1)
  let δ := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift Y k
  have hcut : bfpsPrimeMagnitudeEndpoint X Y k ≤ M := by
    exact min_le_right _ _
  have hsum : finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum Y
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeEndpoint X Y k) (1 - δ) ≤
      finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum Y M (1 - δ) := by
    unfold finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    · intro m hm
      have hmData := mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm
      exact mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr
        ⟨hmData.1, hmData.2.1.trans hcut, hmData.2.2⟩
    · intro m _ _
      exact totientRankinWeight_nonneg _ _
  have hadaptive : finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum Y M (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp
        (δ * Real.log M - dickmanSaddlePhase (rankinU M Y) +
          sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y M +
            totientRankinCorrectionConstant) := by
    exact finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_sharpAdaptive hsharp le_rfl
  unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeLocalRankinMajorant
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant
  dsimp only [M, δ]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsum.trans hadaptive)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass_le_localRankin
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass_le_localRankin
    {X Y k : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 0 < Y) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass X Y k ≤
      bfpsPrimeMagnitudeLocalRankinMajorant X Y k δ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < 1 - δ := sub_pos.mpr hδ1
  have hsubset := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell_subset_endpoint X Y k
  have hlowerNat : 0 < Y ^ k := pow_pos hY _
  have hlower : (0 : ℝ) < ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hlowerNat
  have hshell : bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass X Y k ≤
      ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-δ) *
        smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeEndpoint X Y k) Y (1 - δ) := by
    unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k, (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
          ∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
            ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro p hp
        have hpData := mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp
        have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).1
        have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
        have hpLower : ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ p := by
          exact_mod_cast hpData.2.1
        have hpow : (p : ℝ) ^ (-δ) ≤ ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-δ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hlower hpLower (by linarith)
        calc
          (p : ℝ)⁻¹ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]
          _ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-δ) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hpPos]
            congr 1
            ring
          _ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) * ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-δ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hpPos.le _)
          _ = ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-δ) *
              (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
            (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeEndpoint X Y k) Y,
            ((Y ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-δ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
        intro p _ _
        exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hlower.le _)
          (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _)
  exact hshell.trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_finiteTotientRankinSum
        (X := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeEndpoint X Y k) (R := Y) hc)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg hlower.le _)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass_le_rankinMajorant
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass_le_rankinMajorant
    {X Y k : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass X Y k ≤
      bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellRankinMajorant X Y k
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell_subset_endpoint X Y k
  have hshell : bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass X Y k ≤
      smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeEndpoint X Y k) Y 1 := by
    unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass
    unfold smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k, (p : ℝ)⁻¹) =
          ∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k, (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg p), Real.rpow_one]
      _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeEndpoint X Y k) Y, (p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
        intro p _ _
        positivity
  exact hshell.trans <| by
    unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellRankinMajorant
    exact smoothPredecessorPrimeRpowSum_le_fixedShellTruncatedMajorant
      hY (by norm_num)
      BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
      BFPSTwoAffine.hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_growingCutoff

name: RankAmplification.largePrimeMangoldtFilter_eq_magnitudeShellUnion

  · intro hp

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_logMass
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_logMass
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y k : ℕ} :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel ξ X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k *
        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
        Real.log p * ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y)) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
        (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k *
          (Real.log p / p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp).1).1
      have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
      have hcastDiv : ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
          (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := p))
      have hdecay := bfpsUniformDecay_le_magnitudeInnerEnvelope
        (ξ := ξ) hp
      have hinner : ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y) ≤
        ((X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) *
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k :=
        mul_le_mul hcastDiv hdecay
          (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hpPos.le))
      have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log p :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le)
      calc
        Real.log p * ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y) =
            Real.log p * (((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Real.log p * (((X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) *
              bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner hlog
        _ = (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k *
              (Real.log p / p) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
        (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k *
          (Real.log p / p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (show bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k ⊆
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k from Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      intro p hp _
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp).1).1
      exact mul_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg ξ X Y k))
        (div_nonneg
          (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le))
          (Nat.cast_nonneg p))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_eq_magnitudeSum
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_eq_magnitudeSum
    {X Y : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1),
        bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution X Y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution
  let S := bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet X Y
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun d ↦
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ S, f d) =
        ∑ d ∈ S.filter (fun d ↦ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0), f d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hdS
      by_cases hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0
      · simp [hΛ]
      · have hz : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hΛ
        simp [f, hz]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1)).biUnion
          (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y), f d := by
      rw [← largePrimeMangoldtFilter_eq_magnitudeShellUnion hY]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1),
          ∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k, f p :=
      Finset.sum_biUnion (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell_pairwiseDisjoint hY)
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1),
        bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution X Y k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      unfold bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp).1).1
      dsimp [f]
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hpPrime]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaKernelOn_le_reciprocalMass
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaKernelOn_le_reciprocalMass
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
    (hS : ∀ d ∈ S, 0 < d ∧ d ≤ X) :
    bfpsGammaKernelOn ξ X Y S ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y S *
        bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass S
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGammaKernelOn bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro d hd
  have hdData := hS d hd
  have hdReal : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hdData.1
  have hcastDiv : ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
      (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := d))
  have hdecay := bfpsUniformDecay_le_gammaInnerEnvelope
    (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) hd hdData.2
  have hinner : ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y) ≤
    ((X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹) *
      bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y S :=
    mul_le_mul hcastDiv hdecay (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hdReal.le))
  calc
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y) =
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d *
          (((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y)) := by ring
    _ ≤ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d *
        (((X : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)⁻¹) *
          bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y S) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
    _ = (X : ℝ) * bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y S *
        (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_reciprocal

theorem bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_reciprocal
    (ξ : ℝ) (X Y : ℕ) :

      (X : ℝ) *
        bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) *
          mangoldtReciprocalSum Y

:= by
  have hgeneric := bfpsGammaKernelOn_le_reciprocalMass
    (ξ := ξ) (X := X) (Y := Y) (S := bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y)
    (fun d hd ↦ by
      have hdata := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp (mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet.mp hd).1
      exact ⟨hdata.1, hdata.2.1⟩)
  change bfpsSmallGammaKernel ξ X Y ≤ _ at hgeneric ⊢
  exact hgeneric.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass_small_le X Y)
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
      (bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg _ _ _ _))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_log
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_log
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hY : 0 < Y) :
    bfpsSmallGammaKernel ξ X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) *
          (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant)
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_reciprocal ξ X Y).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mangoldtReciprocalSum_le_log_add_constant hY)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
        (bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg _ _ _ _))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass_repeated_le
statement:
theorem bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass_repeated_le (X Y : ℕ) :
    bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y) ≤
      bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail
  let S := (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y).filter
    (fun d ↦ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0)
  have hsubset : S ⊆ (Finset.Ioc Y X).filter (fun d ↦ ¬ d.Prime) := by
    intro d hd
    have hdFilter := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    have hdData := mem_bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet.mp hdFilter.1
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨hdData.2.1,
      (mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdData.1).2.1⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hdPrime
    have hmin : d.minFac = d := hdPrime.minFac_eq
    rw [hmin] at hdData
    omega
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d) =
      ∑ d ∈ S, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        by_cases hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0
        · simp [hΛ]
        · have hz : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hΛ
          simp [hz]
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ioc Y X).filter (fun d ↦ ¬ d.Prime),
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / d := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro d _ _
      exact div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel_le_reciprocalTail
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel_le_reciprocalTail
    (ξ : ℝ) (X Y : ℕ) :
    bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel ξ X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y) *
          bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hgeneric := bfpsGammaKernelOn_le_reciprocalMass
    (ξ := ξ) (X := X) (Y := Y) (S := bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y)
    (fun d hd ↦ by
      have hdata := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet.mp hd).1
      exact ⟨hdata.1, hdata.2.1⟩)
  change bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel ξ X Y ≤ _ at hgeneric ⊢
  exact hgeneric.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (bfpsMangoldtReciprocalMass_repeated_le X Y)
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
      (bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg _ _ _ _))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel_le_explicit
statement:
theorem bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel_le_explicit
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hYX : Y ≤ X) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel ξ X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) *
        bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtSet X Y) *
          ((X : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X) +
            (2 * Real.log X / Real.sqrt Y) * Real.log ((X : ℝ) / Y))
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsRepeatedGammaKernel_le_reciprocalTail ξ X Y).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (bfpsRepeatedMangoldtReciprocalTail_le hYX hY)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
        (bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg _ _ _ _))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeGammaKernel_eq_magnitudeSum
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeGammaKernel_eq_magnitudeSum
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    bfpsLargePrimeGammaKernel ξ X Y =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1),
        bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel ξ X Y k
proof:
:= by
  let S := bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtSet X Y
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun d ↦
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y)
  unfold bfpsLargePrimeGammaKernel
  change (∑ d ∈ S, f d) = _
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ S, f d) =
        ∑ d ∈ S.filter (fun d ↦ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0), f d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hdS
      by_cases hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d ≠ 0
      · simp [hΛ]
      · have hz : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hΛ
        simp [f, hz]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1)).biUnion
          (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y), f d := by
      rw [← largePrimeMangoldtFilter_eq_magnitudeShellUnion hY]
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1),
          ∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k, f p :=
      Finset.sum_biUnion (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell_pairwiseDisjoint hY)
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1),
        bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel ξ X Y k := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      unfold bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp).1).1
      dsimp [f]
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hpPrime]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel_nonneg
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : 1 < X / 2 := by
    apply (Nat.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (by omega : 0 < 2)).2
    omega
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hhalf)
  unfold bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel
  exact add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _))
    (div_nonneg (bfpsGammaMangoldtKernel_nonneg _ _ _) hlog.le)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_le_gammaPrefix
statement:
theorem smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_le_gammaPrefix
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) :
    smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y ≤
      bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y * bfpsGammaMangoldtKernel ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution bfpsGammaMangoldtKernel
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d * smoothTotientCount (X / d) Y) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y,
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d *
          (((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y *
            bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      by_cases hdOne : d = 1
      · subst d
        simp
      · have hdData := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hd
        have hdTwo : 2 ≤ d := by omega
        have hquotPos : 0 < X / d :=
          Nat.div_pos hdData.2.1 hdData.1
        have hquotLt : X / d < X := Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) hdTwo
        have hinner := smoothTotientCount_le_gammaPrefix
          (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) hquotPos (by omega : X / d ≤ X - 1)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
    _ = bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y *
        ∑ d ∈ smoothTotientSet X Y,
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d *
            ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / d) Y) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d _
      ring

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_gammaPrefix_mul_recurrenceKernel
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_gammaPrefix_mul_recurrenceKernel
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
      bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y * bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hhalfPos : 0 < X / 2 := by omega
  have hhalfLt : X / 2 < X := by omega
  have hhalf := smoothTotientCount_le_gammaPrefix
    (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) hhalfPos (by omega : X / 2 ≤ X - 1)
  have hhalf' : (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) ≤
      bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y *
        (((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / 2) Y)) := by
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hhalf
  have hmangoldt := smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_le_gammaPrefix
    (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) (by omega : 2 ≤ X)
  have hhalfOne : (1 : ℝ) < ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (1 : ℕ) < X / 2 by omega)
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hhalfOne
  have hrec := smoothTotientCount_cast_le_half_add_mangoldt (Y := Y) hX
  calc
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤
        smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y +
          smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution X Y /
            Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hrec
    _ ≤ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y *
          (((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / 2) Y)) +
        (bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y *
          bfpsGammaMangoldtKernel ξ X Y) /
            Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      add_le_add hhalf' (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmangoldt hlog.le)
    _ = bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y *
        bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel ξ X Y := by
      unfold bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel
      ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix_of_kernel
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix_of_kernel
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hX : 4 ≤ X)
    (hkernel : bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel ξ X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y)) :
    bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Y ≤ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ (X - 1) Y
proof:
:= by
  have hprefix := bfpsGammaPrefix_nonneg ξ (X - 1) Y
  have hcount := (smoothTotientCount_le_gammaPrefix_mul_recurrenceKernel
    (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) hX).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkernel hprefix)
  have hXreal : (0 : ℝ) < X := by positivity
  have hdecay := bfpsUniformDecay_pos ξ (bfpsU X Y)
  unfold bfpsGammaRatio smoothTotientDensity
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hdecay).2
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hXreal).2
  simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hcount

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaPrefix_le_initial_of_kernel
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaPrefix_le_initial_of_kernel
    {ξ : ℝ} {B X Y : ℕ} (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hkernel : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel ξ W Y ≤
        (W : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y)) :
    bfpsGammaPrefix ξ X Y ≤ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ B Y
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ W : ℕ, W ≤ X →
      bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Y ≤ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ B Y := by
    intro W
    induction W using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h W ih =>
        intro hWX
        by_cases hWB : W ≤ B
        · exact bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix hWB
        · have hBW : B < W := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hWB
          have hWfour : 4 ≤ W := hB.trans (Nat.le_of_lt hBW)
          have hcontract := bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix_of_kernel
            (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) hWfour (hkernel W hBW hWX)
          apply hcontract.trans
          unfold bfpsGammaPrefix monotoneEnvelope
          apply Finset.sup'_le
          intro Z hZ
          have hZWsub : Z ≤ W - 1 :=
            Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hZ)
          have hWpos : 0 < W := by omega
          have hZW : Z < W := by omega
          exact ih Z hZW (hZW.le.trans hWX)
  unfold bfpsGammaPrefix monotoneEnvelope
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro W hW
  exact hpoint W <| Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hW)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaRatio_le_initial_of_kernel
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaRatio_le_initial_of_kernel
    {ξ : ℝ} {B X Y : ℕ} (hB : 4 ≤ B)
    (hkernel : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      bfpsGammaRecurrenceKernel ξ W Y ≤
        (W : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y)) :
    bfpsGammaRatio ξ X Y ≤ bfpsGammaPrefix ξ B Y
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsGammaRatio_le_prefix (ξ := ξ) (Y := Y) le_rfl).trans
    (bfpsGammaPrefix_le_initial_of_kernel hB hkernel)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaTarget_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaTarget_nonneg (ξ : ℝ) (X Y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_gammaTarget_of_four_budgets
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_gammaTarget_of_four_budgets
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ θ₀ θ₁ θ₂ θ₃ : ℝ} (hX : 4 ≤ X)
    (hθ : θ₀ + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃ ≤ 1)
    (hhalf : (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) ≤
      θ₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)
    (hsmall : bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y /
        Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ θ₁ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)
    (hrepeated : bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y /
        Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ θ₂ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y)
    (hlarge : bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y /
        Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ θ₃ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤ bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := smoothTotientCount_cast_le_half_add_mangoldt (Y := Y) hX
  rw [smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_contributions] at hrec
  rw [add_div, add_div] at hrec
  have hsum :
      (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) +
          bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
          bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
          bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        (θ₀ + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y := by
    calc
      (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) +
            bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y / Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          θ₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y + θ₁ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y +
            θ₂ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y + θ₃ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hhalf hsmall) hrepeated) hlarge
      _ = (θ₀ + θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃) * bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y := by ring
  have htarget := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ (bfpsGammaTarget_nonneg ξ X Y)
  exact hrec.trans <| by linarith

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_gammaTarget_of_recurrenceBudget
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_gammaTarget_of_recurrenceBudget
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hX : 4 ≤ X)
    (hbudget :
      (smoothTotientCount (X / 2) Y : ℝ) +
          (bfpsSmallMangoldtContribution X Y +
            bfpsRepeatedMangoldtContribution X Y +
              bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y) /
            Real.log ((X / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y) :
    (smoothTotientCount X Y : ℝ) ≤ bfpsGammaTarget ξ X Y
proof:
:= by
  exact (smoothTotientCount_cast_le_half_add_mangoldt (Y := Y) hX).trans <| by
    rw [smoothTotientMangoldtConvolution_eq_contributions]
    exact hbudget

name: RankAmplification.bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_pos
statement:
theorem bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_pos (k : ℝ) :
    0 < bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.exp_pos _

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformDecay_mul_shiftedPrimeDecay
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformDecay_mul_shiftedPrimeDecay
    (ξ u k : ℝ) :
    bfpsUniformDecay ξ (u - k) * bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k =
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ u * Real.exp (bfpsGammaConvolutionExponent ξ u k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsUniformDecay bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay bfpsGammaConvolutionExponent
  rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: RankAmplification.log_sub_log_le_sub_div
statement:
theorem log_sub_log_le_sub_div
    {u v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hvu : v ≤ u) :
    Real.log u - Real.log v ≤ (u - v) / v
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 0 < u := hv.trans_le hvu
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hu hv)
  rw [Real.log_div hu.ne' hv.ne'] at h
  calc
    Real.log u - Real.log v ≤ u / v - 1 := h
    _ = (u - v) / v := by
      field_simp [hv.ne']

name: RankAmplification.log2_sub_log2_le
statement:
theorem log2_sub_log2_le
    {u v : ℝ} (hv : 1 < v) (hvu : v ≤ u) :
    log2 u - log2 v ≤ (u - v) / (v * Real.log v)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 1 < u := hv.trans_le hvu
  have hlogv : 0 < Real.log v := Real.log_pos hv
  have hlogvu : Real.log v ≤ Real.log u :=
    Real.log_le_log (zero_lt_one.trans hv) hvu
  have houter := log_sub_log_le_sub_div hlogv hlogvu
  have hinner := log_sub_log_le_sub_div (zero_lt_one.trans hv) hvu
  rw [log2_eq, log2_eq]
  calc
    Real.log (Real.log u) - Real.log (Real.log v) ≤
        (Real.log u - Real.log v) / Real.log v := houter
    _ ≤ ((u - v) / v) / Real.log v :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hinner hlogv.le
    _ = (u - v) / (v * Real.log v) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.log3_sub_log3_le
statement:
theorem log3_sub_log3_le
    {u v : ℝ} (hv : 1 < v) (hlogv : 1 < Real.log v)
    (hvu : v ≤ u) :
    log3 u - log3 v ≤
      (u - v) / (v * Real.log v * log2 v)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 1 < u := hv.trans_le hvu
  have hlogvu : Real.log v ≤ Real.log u :=
    Real.log_le_log (zero_lt_one.trans hv) hvu
  have hlog2v : 0 < log2 v := by
    rw [log2_eq]
    exact Real.log_pos hlogv
  have hlog2vu : log2 v ≤ log2 u := by
    rw [log2_eq, log2_eq]
    exact Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hv) hlogvu
  have houter := log_sub_log_le_sub_div hlog2v hlog2vu
  have hinner := log2_sub_log2_le hv hvu
  rw [log3_eq, log3_eq]
  calc
    Real.log (log2 u) - Real.log (log2 v) ≤
        (log2 u - log2 v) / log2 v := houter
    _ ≤ ((u - v) / (v * Real.log v)) / log2 v :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hinner hlog2v.le
    _ = (u - v) / (v * Real.log v * log2 v) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformSlackPhase_sub_le
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformSlackPhase_sub_le
    {ξ u v : ℝ} (hv : 1 < v) (hlogv : 1 < Real.log v)
    (hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 v) (hvu : v ≤ u) :
    bfpsUniformSlackPhase u ξ - bfpsUniformSlackPhase v ξ ≤
      (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := log2_sub_log2_le hv hvu
  have h3 := log3_sub_log3_le hv hlogv hvu
  have hvpos : 0 < v := zero_lt_one.trans hv
  have hdiff : 0 ≤ u - v := sub_nonneg.mpr hvu
  have hlogvpos : 0 < Real.log v := zero_lt_one.trans hlogv
  have hterm2 : v * (log2 u - log2 v) ≤ u - v := by
    calc
      v * (log2 u - log2 v) ≤
          v * ((u - v) / (v * Real.log v)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hvpos.le
      _ = (u - v) / Real.log v := by field_simp [hvpos.ne']
      _ ≤ u - v := by
        exact div_le_self hdiff hlogv.le
  have hterm3 : v * (log3 u - log3 v) ≤ u - v := by
    calc
      v * (log3 u - log3 v) ≤
          v * ((u - v) / (v * Real.log v * log2 v)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hvpos.le
      _ = (u - v) / (Real.log v * log2 v) := by
        field_simp [hvpos.ne']
      _ ≤ u - v := by
        apply div_le_self hdiff
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlogv.le)
          (sub_nonneg.mpr hlog2v)]
  unfold bfpsUniformSlackPhase
  calc
    u * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) -
          v * (log2 v + log3 v - ξ) =
        (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) +
          v * (log2 u - log2 v) + v * (log3 u - log3 v) := by ring
    _ ≤ (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) +
          (u - v) + (u - v) := by gcongr
    _ = (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap
    {ξ u v a : ℝ} (hv : 1 < v) (hlogv : 1 < Real.log v)
    (hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 v) (hvu : v ≤ u) (hgap : u - v ≤ a)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2) :
    bfpsUniformDecay ξ v ≤
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ u *
        Real.exp (a * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hphase := bfpsUniformSlackPhase_sub_le (ξ := ξ) hv hlogv hlog2v hvu
  have hphase' : bfpsUniformSlackPhase u ξ - bfpsUniformSlackPhase v ξ ≤
      a * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2) :=
    hphase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgap hslope)
  unfold bfpsUniformDecay
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_nat_div_le
statement:
theorem rankinU_nat_div_le
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hd : 0 < d) (hdX : d ≤ X) :
    rankinU (X / d) Y ≤ rankinU X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 0 < X / d := Nat.div_pos hdX hd
  have hqX : X / d ≤ X := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  unfold rankinU
  exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hlogY).2 <|
    Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hq) (by exact_mod_cast hqX)

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_sub_nat_div_le
statement:
theorem rankinU_sub_nat_div_le
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hd : 0 < d) (hdX : d ≤ X) :
    rankinU X Y - rankinU (X / d) Y ≤
      Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)) / Real.log Y
proof:
:= by
  let q := X / d
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.div_pos hdX hd
  have hX : 0 < X := hd.trans_le hdX
  have hround : X < d * (q + 1) := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact Nat.lt_mul_div_succ X hd
  have hqdouble : q + 1 ≤ 2 * q := by omega
  have hboundNat : X ≤ 2 * d * q := by
    calc
      X ≤ d * (q + 1) := hround.le
      _ ≤ d * (2 * q) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d hqdouble
      _ = 2 * d * q := by ring
  have hbound : (X : ℝ) ≤ (2 * (d : ℝ)) * q := by
    exact_mod_cast hboundNat
  have hXreal : (0 : ℝ) < X := by exact_mod_cast hX
  have hqreal : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have htwoD : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlogBound : Real.log X - Real.log q ≤ Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      Real.log X - Real.log q ≤
          Real.log ((2 * (d : ℝ)) * q) - Real.log q :=
        sub_le_sub_right (Real.log_le_log hXreal hbound) _
      _ = Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul htwoD.ne' hqreal.ne']
        ring
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  unfold rankinU
  calc
    Real.log X / Real.log Y -
          Real.log ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log Y =
        (Real.log X - Real.log ((X / d : ℕ) : ℝ)) / Real.log Y := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)) / Real.log Y :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by simpa only [q] using hlogBound) hlogY.le

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_sub_nat_div_le_two
statement:
theorem rankinU_sub_nat_div_le_two
    {X Y d : ℕ} (hY : 2 ≤ Y) (hd : 0 < d) (hdX : d ≤ X) (hdY : d ≤ Y) :
    rankinU X Y - rankinU (X / d) Y ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hYone : 1 < Y := by omega
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hYone)
  have hlogd : Real.log (d : ℝ) ≤ Real.log Y := by
    exact Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hd) (by exact_mod_cast hdY)
  have hlogTwo : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log Y := by
    exact Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  have hlogMul : Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)) =
      Real.log 2 + Real.log d := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne')]
  calc
    rankinU X Y - rankinU (X / d) Y ≤
        Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)) / Real.log Y :=
      rankinU_sub_nat_div_le hYone hd hdX
    _ = (Real.log 2 + Real.log d) / Real.log Y := by rw [hlogMul]
    _ ≤ (Real.log Y + Real.log Y) / Real.log Y :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add hlogTwo hlogd) hlogY.le
    _ = 2 := by
      field_simp [hlogY.ne']
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_sub_nat_div_le_magnitudeShell
statement:
theorem rankinU_sub_nat_div_le_magnitudeShell
    {X Y k p : ℕ} (hY : 2 ≤ Y) (hp : p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k) :
    bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤ ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp
  have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).1
  have hpX := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).2.1
  have hYone : 1 < Y := by omega
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hYone)
  have hlogTwo : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log Y :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
  have hpUpper : (p : ℝ) ≤ (Y : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpData.2.2.le
  have hlogp : Real.log p ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
    calc
      Real.log p ≤ Real.log ((Y : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hpPos hpUpper
      _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := Real.log_pow _ _
  have hlogMul : Real.log (2 * (p : ℝ)) = Real.log 2 + Real.log p := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hpPos.ne']
  have hnum : Real.log (2 * (p : ℝ)) ≤
      ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
    rw [hlogMul]
    calc
      Real.log 2 + Real.log p ≤
          Real.log Y + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y :=
        add_le_add hlogTwo hlogp
      _ = ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
        push_cast
        ring
  calc
    bfpsU X Y - bfpsU (X / p) Y ≤
        Real.log (2 * (p : ℝ)) / Real.log Y :=
      rankinU_sub_nat_div_le hYone hpPrime.pos hpX
    _ ≤ (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y) / Real.log Y :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hlogY.le
    _ = ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by field_simp [hlogY.ne']

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallInnerDecayEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallInnerDecayEnvelope_le
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hY : 2 ≤ Y)
    (hu : 2 + Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ bfpsU X Y)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2) :
    bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) ≤
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
        Real.exp
          (2 * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let u := bfpsU X Y
  let C := log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2
  unfold bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope monotoneEnvelope
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro d hdRange
  by_cases hdSmall : d ∈ bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y
  · rw [if_pos hdSmall]
    have hdData := mem_bfpsSmallMangoldtSet.mp hdSmall
    have hdTotient := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hdData.1
    let v := bfpsU (X / d) Y
    have hvu : v ≤ u := by
      dsimp [u, v]
      exact rankinU_nat_div_le (by omega) hdTotient.1 hdTotient.2.1
    have hgap : u - v ≤ 2 := by
      dsimp [u, v]
      exact rankinU_sub_nat_div_le_two hY hdTotient.1 hdTotient.2.1 hdData.2
    have hvLarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ v := by
      linarith
    have hExpOnePos : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
    have honeExpExp : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 1) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact hExpOnePos
    have hv : 1 < v := honeExpExp.trans_le hvLarge
    have hlogvLower : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log v := le_log_of_exp_le hvLarge
    have hlogv : 1 < Real.log v :=
      (by rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]; norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1).trans_le
        hlogvLower
    have hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 v := by
      rw [log2_eq]
      exact le_log_of_exp_le hlogvLower
    dsimp [C, u] at hslope ⊢
    exact bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap hv hlogv hlog2v hvu hgap hslope
  · rw [if_neg hdSmall]
    exact mul_nonneg (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_phaseBudget
statement:
theorem bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_phaseBudget
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y : ℕ} (hY : 2 ≤ Y)
    (hu : 2 + Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ bfpsU X Y)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2) :
    bfpsSmallGammaKernel ξ X Y ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
        (Real.exp
          (2 * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant))
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall := bfpsSmallGammaKernel_le_log (ξ := ξ) (X := X) (Y := Y) (by omega)
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant := by
    have hlogY : 0 ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ Y by omega))
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  exact hsmall.trans <| by
    calc
      (X : ℝ) *
          bfpsGammaInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y (bfpsSmallMangoldtSet X Y) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) ≤
        (X : ℝ) *
          (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
            Real.exp
              (2 * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2))) *
            (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant) := by
        gcongr
        exact bfpsSmallInnerDecayEnvelope_le hY hu hslope
      _ = (X : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
          (Real.exp
            (2 * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
              (Real.log Y + sharpMangoldtMertensConstant)) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_le_phase
statement:
theorem bfpsMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_le_phase
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y k : ℕ} (hY : 2 ≤ Y)
    (hu : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ bfpsU X Y)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k ≤
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
        Real.exp
          (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let u := bfpsU X Y
  let C := log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2
  unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope monotoneEnvelope
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro p _hpRange
  by_cases hpLarge : p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k
  · rw [if_pos hpLarge]
    have hpLargeData := mem_bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hpLarge
    have hpMag : p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k :=
      mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mpr
        ⟨hpLargeData.1, hpLargeData.2.1, hpLargeData.2.2.1⟩
    have hpData := mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hpMag
    have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).1
    have hpX := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).2.1
    let v := bfpsU (X / p) Y
    have hvu : v ≤ u := by
      dsimp [u, v]
      exact rankinU_nat_div_le (by omega) hpPrime.pos hpX
    have hgap : u - v ≤ ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [u, v]
      exact rankinU_sub_nat_div_le_magnitudeShell hY hpMag
    have hvLarge : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ v := by linarith
    have honeExpExp : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp 1) := by
      rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
      exact Real.exp_pos 1
    have hv : 1 < v := honeExpExp.trans_le hvLarge
    have hlogvLower : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log v := le_log_of_exp_le hvLarge
    have hlogv : 1 < Real.log v :=
      (by rw [Real.one_lt_exp_iff]; norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1).trans_le
        hlogvLower
    have hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 v := by
      rw [log2_eq]
      exact le_log_of_exp_le hlogvLower
    dsimp [C, u] at hslope ⊢
    exact bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap hv hlogv hlog2v hvu hgap hslope
  · rw [if_neg hpLarge]
    exact mul_nonneg (bfpsUniformDecay_nonneg _ _) (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_nonneg (X Y k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
    (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp).1).1
  exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le))
    (Nat.cast_nonneg p)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le
    {X Y k : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k ≤
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y *
        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro p hp
  have hpData := mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp
  have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).1
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
  have hYPos : (0 : ℝ) < Y := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Y by omega)
  have hpowPos : (0 : ℝ) < (Y : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := pow_pos hYPos _
  have hpPow : (p : ℝ) ≤ (Y : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpData.2.2.le
  have hlog : Real.log p ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
    calc
      Real.log p ≤ Real.log ((Y : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hpPos hpPow
      _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y := Real.log_pow _ _
  have hinv : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hpPos.le
  calc
    Real.log p / p = Real.log p * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlog hinv
    _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_localRankin
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_localRankin
    {X Y k : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k ≤
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y *
        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeLocalRankinMajorant X Y k δ
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le hY).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass_le_localRankin
        (X := X) (Y := Y) (k := k) (by omega) hδ0 hδ1)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hY.le)))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_saddle
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_saddle
    {X Y k : ℕ}
    (hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime Y (Y ^ (k + 1))) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k ≤
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y *
        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant Y k
proof:
:= by
  have hYfour : 4 ≤ Y := hsharp.2.1
  have hY : 1 < Y := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hYfour
  have hYtwo : 2 ≤ Y := by omega
  have hδpos : 0 < bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift Y k := by
    unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift
    exact hildebrandSaddleShift_pos_of_large_u hYtwo hsharp.2.2.2
  have hδone : bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleShift Y k < 1 :=
    hsharp.2.2.1.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  exact (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_localRankin
      (X := X) (Y := Y) (k := k) hY hδpos.le hδone).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeLocalRankinMajorant_le_saddle hsharp)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hY.le)))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_saddle
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_saddle
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y k : ℕ}
    (hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime Y (Y ^ (k + 1))) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel ξ X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k *
        (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y *
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant Y k)
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_logMass).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_saddle hsharp)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg _ _ _ _))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant_nonneg (X Y k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant X Y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant
  split_ifs with hsharp
  · have hYfour : 4 ≤ Y := hsharp.2.1
    have hYone : 1 ≤ Y := by omega
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hYone)))
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_nonneg _ _)
  · exact bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellSelbergMajorant_nonneg _ _ _

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_hybrid
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_hybrid
    {X Y k : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k ≤
      bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant X Y k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime Y (Y ^ (k + 1))
  · rw [bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant, if_pos hsharp]
    exact bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_saddle hsharp
  · rw [bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant, if_neg hsharp]
    exact bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_selbergMajorant hY

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_hybrid
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_hybrid
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y k : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel ξ X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k *
        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant X Y k
proof:
:= by
  exact bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_logMass.trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_hybrid hY)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg _ _ _ _))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_phaseHybrid
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_phaseHybrid
    {ξ : ℝ} {X Y k : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hu : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ bfpsU X Y)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel ξ X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
        (Real.exp
          (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant X Y k)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeGammaKernel_le_hybrid
    (ξ := ξ) (X := X) (Y := Y) (k := k) hY
  have hmajorant := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant_nonneg X Y k
  exact hbase.trans <| by
    calc
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k *
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant X Y k ≤
        (X : ℝ) *
          (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
            Real.exp
              (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
                (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2))) *
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant X Y k := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (bfpsMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_le_phase (by omega) hu hslope)
            (Nat.cast_nonneg X)) hmajorant
      _ = (X : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU X Y) *
          (Real.exp
            (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ + 2)) *
            bfpsPrimeMagnitudeHybridLogMajorant X Y k) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.softenedMertensProduct_le_smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct
statement:
theorem softenedMertensProduct_le_smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct
    {R : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    softenedMertensProduct R s ≤ smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct R s
proof:
:= by
  have hsoft : 0 ≤ softenedMertensProduct R s :=
    (softenedMertensProduct_pos R hs).le
  have hcorr : 1 ≤ totientRankinCorrectionProduct R s := by
    unfold totientRankinCorrectionProduct
    apply Finset.one_le_prod
    intro p hp
    have hratio : 0 ≤ rankinEulerRatio p s :=
      Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _
    have hpred : 0 ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (div_nonneg hratio hpred)
  rw [smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_eq R hs]
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcorr hsoft

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_pos

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity
    {R H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hη : 0 < hildebrandSaddleShift H R)
    (hquarter : hildebrandSaddleShift H R ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hbase : hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log 2 ≤ 1)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log R) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      (H : ℝ) * bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R H
proof:
:= by
  let η := hildebrandSaddleShift H R
  have hηone : η < 1 := hquarter.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hs : 0 < 1 - η := sub_pos.mpr hηone
  have htotient := smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharpPhaseSplit
    hR hη hquarter hbase hphase
  have hsoft : softenedMertensProduct R (1 - η) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R η) :=
    (softenedMertensProduct_le_smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct hs).trans htotient
  have hlog : Real.log (softenedMertensProduct R (1 - η)) ≤
      fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R η := by
    rw [← Real.exp_le_exp]
    simpa only [Real.exp_log (softenedMertensProduct_pos R hs)] using hsoft
  have hcount := finiteSmoothCount_le_exp_saddle hH hηone hlog
  simpa only [bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity, η] using hcount

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_eq
statement:
theorem bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_eq
    {R H : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) :
    bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R H =
      Real.exp
        (-rankinU H R *
            (Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))) +
          fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R (hildebrandSaddleShift H R))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity
  dsimp only
  rw [show -hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
      -(hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H) by ring,
    hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH hR]
  congr 1
  ring

statement:

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_log_inv_add_saddleResidual
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_log_inv_add_saddleResidual
    {R M : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hη : 0 < hildebrandSaddleShift M R)
    (hquarter : hildebrandSaddleShift M R ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ hildebrandSaddleShift M R * Real.log R) :
    fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R (hildebrandSaddleShift M R) ≤
      Real.log (1 / hildebrandSaddleShift M R) +
        bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual (rankinU M R)
          (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)
proof:
:= by
  let η := hildebrandSaddleShift M R
  let z := Real.log (rankinU M R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R))
  have hglobal := fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global
    (Y := R) (H := R) hR le_rfl hη hquarter hphase
  have hz : η * Real.log R = z := by
    dsimp [η, z]
    exact hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR (by omega)
  apply hglobal.trans_eq
  unfold fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual
  dsimp only
  rw [hz]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.exp_fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_inv_mul_residual
statement:
theorem exp_fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_inv_mul_residual
    {R M : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hη : 0 < hildebrandSaddleShift M R)
    (hquarter : hildebrandSaddleShift M R ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ hildebrandSaddleShift M R * Real.log R) :
    Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R
        (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) ≤
      (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)⁻¹ *
        Real.exp (bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual (rankinU M R)
          (hildebrandSaddleShift M R))
proof:
:= by
  have hE := fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_log_inv_add_saddleResidual
    hR hη hquarter hphase
  calc
    Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R
        (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) ≤
      Real.exp (Real.log (1 / hildebrandSaddleShift M R) +
        bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual (rankinU M R)
          (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hE
    _ = (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)⁻¹ *
        Real.exp (bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual (rankinU M R)
          (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (div_pos (by norm_num) hη)]
      simp only [one_div]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_le_inv_mul_residual
statement:
theorem bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_le_inv_mul_residual
    {R M : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hη : 0 < hildebrandSaddleShift M R)
    (hquarter : hildebrandSaddleShift M R ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ hildebrandSaddleShift M R * Real.log R) :
    bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R M ≤
      (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)⁻¹ *
        Real.exp
          (-rankinU M R *
              (Real.log (rankinU M R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R))) +
            bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual (rankinU M R)
              (hildebrandSaddleShift M R))
proof:
:= by
  have heuler := exp_fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_inv_mul_residual
    hR hη hquarter hphase
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ Real.exp
      (-rankinU M R *
        (Real.log (rankinU M R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R)))) := by
    positivity
  rw [bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_eq (by omega : 1 < R)]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heuler hfactor
  calc
    Real.exp
        (-rankinU M R *
            (Real.log (rankinU M R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R))) +
          fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) =
      Real.exp
          (-rankinU M R *
            (Real.log (rankinU M R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R)))) *
        Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R
          (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
    _ ≤ Real.exp
          (-rankinU M R *
            (Real.log (rankinU M R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R)))) *
        ((hildebrandSaddleShift M R)⁻¹ *
          Real.exp (bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual (rankinU M R)
            (hildebrandSaddleShift M R))) := hmul
    _ = (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)⁻¹ *
        Real.exp
          (-rankinU M R *
              (Real.log (rankinU M R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R))) +
            bfpsSharpSaddleEulerResidual (rankinU M R)
              (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_le_inv_mul_kernel
statement:
theorem bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_le_inv_mul_kernel
    {R M : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R)
    (hη : 0 < hildebrandSaddleShift M R)
    (hquarter : hildebrandSaddleShift M R ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hphase : 4 ≤ hildebrandSaddleShift M R * Real.log R) :
    bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R M ≤
      (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)⁻¹ *
        bfpsSharpSaddleKernel (rankinU M R)
          (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [bfpsSharpSaddleKernel] using
    bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_le_inv_mul_residual hR hη hquarter hphase

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity
    {R M : ℕ} (hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime R M) :
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R M ≤
      (M : ℝ) * bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R M
proof:
:= by
  let η := hildebrandSaddleShift M R
  have hRfour : 4 ≤ R := hsharp.2.1
  have hRtwo : 2 ≤ R := by omega
  have hRone : 1 < R := by omega
  have hηpos : 0 < η :=
    hildebrandSaddleShift_pos_of_large_u hRtwo hsharp.2.2.2
  have hηone : η < 1 := hsharp.2.2.1.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hbase : η * Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have hlogTwoRaw :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
    calc
      η * Real.log 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul hsharp.2.2.1 hlogTwo
          (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 1 := by norm_num
  have hphase : 4 ≤ η * Real.log R := by
    have hlogu : Real.exp 2 ≤ Real.log (rankinU M R) :=
      le_log_of_exp_le hsharp.2.2.2
    have hloglogu : 2 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (rankinU M R)) :=
      le_log_of_exp_le hlogu
    rw [show η = hildebrandSaddleShift M R by rfl,
      hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR hRone]
    have hexpTwo : 2 ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 : ℝ)
      linarith
    linarith
  have hshift := finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum_le_shiftedEulerProduct
    (R := R) (M := M) (δ := (1 : ℝ)) (η := η) hηone.le hηone
  have heuler := smoothTotientRankinEulerProduct_le_sharpPhaseSplit
    hRfour hηpos hsharp.2.2.1 hbase hphase
  have hpow : 0 ≤ (M : ℝ) ^ (1 - η) :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg M) _
  have hweighted : finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M 0 ≤
      (M : ℝ) ^ (1 - η) *
        Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R η) := by
    have := hshift.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heuler hpow)
    norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  have hMpos : 0 < M := hsharp.1
  calc
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R M =
        finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum R M 0 := by
      unfold finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum finiteSmoothTotientRankinSum
        totientRankinWeight
      simp
    _ ≤ (M : ℝ) ^ (1 - η) *
        Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R η) := hweighted
    _ = (M : ℝ) * bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R M := by
      rw [natCast_rpow_one_sub hMpos, bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity]
      dsimp only [η]
      calc
        (M : ℝ) * Real.exp (-hildebrandSaddleShift M R * Real.log M) *
            Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R
              (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) =
          (M : ℝ) *
            (Real.exp (-hildebrandSaddleShift M R * Real.log M) *
              Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R
                (hildebrandSaddleShift M R))) := by ring
        _ = (M : ℝ) * Real.exp
            (-hildebrandSaddleShift M R * Real.log M +
              fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent R
                (hildebrandSaddleShift M R)) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant_nonneg
    (X Y base K : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  dsimp only
  exact mul_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    (bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_pos _ _).le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardTerm_le_kernel
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardTerm_le_kernel
    {X Y base i : ℕ} (hbase : 2 ≤ base)
    (hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
      (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)) :
    let R
proof:
:= bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i
    let M := bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i
    let u := rankinU M R
    let η := hildebrandSaddleShift M R
    let z := Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u)
    bfpsLogSquaredScale R * (M : ℝ) * bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R M ≤
      ((base : ℝ) * X / (Real.log R * z)) *
        bfpsSharpSaddleKernel u η := by
  dsimp only
  let R := bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i
  let M := bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i
  let u := rankinU M R
  let η := hildebrandSaddleShift M R
  let z := Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u)
  have hRfour : 4 ≤ R := hsharp.2.1
  have hRone : 1 < R := by omega
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hRone)
  have hη : 0 < η :=
    hildebrandSaddleShift_pos_of_large_u (by omega) hsharp.2.2.2
  have hηlog : η * Real.log R = z := by
    dsimp [η, z, u]
    exact hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR hRone
  have hz : 0 < z := by
    rw [← hηlog]
    exact mul_pos hη hlogR
  have hinv : η⁻¹ = Real.log R / z := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hz.ne').2
    rw [← hηlog]
    field_simp [hη.ne']
  have hdensity : bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R M ≤
      η⁻¹ * bfpsSharpSaddleKernel u η := by
    exact bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity_le_inv_mul_kernel hRfour hη
      hsharp.2.2.1 (by
        rw [hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR hRone]
        have hlogu : Real.exp 2 ≤ Real.log u := by
          dsimp [u]
          exact le_log_of_exp_le hsharp.2.2.2
        have hloglogu : 2 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) :=
          le_log_of_exp_le hlogu
        have hexpTwo : 2 ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
          have := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 : ℝ)
          linarith
        linarith)
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ bfpsLogSquaredScale R * (M : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg R) (Nat.cast_nonneg M)
  have hfirst := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdensity hfactor
  have hproductNat : R * M ≤ base * X := by
    dsimp [R, M]
    exact bfpsGeometricEndpoint_mul_shellMultiplierCutoff_le (by omega)
  have hproduct : (R : ℝ) * M ≤ (base : ℝ) * X := by
    exact_mod_cast hproductNat
  have hden : 0 < Real.log R * z := mul_pos hlogR hz
  have hquot : (R : ℝ) * M / (Real.log R * z) ≤
      (base : ℝ) * X / (Real.log R * z) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hproduct hden.le
  have hkernel := (bfpsSharpSaddleKernel_pos u η).le
  calc
    bfpsLogSquaredScale R * (M : ℝ) * bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity R M ≤
        (bfpsLogSquaredScale R * (M : ℝ)) *
          (η⁻¹ * bfpsSharpSaddleKernel u η) := hfirst
    _ = ((R : ℝ) * M / (Real.log R * z)) *
        bfpsSharpSaddleKernel u η := by
      unfold bfpsLogSquaredScale AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
      rw [hinv]
      field_simp [hlogR.ne', hz.ne']
    _ ≤ ((base : ℝ) * X / (Real.log R * z)) *
        bfpsSharpSaddleKernel u η :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hquot hkernel

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricSharpKernelMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricSharpKernelMajorant_nonneg
    {X Y base K : ℕ}
    (hsharp : ∀ i, i < K →
      SharpHildebrandRegime
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
        (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)) :
    0 ≤ bfpsGeometricSharpKernelMajorant X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGeometricSharpKernelMajorant
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i hi
  have hs := hsharp i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  have hRone : (1 : ℕ) < bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hs.2.1
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hRone)
  have hη : 0 < hildebrandSaddleShift
      (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)
      (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) :=
    hildebrandSaddleShift_pos_of_large_u (by omega) hs.2.2.2
  have hz : 0 < Real.log (rankinU (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)) +
      Real.log (Real.log (rankinU (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i))) := by
    rw [← hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logR hRone]
    exact mul_pos hη hlogR
  dsimp only
  exact mul_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg base) (Nat.cast_nonneg X))
      (mul_nonneg hlogR.le hz.le))
    (bfpsSharpSaddleKernel_pos _ _).le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant_le_kernel
statement:
theorem bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant_le_kernel
    {X Y base K : ℕ} (hbase : 2 ≤ base)
    (hsharp : ∀ i, i < K →
      SharpHildebrandRegime
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
        (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)) :
    bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant X Y base K ≤
      bfpsGeometricSharpKernelMajorant X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant
    bfpsGeometricSharpKernelMajorant
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  exact bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardTerm_le_kernel hbase
    (hsharp i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_sharpPhaseGeometric
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_sharpPhaseGeometric
    {X Y base K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hterminal : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C)
    (hsharp : ∀ i, i < K →
      SharpHildebrandRegime
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
        (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)) :
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) ≤
      (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) + K +
        C * bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant X Y base K
proof:
:= by
  have hterminalOne : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K := by omega
  have hdecomp := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_eq_terminal_add_shells
    X Y base K hterminalOne
  have hdecompReal : ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X Y).card : ℝ) =
      ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X
        (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)).card : ℝ) +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
        ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hdecomp
  rw [hdecompReal]
  calc
    ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet X
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)).card : ℝ) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
          ((bfpsGeometricPrimeShell X Y base i).card : ℝ) ≤
      (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K,
          (1 + C * bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
            ((bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity
                (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
                (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i)) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact_mod_cast card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_le_finiteSmoothCount X
          (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
      · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hiK := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
        have hlo : 1 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) :=
          one_le_bfpsGeometricEndpoint_of_le (by omega) hterminalOne
        have hlohi : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1) <
            bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
          bfpsGeometricEndpoint_succ_lt hbase (by omega) hterminalOne
        have hhithree : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i :=
          hterminal.trans (bfpsGeometricEndpoint_le_of_le (by omega))
        have hshell := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeShell_cast_le_weighted
          (X := X)
          hlo hlohi hhithree hsieve
        have hweight :=
          (bfpsWeightedSmoothMultiplierSum_le_finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum
            X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
              (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base (i + 1))).trans
            (finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_bfpsSharpPhaseSmoothDensity
              (hsharp i hiK))
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hweight
          (mul_nonneg hC (bfpsLogSquaredScale_nonneg
            (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)))
        exact hshell.trans <| by
          simpa only [bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff, mul_assoc] using
            add_le_add le_rfl hmul
    _ = (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) X : ℝ) + K +
        C * bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant X Y base K := by
      unfold bfpsGeometricSharpPhaseCardMajorant bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
        Finset.mul_sum]
      ring_nf

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_sharpKernelGeometric
statement:
theorem card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_sharpKernelGeometric
    {X Y base K : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hterminal : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsieve : HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound C)
    (hsharp : ∀ i, i < K →

        Real.log p / p) ≤
      bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j *
        bfpsAdaptiveSharpPredecessorMajorant
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell_subset_endpoint X Y k j
  have hcardNat := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  have hcard : ((bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
        (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  have hglobal := card_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet_cast_le_adaptiveSharpMajorant
    (H := bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) hY
  have hweight := bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight_nonneg j
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j,
        Real.log p / p) ≤
      ((bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicShell X Y k j).card : ℝ) *
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j :=

    _ ≤ ((smoothPredecessorPrimeSet
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y).card : ℝ) *

    _ ≤ bfpsAdaptiveSharpPredecessorMajorant
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y *
        bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hglobal hweight
    _ = bfpsPrimeDyadicLogWeight j *
        bfpsAdaptiveSharpPredecessorMajorant
          (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeDyadicEndpoint X j) Y := by ring

name: RankAmplification.log_log_add_one_sub_log_log_le
statement:
theorem log_log_add_one_sub_log_log_le
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 1 < u) :
    Real.log (Real.log (u + 1)) - Real.log (Real.log u) ≤
      1 / (u * Real.log u)
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : 0 < u := zero_lt_one.trans hu
  have hu1 : 0 < u + 1 := by linarith
  have hlogu : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos hu
  have hlogu1 : 0 < Real.log (u + 1) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hinner : Real.log (u + 1) - Real.log u ≤ 1 / u := by
    calc
      Real.log (u + 1) - Real.log u = Real.log ((u + 1) / u) := by
        rw [Real.log_div hu1.ne' hu0.ne']
      _ ≤ (u + 1) / u - 1 :=
        Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hu1 hu0)
      _ = 1 / u := by field_simp [hu0.ne']; ring
  calc
    Real.log (Real.log (u + 1)) - Real.log (Real.log u) =
        Real.log (Real.log (u + 1) / Real.log u) := by
      rw [Real.log_div hlogu1.ne' hlogu.ne']
    _ ≤ Real.log (u + 1) / Real.log u - 1 :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hlogu1 hlogu)
    _ = (Real.log (u + 1) - Real.log u) / Real.log u := by
      field_simp [hlogu.ne']
    _ ≤ (1 / u) / Real.log u :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hinner hlogu.le
    _ = 1 / (u * Real.log u) := by ring

proof:
:= by
  have hlogu : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos hu
