  apply Real.log_le_log hlogu
  exact Real.log_le_log (zero_lt_one.trans hu) (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsSharpSaddleAbsorptionCost_le_gap
statement:
theorem bfpsSharpSaddleAbsorptionCost_le_gap
    {u η : ℝ} (h : InBFPSSharpSaddleElementaryRange u η) :
    bfpsSharpSaddleAbsorptionCost u η ≤
      u - Real.exp (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u)) /
        (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hu, hloglog, hloglog_le, hη, hηsmall, hfixed, hsqrt⟩
  let L := Real.log u
  let l := Real.log L
  let z := L + l
  have hu0 : 0 < u := zero_lt_one.trans hu
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; exact Real.log_pos hu
  have hlFour : 4 ≤ l := by simpa only [L, l] using hloglog
  have hlL : l ≤ L := by simpa only [L, l] using hloglog_le
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by dsimp [z]; linarith
  have hden : 0 < z - 2 := by dsimp [z]; linarith
  have hdenLe : z - 2 ≤ 2 * L := by dsimp [z]; linarith
  have hexpz : Real.exp z = u * L := by
    dsimp [z, L, l]
    rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hu0, Real.exp_log (Real.log_pos hu)]
  have hsqrtz : Real.exp (z / 2) = Real.sqrt (u * L) := by
    rw [Real.exp_half, hexpz]
  have hlogz : Real.log (z / 2) ≤ z := by
    have hzhalf : 0 < z / 2 := by positivity
    exact (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hzhalf).trans (by linarith)
  have hsqrtTerm : Real.exp (z / 2) * Real.log (z / 2) ≤
      2 * L * Real.sqrt (u * L) := by
    rw [hsqrtz]
    have hzle : z ≤ 2 * L := by dsimp [z]; linarith
    have hsqrtNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (u * L) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    simpa only [mul_comm] using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlogz.trans hzle) hsqrtNonneg)
  have hsqrtBudget : 2 * L * Real.sqrt (u * L) ≤ u / (4 * L) := by
    have hsqrt' : 8 * L ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (u * L) ≤ u := by
      simpa only [L] using hsqrt
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * L)).2
    nlinarith
  have hdiff := log_log_add_one_sub_log_log_le hu
  have hdiffBudget :
      u * (Real.log (Real.log (u + 1)) - Real.log (Real.log u)) ≤ 1 / L := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiff hu0.le
    dsimp [L]
    calc
      u * (Real.log (Real.log (u + 1)) - Real.log (Real.log u)) ≤
          u * (1 / (u * Real.log u)) := hmul
      _ = 1 / Real.log u := by field_simp [hu0.ne']
  have hfixedBudget : max bfpsSharpSaddleFixedErrorConstant 0 +
        1 / L + 2 * L ≤ u / (4 * L) := by
    have hfixed' : 4 * L *
        (max bfpsSharpSaddleFixedErrorConstant 0 + 1 / L + 2 * L) ≤ u := by
      simpa only [L] using hfixed
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * L)).2 (by
      simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hfixed')
  have hA : 0 ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
    linarith [one_le_sharpMangoldtMertensConstant]
  have hηBudget : (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
        (η * Real.exp z / 2) ≤ u / (4 * L) := by
    have hsmall : (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) * η * L ^ 2 ≤
        1 / 2 := by simpa only [L] using hηsmall
    rw [hexpz]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * L)).2
    have hL2 : 0 ≤ L ^ 2 := sq_nonneg L
    nlinarith
  have hcostUpper : bfpsSharpSaddleAbsorptionCost u η ≤
      3 * (u / (4 * L)) := by
    unfold bfpsSharpSaddleAbsorptionCost
    dsimp only
    change bfpsSharpSaddleFixedErrorConstant +
        Real.exp (z / 2) * Real.log (z / 2) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) * (η * Real.exp z / 2) +
        u * (Real.log (Real.log (u + 1)) - Real.log (Real.log u)) +
        2 * L ≤ _
    have hconst : bfpsSharpSaddleFixedErrorConstant ≤
        max bfpsSharpSaddleFixedErrorConstant 0 := le_max_left _ _
    linarith
  have hthreeQuarter : 3 * (u / (4 * L)) ≤ u / L := by
    have huL : 0 < u / L := div_pos hu0 hL
    have heq : 3 * (u / (4 * L)) = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (u / L) := by
      field_simp [hL.ne']
    rw [heq]
    nlinarith
  have hgapLower : u / L ≤ u * (l - 2) / (z - 2) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hL hden).2
    have hnum : 2 ≤ l - 2 := by linarith
    calc
      u * (z - 2) ≤ u * (2 * L) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdenLe hu0.le
      _ = 2 * (u * L) := by ring
      _ ≤ (l - 2) * (u * L) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnum (mul_nonneg hu0.le hL.le)
      _ = u * (l - 2) * L := by ring
  calc
    bfpsSharpSaddleAbsorptionCost u η ≤ 3 * (u / (4 * L)) := hcostUpper
    _ ≤ u / L := hthreeQuarter
    _ ≤ u * (l - 2) / (z - 2) := hgapLower
    _ = u - Real.exp (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u)) /
        (Real.log u + Real.log (Real.log u) - 2) := by
      symm
      simpa only [L, l, z] using sharpSaddle_endpoint_gap_eq hu hden.ne'

statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_trivialLogMass
    {X Y k : ℕ} :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    ∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
          Real.log p * smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y ≤
        ∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
          (X : ℝ) * (Real.log p / p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpData := mem_bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).1
      have hcount : (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤
          (X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        calc
          (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast smoothTotientCount_le_size (X / p) Y
          _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
            simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
              (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := p))
      have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log p :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le)
      calc
        Real.log p * smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y ≤
            Real.log p * ((X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount hlog
        _ = (X : ℝ) * (Real.log p / p) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
          (X : ℝ) * (Real.log p / p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (show bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k ⊆
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k from Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      intro p hp _
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp).1).1
      exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
        (div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le))
          (Nat.cast_nonneg p))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_innerDensity
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_innerDensity
    {X Y k : ℕ} {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hinner : ∀ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * A) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * A * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
        Real.log p * smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
        (X : ℝ) * A * (Real.log p / p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      have hpData := mem_bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp hpData.1).1
      have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
      have hcastDiv : ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
          (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := X) (n := p))
      have hcount : (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤
          ((X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) * A :=
        (hinner p hp).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcastDiv hA)
      have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log p :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le)
      calc
        Real.log p * smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y ≤
            Real.log p * (((X : ℝ) * (p : ℝ)⁻¹) * A) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount hlog
        _ = (X : ℝ) * A * (Real.log p / p) := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          ring
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
        (X : ℝ) * A * (Real.log p / p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (show bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k ⊆
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k from Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      intro p hp _
      have hpPrime := (mem_smoothPredecessorPrimeSet.mp
        (mem_bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShell.mp hp).1).1
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) hA)
        (div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_le))
          (Nat.cast_nonneg p))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_rankinMajorant
statement:

    {X Y k : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :

        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellRankinMajorant X Y k
proof:

      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellReciprocalMass_le_rankinMajorant
        (X := X) (Y := Y) (k := k) hY)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_innerDensity_rankin
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_innerDensity_rankin
    {X Y k : ℕ} {A : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hinner : ∀ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤ ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * A) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * A *
        (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y *
          bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellRankinMajorant X Y k)
proof:
:= by
  exact (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_innerDensity hA hinner).trans <|
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_rankinMajorant hY)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X) hA)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingOuterReciprocalError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingOuterReciprocalError_zero :
    Tendsto movingOuterReciprocalError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (Real.log 2 + 8 * Real.log 4) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) /
        movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hsmall := tendsto_movingSmallCofactorError_zero
    have htwo : Tendsto
        (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
    have hsum := htwo.add hsmall
    have hLnat : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos
    have heq : (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSmallCofactorError x) =ᶠ[atTop]
        (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) /
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hLnat] with x hL
      unfold movingSmallCofactorError
      rw [← add_div]
      congr 1
      rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
        (by nlinarith : 2 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0)]
      congr 1
      ring
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum.congr' heq
  have htwoLog := hlog.const_mul 2
  have hsum := hconst.add htwoLog
  have heq : (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 2 + 8 * Real.log 4) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        2 * (Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) /
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) =ᶠ[atTop] movingOuterReciprocalError := by
    filter_upwards [] with x
    unfold movingOuterReciprocalError
    ring
  simpa only [zero_add, mul_zero] using hsum.congr' heq

name: RankAmplification.eventually_section5_endpoint_log_bound
statement:
theorem eventually_section5_endpoint_log_bound :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      1 + Real.log ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
        4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with x hadmissible
  have hx : 1 ≤ x := by
    exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
        (hadmissible.y_le_Z.trans hadmissible.Z_le_x)
  have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hambPos : 0 < section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    have hZ : 0 < movingNatZ x :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <| hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_Z
    positivity
  have hendPos : 0 < (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt := by
    exact Nat.sqrt_pos.2 hambPos
  have hambLe : (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hambLeNat : section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x) ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 := by
      unfold section5Ambient
      calc
        2 * x * movingNatZ x ≤ 2 * x * x :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * x) hadmissible.Z_le_x
        _ = 2 * x ^ 2 := by ring
    exact_mod_cast hambLeNat
  have hendLe : ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    section5Ambient_sqrt_cast_le_ambient.trans hambLe
  have hlogEnd : Real.log ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have hmodelPos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    exact Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hendPos) hendLe
  have hlogModel : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      Real.log 2 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast (show x ≠ 0 by omega))),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    norm_num
  have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  rw [hlogModel] at hlogEnd
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSection4ReciprocalSum_le
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSection4ReciprocalSum_le :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      section4ReciprocalSum x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        movingExponentialMajorant movingOuterReciprocalError x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility,
    eventually_movingNatZ_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg_K,
    eventually_section5_endpoint_log_bound,
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with
      x hadmissible hzinv hendpoint heta
  have hsec := section4ReciprocalSum_le
    (le_trans (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_Z)
    hadmissible.Z_le_x
  have hxone : 1 ≤ x := by
    exact le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3) <|
      hadmissible.three_le_y.trans
        (hadmissible.y_le_Z.trans hadmissible.Z_le_x)
  have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hxone)
  have hfactorPos : 0 < section4MertensFactor
      (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt := by
    unfold section4MertensFactor
    have hZ : 0 < movingNatZ x :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) <| hadmissible.three_le_y.trans hadmissible.y_le_Z
    have hlogNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log ((section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt : ℝ) := by
      exact Real.log_nonneg (by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt by
          exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt
            (Nat.sqrt_pos.2 (by unfold section5Ambient; positivity)))))
    exact mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by linarith)
  have hfactor : section4MertensFactor
      (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt ≤
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) := by
    unfold section4MertensFactor
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hendpoint (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hfactorSq :
      (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt) ^ 2 ≤
        (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hfactor, hfactorPos.le,
      show 0 ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
        (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) by positivity]
  have hbound : section4ReciprocalSum x (movingNatZ x) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) *
        (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      section4ReciprocalSum x (movingNatZ x) ≤
          (x : ℝ) *
            (section4MertensFactor
              (section5Ambient x (movingNatZ x)).sqrt) ^ 2 *
            (movingNatZ x : ℝ)⁻¹ := hsec
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 *
          (movingNatZ x : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ))) := by
        gcongr
      _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by ring
  calc
    section4ReciprocalSum x (movingNatZ x) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ)) *
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := hbound
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant movingOuterReciprocalError x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant movingOuterReciprocalError
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta.ne']
      rw [show -movingK (x : ℝ) +
          (Real.log 2 + 8 * Real.log 4 +
            2 * Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) =
          -movingK (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 +
            2 * (4 * Real.log 4 +
              Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) by ring,
        Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      have harg : 0 < 4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
        positivity
      have hexp : Real.exp (2 * (4 * Real.log 4 +
          Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))))) =
          (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
            (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          Real.exp (2 * (4 * Real.log 4 +
              Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))))) =
              Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4 +
                Real.log (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 :=
            Real.exp_nat_mul _ 2
          _ = (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
              (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)))) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log harg]
      rw [hexp]
      ring

proof:
:= by

      (fun x ↦ max (movingOuterReciprocalError x) (ρ x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using tendsto_movingOuterReciprocalError_zero.max hρ
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.sum_movingExponentialMajorants_le_outerErrorOfB4
statement:
theorem sum_movingExponentialMajorants_le_outerErrorOfB4
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :
    movingExponentialMajorant movingOuterReciprocalError x +
        movingExponentialMajorant ρ x ≤
      movingExponentialMajorant (movingOuterErrorOfB4 ρ) x
proof:
:= by
  let M := max (movingOuterReciprocalError x) (ρ x)
  have hmono (e : ℝ) (he : e ≤ M) :
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + e * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he heta.le
    linarith
  have hrec : movingExponentialMajorant movingOuterReciprocalError x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold movingExponentialMajorant
    exact hmono (movingOuterReciprocalError x) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hB4 : movingExponentialMajorant ρ x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold movingExponentialMajorant
    exact hmono (ρ x) (le_max_right _ _)
  calc
    movingExponentialMajorant movingOuterReciprocalError x +
        movingExponentialMajorant ρ x ≤
        2 * ((x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) := by
      linarith
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant (movingOuterErrorOfB4 ρ) x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant movingOuterErrorOfB4 M
      rw [show (max (movingOuterReciprocalError x) (ρ x) +
          Real.log 2 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
          max (movingOuterReciprocalError x) (ρ x) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
            Real.log 2 by rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta.ne']]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [show -movingK (x : ℝ) +
            (max (movingOuterReciprocalError x) (ρ x) *
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2) =
            (-movingK (x : ℝ) + max (movingOuterReciprocalError x) (ρ x) *
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) + Real.log 2 by ring,
          Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.movingOuterProviderEstimate_of_B4Estimate
statement:
theorem movingOuterProviderEstimate_of_B4Estimate
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hB4 : MovingB4Estimate ρ) :
    MovingOuterProviderEstimate (movingOuterErrorOfB4 ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingOuterErrorOfB4_zero hB4.1, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSection4ReciprocalSum_le, hB4.2,
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hrec hB4x heta
  rw [movingOuterProviderSum_eq_section4_add_B4]
  exact (add_le_add hrec hB4x).trans <|
    sum_movingExponentialMajorants_le_outerErrorOfB4 (ρ := ρ) (x := x) heta

name: RankAmplification.tauRankinWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem tauRankinWeight_nonneg (j : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ tauRankinWeight j s n
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) _)

name: RankAmplification.tauRankinWeight_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem tauRankinWeight_one (j : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    tauRankinWeight j s 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold tauRankinWeight orderedDivisorCount
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, Real.one_rpow, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast (ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.pow (k := j)).map_one

name: RankAmplification.tauRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem tauRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime {j m n : ℕ}
    (h : Nat.Coprime m n) (s : ℝ) :
    tauRankinWeight j s (m * n) =
      tauRankinWeight j s m * tauRankinWeight j s n
proof:
:= by
  have htau := (ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.pow (k := j)).map_mul_of_coprime h
  simp only [tauRankinWeight, orderedDivisorCount]
  rw [htau, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul,
    Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.orderedDivisorCount_succ_prime_pow
statement:
theorem orderedDivisorCount_succ_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (k a : ℕ) :
    orderedDivisorCount (k + 1) (p ^ a) = (a + k).choose k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing a with
  | zero =>
      simpa using orderedDivisorCount_one (pow_ne_zero a hp.ne_zero)
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [show k + 1 + 1 = (k + 1) + 1 by omega,
        orderedDivisorCount_succ, Nat.sum_divisors_prime_pow hp]
      simp_rw [ih]
      exact Nat.sum_range_add_choose a k

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_tauRankinWeight_prime_pow
statement:
theorem hasSum_tauRankinWeight_prime_pow {p j : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hj : 0 < j) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasSum (fun a : ℕ ↦ tauRankinWeight j s (p ^ a))
      ((1 - rankinEulerRatio p s)⁻¹ ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hj.ne'
  have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
  have hqpos : 0 < rankinEulerRatio p s := rankinEulerRatio_pos hp.pos s
  have hqlt : rankinEulerRatio p s < 1 := rankinEulerRatio_lt_one hp1 hs
  have hqnorm : ‖rankinEulerRatio p s‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hqpos]
    exact hqlt
  have hterm (a : ℕ) : tauRankinWeight (k + 1) s (p ^ a) =
      ((a + k).choose k : ℝ) * rankinEulerRatio p s ^ a := by
    simp only [tauRankinWeight, orderedDivisorCount_succ_prime_pow hp,
      rankinEulerRatio]
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, ← Real.rpow_pow_comm (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (-s) a]
  have hseries := hasSum_choose_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (𝕜 := ℝ) k hqnorm
  have hseries' : HasSum
      (fun a : ℕ ↦ tauRankinWeight (k + 1) s (p ^ a))
      (1 / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p s) ^ (k + 1)) :=
    hseries.congr_fun hterm
  simpa [one_div, inv_pow, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hseries'

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_tauRankinWeight_smooth
statement:
theorem hasSum_tauRankinWeight_smooth (j R : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasSum (fun m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ tauRankinWeight j s m)
      (rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j s)
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime →
      Summable (fun a : ℕ ↦ ‖tauRankinWeight j s (p ^ a)‖) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (hasSum_tauRankinWeight_prime_pow hp hj hs).summable.norm
  have heuler := EulerProduct.summable_and_hasSum_smoothNumbers_prod_primesBelow_tsum
    (f := tauRankinWeight j s) (tauRankinWeight_one j s)
      (fun {_m _n} h ↦ tauRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime h s) hlocal (R + 1)
  have hprod :
      (∏ p ∈ (R + 1).primesBelow,
        ∑' a : ℕ, tauRankinWeight j s (p ^ a)) =
        rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j s := by
    rw [rankinEulerMajorant]
    change (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
      ∑' a : ℕ, tauRankinWeight j s (p ^ a)) =
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, ((1 - rankinEulerRatio p s)⁻¹) ^ j
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    exact (hasSum_tauRankinWeight_prime_pow
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) hj hs).tsum_eq
  exact hprod ▸ heuler.2

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauRankinSum_le_eulerMajorant
statement:
theorem finiteTauRankinSum_le_eulerMajorant
    {j R X : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount j m) R X (-s) ≤
      rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j s
proof:
:= by
  let e : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X} ↪ (R + 1).smoothNumbers :=
    { toFun := fun m ↦
        ⟨m.1, isSmooth_iff_mem_smoothNumbers_succ.mp
          (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp m.2).2.2⟩
      inj' := fun a b hab ↦ Subtype.ext <|
        congrArg (fun z : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ (z : ℕ)) hab }
  let A : Finset ((R + 1).smoothNumbers) := Finset.univ.map e
  have hsmooth := hasSum_tauRankinWeight_smooth j R hj hs
  have hle : (∑ m ∈ A, tauRankinWeight j s m) ≤
      rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j s := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ A, tauRankinWeight j s m) ≤
          ∑' m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers, tauRankinWeight j s m :=
        hsmooth.summable.sum_le_tsum A (fun m _ ↦ tauRankinWeight_nonneg j s m)
      _ = rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j s := hsmooth.tsum_eq
  have hfinite :
      finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount j m) R X (-s) =
        ∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, tauRankinWeight j s m := by
    rw [finiteSmoothRpowSum, ← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
    rfl
  have hmap :
      (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, tauRankinWeight j s m) =
        ∑ m ∈ A, tauRankinWeight j s m := by
    change (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, tauRankinWeight j s m) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.map e, tauRankinWeight j s m
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    rfl
  rw [hfinite, hmap]
  exact hle

name: RankAmplification.tauEulerLoss_nonneg
statement:
theorem tauEulerLoss_nonneg {j : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 ≤ tauEulerLoss j s
proof:
:= by
  unfold tauEulerLoss
  exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (sub_nonneg.mpr
    (Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by norm_num) (by linarith)))

name: RankAmplification.log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_tauEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum
statement:
theorem log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_tauEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum
    {j R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδone : δ < 1) :
    Real.log (rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j (1 - δ)) ≤
      tauEulerLoss j (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := sub_pos.mpr hδone
  have hP : ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, 1 < p := fun p hp ↦
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt
  have hlog := log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_sum (j := j) hP hs
  let q₂ : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ))
  have hq₂pos : 0 < q₂ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hq₂lt : q₂ < 1 :=
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)
  have hlocal (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ Nat.primesLE R) :
      rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) /
          (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ)) ≤
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - q₂) := by
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.two_le_of_mem_primesLE hp
    have hqpos : 0 < rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) :=
      rankinEulerRatio_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (hP p hp)) _
    have hqlt : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) < 1 :=
      rankinEulerRatio_lt_one (hP p hp) hs
    have hqle : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ≤ q₂ := by
      rw [rankinEulerRatio]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hp2 (neg_nonpos.mpr hs.le)
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hqlt) (sub_pos.mpr hq₂lt)).2
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hqle 1) hqpos.le
  calc
    Real.log (rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j (1 - δ)) ≤
        (j : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
          rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) /
            (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ)) := hlog
    _ ≤ (j : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - q₂) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp ↦ hlocal p hp
    _ = tauEulerLoss j (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ := by
      have hexp : -(1 - δ) = -1 + δ := by ring
      dsimp [q₂]
      rw [tauEulerLoss, primeRankinSum]
      simp_rw [rankinEulerRatio, hexp]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.rankinEulerMajorant_pos_general
statement:
theorem rankinEulerMajorant_pos_general {j R : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 < rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j s
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinEulerMajorant]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hqlt := rankinEulerRatio_lt_one
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt hs
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.rankinEulerMajorant_le_exp_tauPrimeRankinSum
statement:
theorem rankinEulerMajorant_le_exp_tauPrimeRankinSum
    {j R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδone : δ < 1) :
    rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp (tauEulerLoss j (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_log (rankinEulerMajorant_pos_general (sub_pos.mpr hδone))]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    (log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_tauEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum hδone)

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    {j R H X : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
        tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H)
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hδhalf : rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hRone (zero_lt_one.trans hu) huSqrt
  have hδone : rankinDelta H R < 1 := hδhalf.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hfinite : finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount j m)
      R X (rankinDelta H R - 1) ≤
        rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j (1 - rankinDelta H R) := by
    simpa only [neg_sub] using finiteTauRankinSum_le_eulerMajorant
      (R := R) (X := X) hj (sub_pos.mpr hδone)
  have hprime := primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU hR hu huSqrt
  have heuler : rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j (1 - rankinDelta H R) ≤
      Real.exp (tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) *
        fullULogUPrimeError R H) := by
    calc
      rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j (1 - rankinDelta H R) ≤
          Real.exp (tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) *
            primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta H R)) :=
        rankinEulerMajorant_le_exp_tauPrimeRankinSum hδone
      _ ≤ Real.exp (tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) *
          fullULogUPrimeError R H) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
          (tauEulerLoss_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr hδone))
  calc
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X ≤
        Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount j m) R X
            (rankinDelta H R - 1) :=
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_chosen_rankin hH hRone hu.le
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) *
        rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) j (1 - rankinDelta H R) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfinite (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) *
        Real.exp (tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) *
          fullULogUPrimeError R H) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heuler (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
        tauEulerLoss j (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add]

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat_cast
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat_cast
    (D a L U : ℕ) :
    (residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat D a L U : ℝ) =
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U
proof:
:= by
  simp [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat,
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum]

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIndex_injective
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIndex_injective {D U : ℕ} :
    Set.InjOn (fun q : ℕ ↦ (q - 1) / D)
      (residuePrimeIntervalSet D 1 0 U)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq r hr hqr
  have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
  have hrData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hr
  have hqD : D ∣ q - 1 :=
    (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hqData.2.2.1.one_le).mp hqData.2.2.2.symm
  have hrD : D ∣ r - 1 :=
    (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hrData.2.2.1.one_le).mp hrData.2.2.2.symm
  have hsub : q - 1 = r - 1 := by
    calc
      q - 1 = ((q - 1) / D) * D := (Nat.div_mul_cancel hqD).symm
      _ = ((r - 1) / D) * D := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun z : ℕ ↦ z * D) hqr
      _ = r - 1 := Nat.div_mul_cancel hrD
  omega

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat_le_harmonic_div
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat_le_harmonic_div
    {D U : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat D 1 0 U ≤
      harmonic U / D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := residuePrimeIntervalSet D 1 0 U
  let index : ℕ → ℕ := fun q ↦ (q - 1) / D
  have hindexInj : Set.InjOn index S := residuePrimeIndex_injective
  have hindexPos (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ S) : 0 < index q := by
    have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
    have hDq : D < q := modulus_lt_prime_of_modEq_one hD
      hqData.2.2.1 hqData.2.2.2
    unfold index
    exact Nat.div_pos (by omega) hD
  have hindexLe (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ S) : index q ≤ U := by
    have hqU := (mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq).2.1
    exact (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans (Nat.sub_le q 1 |>.trans hqU)
  have hpoint (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ S) :
      (q : ℚ)⁻¹ ≤ (D : ℚ)⁻¹ * (index q : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
    have hqData := mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet.mp hq
    have hqD : D ∣ q - 1 :=
      (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hqData.2.2.1.one_le).mp hqData.2.2.2.symm
    have hprodPos : (0 : ℚ) < (index q : ℚ) * D :=
      mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hindexPos q hq) (by exact_mod_cast hD)
    have hprodLe : index q * D ≤ q := by
      rw [show index q * D = q - 1 by
        exact Nat.div_mul_cancel hqD]
      omega
    calc
      (q : ℚ)⁻¹ ≤ ((index q * D : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
        have hprodLe' : (index q : ℚ) * (D : ℚ) ≤ (q : ℚ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hprodLe
        simpa only [one_div, Nat.cast_mul] using
          one_div_le_one_div_of_le hprodPos hprodLe'
      _ = (D : ℚ)⁻¹ * (index q : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
        push_cast
        rw [mul_inv]
        ring
  calc
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat D 1 0 U =
        ∑ q ∈ S, (q : ℚ)⁻¹ := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ S, (D : ℚ)⁻¹ * (index q : ℚ)⁻¹ :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun q hq ↦ hpoint q hq
    _ = ∑ k ∈ S.image index, (D : ℚ)⁻¹ * (k : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image]
      intro q hq r hr heq
      exact hindexInj hq hr heq
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 U, (D : ℚ)⁻¹ * (k : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro k hk
        obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hk
        exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hindexPos q hq, hindexLe q hq⟩
      · intro k hk hnot
        positivity
    _ = harmonic U / D := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hsum : (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 U, (k : ℚ)⁻¹) = harmonic U := by
        rw [harmonic]
        let e : Fin U → ℕ := fun i ↦ i + 1
        have he : Finset.Icc 1 U = Finset.univ.image e := by
          ext k
          simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          constructor
          · intro hk
            exact ⟨⟨k - 1, by omega⟩, by simp [e]; omega⟩
          · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr i.isLt⟩
        rw [he, Finset.sum_image]
        · simpa [e] using (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
            (n := U) (fun k : ℕ ↦ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹))
        · intro i hi j hj hij
          exact Fin.ext (by simpa [e] using hij)
      rw [hsum, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.blockDemandProduct_eq_power_mul_residual
statement:
theorem blockDemandProduct_eq_power_mul_residual
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (B : Finset (Fin J)) (q : ℕ) :
    blockDemandProduct P B =
      q ^ powerMultiplicity P B q * residualDemandProduct P B q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := powerLabels P B q
  have hE : E ⊆ B := fun i hi ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint E (B \ E) := Finset.disjoint_sdiff
  have hunion : E ∪ (B \ E) = B := Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hE
  unfold blockDemandProduct
  calc
    (∏ i ∈ B, P.value i) = ∏ i ∈ E ∪ (B \ E), P.value i := by
      rw [hunion]
    _ = (∏ i ∈ E, P.value i) * (∏ i ∈ B \ E, P.value i) :=
      Finset.prod_union hdisjoint
    _ = q ^ E.card * (∏ i ∈ B \ E, P.value i) := by
      congr 1
      calc
        (∏ i ∈ E, P.value i) = ∏ _i ∈ E, q := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        _ = q ^ E.card := by simp
    _ = q ^ powerMultiplicity P B q * residualDemandProduct P B q := by
      rfl

name: RankAmplification.PowerDescriptor.blockDemandProduct_le_selectedDivisor
statement:
theorem PowerDescriptor.blockDemandProduct_le_selectedDivisor
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y}
    {B : Finset (Fin J)} (d : PowerDescriptor P B) :
    blockDemandProduct P B ≤
      d.natBase ^ (powerMultiplicity P B d.natBase + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hresPos : 0 < residualDemandProduct P B d.natBase :=
    blockDemandProduct_pos P _
  have hpredPos : 0 < d.natBase - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt d.base_prime.one_lt
  have hresLe : residualDemandProduct P B d.natBase ≤ d.natBase :=
    (Nat.le_of_dvd hpredPos d.residual_dvd).trans (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  rw [blockDemandProduct_eq_power_mul_residual]
  calc
    d.natBase ^ powerMultiplicity P B d.natBase *
        residualDemandProduct P B d.natBase ≤
        d.natBase ^ powerMultiplicity P B d.natBase * d.natBase :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hresLe
    _ = d.natBase ^ (powerMultiplicity P B d.natBase + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ]

name: RankAmplification.PowerDescriptor.occurrenceRepresentative_injective
statement:
theorem PowerDescriptor.occurrenceRepresentative_injective
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y}
    {B : Finset (Fin J)} :
    Function.Injective
      (PowerDescriptor.occurrenceRepresentative : PowerDescriptor P B → {i // i ∈ B})
proof:
:= by
  intro d e h
  apply PowerDescriptor.eq_of_base_eq
  have hd := (Finset.mem_filter.mp
    (Finset.min'_mem (powerLabels P B (d.base : ℕ)) d.occurs)).2
  have he := (Finset.mem_filter.mp
    (Finset.min'_mem (powerLabels P B (e.base : ℕ)) e.occurs)).2
  have hlabel := congrArg Subtype.val h
  have hlabel' :
      (powerLabels P B (d.base : ℕ)).min' d.occurs =
        (powerLabels P B (e.base : ℕ)).min' e.occurs := by
    simpa [PowerDescriptor.occurrenceRepresentative] using hlabel
  calc
    d.natBase = P.value ((powerLabels P B (d.base : ℕ)).min' d.occurs) := hd.symm
    _ = P.value ((powerLabels P B (e.base : ℕ)).min' e.occurs) := by rw [hlabel']
    _ = e.natBase := he

name: RankAmplification.powerDescriptor_card_le_block_card
statement:
theorem powerDescriptor_card_le_block_card
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y}
    (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    Fintype.card (PowerDescriptor P B) ≤ B.card
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    PowerDescriptor.occurrenceRepresentative
    PowerDescriptor.occurrenceRepresentative_injective

name: RankAmplification.powerDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_card_div
statement:
theorem powerDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_card_div
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    (∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
        1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      B.card / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hDpos : (0 : ℚ) < blockDemandProduct P B := by
    exact_mod_cast blockDemandProduct_pos P B
  calc
    (∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
        1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
        ∑ _d : PowerDescriptor P B, 1 / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le hDpos
      exact_mod_cast d.blockDemandProduct_le_selectedDivisor
    _ = Fintype.card (PowerDescriptor P B) /
        (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ B.card / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (by exact_mod_cast powerDescriptor_card_le_block_card (P := P) B)
        hDpos.le

name: RankAmplification.LinearDescriptor.toResiduePrime_injective
statement:
theorem LinearDescriptor.toResiduePrime_injective
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x : ℕ}
    {B : Finset (Fin J)} :
    Function.Injective
      (LinearDescriptor.toResiduePrime : LinearDescriptor P x B →
        {q // q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x)})
proof:
:= by
  intro d e h
  apply LinearDescriptor.eq_of_base_eq
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: RankAmplification.linearDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_residue
statement:
theorem linearDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_residue
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    (∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
        1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat
        (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := (LinearDescriptor.toResiduePrime : LinearDescriptor P x B →
    {q // q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x)})
  let image : Finset
      {q // q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x)} :=
    Finset.univ.image f
  calc
    (∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
        1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) =
        ∑ q ∈ image, 1 / (q.1 : ℚ) := by
      change (∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B, 1 / (d.natBase : ℚ)) = _
      rw [show image = Finset.univ.image f by rfl, Finset.sum_image]
      · rfl
      · intro d hd e he hde
        exact LinearDescriptor.toResiduePrime_injective hde
    _ ≤ ∑ q : {q // q ∈ residuePrimeIntervalSet
        (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x)}, 1 / (q.1 : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ image)
      intro q hq hnot
      positivity
    _ = residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat
        (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x) := by
      unfold residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat
      rw [Finset.univ_eq_attach]
      simpa only [one_div] using
        (Finset.sum_attach (residuePrimeIntervalSet
          (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x)) fun q ↦ (q : ℚ)⁻¹)

name: RankAmplification.elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le
statement:
theorem elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    1 ≤ elementarySupplierBlockScale J x
proof:
:= by
  unfold elementarySupplierBlockScale
  have hharm : 0 ≤ harmonic (2 * x) := by
    unfold harmonic
    positivity
  have hJq : (1 : ℚ) ≤ J := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J from hJ)
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.descriptorReciprocalMass_le_elementaryBlock
statement:
theorem descriptorReciprocalMass_le_elementaryBlock
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    {B : Finset (Fin J)} (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    descriptorReciprocalMass P x B ≤
      elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ B.card /
        (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : 0 < J := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hB
    exact (Nat.zero_le i).trans_lt i.isLt
  have hDpos : (0 : ℚ) < blockDemandProduct P B := by
    exact_mod_cast blockDemandProduct_pos P B
  have hlinear := linearDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_residue (x := x) P B
  have hprogression := residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat_le_harmonic_div
    (D := blockDemandProduct P B) (U := 2 * x) (blockDemandProduct_pos P B)
  have hpower := powerDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_card_div (x := x) P B
  have hcard : (B.card : ℚ) ≤ J := by
    have hcardNat : B.card ≤ J := by
      simpa using Finset.card_le_univ B
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  have hscalePow : elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ≤
      elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ B.card := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero
      (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hB)
    rw [hk, pow_succ]
    calc
      elementarySupplierBlockScale J x =
          1 * elementarySupplierBlockScale J x := (one_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ k *
          elementarySupplierBlockScale J x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (one_le_pow₀ (elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le hJ))
          (zero_le_one.trans (elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le hJ))
  have hsplit : descriptorReciprocalMass P x B =
      (∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) +
        ∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    classical
    let L : Finset (SupplierDescriptor P x B) :=
      Finset.univ.image Sum.inl
    let R : Finset (SupplierDescriptor P x B) :=
      Finset.univ.image Sum.inr
    have hcover : L ∪ R = Finset.univ := by
      ext d
      cases d <;> simp [L, R]
    have hdisjoint : Disjoint L R := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro d hdL hdR
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hld⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hdL
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hdR
      exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (hld.trans hrd.symm)
    unfold descriptorReciprocalMass
    change (∑ d ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (SupplierDescriptor P x B)),
      1 / (d.selectedDivisor : ℚ)) = _
    rw [← hcover, Finset.sum_union hdisjoint]
    dsimp only [L, R]
    rw [Finset.sum_image, Finset.sum_image]
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact Sum.inr.inj hab
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact Sum.inl.inj hab
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    (∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) +
        ∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
        harmonic (2 * x) / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) +
          B.card / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) :=
      add_le_add (hlinear.trans hprogression) hpower
    _ ≤ (harmonic (2 * x) + J) / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) := by
      rw [add_div]
      exact add_le_add_right (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcard hDpos.le) _
    _ = elementarySupplierBlockScale J x /
        (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) := rfl
    _ ≤ elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ B.card /
        (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hscalePow hDpos.le

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.prod_blockDemandProduct
statement:
theorem LabelPartition.prod_blockDemandProduct
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (pi : LabelPartition J) :
    (∏ B : pi.Block, blockDemandProduct P B.1) = totalDemandProduct P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpairwise : (pi.blocks : Set (Finset (Fin J))).PairwiseDisjoint id := by
    intro B hB C hC hne
    change Disjoint B C
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro i hiB hiC
    exact hne (pi.eq_of_overlap hB hC hiB hiC)
  have hunion : pi.blocks.biUnion id = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin J)) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hi⟩ := pi.covers i
    exact ⟨B, hB, hi⟩
  calc
    (∏ B : pi.Block, blockDemandProduct P B.1) =
        ∏ B ∈ pi.blocks, blockDemandProduct P B := by
      simpa only [Finset.univ_eq_attach] using
        (Finset.prod_attach pi.blocks (blockDemandProduct P))
    _ = ∏ B ∈ pi.blocks, ∏ i ∈ B, P.value i := by rfl
    _ = ∏ i ∈ pi.blocks.biUnion id, P.value i :=
      (Finset.prod_biUnion hpairwise).symm
    _ = totalDemandProduct P := by
      rw [hunion]
      rfl

name: RankAmplification.elementary_hasPartitionDescriptorMassBound
statement:
theorem elementary_hasPartitionDescriptorMassBound
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x : ℕ) :
    HasPartitionDescriptorMassBound P x (elementarySupplierBlockScale J x)
proof:
:= by
  intro pi
  rw [partitionDescriptorMass]
  calc
    (∏ B : pi.Block, descriptorReciprocalMass P x B.1) ≤
        ∏ B : pi.Block,
          elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ B.1.card /
            (blockDemandProduct P B.1 : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro B hB
        exact descriptorReciprocalMass_nonneg P x B.1
      · intro B hB
        exact descriptorReciprocalMass_le_elementaryBlock P
          (pi.block_nonempty B)
    _ = elementarySupplierBlockScale J x ^ J /
        (totalDemandProduct P : ℚ) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
        pi.sum_block_card]
      congr 1
      exact_mod_cast pi.prod_blockDemandProduct P

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.blockOf_eq_iff_minBlockCode_eq
statement:
theorem LabelPartition.blockOf_eq_iff_minBlockCode_eq
    {J : ℕ} (pi : LabelPartition J) (i j : Fin J) :
    pi.blockOf i = pi.blockOf j ↔ pi.minBlockCode i = pi.minBlockCode j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa [LabelPartition.minBlockCode] using congrArg
      (fun B : pi.Block ↦ B.1.min' (pi.block_nonempty B)) h
  · intro h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply pi.eq_of_overlap (pi.blockOf i).2 (pi.blockOf j).2
    · exact Finset.min'_mem _ (pi.block_nonempty (pi.blockOf i))
    · have hj := Finset.min'_mem (pi.blockOf j).1
          (pi.block_nonempty (pi.blockOf j))
      change pi.minBlockCode j ∈ (pi.blockOf j).1 at hj
      change pi.minBlockCode i ∈ (pi.blockOf j).1
      rwa [h]

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.mem_block_iff_blockOf_eq
statement:
theorem LabelPartition.mem_block_iff_blockOf_eq
    {J : ℕ} (pi : LabelPartition J) (B : pi.Block) (i : Fin J) :
    i ∈ B.1 ↔ pi.blockOf i = B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact pi.block_eq_of_mem i B
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    exact pi.mem_blockOf i

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.minBlockCode_injective
statement:
theorem LabelPartition.minBlockCode_injective {J : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective
      (LabelPartition.minBlockCode : LabelPartition J → Fin J → Fin J)
proof:
:= by
  intro pi rho hcode
  have hblocks : pi.blocks = rho.blocks := by
    ext B
    constructor
    · intro hB
      let PB : pi.Block := ⟨B, hB⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := pi.block_nonempty PB
      have hPi : pi.blockOf i = PB := pi.block_eq_of_mem i PB hi
      have hset : B = (rho.blockOf i).1 := by
        ext j
        rw [pi.mem_block_iff_blockOf_eq PB j, ← hPi,
          pi.blockOf_eq_iff_minBlockCode_eq,
          congrFun hcode j, congrFun hcode i,
          ← rho.blockOf_eq_iff_minBlockCode_eq,
          ← rho.mem_block_iff_blockOf_eq (rho.blockOf i) j]
      rw [hset]
      exact (rho.blockOf i).2
    · intro hB
      let RB : rho.Block := ⟨B, hB⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := rho.block_nonempty RB
      have hRho : rho.blockOf i = RB := rho.block_eq_of_mem i RB hi
      have hset : B = (pi.blockOf i).1 := by
        ext j
        rw [rho.mem_block_iff_blockOf_eq RB j, ← hRho,
          rho.blockOf_eq_iff_minBlockCode_eq,
          ← congrFun hcode j, ← congrFun hcode i,
          ← pi.blockOf_eq_iff_minBlockCode_eq,
          ← pi.mem_block_iff_blockOf_eq (pi.blockOf i) j]
      rw [hset]
      exact (pi.blockOf i).2
  cases pi
  cases rho
  cases hblocks
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.labelledPartitionCount_le_self_pow
statement:
theorem labelledPartitionCount_le_self_pow (J : ℕ) :
    labelledPartitionCount J ≤ J ^ J
proof:
:= by
  unfold labelledPartitionCount
  have hcard : Fintype.card (LabelPartition J) ≤
      Fintype.card (Fin J → Fin J) := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (LabelPartition.minBlockCode (J := J))
      (LabelPartition.minBlockCode_injective (J := J))
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.moving_hasExponentialCutoffScale
statement:
theorem moving_hasExponentialCutoffScale (x : ℕ) :
    HasExponentialCutoffScale (movingNatY x) (movingT (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasExponentialCutoffScale
  rw [← movingY_eq_exp]
  simpa [movingNatY, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
    (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (movingY (x : ℝ))).le

name: RankAmplification.moving_occurrenceCount_le
statement:
theorem moving_occurrenceCount_le
    {x N : ℕ} (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * x))
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x))
    (hT : 0 < movingT (x : ℝ)) :
    (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (2 * x) / movingT (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact occurrenceCount_le_log_two_mul_div_scale P x N
    (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).1 (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).2 hT
      (moving_hasExponentialCutoffScale x)

name: RankAmplification.moving_occurrenceCount_le_slotBound
statement:
theorem moving_occurrenceCount_le_slotBound
    {x N : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ movingNatY x) (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * x))
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x)) :
    admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ≤ movingSupplierSlotBound x
proof:
:= by
  have hpowY := cutoffSucc_pow_admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount_le P x N
    (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).1))
  have hbase : 2 ≤ movingNatY x + 1 := by omega
  have hpowTwo : 2 ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ≤ 2 * x := by
    calc
      2 ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ≤
          (movingNatY x + 1) ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_left hbase _
      _ ≤ N := hpowY
      _ ≤ 2 * x := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).2
  exact (Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num) hpowTwo).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_movingSourceTailCode
statement:
theorem rankinU_movingSourceTailCode {x : ℕ} (hZ : 1 < movingNatZ x) :
    rankinU (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x) = movingSourceRank x
proof:
:= by
  unfold rankinU movingSourceTailCode
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  have hlog : Real.log (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hZ)).ne'
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.movingZ_rpow_movingVsrc
statement:
theorem movingZ_rpow_movingVsrc {t : ℝ} (hK : 0 < movingK t) :
    movingZ t ^ movingVsrc t = movingHsrc t
proof:
:= by
  have hZpos : 0 < movingZ t := by
    rw [movingZ]
    exact Real.exp_pos _
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (x := movingZ t) hZpos, log_movingZ,
    movingVsrc_eq_sourceLog_div, movingHsrc]
  congr 1
  field_simp [hK.ne']

name: RankAmplification.moving_source_factor_identity
statement:
theorem moving_source_factor_identity {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ movingJ t * movingZ t ^ (2 * movingJ t) * movingHsrc t =
      Real.sqrt t
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ^ movingJ t =
      Real.exp ((movingJ t : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ movingJ t =
          Real.exp (Real.log 2) ^ movingJ t := by
        rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      _ = Real.exp ((movingJ t : ℕ) * Real.log 2) :=
        (Real.exp_nat_mul (Real.log 2) (movingJ t)).symm
  have hZ : movingZ t ^ (2 * movingJ t) =
      Real.exp ((2 * movingJ t : ℕ) * movingK t) := by
    rw [movingZ]
    exact (Real.exp_nat_mul (movingK t) (2 * movingJ t)).symm
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt t = Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log t) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos ht]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [htwo, hZ, movingHsrc, hsqrt, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  unfold movingSourceLogThreshold
  rw [scaleL_eq]
  push_cast
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingSourceTailCode_threshold
statement:
theorem movingSourceTailCode_threshold
    {x : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hK : 0 < movingK (x : ℝ))
    (hV : 0 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) :
    (2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) *
        movingSourceTailCode x ≤ x.sqrt
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.floor_le hV
  have hZone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [movingZ]
    exact Real.one_le_exp hK.le
  have hcode : (movingSourceTailCode x : ℝ) ≤ movingHsrc (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (movingSourceTailCode x : ℝ) =
          (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ movingSourceRank x := by
        simp [movingSourceTailCode]
      _ ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ movingSourceRank x :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x) _
      _ = movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
      _ ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hZone hfloor
      _ = movingHsrc (x : ℝ) := movingZ_rpow_movingVsrc hK
  have hreal :
      (((2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) *
        movingSourceTailCode x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
    push_cast
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x *
          (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ^ (2 * movingNatJ x) *
            (movingSourceTailCode x : ℝ) ≤
          (2 : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x *
            movingZ (x : ℝ) ^ (2 * movingNatJ x) *
              movingHsrc (x : ℝ) := by
        gcongr
        exact movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x
      _ = Real.sqrt x := moving_source_factor_identity (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  apply Nat.le_sqrt'.2
  have hleft : 0 ≤ (((2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) *
      movingSourceTailCode x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsquare := mul_self_le_mul_self hleft hreal
  rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast hx.le)] at hsquare
  have hsquareNat :
      ((2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) *
        movingSourceTailCode x) *
        ((2 ^ movingNatJ x * movingNatZ x ^ (2 * movingNatJ x)) *
          movingSourceTailCode x) ≤ x := by
    exact_mod_cast hsquare
  simpa [pow_two] using hsquareNat

name: RankAmplification.tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss
statement:
theorem tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss {j : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    tauEulerLoss j (1 - δ) ≤
      (j : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss
proof:
:= by
  have hdivisor := divisorEulerLoss_le_half hδ
  have hj : 0 ≤ (j : ℝ) / 2 := by positivity
  calc
    tauEulerLoss j (1 - δ) =
        (j : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerLoss (1 - δ) := by
      rw [tauEulerLoss, divisorEulerLoss]
      ring
    _ ≤ (j : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdivisor hj

name: RankAmplification.natFloor_mul_log_loss_le
statement:
theorem natFloor_mul_log_loss_le {v : ℝ} (hv : 3 ≤ v) :
    v * Real.log v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) * Real.log (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ v
proof:
:= by
  have hvpos : 0 < v := by linarith
  have huNat : 2 ≤ ⌊v⌋₊ := by
    apply Nat.le_floor
    exact (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ v by linarith)
  have hupos : (0 : ℝ) < ⌊v⌋₊ := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < ⌊v⌋₊ from lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) huNat)
  have hufloor : (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ v := Nat.floor_le hvpos.le
  have hvlt : v < (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one v
  have hdiff0 : 0 ≤ v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) := sub_nonneg.mpr hufloor
  have hdiff1 : v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hlogv0 : 0 ≤ Real.log v := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hratioPos : 0 < v / (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) := div_pos hvpos hupos
  have hlogRatio :
      Real.log v - Real.log (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤
        v / (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [← Real.log_div hvpos.ne' hupos.ne']
    exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hratioPos
  have hsecond :
      (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) *
          (Real.log v - Real.log (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ)) ≤
        v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) *
          (Real.log v - Real.log (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ)) ≤
          (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) *
            (v / (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) - 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogRatio hupos.le
      _ = v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) := by field_simp
  have hfirst :
      (v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ)) * Real.log v ≤ Real.log v := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdiff1 hlogv0
  have hlogv : Real.log v ≤ v - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hvpos
  calc
    v * Real.log v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) * Real.log (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) =
        (v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ)) * Real.log v +
          (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ) *
            (Real.log v - Real.log (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.log v + (v - (⌊v⌋₊ : ℝ)) := add_le_add hfirst hsecond
    _ ≤ (v - 1) + 1 := add_le_add hlogv hdiff1
    _ = v := by ring

name: RankAmplification.movingSourceRank_log_floor_loss_le
statement:
theorem movingSourceRank_log_floor_loss_le {x : ℕ}
    (hv : 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) :
    movingVsrc (x : ℝ) * Real.log (movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) -
        (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) * Real.log (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤
      movingVsrc (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [movingSourceRank] using
    (natFloor_mul_log_loss_le (v := movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) hv)

name: RankAmplification.movingJMain_mul_sqrtRatio_div_etaR_eq
statement:
theorem movingJMain_mul_sqrtRatio_div_etaR_eq {x : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    (movingJMain x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) / movingEtaR x =
      1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (scaleA x))
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrtA : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleA x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hA
  have hsqrtRatio : 0 < Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)
  have hR : movingR x =
      log2 x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) := by
    exact ((div_eq_iff hsqrtRatio.ne').mp
      (movingR_div_sqrt_div_eq_log2 hL hL2))
  unfold movingJMain movingEtaR movingEta
  rw [hR]
  field_simp [hA.ne', hL2.ne', hsqrtA.ne', hsqrtRatio.ne']
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hA.le]

name: RankAmplification.movingJMain_mul_sqrtRatio_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingJMain_mul_sqrtRatio_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ movingJMain x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) =o[atTop]
      movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hsqrt : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) atTop atTop :=
      Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleA_atTop
    have hden : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 2 * Real.sqrt (scaleA x)) atTop atTop :=
      hsqrt.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
    simp only [one_div]
    change Tendsto
      ((fun r : ℝ ↦ r⁻¹) ∘ (fun x ↦ 2 * Real.sqrt (scaleA x))) atTop (nhds 0)
    exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hden
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun x ↦
      (movingJMain x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) / movingEtaR x)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply hzero.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
    exact (movingJMain_mul_sqrtRatio_div_etaR_eq
      hcore.1 hcore.2.1 hcore.2.2.1).symm
  refine isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ hratio
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hcore
  exact fun hzero ↦
    (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1).ne' hzero |>.elim

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_mul_movingVsrc_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingJ_mul_movingVsrc_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * movingVsrc x) =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * movingVsrc x) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ movingJMain x * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) :=
    movingJ_isEquivalent_main.isBigO.mul
      movingVsrc_isEquivalent_sqrt_ratio.isBigO
  exact hbig.trans_isLittleO movingJMain_mul_sqrtRatio_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingJ_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x) =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x) := by
    apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
    filter_upwards [eventually_two_le_movingJ, eventually_log2_pos] with x hJ hL2
    have hJone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ movingJ x := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ movingJ x by omega)
    have hleft : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x := by positivity
    have hright : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hleft, Real.norm_of_nonneg hright, one_mul]
    nlinarith
  exact hbig.trans_isLittleO movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_cast_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingJ_cast_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ)) =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ)) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 x) := by
    apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
    filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos,
      tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hL2 hL2one
    have hJ : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hJ,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hJ hL2.le), one_mul]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hJ hL2one
  exact hbig.trans_isLittleO movingJ_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingTauRankinBudget_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingTauRankinBudget_div_etaR_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ movingTauRankinBudget x / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hJL2real : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦
      ((movingJ t : ℝ) * log2 t) / movingEtaR t) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    movingJ_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hJreal : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦
      (movingJ t : ℝ) / movingEtaR t) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    movingJ_cast_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hJVreal : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦
      ((movingJ t : ℝ) * movingVsrc t) / movingEtaR t) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    movingJ_mul_movingVsrc_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hnat := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)
  have hJL2 := hJL2real.comp hnat
  have hJ := hJreal.comp hnat
  have hJV := hJVreal.comp hnat
  have hsum : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦
        Real.exp 2 *
            (((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) -
              Real.log (Real.log 2) *
                ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) +
          (3 / Real.log 2) *
            (((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) /
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hfirst := (hJL2.sub
      (hJ.const_mul (Real.log (Real.log 2)))).const_mul (Real.exp 2)
    have hsecond := hJV.const_mul (3 / Real.log 2)
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, movingNatJ, sub_zero, zero_add, mul_zero] using
      hfirst.add hsecond
  have hconstant : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (divisorEulerHalfLoss / 2 * primeCountingConstant) *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) -
              Real.log (Real.log 2) *
                ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) +
          (3 / Real.log 2) *
            (((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) /
              movingEtaR (x : ℝ)))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hsum.const_mul
      (divisorEulerHalfLoss / 2 * primeCountingConstant)
  refine hconstant.congr' ?_
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [heta] with x heta
  unfold movingTauRankinBudget
  field_simp [heta.ne']

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_three_add_movingK_le_scaleL
statement:
theorem eventually_log_three_add_movingK_le_scaleL :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, Real.log 3 + movingK x ≤ scaleL x
proof:
:= by
  have hKsmall := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  have hLlarge := tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 3)
  filter_upwards [hKsmall, hLlarge, eventually_movingK_pos,
    eventually_scaleL_pos] with x hKsmall hLlarge hK hL
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hKsmall
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSourceRank_le_sqrt_natZ
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSourceRank_le_sqrt_natZ :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogQuarter := log_movingVsrc_isLittleO_movingK.bound
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  have hlogQuarterNat :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hlogQuarter
  have hVthree := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_three_le_movingVsrc
  have hKpos := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_movingK_pos
  have hKlarge := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 2))
  filter_upwards [hlogQuarterNat, hVthree, hKpos, hKlarge,
      eventually_movingZ_half_le_natZ] with x hlogQuarter hVthree hK hKlarge hZfloor
  have hlogV0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hlogV0, Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le] at hlogQuarter
  have hfloor : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (by linarith)
  have hVpos : 0 < movingVsrc (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hVsquare : movingVsrc (x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) := by
    calc
      movingVsrc (x : ℝ) ^ 2 =
          Real.exp (2 * Real.log (movingVsrc (x : ℝ))) := by
        calc
          movingVsrc (x : ℝ) ^ 2 =
              Real.exp (Real.log (movingVsrc (x : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.exp_log hVpos]
          _ = Real.exp ((2 : ℕ) * Real.log (movingVsrc (x : ℝ))) :=
            (Real.exp_nat_mul _ 2).symm
          _ = Real.exp (2 * Real.log (movingVsrc (x : ℝ))) := by norm_num
      _ ≤ Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        linarith
  have hhalfTwo : 2 ≤ Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) := by
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 2) := (Real.exp_log (by norm_num)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hhalfLe : Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤
      movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
    have hsq : Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 =
        movingZ (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [movingZ, pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2)]
  have hfloorSq : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hVpos.le).2 hfloor
      _ ≤ Real.exp (movingK (x : ℝ) / 2) := hVsquare
      _ ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) / 2 := hhalfLe
      _ ≤ (movingNatZ x : ℝ) := hZfloor
  exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hfloorSq

name: RankAmplification.full_moving_tauRankin_error_le_budget
statement:
theorem full_moving_tauRankin_error_le_budget {x : ℕ}
    (hZ : 1 < movingNatZ x)
    (hv : 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ))
    (huSqrt : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x))
    (hKL : Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    tauEulerLoss (movingNatJ x)
        (1 - rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x)) *
      fullULogUPrimeError (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x) ≤
        movingTauRankinBudget x
proof:
:= by
  have huEq := rankinU_movingSourceTailCode hZ
  have huNat : 2 ≤ movingSourceRank x := by
    unfold movingSourceRank
    apply Nat.le_floor
    exact (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) by linarith)
  have huReal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingSourceRank x := by exact_mod_cast huNat
  have huPos : (0 : ℝ) < movingSourceRank x := by positivity
  have huV : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (by linarith)
  have hdeltaHalf : rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hZ (by rw [huEq]; positivity)
      (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt)
  have hloss := tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss (j := movingNatJ x) hdeltaHalf
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogu : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) huReal
  have huDiv : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) /
      Real.log (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤
        movingVsrc (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := by
    calc
      (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) / Real.log (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤
          (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left huPos.le hlogTwoPos hlogu
      _ ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right huV hlogTwoPos.le
  have hloglog :
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    have hNatZpos : (0 : ℝ) < movingNatZ x := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hZ)
    have hNatZtwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingNatZ x := by exact_mod_cast hZ
    have hmodelPos : 0 < movingZ (x : ℝ) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hmodelLe : (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) :=
      movingNatZ_cast_le_movingZ x
    have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) :=
      Real.log_pos (by nlinarith)
    have hlogModel : Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ)) ≤
            Real.log (3 * movingZ (x : ℝ)) := by
          apply Real.log_le_log
          · positivity
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmodelLe (by norm_num)
        _ = Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hmodelPos.ne', log_movingZ]
    have hmodelInnerPos : 0 < Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hinnerPos hlogModel
    have hscaleLPos : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hmodelInnerPos hKL
    calc
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (movingNatZ x : ℝ))) ≤
          Real.log (Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hinnerPos hlogModel
      _ ≤ Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hmodelInnerPos hKL
      _ = log2 (x : ℝ) := by rfl
  have hprime : fullULogUPrimeError (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x) ≤
      primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * movingVsrc (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2) := by
    rw [fullULogUPrimeError, huEq]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ primeCountingConstant_pos.le
    apply add_le_add
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sub_le_sub_right hloglog _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · calc
        3 * (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) /
            Real.log (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) =
            3 * ((movingSourceRank x : ℝ) /
              Real.log (movingSourceRank x : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ ≤ 3 * (movingVsrc (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num)
        _ = 3 * movingVsrc (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := by ring
  have hprimeNonneg : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError
      (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x) := by
    exact (primeRankinSum_nonneg (movingNatZ x)
      (rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x))).trans
        (primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU (R := movingNatZ x)
          (X := movingSourceTailCode x) (by omega)
          (by rw [huEq]; linarith) (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt))
  calc
    tauEulerLoss (movingNatJ x)
          (1 - rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x)) *
        fullULogUPrimeError (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x) ≤
        ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
          fullULogUPrimeError (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hloss hprimeNonneg
    _ ≤ ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
        (primeCountingConstant *
          (Real.exp 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
            3 * movingVsrc (x : ℝ) / Real.log 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime
        (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
          divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le)
    _ = movingTauRankinBudget x := by
      unfold movingTauRankinBudget
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent_div_etaR_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent_div_etaR_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hreal := movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hnat := hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hscaled := hnat.const_mul 12
  have hscaled' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      12 * (((movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) /
        movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, movingNatJ, mul_zero] using hscaled
  refine hscaled'.congr' ?_
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.ne'
  filter_upwards [heta] with x heta
  unfold movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent movingNatJ
  field_simp [heta]

name: RankAmplification.movingVsrc_isLittleO_etaR
statement: theorem movingVsrc_isLittleO_etaR : movingVsrc =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:=
  movingVsrc_isEquivalent_sqrt_ratio.isBigO.trans_isLittleO
    sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSupplierSection10Error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSupplierSection10Error_zero :
    Tendsto movingSupplierSection10Error atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomb := tendsto_movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent_div_etaR_zero
  have hVreal := movingVsrc_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hV := hVreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hbudget := tendsto_movingTauRankinBudget_div_etaR_zero
  have hsum := (hcomb.add hV).add hbudget
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingVsrc (x : ℝ) / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          movingTauRankinBudget x / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, zero_add] using hsum
  refine hsum'.congr' ?_
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.ne'
  filter_upwards [heta] with x heta
  unfold movingSupplierSection10Error
  field_simp [heta]

name: RankAmplification.natLogTwo_cast_le_log_div
statement:
theorem natLogTwo_cast_le_log_div {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (Nat.log 2 n : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n / Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hn
  have hpowPos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 n := by positivity
  have hpowReal : (((2 ^ Nat.log 2 n : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpow
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpowPos (by simpa using hpowReal)
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2))).2 hlog

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_cast_isLittleO_scaleL
statement:
theorem movingJ_cast_isLittleO_scaleL :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ)) =o[atTop] scaleL
proof:
:=
  movingJ_cast_isBigO_log2.trans_isLittleO log2_isLittleO_scaleL

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingSupplierScaleBounds
statement:
theorem eventually_movingSupplierScaleBounds :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, MovingSupplierScaleBounds x
proof:
:= by
  have hJsmall := movingJ_cast_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hJsmallNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hJsmall
  have hL2small := log2_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hL2smallNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hL2small
  let C : ℝ := max ((Real.log 2)⁻¹ + 2) (Real.log 2 + 3)
  have hLlarge := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop (max C 1)
  have hL2large := (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [hJsmallNat, hL2smallNat, hLlarge, hL2large,
      eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with x hJsmall hL2small hLlarge hL2large hadm
  change ‖(movingNatJ x : ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖scaleL (x : ℝ)‖ at hJsmall
  change max C 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) at hLlarge
  change 1 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) at hL2large
