  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) ((le_max_right C 1).trans hLlarge)
  have hJ0 : 0 ≤ (movingNatJ x : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hL20 : 0 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := zero_le_one.trans hL2large
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hJ0, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le, one_mul] at hJsmall
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL20, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le, one_mul] at hL2small
  have hx : 0 < x := by
    have : 3 ≤ movingNatY x := hadm.three_le_y
    have := hadm.Z_le_x
    have := hadm.y_le_Z
    omega
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoX : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) = Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'), scaleL]
  have hslotLog := natLogTwo_cast_le_log_div (n := 2 * x) (by positivity)
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hslotLog
  have hCslot : (Real.log 2)⁻¹ + 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_left C 1).trans hLlarge)
  have hslot : (movingSupplierSlotBound x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    unfold movingSupplierSlotBound
    push_cast
    rw [hlogTwoX] at hslotLog
    have hinv : (Real.log 2)⁻¹ * Real.log 2 = 1 := by
      field_simp [hlogTwoPos.ne']
    have hupper : (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
        ((Real.log 2)⁻¹ + 2) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      calc
        (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
            (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 + 1 :=
          by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hslotLog 1
        _ = (Real.log 2)⁻¹ * scaleL (x : ℝ) + 2 := by
          field_simp [hlogTwoPos.ne']
          ring
        _ ≤ ((Real.log 2)⁻¹ + 2) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
          have hLone : 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
            (le_max_right C 1).trans hLlarge
          nlinarith
    calc
      (Nat.log 2 (2 * x) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
          ((Real.log 2)⁻¹ + 2) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := hupper
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCslot hL.le
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hCblock : Real.log 2 + 3 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_left C 1).trans hLlarge)
  have hblock : (elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hharm := harmonic_le_one_add_log (2 * x)
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hharm
    rw [hlogTwoX] at hharm
    unfold elementarySupplierBlockScale
    push_cast
    calc
      ((harmonic (2 * x) : ℚ) : ℝ) + movingNatJ x ≤
          (1 + (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) + scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add hharm hJsmall
      _ ≤ (Real.log 2 + 3) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        have hLone : 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
          (le_max_right C 1).trans hLlarge
        nlinarith
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCblock hL.le
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
  exact ⟨hadm.rank_ge_two, hL, hL2large, hJsmall, hL2small, hslot, hblock⟩

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ n =
        Real.exp (Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ))) ^ n := by
      rw [Real.exp_log hL]
    _ = Real.exp ((n : ℕ) * Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ))) :=
      (Real.exp_nat_mul _ n).symm
    _ = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2
statement:
theorem scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2 {x n : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ n =
      Real.exp (2 * (n : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul, scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 hL]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: RankAmplification.moving_partition_factor_le_exp
statement:
theorem moving_partition_factor_le_exp
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x) :
    (labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hpartNat := labelledPartitionCount_le_self_pow (movingNatJ x)
  have hpart : (labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℝ) ≤
      (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x := by exact_mod_cast hpartNat
  calc
    (labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℝ) ≤
        (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x := hpart
    _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) h.rank_le_scaleL _
    _ = Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos

name: RankAmplification.moving_block_power_factor_le_exp
statement:
theorem moving_block_power_factor_le_exp
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x) :
    ((elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) ≤ elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x := by
    exact_mod_cast (zero_le_one.trans
      (elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h.rank_ge_two)))
  calc
    ((elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ movingNatJ x :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hscale h.block_le_scaleL_sq _
    _ = Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos

name: RankAmplification.three_rank_log2_le_combinatorialExponent
statement:
theorem three_rank_log2_le_combinatorialExponent
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x) :
    3 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) ≤
      movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent
  have hJ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ movingNatJ x := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ movingNatJ x from
      (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2).trans h.rank_ge_two)
  have hL2 : 0 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := zero_le_one.trans h.log2_ge_one
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (movingNatJ x : ℝ)) hL2]

name: RankAmplification.moving_massPrefactor_le_combinatorialExponent
statement:
theorem moving_massPrefactor_le_combinatorialExponent
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x) :
    ((((labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℚ) *
      elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x ^ movingNatJ x : ℚ) : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x)
proof:
:= by
  have hpart := moving_partition_factor_le_exp h
  have hblock := moving_block_power_factor_le_exp h
  have hnonnegPart : 0 ≤ (labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hnonnegBlock : 0 ≤
      (elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x := by
    exact pow_nonneg (by
      exact_mod_cast (zero_le_one.trans
        (elementarySupplierBlockScale_one_le
          (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h.rank_ge_two)))) _
  push_cast
  calc
    (labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℝ) *
        (elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x ≤
        Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul hpart hblock hnonnegBlock (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (3 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (three_rank_log2_le_combinatorialExponent h)

name: RankAmplification.moving_pointwisePrefactor_le_combinatorialExponent
statement:
theorem moving_pointwisePrefactor_le_combinatorialExponent
    {x N : ℕ} (h : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x)
    (hy : 1 ≤ movingNatY x) (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * x))
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x)) :
    ((labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) *
      admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ^ movingNatJ x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x)
proof:
:= by
  have hoccNat := moving_occurrenceCount_le_slotBound hy hN P
  have hocc : (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact (by exact_mod_cast hoccNat :
      (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ≤
        movingSupplierSlotBound x).trans h.slot_le_scaleL_sq
  have hoccPow : (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x ≤
          (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ movingNatJ x :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hocc _
      _ = Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  push_cast
  calc
    (labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℝ) *
        (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x ≤
        Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul (moving_partition_factor_le_exp h) hoccPow (by positivity)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (3 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (three_rank_log2_le_combinatorialExponent h)

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_four_pow_eq_exp_four_rank_log2
statement:
theorem scaleL_four_pow_eq_exp_four_rank_log2 {x n : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ n =
      Real.exp (4 * (n : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul, scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 hL]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: RankAmplification.moving_slotEncodingFactor_le_exp
statement:
theorem moving_slotEncodingFactor_le_exp
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x) :
    (slotEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (8 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let L := scaleL (x : ℝ)
  let j : ℝ := movingNatJ x
  let M : ℝ := movingSupplierSlotBound x
  have hjTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ j := by
    change (2 : ℝ) ≤ (movingNatJ x : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast h.rank_ge_two
  have hjL : j ≤ L := h.rank_le_scaleL
  have hMLsq : M ≤ L ^ 2 := h.slot_le_scaleL_sq
  have hLTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ L := hjTwo.trans hjL
  have hLOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L := (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2).trans hLTwo
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := zero_le_one.trans hLOne
  have hLsq0 : 0 ≤ L ^ 2 := sq_nonneg L
  have hj0 : 0 ≤ j := by positivity
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by positivity
  have hjSucc : j + 1 ≤ L ^ 2 := by
    have hLsq : L + 1 ≤ L ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hL0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hLOne)]
    have hjadd : j + 1 ≤ L + 1 := by
      simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hjL 1
    exact hjadd.trans hLsq
  have hJM : j * M + 1 ≤ L ^ 4 := by
    have hprod : j * M ≤ L * L ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul hjL hMLsq hM0 hL0
    have hcubeOne : 1 ≤ L ^ 3 := one_le_pow₀ hLOne
    have hcube0 : 0 ≤ L ^ 3 := pow_nonneg hL0 _
    calc
      j * M + 1 ≤ L ^ 3 + 1 := by
        rw [show L * L ^ 2 = L ^ 3 by ring] at hprod
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hprod 1
      _ ≤ 2 * L ^ 3 := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ L * L ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLTwo hcube0
      _ = L ^ 4 := by ring
  have htwoPow : (2 : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x ≤
      Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x ≤ L ^ movingNatJ x :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hLTwo _
      _ = Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hjSuccPow : (j + 1) ^ movingNatJ x ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (j + 1) ^ movingNatJ x ≤ (L ^ 2) ^ movingNatJ x :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (add_nonneg hj0 zero_le_one) hjSucc _
      _ = Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hJMPow : (j * M + 1) ^ movingNatJ x ≤
      Real.exp (4 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (j * M + 1) ^ movingNatJ x ≤ (L ^ 4) ^ movingNatJ x :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hj0 hM0) zero_le_one) hJM _
      _ = Real.exp (4 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_four_pow_eq_exp_four_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hfront : j + 1 ≤ Real.exp (2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      j + 1 ≤ L ^ 2 := hjSucc
      _ = Real.exp ((2 : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hproduct : (slotEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x)
      (movingSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp ((2 + 7 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ)) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold slotEncodingFactor
    push_cast
    calc
      (((movingNatJ x : ℝ) + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ movingNatJ x) *
          (((movingNatJ x : ℝ) + 1) ^ movingNatJ x *
            ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * (movingSupplierSlotBound x : ℝ) + 1) ^
              movingNatJ x) ≤
          (Real.exp (2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
            Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))) *
          (Real.exp (2 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
            Real.exp (4 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul
          (mul_le_mul (by simpa [j] using hfront) htwoPow (by positivity)
            (Real.exp_pos _).le)
          (mul_le_mul (by simpa [j] using hjSuccPow) (by simpa [j, M] using hJMPow)
            (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
          (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = Real.exp ((2 + 7 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ)) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
        repeat' rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
  calc
    (slotEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp ((2 + 7 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ)) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := hproduct
    _ ≤ Real.exp (8 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hL2 : 0 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := zero_le_one.trans h.log2_ge_one
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (movingNatJ x : ℝ)) hL2]

name: RankAmplification.moving_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_combinatorialExponent
statement:
theorem moving_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_combinatorialExponent
    {x : ℕ} (h : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x) (hy : 0 < movingNatY x) :
    finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
        (movingSupplierSlotBound x) ≤
      Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x)
proof:
:= by
  have hslot := moving_slotEncodingFactor_le_exp h
  have hyReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ movingNatY x := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hJ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ movingNatJ x := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ movingNatJ x from
      (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2).trans h.rank_ge_two)
  have hL2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := h.log2_ge_one
  have hdiv : (movingNatJ x : ℝ) / movingNatY x ≤
      (movingNatJ x : ℝ) := div_le_self (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hyReal
  unfold finitePowerEncodingFactor
  calc
    (slotEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) / movingNatY x) ≤
        Real.exp (8 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) / movingNatY x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hslot (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (8 * (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) +
        (movingNatJ x : ℝ) / movingNatY x) := by rw [Real.exp_add]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      unfold movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent
      have hJL2 : (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ≤
          (movingNatJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (movingNatJ x : ℝ))
          (zero_le_one.trans hL2)]
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierSection10Error_mul_etaR
statement:
theorem movingSupplierSection10Error_mul_etaR {x : ℕ}
    (heta : movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≠ 0) :
    movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
      movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x + movingVsrc (x : ℝ) +
        movingTauRankinBudget x
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingSupplierSection10Error
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ heta

name: RankAmplification.movingTauRankinBudget_nonneg
statement:
theorem movingTauRankinBudget_nonneg {x : ℕ}
    (hZ : 1 < movingNatZ x)
    (hv : 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ))
    (huSqrt : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x))
    (hKL : Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    0 ≤ movingTauRankinBudget x
proof:
:= by
  have huEq := rankinU_movingSourceTailCode hZ
  have hdeltaHalf : rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hZ (by
      rw [huEq]
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingSourceRank x := by
        unfold movingSourceRank
        exact_mod_cast Nat.le_floor (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) by linarith)
      linarith)
      (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt)
  have hs : 0 < 1 - rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x) := by
    linarith
  have hfull : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError (movingNatZ x)
      (movingSourceTailCode x) := by
    exact (primeRankinSum_nonneg (movingNatZ x)
      (rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x))).trans
        (primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU (R := movingNatZ x)
          (X := movingSourceTailCode x) (by omega)
          (by rw [huEq];
              have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingSourceRank x := by
                unfold movingSourceRank
                exact_mod_cast Nat.le_floor (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) by linarith)
              linarith)
          (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt))
  exact (mul_nonneg (tauEulerLoss_nonneg hs) hfull).trans
    (full_moving_tauRankin_error_le_budget hZ hv huSqrt hKL)

name: RankAmplification.moving_friableProduct_le_endpoint_exp
statement:
theorem moving_friableProduct_le_endpoint_exp
    {x : ℕ} (hscale : MovingSupplierScaleBounds x)
    (hsaddle : HasMovingSaddleMargins (x : ℝ))
    (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
    (hZ : 1 < movingNatZ x)
    (hy : 0 < movingNatY x)
    (hvThree : 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ))
    (huSqrt : (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (movingNatZ x))
    (hKL : Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
        (movingSupplierSlotBound x) *
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
        (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
      Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hj : 0 < movingNatJ x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hscale.rank_ge_two
  have hH : 0 < movingSourceTailCode x := by
    unfold movingSourceTailCode
    exact pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hZ) _
  have huEq := rankinU_movingSourceTailCode hZ
  have hu : 1 < rankinU (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x) := by
    rw [huEq]
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingSourceRank x := by
      unfold movingSourceRank
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_floor
        (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) by linarith)
    linarith
  have htail := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    (X := (2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) hj hH
      (show 2 ≤ movingNatZ x by omega) hu (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt)
  have herror' := full_moving_tauRankin_error_le_budget hZ hvThree huSqrt hKL
  have hfloorLoss := movingSourceRank_log_floor_loss_le hvThree
  have hfactor := moving_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_combinatorialExponent hscale hy
  have hbudget0 := movingTauRankinBudget_nonneg hZ hvThree huSqrt hKL
  have hcomb0 : 0 ≤ movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x := by
    unfold movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg (movingNatJ x : ℝ)))
      (zero_le_one.trans hscale.log2_ge_one)
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have htail0 : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
      (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x)
        ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  calc
    finitePowerEncodingFactor (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x)
          (movingSupplierSlotBound x) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail (movingNatJ x) (movingNatZ x)
          (movingSourceTailCode x) ((2 * x) ^ movingNatJ x) ≤
        Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x) *
          Real.exp (-rankinU (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x) *
              Real.log (rankinU (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x)) +
            tauEulerLoss (movingNatJ x)
              (1 - rankinDelta (movingSourceTailCode x) (movingNatZ x)) *
                fullULogUPrimeError (movingNatZ x) (movingSourceTailCode x)) :=
      mul_le_mul hfactor htail htail0 (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ ≤ Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x +
        (-(movingSourceRank x : ℝ) * Real.log (movingSourceRank x : ℝ) +
          movingTauRankinBudget x)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      rw [huEq]
      linarith
    _ ≤ Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x +
        (-movingVsrc (x : ℝ) * Real.log (movingVsrc (x : ℝ)) +
          movingVsrc (x : ℝ) + movingTauRankinBudget x)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith
    _ ≤ Real.exp (movingSupplierCombinatorialExponent x +
        (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 3 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          movingVsrc (x : ℝ) + movingTauRankinBudget x)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith [hsaddle.1]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        movingSupplierSection10Error x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [movingSupplierSection10Error_mul_etaR heta.ne']
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.primeFactors_card_le_natLogTwo
statement:
theorem primeFactors_card_le_natLogTwo {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.primeFactors.card ≤ Nat.log 2 n
proof:
:= by
  have hpowProd : 2 ^ n.primeFactors.card ≤ ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_const]
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
      (fun p hp ↦ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le)
  have hprod : (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p) ≤ n :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) (Nat.prod_primeFactors_dvd n)
  exact Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num) (hpowProd.trans hprod)

name: RankAmplification.supplierDemandCandidates_card_le
proof:
:= by
  have hpred : q - 1 ≠ 0 := (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq.one_lt).ne'
  have hprimeFactors : (q - 1).primeFactors.card ≤ Nat.log 2 X :=
    (primeFactors_card_le_natLogTwo hpred).trans
      (Nat.log_mono_right (Nat.sub_le q 1 |>.trans hqX))
  cases kind with
  | linear =>
      simpa [supplierDemandCandidates] using hprimeFactors.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  | power =>
      exact (Finset.card_insert_le q (q - 1).primeFactors).trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_right hprimeFactors 1)

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.demand_mem_candidates
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | inl linear =>
      simp only [SupplierDescriptor.sourceType, supplierDemandCandidates,
        SupplierDescriptor.base, Sum.elim_inl]
      rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors]
      exact ⟨P.prime i,
        (demand_dvd_blockDemandProduct P hi).trans linear.demand_dvd,
        (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt linear.base_prime.one_lt).ne'⟩
  | inr power =>
      simp only [SupplierDescriptor.sourceType, supplierDemandCandidates,
        SupplierDescriptor.base, Sum.elim_inr, Finset.mem_insert]
      by_cases heq : P.value i = power.natBase
      · exact Or.inl heq
      · right
        rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors]
        have hnot : i ∉ powerLabels P B power.natBase := by
          simp only [powerLabels, Finset.mem_filter, not_and]
          exact fun _ ↦ heq
        exact ⟨P.prime i,
          (demand_dvd_blockDemandProduct P
            (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hi, hnot⟩)).trans
              power.residual_dvd,
          (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt power.base_prime.one_lt).ne'⟩

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.Block.representative_mem
statement:
theorem LabelPartition.Block.representative_mem {J : ℕ}
    {pi : LabelPartition J} (B : pi.Block) : B.representative ∈ B.1
proof:
:=
  Finset.min'_mem B.1 (pi.block_nonempty B)

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.blockOf_representative
proof:
:=
  pi.block_eq_of_mem B.representative B B.representative_mem

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.Block.representative_injective
statement:
theorem LabelPartition.Block.representative_injective {J : ℕ}
    {pi : LabelPartition J} :
    Function.Injective
      (LabelPartition.Block.representative : pi.Block → Fin J)
proof:
:= by
  intro B C h
  rw [← pi.blockOf_representative B, ← pi.blockOf_representative C, h]

name: RankAmplification.supplierPairSlot_injective
statement:
theorem supplierPairSlot_injective {J M : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun z : Fin J × Fin M ↦ supplierPairSlot z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have hnat : (finProdFinEquiv a : ℕ) = (finProdFinEquiv b : ℕ) :=
    congrArg (fun z : Fin (J * M + 1) ↦ (z : ℕ)) h
  exact finProdFinEquiv.injective (Fin.ext hnat)

name: RankAmplification.supplierCandidateIndex_value_eq
proof:
:= by
  subst kind'
  subst q'
  have hfin : (supplierDemandCandidates kind q).equivFin p =
      (supplierDemandCandidates kind q).equivFin p' := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : Fin M ↦ (z : ℕ)) hindex
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    ((supplierDemandCandidates kind q).equivFin.injective hfin)

name: RankAmplification.supplierSourceTypeBit_injective
statement:
theorem supplierSourceTypeBit_injective {J : ℕ} (i : Fin J) :
    Function.Injective (supplierSourceTypeBit i)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [supplierSourceTypeBit]

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.minBlockCode_representative
proof:
:= by
  unfold LabelPartition.minBlockCode
  change (pi.blockOf B.representative).1.min'
      (pi.block_nonempty (pi.blockOf B.representative)) = B.representative
  rw [pi.blockOf_representative B]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.blockOf_minBlockCode
proof:
:= by
  apply pi.block_eq_of_mem
  exact Finset.min'_mem _ (pi.block_nonempty (pi.blockOf i))

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.minBlockCode_idem
proof:
:= by
  unfold LabelPartition.minBlockCode
  change (pi.blockOf (pi.minBlockCode i)).1.min'
      (pi.block_nonempty (pi.blockOf (pi.minBlockCode i))) =
    (pi.blockOf i).1.min' (pi.block_nonempty (pi.blockOf i))
  rw [pi.blockOf_minBlockCode i]

name: RankAmplification.aggregateLinearTuple_representative
statement:
@[simp] theorem aggregateLinearTuple_representative {J y Y x : ℕ}
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) (B : a.2.partition.Block) :
    aggregateLinearTuple a B.representative =
      (a.2.descriptor B).linearPredecessor
proof:
:= by
  unfold aggregateLinearTuple AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor
  rw [a.2.partition.minBlockCode_representative B, if_pos rfl,
    a.2.partition.blockOf_representative B]

name: RankAmplification.aggregatePowerTuple_representative
statement:
@[simp] theorem aggregatePowerTuple_representative {J y Y x : ℕ}
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) (B : a.2.partition.Block) :
    aggregatePowerTuple a B.representative =
      (a.2.descriptor B).elim (fun _ ↦ none)
        (fun d ↦ d.toPowerSourceChoice)
proof:
:= by
  unfold aggregatePowerTuple AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor
  rw [a.2.partition.minBlockCode_representative B, if_pos rfl,
    a.2.partition.blockOf_representative B]

name: RankAmplification.aggregateCombinatorialCode_partition_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply LabelPartition.minBlockCode_injective
  funext i
  have hslot := congrArg
    (fun c : SlotCombinatorialCode J M ↦ c.2.2 i) hcode
  have hpair : supplierPairSlot (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i)
      (aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM a i) =
      supplierPairSlot (b.2.partition.minBlockCode i)
        (aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM b i) := by
    simpa [aggregateCombinatorialCode, aggregateDemandSlot] using hslot
  have hpairs :
      (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i, aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM a i) =
        (b.2.partition.minBlockCode i, aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM b i) :=
    supplierPairSlot_injective (by simpa using hpair)
  exact congrArg Prod.fst hpairs

name: RankAmplification.aggregateCombinatorialCode_candidateIndex_eq
statement:
theorem aggregateCombinatorialCode_candidateIndex_eq {J y Y x M : ℕ}
    (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M)
    {a b : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x}
    (hcode : aggregateCombinatorialCode hY hM a =
      aggregateCombinatorialCode hY hM b) (i : Fin J) :
    aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM a i =
      aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM b i
proof:
:= by
  have hslot := congrArg
    (fun c : SlotCombinatorialCode J M ↦ c.2.2 i) hcode
  have hpair : supplierPairSlot (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i)
      (aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM a i) =
      supplierPairSlot (b.2.partition.minBlockCode i)
        (aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM b i) := by
    simpa [aggregateCombinatorialCode, aggregateDemandSlot] using hslot
  have hpairs :
      (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i, aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM a i) =
        (b.2.partition.minBlockCode i, aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM b i) :=
    supplierPairSlot_injective (by simpa using hpair)
  exact congrArg Prod.snd hpairs

name: RankAmplification.aggregateCombinatorialCode_sourceType_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply supplierSourceTypeBit_injective i
  exact congrArg (fun c : SlotCombinatorialCode J M ↦ c.2.1 i) hcode

name: RankAmplification.PowerDescriptor.base_eq_of_powerSourceChoice_eq
statement:
theorem PowerDescriptor.base_eq_of_powerSourceChoice_eq
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P Q : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y}
    {B C : Finset (Fin J)} (d : PowerDescriptor P B)
    (e : PowerDescriptor Q C)
    (h : d.toPowerSourceChoice = e.toPowerSourceChoice) :
    d.natBase = e.natBase
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := congrArg
    (fun c : PowerSourceChoice y Y J ↦
      c.map fun z ↦ z.1.1) h
  simpa [PowerDescriptor.toPowerSourceChoice] using hbase

name: RankAmplification.aggregateCandidateIndex_value_injective
statement:
theorem aggregateCandidateIndex_value_injective {J y Y x M : ℕ}
    (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M)
    {a b : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x} {i : Fin J}
    (htype : (a.labelDescriptor i).sourceType =
      (b.labelDescriptor i).sourceType)
    (hbase : (a.labelDescriptor i).base =
      (b.labelDescriptor i).base)
    (hindex : aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM a i =
      aggregateCandidateIndex hY hM b i) :
    a.1.value i = b.1.value i
proof:
:= by
  let da := a.labelDescriptor i
  let db := b.labelDescriptor i
  exact supplierCandidateIndex_value_eq htype hbase hindex

name: RankAmplification.LabelledPrimeDemands.eq_of_value_eq
statement:
theorem LabelledPrimeDemands.eq_of_value_eq {J y Y : ℕ}
    {P Q : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} (h : P.value = Q.value) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | mk pvalue pprime plower pupper =>
      cases Q with
      | mk qvalue qprime qlower qupper =>
          cases h
          rfl

name: RankAmplification.aggregateWeightedCode_injective
statement:
theorem aggregateWeightedCode_injective {J y Y x M : ℕ}
    (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) :
    Function.Injective
      (aggregateWeightedCode hY hM : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x →
        AggregateWeightedCode J y Y M)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hcode
  have hlinear : aggregateLinearTuple a = aggregateLinearTuple b :=
    congrArg Prod.fst hcode
  have hpower : aggregatePowerTuple a = aggregatePowerTuple b :=
    congrArg (fun c : AggregateWeightedCode J y Y M ↦ c.2.1) hcode
  have hcomb : aggregateCombinatorialCode hY hM a =
      aggregateCombinatorialCode hY hM b :=
    congrArg (fun c : AggregateWeightedCode J y Y M ↦ c.2.2) hcode
  have hpartition := aggregateCombinatorialCode_partition_eq hY hM hcomb
  have hbase : ∀ i : Fin J,
      (a.labelDescriptor i).base = (b.labelDescriptor i).base := by
    intro i
    let r := a.2.partition.minBlockCode i
    have hr : r = b.2.partition.minBlockCode i := by
      exact congrFun (congrArg LabelPartition.minBlockCode hpartition) i
    have hidemA : a.2.partition.minBlockCode r = r :=
      a.2.partition.minBlockCode_idem i
    have hidemB : b.2.partition.minBlockCode r = r := by
      rw [hr]
      exact b.2.partition.minBlockCode_idem i
    have hblockB : b.2.partition.blockOf r = b.2.partition.blockOf i := by
      rw [hr]
      exact b.2.partition.blockOf_minBlockCode i
    have htypeR := aggregateCombinatorialCode_sourceType_eq hY hM hcomb r
    have hlinearR := congrFun hlinear r
    have hpowerR := congrFun hpower r
    have hdescBase : (a.labelDescriptor r).base =
        (b.labelDescriptor r).base := by
      cases ha : a.labelDescriptor r with
      | inl da =>
          cases hb : b.labelDescriptor r with
          | inl db =>
              have hpred : da.natBase - 1 = db.natBase - 1 := by
                simpa [aggregateLinearTuple,
                  SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor,
                  hidemA, hidemB, ha, hb] using hlinearR
              have hda := da.base_prime.one_lt
              have hdb := db.base_prime.one_lt
              simpa [SupplierDescriptor.base, ha, hb] using
                (show da.natBase = db.natBase by
                  calc
                    da.natBase = (da.natBase - 1) + 1 :=
                      (Nat.sub_add_cancel hda.le).symm
                    _ = (db.natBase - 1) + 1 := by rw [hpred]
                    _ = db.natBase := Nat.sub_add_cancel hdb.le)
          | inr db =>
              simp [SupplierDescriptor.sourceType, ha, hb] at htypeR
      | inr da =>
          cases hb : b.labelDescriptor r with
          | inl db =>
              simp [SupplierDescriptor.sourceType, ha, hb] at htypeR
          | inr db =>
              have hchoice : da.toPowerSourceChoice = db.toPowerSourceChoice := by
                simpa [aggregatePowerTuple, hidemA, hidemB, ha, hb] using hpowerR
              simpa [SupplierDescriptor.base, ha, hb] using
                da.base_eq_of_powerSourceChoice_eq db hchoice
    unfold AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor at hdescBase ⊢
    rw [a.2.partition.blockOf_minBlockCode i] at hdescBase
    rw [hblockB] at hdescBase
    exact hdescBase
  have hvalue : a.1.value = b.1.value := by
    funext i
    exact aggregateCandidateIndex_value_injective hY hM
      (aggregateCombinatorialCode_sourceType_eq hY hM hcomb i)
      (hbase i)
      (aggregateCombinatorialCode_candidateIndex_eq hY hM hcomb i)
  have hdemands : a.1 = b.1 :=
    LabelledPrimeDemands.eq_of_value_eq hvalue
  cases a with
  | mk P s =>
      cases b with
      | mk Q t =>
          dsimp only at hdemands
          subst Q
          have hs : s = t := by
            cases s with
            | mk pi descriptor bases_injective =>
                cases t with
                | mk rho otherDescriptor otherBases_injective =>
                    dsimp only at hcomb hbase
                    have hpi : pi = rho :=
                      aggregateCombinatorialCode_partition_eq hY hM hcomb
                    subst rho
                    have hdescriptor : descriptor = otherDescriptor := by
                      funext B
                      apply SupplierDescriptor.eq_of_base_eq
                      have hbaseB := hbase B.representative
                      unfold AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor at hbaseB
                      rw [pi.blockOf_representative B] at hbaseB
                      exact hbaseB
                    cases hdescriptor
                    rfl
          cases hs
          rfl

name: RankAmplification.aggregateLinearTuple_prod
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold aggregateLinearTuple SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct
  rw [← Finset.prod_filter]
  symm
  apply Finset.prod_bij
      (fun B (_ : B ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset a.2.partition.Block)) ↦
        B.representative)
  · intro B hB
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact a.2.partition.minBlockCode_representative B
  · intro B hB C hC h
    exact LabelPartition.Block.representative_injective h
  · intro i hi
    have hrep := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    let B := a.2.partition.blockOf i
    refine ⟨B, Finset.mem_univ B, ?_⟩
    exact hrep
  · intro B hB
    unfold AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor
    rw [a.2.partition.blockOf_representative B]

name: RankAmplification.powerSourceChoiceWeight_ite_none
statement:
theorem powerSourceChoiceWeight_ite_none {y Y E : ℕ} (p : Prop)
    [Decidable p] (c : PowerSourceChoice y Y E) :
    powerSourceChoiceWeight (if p then c else none) =
      if p then powerSourceChoiceWeight c else 1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: RankAmplification.aggregatePowerTuple_weight_prod
statement:
theorem aggregatePowerTuple_weight_prod {J y Y x : ℕ}
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) :
    (∏ i, powerSourceChoiceWeight (aggregatePowerTuple a i)) =
      1 / (a.2.powerSelectedProduct : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold aggregatePowerTuple SupplierSystem.powerSelectedProduct
  simp_rw [powerSourceChoiceWeight_ite_none]
  rw [← Finset.prod_filter]
  calc
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun i ↦ a.2.partition.minBlockCode i = i),
        powerSourceChoiceWeight
          ((a.labelDescriptor i).elim (fun _ ↦ none)
            (fun d ↦ d.toPowerSourceChoice))) =
        ∏ B : a.2.partition.Block,
          1 / ((a.2.descriptor B).powerSelectedPart : ℝ) := by
      symm
      apply Finset.prod_bij
          (fun B (_ : B ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset a.2.partition.Block)) ↦
            B.representative)
      · intro B hB
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact a.2.partition.minBlockCode_representative B
      · intro B hB C hC h
        exact LabelPartition.Block.representative_injective h
      · intro i hi
        have hrep := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        let B := a.2.partition.blockOf i
        refine ⟨B, Finset.mem_univ B, ?_⟩
        exact hrep
      · intro B hB
        unfold AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor
        rw [a.2.partition.blockOf_representative B]
        cases d : a.2.descriptor B with
        | inl linear =>
            simp [SupplierDescriptor.powerSelectedPart,
              SupplierDescriptor.powerSelectedExponent,
              powerSourceChoiceWeight]
        | inr power =>
            symm
            simpa [SupplierDescriptor.powerSelectedPart,
              SupplierDescriptor.powerSelectedExponent,
              SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor,
              SupplierDescriptor.base] using
                (PowerDescriptor.powerSourceChoiceWeight_toPowerSourceChoice_eq_selectedDivisor
                  (x := x) power)
    _ = 1 / (∏ B : a.2.partition.Block,
          ((a.2.descriptor B).powerSelectedPart : ℝ)) := by
      simp only [one_div]
      exact Finset.prod_inv_distrib fun B : a.2.partition.Block ↦
        ((a.2.descriptor B).powerSelectedPart : ℝ)
    _ = 1 / (a.2.powerSelectedProduct : ℝ) := by
      change 1 / (∏ B : a.2.partition.Block,
          ((a.2.descriptor B).powerSelectedPart : ℝ)) =
        1 / (((∏ B : a.2.partition.Block,
          (a.2.descriptor B).powerSelectedPart) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      rw [Nat.cast_prod]

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct_le_linearSelectedProduct
statement:
theorem SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct_le_linearSelectedProduct
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x : ℕ}
    (s : SupplierSystem P x) :
    s.linearPredecessorProduct ≤ s.linearSelectedProduct
proof:
:= by
  unfold SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct
    SupplierSystem.linearSelectedProduct
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
  intro B hB
  cases d : s.descriptor B with
  | inl linear =>
    simp [SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor,
        SupplierDescriptor.linearSelectedPart]
  | inr power =>
    simp [SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor,
        SupplierDescriptor.linearSelectedPart]

name: RankAmplification.aggregateEntry_reciprocal_le_codeWeight
statement:
theorem aggregateEntry_reciprocal_le_codeWeight {J y Y x : ℕ}
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) :
    1 / (a.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ) ≤
      1 / (∏ i, aggregateLinearTuple a i : ℕ) *
        ∏ i, powerSourceChoiceWeight (aggregatePowerTuple a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aggregateLinearTuple_prod, aggregatePowerTuple_weight_prod,
    a.2.selectedDivisor_eq_linear_mul_power]
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, one_div]
  have hlinearInv : (a.2.linearSelectedProduct : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      (a.2.linearPredecessorProduct : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [one_div] using
      (one_div_le_one_div_of_le
        (by exact_mod_cast a.2.linearPredecessorProduct_pos :
          (0 : ℝ) < a.2.linearPredecessorProduct)
        (by exact_mod_cast a.2.linearPredecessorProduct_le_linearSelectedProduct :
          (a.2.linearPredecessorProduct : ℝ) ≤ a.2.linearSelectedProduct))
  calc
    ((a.2.linearSelectedProduct : ℝ) *
        (a.2.powerSelectedProduct : ℝ))⁻¹ =
        (a.2.linearSelectedProduct : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          (a.2.powerSelectedProduct : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_inv_rev]
      exact mul_comm _ _
    _ ≤ (a.2.linearPredecessorProduct : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        (a.2.powerSelectedProduct : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlinearInv
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    _ = 1 / (a.2.linearPredecessorProduct : ℝ) *
        (1 / (a.2.powerSelectedProduct : ℝ)) := by
      simp only [one_div]

name: RankAmplification.PositiveProductTuple.split_injective
statement:
theorem PositiveProductTuple.split_injective {J X m : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective
      (PositiveProductTuple.split : PositiveProductTuple (J + 1) X m →
        Σ d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ m.divisors}, PositiveProductTuple J X d.1)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  have hhead : (fun i : Fin J ↦ f.1 i.castSucc) =
      (fun i : Fin J ↦ g.1 i.castSucc) :=
    congrArg (fun z :
      Σ d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ m.divisors}, PositiveProductTuple J X d.1 ↦
        z.2.1) h
  let d : ℕ := ∏ i : Fin J, (f.1 i.castSucc : ℕ)
  have hd : d = ∏ i : Fin J, (g.1 i.castSucc : ℕ) := by
    exact congrArg (fun u : Fin J → Fin (X + 1) ↦
      ∏ i, (u i : ℕ)) hhead
  have hdpos : 0 < d := Finset.prod_pos fun i hi ↦ f.2.1 i.castSucc
  have hlast : f.1 (Fin.last J) = g.1 (Fin.last J) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hdpos
    calc
      d * (f.1 (Fin.last J) : ℕ) = ∏ i, (f.1 i : ℕ) :=
        by
          dsimp [d]
          exact (Fin.prod_univ_castSucc (fun i ↦ (f.1 i : ℕ))).symm
      _ = m := f.2.2
      _ = ∏ i, (g.1 i : ℕ) := g.2.2.symm
      _ = (∏ i : Fin J, (g.1 i.castSucc : ℕ)) *
          (g.1 (Fin.last J) : ℕ) := Fin.prod_univ_castSucc _
      _ = d * (g.1 (Fin.last J) : ℕ) := by rw [hd]
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  refine Fin.lastCases hlast (fun k ↦ ?_) i
  exact congrFun hhead k

name: RankAmplification.positiveProductTuple_card_le_orderedDivisorCount
statement:
theorem positiveProductTuple_card_le_orderedDivisorCount : ∀ J X m,
    Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J X m) ≤ orderedDivisorCount J m
  | 0, X, m => by
      by_cases hm : m = 1
      · subst m
        simp [PositiveProductTuple, orderedDivisorCount_zero]
      · rw [orderedDivisorCount_zero, if_neg hm]
        have hzero : Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple 0 X m) = 0
proof:
:=
          Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mpr
            ⟨fun f ↦ hm (by simpa [PositiveProductTuple] using f.2.2.symm)⟩
        exact hzero.le
  | J + 1, X, m => by
      calc
        Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple (J + 1) X m) ≤
            Fintype.card
              (Σ d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ m.divisors},
                PositiveProductTuple J X d.1) :=
          Fintype.card_le_of_injective PositiveProductTuple.split
            PositiveProductTuple.split_injective
        _ = ∑ d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ m.divisors},
              Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J X d.1) :=
          Fintype.card_sigma
        _ ≤ ∑ d : {d : ℕ // d ∈ m.divisors},
              orderedDivisorCount J d.1 := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro d hd
          exact positiveProductTuple_card_le_orderedDivisorCount J X d.1
        _ = ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, orderedDivisorCount J d := by
          simpa only [Finset.univ_eq_attach] using
            (Finset.sum_attach m.divisors (orderedDivisorCount J))
        _ = orderedDivisorCount (J + 1) m :=
          (orderedDivisorCount_succ J m).symm

name: RankAmplification.aggregateLinearTuple_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem aggregateLinearTuple_le_two_mul {J y Y x : ℕ}
    (_hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hx : 0 < x)
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) (i : Fin J) :
    aggregateLinearTuple a i ≤ 2 * x
proof:

  unfold aggregateLinearTuple
  split_ifs
  · cases d : a.labelDescriptor i with
    | inl linear =>

name: RankAmplification.aggregatePredecessorFibreCode_injective
statement:
theorem aggregatePredecessorFibreCode_injective {J y Y x H M m : ℕ}
    (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) :
    Function.Injective
      (aggregatePredecessorFibreCode hY hx hM :
        AggregatePredecessorFibreEntry J y Y x H m →
          AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply aggregateWeightedCode_injective hY hM
  unfold aggregateWeightedCode
  apply Prod.ext
  · change aggregateLinearTuple a.1 = aggregateLinearTuple b.1
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun
      (congrArg (fun c : AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m ↦ c.1.1) h) i
    exact congrArg Fin.val hi
  · change (aggregatePowerTuple a.1, aggregateCombinatorialCode hY hM a.1) =
      (aggregatePowerTuple b.1, aggregateCombinatorialCode hY hM b.1)
    exact congrArg Prod.snd h

name: RankAmplification.aggregateFibreCodeWeight_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold aggregateFibreCodeWeight
  apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
  apply Finset.prod_nonneg
  intro i hi
  cases c.2.1 i with
  | none => norm_num [powerSourceChoiceWeight]
  | some choice =>
      exact pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg choice.1.1)) _

name: RankAmplification.aggregateFibreCodeWeight_sum
statement:
theorem aggregateFibreCodeWeight_sum {J y Y x M m : ℕ} :
    (∑ c : AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m,
      aggregateFibreCodeWeight c) =
      (Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J (2 * x) m) : ℝ) *
        Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M) *
          (1 / (m : ℝ) * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold aggregateFibreCodeWeight powerSourceTupleMass
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  push_cast
  have hsum :
      (∑ choices : Fin J → PowerSourceChoice y Y J,
        ((J : ℝ) * M + 1) ^ J *
          (1 / (m : ℝ) * ∏ i, powerSourceChoiceWeight (choices i))) =
        ((J : ℝ) * M + 1) ^ J * (1 / (m : ℝ)) *
          ∑ choices : Fin J → PowerSourceChoice y Y J,
            ∏ i, powerSourceChoiceWeight (choices i) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro choices hchoices
    ring
  rw [hsum]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass_le_weightedPower
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass_le_weightedPower
    {J y Y x H M m : ℕ} (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) (hm : 0 < m) :
    aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m ≤
      slotEncodingFactor J M * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J *
        ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := AggregatePredecessorFibreEntry J y Y x H m
  let encode : F → AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m :=
    aggregatePredecessorFibreCode hY hx hM
  have hencode : Function.Injective encode :=
    aggregatePredecessorFibreCode_injective hY hx hM
  have hmass : aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m =
      ∑ a : F, 1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ) := by
    unfold aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass F
    symm
    simpa only [Finset.univ_eq_attach] using
      (Finset.sum_attach
        ((aggregateSupplierTailEntries J y Y x H).filter
          (fun a ↦ a.2.linearPredecessorProduct = m))
        (fun a ↦ 1 / (a.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ)))
  have hentry : ∀ a : F,
      1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ) ≤
        aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) := by
    intro a
    calc
      1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ) ≤
          1 / (∏ i, aggregateLinearTuple a.1 i : ℕ) *
            ∏ i, powerSourceChoiceWeight (aggregatePowerTuple a.1 i) :=
        aggregateEntry_reciprocal_le_codeWeight a.1
      _ = aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) := by
        unfold aggregateFibreCodeWeight encode
        rw [aggregateLinearTuple_prod, (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).2]
        rfl
  have himage :
      (∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset F).image encode,
          aggregateFibreCodeWeight c) =
        ∑ a : F, aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact hencode hab
  have hcodeSum :
      (∑ a : F, aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a)) ≤
        ∑ c : AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m,
          aggregateFibreCodeWeight c := by
    rw [← himage]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun c hc hnot ↦ aggregateFibreCodeWeight_nonneg c)
  rw [hmass]
  calc
    (∑ a : F, 1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ a : F, aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun a ha ↦ hentry a
    _ ≤ ∑ c : AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m,
        aggregateFibreCodeWeight c := hcodeSum
    _ = (Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J (2 * x) m) : ℝ) *
        Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M) *
          (1 / (m : ℝ) * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J) :=
      aggregateFibreCodeWeight_sum
    _ ≤ (orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) *
        Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M) *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        · exact_mod_cast positiveProductTuple_card_le_orderedDivisorCount J (2 * x) m
        · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
      · exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg J y Y J)
    _ ≤ (orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) * slotEncodingFactor J M *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        · exact_mod_cast slotCombinatorialCode_card_le J M
        · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
      · exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg J y Y J)
    _ = slotEncodingFactor J M * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J *
        ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m) := by
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.hasWeightedPowerFibreBound_of_logSlot
statement:
theorem hasWeightedPowerFibreBound_of_logSlot {J y Y x H Hcode M : ℕ}
    (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hx : 0 < x)

name: RankAmplification.exp_combinatorial_le_endpoint_exp
statement:
theorem exp_combinatorial_le_endpoint_exp {x : ℕ}
    (heta : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
    (hV : 0 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ))
    (hbudget : 0 ≤ movingTauRankinBudget x) :

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierSection10Endpoint_of_weightedReconstruction
statement:
theorem movingSupplierSection10Endpoint_of_weightedReconstruction
    (hreconstruction : MovingSupplierWeightedReconstruction) :
    MovingSupplierSection10Endpoint movingSupplierSection10Error
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingSupplierSection10Error_zero, ?_⟩
  have hVthree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 3 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_three_le_movingVsrc
  have hKpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingK (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_movingK_pos
  have hKL : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 3 + movingK (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
      eventually_log_three_add_movingK_le_scaleL
  have heta : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingSupplierScaleBounds,
      eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility, eventually_two_le_movingNatZ,
      eventually_movingSourceRank_le_sqrt_natZ, hVthree, hKpos, hKL, heta,
      hreconstruction] with x hscale hadm hZ huSqrt hVthree hK hKL heta hreconstruction
  intro hsaddle
  have hx : 0 < x := by
    have := hadm.Z_le_x
    omega
  have hy : 0 < movingNatY x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hadm.three_le_y
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ movingVsrc (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hbudget := movingTauRankinBudget_nonneg
    (show 1 < movingNatZ x by omega) hVthree huSqrt hKL
  have hcommon := exp_combinatorial_le_endpoint_exp heta hV0 hbudget
  refine ⟨⟨
    elementarySupplierBlockScale (movingNatJ x) x,
    fun P ↦ elementary_hasPartitionDescriptorMassBound P x,
    (moving_massPrefactor_le_combinatorialExponent hscale).trans hcommon,
    ?_,
    movingSourceTailCode x,
    movingNatJ x,
    movingSupplierSlotBound x,
    hy,
    hx,
    movingSourceTailCode_threshold hx hK hV0,
    hreconstruction,
    moving_friableProduct_le_endpoint_exp hscale hsaddle heta
      (show 1 < movingNatZ x by omega) hy hVthree huSqrt hKL
  ⟩⟩
  intro P N hN
  exact (moving_pointwisePrefactor_le_combinatorialExponent
    hscale (show 1 ≤ movingNatY x by omega) hN P).trans hcommon
