    movingSupplierWeightedReconstruction

name: RankAmplification.hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBound_of_upTo
proof:
:= by
  intro W hWpos hWhigh hgap
  exact h W hWpos (by omega) hgap

name: RankAmplification.hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo_apply_of_ge
statement:
theorem hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo_apply_of_ge {X y W : ℕ} {b B : ℝ}
    (h : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo X y b B) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hXW : X ≤ W) (hW : W ≤ 2 * X) (hXpos : 0 < X) :
    (smoothTotientCount W y : ℝ) ≤ (W : ℝ) * B
proof:
:= by
  have hWpos : 0 < W := lt_of_lt_of_le hXpos hXW
  refine h W hWpos hW ?_
  have hXreal : (0 : ℝ) < X := by exact_mod_cast hXpos
  have hcast : (X : ℝ) ≤ W := by exact_mod_cast hXW
  have hlog : scaleL (X : ℝ) ≤ Real.log W := by
    simpa only [scaleL_eq] using Real.log_le_log hXreal hcast
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound_of_gapUpTo
statement:
theorem hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound_of_gapUpTo
    {x X y H : ℕ} {b B : ℝ} (hHpos : 0 < H) (hHx : 2 * H ≤ x)
    (hxX : x ≤ X) (hX : X ≤ 2 * x)
    (hb : Real.log 2 + Real.log H ≤ b)
    (hgap : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo x y b B) :
    HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y H B
proof:
:= by
  have hxpos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hquotTwo : 2 ≤ X / H := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hHpos).2 (by omega)
  intro W hWlow hWhigh
  have hWpos : 0 < W := by omega
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by omega
  have hXlt : X < (X / H + 1) * H := by
    calc
      X = H * (X / H) + X % H := (Nat.div_add_mod X H).symm
      _ < H * (X / H) + H := Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mod_lt X hHpos) _
      _ = (X / H + 1) * H := by ring
  have hcoef : X / H + 1 ≤ 2 * (X / H) := by omega
  have hXle : X ≤ 2 * W * H := by
    have hfirst : (X / H + 1) * H ≤ (2 * (X / H)) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H hcoef
    have hsecond : (2 * (X / H)) * H ≤ (2 * W) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hWlow)
    omega
  have hxle : x ≤ 2 * W * H := le_trans hxX hXle
  have hxreal : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast hxpos
  have hWreal : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hWpos
  have hHreal : (0 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast hHpos
  have hxcast : (x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hxle
  have hlogAmbient : scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [scaleL_eq] using Real.log_le_log hxreal hxcast
  have hgapBound : scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log H := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne')
      hHreal.ne', Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne']
      at hlogAmbient
    linarith
  exact hgap W hWpos (by omega) (hgapBound.trans hb)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_upTo
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_upTo
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo x y
        (fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x)
        (Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant
  have hC : 0 ≤ C :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget hc₀ hC₀ hC,
      eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hrange hdelta hpred hsmooth hL hA hV
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  intro W hWpos _hWhigh hgapBound
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent_growingCutoff
    (X := W) (Y := y) (c := 1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)
      hWpos hrangeData.1 (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hslack := variableCutoff_slack_mul_scaleL_div_T_le hc₀ hL hA hwindow
  have hcancel := variableCutoffDelta_mul_scaleL hL.le hA.le
    (show T ≠ 0 by
      exact ((mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1).ne')
  have hpredBound := hpred y T W hcutoff hwindow
  have hEuler : smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpredBound
      (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  have hgapMul : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) ≤
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgapBound hdeltaData.1.le
  have hvariableIdentity :
      variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        (variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x := by
    unfold variableCutoffSmoothError
    dsimp only [C]
    field_simp [hV.ne']
  have hbase : fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
        (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
        variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedBFPSAbelExponent
    calc
      -(1 - (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)) * Real.log W +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C =
        -(variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * scaleL (x : ℝ)) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) := by ring
      _ = -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) / T +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) := by
        rw [hcancel]
        ring
      _ ≤ -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          ((variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
              fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x) +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
        linarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← hvariableIdentity]
  have hdeltaWindow := variableCutoffDelta_le_window_bound hc₀ hA.le hG hwindow
  have hdeltaV : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤
      1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤
          scaleA (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := hdeltaWindow
      _ = 1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
        have hAV := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
        field_simp [hc₀.ne', hA.ne', hG.ne', hV.ne']
        nlinarith
  have hbudget0 : 0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
      fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
    positivity
  have hdeltaBudget : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x ≤
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
        (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeltaV hbudget0
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x ≤
        (1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := this
      _ = fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
          (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by ring
  have hsmoothData := hsmooth T hwindow
  have herrorIdentity :
      (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2)) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    field_simp [hc₀.ne', hV.ne']
  have hexponent : fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
        (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
        fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError
    rw [herrorIdentity]
    calc
      fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
        -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := hbase
      _ ≤ -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
        nlinarith [hdeltaBudget]
      _ ≤ -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
              (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
        have hsmoothNeg : -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤
            -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
              fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
          calc
            -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T =
                -(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
                    fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                      scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
                  fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                    scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
            _ ≤ -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
                  fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                    scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
              add_le_add_left (neg_le_neg hsmoothData) _
        calc
          -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
              variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
              fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) =
            -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
              (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
                fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                  (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by ring
          _ ≤ (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
                fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
              (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
                fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                  (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) :=
            by nlinarith [hsmoothNeg]
          _ = _ := by ring
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent) (Nat.cast_nonneg W)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG_upTo
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG_upTo
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo x y
        (fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x)
        (Real.exp (-(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_upTo J hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le hc₀ hC₀]
      with x hgap hcompare
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow W hWpos hWle hWgap
  refine (hgap y T hcutoff hwindow W hWpos hWle hWgap).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (Nat.cast_nonneg W)
  have hlower := (abs_le.mp (hcompare T hwindow)).1
  have hexpand : fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
      fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError
    ring
  rw [hexpand]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.exists_tendsto_zero_eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG_upTo
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_zero_eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG_upTo
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
        IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
        HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo x y
          (fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x)
          (Real.exp (-(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) + ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀,
    tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError_zero J hc₀ hC₀,
    eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG_upTo J hc₀ hC₀⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget_nonneg
    (J : ℕ) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (x : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_natCast_nonneg x
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    div_nonneg hL (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hJ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg J
  have hterm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1) *
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hJ0 (by linarith)) hq
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
    fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
  have hJlog : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := mul_nonneg hJ0 hlog2
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_sub_log_le_of_rpow_le
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < x ^ (1 - δ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx _
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpow hW
  rw [Real.log_rpow hx] at hlog
  simp only [scaleL_eq]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.paperGap_le_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
statement:
theorem paperGap_le_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (x : ℕ) :
    (Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))⁻¹ * scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_natCast_nonneg x
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    div_nonneg hL hs
  have hJr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1) := by nlinarith
  have hmul : scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (J : ℝ) * (C₀ + 1) * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
    nlinarith
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hJlog : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by positivity
  have hinv : (Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))⁻¹ * scaleL (x : ℝ) =
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := inv_mul_eq_div _ _
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
    fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
  rw [hinv]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_paperUniformSmoothCensus_full_window
statement:
theorem eventually_paperUniformSmoothCensus_full_window
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (y : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (W : ℕ),
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      (x : ℝ) ^ (1 - (Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))⁻¹) ≤ (W : ℝ) →
      W ≤ 2 * x →
      (smoothTotientCount W y : ℝ) ≤
        (W : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG_upTo
      J hc₀ hC₀, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hgap hx
  intro y T W hcutoff hwindow hlow hhigh
  have hxr : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ) ^ (1 - (Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))⁻¹) :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hxr _
  have hWr : (0 : ℝ) < W := lt_of_lt_of_le hpow hlow
  have hWpos : 0 < W := by exact_mod_cast hWr
  refine hgap y T hcutoff hwindow W hWpos hhigh ?_
  exact (scaleL_sub_log_le_of_rpow_le hxr hlow).trans
    (paperGap_le_fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J hJ hC₀ x)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_smoothTotientCount_upperHalf
statement:
theorem eventually_smoothTotientCount_upperHalf
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (y : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (W : ℕ),
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      x ≤ W → W ≤ 2 * x →
      (smoothTotientCount W y : ℝ) ≤
        (W : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowGapScaleGError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_scaleG_upTo
      J hc₀ hC₀, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hgap hx
  intro y T W hcutoff hwindow hlow hhigh
  exact hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBoundUpTo_apply_of_ge
    (hgap y T hcutoff hwindow)
    (fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget_nonneg J hC₀ x) hlow hhigh hx

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTail_le_smoothRate_ambient
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTail_le_smoothRate_ambient
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (y : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (X : ℕ),
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
          (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) X ≤
        Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T)
proof:
:= by
  let C := fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant
  have hphase :=
    (tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_natCast_div_scaleG_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop
      (C + 1 / c₀ + 2)
  have herrorOne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x ≤ 1 :=
    (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀ hC₀).eventually
      (Iic_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hVleGReal := scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hVleG := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hVleGReal
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ 2,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailRank_le_sqrt J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError_le_budget J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget_le_G J hJ,
      eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error hc₀ hC₀,
      hphase, herrorOne, hVleG,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with
      x hrange huTwo huSqrt hEuler hbudget hsmooth hphase herrorOne hVleG hcore
  intro y T X hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  let R := y ^ J
  let H := fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J R x
  let u : ℝ := fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ)
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hV.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, one_mul] at hVleG
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hRtwo : 2 ≤ R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    exact (show 2 ≤ y by omega).trans (one_le_pow_rank hJ (by omega))
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have huEq : rankinU H R = u := by
    simpa [H, R, u] using rankinU_fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode
      (show 1 < y ^ J by omega)
  have hu : 1 < rankinU H R := by
    rw [huEq]
    change (1 : ℝ) < (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) by omega)
  have huSqrt' : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [huEq]
    simpa [u, R] using huSqrt y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hfull := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    (j := 1) (R := R) (H := H) (X := X) (by norm_num) hH hRtwo hu huSqrt'
  have htail : finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-u * Real.log u + fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x) := by
    rw [finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_tau_one]
    calc
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail 1 R H X ≤
          Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
            fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError J R x) := by
        simpa [fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerError, H, R] using hfull
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-u * Real.log u +
          fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [huEq]
        linarith [hEuler y T hcutoff hwindow]
  have hcompNonneg : 0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError
    positivity
  have herrorTerm : fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
      scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
          1 * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right herrorOne hV.le
      _ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by simpa using hVleG
  have hGpart : scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
    calc
      scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤
          scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1
      _ = scaleG (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne']
  have hsmoothBound : fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T ≤
      (1 / c₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    have hs := hsmooth T hwindow
    calc
      fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := hs
      _ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) / c₀ + scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add hGpart herrorTerm
      _ = (1 / c₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring
  have hphaseMul : (C + 1 / c₀ + 2) * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
      u * Real.log u := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hG).mp (by simpa [u] using hphase)
  have hEulerG : fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x ≤
      C * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by simpa [C] using hbudget
  have hexponent : -u * Real.log u + fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerBudget J x ≤
      -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T := by
    nlinarith [fixedRankGeneralLowTailEulerConstant_pos.le]
  exact htail.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent)

name: RankAmplification.fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_le_add
statement:
theorem fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_le_add
    {x : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) ≤
      fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + Real.log 4 * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_le hx
  have hexpand : Real.log 4 *
      (Real.log 2 + log2 (x : ℝ) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) =
        fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + Real.log 4 * Real.log 2 := by
    unfold fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound
    rw [log2_eq]
    ring
  linarith [hexpand ▸ hbound]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 4 * Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hsum := (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowError_zero J hc₀ hC₀).add hconst
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError
  simpa only [add_zero] using hsum

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowCensus_upTo_unconditional
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowCensus_upTo_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (y : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (X : ℕ),
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      x ≤ X → X ≤ 2 * x →
      (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount X y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange_upTo J hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_two_mul_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_log_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le_budget J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_split_parameters J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowTail_le_smoothRate_ambient J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hgap htwo hlogH hparams htail hV
  intro y T X hcutoff hwindow hxX hX2
  obtain ⟨hx, hy, hK, hYK, hKJ⟩ := hparams y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hXtwo : 2 ≤ X := le_trans hx hxX
  have hHpos : 0 < fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff
    positivity
  have hbudget : Real.log 2 +
      Real.log (fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    have hlogH' := hlogH y T hcutoff hwindow
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
    linarith
  set ρ := fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x with hρdef
  set B : ℝ := Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T + ρ * scaleV (x : ℝ))
    with hBdef
  have hrangeBound : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y
      (fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x) B :=
    hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound_of_gapUpTo hHpos
      (htwo y T hcutoff hwindow) hxX hX2 hbudget
      (by simpa only [hBdef, hρdef] using hgap y T hcutoff hwindow)
  have hfinite := boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount_cast_le_finiteCompression
    (X := X) (y := y) (Y := y ^ J) (J := J)
    (H := fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x)
    (K := fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff J (y ^ J) x) (B := B)
    hXtwo hy hK hYK hKJ (Real.exp_pos _).le hrangeBound
  rw [fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff_sub_one] at hfinite
  have hρmax : ρ ≤ max ρ 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hmaxNonneg : 0 ≤ max ρ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  set A : ℝ := -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T + max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)
    with hAdef
  have hB : B ≤ Real.exp A := by
    rw [hBdef, hAdef]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hρmax hV.le))
  have htail' : finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
      (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) X ≤ Real.exp A := by
    refine (htail y T X hcutoff hwindow).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    have hnn : 0 ≤ max ρ 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hmaxNonneg hV.le
    rw [hAdef]
    linarith
  have hsum : B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
      (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) X ≤ 2 * Real.exp A := by
    linarith
  have hyInv : (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
    (inv_le_one₀ (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < y by omega))).2
      (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ y by omega))
  set M : ℝ := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + Real.log 4 * Real.log 2 + 1
    with hMdef
  have hcheb : fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ M := by
    have hmono : fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X ≤
        fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound (2 * x) :=
      fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_mono hXtwo hX2
    have hshift := fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound_two_mul_le_add hx
    rw [hMdef]
    linarith
  have hcombined : (X : ℝ) *
      (B + finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (y ^ J)
        (fixedRankGeneralLowTailCode J (y ^ J) x) X) *
      Real.exp (fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound X + (y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp M := by
    refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (Nat.cast_nonneg X))
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hcheb) (Real.exp_pos _).le ?_
    exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
      (by positivity)
  have hmain := hfinite.trans hcombined
  have hoverhead :
      (Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1) /
          scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        Real.log 2 + fixedLinearMassChebyshevBound x + 1 :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
  have hshift :
      Real.log 4 * Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        Real.log 4 * Real.log 2 :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
  refine hmain.trans_eq ?_
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError fixedRankGeneralLowError
  rw [add_mul, add_mul, hoverhead, hshift]
  calc
    (X : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp A) * Real.exp M =
        (X : ℝ) * (Real.exp (Real.log 2) * Real.exp A) * Real.exp M := by
      rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (Real.log 2 + A) * Real.exp M := by
      rw [Real.exp_add (Real.log 2) A]
    _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp ((Real.log 2 + A) + M) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add (Real.log 2 + A) M]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hAdef, hMdef]
      congr 2
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankLowRankCompressionHypothesis_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankLowRankCompressionHypothesis_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    FixedRankLowRankCompressionHypothesis J c₀ C₀
      (fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError J c₀ C₀)
proof:
:=
  ⟨tendsto_fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError_zero J hc₀ hC₀,
    eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowCensus_upTo_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_ambientCensusMajorant
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_ambientCensusMajorant
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (h y : ℕ) (T : ℝ),
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralLowAmbientError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLowCensus_upTo_unconditional
    J hJ hc₀ hC₀] with x hcensus
  intro h y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hcount : (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
      (boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount x y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_boundedTotientLowRankCensusCount
      x h y (y ^ J) J
  exact hcount.trans
    (hcensus y T x hcutoff hwindow le_rfl (by omega))

name: RankAmplification.mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet {x h y Y J n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧
        largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ Y ∧ largePrimeRank y n.totient < J
proof:
:= by
  simp [fixedLowRankShiftedSet]

name: RankAmplification.mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet {x h y Y J n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧
        largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ Y ∧ J ≤ largePrimeRank y n.totient
proof:
:= by
  simp [fixedHighRankShiftedSet]

name: RankAmplification.mem_fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet {x h Y n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y ↔
      n ∈ shiftedEqualTotientSet x h ∧
        largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ Y
proof:
:= by
  simp [fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet]

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankShiftedSet_subset_belowRank
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankShiftedSet_subset_belowRank
    (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ⊆ belowRankShiftedSet x h y J
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  exact mem_belowRankShiftedSet.mpr
    ⟨(mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn).1,
      (mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn).2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedHighRankShiftedSet_subset_atLeastRank
statement:
theorem fixedHighRankShiftedSet_subset_atLeastRank
    (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ⊆ atLeastRankShiftedSet x h y J
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  exact mem_atLeastRankShiftedSet.mpr
    ⟨(mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet.mp hn).1,
      (mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet.mp hn).2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_belowRankCard
statement:
theorem fixedLowRankShiftedCount_le_belowRankCard (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y Y J ≤
      (belowRankShiftedSet x h y J).card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (fixedLowRankShiftedSet_subset_belowRank x h y Y J)

name: RankAmplification.fixedHighRankShiftedCount_le_atLeastRankCount
statement:
theorem fixedHighRankShiftedCount_le_atLeastRankCount (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J ≤
      atLeastRankShiftedCount x h y J
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.card_le_card (fixedHighRankShiftedSet_subset_atLeastRank x h y Y J)

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRank_union_highRank
statement:
theorem fixedLowRank_union_highRank (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ∪ fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J =
      fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet,
    mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet, mem_fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hn, hY, _⟩ | ⟨hn, hY, _⟩)
    · exact ⟨hn, hY⟩
    · exact ⟨hn, hY⟩
  · rintro ⟨hn, hY⟩
    rcases lt_or_ge (largePrimeRank y n.totient) J with hr | hr
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hn, hY, hr⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hn, hY, hr⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRank_disjoint_highRank
statement:
theorem fixedLowRank_disjoint_highRank (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J)
      (fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hnlow hnhigh
  have hl := (mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hnlow).2.2
  have hh := (mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet.mp hnhigh).2.2
  omega

name: RankAmplification.fixedBoundedValueCount_eq_low_add_high
statement:
theorem fixedBoundedValueCount_eq_low_add_high (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    (fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y).card =
      fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y Y J +
        fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fixedLowRank_union_highRank x h y Y J,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (fixedLowRank_disjoint_highRank x h y Y J)]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.fixedBoundedValue_disjoint_nonsmooth
statement:
theorem fixedBoundedValue_disjoint_nonsmooth (x h Y : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y)
      (nonsmoothShiftedSet x h Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hbounded hnonsmooth
  have hb := mem_fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet.mp hbounded
  have hn := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp hnonsmooth
  omega

name: RankAmplification.fixedBoundedValue_union_nonsmooth
statement:
theorem fixedBoundedValue_union_nonsmooth (x h Y : ℕ) :
    fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y ∪ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h Y =
      shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet,
    mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (hn | hn)
    · exact hn.1
    · exact mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mpr ⟨hn.1, hn.2.1, hn.2.2.1⟩
  · intro hn
    by_cases hle : largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ Y
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hn, hle⟩
    · have hndata := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hn
      exact Or.inr ⟨hndata.1, hndata.2.1, hndata.2.2,
        Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_exact_diagonal_decomposition
statement:
theorem fixedRank_exact_diagonal_decomposition (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    shiftedEqualTotientCount x h =
      aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y + offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h Y +
        fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y Y J +
          fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J
proof:
:= by
  have htotal : shiftedEqualTotientCount x h =
      (fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y).card +
        nonsmoothShiftedCount x h Y := by
    rw [shiftedEqualTotientCount, ← fixedBoundedValue_union_nonsmooth x h Y,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
        (fixedBoundedValue_disjoint_nonsmooth x h Y),
      nonsmoothShiftedCount]
  rw [fixedBoundedValueCount_eq_low_add_high x h y Y J,
    nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount
      x h Y] at htotal
  omega

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_fourBranch_union
statement:
theorem fixedRank_fourBranch_union (x h y Y J : ℕ) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ∪ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h Y ∪
        fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ∪
          fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J =
      shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
proof:
:= by
  calc
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ∪ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h Y ∪
          fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ∪
            fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J =
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ∪ offDiagonalNonsmoothSet x h Y) ∪
          (fixedLowRankShiftedSet x h y Y J ∪
            fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J) := by
      simp only [Finset.union_assoc]
    _ = nonsmoothShiftedSet x h Y ∪ fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y := by
      rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_union_offDiagonalNonsmoothSet,
        fixedLowRank_union_highRank]
    _ = fixedBoundedValueShiftedSet x h Y ∪ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h Y := by
      rw [Finset.union_comm]
    _ = shiftedEqualTotientSet x h := fixedBoundedValue_union_nonsmooth x h Y

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_branches
statement:
theorem fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_branches
    {x h y Y J : ℕ} {low high off : ℝ}
    (bounds : FixedRankBranchBounds x h y Y J low high off) :
    (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) + off + low + high
proof:
:= by
  have hexact : (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) =
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) +
        offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h Y +
        fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y Y J +
        fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J := by
    exact_mod_cast fixedRank_exact_diagonal_decomposition x h y Y J
  rw [hexact]
  linarith [bounds.off_bound, bounds.low_bound, bounds.high_bound]

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_three_mul
statement:
theorem fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_three_mul
    {x h y Y J : ℕ} {error : ℝ}
    (hlow : (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y Y J : ℝ) ≤ error)
    (hhigh : (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J : ℝ) ≤ error)
    (hoff : (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤ error) :
    (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) + 3 * error
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_branches
    (FixedRankBranchBounds.mk hlow hhigh hoff)
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_odd_count_le_branches
statement:
theorem fixedRank_odd_count_le_branches
    {x h y Y J : ℕ} {low high off : ℝ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (bounds : FixedRankBranchBounds x h y Y J low high off) :
    (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤ off + low + high
proof:
:= by
  simpa [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd] using
    fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_branches bounds

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_odd_count_le_three_mul
statement:
theorem fixedRank_odd_count_le_three_mul
    {x h y Y J : ℕ} {error : ℝ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (hlow : (fixedLowRankShiftedCount x h y Y J : ℝ) ≤ error)
    (hhigh : (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J : ℝ) ≤ error)
    (hoff : (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤ error) :
    (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤ 3 * error
proof:
:= by
  simpa [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd] using
    fixedRank_count_le_diagonal_add_three_mul hlow hhigh hoff

name: RankAmplification.paperFixedRank_exact_diagonal_decomposition
statement:
theorem paperFixedRank_exact_diagonal_decomposition (J x h : ℕ) :
    shiftedEqualTotientCount x h =
      aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) +
        offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) +
        paperFixedLowRankShiftedCount J x h +
        paperFixedHighRankShiftedCount J x h
proof:
:= by
  exact fixedRank_exact_diagonal_decomposition x h
    (fixedRankNatY J x) (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) J

name: RankAmplification.section10_proposition10_12_unconditional
statement:
theorem section10_proposition10_12_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralHighError J) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ,
        1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
        IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
        (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
            fixedRankGeneralHighError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨tendsto_fixedRankGeneralHighError_zero J,
    fixedRankGeneral_highRank_JT_exponent hJ hc₀ hC₀
      (fixedRankGeneralWeightedFriableTailEndpoint_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀)⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression_le_mul_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression_le_mul_exp
    (J y y' Y x : ℕ) :
    fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression J y Y x ≤
      fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression J y' Y x * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression finitePowerEncodingFactor
  have htail : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y
      (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) ((2 * x) ^ J) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y') :=
    Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y
        (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) ((2 * x) ^ J) *
      Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) htail) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc
    (slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y
          (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) ((2 * x) ^ J) =
        ((slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
            finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y
              (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) ((2 * x) ^ J) *
          Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y)) * 1 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
            finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y
              (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) ((2 * x) ^ J) *
          Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y)) * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y') :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hone hnn
    _ = (slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y') *
          finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y
            (fixedRankGeneralSupplierTailCode J Y x) ((2 * x) ^ J) *
          Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_section10HighRankSharpError_zero
statement:

proof:
:= by

    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop

  simp only [add_zero] at hsum

name: RankAmplification.section10_proposition10_12_sharpCutoff
statement:
theorem section10_proposition10_12_sharpCutoff
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (section10HighRankSharpError J) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ,
        1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
        IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
        (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
            section10HighRankSharpError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_section10HighRankSharpError_zero J, ?_⟩
  have hC₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ + 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨-, hend⟩ :=
    fixedRankGeneralWeightedFriableTailEndpoint_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₁
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperCutoff_le J hC₁,
      eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat, hend] with
      x hrange hupper hscale hV hG hendX
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hy : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  have hx : 0 < x := by omega
  have hcutoff' := isSection5ExponentialCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil T
  have hwindow' := isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hG hwindow
  have hyy' : y ≤ sharpCutoffCeil T :=
    le_sharpCutoffCeil_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff hcutoff le_rfl
  have hy' : 1 ≤ sharpCutoffCeil T := hy.trans hyy'
  have hYx : sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J ≤ x :=
    hupper (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffLog T) c₀ hcutoff' hwindow'
  have hyY : y ≤ sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J :=
    hyy'.trans (one_le_pow_rank hJ hy')
  
  have hendPerturbed := hendX (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffLog T) hcutoff' hwindow'
  have hJy : (J : ℝ) / y ≤ (J : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hyR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
    have hdiv : (J : ℝ) / y ≤ (J : ℝ) := by
      simpa using div_le_self (Nat.cast_nonneg J) hyR
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne']
    exact hdiv
  have hTT : (J : ℝ) * T ≤ (J : ℝ) * sharpCutoffLog T :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_sharpCutoffLog T) (Nat.cast_nonneg J)
  have htail : fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression J y (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) x ≤
      Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        ((J : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    refine (fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression_le_mul_exp J y
      (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) x).trans ?_
    calc
      fixedRankGeneralFriableExpression J (sharpCutoffCeil T)
            (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) x * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) ≤
          Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * sharpCutoffLog T + 0 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
            Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hendPerturbed (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * sharpCutoffLog T + (J : ℝ) / y) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
            ((J : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  
  have hcoverage := fixedHighRankShiftedCount_le_supplierCorrelation
    (x := x) (h := h) (y := y) (Y := sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) (J := J)
      hrangeData.2 hhy (one_le_pow₀ hy')
  have hconvolution := fixedRankSupplierCorrelation_le_convolutionMajorant
    (J := J) (y := y) (Y := sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) (x := x) (h := h)
      (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hh) (hhy.trans hrangeData.2) hhy
  have hsupplier := fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le
    hJ hy hyY hcutoff hx hYx hscale hV htail
  have herror : fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J
      (fun _ ↦ (J : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) x = section10HighRankSharpError J x := by
    have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) := by positivity
    unfold section10HighRankSharpError fixedRankGeneralHighError
      fixedRankGeneralSupplierError
    rw [max_eq_left hnn, max_self]
    ring
  have hmono : (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) ≤
      (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) J : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast fixedHighRankShiftedCount_mono_upperCutoff
      (x := x) (h := h) (y := y) (J := J)
      (natFloor_exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil_pow J T)
  calc
    (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J : ℝ) ≤
        (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) J : ℝ) := hmono
    _ ≤ fixedRankSupplierCorrelation J y (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) x h := hcoverage
    _ ≤ fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) x :=
      hconvolution
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
          section10HighRankSharpError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← herror]; exact hsupplier

name: RankAmplification.fixedHighRankShiftedCount_pow_le_sharpCutoff
statement:
theorem fixedHighRankShiftedCount_pow_le_sharpCutoff
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (J x h : ℕ) (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :

      fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ J
proof:

    (pow_le_natFloor_exp_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff J hcutoff)

name: RankAmplification.section10_proposition10_12_paperForm
statement:
theorem section10_proposition10_12_paperForm
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (section10HighRankSharpError J) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ,
        1 ≤ h → (h : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
        (paperHighRankShiftedCount x h (Real.exp T)
            (Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)) J : ℝ) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
            section10HighRankSharpError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨herror, hsharp⟩ := section10_proposition10_12_sharpCutoff J hJ hc₀ hC₀
  refine ⟨herror, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hsharp] with x hx
  intro h T hh hhy hwindow
  have hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T :=
    isSection5ExponentialCutoff_natFloor_exp T
  have hhfloor : h ≤ ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor hhy
  rw [paperHighRankShiftedCount_eq_fixedHighRankShiftedCount hcutoff]
  exact hx h ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T hh hhfloor hcutoff hwindow

name: RankAmplification.mem_realSmoothSet

@[simp]

proof:

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩

proof:

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hm, hmX, hsmooth⟩
    exact ⟨hm, Nat.le_floor hmX, hsmooth⟩
  · rintro ⟨hm, hmfloor, hsmooth⟩
    have hmX : (m : ℝ) ≤ X := (Nat.le_floor_iff' (by omega)).1 hmfloor
    exact ⟨by omega, hm, hmX, hsmooth⟩

name: RankAmplification.realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_eq_intermediate_add_upper

name: RankAmplification.realSection5Ambient_le_section5Ambient
statement:
theorem realSection5Ambient_le_section5Ambient (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) ≤
      ((section5Ambient x (sharpCutoffCeil T) : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hmul :
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp T ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * ((sharpCutoffCeil T : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T) hx
  simpa only [realSection5Ambient, section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hmul

name: RankAmplification.realSection5PrimeRange_subset_insert
statement:
theorem realSection5PrimeRange_subset_insert (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    realSection5PrimeRange x (Real.exp T) ⊆
      insert (sharpCutoffCeil T) (section5PrimeRange x (sharpCutoffCeil T))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [mem_realSection5PrimeRange] at hp
  obtain ⟨hlow, hup, hprime⟩ := hp
  by_cases hpc : p = sharpCutoffCeil T
  · exact Finset.mem_insert.2 (Or.inl hpc)
  · have hge : sharpCutoffCeil T ≤ p := Nat.ceil_le.2 hlow.le
    have hgt : sharpCutoffCeil T < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hge (Ne.symm hpc)
    have hAnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) := by
      unfold realSection5Ambient
      positivity
    have hsq : (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg p) hup 2
      rwa [Real.sq_sqrt hAnonneg] at this
    have hsqNat : p ^ 2 ≤ section5Ambient x (sharpCutoffCeil T) := by
      have := hsq.trans (realSection5Ambient_le_section5Ambient x T)
      exact_mod_cast this
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      (mem_section5PrimeRange.2 ⟨hgt, Nat.le_sqrt'.2 hsqNat, hprime⟩)

name: RankAmplification.realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange_subset_insert
statement:
theorem realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange_subset_insert (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange x (Real.exp T) ⊆
      insert (sharpCutoffCeil T) (section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (sharpCutoffCeil T))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [mem_realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange] at hp
  obtain ⟨hrange, hsplit⟩ := hp
  have hmem := realSection5PrimeRange_subset_insert x T hrange
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hmem with hpc | hpc
  · exact Finset.mem_insert.2 (Or.inl hpc)
  · refine Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.2 ⟨hpc, ?_⟩)
    have hpow : (Real.exp T) ^ 2 ≤ ((sharpCutoffCeil T : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos T).le (exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T) 2
    have : (p : ℝ) ≤ ((sharpCutoffCeil T ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast this

name: RankAmplification.natFloor_realSection5LocalCutoff_le
statement:
theorem natFloor_realSection5LocalCutoff_le (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p⌋₊ ≤
      section5LocalCutoff x (sharpCutoffCeil T) p
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hle : realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p ≤
      ((section5Ambient x (sharpCutoffCeil T) : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hcast : ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, hcast]
    simpa only [realSection5LocalCutoff, div_eq_mul_inv] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (realSection5Ambient_le_section5Ambient x T)
        (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)
  calc
    ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p⌋₊ ≤
        ⌊((section5Ambient x (sharpCutoffCeil T) : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊ :=
      Nat.floor_le_floor hle
    _ = section5LocalCutoff x (sharpCutoffCeil T) p := by
      rw [Nat.floor_div_natCast, Nat.floor_natCast]
      rfl

name: RankAmplification.realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_natural
statement:
theorem realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_natural (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p) ≤
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x (sharpCutoffCeil T) p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
  exact finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_mono p (natFloor_realSection5LocalCutoff_le x T p)

name: RankAmplification.realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_boundary_add
statement:
theorem realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_boundary_add (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum x (Real.exp T) ≤
      realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount (sharpCutoffCeil T)
          (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) (sharpCutoffCeil T)) +
        smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (sharpCutoffCeil T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun p ↦
    realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p) with hf
  have hfnonneg : ∀ p, 0 ≤ f p := fun p ↦ realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_nonneg _ _
  calc
    realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum x (Real.exp T) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ insert (sharpCutoffCeil T) (section5PrimeRange x (sharpCutoffCeil T)), f p :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (realSection5PrimeRange_subset_insert x T)
        fun p _ _ ↦ hfnonneg p
    _ ≤ f (sharpCutoffCeil T) + ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x (sharpCutoffCeil T), f p := by
      by_cases hmem : sharpCutoffCeil T ∈ section5PrimeRange x (sharpCutoffCeil T)
      · rw [Finset.insert_eq_self.2 hmem]
        linarith [hfnonneg (sharpCutoffCeil T)]
      · rw [Finset.sum_insert hmem]
    _ ≤ f (sharpCutoffCeil T) + smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (sharpCutoffCeil T) := by
      have hterm : ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x (sharpCutoffCeil T), f p ≤
          smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (sharpCutoffCeil T) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_natural x T p
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_ambient_hyperbola
statement:
theorem realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_ambient_hyperbola
    {x : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ realSection5Ambient x y) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
      realSection5LocalCutoff x y p * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y))
proof:
:= by
  have hApos : (0 : ℝ) < realSection5Ambient x y := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hA
  have hlogA : 0 ≤ Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y) := Real.log_nonneg hA
  have hpReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hpSq : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hXnonneg : 0 ≤ realSection5LocalCutoff x y p := by
    unfold realSection5LocalCutoff
    positivity
  have hXA : realSection5LocalCutoff x y p ≤ realSection5Ambient x y := by
    unfold realSection5LocalCutoff
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hpSq]
    have hp2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp2 hApos.le]
  rw [realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
  by_cases h0 : ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ = 0
  · calc
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ ≤
          ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (1 + Real.log ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [h0]; norm_num
      _ ≤ realSection5LocalCutoff x y p *
          (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y)) := by positivity
  · have h1 : 1 ≤ ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 h0
    have hfloorReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h1
    have hfloorle : ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        realSection5LocalCutoff x y p := Nat.floor_le hXnonneg
    have hlog : Real.log ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (hfloorle.trans hXA)
    calc
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ ≤
          ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (1 + Real.log ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola _ _
      _ ≤ ((⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x y p⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by linarith)
        linarith
      _ ≤ realSection5LocalCutoff x y p *
          (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfloorle
        linarith

name: RankAmplification.sum_realSection5UpperPrimeRange_inv_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_realSection5UpperPrimeRange_inv_sq_le {x : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hy : 2 ≤ y ^ 2) :
    (∑ p ∈ realSection5UpperPrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤ 2 * ((y : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m : ℕ := ⌊y ^ 2⌋₊ with hm
  set M : ℕ := max m ⌊Real.sqrt (realSection5Ambient x y)⌋₊ with hM
  have hmPos : 0 < m := by
    have := Nat.le_floor (show ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ y ^ 2 by exact_mod_cast hy)
    omega
  have hsubset : realSection5UpperPrimeRange x y ⊆ squareSourcePrimeRange m M := by
    intro p hp
    rw [mem_realSection5UpperPrimeRange, mem_realSection5PrimeRange] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hup, hprime⟩, hsplit⟩ := hp
    have hmlt : m < p := by
      have hmle : (m : ℝ) ≤ y ^ 2 := Nat.floor_le (by nlinarith)
      have : (m : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hmle hsplit
      exact_mod_cast this
    exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨hmlt, le_max_of_le_right (Nat.le_floor hup)⟩,
      hprime⟩
  have hmM : m ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have hmReal : (y : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
    have := Nat.sub_one_lt_floor (y ^ 2)
    have hfl : y ^ 2 - 1 < (m : ℝ) := this
    linarith
  have hmRealPos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmPos
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ realSection5UpperPrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange m M, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset fun p _ _ ↦ ?_
      positivity
    _ ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv hmPos hmM
    _ ≤ 2 * ((y : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < y ^ 2 := by linarith
      have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < y ^ 2 / 2 := by linarith
      calc
        (m : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ ((y : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hhalf hmReal
        _ = 2 * ((y : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by field_simp

name: RankAmplification.realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper_le
statement:
theorem realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper_le {x : ℕ} {y : ℝ}
    (hA : 1 ≤ realSection5Ambient x y) (hy : 2 ≤ y ^ 2) (hypos : 0 < y) :
    realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper x y ≤
      4 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y)) / y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hApos : (0 : ℝ) < realSection5Ambient x y := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hA
  have hlogA : 0 ≤ Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y) := Real.log_nonneg hA
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ realSection5Ambient x y * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y)) := by
    positivity
  calc
    realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper x y ≤
        ∑ p ∈ realSection5UpperPrimeRange x y,
          (realSection5Ambient x y * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y))) *
            (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp ↦ ?_
      have hprime := (mem_realSection5PrimeRange.1
        (mem_realSection5UpperPrimeRange.1 hp).1).2.2
      have hple : 1 ≤ p := hprime.one_lt.le
      have := realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_ambient_hyperbola (x := x) (y := y) hA hple
      calc
        realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
            realSection5LocalCutoff x y p *
              (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y)) := this
        _ = (realSection5Ambient x y * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y))) *
            (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
          unfold realSection5LocalCutoff
          field_simp
    _ = (realSection5Ambient x y * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y))) *
        ∑ p ∈ realSection5UpperPrimeRange x y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (realSection5Ambient x y * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y))) *
        (2 * ((y : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_realSection5UpperPrimeRange_inv_sq_le hy) hcoef
    _ = 4 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x y)) / y := by
      unfold realSection5Ambient
      field_simp
      ring

name: RankAmplification.realSection5LocalCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil_le
statement:
theorem realSection5LocalCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil_le (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) (sharpCutoffCeil T) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)
proof:
:= by
  have hexpT : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp T := Real.exp_pos T
  have hnReal : Real.exp T ≤ ((sharpCutoffCeil T : ℕ) : ℝ) := exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T
  have hnSq : Real.exp T ^ 2 ≤ ((sharpCutoffCeil T : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hexpT.le hnReal 2
  unfold realSection5LocalCutoff realSection5Ambient
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by nlinarith : (0 : ℝ) < ((sharpCutoffCeil T : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2), Real.exp_neg]
  have hstep : Real.exp T ^ 2 * (Real.exp T)⁻¹ = Real.exp T := by
    field_simp
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnSq
    (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp T)⁻¹)]

name: RankAmplification.realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_sharpCutoffCeil_le
statement:
theorem realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_sharpCutoffCeil_le {x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount (sharpCutoffCeil T)
        (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) (sharpCutoffCeil T)) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) * (1 + Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  set n' : ℕ := sharpCutoffCeil T with hn'
  set X : ℝ := realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) n' with hX
  have hxReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hlogTwoX : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hexpT : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp T := Real.exp_pos T
  have hnReal : Real.exp T ≤ (n' : ℝ) := exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T
  have hXsmall : X ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) :=
    realSection5LocalCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil_le x T
  have hexpNegOne : Real.exp (-T) ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (show -T ≤ 0 by linarith)
    simpa using this
  have hXnonneg : 0 ≤ X := by
    rw [hX]
    unfold realSection5LocalCutoff realSection5Ambient
    positivity
  have hXtwoX : X ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
    have : 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * 1 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexpNegOne
      linarith
    linarith
  rw [realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
  by_cases h0 : ⌊X⌋₊ = 0
  · calc
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount n' ⌊X⌋₊ ≤
          ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [h0]; norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) * (1 + Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ))) := by positivity
  · have h1 : 1 ≤ ⌊X⌋₊ := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 h0
    have hfloorReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have hfloorle : ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ X := Nat.floor_le hXnonneg
    have hlog : Real.log ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (hfloorle.trans hXtwoX)
    calc
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount n' ⌊X⌋₊ ≤
          ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_hyperbola _ _
      _ ≤ ((⌊X⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ))) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by linarith)
        linarith
      _ ≤ (2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)) * (1 + Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ))) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfloorle.trans hXsmall)
        linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_le
statement:
theorem eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_le
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T : ℝ,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum x (Real.exp T) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T + realSection5B4AbsoluteError x)
proof:
:= by
  have hC₁ : (0 : ℝ) < C₀ + 1 := by linarith
  filter_upwards [variableCutoff_proposition5_1_unconditional hc₀ hC₁,
      eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat, eventually_ge_atTop 1,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos]
    with x hmain hG hx hL
  intro T hwindow
  have hxReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hGpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleG (x : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hG
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := le_trans (by positivity) hwindow.1
  have hE : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (-T) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hwindow' := isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hG hwindow
  have hnat := hmain (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffLog T)
    (isSection5ExponentialCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil T) hwindow'
  have hexpNat : Real.exp (-sharpCutoffLog T + variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError x) ≤
      Real.exp (-T) * (18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.exp_add, variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError,
      Real.exp_log (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ))]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [le_sharpCutoffLog T])) (by linarith)
  have hnat' : smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (sharpCutoffCeil T) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-T) * (18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ))) :=
    hnat.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexpNat (by linarith))
  have hbdry := realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_sharpCutoffCeil_le hx hT
  have hlog2x : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) = Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by linarith : (x : ℝ) ≠ 0), scaleL_eq]
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := Real.log_two_lt_d9.le.trans (by norm_num)
  have hexpReal : Real.exp (-T + realSection5B4AbsoluteError x) =
      Real.exp (-T) * (22 + 18 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.exp_add, realSection5B4AbsoluteError,
      Real.exp_log (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 22 + 18 * scaleL (x : ℝ))]
  rw [hexpReal]
  calc
    realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum x (Real.exp T) ≤
        realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount (sharpCutoffCeil T)
            (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) (sharpCutoffCeil T)) +
          smoothMultiplierB4Sum x (sharpCutoffCeil T) :=
      realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_le_boundary_add x T
    _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) * (1 + Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ))) +
        (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-T) * (18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ))) :=
      add_le_add hbdry hnat'
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-T) * (22 + 18 * scaleL (x : ℝ))) := by
      rw [hlog2x]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ)) hE.le)
        (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - Real.log 2)]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_realSection5B4AbsoluteError_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_realSection5B4AbsoluteError_div_scaleV_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ realSection5B4AbsoluteError x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmajor : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hreal : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ log2 t / scaleV t) atTop (nhds 0) :=
      log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    have hnat := hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (2 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 2) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [mul_zero, Function.comp] using hconst.mul hnat
  have hbig : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, (22 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 22
  refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ hmajor
  · filter_upwards [hbig, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hLx hVx
    unfold realSection5B4AbsoluteError
    exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)) hVx.le
  · filter_upwards [hbig, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hLx hVx
    unfold realSection5B4AbsoluteError
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 22 + 18 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hle : 22 + 18 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hsq : Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) = 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.log_pow]
      norm_num
    have hlog : Real.log (22 + 18 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      have hmono := Real.log_le_log hpos hle
      rwa [hsq] at hmono
    calc
      Real.log (22 + 18 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) / scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
          2 * log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog hVx.le
      _ = 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.isSection5UniformLittleOScaleV_realSection5B4AbsoluteError
statement:
theorem isSection5UniformLittleOScaleV_realSection5B4AbsoluteError (c₀ C₀ : ℝ) :
    IsSection5UniformLittleOScaleV c₀ C₀
      (fun x _ ↦ realSection5B4AbsoluteError x)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  have habs : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ |realSection5B4AbsoluteError x / scaleV (x : ℝ)|)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [abs_zero] using
      tendsto_realSection5B4AbsoluteError_div_scaleV_zero.abs
  filter_upwards [habs.eventually_le_const hε, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hx hV
  intro _T _hwindow
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hV] at hx
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hV).1 hx

name: RankAmplification.eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_at_scaleG_le
statement:
theorem eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum_at_scaleG_le

name: RankAmplification.section5LocalCutoff_le_natFloor_realSection5LocalCutoff
statement:
theorem section5LocalCutoff_le_natFloor_realSection5LocalCutoff (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    section5LocalCutoff x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ p ≤
      ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  have hnum : ((section5Ambient x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) := by
    unfold section5Ambient realSection5Ambient
    push_cast
    have hfloor : ((⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := Nat.floor_le (Real.exp_nonneg T)
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) x]
  have hle : ((section5Ambient x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p := by
    have hcast : ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, hcast]
    simpa only [realSection5LocalCutoff, div_eq_mul_inv] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnum (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)
  calc
    section5LocalCutoff x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ p =
        ⌊((section5Ambient x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊ := by
      rw [Nat.floor_div_natCast, Nat.floor_natCast]
      rfl
    _ ≤ ⌊realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p⌋₊ := Nat.floor_le_floor hle

name: RankAmplification.smoothMultiplierB4Sum_natFloor_le_realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum
statement:
theorem smoothMultiplierB4Sum_natFloor_le_realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    smoothMultiplierB4Sum x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ ≤ realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum x (Real.exp T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsubset : section5PrimeRange x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ ⊆
      realSection5PrimeRange x (Real.exp T) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hlow, hup, hprime⟩ := mem_section5PrimeRange.1 hp
    have hfloorlt : Real.exp T < (p : ℝ) := by
      have hle : (⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hlow
      linarith [Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.exp T)]
    refine mem_realSection5PrimeRange.2 ⟨hfloorlt, ?_, hprime⟩
    have hsqNat : p ^ 2 ≤ section5Ambient x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ := Nat.le_sqrt'.1 hup
    have hsq : (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) := by
      have hcast : ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((section5Ambient x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hsqNat
      have hnum : ((section5Ambient x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) := by
        unfold section5Ambient realSection5Ambient
        push_cast
        nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) x, Nat.floor_le (Real.exp_nonneg T)]
      push_cast at hcast
      linarith
    calc
      (p : ℝ) = Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (Nat.cast_nonneg p)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
  calc
    smoothMultiplierB4Sum x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ ≤
        ∑ p ∈ section5PrimeRange x ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊,
          realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ ?_
      rw [realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
      exact finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_mono p
        (section5LocalCutoff_le_natFloor_realSection5LocalCutoff x T p)
    _ ≤ realSmoothMultiplierB4Sum x (Real.exp T) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset fun p _ _ ↦
        realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_nonneg _ _

name: RankAmplification.section5LocalCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem section5LocalCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil_le_two_mul {x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (p : ℕ) :
    ((section5LocalCutoff x (sharpCutoffCeil T) p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      2 * realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p
proof:
:= by
  have hexpOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := Real.one_le_exp hT
  have hceil : ((sharpCutoffCeil T : ℕ) : ℝ) < Real.exp T + 1 :=
    Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.exp_nonneg T)
  calc
    ((section5LocalCutoff x (sharpCutoffCeil T) p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((section5Ambient x (sharpCutoffCeil T) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
      section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x _ p
    _ ≤ (2 * realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T)) * (((p : ℝ)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
      unfold section5Ambient realSection5Ambient
      push_cast
      nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) x]
    _ = 2 * realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p := by
      unfold realSection5LocalCutoff
      ring
