name: RankAmplification.eventually_realSection5Boundary_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV
statement:
theorem eventually_realSection5Boundary_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T : ℝ,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      Real.exp T < ((sharpCutoffCeil T : ℕ) : ℝ) →
      (sharpCutoffCeil T).Prime →
      realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount (sharpCutoffCeil T)
          (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) (sharpCutoffCeil T)) ≤
        realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) (sharpCutoffCeil T) *
          Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_lemma2_5_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_vLogV_le_variableCutoff_local_saddle hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_three_variableCutoff_cube_lt_two_x hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_upperEnvelope_le_exp hc₀,
      eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat, eventually_ge_atTop 1,
      (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1]
    with x hlemma hsaddle hlower hnatRange hcube hexpEnv hG hx hL
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hL
  intro T hwindow hlt hprime
  set n : ℕ := ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ with hn
  set n' : ℕ := sharpCutoffCeil T with hn'
  have hcut : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff n T := isSection5ExponentialCutoff_natFloor_exp T
  have hnle : (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := hcut.1
  have hnn' : n < n' := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_lt hnle hlt
  have hn'le : n' ≤ n + 1 := by
    refine Nat.ceil_le.2 ?_
    have := hcut.2
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hn'eq : n' = n + 1 := by omega
  have hnthree : 3 ≤ n := (hnatRange n T hcut hwindow).1
  have hcubeData : 3 * n ^ 3 < 2 * x := hcube n T hcut hwindow
  
  have hmem : n' ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x n := by
    refine mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.2 ⟨mem_section5PrimeRange.2 ⟨hnn', ?_, hprime⟩, ?_⟩
    · refine Nat.le_sqrt'.2 ?_
      have hsq : n' ^ 2 ≤ 4 * n ^ 2 := by rw [hn'eq]; nlinarith
      have h4 : 4 ≤ 3 * n ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hchain : n' ^ 2 < section5Ambient x n := by
        calc
          n' ^ 2 ≤ 4 * n ^ 2 := hsq
          _ ≤ 3 * n ^ 2 * n ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n ^ 2) h4
          _ = 3 * n ^ 3 * n := by ring
          _ < 2 * x * n := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcubeData (by omega)
          _ = section5Ambient x n := by unfold section5Ambient; ring
      exact hchain.le
    · rw [hn'eq]; nlinarith
  
  have hdata := hlemma n T hcut hwindow n' hmem
  have hsav := hsaddle n T hcut hwindow n' hmem
  have hlow := hlower n T hcut hwindow n' hmem
  set X₀ : ℕ := section5LocalCutoff x n n' with hX₀
  set Xr : ℝ := realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) n' with hXr
  set X : ℕ := ⌊Xr⌋₊ with hX
  have hX₀X : X₀ ≤ X := section5LocalCutoff_le_natFloor_realSection5LocalCutoff x T n'
  have hX₀pos : 0 < X₀ := hlow.1
  have hXpos : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hX₀pos hX₀X
  have hn'two : 2 ≤ n' := hprime.two_le
  have hn'oneReal : (1 : ℝ) < (n' : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hprime.one_lt
  have hlogn' : 0 < Real.log (n' : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hn'oneReal
  
  have hlogX₀X : Real.log ((X₀ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hX₀pos) (by exact_mod_cast hX₀X)
  have huu : rankinU X₀ n' ≤ rankinU X n' := by
    unfold rankinU
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogX₀X hlogn'.le
  have hu0 : lemmaTwoFiveU0 ≤ rankinU X₀ n' := hdata.1
  have hone : 1 < rankinU X₀ n' := one_lt_lemmaTwoFiveU0.trans_le hu0
  have hu0X : lemmaTwoFiveU0 ≤ rankinU X n' := hu0.trans huu
  have hmonoUlogU : rankinU X₀ n' * Real.log (rankinU X₀ n') ≤
      rankinU X n' * Real.log (rankinU X n') := by
    have hlognonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (rankinU X₀ n') := Real.log_nonneg hone.le
    exact mul_le_mul huu (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) huu) hlognonneg (by linarith)
  have hrangeX : lemmaTwoFiveC0 * log2 (3 * (n' : ℝ)) ≤
      rankinU X n' * Real.log (rankinU X n') := hdata.2.trans hmonoUlogU
  
  have hGpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleG (x : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hG
  have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hwindow.1
  have hxReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hXrnonneg : 0 ≤ Xr := by
    rw [hXr]
    unfold realSection5LocalCutoff realSection5Ambient
    positivity
  have hXfloor : ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Xr := Nat.floor_le hXrnonneg
  have hexpNegOne : Real.exp (-T) ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (show -T ≤ 0 by linarith)
    simpa using this
  have hXtwo : ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
    have hsmall : Xr ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) :=
      realSection5LocalCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil_le x T
    nlinarith
  have hlogX : Real.log ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hmono : Real.log ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hXpos) hXtwo
    rwa [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by linarith : (x : ℝ) ≠ 0),
      ← scaleL_eq] at hmono
  have hlogXnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hXpos)
  have hTlogn' : T ≤ Real.log (n' : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos T) (exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T)
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := Real.log_two_lt_d9.le.trans (by norm_num)
  have huSqrt : rankinU X n' ≤ Real.sqrt (n' : ℝ) := by
    have hstep1 : rankinU X n' ≤ (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) / T := by
      unfold rankinU
      calc
        Real.log ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log (n' : ℝ) ≤
            (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) / Real.log (n' : ℝ) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogX hlogn'.le
        _ ≤ (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) / T := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hTpos hTlogn'
    have hstep2 : (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) / T ≤ 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
      have hnum : Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ 4 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by linarith
      have hden : c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ T := hwindow.1
      have hcg : (0 : ℝ) < c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by positivity
      calc
        (Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) / T ≤ 4 * scaleL (x : ℝ) / T :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hTpos.le
        _ ≤ 4 * scaleL (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hcg hden
        _ = 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
          rw [scaleV_eq]
          field_simp
    have hstep3 : 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ ≤ Real.exp (T / 2) := by
      refine hexpEnv.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      have := hwindow.1
      linarith
    have hstep4 : Real.exp (T / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (n' : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.exp_half]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T)
    linarith
  
  have hmain := finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_half_u_log_u_of_range
    hXpos hn'two hu0X huSqrt hrangeX
  have hsavX : section5VLogVConstant C₀ * (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) ≤
      rankinU X n' * Real.log (rankinU X n') / 2 := by
    have := hsav
    linarith
  rw [realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount n' X ≤
        ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(rankinU X n' * Real.log (rankinU X n')) / 2) := hmain
    _ ≤ ((X : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    _ ≤ Xr * Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hXfloor (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: RankAmplification.eventually_realSection5Intermediate_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV
statement:
theorem eventually_realSection5Intermediate_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T : ℝ,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      ∀ p ∈ realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange x (Real.exp T),
        realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p) ≤
          realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p *
            Real.exp (-(realSection5VLogVConstant C₀ *
              (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hC₁ : (0 : ℝ) < C₀ + 1 := by linarith
  have hcpos : 0 < section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) := section5VLogVConstant_pos hC₁
  filter_upwards [eventually_realSection5Boundary_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin_vLogV hc₀ hC₁,
      eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat,
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 6,
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop
        (2 * Real.log 2 / section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1))]
    with x hbdry hRankin hG hV6 hVc
  intro T hwindow p hp
  have hlogV : 1 < Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    one_lt_log_six.trans_le (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hV6)
  have hWnonneg : 0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by nlinarith
  have hWlarge : 2 * Real.log 2 ≤
      section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) * (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
    have hVW : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by nlinarith
    have hVge : 2 * Real.log 2 / section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := hVc
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hcpos] at hVge
    nlinarith
  have hpdata := mem_realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange.1 hp
  have hprange := mem_realSection5PrimeRange.1 hpdata.1
  have hGpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleG (x : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hG
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := le_trans (by positivity) hwindow.1
  have hXnonneg : 0 ≤ realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p := by
    unfold realSection5LocalCutoff realSection5Ambient
    positivity
  by_cases hpc : p = sharpCutoffCeil T
  · subst hpc
    refine (hbdry T hwindow hprange.1 hprange.2.2).trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) hXnonneg
    have hle := realSection5VLogVConstant_le hC₀
    nlinarith
  · have hmem : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x (sharpCutoffCeil T) := by
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 (realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange_subset_insert x T hp) with
        h | h
      · exact absurd h hpc
      · exact h
    have hsaving := finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5Intermediate_le
      (hRankin (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffLog T)
        (isSection5ExponentialCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil T)
        (isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hG hwindow)) hmem
    have hdouble := section5LocalCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil_le_two_mul (x := x) hT p
    have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp
        (section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) / 2) := by
      have hlog : Real.log 2 ≤
          section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) / 2 := by linarith
      calc
        (2 : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 2) := (Real.exp_log (by norm_num)).symm
        _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
    have hkey : 2 * Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) ≤
        Real.exp (-(realSection5VLogVConstant C₀ *
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) := by
      have hsplit : -(realSection5VLogVConstant C₀ *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))) =
          section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
              (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) / 2 +
            -(section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
              (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))) := by
        rw [realSection5VLogVConstant]
        ring
      rw [hsplit, Real.exp_add]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htwo (Real.exp_pos _).le
    calc
      realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p) ≤
          finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x (sharpCutoffCeil T) p) :=
        realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_natural x T p
      _ ≤ ((section5LocalCutoff x (sharpCutoffCeil T) p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) := hsaving
      _ ≤ (2 * realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p) *
          Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdouble (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p *
          (2 * Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant (C₀ + 1) *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))) := by ring
      _ ≤ realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p *
          Real.exp (-(realSection5VLogVConstant C₀ *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey hXnonneg

name: RankAmplification.sum_realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le {x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (h3 : 3 ≤ ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊) :
    (∑ p ∈ realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange x (Real.exp T), (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
      2 * (Real.exp T)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set n : ℕ := ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ with hn
  set M : ℕ := max n ⌊Real.sqrt (realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T))⌋₊ with hM
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
  have hnReal : (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := Nat.floor_le (Real.exp_nonneg T)
  have hnRealPos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
  have hsubset : realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange x (Real.exp T) ⊆
      squareSourcePrimeRange n M := by
    intro p hp
    have hpdata := mem_realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange.1 hp
    have hprange := mem_realSection5PrimeRange.1 hpdata.1
    have hnp : n < p := by
      have : (n : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt hnReal hprange.1
      exact_mod_cast this
    exact Finset.mem_filter.2
      ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨hnp, le_max_of_le_right (Nat.le_floor hprange.2.1)⟩, hprange.2.2⟩
  have hhalf : Real.exp T / 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    have hlt : Real.exp T < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
    linarith
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange x (Real.exp T), (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange n M, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset fun p _ _ ↦ ?_
      positivity
    _ ≤ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv hnpos (le_max_left _ _)
    _ ≤ 2 * (Real.exp T)⁻¹ := by
      have hexp : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp T := Real.exp_pos T
      calc
        (n : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.exp T / 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hhalf
        _ = 2 * (Real.exp T)⁻¹ := by field_simp

name: RankAmplification.eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le
statement:
theorem eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T : ℝ,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      realSmoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (Real.exp T) ≤
        4 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(realSection5VLogVConstant C₀ *
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_realSection5Intermediate_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le] with x hpoint hnatRange
  intro T hwindow
  have hcut : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T :=
    isSection5ExponentialCutoff_natFloor_exp T
  have h3 : 3 ≤ ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ := (hnatRange ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T hcut hwindow).1
  set E : ℝ := Real.exp (-(realSection5VLogVConstant C₀ *
    (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))) with hE
  have hEpos : 0 < E := Real.exp_pos _
  have hAnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) := by
    unfold realSection5Ambient
    positivity
  calc
    realSmoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x (Real.exp T) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange x (Real.exp T),
          (realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) * E) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp ↦ ?_
      calc
        realDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p) ≤
            realSection5LocalCutoff x (Real.exp T) p * E := hpoint T hwindow p hp
        _ = (realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) * E) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
          unfold realSection5LocalCutoff
          ring
    _ = (realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) * E) *
        ∑ p ∈ realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange x (Real.exp T), (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) * E) * (2 * (Real.exp T)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_realSection5IntermediatePrimeRange_inv_sq_le h3)
        (by positivity)
    _ = 4 * (x : ℝ) * E := by
      unfold realSection5Ambient
      have : Real.exp T ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos T).ne'
      field_simp
      ring

name: RankAmplification.eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper_le
statement:
theorem eventually_realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper_le
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T : ℝ,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper x (Real.exp T) ≤
        4 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T))) *
          Real.exp (-T)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hnatRange hx
  intro T hwindow
  have hcut : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T :=
    isSection5ExponentialCutoff_natFloor_exp T
  have h3 : 3 ≤ ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ := (hnatRange ⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ T hcut hwindow).1
  have h3Real : (3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := by
    have hfl : ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊Real.exp T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h3
    have := Nat.floor_le (Real.exp_nonneg T)
    push_cast at hfl
    linarith
  have hxReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hA : 1 ≤ realSection5Ambient x (Real.exp T) := by
    unfold realSection5Ambient
    nlinarith
  have hy2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hmain := realSmoothMultiplierB4Upper_le (x := x) (y := Real.exp T) hA hy2
    (Real.exp_pos T)
  refine hmain.trans ?_
  rw [Real.exp_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.four_le_log_log_of_saddleThreshold_le
statement:
theorem four_le_log_log_of_saddleThreshold_le
    {H : ℕ} (hH : hildebrandSaddleThreshold ≤ H) :
    4 ≤ Real.log (Real.log H)
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : Real.exp (Real.exp 4) ≤ (H : ℝ) :=
    (Nat.le_ceil (Real.exp (Real.exp 4))).trans (by exact_mod_cast hH)
  have hlog : Real.exp 4 ≤ Real.log (H : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos (Real.exp 4)) hcast
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using this
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (H : ℝ) := (Real.exp_pos 4).trans_le hlog
  have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 4) hlog
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using this

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandRange_logR_pos
statement:
theorem hildebrandRange_logR_pos {R H : ℕ} (h : HildebrandSmoothRange R H) :
    0 < Real.log R
proof:
:= by
  have hR : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h.2.1
  exact Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandRange_one_le_logR
statement:
theorem hildebrandRange_one_le_logR {R H : ℕ} (h : HildebrandSmoothRange R H) :
    1 ≤ Real.log R
proof:
:= by
  exact (one_lt_log_nat h.2.1).le

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandRange_loglogH_sq_le_logR
proof:
:= by
  have hlower := h.2.2.2.1
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log
    (Real.exp_pos (Real.log (Real.log H) ^ 2)) hlower
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using hlog

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandRange_rankinU_pos
statement:
theorem hildebrandRange_rankinU_pos {R H : ℕ} (h : HildebrandSmoothRange R H) :
    0 < rankinU H R
proof:
:=
  (Real.exp_pos 1).trans_le h.2.2.2.2

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandRange_logU_le_loglogH
proof:
:= by
  have hlogHPos : 0 < Real.log (H : ℝ) := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    have hRH : R ≤ H := h.2.2.1
    have hRone : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h.2.1
    exact_mod_cast hRone.trans_le hRH
  have hUle : rankinU H R ≤ Real.log H := by
    rw [rankinU]
    exact (div_le_self hlogHPos.le (hildebrandRange_one_le_logR h))
  exact Real.log_le_log (hildebrandRange_rankinU_pos h) hUle

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandRange_loglogU_le_logU
proof:
:= by
  have hlogU : 1 ≤ Real.log (rankinU H R) :=
    one_le_log_of_exp_one_le h.2.2.2.2
  exact Real.log_le_self (zero_le_one.trans hlogU)

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandSaddleShift_pos
statement:
theorem hildebrandSaddleShift_pos {R H : ℕ} (h : HildebrandSmoothRange R H) :
    0 < hildebrandSaddleShift H R
proof:
:= by
  have hlogU : 1 ≤ Real.log (rankinU H R) :=
    one_le_log_of_exp_one_le h.2.2.2.2
  have hloglogU : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R)) :=
    Real.log_nonneg hlogU
  rw [hildebrandSaddleShift]
  exact div_pos (by linarith) (hildebrandRange_logR_pos h)

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandSaddleShift_le_half
proof:
:= by
  have hL2 : 4 ≤ Real.log (Real.log H) :=
    four_le_log_log_of_saddleThreshold_le hH
  have hlogU := hildebrandRange_logU_le_loglogH h
  have hloglogU := hildebrandRange_loglogU_le_logU h
  have hsq := hildebrandRange_loglogH_sq_le_logR h
  have hnumerator :
      2 * (Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))) ≤
        Real.log R := by
    have hlinear : 4 * Real.log (Real.log H) ≤ Real.log (Real.log H) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    linarith
  rw [hildebrandSaddleShift]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (hildebrandRange_logR_pos h)).2
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH
statement:
theorem hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH {R H : ℕ}
    (hR : 1 < R) :
    hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
      rankinU H R *
        (Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rankinU_mul_log hR, hildebrandSaddleShift]
  have hlogR : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).ne'
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.one_sub_hildebrandSaddleShift_pos
proof:
:= by
  linarith [hildebrandSaddleShift_le_half hH h]

name: RankAmplification.smoothBuchstabRawCode_injOn
statement:
theorem smoothBuchstabRawCode_injOn :
    Set.InjOn smoothBuchstabRawCode (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  by_cases ha1 : a = 1
  · subst a
    by_cases hb1 : b = 1
    · exact hb1.symm
    · simp [smoothBuchstabRawCode, hb1] at hab
  · by_cases hb1 : b = 1
    · subst b
      simp [smoothBuchstabRawCode, ha1] at hab
    · have hlargeA : 1 < largestPrimeFactor a := by
        have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le ha)
        have hprime := Nat.minFac_prime ha1
        exact hprime.one_lt.trans_le
          (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hprime ha0 (Nat.minFac_dvd a))
      have hlargeB : 1 < largestPrimeFactor b := by
        have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le hb)
        have hprime := Nat.minFac_prime hb1
        exact hprime.one_lt.trans_le
          (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hprime hb0 (Nat.minFac_dvd b))
      have hcode :
          (⟨largestPrimeFactor a, a / largestPrimeFactor a⟩ : Σ _p : ℕ, ℕ) =
            ⟨largestPrimeFactor b, b / largestPrimeFactor b⟩ := by
        exact Option.some.inj <| by
          simpa [smoothBuchstabRawCode, ha1, hb1] using hab
      have hprimeEq : largestPrimeFactor a = largestPrimeFactor b :=
        congrArg Sigma.fst hcode
      have hquotEq : a / largestPrimeFactor a = b / largestPrimeFactor b :=
        congrArg Sigma.snd hcode
      calc
        a = a / largestPrimeFactor a * largestPrimeFactor a :=
          (Nat.div_mul_cancel (largestPrimeFactor_dvd hlargeA)).symm
        _ = b / largestPrimeFactor b * largestPrimeFactor b := by
          rw [hquotEq, hprimeEq]
        _ = b := Nat.div_mul_cancel (largestPrimeFactor_dvd hlargeB)

name: RankAmplification.smoothBuchstabRawCode_mem_codeSet
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hndata := mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hn
  by_cases hn1 : n = 1
  · simp [smoothBuchstabRawCode, smoothBuchstabCodeSet, hn1]
  · let q := largestPrimeFactor n
    let m := n / q
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hlarge : 1 < q := by
      have hprime := Nat.minFac_prime hn1
      exact hprime.one_lt.trans_le
        (prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hprime hn0 (Nat.minFac_dvd n))
    have hqPrime : q.Prime := largestPrimeFactor_prime hlarge
    have hqDvd : q ∣ n := largestPrimeFactor_dvd hlarge
    have hqLeR : q ≤ R :=
      hndata.2.2.2 q (largestPrimeFactor_mem_primeFactors hlarge)
    have hmPos : 0 < m := by
      exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hqDvd) hqPrime.pos
    have hmLe : m ≤ H / q := Nat.div_le_div_right hndata.2.1
    have hmSmooth : IsSmooth q m := by
      refine ⟨hmPos.ne', ?_⟩
      intro r hr
      have hrPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr
      have hrDvdM := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr
      have hmDvdN : m ∣ n := Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hqDvd
      exact prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hrPrime hn0 (hrDvdM.trans hmDvdN)
    have hmMem : m ∈ finiteSmoothSet q (H / q) :=
      mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr ⟨hmPos, hmLe, hmSmooth⟩
    have hsigma : (⟨q, m⟩ : Σ _p : ℕ, ℕ) ∈
        (Nat.primesLE R).sigma (fun p ↦ finiteSmoothSet p (H / p)) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_sigma]
      exact ⟨Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr ⟨hqLeR, hqPrime⟩, hmMem⟩
    rw [smoothBuchstabRawCode, if_neg hn1, smoothBuchstabCodeSet]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem <| Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨⟨q, m⟩, hsigma, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothBuchstabRawCode_surjOn
statement:
theorem smoothBuchstabRawCode_surjOn {R H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    Set.SurjOn smoothBuchstabRawCode (↑(finiteSmoothSet R H))
      (↑(smoothBuchstabCodeSet R H))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  rw [smoothBuchstabCodeSet, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert] at hz
  rcases hz with rfl | hz
  · refine ⟨1, mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr ⟨by norm_num, hH, isSmooth_one R⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [smoothBuchstabRawCode]
  · rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨code, hcode, rfl⟩
    rcases code with ⟨p, m⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_sigma] at hcode
    have hpMem : p ∈ Nat.primesLE R := hcode.1
    have hmMem : m ∈ finiteSmoothSet p (H / p) := hcode.2
    have hpPrime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpMem
    have hpLeR : p ≤ R := Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hpMem
    have hmData := mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hmMem
    have hnPos : 0 < p * m := Nat.mul_pos hpPrime.pos hmData.1
    have hnLe : p * m ≤ H := by
      have := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hpPrime.pos).mp hmData.2.1
      simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using this
    have hnSmoothP : IsSmooth p (p * m) := by
      refine ⟨hnPos.ne', ?_⟩
      intro r hr
      have hrPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr
      have hrDvd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr
      rcases hrPrime.dvd_mul.mp hrDvd with hrp | hrm
      · rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hpPrime).mp hrp with hrone | hrequal
        · exact (hrPrime.ne_one hrone).elim
        · exact hrequal.le
      · exact hmData.2.2.2 r <| Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
          ⟨hrPrime, hrm, hmData.2.2.1⟩
    have hnSmoothR : IsSmooth R (p * m) := hnSmoothP.mono hpLeR
    have hpLeLpf : p ≤ largestPrimeFactor (p * m) :=
      prime_le_largestPrimeFactor hpPrime hnPos.ne' (Nat.dvd_mul_right p m)
    have hlpfLe : largestPrimeFactor (p * m) ≤ p :=
      hnSmoothP.largestPrimeFactor_le hpPrime.one_le
    have hlpf : largestPrimeFactor (p * m) = p := le_antisymm hlpfLe hpLeLpf
    have hnOne : p * m ≠ 1 := by
      have hpLe : p ≤ p * m := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right p hmData.1
      intro heq
      exact Nat.not_lt_of_ge (heq ▸ hpLe) hpPrime.one_lt
    refine ⟨p * m, mem_finiteSmoothSet.mpr ⟨hnPos, hnLe, hnSmoothR⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [smoothBuchstabRawCode, if_neg hnOne]
    simp only [hlpf]
    rw [Nat.mul_div_right m hpPrime.pos]

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothBuchstabCodeSet_le
statement:
theorem card_smoothBuchstabCodeSet_le (R H : ℕ) :
    (smoothBuchstabCodeSet R H).card ≤
      1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, finiteSmoothCount p (H / p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := (Nat.primesLE R).sigma fun p ↦ finiteSmoothSet p (H / p)
  calc
    (smoothBuchstabCodeSet R H).card = (insert none (S.image some)).card := by
      rfl
    _ ≤ (S.image some).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ S.card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ = 1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, finiteSmoothCount p (H / p) := by
      rw [show S.card = ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        (finiteSmoothSet p (H / p)).card by
          exact Finset.card_sigma _ _]
      simp only [finiteSmoothCount]
      omega

name: RankAmplification.card_smoothBuchstabCodeSet
statement:
theorem card_smoothBuchstabCodeSet (R H : ℕ) :
    (smoothBuchstabCodeSet R H).card =
      1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, finiteSmoothCount p (H / p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := (Nat.primesLE R).sigma fun p ↦ finiteSmoothSet p (H / p)
  calc
    (smoothBuchstabCodeSet R H).card = (insert none (S.image some)).card := by
      rfl
    _ = (S.image some).card + 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
      simp
    _ = S.card + 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective S (Option.some_injective _)]
    _ = 1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, finiteSmoothCount p (H / p) := by
      rw [show S.card = ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        (finiteSmoothSet p (H / p)).card by
          exact Finset.card_sigma _ _]
      simp only [finiteSmoothCount]
      omega

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_one_add_sum_smaller
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_one_add_sum_smaller (R H : ℕ) :
    finiteSmoothCount R H ≤
      1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, finiteSmoothCount p (H / p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteSmoothCount]
  exact (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn smoothBuchstabRawCode
    (fun _ hn ↦ smoothBuchstabRawCode_mem_codeSet hn)
    (fun _ ha _ hb hab ↦ smoothBuchstabRawCode_injOn
      (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp ha).1 (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hb).1 hab)).trans
    (card_smoothBuchstabCodeSet_le R H)

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_eq_one_add_sum_smaller
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_eq_one_add_sum_smaller
    (R : ℕ) {H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    finiteSmoothCount R H =
      1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, finiteSmoothCount p (H / p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteSmoothCount, ← card_smoothBuchstabCodeSet R H]
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun n _ ↦ smoothBuchstabRawCode n)
  · exact fun n hn ↦ smoothBuchstabRawCode_mem_codeSet hn
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    exact smoothBuchstabRawCode_injOn
      (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp ha).1 (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hb).1 hab
  · intro z hz
    rcases smoothBuchstabRawCode_surjOn hH hz with ⟨n, hn, hcode⟩
    exact ⟨n, hn, hcode⟩

name: RankAmplification.smoothBuchstab_induction
statement:
theorem smoothBuchstab_induction
    (P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (hzero : ∀ R, P R 0)
    (hstep : ∀ R H, 0 < H →
      (∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, P p (H / p)) → P R H) :
    ∀ R H, P R H
proof:
:= by
  intro R H
  revert R
  induction H using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h H ih =>
      intro R
      by_cases hH : H = 0
      · subst H
        exact hzero R
      · apply hstep R H (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hH)
        intro p hp
        exact ih (H / p)
          (Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hH)
            (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt) p

name: RankAmplification.smoothRankinWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem smoothRankinWeight_nonneg (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ smoothRankinWeight s n
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) _

name: RankAmplification.smoothRankinWeight_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smoothRankinWeight_one (s : ℝ) : smoothRankinWeight s 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [smoothRankinWeight]

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_smoothRankinWeight_smooth
statement:
theorem hasSum_smoothRankinWeight_smooth (R : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasSum (fun m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ smoothRankinWeight s m)
      (softenedMertensProduct R s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := EulerProduct.summable_and_hasSum_smoothNumbers_prod_primesBelow_geometric
    (f := reciprocalRpowMonoidHom s)
    (fun {_p} hp ↦ norm_reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_prime_lt_one hs hp)
    (R + 1)
  simpa only [softenedMertensProduct, Nat.primesLE,
    reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_apply, smoothRankinWeight] using h.2

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothRankinSum_le_softenedMertensProduct
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothRankinSum_le_softenedMertensProduct
    {R H : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) R H (-s) ≤ softenedMertensProduct R s
proof:
:= by
  let e : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R H} ↪ (R + 1).smoothNumbers :=
    { toFun := fun m ↦
        ⟨m.1, isSmooth_iff_mem_smoothNumbers_succ.mp
          (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp m.2).2.2⟩
      inj' := fun a b hab ↦ Subtype.ext <|
        congrArg (fun z : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ (z : ℕ)) hab }
  let A : Finset ((R + 1).smoothNumbers) := Finset.univ.map e
  have hsmooth := hasSum_smoothRankinWeight_smooth R hs
  have hle : (∑ m ∈ A, smoothRankinWeight s m) ≤ softenedMertensProduct R s := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ A, smoothRankinWeight s m) ≤
          ∑' m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers, smoothRankinWeight s m :=
        hsmooth.summable.sum_le_tsum A
          (fun m _ ↦ smoothRankinWeight_nonneg s m)
      _ = softenedMertensProduct R s := hsmooth.tsum_eq
  have hfinite :
      finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) R H (-s) =
        ∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R H}, smoothRankinWeight s m := by
    rw [finiteSmoothRpowSum, ← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
    simp [smoothRankinWeight]
  have hmap :
      (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R H}, smoothRankinWeight s m) =
        ∑ m ∈ A, smoothRankinWeight s m := by
    change (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R H}, smoothRankinWeight s m) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.map e, smoothRankinWeight s m
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    rfl
  rw [hfinite, hmap]
  exact hle

name: RankAmplification.softenedMertensProduct_pos
statement:
theorem softenedMertensProduct_pos (R : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 < softenedMertensProduct R s
proof:
:= by
  unfold softenedMertensProduct
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp
  have hratio : (p : ℝ) ^ (-s) < 1 :=
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hprime.one_lt)
      (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.natCast_rpow_one_sub
statement:
theorem natCast_rpow_one_sub {H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (δ : ℝ) :
    (H : ℝ) ^ (1 - δ) =
      (H : ℝ) * Real.exp (-δ * Real.log H)
proof:
:= by
  have hHreal : 0 < (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hH
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hHreal]
  rw [show Real.log (H : ℝ) * (1 - δ) =
    Real.log H + (-δ * Real.log H) by ring, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hHreal]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_exp_saddle
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_exp_saddle
    {R H : ℕ} {δ E : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hEuler : Real.log (softenedMertensProduct R (1 - δ)) ≤ E) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      (H : ℝ) * Real.exp (-δ * Real.log H + E)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := sub_pos.mpr hδ1
  have hcount : (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) =
      ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R H, (1 : ℝ) := by
    simp [finiteSmoothCount]
  have hrankin := finiteSmoothWeightedCount_le_rankin
    (w := fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) (R := R) (X := H) (s := 1 - δ)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hδ1.le) (fun _ _ ↦ zero_le_one)
  have heuler := finiteSmoothRankinSum_le_softenedMertensProduct
    (R := R) (H := H) hs
  have hproduct : softenedMertensProduct R (1 - δ) ≤ Real.exp E := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (softenedMertensProduct_pos R hs)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hEuler
  rw [hcount]
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R H, (1 : ℝ)) ≤
        (H : ℝ) ^ (1 - δ) *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun _ ↦ 1) R H (-(1 - δ)) := hrankin
    _ ≤ (H : ℝ) ^ (1 - δ) * softenedMertensProduct R (1 - δ) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heuler (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
    _ ≤ (H : ℝ) ^ (1 - δ) * Real.exp E := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hproduct (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
    _ = (H : ℝ) * Real.exp (-δ * Real.log H + E) := by
      rw [natCast_rpow_one_sub hH]
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.softenedMertensProduct_eq_rankinEulerMajorant
statement:
theorem softenedMertensProduct_eq_rankinEulerMajorant
    (R : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    softenedMertensProduct R s = rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 1 s
proof:
:= by
  rw [softenedMertensProduct, rankinEulerMajorant]
  simp [rankinEulerRatio]

name: RankAmplification.rankOneEulerLoss_pos
statement:
theorem rankOneEulerLoss_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 < rankOneEulerLoss s
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankOneEulerLoss]
  exact div_pos zero_lt_one (sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs))

name: RankAmplification.log_softenedMertensProduct_le_rankOneEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum
statement:
theorem log_softenedMertensProduct_le_rankOneEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    Real.log (softenedMertensProduct R (1 - δ)) ≤
      rankOneEulerLoss (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := sub_pos.mpr hδ1
  have hP : ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, 1 < p := fun p hp ↦
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt
  have hlog := log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_sum (j := 1) hP hs
  let ρ : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ))
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hρlt : ρ < 1 :=
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)
  have hlocal (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ Nat.primesLE R) :
      rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ)) ≤
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - ρ) := by
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast Nat.two_le_of_mem_primesLE hp
    have hqpos : 0 < rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) :=
      rankinEulerRatio_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (hP p hp)) _
    have hqlt : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) < 1 :=
      rankinEulerRatio_lt_one (hP p hp) hs
    have hqρ : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ≤ ρ := by
      rw [rankinEulerRatio]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hp2 (neg_nonpos.mpr hs.le)
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hqlt) (sub_pos.mpr hρlt)).2
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hqρ 1) hqpos.le
  rw [softenedMertensProduct_eq_rankinEulerMajorant]
  calc
    Real.log (rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 1 (1 - δ)) ≤
        (1 : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
          rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using hlog
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - ρ) := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp ↦ hlocal p hp
    _ = rankOneEulerLoss (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ := by
      have hexp : -(1 - δ) = -1 + δ := by ring
      dsimp [ρ]
      rw [rankOneEulerLoss, primeRankinSum]
      simp_rw [rankinEulerRatio, hexp]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.rankOneEulerHalfLoss_pos
statement: theorem rankOneEulerHalfLoss_pos : 0 < rankOneEulerHalfLoss
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankOneEulerHalfLoss]
  exact div_pos zero_lt_one (sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.rankOneEulerLoss_le_half
statement:
theorem rankOneEulerLoss_le_half {δ : ℝ} (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    rankOneEulerLoss (1 - δ) ≤ rankOneEulerHalfLoss
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := sub_pos.mpr hδ1
  have hp := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    (show -(1 - δ) ≤ -(1 / 2 : ℝ) by linarith)
  have hden : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) := sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)
  have hdenHalf : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  rw [rankOneEulerLoss, rankOneEulerHalfLoss]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden hdenHalf).2
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.log_softenedMertensProduct_le_hildebrandChebyshevEulerError
statement:
theorem log_softenedMertensProduct_le_hildebrandChebyshevEulerError
    {R H : ℕ} (hH : hildebrandSaddleThreshold ≤ H)
    (h : HildebrandSmoothRange R H) :
    Real.log (softenedMertensProduct R (1 - hildebrandSaddleShift H R)) ≤
      hildebrandChebyshevEulerError R H
proof:
:= by
  have hδpos := hildebrandSaddleShift_pos h
  have hδhalf := hildebrandSaddleShift_le_half hH h
  have hδone : hildebrandSaddleShift H R < 1 := hδhalf.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hR3 : 3 ≤ R := h.2.1
  have hR : 2 ≤ R := by omega
  have hprime := primeRankinSum_le_full (R := R)
    (δ := hildebrandSaddleShift H R) hR hδpos hδhalf
  have hloss := rankOneEulerLoss_le_half hδone hδhalf
  have hprime0 := primeRankinSum_nonneg R (hildebrandSaddleShift H R)
  have hhalf0 := rankOneEulerHalfLoss_pos.le
  exact (log_softenedMertensProduct_le_rankOneEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum
      hδone).trans <| by
    rw [hildebrandChebyshevEulerError]
    exact mul_le_mul hloss hprime hprime0 hhalf0

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandChebyshev
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandChebyshev
    {R H : ℕ} (hH : hildebrandSaddleThreshold ≤ H)
    (h : HildebrandSmoothRange R H) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      (H : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU H R *
            (Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))) +
          hildebrandChebyshevEulerError R H)
proof:
:= by
  have hδhalf := hildebrandSaddleShift_le_half hH h
  have hδone : hildebrandSaddleShift H R < 1 := hδhalf.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hbound := finiteSmoothCount_le_exp_saddle h.1 hδone
    (log_softenedMertensProduct_le_hildebrandChebyshevEulerError hH h)
  have hshiftNeg :
      -hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
        -rankinU H R *
          (Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))) := by
    have hRone : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h.2.1
    rw [show -hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
      -(hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H) by ring,
      hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH hRone]
    ring
  rw [hshiftNeg] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_of_euler
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_of_euler
    {C : ℝ} {R H : ℕ} (hH : hildebrandSaddleThreshold ≤ H)
    (h : HildebrandSmoothRange R H)
    (hEuler :
      Real.log (softenedMertensProduct R (1 - hildebrandSaddleShift H R)) ≤
        rankinU H R + C * dickmanLogErrorScale (rankinU H R)) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      (H : ℝ) * dickmanSaddleUpperDensity C (rankinU H R)
proof:
:= by
  have hδhalf := hildebrandSaddleShift_le_half hH h
  have hδone : hildebrandSaddleShift H R < 1 := hδhalf.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hbound := finiteSmoothCount_le_exp_saddle h.1 hδone hEuler
  have hshiftNeg :
      -hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
        -rankinU H R *
          (Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))) := by
    have hRone : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h.2.1
    rw [show -hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
      -(hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H) by ring,
      hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH hRone]
    ring
  rw [hshiftNeg] at hbound
  unfold dickmanSaddleUpperDensity dickmanSaddlePhase
  convert hbound using 1
  congr 2
  ring

name: RankAmplification.hasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound_of_sharpEuler
statement:
theorem hasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound_of_sharpEuler
    {C : ℝ} {H₀ : ℕ} (hthreshold : hildebrandSaddleThreshold ≤ H₀)
    (hEuler : HasSharpHildebrandEulerBound C H₀) :
    HasUniformHildebrandSmoothUpperBound C H₀
proof:
:= by
  intro R H hH hrange
  exact finiteSmoothCount_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_of_euler
    (hthreshold.trans hH) hrange (hEuler R H hH hrange)

name: RankAmplification.log3_isLittleO_log2
statement: theorem log3_isLittleO_log2 : log3 =o[atTop] log2
proof:
:= by
  have h := iteratedLog_succ_isLittleO 2
  apply h.congr'
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl

name: RankAmplification.log3_isLittleO_scaleV
statement: theorem log3_isLittleO_scaleV : log3 =o[atTop] scaleV
proof:
:=
  log3_isLittleO_log2.trans_isBigO log2_isLittleO_scaleV.isBigO

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log3_le_const_mul_log2
statement:
theorem eventually_log3_le_const_mul_log2 {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop, log3 x ≤ c * log2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := log3_isLittleO_log2.bound hc
  filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_log3_pos, eventually_log2_pos] with x h h3 h2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h3.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg h2.le] at h
  exact h

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_scaleA_le_log3
statement:
theorem eventually_log_scaleA_le_log3 :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop, Real.log (scaleA x) ≤ log3 x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_scaleA_le_log2] with x hA hAle
  rw [log3_eq]
  exact Real.log_le_log hA hAle

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_scaleV_ge
statement:
theorem eventually_log_scaleV_ge :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop, (log2 x - log3 x) / 2 ≤ Real.log (scaleV x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
    eventually_log_scaleA_le_log3] with x hL hA hlog
  have h := two_mul_log_scaleV hL hA
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_polylogScaleError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_polylogScaleError_zero (a b : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (polylogScaleError a b) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hV : Tendsto (fun x ↦ Real.log (scaleV x) / scaleV x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp tendsto_scaleV_atTop
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h
  have h3 : Tendsto (fun x ↦ log3 x / scaleV x) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log3_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hsum : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ a * (Real.log (scaleV x) / scaleV x) + b * (log3 x / scaleV x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (hV.const_mul a).add (h3.const_mul b)
  apply hsum.congr
  intro x
  unfold polylogScaleError
  ring

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_3_polylog_eq_exp
statement:
theorem lemma10_3_polylog_eq_exp (a b : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (polylogScaleError a b) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
        scaleV x ^ a * log2 x ^ b =
          Real.exp (polylogScaleError a b x * scaleV x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_polylogScaleError_zero a b, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos]
    with x hL hA hL2
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA)
  have hexp : polylogScaleError a b x * scaleV x
      = Real.log (scaleV x) * a + Real.log (log2 x) * b := by
    simp only [polylogScaleError, log3_eq]
    field_simp
  rw [hexp, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hV, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hL2, ← Real.exp_add]

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_3_upperY_pow_lt_rpow
statement:
theorem lemma10_3_upperY_pow_lt_rpow {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      fixedRankUpperY J x ^ (J + 1) < x ^ (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hc := tendsto_scaleV_div_sqrt_log2_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop
    (2 * (J : ℝ) * ((J : ℝ) + 1) * Real.sqrt J)
  filter_upwards [hc, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hcx hL hA hx
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcx hG
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, scaleV_mul_scaleG hG.ne'] at hmul
  have hkey : ((J : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.sqrt J * scaleG x)
      < scaleL x * (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ))) := by
    have hrhs : scaleL x * (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ)))
        = scaleL x / Real.sqrt (log2 x) / (2 * (J : ℝ)) := by
      unfold fixedRankEpsilon
      ring
    rw [hrhs, lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (J : ℝ))]
    have hcomm : ((J : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) * (2 * (J : ℝ))
        = 2 * (J : ℝ) * ((J : ℝ) + 1) * Real.sqrt J * scaleG x := by ring
    rw [hcomm]
    exact hmul
  calc
    fixedRankUpperY J x ^ (J + 1)
        = Real.exp (((J : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.sqrt J * scaleG x)) := by
          rw [fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG x hJ, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
    _ < Real.exp (scaleL x * (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ)))) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.2 hkey
    _ = x ^ (fixedRankEpsilon x / (2 * (J : ℝ))) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < x)]
          rfl

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankEpsRankRatio_eq
statement:
theorem fixedRankEpsRankRatio_eq {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) :
    fixedRankEpsRankRatio J x
      = scaleV x / (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J))
proof:
:= by
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hsJ : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt J := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hs2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  unfold fixedRankEpsRankRatio fixedRankEpsilon
  rw [Real.log_rpow hx, log_fixedRankUpperY x hJ]
  simp only [scaleV_eq, scaleL_eq]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankHalfRankRatio_eq
statement:
theorem fixedRankHalfRankRatio_eq {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    fixedRankHalfRankRatio J x = scaleV x / (2 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J))
proof:
:= by
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hsJ : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt J := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hJR : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  unfold fixedRankHalfRankRatio
  rw [Real.log_rpow hx, log_fixedRankUpperY x hJ]
  simp only [scaleV_eq, scaleL_eq]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log2_div_eight_le_log_epsRatio
statement:
theorem eventually_log2_div_eight_le_log_epsRatio {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, log2 x / 8 ≤ Real.log (fixedRankEpsRankRatio J x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcJ : (0 : ℝ) < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J :=
    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
    eventually_log_scaleV_ge, eventually_log3_le_const_mul_log2 (c := 1 / 8) (by norm_num),
    tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * Real.log ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J)),
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hL hA hL2 hlogV hlog3 hbig hx
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hs2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  rw [fixedRankEpsRankRatio_eq hJ (by linarith) hL hA hL2,
    Real.log_div hV.ne' (mul_pos hs2 hcJ).ne', Real.log_mul hs2.ne' hcJ.ne',
    Real.log_sqrt hL2.le, ← log3_eq]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log2_div_eight_le_log_halfRatio
statement:
theorem eventually_log2_div_eight_le_log_halfRatio {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, log2 x / 8 ≤ Real.log (fixedRankHalfRankRatio J x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcJ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J) :=
    by positivity
  have hcJ' : (0 : ℝ) < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J :=
    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
    eventually_log_scaleV_ge, eventually_log3_le_const_mul_log2 (c := 1 / 8) (by norm_num),
    tendsto_log2_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * Real.log (2 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J))),
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hL hA hL2 hlogV hlog3 hbig hx
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  rw [fixedRankHalfRankRatio_eq hJ (by linarith) hL hA,
    Real.log_div hV.ne' hcJ.ne']
  have hcJ'' : (0 : ℝ) < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J := hcJ'
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_mul_log_div_scaleG_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_mul_log_div_scaleG_atTop {u ψ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 ≤ u x)
    (hψ : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, ψ x ≤ Real.log (u x))
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun x ↦ u x * ψ x / scaleG x) atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ u x * Real.log (u x) / scaleG x) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop ?_ hlim
  filter_upwards [hu, hψ, eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x h0 hl hL hA
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hprod : u x * ψ x ≤ u x * Real.log (u x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl h0
  have e1 : u x * ψ x / scaleG x = u x * ψ x * (scaleG x)⁻¹ := by ring
  have e2 : u x * Real.log (u x) / scaleG x = u x * Real.log (u x) * (scaleG x)⁻¹ := by ring
  rw [e1, e2]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod (inv_nonneg.2 hG.le)

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_3_epsRatio_isBigOmega_scaleG
statement:
theorem lemma10_3_epsRatio_isBigOmega_scaleG {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ fixedRankEpsRankRatio J x * Real.log (fixedRankEpsRankRatio J x) / scaleG x)
      atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hcJ : (0 : ℝ) < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J :=
    mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
  refine tendsto_mul_log_div_scaleG_atTop ?_
    (eventually_log2_div_eight_le_log_epsRatio hJ) ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hL hA hL2 hx
    have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
    have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
    have hs2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (log2 x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
    rw [fixedRankEpsRankRatio_eq hJ (by linarith) hL hA hL2]
    exact (div_pos hV (mul_pos hs2 hcJ)).le
  · have hbase : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (log2 x) / scaleA x / (8 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J))) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_sqrt_log2_div_scaleA_atTop.atTop_div_const (by positivity)
    apply hbase.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos, eventually_log2_pos,
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hL hA hL2 hx
    have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
    have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
    have hAV : scaleA x * scaleV x = scaleG x := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
    rw [fixedRankEpsRankRatio_eq hJ (by linarith) hL hA hL2]
    set s := Real.sqrt (log2 x) with hsdef
    have hs2 : (0 : ℝ) < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
    have hsq : s ^ 2 = log2 x := Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le
    rw [← hsq, ← hAV]
    field_simp

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_3_halfRatio_isBigOmega_scaleG
statement:
theorem lemma10_3_halfRatio_isBigOmega_scaleG {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ fixedRankHalfRankRatio J x * Real.log (fixedRankHalfRankRatio J x) / scaleG x)
      atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hcJ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J) := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J :=
      mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ))
    linarith
  refine tendsto_mul_log_div_scaleG_atTop ?_
    (eventually_log2_div_eight_le_log_halfRatio hJ) ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hL hA hx
    have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
    have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
    rw [fixedRankHalfRankRatio_eq hJ (by linarith) hL hA]
    exact (div_pos hV hcJ).le
  · have hbase : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ log2 x / scaleA x / (8 * (2 * ((J : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J)))) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_log2_div_scaleA_atTop.atTop_div_const (by linarith)
    apply hbase.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hL hA hx
    have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
    have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
    have hAV : scaleA x * scaleV x = scaleG x := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
    rw [fixedRankHalfRankRatio_eq hJ (by linarith) hL hA, ← hAV]
    field_simp

name: RankAmplification.log_three_mul_movingZ_scaleBookkeeping
statement:
theorem log_three_mul_movingZ_scaleBookkeeping (x : ℝ) :
    Real.log (3 * movingZ x) = Real.log 3 + movingK x
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : movingZ x ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos (movingK x)).ne'

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_mul_log2_three_mul_movingZ_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingJ_mul_log2_three_mul_movingZ_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 (3 * movingZ x)) =o[atTop] movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 (3 * movingZ x)) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x) := by
    have hKbound := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
    have hLlarge : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 2 * Real.log 3 ≤ scaleL x :=
      tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * Real.log 3)
    apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
    filter_upwards [eventually_two_le_movingJ, eventually_log2_pos, eventually_scaleL_pos,
      eventually_movingK_pos, tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1, hKbound,
      hLlarge] with x hJ hL2 hL hK hKone hKbd hLbig
    have hlog3nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 3 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hKle : movingK x ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * scaleL x := by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hKbd
      exact hKbd
    simp only [scaleL_eq] at hKle hLbig
    have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log 3 + movingK x := by linarith
    have hinnerOne : 1 ≤ Real.log 3 + movingK x := by linarith
    have hinnerLe : Real.log 3 + movingK x ≤ Real.log x := by linarith
    have hnum : 0 ≤ log2 (3 * movingZ x) := by
      rw [log2_eq, log_three_mul_movingZ_scaleBookkeeping]
      exact Real.log_nonneg hinnerOne
    have hnumLe : log2 (3 * movingZ x) ≤ log2 x := by
      rw [log2_eq, log_three_mul_movingZ_scaleBookkeeping, log2_eq]
      exact Real.log_le_log hinnerPos hinnerLe
    have hJone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ movingJ x by omega)
    have hleft : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * log2 (3 * movingZ x) := by positivity
    have hright : 0 ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 x := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hleft, Real.norm_of_nonneg hright, one_mul]
    nlinarith
  exact hbig.trans_isLittleO movingJ_sq_mul_log2_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_mul_sqrt_ratio_div_log2_isLittleO_etaR
statement:
theorem movingJ_mul_sqrt_ratio_div_log2_isLittleO_etaR :
    (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) / log2 x) =o[atTop]
      movingEtaR
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * (log2 x)⁻¹) =O[atTop] (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := movingJ_cast_isBigO_log2.mul (isBigO_refl (fun x : ℝ ↦ (log2 x)⁻¹) atTop)
    refine h.trans ?_
    apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
    filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
    rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hL2.ne']
    simp
  have h2 := h1.mul (isBigO_refl (fun x : ℝ ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) atTop)
  have h3 : (fun x ↦ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) / log2 x) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x)) := by
    refine h2.congr' ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      ring
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      ring
  exact h3.trans_isLittleO sqrt_scaleL_div_log2_isLittleO_etaR

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingUniformTailError_zero

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_15_uniform_family
statement:
theorem lemma10_15_uniform_family {δ : ℝ → ℝ} (hδ : Tendsto δ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto movingUniformTailError atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x in atTop, ∀ H : ℝ, 3 ≤ H → H ≤ 2 * x →
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - δ x * movingEta x * scaleL x ≤ Real.log H →
        movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤
            Real.log H / movingK x * Real.log (Real.log H / movingK x) ∧
          (movingJ x : ℝ) *
              (log2 (3 * movingZ x) +
                Real.log H / movingK x / Real.log (Real.log H / movingK x)) ≤
            movingUniformTailBound x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingUniformTailError_zero, ?_⟩
  have hδ6 : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, δ x ≤ 1 / 6 := by
    have hmem := hδ.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 6 by norm_num))
    filter_upwards [hmem] with x hx
    exact le_of_lt hx
  have hKratio := tendsto_movingK_div_R_half.eventually
    (Ici_mem_nhds (show (1 / 3 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num))
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive, eventually_movingK_pos,
    eventually_movingEta_lt (1 / 8) (by norm_num), eventually_log3_le_eta_mul_log2_div_two,
    hδ6, hKratio, tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 2),
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with
    x hcore hK heta hlog3 hδx hKratio hlog2 hx
  have hL := hcore.1
  have hL2 := hcore.2.1
  have hR := hcore.2.2.2.1
  have hetaPos := hcore.2.2.2.2.1
  have hscaleL : scaleL x = Real.log x := rfl
  have hKle : movingK x ≤ movingK0 x :=
    movingK_le_K0 hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 hcore.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.le
  set r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (scaleL x / log2 x) with hrdef
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hL hL2)
  have hLR : scaleL x / movingR x = r := scaleL_div_movingR_eq_sqrt_div hL hL2
  have hrL2 : r * log2 x = movingR x := by
    have h := ((div_eq_iff hr.ne').mp (movingR_div_sqrt_div_eq_log2 hL hL2)).symm
    simpa [mul_comm] using h
  have hlogr : Real.log r = (log2 x - log3 x) / 2 := by
    rw [hrdef, Real.log_sqrt (div_nonneg hL.le hL2.le), Real.log_div hL.ne' hL2.ne']
    rfl
  have hlogLower : (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x ≤ Real.log r := by
    rw [hlogr]
    linarith
  have hbase : (1 + (7 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x) * r ≤ scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) := by
    have hcoef : 0 < 1 - 4 * movingEta x := by linarith
    have h2K : 2 * movingK x ≤ (1 - 4 * movingEta x) * movingR x := by
      unfold movingK0 at hKle
      linarith
    have hden : 0 < 2 * movingK x := by linarith
    have hq : scaleL x / ((1 - 4 * movingEta x) * movingR x) ≤ scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le hden h2K
    have heq : scaleL x / ((1 - 4 * movingEta x) * movingR x) =
        r / (1 - 4 * movingEta x) := by
      rw [← hLR]
      field_simp
    have haux : (1 + (7 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x) * r ≤ r / (1 - 4 * movingEta x) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hcoef).2
      nlinarith [mul_pos hetaPos hr,
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hetaPos.le hetaPos.le) hr.le]
    rw [heq] at hq
    exact haux.trans hq
  have hKR : (1 / 3 : ℝ) * movingR x ≤ movingK x := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hR).mp
    simpa [mul_comm] using hKratio
  have hLK : scaleL x / movingK x ≤ 3 * r := by
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3 * movingR x := by linarith
    have h1 : scaleL x / movingK x ≤ scaleL x / (1 / 3 * movingR x) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le hpos hKR
    have h2 : scaleL x / (1 / 3 * movingR x) = 3 * (scaleL x / movingR x) := by
      field_simp
    rw [h2, hLR] at h1
    exact h1
  have hLrK : scaleL x ≤ 3 * r * movingK x := (div_le_iff₀ hK).mp hLK
  have htargetCommon : movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤
      (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x := by
    calc
      movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤ movingK0 x + 3 * movingEtaR x :=
        add_le_add hKle le_rfl
      _ = (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x := by
        simp only [movingK0, movingEtaR]
        ring
  have hsaddleCoef : (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x ≤
      ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r) * ((1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x) := by
    have hcoeff : (1 / 2 + movingEta x) ≤
        (1 + 3 * movingEta x) * (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos hetaPos (show 0 < 1 - 3 * movingEta x by linarith)]
    calc
      (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * movingR x = (1 / 2 + movingEta x) * (r * log2 x) := by
        rw [hrL2]
      _ ≤ ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4)) * (r * log2 x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (mul_nonneg hr.le hL2.le)
      _ = ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r) * ((1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x) := by ring
  intro H h3H hH2x hlogH
  have hHpos : (0 : ℝ) < H := by linarith
  have hlogHupper : Real.log H ≤ scaleL x + Real.log 2 := by
    have h1 : Real.log H ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := Real.log_le_log hHpos hH2x
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by linarith : x ≠ 0)] at h1
    linarith
  set v : ℝ := Real.log H / movingK x with hvdef
  have hvge : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - δ x * movingEta x * scaleL x) / movingK x ≤ v := by
    rw [hvdef]
    have hstep := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlogH (inv_nonneg.2 hK.le)
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hstep
  have hLKnn : 0 ≤ scaleL x / movingK x := div_nonneg hL.le hK.le
  have hdivstep : movingEta x * (scaleL x / movingK x) ≤ movingEta x * (3 * r) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLK hetaPos.le
  have hdeltastep : δ x * (movingEta x * (scaleL x / movingK x))
      ≤ (1 / 6 : ℝ) * (movingEta x * (scaleL x / movingK x)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδx (mul_nonneg hetaPos.le hLKnn)
  have hdiv : δ x * movingEta x * scaleL x / movingK x ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * movingEta x * r := by
    have hrewrite : δ x * movingEta x * scaleL x / movingK x
        = δ x * (movingEta x * (scaleL x / movingK x)) := by ring
    rw [hrewrite]
    linarith
  have hvLower : (1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r ≤ v := by
    have hsplit : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - δ x * movingEta x * scaleL x) / movingK x
        = scaleL x / (2 * movingK x) - δ x * movingEta x * scaleL x / movingK x := by
      field_simp
    rw [hsplit] at hvge
    linarith
  have hfactorOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 3 * movingEta x := by linarith
  have hrv : r ≤ v := (le_mul_of_one_le_left hr.le hfactorOne).trans hvLower
  have hvPos : 0 < v := hr.trans_le hrv
  have hlogvLower : (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x ≤ Real.log v :=
    hlogLower.trans (Real.log_le_log hr hrv)
  have hmargin : movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤ v * Real.log v := by
    have hlogLower0 : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x :=
      (mul_pos (by linarith) hL2).le
    have hprodLower : ((1 + 3 * movingEta x) * r) * ((1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x)
        ≤ v * Real.log v :=
      mul_le_mul hvLower hlogvLower hlogLower0 hvPos.le
    exact htargetCommon.trans (hsaddleCoef.trans hprodLower)
  refine ⟨hmargin, ?_⟩
  have hvUpper : v ≤ 6 * r := by
    rw [hvdef, div_le_iff₀ hK]
    linarith
  have hlogvQuarter : log2 x / 4 ≤ Real.log v := by
    have hc : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * log2 x ≤ (1 / 2 - movingEta x / 4) * log2 x :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hL2.le
    linarith
  have hlogvPos : 0 < Real.log v :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < log2 x / 4) hlogvQuarter
  have hratio : v / Real.log v ≤ 24 * r / log2 x := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hlogvPos]
    have hM : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 24 * r / log2 x := div_nonneg (by linarith) hL2.le
    have hstep : 24 * r / log2 x * (log2 x / 4) = 6 * r := by
      field_simp
      ring
    calc
      v ≤ 6 * r := hvUpper
      _ = 24 * r / log2 x * (log2 x / 4) := hstep.symm
      _ ≤ 24 * r / log2 x * Real.log v :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogvQuarter hM
  have hJnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  unfold movingUniformTailBound
  rw [← hrdef]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hJnn

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSourceGauge_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSourceGauge_zero :
    Tendsto movingSourceGauge atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  movingSourceLoss_isLittleO_etaL.tendsto_div_nhds_zero

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingHsrc_mem_uniform_family
statement:
theorem eventually_movingHsrc_mem_uniform_family :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 3 ≤ movingHsrc x ∧ movingHsrc x ≤ 2 * x ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - movingSourceGauge x * movingEta x * scaleL x ≤
        Real.log (movingHsrc x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_lt_movingHsrc, eventually_moving_core_positive,
    eventually_movingK_pos, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x h3 hcore hK hx
  have hL := hcore.1
  have hetaPos := hcore.2.2.2.2.1
  have hscaleL : scaleL x = Real.log x := rfl
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hlossA : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (movingJ x : ℝ) * movingK x :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) hK.le
  have hlossB : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hlog2
  have hloss : 0 ≤ movingSourceLoss x := by
    unfold movingSourceLoss
    linarith
  refine ⟨h3.le, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hthr : movingSourceLogThreshold x ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (show (0 : ℝ) < x by linarith)),
        movingSourceLogThreshold_eq]
      linarith
    calc
      movingHsrc x = Real.exp (movingSourceLogThreshold x) := rfl
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (2 * x)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hthr
      _ = 2 * x := Real.exp_log (by linarith)
  · have hetaNe : movingEta x ≠ 0 := hetaPos.ne'
    have hLNe : scaleL x ≠ 0 := hL.ne'
    have hgauge : movingSourceGauge x * movingEta x * scaleL x = movingSourceLoss x := by
      unfold movingSourceGauge movingEtaL
      field_simp
    have hval : Real.log (movingHsrc x)
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - movingSourceGauge x * movingEta x * scaleL x := by
      rw [log_movingHsrc, movingSourceLogThreshold_eq, hgauge]
    exact le_of_eq hval.symm

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_15_uniform_family_source_margin
statement:
theorem lemma10_15_uniform_family_source_margin :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
      movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤ movingVsrc x * Real.log (movingVsrc x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(lemma10_15_uniform_family tendsto_movingSourceGauge_zero).2,
    eventually_movingHsrc_mem_uniform_family] with x hfam hmem
  have h := (hfam (movingHsrc x) hmem.1 hmem.2.1 hmem.2.2).1
  unfold movingVsrc
  exact h

name: RankAmplification.log_movingHtr
statement:
theorem log_movingHtr (x : ℝ) :
    Real.log (movingHtr x) = (scaleL x - 3 * movingK x + Real.log 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingHtr, Real.log_exp]

name: RankAmplification.movingUtrMinus_eq_log_movingHtr_div
statement:
theorem movingUtrMinus_eq_log_movingHtr_div (x : ℝ) :
    movingUtrMinus x = Real.log (movingHtr x) / movingK x
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_movingHtr]
  unfold movingUtrMinus
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingTransferLoss_isLittleO_etaL
statement: theorem movingTransferLoss_isLittleO_etaL : movingTransferLoss =o[atTop] movingEtaL
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : movingTransferLoss =O[atTop] movingSourceLoss := by
    apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
    filter_upwards [eventually_two_le_movingJ,
      tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with x hJ hK1
    have hJ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (movingJ x : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ movingJ x by omega)
    have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hlog2le : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith
    have hprod : 0 ≤ ((movingJ x : ℝ) - 1) * movingK x :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hleft : 0 ≤ movingTransferLoss x := by
      unfold movingTransferLoss
      linarith
    have hright : 0 ≤ movingSourceLoss x := by
      unfold movingSourceLoss
      nlinarith
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hleft, Real.norm_of_nonneg hright, one_mul]
    unfold movingTransferLoss movingSourceLoss
    nlinarith
  exact hbig.trans_isLittleO movingSourceLoss_isLittleO_etaL

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingTransferGauge_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingTransferGauge_zero :
    Tendsto movingTransferGauge atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:=
  movingTransferLoss_isLittleO_etaL.tendsto_div_nhds_zero

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingHtr_mem_uniform_family
statement:
theorem eventually_movingHtr_mem_uniform_family :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 3 ≤ movingHtr x ∧ movingHtr x ≤ 2 * x ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - movingTransferGauge x * movingEta x * scaleL x ≤
        Real.log (movingHtr x)
proof:
:= by
  have hKsmall := movingK_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8)
  filter_upwards [eventually_moving_core_positive, eventually_movingK_pos, hKsmall,
    tendsto_movingK_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    tendsto_scaleL_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * Real.log 3),
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hcore hK hKsm hK1 hLbig hx
  have hL := hcore.1
  have hetaPos := hcore.2.2.2.2.1
  have hscaleL : scaleL x = Real.log x := rfl
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hKle : movingK x ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * scaleL x := by
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hK.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hKsm
    exact hKsm
  have hlog2le : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hthree : Real.log 3 ≤ (scaleL x - 3 * movingK x + Real.log 2) / 2 := by
      linarith
    calc
      (3 : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 3) := (Real.exp_log (by norm_num)).symm
      _ ≤ movingHtr x := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hthree
  · have hthr : (scaleL x - 3 * movingK x + Real.log 2) / 2 ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (show (0 : ℝ) < x by linarith))]
      linarith
    calc
      movingHtr x = Real.exp ((scaleL x - 3 * movingK x + Real.log 2) / 2) := rfl
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (2 * x)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hthr
      _ = 2 * x := Real.exp_log (by linarith)
  · have hetaNe : movingEta x ≠ 0 := hetaPos.ne'
    have hLNe : scaleL x ≠ 0 := hL.ne'
    have hgauge : movingTransferGauge x * movingEta x * scaleL x = movingTransferLoss x := by
      unfold movingTransferGauge movingEtaL
      field_simp
    have hval : Real.log (movingHtr x)
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * scaleL x - movingTransferGauge x * movingEta x * scaleL x := by
      rw [log_movingHtr, hgauge]
      unfold movingTransferLoss
      ring
    exact le_of_eq hval.symm

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_15_uniform_family_transfer_margin
statement:
theorem lemma10_15_uniform_family_transfer_margin :
    ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
      movingK x + 3 * movingEtaR x ≤ movingUtrMinus x * Real.log (movingUtrMinus x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(lemma10_15_uniform_family tendsto_movingTransferGauge_zero).2,
    eventually_movingHtr_mem_uniform_family] with x hfam hmem
  have h := (hfam (movingHtr x) hmem.1 hmem.2.1 hmem.2.2).1
  rw [movingUtrMinus_eq_log_movingHtr_div]

name: RankAmplification.lemma10_15_uniform_family_named_margins
statement:
