name: RankAmplification.IsDiagonalRepresentation.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet_div
statement:
theorem IsDiagonalRepresentation.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet_div
    {x h Y n j r : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hnx : n ≤ x)
    (hrep : IsDiagonalRepresentation h Y n j r) :
    n ∈ diagonalPrimeValueSet (x / j) h j
proof:
:= by
  have hj : 0 < j := zero_lt_one.trans_le hrep.1.1
  have hA : 0 < diagonalA h j := diagonalA_pos hj
  have hstep : r ≤ diagonalA h j * r + 1 :=
    le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left r hA) (Nat.le_succ _)
  have hrj : r * j ≤ x := by
    calc r * j = j * r := Nat.mul_comm _ _
      _ ≤ j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left j hstep
      _ = n := hrep.2.2.1.symm
      _ ≤ x := hnx
  have hrdiv : r ≤ x / j := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hj).mpr hrj
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  refine ⟨r, ?_, hrep.2.2.1.symm⟩
  exact (mem_diagonalPrimePairSet hh hj).mpr
    ⟨hrep.2.1, hrdiv, hrep.2.2.2.2.1, hrep.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_div
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_div {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ⊆
      (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).biUnion fun j ↦ diagonalPrimeValueSet (x / j) h j
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hnData := mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mp hn
  obtain ⟨j, r, hrep⟩ := hnData.2.2
  have hjn : j ≤ n := by
    rw [hrep.2.2.1]
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left j (show 1 ≤ diagonalA h j * r + 1 by omega)
  refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, ?_, hrep.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet_div hh hnData.2.1⟩
  exact sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo hh hrep.1 (hjn.trans hnData.2.1)

name: RankAmplification.card_diagonalPrimePairSet_le
statement:
theorem card_diagonalPrimePairSet_le (h j R : ℕ) :
    (diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : diagonalPrimePairSet h j R ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 R := by
    intro r hr
    rw [diagonalPrimePairSet, AffinePrimePair.mem_primePairSet] at hr
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hr.1, hr.2.1⟩
  calc (diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card ≤ (Finset.Icc 1 R).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = R := by simp

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_div
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_div {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y ≤
      ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount]
  calc (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y).card
      ≤ ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).biUnion
          fun j ↦ diagonalPrimeValueSet (x / j) h j).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_div hh)
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (diagonalPrimeValueSet (x / j) h j).card :=
        Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ card_diagonalPrimeValueSet_le (x / j) h j

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_split
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_split {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y ≤
      (∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
          (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card) +
      (∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), x / j)
proof:
:= by
  refine (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_div hh).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x)
      (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x) fun j ↦ (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card]
  exact Nat.add_le_add le_rfl
    (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ card_diagonalPrimePairSet_le h j (x / j))

name: RankAmplification.sqrt_le_div_of_mul_self_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_le_div_of_mul_self_le {x j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjx : j * j ≤ x) :
    Nat.sqrt x ≤ x / j
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).mpr ?_
  calc Nat.sqrt x * j ≤ Nat.sqrt x * Nat.sqrt x :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_sqrt.mpr hjx)
    _ ≤ x := Nat.sqrt_le x

name: RankAmplification.three_le_div_of_mul_self_le
statement:
theorem three_le_div_of_mul_self_le {x j : ℕ} (hx : 9 ≤ x) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjx : j * j ≤ x) :
    3 ≤ x / j
proof:
:=
  (Nat.le_sqrt.mpr (by omega : 3 * 3 ≤ x)).trans (sqrt_le_div_of_mul_self_le hj hjx)

name: RankAmplification.le_div_pow_three_of_mul_self_le
statement:
theorem le_div_pow_three_of_mul_self_le {x j : ℕ} (hx : 9 ≤ x) (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjx : j * j ≤ x) : x ≤ (x / j) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hs3 : 3 ≤ Nat.sqrt x := Nat.le_sqrt.mpr (by omega)
  have hsq : Nat.sqrt x ≤ x / j := sqrt_le_div_of_mul_self_le hj hjx
  have hlt : x < (Nat.sqrt x + 1) * (Nat.sqrt x + 1) := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt x
  have hcube : (Nat.sqrt x + 1) * (Nat.sqrt x + 1) ≤ (Nat.sqrt x) ^ 3 := by nlinarith
  exact (hlt.le.trans hcube).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hsq 3)

name: RankAmplification.div_le_sqrt_of_not_mul_self_le
statement:
theorem div_le_sqrt_of_not_mul_self_le {x j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjx : ¬ j * j ≤ x) :
    x / j ≤ Nat.sqrt x
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : x / j < j := by
    by_contra hcon
    exact hjx ((Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).mp (not_lt.mp hcon))
  refine Nat.le_sqrt.mpr ?_
  calc x / j * (x / j) ≤ x / j * j := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlt.le
    _ ≤ x := Nat.div_mul_le_self x j

name: RankAmplification.logSquaredScale_div_le_of_mul_self_le
statement:
theorem logSquaredScale_div_le_of_mul_self_le {x j : ℕ} (hx : 9 ≤ x) (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjx : j * j ≤ x) :
    AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale (x / j)
      ≤ 9 * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * (1 / (j : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hq3 : 3 ≤ x / j := three_le_div_of_mul_self_le hx hj hjx
  have hcube : x ≤ (x / j) ^ 3 := le_div_pow_three_of_mul_self_le hx hj hjx
  have hjR : (0 : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hxR : (9 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hqR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq3
  have hL : 0 < Real.log (x : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hM : 0 < Real.log ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hcubeR : (x : ℝ) ≤ ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 := by exact_mod_cast hcube
  have hlog : Real.log (x : ℝ) ≤ 3 * Real.log ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hstep := Real.log_le_log (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (x : ℝ)) hcubeR
    rw [Real.log_pow] at hstep
    exact_mod_cast hstep
  have hsq : (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * (Real.log ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hL, hM, hlog]
  have hqx : ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_div_le
  have hLne : Real.log (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hL
  have hjne : (j : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hjR
  have hA : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / (j : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hkey : (x : ℝ) / (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / (j : ℝ)) * (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2
      ≤ (x : ℝ) / (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / (j : ℝ)) *
          (9 * (Real.log ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hA
  have hid : (x : ℝ) / (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / (j : ℝ)) * (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2
      = (x : ℝ) / (j : ℝ) := by
    field_simp
  unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hM 2)]
  have hrw : 9 * ((x : ℝ) / (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2) * (1 / (j : ℝ)) *
        (Real.log ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2
      = (x : ℝ) / (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / (j : ℝ)) *
          (9 * (Real.log ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [hrw]
  calc ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (j : ℝ) := hqx
    _ = (x : ℝ) / (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / (j : ℝ)) * (Real.log (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 := hid.symm
    _ ≤ _ := hkey

name: RankAmplification.sum_below_split_le
statement:
theorem sum_below_split_le {x h : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hx : 9 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : ∀ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, ∀ R : ℕ, 3 ≤ R →
      ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤ C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R) :
    ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
        ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ 9 * C * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) ≤ AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by
    unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
    positivity
  have hconst : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC) hscale
  calc ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
          ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
          9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * (1 / (j : ℝ)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro j hj
        obtain ⟨hjS, hjsq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hj
        have hj1 : 1 ≤ j := (mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo.mp hjS).1
        refine (hsieve j hjS (x / j) (three_le_div_of_mul_self_le hx hj1 hjsq)).trans ?_
        calc C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale (x / j)
            ≤ C * (9 * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * (1 / (j : ℝ))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (logSquaredScale_div_le_of_mul_self_le hx hj1 hjsq) hC
          _ = 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * (1 / (j : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ = 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x *
          ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x), (1 : ℝ) / (j : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hconst
        refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (Finset.filter_subset _ _) fun j _ _ ↦ by positivity) ?_
        exact sum_inv_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le h x hh
    _ = 9 * C * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_above_split_le
statement:
theorem sum_above_split_le (x h : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), x / j
      ≤ (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card * Nat.sqrt x
proof:
:= by
  calc ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), x / j
      ≤ ∑ _j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), Nat.sqrt x := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro j hj
        obtain ⟨hjS, hjsq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hj
        exact div_le_sqrt_of_not_mul_self_le (mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo.mp hjS).1 hjsq
    _ = ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x)).card * Nat.sqrt x := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card * Nat.sqrt x := by
        refine Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ?_
        exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _))
          (card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le h x)

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_reciprocalMass
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_reciprocalMass
    {x h Y : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hx : 9 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : ∀ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, ∀ R : ℕ, 3 ≤ R →
      ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤ C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R) :
    (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      9 * C * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x +
        (Real.sqrt x) * (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
          ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card : ℝ)) +
        (∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_split (Y := Y) hh
  refine hsplit.trans (add_le_add (sum_below_split_le hh hx hC hsieve) ?_)
  have hnat : (∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ))
      ≤ (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((Nat.sqrt x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast sum_above_split_le x h
  refine hnat.trans ?_
  rw [mul_comm]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
  exact Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt

name: RankAmplification.isDiagonalRepresentation_of_le
statement:
theorem isDiagonalRepresentation_of_le {h n j r Y Y' : ℕ} (hYY : Y ≤ Y')
    (hn : IsDiagonalRepresentation h Y' n j r) :
    IsDiagonalRepresentation h Y n j r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hj, hr, hn1, hn2, hp1, hp2, hc1, hc2, hcut⟩ := hn
  exact ⟨hj, hr, hn1, hn2, hp1, hp2, hc1, hc2, lt_of_le_of_lt hYY hcut⟩

name: RankAmplification.isAboveCutoffDiagonal_of_le
statement:
theorem isAboveCutoffDiagonal_of_le {h n Y Y' : ℕ} (hYY : Y ≤ Y')
    (hn : IsAboveCutoffDiagonal h Y' n) : IsAboveCutoffDiagonal h Y n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, r, hrep⟩ := hn
  exact ⟨j, r, isDiagonalRepresentation_of_le hYY hrep⟩

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_of_le
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_of_le {x h Y Y' : ℕ} (hYY : Y ≤ Y') :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y' ⊆ aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  rw [mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet] at hn ⊢
  exact ⟨hn.1, hn.2.1, isAboveCutoffDiagonal_of_le hYY hn.2.2⟩

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_antitone
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_antitone {x h Y Y' : ℕ} (hYY : Y ≤ Y') :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y' ≤ aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_of_le hYY)

name: RankAmplification.pow_le_natFloor_exp_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff
statement:
theorem pow_le_natFloor_exp_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (J : ℕ) (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    y ^ J ≤ ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_floor ?_
  have hpow : (y : ℝ) ^ J ≤ (Real.exp T) ^ J :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hcutoff.1 J
  calc
    ((y ^ J : ℕ) : ℝ) = (y : ℝ) ^ J := by push_cast; ring
    _ ≤ (Real.exp T) ^ J := hpow
    _ = Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) := (Real.exp_nat_mul T J).symm

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_sharpCutoff_le
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_sharpCutoff_le
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (J x h : ℕ) (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ ≤
      aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (y ^ J)
proof:
:=
  aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_antitone
    (pow_le_natFloor_exp_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff J hcutoff)

name: RankAmplification.isAboveCutoffDiagonal_sharpCutoff_iff
statement:
theorem isAboveCutoffDiagonal_sharpCutoff_iff (J h n : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    IsAboveCutoffDiagonal h ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ n ↔
      ∃ j r, IsSameSupportIndex h j ∧
        1 ≤ r ∧
        n = j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        n + h = (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) j ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) (j + h) ∧
        Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) <
          (largestPrimeFactor (diagonalGamma h j * r) : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  isAboveCutoffDiagonal_natFloor_iff (Real.exp_nonneg _) h n

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableRate_le_fixedRankSmoothRate_add_error
statement:
theorem eventually_variableRate_le_fixedRankSmoothRate_add_error
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤
        fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := 1 / (C₀ + 1)
  let b : ℝ := 1 / c₀
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hlogLower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < Real.log (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_scaleV_atTop.const_mul_atTop ha)).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
  have hlog2Lower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < log2 (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((tendsto_generalWindow_log2_atTop ha).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [hlogLower, hlog2Lower,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hlogLower hlog2Lower hcore
  intro T hwindow
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  let z := scaleL (x : ℝ) / T
  let lo := a * scaleV (x : ℝ)
  let hi := b * scaleV (x : ℝ)
  have hlo : 0 < lo := by dsimp [lo]; positivity
  have hhi : 0 < hi := by dsimp [hi]; positivity
  have hz : 0 < z := by dsimp [z]; positivity
  have hloz : lo ≤ z := by
    have hden : T ≤ (C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
      hwindow.2.trans (by gcongr; linarith)
    calc
      lo = scaleL (x : ℝ) / ((C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
        dsimp [lo, a]
        field_simp [hG.ne', (show C₀ + 1 ≠ 0 by positivity)]
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / T :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le hT hden
      _ = z := rfl
  have hzhi : z ≤ hi := by
    calc
      z = scaleL (x : ℝ) / T := rfl
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1
      _ = hi := by
        dsimp [hi, b]
        field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne']
  have hlogLoZ : Real.log lo ≤ Real.log z := Real.log_le_log hlo hloz
  have hlogLoPos : 0 < Real.log lo := by simpa [lo] using hlogLower
  have hlog2LoZ : log2 lo ≤ log2 z := by
    change Real.log (Real.log lo) ≤ Real.log (Real.log z)
    exact Real.log_le_log hlogLoPos hlogLoZ
  have hlog2LoPos : 0 < log2 lo := by simpa [lo] using hlog2Lower
  have hlog3LoZ : log3 lo ≤ log3 z := by
    change Real.log (log2 lo) ≤ Real.log (log2 z)
    exact Real.log_le_log hlog2LoPos hlog2LoZ
  let M := max
      |log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ)|
      |log2 hi + log3 hi - scaleA (x : ℝ)|
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  have hbracket : -M ≤ log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
    have hleft : -M ≤ -|log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ)| :=
      neg_le_neg (le_max_left _ _)
    have hmid : -|log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ)| ≤
        log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ) := neg_abs_le _
    linarith
  have hzM : -(hi * M) ≤ z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hstep : z * (-M) ≤ z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracket hz.le
    have hzMle : z * M ≤ hi * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzhi hM
    nlinarith
  have hsq := scaleG_sq hL.le hA.le
  have hidentity : fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T -
      scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T =
        z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankSmoothRate
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [hsq]
    ring
  have herrorIdentity : hi * M =
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError
    dsimp only [hi, lo, a, b, M]
    field_simp [hc₀.ne']
  rw [← hidentity, herrorIdentity] at hzM
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.sharpCutoffCeil_pos
statement: theorem sharpCutoffCeil_pos (T : ℝ) : 0 < sharpCutoffCeil T
proof:
:=
  Nat.ceil_pos.2 (Real.exp_pos T)

name: RankAmplification.exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil
statement:
theorem exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil (T : ℝ) :
    Real.exp T ≤ (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ)
proof: := Nat.le_ceil _

name: RankAmplification.isSection5ExponentialCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil
statement:
theorem isSection5ExponentialCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil (T : ℝ) :
    IsSection5ExponentialCutoff (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffLog T)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast sharpCutoffCeil_pos T
  have hexp : Real.exp (sharpCutoffLog T) = (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ) :=
    Real.exp_log hpos
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hexp]
  · rw [hexp]; linarith

name: RankAmplification.le_sharpCutoffLog
statement: theorem le_sharpCutoffLog (T : ℝ) : T ≤ sharpCutoffLog T
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos T) (exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T)
  rwa [Real.log_exp] at h

name: RankAmplification.sharpCutoffLog_le_add_exp_neg
statement:
theorem sharpCutoffLog_le_add_exp_neg (T : ℝ) :
    sharpCutoffLog T ≤ T + Real.exp (-T)
proof:
:= by
  have hposCeil : (0 : ℝ) < (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast sharpCutoffCeil_pos T
  have hlt : (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ) < Real.exp T + 1 :=
    Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.exp_pos T).le
  have hfactor : Real.exp T + 1 = Real.exp T * (1 + Real.exp (-T)) := by
    rw [mul_add, mul_one, ← Real.exp_add]
    simp
  have hsplit : Real.log (Real.exp T + 1) = T + Real.log (1 + Real.exp (-T)) := by
    rw [hfactor, Real.log_mul (Real.exp_pos T).ne'
      (by positivity : (1 : ℝ) + Real.exp (-T) ≠ 0), Real.log_exp]
  have hsmall : Real.log (1 + Real.exp (-T)) ≤ Real.exp (-T) := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos
      (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 + Real.exp (-T) by positivity)
    linarith
  have hmono : sharpCutoffLog T ≤ Real.log (Real.exp T + 1) :=
    Real.log_le_log hposCeil hlt.le
  rw [hsplit] at hmono
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.natFloor_exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil_pow
statement:
theorem natFloor_exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil_pow (J : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ ≤ sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) ≤ ((sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hpow : (Real.exp T) ^ J ≤ (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ) ^ J :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos T).le (exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T) J
    calc
      Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T) = (Real.exp T) ^ J := Real.exp_nat_mul T J
      _ ≤ (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ) ^ J := hpow
      _ = ((sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  calc
    ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ ≤ ⌊((sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊ :=
      Nat.floor_le_floor hle
    _ = sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J := Nat.floor_natCast _

name: RankAmplification.le_sharpCutoffCeil_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff
statement:
theorem le_sharpCutoffCeil_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff
    {y h : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) (hhy : h ≤ y) :
    h ≤ sharpCutoffCeil T
proof:
:= by
  have hyle : (y : ℝ) ≤ (sharpCutoffCeil T : ℝ) :=
    hcutoff.1.trans (exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil T)
  exact hhy.trans (by exact_mod_cast hyle)

name: RankAmplification.sharpCutoffShiftError_nonneg
statement:
theorem sharpCutoffShiftError_nonneg {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) {x : ℕ}
    (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ)) : 0 ≤ sharpCutoffShiftError c₀ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold sharpCutoffShiftError
  exact div_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    (mul_pos (by positivity) hV).le

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_sharpCutoffShiftError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_sharpCutoffShiftError_zero {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    Tendsto (sharpCutoffShiftError c₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).const_mul_atTop hc₀
  have hnum : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.exp (-(c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ))))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp hG)
  have hden : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ c₀ ^ 2 * scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.const_mul_atTop (by positivity)
  exact hnum.div_atTop hden

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_sharpCutoffRateError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_sharpCutoffRateError_zero
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀ hC₀
  have h₂ := tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ + 1 by linarith)
  have h₃ := tendsto_sharpCutoffShiftError_zero hc₀
  have hsum := (h₁.add h₂).add h₃
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x +
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ (C₀ + 1) x +
        sharpCutoffShiftError c₀ x) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa using hsum

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_nonneg
    {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (C₀ : ℝ) (x : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError
  exact div_nonneg ((abs_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hc₀.le

name: RankAmplification.sharpCutoffRateError_nonneg
statement:
theorem sharpCutoffRateError_nonneg {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) {x : ℕ}
    (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ)) : 0 ≤ sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold sharpCutoffRateError
  have h₁ := fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_nonneg hc₀ C₀ x
  have h₂ := fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_nonneg hc₀ (C₀ + 1) x
  have h₃ := sharpCutoffShiftError_nonneg hc₀ hV
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat
statement:
theorem eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1

name: RankAmplification.variableRate_sub_le_exp_neg
statement:
theorem variableRate_sub_le_exp_neg
    {c₀ G T T' : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hG : 0 < G) (hT : c₀ * G ≤ T)
    (hTT : T ≤ T') (hshift : T' - T ≤ Real.exp (-T)) :
    G ^ 2 / T - G ^ 2 / T' ≤ Real.exp (-(c₀ * G)) / c₀ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hT
  have hT'pos : 0 < T' := lt_of_lt_of_le hTpos hTT
  have hden : 0 < T * T' := mul_pos hTpos hT'pos
  have hsplit : G ^ 2 / T - G ^ 2 / T' = G ^ 2 / (T * T') * (T' - T) := by
    field_simp
  have hsq : c₀ * G * (c₀ * G) ≤ T * T' :=
    mul_le_mul hT (hT.trans hTT) (mul_pos hc₀ hG).le hTpos.le
  have hA : G ^ 2 / (T * T') ≤ 1 / c₀ ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hden (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hC : T' - T ≤ Real.exp (-(c₀ * G)) :=
    hshift.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hD : 0 ≤ T' - T := by linarith
  have hmul : G ^ 2 / (T * T') * (T' - T) ≤ 1 / c₀ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(c₀ * G)) :=
    mul_le_mul hA hC hD (by positivity)
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    G ^ 2 / (T * T') * (T' - T) ≤ 1 / c₀ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(c₀ * G)) := hmul
    _ = Real.exp (-(c₀ * G)) / c₀ ^ 2 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog
statement:
theorem isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} {x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hG : 1 ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ))
    (hwindow : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T) :
    IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ (C₀ + 1) (x : ℝ) (sharpCutoffLog T)
proof:
:= by
  have hGpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleG (x : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hG
  have hTpos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hc₀ hGpos) hwindow.1
  have hexpLe : Real.exp (-T) ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (show -T ≤ 0 by linarith)
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨hwindow.1.trans (le_sharpCutoffLog T), ?_⟩
  have hupper := sharpCutoffLog_le_add_exp_neg T
  have hwin := hwindow.2
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_sharpCutoffLog
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_sharpCutoffLog
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T -
          sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) (sharpCutoffLog T)
proof:
:= by
  have hC₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ + 1 := by linarith
  have hGone := eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableRate_le_fixedRankSmoothRate_add_error hc₀ hC₁,
      hGone, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hupper hlower hG hV
  intro T hwindow
  have hGpos : (0 : ℝ) < scaleG (x : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hG
  have hwindow' := isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hG hwindow
  have hup := hupper T hwindow
  have hlo := hlower (sharpCutoffLog T) hwindow'
  have hshift : sharpCutoffLog T - T ≤ Real.exp (-T) := by
    have := sharpCutoffLog_le_add_exp_neg T
    linarith
  have hgap := variableRate_sub_le_exp_neg hc₀ hGpos hwindow.1
    (le_sharpCutoffLog T) hshift
  have hshiftError : Real.exp (-(c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ))) / c₀ ^ 2 =
      sharpCutoffShiftError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold sharpCutoffShiftError
    field_simp
  have hexpand : sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ (C₀ + 1) x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          sharpCutoffShiftError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold sharpCutoffRateError
    ring
  rw [hshiftError] at hgap
  rw [hexpand]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralRate_sub_le_of_smooth
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralRate_sub_le_of_smooth
    {J : ℕ} {X T T' c : ℝ} (hTT : T ≤ T') (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hsmooth : fixedRankSmoothRate X T - c ≤ fixedRankSmoothRate X T') :
    fixedRankGeneralRate J X T - c ≤ fixedRankGeneralRate J X T'
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralRate
  refine le_min ?_ ?_
  · have := min_le_left (fixedRankSmoothRate X T) ((J : ℝ) * T)
    linarith
  · have h1 := min_le_right (fixedRankSmoothRate X T) ((J : ℝ) * T)
    have h2 : (J : ℝ) * T ≤ (J : ℝ) * T' :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTT (Nat.cast_nonneg J)
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralMajorant_le_of_rate_sub
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralMajorant_le_of_rate_sub
    {J x : ℕ} {T T' : ℝ} {e ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hrate : fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T - ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T') :
    fixedRankGeneralMajorant J e x T' ≤
      fixedRankGeneralMajorant J (fun n ↦ e n + ε n) x T
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralMajorant
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
  refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
  have hring : (e x + ε x) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
      e x * scaleV (x : ℝ) + ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
  rw [hring]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_sharpCutoffUnconditionalError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_sharpCutoffUnconditionalError_zero
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (sharpCutoffUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := tendsto_fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError_zero J hc₀
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ + 1 by linarith)
  have hsum := hbase.add (tendsto_sharpCutoffRateError_zero hc₀ hC₀)
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ (C₀ + 1) x +
      sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀ x) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa using hsum

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSharpCutoffEstimate_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankSharpCutoffEstimate_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    FixedRankSharpCutoffEstimate J c₀ C₀
      (sharpCutoffUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hC₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ + 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨-, hbase⟩ := fixedRankGeneralEstimate_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₁
  refine ⟨tendsto_sharpCutoffUnconditionalError_zero J hc₀ hC₀, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbase, eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_one_le_scaleG_nat, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hx hsmooth hG hV
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hcutoff' := isSection5ExponentialCutoff_sharpCutoffCeil T
  have hwindow' := isSection5SaddleWindow_sharpCutoffLog hc₀ hG hwindow
  have hhy' : h ≤ sharpCutoffCeil T :=
    le_sharpCutoffCeil_of_isSection5ExponentialCutoff hcutoff hhy
  have hmain := hx h (sharpCutoffCeil T) (sharpCutoffLog T) hh hhy' hcutoff' hwindow'
  have hdiag : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (sharpCutoffCeil T ^ J) : ℝ) ≤
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_antitone
      (natFloor_exp_le_sharpCutoffCeil_pow J T)
  have hrate : fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) T -
      sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
        fixedRankGeneralRate J (x : ℝ) (sharpCutoffLog T) :=
    fixedRankGeneralRate_sub_le_of_smooth (le_sharpCutoffLog T)
      (mul_nonneg (sharpCutoffRateError_nonneg hc₀ hV) hV.le) (hsmooth T hwindow)
  have hmaj : fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
      (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ (C₀ + 1)) x (sharpCutoffLog T) ≤
      fixedRankGeneralMajorant J (sharpCutoffUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) x T :=
    fixedRankGeneralMajorant_le_of_rate_sub
      (e := fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ (C₀ + 1))
      (ε := sharpCutoffRateError c₀ C₀) hrate
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.theorem10_13_sharpCutoff_unconditional
statement:
theorem theorem10_13_sharpCutoff_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    FixedRankSharpCutoffEstimate J c₀ C₀
      (sharpCutoffUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀)
proof:
:=
  fixedRankSharpCutoffEstimate_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneralMajorant_nonneg
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneralMajorant_nonneg
    (J : ℕ) (error : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralMajorant J error x T
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedRankGeneralMajorant

name: RankAmplification.theorem10_13_sharpCutoff_two_sided
statement:
theorem theorem10_13_sharpCutoff_two_sided
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (sharpCutoffUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
        1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
        IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
        |(shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) -
            (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ : ℝ)| ≤
          fixedRankGeneralMajorant J (sharpCutoffUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) x T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨htendsto, hbound⟩ :=
    fixedRankSharpCutoffEstimate_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀
  refine ⟨htendsto, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbound] with x hx
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hupper := hx h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hlower : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount x h
      ⌊Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * T)⌋₊
  have hnonneg := fixedRankGeneralMajorant_nonneg J
    (sharpCutoffUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) x T
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RankAmplification.theorem10_13_two_sided
statement:
theorem theorem10_13_two_sided
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
        1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
        IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
        |(shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) -
            (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ)| ≤
          fixedRankGeneralMajorant J
            (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) x T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨htendsto, hbound⟩ := theorem10_13_unconditional J hJ hc₀ hC₀
  refine ⟨htendsto, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbound] with x hx
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hupper := hx h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hlower : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (y ^ J) : ℝ) ≤
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_shiftedEqualTotientCount x h (y ^ J)
  have hnonneg := fixedRankGeneralMajorant_nonneg J
    (fixedRankGeneralUnconditionalError J c₀ C₀) x T
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_corollary11_1_two_sided
statement:
theorem fixedRank_corollary11_1_two_sided
    {Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankClosedError Q) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ fixedRankNatY Q x →
        |(totientChainCount x r h : ℝ) -
            (firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) : ℝ)| ≤
          fixedRankExponentialMajorant Q (fixedRankClosedError Q) x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankClosedError_zero hQ, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [fixedRank_chain_offDiagonal_unconditional hQ hr] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hle := firstPairDiagonalChainCount_le_totientChainCount x r h
    (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x)
  have hleReal : (firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (fixedRankNatUpperY Q x) : ℝ) ≤
      (totientChainCount x r h : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
  have hupper := hx h hh hhy
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hle] at hupper
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  exact hupper

name: RankAmplification.moving_corollary11_1_two_sided
statement:
theorem moving_corollary11_1_two_sided {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    Tendsto (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
      movingClosedTransferError) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ movingNatY x →
        |(totientChainCount x r h : ℝ) -
            (firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ)| ≤
          movingExponentialMajorant
            (movingCombinedError movingClosedLowRankError movingClosedSupplierError
              movingClosedTransferError) x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingCombinedError_closed_zero, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [moving_chain_offDiagonal_unconditional hr] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy
  have hle := firstPairDiagonalChainCount_le_totientChainCount x r h (movingNatZ x)
  have hleReal : (firstPairDiagonalChainCount x r h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) ≤
      (totientChainCount x r h : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
  have hupper := hx h hh hhy
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hle] at hupper
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  exact hupper

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensFactor_pos

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_pos
statement: theorem directMertensProduct_pos (z : ℕ) : 0 < directMertensProduct z

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.harmonic_le_mertensProduct
statement:
theorem harmonic_le_mertensProduct (z : ℕ) :
    ((harmonic z : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ mertensProduct z
proof:
:= by
  let e := harmonicSmoothEmbedding z
  let A : Finset ((z + 1).smoothNumbers) := Finset.univ.map e
  have hsmooth := (summable_and_hasSum_smooth_reciprocals z).2
  have hle : (∑ n ∈ A, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤ mertensProduct z := by
    calc
      (∑ n ∈ A, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤
          ∑' n : (z + 1).smoothNumbers, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
        hsmooth.summable.sum_le_tsum A
          (fun n _ ↦ inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg n.1))
      _ = mertensProduct z := hsmooth.tsum_eq
  have hfinite :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 z, ((n : ℝ)⁻¹)) =
        ∑ n : {n : ℕ // n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 z}, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
  have hmap :
      (∑ n : {n : ℕ // n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 z}, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) =
        ∑ n ∈ A, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    change (∑ n : {n : ℕ // n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 z}, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.map e, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _hn
    rfl
  calc
    ((harmonic z : ℚ) : ℝ) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 z, ((n : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      simp only [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_inv,
        Rat.cast_natCast]
    _ = ∑ n : {n : ℕ // n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 z}, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) := hfinite
    _ = ∑ n ∈ A, ((n.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) := hmap
    _ ≤ mertensProduct z := hle

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mertensProduct_eq_inv_directMertensProduct
statement:
theorem mertensProduct_eq_inv_directMertensProduct (z : ℕ) :
    mertensProduct z = (directMertensProduct z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertensProduct directMertensProduct
  rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_eq_inv_mertensProduct
statement:
theorem directMertensProduct_eq_inv_mertensProduct (z : ℕ) :
    directMertensProduct z = (mertensProduct z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [mertensProduct_eq_inv_directMertensProduct]
  simp

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_le_inv_log_add_one
statement:
theorem directMertensProduct_le_inv_log_add_one
    {z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    directMertensProduct z ≤ (Real.log ((z + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log ((z + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < z + 1 by omega))
  have hlogHarm : Real.log ((z + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((harmonic z : ℚ) : ℝ) := log_add_one_le_harmonic z
  have hHarmPos : 0 < ((harmonic z : ℚ) : ℝ) :=
    hlogPos.trans_le hlogHarm
  rw [directMertensProduct_eq_inv_mertensProduct]
  exact ((inv_le_inv₀ (mertensProduct_pos z) hHarmPos).mpr
      (harmonic_le_mertensProduct z)).trans
    ((inv_le_inv₀ hHarmPos hlogPos).mpr hlogHarm)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localDensity_apply_prime

theorem localDensity_apply_prime {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :

proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_shiftedRootType
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_shiftedRootType
    (m d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    shiftedBadResidueCount m d = Fintype.card (shiftedRootType m d)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin d ≃ ZMod d := (ZMod.finEquiv d).toEquiv
  have he (t : Fin d) :
      t ∈ shiftedBadResidueSet m d ↔
        shiftedProductMod m d (e t) = 0 := by
    rw [mem_shiftedBadResidueSet,
      ← shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd m d t.val]
    have hfin : (ZMod.finEquiv d) t = (t.val : ZMod d) := by
      cases d with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 t
      | succ d =>
          change t = (t.val : ZMod (d + 1))
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n := d + 1) t).symm
    change shiftedProductMod m d (t.val : ZMod d) = 0 ↔
      shiftedProductMod m d ((ZMod.finEquiv d) t) = 0
    rw [hfin]
  let rootEquiv :
      {t // t ∈ shiftedBadResidueSet m d} ≃ shiftedRootType m d :=
    e.subtypeEquiv he
  calc
    shiftedBadResidueCount m d =
        Fintype.card {t // t ∈ shiftedBadResidueSet m d} := by
      rw [shiftedBadResidueCount, Fintype.card_coe]
    _ = Fintype.card (shiftedRootType m d) := Fintype.card_congr rootEquiv

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedProductMod_chineseRemainder
statement:
theorem shiftedProductMod_chineseRemainder
    {m a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) (q : ZMod (a * b)) :
    ZMod.chineseRemainder hab (shiftedProductMod m (a * b) q) =
      (shiftedProductMod m a (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab q).1,
        shiftedProductMod m b (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab q).2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedProductMod]
  apply Prod.ext <;> rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_mul_of_coprime
    (m : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    shiftedBadResidueCount m (a * b) =
      shiftedBadResidueCount m a * shiftedBadResidueCount m b
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero a := ⟨ha⟩
  letI : NeZero b := ⟨hb⟩
  letI : NeZero (a * b) := ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero ha hb⟩
  rw [shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_shiftedRootType,
    shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_shiftedRootType,
    shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_shiftedRootType]
  exact (Fintype.card_congr (shiftedRootType_mulEquiv m hab)).trans
    (Fintype.card_prod _ _)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative
statement:
theorem shiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative (m : ℕ) :
    (shiftedRootCount m).IsMultiplicative
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro a b hab
    simp only [shiftedRootCount_apply]
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · simp [ha]
    by_cases hb : b = 0

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount
statement:
theorem prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount
    {m d : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, shiftedBadResidueCount m p =
      shiftedBadResidueCount m d
proof:
:= by
  change (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, shiftedRootCount m p) = shiftedRootCount m d
  rw [← (shiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative m).map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors
    d d.primeFactors subset_rfl,
    Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div
statement:
theorem sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div
    {m d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    sieveDensity m d = (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) / d
proof:
:= by
  rw [sieveDensity, ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hd]
  simp only [localDensity, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  rw [← Nat.cast_prod, ← Nat.cast_prod,
    prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount hsq,
    Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.boundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
statement:
theorem boundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    (boundingSieve m R z hm).rem d =
      (residueExcessCount m R d : ℝ) -
        (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess hm hd,
    sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div hd.ne' hsq]
  have hR : (R : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) + (R % d : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_add_div R d).symm.trans (by omega)
  rw [hR]
  have hdCast : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount
statement:
theorem abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    |(boundingSieve m R z hm).rem d| ≤ shiftedBadResidueCount m d
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction hm hd hsq]
  have hdCast : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hcount0 : 0 ≤ (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hexcess0 : 0 ≤ (residueExcessCount m R d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hexcessLe : (residueExcessCount m R d : ℝ) ≤
      shiftedBadResidueCount m d := residueExcessCount_cast_le m R d
  have hfrac : ((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hdCast]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_lt R hd).le
  have hterm0 : 0 ≤
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d := by
    positivity
  have htermLe :
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d ≤
        shiftedBadResidueCount m d := by
    calc
      (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d =
          (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) *
            (((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d) := by ring
      _ ≤ (shiftedBadResidueCount m d : ℝ) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac hcount0
      _ = shiftedBadResidueCount m d := by ring
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
    {m d : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    shiftedBadResidueCount m d ≤ 2 ^ d.primeFactors.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount hsq]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, shiftedBadResidueCount m p) ≤
        ∏ _p ∈ d.primeFactors, 2 := by
      gcongr with p hp
      exact shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two
        (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
    _ = 2 ^ d.primeFactors.card := by simp

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
statement:
theorem abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    |(boundingSieve m R z hm).rem d| ≤
      ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount hm hd hsq).trans
    (by exact_mod_cast shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors hsq)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.one_le_multiplierCorrectionFactor
statement:
theorem one_le_multiplierCorrectionFactor {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    1 ≤ multiplierCorrectionFactor m p
proof:
:= by
  unfold multiplierCorrectionFactor
  split_ifs
  · exact one_le_primeEulerFactor hp
  · exact le_rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.multiplierCorrectionFactor_nonneg
statement:
theorem multiplierCorrectionFactor_nonneg {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    0 ≤ multiplierCorrectionFactor m p
proof:
:=
  zero_le_one.trans (one_le_multiplierCorrectionFactor hp)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.one_sub_localDensity_le_base_sq_mul_correction
statement:
theorem one_sub_localDensity_le_base_sq_mul_correction
    {m p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    1 - localDensity m p ≤
      (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 * multiplierCorrectionFactor m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [localDensity_apply_prime hp]
  unfold multiplierCorrectionFactor
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · simp only [if_pos hpm, Nat.cast_one]
    have hpR : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
    have hfactor : 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
      (directMertensFactor_pos hp).ne'
    field_simp [hfactor]
    rfl
  · simp only [if_neg hpm, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hpR0 : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hinv0 : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hpR0.le
    simp only [mul_one, div_eq_mul_inv]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((p : ℝ)⁻¹)]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localSieveProduct_nonneg
statement:
theorem localSieveProduct_nonneg {m z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) :
    0 ≤ localSieveProduct m z
proof:
:= by
  unfold localSieveProduct
  apply Finset.prod_nonneg
  intro p hpz
  have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
  have hcount := shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime_of_even hm hp
  unfold localDensity
  rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_one (by exact_mod_cast hp.pos)]
  exact_mod_cast hcount.le

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localSieveProduct_le_base_sq_mul_corrections
statement:
theorem localSieveProduct_le_base_sq_mul_corrections (m z : ℕ) :
    localSieveProduct m z ≤
      directMertensProduct z ^ 2 *
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, multiplierCorrectionFactor m p
proof:
:= by
  unfold localSieveProduct directMertensProduct
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 - localDensity m p)) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z,
          ((1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 * multiplierCorrectionFactor m p) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hpz
        have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
        have hlocal : 0 ≤ 1 - localDensity m p := by
          rw [localDensity_apply_prime hp]
          by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
          · rw [if_pos hpm]
            norm_num
            have hpRpos : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
            have hpRone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_le
            exact (inv_le_one₀ hpRpos).2 hpRone
          · rw [if_neg hpm]
            norm_num
            have hpRpos : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
            have hpRTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
            exact (div_le_one hpRpos).2 hpRTwo
        exact hlocal
      · intro p hpz
        exact one_sub_localDensity_le_base_sq_mul_correction
          (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz)
    _ = (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ 2 *
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, multiplierCorrectionFactor m p := by
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← Finset.prod_pow]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.correctionProduct_le_totientEulerWeight
statement:
theorem correctionProduct_le_totientEulerWeight
    {m z : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, multiplierCorrectionFactor m p) ≤
      totientEulerWeight m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrewrite :
      (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, multiplierCorrectionFactor m p) =
        ∏ p ∈ (Nat.primesLE z).filter (· ∣ m),
          (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
    symm
    rw [Finset.prod_filter]
    rfl
  rw [hrewrite, totientEulerWeight]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le
  · intro p hp
    have hpData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    exact Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
      ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpData.1, hpData.2, hm⟩
  · intro p hp
    have hpData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    exact (primeEulerFactor_pos
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpData.1)).le
  · intro p hp _
    exact one_le_primeEulerFactor (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_sq_mul_totientWeight
statement:
theorem localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_sq_mul_totientWeight
    {m z : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    localSieveProduct m z ≤
      directMertensProduct z ^ 2 * totientWeight m
proof:
:= by
  have hcorrection :
      (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, multiplierCorrectionFactor m p) ≤
        totientWeight m := by
    rw [totientWeight_eq_eulerWeight hm]
    exact correctionProduct_le_totientEulerWeight hm
  exact (localSieveProduct_le_base_sq_mul_corrections m z).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcorrection
      (sq_nonneg _))

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
statement:
theorem directMertensProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcut : CutoffLogLowerBound cutoff c) :
    DirectMertensProductUpperBound cutoff c⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hRlog : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega))
  have hdata := hcut R hR
  have hcutLog : 0 < Real.log (((cutoff R) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < cutoff R + 1 by omega))
  have hcLog : 0 < c * Real.log (R : ℝ) := mul_pos hc hRlog
  calc
    directMertensProduct (cutoff R) ≤
        (Real.log (((cutoff R) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
      directMertensProduct_le_inv_log_add_one hdata.1
    _ ≤ (c * Real.log (R : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hcutLog hcLog).mpr hdata.2
    _ = c⁻¹ / Real.log R := by
      simp only [mul_inv_rev, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProductUpperBound_of_le
statement:
theorem directMertensProductUpperBound_of_le
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hcut : ∀ R, 3 ≤ R → R ≤ cutoff R) :
    DirectMertensProductUpperBound cutoff 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : CutoffLogLowerBound cutoff 1 := by
    intro R hR
    have hcR := hcut R hR
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    simp only [one_mul]
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast (show R ≤ cutoff R + 1 by omega)
  simpa using directMertensProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
    (cutoff := cutoff) (c := 1) (by norm_num) hlog

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProductUpperBound_id
statement:
theorem directMertensProductUpperBound_id :
    DirectMertensProductUpperBound id 1
proof:
:= by
  apply directMertensProductUpperBound_of_le
  intro R _hR
  exact le_rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mertensLocalProductUpperBound_of_directMertens
statement:
theorem mertensLocalProductUpperBound_of_directMertens
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hM : DirectMertensProductUpperBound cutoff C) :
    MertensLocalProductUpperBound cutoff (C ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro m R hm _hmEven hR
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega))
  have hbase0 : 0 ≤ directMertensProduct (cutoff R) :=
    (directMertensProduct_pos _).le
  have hupper0 : 0 ≤ C / Real.log R := div_nonneg hC hlog.le
  have hsq : directMertensProduct (cutoff R) ^ 2 ≤
      (C / Real.log R) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hM R hR]
  calc
    localSieveProduct m (cutoff R) ≤
        directMertensProduct (cutoff R) ^ 2 * totientWeight m :=
      localSieveProduct_le_directMertens_sq_mul_totientWeight hm0
    _ ≤ (C / Real.log R) ^ 2 * totientWeight m :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by unfold totientWeight; positivity)
    _ = C ^ 2 / Real.log R ^ 2 * ((m : ℝ) / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by
      unfold totientWeight
      ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mertensLocalProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
statement:
theorem mertensLocalProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcut : CutoffLogLowerBound cutoff c) :
    MertensLocalProductUpperBound cutoff ((c⁻¹) ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  mertensLocalProductUpperBound_of_directMertens (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
    (directMertensProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound hc hcut)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mertensLocalProductUpperBound_id
statement:
theorem mertensLocalProductUpperBound_id :
    MertensLocalProductUpperBound id 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mertensLocalProductUpperBound_of_directMertens
    (C := 1) (by norm_num) directMertensProductUpperBound_id

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_truncatedDivisors {s : SelbergSieve} {l : ℕ} :
    l ∈ truncatedDivisors s ↔
      l ∣ s.prodPrimes ∧ (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level
proof:
:= by
  simp [truncatedDivisors, BoundingSieve.prodPrimes_ne_zero]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.one_mem_truncatedDivisors
statement:
theorem one_mem_truncatedDivisors (s : SelbergSieve) :
    1 ∈ truncatedDivisors s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_truncatedDivisors]
  exact ⟨one_dvd _, by simpa using s.one_le_level⟩

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos
statement: theorem truncatedMass_pos (s : SelbergSieve) : 0 < truncatedMass s
proof:
:= by
  have hle : s.selbergTerms 1 ≤ truncatedMass s := by
    unfold truncatedMass
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun l hl ↦ (s.selbergTerms_pos (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1).le)
      (one_mem_truncatedDivisors s)
  exact (s.selbergTerms_pos (one_dvd _)).trans_le hle

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.selbergTerms_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selbergTerms_one (s : BoundingSieve) : s.selbergTerms 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply, s.nu_mult.map_one]
  simp

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass
statement: theorem one_le_truncatedMass (s : SelbergSieve) : 1 ≤ truncatedMass s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← selbergTerms_one s.toBoundingSieve]
  unfold truncatedMass
  exact Finset.single_le_sum
    (fun l hl ↦ (s.selbergTerms_pos (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1).le)
    (one_mem_truncatedDivisors s)

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_inv_le_one
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_inv_le_one (s : SelbergSieve) :
    (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (inv_le_one₀ (truncatedMass_pos s)).mpr (one_le_truncatedMass s)

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.cast_moebius_sq_eq_one_of_dvd
statement:
theorem cast_moebius_sq_eq_one_of_dvd
    {s : BoundingSieve} {l : ℕ} (hl : l ∣ s.prodPrimes) :
    (μ l : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.moebius_sq_eq_one_of_squarefree
    (s.squarefree_of_dvd_prodPrimes hl)

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal_normalized
statement:
theorem minimizingDiagonal_normalized (s : SelbergSieve) :
    ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        (μ l : ℝ) * minimizingDiagonal s l = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmass : truncatedMass s ≠ 0 := (truncatedMass_pos s).ne'
  calc
    (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        (μ l : ℝ) * minimizingDiagonal s l) =
        ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s,
          (μ l : ℝ) *
            ((μ l : ℝ) * s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s) := by
      simp only [minimizingDiagonal, truncatedDivisors]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      have hlData := Nat.mem_divisors.mp hl
      simp [hlData]
    _ = ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s,
          s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      calc
        (μ l : ℝ) *
            ((μ l : ℝ) * s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s) =
            (μ l : ℝ) ^ 2 * s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s := by ring
        _ = s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s := by
          rw [cast_moebius_sq_eq_one_of_dvd
            (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1, one_mul]
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← truncatedMass, div_self hmass]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal_objective
statement:
theorem minimizingDiagonal_objective (s : SelbergSieve) :
    ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ * minimizingDiagonal s l ^ 2 =
      (truncatedMass s)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hmass : truncatedMass s ≠ 0 := (truncatedMass_pos s).ne'
  calc
    (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ * minimizingDiagonal s l ^ 2) =
        ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s,
          (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ *
            (((μ l : ℝ) * s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s) ^ 2) := by
      simp only [minimizingDiagonal, truncatedDivisors]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      have hlData := Nat.mem_divisors.mp hl
      simp [hlData]
    _ = ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s,
          s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      have hterm : s.selbergTerms l ≠ 0 :=
        (s.selbergTerms_pos (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1).ne'
      calc
        (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ *
            (((μ l : ℝ) * s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s) ^ 2) =
            (μ l : ℝ) ^ 2 * s.selbergTerms l /
              truncatedMass s ^ 2 := by
          field_simp
        _ = s.selbergTerms l / truncatedMass s ^ 2 := by
          rw [cast_moebius_sq_eq_one_of_dvd
            (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1, one_mul]
    _ = (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← truncatedMass]
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal_is_minimal
statement:
theorem minimizingDiagonal_is_minimal
    (s : SelbergSieve) (y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hy : ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s, (μ l : ℝ) * y l = 1) :
    (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ ≤
      ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s, (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ * y l ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hCS := Finset.sq_sum_div_le_sum_sq_div
    (truncatedDivisors s) (fun l ↦ (μ l : ℝ) * y l)
    (fun l hl ↦ s.selbergTerms_pos (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1)
  rw [hy, one_pow, ← truncatedMass] at hCS
  calc
    (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ = 1 / truncatedMass s := by rw [one_div]
    _ ≤ ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s,
        ((μ l : ℝ) * y l) ^ 2 / s.selbergTerms l := hCS
    _ = ∑ l ∈ truncatedDivisors s,
        (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ * y l ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      rw [mul_pow, cast_moebius_sq_eq_one_of_dvd
        (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.sum_reverseMobiusTransform
statement:
theorem sum_reverseMobiusTransform
    (P : ℕ) (y : ℕ → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, reverseMobiusTransform P y d = y (P / n)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((ArithmeticFunction.sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq
    (R := ℝ) (f := reverseMobiusTransform P y)
    (g := fun k ↦ y (P / k))).mpr (by intro k hk; rfl)) n hn

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.div_divisor_complement
statement:
theorem div_divisor_complement
    {P d : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hd : d ∣ P) : P / (P / d) = d
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hP hd)
  have hdle : d ≤ P := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hP) hd
  have hquot : 0 < P / d := Nat.div_pos hdle hd0
  apply (Nat.div_eq_iff_eq_mul_left hquot (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hd)).mpr
  exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hd).symm

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.div_quotient_divisor_complement
statement:
theorem div_quotient_divisor_complement
    {P d a : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hd : d ∣ P) (ha : a ∣ P / d) :
    P / ((P / d) / a) = d * a
proof:
:= by
  have hQpos : 0 < P / d := by
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hP) hd)
      (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hP hd))
  have ha0 : 0 < a :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hQpos.ne' ha)
  have hquot : 0 < (P / d) / a :=
    Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hQpos ha) ha0
  have hquotDvd : (P / d) / a ∣ P :=
    (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd ha).trans (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hd)
  apply (Nat.div_eq_iff_eq_mul_left hquot hquotDvd).mpr
  calc
    P = d * (P / d) := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hd).symm
    _ = d * (a * ((P / d) / a)) := by rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' ha]
    _ = (d * a) * ((P / d) / a) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.weightFromDiagonal_apply_of_dvd
statement:
theorem weightFromDiagonal_apply_of_dvd
    {s : BoundingSieve} {y : ℕ → ℝ} {d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes) :
    s.nu d * weightFromDiagonal s y d =
      reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y (s.prodPrimes / d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightFromDiagonal, dif_pos hd]
  field_simp [s.nu_ne_zero hd]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.divisor_complement_condition
statement:
theorem divisor_complement_condition
    {P l d : ℕ} (hl : l ∣ P) (hd : d ∣ P) :
    l ∣ P / d ↔ d ∣ P / l
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd hd, Nat.dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd hl,
    Nat.mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.diagonalCoordinate_weightFromDiagonal
statement:
theorem diagonalCoordinate_weightFromDiagonal
    (s : BoundingSieve) (y : ℕ → ℝ) {l : ℕ}
    (hl : l ∣ s.prodPrimes) :
    (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if l ∣ d then s.nu d * weightFromDiagonal s y d else 0) = y l
proof:
:= by
  have hP : s.prodPrimes ≠ 0 := s.prodPrimes_ne_zero
  have hl0 : 0 < l := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hP hl)
  have hlle : l ≤ s.prodPrimes := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hP) hl
  have hquotPos : 0 < s.prodPrimes / l := Nat.div_pos hlle hl0
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if l ∣ d then s.nu d * weightFromDiagonal s y d else 0) =
        ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          if l ∣ d then
            reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y (s.prodPrimes / d)
          else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      split_ifs with hld
      · exact weightFromDiagonal_apply_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd)
      · rfl
    _ = ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          if l ∣ s.prodPrimes / d then
            reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y d
          else 0 := by
      rw [← Nat.sum_div_divisors s.prodPrimes
        (fun d ↦ if l ∣ d then
          reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y (s.prodPrimes / d) else 0)]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [div_divisor_complement hP (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd)]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          if d ∣ s.prodPrimes / l then
            reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y d
          else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      have hiff := divisor_complement_condition hl
        (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd)
      by_cases h : l ∣ s.prodPrimes / d
      · have hdvd := hiff.mp h
        simp [h, hdvd]
      · have hndvd : ¬d ∣ s.prodPrimes / l := fun hdvd ↦ h (hiff.mpr hdvd)
        simp [h, hndvd]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ (s.prodPrimes / l).divisors,
          reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y d := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter,
        Nat.divisors_filter_dvd_of_dvd hP (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hl)]
    _ = y (s.prodPrimes / (s.prodPrimes / l)) :=
      sum_reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y hquotPos
    _ = y l := by rw [div_divisor_complement hP hl]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.reverseMobiusTransform_prodPrimes
statement:
theorem reverseMobiusTransform_prodPrimes
    (s : BoundingSieve) (y : ℕ → ℝ) :
    reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes y s.prodPrimes =
      ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (μ l : ℝ) * y l
proof:
:= by
  unfold reverseMobiusTransform
  calc
    (∑ x ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        (μ x.1 : ℝ) * y (s.prodPrimes / x.2)) =
        ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          (μ l : ℝ) * y (s.prodPrimes / (s.prodPrimes / l)) :=
      Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal
        (fun l q ↦ (μ l : ℝ) * y (s.prodPrimes / q))
    _ = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (μ l : ℝ) * y l := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      rw [div_divisor_complement s.prodPrimes_ne_zero
        (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hl)]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.reverseMobiusTransform_divisor
statement:
theorem reverseMobiusTransform_divisor
    {P d : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hd : d ∣ P) (y : ℕ → ℝ) :
    reverseMobiusTransform P y (P / d) =
      ∑ a ∈ (P / d).divisors, (μ a : ℝ) * y (d * a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reverseMobiusTransform
  calc
    (∑ x ∈ (P / d).divisorsAntidiagonal,
        (μ x.1 : ℝ) * y (P / x.2)) =
        ∑ a ∈ (P / d).divisors,
          (μ a : ℝ) * y (P / ((P / d) / a)) :=
      Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal
        (fun a q ↦ (μ a : ℝ) * y (P / q))
    _ = ∑ a ∈ (P / d).divisors, (μ a : ℝ) * y (d * a) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [div_quotient_divisor_complement hP hd
        (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors ha)]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_one
statement:
theorem minimizingWeight_one (s : SelbergSieve) :
    minimizingWeight s 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [minimizingWeight, weightFromDiagonal, dif_pos (one_dvd _),
    s.nu_mult.map_one, inv_one, one_mul, Nat.div_one,
    reverseMobiusTransform_prodPrimes]
  exact minimizingDiagonal_normalized s

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
    {s : SelbergSieve} {d : ℕ} (hd : ¬d ∣ s.prodPrimes) :
    minimizingWeight s d = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [minimizingWeight, weightFromDiagonal, hd]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_level_lt_sq
statement:
theorem minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_level_lt_sq
    {s : SelbergSieve} {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes)
    (hlevel : s.level < (d : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    minimizingWeight s d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [minimizingWeight, weightFromDiagonal, dif_pos hd,
    reverseMobiusTransform_divisor s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd]
  have hd0 : 0 < d :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hzero : ∀ a ∈ (s.prodPrimes / d).divisors,
      minimizingDiagonal s (d * a) = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    have ha0 : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors ha
    have hdaNat : d ≤ d * a := by
      calc
        d = d * 1 := by omega
        _ ≤ d * a := Nat.mul_le_mul_left d (by omega)
    have hda : (d : ℝ) ≤ (d * a : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hdaNat
    have hdR0 : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hdaR0 : 0 ≤ ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hnot : d * a ∉ truncatedDivisors s := by
      intro hmem
      have hsquare := (mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hmem).2
      nlinarith
    rw [minimizingDiagonal, if_neg hnot]
  have hsum :
      (∑ a ∈ (s.prodPrimes / d).divisors,
        (μ a : ℝ) * minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro a ha
    rw [hzero a ha, mul_zero]
  rw [hsum, mul_zero]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated
statement:
theorem minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated
    {s : SelbergSieve} {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∉ truncatedDivisors s) :
    minimizingWeight s d = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdP : d ∣ s.prodPrimes
  · apply minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_level_lt_sq hdP
    exact lt_of_not_ge fun hsq ↦ hd (mem_truncatedDivisors.mpr ⟨hdP, hsq⟩)
  · exact minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hdP

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_level_lt
statement:
theorem lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_level_lt
    {s : SelbergSieve} {n : ℕ} (hn : s.level < (n : ℝ)) :
    BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro d₁ hd₁
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro d₂ hd₂
  split_ifs with heq
  · by_cases h₁ : d₁ ∈ truncatedDivisors s
    · by_cases h₂ : d₂ ∈ truncatedDivisors s
      · have hd₁Data := mem_truncatedDivisors.mp h₁
        have hd₂Data := mem_truncatedDivisors.mp h₂
        have hd₁Pos : 0 < d₁ := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
          (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd₁Data.1)
        have hd₂Pos : 0 < d₂ := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
          (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd₂Data.1)
        have hnleNat : n ≤ d₁ * d₂ := by
          rw [heq]
          exact Nat.lcm_le_mul hd₁Pos hd₂Pos
        have hnle : (n : ℝ) ≤ (d₁ : ℝ) * d₂ := by
          exact_mod_cast hnleNat
        have hd₁Nonneg : 0 ≤ (d₁ : ℝ) := by positivity
        have hd₂Nonneg : 0 ≤ (d₂ : ℝ) := by positivity
        have hmul : (d₁ : ℝ) * d₂ ≤ s.level := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((d₁ : ℝ) - d₂)]
        exfalso
        linarith
      · rw [minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated h₂,
          mul_zero]
    · rw [minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated h₁,
        zero_mul]
  · rfl

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_level_restriction
statement:
theorem errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_level_restriction
    (s : SelbergSieve) :
    s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s)) =
      ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
          |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s) d| * |s.rem d|
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold BoundingSieve.errSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _hd
  by_cases hlevel : (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level
  · rw [if_pos hlevel]
  · rw [if_neg hlevel,
      lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_level_lt (lt_of_not_ge hlevel),
      abs_zero, zero_mul]

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_levelRestrictedRemainder
statement:
theorem errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_levelRestrictedRemainder
    (s : SelbergSieve) :
    s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s)) =
      levelRestrictedRemainder s
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelRestrictedRemainder]
  exact errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_level_restriction s

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.diagonalCoordinate_minimizingWeight
statement:
theorem diagonalCoordinate_minimizingWeight
    (s : SelbergSieve) {l : ℕ} (hl : l ∣ s.prodPrimes) :
    (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if l ∣ d then s.nu d * minimizingWeight s d else 0) =
      minimizingDiagonal s l
proof:
:= by
  exact diagonalCoordinate_weightFromDiagonal s.toBoundingSieve
    (minimizingDiagonal s) hl

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.mainSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight
statement:
theorem mainSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight (s : SelbergSieve) :
    s.mainSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s)) =
      (truncatedMass s)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [BoundingSieve.mainSum_lambdaSquared_eq_sum_mul_sum_sq]
  calc
    (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ *
        (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          if l ∣ d then s.nu d * minimizingWeight s d else 0) ^ 2) =
        ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          (s.selbergTerms l)⁻¹ * minimizingDiagonal s l ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      rw [diagonalCoordinate_minimizingWeight s
        (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hl)]
    _ = (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ := minimizingDiagonal_objective s

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.siftedSum_le_minimizing_main_add_error
statement:
theorem siftedSum_le_minimizing_main_add_error (s : SelbergSieve) :
    s.siftedSum ≤
      s.totalMass * (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ +
        s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    s.siftedSum ≤
        s.totalMass * s.mainSum
          (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s)) +
          s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s)) :=
      s.siftedSum_le_mainSum_errSum_of_upperMoebius _
        (BoundingSieve.upperMoebius_lambdaSquared _ (minimizingWeight_one s))
    _ = s.totalMass * (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ +
          s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s)) := by
      rw [mainSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).level = (z : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.minimizingSelbergSieve_totalMass

theorem minimizingSelbergSieve_totalMass

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_cutoff_lt
statement:
theorem minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_cutoff_lt
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hzd : z < d) :
    SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
      (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) d = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated
  intro hmem
  have hsquare := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hmem).2
  rw [minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz] at hsquare
  have hcast : (z : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hzd
  have hz0 : 0 ≤ (z : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) := by positivity
