name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_cutoff_sq_lt
statement:
theorem lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_cutoff_sq_lt
    {m R z n : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hn : z ^ 2 < n) :
    BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
      (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
        (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SelbergFundamental.lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_level_lt
  rw [minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz]
  exact_mod_cast hn

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.levelRestrictedRemainder_le_minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant
statement:
theorem levelRestrictedRemainder_le_minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant
    (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder
        (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) ≤
      minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant m R z hm
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  change SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder s ≤
    minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant m R z hm
  unfold SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder
  change (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| * |s.rem d|
      else 0) ≤
    ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
      else 0
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro d hdMem
  by_cases hlevel : (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level
  · rw [if_pos hlevel, if_pos hlevel]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
    have hdDvd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdMem
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hdDvd)
    have hdSquarefree : Squarefree d :=
      Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdDvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
    exact abs_boundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
      hm hdPos hdSquarefree
  · rw [if_neg hlevel, if_neg hlevel]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.levelRestrictedRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_of_combinatorial
statement:
theorem levelRestrictedRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_of_combinatorial
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hrem : CombinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff C) :
    LevelRestrictedRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff C
proof:
:= by
  intro m R hm hmEven hR
  exact (levelRestrictedRemainder_le_minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant
    m R (cutoff R) hmEven).trans (hrem m R hm hmEven hR)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.minimizingRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_of_levelRestricted
statement:
theorem minimizingRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_of_levelRestricted
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {C : ℝ}
    (hrem : LevelRestrictedRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff C) :
    MinimizingRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff C
proof:
:= by
  intro m R hm hmEven hR
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R (cutoff R) hmEven
  change s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
    (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s)) ≤
      C * R * localSieveProduct m (cutoff R)
  rw [SelbergFundamental.errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_levelRestrictedRemainder]
  exact hrem m R hm hmEven hR

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
statement:
theorem selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Cmass Crem : ℝ}
    (hmass : TruncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Cmass)
    (hrem : MinimizingRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Crem) :
    SelbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound cutoff (Cmass + Crem)
proof:
:= by
  intro m R hm hmEven hR
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R (cutoff R) hmEven
  have hfinite :=
    SelbergFundamental.siftedSum_le_minimizing_main_add_error s
  have hsMass : s.totalMass = (R : ℝ) := by rfl
  have hmass' := hmass m R hm hmEven hR
  have hrem' := hrem m R hm hmEven hR
  change s.siftedSum ≤
    (Cmass + Crem) * R * localSieveProduct m (cutoff R)
  calc
    s.siftedSum ≤
        (R : ℝ) *
            (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s)⁻¹ +
          s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s)) := by
      rw [hsMass] at hfinite
      exact hfinite
    _ ≤ (R : ℝ) *
          (Cmass * localSieveProduct m (cutoff R)) +
        Crem * R * localSieveProduct m (cutoff R) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass' (by positivity)) hrem'
    _ = (Cmass + Crem) * R * localSieveProduct m (cutoff R) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_levelRestrictedRemainder
statement:
theorem selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_levelRestrictedRemainder
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Cmass Crem : ℝ}
    (hmass : TruncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Cmass)
    (hrem : LevelRestrictedRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Crem) :
    SelbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound cutoff (Cmass + Crem)
proof:
:=
  selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder hmass
    (minimizingRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_of_levelRestricted hrem)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_combinatorialRemainder
statement:
theorem selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_combinatorialRemainder
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Cmass Crem : ℝ}
    (hmass : TruncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Cmass)
    (hrem : CombinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound cutoff Crem) :
    SelbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound cutoff (Cmass + Crem)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
statement:
theorem dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Cmass Crem : ℝ}
    (hmass : L.TruncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound cutoff Cmass)
    (hrem : L.MinimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound cutoff Crem) :
    L.DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff (Cmass + Crem)
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R (cutoff R)
  have hfinite :=
    SelbergFundamental.siftedSum_le_minimizing_main_add_error s
  have hsMass : s.totalMass = (R : ℝ) := by rfl
  have hmass' := hmass R hR
  have hrem' := hrem R hR
  change s.siftedSum ≤ (Cmass + Crem) * logSquaredScale R
  calc
    s.siftedSum ≤
        (R : ℝ) * (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s)⁻¹ +
          s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s)) := by
      rw [hsMass] at hfinite
      exact hfinite
    _ ≤ Cmass * logSquaredScale R + Crem * logSquaredScale R :=
      add_le_add hmass' hrem'
    _ = (Cmass + Crem) * logSquaredScale R := by ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_corollary1_2_fixed_of_sharpBFPS
statement:
theorem fixedRank_corollary1_2_fixed_of_sharpBFPS
    {J h : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {B : ℝ}

    (fixedRankTailData_of_sharpBFPS hJ hsharp) hB hh hodd

name: RankAmplification.logSquaredScale_nonneg
statement: theorem logSquaredScale_nonneg (R : ℕ) : 0 ≤ AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R
proof:
:= by
  unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale

name: RankAmplification.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_nonneg
statement:
theorem growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_nonneg (S : Finset ℕ) :
    0 ≤ AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet S
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hmax : (64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss) ^ 2 ≤
      max ((64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss) ^ 2) AffinePrimePair.affineSmallMassConstant :=
    le_max_left _ _
  unfold AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.diagonalAffinePair_leftSlope
statement:
theorem diagonalAffinePair_leftSlope {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : 0 < j) :
    (diagonalAffinePair h j).leftSlope = diagonalA h j
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagonalAffinePair, hh, hj]

name: RankAmplification.diagonalAffinePair_rightSlope
statement:
theorem diagonalAffinePair_rightSlope {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : 0 < j) :
    (diagonalAffinePair h j).rightSlope = diagonalB h j
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagonalAffinePair, hh, hj]

name: RankAmplification.diagonalB_lt_diagonalA
statement:
theorem diagonalB_lt_diagonalA {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : 0 < j) :
    diagonalB h j < diagonalA h j
proof:
:= by
  have haff : diagonalB h j + normalizedSUnitC h j = diagonalA h j :=
    normalizedSUnit_affine (h := h) hj
  have hc : 0 < normalizedSUnitC h j := normalizedSUnitC_pos hh hj
  omega

name: RankAmplification.diagonalAffinePair_exceptionalPrimeSet_subset
statement:
theorem diagonalAffinePair_exceptionalPrimeSet_subset
    {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    (diagonalAffinePair h j).exceptionalPrimeSet ⊆ primeSupport h
proof:
:= by
  have hjpos : 0 < j := zero_lt_one.trans_le hj.1
  have hleft : (diagonalAffinePair h j).leftSlope = diagonalA h j :=
    diagonalAffinePair_leftSlope hh hjpos
  have hright : (diagonalAffinePair h j).rightSlope = diagonalB h j :=
    diagonalAffinePair_rightSlope hh hjpos
  have hlt : diagonalB h j < diagonalA h j := diagonalB_lt_diagonalA hh hjpos
  have haff : diagonalB h j + normalizedSUnitC h j = diagonalA h j :=
    normalizedSUnit_affine (h := h) hjpos
  
  have hmod : (diagonalAffinePair h j).leftSlope * (diagonalAffinePair h j).rightSlope *
      (max (diagonalAffinePair h j).leftSlope (diagonalAffinePair h j).rightSlope -
        min (diagonalAffinePair h j).leftSlope (diagonalAffinePair h j).rightSlope)
      = diagonalA h j * diagonalB h j * normalizedSUnitC h j := by
    rw [hleft, hright, max_eq_left hlt.le, min_eq_right hlt.le]
    congr 1
    omega
  
  have hAsup : primeSupport (diagonalA h j) ⊆ primeSupport h :=
    (normalizedSUnitB_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hj).2
  have hBsup : primeSupport (diagonalB h j) ⊆ primeSupport h :=
    (normalizedSUnitA_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hj).2
  have hCsup : primeSupport (normalizedSUnitC h j) ⊆ primeSupport h :=
    (normalizedSUnitC_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hj).2
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hprime, hdvd⟩ := (diagonalAffinePair h j).mem_exceptionalPrimeSet.mp hp
  rw [hmod] at hdvd
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hprime).mp hdvd with hab | hc
  · rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hprime).mp hab with ha | hb
    · exact hAsup (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
        ⟨hprime, ha, (diagonalA_pos hjpos).ne'⟩)
    · exact hBsup (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
        ⟨hprime, hb, (diagonalB_pos hjpos).ne'⟩)
  · exact hCsup (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
      ⟨hprime, hc, (normalizedSUnitC_pos hh hjpos).ne'⟩)

name: RankAmplification.diagonalPrimePairSet_card_le_uniform
statement:
theorem diagonalPrimePairSet_card_le_uniform
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {j : ℕ} (hj : IsSameSupportIndex h j) {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤
      AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet (primeSupport h) *
        AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤
      (diagonalAffinePair h j).affinePrimePairGrowingConstant *
        AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R :=
    (diagonalAffinePair h j).card_primePairSet_le_affinePrimePairGrowingConstant hR
  refine hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (logSquaredScale_nonneg R))
  exact (diagonalAffinePair h j).affinePrimePairGrowingConstant_le_of_subset
    (diagonalAffinePair_exceptionalPrimeSet_subset hh hj)

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_div_sameSupport
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_div_sameSupport {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ⊆
      ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).biUnion
        fun j ↦ diagonalPrimeValueSet (x / j) h j
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hnData := mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mp hn
  obtain ⟨j, r, hrep⟩ := hnData.2.2
  have hjn : j ≤ n := by
    rw [hrep.2.2.1]
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left j (show 1 ≤ diagonalA h j * r + 1 by omega)
  refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, ?_, hrep.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet_div hh hnData.2.1⟩
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    ⟨sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo hh hrep.1 (hjn.trans hnData.2.1), hrep.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_div_sameSupport
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_div_sameSupport {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y ≤
      ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h),
        (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount]
  calc (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y).card
      ≤ (((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).biUnion
          fun j ↦ diagonalPrimeValueSet (x / j) h j).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_div_sameSupport hh)
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h),
          (diagonalPrimeValueSet (x / j) h j).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h),
          (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ card_diagonalPrimeValueSet_le (x / j) h j

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_split_sameSupport
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_split_sameSupport {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y ≤
      (∑ j ∈ ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).filter
            (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
          (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card) +
      (∑ j ∈ ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).filter
            (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), x / j)
proof:
:= by
  refine (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_div_sameSupport hh).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not
      ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h))
      (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x) fun j ↦ (diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card]
  exact Nat.add_le_add le_rfl
    (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ card_diagonalPrimePairSet_le h j (x / j))

name: RankAmplification.sum_below_split_le_of_subset
statement:
theorem sum_below_split_le_of_subset {x h : ℕ} {C : ℝ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hx : 9 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT : T ⊆ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x)
    (hsieve : ∀ j ∈ T, ∀ R : ℕ, 3 ≤ R →
      ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤ C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R) :
    ∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
        ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ 9 * C * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) ≤ AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := logSquaredScale_nonneg x
  have hconst : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC) hscale
  calc ∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x), ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
          9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * (1 / (j : ℝ)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro j hj
        obtain ⟨hjT, hjsq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hj
        have hj1 : 1 ≤ j := (mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo.mp (hT hjT)).1
        refine (hsieve j hjT (x / j) (three_le_div_of_mul_self_le hx hj1 hjsq)).trans ?_
        calc C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale (x / j)
            ≤ C * (9 * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * (1 / (j : ℝ))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (logSquaredScale_div_le_of_mul_self_le hx hj1 hjsq) hC
          _ = 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * (1 / (j : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ = 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x *
          ∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x), (1 : ℝ) / (j : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 9 * C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hconst
        refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          ((Finset.filter_subset _ _).trans hT) fun j _ _ ↦ by positivity) ?_
        exact sum_inv_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le h x hh
    _ = 9 * C * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_above_split_le_of_subset
statement:
theorem sum_above_split_le_of_subset {x h : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (hT : T ⊆ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x) :
    ∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), x / j
      ≤ (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card * Nat.sqrt x
proof:
:= by
  calc ∑ j ∈ T.filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), x / j
      ≤ ∑ _j ∈ T.filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), Nat.sqrt x := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
        intro j hj
        obtain ⟨hjT, hjsq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hj
        exact div_le_sqrt_of_not_mul_self_le (mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo.mp (hT hjT)).1 hjsq
    _ = (T.filter (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x)).card * Nat.sqrt x := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card * Nat.sqrt x := by
        refine Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ?_
        exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ((Finset.filter_subset _ _).trans hT))
          (card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le h x)

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_reciprocalMass_sameSupport
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_reciprocalMass_sameSupport
    {x h Y : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hx : 9 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : ∀ j ∈ (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h), ∀ R : ℕ, 3 ≤ R →
      ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤ C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R) :
    (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      9 * C * ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x +
        (Real.sqrt x) * (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h) ⊆
      shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hsplit : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ j ∈ ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).filter
            (fun j ↦ j * j ≤ x),
          ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j (x / j)).card : ℝ)) +
        (∑ j ∈ ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).filter
            (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    exact_mod_cast aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_split_sameSupport (Y := Y) hh
  refine hsplit.trans (add_le_add (sum_below_split_le_of_subset hh hx hC hT hsieve) ?_)
  have hnat : (∑ j ∈ ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).filter
        (fun j ↦ ¬ j * j ≤ x), ((x / j : ℕ) : ℝ))
      ≤ (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((Nat.sqrt x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast sum_above_split_le_of_subset hT
  refine hnat.trans ?_
  rw [mul_comm]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
  exact Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_5_diagonal_bound_unconditional
statement:
theorem proposition9_5_diagonal_bound_unconditional
    {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hx : 9 ≤ x) :
    (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      9 * AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet (primeSupport h) *
          ((h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x +
        (Real.sqrt x) * (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_reciprocalMass_sameSupport hh hx
    (growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_nonneg (primeSupport h)) ?_
  intro j hj R hR
  exact diagonalPrimePairSet_card_le_uniform hh (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2 hR

name: RankAmplification.half_le_variableCutoffBFPSExponent

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffBFPSExponent_pos
statement:
theorem variableCutoffBFPSExponent_pos (x T : ℝ) :

    (half_le_variableCutoffBFPSExponent x T)

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffDelta_mul_T
statement:
theorem variableCutoffDelta_mul_T
    {x T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    variableCutoffDelta x T * T =
      scaleA x - variableCutoffPhaseSlack x
proof:
:= by
  rw [variableCutoffDelta, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hT]

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffDelta_mul_scaleL
statement:
theorem variableCutoffDelta_mul_scaleL
    {x T : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ scaleL x) (hA : 0 ≤ scaleA x)
    (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    variableCutoffDelta x T * scaleL x =
      scaleG x ^ 2 / T -
        variableCutoffPhaseSlack x * scaleL x / T
proof:
:= by
  rw [variableCutoffDelta]
  have hGA : scaleG x ^ 2 = scaleL x * scaleA x := by
    exact scaleG_sq hL hA
  rw [hGA]
  field_simp [hT]

name: RankAmplification.log_natCutoff_le_T
statement:
theorem log_natCutoff_le_T
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    Real.log (y : ℝ) ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  have hyReal : (0 : ℝ) < y := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hyReal hcutoff.1
  simpa using hlog

name: RankAmplification.T_sub_log_two_le_log_natCutoff
statement:
theorem T_sub_log_two_le_log_natCutoff
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hT : Real.log 2 ≤ T)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    T - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hexpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hT
  have hyOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hyZero : y = 0 := by
      have : ¬1 ≤ y := by exact_mod_cast hy
      omega
    subst y
    have hlt := hcutoff.2
    norm_num at hlt
    nlinarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
  have hhalf : Real.exp T / 2 ≤ (y : ℝ) := by
    have hfloor := hcutoff.2
    have hyCast : (y : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * y := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have hpositive : 0 < Real.exp T / 2 := by positivity
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpositive hhalf
  rw [Real.log_div (Real.exp_ne_zero T) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
    Real.log_exp] at hlog
  exact hlog

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      3 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  have hGlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 4 / c₀ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (Real.log 4 / c₀)
  have hGpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
        with x hL hA
    exact scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hCG : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hbound := scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL.bound (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (C₀ + 1))
    have hboundNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hbound
    filter_upwards [hboundNat, hGpos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos]
        with x hx hG hL
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hx
    have hden : 0 < C₀ + 1 := by linarith
    have hratio : C₀ / (C₀ + 1) ≤ (1 : ℝ) :=
      (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)
    calc
      C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
          C₀ * ((1 / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hC₀
      _ = (C₀ / (C₀ + 1)) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio hL.le
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) := one_mul _
  filter_upwards [hGlarge, hCG,
    hGpos,
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
    eventually_ge_atTop 1]
      with x hGlarge hCG hG hL hxNat
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hTfour : Real.log 4 ≤ T := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGlarge hc₀.le
    field_simp [hc₀.ne'] at hmul
    exact hmul.trans hwindow.1
  have hexpFour : (4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hTfour
  have hyThree : 3 ≤ y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hyLe : y ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hyCast : (y : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hyLe 1
    linarith [hcutoff.2]
  have hTL : T ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := hwindow.2.trans hCG
  have hexpLe : Real.exp T ≤ Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hTL
  have hxPos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega)
  have hexpL : Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) = (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [scaleL_eq, Real.exp_log hxPos]
  have hyCast : (y : ℝ) ≤ x := by
    calc
      (y : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := hcutoff.1
      _ ≤ Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hexpLe
      _ = (x : ℝ) := hexpL
  exact ⟨hyThree, by exact_mod_cast hyCast⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      0 < variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ∧
        variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤ 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hslack : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / scaleA (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hreal := tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero.div_atTop
      tendsto_scaleA_atTop
    exact hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hhalf : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
    have hratio := (tendsto_order.1 hslack).2 (1 / 2 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [hratio,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
        with x hx hA
    have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hA).mp hx.le
    nlinarith
  have hratioZero : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hAG : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ scaleA x / scaleG x)
        atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hinv := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_scaleV_atTop
      apply hinv.congr'
      filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
      have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
      have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
      have hAV := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
      apply (eq_div_iff hG.ne').2
      rw [← hAV]
      field_simp [hV.ne']
    have hscaled : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ c₀⁻¹ *
        (scaleA x / scaleG x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ c₀⁻¹)
          atTop (nhds c₀⁻¹)).mul hAG
    have hreal : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ scaleA x / (c₀ * scaleG x))
        atTop (nhds 0) := by
      apply hscaled.congr'
      filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
      have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
      field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne']
    exact hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hquarter : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      scaleA (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 4 :=
    ((tendsto_order.1 hratioZero).2 (1 / 4 : ℝ) (by norm_num)).mono
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  filter_upwards [hhalf, hquarter,
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
    (by
      filter_upwards [
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
          with x hL hA
      exact scaleG_pos hL hA)]
      with x hhalf hquarter hA hG
  intro T hwindow
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hnum : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) - variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) := by
    linarith
  refine ⟨div_pos hnum hT, ?_⟩
  calc
    variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) / T := by
      unfold variableCutoffDelta
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (sub_le_self _ (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _)) hT.le
    _ ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA.le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1
    _ ≤ 1 / 4 := hquarter

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffDelta_le_window_bound
statement:
theorem variableCutoffDelta_le_window_bound
    {c₀ C₀ x T : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀)
    (hA : 0 ≤ scaleA x) (hG : 0 < scaleG x)
    (hwindow : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T) :
    variableCutoffDelta x T ≤ scaleA x / (c₀ * scaleG x)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  calc
    variableCutoffDelta x T ≤ scaleA x / T := by
      unfold variableCutoffDelta
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (sub_le_self _ (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _)) hT.le
    _ ≤ scaleA x / (c₀ * scaleG x) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_natural_phase_le
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_natural_phase_le
    {x T : ℝ} {y : ℕ} (hdelta : 0 ≤ variableCutoffDelta x T)
    (hT : T ≠ 0) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    variableCutoffDelta x T * Real.log y ≤
      scaleA x - variableCutoffPhaseSlack x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    variableCutoffDelta x T * Real.log y ≤
        variableCutoffDelta x T * T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_natCutoff_le_T hy hcutoff) hdelta
    _ = scaleA x - variableCutoffPhaseSlack x :=
      variableCutoffDelta_mul_T hT

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log_variableCutoff_shellCount_le_two_log2
statement:
theorem eventually_log_variableCutoff_shellCount_le_two_log2
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount y : ℝ) ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
    (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1]
      with x hrange hL hL2 hL2one
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hyx := (hrange y T hcutoff hwindow).2
  have hyThree := (hrange y T hcutoff hwindow).1
  have hlogTwoPos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlogTwoHalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    exact (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 0.6931471803).trans
      Real.log_two_gt_d9.le
  have hyPos : (0 : ℝ) < y := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < y by omega)
  have hxPos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega)
  have hlogY : Real.log (y : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [scaleL_eq]
    exact Real.log_le_log hyPos (by exact_mod_cast hyx)
  have hlogY0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ y by omega))
  have hdiv : Real.log (y : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤
      2 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogTwoPos).2
    have hone : 1 ≤ 2 * Real.log 2 := by linarith
    have hmul := le_mul_of_one_le_right hlogY0 hone
    calc
      Real.log (y : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) * (2 * Real.log 2) := hmul
      _ = 2 * Real.log (y : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by ring
  have hcount : (bfpsFixedShellCount y : ℝ) ≤ 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (bfpsFixedShellCount y : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) / Real.log 2 :=
        fixed_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div y
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := hdiv
      _ ≤ 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogY (by norm_num)
  by_cases hcountZero : bfpsFixedShellCount y = 0
  · rw [hcountZero]
    norm_num
    exact hL2.le
  · have hcountPos : (0 : ℝ) < bfpsFixedShellCount y := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcountZero
    have hlogCount := Real.log_le_log hcountPos hcount
    calc
      Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount y : ℝ) ≤
          Real.log (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hlogCount
      _ = Real.log 2 + log2 (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hL.ne']
        simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
      _ ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
        have hlogTwoLe : Real.log 2 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by
          exact (Real.log_two_lt_d9.le.trans
            (by norm_num : (0.6931471808 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).trans hL2one
        linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_eq_phase
statement:
theorem fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_eq_phase (Y : ℕ) (delta : ℝ) :
    fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent Y delta - Real.log (1 / delta) =
      fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant +
        Real.exp (delta * Real.log Y / 2) *
          Real.log (delta * Real.log Y / 2) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          (delta * Real.exp (delta * Real.log Y) / 2) +
        Real.exp (delta * Real.log Y) /
          (delta * Real.log Y - 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant
  dsimp only
  ring

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_sharpTail_le
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_sharpTail_le
    {x P : ℝ} (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hL3 : 0 < log3 x)
    (hPupper : P ≤ scaleA x - variableCutoffPhaseSlack x)
    (hPden : log3 x + 2 ≤ P)
    (hslack : variableCutoffPhaseSlack x ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.exp P / (P - 2) ≤
      log2 x / 2 - fixedBFPSPhaseGap x / 4
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := variableCutoffPhaseSlack x
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _
  have hdenPos : 0 < P - 2 := by linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp P ≤ Real.exp (scaleA x - s) := by
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa only [s] using hPupper)
  have hexpA := fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3
  have hlinear := exp_neg_le_one_sub_half hs0 (by simpa only [s] using hslack)
  calc
    Real.exp P / (P - 2) ≤ Real.exp (scaleA x - s) / (P - 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hexp hdenPos.le
    _ ≤ Real.exp (scaleA x - s) / log3 x :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_pos _).le hL3 (by linarith)
    _ = (log2 x / 2) * Real.exp (-s) := by
      rw [show scaleA x - s = scaleA x + (-s) by ring,
        Real.exp_add, hexpA]
      field_simp [hL3.ne']
    _ ≤ (log2 x / 2) * (1 - s / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlinear (div_nonneg hL2.le (by norm_num))
    _ = log2 x / 2 - fixedBFPSPhaseGap x / 4 := by
      dsimp only [s]
      unfold fixedBFPSPhaseGap
      ring

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_middle_div_phaseGap_le
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_middle_div_phaseGap_le
    {x P : ℝ} (_hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hL2 : 0 < log2 x)
    (hL3 : 0 < log3 x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x)
    (hPfour : 4 ≤ P) (hPA : P ≤ scaleA x) :
    (Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2)) /
        fixedBFPSPhaseGap x ≤
      scaleA x * log3 x / Real.sqrt (log2 x)
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : Real.exp (P / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA x)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_half]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hPA (by norm_num))
  have hlog : Real.log (P / 2) ≤ scaleA x := by
    have hz : 0 < P / 2 := by positivity
    have hbasic := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hz
    nlinarith
  have hmiddle : Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2) ≤
      Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA x)) * scaleA x :=
    mul_le_mul hexp hlog (Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith))
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hexpA := fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (Real.exp (scaleA x)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (log2 x) * Real.sqrt (log3 x) := by
    rw [hexpA]
    calc
      Real.sqrt (log2 x * log3 x / 2) ≤
          Real.sqrt (log2 x * log3 x) := by
        apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
        nlinarith [mul_pos hL2 hL3]
      _ = Real.sqrt (log2 x) * Real.sqrt (log3 x) :=
        Real.sqrt_mul hL2.le _
  have hnum := hmiddle.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsqrt hA.le)
  have hgap : 0 < fixedBFPSPhaseGap x := by
    rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
    positivity
  have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hgap.le
  have hsL2 : Real.sqrt (log2 x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2).ne'
  have hsL3 : Real.sqrt (log3 x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL3).ne'
  calc
    (Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2)) /
        fixedBFPSPhaseGap x ≤
      (Real.sqrt (log2 x) * Real.sqrt (log3 x) * scaleA x) /
        fixedBFPSPhaseGap x := hdiv
    _ = scaleA x * log3 x / Real.sqrt (log2 x) := by
      rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
      field_simp [hsL2, hsL3]
      ring_nf
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt hL2.le, Real.sq_sqrt hL3.le]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget_zero
    {c₀ : ℝ} (_hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    Tendsto (variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlogSq : (fun x : ℝ ↦ log3 x ^ 2) =o[atTop] scaleV := by
    have hpow : (fun x : ℝ ↦ log3 x ^ (2 : ℝ)) =o[atTop] log2 := by
      have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (2 : ℝ)
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).comp_tendsto tendsto_log2_atTop
      apply h.congr'
      · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos, eventually_log3_pos] with x _hL2 hL3
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, log3_eq]
      · filter_upwards [eventually_log2_pos] with x hL2
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, Real.rpow_one]
    have hpowNat : (fun x : ℝ ↦ log3 x ^ 2) =o[atTop] log2 := by
      apply hpow.congr'
      · filter_upwards [] with x
        rw [Real.rpow_two]
      · exact EventuallyEq.rfl
    exact hpowNat.trans log2_isLittleO_scaleV
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦
      (log3 x ^ 2 / scaleV x) / c₀) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_div] using hlogSq.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.div_const c₀
  have hnat := hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  apply hnat.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  change log3 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ =
    variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x
  unfold variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget
  ring

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffDelta_mul_log3_sq_le_budget
statement:
theorem variableCutoffDelta_mul_log3_sq_le_budget
    {c₀ C₀ x T : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀)
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x)
    (_hL3 : 0 ≤ log3 x)
    (hwindow : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T) :
    variableCutoffDelta x T * log3 x ^ 2 ≤
      log3 x ^ 2 / (c₀ * scaleV x)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hdelta := variableCutoffDelta_le_window_bound hc₀ hA.le hG hwindow
  have hAV := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hratio : scaleA x / (c₀ * scaleG x) = 1 / (c₀ * scaleV x) := by
    field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne', hV.ne']
    nlinarith
  calc
    variableCutoffDelta x T * log3 x ^ 2 ≤
        (scaleA x / (c₀ * scaleG x)) * log3 x ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdelta (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = (1 / (c₀ * scaleV x)) * log3 x ^ 2 := by rw [hratio]
    _ = log3 x ^ 2 / (c₀ * scaleV x) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_endpoint_div_phaseGap_le
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_endpoint_div_phaseGap_le
    {x P delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hL2 : 0 < log2 x) (hL3 : 1 ≤ log3 x)
    (hPA : P ≤ scaleA x) :
    (delta * Real.exp P) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap x ≤
      delta * log3 x ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : Real.exp P ≤ Real.exp (scaleA x) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hPA
  have hexpA := fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2
    (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL3)
  have hgap : 0 < fixedBFPSPhaseGap x := by
    rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
    positivity
  have hnum : delta * Real.exp P ≤ delta * Real.exp (scaleA x) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hdelta
  calc
    (delta * Real.exp P) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap x ≤
        (delta * Real.exp (scaleA x)) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap x :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hgap.le
    _ = delta * log3 x * Real.sqrt (log3 x) / 2 := by
      rw [hexpA, fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
      field_simp [hL2.ne', (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL3)).ne']
    _ ≤ delta * log3 x ^ 2 / 2 := by
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (log3 x) ≤ log3 x :=
        Real.sqrt_le_self_iff.mpr (Or.inr hL3)
      have hcoef : 0 ≤ delta * log3 x :=
        mul_nonneg hdelta (zero_le_one.trans hL3)
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (by simpa only [pow_two, mul_assoc] using
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt hcoef)) (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_variableCutoffSharpAuxiliaryRatioBudget_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_variableCutoffSharpAuxiliaryRatioBudget_zero
    {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    Tendsto (variableCutoffSharpAuxiliaryRatioBudget c₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconstant : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)))
  have hmiddle := tendsto_scaleA_mul_log3_div_sqrt_log2_zero.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hmiddle' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      scaleA (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply hmiddle.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  have hendpoint : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
        (variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x / 2)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hhalf := (tendsto_variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget_zero hc₀).div_const 2
    simpa only [zero_div, mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hhalf
  have hsum := (hconstant.add hmiddle').add hendpoint
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) +
        scaleA (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          (variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x / 2)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_phase_lower
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_phase_lower
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      log3 (x : ℝ) + 2 ≤
        variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y
proof:
:= by
  have hGlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 / c₀ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (Real.log 2 / c₀)
  have hslack : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hzero := tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 hzero).2 (1 / 2 : ℝ) (by norm_num)).mono
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hlog4 : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log 2 + 4 ≤ log4 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log4_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (Real.log 2 + 4)
  filter_upwards [hGlarge, hslack, hlog4,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hGlarge hslack hlog4 hdelta hL hA
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hTlog : Real.log 2 ≤ T := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGlarge hc₀.le
    field_simp [hc₀.ne'] at hmul
    exact hmul.trans hwindow.1
  have hlogLower := T_sub_log_two_le_log_natCutoff hTlog hcutoff
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogLower hdeltaData.1.le
  have hlogTwoLeOne : Real.log 2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hdeltaLog : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log 2 ≤
          (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeltaData.2
          (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
      _ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hphase : scaleA (x : ℝ) - variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) - 1 ≤
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y := by
    have hcancel := variableCutoffDelta_mul_T (x := (x : ℝ)) hT.ne'
    calc
      scaleA (x : ℝ) - variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) - 1 ≤
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * T -
            variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log 2 := by linarith
      _ = variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * (T - Real.log 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y := hmul
  rw [scaleA_eq] at hphase
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffSharpAuxiliary_div_phaseGap_le_budget
statement:
theorem variableCutoffSharpAuxiliary_div_phaseGap_le_budget
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} {x : ℕ} {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ))
    (hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ)) (hL2 : 0 < log2 (x : ℝ))
    (hL3 : 1 ≤ log3 (x : ℝ))
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)
    (hPfour : 4 ≤ variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y)
    (hPA : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ))
    (hwindow : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T) :
    (fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant +
        Real.exp (variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y / 2) *
          Real.log (variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y / 2) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
          (variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            Real.exp (variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log y) / 2)) /
      fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) ≤
        variableCutoffSharpAuxiliaryRatioBudget c₀ x
proof:
:= by
  let delta := variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T
  let P := delta * Real.log y
  have hgap : 0 < fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
    positivity
  have hmiddle := variableCutoff_middle_div_phaseGap_le hL hL2
    (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL3) hA hPfour hPA
  have hdeltaBudget := variableCutoffDelta_mul_log3_sq_le_budget
    hc₀ hL hA (zero_le_one.trans hL3) hwindow
  have hbudget0 : 0 ≤ variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x := by
    unfold variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget
    exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg hc₀.le (scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA)).le)
  have hendpoint : (delta * Real.exp P) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) ≤
      variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x := by
    calc
      (delta * Real.exp P) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) ≤
          delta * log3 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 :=
        variableCutoff_endpoint_div_phaseGap_le hdelta hL2 hL3 hPA
      _ ≤ variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x := by
        have hhalf : delta * log3 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 ≤
            variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x / 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdeltaBudget (by norm_num)
        exact hhalf.trans (half_le_self hbudget0)
  have hM : 0 ≤ sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1 := by
    unfold sharpMangoldtMertensConstant
    have := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 4)
    positivity
  have hscaled : (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
        (((delta * Real.exp P) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ)) / 2) ≤
      (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
        (variableCutoffDeltaLog3SqBudget c₀ x / 2) := by
    gcongr
  have hsplit :
      (fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant +
          Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2) +
          (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) * (delta * Real.exp P / 2)) /
          fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) =
        fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) +
          (Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2)) /
            fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) +
          (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) *
            (((delta * Real.exp P) / fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ)) / 2) := by
    field_simp [hgap.ne']
  dsimp only [delta, P] at hsplit hmiddle hscaled ⊢
  rw [hsplit]
  unfold variableCutoffSharpAuxiliaryRatioBudget
  exact add_le_add (add_le_add le_rfl hmiddle) hscaled

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoffSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_le
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoffSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_le
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent y
          (variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) -
          Real.log (1 / variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have haux : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      variableCutoffSharpAuxiliaryRatioBudget c₀ x ≤ 1 / 8 :=
    ((tendsto_order.1
      (tendsto_variableCutoffSharpAuxiliaryRatioBudget_zero hc₀)).2
        (1 / 8 : ℝ) (by norm_num)).mono fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  have hgapLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      8 ≤ fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    (tendsto_fixedBFPSPhaseGap_div_sqrt_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 8
  have hslack : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hzero := tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 hzero).2 (1 / 2 : ℝ) (by norm_num)).mono
      fun _ hx ↦ hx.le
  filter_upwards [haux, hgapLarge, hslack,
      eventually_variableCutoff_phase_lower hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        (tendsto_log3_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 2)] with
      x haux hgapLarge hslack hphaseLower hdelta hrange hL hA hL2 hL3
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  let delta := variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T
  let P := delta * Real.log y
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  have hy := (hrange y T hcutoff hwindow).1
  have hT : 0 < T :=
    (mul_pos hc₀ (scaleG_pos hL hA)).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hPupper0 := variableCutoff_natural_phase_le hdeltaData.1.le hT.ne'
    (by omega : 0 < y) hcutoff
  have hPupper : P ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) - variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [P, delta] using hPupper0
  have hPA : P ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
    hPupper.trans (sub_le_self _ (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _))
  have hPden : log3 (x : ℝ) + 2 ≤ P := by
    simpa only [P, delta] using hphaseLower y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hPfour : 4 ≤ P := by linarith
  have hgap : 0 < fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [fixedBFPSPhaseGap_eq]
    positivity
  have htail := variableCutoff_sharpTail_le hL2
    (zero_lt_two.trans_le hL3) hPupper hPden hslack
  have hauxRatio := variableCutoffSharpAuxiliary_div_phaseGap_le_budget
    hc₀ hL hA hL2 (by linarith : 1 ≤ log3 (x : ℝ))
      hdeltaData.1.le hPfour hPA hwindow
  have hauxBound : fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant +
        Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) * (delta * Real.exp P / 2) ≤
      fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / 8 := by
    have hratio := hauxRatio.trans haux
    have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hgap).mp hratio
    nlinarith
  have hsqrtL2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL2
  have hgapSqrt : Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) ≤
      fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / 8 := by
    have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hsqrtL2).mp hgapLarge
    nlinarith
  rw [fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_eq_phase]
  change fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant +
        Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2) +
        (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) * (delta * Real.exp P / 2) +
        Real.exp P / (P - 2) ≤ _
  calc
    fixedBFPSSharpEulerConstant +
          Real.exp (P / 2) * Real.log (P / 2) +
          (sharpMangoldtMertensConstant + 1) * (delta * Real.exp P / 2) +
          Real.exp P / (P - 2) ≤
        fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / 8 +
          (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / 4) :=
      add_le_add hauxBound htail
    _ = log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - fixedBFPSPhaseGap (x : ℝ) / 8 := by ring
    _ ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      sub_le_sub_left hgapSqrt _

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoffPhaseEnvelope_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoffPhaseEnvelope_le_budget
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope y (variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) ≤
        fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffSharpGlobalEulerRemainder_le hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_log_variableCutoff_shellCount_le_two_log2 hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_scaleA_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log3_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_scaleA_le_log2] with
      x hrange hdelta hB hlogCount hAone hL hA hL2 hL3 hAL2
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  let delta := variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T
  let P := delta * Real.log y
  let B := log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  have hlogSix : delta * Real.log 6 ≤ 2 := by
    have hlogSixNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log 6 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hlogSixLe : Real.log 6 ≤ (5 : ℝ) := by
      have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)
      norm_num at h ⊢
      exact h
    calc
      delta * Real.log 6 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log 6 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeltaData.2 hlogSixNonneg
      _ ≤ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hT : 0 < T :=
    (mul_pos hc₀ (scaleG_pos hL hA)).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hphaseUpper0 := variableCutoff_natural_phase_le hdeltaData.1.le
    hT.ne' (by omega : 0 < y) hcutoff
  have hphaseUpper : P ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) - variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [P, delta] using hphaseUpper0
  have hscalar : bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope y delta ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount y)) +
        (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * P * Real.exp P * Real.exp B := by
    apply bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_phaseScalar hrangeData.1
      hdeltaData.1 hdeltaData.2 hlogSix
    · rfl
    · intro i hi hhigh
      have hHY : bfpsGeometricEndpoint y 2 i ≤ y := Nat.div_le_self _ _
      have hglobal := fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global
        hhigh.1 hHY hdeltaData.1 hdeltaData.2 hhigh.2
      exact (sub_le_sub_right hglobal _).trans
        (by simpa only [B, delta] using hB y T hcutoff hwindow)
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := by
    exact mul_nonneg hdeltaData.1.le
      (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ y by omega)))
  have hPA : P ≤ scaleA (x : ℝ) :=
    hphaseUpper.trans (sub_le_self _ (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _))
  have hPq : P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := hPA.trans hAL2
  have hL3L2 : log3 (x : ℝ) ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hL2]
  have hexpP : Real.exp P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hPA
    rw [fixed_exp_scaleA_eq_log2_mul_log3_div_two hL2 hL3] at he
    have hprod : log2 (x : ℝ) * log3 (x : ℝ) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [pow_two] using
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL3L2 hL2.le)
    exact he.trans (by nlinarith)
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hexpHalf : Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.exp_half]
    have hexpLog : Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ)) = scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq] using Real.exp_log hL
    rw [hexpLog, scaleG_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hL.le
      (by simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hAone)
  have hAV : scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) = scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hexpB : Real.exp B ≤
      log2 (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
    calc
      Real.exp B = Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        dsimp only [B]
        rw [show log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)) =
          log2 (x : ℝ) / 2 + (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) by ring,
          Real.exp_add]
      _ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexpHalf (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = (scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by rw [hAV]
      _ ≤ (log2 (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAL2 hV.le) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hpoly : P * Real.exp P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      P * Real.exp P ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hPq hexpP (Real.exp_pos _).le hL2.le
      _ = log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
  have hsharp : (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * P * Real.exp P * Real.exp B ≤
      (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
        (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) *
          scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) := by positivity
    calc
      (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * P * Real.exp P * Real.exp B =
          (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * (P * Real.exp P) * Real.exp B := by ring
      _ ≤ (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) * (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 3) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ) *
            Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly hcoef) hexpB
          (Real.exp_pos _).le
          (mul_nonneg hcoef (pow_nonneg hL2.le _))
      _ = (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (log2 (x : ℝ)))) *
            scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
  have hmoderate : fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
        (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount y)) ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant * (1 + 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (by linarith [hlogCount y T hcutoff hwindow])
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant_nonneg
  unfold fixedBFPSPhaseEnvelopeBudget
  exact hscalar.trans (add_le_add hmoderate hsharp)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoffAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoffAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget
    {c₀ C₀ C : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T W,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffPhaseEnvelope_le_budget hc₀ hC₀] with
      x hrange hdelta henvelope
  intro y T W hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  have hlogTwoLeOne : Real.log 2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hbase : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * Real.log 2 ≤
          (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeltaData.2
          (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
      _ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hfinite := fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_phaseEnvelope
    (X := W) (Y := y) (δ := variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) (C := C)
      hrangeData.1 hdeltaData.1 hdeltaData.2 hbase hC
  unfold fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget
  exact hfinite.trans (add_le_add le_rfl
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (henvelope y T hcutoff hwindow) hC))

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_slack_mul_scaleL_div_T_le
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_slack_mul_scaleL_div_T_le
    {c₀ C₀ x T : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀)
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x)
    (hwindow : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T) :
    variableCutoffPhaseSlack x * scaleL x / T ≤
      (variableCutoffPhaseSlack x / c₀) * scaleV x
proof:
:= by
  have hG : 0 < scaleG x := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hratio : scaleL x / (c₀ * scaleG x) = scaleV x / c₀ := by
    have hGV := scaleG_mul_scaleV hG.ne'
    field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne']
    nlinarith
  have hdiv : scaleL x / T ≤ scaleL x / (c₀ * scaleG x) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1
  calc
    variableCutoffPhaseSlack x * scaleL x / T =
        variableCutoffPhaseSlack x * (scaleL x / T) := by ring
    _ ≤ variableCutoffPhaseSlack x * (scaleL x / (c₀ * scaleG x)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_nonneg _)
    _ = (variableCutoffPhaseSlack x / c₀) * scaleV x := by
      rw [hratio]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_variableCutoffSmoothError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_variableCutoffSmoothError_zero
    {c₀ : ℝ} (_hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    Tendsto (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hslack : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hraw := (tendsto_fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).div_const c₀
    have hraw' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        (fixedBFPSBaseRateSlack ∘ Nat.cast) x / c₀) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [zero_div] using hraw
    apply hraw'.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  have hpred : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        (fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget
            BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant x /
          scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.mul
      (tendsto_fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget_div_scaleV_zero
        BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant)
  have hsum := hslack.add hpred
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀ +
        smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
          (fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget
              BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant x /
            scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  unfold variableCutoffSmoothError
  ring

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_smoothTotient_unconditional
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_smoothTotient_unconditional
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (smoothTotientCount x y : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
            variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let C := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant
  have hC : 0 ≤ C :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget hc₀ hC₀ hC,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hrange hdelta hpred hL hA hV
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  have hx : 0 < x := by
    have hxReal : (1 : ℝ) < x :=
      (Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg x)).mp
        (by simpa only [scaleL_eq] using hL)
    exact_mod_cast (zero_lt_one.trans hxReal)
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent_growingCutoff
    (X := x) (Y := y) (c := 1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)
      hx hrangeData.1 (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hslack := variableCutoff_slack_mul_scaleL_div_T_le hc₀ hL hA hwindow
  have hcancel := variableCutoffDelta_mul_scaleL hL.le hA.le
    (show T ≠ 0 by
      exact ((mul_pos hc₀ (scaleG_pos hL hA)).trans_le hwindow.1).ne')
  have hpredBound := hpred y T x hcutoff hwindow
  have hEuler : smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant x y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpredBound
      (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  have hexponent : fixedBFPSAbelExponent x y
        (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
        variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedBFPSAbelExponent variableCutoffSmoothError
    rw [show Real.log (x : ℝ) = scaleL (x : ℝ) by rfl]
    have herrorIdentity :
        (variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀ +
            smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
              fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x / scaleV (x : ℝ)) *
            scaleV (x : ℝ) =
          (variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) *
              scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
              fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x := by
      field_simp [hV.ne']
    rw [herrorIdentity]
    calc
      -(1 - (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)) * scaleL (x : ℝ) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant x y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C =
        -(variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * scaleL (x : ℝ)) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant x y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C := by ring
      _ =
        -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) / T +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant x y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C := by
        rw [hcancel]
        ring
      _ ≤ -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          ((variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
              fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x) := by
        linarith
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent) (Nat.cast_nonneg x)

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_smoothShifted_unconditional
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_smoothShifted_unconditional
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (smoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
            variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [variableCutoff_smoothTotient_unconditional hc₀ hC₀] with x hx
  intro h y T hcutoff hwindow
  exact (smoothShiftedCount_cast_le_smoothTotientCount x h y).trans
    (hx y T hcutoff hwindow)

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three
statement:
theorem variableCutoffB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three
    {x y p : ℕ} (hcube : 3 * y ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    3 ≤ section5LocalCutoff x y p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hy0 : y = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hy
    rw [hy0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    exact hpPos.ne' hpData.2
  have hpSq : p ^ 2 ≤ y ^ 4 := by
    calc
      p ^ 2 ≤ (y ^ 2) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hpData.2 2
      _ = y ^ 4 := by ring
  have hthree : 3 * p ^ 2 ≤ section5Ambient x y := by
    unfold section5Ambient
    have hmul : 3 * y ^ 4 < 2 * x * y := by
      calc
        3 * y ^ 4 = (3 * y ^ 3) * y := by ring
        _ < (2 * x) * y := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcube hyPos
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hpSq).trans hmul.le
  exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (pow_pos hpPos 2)).2 hthree

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffB4Intermediate_finite_domain
statement:
theorem variableCutoffB4Intermediate_finite_domain
    {x y p : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hcube : 3 * y ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    0 < section5LocalCutoff x y p ∧ 3 ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  exact ⟨(by
    have hthree := variableCutoffB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three hcube hp
    omega), (by omega)⟩

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower
statement:
theorem variableCutoffB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower
    {x y p : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hcube : 3 * y ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * T ≤
      Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let W := section5Ambient x y
  let d := p ^ 2
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hy0 : y = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hy
    rw [hy0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    exact hpPos.ne' hpData.2
  have hdPos : 0 < d := pow_pos hpPos 2
  have hdW : d ≤ W := Nat.le_sqrt'.mp hpRange.2.1
  have hhalf := half_real_div_le_nat_div hdPos hdW
  have hWpos : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hdPos.trans_le hdW
  have hhalfPos : (0 : ℝ) < (W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ) :=
    div_pos hWpos (by positivity)
  have hlogHalf : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ)) ≤
      Real.log (W / d : ℕ) := Real.log_le_log hhalfPos hhalf
  have hlogY : Real.log (y : ℝ) ≤ T := log_natCutoff_le_T hyPos hcutoff
  have hlogP : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := by
    have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
    simpa [Real.log_pow, hyPos.ne'] using h
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by
    by_contra hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hx
    rw [hx0] at hcube
    simp at hcube
  have hmodel : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / (2 * d : ℕ)) =
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) - 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hneW : (W : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [W, section5Ambient, hxPos.ne', hyPos.ne']
    have hned : ((2 * d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [Real.log_div hneW hned]
    simp only [W, d, section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [Real.log_mul
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'))
      (by exact_mod_cast hyPos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (pow_ne_zero 2 (by exact_mod_cast hpPos.ne')),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    ring
  rw [hmodel] at hlogHalf
  have hlogHalf' : scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) -
      2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) := by
    simpa [W, d, section5LocalCutoff] using hlogHalf
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffUFloorMinus_le_rankinU
statement:
theorem variableCutoffUFloorMinus_le_rankinU
    {x y p : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * T)
    (hcube : 3 * y ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    variableCutoffUFloorMinus (x : ℝ) T ≤
      rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hy0 : y = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hy
    rw [hy0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    exact hpPos.ne' hpData.2
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hlogp : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * T := by
    have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpPos) hpLe
    rw [Real.log_pow] at h
    exact h.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (log_natCutoff_le_T hyPos hcutoff) (by norm_num)
  have hlogX := variableCutoffB4Intermediate_log_localCutoff_lower
    hcube hcutoff hp
  have hden : 0 < 2 * T := by positivity
  unfold variableCutoffUFloorMinus rankinU
  have hfirst : (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * T) / (2 * T) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * T) / Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hlogpPos hlogp
  exact hfirst.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlogX hlogpPos.le)

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_log_p_lower
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_log_p_lower
    {x y p : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hTlog : Real.log 2 ≤ T)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    T - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  have hlogY := T_sub_log_two_le_log_natCutoff hTlog hcutoff
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hy0 : y = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hy
    have hexpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hTlog
    rw [hy0] at hcutoff
    have hlt := hcutoff.2
    norm_num at hlt
    linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
  have hyp : (y : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpRange.1.le
  exact hlogY.trans (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hyPos) hyp)

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_le_variableCutoffUFloorPlus
statement:
theorem rankinU_le_variableCutoffUFloorPlus
    {x y p : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hTlog : Real.log 2 < T)
    (hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2)
    (hcube : 3 * y ^ 3 < 2 * x)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p ≤
      variableCutoffUFloorPlus (x : ℝ) T
proof:
:= by
  let W := section5Ambient x y
  let d := p ^ 2
  let X := section5LocalCutoff x y p
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hy0 : y = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hy
    rw [hy0] at hpData
    simp at hpData
    exact hpPos.ne' hpData.2
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by
    have hthree := variableCutoffB4Intermediate_localCutoff_ge_three hcube hp
    simpa [X] using (show 0 < section5LocalCutoff x y p by omega)
  have hlogpPos : 0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.one_lt)
  have hlogpLower : T - Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
    variableCutoff_log_p_lower hTlog.le hcutoff hp
  have hXcast : (X : ℝ) ≤ (W : ℝ) / d := by
    simpa [X, W, d, section5LocalCutoff, div_eq_mul_inv] using
      (section5LocalCutoff_cast_le x y p)
  have hlogX : Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((W : ℝ) / d) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hXpos) hXcast
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hmodel : Real.log ((W : ℝ) / d) =
      Real.log 2 + scaleL (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) -
        2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    have hWne : (W : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [W, section5Ambient, hxPos.ne', hyPos.ne']
    have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp [d, hpPos.ne']
    rw [Real.log_div hWne hdne]
    simp only [W, d, section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [Real.log_mul
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'))
      (by exact_mod_cast hyPos.ne'),
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by exact_mod_cast hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    ring
  have hlogY : Real.log (y : ℝ) ≤ T := log_natCutoff_le_T hyPos hcutoff
  rw [hmodel] at hlogX
  have hlogX' : Real.log (X : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2 - 2 * Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
    linarith
  have hdenPos : 0 < T - Real.log 2 := sub_pos.mpr hTlog
  unfold rankinU variableCutoffUFloorPlus
  have hfirst : Real.log (X : ℝ) / Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2) / Real.log (p : ℝ) - 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogpPos).2
    field_simp [hlogpPos.ne']
    linarith
  have hsecond :
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2) / Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2) / (T - Real.log 2) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hdenPos hlogpLower
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_window_room
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_window_room
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      2 * Real.log 2 ≤ T ∧ 6 * T ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsmallRaw := scaleG_isLittleO_scaleL.bound
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (6 * C₀) by positivity)
  have hsmall := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hsmallRaw
  have hGlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * Real.log 2 / c₀ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (2 * Real.log 2 / c₀)
  filter_upwards [hsmall, hGlarge,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hsmall hGlarge hL hA
  intro T hwindow
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hsmall
  have hsix : 6 * C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      6 * C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
          6 * C₀ * ((1 / (6 * C₀)) * scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall (by positivity)
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) := by field_simp [hC₀.ne']
  have hTlog : 2 * Real.log 2 ≤ T := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGlarge hc₀.le
    have htwo : 2 * Real.log 2 ≤ c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
      field_simp [hc₀.ne'] at hmul
      exact hmul
    exact htwo.trans hwindow.1
  refine ⟨hTlog, ?_⟩
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.2 (by norm_num)).trans (by
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hsix)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_three_variableCutoff_cube_lt_two_x
statement:
theorem eventually_three_variableCutoff_cube_lt_two_x
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      3 * y ^ 3 < 2 * x
proof:
:= by
  have hLlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * Real.log 3 < scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop
        (2 * Real.log 3)
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀,
      hLlarge, eventually_ge_atTop 2] with x hroom hLlarge hx
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hlogExp : Real.log 3 + 3 * T < scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hlogThree := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3)
    nlinarith
  have hyLe : (y : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := hcutoff.1
  have hreal : 3 * (y : ℝ) ^ 3 < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      3 * (y : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ 3 * (Real.exp T) ^ 3 := by gcongr
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log 3 + 3 * T) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3),
          ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        norm_num
      _ < Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlogExp
