      _ = (x : ℝ) := Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega))
      _ < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
        have hxReal : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega)
        linarith
  exact_mod_cast hreal

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_u_envelopes
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_u_envelopes
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) ≤
          variableCutoffUFloorMinus (x : ℝ) T ∧
        variableCutoffUFloorPlus (x : ℝ) T ≤
          4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hroom hL hA
  intro T hwindow
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hT : 0 < T := by
    have hlogPos := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
    linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hGV := scaleG_mul_scaleV hG.ne'
  have hnumLower : scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * T := by
    linarith
  have hlower : scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) ≤
      variableCutoffUFloorMinus (x : ℝ) T := by
    unfold variableCutoffUFloorMinus
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hT)).2
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) * (2 * T) ≤
          scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) *
            (2 * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.2 (by norm_num))
          (div_nonneg hV.le (by positivity))
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
        rw [← hGV]
        field_simp [hC₀.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * T := hnumLower
  have hdenLower : c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 2 ≤ T - Real.log 2 := by
    linarith [hwindow.1]
  have hnumUpper : scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2 ≤
      2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    have hlogT : Real.log 2 ≤ T := by
      have hlogPos := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith [hroomData.1]
    nlinarith
  have hratio :
      (scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2) / (T - Real.log 2) ≤
        4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
    have hdenPos : 0 < T - Real.log 2 := by
      have hlogPos := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith [hroomData.1]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdenPos).2
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by positivity
    calc
      scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2 ≤ 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := hnumUpper
      _ = (4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀) *
          (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 2) := by
        rw [← hGV]
        field_simp [hc₀.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ (4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀) * (T - Real.log 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdenLower hfactor
  refine ⟨hlower, ?_⟩
  unfold variableCutoffUFloorPlus
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_upperEnvelope_le_exp
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_upperEnvelope_le_exp
    {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ ≤
        Real.exp (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2oG : log2 =o[atTop] scaleG :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.trans scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG
  have hsmallRaw := hL2oG.bound
    (show (0 : ℝ) < c₀ / 8 by positivity)
  have hsmall := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hsmallRaw
  have hGlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      8 * |Real.log (4 / c₀)| / c₀ ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (8 * |Real.log (4 / c₀)| / c₀)
  filter_upwards [hsmall, hGlarge,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1]
      with x hsmall hGlarge hL hA hL2 hGone
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hGone
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le] at hsmall
  have hlogSmall : log2 (x : ℝ) ≤ c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 8 := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hsmall
  have hconstSmall : Real.log (4 / c₀) ≤
      c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 8 := by
    have habs : |Real.log (4 / c₀)| ≤
        c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 8 := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGlarge hc₀.le
      field_simp [hc₀.ne'] at hmul
      linarith
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans habs
  have hphase : Real.log (4 / c₀) + log2 (x : ℝ) ≤
      c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 4 := by linarith
  have hVleL : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [scaleV_eq]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hG).2
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hL.le hGone
  calc
    4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ ≤ 4 * scaleL (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hVleL (by norm_num)) hc₀.le
    _ = Real.exp (Real.log (4 / c₀) + log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 / c₀)]
      have hexp : Real.exp (log2 (x : ℝ)) = scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
        change Real.exp (Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ))) = scaleL (x : ℝ)
        exact Real.exp_log hL
      rw [hexp]
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 4) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hphase

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p ≤ Real.sqrt p
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_three_variableCutoff_cube_lt_two_x hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_u_envelopes hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_upperEnvelope_le_exp hc₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hrange hcube hroom henvelopes hexp hL hA
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2 := by
    have hT : 0 < T := by
      have hlogPos := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith [hroomData.1]
    positivity
  have hu := rankinU_le_variableCutoffUFloorPlus
    (by
      have hlogPos := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith [hroomData.1]) hnum (hcube y T hcutoff hwindow) hcutoff hp
  have hlogp := variableCutoff_log_p_lower
    (by
      have hlogPos := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith [hroomData.1]) hcutoff hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp
    (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1
  have hsqrt : Real.exp (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 4) ≤ Real.sqrt p := by
    calc
      Real.exp (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) / 4) ≤
          Real.exp (Real.log (p : ℝ) / 2) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        linarith [hwindow.1]
      _ = Real.sqrt p := by
        rw [Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.pos)]
  exact hu.trans ((henvelopes T hwindow).2.trans (hexp.trans hsqrt))

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        0 < section5LocalCutoff x y p ∧ 3 ≤ p ∧
          scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) ≤
            rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_three_variableCutoff_cube_lt_two_x hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_u_envelopes hc₀ hC₀] with
      x hrange hcube hroom henvelopes
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hT : 0 < T := by
    have hlogPos := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
    linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) - 3 * T := by linarith [hroomData.2]
  have hdomain := variableCutoffB4Intermediate_finite_domain
    (by omega : 2 ≤ y) (hcube y T hcutoff hwindow) hp
  refine ⟨hdomain.1, hdomain.2, ?_⟩
  exact (henvelopes T hwindow).1.trans
    (variableCutoffUFloorMinus_le_rankinU hT hnum
      (hcube y T hcutoff hwindow) hcutoff hp)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_two_T_le_variableCutoff_local_saddle
statement:
theorem eventually_two_T_le_variableCutoff_local_saddle
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        2 * T ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hAraw := scaleA_isLittleO_log2.bound
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (96 * C₀ ^ 2) by positivity)
  have hAnat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hAraw
  have hL2large : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      6 * |Real.log (4 * C₀)| ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (6 * |Real.log (4 * C₀)|)
  have hqThree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      3 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) :=
    (tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.atTop_div_const (by positivity)).eventually_ge_atTop 3
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      hAnat, hL2large, hqThree,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hlower hAraw hL2large hqThree hlogV hL hA hL2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hA.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le] at hAraw
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  let q := scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)
  let u := rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hqu : q ≤ u := by simpa [q, u] using (hlower y T hcutoff hwindow p hp).2.2
  have huPos : 0 < u := hqPos.trans_le hqu
  have hlogq : 16 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log q := by
    have hAupper : 16 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) / 6 := by
      calc
        16 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤
            16 * C₀ ^ 2 *
              ((1 / (96 * C₀ ^ 2)) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAraw (by positivity)
        _ = log2 (x : ℝ) / 6 := by field_simp [hC₀.ne']; ring
    have hlogModel : Real.log q = Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) -
        Real.log (4 * C₀) := by
      change Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) =
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) - Real.log (4 * C₀)
      rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' (by positivity : (4 : ℝ) * C₀ ≠ 0)]
    rw [hlogModel]
    have habs : Real.log (4 * C₀) ≤ |Real.log (4 * C₀)| := le_abs_self _
    nlinarith
  have hlogq0 : 0 ≤ Real.log q := Real.log_nonneg
    ((by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3).trans (by simpa [q] using hqThree))
  have hlogMono : Real.log q ≤ Real.log u := Real.log_le_log hqPos hqu
  have hmulMono : q * Real.log q ≤ u * Real.log u :=
    mul_le_mul hqu hlogMono hlogq0 huPos.le
  have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hsaving : 2 * C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤ q * Real.log q / 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogq hqPos.le
    rw [← hAG]
    change 2 * C₀ * (scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) *
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) / 2
    change (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) *
        (16 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) *
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) at hmul
    calc
      2 * C₀ * (scaleA (x : ℝ) * scaleV (x : ℝ)) =
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) *
            (16 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ)) / 2 := by
        field_simp [hC₀.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) *
          Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) / 2 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmul (by norm_num)
  calc
    2 * T ≤ 2 * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwindow.2 (by norm_num)
    _ = 2 * C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ q * Real.log q / 2 := hsaving
    _ ≤ u * Real.log u / 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmulMono (by norm_num)
    _ = rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
        Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p) / 2 := by rfl

name: RankAmplification.log2_three_mul_variableCutoff_prime_le_two_log2
statement:
theorem log2_three_mul_variableCutoff_prime_le_two_log2
    {x y p : ℕ} (hxy : y ≤ x) (hL : 3 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ))
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    log2 (3 * (p : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp
  have hpRange := mem_section5PrimeRange.mp hpData.1
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.pos
  have hxPos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by
    have hxNat : 0 < x := by
      by_contra hx
      have hx0 : x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hx
      subst x
      norm_num [scaleL] at hL
    exact_mod_cast hxNat
  have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (p : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hpData.2
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have harg : 3 * (p : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpRange.2.2.two_le
  have hleft : 0 < Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_pos (by nlinarith)
  have hinner : Real.log (3 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      Real.log 3 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (pow_ne_zero 2 hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    norm_num
  have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log 3 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hinnerLe : Real.log 3 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have hlogThree : Real.log 3 ≤ 2 := by
      have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)
      norm_num at h ⊢
      exact h
    nlinarith
  unfold log2 iteratedLog
  have hfirst := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 3 * p) harg
  have houter : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
    Real.log_le_log hleft hfirst
  rw [hinner] at houter
  calc
    Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
        Real.log (Real.log 3 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) := houter
    _ ≤ Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      Real.log_le_log hinnerPos hinnerLe
    _ = 2 * Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.log_pow]
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.eventually_log2_div_six_le_log_variableCutoff_q
statement:
theorem eventually_log2_div_six_le_log_variableCutoff_q
    {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      log2 (x : ℝ) / 6 ≤
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀))
proof:
:= by
  have hL2large : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      6 * |Real.log (4 * C₀)| ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
        (6 * |Real.log (4 * C₀)|)
  filter_upwards [hL2large,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hlarge hlogV hV
  have hmodel : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)) =
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) - Real.log (4 * C₀) := by
    rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' (by positivity : (4 : ℝ) * C₀ ≠ 0)]
  rw [hmodel]
  have habs : Real.log (4 * C₀) ≤ |Real.log (4 * C₀)| := le_abs_self _
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.fullPaperDivisorError_le_variableCutoffEnvelope
statement:
theorem fullPaperDivisorError_le_variableCutoffEnvelope
    {c₀ : ℝ} {x y p : ℕ}
    (hxy : y ≤ x) (hL : 3 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ))
    (hu3 : 3 ≤ rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p)
    (huUpper : rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p ≤
      4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀)
    (hp : p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y) :
    fullPaperDivisorError p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
      variableCutoffRankinErrorEnvelope c₀ x
proof:
:= by
  let u := rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p
  have huPos : 0 < u := (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3).trans_le hu3
  have hlogOne : 1 ≤ Real.log u := by
    have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ u := Real.exp_one_lt_three.le.trans hu3
    have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hexp
    simpa using h
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log u := zero_lt_one.trans_le hlogOne
  have huDiv : u / Real.log u ≤ u := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hlogPos).2
    nlinarith
  have hlogP := log2_three_mul_variableCutoff_prime_le_two_log2 hxy hL hp
  have hlogP' : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
      2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    simpa [log2, iteratedLog] using hlogP
  have hlogTerm : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (p : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
      2 * log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := by
    have hneg : -Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := neg_le_abs _
    linarith [hlogP']
  have huTerm : 3 * u / Real.log u ≤ 12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
    calc
      3 * u / Real.log u = 3 * (u / Real.log u) := by ring
      _ ≤ 3 * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 3 * (4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huUpper (by norm_num)
      _ = 12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by ring
  unfold fullPaperDivisorError fullULogUPrimeError
    variableCutoffRankinErrorEnvelope
  have hinside := add_le_add
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogTerm (Real.exp_pos 2).le) huTerm
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinside
      (mul_nonneg divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le primeCountingConstant_pos.le))

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_variableCutoff_half_saddle
statement:
theorem eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_variableCutoff_half_saddle
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        fullPaperDivisorError p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℝ := divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant
  have hVlarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      288 * D * Real.exp 2 * C₀ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hL2large : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      max |Real.log (Real.log 2)| (1152 * D * C₀ / c₀) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_log2_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop _
  have hVthree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      12 * C₀ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop _
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_u_envelopes hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_three_variableCutoff_cube_lt_two_x hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_log2_div_six_le_log_variableCutoff_q hC₀,
      hVlarge, hL2large, hVthree,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
      with x hrange hlower henvelopes hroom hcube hlogq hVlarge hL2large
        hVthree hL hA hL2
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  let q := scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀)
  let u := rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hqu : q ≤ u := by simpa [q, u] using (hlower y T hcutoff hwindow p hp).2.2
  have huPos : 0 < u := hqPos.trans_le hqu
  have hqThree : 3 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (4 : ℝ) * C₀)).2
    calc
      3 * (4 * C₀) = 12 * C₀ := by ring
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := hVthree
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hTlog : Real.log 2 < T := by linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hTpos : 0 < T := hlogTwo.trans hTlog
  have hnum : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) + T + Real.log 2 := by positivity
  have huFloor := rankinU_le_variableCutoffUFloorPlus hTlog hnum
    (hcube y T hcutoff hwindow) hcutoff hp
  have huUpper : u ≤ 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀ := by
    exact (by simpa [u] using huFloor.trans (henvelopes T hwindow).2)
  have huThree : 3 ≤ rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p := by
    simpa [u] using hqThree.trans hqu
  have hlogTwoHalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    exact (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 0.6931471803).trans
      Real.log_two_gt_d9.le
  have hfull := fullPaperDivisorError_le_variableCutoffEnvelope
    (hrange y T hcutoff hwindow).2 (by linarith [hroomData.1, hroomData.2] :
      3 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) huThree huUpper hp
  have hDpos : 0 < D := mul_pos divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos primeCountingConstant_pos
  have habsLe : |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans hL2large
  have hsecondThreshold : 1152 * D * C₀ / c₀ ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans hL2large
  have henvFirst : D * (Real.exp 2 *
      (2 * log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|)) ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (96 * C₀) := by
    have hsum : 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| ≤
        3 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by linarith
    calc
      D * (Real.exp 2 * (2 * log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|)) ≤
          D * (Real.exp 2 * (3 * log2 (x : ℝ))) := by gcongr
      _ = (288 * D * Real.exp 2 * C₀ * log2 (x : ℝ)) /
          (96 * C₀) := by field_simp [hC₀.ne']; ring
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (96 * C₀) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hVlarge hL2.le) (by positivity)
  have henvSecond : D * (12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀) ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (96 * C₀) := by
    calc
      D * (12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀) =
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * (1152 * D * C₀ / c₀)) /
            (96 * C₀) := by field_simp [hc₀.ne', hC₀.ne']; ring
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (96 * C₀) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecondThreshold hV.le) (by positivity)
  have henv : variableCutoffRankinErrorEnvelope c₀ x ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (48 * C₀) := by
    change D * (Real.exp 2 *
        (2 * log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
          12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀) ≤ _
    rw [mul_add]
    calc
      D * (Real.exp 2 *
          (2 * log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|)) +
          D * (12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / c₀) ≤
          scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (96 * C₀) +
            scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (96 * C₀) :=
        add_le_add henvFirst henvSecond
      _ = scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (48 * C₀) := by ring
  have hqSaddle : scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (48 * C₀) ≤
      q * Real.log q / 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (by simpa [q] using hlogq) hqPos.le
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ) / (48 * C₀) =
          q * (log2 (x : ℝ) / 6) / 2 := by
        dsimp [q]
        field_simp [hC₀.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ q * Real.log q / 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmul (by norm_num)
  have hlogq0 : 0 ≤ Real.log q := Real.log_nonneg
    ((by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3).trans hqThree)
  have hlogMono : Real.log q ≤ Real.log u := Real.log_le_log hqPos hqu
  have hmulMono : q * Real.log q ≤ u * Real.log u :=
    mul_le_mul hqu hlogMono hlogq0 huPos.le
  exact hfull.trans (henv.trans (hqSaddle.trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmulMono (by norm_num))))

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y (2 * T)
proof:
:= by
  have hVthree : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      12 * C₀ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop _
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_variableCutoff_half_saddle hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_two_T_le_variableCutoff_local_saddle hc₀ hC₀,
      hVthree] with x hlower hupper herror hsaving hVthree
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hlowerData := hlower y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hCfour : 0 < 4 * C₀ := by positivity
  have hqThree : (3 : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hCfour).2
    calc
      3 * (4 * C₀) = 12 * C₀ := by ring
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := hVthree
  refine ⟨hlowerData.1, ?_, hupper y T hcutoff hwindow p hp,
    herror y T hcutoff hwindow p hp, hsaving y T hcutoff hwindow p hp⟩
  exact (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3).trans_le
    (hqThree.trans hlowerData.2.2)

name: RankAmplification.natCutoff_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg
statement:
theorem natCutoff_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg
    {y : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hT : Real.log 2 ≤ T)
    (hcutoff : IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T) :
    (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-T)
proof:
:= by
  have hexpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp T := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hT
  have hyOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    by_contra hy
    have hyZero : y = 0 := by
      have : ¬1 ≤ y := by exact_mod_cast hy
      omega
    subst y
    have hlt := hcutoff.2
    norm_num at hlt
    linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
  have hhalf : Real.exp T / 2 ≤ (y : ℝ) := by
    have hfloor := hcutoff.2
    have hyCast : (y : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * y := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  calc
    (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.exp T / 2)⁻¹ :=
      inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hhalf
    _ = 2 * Real.exp (-T) := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.section5Ambient_log_le_four_scaleL
statement:
theorem section5Ambient_log_le_four_scaleL
    {x y : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y) (hxy : y ≤ x) :
    1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) ≤
      4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hxPos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x by omega)
  have hyPos : (0 : ℝ) < y := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hambPos : (0 : ℝ) < section5Ambient x y := by
    simp only [section5Ambient, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    positivity
  have hambLe : (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast (show section5Ambient x y ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 by
      unfold section5Ambient
      calc
        2 * x * y ≤ 2 * x * x := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * x) hxy
        _ = 2 * x ^ 2 := by ring)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hambPos hambLe
  have hmodel : Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      Real.log 2 + 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (pow_ne_zero 2 hxPos.ne'),
      Real.log_pow, scaleL]
    norm_num
  rw [hmodel] at hlog
  have hlogTwo : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    exact Real.log_two_lt_d9.le.trans (by norm_num)
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_section5B4Absorption
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_section5B4Absorption
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      HasSection5B4Absorption x y T (2 * T)
        (variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀] with x hrange hroom
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hTlog : Real.log 2 ≤ T := by linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hinv := natCutoff_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg hTlog hcutoff
  have hxOne : 1 ≤ x := (by omega : 1 ≤ y).trans hrangeData.2
  have hamb := section5Ambient_log_le_four_scaleL hxOne (by omega) hrangeData.2
  have hL : 0 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hxOne)
  have hambNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) := by
    have hambOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ section5Ambient x y := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ section5Ambient x y by
        unfold section5Ambient
        exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
          (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Nat.ne_of_gt (by omega)))
            (Nat.ne_of_gt (by omega))))
    positivity
  have hfirst : 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-T) := by
    gcongr
    linarith
  have hsecond :
      2 * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
        16 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-T) := by
    calc
      2 * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          2 * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
            (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ 2 * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ = 16 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-T) := by ring
  unfold HasSection5B4Absorption variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError
  calc
    2 * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
        2 * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-T) +
          16 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-T) :=
      add_le_add hfirst hsecond
    _ = Real.exp (-T) * (18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ = Real.exp (-T + Real.log (18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ))) := by
      have hcoef : 0 < 18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by nlinarith
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hcoef]

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_proposition5_1_unconditional
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_proposition5_1_unconditional
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      smoothMultiplierB4Sum x y ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T + variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_section5B4Absorption hc₀ hC₀] with
      x hrange hRankin hAbsorb
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  exact proposition5_1_finite (by omega) hrangeData.2
    (hRankin y T hcutoff hwindow) (hAbsorb y T hcutoff hwindow)

name: RankAmplification.two_natSqrt_le_two_mul_exp_neg
statement:
theorem two_natSqrt_le_two_mul_exp_neg
    {x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hlog : Real.log 2 + 2 * T ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)
proof:
:= by
  have hxReal : (0 : ℝ) < x := by exact_mod_cast hx
  have hreal : Real.sqrt (2 * (x : ℝ)) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) := by
    have hsquare : (Real.sqrt (2 * (x : ℝ))) ^ 2 ≤
        ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      calc
        2 * (x : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log (x : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num), Real.exp_log hxReal]
        _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.log (x : ℝ) - 2 * T) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          rw [scaleL_eq] at hlog
          linarith
        _ = ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)) ^ 2 := by
          rw [show 2 * Real.log (x : ℝ) - 2 * T =
              (Real.log (x : ℝ) - T) + (Real.log (x : ℝ) - T) by ring,
            Real.exp_add, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hxReal, Real.exp_neg,
            div_eq_mul_inv]
          ring
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg hxReal.le (Real.exp_pos _).le)).mp hsquare
  have hnat : ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
    exact Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt.trans_eq (by norm_num)
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_variableCutoffNonsmoothError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_variableCutoffNonsmoothError_zero :
    Tendsto variableCutoffNonsmoothError atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 128 + 8 * Real.log 4 + 2 * Real.log 2) /
        scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      2 * log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hbase := log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    have hscaled := hbase.const_mul 2
    have hscaled' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
        2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_zero] using hscaled
    apply hscaled'.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  have hsum := hconst.add hlog
  have hsum' : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (Real.log 128 + 8 * Real.log 4 + 2 * Real.log 2) /
          scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        2 * log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  unfold variableCutoffNonsmoothError
  ring

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoffNonsmoothCoefficient_le_errorExp
statement:
theorem variableCutoffNonsmoothCoefficient_le_errorExp
    {x : ℕ} (hL : 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) (hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ)) :
    128 * Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4) * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
      Real.exp (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hLpos : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans_le hL
  have hpoly : 1 + scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hsq : (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
      (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hfinite :
      128 * Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4) * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
        128 * Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4) * (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    gcongr
  calc
    128 * Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4) * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
        128 * Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4) * (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 := hfinite
    _ = Real.exp (Real.log 128 + 8 * Real.log 4 + 2 * Real.log 2 +
          2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hexpSquare : Real.exp
          (2 * (Real.log 2 + Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)))) =
          (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          Real.exp (2 * (Real.log 2 + Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)))) =
              Real.exp (Real.log 2 + Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by
            simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using Real.exp_nat_mul
              (Real.log 2 + Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ))) 2
          _ = (2 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
              Real.exp_log hLpos]
      rw [show Real.log 128 + 8 * Real.log 4 + 2 * Real.log 2 +
            2 * log2 (x : ℝ) =
          Real.log 128 + (8 * Real.log 4 +
            2 * (Real.log 2 + Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)))) by
          simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]
          ring,
        Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 128),
        hexpSquare]
      ring
    _ = Real.exp (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      unfold variableCutoffNonsmoothError
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.variableCutoff_nonsmooth_unconditional
statement:
theorem variableCutoff_nonsmooth_unconditional
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y → Odd h →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-T + variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hLone : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      eventually_variableCutoff_window_room hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, hLone] with x hrange hroom hRankin hV hL
  intro h y T hh hhy hodd hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hroomData := hroom T hwindow
  have hy : 2 ≤ y := by omega
  have hyPos : 0 < y := by omega
  have hxOne : 1 ≤ x := (by omega : 1 ≤ y).trans hrangeData.2
  have hxPos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hlogTwo : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hTpos : 0 < T := by linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hTlog : Real.log 2 ≤ T := by linarith [hroomData.1]
  have hinv := natCutoff_inv_le_two_mul_exp_neg hTlog hcutoff
  have hRankinData := hRankin y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hfinite := theorem1_6_with_section5_rankin hodd hy hhy hrangeData.2
    hRankinData
  let a := 1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)
  let M := Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4)
  let base := (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T)
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := by
    change 1 ≤ 1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)
    linarith [hL]
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := by
    dsimp [M]
    exact Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)))
  have hbase : 0 ≤ base := by dsimp [base]; positivity
  have hcut : 2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 4 * base := by
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ = 4 * base := by dsimp [base]; ring
  have hlogSqrt : Real.log 2 + 2 * T ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    linarith [hroomData.1, hroomData.2]
  have hsqrt : 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤ 2 * base := by
    change 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) ≤
      2 * ((x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T))
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using two_natSqrt_le_two_mul_exp_neg hxPos hlogSqrt
  have hsmallFinite := smallCofactorLogTerm_le hxOne hyPos
  have hsmall : ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) ≤
      2 * a * base := by
    calc
      ((x / y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := hsmallFinite
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (2 * Real.exp (-T)) *
          (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ)) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * a * base := by dsimp [a, base]; ring
  have hendpoint := section5_endpoint_log_bound_of_le
    hxOne hyPos hrangeData.2
  have hfactorPos : 0 ≤ section4MertensFactor
      (section5Ambient x y).sqrt := section4MertensFactor_nonneg _
  have hfactor : section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt ≤
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a) := by
    unfold section4MertensFactor
    dsimp [a]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hendpoint (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hfactorSq :
      (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 ≤
        (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a)) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hfactor, hfactorPos,
      show 0 ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a) by positivity]
  have hE2 : Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 = M := by
    dsimp [M]
    calc
      Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) ^ 2 =
          Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) := by ring
      _ = Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4 + 4 * Real.log 4) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add]
      _ = Real.exp (8 * Real.log 4) := by
        congr 1
        ring
  have hreciprocal :
      (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
          (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 32 * M * a ^ 2 * base := by
    calc
      (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
          (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a)) ^ 2 *
            (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := by gcongr
      _ ≤ (x : ℝ) * (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (4 * a)) ^ 2 *
          (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ = 32 * M * a ^ 2 * base := by
        dsimp [base]
        rw [mul_pow, hE2]
        ring
  have hintermediate : 2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) ≤
      2 * base := by
    have hexp : Real.exp (-(2 * T)) ≤ Real.exp (-T) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-T) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * base := by dsimp [base]; ring
  have hamb := section5Ambient_log_le_four_scaleL hxOne hyPos hrangeData.2
  have hupper :
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
        16 * a * base := by
    have hambNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y : ℝ) := by
      have hambOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ section5Ambient x y := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ section5Ambient x y by
          unfold section5Ambient
          exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
            (Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hxPos.ne') hyPos.ne'))
      positivity
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
            (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * (4 * (1 + scaleL (x : ℝ))) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-T)) := by gcongr
      _ = 16 * a * base := by dsimp [a, base]; ring
  have haSq : a ≤ a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have honeMass : 1 ≤ M * a ^ 2 := by
    calc
      1 ≤ a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ M * a ^ 2 := by
        exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg a) hM
  have haMass : a ≤ M * a ^ 2 := haSq.trans
    (le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg a) hM)
  have hcoeff :
      4 + 2 + 2 * a + 32 * M * a ^ 2 + 2 + 16 * a ≤
        128 * M * a ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hsum :
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
          (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          ((x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        base * (128 * M * a ^ 2) := by
    have hcoeffMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcoeff hbase
    have hfirstThree :
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
            (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) ≤
          4 * base + 2 * base + 2 * a * base :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add hcut hsqrt) hsmall
    have hlastThree :
        (x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
          32 * M * a ^ 2 * base + 2 * base + 16 * a * base :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add hreciprocal hintermediate) hupper
    calc
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
          (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          ((x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
          (4 * base + 2 * base + 2 * a * base) +
            (32 * M * a ^ 2 * base + 2 * base + 16 * a * base) :=
        add_le_add hfirstThree hlastThree
      _ = base * (4 + 2 + 2 * a + 32 * M * a ^ 2 + 2 + 16 * a) := by ring
      _ ≤ base * (128 * M * a ^ 2) := hcoeffMul
  have hpoly := variableCutoffNonsmoothCoefficient_le_errorExp hL hV
  calc
    (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) +
          (x / y : ℕ) * (1 + Real.log (x / y : ℕ)) +
          ((x : ℝ) * (section4MertensFactor (section5Ambient x y).sqrt) ^ 2 *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹ +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * T)) +
            2 * (x : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (section5Ambient x y)) *
              (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := hfinite
    _ ≤ base * (128 * M * a ^ 2) := hsum
    _ ≤ base * Real.exp
        (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [a, M]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly hbase
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-T + variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      dsimp [base]
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_variableCutoffRankOneError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_variableCutoffRankOneError_zero
    {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) :
    Tendsto (variableCutoffRankOneError c₀) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      max (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x)
        (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using
      (tendsto_variableCutoffSmoothError_zero hc₀).max
        tendsto_variableCutoffNonsmoothError_zero
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hsum := hmax.add hconst
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      max (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x) (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x) +
        Real.log 2 / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hsum

name: RankAmplification.proposition7_1_variableCutoff_unconditional
statement:
theorem proposition7_1_variableCutoff_unconditional
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y T,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y → Odd h →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-min T (scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
            variableCutoffRankOneError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      variableCutoff_smoothShifted_unconditional hc₀ hC₀.le,
      variableCutoff_nonsmooth_unconditional hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hrange hsmooth hnonsmooth hV
  intro h y T hh hhy hodd hcutoff hwindow
  have hyOne : 1 ≤ y := by
    exact (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3).trans (hrange y T hcutoff hwindow).1
  have hs := hsmooth h y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hn := hnonsmooth h y T hh hhy hodd hcutoff hwindow
  let E := max (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x)
    (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x)
  let P := min T (scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T)
  have hsError : variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
      E * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact le_max_left _ _) hV.le
  have hnError : variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
      E * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact le_max_right _ _) hV.le
  have hsExponent :
      -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
        -P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hphase : P ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T := by
      dsimp [P]
      exact min_le_right _ _
    calc
      -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
          -(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
            variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ -P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add (neg_le_neg hphase) hsError
  have hnExponent :
      -T + variableCutoffNonsmoothError x * scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
        -P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hphase : P ≤ T := by
      dsimp [P]
      exact min_le_left _ _
    exact add_le_add (neg_le_neg hphase) hnError
  have hsCommon : (smoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    hs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hsExponent)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg x))
  have hnCommon : (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    hn.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hnExponent)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg x))
  rw [shiftedEqualTotientCount_eq_smooth_add_nonsmooth hyOne, Nat.cast_add]
  calc
    (smoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) + (nonsmoothShiftedCount x h y : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
          (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
      add_le_add hsCommon hnCommon
    _ = (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-min T (scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
          variableCutoffRankOneError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      have herr : variableCutoffRankOneError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
          max (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x) (variableCutoffNonsmoothError x) *
              scaleV (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2 := by
        rw [variableCutoffRankOneError, add_mul,
          div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne']
      have hexponent :
          -min T (scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T) +
              variableCutoffRankOneError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
            (-P + E * scaleV (x : ℝ)) + Real.log 2 := by
        rw [herr]
        dsimp only [P, E]
        ring
      rw [hexponent]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      ring

statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_generalRootSet {p A B : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {r : ZMod p} :
    r ∈ generalRootSet p A B hp ↔ (A : ZMod p) * r + (B : ZMod p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  simp [generalRootSet]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_generalRootSet_le_one
statement:
theorem card_generalRootSet_le_one {p A B : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hAB : Nat.Coprime A B) :
    (generalRootSet p A B hp).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro x hx y hy
  have hxEq := (mem_generalRootSet hp).mp hx
  have hyEq := (mem_generalRootSet hp).mp hy
  by_cases hA : (A : ZMod p) = 0
  · exfalso
    rw [hA, zero_mul, zero_add] at hxEq
    have hpA : p ∣ A := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hA
    have hpB : p ∣ B := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hxEq
    have hgcd : p ∣ Nat.gcd A B := Nat.dvd_gcd hpA hpB
    have hABeq : Nat.gcd A B = 1 := hAB
    rw [hABeq] at hgcd
    exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp hgcd)
  · have hmul : (A : ZMod p) * (x - y) = 0 := by
      calc
        (A : ZMod p) * (x - y) =
            ((A : ZMod p) * x + (B : ZMod p)) - ((A : ZMod p) * y + (B : ZMod p)) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hxEq, hyEq]; ring
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hA)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_generalRootSet_eq_one_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem card_generalRootSet_eq_one_of_not_dvd
    {p A B : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hAp : ¬ p ∣ A) :
    (generalRootSet p A B hp).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hA : (A : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    exact hAp ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hzero)
  let r : ZMod p := -((A : ZMod p)⁻¹ * (B : ZMod p))
  have hr : r ∈ generalRootSet p A B hp := by
    rw [mem_generalRootSet hp]
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hA, one_mul]
    ring
  apply Finset.card_eq_one.mpr
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  ext x
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxEq := (mem_generalRootSet hp).mp hx
    have hxMul : (A : ZMod p) * x = -(B : ZMod p) := by
      calc
        (A : ZMod p) * x = ((A : ZMod p) * x + (B : ZMod p)) - (B : ZMod p) := by ring
        _ = -(B : ZMod p) := by rw [hxEq]; ring
    calc
      x = (A : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((A : ZMod p) * x) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hA, one_mul]
      _ = (A : ZMod p)⁻¹ * (-(B : ZMod p)) := by rw [hxMul]
      _ = r := by dsimp only [r]; ring
  · rintro rfl
    exact hr

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_badResidueSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_badResidueSet_iff {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {r : ZMod p} :
    r ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp ↔
      ((L.leftSlope : ZMod p) * r + (L.leftIntercept : ZMod p)) *
        ((L.rightSlope : ZMod p) * r + (L.rightIntercept : ZMod p)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  simp [badResidueSet]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_badResidueSet_le_two
statement:
theorem card_badResidueSet_le_two {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (L.badResidueSet p hp).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold badResidueSet
  calc
    (generalRootSet p L.leftSlope L.leftIntercept hp ∪
        generalRootSet p L.rightSlope L.rightIntercept hp).card ≤
        (generalRootSet p L.leftSlope L.leftIntercept hp).card +
          (generalRootSet p L.rightSlope L.rightIntercept hp).card :=
      Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ 1 + 1 :=
      Nat.add_le_add (card_generalRootSet_le_one hp L.left_primitive)
        (card_generalRootSet_le_one hp L.right_primitive)
    _ = 2 := rfl

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.detAbs_pos

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.exceptionalModulus_pos

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_exceptionalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem mem_exceptionalPrimeSet {p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ L.exceptionalPrimeSet ↔ p.Prime ∧ p ∣ L.exceptionalModulus
proof:

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.two_mem_exceptionalPrimeSet
statement: theorem two_mem_exceptionalPrimeSet : 2 ∈ L.exceptionalPrimeSet
proof:

  L.mem_exceptionalPrimeSet.mpr
    ⟨Nat.prime_two, by
      unfold exceptionalModulus

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.not_dvd_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem not_dvd_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (h : p ∉ L.exceptionalPrimeSet) :
    ¬ p ∣ L.leftSlope ∧ ¬ p ∣ L.rightSlope ∧ ¬ p ∣ L.detAbs
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hdvd ↦ h ?_, fun hdvd ↦ h ?_, fun hdvd ↦ h ?_⟩ <;>
    refine L.mem_exceptionalPrimeSet.mpr ⟨hp, ?_⟩ <;> unfold exceptionalModulus
  · exact Dvd.dvd.mul_right (Dvd.dvd.mul_right (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hdvd 2) _) _
  · exact Dvd.dvd.mul_right (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hdvd _) _
  · exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hdvd _

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.three_le_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem three_le_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hmem : p ∉ L.exceptionalPrimeSet) :
    3 ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  have hpTwo := hp.two_le
  have hne : p ≠ 2 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hmem L.two_mem_exceptionalPrimeSet
  omega

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.disjoint_generalRootSet_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem disjoint_generalRootSet_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hmem : p ∉ L.exceptionalPrimeSet) :
    Disjoint (generalRootSet p L.leftSlope L.leftIntercept hp)
      (generalRootSet p L.rightSlope L.rightIntercept hp)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨-, -, hdet⟩ := L.not_dvd_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hp hmem
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro r hrLeft hrRight
  have hleft := (mem_generalRootSet hp).mp hrLeft
  have hright := (mem_generalRootSet hp).mp hrRight
  
  have hcross :
      ((L.leftSlope * L.rightIntercept : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
        ((L.rightSlope * L.leftIntercept : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
    have hmul :
        (L.rightSlope : ZMod p) * (L.leftIntercept : ZMod p) -
          (L.leftSlope : ZMod p) * (L.rightIntercept : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      calc
        (L.rightSlope : ZMod p) * (L.leftIntercept : ZMod p) -
            (L.leftSlope : ZMod p) * (L.rightIntercept : ZMod p) =
            (L.rightSlope : ZMod p) *
                ((L.leftSlope : ZMod p) * r + (L.leftIntercept : ZMod p)) -
              (L.leftSlope : ZMod p) *
                ((L.rightSlope : ZMod p) * r + (L.rightIntercept : ZMod p)) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hleft, hright]; ring
    push_cast
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hmul).symm
  have hcastMaxMin :
      ((max (L.leftSlope * L.rightIntercept) (L.rightSlope * L.leftIntercept) : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
        ((min (L.leftSlope * L.rightIntercept) (L.rightSlope * L.leftIntercept) : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
    rcases le_total (L.leftSlope * L.rightIntercept) (L.rightSlope * L.leftIntercept) with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h, min_eq_left h]
      exact hcross.symm
    · rw [max_eq_left h, min_eq_right h]
      exact hcross
  have hdetZero : ((L.detAbs : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
    unfold detAbs
    rw [Nat.cast_sub min_le_max, hcastMaxMin, sub_self]
  exact hdet ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hdetZero)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.productValue_pos

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_selbergSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_selbergSupport {R N : ℕ} :
    N ∈ L.selbergSupport R ↔ ∃ t < R, L.shiftedProductValue t = N
proof:

  simp [selbergSupport, shiftedProductEmbedding]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_shiftedBadResidueSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_shiftedBadResidueSet {d : ℕ} {t : Fin d} :
    t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet d ↔ d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue t
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedBadResidueSet]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd (d t : ℕ) :
    L.shiftedProductMod d t = 0 ↔ d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [shiftedProductMod, shiftedProductValue, productValue, leftValue, rightValue,
    Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p = (L.badResidueSet p hp).card
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  let e : Fin p ≃ ZMod p :=
    (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv.trans (Equiv.addRight 1)
  have he (t : Fin p) :
      t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet p ↔ e t ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp := by
    rw [mem_shiftedBadResidueSet, mem_badResidueSet_iff (L := L) hp,
      ← L.shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd p t]
    have hfin : (ZMod.finEquiv p) t = (t.val : ZMod p) := by
      cases p with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 t
      | succ p =>
          change t = (t.val : ZMod (p + 1))
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n := p + 1) t).symm
    have hfin' : (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv t = (t.val : ZMod p) := hfin
    simp only [e, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight]
    rw [hfin']
    rfl
  have rootEquiv :
      {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet p} ≃
        {u // u ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp} :=
    e.subtypeEquiv he
  calc
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p =
        Fintype.card {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet p} := by
      rw [shiftedBadResidueCount, Fintype.card_coe]
    _ = Fintype.card {u // u ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp} :=
      Fintype.card_congr rootEquiv
    _ = (L.badResidueSet p hp).card := Fintype.card_coe _

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card hp]
  exact L.card_badResidueSet_le_two hp

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime_of_two_lt
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime_of_two_lt {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpTwo : 2 < p) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p < p
proof:
:=
  (L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two hp).trans_lt hpTwo

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedProductValue_modEq
statement:
theorem shiftedProductValue_modEq {d t u : ℕ} (htu : t ≡ u [MOD d]) :
    L.shiftedProductValue t ≡ L.shiftedProductValue u [MOD d]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at htu ⊢
  simp only [shiftedProductValue, productValue, leftValue, rightValue, Nat.cast_mul,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [htu]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_divisibleParameterSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_divisibleParameterSet {R d t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ L.divisibleParameterSet R d ↔ t < R ∧ d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue t
proof:
:= by
  simp [divisibleParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} {a : Fin d} {t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ parameterResidueFiber R d a ↔ t < R ∧ t ≡ a.val [MOD d]
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameterResidueFiber]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
theorem card_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (a : Fin d) :
    (parameterResidueFiber R d a).card =
      R / d + if a.val < R % d then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterResidueFiber, ← Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  simpa only [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt] using Nat.count_modEq_card R hd a.val

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.residueExcessCount_le
statement:
theorem residueExcessCount_le (R d : ℕ) :
    L.residueExcessCount R d ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_filter_le _ _

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    L.divisibleParameterSet R d =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueSet d).biUnion (parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_divisibleParameterSet, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨htR, htDiv⟩
    let a : Fin d := ⟨t % d, Nat.mod_lt t hd⟩
    have hta : t ≡ a.val [MOD d] := (Nat.mod_modEq t d).symm
    have hvalue := L.shiftedProductValue_modEq hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue a.val :=
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.symm.trans htDiv.modEq_zero_nat)
    exact ⟨a, by simpa [shiftedBadResidueSet] using haDiv,
      mem_parameterResidueFiber.mpr ⟨htR, hta⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, haRoot, hta⟩
    have htaData := mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue a := by
      simpa [shiftedBadResidueSet] using haRoot
    have hvalue := L.shiftedProductValue_modEq htaData.2
    exact ⟨htaData.1,
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.trans haDiv.modEq_zero_nat)⟩

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint (R d : ℕ) :
    ((L.shiftedBadResidueSet d : Finset (Fin d)) : Set (Fin d)).PairwiseDisjoint
      (parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ha b _hb hab
  change Disjoint (parameterResidueFiber R d a) (parameterResidueFiber R d b)
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro t hta htb
  have hat := (mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta).2
  have hbt := (mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp htb).2
  apply hab
  apply Fin.ext
  have habMod : a.val ≡ b.val [MOD d] := hat.symm.trans hbt
  simpa only [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.isLt] using habMod

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_eq {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card =
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount d * (R / d) + L.residueExcessCount R d
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion hd,
    Finset.card_biUnion (L.parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint R d)]
  simp_rw [card_parameterResidueFiber hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_nat, shiftedBadResidueCount, residueExcessCount,
    Finset.card_filter]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card : ℝ) =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        L.residueExcessCount R d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast L.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq hd

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.residueExcessCount_cast_le
statement:
theorem residueExcessCount_cast_le (R d : ℕ) :
    (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast L.residueExcessCount_le R d

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_activePrimeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_activePrimeSet {z p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z ↔
      p.Prime ∧ p ≤ z ∧ 2 < p ∧ 0 < L.shiftedBadResidueCount p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [activePrimeSet, Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mem_primesLE]
  aesop

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.activePrimeProduct_squarefree
statement: theorem activePrimeProduct_squarefree (z : ℕ) : Squarefree (L.activePrimeProduct z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [activePrimeProduct]
  refine Finset.squarefree_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime (fun p hp q hq hpq ↦ ?_)
    (fun p hp ↦ (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1.squarefree)
  simp only [← coprime_iff_isRelPrime]
  exact (coprime_primes (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1
    (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hq).1).mpr hpq

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff {z p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z ↔ p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hpd
    rw [activePrimeProduct, hp.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff] at hpd
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := hpd
    have hqPrime := (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hq).1
    have hpEq : p = q := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hqPrime).mp hpq
    simpa [hpEq] using hq
  · intro hpMem
    exact dvd_prod_of_mem _ hpMem

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineBoundingSieve_multSum
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_multSum (R z d : ℕ) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).multSum d =
      (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [BoundingSieve.multSum, affineBoundingSieve, selbergSupport,
    shiftedProductEmbedding, divisibleParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem

theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem (R z d : ℕ) :

proof:

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        L.residueExcessCount R d - L.sieveDensity d * R
proof:

  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem, L.card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error hd]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineBoundingSieve_siftedSum

theorem affineBoundingSieve_siftedSum (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).siftedSum = (L.siftedParameterSet R z).card
proof:

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.parameterShiftEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parameterShiftEmbedding_apply (t : ℕ) : parameterShiftEmbedding t = t + 1
proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_siftedPairSet
statement:
theorem mem_siftedPairSet {R z r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.siftedPairSet R z ↔
      1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ R ∧ Nat.Coprime (L.activePrimeProduct z) (L.productValue r)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr
    rw [siftedPairSet, Finset.mem_map] at hr
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hr
    have htData := L.mem_siftedParameterSet.mp ht
    refine ⟨by simp, by simpa using htData.1, ?_⟩
    simpa [shiftedProductValue] using htData.2
  · rintro ⟨hr1, hrR, hcop⟩
    rw [siftedPairSet, Finset.mem_map]
    refine ⟨r - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply L.mem_siftedParameterSet.mpr
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      have hshift : r - 1 + 1 = r := by omega
      simpa [shiftedProductValue, hshift] using hcop
    · simp only [parameterShiftEmbedding_apply]
      omega

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum
statement:
theorem card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum (R z : ℕ) :
    ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card : ℝ) = (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).siftedSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [siftedPairSet, Finset.card_map, L.affineBoundingSieve_siftedSum]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt
statement:
theorem mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt {R z r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ L.primePairSet R)
    (hleft : z < L.leftValue r) (hright : z < L.rightValue r) :
    r ∈ L.siftedPairSet R z
proof:
:= by
  have hp := L.mem_primePairSet.mp hr
  refine L.mem_siftedPairSet.mpr ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, ?_⟩
  rw [activePrimeProduct, Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff]
  intro p hpMem
  have hpData := L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpMem
  refine hpData.1.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr ?_
  intro hdvd
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hpData.1).mp hdvd with hpLeft | hpRight
  · have heq : p = L.leftValue r :=
      (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpData.1 hp.2.2.1).mp hpLeft
    have hple : p ≤ z := hpData.2.1
    omega
  · have heq : p = L.rightValue r :=
      (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpData.1 hp.2.2.2).mp hpRight
    have hple : p ≤ z := hpData.2.1
    omega

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le
statement:
theorem card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z).card ≤ z + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range (z + 1)]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn L.leftValue ?_ ?_
  · intro r hr
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr
      (L.mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet.mp hr).2)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small
statement:
theorem primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small (R z : ℕ) :
    L.primePairSet R ⊆
      (L.siftedPairSet R z ∪ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z) ∪
        L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  by_cases hleft : z < L.leftValue r
  · by_cases hright : z < L.rightValue r
    · have hsift := L.mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt hr hleft hright
      exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hsift)))
    · have hsmall : r ∈ L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z :=
        L.mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet.mpr ⟨hr, Nat.le_of_not_gt hright⟩
      exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hsmall)
  · have hsmall : r ∈ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z :=
      L.mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet.mpr ⟨hr, Nat.le_of_not_gt hleft⟩
    exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hsmall)))

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.primePairSet R).card ≤ (L.siftedPairSet R z).card + 2 * (z + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (L.primePairSet R).card ≤
        ((L.siftedPairSet R z ∪ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z) ∪
          L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (L.primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small R z)
    _ ≤ (L.siftedPairSet R z ∪ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z).card +
        (L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card + (L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z).card) +
        (L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z).card :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _
    _ ≤ ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card + (z + 1)) + (z + 1) :=
      Nat.add_le_add
        (Nat.add_le_add_left (L.card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le R z) _)
        (L.card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le R z)
    _ = (L.siftedPairSet R z).card + 2 * (z + 1) := by omega

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add (R z : ℕ) :
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
      (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).siftedSum + (2 * (z + 1) : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := L.card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add R z
  have hcast : ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card : ℝ) + ((2 * (z + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  rwa [L.card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum R z] at hcast

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_primePairSet_cast_le_logSquared_of_terminal
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_cast_le_logSquared_of_terminal
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Csieve Csmall : ℝ}
    (hsieve : L.DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff Csieve)
    (hsmall : AffinePrimePair.CutoffExceptionUpperBound cutoff Csmall)
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
      (Csieve + Csmall) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
        (L.affineBoundingSieve R (cutoff R)).siftedSum +
          (2 * (cutoff R + 1) : ℕ) :=
      L.card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add R (cutoff R)
    _ ≤ Csieve * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R +
        Csmall * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R :=
      add_le_add (hsieve R hR) (hsmall R hR)
    _ = (Csieve + Csmall) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R := by ring

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.hasLogSquaredPrimePairBound_of_terminal
statement:
theorem hasLogSquaredPrimePairBound_of_terminal
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Csieve Csmall : ℝ}
    (hsieve : L.DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff Csieve)
    (hsmall : AffinePrimePair.CutoffExceptionUpperBound cutoff Csmall) :
    L.HasLogSquaredPrimePairBound
proof:
:=
  ⟨Csieve + Csmall, fun _ hR ↦
    L.card_primePairSet_cast_le_logSquared_of_terminal hsieve hsmall hR⟩

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_two_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet

theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_two_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet

      (L.disjoint_generalRootSet_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hp hmem),

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_of_notMem
statement:
theorem dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_of_notMem
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hmem : p ∉ L.exceptionalPrimeSet) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p +
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p +
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p *
            BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p ≤
      L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight, localDensity,
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_two_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hp hmem]
  unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := L.three_le_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hp hmem
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_one]
  have hsubOne : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hpOne
  have hsubTwo : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 2 := sub_pos.mpr hpTwo
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) * (1 - (2 : ℝ) / p)⁻¹ =
      2 / ((p : ℝ) - 2) by
        rw [show 1 - 2 / (p : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 2) / p by
          field_simp [hpPos.ne']]
        field_simp [hpPos.ne', hsubTwo.ne']]
  field_simp [hsubOne.ne', hsubTwo.ne']
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg_of_mem
statement:
theorem affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg_of_mem
    {z p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z) :
    0 ≤ L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp
  rw [affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight, localDensity]
  have hcountPos : (0 : ℝ) < L.shiftedBadResidueCount p := by
    exact_mod_cast hpData.2.2.2
  have hcountLt : (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast L.shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime_of_two_lt hpData.1 hpData.2.2.1
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpData.1.pos
  have hdensityPos : 0 < (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) / p :=
    div_pos hcountPos hpPos
  have hsurvival : 0 < 1 - (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) / p := by
    rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hpPos]
    exact hcountLt
  exact mul_nonneg hdensityPos.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hsurvival.le)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_totalMass
statement:
