name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).level = (z : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change (((max 1 z : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) = (z : ℝ) ^ 2
  rw [max_eq_right hz]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
statement:
theorem dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Cmass Crem : ℝ}
    (hmass : L.TruncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound cutoff Cmass)
    (hrem : L.MinimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound cutoff Crem) :
    L.DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff (Cmass + Crem)
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R (cutoff R)
  have hfinite :=
    SelbergFundamental.siftedSum_le_minimizing_main_add_error s
  have hsMass : s.totalMass = (R : ℝ) := by rfl
  have hmass' := hmass R hR
  have hrem' := hrem R hR
  change s.siftedSum ≤ (Cmass + Crem) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R
  calc
    s.siftedSum ≤
        (R : ℝ) * (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s)⁻¹ +
          s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s)) := by
      rw [hsMass] at hfinite
      exact hfinite
    _ ≤ Cmass * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R +
        Crem * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R :=
      add_le_add hmass' hrem'
    _ = (Cmass + Crem) * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R := by ring

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.product_injective_on_affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets
statement:
theorem product_injective_on_affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets {z : ℕ} :
    Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z : Set (Finset ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA B hB hprod
  have hASub : A ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1).trans
      (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hBSub : B ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hB).1).trans
      (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hASub hp)
  have hBPrime : ∀ p ∈ B, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hBSub hp)
  rw [← Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime, ← Nat.primeFactors_prod hBPrime]
  exact congrArg Nat.primeFactors hprod

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
statement:
theorem affineProductBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
    {R z : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ}
    (hA : A ∈ L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z) :
    (∏ p ∈ A, L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p) =
      (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).selbergTerms (A.prod id)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  have hASub : A ⊆ L.activePrimeSet z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp (hASub hp)).1
  have hdvd : A.prod id ∣ s.prodPrimes := by
    change A.prod id ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z
    rw [activePrimeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (L.activePrimeSet z) id hASub
  have hsq : Squarefree (A.prod id) :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  have hpf : (A.prod id).primeFactors = A := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime
  rw [hpf]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hpA
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [(hAPrime p hpA).primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p =
    L.sieveDensity p * (1 - L.sieveDensity p)⁻¹
  rw [L.sieveDensity_apply_prime (hAPrime p hpA)]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
statement:
theorem affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z).image (fun A ↦ A.prod id) ⊆
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors
        (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hd
  obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ := hd
  have hASub : A ⊆ L.activePrimeSet z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hprod : A.prod id ≤ z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2
  rw [SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors,
    L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz]
  constructor
  · change A.prod id ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z
    rw [activePrimeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (L.activePrimeSet z) id hASub
  · exact_mod_cast pow_le_pow_left' hprod 2

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.weightedPowersetMass_affineLocal_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem weightedPowersetMass_affineLocal_le_truncatedMass
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
        L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  let C := L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (C : Set (Finset ℕ)) :=
    L.product_injective_on_affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets
  have hsum :
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
          L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) =
        ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
    calc
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
          L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) =
          ∑ A ∈ C, ∏ p ∈ A, L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p := by
        unfold BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep
          C affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A _hA
        by_cases hprod : A.prod id ≤ z
        · rw [if_pos (decide_eq_true hprod), if_pos hprod]
        · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hprod), if_neg hprod]
      _ = ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
        rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        exact L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms hA
  rw [hsum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors hz)
  intro d hd _hnot
  exact (s.selbergTerms_pos
    (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hd).1).le

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.genericDimensionTwoMassProduct_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem genericDimensionTwoMassProduct_le_truncatedMass
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass
          (L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes z.sqrt) z.sqrt ^ 2 ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  let T := z.sqrt
  let S := L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T
  have hTz : T ≤ z := Nat.sqrt_le_self z
  have hsquare : T ^ 2 ≤ z := by simpa [T] using Nat.sqrt_le' z
  have hprime : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    (L.mem_genericDimensionTwoPrimes.mp hp).1
  have hSactive : S ⊆ L.activePrimeSet z := fun p hp ↦ by
    have hpData := L.mem_genericDimensionTwoPrimes.mp hp
    refine L.mem_activePrimeSet.mpr ⟨hpData.1, hpData.2.1.trans hTz, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := L.three_le_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hpData.1 hpData.2.2
      omega
    · rw [L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_two_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
        hpData.1 hpData.2.2]
      norm_num
  have hmassEq :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass S T =
        BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
            (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep T) := by
    unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep
    simp
  rw [pow_two, hmassEq]
  calc
    BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
          (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep T) *
        BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
          (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep T) ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.pairUnionPowersetMass S
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
            (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) :=
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedRectangleMass_le_pairUnionMass hprime hsquare
        (fun p _hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p)
        (fun p _hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p)
    _ ≤ BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight
          (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) := by
      apply BFPSTwoAffine.pairUnionPowersetMass_le_weightedPowersetMass
      · exact fun p _hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
      · exact fun p _hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
      · intro p hp
        have hpData := L.mem_genericDimensionTwoPrimes.mp hp
        exact L.dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_of_notMem
          hpData.1 hpData.2.2
    _ ≤ BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
          L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) := by
      apply BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass_mono_coordinates hSactive
      intro p hp
      exact L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg_of_mem hp
    _ ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z) :=
      L.weightedPowersetMass_affineLocal_le_truncatedMass hz

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos
statement:
theorem exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos :
    0 < L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor
proof:
:=
  BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_le_exceptional_mul_generic
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_le_exceptional_mul_generic (T : ℕ) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) ≤
      L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct
          (L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T)
proof:
:= by
  let low := Nat.primesLE T ∩ L.exceptionalPrimeSet
  let high := L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T
  have hunion : high ∪ low = Nat.primesLE T := by
    ext p
    simp only [high, low, genericDimensionTwoPrimes, Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_inter]
    tauto
  have hdisj : Disjoint high low := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro p hpHigh hpLow
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hpHigh).2 (Finset.mem_inter.mp hpLow).2
  have hlowSub : low ⊆ L.exceptionalPrimeSet :=
    Finset.inter_subset_right
  have hlow :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct low ≤
        L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_of_subset hlowSub
  have hfactor :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) =
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct low := by
    unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct
    rw [← hunion, Finset.prod_union hdisj]
  rw [hfactor]
  calc
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct low ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high *
          L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow
      exact (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos high).le
    _ = L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high := by ring

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos
statement: theorem affineGrowingMassConstant_pos : 0 < L.affineGrowingMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineGrowingMassConstant
  exact sq_pos_of_pos (mul_pos
    (mul_pos (by norm_num) L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos)
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss_pos)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingMassConstant_of_three_le
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingMassConstant_of_three_le
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) (hT : 3 ≤ AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff R) :
    (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
      (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let z := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R
  let T := AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff R
  let S := L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T
  let M := BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass S T
  let G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
    (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z)
  let D := BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct T
  have hz : 1 ≤ z :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hSsub : S ⊆ Nat.primesLE T :=
    L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes_subset_primesLE T
  have hprodMass :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_massLoss_mul_mass hSsub hT
  have hmassSquare : M ^ 2 ≤ G := by
    simpa [M, G, S, T, z, AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff] using
      (L.genericDimensionTwoMassProduct_le_truncatedMass (R := R) hz)
  have hGpos : 0 < G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos _
  have hDpos : 0 < D := BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_pos T
  have hEpos : 0 < L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor :=
    L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos
  have hLossp : 0 < BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss_pos
  have hMertens : D⁻¹ ≤
      L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M := by
    calc
      D⁻¹ = mertensProduct T := by
        symm
        exact BFPSTwoAffine.mertensProduct_eq_inv_directMertensProduct T
      _ = BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) :=
        (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE T).symm
      _ ≤ L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S := by
        simpa [S] using
          L.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_le_exceptional_mul_generic T
      _ ≤ L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprodMass hEpos.le
      _ = L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M := by ring
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by
    have hleft : 0 < D⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hDpos
    have hright : 0 ≤ L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss :=
      mul_nonneg hEpos.le hLossp.le
    nlinarith
  have hDupper : D ≤ 64 / Real.log R :=
    AffinePrimePair.directMertensProductUpperBound_affineMassCutoff R hR
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega))
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ D *
      (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) = D * D⁻¹ := by field_simp [hDpos.ne']
      _ ≤ D * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMertens hDpos.le
  have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤
      (64 * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M)) / Real.log R := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ D * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) := hone
      _ ≤ (64 / Real.log R) * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDupper
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hEpos.le hLossp.le) hMpos.le
      _ = (64 * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M)) / Real.log R := by ring
  have hlogBound : Real.log R ≤
      64 * L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ hlogPos).mp hratio
    simpa only [one_mul, mul_assoc] using h
  have hlogSq : Real.log R ^ 2 ≤
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant * M ^ 2 := by
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlogPos.le hlogBound 2
    unfold affineGrowingMassConstant
    simpa only [mul_pow, mul_assoc] using hpow
  have hlogG : Real.log R ^ 2 ≤
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant * G :=
    hlogSq.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmassSquare
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos.le)
  have hlogSqPos : 0 < Real.log R ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hlogPos
  have hlower : Real.log R ^ 2 / L.affineGrowingMassConstant ≤ G :=
    (div_le_iff₀ L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos).2
      (by simpa [mul_comm] using hlogG)
  calc
    G⁻¹ ≤ (Real.log R ^ 2 / L.affineGrowingMassConstant)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hGpos
        (div_pos hlogSqPos L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos)).2 hlower
    _ = L.affineGrowingMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [hlogSqPos.ne', L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos.ne']

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineSmallMassConstant_of_lt_three
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_inv_le_affineSmallMassConstant_of_lt_three
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) (hT : AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff R < 3) :
    (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
      (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      AffinePrimePair.affineSmallMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
    (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R
      (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R))
  have hGpos : 0 < G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos _
  have hGone : 1 ≤ G := SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass _
  have hGinv : G⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ hGpos).2 hGone
  have hcutSucc : AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff R + 1 ≤ 3 := by omega
  have hRleNat : R ≤ 3 ^ 64 := by
    calc
      R ≤ R + 1 := Nat.le_succ R
      _ ≤ (AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff R + 1) ^ 64 :=
        AffinePrimePair.succ_le_affineMassCutoff_succ_pow R
      _ ≤ 3 ^ 64 := pow_le_pow_left' hcutSucc 64
  have hRle : (R : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ 64 := by exact_mod_cast hRleNat
  have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega))
  have hlogR : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤ R := Real.log_le_self hRpos.le
  have hlogBound : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ 64 := hlogR.trans hRle
  have hlogSq : Real.log (R : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ AffinePrimePair.affineSmallMassConstant := by
    unfold AffinePrimePair.affineSmallMassConstant
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hlogPos.le hlogBound 2
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ AffinePrimePair.affineSmallMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hlogPos)).2 (by simpa using hlogSq)
  exact hGinv.trans hone

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant_pos
statement:
theorem affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant_pos :
    0 < L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
proof:
:=
  L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos.trans_le (le_max_left _ _)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
      (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlogSq : 0 ≤ Real.log (R : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  by_cases hT : 3 ≤ AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff R
  · exact (L.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingMassConstant_of_three_le hR hT).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hlogSq)
  · have hTlt : AffinePrimePair.affineMassCutoff R < 3 := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hT
    exact (L.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineSmallMassConstant_of_lt_three hR hTlt).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hlogSq)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.truncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem truncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff :
    L.TruncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff
      L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hinv := L.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant hR
  unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
  calc
    (R : ℝ) * (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
        (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R
          (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      (R : ℝ) * (L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv (by positivity)
    _ = L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant *
        ((R : ℝ) / Real.log R ^ 2) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType
    (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount d = Fintype.card (L.affineShiftedRootType d)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin d ≃ ZMod d := (ZMod.finEquiv d).toEquiv
  have he (t : Fin d) :
      t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet d ↔
        L.shiftedProductMod d (e t) = 0 := by
    rw [mem_shiftedBadResidueSet,
      ← L.shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd d t.val]
    have hfin : (ZMod.finEquiv d) t = (t.val : ZMod d) := by
      cases d with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 t
      | succ d =>
          change t = (t.val : ZMod (d + 1))
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n := d + 1) t).symm
    change L.shiftedProductMod d (t.val : ZMod d) = 0 ↔
      L.shiftedProductMod d ((ZMod.finEquiv d) t) = 0
    rw [hfin]
  let rootEquiv :
      {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet d} ≃ L.affineShiftedRootType d :=
    e.subtypeEquiv he
  calc
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount d =
        Fintype.card {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet d} := by
      rw [shiftedBadResidueCount, Fintype.card_coe]
    _ = Fintype.card (L.affineShiftedRootType d) :=
      Fintype.card_congr rootEquiv

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedProductMod_chineseRemainder
statement:
theorem shiftedProductMod_chineseRemainder
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) (q : ZMod (a * b)) :
    ZMod.chineseRemainder hab (L.shiftedProductMod (a * b) q) =
      (L.shiftedProductMod a (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab q).1,
        L.shiftedProductMod b (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab q).2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedProductMod]
  apply Prod.ext <;> rfl

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_mul_of_coprime
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount (a * b) =
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount a * L.shiftedBadResidueCount b
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero a := ⟨ha⟩
  letI : NeZero b := ⟨hb⟩
  letI : NeZero (a * b) := ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero ha hb⟩
  rw [L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType,
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType,
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType]
  exact (Fintype.card_congr (L.affineShiftedRootMulEquiv hab)).trans
    (Fintype.card_prod _ _)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineShiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative
statement:
theorem affineShiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative :
    L.affineShiftedRootCount.IsMultiplicative
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro a b hab
    simp only [affineShiftedRootCount_apply]
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · simp [ha]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount
statement:
theorem prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount
    {d : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, L.shiftedBadResidueCount p =
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof:
:= by
  change (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, L.affineShiftedRootCount p) =
    L.affineShiftedRootCount d
  rw [← L.affineShiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative.map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors
    d d.primeFactors subset_rfl,
    Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div
statement:
theorem sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div
    {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    L.sieveDensity d = (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) / d
proof:
:= by
  rw [sieveDensity, ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hd]
  simp only [localDensity, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  rw [← Nat.cast_prod, ← Nat.cast_prod,
    L.prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount hsq,
    Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) -
        (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess hd,
    L.sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div hd.ne' hsq]
  have hRcast : (R : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) + (R % d : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_add_div R d).symm.trans (by omega)
  rw [hRcast]
  have hdCast : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount
statement:
theorem abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    |(L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d| ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction hd hsq]
  have hdCast : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hcount0 : 0 ≤ (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hexcess0 : 0 ≤ (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hexcessLe : (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) ≤
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount d := L.residueExcessCount_cast_le R d
  have hfrac : ((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hdCast]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_lt R hd).le
  have hterm0 : 0 ≤
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d := by positivity
  have htermLe :
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d ≤
        L.shiftedBadResidueCount d := by
    calc
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d =
          (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) *
            (((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d) := by ring
      _ ≤ (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac hcount0
      _ = L.shiftedBadResidueCount d := by ring
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
    {d : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount d ≤ 2 ^ d.primeFactors.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← L.prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount hsq]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, L.shiftedBadResidueCount p) ≤
        ∏ _p ∈ d.primeFactors, 2 := by
      gcongr with p hp
      exact L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two
        (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
    _ = 2 ^ d.primeFactors.card := by simp

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
statement:
theorem abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    |(L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d| ≤
      ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  (L.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount hd hsq).trans
    (by exact_mod_cast L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors hsq)

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineSelbergTerms_prime_le_cast
statement:
theorem affineSelbergTerms_prime_le_cast
    {R z p : ℕ} (hpMem : p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z) :
    (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).selbergTerms p ≤ (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpData := L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpMem
  have hp := hpData.1
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [hp.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change L.sieveDensity p * (1 - L.sieveDensity p)⁻¹ ≤ (p : ℝ)
  rw [L.sieveDensity_apply_prime hp]
  unfold localDensity
  set k : ℕ := L.shiftedBadResidueCount p with hkDef
  have hkPos : 0 < k := hpData.2.2.2
  have hkTwo : k ≤ 2 := L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two hp
  have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := hpData.2.2.1
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hkPos
  have hpThreeR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpThree
  have hkTwoR : (k : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hkTwo
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - k := by linarith
  rw [show (k : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) * (1 - (k : ℝ) / p)⁻¹ =
      (k : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - k) by
        rw [show 1 - (k : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) =
          ((p : ℝ) - k) / p by field_simp [hpR.ne']]
        field_simp [hpR.ne', hden.ne']]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineSelbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem affineSelbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).selbergTerms d ≤ (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.selbergTerms p) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hpMem
        have hpDvdD : p ∣ d := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        exact (s.selbergTerms_pos (hpDvdD.trans hd)).le
      · intro p hpMem
        have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        have hpDvd : p ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z := by
          change p ∣ s.prodPrimes
          exact (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem).trans hd
        exact L.affineSelbergTerms_prime_le_cast
          ((L.prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff hp).mp hpDvd)
    _ = (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_prod]
      norm_cast
      exact Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.inv_cast_le_affineSieveDensity_of_dvd
statement:
theorem inv_cast_le_affineSieveDensity_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (d : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).nu d
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  have hprodCast : (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ)) = (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod]
    norm_cast
    exact Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq
  calc
    (d : ℝ)⁻¹ = (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ))⁻¹ := by rw [hprodCast]
    _ = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      (Finset.prod_inv_distrib (s := d.primeFactors) (fun p ↦ (p : ℝ))).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.nu p := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p _hpMem
        positivity
      · intro p hpMem
        have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        have hpDvd : p ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z := by
          change p ∣ s.prodPrimes
          exact (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem).trans hd
        have hpActive := (L.prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff hp).mp hpDvd
        change (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ L.sieveDensity p
        rw [L.sieveDensity_apply_prime hp, localDensity]
        have hcount : 1 ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount p :=
          (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpActive).2.2.2
        have hcountR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount p := by
          exact_mod_cast hcount
        have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        simpa only [one_mul] using
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcountR (inv_nonneg.mpr hpR.le)
    _ = s.nu d := s.nu_mult.prod_primeFactors hsq

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineSieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem affineSieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    ((L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).nu d)⁻¹ ≤ (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hnu : 0 < s.nu d := s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd
  have hlower : (d : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ s.nu d :=
    L.inv_cast_le_affineSieveDensity_of_dvd hd
  calc
    (s.nu d)⁻¹ ≤ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hnu (inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hdPos))).2 hlower
    _ = (d : ℝ) := inv_inv _

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineActiveReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem affineActiveReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors
        (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z) d ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 z
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  intro a ha
  have haData := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
  have haPos : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors haData.1
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hdaData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp haData.2
  rw [L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdaData
  have hdaLe : d * a ≤ z := by
    have hcast : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ z := by
      have hda0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d * a : ℕ) := by positivity
      have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
    ⟨haPos, (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left a hdPos).trans hdaLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_affineActiveReverseDivisors_le
statement:
theorem card_affineActiveReverseDivisors_le
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors
      (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z) d).card ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card
    (L.affineActiveReverseDivisors_subset_Icc hz hd)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.abs_affineMinimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
statement:
theorem abs_affineMinimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal
        (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z) d| ≤ (z : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  by_cases hdMem : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hdData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      rw [L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdData
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    have htermPos : 0 < s.selbergTerms d := s.selbergTerms_pos hdData.1
    have hmass : 1 ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s :=
      SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass s
    have hquot : s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s ≤
        s.selbergTerms d := div_le_self htermPos.le hmass
    have hmu : |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := d)
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_pos hdMem, abs_div, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos htermPos, abs_of_pos (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos s)]
    calc
      |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| * s.selbergTerms d /
          SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s =
          |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| *
            (s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * s.selbergTerms d := by
        exact mul_le_mul hmu hquot
          (div_nonneg htermPos.le (zero_le_one.trans hmass)) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ (d : ℝ) := by
        simpa using L.affineSelbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd hdData.1
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdLe
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_neg hdMem, abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.abs_affineMinimizingWeight_le_cube
statement:
theorem abs_affineMinimizingWeight_le_cube
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
        (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z) d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  by_cases hdMem : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hd := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).1
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      have hsquare := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).2
      rw [L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hsquare
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight,
      SelbergFundamental.weightFromDiagonal, dif_pos hd, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd)),
      BFPSTwoAffine.reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors hd]
    have hsum :
        |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
          (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
            (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
            (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
            ∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
              |(μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d, (z : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a _ha
          rw [abs_mul]
          have hmu : |(μ a : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
            exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := a)
          exact (mul_le_mul hmu (L.abs_affineMinimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff hz)
            (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq (one_mul _)
        _ = ((BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d).card : ℝ) * z := by simp
        _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * z := by
          gcongr
          exact_mod_cast L.card_affineActiveReverseDivisors_le hz hd
        _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hnu := L.affineSieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd hd
    calc
      (s.nu d)⁻¹ *
          |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
            (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
          (d : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hnu hsum (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hdLe) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated hdMem,
      abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.abs_lambdaSquared_affineMinimizingWeight_le_tenth
statement:
theorem abs_lambdaSquared_affineMinimizingWeight_le_tenth
    {R z n : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hn : n ≤ z ^ 2) :
    |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
        (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
          (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z)) n| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 10
proof:
:= by
  let w := SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
    (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z)
  have hw (d : ℕ) : |w d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
    L.abs_affineMinimizingWeight_le_cube hz
  have hterm (d₁ d₂ : ℕ) :
      |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    by_cases h : n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂
    · rw [if_pos h, abs_mul]
      calc
        |w d₁| * |w d₂| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 * (z : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
          mul_le_mul (hw d₁) (hw d₂) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by ring
    · rw [if_neg h, abs_zero]
      positivity
  have hinner (d₁ : ℕ) :
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    calc
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
          ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _d₂ ∈ n.divisors, (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro d₂ _hd₂
        exact hterm d₁ d₂
      _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by simp
  unfold BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
  change |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
      ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
        if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ _
  have hcardNat : n.divisors.card ≤ n := Nat.card_divisors_le_self n
  have hcard : ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat.trans hn
  calc
    |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
          |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₁ _hd₁
      exact hinner d₁
    _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      simp
      ring
    _ ≤ ((z : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by gcongr
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
  have hdPos := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
  rw [L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdData
  have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hdData.2
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hdPos, hdLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_le
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z).card ≤ z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card
    (L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc (R := R) hz)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineLevelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant
statement:
theorem affineLevelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant (R z : ℕ) :
    SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder
        (L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z) ≤
      L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  unfold SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder
    affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro d hdMem
  by_cases hlevel : (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level
  · rw [if_pos hlevel, if_pos hlevel]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
    have hdDvd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdMem
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hdDvd)
    have hdSquarefree : Squarefree d :=
      Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdDvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
    exact L.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
      hdPos hdSquarefree
  · rw [if_neg hlevel, if_neg hlevel]

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth
statement:
theorem affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 14
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  have heq : L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z =
      ∑ d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    unfold affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant affineMinimizingRemainderSupport
    change (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
          |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
              (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
            ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
        else 0) = _
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [heq]
  have hterm (d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z) :
      |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
    have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    have hdDvd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
    have hdSq : Squarefree d :=
      Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdDvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
    have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by
      have hlevel := hdData.2
      rw [L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hlevel
      exact_mod_cast hlevel
    have hlambda := L.abs_lambdaSquared_affineMinimizingWeight_le_tenth
      (R := R) hz hdLe
    have htwoNat := BFPSTwoAffine.two_pow_card_primeFactors_le_self hdPos hdSq
    have htwo : (((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast htwoNat.trans hdLe
    calc
      |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (z : ℝ) ^ 10 * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hlambda htwo (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by ring
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ _d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z, (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      exact hterm d hd
    _ = ((L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z).card : ℝ) *
        (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by simp
    _ ≤ ((z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
      gcongr
      exact_mod_cast L.card_affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_le (R := R) hz
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 14 := by norm_num; ring

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.minimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem minimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff :
    L.MinimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound
      BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff 16
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  let z := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R
  let s := L.minimizingGeneralSelbergSieve R z
  have hz : 1 ≤ z :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  change s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
      (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s)) ≤
    16 * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R
  rw [SelbergFundamental.errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_levelRestrictedRemainder]
  calc
    SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder s ≤
        L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z :=
      L.affineLevelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant R z
    _ ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 14 :=
      L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth hz
    _ ≤ 16 * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R := by
      simpa [z] using
        AffinePrimePair.selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_fourteen_le_logSquaredScale hR

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_growingCutoff :
    L.DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff
      (L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant + 16)
proof:
:=
  L.dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_of_mass_and_remainder
    L.truncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff
    L.minimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff

statement:

    L.HasLogSquaredPrimePairBound

    L.dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_growingCutoff
    BFPSTwoAffine.cutoffExceptionUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.card_primePairSet_le_generalPairGrowingConstant
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_le_generalPairGrowingConstant
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
      L.generalPairGrowingConstant * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R
proof:
:=
  L.card_primePairSet_cast_le_logSquared_of_terminal
    L.dimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound_growingCutoff
    BFPSTwoAffine.cutoffExceptionUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff hR

    L.generalPairGrowingConstant ≤
      AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet S

:=
  L.generalPairGrowingConstant_eq_growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet.trans_le

name: RankAmplification.GeneralAffinePair.exceptionalPrimeSet_subset_insert_two
statement:
theorem exceptionalPrimeSet_subset_insert_two {P : Finset ℕ}
    (hleft : ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ L.leftSlope → p ∈ P)
    (hright : ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ L.rightSlope → p ∈ P)
    (hdet : ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ L.detAbs → p ∈ P) :
    L.exceptionalPrimeSet ⊆ insert 2 P
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hprime, hdvd⟩ := L.mem_exceptionalPrimeSet.mp hp
  rw [Finset.mem_insert]
  unfold exceptionalModulus at hdvd
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hprime).mp hdvd with hslopes | hdetDvd
  · rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hprime).mp hslopes with htwoLeft | hrightDvd
    · rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hprime).mp htwoLeft with htwo | hleftDvd
      · exact Or.inl ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hprime Nat.prime_two).mp htwo)
      · exact Or.inr (hleft p hprime hleftDvd)
    · exact Or.inr (hright p hprime hrightDvd)
  · exact Or.inr (hdet p hprime hdetDvd)

name: RankAmplification.exists_uniform_generalPair_constant
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_generalPair_constant (S : Finset ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ L : GeneralAffinePair, L.exceptionalPrimeSet ⊆ S →
      ∀ R : ℕ, 3 ≤ R →
        ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
          C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet S, ?_⟩
  intro L hL R hR
  have hscale : 0 ≤ AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R := by
    unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
    positivity
  calc
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
        L.generalPairGrowingConstant * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R :=
      L.card_primePairSet_le_generalPairGrowingConstant hR
    _ ≤ AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet S *
        AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (L.generalPairGrowingConstant_le_of_subset hL) hscale
