name: RankAmplification.hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound_of_gap
statement:
theorem hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound_of_gap
    {X y H : ℕ} {b B : ℝ} (hHpos : 0 < H) (hHX : 2 * H ≤ X)
    (hb : Real.log 2 + Real.log H ≤ b)
    (hgap : HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBound X y b B) :
    HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound X y H B
proof:
:= by
  have hquotTwo : 2 ≤ X / H := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hHpos).2 hHX
  intro W hWlow hWhigh
  have hWpos : 0 < W := by omega
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by omega
  have hXlt : X < (X / H + 1) * H := by
    calc
      X = H * (X / H) + X % H := (Nat.div_add_mod X H).symm
      _ < H * (X / H) + H := Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mod_lt X hHpos) _
      _ = (X / H + 1) * H := by ring
  have hcoef : X / H + 1 ≤ 2 * (X / H) := by omega
  have hXle : X ≤ 2 * W * H := by
    have hfirst : (X / H + 1) * H ≤ (2 * (X / H)) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H hcoef
    have hsecond : (2 * (X / H)) * H ≤ (2 * W) * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right H (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hWlow)
    omega
  have hXreal : (0 : ℝ) < X := by exact_mod_cast hXpos
  have hWreal : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hWpos
  have hHreal : (0 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast hHpos
  have hXcast : (X : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hXle
  have hlogAmbient : scaleL (X : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (W : ℝ) * (H : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [scaleL_eq] using Real.log_le_log hXreal hXcast
  have hgapBound : scaleL (X : ℝ) - Real.log W ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log H := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne')
      hHreal.ne', Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hWreal.ne']
      at hlogAmbient
    linarith
  exact hgap W hWpos hWhigh (hgapBound.trans hb)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange
    (J : ℕ) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientGapBound x y
        (fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x)
        (Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant
  have hC : 0 ≤ C :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffDelta_admissible hc₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_budget hc₀ hC₀ hC,
      eventually_fixedRankSmoothRate_le_variableRate_add_error hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hrange hdelta hpred hsmooth hL hA hV
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hdeltaData := hdelta T hwindow
  intro W hWpos _hWhigh hgapBound
  have hfinite := smoothTotientCount_le_fixedBFPSAbelExponent_growingCutoff
    (X := W) (Y := y) (c := 1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)
      hWpos hrangeData.1 (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hslack := variableCutoff_slack_mul_scaleL_div_T_le hc₀ hL hA hwindow
  have hcancel := variableCutoffDelta_mul_scaleL hL.le hA.le
    (show T ≠ 0 by
      exact ((mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1).ne')
  have hpredBound := hpred y T W hcutoff hwindow
  have hEuler : smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpredBound
      (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  have hgapMul : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) ≤
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgapBound hdeltaData.1.le
  have hvariableIdentity :
      variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        (variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x := by
    unfold variableCutoffSmoothError
    dsimp only [C]
    field_simp [hV.ne']
  have hbase : fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
        (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
        variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedBFPSAbelExponent
    calc
      -(1 - (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T)) * Real.log W +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C =
        -(variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T * scaleL (x : ℝ)) +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) := by ring
      _ = -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) * scaleL (x : ℝ) / T +
          smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
            fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant W y
              (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) - Real.log W) := by
        rw [hcancel]
        ring
      _ ≤ -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          ((variableCutoffPhaseSlack (x : ℝ) / c₀) * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
              fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorBudget C x) +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
        linarith
      _ = _ := by rw [← hvariableIdentity]
  have hdeltaWindow := variableCutoffDelta_le_window_bound hc₀ hA.le hG hwindow
  have hdeltaV : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤
      1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T ≤
          scaleA (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := hdeltaWindow
      _ = 1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
        have hAV := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
        field_simp [hc₀.ne', hA.ne', hG.ne', hV.ne']
        nlinarith
  have hbudget0 : 0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
      fixedRankGeneralLowProductLogBudget
    positivity
  have hdeltaBudget : variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
        fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x ≤
      fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
        (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdeltaV hbudget0
    calc
      variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x ≤
        (1 / (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) *
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := this
      _ = fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
          (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by ring
  have hsmoothData := hsmooth T hwindow
  have herrorIdentity :
      (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ) ^ 2)) * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
        variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    field_simp [hc₀.ne', hV.ne']
  have hexponent : fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
        (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
      -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
        fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError
    rw [herrorIdentity]
    calc
      fixedBFPSAbelExponent W y
          (1 - variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T) C ≤
        -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          variableCutoffDelta (x : ℝ) T *
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x := hbase
      _ ≤ -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
          variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
          fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
            (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
        nlinarith [hdeltaBudget]
      _ ≤ -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
            fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
              (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
        have hsmoothNeg : -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T ≤
            -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
              fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
          calc
            -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T =
                -(scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
                    fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                      scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
                  fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                    scaleV (x : ℝ) := by ring
            _ ≤ -fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
                  fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
                    scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
              add_le_add_left (neg_le_neg hsmoothData) _
        calc
          -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
              variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
              fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ)) =
            -scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T +
              (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
                fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                  (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by ring
          _ ≤ (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
                fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
              (variableCutoffSmoothError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) +
                fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget J C₀ x /
                  (c₀ * scaleV (x : ℝ))) :=
            by nlinarith [hsmoothNeg]
          _ = _ := by ring
  exact hfinite.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent) (Nat.cast_nonneg W)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSRange_of_gapRange
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSRange_of_gapRange
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      HasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound x y
        (fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x)
        (Real.exp (-fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T +
          fixedRankGeneralLowBFPSRangeError J c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankGeneralLow_sharpBFPSGapRange J hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_two_mul_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le J hJ hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_log_fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit_le_budget J hJ hc₀ hC₀]
      with x hgap htwo hlogH
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hHpos : 0 < fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit J (y ^ J) x := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralLowProductSplit fixedRankGeneralLowAtomCutoff
    positivity
  refine hasSharpBFPSSmoothTotientRangeBound_of_gap hHpos
    (htwo y T hcutoff hwindow) ?_ (hgap y T hcutoff hwindow)
  have hlogH' := hlogH y T hcutoff hwindow
  unfold fixedRankGeneralLowQuotientLogBudget
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le
statement:
theorem eventually_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
      |fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T - scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T| ≤
        fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := 1 / (C₀ + 1)
  let b : ℝ := 1 / c₀
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hlogLower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < Real.log (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_scaleV_atTop.const_mul_atTop ha)).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
  have hlog2Lower : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < log2 (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    ((tendsto_generalWindow_log2_atTop ha).comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [hlogLower, hlog2Lower,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hlogLower hlog2Lower hcore
  intro T hwindow
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  let z := scaleL (x : ℝ) / T
  let lo := a * scaleV (x : ℝ)
  let hi := b * scaleV (x : ℝ)
  have hlo : 0 < lo := by dsimp [lo]; positivity
  have hhi : 0 < hi := by dsimp [hi]; positivity
  have hz : 0 < z := by dsimp [z]; positivity
  have hloz : lo ≤ z := by
    have hden : T ≤ (C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ) :=
      hwindow.2.trans (by gcongr; linarith)
    calc
      lo = scaleL (x : ℝ) / ((C₀ + 1) * scaleG (x : ℝ)) := by
        dsimp [lo, a]
        field_simp [hG.ne', (show C₀ + 1 ≠ 0 by positivity)]
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / T :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le hT hden
      _ = z := rfl
  have hzhi : z ≤ hi := by
    calc
      z = scaleL (x : ℝ) / T := rfl
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / (c₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le (mul_pos hc₀ hG) hwindow.1
      _ = hi := by
        dsimp [hi, b]
        field_simp [hc₀.ne', hG.ne']
  have hlogLoZ : Real.log lo ≤ Real.log z := Real.log_le_log hlo hloz
  have hlogZHi : Real.log z ≤ Real.log hi := Real.log_le_log hz hzhi
  have hlogZ : 0 < Real.log z := by
    change 0 < Real.log (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) at hlogLower
    linarith
  have hlog2LoZ : log2 lo ≤ log2 z := by
    change Real.log (Real.log lo) ≤ Real.log (Real.log z)
    exact Real.log_le_log (by simpa [lo] using hlogLower) hlogLoZ
  have hlog2ZHi : log2 z ≤ log2 hi := by
    change Real.log (Real.log z) ≤ Real.log (Real.log hi)
    exact Real.log_le_log hlogZ hlogZHi
  have hlog2Lo : 0 < log2 lo := by
    change 0 < log2 (a * scaleV (x : ℝ)) at hlog2Lower
    simpa only [lo] using hlog2Lower
  have hlog2Z : 0 < log2 z := lt_of_lt_of_le hlog2Lo hlog2LoZ
  have hlog3LoZ : log3 lo ≤ log3 z := by
    change Real.log (log2 lo) ≤ Real.log (log2 z)
    exact Real.log_le_log hlog2Lo hlog2LoZ
  have hlog3ZHi : log3 z ≤ log3 hi := by
    change Real.log (log2 z) ≤ Real.log (log2 hi)
    exact Real.log_le_log hlog2Z hlog2ZHi
  let M := max
      |log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ)|
      |log2 hi + log3 hi - scaleA (x : ℝ)|
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  have hbracketHi : log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤ M := by
    calc
      log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤
          log2 hi + log3 hi - scaleA (x : ℝ) := by linarith
      _ ≤ |log2 hi + log3 hi - scaleA (x : ℝ)| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hbracketLo : -M ≤ log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ) := by
    have habs : |log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ)| ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    have hneg : -|log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ)| ≤
        log2 lo + log3 lo - scaleA (x : ℝ) := neg_abs_le _
    linarith
  have hupper : z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) ≤ hi * M := by
    calc
      z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) ≤ z * M :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracketHi hz.le
      _ ≤ hi * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzhi hM
  have hlower : -(hi * M) ≤ z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    rcases lt_or_ge (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) 0 with hneg | hnn
    · have hstep : hi * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) ≤
          z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
        nlinarith [hzhi, hneg]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracketLo hhi.le]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hz.le hnn, mul_nonneg hhi.le hM]
  have hsq := scaleG_sq hL.le hA.le
  have hidentity : fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T -
      scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T =
        z * (log2 z + log3 z - scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankSmoothRate
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [hsq]
    ring
  have herrorIdentity : hi * M =
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError
    dsimp only [hi, lo, a, b, M]
    field_simp [hc₀.ne']
  rw [hidentity, ← herrorIdentity]
  exact abs_le.2 ⟨hlower, hupper⟩

name: RankAmplification.exists_tendsto_zero_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_zero_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∃ ε : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto ε atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
        IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ x T →
        |fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T - scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T| ≤
          ε x * scaleV (x : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀,
    tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀ hC₀,
    eventually_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le hc₀ hC₀⟩

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (P.minimizingSieve R z).level = (z : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change (((max 1 z : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) = (z : ℝ) ^ 2
  rw [max_eq_right hz]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.product_injective_on_productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets
statement:
theorem product_injective_on_productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets {z : ℕ} :
    Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (P.productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets z : Set (Finset ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA B hB hprod
  have hASub : A ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1).trans
      (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hBSub : B ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hB).1).trans
      (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hASub hp)
  have hBPrime : ∀ p ∈ B, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hBSub hp)
  rw [← Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime, ← Nat.primeFactors_prod hBPrime]
  exact congrArg Nat.primeFactors hprod

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.dimensionOneLocalWeight_eq_selbergTerms_prime
statement:
theorem dimensionOneLocalWeight_eq_selbergTerms_prime
    {R z p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ P.activePrimeSet z) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p =
      (P.minimizingSieve R z).selbergTerms p
proof:
:= by
  have hpPrime := (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [hpPrime.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p =
    P.sieveDensity p * (1 - P.sieveDensity p)⁻¹
  rw [P.sieveDensity_apply_prime hpPrime]
  unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
  have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_lt
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := zero_lt_one.trans hpOne
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hpPrime.one_le]
  field_simp [hpPos.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hpOne).ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.productBoundedActivePrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
statement:
theorem productBoundedActivePrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
    {R z : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ}
    (hA : A ∈ P.productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets z) :
    (∏ p ∈ A, BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p) =
      (P.minimizingSieve R z).selbergTerms (A.prod id)
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  have hASub : A ⊆ P.activePrimeSet z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp (hASub hp)).1
  have hdvd : A.prod id ∣ s.prodPrimes := by
    change A.prod id ∣ P.activePrimeProduct z
    rw [activePrimeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (P.activePrimeSet z) id hASub
  have hsq : Squarefree (A.prod id) :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  have hpf : (A.prod id).primeFactors = A := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime
  rw [hpf]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hpA
  exact P.dimensionOneLocalWeight_eq_selbergTerms_prime (hASub hpA)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
statement:
theorem productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (P.productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets z).image (fun A ↦ A.prod id) ⊆
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors (P.minimizingSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hd
  obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ := hd
  have hASub : A ⊆ P.activePrimeSet z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hprod : A.prod id ≤ z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2
  rw [SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors,
    P.minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le hz]
  constructor
  · change A.prod id ∣ P.activePrimeProduct z
    rw [activePrimeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (P.activePrimeSet z) id hASub
  · exact_mod_cast pow_le_pow_left' hprod 2

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.dimensionOneSubsetMass_active_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetMass_active_le_truncatedMass
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass (P.activePrimeSet z) z ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (P.minimizingSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  let C := P.productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets z
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (C : Set (Finset ℕ)) :=
    P.product_injective_on_productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets
  have hsum :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass (P.activePrimeSet z) z =
        ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
    calc
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass (P.activePrimeSet z) z =
          ∑ A ∈ C, ∏ p ∈ A, BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p := by
        unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass C productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      _ = ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
        rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        exact P.productBoundedActivePrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms hA
  rw [hsum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (P.productBoundedActivePrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors hz)
  intro d hd _hnot
  exact (s.selbergTerms_pos
    (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hd).1).le

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_active_eq_localSieveProduct_inv
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_active_eq_localSieveProduct_inv (z : ℕ) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct (P.activePrimeSet z) =
      (P.localSieveProduct z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight localSieveProduct
  rw [← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime := (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1
  have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_lt
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := zero_lt_one.trans hpOne
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hpPrime.one_le]
  field_simp [hpPos.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hpOne).ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.dimensionOneMassLowerBound
statement:
theorem dimensionOneMassLowerBound
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 3 ≤ z) :
    (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss)⁻¹ *
        (P.localSieveProduct z)⁻¹ ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (P.minimizingSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : P.activePrimeSet z ⊆ Nat.primesLE z := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hmass := BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass_lower hsub hz
  rw [P.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_active_eq_localSieveProduct_inv] at hmass
  change (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss)⁻¹ *
      (P.localSieveProduct z)⁻¹ ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass (P.activePrimeSet z) z at hmass
  exact hmass.trans (P.dimensionOneSubsetMass_active_le_truncatedMass (by omega))

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.directMertensProduct_le_localSieveProduct
statement:
theorem directMertensProduct_le_localSieveProduct (z : ℕ) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct z ≤ P.localSieveProduct z
proof:
:= by
  rw [localSieveProduct_eq_directMertens_mul_correction]
  have hcorrection : (1 : ℝ) ≤
      ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z,
        BFPSTwoAffine.multiplierCorrectionFactor P.step p := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) = ∏ _p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 : ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z,
          BFPSTwoAffine.multiplierCorrectionFactor P.step p := by
        gcongr with p hp
        exact BFPSTwoAffine.one_le_multiplierCorrectionFactor
          (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)
  nlinarith [BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_pos z]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.truncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem truncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff :
    TruncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss
proof:
:= by
  intro P R hR
  let z := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R
  have hz : 1 ≤ z := by
    exact BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  by_cases hlarge : 3 ≤ z
  · have hlower := P.dimensionOneMassLowerBound (R := R) hlarge
    have hmain := BFPSTwoAffine.inv_le_inv_mul_of_mul_inv_le
      (inv_pos.mpr BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss_pos)
      (P.localSieveProduct_pos z)
      (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos (P.minimizingSieve R z)) hlower
    simpa using hmain
  · have hmass := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_inv_le_one
      (P.minimizingSieve R z)
    have hzSmall : z ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hinv : ((z : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ P.localSieveProduct z :=
      (BFPSTwoAffine.inv_cast_le_directMertensProduct hz).trans
        (P.directMertensProduct_le_localSieveProduct z)
    have hzReal : (z : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hzSmall
    have hzPos : (0 : ℝ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hz
    have hhalf : (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (z : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ (by norm_num) hzPos).2 hzReal
    have hlocalHalf : (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ P.localSieveProduct z := hhalf.trans hinv
    have hexp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) :=
      Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
    have htarget : (1 : ℝ) ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * P.localSieveProduct z := by
      unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss
      nlinarith
    exact hmass.trans htarget

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.selbergTerms_prime_le_cast
statement:
theorem selbergTerms_prime_le_cast
    {R z p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ P.activePrimeSet z) :
    (P.minimizingSieve R z).selbergTerms p ≤ (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpPrime := (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [hpPrime.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change P.sieveDensity p * (1 - P.sieveDensity p)⁻¹ ≤ (p : ℝ)
  rw [P.sieveDensity_apply_prime hpPrime]
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
  have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_lt
  have hden : 0 < 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [sub_pos]
    exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hpOne
  rw [show (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ =
      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ / (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) by ring]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
  have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.two_le
  field_simp [hpPos.ne']
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.selbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem selbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ (P.minimizingSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (P.minimizingSieve R z).selbergTerms d ≤ (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.selbergTerms p) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hpMem
        exact (s.selbergTerms_pos
          ((Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem).trans hd)).le
      · intro p hpMem
        have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        have hpDvd : p ∣ P.activePrimeProduct z := by
          change p ∣ s.prodPrimes
          exact (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem).trans hd
        have hpActive : p ∈ P.activePrimeSet z := by
          have hpFactors : p ∈ (P.activePrimeProduct z).primeFactors :=
            Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hpPrime, hpDvd, by
              change s.prodPrimes ≠ 0
              exact s.prodPrimes_ne_zero⟩
          have hpf : (P.activePrimeProduct z).primeFactors =
              P.activePrimeSet z := by
            rw [activePrimeProduct]
            simpa only [id_eq] using Nat.primeFactors_prod
              (fun q hq ↦ (P.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hq).1)
          simpa [hpf] using hpFactors
        exact P.selbergTerms_prime_le_cast hpActive
    _ = (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_prod]
      norm_cast
      exact Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.abs_minimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
statement:
theorem abs_minimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal (P.minimizingSieve R z) d| ≤
      (z : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  by_cases hd : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hdData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hd
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      rw [P.minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdData
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    have htermPos : 0 < s.selbergTerms d := s.selbergTerms_pos hdData.1
    have hmass : 1 ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s :=
      SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass s
    have hquot : s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s ≤
        s.selbergTerms d := div_le_self htermPos.le hmass
    have hmu : |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := d)
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_pos hd, abs_div, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos htermPos, abs_of_pos (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos s)]
    calc
      |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| * s.selbergTerms d /
          SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s =
          |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| *
            (s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * s.selbergTerms d := by
        exact mul_le_mul hmu hquot
          (div_nonneg htermPos.le (zero_le_one.trans hmass)) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ (d : ℝ) := by simpa using P.selbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd hdData.1
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdLe
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_neg hd, abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.sieveDensity_inv_eq_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem sieveDensity_inv_eq_cast_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ (P.minimizingSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    ((P.minimizingSieve R z).nu d)⁻¹ = (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  change (P.sieveDensity d)⁻¹ = (d : ℝ)
  rw [P.sieveDensity_eq_inv hdPos.ne' hsq, inv_inv]

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.activeReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem activeReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (P.minimizingSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors (P.minimizingSieve R z) d ⊆
      Finset.Icc 1 z
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  intro a ha
  have haData := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
  have haPos : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors haData.1
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hdaData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp haData.2
  rw [P.minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdaData
  have hdaLe : d * a ≤ z := by
    have hcast : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ z := by
      have hda0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d * a : ℕ) := by positivity
      have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
    ⟨haPos, (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left a hdPos).trans hdaLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.card_activeReverseDivisors_le
statement:
theorem card_activeReverseDivisors_le
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (P.minimizingSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors
      (P.minimizingSieve R z) d).card ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card (P.activeReverseDivisors_subset_Icc hz hd)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.abs_minimizingWeight_le_cube
statement:
theorem abs_minimizingWeight_le_cube
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight (P.minimizingSieve R z) d| ≤
      (z : ℝ) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  by_cases hdMem : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hd := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).1
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      have hsquare := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).2
      rw [P.minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hsquare
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight,
      SelbergFundamental.weightFromDiagonal, dif_pos hd, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd)),
      BFPSTwoAffine.reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors hd]
    have hsum :
        |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
          (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
            (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
            (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
            ∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
              |(μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d, (z : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a ha
          rw [abs_mul]
          have hmu : |(μ a : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
            exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := a)
          exact (mul_le_mul hmu (P.abs_minimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff hz)
            (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq (one_mul _)
        _ = ((BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d).card : ℝ) * z := by simp
        _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * z := by
          gcongr
          exact_mod_cast P.card_activeReverseDivisors_le hz hd
        _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [P.sieveDensity_inv_eq_cast_of_dvd hd]
    calc
      (d : ℝ) *
          |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
            (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
          (d : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hdLe) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated hdMem,
      abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.abs_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_le_tenth
statement:
theorem abs_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_le_tenth
    {R z n : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hn : n ≤ z ^ 2) :
    |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
        (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight (P.minimizingSieve R z)) n| ≤
      (z : ℝ) ^ 10
proof:
:= by
  let w := SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight (P.minimizingSieve R z)
  have hw (d : ℕ) : |w d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 := P.abs_minimizingWeight_le_cube hz
  have hterm (d₁ d₂ : ℕ) :
      |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    by_cases h : n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂
    · rw [if_pos h, abs_mul]
      calc
        |w d₁| * |w d₂| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 * (z : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
          mul_le_mul (hw d₁) (hw d₂) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by ring
    · rw [if_neg h, abs_zero]
      positivity
  have hinner (d₁ : ℕ) :
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    calc
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
          ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _d₂ ∈ n.divisors, (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro d₂ hd₂
        exact hterm d₁ d₂
      _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by simp
  unfold BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
  change |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
      ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
        if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ _
  have hcardNat : n.divisors.card ≤ n := Nat.card_divisors_le_self n
  have hcard : ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat.trans hn
  calc
    |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
          |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₁ hd₁
      exact hinner d₁
    _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      simp
      ring
    _ ≤ ((z : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by gcongr
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.minimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem minimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    P.minimizingRemainderSupport R z ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  intro d hd
  have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
  have hdPos := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
  rw [P.minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdData
  have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hdData.2
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hdPos, hdLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.card_minimizingRemainderSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_minimizingRemainderSupport_le
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (P.minimizingRemainderSupport R z).card ≤ z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card
    (P.minimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc (R := R) hz)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_twelfth
statement:
theorem minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_twelfth
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    P.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 12
proof:
:= by
  let s := P.minimizingSieve R z
  have heq : P.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z =
      ∑ d ∈ P.minimizingRemainderSupport R z,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| := by
    unfold minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant minimizingRemainderSupport
    change (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
          |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d|
        else 0) = _
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [heq]
  have hterm (d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ P.minimizingRemainderSupport R z) :
      |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by
    have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by
      have hlevel := hdData.2
      rw [P.minimizingSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hlevel
      exact_mod_cast hlevel
    exact P.abs_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_le_tenth hz hdLe
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ P.minimizingRemainderSupport R z,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d|) ≤
        ∑ _d ∈ P.minimizingRemainderSupport R z, (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      exact hterm d hd
    _ = ((P.minimizingRemainderSupport R z).card : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by simp
    _ ≤ ((z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by
      gcongr
      exact_mod_cast P.card_minimizingRemainderSupport_le (R := R) hz
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by norm_num; ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.inv_cast_le_localSieveProduct
statement:
theorem inv_cast_le_localSieveProduct
    {z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (z : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ P.localSieveProduct z
proof:
:=
  (BFPSTwoAffine.inv_cast_le_directMertensProduct hz).trans
    (P.directMertensProduct_le_localSieveProduct z)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.Progression.combinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem combinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff :
    CombinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound
      BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff 1
proof:
:= by
  intro P R hR
  let z := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R
  have hz : 1 ≤ z :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hzPos : (0 : ℝ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hz
  have hpowNat : z ^ 32 ≤ R := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_le R
  have hpow : (z : ℝ) ^ 32 ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpowNat
  have hthirteen : (z : ℝ) ^ 13 ≤ (R : ℝ) :=
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ z by exact_mod_cast hz)
      (show 13 ≤ 32 by norm_num)).trans hpow
  have hlocal : (z : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ P.localSieveProduct z :=
    P.inv_cast_le_localSieveProduct hz
  have hsplit : (z : ℝ) ^ 12 = (z : ℝ) ^ 13 * (z : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    field_simp [hzPos.ne']
  calc
    P.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 12 :=
      P.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_twelfth hz
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 13 * (z : ℝ)⁻¹ := hsplit
    _ ≤ (R : ℝ) * (z : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hthirteen (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (R : ℝ) * P.localSieveProduct z :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlocal (by positivity)
    _ = (1 : ℝ) * R * P.localSieveProduct z := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffProgressionSieveConstant_pos

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.progressionSelbergUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:

      growingCutoffProgressionSieveConstant

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicCutoffBelowInterval_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem dyadicCutoffBelowInterval_selbergGrowingCutoff
    {D J : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    DyadicCutoffBelowInterval BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff D J
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  calc
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff (dyadicLength j) ≤
        (dyadicLength j).sqrt :=
      BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_le_sqrt _
    _ ≤ dyadicLength j := Nat.sqrt_le_self _
    _ ≤ dyadicLength j * D := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hD

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicDirectMertensUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem dyadicDirectMertensUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff (J : ℕ) :
    DyadicDirectMertensUpperBound BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff
      growingCutoffDyadicMertensConstant J
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : BFPSTwoAffine.DirectMertensProductUpperBound
      BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff 32 := by
    have h := BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
      (cutoff := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff) (c := (1 / 32 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num) BFPSTwoAffine.cutoffLogLowerBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  intro j hj
  have hjData := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj
  have hjPos : 0 < j := by omega
  have hN3 : 3 ≤ dyadicLength j := by
    have hpow : 2 ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ j := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hjData.1
    change 3 ≤ 2 ^ j
    norm_num at hpow ⊢
    omega
  have hM := hbase (dyadicLength j) hN3
  change BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct
      (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff (dyadicLength j)) ≤
    growingCutoffDyadicMertensConstant / j
  calc
    BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff (dyadicLength j)) ≤
        32 / Real.log (dyadicLength j) := hM
    _ = 32 / ((j : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      congr 1
      rw [show (dyadicLength j : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ j by
        norm_num [dyadicLength], Real.log_pow]
    _ = growingCutoffDyadicMertensConstant / j := by
      have hjNe : (j : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hlogNe : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
        ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
      unfold growingCutoffDyadicMertensConstant
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_growingCutoff
    {D a J : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis
      growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant D a J
proof:
:= by
  unfold growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant
  apply dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_of_progressionSelberg
    growingCutoffProgressionSieveConstant_pos.le
    growingCutoffDyadicMertensConstant_pos.le
    progressionSelbergUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
    (dyadicDirectMertensUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff J)
    (dyadicCutoffBelowInterval_selbergGrowingCutoff hD)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_growingCutoff
    {D X : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hX : 2 ≤ X) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 X ≤
      (5 + growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 X))) *
        (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_canonical
    growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant_nonneg hD hX
    (dyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis_growingCutoff hD)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_growingCutoff_or_zero
statement:
theorem residuePrimeReciprocalSum_growingCutoff_or_zero
    {D X : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    (X < D ∧ residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 X = 0) ∨
      (D ≤ X ∧
        residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 X ≤
          (5 + growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant *
              (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 ((max 2 X : ℕ) : ℝ)))) *
            (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hXD : X < D
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hXD,
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_one_eq_zero_of_upper_lt_modulus hXD⟩
  · right
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    exact (residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_mono_upper (Nat.le_max_right 2 X)).trans
      (residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_growingCutoff hD (Nat.le_max_left 2 X))

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_nonneg
statement:
theorem supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_nonneg (X : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient X
proof:
:= by
  unfold supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient
  have hlogb : 0 ≤ Real.logb 2 (max 2 X : ℕ) := by
    rw [Real.logb]
    exact div_nonneg
      (Real.log_nonneg (by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ max 2 X by omega)))
      (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)).le
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 (max 2 X : ℕ)) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 (max 2 X : ℕ)) := by linarith
  have hmul := mul_nonneg growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant_nonneg hfactor
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.linearDescriptorReciprocalMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarsh
statement:
theorem linearDescriptorReciprocalMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarsh
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (B : Finset (Fin J)) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    ((∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
        1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) ≤
      supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient (2 * x) *
        ((blockDemandProduct P B).totient : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear := linearDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_residue (x := x) P B
  have hlinearReal :
      ((∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) ≤
        (residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat
          (blockDemandProduct P B) 1 0 (2 * x) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hlinear
  rw [residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSumRat_cast] at hlinearReal
  have hBT := residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_growingCutoff
    (D := blockDemandProduct P B) (X := 2 * x)
    (blockDemandProduct_pos P B) (by omega)
  exact hlinearReal.trans (by
    simpa [supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient, max_eq_right (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * x)]
      using hBT)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_nonneg
statement:
theorem supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_nonneg
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x : ℕ)
    (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    0 ≤ supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor P x B
proof:
:= by
  unfold supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor
  exact add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_nonneg _)
      (div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)))
    (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.descriptorReciprocalMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarshBlock
statement:
theorem descriptorReciprocalMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarshBlock
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (B : Finset (Fin J)) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (descriptorReciprocalMass P x B : ℝ) ≤
      supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor P x B /
        (blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear := linearDescriptorReciprocalMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarsh P B hx
  have hpowerQ := powerDescriptorReciprocalMass_le_card_div (x := x) P B
  have hpower :
      ((∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) ≤
        (B.card : ℝ) / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ) := by
    have hc :
        (↑(∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
          (1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) ≤
          (((B.card : ℚ) / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) :=
      (Rat.cast_le).2 hpowerQ
    simpa using hc
  have hsplitQ : descriptorReciprocalMass P x B =
      (∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) +
        ∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    classical
    let L : Finset (SupplierDescriptor P x B) := Finset.univ.image Sum.inl
    let R : Finset (SupplierDescriptor P x B) := Finset.univ.image Sum.inr
    have hcover : L ∪ R = Finset.univ := by
      ext d
      cases d <;> simp [L, R]
    have hdisjoint : Disjoint L R := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro d hdL hdR
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hld⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hdL
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hdR
      exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (hld.trans hrd.symm)
    unfold descriptorReciprocalMass
    change (∑ d ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (SupplierDescriptor P x B)),
      1 / (d.selectedDivisor : ℚ)) = _
    rw [← hcover, Finset.sum_union hdisjoint]
    dsimp only [L, R]
    rw [Finset.sum_image, Finset.sum_image]
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact Sum.inr.inj hab
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact Sum.inl.inj hab
  have hsplit : (descriptorReciprocalMass P x B : ℝ) =
      ((∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) +
        ((∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hsplitQ
  rw [hsplit]
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < blockDemandProduct P B := by
    exact_mod_cast blockDemandProduct_pos P B
  have hphi : (0 : ℝ) < (blockDemandProduct P B).totient := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr (blockDemandProduct_pos P B)
  calc
    ((∑ d : LinearDescriptor P x B,
        1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (Sum.inl d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) +
        ((∑ d : PowerDescriptor P B,
          1 / ((SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor (x := x) (Sum.inr d) : ℕ) : ℚ)) : ℝ) ≤
        supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient (2 * x) *
            ((blockDemandProduct P B).totient : ℝ)⁻¹ +
          (B.card : ℝ) / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ) := add_le_add hlinear hpower
    _ = supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor P x B /
        (blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ) := by
      unfold supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor
      field_simp [hD.ne', hphi.ne']

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.partitionDescriptorMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarsh
statement:
theorem partitionDescriptorMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarsh
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (pi : LabelPartition J) (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (partitionDescriptorMass P x pi : ℝ) ≤
      supplierBrunTitchmarshPartitionFactor P x pi /
        (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [partitionDescriptorMass]
  push_cast
  calc
    (∏ B : pi.Block, (descriptorReciprocalMass P x B.1 : ℝ)) ≤
        ∏ B : pi.Block,
          supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor P x B.1 /
            (blockDemandProduct P B.1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro B hB
        exact_mod_cast descriptorReciprocalMass_nonneg P x B.1
      · intro B hB
        exact descriptorReciprocalMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarshBlock P B.1 hx
    _ = supplierBrunTitchmarshPartitionFactor P x pi /
        (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ) := by
      unfold supplierBrunTitchmarshPartitionFactor
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
      congr 1
      exact_mod_cast pi.prod_blockDemandProduct P

name: RankAmplification.BrunTitchmarsh.hasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal_of_brunTitchmarshBlocks
statement:
theorem hasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal_of_brunTitchmarshBlocks
    {J y Y x : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) {L : ℝ}
    (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hblock : ∀ B : Finset (Fin J), B.Nonempty →
      supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor P x B ≤ L ^ B.card) :
    HasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal P x L
proof:
:= by
  intro pi
  refine (partitionDescriptorMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarsh P pi hx).trans ?_
  have hprod : supplierBrunTitchmarshPartitionFactor P x pi ≤ L ^ J := by
    calc
      supplierBrunTitchmarshPartitionFactor P x pi ≤
          ∏ B : pi.Block, L ^ B.1.card := by
        unfold supplierBrunTitchmarshPartitionFactor
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod
        · intro B hB
          exact supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_nonneg P x B.1
        · intro B hB
          exact hblock B.1 (pi.block_nonempty B)
      _ = L ^ J := by
        rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, pi.sum_block_card]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hprod (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.localTotientFactor_pos
statement:
theorem localTotientFactor_pos {N q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) :
    0 < localTotientFactor N q
proof:
:= by
  unfold localTotientFactor
  exact mul_pos (pow_pos hq.pos _) (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq.one_lt)

name: RankAmplification.card_demandLabelsAt_eq_factorization_totalDemandProduct
statement:
theorem card_demandLabelsAt_eq_factorization_totalDemandProduct
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (p : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (DemandLabelsAt P p) = (totalDemandProduct P).factorization p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfilter : Fintype.card (DemandLabelsAt P p) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin J ↦ P.value i = p).card := by
    rw [← Fintype.card_coe]
    apply Fintype.card_congr
    exact
      { toFun := fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, i.2⟩⟩
        invFun := fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp i.2).2⟩
        left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
        right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  rw [hfilter]
  unfold totalDemandProduct blockDemandProduct
  rw [Nat.factorization_prod_apply]
  · symm
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [(P.prime i).factorization]
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
  · intro i hi
    exact (P.prime i).ne_zero

name: RankAmplification.totient_eq_prod_localTotientFactor
statement:
theorem totient_eq_prod_localTotientFactor {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    N.totient = ∏ q ∈ primeSupport N, localTotientFactor N q
proof:
:= by
  change N.totient = N.factorization.prod
    (fun q a ↦ q ^ (a - 1) * (q - 1))
  exact Nat.totient_eq_prod_factorization hN

name: RankAmplification.card_localTotientOccurrence
statement:
theorem card_localTotientOccurrence {N p : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    Fintype.card (LocalTotientOccurrence N p) = N.totient.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  calc
    (∑ q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ primeSupport N},
        (localTotientFactor N q.1).factorization p) =
        ∑ q ∈ primeSupport N, (localTotientFactor N q).factorization p :=
      by simpa using (Finset.sum_attach (primeSupport N)
        fun q ↦ (localTotientFactor N q).factorization p)
    _ = (∏ q ∈ primeSupport N, localTotientFactor N q).factorization p := by
      rw [Nat.factorization_prod_apply]
      intro q hq
      exact (localTotientFactor_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq)).ne'
    _ = N.totient.factorization p := by
      rw [← totient_eq_prod_localTotientFactor hN]

name: RankAmplification.card_demandLabelsAt_le_card_localTotientOccurrence
statement:
theorem card_demandLabelsAt_le_card_localTotientOccurrence
    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hD : totalDemandProduct P ∣ N.totient) (p : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (DemandLabelsAt P p) ≤ Fintype.card (LocalTotientOccurrence N p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_demandLabelsAt_eq_factorization_totalDemandProduct,
    card_localTotientOccurrence hN]
  exact ((Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd
    (blockDemandProduct_pos P Finset.univ).ne'
    (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hN)).ne').mpr hD) p

name: RankAmplification.card_assignedDemandLabels_le_localFactor_factorization
statement:
theorem card_assignedDemandLabels_le_localFactor_factorization
    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hD : totalDemandProduct P ∣ N.totient) {q p : ℕ}
    (hq : q ∈ primeSupport N) :
    (assignedDemandLabels P hN hD q p).card ≤
      (localTotientFactor N q).factorization p
proof:
:= by
  let e := (assignedDemandLabelsEmbedding P hN hD q p).trans
    (localTotientOccurrenceFiberEquiv hq).toEmbedding
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_embedding e
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fin] using hcard

name: RankAmplification.localTotientFactor_factorization_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  unfold localTotientFactor
  rw [Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hq.ne_zero)
    (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq.one_lt).ne']
  simp [hq.factorization_pow, hpq]

name: RankAmplification.localTotientFactor_factorization_self
statement:
theorem localTotientFactor_factorization_self {N q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) :
    (localTotientFactor N q).factorization q = N.factorization q - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpredPos : 0 < q - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq.one_lt
  have hnotDvd : ¬q ∣ q - 1 := by
    intro hdvd
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd hpredPos hdvd
    omega
  unfold localTotientFactor
  rw [Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hq.ne_zero) hpredPos.ne',
    Finsupp.add_apply, Nat.factorization_pow_self hq,
    Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hnotDvd]
  simp

name: RankAmplification.mem_assignedResidualLabels
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_assignedResidualLabels
    {J y Y N : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {hN : N ≠ 0}
    {hD : totalDemandProduct P ∣ N.totient} {q : ℕ} {i : Fin J} :
    i ∈ assignedResidualLabels P hN hD q ↔
      allocatedSource P hN hD i = q ∧ P.value i ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  simp [assignedResidualLabels]

name: RankAmplification.factorization_assignedResidualProduct_of_ne
statement:
theorem factorization_assignedResidualProduct_of_ne
    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hD : totalDemandProduct P ∣ N.totient) {q p : ℕ} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    (∏ i ∈ assignedResidualLabels P hN hD q, P.value i).factorization p =
      (assignedDemandLabels P hN hD q p).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.factorization_prod_apply]
  · calc
      (∑ i ∈ assignedResidualLabels P hN hD q, (P.value i).factorization p) =
          ((assignedResidualLabels P hN hD q).filter fun i ↦ P.value i = p).card := by
        rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [(P.prime i).factorization]
        simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
      _ = (assignedDemandLabels P hN hD q p).card := by
        congr 1
        ext i
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_assignedResidualLabels,
          mem_assignedDemandLabels]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hsource, hne⟩, hvalue⟩
          exact ⟨hvalue, hsource⟩
        · rintro ⟨hvalue, hsource⟩
          exact ⟨⟨hsource, hvalue.trans_ne hpq⟩, hvalue⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact (P.prime i).ne_zero

name: RankAmplification.assignedResidualProduct_dvd_pred
statement:
theorem assignedResidualProduct_dvd_pred
    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hD : totalDemandProduct P ∣ N.totient) {q : ℕ}
    (hqMem : q ∈ primeSupport N) :
    (∏ i ∈ assignedResidualLabels P hN hD q, P.value i) ∣ q - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hq : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqMem
  apply (Nat.factorization_prime_le_iff_dvd
    (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i hi ↦ (P.prime i).ne_zero)
    (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq.one_lt).ne').mp
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst p
    rw [Nat.factorization_prod_apply]
    · have hzero :
          (∑ i ∈ assignedResidualLabels P hN hD q,
            (P.value i).factorization q) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i hi
        rw [(P.prime i).factorization]
        simp [(mem_assignedResidualLabels.mp hi).2]
      rw [hzero]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · intro i hi
      exact (P.prime i).ne_zero
  · rw [factorization_assignedResidualProduct_of_ne P hN hD hpq]
    exact (card_assignedDemandLabels_le_localFactor_factorization
      P hN hD hqMem).trans_eq
        (localTotientFactor_factorization_of_ne hq hpq)

name: RankAmplification.assignedPowerMultiplicity_succ_le_factorization
statement:
theorem assignedPowerMultiplicity_succ_le_factorization
    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hD : totalDemandProduct P ∣ N.totient) {q : ℕ}
    (hqMem : q ∈ primeSupport N) :
    (assignedDemandLabels P hN hD q q).card + 1 ≤ N.factorization q
proof:
:= by
  have hq : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqMem
  have hcard := card_assignedDemandLabels_le_localFactor_factorization
    (q := q) (p := q) P hN hD hqMem
  rw [localTotientFactor_factorization_self hq] at hcard
  have hfacPos : 0 < N.factorization q := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp
    simpa only [Nat.support_factorization] using hqMem
  omega

name: RankAmplification.assignedPowerSelectedDivisor_dvd
statement:
theorem assignedPowerSelectedDivisor_dvd
    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hD : totalDemandProduct P ∣ N.totient) {q : ℕ}
    (hqMem : q ∈ primeSupport N) :
    q ^ ((assignedDemandLabels P hN hD q q).card + 1) ∣ N
proof:
:= by
  exact ((Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqMem).pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hN).mpr
    (assignedPowerMultiplicity_succ_le_factorization P hN hD hqMem)

    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)

name: RankAmplification.residualDemandProduct_allocatedSourceBlock_dvd_pred

    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)

name: RankAmplification.allocatedSource_powerSelectedDivisor_dvd
statement:
theorem allocatedSource_powerSelectedDivisor_dvd
    {J y Y N : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (hN : N ≠ 0)

name: RankAmplification.paperDemandCandidates_prime
proof:
:= by
  rw [paperDemandCandidates, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
  refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
  cases kind with
  | linear =>
      have hmem : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors := by
        simpa [supplierDemandCandidates] using hp.1
      exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
  | power =>
      have hmem : p ∈ insert q (q - 1).primeFactors := by
        simpa [supplierDemandCandidates] using hp.1
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hmem with h | h
      · exact h ▸ hq
      · exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors h

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotUnion_card_le
statement:
theorem paperSlotUnion_card_le {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) :
    Fintype.card (PaperSlotUnion a) ≤ J * paperSlotWidth J x T
proof:
:= by
  calc Fintype.card (PaperSlotUnion a)
      = ∑ B : a.2.partition.Block, (paperSourceSlots a B).card :=
        paperSlotUnion_card_eq_sum a
    _ ≤ ∑ _B : a.2.partition.Block, paperSlotWidth J x T :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun B _ ↦
          paperSourceSlots_card_le_paperSlotWidth hy hT hyT hY a B
    _ = Fintype.card a.2.partition.Block * paperSlotWidth J x T := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ J * paperSlotWidth J x T :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (paperSourceCount_le a)

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotUnion_map_card_le
statement:
theorem paperSlotUnion_map_card_le {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) :
    Fintype.card (Fin J → PaperSlotUnion a) ≤ (J * paperSlotWidth J x T) ^ J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (paperSlotUnion_card_le hy hT hyT hY a) J

name: RankAmplification.paperUnionFlatten_injective
statement:
theorem paperUnionFlatten_injective {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) :
    Function.Injective (paperUnionFlatten hy hY hM a)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨B, p⟩ ⟨C, q⟩ h
  have h1 : supplierPairSlot (paperSourceIndex a B)
      (slotIndexOfFinset ((paperSourceSlots_card_le hy hY a B).trans hM) p) =
      supplierPairSlot (paperSourceIndex a C)
        (slotIndexOfFinset ((paperSourceSlots_card_le hy hY a C).trans hM) q) := h
  have hpair :
      (paperSourceIndex a B,
          slotIndexOfFinset ((paperSourceSlots_card_le hy hY a B).trans hM) p) =
        (paperSourceIndex a C,
          slotIndexOfFinset ((paperSourceSlots_card_le hy hY a C).trans hM) q) :=
    supplierPairSlot_injective (by simpa using h1)
  have hBC : B = C := paperSourceIndex_injective a (congrArg Prod.fst hpair)
  subst hBC
  have hval : (p : ℕ) = (q : ℕ) :=
    slotIndexOfFinset_val_eq (hcard := (paperSourceSlots_card_le hy hY a B).trans hM)
      (hcard' := (paperSourceSlots_card_le hy hY a B).trans hM) rfl (congrArg Prod.snd hpair)
  exact congrArg (Sigma.mk B) (Subtype.ext hval)

name: RankAmplification.paperDemandSlot_eq_flatten
statement:
theorem paperDemandSlot_eq_flatten {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) (i : Fin J) :
    paperDemandSlot hy hY hM a i = paperUnionFlatten hy hY hM a (paperUnionSlot a i)

:=

name: RankAmplification.paperCarriedPrime_paperUnionFlatten
statement:
theorem paperCarriedPrime_paperUnionFlatten {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x)
    (s : PaperSlotUnion a) :
    paperCarriedPrime (M := M) a (paperUnionFlatten hy hY hM a s) = (s.2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, p⟩ := s
  have hblock : a.2.partition.blockOf (paperSourceIndex a B) = B :=
    a.2.partition.blockOf_representative B
  have htype : (a.labelDescriptor (paperSourceIndex a B)).sourceType =
      (a.2.descriptor B).sourceType :=
    congrArg (fun C : a.2.partition.Block ↦ (a.2.descriptor C).sourceType) hblock
  have hbase : (a.labelDescriptor (paperSourceIndex a B)).base = (a.2.descriptor B).base :=
    congrArg (fun C : a.2.partition.Block ↦ (a.2.descriptor C).base) hblock
  unfold paperCarriedPrime paperUnionFlatten
  rw [paperSlotPair_supplierPairSlot]
  show finsetSlotPrime
      (paperDemandCandidates y (a.labelDescriptor (paperSourceIndex a B)).sourceType
        (a.labelDescriptor (paperSourceIndex a B)).base)
      (slotIndexOfFinset ((paperSourceSlots_card_le hy hY a B).trans hM) p) = (p : ℕ)
  rw [htype, hbase]
  exact finsetSlotPrime_slotIndexOfFinset _ _

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_codomain
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_codomain {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) :
    (∀ i : Fin J, (paperUnionSlot a i).1 = a.2.partition.blockOf i) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin J, ((paperUnionSlot a i).2 : ℕ) = a.1.value i) ∧
      (∀ (B : a.2.partition.Block) (p : ℕ), p ∈ paperSourceSlots a B → Nat.Prime p ∧ y < p) ∧
      Function.Injective (paperSourceIndex a) ∧
      Fintype.card (PaperSlotUnion a) ≤ J * paperSlotWidth J x T ∧
      (∀ i : Fin J,
        paperDemandSlot hy hY (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) a i =
          paperUnionFlatten hy hY (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) a
            (paperUnionSlot a i)) ∧
      Function.Injective
        (paperUnionFlatten hy hY (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun i ↦ paperUnionSlot_source a i,
    fun i ↦ paperUnionSlot_carriedPrime a i,
    fun B _ hp ↦ paperSourceSlots_prime a B hp,
    paperSourceIndex_injective a,
    paperSlotUnion_card_le hy hT hyT hY a,
    fun i ↦ paperDemandSlot_eq_flatten hy hY _ a i,
    paperUnionFlatten_injective hy hY _ a⟩

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_codomain_nonvacuous

theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_codomain_nonvacuous :

name: RankAmplification.paperUnionSlot_not_injective
statement:
theorem paperUnionSlot_not_injective :
    paperUnionSlot workedEntry 0 = paperUnionSlot workedEntry 1 ∧
      ¬ Function.Injective (paperUnionSlot workedEntry)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 2 := le_rfl
  have hY : (16 : ℕ) ≤ 2 * 2000 := by norm_num
  have hM : Nat.log 2 (2 * 2000) + 1 ≤ paperSlotWidth 4 2000 (Real.log 2) :=
    natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := 4) (x := 2000) (T := Real.log 2) le_rfl
      (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)) (by rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]; norm_num)
  obtain ⟨-, hslot, -⟩ := section10_lemma10_10_paper_sigma_not_injective
  have hflat : paperUnionFlatten hy hY hM workedEntry (paperUnionSlot workedEntry 0) =
      paperUnionFlatten hy hY hM workedEntry (paperUnionSlot workedEntry 1) := by
    rw [← paperDemandSlot_eq_flatten, ← paperDemandSlot_eq_flatten]
    exact hslot
  have heq : paperUnionSlot workedEntry 0 = paperUnionSlot workedEntry 1 :=
    paperUnionFlatten_injective hy hY hM workedEntry hflat
  exact ⟨heq, fun hinj ↦ absurd (hinj heq) (by decide)⟩

name: RankAmplification.rankinU_fixedRankFriablePowerCode
statement:
theorem rankinU_fixedRankFriablePowerCode
    {J x : ℕ} (hY : 1 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x) :
    rankinU (fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x) (fixedRankNatUpperY J x) =
      fixedRankFriableRank J x
proof:

  have hlog : Real.log (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_antitone_cutoff
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_antitone_cutoff
    {j R H₁ H₂ X : ℕ} (hH : H₁ ≤ H₂) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H₂ X ≤
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H₁ X
proof:
:= by

  unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro m hm
    rw [mem_finiteSmoothTailSet] at hm ⊢
    exact ⟨hH.trans_lt hm.1, hm.2⟩
  · intro m hm hnot
