name: RankAmplification.fixedRankB4K_mul_friableModel
statement:
theorem fixedRankB4K_mul_friableModel {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    {x : ℝ} (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) :
    fixedRankB4K J x * (scaleV x / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) =
      scaleL x / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)).ne'
  unfold fixedRankB4K
  calc
    Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) * scaleG x *
        (scaleV x / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) =
        (scaleG x * scaleV x) / 4 := by field_simp [hsqrt]
    _ = scaleL x / 4 := by rw [scaleG_mul_scaleV hG]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRank_encoding_room
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRank_encoding_room
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
          2 * (J : ℝ) * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
        scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (32 * (J : ℝ))
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hsmall := (fixedRankB4K_isLittleO_scaleL J).bound hc
  have hsmallNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hsmall
  have hLlarge := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
      (8 * (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
  have hLpos := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_scaleL_pos
  filter_upwards [hsmallNat, hLlarge, hLpos] with x hsmall hLlarge hL
  have hKnonneg : 0 ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankB4K
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (scaleG_nonneg _)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hKnonneg, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL.le] at hsmall
  have hK : fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / (32 * (J : ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [c] at hsmall
    calc
      fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
          (1 / (32 * (J : ℝ))) * scaleL (x : ℝ) := hsmall
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / (32 * (J : ℝ)) := by ring
  have htwoJK : 2 * (J : ℝ) * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / 16 := by
    calc
      2 * (J : ℝ) * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
          2 * (J : ℝ) *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) / (32 * (J : ℝ))) := by gcongr
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / 16 := by
        field_simp [show (J : ℝ) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast hJ.ne']
        ring
  have hconst : (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 8 := by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hLlarge
    linarith
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankFriablePowerCode_threshold
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankFriablePowerCode_threshold
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (2 ^ J * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ (2 * J)) *
          fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x ≤ x.sqrt
proof:
:= by
  have hroom := eventually_fixedRank_encoding_room J hJ
  have hcore := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_moving_core_positive
  filter_upwards [hroom, hcore] with x hroom hcore
  have hx : 0 < x := by
    have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
    by_contra hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hx
    subst x
    simp [scaleL] at hL
  have hL := hcore.1
  have hA := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hmodelNonneg : 0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    exact div_nonneg hV.le (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hsqrt.le)
  have hv : (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    exact Nat.floor_le hmodelNonneg
  have hK : 0 ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankB4K
    positivity
  have hvK : (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) *
      fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 := by
    calc
      (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) *
            fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv hK
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 := by
        rw [mul_comm]
        exact fixedRankB4K_mul_friableModel hJ hG.ne'
  have hexponent : (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
      (2 * (J : ℝ) + fixedRankFriableRank J x) *
          fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
    calc
      (J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
          (2 * (J : ℝ) + fixedRankFriableRank J x) *
            fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) =
          ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
            2 * (J : ℝ) * fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) +
              (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) *
                fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 + scaleL (x : ℝ) / 4 :=
        add_le_add hroom hvK
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2 := by ring
  have hYcast : (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ≤
          fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) :=
        Nat.floor_le (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le
      _ = Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) :=
        fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG (x : ℝ) hJ
  have hreal :
      (((2 ^ J * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ (2 * J)) *
      fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
    push_cast
    rw [fixedRankFriablePowerCode, Nat.cast_pow, mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ J *
          (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) ^
            (2 * J + fixedRankFriableRank J x) ≤
          Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2) *
            Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) ^
              (2 * J + fixedRankFriableRank J x) := by
        gcongr
        · rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      _ = Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * Real.log 2 +
          (2 * (J : ℝ) + fixedRankFriableRank J x) *
            fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (scaleL (x : ℝ) / 2) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent
      _ = Real.sqrt x := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hx)]
        congr 1
        rw [scaleL]
        ring
  apply Nat.le_sqrt'.2
  have hleft : 0 ≤ (((2 ^ J * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ (2 * J)) *
      fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsquare := mul_self_le_mul_self hleft hreal
  rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast hx.le)] at hsquare
  have hsquareNat :
      (2 ^ J * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ (2 * J) *
          fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x) *
        (2 ^ J * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ (2 * J) *
          fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x) ≤ x := by
    exact_mod_cast hsquare
  simpa [pow_two, mul_assoc] using hsquareNat

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankFriablePowerCode_le_tailCode
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankFriablePowerCode_le_tailCode
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x ≤ fixedRankSupplierTailCode J x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankFriablePowerCode_threshold J hJ,
    eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ] with x hthreshold hY
  unfold fixedRankSupplierTailCode
  apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by positivity :
    0 < 2 ^ J * fixedRankNatUpperY J x ^ (2 * J))).2
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hthreshold

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_slotEncodingFactor_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRank_slotEncodingFactor_le_exp
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hLTwo : 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) :
    (slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (9 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let L := scaleL (x : ℝ)
  let j : ℝ := J
  let M : ℝ := fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x
  have hjOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega)
  have hjL : j ≤ L := h.rank_le_scaleL
  have hMLsq : M ≤ L ^ 2 := h.slot_le_scaleL_sq
  have hLOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L := (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2).trans hLTwo
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := zero_le_one.trans hLOne
  have hj0 : 0 ≤ j := zero_le_one.trans hjOne
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by positivity
  have hjSucc : j + 1 ≤ L ^ 2 := by
    have hLsq : L + 1 ≤ L ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hL0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hLOne)]
    have hjadd : j + 1 ≤ L + 1 := by linarith
    exact hjadd.trans hLsq
  have hJM : j * M + 1 ≤ L ^ 4 := by
    have hprod : j * M ≤ L * L ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul hjL hMLsq hM0 hL0
    have hcubeOne : 1 ≤ L ^ 3 := one_le_pow₀ hLOne
    have hcube0 : 0 ≤ L ^ 3 := pow_nonneg hL0 _
    calc
      j * M + 1 ≤ L ^ 3 + 1 := by
        rw [show L * L ^ 2 = L ^ 3 by ring] at hprod
        simpa [add_comm] using (add_le_add_right hprod 1)
      _ ≤ 2 * L ^ 3 := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ L * L ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLTwo hcube0
      _ = L ^ 4 := by ring
  have htwoPow : (2 : ℝ) ^ J ≤
      Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ J ≤ L ^ J := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hLTwo _
      _ = Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hjSuccPow : (j + 1) ^ J ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (j + 1) ^ J ≤ (L ^ 2) ^ J :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (add_nonneg hj0 zero_le_one) hjSucc _
      _ = Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_sq_pow_eq_exp_two_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hJMPow : (j * M + 1) ^ J ≤
      Real.exp (4 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (j * M + 1) ^ J ≤ (L ^ 4) ^ J :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hj0 hM0) zero_le_one) hJM _
      _ = Real.exp (4 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_four_pow_eq_exp_four_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hfront : j + 1 ≤ Real.exp (2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      j + 1 ≤ L ^ 2 := hjSucc
      _ = Real.exp ((2 : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
        scaleL_pow_eq_exp_rank_log2 h.scaleL_pos
  have hproduct : (slotEncodingFactor J
      (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp ((2 + 7 * (J : ℝ)) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold slotEncodingFactor
    push_cast
    calc
      (((J : ℝ) + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ J) *
          (((J : ℝ) + 1) ^ J *
            ((J : ℝ) * (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x : ℝ) + 1) ^ J) ≤
          (Real.exp (2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
            Real.exp ((J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))) *
          (Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
            Real.exp (4 * (J : ℝ) * log2 (x : ℝ))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul
          (mul_le_mul (by simpa [j] using hfront) htwoPow (by positivity)
            (Real.exp_pos _).le)
          (mul_le_mul (by simpa [j] using hjSuccPow)
            (by simpa [j, M] using hJMPow) (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
          (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = Real.exp ((2 + 7 * (J : ℝ)) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
        repeat' rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
  calc
    (slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp ((2 + 7 * (J : ℝ)) * log2 (x : ℝ)) := hproduct
    _ ≤ Real.exp (9 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hL2 : 0 ≤ log2 (x : ℝ) := zero_le_one.trans h.log2_ge_one
      have hcoeff : 2 + 7 * (J : ℝ) ≤ 9 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have hprod : 0 ≤ (9 * (J : ℝ) + 2) * ((J : ℝ) - 1) :=
          mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr hjOne)
        nlinarith
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff hL2

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_exp
statement:
theorem fixedRank_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_exp
    {J x : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (h : FixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J x)
    (hLTwo : 2 ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ)) (hy : 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x) :
    finitePowerEncodingFactor J (fixedRankNatY J x)
        (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x)
proof:
:= by
  have hslot := fixedRank_slotEncodingFactor_le_exp hJ h hLTwo
  have hdiv : (J : ℝ) / fixedRankNatY J x ≤ J := by
    exact div_le_self (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hy)
  unfold finitePowerEncodingFactor fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget
  calc
    (slotEncodingFactor J (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / fixedRankNatY J x) ≤
      Real.exp (9 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ)) *
        Real.exp (J : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul hslot (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hdiv) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_add]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_basic
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_basic
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      3 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) ∧
      2 ≤ fixedRankFriableRank J x ∧
      (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ≤
        scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) ∧
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) ≤
        (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤
        Real.log (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hqTop : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.atTop_div_const (by positivity)
  have hqThree := hqTop.eventually_ge_atTop 3
  have hlogLarge : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      2 * Real.log (8 * Real.sqrt J) ≤
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop _
  filter_upwards [hqThree, hlogLarge, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hq hlogLarge hV
  let q := scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)
  let u := fixedRankFriableRank J x
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have huTwo : 2 ≤ u := by
    unfold u fixedRankFriableRank
    apply Nat.le_floor
    exact (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ q by linarith)
  have huPos : (0 : ℝ) < u := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < u by omega)
  have huLe : (u : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    unfold u fixedRankFriableRank
    exact Nat.floor_le hqPos.le
  have hqLt : q < (u : ℝ) + 1 := by
    unfold u fixedRankFriableRank
    exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one q
  have hhalf : q / 2 ≤ (u : ℝ) := by
    have huOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ u := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ u by omega)
    linarith
  have hsqrtOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt J := by
    rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega)
  have hdenPos : 0 < (8 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt J := by positivity
  have hlogModel :
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J)) =
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) - Real.log (8 * Real.sqrt J) := by
    rw [Real.log_div hV.ne' hdenPos.ne']
  have hmodelLe : scaleV (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) ≤ (u : ℝ) := by
    change scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) / 2 ≤ (u : ℝ) at hhalf
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) =
          scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) / 2 := by
        field_simp [hsqrt.ne']
        norm_num
      _ ≤ (u : ℝ) := hhalf
  have hmodelPos : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J) := by positivity
  have hlogMono :
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J)) ≤
        Real.log (u : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_le_log hmodelPos hmodelLe
  have hlogHalf : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (8 * Real.sqrt J)) := by
    rw [hlogModel]
    linarith
  exact ⟨by simpa [q] using hq, huTwo, by simpa [q, u] using huLe,
    by simpa [q, u] using hmodelLe, hlogHalf.trans hlogMono⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_le_sqrt_upperY
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_le_sqrt_upperY
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ≤
        Real.sqrt (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
proof:
:= by
  have hfour := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_four_scaleV_div_sqrt_le_fixedRankB4K J hJ)
  have hKexp := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_exp_quarter J hJ)
  have hKlarge := ((tendsto_fixedRankB4K_atTop J hJ).comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
      (2 * Real.log 2)
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_basic J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankUpperY_half_le_natUpperY J hJ,
    hfour, hKexp, hKlarge, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with
      x hbasic hYlower hfour hKexp hKlarge hV
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hKlarge
  have huNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankFriableRank J x := by positivity
  have hKNonneg : 0 ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankB4K
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (scaleG_nonneg _)
  have huK : (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ≤
          scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) := hbasic.2.2.1
      _ ≤ 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J := by
        have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
          Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
        have hquot : 0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J :=
          div_nonneg hV.le hsqrt.le
        calc
          scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) =
              (scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J) / 4 := by
            field_simp [hsqrt.ne']
          _ ≤ 4 * (scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J) := by linarith
          _ = 4 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt J := by ring
      _ ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := hfour
  have huExp : (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) / 4) := huK.trans hKexp
  have hsquare : (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) / 2) := by
    calc
      (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
          Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) / 4) ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) / 2) := by
        rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
  have hhalfExp : Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤
      fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
    calc
      Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) / 2) ≤
          Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) - Real.log 2) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = Real.exp (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ)) / 2 := by
        rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      _ = fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) / 2 := by
        rw [fixedRankUpperY_eq_exp_sqrt_mul_scaleG (x : ℝ) hJ]
        rfl
  have hsquareY : (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ) :=
    hsquare.trans (hhalfExp.trans hYlower)
  exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hsquareY

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_friableRank_log
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_friableRank_log
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
        (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsaving := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankSaving_le_V_logV J hJ)
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_basic J hJ, hsaving,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hbasic hsaving hV
  let q := scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)
  let u : ℝ := fixedRankFriableRank J x
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hsqrtOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt J := by
    rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega)
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hqLeV : q ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact div_le_self hV.le (by nlinarith)
  have hlogq : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤ Real.log q := by
    have huPos : (0 : ℝ) < fixedRankFriableRank J x := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < fixedRankFriableRank J x by omega)
    have hlogMono : Real.log (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log q :=
      Real.log_le_log huPos (by simpa [q] using hbasic.2.2.1)
    exact hbasic.2.2.2.2.trans hlogMono
  have hqLog : scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
      (16 * Real.sqrt J) ≤ q * Real.log q / 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogq hqPos.le
    dsimp [q] at hmul ⊢
    calc
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) /
          (16 * Real.sqrt J) =
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) *
            (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2) / 2 := by field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) *
          Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J)) / 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmul (by norm_num)
  have hfloor := natFloor_mul_log_loss_le (by simpa [q] using hbasic.1)
  have hqU : q * Real.log q - u * Real.log u ≤ q := by
    simpa [q, u, fixedRankFriableRank] using hfloor
  have htwice : 2 * (fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) + scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≤
      q * Real.log q := by linarith
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    unfold fixedRankB4K
    exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (scaleG_nonneg _)
  change fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤ u * Real.log u
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankFriableEulerError_le_budget
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankFriableEulerError_le_budget
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankFriableEulerError J x ≤ fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x
proof:
:= by
  have hKsmall := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_eighth_scaleL J)
  have hLlarge := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop
      (2 * Real.log 3)
  have hcore := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_moving_core_positive
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_basic J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_le_sqrt_upperY J hJ,
    eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ, hKsmall, hLlarge, hcore] with
      x hbasic huSqrt hRthree hKsmall hLlarge hcore
  let R := fixedRankNatUpperY J x
  let H := fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x
  let u : ℝ := fixedRankFriableRank J x
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have huEq : rankinU H R = u := by
    simpa [H, R, u] using rankinU_fixedRankFriablePowerCode
      (show 1 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x by omega)
  have huTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    change (2 : ℝ) ≤ (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast hbasic.2.1
  have huPos : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hloguPos : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogVPos : 0 < Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    have hsqrt : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt J := by
      rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega)
    have hVlarge : 12 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
      have hq := hbasic.1
      have hsqrtPos : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
        Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
      have hmul := (le_div_iff₀
        (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) hsqrtPos)).mp hq
      nlinarith
    exact Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have huSqrt' : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [huEq]
    simpa [u, R] using huSqrt
  have hdeltaHalf : rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt (show 1 < R by omega)
      (by rw [huEq]; exact huPos) huSqrt'
  have hloss := tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss (j := J) hdeltaHalf
  have hfullNonneg : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R H := by
    exact (primeRankinSum_nonneg R (rankinDelta H R)).trans
      (primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU (show 2 ≤ R by omega)
        (by rw [huEq]; linarith) huSqrt')
  have hRcast : (R : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.floor_le (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).le
  have hinner : Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.log 3 + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤
          Real.log (3 * fixedRankUpperY J (x : ℝ)) := by
        apply Real.log_le_log
        · positivity
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRcast (by norm_num)
      _ = Real.log 3 + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
          (fixedRankUpperY_pos J (x : ℝ)).ne',
          log_fixedRankUpperY (x : ℝ) hJ]
        rfl
  have hinnerLe : Real.log 3 + fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hLlarge
    linarith
  have hinnerPos : 0 < Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ R by omega)
    nlinarith
  have hloglog : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) ≤
      log2 (x : ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) ≤
          Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hinnerPos (hinner.trans hinnerLe)
      _ = log2 (x : ℝ) := by rfl
  have huV : u ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    have hsqrt : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt J := by
      rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ J by omega)
    calc
      u ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * Real.sqrt J) := hbasic.2.2.1
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        div_le_self hV.le (by nlinarith)
  have hlogLower : Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2 ≤ Real.log u :=
    hbasic.2.2.2.2
  have huDiv : u / Real.log u ≤
      2 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      u / Real.log u ≤
          scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log u :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right huV hloguPos.le
      _ ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) /
          (Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hV.le (by positivity) hlogLower
      _ = 2 * scaleV (x : ℝ) /
          Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by field_simp
  have hlogTerm :
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
        log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)| := by
    have habs : -Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| :=
      neg_le_abs _
    linarith
  have hfull : fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
      primeCountingConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
          12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
    unfold fullULogUPrimeError
    rw [huEq]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ primeCountingConstant_pos.le
    have hexp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogTerm (Real.exp_pos 2).le
    have hthree := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huDiv (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
    have hratio0 : 0 ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) /
        Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := div_nonneg hV.le hlogVPos.le
    have hthree' :
        3 * (2 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) ≤
          12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [show 3 * (2 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) =
          6 * (scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) by ring,
        show 12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) =
          12 * (scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) by ring]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (6 : ℝ) ≤ 12) hratio0
    have hthreeFinal : 3 * u / Real.log u ≤
        12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        3 * u / Real.log u = 3 * (u / Real.log u) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := hthree.trans hthree'
    exact add_le_add hexp hthreeFinal
  have hcoef0 : 0 ≤ (J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le
  have hbound :
      tauEulerLoss J (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
        ((J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant) *
          (Real.exp 2 *
              (log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
            12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
    calc
      tauEulerLoss J (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
          ((J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss) *
            (primeCountingConstant *
              (Real.exp 2 *
                  (log2 (x : ℝ) + |Real.log (Real.log 2)|) +
                12 * scaleV (x : ℝ) /
                  Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))) :=
        mul_le_mul hloss hfull hfullNonneg hcoef0
      _ = _ := by ring
  simpa [fixedRankFriableEulerError, fixedRankFriableEulerBudget, H, R] using hbound

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget_div_scaleV_zero
    (J : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hscaled := hlog.const_mul (9 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2)
  have hconst : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (J : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hsum := hscaled.add hconst
  have hsum0 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      (9 * (J : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
        (J : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hsum
  refine hsum0.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  unfold fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget
  field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankFriableEulerBudget_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankFriableEulerBudget_div_scaleV_zero
    (J : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.comp
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have habs : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ |Real.log (Real.log 2)| / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hlogV : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop
  have hinv : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (1 : ℝ) / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hlogV
  have hfirst := (hlog.add habs).const_mul (Real.exp 2)
  have hsecond := hinv.const_mul 12
  have hinner := hfirst.add hsecond
  have hscaled := hinner.const_mul
    ((J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant)
  have hscaled0 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      ((J : ℝ) / 2 * divisorEulerHalfLoss * primeCountingConstant) *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
              |Real.log (Real.log 2)| / scaleV (x : ℝ)) +
          12 * (1 / Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hscaled
  refine hscaled0.congr' ?_
  have hlogVne : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
    hlogV.eventually_ne_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, hlogVne] with x hV hlogVne
  unfold fixedRankFriableEulerBudget
  field_simp [hV.ne', hlogVne]

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankFriableEndpointError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankFriableEndpointError_zero
    (J : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankFriableEndpointError J) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :=
    (tendsto_fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget_div_scaleV_zero J).add
      (tendsto_fixedRankFriableEulerBudget_div_scaleV_zero J)
  have hsum0 : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
      fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x / scaleV (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by simpa using hsum
  refine hsum0.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hV
  unfold fixedRankFriableEndpointError
  field_simp [hV.ne']

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankWeightedFriableTailEndpoint_unconditional
statement:
theorem fixedRankWeightedFriableTailEndpoint_unconditional
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    FixedRankWeightedFriableTailEndpoint J
      (fixedRankFriableEndpointError J)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_fixedRankFriableEndpointError_zero J, ?_⟩
  have hLTwo := (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 2
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J,
    eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatY J hJ,
    eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_basic J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankFriableRank_le_sqrt_upperY J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankFriablePowerCode_le_tailCode J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankB4K_le_friableRank_log J hJ,
    eventually_fixedRankFriableEulerError_le_budget J hJ,
    eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, hLTwo] with
      x hscale hy hR hbasic huSqrt hcode hsaving hEuler hV hLTwo
  let R := fixedRankNatUpperY J x
  let H := fixedRankFriablePowerCode J x
  let Hcanon := fixedRankSupplierTailCode J x
  let X := (2 * x) ^ J
  let u : ℝ := fixedRankFriableRank J x
  have hfactor := fixedRank_finitePowerEncodingFactor_le_exp
    hJ hscale hLTwo (show 1 ≤ fixedRankNatY J x by omega)
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    unfold H fixedRankFriablePowerCode
    exact pow_pos (show 0 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x by omega) _
  have huEq : rankinU H R = u := by
    simpa [H, R, u] using rankinU_fixedRankFriablePowerCode
      (show 1 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x by omega)
  have hu : 1 < rankinU H R := by
    rw [huEq]
    change (1 : ℝ) < (fixedRankFriableRank J x : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 < fixedRankFriableRank J x by omega)
  have huSqrt' : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [huEq]
    simpa [u, R] using huSqrt
  have htailPower := finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    (j := J) (R := R) (H := H) (X := X) hJ hH
      (show 2 ≤ R by omega) hu huSqrt'
  have htailBudget : finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-u * Real.log u + fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x) := by
    calc
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X ≤
          Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
            fixedRankFriableEulerError J x) := by
        simpa [fixedRankFriableEulerError, H, R] using htailPower
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-u * Real.log u + fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [huEq]
        linarith
  have hmono : finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R Hcanon X ≤
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X := by
    exact finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_antitone_cutoff
      (by simpa [H, Hcanon] using hcode)
  have htail0 : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  have hencoding0 : 0 ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor J
      (fixedRankNatY J x) (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) :=
    finitePowerEncodingFactor_nonneg _ _ _
  have herrIdentity : fixedRankFriableEndpointError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ) =
      fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x + fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x := by
    unfold fixedRankFriableEndpointError
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hV.ne'
  have hexponent : fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x -
        u * Real.log u + fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x ≤
      -fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankFriableEndpointError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [herrIdentity]
    linarith
  calc
    finitePowerEncodingFactor J (fixedRankNatY J x)
          (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (fixedRankSupplierTailCode J x) ((2 * x) ^ J) ≤
        finitePowerEncodingFactor J (fixedRankNatY J x)
          (fixedRankSupplierSlotBound x) *
            finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J R H X :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hencoding0
    _ ≤ Real.exp (fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x) *
        Real.exp (-u * Real.log u + fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x) :=
      mul_le_mul hfactor htailBudget htail0 (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (fixedRankFriableEncodingBudget J x -
        u * Real.log u + fixedRankFriableEulerBudget J x) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-fixedRankB4K J (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankFriableEndpointError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent
    _ = Real.exp (-Real.sqrt J * scaleG (x : ℝ) +
        fixedRankFriableEndpointError J x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
      unfold fixedRankB4K
      congr 1
      ring

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSupplierMassTailHypothesis_unconditional

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility
statement:
theorem eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, MovingNaturalAdmissibility x
proof:
:= by
  have hadmissible := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_movingAdmissibility
  filter_upwards [hadmissible] with x hx
  have hZ0 : 0 ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hyFloor : 3 ≤ movingNatY x := by
    apply Nat.le_floor
    exact hx.three_le_y
  have hyZ : movingNatY x ≤ movingNatZ x := by
    exact Nat.floor_mono hx.y_lt_Z.le
  have hZx : movingNatZ x ≤ x := by
    have hfloor : (movingNatZ x : ℝ) ≤ movingZ (x : ℝ) := Nat.floor_le hZ0
    exact_mod_cast hfloor.trans hx.Z_lt_x.le
  exact ⟨hx.rank_ge_two, hyFloor, hyZ, hZx⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
statement:
theorem eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop :

proof:
:= by
  have hreal : Tendsto movingEtaR atTop atTop := by
    have hbound := movingT_isLittleO_etaR.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    have hle : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, movingT x ≤ movingEtaR x := by
      filter_upwards [hbound, eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hb hx
      have hT : 0 < movingT x := hx.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
      have hetaR : 0 < movingEtaR x := mul_pos hx.2.2.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2.1
      simpa [Real.norm_of_nonneg hT.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hetaR.le] using hb
    exact tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop hle tendsto_movingT_atTop
  exact hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRankShiftedSet_subset_census

proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hnlow := mem_movingLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn
  have hnshift := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hnlow.1
  exact mem_movingLowRankCensusSet.mpr

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRank_union_highRank
statement:
theorem movingLowRank_union_highRank (x h : ℕ) :
    movingLowRankShiftedSet x h ∪ movingHighRankShiftedSet x h =
      movingBoundedValueShiftedSet x h
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_movingLowRankShiftedSet,
    mem_movingHighRankShiftedSet, mem_movingBoundedValueShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hn, hz, _hr⟩ | ⟨hn, hz, _hr⟩)
    · exact ⟨hn, hz⟩
    · exact ⟨hn, hz⟩
  · rintro ⟨hn, hz⟩
    rcases lt_or_ge (largePrimeRank (movingNatY x) n.totient) (movingNatJ x) with
      hr | hr
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hn, hz, hr⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hn, hz, hr⟩

name: RankAmplification.movingLowRank_disjoint_highRank
statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hnlow hnhigh
  have hl := mem_movingLowRankShiftedSet.mp hnlow
  have hh := mem_movingHighRankShiftedSet.mp hnhigh
  omega

      (nonsmoothShiftedSet x h (movingNatZ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hbounded hnonsmooth
  have hb := mem_movingBoundedValueShiftedSet.mp hbounded
  have hn := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp hnonsmooth

name: RankAmplification.movingBoundedValue_union_nonsmooth
statement:
theorem movingBoundedValue_union_nonsmooth (x h : ℕ) :
    movingBoundedValueShiftedSet x h ∪ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h (movingNatZ x) =
      shiftedEqualTotientSet x h
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, mem_movingBoundedValueShiftedSet,
    mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact h.1
    · exact mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mpr ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩
  · intro hn
    by_cases hle : largestPrimeFactor n.totient ≤ movingNatZ x
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hn, hle⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨(mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hn).1,
        (mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hn).2.1,
        (mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hn).2.2,
        Nat.lt_of_not_ge hle⟩

name: RankAmplification.movingBoundedValueCount_eq_low_add_high

      movingLowRankShiftedCount x h + movingHighRankShiftedCount x h

name: RankAmplification.moving_exact_rank_diagonal_decomposition
statement:
theorem moving_exact_rank_diagonal_decomposition (x h : ℕ) :
    shiftedEqualTotientCount x h =
      aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) +
        offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (movingNatZ x) +
        movingLowRankShiftedCount x h + movingHighRankShiftedCount x h
proof:
:= by
  have htotal : shiftedEqualTotientCount x h =
      (movingBoundedValueShiftedSet x h).card +
        nonsmoothShiftedCount x h (movingNatZ x) := by
    rw [shiftedEqualTotientCount, ← movingBoundedValue_union_nonsmooth x h,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (movingBoundedValue_disjoint_nonsmooth x h),
      nonsmoothShiftedCount]
  rw [movingBoundedValueCount_eq_low_add_high,
    nonsmoothShiftedCount_eq_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_add_offDiagonalNonsmoothCount] at htotal
  omega

name: RankAmplification.moving_proposition10_23

theorem moving_proposition10_23 {ε : ℕ → ℝ}

name: RankAmplification.moving_proposition10_24
statement:
theorem moving_proposition10_24
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hcoverage : MovingHighRankSupplierCoverage)
    (hsupplier : MovingSupplierMassTailHypothesis ε)
    (hsaddle : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, HasMovingSaddleMargins (x : ℝ)) :

  exact (hcoverage h hh hhy).trans
    ((movingSupplierCorrelation_le_convolutionMajorant (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hh) hhx hhy).trans
      (hsupplier hsaddle))

name: RankAmplification.moving_offDiagonal_transfer

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingCombinedError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingCombinedError_zero
    {εlow εsupplier εtransfer : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hlow : Tendsto εlow atTop (nhds 0))
    (hsupplier : Tendsto εsupplier atTop (nhds 0))
    (htransfer : Tendsto εtransfer atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (movingCombinedError εlow εsupplier εtransfer) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (movingMaximumError εlow εsupplier εtransfer) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    change Tendsto (fun x ↦ max (max (εlow x) (εsupplier x)) (εtransfer x))
      atTop (nhds 0)
    simpa only [max_self] using (hlow.max hsupplier).max htransfer
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 3 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  change Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingMaximumError εlow εsupplier εtransfer x +
    Real.log 3 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hmax.add hconst

name: RankAmplification.sum_three_movingExponentialMajorant_le_combined
statement:
theorem sum_three_movingExponentialMajorant_le_combined
    {εlow εsupplier εtransfer : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ}
    (hetaR : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :
    movingExponentialMajorant εtransfer x +
        movingExponentialMajorant εlow x +
        movingExponentialMajorant εsupplier x ≤
      movingExponentialMajorant (movingCombinedError εlow εsupplier εtransfer) x
proof:
:= by
  let M := movingMaximumError εlow εsupplier εtransfer x
  have hlowM : εlow x ≤ M := le_max_of_le_left (le_max_left _ _)
  have hsupplierM : εsupplier x ≤ M :=
    le_max_of_le_left (le_max_right _ _)
  have htransferM : εtransfer x ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hmono (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ≤ M) :
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + ε * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg x)
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (add_le_add_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε hetaR.le) (-movingK (x : ℝ)))
  have hsum :
      movingExponentialMajorant εtransfer x +
          movingExponentialMajorant εlow x +
          movingExponentialMajorant εsupplier x ≤
        3 * ((x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) := by
    unfold movingExponentialMajorant
    linarith [hmono _ htransferM, hmono _ hlowM, hmono _ hsupplierM]
  calc
    movingExponentialMajorant εtransfer x +
        movingExponentialMajorant εlow x +
        movingExponentialMajorant εsupplier x ≤
        3 * ((x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) := hsum
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant
        (movingCombinedError εlow εsupplier εtransfer) x := by
      unfold movingExponentialMajorant movingCombinedError
      change 3 * ((x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) + M * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) =
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
            (M + Real.log 3 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      have hcancel : Real.log 3 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ) * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
          Real.log 3 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hetaR.ne'
      rw [add_mul, hcancel]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [← add_assoc, Real.exp_add,
          Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.moving_theorem10_25_raw
statement:
theorem moving_theorem10_25_raw
    {εlow εsupplier εtransfer : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : MovingRankAssemblyData εlow εsupplier εtransfer) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ movingNatY x →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) +
          movingExponentialMajorant
            (movingCombinedError εlow εsupplier εtransfer) x
proof:
:= by
  have hlow := moving_proposition10_23 data.lowRank
  have hhigh := moving_proposition10_24 data.highRankCoverage
    data.supplierMassTail data.saddleMargins
  have htransfer := moving_offDiagonal_transfer data.offDiagonalTransfer data.saddleMargins
  have hcoreNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_moving_core_positive
  filter_upwards [hcoreNat, hlow, hhigh, htransfer] with
      x hcore hlow hhigh htransfer
  intro h hh hhy
  have hexact := moving_exact_rank_diagonal_decomposition x h
  have hexactReal : (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) =
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) +
        (offDiagonalNonsmoothCount x h (movingNatZ x) : ℝ) +
        (movingLowRankShiftedCount x h : ℝ) +
        (movingHighRankShiftedCount x h : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hexact
  rw [hexactReal]
  have hparts0 := add_le_add
    (add_le_add (htransfer h hh hhy) (hlow h)) (hhigh h hh hhy)
  have hparts := hparts0.trans
      (sum_three_movingExponentialMajorant_le_combined
        (mul_pos hcore.2.2.2.2.1 hcore.2.2.2.1))
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingHalfExponentError_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hK := tendsto_movingK_div_R_half.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have heta := tendsto_movingEta_zero.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have hprod := hε.mul heta
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have hresult := (hconst.sub hK).add hprod
  have ht : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) -
      movingK (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ) + ε x * movingEta (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds ((1 / 2 : ℝ) - 1 / 2 + 0 * 0)) := by
    apply hresult.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) -
    movingK (x : ℝ) / movingR (x : ℝ) + ε x * movingEta (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa using ht

name: RankAmplification.movingExponentialMajorant_eq_halfExponentMajorant
statement:
theorem movingExponentialMajorant_eq_halfExponentMajorant
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (hR : 0 < movingR (x : ℝ)) :
    movingExponentialMajorant ε x =
      halfExponentMajorant (movingHalfExponentError ε) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingExponentialMajorant halfExponentMajorant movingHalfExponentError movingEtaR
  rw [movingRankScale_eq_movingR]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  field_simp [hR.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingRankDiagonalHypothesis_of_assembly
statement:
theorem movingRankDiagonalHypothesis_of_assembly
    {εlow εsupplier εtransfer : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : MovingRankAssemblyData εlow εsupplier εtransfer) :
    MovingRankDiagonalHypothesis movingNatZ movingNatY
      (movingHalfExponentError
        (movingCombinedError εlow εsupplier εtransfer))
proof:
:= by
  let εcombined := movingCombinedError εlow εsupplier εtransfer
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingHalfExponentError_zero
    (tendsto_movingCombinedError_zero data.lowRank.1
      data.supplierMassTail.1 data.offDiagonalTransfer.1), ?_⟩
  have hraw := moving_theorem10_25_raw data
  have hcoreNat := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    eventually_moving_core_positive
  filter_upwards [hraw, hcoreNat] with x hraw hcore
  intro h hh hhy
  rw [← movingExponentialMajorant_eq_halfExponentMajorant
    (ε := εcombined) hcore.2.2.2.1]
  exact hraw h hh hhy

name: RankAmplification.movingRank_odd_shift_bound_of_assembly
statement:
theorem movingRank_odd_shift_bound_of_assembly
    {εlow εsupplier εtransfer : ℕ → ℝ}

    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h, 1 ≤ h → h ≤ movingNatY x → Odd h →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        halfExponentMajorant
          (movingHalfExponentError
            (movingCombinedError εlow εsupplier εtransfer)) x
proof:

  filter_upwards [hmove] with x hx
  intro h hh hhy hodd
  simpa [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_eq_zero_of_odd hodd] using hx h hh hhy

name: RankAmplification.movingRank_consecutive_bound_of_assembly
statement:
theorem movingRank_consecutive_bound_of_assembly
    {εlow εsupplier εtransfer : ℕ → ℝ}
    (data : MovingRankAssemblyData εlow εsupplier εtransfer) :
    HasConsecutiveHalfExponentBound
proof:

  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility] with x hx

name: RankAmplification.isSmooth_iff_mem_smoothNumbers_succ
statement:
theorem isSmooth_iff_mem_smoothNumbers_succ {R n : ℕ} :
    IsSmooth R n ↔ n ∈ (R + 1).smoothNumbers
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mem_smoothNumbers_iff_primeFactors_subset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn, hs⟩
    refine ⟨hn, fun p hp ↦ Nat.mem_primesBelow.mpr ⟨?_, Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp⟩⟩
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hs p hp)
  · rintro ⟨hn, hs⟩
    refine ⟨hn, fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_mem_primesBelow (hs hp))

name: RankAmplification.divisorRankinWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem divisorRankinWeight_nonneg (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ divisorRankinWeight s n
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) _)

name: RankAmplification.divisorRankinWeight_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisorRankinWeight_one (s : ℝ) : divisorRankinWeight s 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [divisorRankinWeight, orderedDivisorCount, Nat.cast_one, Real.one_rpow, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast (ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.pow (k := 2)).map_one

name: RankAmplification.divisorRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem divisorRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime {m n : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime m n) (s : ℝ) :
    divisorRankinWeight s (m * n) =
      divisorRankinWeight s m * divisorRankinWeight s n
proof:
:= by
  have htau := (ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.pow (k := 2)).map_mul_of_coprime h
  simp only [divisorRankinWeight, orderedDivisorCount]
  rw [
    htau, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.orderedDivisorCount_two_prime_pow
statement:
theorem orderedDivisorCount_two_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (a : ℕ) :
    orderedDivisorCount 2 (p ^ a) = a + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedDivisorCount_two, Nat.card_divisors (pow_ne_zero a hp.ne_zero)]
  rcases a with _ | a
  · simp
  · rw [Nat.primeFactors_prime_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero a) hp, Finset.prod_singleton,
      Nat.factorization_pow_self hp]

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_divisorRankinWeight_prime_pow
statement:
theorem hasSum_divisorRankinWeight_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasSum (fun a : ℕ ↦ divisorRankinWeight s (p ^ a))
      ((1 - rankinEulerRatio p s)⁻¹ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
  have hqpos : 0 < rankinEulerRatio p s :=
    rankinEulerRatio_pos hp.pos s
  have hqlt : rankinEulerRatio p s < 1 :=
    rankinEulerRatio_lt_one hp1 hs
  have hqnorm : ‖rankinEulerRatio p s‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hqpos]
    exact hqlt
  have hterm (a : ℕ) : divisorRankinWeight s (p ^ a) =
      ((a : ℝ) + 1) * rankinEulerRatio p s ^ a := by
    simp only [divisorRankinWeight, orderedDivisorCount_two_prime_pow hp, Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_one, rankinEulerRatio]
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, ← Real.rpow_pow_comm (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (-s) a]
  have hseries : HasSum (fun a : ℕ ↦
      ((a : ℝ) + 1) * rankinEulerRatio p s ^ a)
      (1 / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p s) ^ 2) := by
    simpa using hasSum_choose_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (𝕜 := ℝ) 1 hqnorm
  have hseries' : HasSum (fun a : ℕ ↦ divisorRankinWeight s (p ^ a))
      (1 / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p s) ^ 2) :=
    hseries.congr_fun hterm
  simpa [one_div] using hseries'

name: RankAmplification.hasSum_divisorRankinWeight_smooth
statement:
theorem hasSum_divisorRankinWeight_smooth (R : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasSum (fun m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ divisorRankinWeight s m)
      (rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 s)
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime →
      Summable (fun a : ℕ ↦ ‖divisorRankinWeight s (p ^ a)‖) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (hasSum_divisorRankinWeight_prime_pow hp hs).summable.norm
  have heuler := EulerProduct.summable_and_hasSum_smoothNumbers_prod_primesBelow_tsum
    (f := divisorRankinWeight s) (divisorRankinWeight_one s)
      (fun {_m _n} h ↦ divisorRankinWeight_mul_of_coprime h s) hlocal (R + 1)
  have hprod :
      (∏ p ∈ (R + 1).primesBelow,
        ∑' a : ℕ, divisorRankinWeight s (p ^ a)) =
        rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 s := by
    rw [rankinEulerMajorant]
    change (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
      ∑' a : ℕ, divisorRankinWeight s (p ^ a)) =
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, ((1 - rankinEulerRatio p s)⁻¹) ^ 2
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    exact (hasSum_divisorRankinWeight_prime_pow
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) hs).tsum_eq
  exact hprod ▸ heuler.2

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorRankinSum_le_eulerMajorant
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorRankinSum_le_eulerMajorant {R X : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount 2 m) R X (-s) ≤
      rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 s
proof:
:= by
  let e : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X} ↪ (R + 1).smoothNumbers :=
    { toFun := fun m ↦
        ⟨m.1, isSmooth_iff_mem_smoothNumbers_succ.mp
          (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp m.2).2.2⟩
      inj' := fun a b hab ↦ Subtype.ext <|
        congrArg (fun z : (R + 1).smoothNumbers ↦ (z : ℕ)) hab }
  let A : Finset ((R + 1).smoothNumbers) := Finset.univ.map e
  have hsmooth := hasSum_divisorRankinWeight_smooth R hs
  have hle : (∑ m ∈ A, divisorRankinWeight s m) ≤
      rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 s := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ A, divisorRankinWeight s m) ≤
          ∑' m : (R + 1).smoothNumbers, divisorRankinWeight s m :=
        hsmooth.summable.sum_le_tsum A (fun m _ ↦ divisorRankinWeight_nonneg s m)
      _ = rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 s := hsmooth.tsum_eq
  have hfinite :
      finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount 2 m) R X (-s) =
        ∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, divisorRankinWeight s m := by
    rw [finiteSmoothRpowSum, ← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ]
    rfl
  have hmap :
      (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, divisorRankinWeight s m) =
        ∑ m ∈ A, divisorRankinWeight s m := by
    change (∑ m : {m : ℕ // m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X}, divisorRankinWeight s m) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.map e, divisorRankinWeight s m
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m _
    rfl
  rw [hfinite, hmap]
  exact hle

name: RankAmplification.divisorEulerLoss_pos
statement: theorem divisorEulerLoss_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < divisorEulerLoss s
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorEulerLoss]
  exact div_pos (by norm_num) (sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs))

name: RankAmplification.log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_divisorEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum
statement:
theorem log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_divisorEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum
    {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    Real.log (rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 (1 - δ)) ≤
      divisorEulerLoss (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := sub_pos.mpr hδ1
  have hP : ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R, 1 < p := fun p hp ↦
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt
  have hlog := log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_sum (j := 2) hP hs
  let ρ : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ))
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hρlt : ρ < 1 :=
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)
  have hlocal (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ Nat.primesLE R) :
      rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ)) ≤
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - ρ) := by
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast Nat.two_le_of_mem_primesLE hp
    have hqpos : 0 < rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) :=
      rankinEulerRatio_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (hP p hp)) _
    have hqlt : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) < 1 :=
      rankinEulerRatio_lt_one (hP p hp) hs
    have hqρ : rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) ≤ ρ := by
      rw [rankinEulerRatio]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hp2 (neg_nonpos.mpr hs.le)
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hqlt) (sub_pos.mpr hρlt)).2
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hqρ 1) hqpos.le
  calc
    Real.log (rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 (1 - δ)) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
          rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ)) := hlog
    _ ≤ 2 * ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE R,
        rankinEulerRatio p (1 - δ) / (1 - ρ) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp ↦ hlocal p hp
    _ = divisorEulerLoss (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ := by
      have hexp : -(1 - δ) = -1 + δ := by ring
      dsimp [ρ]
      rw [divisorEulerLoss, primeRankinSum]
      simp_rw [rankinEulerRatio, hexp]
      rw [← Finset.sum_div]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.rankinEulerMajorant_primes_pos
statement:
theorem rankinEulerMajorant_primes_pos {R : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 < rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 s
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinEulerMajorant]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  have hqlt := rankinEulerRatio_lt_one
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).one_lt hs
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.rankinEulerMajorant_le_exp_primeRankinSum
statement:
theorem rankinEulerMajorant_le_exp_primeRankinSum {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 (1 - δ) ≤
      Real.exp (divisorEulerLoss (1 - δ) * primeRankinSum R δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_log (rankinEulerMajorant_primes_pos (sub_pos.mpr hδ1))]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    (log_rankinEulerMajorant_le_divisorEulerLoss_mul_primeRankinSum hδ1)

name: RankAmplification.rankinDelta_lt_one
statement:
theorem rankinDelta_lt_one {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (huR : rankinU H R < R) (hu : 0 < rankinU H R) :
    rankinDelta H R < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinDelta, div_lt_one (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR))]
  exact Real.log_lt_log hu huR

name: RankAmplification.rankinDelta_mul_log_base
statement:
theorem rankinDelta_mul_log_base {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) :
    rankinDelta H R * Real.log R = Real.log (rankinU H R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinDelta, div_mul_cancel₀]
  exact (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).ne'

name: RankAmplification.rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt {H R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R)
    (hu : 0 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  rw [rankinDelta, div_le_iff₀ hlogR]
  calc
    Real.log (rankinU H R) ≤ Real.log (Real.sqrt R) :=
      Real.log_le_log hu huSqrt
    _ = Real.log R / 2 := Real.log_sqrt hRpos.le
    _ = (1 / 2) * Real.log R := by ring

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_exp_primeRankinSum
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_exp_primeRankinSum {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 1 < R) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU X R)
    (huR : rankinU X R < R) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
          divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
            primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R))
proof:
:= by
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ rankinDelta X R := rankinDelta_nonneg hR hu
  have hδ1 : rankinDelta X R < 1 :=
    rankinDelta_lt_one hR huR (zero_lt_one.trans_le hu)
  have hfinite :
      finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount 2 m) R X
          (rankinDelta X R - 1) ≤
        rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 (1 - rankinDelta X R) := by
    simpa only [neg_sub] using
      finiteDivisorRankinSum_le_eulerMajorant (R := R) (X := X)
        (sub_pos.mpr hδ1)
  have heuler := rankinEulerMajorant_le_exp_primeRankinSum
    (R := R) (δ := rankinDelta X R) hδ1
  have hxpow : (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - rankinDelta X R) =
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) := by
    rw [show 1 - rankinDelta X R = 1 + (-rankinDelta X R) by ring,
      Real.rpow_add (by exact_mod_cast hX), Real.rpow_one,
      rankin_cutoff_rpow hX hR]
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
        (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount 2 m) R X
            (rankinDelta X R - 1) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_chosen_rankin hR hu huR.le
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
        rankinEulerMajorant (Nat.primesLE R) 2 (1 - rankinDelta X R) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfinite (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
        Real.exp (divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
          primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heuler (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
    _ = (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
          divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
            primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R)) := by
      rw [hxpow, Real.exp_add]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.smallPrimeRankinError_le_uLogUPrimeError
statement:
theorem smallPrimeRankinError_le_uLogUPrimeError {R X : ℕ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (hsmall : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    smallPrimeRankinError R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ uLogUPrimeError R X
proof:
:= by
  have hR' : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hlogRpos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR')
  have hlog2pos : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog2le : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log R :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ rankinDelta X R := rankinDelta_nonneg hR' hu.le
  have hlogu : 0 < Real.log (rankinU X R) := Real.log_pos hu
  have hδlog : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R = Real.log (rankinU X R) :=
    rankinDelta_mul_log_base hR'
  have hlogu_le_one : Real.log (rankinU X R) ≤ 1 := hδlog ▸ hsmall
  have hδlog2 : rankinDelta X R * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (rankinU X R) := by
    calc
      rankinDelta X R * Real.log 2 ≤ rankinDelta X R * Real.log R :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2le hδ0
      _ = Real.log (rankinU X R) := hδlog
  have hδle : rankinDelta X R ≤
      Real.log (rankinU X R) / Real.log 2 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hlog2pos).2 hδlog2
  have hlogu_le_frac : Real.log (rankinU X R) ≤
      rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hlogu).2
    nlinarith [hlogu.le]
  have hkernel : rankinDelta X R * (1 + Real.log R) ≤
      (1 + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) *
        (rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R)) := by
    calc
      rankinDelta X R * (1 + Real.log R) =
          rankinDelta X R + Real.log (rankinU X R) := by
        rw [← hδlog]
        ring
      _ ≤ Real.log (rankinU X R) / Real.log 2 +
          Real.log (rankinU X R) := add_le_add_left hδle _
      _ = (1 + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) * Real.log (rankinU X R) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) *
          (rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogu_le_frac (by positivity)
  rw [smallPrimeRankinError, uLogUPrimeError]
  apply add_le_add_right _ _
  calc
    2 * rankinDelta X R * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R)) =
        (2 * Real.log 4) * (rankinDelta X R * (1 + Real.log R)) := by ring
    _ ≤ (2 * Real.log 4) * ((1 + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) *
        (rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkernel (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * Real.log 4 * (1 + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) *
        (rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R)) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_uLogUPrimeError
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_uLogUPrimeError {R X : ℕ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (hsmall : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ uLogUPrimeError R X
proof:
:= by
  exact (primeRankinSum_le_loglog_three_mul hR
    (rankinDelta_nonneg (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR) hu.le) hsmall).trans
      (smallPrimeRankinError_le_uLogUPrimeError hR hu hsmall)

name: RankAmplification.divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos
statement: theorem divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos : 0 < divisorEulerHalfLoss
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorEulerHalfLoss]
  exact div_pos (by norm_num) (sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.divisorEulerLoss_le_half
statement:
theorem divisorEulerLoss_le_half {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    divisorEulerLoss (1 - δ) ≤ divisorEulerHalfLoss
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < 1 - δ := by linarith
  have hp := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    (show -(1 - δ) ≤ -(1 / 2 : ℝ) by linarith)
  have hden : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - δ)) := sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (neg_lt_zero.mpr hs)
  have hdenHalf : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := sub_pos.mpr <|
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  rw [divisorEulerLoss, divisorEulerHalfLoss]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden hdenHalf).2
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_explicit
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_explicit {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU X R)
    (huR : rankinU X R < R)
    (hsmall : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + divisorSmoothError R X)
proof:
:= by
  have hR' : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ rankinDelta X R := rankinDelta_nonneg hR' hu
  have hprime : primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤
      smallPrimeRankinError R (rankinDelta X R) := by
    simpa only [smallPrimeRankinError] using
      primeRankinSum_le_loglog_three_mul hR hδ0 hsmall
  have hloss : 0 ≤ divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) :=
    (divisorEulerLoss_pos (sub_pos.mpr <| rankinDelta_lt_one hR' huR
      (zero_lt_one.trans_le hu))).le
  have herror :
      divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
          primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ divisorSmoothError R X := by
    rw [divisorSmoothError]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprime hloss
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
            divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
              primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R)) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_exp_primeRankinSum hX hR' hu huR
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + divisorSmoothError R X) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (add_le_add_right herror _)

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_half_u_log_u
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_half_u_log_u {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU X R)
    (huR : rankinU X R < R)
    (hsmall : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R ≤ 1)
    (hdom : divisorSmoothError R X ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 2) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + divisorSmoothError R X) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_explicit hX hR hu huR hsmall
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) / 2) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_pos
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_pos {R X : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    0 < finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : 1 ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X := by
    rw [mem_finiteSmoothSet]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, hX, by simp [IsSmooth]⟩
  have hone : (orderedDivisorCount 2 1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    simpa [divisorRankinWeight] using divisorRankinWeight_one (1 : ℝ)
  rw [finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount, finiteTauSmoothCount]
  have hle : (orderedDivisorCount 2 1 : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (orderedDivisorCount 2 m : ℝ) := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun m _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg (orderedDivisorCount 2 m)) hmem
  rw [hone] at hle
  exact zero_lt_one.trans_le hle

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_paper_error
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_paper_error {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (hsmall : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + paperDivisorError R X)
proof:
:= by
  have hR' : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have huR : rankinU X R < R :=
    huSqrt.trans_lt (Real.sqrt_lt_self_iff.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hR'))
  have hδhalf : rankinDelta X R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hR' (zero_lt_one.trans hu) huSqrt
  have hprime : primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ uLogUPrimeError R X :=
    primeRankinSum_le_uLogUPrimeError hR hu hsmall
  have hloss : divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) ≤ divisorEulerHalfLoss :=
    divisorEulerLoss_le_half hδhalf
  have herror : divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
      primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ paperDivisorError R X := by
    rw [paperDivisorError]
    exact mul_le_mul hloss hprime (primeRankinSum_nonneg R (rankinDelta X R))
      divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
            divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
              primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R)) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_exp_primeRankinSum hX hR' hu.le huR
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + paperDivisorError R X) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (add_le_add_right herror _)

name: RankAmplification.log_divisorWeightedSmoothCount_div_le_paper_error
statement:
theorem log_divisorWeightedSmoothCount_div_le_paper_error {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (hsmall : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    Real.log (finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / X) ≤
      -rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + paperDivisorError R X
proof:
:= by
  have hXreal : 0 < (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hX
  have hbound := finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_paper_error
    hX hR hu huSqrt hsmall
  have hdiv : finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / X ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
        paperDivisorError R X) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hXreal).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hbound
  have hdivpos : 0 < finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / X :=
    div_pos (finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_pos hX) hXreal
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log hdivpos hdiv

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_paper_half_u_log_u
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_paper_half_u_log_u {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (hsmall : rankinDelta X R * Real.log R ≤ 1)
    (hdom : paperDivisorError R X ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 2) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + paperDivisorError R X) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_paper_error hX hR hu huSqrt hsmall
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) / 2) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.mem_exactPrimePowerFactors_iff
statement:
theorem mem_exactPrimePowerFactors_iff {N m : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    m ∈ exactPrimePowerFactors N ↔
      ∃ q a : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ 0 < a ∧ q ^ a ∣ N ∧ ¬q ^ (a + 1) ∣ N ∧ m = q ^ a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
    have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
    refine ⟨q, N.factorization q, hqPrime, ?_, Nat.ordProj_dvd N q,
      Nat.pow_succ_factorization_not_dvd hN hqPrime, rfl⟩
    exact hqPrime.factorization_pos_of_dvd hN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq)
  · rintro ⟨q, a, hqPrime, ha, hdvd, hndvd, rfl⟩
    have hle : a ≤ N.factorization q :=
      (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hqPrime hN).mp hdvd
    have hge : N.factorization q ≤ a := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact hndvd ((Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hqPrime hN).mpr (by omega))
    have haeq : a = N.factorization q := le_antisymm hle hge
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q, ?_, by rw [haeq]⟩
    exact Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
      ⟨hqPrime, dvd_trans (dvd_pow_self q ha.ne') hdvd, hN⟩

name: RankAmplification.mem_largeTotientLocalFactors_iff
statement:
theorem mem_largeTotientLocalFactors_iff {y N m : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    m ∈ largeTotientLocalFactors y N ↔
      (∃ q a : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ 0 < a ∧ q ^ a ∣ N ∧ ¬q ^ (a + 1) ∣ N ∧ m = q ^ a) ∧
        y < largestPrimeFactor m.totient
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeTotientLocalFactors, Finset.mem_filter, mem_exactPrimePowerFactors_iff hN]

name: RankAmplification.totient_ordProj_eq_localTotientFactor
statement:
theorem totient_ordProj_eq_localTotientFactor {N q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ primeSupport N) :
    (q ^ N.factorization q).totient = localTotientFactor N q
proof:
:= by
  have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  have hN : N ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp [primeSupport] at hq
  have hpos : 0 < N.factorization q :=
    hqPrime.factorization_pos_of_dvd hN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq)
  rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow hqPrime hpos]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.largeTotientLocalFactors_eq_image
statement:
theorem largeTotientLocalFactors_eq_image (y N : ℕ) :
    largeTotientLocalFactors y N =
      (badLocalPrimeSet N y).image fun q ↦ q ^ N.factorization q
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [largeTotientLocalFactors, Finset.mem_filter, exactPrimePowerFactors,
    Finset.mem_image, mem_badLocalPrimeSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, hlarge⟩
    exact ⟨q, ⟨hq, by rwa [totient_ordProj_eq_localTotientFactor hq] at hlarge⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, ⟨hq, hlarge⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, by rwa [totient_ordProj_eq_localTotientFactor hq]⟩

name: RankAmplification.ordProj_injOn_primeFactors
statement:
theorem ordProj_injOn_primeFactors {N : ℕ} :
    Set.InjOn (fun q ↦ q ^ N.factorization q) (primeSupport N)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq r hr hqr
  have hN : N ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp [primeSupport] at hq
  have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
  have hrPrime : r.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr
  have hqPos : 0 < N.factorization q :=
    hqPrime.factorization_pos_of_dvd hN (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq)
  have hqr' : q ^ N.factorization q = r ^ N.factorization r := hqr
  have hdvd : q ∣ r ^ N.factorization r := by
    rw [← hqr']
    exact dvd_pow_self q hqPos.ne'
  exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hqPrime hrPrime).mp (hqPrime.dvd_of_dvd_pow hdvd)

name: RankAmplification.largeTotientLocalFactorCount_eq_card_badLocalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem largeTotientLocalFactorCount_eq_card_badLocalPrimeSet (y N : ℕ) :
    largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N = (badLocalPrimeSet N y).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [largeTotientLocalFactorCount, largeTotientLocalFactors_eq_image y N]
  apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
  exact ordProj_injOn_primeFactors.mono
    (by exact_mod_cast badLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)

name: RankAmplification.largestPrimeFactor_dvd_self
statement: theorem largestPrimeFactor_dvd_self (m : ℕ) : largestPrimeFactor m ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge 1 (largestPrimeFactor m) with hlarge | hsmall
  · exact largestPrimeFactor_dvd hlarge
  · have hone : largestPrimeFactor m = 1 :=
      le_antisymm hsmall (le_max_left 1 _)
    rw [hone]
    exact one_dvd m

name: RankAmplification.cutoffSucc_pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_totient
statement:
theorem cutoffSucc_pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_totient {y N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    (y + 1) ^ largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N ≤ N.totient
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hselect : ∀ q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y,
      largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N q) ∣ localTotientFactor N q :=
    fun q _ ↦ largestPrimeFactor_dvd_self _
  have hprodDvd :
      (∏ q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y, largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N q)) ∣
        N.totient := by
    refine dvd_trans (Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd _ _ hselect) ?_
    exact badLocalTotientProduct_dvd_totient hN
  have hphiPos : 0 < N.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hN)
  calc
    (y + 1) ^ largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N =
        ∏ _q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y, (y + 1) := by
      rw [largeTotientLocalFactorCount_eq_card_badLocalPrimeSet y N]
      simp
    _ ≤ ∏ q ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y, largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N q) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · exact fun q _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _
      · intro q hq
        exact (mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mp hq).2
    _ ≤ N.totient := Nat.le_of_dvd hphiPos hprodDvd

name: RankAmplification.pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_totient
statement:
theorem pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_totient {y N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    y ^ largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N ≤ N.totient
proof:
:=
  le_trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ y) _)
    (cutoffSucc_pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_totient hN)

name: RankAmplification.pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_two_mul {y N x : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) :
    y ^ largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N ≤ 2 * x
proof:
:=
  ((pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_totient hN).trans (Nat.totient_le N)).trans hNx

name: RankAmplification.exp_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_mul_le_totient
statement:
theorem exp_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_mul_le_totient {y N : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hscale : HasExponentialCutoffScale y T) :
    Real.exp ((largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N : ℝ) * T) ≤ (N.totient : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
  calc
    Real.exp T ^ largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N ≤
        ((y + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N := by
      gcongr
      simpa [HasExponentialCutoffScale] using hscale
    _ ≤ (N.totient : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast cutoffSucc_pow_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_totient (y := y) hN

name: RankAmplification.largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_log_two_mul_div_scale
statement:
theorem largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_log_two_mul_div_scale {y N x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hscale : HasExponentialCutoffScale y T) :
    (largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * x) / T
proof:
:= by
  have hphiPos : 0 < N.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hN
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hT).mpr
  calc
    (largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N : ℝ) * T ≤ Real.log (N.totient : ℝ) :=
      (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by exact_mod_cast hphiPos)).mpr
        (exp_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_mul_le_totient hN.ne' hscale)
    _ ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := by
      apply Real.log_le_log
      · exact_mod_cast hphiPos
      · have : (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le N
        refine this.trans ?_
        exact_mod_cast hNx
