name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.base_mem_badLocalPrimeSet
proof:
:= by
  have hqPrime : Nat.Prime d.base := d.base_prime
  have hqN : d.base ∣ N := d.base_dvd_selectedDivisor.trans hdvd
  have hqSupport : d.base ∈ primeSupport N :=
    Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hqPrime, hqN, hN⟩
  refine mem_badLocalPrimeSet.mpr ⟨hqSupport, ?_⟩
  cases d with
  | inl linear =>
      show y < largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N linear.natBase)
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hB
      have hdemand : P.value i ∣ linear.natBase - 1 :=
        (demand_dvd_blockDemandProduct P hi).trans linear.demand_dvd
      have hlocal : P.value i ∣ localTotientFactor N linear.natBase := by
        rw [localTotientFactor]
        exact hdemand.mul_left _
      have hle : P.value i ≤ largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N linear.natBase) := by
        refine prime_le_largestPrimeFactor (P.prime i) ?_ hlocal
        exact (localTotientFactor_pos linear.base_prime).ne'
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (P.lower i) hle
  | inr power =>
      show y < largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N power.natBase)
      have hpow : power.natBase ^ (powerMultiplicity P B power.natBase + 1) ∣ N := hdvd
      have hexp : powerMultiplicity P B power.natBase + 1 ≤ N.factorization power.natBase :=
        (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization power.base_prime hN).mp hpow
      have hmult : 0 < powerMultiplicity P B power.natBase := power.multiplicity_pos
      have hbasedvd : power.natBase ∣ localTotientFactor N power.natBase := by
        rw [localTotientFactor]
        refine Dvd.dvd.mul_right ?_ _
        exact dvd_pow_self power.natBase (by omega)
      have hle : power.natBase ≤ largestPrimeFactor (localTotientFactor N power.natBase) := by
        refine prime_le_largestPrimeFactor power.base_prime ?_ hbasedvd
        exact (localTotientFactor_pos power.base_prime).ne'
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le power.base_gt_lowerCutoff hle

name: RankAmplification.DividingSupplierSystem.largeLocalBaseCode_injective
statement:
theorem DividingSupplierSystem.largeLocalBaseCode_injective {J y Y : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective
      (DividingSupplierSystem.largeLocalBaseCode (P := P) (x := x) (N := N) hN)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hcode
  apply DividingSupplierSystem.labelBaseCode_injective hN
  have hfst : s.1.partition = t.1.partition := congrArg Prod.fst hcode
  have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd hcode
  have hval : ∀ i : Fin J,
      (s.1.descriptor (s.1.partition.blockOf i)).base =
        (t.1.descriptor (t.1.partition.blockOf i)).base :=
    fun i ↦ congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hsnd i)
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact hfst
  · funext i
    exact Subtype.ext (hval i)

name: RankAmplification.supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_pow
statement:
theorem supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_pow
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
      labelledPartitionCount J * largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N ^ J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supplierDivisorWeight_eq_dividingSystemCard P x N hN]
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (DividingSupplierSystem.largeLocalBaseCode (P := P) (x := x) (N := N) hN)
    (DividingSupplierSystem.largeLocalBaseCode_injective (P := P) (x := x) (N := N) hN)
  have hfilterCard :
      ((allSupplierSystems P x).filter fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor ∣ N).card =
        Fintype.card (DividingSupplierSystem P x N) := by
    let dividingSystems :=
      (allSupplierSystems P x).filter fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor ∣ N
    let e : {s // s ∈ dividingSystems} ≃ DividingSupplierSystem P x N :=
      { toFun := fun s ↦ ⟨s.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp s.2).2⟩
        invFun := fun s ↦ ⟨s.1, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_allSupplierSystems s.1, s.2⟩⟩
        left_inv := fun s ↦ by rfl
        right_inv := fun s ↦ by rfl }
    exact (Fintype.card_coe dividingSystems).symm.trans (Fintype.card_congr e)
  rw [hfilterCard]
  simpa [labelledPartitionCount,
    largeTotientLocalFactorCount_eq_card_badLocalPrimeSet y N] using hcard

name: RankAmplification.supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_maxLargeTotientLocalFactorCount_pow
statement:
theorem supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_maxLargeTotientLocalFactorCount_pow
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
      labelledPartitionCount J * max 1 (largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N) ^ J
proof:
:= by
  refine (supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_largeTotientLocalFactorCount_pow
    P x N hN).trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact le_max_right _ _

name: RankAmplification.section10_eqFormalPointwise
statement:
theorem section10_eqFormalPointwise {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ)
    {T : ℝ} (hN : 0 < N) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hscale : HasExponentialCutoffScale y T) :
    supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
        labelledPartitionCount J * max 1 (largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N) ^ J ∧
      (largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * x) / T
proof:
:=
  ⟨supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_maxLargeTotientLocalFactorCount_pow P x N hN.ne',
    largeTotientLocalFactorCount_le_log_two_mul_div_scale hN hNx hT hscale⟩

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_9_paperOccurrenceCount
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_9_paperOccurrenceCount
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) {T : ℝ}
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hN : 0 < N) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hscale : HasExponentialCutoffScale y T) :
    (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
        (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) * supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ^ J /
          (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ) ∧
      supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
        labelledPartitionCount J * max 1 (largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N) ^ J ∧
      (largeTotientLocalFactorCount y N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * x) / T
proof:
:=
  ⟨section10_eq10_8_uniformBlockScale hy hx P,
    (section10_eqFormalPointwise P x N hN hNx hT hscale).1,
    (section10_eqFormalPointwise P x N hN hNx hT hscale).2⟩

name: RankAmplification.log_two_le_one
statement: theorem log_two_le_one : Real.log 2 ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  Real.log_two_lt_d9.le.trans (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.six_le_exp_two
statement: theorem six_le_exp_two : (6 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : (2.7182818283 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have hsplit : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    norm_num
  rw [hsplit]
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]

name: RankAmplification.log_six_le_two
statement: theorem log_six_le_two : Real.log 6 ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Real.log 6 ≤ Real.log (Real.exp 2) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) six_le_exp_two
    _ = 2 := Real.log_exp 2

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformRankinShift_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformRankinShift_nonneg {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y)
    (hnum : 0 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ
proof:
:= by
  have hYreal : (1 : ℝ) < (Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hY
  exact div_nonneg hnum (Real.log_pos hYreal).le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformRankinShift_pos
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformRankinShift_pos {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ)
    (hu : Real.exp (Real.exp (ξ + 1)) ≤ bfpsU X Y) :
    0 < bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ
proof:
:= by
  have hYreal : (1 : ℝ) < (Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hY
  have hlogu : Real.exp (ξ + 1) ≤ Real.log (bfpsU X Y) := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hu
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hloguPos : 0 < Real.log (bfpsU X Y) :=
    (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hlogu
  have hlog2 : ξ + 1 ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) := by
    rw [log2_eq]
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos (ξ + 1)) hlogu
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hlog2One : (1 : ℝ) ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) := by linarith
  have hlog3 : 0 ≤ log3 (bfpsU X Y) := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    exact Real.log_nonneg hlog2One
  have hnum : 0 < log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ := by linarith
  exact div_pos hnum (Real.log_pos hYreal)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformRankinShift_le_quarter
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformRankinShift_le_quarter {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y)
    (h : 4 * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) ≤ Real.log Y) :
    bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ ≤ 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hYreal : (1 : ℝ) < (Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hY
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hYreal
  rw [bfpsUniformRankinShift, div_le_iff₀ hlogY]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.log2_add_log3_bfpsU_le
statement:
theorem log2_add_log3_bfpsU_le {X Y : ℕ}
    (hlogX : 0 < Real.log X) (hlogY : 1 ≤ Real.log Y)
    (hu : Real.exp 1 < bfpsU X Y) :
    log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) ≤ log3 (X : ℝ) + log4 (X : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have huPos : 0 < bfpsU X Y := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans hu
  have huLe : bfpsU X Y ≤ Real.log X := by
    rw [bfpsU, rankinU]
    exact div_le_self hlogX.le hlogY
  have hloguOne : 1 < Real.log (bfpsU X Y) := by
    have := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hu
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hlogu : Real.log (bfpsU X Y) ≤ log2 (X : ℝ) := by
    rw [log2_eq]
    exact Real.log_le_log huPos huLe
  have hlog2 : log2 (bfpsU X Y) ≤ log3 (X : ℝ) := by
    rw [log2_eq, log3_eq]
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hlogu
  have hlog2Pos : 0 < log2 (bfpsU X Y) := by
    rw [log2_eq]
    exact Real.log_pos hloguOne
  have hlog3 : log3 (bfpsU X Y) ≤ log4 (X : ℝ) := by
    rw [log3_eq, log4_eq]
    exact Real.log_le_log hlog2Pos hlog2
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformRankinShift_le_lowerCutoffRatio
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformRankinShift_le_lowerCutoffRatio {X Y : ℕ} {δ ξ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hcut : InBFPSLowerCutoffRange δ X Y)
    (hlog2X : 1 < log2 (X : ℝ)) (hlogX : 0 < Real.log X)
    (hlogY : 1 ≤ Real.log Y) (hu : Real.exp 1 < bfpsU X Y)
    (hnum : 0 ≤ log3 (X : ℝ) + log4 (X : ℝ) - ξ) :
    bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ ≤
      (log3 (X : ℝ) + log4 (X : ℝ) - ξ) / ((1 + δ) * log3 (X : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hlog3X : 0 < log3 (X : ℝ) := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    exact Real.log_pos hlog2X
  have hlog2Xpos : (0 : ℝ) < log2 (X : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlogYpos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log Y := by linarith
  have hcutLog : (1 + δ) * log3 (X : ℝ) ≤ Real.log Y := by
    have hle : Real.log ((log2 (X : ℝ)) ^ (1 + δ)) ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) := by
      apply Real.log_le_log _ hcut
      exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog2Xpos _
    rwa [Real.log_rpow hlog2Xpos, ← log3_eq] at hle
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (1 + δ) * log3 (X : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hnumLe := log2_add_log3_bfpsU_le (X := X) (Y := Y) hlogX hlogY hu
  calc
    bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ =
        (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) / Real.log Y := rfl
    _ ≤ (log3 (X : ℝ) + log4 (X : ℝ) - ξ) / Real.log Y := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hlogYpos.le
    _ ≤ (log3 (X : ℝ) + log4 (X : ℝ) - ξ) / ((1 + δ) * log3 (X : ℝ)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hden hcutLog

name: RankAmplification.bfpsFixedShellCount_le_two_mul_log
statement:
theorem bfpsFixedShellCount_le_two_mul_log {Y : ℕ} (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log Y
proof:
:= by
  have hlogY : 0 ≤ Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  have hlogTwo : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 :=
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 0.6931471803).trans Real.log_two_gt_d9.le
  have hlogTwoPos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := by linarith
  refine (fixed_bfpsFixedShellCount_cast_le_log_div Y).trans ?_
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hlogTwoPos]
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.log_bfpsFixedShellCount_le
statement:
theorem log_bfpsFixedShellCount_le {Y : ℕ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y) :
    Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 + log2 (Y : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hexpOne : Real.exp 1 < (Y : ℝ) := by
    have h3 : Real.exp 1 < (3 : ℝ) := by
      have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      linarith
    exact h3.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  have hlogY : 1 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hexpOne
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hlog2Y : 0 < log2 (Y : ℝ) := by
    rw [log2_eq]
    exact Real.log_pos hlogY
  have hcount := bfpsFixedShellCount_le_two_mul_log (Y := Y) (by omega)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (bfpsFixedShellCount Y) with hK | hK
  · rw [hK]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, Real.log_zero]
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  · have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
    calc
      Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount Y : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.log Y) :=
        Real.log_le_log hKpos hcount
      _ = Real.log 2 + log2 (Y : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by linarith), log2_eq]

name: RankAmplification.exp_bfpsUniformPhase
statement:
theorem exp_bfpsUniformPhase {u ξ : ℝ} (hu : 0 < Real.log u) (hu2 : 0 < log2 u) :
    Real.exp (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) = Real.exp (-ξ) * (Real.log u * log2 u)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Real.exp (log2 u) = Real.log u := by
    rw [log2_eq]
    exact Real.exp_log hu
  have h2 : Real.exp (log3 u) = log2 u := by
    rw [log3_eq]
    exact Real.exp_log hu2
  rw [show log2 u + log3 u - ξ = log2 u + (log3 u + -ξ) by ring, Real.exp_add,
    Real.exp_add, h1, h2]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformAbelRemainder_nonneg
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformAbelRemainder_nonneg (X Y : ℕ) (ξ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsUniformAbelRemainder]
  exact mul_nonneg
    (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
    (fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_nonneg _ _ _
      BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg)

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformAbelRemainder_le_phaseScalar
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformAbelRemainder_le_phaseScalar {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hshift : 0 < bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ)
    (hquarter : bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ ≤ 1 / 4) :
    bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        (Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant +
          BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant *
            (fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
                (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) +
              (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
                (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) *
                Real.exp (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) *
                Real.exp
                  (fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent Y
                      (bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ) -
                    Real.log (1 / bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ))))
proof:
:= by
  set δ : ℝ := bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ with hδdef
  set C : ℝ := BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant with hCdef
  have hC : 0 ≤ C :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg
  have hYone : 1 < Y := by omega
  have hbasePhase : δ * Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [log_two_le_one, Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  have hlogSix : δ * Real.log 6 ≤ 2 := by
    nlinarith [log_six_le_two, Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 6)]
  have hU : δ * Real.log Y ≤ log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ := by
    rw [hδdef, bfpsUniformRankinShift_mul_log hYone]
  have hB : ∀ i, i < bfpsFixedShellCount Y →
      4 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ∧
        4 ≤ δ * Real.log (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) →
      fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i) δ -
          Real.log (1 / δ) ≤
        fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent Y δ - Real.log (1 / δ) := by
    intro i _ hhigh
    have hHY : bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y 2 i ≤ Y := Nat.div_le_self _ _
    exact sub_le_sub_right
      (fixedBFPSSharpPhaseEulerExponent_le_global hhigh.1 hHY hshift hquarter
        hhigh.2) _
  have hshell : bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope Y δ ≤
      fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
          (1 + Real.log (bfpsFixedShellCount Y)) +
        (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
          (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) *
          Real.exp (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) *
          Real.exp (fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent Y δ - Real.log (1 / δ)) :=
    bfpsFixedShellPhaseEnvelope_le_phaseScalar hY hshift hquarter hlogSix hU hB
  have hmaj := fixedBFPSAbelPredecessorMajorant_le_phaseEnvelope
    (X := X) (Y := Y) (δ := δ) (C := C) hY hshift hquarter hbasePhase hC
  rw [bfpsUniformAbelRemainder, bfpsUniformRankinExponent, ← hδdef, ← hCdef]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_
    (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  exact hmaj.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hshell hC))

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformAbelRemainder_le_explicit
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformAbelRemainder_le_explicit {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hY : 3 ≤ Y)
    (hshift : 0 < bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ)
    (hquarter : bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hlogu : 0 < Real.log (bfpsU X Y)) (hlog2u : 0 < log2 (bfpsU X Y)) :
    bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ ≤
      smoothPredecessorEulerLoss (1 / 2) *
        (Real.exp fixedBFPSTerminalEulerConstant +
          BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant *
            (fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant *
                (1 + (Real.log 2 + log2 (Y : ℝ))) +
              (3 / (4 * Real.log 2) : ℝ) *
                (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) *
                (Real.exp (-ξ) *
                  (Real.log (bfpsU X Y) * log2 (bfpsU X Y))) *
                Real.exp
                  (fixedBFPSSharpGlobalEulerExponent Y
                      (bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ) -
                    Real.log (1 / bfpsUniformRankinShift X Y ξ))))
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := bfpsUniformAbelRemainder_le_phaseScalar hY hshift hquarter
  rw [exp_bfpsUniformPhase (u := bfpsU X Y) (ξ := ξ) hlogu hlog2u] at hbase
  refine hbase.trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_
    (smoothPredecessorEulerLoss_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).le
  refine add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_
    BFPSTwoAffine.bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant_nonneg)
  refine add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_
    fixedBFPSModerateShellConstant_nonneg) le_rfl
  linarith [log_bfpsFixedShellCount_le (Y := Y) hY]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsNormalizedExcess_le_uniformAbelError_of_explicit
statement:
theorem bfpsNormalizedExcess_le_uniformAbelError_of_explicit
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hY : 3 ≤ Y) (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ)
    (hu : Real.exp (Real.exp (ξ + 1)) ≤ bfpsU X Y)
    (hlogY : 4 * (log2 (bfpsU X Y) + log3 (bfpsU X Y) - ξ) ≤ Real.log Y) :
    bfpsNormalizedExcess X Y ≤
      max 0 (ξ + bfpsUniformAbelRemainder X Y ξ / bfpsU X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hYone : 1 < Y := by omega
  have huPos : 0 < bfpsU X Y :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hu
  exact bfpsNormalizedExcess_le_uniformAbelError hX hY huPos
    (bfpsUniformRankinShift_pos hYone hξ hu)
    (bfpsUniformRankinShift_le_quarter hYone hlogY)

name: RankAmplification.coprime_pair_eq_of_cross_mul
statement:
theorem coprime_pair_eq_of_cross_mul {a b c d : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hab : a.Coprime b) (hcd : c.Coprime d) (hcross : a * d = c * b) :
    a = c ∧ b = d
proof:
:= by
  have hac : a ∣ c := by
    apply hab.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    exact ⟨d, hcross.symm⟩
  have hca : c ∣ a := by
    apply hcd.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    exact ⟨b, hcross⟩
  have hacEq : a = c := Nat.dvd_antisymm hac hca
  subst c
  have hbd : d = b := Nat.mul_left_cancel ha hcross
  exact ⟨rfl, hbd.symm⟩

name: RankAmplification.diagonalA_coprime_diagonalB
statement:
theorem diagonalA_coprime_diagonalB {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    (diagonalA h j).Coprime (diagonalB h j)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd (j + h) j := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ hj
  simpa only [diagonalA, diagonalB, diagonalGCD, Nat.gcd_comm] using
    (Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hg)

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.m2_eq_m1_add_h_of_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, _hc, hk₁, hk₂⟩ := s.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
  have hshift := s.normalized_shift_equation hk₁ hk₂
  have hexpanded :
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + (s.m1 + h) =
        (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + s.m2 := by
    calc
      (s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + (s.m1 + h) =
          s.m1 * (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) + h := by ring
      _ = s.m2 * (normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 * (c * p) + 1) := hshift
      _ = (s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) * (c * p) + s.m2 := by ring
  rw [hdiag] at hexpanded
  exact (Nat.add_left_cancel hexpanded).symm

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.primeSupport_eq_of_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  have hcross := totient_cross_eq_of_normalized_diagonal hdiag
  exact primeSupport_eq_of_totient_cross_eq s.m1_pos.ne' s.m2_pos.ne' hcross

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.sameSupportIndex_of_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨s.m1_pos, ?_⟩
  rw [← s.m2_eq_m1_add_h_of_diagonal hdiag]
  exact s.primeSupport_eq_of_diagonal hdiag

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.normalized_eq_diagonal_coefficients
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.normalized_eq_diagonal_coefficients {h n p : ℕ}
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (hdiag : s.IsDiagonal) :
    normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 = diagonalA h s.m1 ∧
      normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 = diagonalB h s.m1
proof:
:= by
  have hm₂ : s.m2 = s.m1 + h := s.m2_eq_m1_add_h_of_diagonal hdiag
  have hg : 0 < diagonalGCD h s.m1 := by
    exact Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ s.m1_pos
  have hm₁factor : s.m1 = diagonalB h s.m1 * diagonalGCD h s.m1 := by
    exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left s.m1 (s.m1 + h))).symm
  have hm₂factor : s.m1 + h = diagonalA h s.m1 * diagonalGCD h s.m1 := by
    exact (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right s.m1 (s.m1 + h))).symm
  have hcross :
      normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * diagonalB h s.m1 =
        diagonalA h s.m1 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 := by
    apply Nat.mul_right_cancel hg
    calc
      (normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 * diagonalB h s.m1) * diagonalGCD h s.m1 =
          (diagonalB h s.m1 * diagonalGCD h s.m1) *
            normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 := by ac_rfl
      _ = s.m1 * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 :=
        congrArg (fun t ↦ t * normalizedA s.m1 s.m2) hm₁factor.symm
      _ = s.m2 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 := hdiag
      _ = (s.m1 + h) * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 :=
        congrArg (fun t ↦ t * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) hm₂
      _ = (diagonalA h s.m1 * diagonalGCD h s.m1) *
          normalizedB s.m1 s.m2 :=
        congrArg (fun t ↦ t * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) hm₂factor
      _ = (diagonalA h s.m1 * normalizedB s.m1 s.m2) *
          diagonalGCD h s.m1 := by ac_rfl
  have hnormCoprime := normalizedA_coprime_normalizedB s.m1_pos s.m2_pos
  have hdiagCoprime := diagonalA_coprime_diagonalB (h := h) s.m1_pos
  have hnormPos : 0 < normalizedA s.m1 s.m2 := by
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.gcd_le_right _ (Nat.totient_pos.mpr s.m2_pos))
      (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (Nat.totient_pos.mpr s.m1_pos))
  exact coprime_pair_eq_of_cross_mul hnormPos hnormCoprime hdiagCoprime hcross

name: RankAmplification.LargePrimeSkeleton.exists_diagonalRepresentation
statement:
theorem LargePrimeSkeleton.exists_diagonalRepresentation {h n p Y : ℕ}
    (s : LargePrimeSkeleton h n p) (hp : p.Prime) (hdiag : s.IsDiagonal)
    (hcut : Y < largestPrimeFactor n.totient) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, IsDiagonalRepresentation h Y n s.m1 r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hk₁, hk₂⟩ := s.exists_pos_normalized_common_multiplier
  obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := s.normalized_eq_diagonal_coefficients hdiag
  let r := c * p
  have hr : 1 ≤ r := Nat.mul_pos hc hp.pos
  have hq₁ : s.q1 = diagonalA h s.m1 * r + 1 := by
    rw [s.q1_eq, hk₁, ha]
    simp only [r]
    ring
  have hq₂ : s.q2 = diagonalB h s.m1 * r + 1 := by
    rw [s.q2_eq, hk₂, hb]
    simp only [r]
    ring
  have hn : n = s.m1 * (diagonalA h s.m1 * r + 1) := by
    calc
      n = s.m1 * s.q1 := s.n_eq
      _ = s.m1 * (diagonalA h s.m1 * r + 1) :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ s.m1 * q) hq₁
  have hm₂ : s.m2 = s.m1 + h := s.m2_eq_m1_add_h_of_diagonal hdiag
  have hnshift : n + h = (s.m1 + h) * (diagonalB h s.m1 * r + 1) := by
    calc
      n + h = s.m2 * s.q2 := s.shifted_eq
      _ = s.m2 * (diagonalB h s.m1 * r + 1) :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ s.m2 * q) hq₂
      _ = (s.m1 + h) * (diagonalB h s.m1 * r + 1) :=
        congrArg (fun m ↦ m * (diagonalB h s.m1 * r + 1)) hm₂
  have hprimeA : Nat.Prime (diagonalA h s.m1 * r + 1) := by rw [← hq₁]; exact s.q1_prime
  have hprimeB : Nat.Prime (diagonalB h s.m1 * r + 1) := by rw [← hq₂]; exact s.q2_prime
  have hcopA : Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h s.m1 * r + 1) s.m1 := by
    rw [← hq₁, s.q1_prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
    exact s.q1_not_dvd_m1
  have hcopB : Nat.Coprime (diagonalB h s.m1 * r + 1) (s.m1 + h) := by
    rw [← hq₂, ← hm₂, s.q2_prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
    exact s.q2_not_dvd_m2
  have hphi : n.totient = diagonalGamma h s.m1 * r := by
    calc
      n.totient = (s.m1 * (diagonalA h s.m1 * r + 1)).totient :=
        congrArg Nat.totient hn
      _ = diagonalGamma h s.m1 * r :=
        diagonal_left_totient_eq_gamma_mul hprimeA hcopA
  refine ⟨r, s.sameSupportIndex_of_diagonal hdiag, hr, hn, hnshift,
    hprimeA, hprimeB, hcopA, hcopB, ?_⟩
  rw [← hphi]
  exact hcut

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_dvd_left
statement: theorem diagonalGCD_dvd_left (h j : ℕ) : diagonalGCD h j ∣ j
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left j (j + h)

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_dvd_right
statement: theorem diagonalGCD_dvd_right (h j : ℕ) : diagonalGCD h j ∣ j + h
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right j (j + h)

name: RankAmplification.diagonalB_mul_diagonalGCD
statement:
theorem diagonalB_mul_diagonalGCD (h j : ℕ) :
    diagonalB h j * diagonalGCD h j = j
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (diagonalGCD_dvd_left h j)

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalB
statement:
theorem diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalB (h j : ℕ) :
    diagonalGCD h j * diagonalB h j = j
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact diagonalB_mul_diagonalGCD h j

name: RankAmplification.diagonalA_mul_diagonalGCD
statement:
theorem diagonalA_mul_diagonalGCD (h j : ℕ) :
    diagonalA h j * diagonalGCD h j = j + h
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (diagonalGCD_dvd_right h j)

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalA
statement:
theorem diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalA (h j : ℕ) :
    diagonalGCD h j * diagonalA h j = j + h
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact diagonalA_mul_diagonalGCD h j

name: RankAmplification.diagonal_cross_mul
statement:
theorem diagonal_cross_mul (h j : ℕ) :
    (j + h) * diagonalB h j = j * diagonalA h j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (j + h) * diagonalB h j =
        (diagonalGCD h j * diagonalA h j) * diagonalB h j := by
          rw [diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalA]
    _ = (diagonalGCD h j * diagonalB h j) * diagonalA h j := by
          ac_rfl
    _ = j * diagonalA h j := by rw [diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalB]

name: RankAmplification.diagonalB_pos
statement: theorem diagonalB_pos {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) : 0 < diagonalB h j
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.div_pos
  · exact Nat.gcd_le_left (j + h) hj
  · exact Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (j + h) hj

name: RankAmplification.diagonalA_pos
statement: theorem diagonalA_pos {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) : 0 < diagonalA h j
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.div_pos
  · exact Nat.gcd_le_right j (by omega)
  · exact Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (j + h) hj

name: RankAmplification.log2_add_log3_le_two_mul_max
statement:
theorem log2_add_log3_le_two_mul_max (v : ℝ) :
    log2 v + log3 v ≤ 2 * max 0 (log2 v)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : log3 v = Real.log (log2 v) := log3_eq v
  rcases lt_trichotomy (log2 v) 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · have hmax : max 0 (log2 v) = 0 := max_eq_left hneg.le
    have hpos' : 0 < -log2 v := by linarith
    have hlog : Real.log (log2 v) = Real.log (-log2 v) := by
      rw [Real.log_neg_eq_log]
    have hle : Real.log (-log2 v) ≤ -log2 v - 1 :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos'
    rw [hmax, h3, hlog]
    linarith
  · have hmax : max 0 (log2 v) = 0 := by rw [hzero]; simp
    rw [hmax, h3, hzero, Real.log_zero]
    norm_num
  · have hmax : max 0 (log2 v) = log2 v := max_eq_right hpos.le
    have hle : Real.log (log2 v) ≤ log2 v - 1 :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos
    rw [hmax, h3]
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.mul_max_log2_le_one_of_lt_exp_one
statement:
theorem mul_max_log2_le_one_of_lt_exp_one
    {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hve : v < Real.exp 1) :
    v * max 0 (log2 v) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge v 1 with hone | hone
  · 
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hv with hzero | hvpos
    · rw [← hzero, zero_mul]
      norm_num
    · have hlogneg : Real.log v < 0 := Real.log_neg hvpos hone
      have hlog2 : log2 v = Real.log (-Real.log v) := by
        rw [log2_eq, ← Real.log_neg_eq_log (Real.log v)]
      rcases lt_or_ge 1 (-Real.log v) with hbig | hsmall
      · have hmax : max 0 (log2 v) = log2 v :=
          max_eq_right (by
            rw [hlog2]
            exact Real.log_nonneg hbig.le)
        have hstep : Real.log (-Real.log v) ≤ -Real.log v - 1 :=
          Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith)
        
        have hinv : -Real.log v ≤ 1 / v - 1 := by
          have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < v⁻¹ by positivity)
          rw [Real.log_inv] at h
          rw [one_div]
          linarith
        rw [hmax, hlog2]
        have hvmul : v * (-Real.log v - 1) ≤ v * (1 / v - 1 - 1) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hvpos.le
          linarith
        have hfinal : v * (1 / v - 1 - 1) = 1 - 2 * v := by
          field_simp
          ring
        have hchain : v * Real.log (-Real.log v) ≤ v * (-Real.log v - 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hvpos.le
        have hlast : v * (1 / v - 1 - 1) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [hfinal]; linarith
        linarith
      · have hnonpos : log2 v ≤ 0 := by
          rw [hlog2]
          exact Real.log_nonpos (by linarith) hsmall
        rw [max_eq_left hnonpos, mul_zero]
        norm_num
  · 
    have hlogpos : 0 ≤ Real.log v := Real.log_nonneg hone
    have hloglt : Real.log v < 1 := by
      have := Real.log_lt_log (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < v) hve
      simpa only [Real.log_exp] using this
    have hlog2 : log2 v ≤ 0 := by
      rw [log2_eq]
      exact Real.log_nonpos hlogpos hloglt.le
    have hmax : max 0 (log2 v) = 0 := max_eq_left hlog2
    rw [hmax, mul_zero]
    norm_num

name: RankAmplification.mul_max_log2_le_initial
statement:
theorem mul_max_log2_le_initial
    {v u₀ : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hvu : v ≤ u₀) (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀) :
    v * max 0 (log2 v) ≤ u₀ * max 0 (log2 u₀) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hu₀pos : 0 < u₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hu₀
  have hmaxu₀ : 0 ≤ max 0 (log2 u₀) := le_max_left _ _
  rcases lt_or_ge v (Real.exp 1) with hsmall | hlarge
  · have h := mul_max_log2_le_one_of_lt_exp_one hv hsmall
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hu₀pos.le hmaxu₀]
  · 
    have hvpos : 0 < v := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hlarge
    have hlogv : 1 ≤ Real.log v := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hlarge
      simpa only [Real.log_exp] using this
    have hlogu₀ : 1 ≤ Real.log u₀ := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) (hlarge.trans hvu)
      simpa only [Real.log_exp] using this
    have hlog2v : 0 ≤ log2 v := by
      rw [log2_eq]
      exact Real.log_nonneg hlogv
    have hmono : log2 v ≤ log2 u₀ := by
      rw [log2_eq, log2_eq]
      exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith)
        (Real.log_le_log hvpos hvu)
    have hmaxv : max 0 (log2 v) = log2 v := max_eq_right hlog2v
    have hmaxU : max 0 (log2 u₀) = log2 u₀ :=
      max_eq_right (hlog2v.trans hmono)
    rw [hmaxv, hmaxU]
    nlinarith [Real.log_nonneg hlogv]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformSlackPhase_le_initial
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformSlackPhase_le_initial
    {ξ v u₀ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hvu : v ≤ u₀)
    (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀) :
    bfpsUniformSlackPhase v ξ ≤ 2 * (u₀ * max 0 (log2 u₀) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hphase : bfpsUniformSlackPhase v ξ ≤ v * (log2 v + log3 v) := by
    unfold bfpsUniformSlackPhase
    nlinarith
  have hlog := log2_add_log3_le_two_mul_max v
  have hmul : v * (log2 v + log3 v) ≤ v * (2 * max 0 (log2 v)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hv
  have hinit := mul_max_log2_le_initial hv hvu hu₀
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsInitialGammaConstant_pos
statement:
theorem bfpsInitialGammaConstant_pos (u₀ : ℝ) :
    0 < bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀
proof:
:=
  Real.exp_pos _

name: RankAmplification.one_le_bfpsInitialGammaConstant
statement:
theorem one_le_bfpsInitialGammaConstant {u₀ : ℝ} (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀) :
    1 ≤ bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀
proof:
:= by
  have hu₀pos : 0 < u₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hu₀
  have hmax : 0 ≤ max 0 (log2 u₀) := le_max_left _ _
  unfold bfpsInitialGammaConstant
  apply Real.one_le_exp
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsU_nonneg
statement: theorem bfpsU_nonneg {X Y : ℕ} (hY : 2 ≤ Y) : 0 ≤ bfpsU X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  have hlogX : 0 ≤ Real.log (X : ℝ) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos X with hX | hX
    · simp [hX]
    · exact Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hX)
  unfold bfpsU rankinU
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.bfpsU_mono
statement:
theorem bfpsU_mono {W X Y : ℕ} (hY : 2 ≤ Y) (hWX : W ≤ X) :
    bfpsU W Y ≤ bfpsU X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY)
  have hlog : Real.log (W : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (X : ℝ) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos W with hW | hW
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos X with hX | hX
      · simp [hW, hX]
      · simpa [hW] using Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hX : (1:ℝ) ≤ (X:ℝ))
    · exact Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hW) (by exact_mod_cast hWX)
  unfold bfpsU rankinU
  exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hlogY).2 hlog

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaRatio_le_initialGammaConstant
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaRatio_le_initialGammaConstant
    {ξ : ℝ} {W Y : ℕ} {u₀ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) (hY : 2 ≤ Y)
    (hu : bfpsU W Y ≤ u₀) (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀) :
    bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Y ≤ bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀
proof:
:= by
  have hdecay : 0 < bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y) := bfpsUniformDecay_pos _ _
  have hdensity : smoothTotientDensity W Y ≤ 1 := smoothTotientDensity_le_one W Y
  have hphase := bfpsUniformSlackPhase_le_initial (ξ := ξ)
    hξ (bfpsU_nonneg (X := W) hY) hu hu₀
  have hinv : (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y))⁻¹ ≤ bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ := by
    unfold bfpsUniformDecay bfpsInitialGammaConstant
    rw [← Real.exp_neg]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  unfold bfpsGammaRatio
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  calc
    smoothTotientDensity W Y * (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y))⁻¹ ≤
        1 * (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y))⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdensity (inv_nonneg.mpr hdecay.le)
    _ = (bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y))⁻¹ := one_mul _
    _ ≤ bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ := hinv

name: RankAmplification.bfpsGammaPrefix_le_initialGammaConstant
statement:
theorem bfpsGammaPrefix_le_initialGammaConstant
    {ξ : ℝ} {B Y : ℕ} {u₀ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) (hY : 2 ≤ Y)
    (hu : bfpsU B Y ≤ u₀) (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀) :
    bfpsGammaPrefix ξ B Y ≤ bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀
proof:
:= by
  unfold bfpsGammaPrefix monotoneEnvelope
  apply Finset.sup'_le
  intro W hW
  have hWB : W ≤ B := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hW)
  exact bfpsGammaRatio_le_initialGammaConstant hξ hY
    ((bfpsU_mono hY hWB).trans hu) hu₀

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_zero
statement: theorem smoothTotientCount_zero (Y : ℕ) : smoothTotientCount 0 Y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : smoothTotientSet 0 Y = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
    intro n hn
    have hdata := mem_smoothTotientSet.mp hn
    omega
  rw [smoothTotientCount, this, Finset.card_empty]

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_of_gammaRatio_le
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_of_gammaRatio_le
    {ξ γ : ℝ} {W Y : ℕ} (h : bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Y ≤ γ) :
    (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos W with hW | hW
  · subst hW
    simp [smoothTotientCount_zero, bfpsGammaTarget]
  · have hWreal : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hW
    have hdecay : 0 < bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y) := bfpsUniformDecay_pos _ _
    have hratio : smoothTotientDensity W Y ≤
        γ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y) := by
      have := (div_le_iff₀ hdecay).1 h
      simpa only [bfpsGammaRatio] using this
    have hdens : (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) / W ≤
        γ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y) := by
      simpa only [smoothTotientDensity] using hratio
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hWreal).1 hdens
    unfold bfpsGammaTarget
    linarith [this]

name: RankAmplification.gammaRatio_le_of_smoothTotientCount_le
statement:
theorem gammaRatio_le_of_smoothTotientCount_le
    {ξ γ : ℝ} {W Y : ℕ} (hW : 0 < W)
    (h : (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y) :
    bfpsGammaRatio ξ W Y ≤ γ
proof:
:= by
  have hWreal : (0 : ℝ) < W := by exact_mod_cast hW
  have hdecay : 0 < bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y) := bfpsUniformDecay_pos _ _
  have hdens : (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) / W ≤
      γ * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU W Y) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hWreal).2
    unfold bfpsGammaTarget at h
    linarith [h]
  unfold bfpsGammaRatio smoothTotientDensity
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hdecay).2 hdens

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_mul_target
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_mul_target
    {ξ : ℝ} {W Y : ℕ} {u₀ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) (hY : 2 ≤ Y)
    (hu : bfpsU W Y ≤ u₀) (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀) :
    (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤
      bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y
proof:
:=
  smoothTotientCount_le_of_gammaRatio_le
    (bfpsGammaRatio_le_initialGammaConstant hξ hY hu hu₀)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_mul_target_of_step
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_mul_target_of_step
    {ξ γ : ℝ} {B X Y : ℕ}
    (hbase : ∀ W : ℕ, W ≤ B →
      (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y)
    (hstep : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      (∀ Z : ℕ, Z < W →
        (smoothTotientCount Z Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ Z Y) →
      (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y) :
    ∀ W : ℕ, W ≤ X →
      (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤ γ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y
proof:
:= by
  intro W
  induction W using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h W ih =>
      intro hWX
      by_cases hWB : W ≤ B
      · exact hbase W hWB
      · have hBW : B < W := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hWB
        refine hstep W hBW hWX ?_
        intro Z hZW
        exact ih Z hZW (le_trans hZW.le hWX)

name: RankAmplification.smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_of_step
statement:
theorem smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_of_step
    {ξ : ℝ} {B X Y : ℕ} {u₀ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) (hY : 2 ≤ Y)
    (hB : bfpsU B Y ≤ u₀) (hu₀ : Real.exp 1 ≤ u₀)
    (hstep : ∀ W : ℕ, B < W → W ≤ X →
      (∀ Z : ℕ, Z < W →
        (smoothTotientCount Z Y : ℝ) ≤
          bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ Z Y) →
      (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤
        bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y) :
    ∀ W : ℕ, W ≤ X →
      (smoothTotientCount W Y : ℝ) ≤
        bfpsInitialGammaConstant u₀ * bfpsGammaTarget ξ W Y
proof:
:= by
  refine smoothTotientCount_le_gamma_mul_target_of_step ?_ hstep
  intro W hWB
  exact smoothTotientCount_le_initialGammaConstant_mul_target hξ hY
    ((bfpsU_mono hY hWB).trans hB) hu₀

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error
    {R H X : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) +
        tauEulerLoss 1 (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_eq_tau_one]
  exact finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error Nat.one_pos hH hR hu huSqrt

name: RankAmplification.rankinTailErrorConstant_pos
statement: theorem rankinTailErrorConstant_pos : 0 < rankinTailErrorConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinTailErrorConstant]
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos) primeCountingConstant_pos

name: RankAmplification.rankinTailPhaseConstant_pos
statement: theorem rankinTailPhaseConstant_pos : 0 < rankinTailPhaseConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinTailPhaseConstant]
  have h : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ := by
    have := norm_nonneg (Real.log (Real.log 2))
    linarith
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) rankinTailErrorConstant_pos)
    (Real.exp_pos 2)) h

name: RankAmplification.one_lt_rankinTailRankThreshold
statement: theorem one_lt_rankinTailRankThreshold : 1 < rankinTailRankThreshold
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinTailRankThreshold]
  have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (12 * rankinTailErrorConstant) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) rankinTailErrorConstant_pos)
  simpa using Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hpos

name: RankAmplification.rankinTailPaperError_le_bracket
statement:
theorem rankinTailPaperError_le_bracket {R H : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    tauEulerLoss 1 (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
      rankinTailErrorConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R))
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hδhalf : rankinDelta H R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hRone (zero_lt_one.trans hu) huSqrt
  have hloss : tauEulerLoss 1 (1 - rankinDelta H R) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * divisorEulerHalfLoss := by
    simpa using tauEulerLoss_le_rank_mul_halfLoss (j := 1) hδhalf
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R H :=
    (primeRankinSum_nonneg R (rankinDelta H R)).trans
      (primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU hR hu huSqrt)
  calc
    tauEulerLoss 1 (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * divisorEulerHalfLoss) * fullULogUPrimeError R H :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hloss hnonneg
    _ = rankinTailErrorConstant *
        (Real.exp 2 *
            (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) := by
      rw [rankinTailErrorConstant, fullULogUPrimeError]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.log_log_three_mul_nonneg
statement:
theorem log_log_three_mul_nonneg {R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hR' : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hR
  have hsix : (6 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (R : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 * (R : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    linarith
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 3 * (R : ℝ) := by linarith
  exact Real.log_nonneg ((Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).mpr hexp)

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU_of_error_le
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU_of_error_le
    {R H X : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU H R) (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (herror : tauEulerLoss 1 (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
      rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) / 2) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-(rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) / 2)
proof:
:=
  (finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_full_paper_error hH hR hu huSqrt).trans
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU
    {R H X : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : rankinTailRankThreshold ≤ rankinU H R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU H R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (hdom : rankinTailPhaseConstant *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) + 1) ≤
      rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) :
    finiteSmoothReciprocalTail R H X ≤
      Real.exp (-(rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R)) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hKpos := rankinTailErrorConstant_pos
  have hK12 : (0 : ℝ) < 12 * rankinTailErrorConstant := by linarith
  have huOne : 1 < rankinU H R := lt_of_lt_of_le one_lt_rankinTailRankThreshold hu
  have huPos : 0 < rankinU H R := zero_lt_one.trans huOne
  
  have hlogSqrt : Real.sqrt (12 * rankinTailErrorConstant) ≤
      Real.log (rankinU H R) :=
    (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le huPos).mpr hu
  have hsqrtNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (12 * rankinTailErrorConstant) :=
    Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (rankinU H R) := Real.log_pos huOne
  have hlogSq : 12 * rankinTailErrorConstant ≤ Real.log (rankinU H R) ^ 2 := by
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (12 * rankinTailErrorConstant) ^ 2 =
        12 * rankinTailErrorConstant := Real.sq_sqrt hK12.le
    nlinarith
  
  have hterm2 : rankinTailErrorConstant *
      (3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) ≤
      rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) / 4 := by
    have hexpand : rankinTailErrorConstant *
        (3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) =
        (3 * rankinTailErrorConstant * rankinU H R) / Real.log (rankinU H R) := by
      ring
    rw [hexpand, div_le_iff₀ hlogPos]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogSq huPos.le]
  
  have hlogloNonneg := log_log_three_mul_nonneg hR
  have hnormNonneg : 0 ≤ ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hneg : -Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤ ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖ := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using neg_le_abs (Real.log (Real.log 2))
  have hbracket : Real.exp 2 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) ≤
      Real.exp 2 * ((1 + ‖Real.log (Real.log 2)‖) *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) + 1)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos 2).le
    nlinarith
  have hterm1 : rankinTailErrorConstant *
      (Real.exp 2 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2))) ≤
      rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) / 4 := by
    have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbracket hKpos.le
    rw [rankinTailPhaseConstant] at hdom
    linarith
  
  have herror : tauEulerLoss 1 (1 - rankinDelta H R) * fullULogUPrimeError R H ≤
      rankinU H R * Real.log (rankinU H R) / 2 := by
    have hbound := rankinTailPaperError_le_bracket hR huOne huSqrt
    have hsplit : rankinTailErrorConstant *
          (Real.exp 2 *
              (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
            3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) =
        rankinTailErrorConstant *
            (Real.exp 2 *
              (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2))) +
          rankinTailErrorConstant *
            (3 * rankinU H R / Real.log (rankinU H R)) := by
      ring
    rw [hsplit] at hbound
    linarith
  exact finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU_of_error_le
    hH hR huOne huSqrt herror

name: RankAmplification.eventually_rankinTailRankThreshold_le_fixedLowRankTailRank
statement:
theorem eventually_rankinTailRankThreshold_le_fixedLowRankTailRank
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      rankinTailRankThreshold ≤ (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_ge J hJ
      ⌈rankinTailRankThreshold⌉₊] with x hx
  have hcast : ((⌈rankinTailRankThreshold⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
  exact (Nat.le_ceil rankinTailRankThreshold).trans hcast

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRank_rankinTailPhase_dominates
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRank_rankinTailPhase_dominates
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      rankinTailPhaseConstant *
          (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (fixedRankNatUpperY J x : ℝ))) + 1) ≤
        (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2oG : log2 =o[atTop] scaleG :=
    log2_isLittleO_scaleV.trans scaleV_isLittleO_scaleG
  have hL2bound := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
    (hL2oG.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  have hGone := (tendsto_scaleG_atTop.comp
    (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 1
  have hphase :=
    (tendsto_fixedLowRankTailRankPhase_natCast_div_scaleG_atTop J hJ).eventually_ge_atTop
      (2 * rankinTailPhaseConstant)
  filter_upwards [hL2bound, hGone, hphase,
      eventually_fixedLowRank_loglog_upperY_le_log2 J hJ,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos]
      with x hL2bound hGone hphase hloglog hL2 hL hA
  change (1 : ℝ) ≤ scaleG (x : ℝ) at hGone
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le, one_mul] at hL2bound
  have hphaseMul : 2 * rankinTailPhaseConstant * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
      (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hG).mp hphase
  have hCpos := rankinTailPhaseConstant_pos
  linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hloglog hCpos.le,
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL2bound hCpos.le,
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGone hCpos.le]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedLowRankTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedLowRankTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      finiteSmoothReciprocalTail (fixedRankNatUpperY J x)
          (fixedLowRankTailCode J x) x ≤
        Real.exp (-((fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log (fixedLowRankTailRank J (x : ℝ) : ℝ)) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_three_le_fixedRankNatUpperY J hJ,
      eventually_rankinTailRankThreshold_le_fixedLowRankTailRank J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRankTailRank_le_sqrt_upperY J hJ,
      eventually_fixedLowRank_rankinTailPhase_dominates J hJ]
      with x hY hu huSqrt hdom
  have hYone : 1 < fixedRankNatUpperY J x := by omega
  have hcode : 0 < fixedLowRankTailCode J x := by
    unfold fixedLowRankTailCode
    exact pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hYone) _
  have huEq := rankinU_fixedLowRankTailCode (J := J) (x := x) hYone
  have hmain := finiteSmoothReciprocalTail_le_exp_neg_half_uLogU
    (R := fixedRankNatUpperY J x) (H := fixedLowRankTailCode J x) (X := x)
    hcode (by omega) (by rw [huEq]; exact hu) (by rw [huEq]; exact huSqrt)
    (by rw [huEq]; exact hdom)
  rw [huEq] at hmain
  exact hmain

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd (d t : ℕ) :
    L.shiftedProductMod d t = 0 ↔ d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]

    Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p = (L.badResidueSet p hp).card
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  let e : Fin p ≃ ZMod p :=
    (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv.trans (Equiv.addRight 1)
  have he (t : Fin p) :
      t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet p ↔ e t ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp := by
    rw [mem_shiftedBadResidueSet, mem_badResidueSet_iff (L := L) hp,
      ← L.shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd p t]
    have hfin : (ZMod.finEquiv p) t = (t.val : ZMod p) := by
      cases p with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 t
      | succ p =>
          change t = (t.val : ZMod (p + 1))
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n := p + 1) t).symm
    have hfin' : (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv t = (t.val : ZMod p) := hfin
    simp only [e, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight]
    rw [hfin']
    rfl
  have rootEquiv :
      {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet p} ≃
        {u // u ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp} :=
    e.subtypeEquiv he
  calc
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p =
        Fintype.card {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet p} := by
      rw [shiftedBadResidueCount, Fintype.card_coe]
    _ = Fintype.card {u // u ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp} :=
      Fintype.card_congr rootEquiv
    _ = (L.badResidueSet p hp).card := Fintype.card_coe _

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card hp]
  exact L.card_badResidueSet_le_two hp

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount p < p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpTwo : p = 2
  · subst p
    rw [L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_badResidueSet_card Nat.prime_two]
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ (by norm_num : 1 < 2)
    apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
    intro x hx y hy
    have hxEq := (L.mem_badResidueSet_iff Nat.prime_two).mp hx
    have hyEq := (L.mem_badResidueSet_iff Nat.prime_two).mp hy
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      subst x
      norm_num at hxEq
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      subst y
      norm_num at hyEq
    apply ZMod.val_injective 2
    have hxVal0 : x.val ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_eq_zero x).not.mpr hx0
    have hyVal0 : y.val ≠ 0 := (ZMod.val_eq_zero y).not.mpr hy0
    have hxValLt := ZMod.val_lt x
    have hyValLt := ZMod.val_lt y
    omega
  · exact (L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two hp).trans_lt (by
      have hpTwoLe := hp.two_le
      omega)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    L.divisibleParameterSet R d =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueSet d).biUnion (parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_divisibleParameterSet, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨htR, htDiv⟩
    let a : Fin d := ⟨t % d, Nat.mod_lt t hd⟩
    have hta : t ≡ a.val [MOD d] := (Nat.mod_modEq t d).symm
    have hvalue := L.shiftedProductValue_modEq hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue a.val :=
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.symm.trans htDiv.modEq_zero_nat)
    exact ⟨a, by simpa [shiftedBadResidueSet] using haDiv,
      mem_parameterResidueFiber.mpr ⟨htR, hta⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, haRoot, hta⟩
    have htaData := mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta
    have haDiv : d ∣ L.shiftedProductValue a := by
      simpa [shiftedBadResidueSet] using haRoot
    have hvalue := L.shiftedProductValue_modEq htaData.2
    exact ⟨htaData.1,
      Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.trans haDiv.modEq_zero_nat)⟩

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint (R d : ℕ) :
    ((L.shiftedBadResidueSet d : Finset (Fin d)) : Set (Fin d)).PairwiseDisjoint
      (parameterResidueFiber R d)
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ha b _hb hab
  change Disjoint (parameterResidueFiber R d a) (parameterResidueFiber R d b)
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro t hta htb
  have hat := (mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp hta).2
  have hbt := (mem_parameterResidueFiber.mp htb).2
  apply hab
  apply Fin.ext
  have habMod : a.val ≡ b.val [MOD d] := hat.symm.trans hbt
  simpa only [Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.isLt] using habMod

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_eq {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card =
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount d * (R / d) + L.residueExcessCount R d
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion hd,
    Finset.card_biUnion (L.parameterResidueFiber_pairwiseDisjoint R d)]
  simp_rw [card_parameterResidueFiber hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_nat, shiftedBadResidueCount, residueExcessCount,
    Finset.card_filter]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card : ℝ) =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        L.residueExcessCount R d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast L.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq hd

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.residueExcessCount_cast_le
statement:
theorem residueExcessCount_cast_le (R d : ℕ) :
    (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast L.residueExcessCount_le R d

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.sieveDensity_isMultiplicative
statement: theorem sieveDensity_isMultiplicative : L.sieveDensity.IsMultiplicative
proof:
:=
  ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors L.localDensity

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.sieveDensity_apply_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sieveDensity_apply_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    L.sieveDensity p = L.localDensity p
proof:

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_activePrimeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_activePrimeSet {z p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z ↔
      p.Prime ∧ p ≤ z ∧ 0 < L.shiftedBadResidueCount p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [activePrimeSet, Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mem_primesLE]
  aesop

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.activePrimeProduct_squarefree
statement: theorem activePrimeProduct_squarefree (z : ℕ) : Squarefree (L.activePrimeProduct z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [activePrimeProduct]
  refine Finset.squarefree_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime (fun p hp q hq hpq ↦ ?_)
    (fun p hp ↦ (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1.squarefree)
  simp only [← coprime_iff_isRelPrime]
  exact (coprime_primes (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1
    (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hq).1).mpr hpq

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff {z p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z ↔ p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hpd
    rw [activePrimeProduct, hp.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff] at hpd
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := hpd
    have hqPrime := (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hq).1
    have hpEq : p = q := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hqPrime).mp hpq
    simpa [hpEq] using hq
  · intro hpMem
    exact dvd_prod_of_mem _ hpMem

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.not_dvd_shiftedProductValue_of_count_eq_zero
statement:
theorem not_dvd_shiftedProductValue_of_count_eq_zero {p t : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hcount : L.shiftedBadResidueCount p = 0) :
    ¬p ∣ L.shiftedProductValue t
proof:
:= by
  intro hdiv
  let a : Fin p := ⟨t % p, Nat.mod_lt t hp.pos⟩
  have hta : t ≡ a.val [MOD p] := (Nat.mod_modEq t p).symm
  have hvalue := L.shiftedProductValue_modEq hta
  have haDiv : p ∣ L.shiftedProductValue a.val :=
    Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp (hvalue.symm.trans hdiv.modEq_zero_nat)
  have haMem : a ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet p := by
    simpa using haDiv
  have hne : L.shiftedBadResidueCount p ≠ 0 := by
    rw [shiftedBadResidueCount]
    exact Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨a, haMem⟩
  exact hne hcount

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_multSum
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_multSum (R z d : ℕ) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).multSum d =
      (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [BoundingSieve.multSum, affineBoundingSieve, selbergSupport,
    shiftedProductEmbedding, divisibleParameterSet]
  rw [Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem (R z d : ℕ) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card - L.sieveDensity d * R
proof:
:= by
  rw [BoundingSieve.rem, L.affineBoundingSieve_multSum]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        L.residueExcessCount R d - L.sieveDensity d * R
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem, L.card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error hd]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime {R z p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem p =
      (L.residueExcessCount R p : ℝ) -
        (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess hp.pos,
    L.sieveDensity_apply_prime hp]
  unfold localDensity
  have hR : (R : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) * (R / p : ℕ) + (R % p : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_add_div R p).symm.trans (by omega)
  rw [hR]
  have hpCast : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime_le
statement:
theorem abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime_le {R z p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    |(L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem p| ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount p
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime hp]
  have hpCast : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) := by positivity
  have he0 : 0 ≤ (L.residueExcessCount R p : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hek : (L.residueExcessCount R p : ℝ) ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount p :=
    L.residueExcessCount_cast_le R p
  have hfrac0 : 0 ≤ ((R % p : ℕ) : ℝ) / p := div_nonneg (by positivity) hpCast.le
  have hfrac1 : ((R % p : ℕ) : ℝ) / p ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hpCast]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_lt R hp.pos).le
  have hterm0 : 0 ≤
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p := by positivity
  have htermk :
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p ≤
        L.shiftedBadResidueCount p := by
    calc
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p =
          (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) * (((R % p : ℕ) : ℝ) / p) := by ring
      _ ≤ (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac1 hk0
      _ = L.shiftedBadResidueCount p := by ring
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.coprime_activePrimeProduct_iff
statement:
theorem coprime_activePrimeProduct_iff {z t : ℕ} :
    Nat.Coprime (L.activePrimeProduct z) (L.shiftedProductValue t) ↔
      ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, ¬p ∣ L.shiftedProductValue t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcop p hpz
    have hp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
    by_cases hactive : 0 < L.shiftedBadResidueCount p
    · have hpMem : p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z := L.mem_activePrimeSet.mpr
        ⟨hp, Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hpz, hactive⟩
      have hpcop : Nat.Coprime p (L.shiftedProductValue t) := by
        rw [activePrimeProduct, Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff] at hcop
        exact hcop p hpMem
      exact hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mp hpcop
    · have hzero : L.shiftedBadResidueCount p = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hactive
      exact L.not_dvd_shiftedProductValue_of_count_eq_zero hp hzero
  · intro hall
    rw [activePrimeProduct, Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff]
    intro p hpMem
    have hpData := L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpMem
    exact hpData.1.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
      (hall p (Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr ⟨hpData.2.1, hpData.1⟩))

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_siftedParameterSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_siftedParameterSet {R z t : ℕ} :
    t ∈ L.siftedParameterSet R z ↔
      t < R ∧ Nat.Coprime (L.activePrimeProduct z) (L.shiftedProductValue t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [siftedParameterSet]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_siftedSum
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_siftedSum (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).siftedSum = (L.siftedParameterSet R z).card
proof:
:= by
  simp [BoundingSieve.siftedSum, affineBoundingSieve, selbergSupport,
    shiftedProductEmbedding, siftedParameterSet]
  rw [Finset.filter_map, Finset.card_map]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.parameterShiftEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parameterShiftEmbedding_apply (t : ℕ) : parameterShiftEmbedding t = t + 1
proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.siftedPairSet_eq_map
statement:
theorem siftedPairSet_eq_map (R z : ℕ) :
    L.siftedPairSet R z =
      (L.siftedParameterSet R z).map parameterShiftEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  constructor
  · intro hr
    have hrData := L.mem_siftedPairSet.mp hr
    have hrShift : r - 1 + 1 = r := by omega
    rw [Finset.mem_map]
    refine ⟨r - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply L.mem_siftedParameterSet.mpr
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [L.coprime_activePrimeProduct_iff]
      simpa [shiftedProductValue, productValue, hrShift] using hrData.2.2
    · simp only [parameterShiftEmbedding_apply, hrShift]
  · intro hr
    rw [Finset.mem_map] at hr
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hr
    have htData := L.mem_siftedParameterSet.mp ht
    apply L.mem_siftedPairSet.mpr
    refine ⟨by change 1 ≤ t + 1; omega, by change t + 1 ≤ R; omega, ?_⟩
    rw [L.coprime_activePrimeProduct_iff] at htData
    simpa [parameterShiftEmbedding_apply, shiftedProductValue, productValue] using htData.2

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum
statement:
theorem card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum (R z : ℕ) :
    ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card : ℝ) = (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).siftedSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.siftedPairSet_eq_map R z, Finset.card_map, L.affineBoundingSieve_siftedSum]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet {R z r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z ↔
      r ∈ L.primePairSet R ∧ L.leftValue r ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftSmallPrimePairSet]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet {R z r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z ↔
      r ∈ L.primePairSet R ∧ L.rightValue r ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightSmallPrimePairSet]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le
statement:
theorem card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z).card ≤ z + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range (z + 1)]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn L.leftValue ?_ ?_
  · intro r hr
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr
      (L.mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet.mp hr).2)
  · intro a _ha b _hb hab
    exact L.value_strictMono_left.injective hab

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le
statement:
theorem card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z).card ≤ z + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range (z + 1)]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn L.rightValue ?_ ?_
  · intro r hr
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr
      (L.mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet.mp hr).2)
  · intro a _ha b _hb hab
    exact L.value_strictMono_right.injective hab

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small
statement:
theorem primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small (R z : ℕ) :
    L.primePairSet R ⊆
      (L.siftedPairSet R z ∪ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z) ∪
        L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  by_cases hleft : z < L.leftValue r
  · by_cases hright : z < L.rightValue r
    · have hsift := L.mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt hr hleft hright
      exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hsift)))
    · have hsmall : r ∈ L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z :=
        L.mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet.mpr ⟨hr, Nat.le_of_not_gt hright⟩
      exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hsmall)
  · have hsmall : r ∈ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z :=
      L.mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet.mpr ⟨hr, Nat.le_of_not_gt hleft⟩
    exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hsmall)))

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.primePairSet R).card ≤ (L.siftedPairSet R z).card + 2 * (z + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (L.primePairSet R).card ≤
        ((L.siftedPairSet R z ∪ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z) ∪
          L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (L.primePairSet_subset_sifted_union_small R z)
    _ ≤ (L.siftedPairSet R z ∪ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z).card +
        (L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card + (L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z).card) +
        (L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z).card :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _
    _ ≤ ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card + (z + 1)) + (z + 1) :=
      Nat.add_le_add
        (Nat.add_le_add_left (L.card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le R z) _)
        (L.card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le R z)
    _ = (L.siftedPairSet R z).card + 2 * (z + 1) := by omega

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add (R z : ℕ) :
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
      (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).siftedSum + (2 * (z + 1) : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := L.card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add R z
  have hcast : ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((L.siftedPairSet R z).card : ℝ) + ((2 * (z + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  rwa [L.card_siftedPairSet_eq_siftedSum R z] at hcast

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_primePairSet_cast_le_logSquared_of_terminal
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_cast_le_logSquared_of_terminal
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Csieve Csmall : ℝ}
    (hsieve : L.DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff Csieve)
    (hsmall : CutoffExceptionUpperBound cutoff Csmall)
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
      (Csieve + Csmall) * logSquaredScale R
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((L.primePairSet R).card : ℝ) ≤
        (L.affineBoundingSieve R (cutoff R)).siftedSum +
          (2 * (cutoff R + 1) : ℕ) :=
      L.card_primePairSet_cast_le_siftedSum_add R (cutoff R)
    _ ≤ Csieve * logSquaredScale R + Csmall * logSquaredScale R :=
      add_le_add (hsieve R hR) (hsmall R hR)
    _ = (Csieve + Csmall) * logSquaredScale R := by ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.hasLogSquaredPrimePairBound_of_terminal
statement:
theorem hasLogSquaredPrimePairBound_of_terminal
    {cutoff : ℕ → ℕ} {Csieve Csmall : ℝ}
    (hsieve : L.DimensionTwoSelbergUpperBound cutoff Csieve)
    (hsmall : CutoffExceptionUpperBound cutoff Csmall) :
    L.HasLogSquaredPrimePairBound
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨Csieve + Csmall, fun _ hR ↦
    L.card_primePairSet_cast_le_logSquared_of_terminal hsieve hsmall hR⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSShellMass.one_lt_log_three
statement: theorem one_lt_log_three : (1 : ℝ) < Real.log 3
proof:
:= by
