  exact Real.exp_one_lt_three

name: RankAmplification.BFPSShellMass.two_thirds_lt_log_two
statement: theorem two_thirds_lt_log_two : (2 : ℝ) / 3 < Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  norm_num at h ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSShellMass.log_two_lt_three_quarters
statement: theorem log_two_lt_three_quarters : Real.log 2 < 3 / 4
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.log_two_lt_d9
  norm_num at h ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSShellMass.log_four_eq
statement: theorem log_four_eq : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ (2 : ℕ) by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
  push_cast
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSShellMass.log_six_eq
statement: theorem log_six_eq : Real.log 6 = Real.log 2 + Real.log 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (6 : ℝ) = 2 * 3 by norm_num, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSShellMass.quarter_le_log_log_add_one
statement:
theorem quarter_le_log_log_add_one {k : ℝ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hlog2 := two_thirds_lt_log_two
  have hexpQuarter : Real.exp (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 4 / 3 := by
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(1 / 4) : ℝ)
    have hmul : Real.exp (-(1 / 4) : ℝ) * Real.exp (1 / 4 : ℝ) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      norm_num
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (1 / 4 : ℝ)]
  have hfour : (4 : ℝ) ≤ k + 1 := by linarith
  have hmono : Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log (k + 1) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hfour
  have hlower : Real.exp (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (k + 1) := by
    rw [log_four_eq] at hmono
    linarith
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log (k + 1) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hlower
  exact (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).2 hlower

name: RankAmplification.bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_nonneg
statement: theorem bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_nonneg (k : ℝ) : 0 ≤ bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k
proof:
:=
  (bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_pos k).le

name: RankAmplification.bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_le_one_of_exp_one_le
statement:
theorem bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_le_one_of_exp_one_le
    {k : ℝ} (hk : Real.exp 1 ≤ k) :
    bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hk
  have hlogk : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log k := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hkpos).2 hk
  have hlogk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (k + 1) :=
    hlogk.trans (Real.log_le_log hkpos (by linarith))
  have hloglog : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (k + 1)) := Real.log_nonneg hlogk1
  unfold bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay
  rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_antitone_of_exp_one_le
statement:
theorem bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_antitone_of_exp_one_le
    {k l : ℝ} (hk : Real.exp 1 ≤ k) (hkl : k ≤ l) :
    bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay l ≤ bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hk
  have hlogk : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log k := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hkpos).2 hk
  have hlogk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (k + 1) :=
    hlogk.trans (Real.log_le_log hkpos (by linarith))
  have hloglog : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (k + 1)) := Real.log_nonneg hlogk1
  have hlogmono : Real.log k ≤ Real.log l := Real.log_le_log hkpos hkl
  have hloglogmono :
      Real.log (Real.log (k + 1)) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (l + 1)) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by linarith)
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
  unfold bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_le_geometric
statement:
theorem bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_le_geometric
    {k : ℝ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k ≤ 8 * Real.exp (-(k * Real.log 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hlog2lo := BFPSShellMass.two_thirds_lt_log_two
  have hlog2hi := BFPSShellMass.log_two_lt_three_quarters
  have hlog3 := BFPSShellMass.one_lt_log_three
  have hll := BFPSShellMass.quarter_le_log_log_add_one hk
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
  have hlogk : Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log k := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hk
  set B : ℝ := Real.log k + Real.log (Real.log (k + 1)) - 1 with hBdef
  have hBquarter : (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ B := by
    rw [hBdef]
    linarith
  have hkey : (k - 3) * Real.log 2 ≤ k * B := by
    rcases le_or_gt k 4 with h4 | h4
    · have hstep : 3 * B ≤ k * B := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    · rcases le_or_gt k 6 with h6 | h6
      · have hlogk4 : Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log k := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h4.le
        rw [BFPSShellMass.log_four_eq] at hlogk4
        have hBbig : 2 * Real.log 2 - 3 / 4 ≤ B := by
          rw [hBdef]
          linarith
        have hstep : 4 * B ≤ k * B := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
      · have hlogk6 : Real.log 6 ≤ Real.log k := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h6.le
        rw [BFPSShellMass.log_six_eq] at hlogk6
        have hBbig : Real.log 2 ≤ B := by
          rw [hBdef]
          linarith
        nlinarith
  have height : Real.exp (3 * Real.log 2) = 8 := by
    rw [show (3 : ℝ) * Real.log 2 = Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℕ)) by
      rw [Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring]
    rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  calc
    bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k = Real.exp (-(k * B)) := by
      rw [hBdef]
      unfold bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (3 * Real.log 2 + -(k * Real.log 2)) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by nlinarith)
    _ = 8 * Real.exp (-(k * Real.log 2)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, height]

name: RankAmplification.bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_nat_le_geometric
statement:
theorem bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_nat_le_geometric
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k ≤ 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hlog2pos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := by
    linarith [BFPSShellMass.two_thirds_lt_log_two]
  have hpow : (8 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k = 8 * Real.exp (-((k : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) := by
    congr 1
    rw [show -((k : ℝ) * Real.log 2) = Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) by
      rw [Real.log_pow, one_div, Real.log_inv]; ring]
    exact (Real.exp_log (by positivity)).symm
  rw [hpow]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 3 with hlt | hge
  · interval_cases k
    · have hval : bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          Real.exp 1 / Real.log 2 := by
        unfold bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay
        rw [show ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 by norm_num, Real.log_one,
          show -(1 : ℝ) * (0 + Real.log (Real.log (1 + 1)) - 1) =
            1 - Real.log (Real.log 2) by norm_num,
          Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hlog2pos]
      have hrhs : (8 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) = 4 := by
        rw [show -(((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2) = -Real.log 2 by push_cast; ring,
          Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
      rw [hval, hrhs, div_le_iff₀ hlog2pos]
      have h1 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      have h2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
      norm_num at h1 h2 ⊢
      linarith
    · have hloglog3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Real.log 3) :=
        Real.log_nonneg BFPSShellMass.one_lt_log_three.le
      have hval : bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          Real.exp (-2 * (Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log 3) - 1)) := by
        unfold bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay
        norm_num
      have hrhs : (8 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) =
          Real.exp (Real.log 2) := by
        rw [show -(((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2) = -(2 * Real.log 2) by push_cast; ring,
          Real.exp_neg, ← BFPSShellMass.log_four_eq, Real.exp_log (by norm_num),
          Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
      rw [hval, hrhs]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      nlinarith [BFPSShellMass.two_thirds_lt_log_two]
  · have hkR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hge
    exact bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_le_geometric hkR

name: RankAmplification.sum_pow_half_Icc_le
statement:
theorem sum_pow_half_Icc_le (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 1)]
      have hp : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n * (1 / 2) := pow_succ _ _
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.sum_bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_le
statement:
theorem sum_bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_le (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k hk
    exact bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_nat_le_geometric (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1
  have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k =
      8 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have h3 := sum_pow_half_Icc_le K
  have h4 : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K := by positivity
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_eq_shiftedPrimeDecay_mul
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_eq_shiftedPrimeDecay_mul
    {Y k : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant Y k =
      bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k *
        Real.exp (1 - (k : ℝ) * (Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (k : ℝ)) +
          sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
          totientRankinCorrectionConstant)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_eq_exp hY, bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleExponent,
    bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_le_shiftedPrimeDecay
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_le_shiftedPrimeDecay
    {Y k : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant Y k ≤
      Real.exp (1 / 2) * bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k *
        Real.exp (sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
          totientRankinCorrectionConstant)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hstep : 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (k : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos
      (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div hkpos.ne' (by positivity)] at h
    have hval : (k : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) - 1 = -(1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hval] at h
    linarith
  have hhalf : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (k : ℝ) * (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    rw [mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
    linarith
  have hgap : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤
      (k : ℝ) * (Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (k : ℝ)) := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hkpos.le
    linarith
  rw [bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_eq_shiftedPrimeDecay_mul hY]
  have hpos := bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay_nonneg (k : ℝ)
  have hexp : Real.exp
        (1 - (k : ℝ) * (Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (k : ℝ)) +
          sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
          totientRankinCorrectionConstant) ≤
      Real.exp (1 / 2) *
        Real.exp (sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
          totientRankinCorrectionConstant) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
  calc
    bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay (k : ℝ) *
        Real.exp
          (1 - (k : ℝ) * (Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (k : ℝ)) +
            sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
            totientRankinCorrectionConstant) ≤
        bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay (k : ℝ) *
          (Real.exp (1 / 2) *
            Real.exp (sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
              totientRankinCorrectionConstant)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hpos
    _ = Real.exp (1 / 2) * bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay (k : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
          totientRankinCorrectionConstant) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_shiftedPrimeDecay
statement:
theorem bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_shiftedPrimeDecay
    {X Y k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hsharp : SharpHildebrandRegime Y (Y ^ (k + 1))) :
    bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k ≤
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Y *
        (Real.exp (1 / 2) * bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k *
          Real.exp (sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder Y (Y ^ (k + 1)) +
            totientRankinCorrectionConstant))
proof:
:= by
  have hY : 1 < Y := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hsharp.2.1
  refine (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass_le_saddle hsharp).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeSaddleMajorant_le_shiftedPrimeDecay hY hk) ?_
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hY.le))

name: RankAmplification.primeCountingConstant_pos
statement: theorem primeCountingConstant_pos : 0 < primeCountingConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeCountingConstant]
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.log_le_two_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem log_le_two_mul_sqrt {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    Real.log x ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt x
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (zero_lt_one.trans hx)
  have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.log x / 2)
  rw [← Real.log_sqrt (zero_lt_one.trans hx).le, Real.exp_log hsqrt] at h
  calc
    Real.log x = 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt x) := by
      rw [Real.log_sqrt (zero_lt_one.trans hx).le]
      ring
    _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt x := by linarith

name: RankAmplification.primeCounting_le_constant_mul_div
statement:
theorem primeCounting_le_constant_mul_div {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ primeCountingConstant * x / Real.log x
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (zero_lt_one.trans hx)
  have hsqrtTerm : Real.sqrt x ≤ 2 * x / Real.log x := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hlog).2
    calc
      Real.sqrt x * Real.log x ≤ Real.sqrt x * (2 * Real.sqrt x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_le_two_mul_sqrt hx) hsqrt.le
      _ = 2 * (Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt x) := by ring
      _ = 2 * x := by rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (zero_lt_one.trans hx).le]
  calc
    (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log 4 * x / Real.log (Real.sqrt x) + Real.sqrt x :=
      Chebyshev.pi_le_log4_mul_div hx
    _ = 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x + Real.sqrt x := by
      rw [Real.log_sqrt (zero_lt_one.trans hx).le]
      field_simp
    _ ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x + 2 * x / Real.log x :=
      add_le_add_right hsqrtTerm _
    _ = primeCountingConstant * x / Real.log x := by
      rw [primeCountingConstant]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.integrableOn_primeCounting_mul_rpow
statement:
theorem integrableOn_primeCounting_mul_rpow (R : ℝ) (δ : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦
      (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2)) (Set.Icc 2 R) volume
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := Set.indicator {n : ℕ | n.Prime} (fun _ ↦ 1)
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ (δ - 2)) (Set.Icc 2 R) volume := by
    refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ?_
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith [ht.1]
    exact (continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl ht0)).continuousWithinAt
  have h := integrableOn_mul_sum_Icc (m := 0) c (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num) hg
  convert h using 1
  funext t
  rw [← Nat.primesLE_card_eq_primeCounting, Nat.primesLE_eq_filter_Icc_zero]
  simp [c, Set.indicator_apply]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_eq_primeCounting_integral
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_eq_primeCounting_integral {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    primeRankinSum R δ =
      (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * Nat.primeCounting R +
        (1 - δ) * ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2)
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := Set.indicator {n : ℕ | n.Prime} (fun _ ↦ 1)
  rw [primeRankinSum, Nat.primesLE_eq_filter_Icc_zero, sum_filter]
  trans ∑ n ∈ Icc 0 R, (n : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * c n
  · apply sum_congr rfl
    intro n hn
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp [c, hp]
    · simp [c, hp]
  nth_rewrite 1 [← Nat.floor_natCast (R := ℝ) R]
  rw [sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₁ (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ (-1 + δ)) c
    (by simp [c, Nat.not_prime_zero]) (by simp [c, Nat.not_prime_one]) R,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (mod_cast hR)]
  · have hsum (t : ℝ) : ∑ k ∈ Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, c k =
        (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.primesLE_card_eq_primeCounting, Nat.primesLE_eq_filter_Icc_zero]
      simp [c, Set.indicator_apply]
    simp_rw [hsum]
    rw [Nat.floor_natCast]
    have hderiv (t : ℝ) :
        deriv (fun u : ℝ ↦ u ^ (-1 + δ)) t =
          (-1 + δ) * t ^ (δ - 2) := by
      rw [Real.deriv_rpow_const]
      congr 2
      ring
    simp_rw [hderiv]
    have hinterm (t : ℝ) :
        (-1 + δ) * t ^ (δ - 2) * (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) =
          (-1 + δ) * ((Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2)) := by ring
    simp_rw [hinterm]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    ring
  · intro t ht
    exact (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl <| by linarith [ht.1])).differentiableAt
  · have hint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ ↦
        (-1 + δ) * t ^ (δ - 2)) (Set.Icc 2 R) := by
      refine ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc fun t ht ↦ ?_
      have ht0 : id t ≠ 0 := by
        simpa only [id_eq] using (show t ≠ 0 by linarith [ht.1])
      exact (continuousAt_const.mul <|
        continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl ht0)).continuousWithinAt
    convert hint using 1
    funext t
    rw [Real.deriv_rpow_const]
    congr 2
    ring

name: RankAmplification.intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel {δ a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) volume a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at ht
  have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans_le (ha.le.trans ht.1)
  have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.log_pos (ha.trans_le ht.1)).ne'
  exact (continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl htpos.ne')).div
    (Real.continuousAt_log htpos.ne') hlog

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_nonneg
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_nonneg {δ : ℝ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :
    0 ≤ rankinLogIntegral δ R
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hR
  intro t ht
  exact div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [ht.1]) _)
    (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [ht.1]))

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_rankinLogIntegral
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_rankinLogIntegral {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤ primeCountingConstant *
      ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R + rankinLogIntegral δ R)
proof:
:= by
  have hRreal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hR
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hRreal
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans hRone
  have hboundaryPi : (Nat.primeCounting R : ℝ) ≤
      primeCountingConstant * R / Real.log R := by
    simpa using primeCounting_le_constant_mul_div hRone
  have hboundary : (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * Nat.primeCounting R ≤
      primeCountingConstant * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) := by
    calc
      (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * Nat.primeCounting R ≤
          (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) *
            (primeCountingConstant * R / Real.log R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hboundaryPi (Real.rpow_nonneg hRpos.le _)
      _ = primeCountingConstant * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) := by
        have hrpow : (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * R = (R : ℝ) ^ δ := by
          calc
            (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * R =
                (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * (R : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
              rw [Real.rpow_one]
            _ = (R : ℝ) ^ ((-1 + δ) + 1) :=
              (Real.rpow_add hRpos (-1 + δ) 1).symm
            _ = (R : ℝ) ^ δ := by congr 1; ring
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, ← hrpow]
        ring
  have hleft : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦
      (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2)) volume 2 R := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hRreal]
    exact integrableOn_primeCounting_mul_rpow R δ
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦
      primeCountingConstant * (t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t)) volume 2 R :=
    (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (by norm_num) hRreal).const_mul _
  have hintegral : (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
      (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2)) ≤
      primeCountingConstant * rankinLogIntegral δ R := by
    rw [rankinLogIntegral, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hRreal hleft hright
    intro t ht
    have htone : 1 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) ht.1
    have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
    have hpi := primeCounting_le_constant_mul_div htone
    calc
      (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2) ≤
          (primeCountingConstant * t / Real.log t) * t ^ (δ - 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpi (Real.rpow_nonneg htpos.le _)
      _ = primeCountingConstant * (t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) := by
        have hrpow : t * t ^ (δ - 2) = t ^ (δ - 1) := by
          calc
            t * t ^ (δ - 2) = t ^ (1 : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2) := by
              rw [Real.rpow_one]
            _ = t ^ ((1 : ℝ) + (δ - 2)) :=
              (Real.rpow_add htpos 1 (δ - 2)).symm
            _ = t ^ (δ - 1) := by congr 1; ring
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, ← hrpow]
        ring
  have hintegral0 : 0 ≤ ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
      (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hRreal
    intro t ht
    exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [ht.1]) _)
  have hcoeffOne : 1 - δ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  rw [primeRankinSum_eq_primeCounting_integral hR]
  calc
    (R : ℝ) ^ (-1 + δ) * Nat.primeCounting R +
        (1 - δ) * ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
          (Nat.primeCounting ⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) * t ^ (δ - 2) ≤
        primeCountingConstant * ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R) +
          primeCountingConstant * rankinLogIntegral δ R := by
      apply add_le_add hboundary
      exact (mul_le_mul hcoeffOne hintegral hintegral0 zero_le_one).trans_eq (one_mul _)
    _ = primeCountingConstant *
        ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R + rankinLogIntegral δ R) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.deriv_rpow_div_log
statement:
theorem deriv_rpow_div_log {δ t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) :
    deriv (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t =
      t ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log t - 1) / Real.log t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans ht).ne'
  have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos ht).ne'
  have hd := (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := t) (p := δ) (Or.inl ht0)).div
    (Real.hasDerivAt_log ht0) hlog
  change deriv ((fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ) / Real.log) t = _
  rw [hd.deriv]
  rw [Real.rpow_sub_one ht0]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_le_exp_two_loglog
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_le_exp_two_loglog {δ B : ℝ}
    (hB : 2 ≤ B) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδB : δ * Real.log B ≤ 2) :
    rankinLogIntegral δ B ≤ Real.exp 2 *
      (Real.log (Real.log B) - Real.log (Real.log 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hBone : (1 : ℝ) < B := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hB
  have hBpos : 0 < B := zero_lt_one.trans hBone
  have hBpow : B ^ δ ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hBpos]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hleft := intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := δ) (by norm_num) hB
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ ↦
      Real.exp 2 * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t)) volume 2 B := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hB] at ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [ht.1]
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos (by linarith [ht.1])).ne'
    exact continuousAt_const.mul <|
      (continuousAt_id.inv₀ htpos.ne').div (Real.continuousAt_log htpos.ne') hlog
  rw [rankinLogIntegral]
  calc
    (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..B, Real.exp 2 * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hB hleft hright
      intro t ht
      have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [ht.1]
      have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos (by linarith [ht.1])
      have htpow : t ^ δ ≤ Real.exp 2 :=
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow htpos.le ht.2 hδ0).trans hBpow
      have hq : 0 ≤ t⁻¹ / Real.log t := div_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr htpos.le) hlogpos.le
      calc
        t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t = t ^ δ * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) := by
          rw [Real.rpow_sub_one htpos.ne']
          field_simp
        _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * (t⁻¹ / Real.log t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htpow hq
    _ = Real.exp 2 *
        (Real.log (Real.log B) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_inv_div_log (by norm_num) hBone]

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_tail_le
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_tail_le {δ A B : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hA : 1 < A) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hδA : 2 ≤ δ * Real.log A) :
    (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
      2 * B ^ δ / (δ * Real.log B)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ t ^ δ / Real.log t
  let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    t ^ (δ - 1) * (δ * Real.log t - 1) / Real.log t ^ 2
  have hleft := intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (δ := δ) hA hAB
  have hg'int : IntervalIntegrable g' volume A B := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable fun t ht ↦ ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hAB] at ht
    have htone : 1 < t := hA.trans_le ht.1
    have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
    have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos htone).ne'
    have hlog2 : Real.log t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hlog
    dsimp [g']
    exact ((continuousAt_id.rpow_const (Or.inl htpos.ne')).mul
      (continuousAt_const.mul (Real.continuousAt_log htpos.ne') |>.sub continuousAt_const)).div
        ((Real.continuousAt_log htpos.ne').pow 2) hlog2
  have hright : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ (2 / δ) * g' t) volume A B :=
    hg'int.const_mul _
  have hmono : (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
      ∫ t in A..B, (2 / δ) * g' t := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hAB hleft hright
    intro t ht
    have htone : 1 < t := hA.trans_le ht.1
    have htpos : 0 < t := zero_lt_one.trans htone
    have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log t := Real.log_pos htone
    have hlogle : Real.log A ≤ Real.log t :=
      Real.log_le_log (zero_lt_one.trans hA) ht.1
    have hδt : 2 ≤ δ * Real.log t :=
      hδA.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogle hδ.le)
    have hpowpos : 0 < t ^ (δ - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos htpos _
    dsimp [g']
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hfund : (∫ t in A..B, g' t) = g B - g A := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hAB] at ht
      have htone : 1 < t := hA.trans_le ht.1
      have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans htone).ne'
      have hlog : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos htone).ne'
      have hdiffer : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ δ / Real.log x) t :=
        ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := t) (p := δ) (Or.inl ht0)).div
          (Real.hasDerivAt_log ht0) hlog).differentiableAt
      dsimp [g, g']
      rw [← deriv_rpow_div_log htone]
      exact hdiffer.hasDerivAt
    · exact hg'int
  have hgA : 0 ≤ g A := by
    dsimp [g]
    exact div_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_lt_one.trans hA).le _)
      (Real.log_pos hA).le
  have hlogB : 0 < Real.log B := Real.log_pos (hA.trans_le hAB)
  calc
    (∫ t in A..B, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) ≤
        ∫ t in A..B, (2 / δ) * g' t := hmono
    _ = (2 / δ) * (g B - g A) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hfund]
    _ ≤ (2 / δ) * g B := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_self _ hgA) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * B ^ δ / (δ * Real.log B) := by
      dsimp [g]
      field_simp

name: RankAmplification.rankinLogIntegral_le_full
statement:
theorem rankinLogIntegral_le_full {δ R : ℝ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    rankinLogIntegral δ R ≤
      Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        2 * R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R)
proof:
:= by
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hRone
  by_cases hsmall : δ * Real.log R ≤ 2
  · exact (rankinLogIntegral_le_exp_two_loglog hR hδ.le hsmall).trans <|
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)
  · have hlarge : 2 < δ * Real.log R := lt_of_not_ge hsmall
    let A : ℝ := Real.exp (2 / δ)
    have hfour : (4 : ℝ) ≤ 2 / δ := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2
      linarith
    have hlog2lt : Real.log (2 : ℝ) < 2 / δ := by
      have hlog2one : Real.log (2 : ℝ) < 1 := by
        have h := Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos
          (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        norm_num at h ⊢
        exact h
      exact hlog2one.trans (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hfour)
    have hA2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ A := by
      calc
        (2 : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log 2) :=
          (Real.exp_log (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (2 / δ) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog2lt.le
        _ = A := rfl
    have hAone : (1 : ℝ) < A := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hA2
    have hApos : 0 < A := zero_lt_one.trans hAone
    have hlogA : Real.log A = 2 / δ := by simp [A]
    have hδA : δ * Real.log A = 2 := by
      rw [hlogA]
      field_simp
    have hAB : A ≤ R := by
      have hquot : 2 / δ < Real.log R := by
        apply (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).2
        nlinarith
      dsimp [A]
      rw [← Real.exp_log (zero_lt_one.trans hRone)]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hquot.le
    have hlowA := rankinLogIntegral_le_exp_two_loglog hA2 hδ.le hδA.le
    have hlogAle : Real.log A ≤ Real.log R := Real.log_le_log hApos hAB
    have hloglogle : Real.log (Real.log A) ≤ Real.log (Real.log R) :=
      Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hAone) hlogAle
    have hlow : rankinLogIntegral δ A ≤
        Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) :=
      hlowA.trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (sub_le_sub_right hloglogle _) (Real.exp_pos 2).le
    have htail := rankinLogIntegral_tail_le hδ hAone hAB hδA.symm.le
    rw [rankinLogIntegral]
    calc
      (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) =
          (∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..A, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t) +
            ∫ t in A..R, t ^ (δ - 1) / Real.log t := by
        exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
          (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel (by norm_num) hA2)
          (intervalIntegrable_rankinLogKernel hAone hAB)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          2 * R ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) := add_le_add hlow htail

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_full_raw
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_full_raw {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤ primeCountingConstant *
      ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R +
        Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
        2 * (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R))
proof:
:= by
  have hreduce := primeRankinSum_le_rankinLogIntegral hR hδ.le
  have hint := rankinLogIntegral_le_full
    (R := (R : ℝ)) (δ := δ) (by exact_mod_cast hR) hδ hδhalf
  apply hreduce.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ primeCountingConstant_pos.le
  simpa only [add_assoc] using
    add_le_add_right hint ((R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R)

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_full
proof:
:= by
  have hRreal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast hR
  have hRone : (1 : ℝ) < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hRreal
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans hRone
  have hlogR : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRone
  have hδone : δ ≤ 1 := hδhalf.trans (by norm_num)
  have hendpoint : (R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R ≤
      (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hlogR (mul_pos hδ hlogR)).2
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.rpow_nonneg hRpos.le _)
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hlogR.le hδone
  have hRle : (R : ℝ) ≤ 3 * R := by nlinarith
  have hlogle : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (3 * R) :=
    Real.log_le_log hRpos hRle
  have hloglogle : Real.log (Real.log (R : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.log (Real.log (3 * R)) :=
    Real.log_le_log hlogR hlogle
  have hinside :
      (R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R +
          Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          2 * (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) ≤
        Real.exp 2 *
            (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) := by
    calc
      (R : ℝ) ^ δ / Real.log R +
            Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
            2 * (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) ≤
          (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) +
            Real.exp 2 *
              (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
            2 * (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) := by
        exact add_le_add (add_le_add hendpoint <|
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_right hloglogle _) (Real.exp_pos 2).le) le_rfl
      _ = Real.exp 2 *
            (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2)) +
          3 * (R : ℝ) ^ δ / (δ * Real.log R) := by ring
  exact (primeRankinSum_le_full_raw hR hδ hδhalf).trans <| by
    rw [fullPrimeRankinError]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinside primeCountingConstant_pos.le

name: RankAmplification.rankinBase_rpow_delta
statement:
theorem rankinBase_rpow_delta {X R : ℕ} (hR : 1 < R) (hu : 0 < rankinU X R) :
    (R : ℝ) ^ rankinDelta X R = rankinU X R
proof:
:= by
  have hRpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlogR : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR)).ne'
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hRpos, rankinDelta]
  have hexp : Real.log (R : ℝ) *
      (Real.log (rankinU X R) / Real.log R) = Real.log (rankinU X R) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hexp, Real.exp_log hu]

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU {R X : ℕ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R X
proof:
:= by
  have hR' : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have hδpos : 0 < rankinDelta X R := by
    rw [rankinDelta]
    exact div_pos (Real.log_pos hu) (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hR'))
  have hδhalf : rankinDelta X R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hR' (zero_lt_one.trans hu) huSqrt
  have h := primeRankinSum_le_full hR hδpos hδhalf
  have hpow := rankinBase_rpow_delta hR' (zero_lt_one.trans hu)
  have hδlog := rankinDelta_mul_log_base (H := X) hR'
  rw [fullPrimeRankinError, hpow, hδlog] at h
  simpa only [fullULogUPrimeError] using h

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X)
proof:
:= by
  have hR' : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hR
  have huR : rankinU X R < R :=
    huSqrt.trans_lt (Real.sqrt_lt_self_iff.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hR'))
  have hδhalf : rankinDelta X R ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    rankinDelta_le_half_of_u_le_sqrt hR' (zero_lt_one.trans hu) huSqrt
  have hprime : primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ fullULogUPrimeError R X :=
    primeRankinSum_le_full_uLogU hR hu huSqrt
  have hloss : divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) ≤ divisorEulerHalfLoss :=
    divisorEulerLoss_le_half hδhalf
  have herror : divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
      primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R) ≤ fullPaperDivisorError R X := by
    rw [fullPaperDivisorError]
    exact mul_le_mul hloss hprime (primeRankinSum_nonneg R (rankinDelta X R))
      divisorEulerHalfLoss_pos.le
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
            divisorEulerLoss (1 - rankinDelta X R) *
              primeRankinSum R (rankinDelta X R)) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_exp_primeRankinSum hX hR' hu.le huR
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (add_le_add_right herror _)

name: RankAmplification.log_divisorWeightedSmoothCount_div_le_full_paper_error
statement:
theorem log_divisorWeightedSmoothCount_div_le_full_paper_error {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    Real.log (finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / X) ≤
      -rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X
proof:
:= by
  have hXreal : 0 < (X : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hX
  have hbound := finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error
    hX hR hu huSqrt
  have hdiv : finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / X ≤
      Real.exp (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) +
        fullPaperDivisorError R X) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hXreal).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hbound
  have hdivpos : 0 < finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / X :=
    div_pos (finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_pos hX) hXreal
  simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log hdivpos hdiv

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_half_u_log_u
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_half_u_log_u {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (hdom : fullPaperDivisorError R X ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 2) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
        (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X) :=
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error hX hR hu huSqrt
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-(rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) / 2) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith

name: RankAmplification.fixedHighRank_n_pos
statement:
theorem fixedHighRank_n_pos {x h y Y J n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ∈ fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J) : 0 < n
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.zero_lt_of_lt <| (mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp
    (mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet.mp hn).1).1

name: RankAmplification.fixedHighRank_n_le
statement:
theorem fixedHighRank_n_le {x h y Y J n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ∈ fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J) : n ≤ x
proof:
:=
  (mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp (mem_fixedHighRankShiftedSet.mp hn).1).2.1

name: RankAmplification.fixedHighRank_totient_eq
proof:
:=

name: RankAmplification.one_le_fixedHighRank_aggregateSupplierSummand
statement:
theorem one_le_fixedHighRank_aggregateSupplierSummand {x h y Y J n : ℕ}
    (hyx : y ≤ x) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hY : 1 ≤ Y)
    (hn : n ∈ fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J) :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
      (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
        (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hw := fixedHighRank_supplierWeights_one_le hyx hhy hY hn
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤
      (supplierDivisorWeight (fixedHighRankDemands hn) x n : ℝ) *
        (supplierDivisorWeight (fixedHighRankDemands hn) x (n + h) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul hw.1 hw.2
  refine hone.trans ?_
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y ↦
    (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
      (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ))
  · intro P hP
    positivity
  · exact Finset.mem_univ (fixedHighRankDemands hn)

name: RankAmplification.fixedHighRankShiftedCount_le_supplierCorrelation
statement:
theorem fixedHighRankShiftedCount_le_supplierCorrelation
    {x h y Y J : ℕ} (hyx : y ≤ x) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) :
    (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J : ℝ) ≤
      fixedRankSupplierCorrelation J y Y x h
proof:
:= by
  let S := fixedHighRankShiftedSet x h y Y J
  let I := Finset.Icc 1 x
  let G : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
    (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
      (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ)
  have hsubset : S ⊆ I := by
    intro n hn
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨(fixedHighRank_n_pos hn), fixedHighRank_n_le hn⟩
  calc
    (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y Y J : ℝ) = ∑ _n ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) := by
      simp [fixedHighRankShiftedCount, S]
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ S, G n := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      exact one_le_fixedHighRank_aggregateSupplierSummand hyx hhy hY hn
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ I, G n := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
      intro n hnI hnS
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun P hP ↦ by positivity
    _ = fixedRankSupplierCorrelation J y Y x h := by
      unfold G I fixedRankSupplierCorrelation
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]

    {J : ℕ} {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J)

    FixedRankHighRankHypothesis J ε
proof:

  filter_upwards [eventually_fixedRankNaturalAdmissibility J hJ,
    hsupplier.2] with x hadmissible hsupplier
  intro h hh hhy

  have hY : 1 ≤ fixedRankNatUpperY J x :=
    (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3).trans

      (hadmissible.y_le_upper.trans hadmissible.upper_le_x) hhy hY).trans <|

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_affineRootSet_eq_one_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem card_affineRootSet_eq_one_of_not_dvd
    {p A : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hAp : ¬ p ∣ A) :
    (affineRootSet p A hp).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hA : (A : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
    exact hAp hzero
  let r : ZMod p := -(A : ZMod p)⁻¹
  have hr : r ∈ affineRootSet p A hp := by
    rw [mem_affineRootSet hp]
    dsimp [r]
    rw [mul_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ hA]
    ring
  apply Finset.card_eq_one.mpr
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  ext x
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxEq := (mem_affineRootSet hp).mp hx
    have hxMul : (A : ZMod p) * x = -1 := by
      calc
        (A : ZMod p) * x = ((A : ZMod p) * x + 1) - 1 := by ring
        _ = -1 := by rw [hxEq]; ring
    calc
      x = (A : ZMod p)⁻¹ * ((A : ZMod p) * x) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hA, one_mul]
      _ = (A : ZMod p)⁻¹ * (-1) := by rw [hxMul]
      _ = -(A : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by ring
      _ = r := rfl
  · rintro rfl
    exact hr

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.disjoint_affineRootSet_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
statement:
theorem disjoint_affineRootSet_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hmem : p ∉ L.exceptionalPrimeSet) :
    Disjoint (affineRootSet p L.leftSlope hp)
      (affineRootSet p L.rightSlope hp)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro r hrLeft hrRight
  have hleft := (mem_affineRootSet hp).mp hrLeft
  have hright := (mem_affineRootSet hp).mp hrRight
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro hr0
    rw [hr0, mul_zero, zero_add] at hleft
    exact one_ne_zero hleft
  have hmul :
      ((L.leftSlope : ZMod p) - L.rightSlope) * r = 0 := by
    calc
      ((L.leftSlope : ZMod p) - L.rightSlope) * r =
          ((L.leftSlope : ZMod p) * r + 1) -
            ((L.rightSlope : ZMod p) * r + 1) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hleft, hright]; ring
  have hslopes : (L.leftSlope : ZMod p) = L.rightSlope := by
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right hr)
  have hmaxmin : ((max L.leftSlope L.rightSlope : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
      ((min L.leftSlope L.rightSlope : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
    rcases le_total L.leftSlope L.rightSlope with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h, min_eq_left h]
      exact hslopes.symm
    · rw [max_eq_left h, min_eq_right h]
      exact hslopes
  have hzero :
      ((max L.leftSlope L.rightSlope - min L.leftSlope L.rightSlope : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub min_le_max, hmaxmin, sub_self]
  exact (L.not_dvd_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hp hmem).2.2
    ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hzero)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_of_notMem
statement:
theorem dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_of_notMem
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hmem : p ∉ L.exceptionalPrimeSet) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p +
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p +
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p *
            BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight p ≤
      L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight, localDensity,
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_two_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hp hmem]
  unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := L.three_le_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet hp hmem
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_one]
  have hsubOne : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hpOne
  have hsubTwo : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 2 := sub_pos.mpr hpTwo
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) * (1 - (2 : ℝ) / p)⁻¹ =
      2 / ((p : ℝ) - 2) by
        rw [show 1 - 2 / (p : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 2) / p by
          field_simp [hpPos.ne']]
        field_simp [hpPos.ne', hsubTwo.ne']]
  field_simp [hsubOne.ne', hsubTwo.ne']
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ L.activePrimeSet (max p L.exceptionalPrimeThreshold)) :
    0 ≤ L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p
proof:
:= by
  have hpPrime := (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).1
  rw [affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight, localDensity]
  have hcountPos : (0 : ℝ) < L.shiftedBadResidueCount p := by
    exact_mod_cast (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hp).2.2
  have hcountLt : (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast L.shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime hpPrime
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
  have hdensityPos : 0 < (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) / p :=
    div_pos hcountPos hpPos
  have hsurvival : 0 < 1 - (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) / p := by
    rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hpPos]
    exact hcountLt
  exact mul_nonneg hdensityPos.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hsurvival.le)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).level = (z : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change (((max 1 z : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) = (z : ℝ) ^ 2
  rw [max_eq_right hz]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.product_injective_on_affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets
statement:
theorem product_injective_on_affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets {z : ℕ} :
    Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z : Set (Finset ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA B hB hprod
  have hASub : A ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1).trans
      (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hBSub : B ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hB).1).trans
      (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hASub hp)
  have hBPrime : ∀ p ∈ B, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hBSub hp)
  rw [← Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime, ← Nat.primeFactors_prod hBPrime]
  exact congrArg Nat.primeFactors hprod

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
statement:
theorem affineProductBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
    {R z : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ}
    (hA : A ∈ L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z) :
    (∏ p ∈ A, L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p) =
      (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).selbergTerms (A.prod id)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  have hASub : A ⊆ L.activePrimeSet z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp (hASub hp)).1
  have hdvd : A.prod id ∣ s.prodPrimes := by
    change A.prod id ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z
    rw [activePrimeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (L.activePrimeSet z) id hASub
  have hsq : Squarefree (A.prod id) :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  have hpf : (A.prod id).primeFactors = A := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime
  rw [hpf]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hpA
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [(hAPrime p hpA).primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p =
    L.sieveDensity p * (1 - L.sieveDensity p)⁻¹
  rw [L.sieveDensity_apply_prime (hAPrime p hpA)]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
statement:
theorem affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z).image (fun A ↦ A.prod id) ⊆
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors
        (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hd
  obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ := hd
  have hASub : A ⊆ L.activePrimeSet z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hprod : A.prod id ≤ z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2
  rw [SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors,
    L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz]
  constructor
  · change A.prod id ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z
    rw [activePrimeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (L.activePrimeSet z) id hASub
  · exact_mod_cast pow_le_pow_left' hprod 2

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.weightedPowersetMass_affineLocal_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem weightedPowersetMass_affineLocal_le_truncatedMass
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
        L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  let C := L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets z
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (C : Set (Finset ℕ)) :=
    L.product_injective_on_affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets
  have hsum :
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
          L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) =
        ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
    calc
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
          L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) =
          ∑ A ∈ C, ∏ p ∈ A, L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight p := by
        unfold BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep
          C affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        by_cases hprod : A.prod id ≤ z
        · rw [if_pos (decide_eq_true hprod), if_pos hprod]
        · rw [if_neg (by simpa using hprod), if_neg hprod]
      _ = ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
        rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        exact L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms hA
  rw [hsum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (L.affineProductBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors hz)
  intro d hd _hnot
  exact (s.selbergTerms_pos
    (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hd).1).le

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.genericDimensionTwoMassProduct_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem genericDimensionTwoMassProduct_le_truncatedMass
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass
          (L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes z.sqrt) z.sqrt ^ 2 ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z)
proof:
:= by
  let T := z.sqrt
  let S := L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T
  have hTz : T ≤ z := Nat.sqrt_le_self z
  have hsquare : T ^ 2 ≤ z := by simpa [T] using Nat.sqrt_le' z
  have hprime : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    (L.mem_genericDimensionTwoPrimes.mp hp).1
  have hSactive : S ⊆ L.activePrimeSet z := fun p hp ↦ by
    have hpData := L.mem_genericDimensionTwoPrimes.mp hp
    exact L.mem_activePrimeSet.mpr
      ⟨hpData.1, hpData.2.1.trans hTz,
        by
          rw [L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_two_of_notMem_exceptionalPrimeSet
            hpData.1 hpData.2.2]
          norm_num⟩
  have hmassEq :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass S T =
        BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
            (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep T) := by
    unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep
    simp
  rw [pow_two, hmassEq]
  calc
    BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
          (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep T) *
        BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
          (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep T) ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.pairUnionPowersetMass S
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight
            (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) :=
      BFPSTwoAffine.weightedRectangleMass_le_pairUnionMass hprime hsquare
        (fun p hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p)
        (fun p hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p)
    _ ≤ BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass S L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight
          (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) := by
      apply BFPSTwoAffine.pairUnionPowersetMass_le_weightedPowersetMass
      · exact fun p hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
      · exact fun p hp ↦ BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
      · intro p hp
        have hpData := L.mem_genericDimensionTwoPrimes.mp hp
        exact L.dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_of_notMem
          hpData.1 hpData.2.2
    _ ≤ BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass (L.activePrimeSet z)
          L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight (BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundKeep z) := by
      apply BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass_mono_coordinates hSactive
      intro p hp
      exact L.affineLocalSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg_of_mem hp
    _ ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z) :=
      L.weightedPowersetMass_affineLocal_le_truncatedMass hz

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos
statement:
theorem exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos :
    0 < L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor
proof:
:= by
  exact BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_le_exceptional_mul_generic
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_le_exceptional_mul_generic (T : ℕ) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) ≤
      L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct
          (L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T)
proof:
:= by
  let low := Nat.primesLE T ∩ L.exceptionalPrimeSet
  let high := L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T
  have hunion : high ∪ low = Nat.primesLE T := by
    ext p
    simp only [high, low, genericDimensionTwoPrimes, Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_inter]
    tauto
  have hdisj : Disjoint high low := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro p hpHigh hpLow
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hpHigh).2 (Finset.mem_inter.mp hpLow).2
  have hlowSub : low ⊆ L.exceptionalPrimeSet :=
    Finset.inter_subset_right
  have hlow :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct low ≤
        L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_of_subset hlowSub
  have hfactor :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) =
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct low := by
    unfold BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct
    rw [← hunion, Finset.prod_union hdisj]
  rw [hfactor]
  calc
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct low ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high *
          L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow
      exact (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos high).le
    _ = L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct high := by ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.succ_le_affineMassCutoff_succ_pow
statement:
theorem succ_le_affineMassCutoff_succ_pow (R : ℕ) :
    R + 1 ≤ (affineMassCutoff R + 1) ^ 64
proof:
:= by
  have houter := BFPSTwoAffine.succ_le_selbergGrowingCutoff_succ_pow R
  have hinner : BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1 ≤
      (affineMassCutoff R + 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [affineMassCutoff] using
      Nat.succ_le_succ_sqrt' (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)
  calc
    R + 1 ≤ (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1) ^ 32 := houter
    _ ≤ ((affineMassCutoff R + 1) ^ 2) ^ 32 :=
      pow_le_pow_left' hinner 32
    _ = (affineMassCutoff R + 1) ^ 64 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.cutoffLogLowerBound_affineMassCutoff
statement:
theorem cutoffLogLowerBound_affineMassCutoff :
    BFPSTwoAffine.CutoffLogLowerBound affineMassCutoff (1 / 64)
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hz : 1 ≤ BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hT : 1 ≤ affineMassCutoff R := by
    have hTpos : 0 < affineMassCutoff R := by
      unfold affineMassCutoff
      exact Nat.sqrt_pos.2
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega))
    omega
  refine ⟨hT, ?_⟩
  have hnat := succ_le_affineMassCutoff_succ_pow R
  have hcast : (R : ℝ) ≤
      (((affineMassCutoff R + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 64) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show R ≤ (affineMassCutoff R + 1) ^ 64 by omega)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < R) hcast
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  norm_num at hlog ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.directMertensProductUpperBound_affineMassCutoff
statement:
theorem directMertensProductUpperBound_affineMassCutoff :
    BFPSTwoAffine.DirectMertensProductUpperBound affineMassCutoff 64
proof:
:= by
  have h := BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
    (c := (1 / 64 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    cutoffLogLowerBound_affineMassCutoff
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos
statement: theorem affineGrowingMassConstant_pos : 0 < L.affineGrowingMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineGrowingMassConstant
  exact sq_pos_of_pos (mul_pos
    (mul_pos (by norm_num) L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos)
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss_pos)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingMassConstant_of_three_le
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingMassConstant_of_three_le
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) (hT : 3 ≤ affineMassCutoff R) :
    (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
      (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let z := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R
  let T := affineMassCutoff R
  let S := L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes T
  let M := BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass S T
  let G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
    (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z)
  let D := BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct T
  have hz : 1 ≤ z := by
    exact BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hTdef : T = z.sqrt := rfl
  have hSsub : S ⊆ Nat.primesLE T :=
    L.genericDimensionTwoPrimes_subset_primesLE T
  have hprodMass :
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S ≤
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_massLoss_mul_mass hSsub hT
  have hmassSquare : M ^ 2 ≤ G := by
    simpa [M, G, S, T, z, affineMassCutoff] using
      (L.genericDimensionTwoMassProduct_le_truncatedMass (R := R) hz)
  have hGpos : 0 < G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos _
  have hDpos : 0 < D := BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_pos T
  have hEpos : 0 < L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor :=
    L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor_pos
  have hLossp : 0 < BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss_pos
  have hMertens : D⁻¹ ≤
      L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M := by
    calc
      D⁻¹ = mertensProduct T := by
        symm
        exact BFPSTwoAffine.mertensProduct_eq_inv_directMertensProduct T
      _ = BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) :=
        (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE T).symm
      _ ≤ L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S := by
        simpa [S] using
          L.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_le_exceptional_mul_generic T
      _ ≤ L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          (BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprodMass hEpos.le
      _ = L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M := by ring
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by
    have hleft : 0 < D⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hDpos
    have hright : 0 ≤ L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss :=
      mul_nonneg hEpos.le hLossp.le
    nlinarith
  have hDupper : D ≤ 64 / Real.log R := by
    exact directMertensProductUpperBound_affineMassCutoff R hR
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega))
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ D *
      (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) = D * D⁻¹ := by field_simp [hDpos.ne']
      _ ≤ D * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMertens hDpos.le
  have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤
      (64 * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M)) / Real.log R := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ D * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) := hone
      _ ≤ (64 / Real.log R) * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDupper
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hEpos.le hLossp.le) hMpos.le
      _ = (64 * (L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M)) / Real.log R := by ring
  have hlogBound : Real.log R ≤
      64 * L.exceptionalDimensionOneFactor *
        BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss * M := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ hlogPos).mp hratio
    simpa only [one_mul, mul_assoc] using h
  have hlogSq : Real.log R ^ 2 ≤
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant * M ^ 2 := by
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlogPos.le hlogBound 2
    unfold affineGrowingMassConstant
    simpa only [mul_pow, mul_assoc] using hpow
  have hlogG : Real.log R ^ 2 ≤
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant * G :=
    hlogSq.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmassSquare
      L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos.le)
  have hlogSqPos : 0 < Real.log R ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hlogPos
  have hlower : Real.log R ^ 2 / L.affineGrowingMassConstant ≤ G := by
    exact (div_le_iff₀ L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos).2
      (by simpa [mul_comm] using hlogG)
  calc
    G⁻¹ ≤ (Real.log R ^ 2 / L.affineGrowingMassConstant)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hGpos
        (div_pos hlogSqPos L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos)).2 hlower
    _ = L.affineGrowingMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [hlogSqPos.ne', L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos.ne']

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineSmallMassConstant_pos
statement: theorem affineSmallMassConstant_pos : 0 < affineSmallMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineSmallMassConstant
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineSmallMassConstant_of_lt_three
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_inv_le_affineSmallMassConstant_of_lt_three
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) (hT : affineMassCutoff R < 3) :
    (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
      (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      affineSmallMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
    (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R
      (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R))
  have hGpos : 0 < G := SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos _
  have hGone : 1 ≤ G := SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass _
  have hGinv : G⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ hGpos).2 hGone
  have hcutSucc : affineMassCutoff R + 1 ≤ 3 := by omega
  have hRleNat : R ≤ 3 ^ 64 := by
    calc
      R ≤ R + 1 := Nat.le_succ R
      _ ≤ (affineMassCutoff R + 1) ^ 64 :=
        succ_le_affineMassCutoff_succ_pow R
      _ ≤ 3 ^ 64 := pow_le_pow_left' hcutSucc 64
  have hRle : (R : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ 64 := by exact_mod_cast hRleNat
  have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) :=
    Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega))
  have hlogR : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤ R :=
    (Real.log_le_self hRpos.le)
  have hlogBound : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ 64 :=
    hlogR.trans hRle
  have hlogSq : Real.log (R : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ affineSmallMassConstant := by
    unfold affineSmallMassConstant
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hlogPos.le hlogBound 2
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ affineSmallMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2 := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hlogPos)).2 (by simpa using hlogSq)
  exact hGinv.trans hone

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant_pos
statement:
theorem affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant_pos :
    0 < L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  exact L.affineGrowingMassConstant_pos.trans_le (le_max_left _ _)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
      (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R
        (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlogSq : 0 ≤ Real.log (R : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  by_cases hT : 3 ≤ affineMassCutoff R
  · exact (L.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingMassConstant_of_three_le hR hT).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hlogSq)
  · have hTlt : affineMassCutoff R < 3 := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hT
    exact (L.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineSmallMassConstant_of_lt_three hR hTlt).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hlogSq)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.truncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem truncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff :
    L.TruncatedMassLogSquaredUpperBound BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff
      L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hinv := L.truncatedMass_inv_le_affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant hR
  unfold logSquaredScale
  calc
    (R : ℝ) * (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
        (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R
          (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R)))⁻¹ ≤
      (R : ℝ) * (L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant / Real.log R ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv (by positivity)
    _ = L.affineGrowingTruncatedMassConstant *
        ((R : ℝ) / Real.log R ^ 2) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType
    (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount d = Fintype.card (L.affineShiftedRootType d)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin d ≃ ZMod d := (ZMod.finEquiv d).toEquiv
  have he (t : Fin d) :
      t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet d ↔
        L.shiftedProductMod d (e t) = 0 := by
    rw [mem_shiftedBadResidueSet,
      ← L.shiftedProductMod_natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd d t.val]
    have hfin : (ZMod.finEquiv d) t = (t.val : ZMod d) := by
      cases d with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 t
      | succ d =>
          change t = (t.val : ZMod (d + 1))
          exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (n := d + 1) t).symm
    change L.shiftedProductMod d (t.val : ZMod d) = 0 ↔
      L.shiftedProductMod d ((ZMod.finEquiv d) t) = 0
    rw [hfin]
  let rootEquiv :
      {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet d} ≃ L.affineShiftedRootType d :=
    e.subtypeEquiv he
  calc
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount d =
        Fintype.card {t // t ∈ L.shiftedBadResidueSet d} := by
      rw [shiftedBadResidueCount, Fintype.card_coe]
    _ = Fintype.card (L.affineShiftedRootType d) :=
      Fintype.card_congr rootEquiv

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedProductMod_chineseRemainder
statement:
theorem shiftedProductMod_chineseRemainder
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) (q : ZMod (a * b)) :
    ZMod.chineseRemainder hab (L.shiftedProductMod (a * b) q) =
      (L.shiftedProductMod a (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab q).1,
        L.shiftedProductMod b (ZMod.chineseRemainder hab q).2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedProductMod]
  apply Prod.ext <;> rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_mul_of_coprime
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount (a * b) =
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount a * L.shiftedBadResidueCount b
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero a := ⟨ha⟩
  letI : NeZero b := ⟨hb⟩
  letI : NeZero (a * b) := ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero ha hb⟩
  rw [L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType,
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType,
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount_eq_card_affineShiftedRootType]
  exact (Fintype.card_congr (L.affineShiftedRootType_mulEquiv hab)).trans
    (Fintype.card_prod _ _)

theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_zero : L.shiftedBadResidueCount 0 = 0
proof:

@[simp]
