name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineShiftedRootCount_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineShiftedRootCount_apply (d : ℕ) :
    L.affineShiftedRootCount d = L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof: := rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineShiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative
statement:
theorem affineShiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative :
    L.affineShiftedRootCount.IsMultiplicative
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro a b hab
    simp only [affineShiftedRootCount_apply]
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · simp [ha]
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · simp [hb]
    exact L.shiftedBadResidueCount_mul_of_coprime hab ha hb

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount
statement:
theorem prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount
    {d : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, L.shiftedBadResidueCount p =
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof:
:= by
  change (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, L.affineShiftedRootCount p) =
    L.affineShiftedRootCount d
  rw [← L.affineShiftedRootCount_isMultiplicative.map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors
    d d.primeFactors subset_rfl,
    Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div
statement:
theorem sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div
    {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    L.sieveDensity d = (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) / d
proof:
:= by
  rw [sieveDensity, ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hd]
  simp only [localDensity, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  rw [← Nat.cast_prod, ← Nat.cast_prod,
    L.prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount hsq,
    Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) -
        (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess hd,
    L.sieveDensity_eq_shiftedBadResidueCount_div hd.ne' hsq]
  have hRcast : (R : ℝ) = (d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) + (R % d : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_add_div R d).symm.trans (by omega)
  rw [hRcast]
  have hdCast : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount
statement:
theorem abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    |(L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d| ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount d
proof:
:= by
  rw [L.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_excess_sub_fraction hd hsq]
  have hdCast : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hcount0 : 0 ≤ (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hexcess0 : 0 ≤ (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hexcessLe : (L.residueExcessCount R d : ℝ) ≤
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount d := L.residueExcessCount_cast_le R d
  have hfrac : ((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hdCast]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_lt R hd).le
  have hterm0 : 0 ≤
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d := by positivity
  have htermLe :
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d ≤
        L.shiftedBadResidueCount d := by
    calc
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R % d : ℕ) / d =
          (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) *
            (((R % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d) := by ring
      _ ≤ (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac hcount0
      _ = L.shiftedBadResidueCount d := by ring
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
statement:
theorem shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
    {d : ℕ} (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    L.shiftedBadResidueCount d ≤ 2 ^ d.primeFactors.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← L.prod_primeFactors_shiftedBadResidueCount hsq]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, L.shiftedBadResidueCount p) ≤
        ∏ _p ∈ d.primeFactors, 2 := by
      gcongr with p hp
      exact L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two
        (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
    _ = 2 ^ d.primeFactors.card := by simp

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
statement:
theorem abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
    {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    |(L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d| ≤
      ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (L.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_shiftedBadResidueCount hd hsq).trans
    (by exact_mod_cast L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors hsq)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineSelbergTerms_prime_le_cast
statement:
theorem affineSelbergTerms_prime_le_cast
    {R z p : ℕ} (hpMem : p ∈ L.activePrimeSet z) :
    (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).selbergTerms p ≤ (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpMem).1
  have hpDvd : p ∣ (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes := by
    change p ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z
    exact (L.prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff hp).mpr hpMem
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [hp.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change L.sieveDensity p * (1 - L.sieveDensity p)⁻¹ ≤ (p : ℝ)
  rw [L.sieveDensity_apply_prime hp]
  unfold localDensity
  let k : ℕ := L.shiftedBadResidueCount p
  have hkPos : 0 < k := (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpMem).2.2
  have hkTwo : k ≤ 2 := L.shiftedBadResidueCount_le_two hp
  have hkp : k < p := L.shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime hp
  have hpTwo : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
  have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hkPos
  have hkpR : (k : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hkp
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - k := by linarith
  rw [show (k : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) * (1 - (k : ℝ) / p)⁻¹ =
      (k : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - k) by
        rw [show 1 - (k : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) =
          ((p : ℝ) - k) / p by field_simp [hpR.ne']]
        field_simp [hpR.ne', hden.ne']]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
  have hkTwoR : (k : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hkTwo
  have hpTwoR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpTwo
  have hkCases : k = 1 ∨ k = 2 := by omega
  rcases hkCases with hk | hk
  · rw [hk]
    norm_num
    nlinarith
  · rw [hk]
    have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := by omega
    have hpThreeR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpThree
    norm_num
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineSelbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem affineSelbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).selbergTerms d ≤ (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.selbergTerms p) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hpMem
        have hpDvdD : p ∣ d := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        exact (s.selbergTerms_pos (hpDvdD.trans hd)).le
      · intro p hpMem
        have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        have hpDvd : p ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z := by
          change p ∣ s.prodPrimes
          exact (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem).trans hd
        exact L.affineSelbergTerms_prime_le_cast
          ((L.prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff hp).mp hpDvd)
    _ = (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_prod]
      norm_cast
      exact Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.inv_cast_le_affineSieveDensity_of_dvd
statement:
theorem inv_cast_le_affineSieveDensity_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (d : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).nu d
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hprodCast : (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ)) = (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod]
    norm_cast
    exact Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq
  calc
    (d : ℝ)⁻¹ = (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ))⁻¹ := by rw [hprodCast]
    _ = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      (Finset.prod_inv_distrib (s := d.primeFactors) (fun p ↦ (p : ℝ))).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.nu p := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hpMem
        positivity
      · intro p hpMem
        have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        have hpDvd : p ∣ L.activePrimeProduct z := by
          change p ∣ s.prodPrimes
          exact (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem).trans hd
        have hpActive := (L.prime_dvd_activePrimeProduct_iff hp).mp hpDvd
        change (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ L.sieveDensity p
        rw [L.sieveDensity_apply_prime hp, localDensity]
        have hcount : 1 ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount p :=
          (L.mem_activePrimeSet.mp hpActive).2.2
        have hcountR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount p := by
          exact_mod_cast hcount
        have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        simpa only [one_mul] using
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcountR (inv_nonneg.mpr hpR.le)
    _ = s.nu d := s.nu_mult.prod_primeFactors hsq

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineSieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem affineSieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd
    {R z d : ℕ}
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    ((L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).nu d)⁻¹ ≤ (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hnu : 0 < s.nu d := s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd
  have hlower : (d : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ s.nu d :=
    L.inv_cast_le_affineSieveDensity_of_dvd hd
  calc
    (s.nu d)⁻¹ ≤ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hnu (inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hdPos))).2 hlower
    _ = (d : ℝ) := inv_inv _

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineActiveReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem affineActiveReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors
        (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z) d ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 z
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  intro a ha
  have haData := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
  have hquotPos : 0 < s.prodPrimes / d := by
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
    exact Nat.div_pos
      (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero) hd) hdPos
  have haPos : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors haData.1
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hdaData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp haData.2
  rw [L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdaData
  have hdaLe : d * a ≤ z := by
    have hcast : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ z := by
      have hda0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d * a : ℕ) := by positivity
      have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
    ⟨haPos, (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left a hdPos).trans hdaLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_affineActiveReverseDivisors_le
statement:
theorem card_affineActiveReverseDivisors_le
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z).prodPrimes) :
    (BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors
      (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z) d).card ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card
    (L.affineActiveReverseDivisors_subset_Icc hz hd)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.abs_affineMinimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
statement:
theorem abs_affineMinimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal
        (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z) d| ≤ (z : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  by_cases hdMem : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hdData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hdData.1)
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      rw [L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdData
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    have htermPos : 0 < s.selbergTerms d := s.selbergTerms_pos hdData.1
    have hmass : 1 ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s :=
      SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass s
    have hquot : s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s ≤
        s.selbergTerms d := div_le_self htermPos.le hmass
    have hmu : |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := d)
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_pos hdMem, abs_div, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos htermPos, abs_of_pos (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos s)]
    calc
      |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| * s.selbergTerms d /
          SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s =
          |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| *
            (s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * s.selbergTerms d := by
        exact mul_le_mul hmu hquot
          (div_nonneg htermPos.le (zero_le_one.trans hmass)) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ (d : ℝ) := by
        simpa using L.affineSelbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd hdData.1
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdLe
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_neg hdMem, abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.abs_affineMinimizingWeight_le_cube
statement:
theorem abs_affineMinimizingWeight_le_cube
    {R z d : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
        (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z) d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  by_cases hdMem : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hd := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).1
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      have hsquare := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).2
      rw [L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hsquare
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight,
      SelbergFundamental.weightFromDiagonal, dif_pos hd, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd)),
      BFPSTwoAffine.reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors hd]
    have hsum :
        |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
          (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
            (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
            (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
            ∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
              |(μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d, (z : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a ha
          rw [abs_mul]
          have hmu : |(μ a : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
            exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := a)
          exact (mul_le_mul hmu (L.abs_affineMinimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff hz)
            (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq (one_mul _)
        _ = ((BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d).card : ℝ) * z := by simp
        _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * z := by
          gcongr
          exact_mod_cast L.card_affineActiveReverseDivisors_le hz hd
        _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hnu := L.affineSieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd hd
    calc
      (s.nu d)⁻¹ *
          |∑ a ∈ BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors s d,
            (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
          (d : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hnu hsum (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hdLe) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated hdMem,
      abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.abs_lambdaSquared_affineMinimizingWeight_le_tenth
statement:
theorem abs_lambdaSquared_affineMinimizingWeight_le_tenth
    {R z n : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hn : n ≤ z ^ 2) :
    |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
        (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
          (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z)) n| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 10
proof:
:= by
  let w := SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
    (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z)
  have hw (d : ℕ) : |w d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
    L.abs_affineMinimizingWeight_le_cube hz
  have hterm (d₁ d₂ : ℕ) :
      |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    by_cases h : n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂
    · rw [if_pos h, abs_mul]
      calc
        |w d₁| * |w d₂| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 * (z : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
          mul_le_mul (hw d₁) (hw d₂) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by ring
    · rw [if_neg h, abs_zero]
      positivity
  have hinner (d₁ : ℕ) :
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    calc
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
          ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _d₂ ∈ n.divisors, (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro d₂ hd₂
        exact hterm d₁ d₂
      _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by simp
  unfold BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
  change |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
      ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
        if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ _
  have hcardNat : n.divisors.card ≤ n := Nat.card_divisors_le_self n
  have hcard : ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat.trans hn
  calc
    |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
          |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₁ hd₁
      exact hinner d₁
    _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      simp
      ring
    _ ≤ ((z : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by gcongr
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  intro d hd
  have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
  have hdPos := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
  rw [L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hdData
  have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hdData.2
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hdPos, hdLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_le
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z).card ≤ z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card
    (L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc (R := R) hz)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineLevelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant
statement:
theorem affineLevelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant (R z : ℕ) :
    SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder
        (L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z) ≤
      L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  unfold SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder
    affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro d hdMem
  by_cases hlevel : (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level
  · rw [if_pos hlevel, if_pos hlevel]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
    have hdDvd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdMem
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hdDvd)
    have hdSquarefree : Squarefree d :=
      Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdDvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
    exact L.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_le_two_pow_card_primeFactors
      hdPos hdSquarefree
  · rw [if_neg hlevel, if_neg hlevel]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth
statement:
theorem affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth
    {R z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 14
proof:
:= by
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  have heq : L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z =
      ∑ d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    unfold affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant affineMinimizingRemainderSupport
    change (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
          |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
              (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
            ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
        else 0) = _
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [heq]
  have hterm (d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z) :
      |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
    have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    have hdDvd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
    have hdSq : Squarefree d :=
      Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdDvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
    have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by
      have hlevel := hdData.2
      rw [L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hz] at hlevel
      exact_mod_cast hlevel
    have hlambda := L.abs_lambdaSquared_affineMinimizingWeight_le_tenth
      (R := R) hz hdLe
    have htwoNat := BFPSTwoAffine.two_pow_card_primeFactors_le_self hdPos hdSq
    have htwo : (((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast htwoNat.trans hdLe
    calc
      |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (z : ℝ) ^ 10 * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hlambda htwo (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by ring
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ _d ∈ L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z, (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      exact hterm d hd
    _ = ((L.affineMinimizingRemainderSupport R z).card : ℝ) *
        (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by simp
    _ ≤ ((z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
      gcongr
      exact_mod_cast L.card_affineMinimizingRemainderSupport_le (R := R) hz
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 14 := by norm_num; ring

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_fourteen_le_logSquaredScale
statement:
theorem selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_fourteen_le_logSquaredScale
    {R : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    (BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R : ℝ) ^ 14 ≤
      16 * logSquaredScale R
proof:
:= by
  let z := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R
  have hzNat : 1 ≤ z :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hzReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzNat
  have hpowNat : z ^ 32 ≤ R :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_le R
  have hpowReal : (z : ℝ) ^ 32 ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpowNat
  have hpow28 : (z : ℝ) ^ 28 ≤ (R : ℝ) :=
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ hzReal (show 28 ≤ 32 by norm_num)).trans hpowReal
  have hzsqrt : (z : ℝ) ^ 14 ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    calc
      ((z : ℝ) ^ 14) ^ 2 = (z : ℝ) ^ 28 := by ring
      _ ≤ (R : ℝ) := hpow28
  have hRreal : (1 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega)
  have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) < R := zero_lt_one.trans hRreal
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRreal
  have hsqrtPos : 0 < Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hRpos
  have hsqrtOne : (1 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt R := by
    exact (Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hlogSqrt := log_le_two_mul_sqrt hsqrtOne
  have hlogEq : Real.log (R : ℝ) = 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt R) := by
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hRpos.le]
    ring
  have hlogBound : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt R) := by
    rw [hlogEq]
    linarith
  have hlogSq : Real.log (R : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * Real.sqrt R := by
    have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlogPos.le hlogBound 2
    rw [show (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt R)) ^ 2 =
      16 * Real.sqrt R by
        rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hsqrtPos.le]
        norm_num] at hsquare
    exact hsquare
  unfold logSquaredScale
  change (z : ℝ) ^ 14 ≤ 16 * ((R : ℝ) / Real.log R ^ 2)
  rw [show 16 * ((R : ℝ) / Real.log R ^ 2) =
    (16 * (R : ℝ)) / Real.log R ^ 2 by ring]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hlogPos)).2
  calc
    (z : ℝ) ^ 14 * Real.log R ^ 2 ≤
        Real.sqrt R * (16 * Real.sqrt R) :=
      mul_le_mul hzsqrt hlogSq (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = 16 * (R : ℝ) := by
      rw [show Real.sqrt R * (16 * Real.sqrt R) =
        16 * (Real.sqrt R * Real.sqrt R) by ring,
        Real.mul_self_sqrt hRpos.le]
    _ = 16 * (R : ℝ) := rfl

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.minimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem minimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound_growingCutoff :
    L.MinimizingRemainderLogSquaredUpperBound
      BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff 16
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  let z := BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff R
  let s := L.minimizingAffineSelbergSieve R z
  have hz : 1 ≤ z :=
    BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  change s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
      (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s)) ≤
    16 * logSquaredScale R
  rw [SelbergFundamental.errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_levelRestrictedRemainder]
  calc
    SelbergFundamental.levelRestrictedRemainder s ≤
        L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant R z :=
      L.affineLevelRestrictedRemainder_le_majorant R z
    _ ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 14 :=
      L.affineMinimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth hz
    _ ≤ 16 * logSquaredScale R := by
      simpa [z] using selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_fourteen_le_logSquaredScale hR

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_mono
statement:
theorem growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_mono {S T : Finset ℕ} (h : S ⊆ T) :
    growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet S ≤ growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet T
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_of_subset h
  have hSpos := BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos S
  have hloss := BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss_pos
  have hbase : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hSpos.le) hloss.le
  have hstep : 64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct S *
      BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss ≤
        64 * BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct T *
          BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hprod) hloss.le]
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase hstep 2
  have hmax := max_le_max hsq (le_refl affineSmallMassConstant)
  unfold growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affinePrimePairGrowingConstant_le_of_subset
proof:
:=
  L.affinePrimePairGrowingConstant_eq_growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet.trans_le
    (growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet_mono h)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affinePrimePairGrowingConstant_le_of_exceptionalPrimeSet_subset

proof:
:=
  (L₁.affinePrimePairGrowingConstant_le_of_subset h).trans_eq
    L₂.affinePrimePairGrowingConstant_eq_growingConstantOfExceptionalPrimeSet.symm

name: RankAmplification.proposition9_5_diagonal_bound_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem proposition9_5_diagonal_bound_growingCutoff
    {x h Y : ℕ} {J : Finset ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hx : 3 ≤ x)

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.eval_nonneg

proof:
:= by
  unfold eval

    by_cases hdiv : d ∣ N
    · simpa [hdiv] using W.weight_nonneg d hd
    · simp [hdiv]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.eval_le_supNorm
statement:
theorem eval_le_supNorm {B N : ℕ} (hN : N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 B) :
    W.eval N ≤ W.supNorm B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnonempty : (Finset.Icc 1 B).Nonempty := ⟨N, hN⟩
  unfold supNorm
  rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
  exact Finset.le_max' _ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩)

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.supNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem supNorm_nonneg {B : ℕ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) : 0 ≤ W.supNorm B
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : 1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 B := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hB⟩
  exact (W.eval_nonneg 1).trans (W.eval_le_supNorm hmem)

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum_two
statement:
theorem sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum_two (W₁ W₂ : FiniteDivisorWeight) (x h : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W₁.eval n * W₂.eval (n + h) =
      ∑ d₂ ∈ W₂.support, ∑ d₁ ∈ W₁.support,
        W₁.weight d₁ * W₂.weight d₂ *
          (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [eval, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d₂ hd₂
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d₁ hd₁
  change (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x,
      (if d₁ ∣ n then W₁.weight d₁ else 0) *
        (if d₂ ∣ n + h then W₂.weight d₂ else 0)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x,
        if d₁ ∣ n ∧ d₂ ∣ n + h then W₁.weight d₁ * W₂.weight d₂ else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      by_cases h₁ : d₁ ∣ n <;> by_cases h₂ : d₂ ∣ n + h <;> simp [h₁, h₂]
    _ = ∑ n ∈ shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂, W₁.weight d₁ * W₂.weight d₂ := by
      unfold shiftedDivisibilitySet
      exact (Finset.sum_filter (s := Finset.Icc 1 x)
        (fun n ↦ d₁ ∣ n ∧ d₂ ∣ n + h)
        (fun _ ↦ W₁.weight d₁ * W₂.weight d₂)).symm
    _ = W₁.weight d₁ * W₂.weight d₂ *
        (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card := by
      simp [mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum_swapped
statement:
theorem sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum_swapped (x h : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * W.eval (n + h) =
      ∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support,
        W.weight d₂ * W.weight d₁ *
          (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₂ d₁).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [eval, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d₁ hd₁
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d₂ hd₂
  change (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x,
      (if d₂ ∣ n then W.weight d₂ else 0) *
        (if d₁ ∣ n + h then W.weight d₁ else 0)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x,
        if d₂ ∣ n ∧ d₁ ∣ n + h then W.weight d₂ * W.weight d₁ else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      by_cases h₂ : d₂ ∣ n <;> by_cases h₁ : d₁ ∣ n + h <;> simp [h₁, h₂]
    _ = ∑ n ∈ shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₂ d₁, W.weight d₂ * W.weight d₁ := by
      unfold shiftedDivisibilitySet
      exact (Finset.sum_filter (s := Finset.Icc 1 x)
        (fun n ↦ d₂ ∣ n ∧ d₁ ∣ n + h)
        (fun _ ↦ W.weight d₂ * W.weight d₁)).symm
    _ = W.weight d₂ * W.weight d₁ *
        (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₂ d₁).card := by
      simp [mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum
statement:
theorem sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum (x h : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * W.eval (n + h) =
      ∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support,
        W.weight d₁ * W.weight d₂ *
          (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum_swapped x h, Finset.sum_comm]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.shiftedDivisibilitySet_card_cast_le_two_mul_div
statement:
theorem shiftedDivisibilitySet_card_cast_le_two_mul_div {x h d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd₂ : 0 < d₂)
    (hlarge : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d₁ → h < p) (hprod : d₁ * d₂ ≤ x) :
    ((shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * x / (d₁ * d₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := shiftedDivisibilitySet_card_le (x := x) hh hd₁ hd₂ hlarge
  have hcardCast : ((shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((x / (d₁ * d₂) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  have hdiv : ((x / (d₁ * d₂) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (d₁ * d₂) :=
    by simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using
      (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := x) (n := d₁ * d₂))
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (d₁ : ℝ) * (d₂ : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / (d₁ * d₂) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
    norm_num
    exact_mod_cast hprod
  calc
    ((shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((x / (d₁ * d₂) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hcardCast
    _ = ((x / (d₁ * d₂) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ (x : ℝ) / (d₁ * d₂) + 1 := by linarith
    _ ≤ 2 * x / (d₁ * d₂) := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc]
      nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sqrt_lt_left_or_right_of_lt_mul
statement:
theorem sqrt_lt_left_or_right_of_lt_mul {x d₁ d₂ : ℕ} (hprod : x < d₁ * d₂) :
    x.sqrt < d₁ ∨ x.sqrt < d₂
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hmul : d₁ * d₂ ≤ x.sqrt * x.sqrt := Nat.mul_le_mul h.1 h.2
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hmul.trans (Nat.sqrt_le x))) hprod

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.largePairSum_le_tailPairSums
statement:
theorem largePairSum_le_tailPairSums (x h : ℕ) :
    W.largePairSum x h ≤
      W.leftTailPairSum x h x.sqrt + W.rightTailPairSum x h x.sqrt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let term : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun d₁ d₂ ↦
    W.weight d₁ * W.weight d₂ * (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card
  have hterm : ∀ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∀ d₂ ∈ W.support, 0 ≤ term d₁ d₂ := by
    intro d₁ hd₁ d₂ hd₂
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (W.weight_nonneg d₁ hd₁) (W.weight_nonneg d₂ hd₂)) (by positivity)
  unfold largePairSum leftTailPairSum rightTailPairSum
  change (∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with x < d₁ * d₂, term d₁ d₂) ≤ _
  calc
    (∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with x < d₁ * d₂, term d₁ d₂) ≤
        ∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, (
          (if x.sqrt < d₁ then ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support, term d₁ d₂ else 0) +
            ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with x.sqrt < d₂, term d₁ d₂) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₁ hd₁
      by_cases htail : x.sqrt < d₁
      · rw [if_pos htail]
        have hleft : (∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with x < d₁ * d₂, term d₁ d₂) ≤
            ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support, term d₁ d₂ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
            (fun d₂ hd₂ _ ↦ hterm d₁ hd₁ d₂ hd₂)
        have hright : 0 ≤ ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with x.sqrt < d₂, term d₁ d₂ :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg fun d₂ hd₂ ↦
            hterm d₁ hd₁ d₂ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd₂).1
        linarith
      · rw [if_neg htail, zero_add]
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        · intro d₂ hd₂
          have hd₂mem := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd₂).1
          have hprod := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd₂).2
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hd₂mem,
            (sqrt_lt_left_or_right_of_lt_mul hprod).resolve_left htail⟩
        · intro d₂ hd₂ _
          exact hterm d₁ hd₁ d₂ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd₂).1
    _ = (∑ d₁ ∈ W.support with x.sqrt < d₁, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support, term d₁ d₂) +
          ∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with x.sqrt < d₂, term d₁ d₂ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_filter]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.Icc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div
statement:
theorem Icc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div (x d : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (d ∣ ·)).card = x / d
proof:
:= by
  have hinterval : Finset.Icc 1 x = Finset.Ioc 0 x := by
    ext n
    simp
    omega
  rw [hinterval]
  exact Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div x d

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sum_dvd_indicator_eq
statement:
theorem sum_dvd_indicator_eq (x d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, if d ∣ n then a else 0) = a * (x / d : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, if d ∣ n then a else 0) =
        ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (d ∣ ·), a := by
      exact (Finset.sum_filter (s := Finset.Icc 1 x) (d ∣ ·) (fun _ ↦ a)).symm
    _ = a * ((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (d ∣ ·)).card := by simp [mul_comm]
    _ = a * (x / d : ℕ) := by rw [Icc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sum_eval_le_mul_mass
statement:
theorem sum_eval_le_mul_mass (x : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n) ≤ x * W.mass
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold eval mass
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ W.support, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x,
        if d ∣ n then W.weight d else 0) =
        ∑ d ∈ W.support, W.weight d * (x / d : ℕ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      exact sum_dvd_indicator_eq x d (W.weight d)
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ W.support, x * (W.weight d / d) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      have hcast : ((x / d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) / d := by
        simpa using (Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := x) (n := d))
      calc
        W.weight d * (x / d : ℕ) ≤ W.weight d * ((x : ℝ) / d) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcast (W.weight_nonneg d hd)
        _ = x * (W.weight d / d) := by
          field_simp [W.support_ne_zero hd]
    _ = x * ∑ d ∈ W.support, W.weight d / d := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.leftTailPairSum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem leftTailPairSum_eq_sum (x h H : ℕ) :
    W.leftTailPairSum x h H =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, (W.restrictAbove H).eval n * W.eval (n + h)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum_two, Finset.sum_comm]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.rightTailPairSum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem rightTailPairSum_eq_sum (x h H : ℕ) :
    W.rightTailPairSum x h H =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * (W.restrictAbove H).eval (n + h)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum_two, Finset.sum_comm]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sum_restrictAbove_eval_shift_le
statement:
theorem sum_restrictAbove_eval_shift_le {x h H : ℕ} (hhx : h ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, (W.restrictAbove H).eval (n + h)) ≤
      2 * x * W.tailMass H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : ℕ ↪ ℕ := addRightEmbedding h
  have hsubset : (Finset.Icc 1 x).map e ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * x) := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hm
    have hnIcc := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
    apply Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
    change 1 ≤ n + h ∧ n + h ≤ 2 * x
    omega
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, (W.restrictAbove H).eval (n + h)) =
        ∑ m ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 x).map e, (W.restrictAbove H).eval m := by
      rw [Finset.sum_map]
      rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * x), (W.restrictAbove H).eval m :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
        (fun m hm _ ↦ (W.restrictAbove H).eval_nonneg m)
    _ ≤ 2 * x * (W.restrictAbove H).mass := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
        (W.restrictAbove H).sum_eval_le_mul_mass (2 * x)
    _ = 2 * x * W.tailMass H := by rw [W.restrictAbove_mass]

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.leftTailPairSum_le
statement:
theorem leftTailPairSum_le {x h H : ℕ} {M : ℝ} (hhx : h ≤ x) (hMnonneg : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → N ≤ 2 * x → W.eval N ≤ M) :
    W.leftTailPairSum x h H ≤ x * M * W.tailMass H
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.leftTailPairSum_eq_sum]
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, (W.restrictAbove H).eval n * W.eval (n + h)) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, (W.restrictAbove H).eval n * M := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      have hnIcc := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hM (n + h) (by omega) (by omega)) ((W.restrictAbove H).eval_nonneg n)
    _ = (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, (W.restrictAbove H).eval n) * M := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ (x * (W.restrictAbove H).mass) * M :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((W.restrictAbove H).sum_eval_le_mul_mass x) hMnonneg
    _ = x * M * W.tailMass H := by
      rw [W.restrictAbove_mass]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.rightTailPairSum_le
statement:
theorem rightTailPairSum_le {x h H : ℕ} {M : ℝ} (hhx : h ≤ x) (hMnonneg : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → N ≤ 2 * x → W.eval N ≤ M) :
    W.rightTailPairSum x h H ≤ 2 * x * M * W.tailMass H
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.rightTailPairSum_eq_sum]
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * (W.restrictAbove H).eval (n + h)) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, M * (W.restrictAbove H).eval (n + h) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      have hnIcc := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (hM n hnIcc.1 (by omega)) ((W.restrictAbove H).eval_nonneg (n + h))
    _ = M * (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, (W.restrictAbove H).eval (n + h)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ M * (2 * x * W.tailMass H) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (W.sum_restrictAbove_eval_shift_le hhx) hMnonneg
    _ = 2 * x * M * W.tailMass H := by ring

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_small_add_large
statement:
theorem sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_small_add_large (x h : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * W.eval (n + h)) =
      W.smallPairSum x h + W.largePairSum x h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [W.sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_pair_sum]
  unfold smallPairSum largePairSum
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d₁ hd₁
  symm
  simpa only [not_le] using
    (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not W.support (fun d₂ ↦ d₁ * d₂ ≤ x)
      (fun d₂ ↦ W.weight d₁ * W.weight d₂ *
        (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card))

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.smallPairSum_le_two_mul_mass_sq
statement:
theorem smallPairSum_le_two_mul_mass_sq {x h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hlarge : ∀ d ∈ W.support, 0 < W.weight d →
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d → h < p) :
    W.smallPairSum x h ≤ 2 * x * W.mass ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold smallPairSum
  calc
    (∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with d₁ * d₂ ≤ x,
        W.weight d₁ * W.weight d₂ *
          (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card) ≤
        ∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support with d₁ * d₂ ≤ x,
          2 * x * (W.weight d₁ / d₁) * (W.weight d₂ / d₂) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₁ hd₁
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₂ hd₂
      have hd₂mem := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd₂).1
      have hprod := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd₂).2
      by_cases hw₁ : W.weight d₁ = 0
      · simp [hw₁]
      by_cases hw₂ : W.weight d₂ = 0
      · simp [hw₂]
      have hw₁pos : 0 < W.weight d₁ :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (W.weight_nonneg d₁ hd₁) (Ne.symm hw₁)
      have hw₂pos : 0 < W.weight d₂ :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (W.weight_nonneg d₂ hd₂mem) (Ne.symm hw₂)
      have hcount := shiftedDivisibilitySet_card_cast_le_two_mul_div
        hh (W.support_pos d₁ hd₁) (W.support_pos d₂ hd₂mem)
        (hlarge d₁ hd₁ hw₁pos) hprod
      calc
        W.weight d₁ * W.weight d₂ *
            (shiftedDivisibilitySet x h d₁ d₂).card ≤
            W.weight d₁ * W.weight d₂ * (2 * x / (d₁ * d₂)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount (mul_nonneg hw₁pos.le hw₂pos.le)
        _ = 2 * x * (W.weight d₁ / d₁) * (W.weight d₂ / d₂) := by
          field_simp [W.support_ne_zero hd₁, W.support_ne_zero hd₂mem]
    _ ≤ ∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support,
          2 * x * (W.weight d₁ / d₁) * (W.weight d₂ / d₂) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₁ hd₁
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        (fun d₂ hd₂ _ ↦
          mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
              (div_nonneg (W.weight_nonneg d₁ hd₁) (Nat.cast_nonneg d₁)))
            (div_nonneg (W.weight_nonneg d₂ hd₂) (Nat.cast_nonneg d₂)))
    _ = 2 * x * W.mass ^ 2 := by
      unfold mass
      calc
        (∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, ∑ d₂ ∈ W.support,
            2 * x * (W.weight d₁ / d₁) * (W.weight d₂ / d₂)) =
            ∑ d₁ ∈ W.support,
              (2 * x * (W.weight d₁ / d₁)) *
                (∑ d₂ ∈ W.support, W.weight d₂ / d₂) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro d₁ hd₁
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = (2 * x) * (∑ d₁ ∈ W.support, W.weight d₁ / d₁) *
              (∑ d₂ ∈ W.support, W.weight d₂ / d₂) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = 2 * x * (∑ d ∈ W.support, W.weight d / d) ^ 2 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.shifted_divisor_convolution
statement:
theorem shifted_divisor_convolution {x h : ℕ} {M : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhx : h ≤ x)
    (hMnonneg : 0 ≤ M)
    (hM : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → N ≤ 2 * x → W.eval N ≤ M)
    (hlarge : ∀ d ∈ W.support, 0 < W.weight d →
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d → h < p) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * W.eval (n + h)) ≤
      2 * x * W.mass ^ 2 + 4 * x * M * W.tailMass x.sqrt
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.sum_eval_mul_eval_eq_small_add_large]
  have hsmall := W.smallPairSum_le_two_mul_mass_sq (x := x) hh hlarge
  have hlargePairs := W.largePairSum_le_tailPairSums x h
  have hleft := W.leftTailPairSum_le hhx hMnonneg hM (H := x.sqrt)
  have hright := W.rightTailPairSum_le hhx hMnonneg hM (H := x.sqrt)
  have htailNonneg : 0 ≤ (x : ℝ) * M * W.tailMass x.sqrt := by
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg x) hMnonneg) (W.tailMass_nonneg x.sqrt)
  calc
    W.smallPairSum x h + W.largePairSum x h ≤
        2 * x * W.mass ^ 2 +
          (W.leftTailPairSum x h x.sqrt + W.rightTailPairSum x h x.sqrt) :=
      add_le_add hsmall hlargePairs
    _ ≤ 2 * x * W.mass ^ 2 +
          (x * M * W.tailMass x.sqrt + 2 * x * M * W.tailMass x.sqrt) :=
      add_le_add (le_refl _) (add_le_add hleft hright)
    _ ≤ 2 * x * W.mass ^ 2 + 4 * x * M * W.tailMass x.sqrt := by
      nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.FiniteDivisorWeight.shifted_divisor_convolution_supNorm
statement:
theorem shifted_divisor_convolution_supNorm {x h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhx : h ≤ x)
    (hlarge : ∀ d ∈ W.support, 0 < W.weight d →
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d → h < p) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * W.eval (n + h)) ≤
      2 * x * W.mass ^ 2 +
        4 * x * W.supNorm (2 * x) * W.tailMass x.sqrt
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 1 ≤ x := by omega
  apply W.shifted_divisor_convolution hh hhx (W.supNorm_nonneg (by omega))
  · intro N hN1 hN2
    exact W.eval_le_supNorm (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hN1, hN2⟩)
  · exact hlarge

name: RankAmplification.mem_sUnitAffineCarrier
statement:
@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem mem_sUnitAffineCarrier {S : Finset ℕ} {h : ℕ} {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier S h U) {u v : ℕ} :
    (u, v) ∈ U ↔ IsSUnitAffineSolution S h u v
proof:
:=
  hU u v

name: RankAmplification.IsPrimeSupportUnit.pos
statement:
theorem IsPrimeSupportUnit.pos {S : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : IsPrimeSupportUnit S n) : 0 < n

name: RankAmplification.IsPrimeSupportUnit.ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsPrimeSupportUnit.ne_zero {S : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : IsPrimeSupportUnit S n) : n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  hn.1.ne'

name: RankAmplification.IsPrimeSupportUnit.mono
proof:
:=
  ⟨hn.1, hn.2.trans hST⟩

name: RankAmplification.primeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport
statement:
theorem primeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    primeSupport j ⊆ primeSupport h
proof:
:= by
  intro p hpj
  have hpjh : p ∈ primeSupport (j + h) := by
    simpa only [hsame.2] using hpj
  have hpj_dvd : p ∣ j := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpj
  have hpjh_dvd : p ∣ j + h := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpjh
  have hph : p ∣ h := by
    simpa using Nat.dvd_sub hpjh_dvd hpj_dvd
  exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpj).mem_primeFactors hph hh.ne'

name: RankAmplification.shiftedPrimeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport
statement:
theorem shiftedPrimeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    primeSupport (j + h) ⊆ primeSupport h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hsame.2]
  exact primeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport hh hsame

name: RankAmplification.sameSupport_left_isPrimeSupportUnit
statement:
theorem sameSupport_left_isPrimeSupportUnit {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit (primeSupport h) j
proof:
:=
  ⟨zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1,
    primeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport hh hsame⟩

name: RankAmplification.sameSupport_right_isPrimeSupportUnit
statement:
theorem sameSupport_right_isPrimeSupportUnit {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit (primeSupport h) (j + h)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by omega, shiftedPrimeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport hh hsame⟩

name: RankAmplification.sameSupport_isSUnitAffineSolution
statement:
theorem sameSupport_isSUnitAffineSolution {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsSUnitAffineSolution (primeSupport h) h j (j + h)
proof:
:=
  ⟨sameSupport_left_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame,
    sameSupport_right_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_dvd_shift
statement: theorem diagonalGCD_dvd_shift (h j : ℕ) : diagonalGCD h j ∣ h
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Nat.dvd_sub (diagonalGCD_dvd_right h j)
    (diagonalGCD_dvd_left h j)

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitA
statement:
theorem diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitA (h j : ℕ) :
    diagonalGCD h j * normalizedSUnitA h j = j
proof:
:= by
  exact diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalB h j

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitB
statement:
theorem diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitB (h j : ℕ) :
    diagonalGCD h j * normalizedSUnitB h j = j + h
proof:
:= by
  exact diagonalGCD_mul_diagonalA h j

name: RankAmplification.diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitC
statement:
theorem diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitC (h j : ℕ) :
    diagonalGCD h j * normalizedSUnitC h j = h
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedSUnitC, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (diagonalGCD_dvd_shift h j)]

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitA_pos
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitA_pos {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    0 < normalizedSUnitA h j
proof:
:=
  diagonalB_pos hj

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitB_pos
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitB_pos {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    0 < normalizedSUnitB h j
proof:
:=
  diagonalA_pos hj

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitC_pos
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitC_pos {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hj : 0 < j) :
    0 < normalizedSUnitC h j
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.div_pos
  · exact Nat.le_of_dvd hh (diagonalGCD_dvd_shift h j)
  · exact Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (j + h) hj

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnit_affine
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnit_affine {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    normalizedSUnitA h j + normalizedSUnitC h j = normalizedSUnitB h j
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (j + h) hj)
  calc
    diagonalGCD h j * (normalizedSUnitA h j + normalizedSUnitC h j) =
        j + h := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitA,
        diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitC]
    _ = diagonalGCD h j * normalizedSUnitB h j :=
      (diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitB h j).symm

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnit_coprime
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnit_coprime {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    Nat.Coprime (normalizedSUnitA h j) (normalizedSUnitB h j)
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd
    (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left (j + h) hj)

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnit_coprime_a_c
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnit_coprime_a_c {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    Nat.Coprime (normalizedSUnitA h j) (normalizedSUnitC h j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.coprime_self_add_right]
  rw [normalizedSUnit_affine hj]
  exact normalizedSUnit_coprime hj

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnit_coprime_b_c
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnit_coprime_b_c {h j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    Nat.Coprime (normalizedSUnitB h j) (normalizedSUnitC h j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalizedSUnit_affine hj]
  rw [Nat.coprime_add_self_left]
  exact normalizedSUnit_coprime_a_c hj

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitA_dvd_left
statement: theorem normalizedSUnitA_dvd_left (h j : ℕ) : normalizedSUnitA h j ∣ j
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨diagonalGCD h j, (diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitA h j).symm.trans
    (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitB_dvd_right
statement: theorem normalizedSUnitB_dvd_right (h j : ℕ) : normalizedSUnitB h j ∣ j + h
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨diagonalGCD h j, (diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitB h j).symm.trans
    (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitC_dvd_shift
statement: theorem normalizedSUnitC_dvd_shift (h j : ℕ) : normalizedSUnitC h j ∣ h
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨diagonalGCD h j, (diagonalGCD_mul_normalizedSUnitC h j).symm.trans
    (Nat.mul_comm _ _)⟩

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitA_isPrimeSupportUnit
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitA_isPrimeSupportUnit {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit (primeSupport h) (normalizedSUnitA h j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨normalizedSUnitA_pos (zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1), ?_⟩
  exact (Nat.primeFactors_mono (normalizedSUnitA_dvd_left h j)
    (sameSupport_left_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame).ne_zero).trans
      (primeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport hh hsame)

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitB_isPrimeSupportUnit
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitB_isPrimeSupportUnit {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit (primeSupport h) (normalizedSUnitB h j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨normalizedSUnitB_pos (zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1), ?_⟩
  exact (Nat.primeFactors_mono (normalizedSUnitB_dvd_right h j)
    (sameSupport_right_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame).ne_zero).trans
      (shiftedPrimeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport hh hsame)

name: RankAmplification.normalizedSUnitC_isPrimeSupportUnit
statement:
theorem normalizedSUnitC_isPrimeSupportUnit {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsPrimeSupportUnit (primeSupport h) (normalizedSUnitC h j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨normalizedSUnitC_pos hh (zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1), ?_⟩
  exact Nat.primeFactors_mono (normalizedSUnitC_dvd_shift h j) hh.ne'

name: RankAmplification.sameSupport_isNormalizedSUnitTriple
statement:
theorem sameSupport_isNormalizedSUnitTriple {h j : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsame : IsSameSupportIndex h j) :
    IsNormalizedSUnitTriple (primeSupport h)
      (normalizedSUnitA h j) (normalizedSUnitB h j) (normalizedSUnitC h j) where
  a_unit
proof:
:= normalizedSUnitA_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame
  b_unit := normalizedSUnitB_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame
  c_unit := normalizedSUnitC_isPrimeSupportUnit hh hsame
  affine := normalizedSUnit_affine (zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1)
  coprime_ab := normalizedSUnit_coprime (zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1)
  coprime_ac := normalizedSUnit_coprime_a_c (zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1)
  coprime_bc := normalizedSUnit_coprime_b_c (zero_lt_one.trans_le hsame.1)

name: RankAmplification.mem_sameSupportAffineImage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sameSupportAffineImage {h : ℕ} {J : Finset ℕ} {u v : ℕ} :
    (u, v) ∈ sameSupportAffineImage h J ↔ u ∈ J ∧ v = u + h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro huv
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hpair⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp huv
    have hu : j = u := congrArg Prod.fst hpair
    subst u
    exact ⟨hj, (congrArg Prod.snd hpair).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hu, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.card_sameSupportAffineImage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_sameSupportAffineImage (h : ℕ) (J : Finset ℕ) :
    (sameSupportAffineImage h J).card = J.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_map _

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportAffineImage_subset_sUnitCarrier
statement:
theorem sameSupportAffineImage_subset_sUnitCarrier
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {J : Finset ℕ} {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J)
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h U) :
    sameSupportAffineImage h J ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨u, v⟩ := z
  have hzData := mem_sameSupportAffineImage.mp hz
  rw [hzData.2]
  exact (hU u (u + h)).mpr
    (sameSupport_isSUnitAffineSolution hh ((hJ u).mp hzData.1))

name: RankAmplification.card_sameSupportCarrier_le_sUnitCarrier
statement:
theorem card_sameSupportCarrier_le_sUnitCarrier
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {J : Finset ℕ} {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J)
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h U) :
    J.card ≤ U.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_sameSupportAffineImage h J]
  exact Finset.card_le_card
    (sameSupportAffineImage_subset_sUnitCarrier hh hJ hU)

name: RankAmplification.isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit
statement:
theorem isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h U) :
    IsSameSupportCarrier h (sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit h U)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro j
  constructor
  · intro hj
    rw [sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit, Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    exact hj.2
  · intro hj
    rw [sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, hj⟩
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨(j, j + h), ?_, rfl⟩
    exact (hU j (j + h)).mpr (sameSupport_isSUnitAffineSolution hh hj)

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportAffineImage_fromSUnit_eq_part
statement:
theorem sameSupportAffineImage_fromSUnit_eq_part
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h U) :
    sameSupportAffineImage h (sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit h U) =
      sameSupportPartOfSUnitCarrier h U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z
  obtain ⟨u, v⟩ := z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzData := mem_sameSupportAffineImage.mp hz
    have huCarrier : u ∈ U.image Prod.fst ∧ IsSameSupportIndex h u := by
      simpa only [sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit, Finset.mem_filter] using hzData.1
    have hsame := huCarrier.2
    have hv : v = u + h := hzData.2
    rw [sameSupportPartOfSUnitCarrier, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, hsame⟩
    rw [hv]
    exact (hU u (u + h)).mpr (sameSupport_isSUnitAffineSolution hh hsame)
  · intro hz
    have hzData : (u, v) ∈ U ∧ IsSameSupportIndex h u := by
      simpa only [sameSupportPartOfSUnitCarrier, Finset.mem_filter] using hz
    have hsolution := (hU u v).mp hzData.1
    apply mem_sameSupportAffineImage.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, hsolution.2.2.symm⟩
    rw [sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, hzData.2⟩
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(u, v), hzData.1, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.card_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit_eq_part
statement:
theorem card_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit_eq_part
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h U) :
    (sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit h U).card =
      (sameSupportPartOfSUnitCarrier h U).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_sameSupportAffineImage h (sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit h U),
    sameSupportAffineImage_fromSUnit_eq_part hh hU]

name: RankAmplification.card_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit_le
statement:
theorem card_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit_le
    (h : ℕ) (U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    (sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit h U).card ≤ U.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit
  calc
    ((U.image Prod.fst).filter (IsSameSupportIndex h)).card ≤ (U.image Prod.fst).card :=
      Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    _ ≤ U.card := Finset.card_image_le

name: RankAmplification.terminalEvertseSUnitCarrier_spec
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitCarrier_spec (h : ℕ)
    (hE : TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h) :
    IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h (terminalEvertseSUnitCarrier h hE)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec hE

name: RankAmplification.isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse
statement:
theorem isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hE : TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h) :
    IsSameSupportCarrier h (sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse h hE)
proof:
:=
  isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierFromSUnit hh
    (terminalEvertseSUnitCarrier_spec h hE)

name: RankAmplification.exists_isSameSupportCarrier_of_terminalEvertse
statement:
theorem exists_isSameSupportCarrier_of_terminalEvertse
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hE : TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h) :
    ∃ J : Finset ℕ, IsSameSupportCarrier h J
proof:
:=
  ⟨sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse h hE,
    isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse hh hE⟩

name: RankAmplification.isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierOfPPT
statement:
theorem isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierOfPPT
    (h : ℕ) (hPPT : TerminalPPTSameSupportBound h) :
    IsSameSupportCarrier h (sameSupportCarrierOfPPT h hPPT)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec hPPT).1

name: RankAmplification.card_sameSupportCarrierOfPPT_le
statement:
theorem card_sameSupportCarrierOfPPT_le
    (h : ℕ) (hPPT : TerminalPPTSameSupportBound h) :
    (sameSupportCarrierOfPPT h hPPT).card ≤ pptSameSupportBound h
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec hPPT).2

name: RankAmplification.IsPrimeSupportUnit.odd_of_shift_odd
statement:
theorem IsPrimeSupportUnit.odd_of_shift_odd {h n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h)
    (hn : IsPrimeSupportUnit (primeSupport h) n) : Odd n
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp
  intro hneven
  have htwo_dvd_n : 2 ∣ n := even_iff_two_dvd.mp hneven
  have htwo_mem_n : 2 ∈ primeSupport n :=
    Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_two, htwo_dvd_n, hn.ne_zero⟩
  have htwo_mem_h : 2 ∈ primeSupport h := hn.2 htwo_mem_n
  have htwo_dvd_h : 2 ∣ h := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors htwo_mem_h
  exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd) (even_iff_two_dvd.mpr htwo_dvd_h)

name: RankAmplification.not_isSUnitAffineSolution_of_odd
statement:
theorem not_isSUnitAffineSolution_of_odd {h u v : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    ¬IsSUnitAffineSolution (primeSupport h) h u v
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hu, hv, huv⟩
  have huodd : Odd u := hu.odd_of_shift_odd hodd
  have hvodd : Odd v := hv.odd_of_shift_odd hodd
  have heven : Even (u + h) :=
    Nat.even_add'.mpr ⟨fun _ ↦ hodd, fun _ ↦ huodd⟩
  rw [huv] at heven
  exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hvodd) heven

name: RankAmplification.sUnitAffineCarrier_eq_empty_of_odd
statement:
theorem sUnitAffineCarrier_eq_empty_of_odd
    {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) {U : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hU : IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h U) :
    U = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
  rintro ⟨u, v⟩ huv
  exact not_isSUnitAffineSolution_of_odd hodd ((hU u v).mp huv)

name: RankAmplification.isSUnitAffineCarrier_empty_of_odd
statement:
theorem isSUnitAffineCarrier_empty_of_odd {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    IsSUnitAffineCarrier (primeSupport h) h ∅
proof:
:= by
  intro u v
  simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, false_iff]
  exact not_isSUnitAffineSolution_of_odd hodd

name: RankAmplification.terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_odd
statement:
theorem terminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness_of_odd {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h
proof:
:=
  ⟨∅, isSUnitAffineCarrier_empty_of_odd hodd⟩

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportCarrier_eq_empty_of_odd
statement:
theorem sameSupportCarrier_eq_empty_of_odd
    {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) {J : Finset ℕ}
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J) :
    J = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [hJ j]
  simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false]
  exact not_isSameSupportIndex_of_odd hodd

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportAffineImage_eq_empty_of_odd
statement:
theorem sameSupportAffineImage_eq_empty_of_odd
    {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) {J : Finset ℕ}
    (hJ : IsSameSupportCarrier h J) :
    sameSupportAffineImage h J = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [sameSupportCarrier_eq_empty_of_odd hodd hJ]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_odd
statement:
theorem terminalPPTSameSupportBound_of_odd {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) :
    TerminalPPTSameSupportBound h
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∅, isSameSupportCarrier_empty_of_odd hodd, ?_⟩
  simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.zero_le]

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse_eq_empty_of_odd
statement:
theorem sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse_eq_empty_of_odd
    {h : ℕ} (hodd : Odd h) (hE : TerminalEvertseSUnitFiniteness h) :
    sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse h hE = ∅
proof:
:=
  sameSupportCarrier_eq_empty_of_odd hodd
    (isSameSupportCarrier_sameSupportCarrierOfEvertse hodd.pos hE)

name: RankAmplification.paperDemandCandidates_card_le
proof:
:= by
  have hScard : (((q - 1).primeFactors.filter fun p ↦ y < p).card) ≤ Nat.log y (2 * x) := by
    set S : Finset ℕ := (q - 1).primeFactors.filter fun p ↦ y < p with hSdef
    have hsub : S ⊆ (q - 1).primeFactors := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    have hprod : (∏ p ∈ S, p) ∣ q - 1 :=
      (Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset S (q - 1).primeFactors (fun p ↦ p) hsub).trans
        (Nat.prod_primeFactors_dvd (q - 1))
    have hq1 : 0 < q - 1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq.one_lt
    have hle : (∏ p ∈ S, p) ≤ q - 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd hq1 hprod
    have hpow : y ^ S.card ≤ ∏ p ∈ S, p := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_const]
      refine Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) ?_
      intro p hp
      exact le_of_lt (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    have hfinal : y ^ S.card ≤ 2 * x :=
      hpow.trans (hle.trans ((Nat.sub_le q 1).trans hqx))
    exact Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by omega) hfinal
  cases kind with
  | linear =>
      simpa [paperDemandCandidates, supplierDemandCandidates] using
        hScard.trans (Nat.le_succ _)
  | power =>
      simp only [paperDemandCandidates, supplierDemandCandidates, Finset.filter_insert]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right hScard 1)
      · exact hScard.trans (Nat.le_succ _)

name: RankAmplification.natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with hx | hx
  · subst hx
    simp [paperSlotWidth]
  have hkey : Nat.log y (2 * x) ≤ ⌊Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T⌋₊ := by
    set k : ℕ := Nat.log y (2 * x) with hkdef
    have hpow : y ^ k ≤ 2 * x := Nat.pow_log_le_self y (by omega)
    have hpowReal : ((y : ℝ)) ^ k ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
      have := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mpr hpow
      push_cast at this
      exact this
    have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < (y : ℝ) := by
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
      linarith
    have hTlog : T ≤ Real.log (y : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hypos]
      exact hyT
    have hlogpow : (k : ℝ) * Real.log (y : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
      have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (x : ℝ) := by
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
        linarith
      have := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hpowReal
      rwa [Real.log_pow] at this
    have hkT : (k : ℝ) * T ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k, Real.log_pos (show (1 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)]
    have hkdiv : (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hT]
      exact hkT
    exact Nat.le_floor hkdiv
  unfold paperSlotWidth
  omega

name: RankAmplification.slotIndexOfFinset_val_eq
proof:

  have hfin : S.equivFin p = S.equivFin p' := by

  exact congrArg Subtype.val (S.equivFin.injective hfin)

name: RankAmplification.paperCombinatorialCode_partition_eq
statement:
theorem paperCombinatorialCode_partition_eq {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M)
    {a b : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x}
    (hcode : paperCombinatorialCode hy hY hM a = paperCombinatorialCode hy hY hM b) :
    a.2.partition = b.2.partition
proof:
:= by
  apply LabelPartition.minBlockCode_injective
  funext i
  have hslot := congrArg (fun c : SlotCombinatorialCode J M ↦ c.2.2 i) hcode
  have hpair : supplierPairSlot (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i)
      (paperCandidateIndex hy hY hM a i) =
      supplierPairSlot (b.2.partition.minBlockCode i)
        (paperCandidateIndex hy hY hM b i) := by
    simpa [paperCombinatorialCode, paperDemandSlot] using hslot
  have hpairs :
      (a.2.partition.minBlockCode i, paperCandidateIndex hy hY hM a i) =
        (b.2.partition.minBlockCode i, paperCandidateIndex hy hY hM b i) :=
    supplierPairSlot_injective (by simpa using hpair)
  exact congrArg Prod.fst hpairs
