name: RankAmplification.paperWeightedCode_injective
statement:
theorem paperWeightedCode_injective {J y Y x M : ℕ} (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) :
    Function.Injective
      (paperWeightedCode hy hY hM : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x →
        AggregateWeightedCode J y Y M)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hcode
  have hlinear : aggregateLinearTuple a = aggregateLinearTuple b :=
    congrArg Prod.fst hcode
  have hpower : aggregatePowerTuple a = aggregatePowerTuple b :=
    congrArg (fun c : AggregateWeightedCode J y Y M ↦ c.2.1) hcode
  have hcomb : paperCombinatorialCode hy hY hM a = paperCombinatorialCode hy hY hM b :=
    congrArg (fun c : AggregateWeightedCode J y Y M ↦ c.2.2) hcode
  have hpartition := paperCombinatorialCode_partition_eq hy hY hM hcomb
  have hbase : ∀ i : Fin J,
      (a.labelDescriptor i).base = (b.labelDescriptor i).base := by
    intro i
    let r := a.2.partition.minBlockCode i
    have hr : r = b.2.partition.minBlockCode i :=
      congrFun (congrArg LabelPartition.minBlockCode hpartition) i
    have hidemA : a.2.partition.minBlockCode r = r :=
      a.2.partition.minBlockCode_idem i
    have hidemB : b.2.partition.minBlockCode r = r := by
      rw [hr]
      exact b.2.partition.minBlockCode_idem i
    have hblockB : b.2.partition.blockOf r = b.2.partition.blockOf i := by
      rw [hr]
      exact b.2.partition.blockOf_minBlockCode i
    have htypeR := paperCombinatorialCode_sourceType_eq hy hY hM hcomb r
    have hlinearR := congrFun hlinear r
    have hpowerR := congrFun hpower r
    have hdescBase : (a.labelDescriptor r).base =
        (b.labelDescriptor r).base := by
      cases ha : a.labelDescriptor r with
      | inl da =>
          cases hb : b.labelDescriptor r with
          | inl db =>
              have hpred : da.natBase - 1 = db.natBase - 1 := by
                simpa [aggregateLinearTuple,
                  SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor,
                  hidemA, hidemB, ha, hb] using hlinearR
              have hda := da.base_prime.one_lt
              have hdb := db.base_prime.one_lt
              simpa [SupplierDescriptor.base, ha, hb] using
                (show da.natBase = db.natBase by
                  calc
                    da.natBase = (da.natBase - 1) + 1 :=
                      (Nat.sub_add_cancel hda.le).symm
                    _ = (db.natBase - 1) + 1 := by rw [hpred]
                    _ = db.natBase := Nat.sub_add_cancel hdb.le)
          | inr db =>
              simp [SupplierDescriptor.sourceType, ha, hb] at htypeR
      | inr da =>
          cases hb : b.labelDescriptor r with
          | inl db =>
              simp [SupplierDescriptor.sourceType, ha, hb] at htypeR
          | inr db =>
              have hchoice : da.toPowerSourceChoice = db.toPowerSourceChoice := by
                simpa [aggregatePowerTuple, hidemA, hidemB, ha, hb] using hpowerR
              simpa [SupplierDescriptor.base, ha, hb] using
                da.base_eq_of_powerSourceChoice_eq db hchoice
    unfold AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor at hdescBase ⊢
    rw [a.2.partition.blockOf_minBlockCode i] at hdescBase
    rw [hblockB] at hdescBase
    exact hdescBase
  have hvalue : a.1.value = b.1.value := by
    funext i
    exact paperCandidateIndex_value_injective hy hY hM
      (paperCombinatorialCode_sourceType_eq hy hY hM hcomb i)
      (hbase i)
      (paperCombinatorialCode_candidateIndex_eq hy hY hM hcomb i)
  have hdemands : a.1 = b.1 :=
    LabelledPrimeDemands.eq_of_value_eq hvalue
  cases a with
  | mk P s =>
      cases b with
      | mk Q t =>
          dsimp only at hdemands
          subst Q
          have hs : s = t := by
            cases s with
            | mk pi descriptor bases_injective =>
                cases t with
                | mk rho otherDescriptor otherBases_injective =>
                    dsimp only at hcomb hbase
                    have hpi : pi = rho :=
                      paperCombinatorialCode_partition_eq hy hY hM hcomb
                    subst rho
                    have hdescriptor : descriptor = otherDescriptor := by
                      funext B
                      apply SupplierDescriptor.eq_of_base_eq
                      have hbaseB := hbase B.representative
                      unfold AggregateSupplierEntry.labelDescriptor at hbaseB
                      rw [pi.blockOf_representative B] at hbaseB
                      exact hbaseB
                    cases hdescriptor
                    rfl
          cases hs
          rfl

name: RankAmplification.paperPredecessorFibreCode_injective
statement:
theorem paperPredecessorFibreCode_injective {J y Y x H M m : ℕ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) :
    Function.Injective
      (paperPredecessorFibreCode hy hx hY hM :
        AggregatePredecessorFibreEntry J y Y x H m →
          AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply paperWeightedCode_injective hy hY hM
  unfold paperWeightedCode
  apply Prod.ext
  · change aggregateLinearTuple a.1 = aggregateLinearTuple b.1
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun
      (congrArg (fun c : AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m ↦ c.1.1) h) i
    exact congrArg Fin.val hi
  · change (aggregatePowerTuple a.1, paperCombinatorialCode hy hY hM a.1) =
      (aggregatePowerTuple b.1, paperCombinatorialCode hy hY hM b.1)
    exact congrArg Prod.snd h

name: RankAmplification.paperPredecessorFibreMass_le_weightedPower
statement:
theorem paperPredecessorFibreMass_le_weightedPower {J y Y x H M m : ℕ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hM : Nat.log y (2 * x) + 1 ≤ M) (hm : 0 < m) :
    aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m ≤
      slotEncodingFactor J M * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J *
        ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := AggregatePredecessorFibreEntry J y Y x H m
  let encode : F → AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m :=
    paperPredecessorFibreCode hy hx hY hM
  have hencode : Function.Injective encode :=
    paperPredecessorFibreCode_injective hy hx hY hM
  have hmass : aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m =
      ∑ a : F, 1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ) := by
    unfold aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass F
    symm
    simpa only [Finset.univ_eq_attach] using
      (Finset.sum_attach
        ((aggregateSupplierTailEntries J y Y x H).filter
          (fun a ↦ a.2.linearPredecessorProduct = m))
        (fun a ↦ 1 / (a.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ)))
  have hentry : ∀ a : F,
      1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ) ≤
        aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) := by
    intro a
    calc
      1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ) ≤
          1 / (∏ i, aggregateLinearTuple a.1 i : ℕ) *
            ∏ i, powerSourceChoiceWeight (aggregatePowerTuple a.1 i) :=
        aggregateEntry_reciprocal_le_codeWeight a.1
      _ = aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) := by
        unfold aggregateFibreCodeWeight encode
        rw [aggregateLinearTuple_prod, (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).2]
        rfl
  have himage :
      (∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset F).image encode,
          aggregateFibreCodeWeight c) =
        ∑ a : F, aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    intro a _ b _ hab
    exact hencode hab
  have hcodeSum :
      (∑ a : F, aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a)) ≤
        ∑ c : AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m,
          aggregateFibreCodeWeight c := by
    rw [← himage]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun c _ _ ↦ aggregateFibreCodeWeight_nonneg c)
  rw [hmass]
  calc
    (∑ a : F, 1 / (a.1.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ a : F, aggregateFibreCodeWeight (encode a) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ ↦ hentry a
    _ ≤ ∑ c : AggregateFibreCode J y Y x M m,
        aggregateFibreCodeWeight c := hcodeSum
    _ = (Fintype.card (PositiveProductTuple J (2 * x) m) : ℝ) *
        Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M) *
          (1 / (m : ℝ) * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J) :=
      aggregateFibreCodeWeight_sum
    _ ≤ (orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) *
        Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M) *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        · exact_mod_cast positiveProductTuple_card_le_orderedDivisorCount J (2 * x) m
        · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
      · exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg J y Y J)
    _ ≤ (orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) * slotEncodingFactor J M *
        (1 / (m : ℝ) * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        · exact_mod_cast slotCombinatorialCode_card_le J M
        · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
      · exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg J y Y J)
    _ = slotEncodingFactor J M * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y J *
        ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m) := by
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_injective
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_injective {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) :
    Function.Injective
      (paperWeightedCode hy hY (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) (x := x) hy hT hyT) :
        AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x → AggregateWeightedCode J y Y (paperSlotWidth J x T))
proof:
:=
  paperWeightedCode_injective hy hY _

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)) ≤
      (4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:=
  section10_lemma10_10_slot_card hJ (by
    unfold paperSlotWidth
    omega)

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_fibre_mass
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_10_paper_fibre_mass {J y Y x H m : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ))
    (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) (hm : 0 < m) :
    aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m ≤
      ((4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J) : ℕ) * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) *
        ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m)
proof:
:= by
  have hMpos : 0 < paperSlotWidth J x T := by
    unfold paperSlotWidth
    omega
  have hypos : 0 < y := by omega
  refine (paperPredecessorFibreMass_le_weightedPower hy hx hY
    (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) hy hT hyT) hm).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
  refine mul_le_mul ?_ (powerSourceTupleMass_le_exp hypos)
    (powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg _ _ _ _) (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast slotEncodingFactor_le_paperFactor hJ hMpos

name: RankAmplification.hasWeightedPowerFibreBound_paperSlotWidth
statement:
theorem hasWeightedPowerFibreBound_paperSlotWidth {J y Y x H Hcode : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ))
    (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x) :
    HasWeightedPowerFibreBound J y Y x H Hcode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  exact paperPredecessorFibreMass_le_weightedPower hy hx hY
    (natLogSucc_le_paperSlotWidth (J := J) hy hT hyT)
    (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mp hm).1)

name: RankAmplification.section10_proposition10_11_paper_slot
statement:
theorem section10_proposition10_11_paper_slot {J y Y x H Hcode : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ))
    (hx : 0 < x) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (hthreshold : 2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y, (supplierReciprocalTail P x H : ℝ)) ≤
      ((4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J) : ℕ) * Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  have hMpos : 0 < paperSlotWidth J x T := by
    unfold paperSlotWidth
    omega
  have hypos : 0 < y := by omega
  refine (section10_proposition10_11 hypos hx hthreshold
    (hasWeightedPowerFibreBound_paperSlotWidth hy hT hyT hx hY)).trans ?_
  have htail : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ htail
  rw [finitePowerEncodingFactor]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.exp_pos _).le
  exact_mod_cast slotEncodingFactor_le_paperFactor hJ hMpos

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotWidth_satisfiable

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_10_paper_injective_nonvacuous

        (paperWeightedCode (J := 4) (y := 2) (Y := 16) (x := 2000)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError_div_scaleV_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError_div_scaleV_zero :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError x / scaleV (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmajor : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hreal : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ log2 t / scaleV t) atTop (nhds 0) :=
      log2_isLittleO_scaleV.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
    have hnat := hreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (2 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 2) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [mul_zero, Function.comp] using hconst.mul hnat
  have hbig : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, (18 : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 18
  refine squeeze_zero' ?_ ?_ hmajor
  · filter_upwards [hbig, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hLx hVx
    unfold variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError
    have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hone) hVx.le
  · filter_upwards [hbig, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hLx hVx
    unfold variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hle : 18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hsq : Real.log (scaleL (x : ℝ) ^ 2) = 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.log_pow]
      norm_num
    have hlog : Real.log (18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) := by
      have hmono := Real.log_le_log hpos hle
      rwa [hsq] at hmono
    calc
      Real.log (18 + 16 * scaleL (x : ℝ)) / scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤
          2 * log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog hVx.le
      _ = 2 * (log2 (x : ℝ) / scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.isSection5UniformLittleOScaleV_variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError
statement:
theorem isSection5UniformLittleOScaleV_variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError (c₀ C₀ : ℝ) :
    IsSection5UniformLittleOScaleV c₀ C₀
      (fun x _ ↦ variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError x)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  have habs : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ |variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError x / scaleV (x : ℝ)|)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [abs_zero] using
      tendsto_variableCutoffB4AbsoluteError_div_scaleV_zero.abs
  filter_upwards [habs.eventually_le_const hε, eventually_scaleV_nat_pos] with x hx hV
  intro _T _hwindow
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hV] at hx
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hV).1 hx

name: RankAmplification.corollary7_2_fixed_ratio_counting
statement:
theorem corollary7_2_fixed_ratio_counting
    {c₀ C₀ lam : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀)
    (hlow : c₀ ≤ lam) (hhigh : lam ≤ C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y : ℕ,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y → Odd h →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y (lam * scaleG (x : ℝ)) →
      (shiftedEqualTotientCount x h : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-(min lam lam⁻¹ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) +
            variableCutoffRankOneError c₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hlam : 0 < lam := hc₀.trans_le hlow
  filter_upwards [proposition7_1_variableCutoff_unconditional hc₀ hC₀,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x hprop hcore
  intro h y hh hhy hodd hcutoff
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hcore.1 hcore.2.2.1
  have hwindow : IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) (lam * scaleG (x : ℝ)) :=
    ⟨mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlow hG.le,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhigh hG.le⟩
  have hcount := hprop h y (lam * scaleG (x : ℝ)) hh hhy hodd hcutoff hwindow
  have hexp := corollary7_2_fixed_ratio (X := (x : ℝ)) hG.ne' hlam.ne'
  unfold section5SaddleExponent at hexp
  rwa [hexp] at hcount

name: RankAmplification.eventually_saddleBracket_sub_scaleA_le_window
statement:
theorem eventually_saddleBracket_sub_scaleA_le_window
    {c₀ C₀ ε : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T : ℝ,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      |log2 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) + log3 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) - scaleA (x : ℝ)| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have herr : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop,
      fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x ≤ ε / C₀ :=
    (tendsto_fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError_zero hc₀ hC₀.le).eventually_le_const
      (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [eventually_abs_fixedRankSmoothRate_sub_scaleG_sq_div_le hc₀ hC₀.le,
      herr,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_moving_core_positive] with x habs herrx hcore
  intro T hwindow
  have hL : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) := hcore.1
  have hA : 0 < scaleA (x : ℝ) := hcore.2.2.1
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hT : 0 < T := (mul_pos hc₀ hG).trans_le hwindow.1
  have hz : 0 < scaleL (x : ℝ) / T := div_pos hL hT
  have hrate : fixedRankSmoothRate (x : ℝ) T - scaleG (x : ℝ) ^ 2 / T =
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / T *
        (log2 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) + log3 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) - scaleA (x : ℝ)) := by
    unfold fixedRankSmoothRate
    rw [scaleG_sq hL.le hA.le]
    ring
  have habsT := habs T hwindow
  rw [hrate, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hz] at habsT
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) :=
    le_trans (mul_nonneg hz.le (abs_nonneg _)) habsT
  have herrnn : 0 ≤ fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x := by
    rcases lt_or_ge (fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x) 0 with hcon | hcon
    · linarith [mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hcon hV]
    · exact hcon
  have herrC : fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * C₀ ≤ ε :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hC₀).1 herrx
  have hzlow : scaleV (x : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) := by
    have hstep : scaleL (x : ℝ) / (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) ≤ scaleL (x : ℝ) / T :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hL.le hT hwindow.2
    have heq : scaleL (x : ℝ) / (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) = scaleV (x : ℝ) / C₀ := by
      rw [scaleV_eq]
      field_simp
    rw [heq] at hstep
    have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hC₀).1 hstep
    linarith [hmul]
  have hchain : scaleL (x : ℝ) / T *
      |log2 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) + log3 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) - scaleA (x : ℝ)| ≤
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / T * ε := by
    calc
      scaleL (x : ℝ) / T *
          |log2 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) + log3 (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) - scaleA (x : ℝ)| ≤
          fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * scaleV (x : ℝ) := habsT
      _ ≤ fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x *
            (C₀ * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzlow herrnn
      _ = fixedRankGeneralSmoothComparisonError c₀ C₀ x * C₀ *
            (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) := by ring
      _ ≤ ε * (scaleL (x : ℝ) / T) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right herrC hz.le
      _ = scaleL (x : ℝ) / T * ε := by ring
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hchain hz

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankGeneral_highRank_JT_exponent
statement:
theorem fixedRankGeneral_highRank_JT_exponent
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) {c₀ C₀ : ℝ}
    (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) {tailError : ℕ → ℝ}
    (htail : FixedRankGeneralWeightedFriableTailEndpoint J c₀ C₀ tailError) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h y : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ,
      1 ≤ h → h ≤ y →
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      (fixedHighRankShiftedCount x h y (y ^ J) J : ℝ) ≤
        (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
          fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J tailError x * scaleV (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankGeneral_upperCutoff_le J hC₀,
      eventually_fixedRankSupplierScaleBounds J,
      eventually_scaleV_nat_pos, htail.2] with
      x hrange hupper hscale hV htailX
  intro h y T hh hhy hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hYx : y ^ J ≤ x := hupper y T c₀ hcutoff hwindow
  have hy : 1 ≤ y := by omega
  have hyY : y ≤ y ^ J := one_le_pow_rank hJ hy
  have hx : 0 < x := by omega
  have hcoverage := fixedHighRankShiftedCount_le_supplierCorrelation
    (x := x) (h := h) (y := y) (Y := y ^ J) (J := J)
      hrangeData.2 hhy (one_le_pow₀ hy)
  have hconvolution := fixedRankSupplierCorrelation_le_convolutionMajorant
    (J := J) (y := y) (Y := y ^ J) (x := x) (h := h)
      (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hh) (hhy.trans hrangeData.2) hhy
  have hsupplier := fixedRankGeneralSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le
    hJ hy hyY hcutoff hx hYx hscale hV
      (htailX y T hcutoff hwindow)
  have hsupplier' : fixedRankSupplierConvolutionMajorant J y (y ^ J) x ≤
      (x : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(J : ℝ) * T +
        fixedRankGeneralSupplierError J tailError x * scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    simpa [fixedRankGeneralSupplierError] using hsupplier
  exact hcoverage.trans (hconvolution.trans hsupplier')

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.succ_le_selbergGrowingCutoff_succ_pow
statement:
theorem succ_le_selbergGrowingCutoff_succ_pow (R : ℕ) :
    R + 1 ≤ (selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1) ^ 32
proof:
:= by
  let r₁ := R.sqrt
  let r₂ := r₁.sqrt
  let r₃ := r₂.sqrt
  let r₄ := r₃.sqrt
  let r₅ := r₄.sqrt
  have h₁ : R + 1 ≤ (r₁ + 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [r₁] using Nat.succ_le_succ_sqrt' R
  have h₂ : r₁ + 1 ≤ (r₂ + 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [r₂] using Nat.succ_le_succ_sqrt' r₁
  have h₃ : r₂ + 1 ≤ (r₃ + 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [r₃] using Nat.succ_le_succ_sqrt' r₂
  have h₄ : r₃ + 1 ≤ (r₄ + 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [r₄] using Nat.succ_le_succ_sqrt' r₃
  have h₅ : r₄ + 1 ≤ (r₅ + 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [r₅] using Nat.succ_le_succ_sqrt' r₄
  calc
    R + 1 ≤ (r₁ + 1) ^ 2 := h₁
    _ ≤ ((r₂ + 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left' h₂ 2
    _ = (r₂ + 1) ^ 4 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((r₃ + 1) ^ 2) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left' h₃ 4
    _ = (r₃ + 1) ^ 8 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((r₄ + 1) ^ 2) ^ 8 := pow_le_pow_left' h₄ 8
    _ = (r₄ + 1) ^ 16 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((r₅ + 1) ^ 2) ^ 16 := pow_le_pow_left' h₅ 16
    _ = (selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1) ^ 32 := by
      rw [show r₅ = selbergGrowingCutoff R by rfl]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_le
statement:
theorem selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_le (R : ℕ) :
    selbergGrowingCutoff R ^ 32 ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  let r₁ := R.sqrt
  let r₂ := r₁.sqrt
  let r₃ := r₂.sqrt
  let r₄ := r₃.sqrt
  let r₅ := r₄.sqrt
  have h₁ : r₁ ^ 2 ≤ R := by simpa [r₁] using Nat.sqrt_le' R
  have h₂ : r₂ ^ 2 ≤ r₁ := by simpa [r₂] using Nat.sqrt_le' r₁
  have h₃ : r₃ ^ 2 ≤ r₂ := by simpa [r₃] using Nat.sqrt_le' r₂
  have h₄ : r₄ ^ 2 ≤ r₃ := by simpa [r₄] using Nat.sqrt_le' r₃
  have h₅ : r₅ ^ 2 ≤ r₄ := by simpa [r₅] using Nat.sqrt_le' r₄
  calc
    selbergGrowingCutoff R ^ 32 = (r₅ ^ 2) ^ 16 := by
      change r₅ ^ 32 = (r₅ ^ 2) ^ 16
      ring
    _ ≤ r₄ ^ 16 := pow_le_pow_left' h₅ 16
    _ = (r₄ ^ 2) ^ 8 := by ring
    _ ≤ r₃ ^ 8 := pow_le_pow_left' h₄ 8
    _ = (r₃ ^ 2) ^ 4 := by ring
    _ ≤ r₂ ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left' h₃ 4
    _ = (r₂ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ r₁ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left' h₂ 2
    _ ≤ R := h₁

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.cutoffLogLowerBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem cutoffLogLowerBound_selbergGrowingCutoff :
    CutoffLogLowerBound selbergGrowingCutoff (1 / 32)
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hz : 1 ≤ selbergGrowingCutoff R :=
    selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
  have hnat := succ_le_selbergGrowingCutoff_succ_pow R
  have hcast : (R : ℝ) ≤
      (((selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 32) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show R ≤ (selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1) ^ 32 by omega)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < R) hcast
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  norm_num at hlog ⊢
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.mertensLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff

:= by
  have h := mertensLocalProductUpperBound_of_cutoffLogLowerBound
    (cutoff := selbergGrowingCutoff) (c := (1 / 32 : ℝ))
    (by norm_num) cutoffLogLowerBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
  norm_num at h ⊢

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.cutoffExceptionUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem cutoffExceptionUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff :
    AffinePrimePair.CutoffExceptionUpperBound selbergGrowingCutoff 64
proof:
:= by
  intro R hR
  have hRreal : (1 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < R by omega)
  have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) < R := zero_lt_one.trans hRreal
  have hlogPos : 0 < Real.log (R : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hRreal
  have hsqrtPos : 0 < Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hRpos
  have hsqrtOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hzNat : selbergGrowingCutoff R ≤ R.sqrt := selbergGrowingCutoff_le_sqrt R
  have hzReal : (selbergGrowingCutoff R : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt R := by
    have hcast : (selbergGrowingCutoff R : ℝ) ≤ (R.sqrt : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hzNat
    exact hcast.trans Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt
  have hexception : (((2 * (selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt R := by
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    nlinarith
  have hsqrtSqrtOne : (1 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt R := by
    exact (Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hlogSqrt := log_le_two_mul_sqrt hsqrtSqrtOne
  have hlogEq : Real.log (R : ℝ) = 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt R) := by
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hRpos.le]
    ring
  have hlogBound : Real.log (R : ℝ) ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt R) := by
    rw [hlogEq]
    linarith
  have hlogSq : Real.log (R : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * Real.sqrt R := by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (R : ℝ) := hlogPos.le
    have hrootNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt R) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg hlogBound 2
    rw [show (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt R)) ^ 2 =
      16 * Real.sqrt R by
        rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hsqrtPos.le]
        norm_num] at hsquare
    exact hsquare
  unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
  rw [show (64 : ℝ) * ((R : ℝ) / Real.log R ^ 2) =
      64 * (R : ℝ) / Real.log R ^ 2 by ring]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hlogPos)).2
  calc
    (((2 * (selbergGrowingCutoff R + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Real.log R ^ 2 ≤
        (4 * Real.sqrt R) * (16 * Real.sqrt R) :=
      mul_le_mul hexception hlogSq (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = 64 * (R : ℝ) := by
      rw [show 4 * Real.sqrt R * (16 * Real.sqrt R) =
        64 * (Real.sqrt R * Real.sqrt R) by ring,
        Real.mul_self_sqrt hRpos.le]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.fullSelbergMass_pos
statement:
theorem fullSelbergMass_pos (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    0 < fullSelbergMass m R z hm
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  change 0 < ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, s.selbergTerms l
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun l hl ↦
    (s.selbergTerms_pos (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hl)).le)
    ⟨1, Nat.one_mem_divisors.mpr s.prodPrimes_ne_zero,
      s.selbergTerms_pos (one_dvd _)⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.fullSelbergMass_eq_localSieveProduct_inv
statement:
theorem fullSelbergMass_eq_localSieveProduct_inv
    (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    fullSelbergMass m R z hm = (localSieveProduct m z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hsum := s.sum_divisors_selbergTerms_eq_selbergTerms_mul_nu_inv
    (d := s.prodPrimes) (dvd_refl _)
  have hnu : 0 < s.nu s.prodPrimes :=
    s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes (dvd_refl _)
  have hcancel :
      s.selbergTerms s.prodPrimes * (s.nu s.prodPrimes)⁻¹ =
        ∏ p ∈ s.prodPrimes.primeFactors, (1 - s.nu p)⁻¹ := by
    rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
    field_simp [hnu.ne']
  rw [hcancel] at hsum
  have hsum' : (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, s.selbergTerms l) =
      ∏ p ∈ s.prodPrimes.primeFactors, (1 - s.nu p)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, s.selbergTerms l) =
          ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            if l ∣ s.prodPrimes then s.selbergTerms l else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro l hl
        rw [if_pos (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hl)]
      _ = _ := hsum
  change fullSelbergMass m R z hm = (localSieveProduct m z)⁻¹
  rw [fullSelbergMass]
  change (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, s.selbergTerms l) = _
  rw [hsum']
  change (∏ p ∈ (primeProduct z).primeFactors,
      (1 - sieveDensity m p)⁻¹) =
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 - localDensity m p))⁻¹
  rw [primeProduct, Nat.primeFactors_prod (fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp), Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  rw [sieveDensity_apply_prime (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.truncatedMass_le_fullSelbergMass
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_le_fullSelbergMass
    (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) ≤
      fullSelbergMass m R z hm
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  change (∑ l ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s, s.selbergTerms l) ≤
    ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, s.selbergTerms l
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro l hl
    exact (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1 |> Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ∘
      (fun h ↦ ⟨h, s.prodPrimes_ne_zero⟩)
  · intro l hl _hnot
    exact (s.selbergTerms_pos (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hl)).le

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.truncatedMassDefect_nonneg
statement:
theorem truncatedMassDefect_nonneg (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    0 ≤ truncatedMassDefect m R z hm
proof:
:=
  sub_nonneg.mpr (truncatedMass_le_fullSelbergMass m R z hm)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.truncatedMass_add_defect
statement:
theorem truncatedMass_add_defect (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) +
        truncatedMassDefect m R z hm = fullSelbergMass m R z hm
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncatedMassDefect
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localSieveProduct_pos
statement:
theorem localSieveProduct_pos {m z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) :
    0 < localSieveProduct m z
proof:
:= by
  unfold localSieveProduct
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hpz
  have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
  have hcount := shiftedBadResidueCount_lt_prime_of_even hm hp
  unfold localDensity
  rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one (by exact_mod_cast hp.pos)]
  exact_mod_cast hcount

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.inv_prime_le_selbergTerms
statement:
theorem inv_prime_le_selbergTerms
    {m R z p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) (hpz : p ≤ z) :
    (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).selbergTerms p
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hpDvd : p ∣ s.prodPrimes := by
    change p ∣ primeProduct z
    exact (prime_dvd_primeProduct_iff hp).mpr
      (Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr ⟨hpz, hp⟩)
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [hp.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
    sieveDensity m p * (1 - sieveDensity m p)⁻¹
  rw [sieveDensity_apply_prime hp, localDensity_apply_prime hp]
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · rw [if_pos hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one]
    have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hden : 0 < 1 - (1 : ℝ) / p := by
      rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hpR]
      exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) / p * (1 - 1 / (p : ℝ))⁻¹ =
      ((1 : ℝ) / p) / (1 - 1 / p) by ring]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).2
    have hinv : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hpR.le
    have hinvLe : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      (inv_le_one₀ hpR).2 (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_le)
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at *
    nlinarith
  · rw [if_neg hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hpNeTwo : p ≠ 2 := by
      intro hpTwo
      subst p
      exact hpm (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)
    have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := by
      have hpStrict : 2 < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp.two_le (Ne.symm hpNeTwo)
      omega
    have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hden : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) / p := by
      rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hpR]
      exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) / p * (1 - 2 / (p : ℝ))⁻¹ =
      ((2 : ℝ) / p) / (1 - 2 / p) by ring]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).2
    have hinv : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hpR.le
    have hinvLe : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      (inv_le_one₀ hpR).2 (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_le)
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at *
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.one_add_primeReciprocalSum_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem one_add_primeReciprocalSum_le_truncatedMass
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    1 + primeReciprocalSum z ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  let T : Finset ℕ := insert 1 (Nat.primesLE z)
  have hsubset : T ⊆ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s := by
    intro l hl
    rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hl
    rcases hl with rfl | hl
    · exact SelbergFundamental.one_mem_truncatedDivisors s
    · have hlPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hl
      have hlLe := Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hl
      rw [SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors,
        minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · change l ∣ primeProduct z
        exact (prime_dvd_primeProduct_iff hlPrime).mpr hl
      · exact_mod_cast pow_le_pow_left' hlLe 2
  have hfinite : (∑ l ∈ T, s.selbergTerms l) ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s := by
    change (∑ l ∈ T, s.selbergTerms l) ≤
      ∑ l ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s, s.selbergTerms l
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset fun l hl _ ↦
      (s.selbergTerms_pos
        (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hl).1).le
  calc
    1 + primeReciprocalSum z =
        1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := rfl
    _ ≤ 1 + ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, s.selbergTerms p := by
      gcongr with p hp
      exact inv_prime_le_selbergTerms hm
        (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) (Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hp)
    _ = ∑ l ∈ T, s.selbergTerms l := by
      have hone : 1 ∉ Nat.primesLE z := by
        intro h
        exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE h).ne_one rfl
      rw [show T = insert 1 (Nat.primesLE z) by rfl,
        Finset.sum_insert hone,
        SelbergFundamental.selbergTerms_one]
    _ ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s := hfinite

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergTerms_prime_le_cast
statement:
theorem selbergTerms_prime_le_cast
    {m R z p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) (hpz : p ≤ z) :
    (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).selbergTerms p ≤ (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [hp.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change sieveDensity m p * (1 - sieveDensity m p)⁻¹ ≤ (p : ℝ)
  rw [sieveDensity_apply_prime hp, localDensity_apply_prime hp]
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · rw [if_pos hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one]
    have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hden : 0 < 1 - (1 : ℝ) / p := by
      rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hpR]
      exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) / p * (1 - 1 / (p : ℝ))⁻¹ =
      ((1 : ℝ) / p) / (1 - 1 / p) by ring]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    field_simp [hpR.ne']
    have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    nlinarith
  · rw [if_neg hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hpNeTwo : p ≠ 2 := by
      intro hpTwo
      subst p
      exact hpm (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)
    have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := by
      have hpStrict : 2 < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp.two_le (Ne.symm hpNeTwo)
      omega
    have hpR : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hden : 0 < 1 - (2 : ℝ) / p := by
      rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hpR]
      exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) / p * (1 - 2 / (p : ℝ))⁻¹ =
      ((2 : ℝ) / p) / (1 - 2 / p) by ring]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    field_simp [hpR.ne']
    have hpThreeR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpThree
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem selbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m)
    (hd : d ∣ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes) :
    (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).selbergTerms d ≤ (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.selbergTerms p) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hpMem
        have hpDvdD : p ∣ d := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        exact (s.selbergTerms_pos (hpDvdD.trans hd)).le
      · intro p hpMem
        have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        have hpDvdP : p ∣ primeProduct z := by
          change p ∣ s.prodPrimes
          exact (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem).trans hd
        have hpz : p ≤ z := Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE
          ((prime_dvd_primeProduct_iff hp).mp hpDvdP)
        exact selbergTerms_prime_le_cast hm hp hpz
    _ = (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_prod]
      norm_cast
      exact Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.abs_minimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
statement:
theorem abs_minimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal
        (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) d| ≤ (z : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  by_cases hd : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hdData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hd
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hdData.1)
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      rw [minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz] at hdData
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    have htermPos : 0 < s.selbergTerms d := s.selbergTerms_pos hdData.1
    have hmass : 1 ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s :=
      SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass s
    have hquot : s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s ≤
        s.selbergTerms d := by
      exact div_le_self htermPos.le hmass
    have hmu : |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := d)
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_pos hd, abs_div, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos htermPos, abs_of_pos (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos s)]
    calc
      |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| * s.selbergTerms d /
          SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s =
          |((μ d : ℤ) : ℝ)| *
            (s.selbergTerms d / SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass s) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * s.selbergTerms d := by
        exact mul_le_mul hmu hquot
          (div_nonneg htermPos.le (zero_le_one.trans hmass))
          (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ (d : ℝ) := by
        simpa using selbergTerms_le_cast_of_dvd hm hdData.1
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdLe
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_neg hd, abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.inv_cast_le_sieveDensity_of_dvd
statement:
theorem inv_cast_le_sieveDensity_of_dvd
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m)
    (hd : d ∣ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes) :
    (d : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).nu d
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hsq : Squarefree d :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hprodCast : (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ)) = (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod]
    norm_cast
    exact Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq
  calc
    (d : ℝ)⁻¹ = (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ))⁻¹ := by rw [hprodCast]
    _ = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      (Finset.prod_inv_distrib (s := d.primeFactors)
        (fun p ↦ (p : ℝ))).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, s.nu p := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hpMem
        positivity
      · intro p hpMem
        have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpMem
        change (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ sieveDensity m p
        rw [sieveDensity_apply_prime hp, localDensity_apply_prime hp]
        by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
        · simp [hpm]
        · simp only [hpm, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_ofNat, div_eq_mul_inv]
          have hpR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
          nlinarith
    _ = s.nu d := s.nu_mult.prod_primeFactors hsq

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.sieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd
statement:
theorem sieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m)
    (hd : d ∣ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes) :
    ((minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).nu d)⁻¹ ≤ (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hnu : 0 < s.nu d := s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd
  have hlower : (d : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ s.nu d :=
    inv_cast_le_sieveDensity_of_dvd hm hd
  calc
    (s.nu d)⁻¹ ≤ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hnu (inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hdPos))).2 hlower
    _ = (d : ℝ) := inv_inv _

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.activeReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem activeReverseDivisors_subset_Icc
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes) :
    activeReverseDivisors (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) d ⊆
      Finset.Icc 1 z
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  intro a ha
  have haData := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
  have hquotPos : 0 < s.prodPrimes / d := by
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero) hd) hdPos
  have haPos : 0 < a := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors haData.1
  have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd)
  have hdaData := SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp haData.2
  rw [minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz] at hdaData
  have hdaLe : d * a ≤ z := by
    have hcast : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ z := by
      have hda0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d * a : ℕ) := by positivity
      have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨haPos, (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left a hdPos).trans hdaLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_activeReverseDivisors_le
statement:
theorem card_activeReverseDivisors_le
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes) :
    (activeReverseDivisors (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) d).card ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card (activeReverseDivisors_subset_Icc hm hz hd)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors
statement:
theorem reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors
    {s : SelbergSieve} {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes) :
    SelbergFundamental.reverseMobiusTransform s.prodPrimes
        (SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s) (s.prodPrimes / d) =
      ∑ a ∈ activeReverseDivisors s d,
        (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SelbergFundamental.reverseMobiusTransform_divisor s.prodPrimes_ne_zero hd]
  rw [activeReverseDivisors, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  by_cases hda : d * a ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · rw [if_pos hda]
  · rw [if_neg hda, SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal, if_neg hda, mul_zero]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.abs_reverseMobiusTransform_minimizingDiagonal_le_sq
statement:
theorem abs_reverseMobiusTransform_minimizingDiagonal_le_sq
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z)
    (hd : d ∣ (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes) :
    |SelbergFundamental.reverseMobiusTransform
        (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes
        (SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal
          (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm))
        ((minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).prodPrimes / d)| ≤
      (z : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  rw [reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors hd]
  calc
    |∑ a ∈ activeReverseDivisors s d,
        (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
        ∑ a ∈ activeReverseDivisors s d,
          |(μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ activeReverseDivisors s d, (z : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro a ha
      rw [abs_mul]
      have hmu : |(μ a : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one (n := a)
      exact (mul_le_mul hmu (abs_minimizingDiagonal_le_cutoff hm hz)
        (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq (one_mul _)
    _ = ((activeReverseDivisors s d).card : ℝ) * z := by simp
    _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * z := by
      gcongr
      exact_mod_cast card_activeReverseDivisors_le hm hz hd
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.abs_minimizingWeight_le_cube
statement:
theorem abs_minimizingWeight_le_cube
    {m R z d : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
        (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  by_cases hdMem : d ∈ SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors s
  · have hd := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).1
    have hdLe : d ≤ z := by
      have hsquare := (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hdMem).2
      rw [minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz] at hsquare
      have hcast : (d : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by positivity
        nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hcast
    rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight,
      SelbergFundamental.weightFromDiagonal, dif_pos hd,
      abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (s.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd)),
      reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors hd]
    have hsum :
        |∑ a ∈ activeReverseDivisors s d,
          (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
            (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← reverseMobiusTransform_eq_activeReverseDivisors hd]
      exact abs_reverseMobiusTransform_minimizingDiagonal_le_sq hm hz hd
    have hnu := sieveDensity_inv_le_cast_of_dvd hm hd
    calc
      (s.nu d)⁻¹ *
          |∑ a ∈ activeReverseDivisors s d,
            (μ a : ℝ) * SelbergFundamental.minimizingDiagonal s (d * a)| ≤
          (d : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hnu hsum (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (z : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hdLe) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
  · rw [SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_truncated hdMem,
      abs_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.abs_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_le_tenth
statement:
theorem abs_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_le_tenth
    {m R z n : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) (hn : n ≤ z ^ 2) :
    |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
        (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
          (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)) n| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 10
proof:
:= by
  let w := SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight
    (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
  have hw (d : ℕ) : |w d| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
    abs_minimizingWeight_le_cube hm hz
  have hterm (d₁ d₂ : ℕ) :
      |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    by_cases h : n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂
    · rw [if_pos h, abs_mul]
      calc
        |w d₁| * |w d₂| ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 3 * (z : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
          mul_le_mul (hw d₁) (hw d₂) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by ring
    · rw [if_neg h, abs_zero]
      positivity
  have hinner (d₁ : ℕ) :
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
    calc
      |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
          ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            |if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _d₂ ∈ n.divisors, (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro d₂ hd₂
        exact hterm d₁ d₂
      _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by simp
  unfold BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
  change |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
      ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
        if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤ _
  have hcardNat : n.divisors.card ≤ n := Nat.card_divisors_le_self n
  have hcard : ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat.trans hn
  calc
    |∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| ≤
        ∑ d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
          |∑ d₂ ∈ n.divisors,
            if n = Nat.lcm d₁ d₂ then w d₁ * w d₂ else 0| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _d₁ ∈ n.divisors,
        ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d₁ hd₁
      exact hinner d₁
    _ = ((n.divisors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      simp
      ring
    _ ≤ ((z : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (z : ℝ) ^ 6 := by
      gcongr
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 10 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.two_pow_card_primeFactors_le_self
statement:
theorem two_pow_card_primeFactors_le_self
    {n : ℕ} (_hnPos : 0 < n) (hnSq : Squarefree n) :
    2 ^ n.primeFactors.card ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    2 ^ n.primeFactors.card = ∏ _p ∈ n.primeFactors, 2 := by simp
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hp
        omega
      · intro p hp
        exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
    _ = n := Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hnSq

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.minimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem minimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    minimizingRemainderSupport (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) ⊆
      Finset.Icc 1 (z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  intro d hd
  have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
  have hdPos := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
  rw [minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz] at hdData
  have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hdData.2
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hdPos, hdLe⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.card_minimizingRemainderSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_minimizingRemainderSupport_le
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (minimizingRemainderSupport (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)).card ≤ z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card
    (minimizingRemainderSupport_subset_Icc (R := R) hm hz)
  simpa using hcard

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth
statement:
theorem minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant m R z hm ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 14
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have heq : minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant m R z hm =
      ∑ d ∈ minimizingRemainderSupport s,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    unfold minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant minimizingRemainderSupport
    change (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
          |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
              (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
            ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
        else 0) = _
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [heq]
  have hterm (d : ℕ) (hd : d ∈ minimizingRemainderSupport s) :
      |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
    have hdData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hd
    have hdDvd : d ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
    have hdPos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hdData.1
    have hdSq : Squarefree d :=
      Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdDvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
    have hdLe : d ≤ z ^ 2 := by
      have hlevel := hdData.2
      rw [minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz] at hlevel
      exact_mod_cast hlevel
    have hlambda := abs_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_le_tenth
      (R := R) hm hz hdLe
    have htwoNat := two_pow_card_primeFactors_le_self hdPos hdSq
    have htwo : (((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast htwoNat.trans hdLe
    calc
      |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
          (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (z : ℝ) ^ 10 * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hlambda htwo (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by ring
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ minimizingRemainderSupport s,
        |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared
            (SelbergFundamental.minimizingWeight s) d| *
          ((2 ^ d.primeFactors.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ _d ∈ minimizingRemainderSupport s, (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro d hd
      exact hterm d hd
    _ = ((minimizingRemainderSupport s).card : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by simp
    _ ≤ ((z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ^ 12 := by
      gcongr
      exact_mod_cast card_minimizingRemainderSupport_le (R := R) hm hz
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 14 := by norm_num; ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensFactor_cube_le_localFactor
statement:
theorem directMertensFactor_cube_le_localFactor
    {m p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) :
    (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 ≤ 1 - localDensity m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [localDensity_apply_prime hp]
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · rw [if_pos hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one]
    have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hfactorPos : 0 < 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := directMertensFactor_pos hp
    have hfactorLe : 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      sub_le_self _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hpPos.le)
    calc
      (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 =
          (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (pow_le_one₀ hfactorPos.le hfactorLe) hfactorPos.le
      _ = 1 - (1 : ℝ) / p := by rw [one_mul, one_div]
  · rw [if_neg hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hpNeTwo : p ≠ 2 := by
      intro hpTwo
      subst p
      exact hpm (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)
    have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := by
      have hpStrict : 2 < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp.two_le (Ne.symm hpNeTwo)
      omega
    have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    field_simp [hpPos.ne']
    have hpThreeReal : (3 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hpThree
    nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.directMertensProduct_cube_le_localSieveProduct
statement:
theorem directMertensProduct_cube_le_localSieveProduct
    {m z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) :
    directMertensProduct z ^ 3 ≤ localSieveProduct m z
proof:
:= by
  unfold directMertensProduct localSieveProduct
  rw [← Finset.prod_pow]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod
  · intro p hpz
    exact (pow_nonneg
      (directMertensFactor_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz)).le 3)
  · intro p hpz
    exact directMertensFactor_cube_le_localFactor hm
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.telescopingNaturalProduct_eq_inv
statement:
theorem telescopingNaturalProduct_eq_inv
    {z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (∏ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 z, (1 - (n : ℝ)⁻¹)) = (z : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | zero => omega
  | succ z ih =>
      by_cases hzZero : z = 0
      · subst z
        norm_num
      · have hzPos : 1 ≤ z := by omega
        rw [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top (show 2 ≤ z + 1 by omega), ih hzPos]
        have hzReal : (z : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        have hzSuccReal : ((z + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [hzReal, hzSuccReal]
        norm_num

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.inv_cast_le_directMertensProduct
statement:
theorem inv_cast_le_directMertensProduct
    {z : ℕ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (z : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ directMertensProduct z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← telescopingNaturalProduct_eq_inv hz]
  unfold directMertensProduct
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_le_one
  · intro p hp
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
      ⟨(Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).two_le,
        Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hp⟩
  · intro n hn
    have hnTwo : 2 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
    have hnPos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((inv_le_one₀ hnPos).2 (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ n by omega)))
  · intro n hn _hnPrime
    exact sub_le_self _ (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.inv_cast_cube_le_localSieveProduct
statement:
theorem inv_cast_cube_le_localSieveProduct
    {m z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    ((z : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 ≤ localSieveProduct m z
proof:
:= by
  exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
    (inv_cast_le_directMertensProduct hz) 3).trans
    (directMertensProduct_cube_le_localSieveProduct hm)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.combinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem combinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff :
    CombinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound selbergGrowingCutoff 1
proof:
:= by
  intro m R _hm hmEven hR
  let z := selbergGrowingCutoff R
  have hzNat : 1 ≤ z := selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hzReal : (0 : ℝ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hzNat
  have hpowNat : z ^ 32 ≤ R := selbergGrowingCutoff_pow_le R
  have hpowReal : (z : ℝ) ^ 32 ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpowNat
  have hseventeen : (z : ℝ) ^ 17 ≤ (R : ℝ) :=
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ z by exact_mod_cast hzNat)
      (show 17 ≤ 32 by norm_num)).trans hpowReal
  have hlocal : ((z : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 ≤ localSieveProduct m z :=
    inv_cast_cube_le_localSieveProduct hmEven hzNat
  have hsplit : (z : ℝ) ^ 14 = (z : ℝ) ^ 17 * ((z : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 := by
    field_simp [hzReal.ne']
  calc
    minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant m R z hmEven ≤ (z : ℝ) ^ 14 :=
      minimizingWeightRemainderMajorant_le_fourteenth hmEven hzNat
    _ = (z : ℝ) ^ 17 * ((z : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 := hsplit
    _ ≤ (R : ℝ) * ((z : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hseventeen (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (R : ℝ) * localSieveProduct m z :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlocal (by positivity)
    _ = (1 : ℝ) * R * localSieveProduct m z := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.inv_le_inv_mul_of_mul_inv_le
statement:
theorem inv_le_inv_mul_of_mul_inv_le
    {c V G : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hV : 0 < V) (hG : 0 < G)
    (h : c * V⁻¹ ≤ G) : G⁻¹ ≤ c⁻¹ * V
proof:
:= by
  calc
    G⁻¹ ≤ (c * V⁻¹)⁻¹ :=
      (inv_le_inv₀ hG (mul_pos hc (inv_pos.mpr hV))).2 h
    _ = c⁻¹ * V := by rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]; ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.truncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem truncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hmass : GrowingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound c) :
    TruncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound selbergGrowingCutoff c⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  intro m R hm hmEven hR
  exact inv_le_inv_mul_of_mul_inv_le hc
    (localSieveProduct_pos hmEven)
    (SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass_pos _)
    (hmass m R hm hmEven hR)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hmass : GrowingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound c) :
    SelbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound selbergGrowingCutoff (c⁻¹ + 1)
proof:
:=
  selbergFundamentalLemmaUpperBound_of_mass_and_combinatorialRemainder
    (truncatedMassLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff hc hmass)
    combinatorialRemainderLocalProductUpperBound_selbergGrowingCutoff

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
statement:
theorem hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_selbergGrowingCutoff
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hmass : GrowingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound c) :
    HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound
      (bfpsTerminalSelbergDataSelbergGrowingCutoff hc hmass).sieveConstant
