  (bfpsTerminalSelbergDataSelbergGrowingCutoff hc hmass).hasTwoAffineSieveBound

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg (p : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ dimensionOneLocalWeight p
proof:
:= by
  exact inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetMass_nonneg (S : Finset ℕ) (T : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ dimensionOneSubsetMass S T
proof:
:= by
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetMass
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro A hA
  split_ifs
  · exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
  · positivity

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos (S : Finset ℕ) :
    0 < dimensionOneSubsetProduct S
proof:
:= by
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  linarith [dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass_insert_le
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetMass_insert_le
    {S : Finset ℕ} {p T : ℕ} (hpS : p ∉ S) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    dimensionOneSubsetMass (insert p S) T ≤
      (1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p) * dimensionOneSubsetMass S T
proof:
:= by
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetMass
  rw [Finset.sum_powerset_insert hpS]
  have hsecond :
      (∑ A ∈ S.powerset,
        if (insert p A).prod id ≤ T then
          ∏ q ∈ insert p A, dimensionOneLocalWeight q else 0) ≤
        dimensionOneLocalWeight p *
          ∑ A ∈ S.powerset,
            if A.prod id ≤ T then
              ∏ q ∈ A, dimensionOneLocalWeight q else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro A hA
    have hpA : p ∉ A := fun hpMem ↦ hpS (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hpMem)
    have hprodNat : (insert p A).prod id = p * A.prod id := by
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hpA]
      rfl
    have hprodWeight :
        (∏ q ∈ insert p A, dimensionOneLocalWeight q) =
          dimensionOneLocalWeight p *
            ∏ q ∈ A, dimensionOneLocalWeight q := by
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hpA]
    rw [hprodNat, hprodWeight]
    by_cases hInsert : p * A.prod id ≤ T
    · rw [if_pos hInsert]
      have hprod : A.prod id ≤ T := by
        have hfactor : A.prod id ≤ p * A.prod id := by
          exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (show 0 < p by omega)
        exact hfactor.trans hInsert
      rw [if_pos hprod]
    · rw [if_neg hInsert]
      exact mul_nonneg (dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p)
        (by
          by_cases hprod : A.prod id ≤ T
          · rw [if_pos hprod]
            exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun q hq ↦ dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg q
          · rw [if_neg hprod])
  calc
    (∑ A ∈ S.powerset,
        if A.prod id ≤ T then
          ∏ q ∈ A, dimensionOneLocalWeight q else 0) +
        (∑ A ∈ S.powerset,
          if (insert p A).prod id ≤ T then
            ∏ q ∈ insert p A, dimensionOneLocalWeight q else 0) ≤
      dimensionOneSubsetMass S T +
        dimensionOneLocalWeight p * dimensionOneSubsetMass S T := by
      exact add_le_add_right hsecond _
    _ = (1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p) * dimensionOneSubsetMass S T := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass_div_product_antitone
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetMass_div_product_antitone
    {S U : Finset ℕ} (hdisj : Disjoint S U)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ U, 1 ≤ p) (T : ℕ) :
    dimensionOneSubsetMass (S ∪ U) T /
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∪ U) ≤
      dimensionOneSubsetMass S T / dimensionOneSubsetProduct S
proof:
:= by
  induction U using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert p U hpU ih =>
      have hpS : p ∉ S := by
        intro hpMem
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hpMem (Finset.mem_insert_self p U)
      have hdisj' : Disjoint S U := by
        exact hdisj.mono_right (Finset.subset_insert p U)
      have hpUnion : p ∉ S ∪ U := by simp [hpS, hpU]
      have hpOne : 1 ≤ p := hprime p (Finset.mem_insert_self p U)
      have hmass := dimensionOneSubsetMass_insert_le
        (S := S ∪ U) (T := T) hpUnion hpOne
      have hfactorPos : 0 < 1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p := by
        linarith [dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p]
      have hprodPos : 0 < dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∪ U) :=
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _
      have hinsertProd :
          dimensionOneSubsetProduct (insert p (S ∪ U)) =
            (1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p) *
              dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∪ U) := by
        unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hpUnion]
      have hlocal :
          dimensionOneSubsetMass (insert p (S ∪ U)) T /
              dimensionOneSubsetProduct (insert p (S ∪ U)) ≤
            dimensionOneSubsetMass (S ∪ U) T /
              dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∪ U) := by
        rw [hinsertProd]
        apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hfactorPos hprodPos)).2
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        calc
          dimensionOneSubsetMass (insert p (S ∪ U)) T ≤
              (1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p) *
                dimensionOneSubsetMass (S ∪ U) T := hmass
          _ = dimensionOneSubsetMass (S ∪ U) T /
                dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∪ U) *
              ((1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p) *
                dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∪ U)) := by
            field_simp [hprodPos.ne']
      rw [show S ∪ insert p U = insert p (S ∪ U) by ext q; simp]
      exact hlocal.trans (ih hdisj' (fun q hq ↦ hprime q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)))

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.squarePartRoot_sq_mul_squarefreeCore
statement:
theorem squarePartRoot_sq_mul_squarefreeCore (n : ℕ) :
    squarePartRoot n ^ 2 * squarefreeCore n = n
proof:
:=
  (Nat.sq_mul_squarefree n).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.squarefree_squarefreeCore
statement: theorem squarefree_squarefreeCore (n : ℕ) : Squarefree (squarefreeCore n)
proof:
:=
  (Nat.sq_mul_squarefree n).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.inv_cast_le_primeFactorDimensionOneWeight
statement:
theorem inv_cast_le_primeFactorDimensionOneWeight
    {a : ℕ} (ha : Squarefree a) :
    (a : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      ∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors, dimensionOneLocalWeight p
proof:
:= by
  have haNe : a ≠ 0 := ha.ne_zero
  have hprodNat : ∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors, p = a :=
    Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree ha
  calc
    (a : ℝ)⁻¹ =
        (∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors, (p : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_prod, hprodNat]
    _ = ∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors, (p : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      (Finset.prod_inv_distrib (s := a.primeFactors)
        (fun p ↦ (p : ℝ))).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors, dimensionOneLocalWeight p := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hp
        positivity
      · intro p hp
        have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
        have hpPredPos : (0 : ℝ) < (p - 1 : ℕ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hpPrime.one_lt
        have hpPredLe : (((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le p 1
        unfold dimensionOneLocalWeight
        simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpPredPos hpPredLe

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.sum_inverseSquares_Icc_le_two
statement:
theorem sum_inverseSquares_Icc_le_two (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ((b : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hset : Finset.Icc 1 T = Finset.Ioo 0 (T + 1) := by
    ext b
    simp
    omega
  rw [hset]
  simpa using (sum_Ioo_inv_sq_le (α := ℝ) 0 (T + 1))

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.squarefreeCore_mem_interval
statement:
theorem squarefreeCore_mem_interval
    {n T : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T) :
    squarefreeCore n ∈ squarefreeInterval T
proof:
:= by
  have hnPos : 0 < n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
  have hcoreSq := squarefree_squarefreeCore n
  have hcorePos : 0 < squarefreeCore n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcoreSq.ne_zero
  have hrootPos : 0 < squarePartRoot n := by
    by_contra hzero
    have : squarePartRoot n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hzero
    have hdecomp := squarePartRoot_sq_mul_squarefreeCore n
    rw [this] at hdecomp
    simp at hdecomp
    omega
  have hcoreLe : squarefreeCore n ≤ n := by
    calc
      squarefreeCore n ≤ squarePartRoot n ^ 2 * squarefreeCore n :=
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (pow_pos hrootPos 2)
      _ = n := squarePartRoot_sq_mul_squarefreeCore n
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hcorePos, hcoreLe.trans (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).2⟩, hcoreSq⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.squarePartRoot_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem squarePartRoot_mem_Icc
    {n T : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T) :
    squarePartRoot n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T
proof:
:= by
  have hnPos : 0 < n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
  have hcorePos : 0 < squarefreeCore n :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (squarefree_squarefreeCore n).ne_zero
  have hrootPos : 0 < squarePartRoot n := by
    by_contra hzero
    have : squarePartRoot n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hzero
    have hdecomp := squarePartRoot_sq_mul_squarefreeCore n
    rw [this] at hdecomp
    simp at hdecomp
    omega
  have hrootSq : squarePartRoot n ≤ squarePartRoot n ^ 2 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (squarePartRoot n) hrootPos
  have hrootLe : squarePartRoot n ≤ n := by
    calc
      squarePartRoot n ≤ squarePartRoot n ^ 2 := hrootSq
      _ ≤ squarePartRoot n ^ 2 * squarefreeCore n :=
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hcorePos
      _ = n := squarePartRoot_sq_mul_squarefreeCore n
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hrootPos, hrootLe.trans (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).2⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.harmonic_le_two_mul_squarefreeDimensionOneMass
statement:
theorem harmonic_le_two_mul_squarefreeDimensionOneMass (T : ℕ) :
    ((harmonic T : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * squarefreeDimensionOneMass T
proof:
:= by
  let source := Finset.Icc 1 T
  let image := source.map squarefreeDecompositionEmbedding
  let target := (squarefreeInterval T).product (Finset.Icc 1 T)
  have himageTarget : image ⊆ target := by
    intro ab hab
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hab with ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨squarefreeCore_mem_interval hn, squarePartRoot_mem_Icc hn⟩
  have himageSum :
      (∑ n ∈ source, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) =
        ∑ ab ∈ image, (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
    change (∑ n ∈ source, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      ∑ ab ∈ source.map squarefreeDecompositionEmbedding,
        (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹
    rw [Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n hn
    change (n : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      ((squarePartRoot n ^ 2 * squarefreeCore n : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹
    rw [squarePartRoot_sq_mul_squarefreeCore]
  have htargetNonneg (ab : ℕ × ℕ) :
      0 ≤ (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hsubsetSum :
      (∑ ab ∈ image, (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ ab ∈ target, (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg himageTarget
      (fun ab hab _ ↦ htargetNonneg ab)
  have htargetBound :
      (∑ ab ∈ target, (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤
        squarefreeDimensionOneMass T *
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ((b : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    unfold target
    change (∑ ab ∈ squarefreeInterval T ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 T,
      (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤ _
    rw [Finset.sum_product]
    calc
      (∑ a ∈ squarefreeInterval T,
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
            ((((b ^ 2 * a : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹)) ≤
          ∑ a ∈ squarefreeInterval T,
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T,
              (∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors, dimensionOneLocalWeight p) *
                ((b : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro a ha
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro b hb
        have haSq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
        have haPos : (0 : ℝ) < a := by
          exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1).1
        have hbPos : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hb).1
        rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow]
        rw [mul_inv_rev]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (inv_cast_le_primeFactorDimensionOneWeight haSq)
          (inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg _))
      _ = squarefreeDimensionOneMass T *
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ((b : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        unfold squarefreeDimensionOneMass
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    ((harmonic T : ℚ) : ℝ) = ∑ n ∈ source, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      simp only [source, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc, Rat.cast_sum, Rat.cast_inv,
        Rat.cast_natCast]
    _ = ∑ ab ∈ image, (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := himageSum
    _ ≤ ∑ ab ∈ target, (((ab.2 ^ 2 * ab.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := hsubsetSum
    _ ≤ squarefreeDimensionOneMass T *
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, ((b : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := htargetBound
    _ ≤ squarefreeDimensionOneMass T * 2 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_inverseSquares_Icc_le_two T)
        (by
          unfold squarefreeDimensionOneMass
          exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a ha ↦
            Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p)
    _ = 2 * squarefreeDimensionOneMass T := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.squarefreeDimensionOneMass_le_subsetMass
statement:
theorem squarefreeDimensionOneMass_le_subsetMass (T : ℕ) :
    squarefreeDimensionOneMass T ≤
      dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T
proof:
:= by
  let e := squarefreePrimeFactorsEmbedding T
  let image : Finset (Finset ℕ) := Finset.univ.map e
  have himageSubset : image ⊆ (Nat.primesLE T).powerset := by
    intro A hA
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hA with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_powerset]
    intro p hp
    have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hpDvd : p ∣ a.1 := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have haPos : 0 < a.1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).1).1
    exact Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr
      ⟨(Nat.le_of_dvd haPos hpDvd).trans
        (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).1).2, hpPrime⟩
  have himageTerms :
      squarefreeDimensionOneMass T =
        ∑ A ∈ image,
          if A.prod id ≤ T then
            ∏ p ∈ A, dimensionOneLocalWeight p else 0 := by
    unfold squarefreeDimensionOneMass image e
    rw [← Finset.sum_attach, Finset.attach_eq_univ, Finset.sum_map]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    have haSq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).2
    have hprod := Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree haSq
    have haLe := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).1).2
    change (∏ p ∈ a.1.primeFactors, dimensionOneLocalWeight p) =
      if a.1.primeFactors.prod id ≤ T then
        ∏ p ∈ a.1.primeFactors, dimensionOneLocalWeight p else 0
    rw [show a.1.primeFactors.prod id = a.1 by simpa using hprod,
      if_pos haLe]
  rw [himageTerms]
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetMass
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg himageSubset
  intro A hA _hnot
  by_cases hprod : A.prod id ≤ T
  · rw [if_pos hprod]
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
  · rw [if_neg hprod]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE (T : ℕ) :
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) = mertensProduct T
proof:
:= by
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct mertensProduct dimensionOneLocalWeight
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp
  have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.pos
  have hpPredPos : (0 : ℝ) < (p - 1 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hpPrime.one_lt
  have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpPrime.one_lt
  have hden : (p : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hpOne.ne'
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hpPrime.one_le]
  field_simp [hpPos.ne', hden]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneAllPrimeMass_lower
statement:
theorem dimensionOneAllPrimeMass_lower {T : ℕ} (hT : 3 ≤ T) :
    (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4))⁻¹ *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) ≤
      dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 1 < Real.log (T : ℝ) := by
    apply (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by positivity)).2
    exact Real.exp_one_lt_three.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hT)
  have hlogMono : Real.log (T : ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ T
  have hlogHarm : Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((harmonic T : ℚ) : ℝ) := log_add_one_le_harmonic T
  have hmassHarm : ((harmonic T : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤
      2 * dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T :=
    (harmonic_le_two_mul_squarefreeDimensionOneMass T).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (squarefreeDimensionOneMass_le_subsetMass T) (by norm_num))
  have hfull := mertensProduct_le_log T hT
  rw [← dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE] at hfull
  have hfullMass :
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) ≤
        (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4)) *
          dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T := by
    calc
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) ≤
          Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log T) := hfull
      _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          (2 * Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        gcongr
        linarith
      _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          (2 * ((harmonic T : ℚ) : ℝ)) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          (2 * (2 * dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T)) := by gcongr
      _ = (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4)) *
          dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T := by ring
  have hconstant : 0 < 4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) := by positivity
  rw [show (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4))⁻¹ *
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) =
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) /
        (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4)) by ring]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hconstant).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hfullMass)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetMass_lower
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetMass_lower
    {S : Finset ℕ} {T : ℕ} (hS : S ⊆ Nat.primesLE T) (hT : 3 ≤ T) :
    (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4))⁻¹ * dimensionOneSubsetProduct S ≤
      dimensionOneSubsetMass S T
proof:
:= by
  let U := Nat.primesLE T \ S
  have hdisj : Disjoint S U := by
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun p hpS hpU ↦
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hpU).2 hpS
  have hunion : S ∪ U = Nat.primesLE T := by
    exact Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hS
  have hprime : ∀ p ∈ U, 1 ≤ p := by
    intro p hp
    exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp).1).one_le
  have hanti := dimensionOneSubsetMass_div_product_antitone hdisj hprime T
  rw [hunion] at hanti
  have hfullPos : 0 < dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) :=
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _
  have hsubPos : 0 < dimensionOneSubsetProduct S :=
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _
  have hbaseRatio :
      (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4))⁻¹ ≤
        dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T /
          dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hfullPos).2 (dimensionOneAllPrimeMass_lower hT)
  have hratio :
      (4 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4))⁻¹ ≤
        dimensionOneSubsetMass S T / dimensionOneSubsetProduct S :=
    hbaseRatio.trans hanti
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hsubPos).mp hratio

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.primesLE_mono
statement:
theorem primesLE_mono {T z : ℕ} (hTz : T ≤ z) :
    Nat.primesLE T ⊆ Nat.primesLE z
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr
    ⟨(Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hp).trans hTz, Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_factor
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_factor
    {T z : ℕ} (hTz : T ≤ z) :
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) =
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) *
        dimensionOneTailProduct T z
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := primesLE_mono hTz
  have hunion : Nat.primesLE T ∪ (Nat.primesLE z \ Nat.primesLE T) =
      Nat.primesLE z := Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hsub
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Nat.primesLE T)
      (Nat.primesLE z \ Nat.primesLE T) := by
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun p hpT hpDiff ↦
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hpDiff).2 hpT
  unfold dimensionOneTailProduct
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct
  rw [← Finset.prod_union hdisj, hunion]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneTailProduct_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem dimensionOneTailProduct_sqrt_le
    {z : ℕ} (hz : 9 ≤ z) :
    dimensionOneTailProduct z.sqrt z ≤
      3 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4)
proof:
:= by
  let T := z.sqrt
  have hTz : T ≤ z := Nat.sqrt_le_self z
  have hT : 3 ≤ T := by
    rw [Nat.le_sqrt]
    omega
  have hfactor := dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_factor hTz
  have hTprodPos : 0 < dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) :=
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _
  have hlogT : 1 < Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    apply (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by positivity)).2
    exact Real.exp_one_lt_three.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show 3 ≤ T + 1 by omega))
  have hzSuccSq : z < (T + 1) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [T] using Nat.lt_succ_sqrt' z
  have hlogz : Real.log (z : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hcast : (z : ℝ) ≤ (((T + 1) ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hzSuccSq.le
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < z) hcast
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow] at hlog
    norm_num at hlog ⊢
    exact hlog
  have hfullUpper : dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) ≤
      3 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
        Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE]
    calc
      mertensProduct z ≤
          Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log z) :=
        mertensProduct_le_log z (by omega)
      _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          (3 * Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        gcongr
        linarith
      _ = 3 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) *
          Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by ring
  have hfullLower : Real.log ((T + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) := by
    rw [dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE]
    exact (log_add_one_le_harmonic T).trans (harmonic_le_mertensProduct T)
  have hprodBound : dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) ≤
      (3 * Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4)) *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) :=
    hfullUpper.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfullLower (by positivity))
  have htailEq : dimensionOneTailProduct T z =
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) /
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hTprodPos.ne').2
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact hfactor.symm
  rw [htailEq]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hTprodPos).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hprodBound)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_tail_mul_restriction
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_tail_mul_restriction
    {S : Finset ℕ} {T z : ℕ} (hS : S ⊆ Nat.primesLE z) :
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct S ≤
      dimensionOneTailProduct T z *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∩ Nat.primesLE T)
proof:
:= by
  let small := S ∩ Nat.primesLE T
  let large := S \ small
  have hsmallLarge : Disjoint small large := by
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun p hpSmall hpLarge ↦
      (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hpLarge).2 hpSmall
  have hunion : small ∪ large = S := by
    ext p
    simp [small, large]
    tauto
  have hlargeTail : large ⊆ Nat.primesLE z \ Nat.primesLE T := by
    intro p hp
    have hpData := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp
    have hpS : p ∈ S := hpData.1
    have hpNotT : p ∉ Nat.primesLE T := by
      intro hpT
      exact hpData.2 (Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hpS, hpT⟩)
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hS hpS, hpNotT⟩
  have hlargeProd : dimensionOneSubsetProduct large ≤
      dimensionOneTailProduct T z := by
    unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct dimensionOneTailProduct
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le hlargeTail
    · intro p hp
      linarith [dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p]
    · intro p hp _
      linarith [dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p]
  have hfactor : dimensionOneSubsetProduct S =
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct small * dimensionOneSubsetProduct large := by
    unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct
    rw [← Finset.prod_union hsmallLarge, hunion]
  rw [hfactor]
  calc
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct small * dimensionOneSubsetProduct large ≤
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct small * dimensionOneTailProduct T z :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlargeProd
        (dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos small).le
    _ = dimensionOneTailProduct T z *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (S ∩ Nat.primesLE T) := by
      rw [show small = S ∩ Nat.primesLE T by rfl]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.pairUnionPowersetMass_le_weightedPowersetMass
statement:
theorem pairUnionPowersetMass_le_weightedPowersetMass
    {Ω : Finset ℕ} {w₁ w₂ g : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hw₁ : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w₁ p) (hw₂ : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w₂ p)
    (hg : ∀ p ∈ Ω, w₁ p + w₂ p + w₁ p * w₂ p ≤ g p)
    (keep : Finset ℕ → Bool) :
    pairUnionPowersetMass Ω w₁ w₂ keep ≤ weightedPowersetMass Ω g keep
proof:
:= by
  induction Ω using Finset.induction_on generalizing keep with
  | empty => simp [pairUnionPowersetMass, weightedPowersetMass]
  | @insert p Ω hp ih =>
      have ih0 := ih (fun q hq ↦ hw₁ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq))
        (fun q hq ↦ hw₂ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq))
        (fun q hq ↦ hg q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)) keep
      have ih1 := ih (fun q hq ↦ hw₁ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq))
        (fun q hq ↦ hw₂ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq))
        (fun q hq ↦ hg q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq))
        (fun U ↦ keep (insert p U))
      let M₁ := pairUnionPowersetMass Ω w₁ w₂ (fun U ↦ keep (insert p U))
      let W₁ := weightedPowersetMass Ω g (fun U ↦ keep (insert p U))
      have hpNot {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A ∈ Ω.powerset) : p ∉ A :=
        fun hpA ↦ hp (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hpA)
      have h01 :
          (∑ A ∈ Ω.powerset, ∑ B ∈ Ω.powerset,
            if keep (A ∪ insert p B) then
              (∏ q ∈ A, w₁ q) * ∏ q ∈ insert p B, w₂ q else 0) = w₂ p * M₁ := by
        unfold M₁ pairUnionPowersetMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B hB
        have hpB := hpNot hB
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hpB]
        have hu : A ∪ insert p B = insert p (A ∪ B) := by ext q; simp
        rw [hu]
        by_cases hk : keep (insert p (A ∪ B))
        · simp [hk]
          ring
        · simp [hk]
      have h10 :
          (∑ A ∈ Ω.powerset, ∑ B ∈ Ω.powerset,
            if keep (insert p A ∪ B) then
              (∏ q ∈ insert p A, w₁ q) * ∏ q ∈ B, w₂ q else 0) = w₁ p * M₁ := by
        unfold M₁ pairUnionPowersetMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B hB
        have hpA := hpNot hA
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hpA]
        have hu : insert p A ∪ B = insert p (A ∪ B) := by ext q; simp
        rw [hu]
        by_cases hk : keep (insert p (A ∪ B))
        · simp [hk]
          ring
        · simp [hk]
      have h11 :
          (∑ A ∈ Ω.powerset, ∑ B ∈ Ω.powerset,
            if keep (insert p A ∪ insert p B) then
              (∏ q ∈ insert p A, w₁ q) * ∏ q ∈ insert p B, w₂ q else 0) =
            (w₁ p * w₂ p) * M₁ := by
        unfold M₁ pairUnionPowersetMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B hB
        have hpA := hpNot hA
        have hpB := hpNot hB
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hpA, Finset.prod_insert hpB]
        have hu : insert p A ∪ insert p B = insert p (A ∪ B) := by ext q; simp
        rw [hu]
        by_cases hk : keep (insert p (A ∪ B))
        · simp [hk]
          ring
        · simp [hk]
      have hR :
          (∑ A ∈ Ω.powerset,
            if keep (insert p A) then ∏ q ∈ insert p A, g q else 0) = g p * W₁ := by
        unfold W₁ weightedPowersetMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        rw [Finset.prod_insert (hpNot hA)]
        by_cases hk : keep (insert p A)
        · simp [hk]
        · simp [hk]
      have hW₁ : 0 ≤ W₁ := by
        unfold W₁ weightedPowersetMass
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro A hA
        split_ifs
        · apply Finset.prod_nonneg
          intro q hq
          have hqΩ := Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hq
          exact (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (hw₁ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hqΩ))
            (hw₂ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hqΩ)))
            (mul_nonneg (hw₁ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hqΩ))
              (hw₂ q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hqΩ)))).trans
            (hg q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hqΩ))
        · positivity
      have hpCoeff : 0 ≤ w₁ p + w₂ p + w₁ p * w₂ p :=
        add_nonneg (add_nonneg (hw₁ p (Finset.mem_insert_self p Ω))
          (hw₂ p (Finset.mem_insert_self p Ω)))
          (mul_nonneg (hw₁ p (Finset.mem_insert_self p Ω))
            (hw₂ p (Finset.mem_insert_self p Ω)))
      simp only [pairUnionPowersetMass, weightedPowersetMass,
        Finset.sum_powerset_insert hp]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [h01, h10, h11, hR]
      change pairUnionPowersetMass Ω w₁ w₂ keep + w₂ p * M₁ +
          (w₁ p * M₁ + w₁ p * w₂ p * M₁) ≤
        weightedPowersetMass Ω g keep + g p * W₁
      calc
        _ = pairUnionPowersetMass Ω w₁ w₂ keep +
            (w₁ p + w₂ p + w₁ p * w₂ p) * M₁ := by ring
        _ ≤ weightedPowersetMass Ω g keep +
            (w₁ p + w₂ p + w₁ p * w₂ p) * W₁ :=
          add_le_add ih0 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih1 hpCoeff)
        _ ≤ weightedPowersetMass Ω g keep + g p * W₁ :=
          add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (hg p (Finset.mem_insert_self p Ω)) hW₁) _

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.secondDimensionLocalWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem secondDimensionLocalWeight_nonneg (m p : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ secondDimensionLocalWeight m p
proof:
:= by
  unfold secondDimensionLocalWeight
  split_ifs
  · positivity
  · exact dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_localSelbergPrimeWeight
statement:
theorem dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_localSelbergPrimeWeight
    {m p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) :
    dimensionOneLocalWeight p + secondDimensionLocalWeight m p +
        dimensionOneLocalWeight p * secondDimensionLocalWeight m p ≤
      localSelbergPrimeWeight m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [localSelbergPrimeWeight, localDensity_apply_prime hp]
  unfold secondDimensionLocalWeight dimensionOneLocalWeight
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · rw [if_pos hpm, if_pos hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, add_zero, mul_zero]
    have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
    have hden : (p : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.mpr hpOne).ne'
    field_simp [hpPos.ne', hden]
    norm_num
  · rw [if_neg hpm, if_neg hpm]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hpNeTwo : p ≠ 2 := by
      intro hpTwo
      subst p
      exact hpm (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)
    have hpTwo := hp.two_le
    have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := by omega
    have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hpTwoReal : (2 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)
    have hpSubTwo : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 2 := sub_pos.mpr hpTwoReal
    have hpOneReal : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    have hpSubOne : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hpOneReal
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one]
    have hrhs : (2 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) *
        (1 - (2 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ))⁻¹ = 2 / ((p : ℝ) - 2) := by
      rw [show 1 - 2 / (p : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 2) / p by
        field_simp [hpPos.ne']]
      field_simp [hpPos.ne', hpSubTwo.ne']
    rw [hrhs]
    have hlhs :
        ((p : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ + ((p : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ +
          ((p : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ * ((p : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ =
        2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ + (((p : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hlhs]
    field_simp [hpSubOne.ne', hpSubTwo.ne']
    nlinarith [show (3 : ℝ) ≤ p by exact_mod_cast hpThree]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneFilteredMass_le_secondWeightedMass
statement:
theorem dimensionOneFilteredMass_le_secondWeightedMass
    {m T : ℕ} :
    dimensionOneSubsetMass ((Nat.primesLE T).filter fun p ↦ ¬p ∣ m) T ≤
      weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE T)
        (secondDimensionLocalWeight m) (productBoundKeep T)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ((Nat.primesLE T).filter fun p ↦ ¬p ∣ m).powerset ⊆
      (Nat.primesLE T).powerset := Finset.powerset_mono.mpr (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetMass weightedPowersetMass productBoundKeep
  calc
    (∑ A ∈ ((Nat.primesLE T).filter fun p ↦ ¬p ∣ m).powerset,
        if A.prod id ≤ T then ∏ p ∈ A, dimensionOneLocalWeight p else 0) =
        ∑ A ∈ ((Nat.primesLE T).filter fun p ↦ ¬p ∣ m).powerset,
          if decide (A.prod id ≤ T) then
            ∏ p ∈ A, secondDimensionLocalWeight m p else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A hA
      have hAActive : ∀ p ∈ A, ¬p ∣ m := by
        intro p hp
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hp)).2
      by_cases hprod : A.prod id ≤ T
      · simp only [hprod, ↓reduceIte, decide_true]
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        simp [secondDimensionLocalWeight, hAActive p hp]
      · have hdec : ¬decide (A.prod id ≤ T) = true := fun h ↦
          hprod (of_decide_eq_true h)
        rw [if_neg hprod, if_neg hdec]
    _ ≤ ∑ A ∈ (Nat.primesLE T).powerset,
          if decide (A.prod id ≤ T) then
            ∏ p ∈ A, secondDimensionLocalWeight m p else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
      intro A hA _hnot
      by_cases hprod : A.prod id ≤ T
      · have hdec : decide (A.prod id ≤ T) = true := decide_eq_true hprod
        rw [if_pos hdec]
        exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ secondDimensionLocalWeight_nonneg m p
      · have hdec : ¬decide (A.prod id ≤ T) = true := fun h ↦
          hprod (of_decide_eq_true h)
        rw [if_neg hdec]

theorem dimensionOneMass_eq_weightedPowersetMass (T : ℕ) :

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.pairUnionPowersetMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem pairUnionPowersetMass_nonneg
    {Ω : Finset ℕ} {w₁ w₂ : ℕ → ℝ} {keep : Finset ℕ → Bool}
    (hw₁ : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w₁ p) (hw₂ : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w₂ p) :
    0 ≤ pairUnionPowersetMass Ω w₁ w₂ keep
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairUnionPowersetMass
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro A hA
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro B hB
  split_ifs
  · exact mul_nonneg
      (Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ hw₁ p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hp))
      (Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ hw₂ p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hB hp))
  · positivity

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.weightedRectangleMass_le_pairUnionMass
statement:
theorem weightedRectangleMass_le_pairUnionMass
    {Ω : Finset ℕ} {w₁ w₂ : ℕ → ℝ} {T z : ℕ}
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ Ω, p.Prime) (hTz : T ^ 2 ≤ z)
    (hw₁ : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w₁ p) (hw₂ : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w₂ p) :
    weightedPowersetMass Ω w₁ (productBoundKeep T) *
        weightedPowersetMass Ω w₂ (productBoundKeep T) ≤
      pairUnionPowersetMass Ω w₁ w₂ (productBoundKeep z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedPowersetMass pairUnionPowersetMass productBoundKeep
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro A hA
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro B hB
  have hUnionProd : (A ∪ B).prod id ≤ A.prod id * B.prod id := by
    have hInterPos : 0 < (A ∩ B).prod id := by
      apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro p hp
      exact (hprime p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA (Finset.mem_inter.mp hp).1)).pos
    calc
      (A ∪ B).prod id ≤ (A ∪ B).prod id * (A ∩ B).prod id :=
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hInterPos
      _ = A.prod id * B.prod id := Finset.prod_union_inter
  by_cases hAProd : A.prod id ≤ T
  · by_cases hBProd : B.prod id ≤ T
    · have hkeep : (A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z :=
        hUnionProd.trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul hAProd hBProd).trans (by simpa [pow_two] using hTz))
      have hAdec : decide (A.prod id ≤ T) = true := decide_eq_true hAProd
      have hBdec : decide (B.prod id ≤ T) = true := decide_eq_true hBProd
      have hkdec : decide ((A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z) = true := decide_eq_true hkeep
      rw [if_pos hAdec, if_pos hBdec, if_pos hkdec]
    · have hBdec : ¬decide (B.prod id ≤ T) = true := fun h ↦
        hBProd (of_decide_eq_true h)
      rw [if_neg hBdec]
      simp only [mul_zero]
      by_cases hkeep : (A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z
      · have hkdec : decide ((A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z) = true := decide_eq_true hkeep
        rw [if_pos hkdec]
        exact mul_nonneg
          (Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ hw₁ p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hp))
          (Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ hw₂ p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hB hp))
      · have hkdec : ¬decide ((A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z) = true := fun h ↦
          hkeep (of_decide_eq_true h)
        rw [if_neg hkdec]
  · have hAdec : ¬decide (A.prod id ≤ T) = true := fun h ↦
      hAProd (of_decide_eq_true h)
    rw [if_neg hAdec]
    simp only [zero_mul]
    by_cases hkeep : (A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z
    · have hkdec : decide ((A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z) = true := decide_eq_true hkeep
      rw [if_pos hkdec]
      exact mul_nonneg
        (Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ hw₁ p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hp))
        (Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp ↦ hw₂ p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hB hp))
    · have hkdec : ¬decide ((A ∪ B).prod id ≤ z) = true := fun h ↦
        hkeep (of_decide_eq_true h)
      rw [if_neg hkdec]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.selbergTerms_prime_eq_localSelbergPrimeWeight
statement:
theorem selbergTerms_prime_eq_localSelbergPrimeWeight
    {m R z p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) (hpz : p ≤ z) :
    (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).selbergTerms p =
      localSelbergPrimeWeight m p
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hpDvd : p ∣ s.prodPrimes := by
    change p ∣ primeProduct z
    exact (prime_dvd_primeProduct_iff hp).mpr
      (Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr ⟨hpz, hp⟩)
  rw [BoundingSieve.selbergTerms_apply]
  simp only [hp.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
  change sieveDensity m p * (1 - sieveDensity m p)⁻¹ = _
  rw [sieveDensity_apply_prime hp]
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.product_injective_on_productBoundedPrimeSubsets
statement:
theorem product_injective_on_productBoundedPrimeSubsets {z : ℕ} :
    Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (productBoundedPrimeSubsets z : Set (Finset ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA B hB hprod
  have hASub : A ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hBSub : B ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hB).1
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hASub hp)
  have hBPrime : ∀ p ∈ B, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hBSub hp)
  rw [← Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime, ← Nat.primeFactors_prod hBPrime]
  exact congrArg Nat.primeFactors hprod

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
statement:
theorem productBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) {A : Finset ℕ}
    (hA : A ∈ productBoundedPrimeSubsets z) :
    (∏ p ∈ A, localSelbergPrimeWeight m p) =
      (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm).selbergTerms (A.prod id)
proof:
:= by
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hASub : A ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hAPrime : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE (hASub hp)
  have hdvd : A.prod id ∣ s.prodPrimes := by
    change A.prod id ∣ primeProduct z
    rw [primeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (Nat.primesLE z) id hASub
  have hsq : Squarefree (A.prod id) :=
    Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdvd s.prodPrimes_squarefree
  rw [← s.selbergTerms_isMultiplicative.prod_primeFactors hsq]
  have hpf : (A.prod id).primeFactors = A := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using Nat.primeFactors_prod hAPrime
  rw [hpf]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hpA
  exact (selbergTerms_prime_eq_localSelbergPrimeWeight hm
    (hAPrime p hpA) (Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE (hASub hpA))).symm

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.productBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
statement:
theorem productBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (productBoundedPrimeSubsets z).image (fun A ↦ A.prod id) ⊆
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedDivisors (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hd
  obtain ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ := hd
  have hASub : A ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  have hprod : A.prod id ≤ z := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2
  rw [SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors,
    minimizingSelbergSieve_level_of_one_le hm hz]
  constructor
  · change A.prod id ∣ primeProduct z
    rw [primeProduct]
    exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset A (Nat.primesLE z) id hASub
  · exact_mod_cast pow_le_pow_left' hprod 2

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass_localSelberg_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem weightedPowersetMass_localSelberg_le_truncatedMass
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE z) (localSelbergPrimeWeight m)
        (productBoundKeep z) ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
proof:
:= by
  let C := productBoundedPrimeSubsets z
  let s := minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ A.prod id)
      (C : Set (Finset ℕ)) := by
    exact product_injective_on_productBoundedPrimeSubsets
  have hsum : weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE z) (localSelbergPrimeWeight m)
        (productBoundKeep z) =
      ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
    calc
      weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE z) (localSelbergPrimeWeight m)
          (productBoundKeep z) =
          ∑ A ∈ C, ∏ p ∈ A, localSelbergPrimeWeight m p := by
        unfold weightedPowersetMass productBoundKeep C productBoundedPrimeSubsets
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        by_cases hprod : A.prod id ≤ z
        · have hdec : decide (A.prod id ≤ z) = true := decide_eq_true hprod
          rw [if_pos hdec, if_pos hprod]
        · have hdec : ¬decide (A.prod id ≤ z) = true := fun h ↦
            hprod (of_decide_eq_true h)
          rw [if_neg hdec, if_neg hprod]
      _ = ∑ A ∈ C, s.selbergTerms (A.prod id) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A hA
        exact productBoundedPrimeSubset_weight_eq_selbergTerms hm hA
      _ = ∑ d ∈ C.image (fun A ↦ A.prod id), s.selbergTerms d := by
        rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
  rw [hsum]
  unfold SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · exact productBoundedPrimeSubsets_image_subset_truncatedDivisors hm hz
  · intro d hd _hnot
    exact (s.selbergTerms_pos
      (SelbergFundamental.mem_truncatedDivisors.mp hd).1).le

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionTwoPairCorrection_pos
statement:
theorem dimensionTwoPairCorrection_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    0 < dimensionTwoPairCorrection n
proof:
:= by
  unfold dimensionTwoPairCorrection
  have hnR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  exact div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith)) (mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.one_le_dimensionTwoPairCorrection
statement:
theorem one_le_dimensionTwoPairCorrection {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    1 ≤ dimensionTwoPairCorrection n
proof:
:= by
  have hnR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hden : 0 < (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 2) :=
    mul_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [dimensionTwoPairCorrection, le_div_iff₀ hden]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((n : ℝ) - 1)]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.prod_dimensionTwoPairCorrection_Icc
statement:
theorem prod_dimensionTwoPairCorrection_Icc {z : ℕ} (hz : 3 ≤ z) :
    (∏ n ∈ Finset.Icc 3 z, dimensionTwoPairCorrection n) =
      2 * ((z : ℝ) - 1) / z
proof:
:= by
  induction z, hz using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => norm_num [dimensionTwoPairCorrection]
  | succ z hz ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
      unfold dimensionTwoPairCorrection
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      have hzThree : (3 : ℝ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hz
      have hzR : (0 : ℝ) < z := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < z by omega)
      have hzm1 : (0 : ℝ) < z - 1 := by linarith
      have hz1 : (0 : ℝ) < z + 1 := by positivity
      have hsubOne : (z : ℝ) + 1 - 1 = z := by ring
      have hsubTwo : (z : ℝ) + 1 - 2 = z - 1 := by ring
      rw [hsubOne, hsubTwo]
      field_simp [hzR.ne', hzm1.ne', hz1.ne']

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.prod_dimensionTwoPairCorrection_Icc_le_two
statement:
theorem prod_dimensionTwoPairCorrection_Icc_le_two {z : ℕ} (hz : 3 ≤ z) :
    (∏ n ∈ Finset.Icc 3 z, dimensionTwoPairCorrection n) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_dimensionTwoPairCorrection_Icc hz]
  have hzR : (0 : ℝ) < z := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < z by omega)
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hzR).2
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.activeDimensionTwoPrimes_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem activeDimensionTwoPrimes_subset_Icc {m z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) :
    activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z ⊆ Finset.Icc 3 z
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hpData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
  have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpData.1
  have hpNeTwo : p ≠ 2 := by
    intro h
    subst p
    exact hpData.2 (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)
  exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by
    have hpTwo := hpPrime.two_le
    omega, Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hpData.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.activeDimensionTwoCorrectionProduct_le_two
statement:
theorem activeDimensionTwoCorrectionProduct_le_two
    {m z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 3 ≤ z) :
    (∏ p ∈ activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z, dimensionTwoPairCorrection p) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z, dimensionTwoPairCorrection p) ≤
        ∏ n ∈ Finset.Icc 3 z, dimensionTwoPairCorrection n := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le
        (activeDimensionTwoPrimes_subset_Icc hm)
      · intro p hp
        exact (dimensionTwoPairCorrection_pos (Finset.mem_Icc.mp
          (activeDimensionTwoPrimes_subset_Icc hm hp)).1).le
      · intro n hn _hnnot
        exact one_le_dimensionTwoPairCorrection (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
    _ ≤ 2 := prod_dimensionTwoPairCorrection_Icc_le_two hz

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localEulerFactor_eq_dimensionOneFactors
statement:
theorem localEulerFactor_eq_dimensionOneFactors
    {m p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) :
    1 + localSelbergPrimeWeight m p =
      (1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p) * (1 + secondDimensionLocalWeight m p) *
        conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [localSelbergPrimeWeight, localDensity_apply_prime hp]
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · simp only [secondDimensionLocalWeight, conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection, if_pos hpm]
    unfold dimensionOneLocalWeight
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, add_zero, mul_one]
    have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
    field_simp [hpPos.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hpOne).ne']
    ring
  · simp only [secondDimensionLocalWeight, conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection, if_neg hpm]
    unfold dimensionOneLocalWeight dimensionTwoPairCorrection
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have hpNeTwo : p ≠ 2 := by
      intro h
      subst p
      exact hpm (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)
    have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := by
      have := hp.two_le
      omega
    have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hpOne : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    have hpTwo : (2 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le]
    field_simp [hpPos.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hpOne).ne', (sub_pos.mpr hpTwo).ne']
    ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.fullSelbergMass_eq_prod_localSelbergPrimeWeight
statement:
theorem fullSelbergMass_eq_prod_localSelbergPrimeWeight
    (m R z : ℕ) (hm : Even m) :
    fullSelbergMass m R z hm =
      ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 + localSelbergPrimeWeight m p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullSelbergMass_eq_localSieveProduct_inv]
  unfold localSieveProduct
  rw [← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hpz
  have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
  have hsurvival : 0 < 1 - localDensity m p := by
    rw [localDensity_apply_prime hp]
    by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
    · rw [if_pos hpm]
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_one]
      have hpR : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
      have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by linarith
      exact sub_pos.mpr ((div_lt_one hpPos).2 (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt))
    · rw [if_neg hpm]
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
      have hpNeTwo : p ≠ 2 := by
        intro h
        subst p
        exact hpm (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hm)
      have hpThree : 3 ≤ p := by
        have := hp.two_le
        omega
      have hpPos : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
      exact sub_pos.mpr ((div_lt_one hpPos).2
        (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 < p by omega)))
  unfold localSelbergPrimeWeight
  field_simp [hsurvival.ne']
  ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.prod_secondDimensionLocalWeight_eq_activeProduct
statement:
theorem prod_secondDimensionLocalWeight_eq_activeProduct (m z : ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 + secondDimensionLocalWeight m p)) =
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct activeDimensionTwoPrimes secondDimensionLocalWeight
  rw [Finset.prod_filter]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · simp [hpm]
  · simp [hpm]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.prod_conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection_eq_active
statement:
theorem prod_conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection_eq_active (m z : ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection m p) =
      ∏ p ∈ activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z, dimensionTwoPairCorrection p
proof:
:= by
  unfold activeDimensionTwoPrimes conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection
  rw [Finset.prod_filter]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpm : p ∣ m
  · simp [hpm]
  · simp [hpm]

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.fullSelbergMass_le_two_dimensionOneProducts
statement:
theorem fullSelbergMass_le_two_dimensionOneProducts
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 3 ≤ z) :
    fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
      2 * dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullSelbergMass_eq_prod_localSelbergPrimeWeight]
  have hsplit :
      (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 + localSelbergPrimeWeight m p)) =
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) *
          (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 + secondDimensionLocalWeight m p)) *
            (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection m p) := by
    unfold dimensionOneSubsetProduct
    calc
      (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 + localSelbergPrimeWeight m p)) =
          ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z,
            ((1 + dimensionOneLocalWeight p) *
              (1 + secondDimensionLocalWeight m p) *
                conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection m p) := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        exact localEulerFactor_eq_dimensionOneFactors hm
          (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [hsplit, prod_secondDimensionLocalWeight_eq_activeProduct,
    prod_conditionalDimensionTwoCorrection_eq_active]
  have hprodNonneg : 0 ≤ dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) *
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) :=
    mul_nonneg (dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _).le
      (dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _).le
  calc
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) *
          dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) *
          (∏ p ∈ activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z, dimensionTwoPairCorrection p) ≤
        (dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) *
          dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z)) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (activeDimensionTwoCorrectionProduct_le_two hm hz) hprodNonneg
    _ = 2 * dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem localSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg
    {m p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) :
    0 ≤ localSelbergPrimeWeight m p
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
  have h₂ := secondDimensionLocalWeight_nonneg m p
  exact (add_nonneg (add_nonneg h₁ h₂) (mul_nonneg h₁ h₂)).trans
    (dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_localSelbergPrimeWeight hm hp)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.weightedPowersetMass_mono_coordinates
statement:
theorem weightedPowersetMass_mono_coordinates
    {Ω Ω' : Finset ℕ} {w : ℕ → ℝ} {keep : Finset ℕ → Bool}
    (hΩ : Ω ⊆ Ω') (hw : ∀ p ∈ Ω', 0 ≤ w p) :
    weightedPowersetMass Ω w keep ≤ weightedPowersetMass Ω' w keep
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedPowersetMass
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.powerset_mono.mpr hΩ)
  intro A hA _hnot
  split_ifs
  · apply Finset.prod_nonneg
    intro p hp
    exact hw p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA hp)
  · positivity

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassProduct_le_truncatedMass
statement:
theorem dimensionOneMassProduct_le_truncatedMass
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE z.sqrt) z.sqrt *
        dimensionOneSubsetMass (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z.sqrt) z.sqrt ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
proof:
:= by
  let T := z.sqrt
  have hTz : T ≤ z := Nat.sqrt_le_self z
  have hsquare : T ^ 2 ≤ z := by simpa [T] using Nat.sqrt_le' z
  have hprime : ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE T, p.Prime := fun p hp ↦
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp
  have hΩ : Nat.primesLE T ⊆ Nat.primesLE z := primesLE_mono hTz
  calc
    dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T *
          dimensionOneSubsetMass (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m T) T =
        weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE T) dimensionOneLocalWeight
            (productBoundKeep T) *
          dimensionOneSubsetMass (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m T) T := by
      rw [dimensionOneMass_eq_weightedPowersetMass]
    _ ≤ weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE T) dimensionOneLocalWeight
            (productBoundKeep T) *
          weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE T) (secondDimensionLocalWeight m)
            (productBoundKeep T) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact dimensionOneFilteredMass_le_secondWeightedMass
      · rw [← dimensionOneMass_eq_weightedPowersetMass]
        exact dimensionOneSubsetMass_nonneg _ _
    _ ≤ pairUnionPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE T) dimensionOneLocalWeight
          (secondDimensionLocalWeight m) (productBoundKeep z) :=
      weightedRectangleMass_le_pairUnionMass hprime hsquare
        (fun p hp ↦ dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p)
        (fun p hp ↦ secondDimensionLocalWeight_nonneg m p)
    _ ≤ weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE T) (localSelbergPrimeWeight m)
          (productBoundKeep z) := by
      apply pairUnionPowersetMass_le_weightedPowersetMass
      · exact fun p hp ↦ dimensionOneLocalWeight_nonneg p
      · exact fun p hp ↦ secondDimensionLocalWeight_nonneg m p
      · intro p hp
        exact dimensionOnePairCoefficient_le_localSelbergPrimeWeight hm (hprime p hp)
    _ ≤ weightedPowersetMass (Nat.primesLE z) (localSelbergPrimeWeight m)
          (productBoundKeep z) := by
      apply weightedPowersetMass_mono_coordinates hΩ
      intro p hp
      exact localSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg hm (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)
    _ ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) :=
      weightedPowersetMass_localSelberg_le_truncatedMass hm hz

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneMassLoss_pos
statement: theorem dimensionOneMassLoss_pos : 0 < dimensionOneMassLoss
proof:
:= by
  unfold dimensionOneMassLoss

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneTailLoss_pos
statement: theorem dimensionOneTailLoss_pos : 0 < dimensionOneTailLoss
proof:
:= by

  positivity

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss_pos
statement: theorem dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss_pos : 0 < dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss
proof:
:= by

    (sq_pos_of_pos (mul_pos dimensionOneTailLoss_pos dimensionOneMassLoss_pos))

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant_pos
statement: theorem dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant_pos : 0 < dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant
proof:
:=
  inv_pos.mpr dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss_pos

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_massLoss_mul_mass
statement:
theorem dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_massLoss_mul_mass
    {S : Finset ℕ} {T : ℕ} (hS : S ⊆ Nat.primesLE T) (hT : 3 ≤ T) :
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct S ≤
      dimensionOneMassLoss * dimensionOneSubsetMass S T
proof:
:= by
  have h := dimensionOneSubsetMass_lower hS hT
  have hK := dimensionOneMassLoss_pos
  calc
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct S = dimensionOneMassLoss * (dimensionOneMassLoss)⁻¹ *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct S := by field_simp [hK.ne']
    _ = dimensionOneMassLoss *
        ((dimensionOneMassLoss)⁻¹ * dimensionOneSubsetProduct S) := by ring
    _ ≤ dimensionOneMassLoss * dimensionOneSubsetMass S T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa [dimensionOneMassLoss] using h) hK.le

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.activeDimensionTwoPrimes_inter_primesLE
statement:
theorem activeDimensionTwoPrimes_inter_primesLE
    {m T z : ℕ} (hTz : T ≤ z) :
    activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z ∩ Nat.primesLE T =
      activeDimensionTwoPrimes m T
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hpData := Finset.mem_inter.mp hp
    have hpActive := Finset.mem_filter.mp hpData.1
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpData.2, hpActive.2⟩
  · intro hp
    have hpData := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨primesLE_mono hTz hpData.1, hpData.2⟩, hpData.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionOneAllPrimeProduct_le_tailLoss
statement:
theorem dimensionOneAllPrimeProduct_le_tailLoss {z : ℕ} (hz : 9 ≤ z) :
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) ≤
      dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z.sqrt)
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor := dimensionOneSubsetProduct_primesLE_factor (Nat.sqrt_le_self z)
  have htail := dimensionOneTailProduct_sqrt_le hz
  calc
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) =
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z.sqrt) *
          dimensionOneTailProduct z.sqrt z := hfactor
    _ ≤ dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z.sqrt) * dimensionOneTailLoss := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · simpa [dimensionOneTailLoss] using htail
      · exact (dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _).le
    _ = dimensionOneTailLoss *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z.sqrt) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.activeDimensionTwoProduct_le_tailLoss
statement:
theorem activeDimensionTwoProduct_le_tailLoss {m z : ℕ} (hz : 9 ≤ z) :
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) ≤
      dimensionOneTailLoss *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z.sqrt)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z ⊆ Nat.primesLE z :=
    Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hbase := dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_tail_mul_restriction
    (T := z.sqrt) hsub
  rw [activeDimensionTwoPrimes_inter_primesLE (Nat.sqrt_le_self z)] at hbase
  calc
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) ≤
        dimensionOneTailProduct z.sqrt z *
          dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z.sqrt) := hbase
    _ ≤ dimensionOneTailLoss *
        dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z.sqrt) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      · simpa [dimensionOneTailLoss] using dimensionOneTailProduct_sqrt_le hz
      · exact (dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _).le

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.largeCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound
statement:
theorem largeCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 9 ≤ z) :
    dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant * fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
proof:
:= by
  let T := z.sqrt
  let M₁ := dimensionOneSubsetMass (Nat.primesLE T) T
  let M₂ := dimensionOneSubsetMass (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m T) T
  have hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁ := dimensionOneSubsetMass_nonneg _ _
  have hM₂ : 0 ≤ M₂ := dimensionOneSubsetMass_nonneg _ _
  have hT : 3 ≤ T := by rw [Nat.le_sqrt]; omega
  have hfirstSmall : dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) ≤
      dimensionOneMassLoss * M₁ :=
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_massLoss_mul_mass (fun p hp ↦ hp) hT
  have hsecondSub : activeDimensionTwoPrimes m T ⊆ Nat.primesLE T :=
    Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hsecondSmall : dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m T) ≤
      dimensionOneMassLoss * M₂ :=
    dimensionOneSubsetProduct_le_massLoss_mul_mass hsecondSub hT
  have hfirst : dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) ≤
      dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneMassLoss * M₁ := by
    calc
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) ≤
          dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE T) :=
        dimensionOneAllPrimeProduct_le_tailLoss hz
      _ ≤ dimensionOneTailLoss * (dimensionOneMassLoss * M₁) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfirstSmall dimensionOneTailLoss_pos.le
      _ = dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneMassLoss * M₁ := by ring
  have hsecond : dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) ≤
      dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneMassLoss * M₂ := by
    calc
      dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) ≤
          dimensionOneTailLoss *
            dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m T) :=
        activeDimensionTwoProduct_le_tailLoss hz
      _ ≤ dimensionOneTailLoss * (dimensionOneMassLoss * M₂) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsecondSmall dimensionOneTailLoss_pos.le
      _ = dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneMassLoss * M₂ := by ring
  have hfull : fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
      dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss * (M₁ * M₂) := by
    have hactiveZ : 0 ≤ dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) :=
      (dimensionOneSubsetProduct_pos _).le
    have hfirstBound :
        0 ≤ 2 * (dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneMassLoss * M₁) := by
      exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg dimensionOneTailLoss_pos.le dimensionOneMassLoss_pos.le) hM₁)
    calc
      fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
          2 * dimensionOneSubsetProduct (Nat.primesLE z) *
            dimensionOneSubsetProduct (activeDimensionTwoPrimes m z) :=
        fullSelbergMass_le_two_dimensionOneProducts hm (by omega)
      _ ≤ 2 * (dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneMassLoss * M₁) *
          (dimensionOneTailLoss * dimensionOneMassLoss * M₂) := by
        gcongr
      _ = dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss * (M₁ * M₂) := by
        unfold dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss
        ring
  calc
    dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant * fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
        dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant *
          (dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss * (M₁ * M₂)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfull dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant_pos.le
    _ = M₁ * M₂ := by
      unfold dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant
      field_simp [dimensionTwoLargeMassLoss_pos.ne']
    _ ≤ SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm) :=
      dimensionOneMassProduct_le_truncatedMass hm (by omega)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.localEulerFactor_le_succ
statement:
theorem localEulerFactor_le_succ
    {m R z p : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hp : p.Prime) (hpz : p ≤ z) :
    1 + localSelbergPrimeWeight m p ≤ 1 + (p : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm := selbergTerms_prime_le_cast (R := R) hm hp hpz
  rw [selbergTerms_prime_eq_localSelbergPrimeWeight hm hp hpz] at hterm
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.fullSelbergMass_le_576
statement:
theorem fullSelbergMass_le_576
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : z < 9) :
    fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤ 576
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullSelbergMass_eq_prod_localSelbergPrimeWeight]
  have hz8 : z ≤ 8 := by omega
  calc
    (∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 + localSelbergPrimeWeight m p)) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, (1 + (p : ℝ)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro p hp
        have hpPrime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp
        have hw := localSelbergPrimeWeight_nonneg hm hpPrime
        linarith
      · intro p hp
        exact localEulerFactor_le_succ (R := R) hm
          (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) (Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hp)
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesLE 8, (1 + (p : ℝ)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le (primesLE_mono hz8)
      · intro p hp
        positivity
      · intro p hp _hnot
        have hpNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := by positivity
        linarith
    _ = 576 := by
      have hprimes : Nat.primesLE 8 = {2, 3, 5, 7} := by decide
      rw [hprimes]
      norm_num

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant_pos
statement:
theorem growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant_pos :
    0 < growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant
  exact lt_min dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant_pos (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.dimensionTwoMassLowerBound_all_cutoffs
statement:
theorem dimensionTwoMassLowerBound_all_cutoffs
    {m R z : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant * fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
      SelbergFundamental.truncatedMass (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlarge : 9 ≤ z
  · calc
      growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant * fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
          dimensionTwoLargeMassConstant * fullSelbergMass m R z hm := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        · exact min_le_left _ _
        · exact (fullSelbergMass_pos m R z hm).le
      _ ≤ _ := largeCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound hm hlarge
  · have hfull := fullSelbergMass_le_576 (R := R) (z := z) hm (by omega)
    have hc : growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant ≤ (576 : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      min_le_right _ _
    have hmassOne := SelbergFundamental.one_le_truncatedMass
      (minimizingSelbergSieve m R z hm)
    calc
      growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant * fullSelbergMass m R z hm ≤
          (576 : ℝ)⁻¹ * 576 := by
        apply mul_le_mul hc hfull
        · exact (fullSelbergMass_pos m R z hm).le
        · positivity
      _ = 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ _ := hmassOne

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound
statement:
theorem growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound :
    GrowingCutoffDimensionTwoMassLowerBound growingCutoffDimensionTwoMassConstant
proof:
:= by
  intro m R _hm hmEven hR
  rw [← fullSelbergMass_eq_localSieveProduct_inv]
  have hz : 1 ≤ selbergGrowingCutoff R := by
    have hzPos := selbergGrowingCutoff_pos (R := R) (by omega)
    omega
  exact dimensionTwoMassLowerBound_all_cutoffs hmEven hz

name: RankAmplification.BFPSTwoAffine.hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_growingCutoff
statement:
theorem hasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound_growingCutoff :
    HasBFPSTwoAffineSieveBound bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.sieveConstant
proof:

  bfpsTerminalSelbergDataGrowingCutoff.hasTwoAffineSieveBound

name: RankAmplification.movingZ_eq_exp

name: RankAmplification.log_movingZ
statement: @[simp, nolint simpNF] theorem log_movingZ (x : ℝ) : Real.log (movingZ x) = movingK x

name: RankAmplification.movingJ_eq_floor

proof: := rfl

@[simp] theorem movingK_eq_rank_mul (x : ℝ) :
