name: RankAmplification.lemmaTwoFiveC0_pos
statement: theorem lemmaTwoFiveC0_pos : 0 < lemmaTwoFiveC0
proof:
:= by
  have hK := lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant_pos
  have h6 := log_log_six_pos
  have h2 := log_log_two_neg
  have hquot : Real.log (Real.log 2) / Real.log (Real.log 6) < 0 :=
    div_neg_of_neg_of_pos h2 h6
  rw [lemmaTwoFiveC0]
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant)
    (Real.exp_pos 2)) (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.lemma2_5_dominance_of_range
statement:
theorem lemma2_5_dominance_of_range {R X : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu0 : lemmaTwoFiveU0 ≤ rankinU X R)
    (hrange : lemmaTwoFiveC0 * log2 (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) :
    fullPaperDivisorError R X ≤ rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hKpos : 0 < lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant := lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant_pos
  have hu1 : 1 < rankinU X R := one_lt_lemmaTwoFiveU0.trans_le hu0
  have hupos : 0 < rankinU X R := zero_lt_one.trans hu1
  have hlogu_pos : 0 < Real.log (rankinU X R) := Real.log_pos hu1
  
  have hlogu_sqrt : Real.sqrt (12 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant) ≤ Real.log (rankinU X R) := by
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < lemmaTwoFiveU0 := zero_lt_one.trans one_lt_lemmaTwoFiveU0
    have h := Real.log_le_log h0 hu0
    rwa [lemmaTwoFiveU0, Real.log_exp] at h
  have hsq : 12 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant ≤ Real.log (rankinU X R) ^ 2 := by
    have hval := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 12 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant by linarith)
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (12 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant)]
  
  have hA : lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant * (3 * rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R)) ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 4 := by
    have hkey : 3 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant * rankinU X R ≤
        rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 4 * Real.log (rankinU X R) := by
      have hmul : rankinU X R * (12 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant) ≤
          rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hupos.le
      nlinarith
    calc
      lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant * (3 * rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R)) =
          3 * lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant * rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R) := by ring
      _ ≤ rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 4 := (div_le_iff₀ hlogu_pos).2 hkey
  
  have hrange' : lemmaTwoFiveC0 * Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) := by
    simpa [log2, iteratedLog] using hrange
  have hm : 0 < Real.log (Real.log 6) := log_log_six_pos
  have h2neg : Real.log (Real.log 2) < 0 := log_log_two_neg
  have hLLge : Real.log (Real.log 6) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) := by
    have hRreal : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hR
    have hlog6 : Real.log 6 ≤ Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ)) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith [one_lt_log_six]) hlog6
  have hstep : Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) ≤
      (1 - Real.log (Real.log 2) / Real.log (Real.log 6)) *
        Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) := by
    have hquot : Real.log (Real.log 2) * Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) /
        Real.log (Real.log 6) ≤ Real.log (Real.log 2) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hm]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 h2neg.le) (sub_nonneg.2 hLLge)]
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    linarith
  have hB : lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant *
      (Real.exp 2 * (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2))) ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 4 := by
    calc
      lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant *
          (Real.exp 2 *
            (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2))) ≤
          lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant *
            (Real.exp 2 *
              ((1 - Real.log (Real.log 2) / Real.log (Real.log 6)) *
                Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (Real.exp_pos 2).le) hKpos.le
      _ = lemmaTwoFiveC0 * Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) / 4 := by
        rw [lemmaTwoFiveC0]; ring
      _ ≤ rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 4 := by linarith
  calc
    fullPaperDivisorError R X =
        lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant *
            (Real.exp 2 *
              (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2))) +
          lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant *
            (3 * rankinU X R / Real.log (rankinU X R)) := by
      rw [fullPaperDivisorError, fullULogUPrimeError, lemmaTwoFiveErrorConstant]
      ring
    _ ≤ rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 4 +
        rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 4 := add_le_add hB hA
    _ = rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) / 2 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_half_u_log_u_of_range
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_half_u_log_u_of_range {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu0 : lemmaTwoFiveU0 ≤ rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R)
    (hrange : lemmaTwoFiveC0 * log2 (3 * (R : ℝ)) ≤
      rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤
      (X : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R)) / 2)
proof:
:=
  finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_half_u_log_u hX hR
    (one_lt_lemmaTwoFiveU0.trans_le hu0) huSqrt
    (lemma2_5_dominance_of_range hR hu0 hrange)

name: RankAmplification.section5VLogVConstant_pos
statement:
theorem section5VLogVConstant_pos {C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    0 < section5VLogVConstant C₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [section5VLogVConstant]
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.vLogV_le_half_u_log_u_of_lower
statement:
theorem vLogV_le_half_u_log_u_of_lower
    {C₀ V u : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 < C₀)
    (hVsq : (4 * C₀) ^ 2 ≤ V) (hVthree : 12 * C₀ ≤ V)
    (hqu : V / (4 * C₀) ≤ u) :
    section5VLogVConstant C₀ * (V * Real.log V) ≤ u * Real.log u / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hCne : C₀ ≠ 0 := hC₀.ne'
  have hCfour : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * C₀ := by linarith
  have hVpos : 0 < V := by linarith
  have hqpos : 0 < V / (4 * C₀) := div_pos hVpos hCfour
  have hq3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ V / (4 * C₀) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hCfour]
    linarith
  have hupos : 0 < u := hqpos.trans_le hqu
  have hlogq0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (V / (4 * C₀)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlogPow : Real.log ((4 * C₀) ^ 2) = 2 * Real.log (4 * C₀) := by
    rw [Real.log_pow]
    norm_num
  have hlogVge : 2 * Real.log (4 * C₀) ≤ Real.log V := by
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (4 * C₀) ^ 2) hVsq
    rwa [hlogPow] at h
  have hlogq : Real.log (V / (4 * C₀)) = Real.log V - Real.log (4 * C₀) :=
    Real.log_div hVpos.ne' hCfour.ne'
  have hhalf : Real.log V / 2 ≤ Real.log (V / (4 * C₀)) := by
    rw [hlogq]
    linarith
  have hmono : V / (4 * C₀) * Real.log (V / (4 * C₀)) ≤ u * Real.log u :=
    mul_le_mul hqu (Real.log_le_log hqpos hqu) hlogq0 hupos.le
  have hstart : section5VLogVConstant C₀ * (V * Real.log V) =
      V / (4 * C₀) * (Real.log V / 2) / 2 := by
    rw [section5VLogVConstant]
    field_simp
    ring
  have h1 : V / (4 * C₀) * (Real.log V / 2) ≤
      V / (4 * C₀) * Real.log (V / (4 * C₀)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf hqpos.le
  rw [hstart]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.eventually_vLogV_le_variableCutoff_local_saddle
statement:
theorem eventually_vLogV_le_variableCutoff_local_saddle
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop ((4 * C₀) ^ 2),
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (12 * C₀)]
    with x hlower hVsq hVthree
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  exact vLogV_le_half_u_log_u_of_lower hC₀ hVsq hVthree
    (hlower y T hcutoff hwindow p hp).2.2

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin_vLogV
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin_vLogV
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      HasSection5IntermediateRankinSaving x y
        (section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
          (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_rankinU_le_sqrt hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_fullPaperDivisorError_le_variableCutoff_half_saddle hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_vLogV_le_variableCutoff_local_saddle hc₀ hC₀,
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (12 * C₀)]
    with x hlower hupper herror hsaving hVthree
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hlowerData := hlower y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hCfour : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * C₀ := by linarith
  have hq3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hCfour]
    linarith
  exact ⟨hlowerData.1,
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3).trans_le (hq3.trans hlowerData.2.2),
    hupper y T hcutoff hwindow p hp, herror y T hcutoff hwindow p hp,
    hsaving y T hcutoff hwindow p hp⟩

name: RankAmplification.eventually_section5Intermediate_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV
statement:
theorem eventually_section5Intermediate_psiTau_le_exp_neg_vLogV
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
          (section5LocalCutoff x y p : ℝ) *
            Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
              (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin_vLogV hc₀ hC₀]
    with x hx
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  exact finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_section5Intermediate_le
    (hx y T hcutoff hwindow) hp

name: RankAmplification.eventually_smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le_exp_neg_vLogV
statement:
theorem eventually_smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le_exp_neg_vLogV
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate x y ≤
        2 * (x : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-(section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
            (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_section5IntermediateRankin_vLogV hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le]
    with x hx hrange
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow
  have hrangeData := hrange y T hcutoff hwindow
  exact smoothMultiplierB4Intermediate_le (by omega) hrangeData.2
    (hx y T hcutoff hwindow)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_two_T_le_section5VLogV_saving
statement:
theorem eventually_two_T_le_section5VLogV_saving
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T,
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      2 * T ≤ section5VLogVConstant C₀ *
        (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hCne : C₀ ≠ 0 := hC₀.ne'
  have hAraw := scaleA_isLittleO_log2.bound
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (96 * C₀ ^ 2) by positivity)
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually hAraw,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleL_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_scaleA_pos,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually eventually_log2_pos]
    with x hAbound hlogV hL hA hL2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hA.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hL2.le] at hAbound
  intro T hwindow
  have hG : 0 < scaleG (x : ℝ) := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV : 0 < scaleV (x : ℝ) := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hAG := scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  have hlogVge : 32 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    have h1 : 32 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ) ≤
        32 * C₀ ^ 2 * (1 / (96 * C₀ ^ 2) * log2 (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAbound (by positivity)
    have h2 : 32 * C₀ ^ 2 * (1 / (96 * C₀ ^ 2) * log2 (x : ℝ)) = log2 (x : ℝ) / 3 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    linarith
  have hGeq : scaleV (x : ℝ) * (32 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleA (x : ℝ)) =
      32 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) := by
    rw [← hAG]; ring
  have h32 : 32 * C₀ ^ 2 * scaleG (x : ℝ) ≤
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← hGeq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogVge hV.le
  have hkey : 2 * (C₀ * scaleG (x : ℝ)) ≤
      1 / (16 * C₀) * (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) := by
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) / (16 * C₀) * (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) =
      scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (16 * C₀) from by ring,
      le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 16 * C₀)]
    nlinarith [h32]
  rw [section5VLogVConstant]
  linarith [hwindow.2]

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_lemma2_5_range
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_lemma2_5_range
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        lemmaTwoFiveU0 ≤ rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p ∧
          lemmaTwoFiveC0 * log2 (3 * (p : ℝ)) ≤
            rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
              Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoffB4Intermediate_lowerRankin hc₀ hC₀,
      eventually_variableCutoff_natural_range hc₀ hC₀.le,
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop ((4 * C₀) ^ 2),
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (12 * C₀),
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * C₀ * lemmaTwoFiveU0),
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (48 * C₀ * lemmaTwoFiveC0),
      tendsto_scaleV_nat_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).eventually
        eventually_log2_le_three_log_scaleV,
      (tendsto_scaleL_atTop.comp
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).eventually_ge_atTop 3]
    with x hlower hnat hVsq hVthree hVu0 hVC0 hVone hlogV hL3
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hCne : C₀ ≠ 0 := hC₀.ne'
  have hCfour : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * C₀ := by linarith
  have hqu : scaleV (x : ℝ) / (4 * C₀) ≤ rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p :=
    (hlower y T hcutoff hwindow p hp).2.2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine le_trans ?_ hqu
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hCfour]
    nlinarith [hVu0]
  · have hsaving := vLogV_le_half_u_log_u_of_lower hC₀ hVsq hVthree hqu
    have hlogV0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg hVone
    have hlog2p : log2 (3 * (p : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * log2 (x : ℝ) :=
      log2_three_mul_variableCutoff_prime_le_two_log2 (hnat y T hcutoff hwindow).2 hL3 hp
    have hstep : log2 (3 * (p : ℝ)) ≤ 6 * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) := by linarith
    have hkey : lemmaTwoFiveC0 * log2 (3 * (p : ℝ)) ≤
        lemmaTwoFiveC0 * (6 * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep lemmaTwoFiveC0_pos.le
    have hmid : lemmaTwoFiveC0 * (6 * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ))) ≤
        scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (8 * C₀) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 8 * C₀)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hVC0 hlogV0]
    have hVW : scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (8 * C₀) ≤
        rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
          Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p) := by
      have heq : scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)) / (8 * C₀) =
          2 * (1 / (16 * C₀) * (scaleV (x : ℝ) * Real.log (scaleV (x : ℝ)))) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [section5VLogVConstant] at hsaving
      rw [heq]
      linarith
    exact hkey.trans (hmid.trans hVW)

name: RankAmplification.eventually_variableCutoff_dominance_of_lemma2_5_range
statement:
theorem eventually_variableCutoff_dominance_of_lemma2_5_range
    {c₀ C₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, ∀ y T,
      IsSection5ExponentialCutoff y T →
      IsSection5SaddleWindow c₀ C₀ (x : ℝ) T →
      ∀ p ∈ section5IntermediatePrimeRange x y,
        fullPaperDivisorError p (section5LocalCutoff x y p) ≤
          rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p *
            Real.log (rankinU (section5LocalCutoff x y p) p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_variableCutoff_lemma2_5_range hc₀ hC₀] with x hx
  intro y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  have hpPrime : p.Prime :=
    (mem_section5PrimeRange.mp (mem_section5IntermediatePrimeRange.mp hp).1).2.2
  have hdata := hx y T hcutoff hwindow p hp
  exact lemma2_5_dominance_of_range hpPrime.two_le hdata.1 hdata.2

name: RankAmplification.inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_eq_prod
statement:
theorem inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_eq_prod {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 =
      ∏ i : Fin J, (((P.value i : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [totalDemandProduct, blockDemandProduct, Nat.cast_prod, inv_pow]
  rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib, Finset.prod_pow]

name: RankAmplification.sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq
statement:
theorem sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq (J y Y : ℕ) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) =
      (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y Y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ^ J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := labelledPrimeDemandsEquiv J y Y
  calc
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) =
        ∑ f : Fin J → MovingDemandPrime y Y,
          ∏ i : Fin J, (((f i : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv e
      intro P
      rw [inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_eq_prod]
      rfl
    _ = (∑ p : MovingDemandPrime y Y, (((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ J := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_pow]
    _ = (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y Y, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ^ J := by
      congr 1
      have h := @Finset.sum_subtype ℕ ℝ _
        (fun p : ℕ ↦ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y Y)
        (movingDemandPrimeFintype y Y) (squareSourcePrimeRange y Y)
        (fun _ : ℕ ↦ Iff.rfl) (fun p : ℕ ↦ (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹))
      exact h.symm

name: RankAmplification.sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_inv_pow
statement:
theorem sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_inv_pow
    {J y Y : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) (hyY : y ≤ Y) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y,
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤ ((y : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Finset.sum_nonneg fun p hp ↦ by positivity)
    (sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv hy hyY) J

name: RankAmplification.movingNatY_inv_le_exp
statement:
theorem movingNatY_inv_le_exp {x : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ movingNatY x) :
    ((movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      Real.exp (-movingT (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < movingNatY x := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy)
  have hfloor : movingY (x : ℝ) < (movingNatY x : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hone : (movingNatY x : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * movingNatY x := by
    exact_mod_cast (show movingNatY x + 1 ≤ 2 * movingNatY x by omega)
  have hexp : Real.exp (movingT (x : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * movingNatY x := by
    rw [← movingY_eq_exp]
    exact hfloor.le.trans hone
  have hinv : ((movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      2 / Real.exp (movingT (x : ℝ)) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).2
    calc
      (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹ * Real.exp (movingT (x : ℝ)) ≤
          (movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * movingNatY x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (inv_nonneg.mpr hypos.le)
      _ = 2 := by field_simp
  convert hinv using 1
  rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.moving_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp
statement:
theorem moving_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp {x : ℕ}
    (hy : 1 ≤ movingNatY x) (hyZ : movingNatY x ≤ movingNatZ x) :
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤
      Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
        (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
        ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤
        ((movingNatY x : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ movingNatJ x :=
      sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_inv_pow (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hy) hyZ
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (-movingT (x : ℝ) + Real.log 2)) ^ movingNatJ x :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        (movingNatY_inv_le_exp hy) _
    _ = Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
        (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      simp only [movingNatJ, movingK_eq_rank_mul]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierMassSquareSum_nonneg

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq
statement:
theorem movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq (x : ℕ) :

proof:

    movingSupplierWeightedTailSum

name: RankAmplification.supplierSupNorm_le_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem supplierSupNorm_le_of_pointwise
    {J y Y x B : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) {C : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hpoint : ∀ N ∈ Finset.Icc 1 B, (supplierDivisorWeight P x N : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    supplierSupNorm P x B ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold supplierSupNorm FiniteDivisorWeight.supNorm
  split_ifs with hnonempty
  · apply Finset.max'_le
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    rw [supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_eval P x N (by
      have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).1
      omega)]
    exact hpoint N hN
  · exact hC

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierFiniteBounds_of_section10Certificate
statement:
theorem movingSupplierFiniteBounds_of_section10Certificate
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (c : MovingSupplierSection10Certificate ρ x) :
    MovingSupplierFiniteBounds ρ x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro P
    have hq := section10_lemma10_9_blockMass P (c.blockMass P)
    calc
      (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
          (((labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℚ) *
            c.blockScale ^ movingNatJ x /
              (totalDemandProduct P : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hq
      _ = ((((labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) : ℚ) *
            c.blockScale ^ movingNatJ x : ℚ) : ℝ)) *
              (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        push_cast
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) *
          (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right c.massPrefactor
          (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  · intro P
    apply supplierSupNorm_le_of_pointwise P (Real.exp_pos _).le
    intro N hN
    have hNne : N ≠ 0 := by
      have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).1
      omega
    have hpoint := section10_lemma10_9_pointwise P x N hNne
    have hcast : (supplierDivisorWeight P x N : ℝ) ≤
        ((labelledPartitionCount (movingNatJ x) *
          admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ^ movingNatJ x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpoint
    exact hcast.trans (c.pointwise P N hN)
  · unfold movingSupplierTailSum
    exact (section10_corollary10_22_finite c.lowerCutoff_pos c.ambient_pos
      c.threshold c.reconstruction).trans c.friable

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_two_le_full_paper_error
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_two_le_full_paper_error
    {R H X : ℕ} (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hu : 1 < rankinU X R) (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail 2 R H X ≤
      ((X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X)) /
          (H + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail 2 R H X ≤
        finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / (H + 1) :=
      finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_two_le_count_div R H X
    _ ≤ ((X : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X)) /

        (finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error hX hR hu huSqrt)

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierMassSquareSum_le
statement:
theorem movingSupplierMassSquareSum_le
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ}
    (hy : 1 ≤ movingNatY x) (hyZ : movingNatY x ≤ movingNatZ x)
    (hmass : ∀ P : LabelledPrimeDemands
      (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
      (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
        Real.exp (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) *
          (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) :
    movingSupplierMassSquareSum x ≤
      Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
        (2 * ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2))
proof:
:= by
  let a := ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)
  calc
    movingSupplierMassSquareSum x ≤
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands
            (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
          (Real.exp a * (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro P hP
      have hleft : 0 ≤ (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast supplierReciprocalMass_nonneg P x
      have hright : 0 ≤ Real.exp a * (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      exact (sq_le_sq₀ hleft hright).2 (hmass P)
    _ = Real.exp (a + a) *
        ∑ P : LabelledPrimeDemands
            (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
          ((totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro P hP
      rw [mul_pow, pow_two (Real.exp a), ← Real.exp_add]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (a + a) *
        Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
          (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (moving_sum_inv_totalDemandProduct_sq_le_exp hy hyZ)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) +
        (2 * ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      dsimp [a]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierWeightedTailSum_le
statement:
theorem movingSupplierWeightedTailSum_le
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ}
    (hsup : ∀ P : LabelledPrimeDemands
      (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
      supplierSupNorm P x (2 * x) ≤
        Real.exp (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) :
    movingSupplierWeightedTailSum x ≤
      Real.exp (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) * movingSupplierTailSum x
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingSupplierWeightedTailSum, movingSupplierTailSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro P hP
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsup P) (by
    exact_mod_cast supplierReciprocalTail_nonneg P x x.sqrt)

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierWeightedTailSum_le_exp
statement:
theorem movingSupplierWeightedTailSum_le_exp
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ}
    (hsup : ∀ P : LabelledPrimeDemands
      (movingNatJ x) (movingNatY x) (movingNatZ x),
      supplierSupNorm P x (2 * x) ≤
        Real.exp (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)))
    (htail : movingSupplierTailSum x ≤
      Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))) :
    movingSupplierWeightedTailSum x ≤
      Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        2 * ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    movingSupplierWeightedTailSum x ≤
        Real.exp (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) * movingSupplierTailSum x :=
      movingSupplierWeightedTailSum_le hsup
    _ ≤ Real.exp (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) *
        Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
        2 * ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSupplierMassTailError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSupplierMassTailError_zero
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hρ : Tendsto ρ atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (movingSupplierMassTailError ρ) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ max (ρ x) 0) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [max_self] using hρ.max (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0))
  have hscaled : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ 2 * max (ρ x) 0)
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hmax.const_mul 2
  have hJreal : Tendsto
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ ((movingJ t : ℝ) * Real.log 2) / movingEtaR t)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    movingJ_mul_log_two_isLittleO_etaR.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hJnat : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2) /
        movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    apply (hJreal.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))).congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rfl
  have hsix : Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦ Real.log 6 / movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop
  have hfloor : Tendsto
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6) /
        movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [add_div, zero_add] using hJnat.add hsix
  change Tendsto (fun x : ℕ ↦
    2 * max (ρ x) 0 +
      ((movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log 6) /
        movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)
  simpa only [zero_add] using hscaled.add hfloor

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le_common
statement:
theorem movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le_common
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ}
    (hy : 1 ≤ movingNatY x) (hyZ : movingNatY x ≤ movingNatZ x)
    (hetaR : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ))
    (hb : MovingSupplierFiniteBounds ρ x) :
    movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant x ≤
      6 * x * Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x)
proof:
:= by
  let r := max (ρ x) 0
  have hρr : ρ x ≤ r := le_max_left _ _
  have hρmul : ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≤
      r * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hρr hetaR.le
  have hlog : 0 ≤ (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num))
  have hmass := movingSupplierMassSquareSum_le hy hyZ hb.mass
  have hmassCommon : movingSupplierMassSquareSum x ≤
      Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x) := by
    refine hmass.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    dsimp [movingSupplierCommonExponent, r]
    linarith
  have htail := movingSupplierWeightedTailSum_le_exp hb.supNorm hb.friableTail
  have htailCommon : movingSupplierWeightedTailSum x ≤
      Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x) := by
    refine htail.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
    dsimp [r] at hρmul
    dsimp [movingSupplierCommonExponent, r]
    have htwo : 2 * (ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) ≤
        2 * (max (ρ x) 0 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρmul (by norm_num)
    calc
      -movingK (x : ℝ) - 2 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
          2 * ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≤
          -movingK (x : ℝ) + 2 * ρ x * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
        linarith
      _ ≤ -movingK (x : ℝ) +
          2 * max (ρ x) 0 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) := by
        linarith
      _ ≤ -movingK (x : ℝ) +
          2 * max (ρ x) 0 * movingEtaR (x : ℝ) +
            (movingNatJ x : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right hlog
  rw [movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant_eq]
  calc
    2 * x * movingSupplierMassSquareSum x +
        4 * x * movingSupplierWeightedTailSum x ≤
        2 * x * Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x) +
          4 * x * Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmassCommon (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htailCommon (by positivity))
    _ = 6 * x * Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.six_mul_exp_common_eq_movingExponentialMajorant
statement:
theorem six_mul_exp_common_eq_movingExponentialMajorant
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (hetaR : 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ)) :
    6 * x * Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x) =
      movingExponentialMajorant (movingSupplierMassTailError ρ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hetaRne : movingEtaR (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hetaR.ne'
  have hexponent :
      -movingK (x : ℝ) + movingSupplierMassTailError ρ x *
          movingEtaR (x : ℝ) =
        movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x + Real.log 6 := by
    unfold movingSupplierMassTailError movingSupplierCommonExponent
    field_simp [hetaRne]
    ring
  unfold movingExponentialMajorant
  rw [hexponent, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_finiteEndpoint
statement:
theorem movingSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_finiteEndpoint
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (hendpoint : MovingSupplierFiniteEndpoint ρ) :
    MovingSupplierMassTailHypothesis (movingSupplierMassTailError ρ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_movingSupplierMassTailError_zero hendpoint.1, ?_⟩
  have hetaR : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < movingEtaR (x : ℝ) :=
    eventually_movingEtaR_nat_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0
  filter_upwards [eventually_movingNaturalAdmissibility, hetaR, hendpoint.2] with
      x hadmissible hetaR hendpoint
  intro hsaddle
  calc
    movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant x ≤
        6 * x * Real.exp (movingSupplierCommonExponent ρ x) :=
      movingSupplierConvolutionMajorant_le_common
        ((by norm_num : 1 ≤ 3).trans hadmissible.three_le_y)
        hadmissible.y_le_Z hetaR (hendpoint hsaddle)
    _ = movingExponentialMajorant (movingSupplierMassTailError ρ) x :=
      six_mul_exp_common_eq_movingExponentialMajorant hetaR

name: RankAmplification.movingSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_section10Endpoint
statement:
theorem movingSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_section10Endpoint
    {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} (h : MovingSupplierSection10Endpoint ρ) :
    MovingSupplierMassTailHypothesis (movingSupplierMassTailError ρ)
proof:
:=
  movingSupplierMassTailHypothesis_of_finiteEndpoint
    (movingSupplierFiniteEndpoint_of_section10Endpoint h)

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotWidth_le_paperRealSlotWidth
statement:
theorem paperSlotWidth_le_paperRealSlotWidth {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) ≤ paperRealSlotWidth J x T
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with hx | hx
    · subst hx
      simp
    · have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
      exact Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hquot : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T := div_nonneg hlog hT.le
  have hfloor : ((⌊Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * (x : ℝ)) / T :=
    Nat.floor_le hquot
  unfold paperSlotWidth paperRealSlotWidth
  push_cast
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.section10_slot_count_second_inequality
statement:
theorem section10_slot_count_second_inequality {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (4 * (J : ℝ) * (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ)) ^ (3 * J) ≤
      (4 * (J : ℝ) * paperRealSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:= by
  have hwidth : (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) ≤ paperRealSlotWidth J x T :=
    paperSlotWidth_le_paperRealSlotWidth (J := J) hT
  have hJ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg J
  have hbase : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (J : ℝ) * (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) := by positivity
  gcongr

name: RankAmplification.section10_slot_count_second_inequality_const
statement:
theorem section10_slot_count_second_inequality_const {J x : ℕ} {T C : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (C * (J : ℝ) * (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ)) ^ (3 * J) ≤
      (C * (J : ℝ) * paperRealSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:= by
  have hwidth : (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) ≤ paperRealSlotWidth J x T :=
    paperSlotWidth_le_paperRealSlotWidth (J := J) hT
  have hJ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg J
  have hbase : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C * (J : ℝ) * (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ) := by positivity
  gcongr

name: RankAmplification.section10_eq_supplier_slot_count
statement:
theorem section10_eq_supplier_slot_count {J x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)) : ℝ) ≤
        (4 * (J : ℝ) * (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ)) ^ (3 * J) ∧
      (4 * (J : ℝ) * (paperSlotWidth J x T : ℝ)) ^ (3 * J) ≤
        (4 * (J : ℝ) * paperRealSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, section10_slot_count_second_inequality hT⟩
  have hcard := section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card (x := x) (T := T) hJ
  have hcast : ((Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (((4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  refine hcast.trans_eq ?_
  push_cast
  ring

name: RankAmplification.paperCombinatorialCode_fixedNumerical_ncard_le
statement:
theorem paperCombinatorialCode_fixedNumerical_ncard_le {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)
    (ℓ : Fin J → ℕ) (π : Fin J → PowerSourceChoice y Y J) :
    (paperCombinatorialCodeFixedNumerical hy hT hyT hY ℓ π).ncard ≤
      (4 * J * paperSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ (section10_lemma10_10_paper_slot_card (x := x) (T := T) hJ)
  calc
    (paperCombinatorialCodeFixedNumerical hy hT hyT hY ℓ π).ncard ≤
        (Set.univ : Set (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T))).ncard :=
      Set.ncard_le_ncard (Set.subset_univ _) Set.finite_univ
    _ = Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J (paperSlotWidth J x T)) := by
      rw [Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: RankAmplification.section10_eq_supplier_slot_count_fixed_numerical
statement:
theorem section10_eq_supplier_slot_count_fixed_numerical {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}

        (4 * (J : ℝ) * paperRealSlotWidth J x T) ^ (3 * J)

  have hcard := paperCombinatorialCode_fixedNumerical_ncard_le hJ hy hT hyT hY ℓ π

name: RankAmplification.section10_eq_supplier_slot_count_composite
statement:
theorem section10_eq_supplier_slot_count_composite {J y Y x : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hy : 2 ≤ y) (hT : 0 < T) (hyT : Real.exp T ≤ (y : ℝ)) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * x)

name: RankAmplification.section10_eq_supplier_slot_count_absolute
statement:
theorem section10_eq_supplier_slot_count_absolute :

name: RankAmplification.paperSlotWidth_lt_paperRealSlotWidth_example
statement:
theorem paperSlotWidth_lt_paperRealSlotWidth_example :
    (paperSlotWidth 1 1 (Real.log 3) : ℝ) < paperRealSlotWidth 1 1 (Real.log 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 3 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlt : Real.log 2 < Real.log 3 := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hquot : Real.log (2 * ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / Real.log 3 < 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
    rw [div_lt_one h3]
    exact hlt
  have hquotpos : 0 < Real.log (2 * ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / Real.log 3 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
    exact div_pos h2 h3
  have hfloor : ⌊Real.log (2 * ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / Real.log 3⌋₊ = 0 :=
    Nat.floor_eq_zero.mpr hquot
  unfold paperSlotWidth paperRealSlotWidth
  rw [hfloor]
  push_cast
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.scaleL_div_fixedRankT_eq_sqrt_mul_scaleV
statement:
theorem scaleL_div_fixedRankT_eq_sqrt_mul_scaleV
    {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) :
    scaleL x / fixedRankT J x = Real.sqrt J * scaleV x
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)).ne'
  rw [fixedRankT, scaleV_eq]
  field_simp [hsqrt, hG]

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSaddleRate_eq
statement:
theorem fixedRankSaddleRate_eq
    {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) (hG : scaleG x ≠ 0) :
    fixedRankSaddleRate J x =
      (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) *
        (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) +
          log3 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedRankSaddleRate, fixedRankSmoothRate,
    scaleL_div_fixedRankT_eq_sqrt_mul_scaleV hJ hG]

name: RankAmplification.fixedRank_J_mul_T_eq_sqrt_mul_G
statement:
theorem fixedRank_J_mul_T_eq_sqrt_mul_G
    {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J) :
    (J : ℝ) * fixedRankT J x = Real.sqrt J * scaleG x
proof:
:=
  nat_mul_fixedRankT hJ

name: RankAmplification.scaleV_sq_eq_scaleL_div_scaleA
statement:
theorem scaleV_sq_eq_scaleL_div_scaleA
    {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    scaleV x ^ 2 = scaleL x / scaleA x
proof:
:= by
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hGsq := scaleG_sq hL.le hA.le
  rw [scaleV_eq]
  field_simp [hG.ne', hA.ne']
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.two_mul_log_scaleV
statement:
theorem two_mul_log_scaleV
    {x : ℝ} (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    2 * Real.log (scaleV x) = log2 x - Real.log (scaleA x)
proof:
:= by
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA)
  calc
    2 * Real.log (scaleV x) = Real.log (scaleV x ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.log_pow]
      norm_num
    _ = Real.log (scaleL x / scaleA x) := by
      rw [scaleV_sq_eq_scaleL_div_scaleA hL hA]
    _ = Real.log (scaleL x) - Real.log (scaleA x) := by
      rw [Real.log_div hL.ne' hA.ne']
    _ = log2 x - Real.log (scaleA x) := by
      simp only [log2_eq, scaleL_eq]

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_eq
statement:
theorem fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_eq
    {J : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hL : 0 < scaleL x) (hA : 0 < scaleA x) :
    fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J x =
      Real.sqrt J *
        (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) +
          log3 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - scaleA x)
proof:
:= by
  have hG := scaleG_pos hL hA
  have hV := scaleV_pos hL hG
  have hAG : scaleA x * scaleV x = scaleG x :=
    scaleA_mul_scaleV hL.le hA.le hG.ne'
  rw [fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError, fixedRankSaddleError,
    fixedRankSaddleRate_eq hJ hG.ne']
  field_simp [hV.ne']
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.log_scaleA_isLittleO_log2
statement:
theorem log_scaleA_isLittleO_log2 :
    (fun x ↦ Real.log (scaleA x)) =o[atTop] log2
proof:
:= by
  have hlogA : (fun x ↦ Real.log (scaleA x)) =o[atTop] scaleA := by
    have h := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.comp_tendsto tendsto_scaleA_atTop
    apply h.congr'
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      rfl
    · filter_upwards [] with x
      rfl
  exact hlogA.trans scaleA_isLittleO_log2

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_log_sqrt_mul_scaleV_div_half_log2_one
statement:
theorem tendsto_log_sqrt_mul_scaleV_div_half_log2_one
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) /
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x))
      atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt J)) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_log2_atTop
  have hA : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.log (scaleA x) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    log_scaleA_isLittleO_log2.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have hmodel : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (1 : ℝ) +
        (2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt J)) / log2 x -
          Real.log (scaleA x) / log2 x)
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have hone : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    have hraw : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ (1 : ℝ) +
          ((2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt J)) / log2 x -
            Real.log (scaleA x) / log2 x))
        atTop (nhds 1) := by
      simpa only [sub_self, add_zero] using hone.add (hc.sub hA)
    apply hraw.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  apply hmodel.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos,
      eventually_log2_pos] with x hL hApos hL2
  have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hApos)
  rw [Real.log_mul hsqrtJ.ne' hV.ne']
  have hlogV := two_mul_log_scaleV hL hApos
  field_simp [hL2.ne']
  nlinarith

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRank_log2_error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRank_log2_error_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log3 x + Real.log 2)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio := tendsto_log_sqrt_mul_scaleV_div_half_log2_one J hJ
  have hlogRatio : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.log
        (Real.log (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) / ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x)))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hcont := (Real.continuousAt_log (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).tendsto.comp hratio
    change Tendsto
      (Real.log ∘ (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) /
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x))) atTop (nhds 0)
    simpa only [Real.log_one] using hcont
  apply hlogRatio.congr'
  have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  have hinner : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_scaleV_atTop.const_mul_atTop hsqrtJ)
  filter_upwards [hinner.eventually_gt_atTop 0, eventually_log2_pos] with x hinnerPos hL2
  have hhalf : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * log2 x := mul_pos (by norm_num) hL2
  rw [Real.log_div hinnerPos.ne' hhalf.ne', Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hL2.ne']
  simp only [log2_eq, log3_eq]
  have hlogHalf : Real.log (1 / 2 : ℝ) = -Real.log 2 := by
    rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
      Real.log_one]
    ring
  rw [hlogHalf]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_log2_sqrt_mul_scaleV_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_log2_sqrt_mul_scaleV_atTop
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x)) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrtJ : 0 < Real.sqrt (J : ℝ) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hJ)
  change Tendsto
    (fun x ↦ Real.log (Real.log (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x))) atTop atTop
  exact Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp <|
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp
      (tendsto_scaleV_atTop.const_mul_atTop hsqrtJ)

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRank_log3_error_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRank_log3_error_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ log3 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log4 x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsecond := tendsto_fixedRank_log2_error_zero J hJ
  have hdiff : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log3 x)
      atTop (nhds (-Real.log 2)) := by
    have h := hsecond.sub (tendsto_const_nhds :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Real.log 2) atTop (nhds (Real.log 2)))
    have hraw : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦
          (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log3 x + Real.log 2) - Real.log 2)
        atTop (nhds (-Real.log 2)) := by
      simpa only [zero_sub] using h
    apply hraw.congr'
    filter_upwards [] with x
    ring
  have hsmall : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦
        (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log3 x) / log3 x)
      atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hdiff.div_atTop tendsto_log3_atTop
  have hratio : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) / log3 x)
      atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have hone : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 1) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    have hmodel := hone.add hsmall
    have hmodel' : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ (1 : ℝ) +
          (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log3 x) / log3 x)
        atTop (nhds 1) := by
      simpa only [add_zero] using hmodel
    apply hmodel'.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_log3_pos] with x hL3
    field_simp [hL3.ne']
    ring
  have hlogRatio : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.log
        (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) / log3 x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hcont := (Real.continuousAt_log (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).tendsto.comp hratio
    change Tendsto
      (Real.log ∘ (fun x ↦ log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) / log3 x))
      atTop (nhds 0)
    simpa only [Real.log_one] using hcont
  apply hlogRatio.congr'
  filter_upwards [
      (tendsto_log2_sqrt_mul_scaleV_atTop J hJ).eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      eventually_log3_pos] with x hleft hright
  rw [Real.log_div hleft.ne' hright.ne']
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRank_saddleBracket_sub_scaleA_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRank_saddleBracket_sub_scaleA_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) +
        log3 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - scaleA x)
      atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := tendsto_fixedRank_log2_error_zero J hJ
  have h3 := tendsto_fixedRank_log3_error_zero J hJ
  have hsum := h2.add h3
  have hsum' : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log3 x + Real.log 2) +
        (log3 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - log4 x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hsum
  apply hsum'.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with x
  simp only [scaleA_eq]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_zero
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    Tendsto (fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hbracket := tendsto_fixedRank_saddleBracket_sub_scaleA_zero J hJ
  have hscaled : Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt J *
        (log2 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) +
          log3 (Real.sqrt J * scaleV x) - scaleA x))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Real.sqrt J) atTop (nhds (Real.sqrt J)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    have hmul := hc.mul hbracket
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hmul
  apply hscaled.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
  exact (fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_eq hJ hL hA).symm

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSaddleError_isLittleO_scaleV
statement:
theorem fixedRankSaddleError_isLittleO_scaleV
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    (fun x ↦ fixedRankSaddleRate J x - Real.sqrt J * scaleG x)
      =o[atTop] scaleV
proof:
:= by
  refine isLittleO_of_tendsto' ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_scaleL_pos, eventually_scaleA_pos] with x hL hA
    intro hzero
    have hV : 0 < scaleV x := scaleV_pos hL (scaleG_pos hL hA)
    exact (hV.ne' hzero).elim
  · change Tendsto (fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError J) atTop (nhds 0)
    exact tendsto_fixedRankSaddleNormalizedError_zero J hJ

name: RankAmplification.fixedRankSmoothRate_at_saddle_isLittleO
statement:
theorem fixedRankSmoothRate_at_saddle_isLittleO
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) :
    (fun x ↦ fixedRankSmoothRate x (scaleG x / Real.sqrt J) -
      Real.sqrt J * scaleG x) =o[atTop] scaleV
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [fixedRankSaddleRate, fixedRankT] using
    fixedRankSaddleError_isLittleO_scaleV J hJ

name: RankAmplification.eventually_fixedRankSaddleError_norm_le
statement:
theorem eventually_fixedRankSaddleError_norm_le
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      ‖fixedRankSaddleRate J x - Real.sqrt J * scaleG x‖ ≤
        c * ‖scaleV x‖
proof:
:=
  (fixedRankSaddleError_isLittleO_scaleV J hJ).bound hc

name: RankAmplification.div_sub_one_le_exp_two_div
statement:
theorem div_sub_one_le_exp_two_div {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ Real.exp (2 / (p : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hppos : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hpm : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  have hstep : (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ 1 + 2 / (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hpm, ← sub_nonneg]
    have hid : (1 + 2 / (p : ℝ)) * ((p : ℝ) - 1) - (p : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 2) / (p : ℝ) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hid]
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hppos.le
  have hexp : 1 + 2 / (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 / (p : ℝ)) := by
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 / (p : ℝ))
    linarith
  exact hstep.trans hexp

name: RankAmplification.prod_div_sub_one_le_exp
statement:
theorem prod_div_sub_one_le_exp {y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) (hlower : ∀ p ∈ S, y < p) :
    ∏ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ Real.exp (2 * (S.card : ℝ) / (y : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < (y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
  calc
    ∏ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ ∏ p ∈ S, Real.exp (2 / (p : ℝ)) := by
      refine Finset.prod_le_prod ?_ ?_
      · intro p hp
        have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (hprime p hp).two_le
        have hpm : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
        exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) hpm.le
      · intro p hp
        exact div_sub_one_le_exp_two_div (hprime p hp).two_le
    _ = Real.exp (∑ p ∈ S, 2 / (p : ℝ)) := (Real.exp_sum S _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * (S.card : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
      calc
        ∑ p ∈ S, 2 / (p : ℝ) ≤ ∑ _p ∈ S, 2 / (y : ℝ) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
          intro p hp
          have hyp : (y : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (hlower p hp).le
          gcongr
        _ = 2 * (S.card : ℝ) / (y : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          ring

name: RankAmplification.div_totient_le_exp_of_primeFactors_gt
statement:
theorem div_totient_le_exp_of_primeFactors_gt {y D : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hlower : ∀ p ∈ D.primeFactors, y < p) :
    (D : ℝ) / (D.totient : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * (D.primeFactors.card : ℝ) / (y : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_div_pred_primeSupport_eq_div_totient hD]
  exact prod_div_sub_one_le_exp hy _ (fun p hp ↦ Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp) hlower

name: RankAmplification.primeFactors_blockDemandProduct_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors] at hp
  obtain ⟨hpp, hpdvd, -⟩ := hp
  unfold blockDemandProduct at hpdvd
  obtain ⟨i, hiB, hdvd⟩ := (hpp.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff _).mp hpdvd
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨i, hiB, ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpp (P.prime i)).mp hdvd).symm⟩

name: RankAmplification.blockDemandProduct_div_totient_le_exp
statement:
theorem blockDemandProduct_div_totient_le_exp {J y Y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    (blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ) / ((blockDemandProduct P B).totient : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (B.card : ℝ) / (y : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < (y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hsub := primeFactors_blockDemandProduct_subset P B
  have hlower : ∀ p ∈ (blockDemandProduct P B).primeFactors, y < p := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (hsub hp)
    exact hi ▸ P.lower i
  refine (div_totient_le_exp_of_primeFactors_gt hy (blockDemandProduct_pos P B) hlower).trans ?_
  rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
  have hcard : ((blockDemandProduct P B).primeFactors.card : ℝ) ≤ (B.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans Finset.card_image_le
  gcongr

name: RankAmplification.blockDemandProduct_div_totient_le_exp_rank
statement:
theorem blockDemandProduct_div_totient_le_exp_rank {J y Y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    (blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ) / ((blockDemandProduct P B).totient : ℝ) ≤
      Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hypos : (0 : ℝ) < (y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have hcard : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := by
    have hcardNat : B.card ≤ J := by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ B
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  refine (blockDemandProduct_div_totient_le_exp hy P B).trans ?_
  rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
  gcongr

name: RankAmplification.supplierUniformBlockScale_nonneg
statement:
theorem supplierUniformBlockScale_nonneg (J x y : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ supplierUniformBlockScale J x y
proof:
:=
  add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_nonneg (2 * x))
      (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg J)

name: RankAmplification.one_le_supplierUniformBlockScale
statement:
theorem one_le_supplierUniformBlockScale {J : ℕ} (hJ : 0 < J) (x y : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ supplierUniformBlockScale J x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold supplierUniformBlockScale
  have hc := mul_nonneg (BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_nonneg (2 * x))
    (Real.exp_pos (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ))).le
  have hJ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_le_uniformBlockScale
statement:
theorem supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_le_uniformBlockScale {J y Y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x : ℕ) (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor P x B ≤
      supplierUniformBlockScale J x y
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := by
    have hcardNat : B.card ≤ J := by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ B
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  have hratio := blockDemandProduct_div_totient_le_exp_rank hy P B
  have hcoef := BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_nonneg (2 * x)
  unfold BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor supplierUniformBlockScale
  have hmul : BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient (2 * x) *
      ((blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ) / ((blockDemandProduct P B).totient : ℝ)) ≤
      BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient (2 * x) *
        Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio hcoef
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.descriptorReciprocalMass_le_uniformBlockScale
statement:
theorem descriptorReciprocalMass_le_uniformBlockScale {J y Y x : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (B : Finset (Fin J)) :
    (descriptorReciprocalMass P x B : ℝ) ≤
      supplierUniformBlockScale J x y / (blockDemandProduct P B : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (BrunTitchmarsh.descriptorReciprocalMass_cast_le_brunTitchmarshBlock P B hx).trans ?_
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_le_uniformBlockScale hy P x B) (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_le_uniformBlockScale_pow
statement:
theorem supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_le_uniformBlockScale_pow {J y Y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x : ℕ) {B : Finset (Fin J)} (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor P x B ≤
      supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ^ B.card
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : 0 < J := by
    obtain ⟨i, -⟩ := hB
    exact (Nat.zero_le (i : ℕ)).trans_lt i.isLt
  have hL := one_le_supplierUniformBlockScale hJ x y
  refine (supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_le_uniformBlockScale hy P x B).trans ?_
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hB)
  rw [hk, pow_succ]
  calc
    supplierUniformBlockScale J x y = 1 * supplierUniformBlockScale J x y := (one_mul _).symm
    _ ≤ supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ^ k * supplierUniformBlockScale J x y :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (one_le_pow₀ hL) (zero_le_one.trans hL)

name: RankAmplification.hasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal_uniformBlockScale
statement:
theorem hasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal_uniformBlockScale {J y Y x : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y)
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    BrunTitchmarsh.HasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal P x
      (supplierUniformBlockScale J x y)
proof:
:=
  BrunTitchmarsh.hasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal_of_brunTitchmarshBlocks P hx
    fun _ hB ↦ supplierBrunTitchmarshBlockFactor_le_uniformBlockScale_pow hy P x hB

name: RankAmplification.section10_eq10_8_uniformBlockScale
statement:
theorem section10_eq10_8_uniformBlockScale {J y Y x : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
      (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) * supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ^ J /
        (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmass := hasPartitionDescriptorMassBoundReal_uniformBlockScale hy hx P
  have hstart : (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ pi : LabelPartition J, (partitionDescriptorMass P x pi : ℝ) := by
    have h := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).2 (supplierReciprocalMass_le_partitionDescriptorMass P x)
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  refine hstart.trans ?_
  calc
    ∑ pi : LabelPartition J, (partitionDescriptorMass P x pi : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ _pi : LabelPartition J,
          supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ^ J / (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun pi _ ↦ hmass pi
    _ = (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) * supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ^ J /
        (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ) := by
      simp only [labelledPartitionCount, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring

name: RankAmplification.section10_lemma10_9_uniformBlockScale
statement:
theorem section10_lemma10_9_uniformBlockScale
    {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) {T : ℝ}
    (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hN : 0 < N) (hNx : N ≤ 2 * x) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hscale : HasExponentialCutoffScale y T) :
    (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ≤
        (labelledPartitionCount J : ℝ) * supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ^ J /
          (totalDemandProduct P : ℝ) ∧
      supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
        labelledPartitionCount J *
          max 1 (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N) ^ J ∧
      (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2 * x) / T
proof:
:=
  ⟨section10_eq10_8_uniformBlockScale hy hx P,
    supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_maxOccurrenceCount_pow P x N hN.ne',
    occurrenceCount_le_log_two_mul_div_scale P x N hN hNx hT hscale⟩

name: RankAmplification.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_le_logLog
statement:
theorem supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_le_logLog {x : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient (2 * x) ≤
      (5 + BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant * (1 + Real.log 2)) +
        BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant *
          Real.log (1 + Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hC := BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant_nonneg
  have hmax : max 2 (2 * x) = 2 * x := max_eq_right (by omega)
  have h2x : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 2 * x := by omega
    exact_mod_cast h
  have htpos : 0 < Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hquot : 0 < Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 := div_pos htpos hlog2
  have hdiv : Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ≤ 2 * Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hlog2]
    nlinarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + Real.logb 2 ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.logb]
    linarith
  have hle : 1 + Real.logb 2 ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1 + Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.logb]
    linarith
  have hlogle : Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.log 2 + Real.log (1 + Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have hstep := Real.log_le_log hpos hle
    rwa [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (by linarith))] at hstep
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogle hC
  unfold BrunTitchmarsh.supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient
  rw [hmax]
  linarith

name: RankAmplification.affine_le_mul_one_add
statement:
theorem affine_le_mul_one_add {a b c u : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) : a + b * u + c ≤ (a + c + b) * (1 + u)
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha hu, mul_nonneg hc hu]

name: RankAmplification.exists_supplierUniformBlockScale_logLog_bound
statement:
theorem exists_supplierUniformBlockScale_logLog_bound (J y : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ x : ℕ, 1 ≤ x →
      supplierUniformBlockScale J x y ≤
        A * (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hC := BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant_nonneg
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hE : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hA0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 + BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant *
      (1 + Real.log 2) := by
    have h := mul_nonneg hC (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log 2)
    linarith
  refine ⟨(5 + BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant * (1 + Real.log 2)) *
        Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)) + (J : ℝ) +
      BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant *
        Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := mul_nonneg hA0 hE.le
    have h2 := mul_nonneg hC hE.le
    have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (J : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg J
    linarith
  · intro x hx
    have h2x : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      have h : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 2 * x := by omega
      exact_mod_cast h
    have htpos : 0 < Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hu : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have hcoef := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (supplierBrunTitchmarshCoefficient_le_logLog hx) hE.le
    have hkey := affine_le_mul_one_add
      (a := (5 + BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant * (1 + Real.log 2)) *
        Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)))
      (b := BrunTitchmarsh.growingCutoffBrunTitchmarshConstant *
        Real.exp (2 * (J : ℝ) / (y : ℝ)))
      (c := (J : ℝ))
      (u := Real.log (1 + Real.log ((2 * x : ℕ) : ℝ)))
      (mul_nonneg hA0 hE.le) (mul_nonneg hC hE.le) (Nat.cast_nonneg J) hu
    unfold supplierUniformBlockScale
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_primePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primePairSet {R r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.primePairSet R ↔
      1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ R ∧ (L.leftValue r).Prime ∧ (L.rightValue r).Prime
proof:
:= by

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_siftedPairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_siftedPairSet {R z r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.siftedPairSet R z ↔
      1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ R ∧
        ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, ¬p ∣ L.leftValue r * L.rightValue r
proof:
:= by
  simp [siftedPairSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.value_pos
statement: theorem value_pos (r : ℕ) : 0 < L.leftValue r ∧ 0 < L.rightValue r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [leftValue]
    omega
  · simp only [rightValue]
    omega

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.value_strictMono_left
statement: theorem value_strictMono_left : StrictMono L.leftValue
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  unfold leftValue
  exact Nat.add_lt_add_right (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hab L.left_pos) 1

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.value_strictMono_right
statement: theorem value_strictMono_right : StrictMono L.rightValue
proof:
:= by

  unfold rightValue
