name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt
statement:
theorem mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt {R z r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ L.primePairSet R)
    (hleft : z < L.leftValue r) (hright : z < L.rightValue r) :
    r ∈ L.siftedPairSet R z
proof:
:= by
  have hp := L.mem_primePairSet.mp hr
  apply L.mem_siftedPairSet.mpr
  refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro p hpz hpdvd
  have pp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hpz
  rcases pp.dvd_mul.mp hpdvd with hpLeft | hpRight
  · have heq : p = L.leftValue r := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq pp hp.2.2.1).mp hpLeft
    have hple : p ≤ z := Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hpz
    omega
  · have heq : p = L.rightValue r := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq pp hp.2.2.2).mp hpRight
    have hple : p ≤ z := Nat.le_of_mem_primesLE hpz
    omega

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_filter_leftValue_le_one
statement:
theorem card_filter_leftValue_le_one (R q : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 R).filter fun r ↦ L.leftValue r = q).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro a ha b hb
  have haEq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hbEq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
  exact L.value_strictMono_left.injective (haEq.trans hbEq.symm)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_filter_rightValue_le_one
statement:
theorem card_filter_rightValue_le_one (R q : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 R).filter fun r ↦ L.rightValue r = q).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro a ha b hb
  have haEq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hbEq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
  exact L.value_strictMono_right.injective (haEq.trans hbEq.symm)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_affineRootSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_affineRootSet {p A : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {r : ZMod p} :
    r ∈ affineRootSet p A hp ↔ (A : ZMod p) * r + 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  simp [affineRootSet]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_affineRootSet_le_one
statement:
theorem card_affineRootSet_le_one {p A : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (affineRootSet p A hp).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
  intro x hx y hy
  have hxEq := (mem_affineRootSet hp).mp hx
  have hyEq := (mem_affineRootSet hp).mp hy
  by_cases hA : (A : ZMod p) = 0
  · rw [hA, zero_mul, zero_add] at hxEq
    exact False.elim (one_ne_zero hxEq)
  · have hmul : (A : ZMod p) * (x - y) = 0 := by
      calc
        (A : ZMod p) * (x - y) = ((A : ZMod p) * x + 1) - ((A : ZMod p) * y + 1) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hxEq, hyEq]; ring
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hA)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_badResidueSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_badResidueSet_iff {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {r : ZMod p} :
    r ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp ↔
      ((L.leftSlope : ZMod p) * r + 1) * ((L.rightSlope : ZMod p) * r + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  simp [badResidueSet, mul_eq_zero]

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_badResidueSet_le_two
statement:
theorem card_badResidueSet_le_two {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (L.badResidueSet p hp).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold badResidueSet
  calc
    (affineRootSet p L.leftSlope hp ∪ affineRootSet p L.rightSlope hp).card ≤
        (affineRootSet p L.leftSlope hp).card + (affineRootSet p L.rightSlope hp).card :=
      Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ 1 + 1 := Nat.add_le_add (card_affineRootSet_le_one hp) (card_affineRootSet_le_one hp)
    _ = 2 := rfl

name: RankAmplification.factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport
statement:
theorem factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport {N q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ primeSupport N) :
    0 < N.factorization q
proof:
:= by
  change q ∈ N.factorization.support at hq
  exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hq)

name: RankAmplification.primeSupport_primePowerSubproduct
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M := ∏ q ∈ S, q ^ N.factorization q
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro q hq
    exact pow_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hS hq)).pos _
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hpM
    have hpPrime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpM
    have hpDvd : p ∣ M := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpM
    dsimp [M] at hpDvd
    obtain ⟨q, hqS, hpq⟩ :=
      (hpPrime.prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff (fun q ↦ q ^ N.factorization q)).mp hpDvd
    have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hS hqS)
    have : p = q := Nat.prime_eq_prime_of_dvd_pow hpPrime hqPrime hpq
    simpa [this] using hqS
  · intro hpS
    have hpSupport : p ∈ primeSupport N := hS hpS
    have hpPrime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpSupport
    have hpExp : N.factorization p ≠ 0 :=
      (factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport hpSupport).ne'
    apply Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
    refine ⟨hpPrime, ?_, hMpos.ne'⟩
    exact (dvd_pow_self p hpExp).trans <|
      Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (f := fun q ↦ q ^ N.factorization q) hpS

name: RankAmplification.factorization_primePowerSubproduct
statement:
theorem factorization_primePowerSubproduct (N p : ℕ) {S : Finset ℕ}
    (hS : S ⊆ primeSupport N) :
    (∏ q ∈ S, q ^ N.factorization q).factorization p =
      if p ∈ S then N.factorization p else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p ∈ S
  · rw [if_pos hp, Nat.factorization_prod_apply]
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
      · exact Nat.factorization_pow_self
          (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hS hp))
      · intro q hq hqp
        have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hS hq)
        rw [hqPrime.factorization_pow]
        simp [hqp]
      · exact fun h ↦ (h hp).elim
    · intro q hq
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hS hq)).ne_zero
  · rw [if_neg hp]
    have hpNotSupport :
        p ∉ (∏ q ∈ S, q ^ N.factorization q).factorization.support := by
      simpa [Nat.support_factorization,
        primeSupport_primePowerSubproduct N hS] using hp
    exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hpNotSupport

name: RankAmplification.totient_primePowerSubproduct
statement:
theorem totient_primePowerSubproduct (N : ℕ) {S : Finset ℕ}
    (hS : S ⊆ primeSupport N) :
    Nat.totient (∏ q ∈ S, q ^ N.factorization q) =
      ∏ q ∈ S, localTotientFactor N q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert q S hq ih =>
      have hqSupport : q ∈ primeSupport N := hS (Finset.mem_insert_self q S)
      have hSsub : S ⊆ primeSupport N := fun r hr ↦ hS (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hr)
      have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqSupport
      have hcoprime :
          (q ^ N.factorization q).Coprime (∏ r ∈ S, r ^ N.factorization r) := by
        rw [Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff]
        intro r hr
        have hrPrime : r.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hSsub hr)
        exact Nat.coprime_pow_primes _ _ hqPrime hrPrime fun hqr ↦
          hq (hqr ▸ hr)
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hq, Finset.prod_insert hq,
        Nat.totient_mul hcoprime, ih hSsub]
      exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z * ∏ r ∈ S, localTotientFactor N r) <| by
        simpa [localTotientFactor] using
          Nat.totient_prime_pow hqPrime
            (factorization_pos_of_mem_primeSupport hqSupport)

name: RankAmplification.primePowerSubproducts_coprime
statement:
theorem primePowerSubproducts_coprime (N : ℕ) {S T : Finset ℕ}
    (hS : S ⊆ primeSupport N) (hT : T ⊆ primeSupport N) (hST : Disjoint S T) :
    (∏ q ∈ S, q ^ N.factorization q).Coprime
      (∏ r ∈ T, r ^ N.factorization r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff]
  intro q hq
  rw [Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff]
  intro r hr
  have hqPrime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hS hq)
  have hrPrime : r.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hT hr)
  apply Nat.coprime_pow_primes _ _ hqPrime hrPrime
  intro hqr
  subst r
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hST) hq hr

name: RankAmplification.primeSupport_badLocalProduct
statement:
@[simp] theorem primeSupport_badLocalProduct (N y : ℕ) :
    primeSupport (badLocalProduct N y) = badLocalPrimeSet N y
proof:
:= by
  unfold badLocalProduct
  exact primeSupport_primePowerSubproduct N (badLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)

name: RankAmplification.primeSupport_goodLocalProduct
statement:
@[simp] theorem primeSupport_goodLocalProduct (N y : ℕ) :
    primeSupport (goodLocalProduct N y) = goodLocalPrimeSet N y
proof:
:= by
  unfold goodLocalProduct
  exact primeSupport_primePowerSubproduct N (goodLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)

name: RankAmplification.factorization_badLocalProduct
statement:
@[simp] theorem factorization_badLocalProduct (N y p : ℕ) :
    (badLocalProduct N y).factorization p =
      if p ∈ badLocalPrimeSet N y then N.factorization p else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold badLocalProduct
  exact factorization_primePowerSubproduct N p (badLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)

name: RankAmplification.factorization_goodLocalProduct
statement:
@[simp] theorem factorization_goodLocalProduct (N y p : ℕ) :
    (goodLocalProduct N y).factorization p =
      if p ∈ goodLocalPrimeSet N y then N.factorization p else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold goodLocalProduct
  exact factorization_primePowerSubproduct N p (goodLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)

name: RankAmplification.badLocalProduct_coprime_goodLocalProduct
statement:
theorem badLocalProduct_coprime_goodLocalProduct (N y : ℕ) :
    (badLocalProduct N y).Coprime (goodLocalProduct N y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold badLocalProduct goodLocalProduct
  exact primePowerSubproducts_coprime N
    (badLocalPrimeSet_subset N y) (goodLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)
    (badLocalPrimeSet_disjoint_goodLocalPrimeSet N y)

name: RankAmplification.totient_badLocalProduct
statement:
theorem totient_badLocalProduct (N y : ℕ) :
    Nat.totient (badLocalProduct N y) = badLocalTotientProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  unfold badLocalProduct badLocalTotientProduct
  exact totient_primePowerSubproduct N (badLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)

name: RankAmplification.totient_goodLocalProduct
statement:
theorem totient_goodLocalProduct (N y : ℕ) :
    Nat.totient (goodLocalProduct N y) = goodLocalTotientProduct N y
proof:
:= by
  unfold goodLocalProduct goodLocalTotientProduct
  exact totient_primePowerSubproduct N (goodLocalPrimeSet_subset N y)

name: RankAmplification.totient_goodLocalProduct_isSmooth
statement:
theorem totient_goodLocalProduct_isSmooth {N y : ℕ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) :
    IsSmooth y (Nat.totient (goodLocalProduct N y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [totient_goodLocalProduct]
  exact goodLocalTotientProduct_isSmooth hy

name: RankAmplification.totient_eq_totient_badLocalProduct_mul_totient_goodLocalProduct
statement:
theorem totient_eq_totient_badLocalProduct_mul_totient_goodLocalProduct
    {N y : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    N.totient = Nat.totient (badLocalProduct N y) *
      Nat.totient (goodLocalProduct N y)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    N.totient = Nat.totient (badLocalProduct N y * goodLocalProduct N y) :=
      congrArg Nat.totient (eq_badLocalProduct_mul_goodLocalProduct hN)
    _ = Nat.totient (badLocalProduct N y) * Nat.totient (goodLocalProduct N y) :=
      Nat.totient_mul (badLocalProduct_coprime_goodLocalProduct N y)

name: RankAmplification.fixedLowRankCofactorCertificate_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hnData := mem_fixedLowRankShiftedSet.mp hn
  have hnShift := mem_shiftedEqualTotientSet.mp hnData.1
  have hnPos : 0 < n := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hnShift.1
  exact
    { shifted_mem := hnData.1
      n_pos := hnPos
      bounded_common_totient := hnData.2.1
      rank_lt := hnData.2.2
      decomposition := eq_badLocalProduct_mul_goodLocalProduct hnPos.ne'
      factors_coprime := badLocalProduct_coprime_goodLocalProduct n y
      bad_support := primeSupport_badLocalProduct n y
      good_support := primeSupport_goodLocalProduct n y
      bad_factor_count_lt := fixedLowRank_badLocalPrimeSet_card_lt hy hn
      good_totient_formula := totient_goodLocalProduct n y
      good_totient_smooth := totient_goodLocalProduct_isSmooth hy }

name: RankAmplification.reciprocalSaddleProfile_le_one
statement:
theorem reciprocalSaddleProfile_le_one {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    reciprocalSaddleProfile r ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalSaddleProfile
  by_cases h : r ≤ 1
  · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans h
  · have hrOne : 1 < r := lt_of_not_ge h
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans ((inv_le_one₀ hr).2 hrOne.le)

name: RankAmplification.reciprocalSaddleProfile_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem reciprocalSaddleProfile_eq_one_iff {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    reciprocalSaddleProfile r = 1 ↔ r = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hleft : 1 ≤ r := heq.ge.trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hright : 1 ≤ r⁻¹ := heq.ge.trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hrle : r ≤ 1 := by
      rw [one_le_inv₀ hr] at hright
      exact hright
    exact le_antisymm hrle hleft
  · rintro rfl
    simp [reciprocalSaddleProfile]

name: RankAmplification.reciprocalSaddleProfile_lt_one
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (reciprocalSaddleProfile_le_one hr)
    (fun h ↦ hne ((reciprocalSaddleProfile_eq_one_iff hr).mp h))

name: RankAmplification.reciprocalSaddleProfile_loss_bounds
statement:
theorem reciprocalSaddleProfile_loss_bounds
    {r C : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrC : r ≤ C) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile r ≤ |r - 1| ∧
      |r - 1| ≤ C * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalSaddleProfile
  by_cases hrOne : r ≤ 1
  · have hinv : r ≤ r⁻¹ := by
      rw [inv_eq_one_div]
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hr).2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 1)]
    rw [min_eq_left hinv, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hrOne)]
    constructor
    · linarith
    · have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - r := sub_nonneg.mpr hrOne
      nlinarith
  · have hrOne' : 1 < r := lt_of_not_ge hrOne
    have hinv : r⁻¹ ≤ r := by
      rw [inv_eq_one_div]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hr).2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 1)]
    rw [min_eq_right hinv, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrOne'.le)]
    have hloss : 1 - r⁻¹ = (r - 1) / r := by
      field_simp [hr.ne']
    rw [hloss]
    constructor
    · apply (div_le_iff₀ hr).2
      nlinarith
    · rw [show C * ((r - 1) / r) = (C * (r - 1)) / r by ring]
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hr).2
      have hdelta : 0 ≤ r - 1 := sub_nonneg.mpr hrOne'.le
      simpa [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrC hdelta

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_reciprocalSaddleProfile_one_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_reciprocalSaddleProfile_one_iff
    {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} {r : α → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hr : ∀ᶠ x in l, 0 < r x ∧ r x ≤ C) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ reciprocalSaddleProfile (r x)) l (nhds 1) ↔
      Tendsto r l (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hprofile
    have hloss : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile (r x)) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [sub_self] using
        ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : α ↦ (1 : ℝ)) l (nhds 1)).sub hprofile)
    have hupper : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ C * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile (r x))) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using
        ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : α ↦ C) l (nhds C)).mul hloss)
    have habs : Tendsto (fun x ↦ |r x - 1|) l (nhds 0) := by
      apply squeeze_zero'
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ abs_nonneg (r x - 1)
      · filter_upwards [hr] with x hx
        exact (reciprocalSaddleProfile_loss_bounds hx.1 hx.2 hC).2
      · exact hupper
    apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.2
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs
  · intro hsaddle
    have habs : Tendsto (fun x ↦ |r x - 1|) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        (tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.1 hsaddle)
    have hloss : Tendsto (fun x ↦ 1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile (r x)) l (nhds 0) := by
      apply squeeze_zero'
      · filter_upwards [hr] with x hx
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr (reciprocalSaddleProfile_le_one hx.1)
      · filter_upwards [hr] with x hx
        exact (reciprocalSaddleProfile_loss_bounds hx.1 hx.2 hC).1
      · exact habs
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel, sub_zero] using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : α ↦ (1 : ℝ)) l (nhds 1)).sub hloss)

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_div_scaleG
statement:
theorem section5SaddleExponent_div_scaleG
    {X T : ℝ} (hG : scaleG X ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    section5SaddleExponent X T / scaleG X =
      reciprocalSaddleProfile (T / scaleG X)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio : T / scaleG X ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hT hG
  have hTform : (T / scaleG X) * scaleG X = T := div_mul_cancel₀ T hG
  rw [← hTform, section5SaddleExponent_at_mul_scaleG hG hratio]
  unfold reciprocalSaddleProfile
  field_simp [hG]

name: RankAmplification.corollary7_2_exact_maximum
statement:
theorem corollary7_2_exact_maximum {X T : ℝ}
    (hG : 0 < scaleG X) (hT : 0 < T) :
    section5SaddleExponent X T ≤ scaleG X ∧
      (section5SaddleExponent X T = scaleG X ↔ T = scaleG X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨section5SaddleExponent_le_scaleG hG.le hT,
    section5SaddleExponent_eq_scaleG_iff hG hT⟩

name: RankAmplification.corollary7_2_fixed_ratio
statement:
theorem corollary7_2_fixed_ratio
    {X lam : ℝ} (hG : scaleG X ≠ 0) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) :
    section5SaddleExponent X (lam * scaleG X) =
      min lam lam⁻¹ * scaleG X
proof:
:= by
  rw [section5SaddleExponent_at_mul_scaleG hG hlam]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_loss_bounds
statement:
theorem section5SaddleExponent_loss_bounds
    {X T C : ℝ} (hG : 0 < scaleG X) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hTC : T ≤ C * scaleG X) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    scaleG X - section5SaddleExponent X T ≤ |T - scaleG X| ∧
      |T - scaleG X| ≤
        C * (scaleG X - section5SaddleExponent X T)
proof:
:= by
  let r := T / scaleG X
  have hr : 0 < r := div_pos hT hG
  have hrC : r ≤ C := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hG).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hTC
  have hprofile := reciprocalSaddleProfile_loss_bounds hr hrC hC
  have hnormalized := section5SaddleExponent_div_scaleG hG.ne' hT.ne'
  have hexponent :
      section5SaddleExponent X T = reciprocalSaddleProfile r * scaleG X :=
    (div_eq_iff hG.ne').mp hnormalized
  have hTform : T = r * scaleG X := by
    exact (div_mul_cancel₀ T hG.ne').symm
  have hloss : scaleG X - section5SaddleExponent X T =
      scaleG X * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile r) := by
    rw [hexponent]
    ring
  have hdistance : |T - scaleG X| = scaleG X * |r - 1| := by
    rw [hTform]
    have hfactor : r * scaleG X - scaleG X = (r - 1) * scaleG X := by ring
    rw [hfactor, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hG]
    ring
  constructor
  · rw [hloss, hdistance]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprofile.1 hG.le
  · rw [hloss, hdistance]
    calc
      scaleG X * |r - 1| ≤ scaleG X *
          (C * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile r)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprofile.2 hG.le
      _ = C * (scaleG X * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile r)) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.corollary7_2_leadingCoefficient_iff
statement:
theorem corollary7_2_leadingCoefficient_iff
    {T : ℝ → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hwindow : ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
      0 < scaleG x ∧ 0 < T x ∧ T x ≤ C * scaleG x) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ section5SaddleExponent x (T x) / scaleG x)
        atTop (nhds 1) ↔
      Tendsto (fun x ↦ T x / scaleG x) atTop (nhds 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio : ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
      0 < T x / scaleG x ∧ T x / scaleG x ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [hwindow] with x hx
    refine ⟨div_pos hx.2.1 hx.1, ?_⟩
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hx.1).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hx.2.2
  have hnormalized :
      (fun x ↦ section5SaddleExponent x (T x) / scaleG x) =ᶠ[atTop]
        (fun x ↦ reciprocalSaddleProfile (T x / scaleG x)) := by
    filter_upwards [hwindow] with x hx
    exact section5SaddleExponent_div_scaleG hx.1.ne' hx.2.1.ne'
  exact (tendsto_congr' hnormalized).trans
    (tendsto_reciprocalSaddleProfile_one_iff hC hratio)

name: RankAmplification.corollary7_2_fixed_ratio_limit
statement:
theorem corollary7_2_fixed_ratio_limit {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ section5SaddleExponent x (lam * scaleG x) / scaleG x)
      atTop (nhds (min lam lam⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  apply (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ min lam lam⁻¹)
    atTop (nhds (min lam lam⁻¹))).congr'
  filter_upwards [tendsto_scaleG_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hG
  rw [corollary7_2_fixed_ratio hG.ne' hlam.ne', mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hG.ne']

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_add_scaleG_exact
statement:
theorem section5SaddleExponent_add_scaleG_exact
    {X Δ : ℝ} (hG : 0 < scaleG X) (hT : 0 < scaleG X + Δ) :
    section5SaddleExponent X (scaleG X + Δ) =
      scaleG X - |Δ| + if Δ ≤ 0 then 0 else Δ ^ 2 / (scaleG X + Δ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hΔ : Δ ≤ 0
  · have hTG : scaleG X + Δ ≤ scaleG X := by linarith
    have hleft : scaleG X + Δ ≤
        scaleG X ^ 2 / (scaleG X + Δ) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hT).2
      nlinarith
    rw [section5SaddleExponent, min_eq_left hleft, if_pos hΔ,
      abs_of_nonpos hΔ]
    ring
  · have hΔpos : 0 < Δ := lt_of_not_ge hΔ
    have hGleT : scaleG X ≤ scaleG X + Δ := by linarith
    have hright : scaleG X ^ 2 / (scaleG X + Δ) ≤ scaleG X + Δ := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hT).2
      nlinarith
    rw [section5SaddleExponent, min_eq_right hright, if_neg hΔ,
      abs_of_pos hΔpos]
    field_simp [hT.ne']
    ring

name: RankAmplification.section5SaddleExponent_secondOrder_error
statement:
theorem section5SaddleExponent_secondOrder_error
    {X Δ : ℝ} (hG : 0 < scaleG X) (hT : 0 < scaleG X + Δ) :
    |section5SaddleExponent X (scaleG X + Δ) -
        (scaleG X - |Δ|)| ≤ Δ ^ 2 / scaleG X
proof:
:= by
  rw [section5SaddleExponent_add_scaleG_exact hG hT]
  by_cases hΔ : Δ ≤ 0
  · rw [if_pos hΔ]
    simp only [add_zero, sub_self, abs_zero]
    positivity
  · rw [if_neg hΔ]
    have hsimp :
        scaleG X - |Δ| + Δ ^ 2 / (scaleG X + Δ) -
            (scaleG X - |Δ|) = Δ ^ 2 / (scaleG X + Δ) := by
      ring
    rw [hsimp, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hT.le)]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) hG
    linarith

name: RankAmplification.corollary7_2_secondOrder_iff
statement:
theorem corollary7_2_secondOrder_iff
    {T S : ℝ → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hwindow : ∀ᶠ x in atTop,
      0 < scaleG x ∧ 0 < T x ∧ T x ≤ C * scaleG x ∧ 0 < S x) :
    Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ (scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x)) / S x)
        atTop (nhds 0) ↔
      Tendsto (fun x ↦ (T x - scaleG x) / S x) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hexponent
    have hupper : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ C *
          ((scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x)) / S x))
        atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using
        ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ C) atTop (nhds C)).mul hexponent)
    have habs : Tendsto (fun x ↦ |(T x - scaleG x) / S x|)
        atTop (nhds 0) := by
      refine squeeze_zero'
        (f := fun x ↦ |(T x - scaleG x) / S x|)
        (g := fun x ↦ C *
          ((scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x)) / S x)) ?_ ?_ hupper
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ abs_nonneg _
      · filter_upwards [hwindow] with x hx
        have hloss := section5SaddleExponent_loss_bounds
          hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2.1 hC
        have hquotient :
          |T x - scaleG x| / S x ≤
              (C * (scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x))) / S x :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hloss.2 hx.2.2.2.le
        calc
          |(T x - scaleG x) / S x| = |T x - scaleG x| / S x := by
            rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hx.2.2.2]
          _ ≤ (C * (scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x))) / S x :=
            hquotient
          _ = C * ((scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x)) / S x) := by
            ring
    apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.2
    simpa only [sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs
  · intro hparameter
    have habs : Tendsto (fun x ↦ |(T x - scaleG x) / S x|)
        atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        (tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.1 hparameter)
    refine squeeze_zero'
      (f := fun x ↦
        (scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x)) / S x)
      (g := fun x ↦ |(T x - scaleG x) / S x|) ?_ ?_ habs
    · filter_upwards [hwindow] with x hx
      exact div_nonneg
        (sub_nonneg.mpr (section5SaddleExponent_le_scaleG hx.1.le hx.2.1))
        hx.2.2.2.le
    · filter_upwards [hwindow] with x hx
      have hloss := section5SaddleExponent_loss_bounds
        hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2.1 hC
      calc
        (scaleG x - section5SaddleExponent x (T x)) / S x ≤
            |T x - scaleG x| / S x :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hloss.1 hx.2.2.2.le
        _ = |(T x - scaleG x) / S x| := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hx.2.2.2]

name: RankAmplification.corollary7_2_secondOrder_expansion
statement:
theorem corollary7_2_secondOrder_expansion
    {Delta : ℝ → ℝ} (hDelta : Delta =o[atTop] scaleG) :
    (fun x ↦ section5SaddleExponent x (scaleG x + Delta x) -
        (scaleG x - |Delta x|)) =O[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ Delta x ^ 2 / scaleG x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall := hDelta.bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  have hpositive : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 < scaleG x + Delta x := by
    filter_upwards [hsmall, tendsto_scaleG_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hx hG
    change |Delta x| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |scaleG x| at hx
    rw [abs_of_pos hG] at hx
    have hlower : -|Delta x| ≤ Delta x := neg_abs_le (Delta x)
    nlinarith
  apply IsBigO.of_bound 1
  filter_upwards [hpositive, tendsto_scaleG_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hT hG
  rw [one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hG.le)]
  exact section5SaddleExponent_secondOrder_error hG hT

name: RankAmplification.log_movingOuterCutoff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_movingOuterCutoff (c x : ℝ) :
    Real.log (movingOuterCutoff c x) = c * movingR x
proof:
:= by
  simp [movingOuterCutoff]

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_mul_reciprocalSaddleProfile
statement:
theorem movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_mul_reciprocalSaddleProfile
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    movingSaddleExponent c =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * reciprocalSaddleProfile (2 * c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold movingSaddleExponent reciprocalSaddleProfile
  rw [mul_min_of_nonneg (2 * c) (2 * c)⁻¹ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
  congr 1
  · ring
  · field_simp [hc.ne']
    norm_num

name: RankAmplification.movingTransferExponent_eq_profile_mul_movingR
statement:
theorem movingTransferExponent_eq_profile_mul_movingR (c x : ℝ) :
    movingTransferExponent c x = movingSaddleExponent c * movingR x
proof:
:= by
  have hR : 0 ≤ movingR x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsecond : movingR x / (4 * c) = (1 / (4 * c)) * movingR x := by ring
  rw [movingTransferExponent, hsecond, movingSaddleExponent]
  simpa [mul_comm] using
    (mul_min_of_nonneg c (1 / (4 * c)) hR).symm

name: RankAmplification.movingTransferExponent_div_movingR
statement:
theorem movingTransferExponent_div_movingR
    {c x : ℝ} (hR : movingR x ≠ 0) :
    movingTransferExponent c x / movingR x = movingSaddleExponent c
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingTransferExponent_eq_profile_mul_movingR,
    mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hR]

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_exact_maximum
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_exact_maximum {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    movingSaddleExponent c ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      (movingSaddleExponent c = 1 / 2 ↔ c = 1 / 2)
proof:
:=
  ⟨movingSaddleExponent_le_half hc,
    movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_iff hc⟩

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_transfer_exact_maximum
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_transfer_exact_maximum
    {c x : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hR : 0 < movingR x) :
    movingTransferExponent c x ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * movingR x ∧
      (movingTransferExponent c x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * movingR x ↔
        c = 1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingTransferExponent_eq_profile_mul_movingR]
  constructor
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (movingSaddleExponent_le_half hc) hR.le
  · constructor
    · intro heq
      have hcoefficient : movingSaddleExponent c = 1 / 2 := by
        nlinarith
      exact (movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_iff hc).mp hcoefficient
    · intro hcHalf
      rw [hcHalf]
      norm_num [movingSaddleExponent]

name: RankAmplification.movingSaddleExponent_loss_bounds
statement:
theorem movingSaddleExponent_loss_bounds
    {c C : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hcC : c ≤ C) (hC : 1 / 2 ≤ C) :
    1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent c ≤ |c - 1 / 2| ∧
      |c - 1 / 2| ≤
        2 * C * (1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent c)
proof:
:= by
  have hscaledPositive : 0 < 2 * c := by positivity
  have hscaledUpper : 2 * c ≤ 2 * C := by linarith
  have hscaledC : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * C := by linarith
  have hprofile := reciprocalSaddleProfile_loss_bounds
    hscaledPositive hscaledUpper hscaledC
  have hfactor := movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_mul_reciprocalSaddleProfile hc
  have hloss :
      1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent c =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile (2 * c)) := by
    rw [hfactor]
    ring
  have hdistance :
      |c - 1 / 2| = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |2 * c - 1| := by
    have hrewrite : c - 1 / 2 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (2 * c - 1) := by ring
    rw [hrewrite, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
  constructor
  · rw [hloss, hdistance]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprofile.1 (by norm_num)
  · rw [hloss, hdistance]
    calc
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |2 * c - 1| ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            ((2 * C) * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile (2 * c))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprofile.2 (by norm_num)
      _ = 2 * C *
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - reciprocalSaddleProfile (2 * c))) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.tendsto_movingSaddleExponent_half_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_movingSaddleExponent_half_iff
    {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} {c : α → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hC : 1 / 2 ≤ C) (hc : ∀ᶠ x in l, 0 < c x ∧ c x ≤ C) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingSaddleExponent (c x)) l (nhds (1 / 2)) ↔
      Tendsto c l (nhds (1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hprofile
    have hloss : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ 1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent (c x)) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [sub_self] using
        ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : α ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) l
          (nhds (1 / 2))).sub hprofile)
    have hupper : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ 2 * C * (1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent (c x)))
        l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using
        ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : α ↦ (2 * C : ℝ)) l
          (nhds (2 * C))).mul hloss)
    have habs : Tendsto (fun x ↦ |c x - 1 / 2|) l (nhds 0) := by
      refine squeeze_zero' (f := fun x ↦ |c x - 1 / 2|)
        (g := fun x ↦ 2 * C *
          (1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent (c x))) ?_ ?_ hupper
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ abs_nonneg _
      · filter_upwards [hc] with x hx
        exact (movingSaddleExponent_loss_bounds hx.1 hx.2 hC).2
    apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.2
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs
  · intro hsaddle
    have habs : Tendsto (fun x ↦ |c x - 1 / 2|) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        (tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.1 hsaddle)
    have hloss : Tendsto
        (fun x ↦ 1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent (c x)) l (nhds 0) := by
      refine squeeze_zero'
        (f := fun x ↦ 1 / 2 - movingSaddleExponent (c x))
        (g := fun x ↦ |c x - 1 / 2|) ?_ ?_ habs
      · filter_upwards [hc] with x hx
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr (movingSaddleExponent_le_half hx.1)
      · filter_upwards [hc] with x hx
        exact (movingSaddleExponent_loss_bounds hx.1 hx.2 hC).1
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel, sub_zero] using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : α ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) l
        (nhds (1 / 2))).sub hloss)

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_fixed_ratio_limit
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_fixed_ratio_limit {c : ℝ} :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingTransferExponent c x / movingR x)
      atTop (nhds (movingSaddleExponent c))
proof:
:= by
  apply (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ movingSaddleExponent c)
    atTop (nhds (movingSaddleExponent c))).congr'
  filter_upwards [tendsto_movingR_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hR
  exact (movingTransferExponent_div_movingR hR.ne').symm

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_leadingCoefficient_iff
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_leadingCoefficient_iff
    {c : ℝ → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 1 / 2 ≤ C)
    (hwindow : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, 0 < c x ∧ c x ≤ C) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingTransferExponent (c x) x / movingR x)
        atTop (nhds (1 / 2)) ↔
      Tendsto c atTop (nhds (1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized :
      (fun x ↦ movingTransferExponent (c x) x / movingR x) =ᶠ[atTop]
        (fun x ↦ movingSaddleExponent (c x)) := by
    filter_upwards [tendsto_movingR_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hR
    exact movingTransferExponent_div_movingR hR.ne'
  exact (tendsto_congr' hnormalized).trans
    (tendsto_movingSaddleExponent_half_iff hC hwindow)

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_fixed_ratio_with_vanishing_error
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_fixed_ratio_with_vanishing_error
    {c : ℝ} {error : ℝ → ℝ} (herror : Tendsto error atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (movingTransferExponent c x + error x * movingR x) / movingR x)
      atTop (nhds (movingSaddleExponent c))
proof:
:= by
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun x ↦ movingSaddleExponent c + error x)
      atTop (nhds (movingSaddleExponent c)) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using
      ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ ↦ movingSaddleExponent c)
        atTop (nhds (movingSaddleExponent c))).add herror)
  apply hlimit.congr'
  filter_upwards [tendsto_movingR_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hR
  rw [add_div, movingTransferExponent_div_movingR hR.ne',
    mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hR.ne']

name: RankAmplification.proposition10_27_optimal_with_vanishing_error
statement:
theorem proposition10_27_optimal_with_vanishing_error
    {error : ℝ → ℝ} (herror : Tendsto error atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto
      (fun x ↦ (movingTransferExponent (1 / 2) x +
        error x * movingR x) / movingR x)
      atTop (nhds (1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : movingSaddleExponent (1 / 2) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (movingSaddleExponent_eq_half_iff (by norm_num)).2 rfl
  simpa only [hhalf] using
    (proposition10_27_fixed_ratio_with_vanishing_error
      (c := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) herror)

name: RankAmplification.mem_supportUnitsUpTo
statement:
theorem mem_supportUnitsUpTo {S : Finset ℕ} {x j : ℕ} :
    j ∈ supportUnitsUpTo S x ↔ 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ x ∧ primeSupport j ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  simp [supportUnitsUpTo, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo
statement:
theorem mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo {h x j : ℕ} :
    j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x ↔
      1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ x ∧ primeSupport j ⊆ primeSupport h
proof:
:=
  mem_supportUnitsUpTo

name: RankAmplification.sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo
statement:
theorem sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo {h j x : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hj : IsSameSupportIndex h j) (hjx : j ≤ x) :
    j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x
proof:
:=
  mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo.mpr
    ⟨hj.1, hjx, primeSupport_subset_shift_of_sameSupport hh hj⟩

name: RankAmplification.prod_pow_factorization_eq_self_of_subset
statement:
theorem prod_pow_factorization_eq_self_of_subset {S : Finset ℕ} {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (hjS : primeSupport j ⊆ S) :
    ∏ p ∈ S, p ^ j.factorization p = j
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ p ∈ S, p ∉ primeSupport j → p ^ j.factorization p = 1 := by
    intro p _ hp
    have h0 : j.factorization p = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hp (by
        simpa [Nat.support_factorization] using Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hne)
    simp [h0]
  rw [← Finset.prod_subset hjS hzero]
  exact (Nat.prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization hj).symm

name: RankAmplification.prod_inv_pow_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem prod_inv_pow_factorization_eq {S : Finset ℕ} {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (hjS : primeSupport j ⊆ S) :
    ∏ p ∈ S, ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ j.factorization p = ((j : ℝ))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := prod_pow_factorization_eq_self_of_subset hj hjS
  have hcast : ∏ p ∈ S, ((p : ℝ)) ^ j.factorization p = (j : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  simp only [inv_pow, Finset.prod_inv_distrib, hcast]

name: RankAmplification.supportExponents_injOn
statement:
theorem supportExponents_injOn (S : Finset ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (supportExponents S) {j : ℕ | j ≠ 0 ∧ primeSupport j ⊆ S}
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  have hfac : ∀ p ∈ S, a.factorization p = b.factorization p := by
    intro p hp
    simpa [supportExponents] using congrFun hab ⟨p, hp⟩
  calc a = ∏ p ∈ S, p ^ a.factorization p :=
        (prod_pow_factorization_eq_self_of_subset ha.1 ha.2).symm
    _ = ∏ p ∈ S, p ^ b.factorization p :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ by rw [hfac p hp]
    _ = b := prod_pow_factorization_eq_self_of_subset hb.1 hb.2

name: RankAmplification.supportExponents_mem_piFinset
statement:
theorem supportExponents_mem_piFinset {S : Finset ℕ} {x j : ℕ}
    (hj : j ∈ supportUnitsUpTo S x) :
    supportExponents S j ∈
      Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S} ↦ Finset.range (Nat.log 2 x + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hj1, hjx, _⟩ := mem_supportUnitsUpTo.mp hj
  rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
  intro a
  simp only [supportExponents, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (j.factorization a.1) with h0 | hpos
  · simp [h0]
  · have hmem : a.1 ∈ j.primeFactors := by
      simpa [Nat.support_factorization] using
        Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (by omega : j.factorization a.1 ≠ 0)
    have hprime : a.1.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
    have hle : a.1 ^ j.factorization a.1 ≤ j :=
      Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.ordProj_dvd j a.1)
    have h2 : 2 ^ j.factorization a.1 ≤ a.1 ^ j.factorization a.1 :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_left hprime.two_le _
    exact Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by norm_num) (le_trans (le_trans h2 hle) hjx)

name: RankAmplification.card_supportUnitsUpTo_le
statement:
theorem card_supportUnitsUpTo_le (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ) :
    (supportUnitsUpTo S x).card ≤ (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ S.card
proof:
:= by
  have hcard :
      (Fintype.piFinset
          (fun _ : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S} ↦ Finset.range (Nat.log 2 x + 1))).card
        = (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ S.card := by
    rw [Fintype.card_piFinset]
    simp [Finset.prod_const]
  rw [← hcard]
  refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (supportExponents S) ?_ ?_
  · intro j hj
    exact supportExponents_mem_piFinset (by simpa using hj)
  · refine (supportExponents_injOn S).mono ?_
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hj1, _, hjS⟩ := mem_supportUnitsUpTo.mp (by simpa using hj)
    exact ⟨by omega, hjS⟩

name: RankAmplification.card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le
statement:
theorem card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le (h x : ℕ) :
    (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).card ≤ (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card
proof:
:=
  card_supportUnitsUpTo_le _ x

name: RankAmplification.card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le_real
statement:
theorem card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le_real (h x : ℕ) :
    ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (1 + Real.log x / Real.log 2) ^ (primeSupport h).card
proof:
:= by
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hK : ((Nat.log 2 x : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log x / Real.log 2 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with hx | hx
    · simp [hx]
    · have h2 : (2 : ℕ) ^ Nat.log 2 x ≤ x := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)
      have h2R : ((2 : ℝ)) ^ (Nat.log 2 x) ≤ (x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
      have hposR : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 x) := by positivity
      have hlog := Real.log_le_log hposR h2R
      rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hlog2]
      linarith
  calc ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le h x
    _ = ((Nat.log 2 x : ℝ) + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card := by push_cast; ring
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.log x / Real.log 2) ^ (primeSupport h).card := by
        refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ _
        linarith

name: RankAmplification.geomSum_inv_le_div_pred
statement:
theorem geomSum_inv_le_div_pred {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k ≤ (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hppos : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hpne : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hppos
  have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hcancel : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * (p : ℝ) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hpne
  have hhalf : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hlt1 : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 := by linarith
  have hkey := mul_neg_geom_sum ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) n
  have hrn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ n := by positivity
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  have hfinal : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k ≤ 1 / (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)]
    linarith
  have heq : 1 / (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) = (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hden)]
    field_simp
  linarith [hfinal, heq.le, heq.ge]

name: RankAmplification.sum_inv_supportUnitsUpTo_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_supportUnitsUpTo_le {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) (x : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ supportUnitsUpTo S x, (1 : ℝ) / j ≤ ∏ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI : DecidableEq ({p : ℕ // p ∈ S} → ℕ) := Classical.decEq _
  have hrepr : ∀ j ∈ supportUnitsUpTo S x,
      (1 : ℝ) / j
        = ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S}, ((a.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (supportExponents S j a) := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hj1, _, hjS⟩ := mem_supportUnitsUpTo.mp hj
    have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
    have h1 : ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S}, ((a.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (supportExponents S j a)
        = ∏ p ∈ S, ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ j.factorization p :=
      Finset.prod_coe_sort S (fun p : ℕ ↦ ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ j.factorization p)
    rw [h1, prod_inv_pow_factorization_eq hj0 hjS, one_div]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (supportExponents S) ↑(supportUnitsUpTo S x) := by
    refine (supportExponents_injOn S).mono ?_
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hj1, _, hjS⟩ := mem_supportUnitsUpTo.mp (by simpa using hj)
    exact ⟨by omega, hjS⟩
  have hsub : (supportUnitsUpTo S x).image (supportExponents S) ⊆
      Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S} ↦ Finset.range (Nat.log 2 x + 1)) := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    exact supportExponents_mem_piFinset hj
  calc ∑ j ∈ supportUnitsUpTo S x, (1 : ℝ) / j
      = ∑ j ∈ supportUnitsUpTo S x,
          ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S}, ((a.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (supportExponents S j a) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl hrepr
    _ = ∑ e ∈ (supportUnitsUpTo S x).image (supportExponents S),
          ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S}, ((a.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (e a) :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun e : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S} → ℕ ↦
          ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S}, ((a.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (e a)) hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ Fintype.piFinset
            (fun _ : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S} ↦ Finset.range (Nat.log 2 x + 1)),
          ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S}, ((a.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (e a) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub ?_
        intro e _ _
        exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun a _ ↦ by positivity
    _ = ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S},
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.log 2 x + 1), ((a.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k :=
        (Finset.prod_univ_sum _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ a : {p : ℕ // p ∈ S}, ((a.1 : ℝ) / ((a.1 : ℝ) - 1)) := by
        refine Finset.prod_le_prod ?_ ?_
        · intro a _
          exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ ↦ by positivity
        · intro a _
          exact geomSum_inv_le_div_pred (hS a.1 a.2).two_le _
    _ = ∏ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) :=
        Finset.prod_coe_sort S (fun p : ℕ ↦ (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1))

name: RankAmplification.prod_div_pred_primeSupport_eq_div_totient
statement:
theorem prod_div_pred_primeSupport_eq_div_totient {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∏ p ∈ primeSupport h, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) = (h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 : ∀ p ∈ primeSupport h, 2 ≤ p := fun p hp ↦
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
  have hcast2 : ∏ p ∈ primeSupport h, ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = ∏ p ∈ primeSupport h, ((p : ℝ) - 1) :=
    Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ p := le_trans (by norm_num) (hp2 p hp)
      rw [Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_one]
  have hQpos : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ p ∈ primeSupport h, ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    refine Finset.prod_pos fun p hp ↦ ?_
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp2 p hp
    linarith
  have hφpos : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.totient h : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < Nat.totient h := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hh
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hnatR : (Nat.totient h : ℝ) * ((∏ p ∈ primeSupport h, p : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = (h : ℝ) * ((∏ p ∈ primeSupport h, (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ)) (Nat.totient_mul_prod_primeFactors h)
  simp only [Nat.cast_prod] at hnatR
  rw [hcast2] at hnatR
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hQpos) (ne_of_gt hφpos)]
  linear_combination hnatR

name: RankAmplification.sum_inv_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le (h x : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (1 : ℝ) / j ≤ (h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_div_pred_primeSupport_eq_div_totient hh]
  exact sum_inv_supportUnitsUpTo_le
    (fun p hp ↦ Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp) x

name: RankAmplification.sum_inv_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem sum_inv_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le_two_pow (h x : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (1 : ℝ) / j ≤ 2 ^ (primeSupport h).card
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := sum_inv_supportUnitsUpTo_le
    (S := primeSupport h) (fun p hp ↦ Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp) x
  refine hmain.trans ?_
  calc ∏ p ∈ primeSupport h, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)
      ≤ ∏ _p ∈ primeSupport h, (2 : ℝ) := by
        refine Finset.prod_le_prod ?_ ?_
        · intro p hp
          have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
          have : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
          positivity
        · intro p hp
          have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1)]
          linarith
    _ = 2 ^ (primeSupport h).card := by simp

name: RankAmplification.sum_inv_sameSupportIndices_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sameSupportIndices_le {h x : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (J : Finset ℕ)
    (hJ : ∀ j ∈ J, IsSameSupportIndex h j) (hJx : ∀ j ∈ J, j ≤ x) :
    ∑ j ∈ J, (1 : ℝ) / j ≤ (h : ℝ) / (Nat.totient h : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : J ⊆ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x := by
    intro j hj
    exact sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo hh (hJ j hj) (hJx j hj)
  refine le_trans ?_ (sum_inv_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le h x hh)
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub ?_
  intro j _ _
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.card_sameSupportIndices_le
statement:
theorem card_sameSupportIndices_le {h x : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (J : Finset ℕ)
    (hJ : ∀ j ∈ J, IsSameSupportIndex h j) (hJx : ∀ j ∈ J, j ≤ x) :
    J.card ≤ (Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : J ⊆ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x := by
    intro j hj
    exact sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo hh (hJ j hj) (hJx j hj)
  exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (card_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo_le h x)

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo
    {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ⊆
      (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).biUnion (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h)
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hnData := mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mp hn
  obtain ⟨j, r, hrep⟩ := hnData.2.2
  have hjn : j ≤ n := by
    rw [hrep.2.2.1]
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left j (show 1 ≤ diagonalA h j * r + 1 by omega)
  refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, ?_, hrep.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet hh hnData.2.1⟩
  exact sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo hh hrep.1 (hjn.trans hnData.2.1)

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_sum_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo
    {x h Y : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y ≤
      ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount]
  calc (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y).card
      ≤ ((shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).biUnion (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card
          (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet_subset_biUnion_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo hh)
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h j).card :=
        Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ card_diagonalPrimeValueSet_le x h j

name: RankAmplification.aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_smoothUnitCount_mul_of_uniformSieve
statement:
theorem aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_smoothUnitCount_mul_of_uniformSieve
    {h : ℕ} {C : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hsieve : ∀ j : ℕ, IsSameSupportIndex h j → ∀ R : ℕ, 3 ≤ R →
      ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤ C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R)
    (x Y : ℕ) (hx : 3 ≤ x) :
    (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) * C *
        AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hscale : (0 : ℝ) ≤ AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by
    unfold AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale
    positivity
  set T : Finset ℕ :=
    (shiftSupportUnitsUpTo h x).filter (fun j ↦ IsSameSupportIndex h j)
  have hTsame : ∀ j ∈ T, IsSameSupportIndex h j := fun j hj ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
  have hTle : ∀ j ∈ T, j ≤ x := fun j hj ↦
    (mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).2.1
  have hcover : aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y ⊆ T.biUnion (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h) := by
    intro n hn
    have hnData := mem_aboveCutoffDiagonalSet.mp hn
    obtain ⟨j, r, hrep⟩ := hnData.2.2
    have hjn : j ≤ n := by
      rw [hrep.2.2.1]
      simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left j (show 1 ≤ diagonalA h j * r + 1 by omega)
    refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, ?_, hrep.mem_diagonalPrimeValueSet hh hnData.2.1⟩
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨sameSupportIndex_mem_shiftSupportUnitsUpTo hh hrep.1 (hjn.trans hnData.2.1), hrep.1⟩
  have hcountNat : aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y ≤
      ∑ j ∈ T, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card := by
    rw [aboveCutoffDiagonalCount]
    calc (aboveCutoffDiagonalSet x h Y).card
        ≤ (T.biUnion (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h)).card := Finset.card_le_card hcover
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ T, (diagonalPrimeValueSet x h j).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ T, (diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ card_diagonalPrimeValueSet_le x h j
  have hcountR : (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ T, ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcountNat
  have hTcard : (T.card : ℝ) ≤ (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_sameSupportIndices_le hh T hTsame hTle
  calc (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ T, ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j x).card : ℝ) := hcountR
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ T, C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj ↦ hsieve j (hTsame j hj) x hx
    _ = (T.card : ℝ) * (C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTcard (mul_nonneg hC hscale)
    _ = (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) * C *
          AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x := by ring

name: RankAmplification.exists_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_bound_of_uniformSieve
statement:
theorem exists_aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_bound_of_uniformSieve {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (huniform : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, IsSameSupportIndex h j → ∀ R : ℕ, 3 ≤ R →
      ((diagonalPrimePairSet h j R).card : ℝ) ≤ C * AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x Y : ℕ, 3 ≤ x →
      (aboveCutoffDiagonalCount x h Y : ℝ) ≤
        (((Nat.log 2 x + 1) ^ (primeSupport h).card : ℕ) : ℝ) * C *
          AffinePrimePair.logSquaredScale x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hsieve⟩ := huniform
  exact ⟨C, fun x Y hx ↦
    aboveCutoffDiagonalCount_le_smoothUnitCount_mul_of_uniformSieve hh hC hsieve x Y hx⟩

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformSlackPhase_sub_le_sharp
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformSlackPhase_sub_le_sharp
    {ξ u v : ℝ} (hv : 1 < v) (hlogv : 1 < Real.log v)
    (hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 v) (hvu : v ≤ u) :
    bfpsUniformSlackPhase u ξ - bfpsUniformSlackPhase v ξ ≤
      (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) + (u - v) * (2 / Real.log v)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := log2_sub_log2_le hv hvu
  have h3 := log3_sub_log3_le hv hlogv hvu
  have hvpos : 0 < v := zero_lt_one.trans hv
  have hdiff : 0 ≤ u - v := sub_nonneg.mpr hvu
  have hlogvpos : 0 < Real.log v := zero_lt_one.trans hlogv
  have hquot : 0 ≤ (u - v) / Real.log v := div_nonneg hdiff hlogvpos.le
  have hterm2 : v * (log2 u - log2 v) ≤ (u - v) / Real.log v := by
    calc
      v * (log2 u - log2 v) ≤
          v * ((u - v) / (v * Real.log v)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hvpos.le
      _ = (u - v) / Real.log v := by field_simp [hvpos.ne']
  have hterm3 : v * (log3 u - log3 v) ≤ (u - v) / Real.log v := by
    calc
      v * (log3 u - log3 v) ≤
          v * ((u - v) / (v * Real.log v * log2 v)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hvpos.le
      _ = ((u - v) / Real.log v) / log2 v := by
        field_simp [hvpos.ne']
      _ ≤ (u - v) / Real.log v := div_le_self hquot hlog2v
  unfold bfpsUniformSlackPhase
  calc
    u * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) -
          v * (log2 v + log3 v - ξ) =
        (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) +
          v * (log2 u - log2 v) + v * (log3 u - log3 v) := by ring
    _ ≤ (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) +
          (u - v) / Real.log v + (u - v) / Real.log v := by gcongr
    _ = (u - v) * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ) + (u - v) * (2 / Real.log v) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap_sharp
statement:
theorem bfpsUniformDecay_le_of_gap_sharp
    {ξ u v a : ℝ} (hv : 1 < v) (hlogv : 1 < Real.log v)
    (hlog2v : 1 ≤ log2 v) (hvu : v ≤ u) (hgap : u - v ≤ a)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2 / Real.log v) :
    bfpsUniformDecay ξ v ≤
      bfpsUniformDecay ξ u *
        Real.exp (a * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2 / Real.log v))
proof:
:= by
  have hphase := bfpsUniformSlackPhase_sub_le_sharp (ξ := ξ) hv hlogv hlog2v hvu
  have hphase' : bfpsUniformSlackPhase u ξ - bfpsUniformSlackPhase v ξ ≤
      a * (log2 u + log3 u - ξ + 2 / Real.log v) := by
    refine hphase.trans ?_
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgap hslope
    nlinarith [this]
  unfold bfpsUniformDecay
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.exp_mul_sub_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem exp_mul_sub_sub_log_le
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (A : ℝ) :
    Real.exp t * (A - t - Real.log t) ≤ Real.exp (A - 1) / t
proof:
:= by
  set s := A - t - Real.log t with hs
  rcases lt_or_ge 0 s with hspos | hsnonpos
  · have hAs : A - s = t + Real.log t := by rw [hs]; ring
    have hexpAs : Real.exp (A - s) = Real.exp t * t := by
      rw [hAs, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log ht]
    have hsplit : Real.exp (A - s) = Real.exp A * Real.exp (-s) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1
    have hprod : Real.exp t * t = Real.exp A * Real.exp (-s) := hexpAs.symm.trans hsplit
    have hkey : s * Real.exp (-s) ≤ Real.exp (-1) := by
      have h1 : s ≤ Real.exp (s - 1) := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (s - 1)
        linarith
      calc
        s * Real.exp (-s) ≤ Real.exp (s - 1) * Real.exp (-s) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-1) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ht]
    calc
      Real.exp t * s * t = (Real.exp t * t) * s := by ring
      _ = (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-s)) * s := by rw [hprod]
      _ = Real.exp A * (s * Real.exp (-s)) := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp A * Real.exp (-1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey (Real.exp_pos A).le
      _ = Real.exp (A - 1) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1
  · have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (A - 1) / t := div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) ht
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos t]

name: RankAmplification.mul_sub_log_le_exp
statement:
theorem mul_sub_log_le_exp
    {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (A : ℝ) :
    k * (A - Real.log k) ≤ Real.exp (A - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : A - Real.log k ≤ Real.exp (A - 1 - Real.log k) := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (A - 1 - Real.log k)
    linarith
  have hmul : k * (A - Real.log k) ≤ k * Real.exp (A - 1 - Real.log k) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey hk.le
  refine hmul.trans_eq ?_
  have hrw : Real.exp (A - 1 - Real.log k) = Real.exp (A - 1) / k := by
    rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hk]
  rw [hrw]
  field_simp

name: RankAmplification.exp_slope_mul_shiftedPrimeDecay_le
statement:
theorem exp_slope_mul_shiftedPrimeDecay_le
    {k σ : ℝ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Real.exp (k * σ) * bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay k ≤
      Real.exp (Real.exp σ / Real.log k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
  have hlogk : 0 < Real.log k := Real.log_pos hk1
  have hstep : Real.log (Real.log k) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (k + 1)) :=
    Real.log_le_log hlogk (Real.log_le_log hk0 (by linarith))
  have hsaddle := exp_mul_sub_sub_log_le hlogk (σ + 1)
  rw [Real.exp_log hk0] at hsaddle
  have hA : Real.exp (σ + 1 - 1) = Real.exp σ := by congr 1; ring
  rw [hA] at hsaddle
  have hmono : k * (σ + 1 - Real.log k - Real.log (Real.log (k + 1))) ≤
      k * (σ + 1 - Real.log k - Real.log (Real.log k)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hk0.le
  unfold bfpsShiftedPrimeDecay
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
  calc
    k * σ + -k * (Real.log k + Real.log (Real.log (k + 1)) - 1)
        = k * (σ + 1 - Real.log k - Real.log (Real.log (k + 1))) := by ring
    _ ≤ k * (σ + 1 - Real.log k - Real.log (Real.log k)) := hmono
    _ ≤ Real.exp σ / Real.log k := hsaddle

name: RankAmplification.sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity_pos
statement:
theorem sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity_pos (R H : ℕ) :
    0 < sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity R H
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.exp_pos _

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity
    {R H : ℕ} (h : SharpHildebrandRegime R H) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      (H : ℝ) * sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity R H
proof:
:= by
  have hδone : hildebrandSaddleShift H R < 1 :=
    h.2.2.1.trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hEuler := log_softenedMertensProduct_le_rankinU_add_sharpRemainder
    h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2
  have hbound := finiteSmoothCount_le_exp_saddle h.1 hδone hEuler
  have hRone : 1 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h.2.1
  have hshift :
      -hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
        -rankinU H R *
          (Real.log (rankinU H R) + Real.log (Real.log (rankinU H R))) := by
    rw [show -hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H =
      -(hildebrandSaddleShift H R * Real.log H) by ring,
      hildebrandSaddleShift_mul_logH hRone]
    ring
  rw [hshift] at hbound
  rw [sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity, dickmanSaddlePhase]
  convert hbound using 1
  congr 2
  ring

name: RankAmplification.hildebrandModerateSplitDensity_pos
statement:
theorem hildebrandModerateSplitDensity_pos (R H : ℕ) :
    0 < hildebrandModerateSplitDensity R H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold hildebrandModerateSplitDensity
  split_ifs
  · exact sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity_pos R H
  · norm_num

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandModerateSplit
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandModerateSplit (R H : ℕ) :
    (finiteSmoothCount R H : ℝ) ≤
      (H : ℝ) * hildebrandModerateSplitDensity R H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : SharpHildebrandRegime R H
  · rw [hildebrandModerateSplitDensity, if_pos h]
    exact finiteSmoothCount_le_sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity h
  · rw [hildebrandModerateSplitDensity, if_neg h, mul_one]
    exact_mod_cast finiteSmoothCount_le_cutoff R H

name: RankAmplification.hasHildebrandModerateSplitUpperBound
statement:
theorem hasHildebrandModerateSplitUpperBound :
    HasHildebrandModerateSplitUpperBound
proof:
:=
  finiteSmoothCount_le_hildebrandModerateSplit

name: RankAmplification.sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity
statement:
theorem sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity
    {C : ℝ} {R H : ℕ}
    (hrem : sharpHildebrandEulerRemainder R H ≤
      C * dickmanLogErrorScale (rankinU H R)) :
    sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity R H ≤
      dickmanSaddleUpperDensity C (rankinU H R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sharpHildebrandCorrectedDensity, dickmanSaddleUpperDensity]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (add_le_add le_rfl hrem)

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothCount_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_of_remainder
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothCount_le_dickmanSaddleUpperDensity_of_remainder

proof:

name: RankAmplification.eventually_sharpHildebrandRegime_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem eventually_sharpHildebrandRegime_of_tendsto
    {R H : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hH : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 0 < H n)
    (hR : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 4 ≤ R n)
    (hδ : Tendsto (fun n ↦ hildebrandSaddleShift (H n) (R n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n ↦ rankinU (H n) (R n)) atTop atTop) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, SharpHildebrandRegime (R n) (H n)
proof:
:= by
  have hδlt : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      hildebrandSaddleShift (H n) (R n) < (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
    (tendsto_order.1 hδ).2 (1 / 4 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
  have hδquarter : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      hildebrandSaddleShift (H n) (R n) ≤ 1 / 4 :=
    hδlt.mono fun _ hn ↦ hn.le
  have huLarge : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.exp (Real.exp 2) ≤ rankinU (H n) (R n) :=
    (tendsto_atTop.1 hu) _
  filter_upwards [hH, hR, hδquarter, huLarge] with n hnH hnR hnδ hnu
  exact ⟨hnH, hnR, hnδ, hnu⟩

  have hxpos : ∀ᶠ x : ℕ in atTop, 0 < x :=

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_gamma_envelope
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_gamma_envelope
    {X Y k : ℕ} {ξ γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hinner : ∀ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤
        γ * (((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y))) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution X Y k ≤
      (X : ℝ) * (γ * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k) *
        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 ≤ γ * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k :=
    mul_nonneg hγ (bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope_nonneg ξ X Y k)
  refine bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_innerDensity hA ?_
  intro p hp
  have hg : bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y) ≤
      bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k :=
    bfpsUniformDecay_le_magnitudeInnerEnvelope hp
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  calc
    (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤
        γ * (((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y)) := hinner p hp
    _ ≤ γ * (((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hD) hγ
    _ = ((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * (γ * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k) := by ring

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_le_shellSplit
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_le_shellSplit
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (K : ℕ)
    (hinner : ∀ k : ℕ, k < K → ∀ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤
        γ * (((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y))) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1)).filter (fun k ↦ k < K),
          (X : ℝ) * (γ * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k) *
            bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k) +
        ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1)).filter (fun k ↦ ¬ k < K),
          (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  rw [bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_eq_magnitudeSum hY,
    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1))
      (fun k ↦ k < K) (bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution X Y)]
  refine add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum ?_) (Finset.sum_le_sum ?_)
  · intro k hk
    exact bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_gamma_envelope hγ
      (hinner k (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2)
  · intro k _
    exact bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeContribution_le_trivialLogMass

name: RankAmplification.bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_le_shellSplit_majorant
statement:
theorem bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_le_shellSplit_majorant
    {X Y : ℕ} {ξ γ : ℝ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (K : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hinner : ∀ k : ℕ, k < K → ∀ p ∈ bfpsLargePrimeMagnitudeShell X Y k,
      (smoothTotientCount (X / p) Y : ℝ) ≤
        γ * (((X / p : ℕ) : ℝ) * bfpsUniformDecay ξ (bfpsU (X / p) Y)))
    (hF : ∀ k : ℕ, k < K →
      (X : ℝ) * (γ * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeInnerDecayEnvelope ξ X Y k) *
        bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k ≤ F k) :
    bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution X Y ≤
      (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1)).filter (fun k ↦ k < K), F k) +
        ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.log Y X + 1)).filter (fun k ↦ ¬ k < K),
          (X : ℝ) * bfpsPrimeMagnitudeShellLogMass X Y k
proof:
:= by
  refine (bfpsLargePrimeMangoldtContribution_le_shellSplit hY hγ K hinner).trans ?_
  exact add_le_add
    (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk ↦ hF k (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2) le_rfl

name: RankAmplification.norm_reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_prime_lt_one

theorem norm_reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_prime_lt_one {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    ‖reciprocalRpowMonoidHom s p‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) _)]
  exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt) (neg_neg_of_pos hs)

name: RankAmplification.smoothRpowTsum_eq_softenedMertensProduct
statement:
theorem smoothRpowTsum_eq_softenedMertensProduct (R : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    smoothRpowTsum R s = softenedMertensProduct R s
proof:
:= by
  have h := EulerProduct.summable_and_hasSum_smoothNumbers_prod_primesBelow_geometric
    (f := reciprocalRpowMonoidHom s)
    (fun {_p} hp ↦ norm_reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_prime_lt_one hs hp)
    (R + 1)
  exact h.2.tsum_eq.trans (by
    simp only [softenedMertensProduct, Nat.primesLE,
      reciprocalRpowMonoidHom_apply])

name: RankAmplification.summable_naturalPSeries
statement:

    Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (-s))
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.summable_nat_rpow.mpr (by linarith)

name: RankAmplification.smoothRpowTsum_le_naturalPSeries
statement:

    smoothRpowTsum R s ≤ naturalPSeries s
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothRpowTsum naturalPSeries
  exact Summable.tsum_subtype_le
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (-s))
    ((R + 1).smoothNumbers)
    (fun n ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) _)
    (summable_naturalPSeries hs)

name: RankAmplification.naturalPSeries_tail_le
statement:
theorem naturalPSeries_tail_le {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ≤ 1 / (s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (-s)) (Ici (1 : ℝ)) :=
    (Real.antitoneOn_rpow_Ioi_of_exponent_nonpos (by linarith)).mono
      (fun _ hx ↦ by simpa only [mem_Ioi] using zero_lt_one.trans_le hx)
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (-s)) (Ioi (1 : ℝ)) :=
    integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) zero_lt_one
  have hnonneg : ∀ x ∈ Ioi (1 : ℝ), 0 ≤ x ^ (-s) :=
    fun x _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_one ‹1 < x›)) _
  have h := AntitoneOn.tsum_comp_add_le_integral
    (f := fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (-s)) 1
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using hanti)
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using hint)
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using hnonneg)
  have h' : (∑' n : ℕ, ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ≤
      ∫ x in Ioi (1 : ℝ), x ^ (-s) := by
    convert h using 1
    all_goals norm_num
  rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) zero_lt_one] at h'
  convert h' using 1
  all_goals norm_num
  have hsne : s - 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hs)
  have hneg : -s + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  field_simp [hsne, hneg]
  ring

name: RankAmplification.naturalPSeries_le
statement:
theorem naturalPSeries_le (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 < s) :
    naturalPSeries s ≤ 1 + 1 / (s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := summable_naturalPSeries hs
  have hshift : Summable (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) :=
    hsum.comp_injective Nat.succ_injective
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ^ (-s) = 0 := by
    rw [Real.zero_rpow]
    linarith
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ^ (-s) = 1 := by simp
  calc
    naturalPSeries s = ∑' n : ℕ, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
      rw [naturalPSeries, hsum.tsum_eq_zero_add]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, hzero, zero_add]
    _ = 1 + ∑' n : ℕ, ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
      rw [hshift.tsum_eq_zero_add]
      simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_one, hone]
    _ ≤ 1 + 1 / (s - 1) := add_le_add le_rfl (naturalPSeries_tail_le hs)

name: RankAmplification.softenedMertensProduct_le
statement:
theorem softenedMertensProduct_le (R : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 < s) :
    softenedMertensProduct R s ≤ 1 + 1 / (s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← smoothRpowTsum_eq_softenedMertensProduct R (lt_trans zero_lt_one hs)]
  exact (smoothRpowTsum_le_naturalPSeries R hs).trans (naturalPSeries_le s hs)

name: RankAmplification.primeEulerFactor_pos

    0 < (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt

name: RankAmplification.one_le_primeEulerFactor
statement:
theorem one_le_primeEulerFactor {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    1 ≤ (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hden : 0 < 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
    sub_pos.mpr (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt))
  exact (one_le_inv₀ hden).2 (by linarith [inv_nonneg.mpr hp0.le])

name: RankAmplification.totientWeight_eq_eulerWeight
statement:
theorem totientWeight_eq_eulerWeight {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    totientWeight m = totientEulerWeight m
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hprodPos : 0 < ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro p hp
    have pp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    exact sub_pos.mpr (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast pp.one_lt))
  rw [totientWeight, totientEulerWeight, totient_cast_eq_mul_prod_factors_real,
    div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  calc
    (m : ℝ) * ((∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹))⁻¹ * (m : ℝ)⁻¹) =
        (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹))⁻¹ * ((m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      ring
    _ = (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹))⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hmR, mul_one]
    _ = ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]

name: RankAmplification.totientEulerWeight_le_mertensProduct

proof:
:= by
  unfold totientEulerWeight mertensProduct
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le
  · intro p hp
    exact Nat.mem_primesLE.mpr
      ⟨hm.2 p hp, Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact (primeEulerFactor_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)).le
  · intro p hp _
    exact one_le_primeEulerFactor (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesLE hp)
