name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le (R X : ℕ) :
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R X ≤
      mertensProduct R * finiteSmoothCount R X
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum, finiteSmoothCount]
  calc
    ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, totientWeight m ≤
        ∑ _m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, mertensProduct R := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      exact totientWeight_le_mertensProduct (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm).2.2
    _ = mertensProduct R * (finiteSmoothSet R X).card := by
      simp [mul_comm]

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_log
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_log {R X : ℕ} (hR : 3 ≤ R) :
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R X ≤
      (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log R)) * finiteSmoothCount R X
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R X ≤
        mertensProduct R * finiteSmoothCount R X := finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le R X
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log R)) * finiteSmoothCount R X := by
      gcongr
      exact mertensProduct_le_log R hR

name: RankAmplification.finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_full_paper_error
statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_full_paper_error {R X : ℕ}
    (hX : 0 < X) (hR : 3 ≤ R) (hu : 1 < rankinU X R)
    (huSqrt : rankinU X R ≤ Real.sqrt R) :
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R X ≤
      (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log R)) *
        ((X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum R X ≤
        (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log R)) * finiteSmoothCount R X :=
      finiteSmoothTotientWeightSum_le_log hR
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (4 * Real.log 4) * (1 + Real.log R)) *
        ((X : ℝ) * Real.exp
          (-rankinU X R * Real.log (rankinU X R) + fullPaperDivisorError R X)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (finiteSmoothCount_le_full_paper_error hX (hR.trans' (by norm_num)) hu huSqrt)
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le
        (add_nonneg zero_le_one (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ R by omega))))

name: RankAmplification.mem_shiftedMultipleSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_shiftedMultipleSet {x a d n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ shiftedMultipleSet x a d ↔ 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ x ∧ d ∣ n + a
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftedMultipleSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.shiftedMultipleSet_card_le
statement:
theorem shiftedMultipleSet_card_le {x a d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (shiftedMultipleSet x a d).card ≤ x / d + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hempty : shiftedMultipleSet x a d = ∅
  · simp [hempty]
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
    calc
      (shiftedMultipleSet x a d).card ≤
          ((Finset.range (x + 1)).filter fun n ↦ n ≡ b [MOD d]).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro n hn
        have hnData := mem_shiftedMultipleSet.mp hn
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
        refine ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le hnData.2.1, ?_⟩
        exact shifted_divisors_modEq hnData.2.2 (mem_shiftedMultipleSet.mp hb).2.2
      _ = Nat.count (· ≡ b [MOD d]) (x + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
      _ ≤ x / d + 1 := count_modEq_le_div_add_one x b d hd

name: RankAmplification.mem_squareSourceAtPrimeSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_squareSourceAtPrimeSet {x h p n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ squareSourceAtPrimeSet x h p ↔
      1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ x ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)
proof:
:= by
  simp [squareSourceAtPrimeSet, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.prime_sq_dvd_mul_shifted_iff
statement:
theorem prime_sq_dvd_mul_shifted_iff {p n h : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hph : h < p) :
    p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h) ↔ p ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ p ^ 2 ∣ n + h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsquare
    have hpSquare : p ∣ p ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_two]
      exact Nat.dvd_mul_right p p
    have hpProduct : p ∣ n * (n + h) := hpSquare.trans hsquare
    rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hpProduct with hpn | hpnShift
    · have hpNotShift : ¬p ∣ n + h :=
        prime_not_dvd_both_shifted hp hh hph hpn
      have hcop : (p ^ 2).Coprime (n + h) :=
        (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hpNotShift).pow_left 2
      exact Or.inl (hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hsquare)
    · have hpNotN : ¬p ∣ n := by
        intro hpn
        exact (prime_not_dvd_both_shifted hp hh hph hpn) hpnShift
      have hcop : (p ^ 2).Coprime n :=
        (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hpNotN).pow_left 2
      exact Or.inr (hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hsquare)
  · rintro (hn | hnShift)
    · exact hn.trans (Nat.dvd_mul_right n (n + h))
    · exact hnShift.trans (Nat.dvd_mul_left (n + h) n)

name: RankAmplification.squareSourceAtPrimeSet_subset_two_classes
statement:
theorem squareSourceAtPrimeSet_subset_two_classes {x h p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hph : h < p) :
    squareSourceAtPrimeSet x h p ⊆
      shiftedMultipleSet x 0 (p ^ 2) ∪ shiftedMultipleSet x h (p ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hnData := mem_squareSourceAtPrimeSet.mp hn
  rw [prime_sq_dvd_mul_shifted_iff hp hh hph] at hnData
  rcases hnData.2.2 with hnSquare | hnShiftSquare
  · apply Finset.mem_union_left
    exact mem_shiftedMultipleSet.mpr ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.1, by simpa using hnSquare⟩
  · apply Finset.mem_union_right
    exact mem_shiftedMultipleSet.mpr ⟨hnData.1, hnData.2.1, hnShiftSquare⟩

name: RankAmplification.squareSourceAtPrimeSet_card_le
statement:
theorem squareSourceAtPrimeSet_card_le {x h p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hph : h < p) :
    (squareSourceAtPrimeSet x h p).card ≤ 2 * (x / p ^ 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (squareSourceAtPrimeSet x h p).card ≤
        (shiftedMultipleSet x 0 (p ^ 2) ∪ shiftedMultipleSet x h (p ^ 2)).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (squareSourceAtPrimeSet_subset_two_classes hp hh hph)
    _ ≤ (shiftedMultipleSet x 0 (p ^ 2)).card +
        (shiftedMultipleSet x h (p ^ 2)).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (x / p ^ 2 + 1) + (x / p ^ 2 + 1) := by
      exact Nat.add_le_add
        (shiftedMultipleSet_card_le (pow_pos hp.pos 2))
        (shiftedMultipleSet_card_le (pow_pos hp.pos 2))
    _ = 2 * (x / p ^ 2 + 1) := by omega

name: RankAmplification.squareSource_prime_le_sqrt_two_mul
statement:
theorem squareSource_prime_le_sqrt_two_mul {x h p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hph : h < p) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnx : n ≤ x) (hhx : h ≤ x)
    (hsquare : p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)) :
    p ≤ (2 * x).sqrt
proof:
:= by
  rw [prime_sq_dvd_mul_shifted_iff hp hh hph] at hsquare
  apply Nat.le_sqrt'.2
  rcases hsquare with hnSquare | hnShiftSquare
  · have hp2n : p ^ 2 ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hnSquare
    omega
  · have hp2Shift : p ^ 2 ≤ n + h := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hnShiftSquare
    omega

name: RankAmplification.mem_squareSourcePrimeRange
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_squareSourcePrimeRange {y P p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P ↔ y < p ∧ p ≤ P ∧ p.Prime
proof:
:= by
  simp [squareSourcePrimeRange, and_assoc]

name: RankAmplification.mem_squareSourceSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_squareSourceSet {x h y P n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ squareSourceSet x h y P ↔
      ∃ p, y < p ∧ p ≤ P ∧ p.Prime ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h) ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨p, hpRange, hnp⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hn
    have hpData := mem_squareSourcePrimeRange.mp hpRange
    have hnData := mem_squareSourceAtPrimeSet.mp hnp
    exact ⟨p, hpData.1, hpData.2.1, hpData.2.2, hnData.2.2, hnData.1, hnData.2.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hyp, hpP, hp, hsquare, hn, hnx⟩
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨p, mem_squareSourcePrimeRange.mpr ⟨hyp, hpP, hp⟩,
      mem_squareSourceAtPrimeSet.mpr ⟨hn, hnx, hsquare⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.mem_squareSourceSet_sqrt_cutoff
statement:
theorem mem_squareSourceSet_sqrt_cutoff {x h y n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hhy : h ≤ y) (hhx : h ≤ x) :
    n ∈ squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt ↔
      1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ x ∧ ∃ p, y < p ∧ p.Prime ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨p, hyp, _hpUpper, hp, hsquare, hnPos, hnx⟩ := mem_squareSourceSet.mp hn
    exact ⟨hnPos, hnx, p, hyp, hp, hsquare⟩
  · rintro ⟨hnPos, hnx, p, hyp, hp, hsquare⟩
    have hph : h < p := hhy.trans_lt hyp
    have hpUpper : p ≤ (2 * x).sqrt :=
      squareSource_prime_le_sqrt_two_mul hp hh hph hnPos hnx hhx hsquare
    exact mem_squareSourceSet.mpr ⟨p, hyp, hpUpper, hp, hsquare, hnPos, hnx⟩

name: RankAmplification.squareSourceSet_card_le_sum
statement:
theorem squareSourceSet_card_le_sum {x h y P : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) :
    (squareSourceSet x h y P).card ≤
      ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, 2 * (x / p ^ 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [squareSourceSet]
  refine Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans ?_
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro p hp
  have hpData := mem_squareSourcePrimeRange.mp hp
  exact squareSourceAtPrimeSet_card_le hpData.2.2 hh (hhy.trans_lt hpData.1)

name: RankAmplification.mem_nonsmoothSquareSourceSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_nonsmoothSquareSourceSet {x h y P n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y P ↔
      n ∈ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y ∧
        ∃ p, y < p ∧ p ≤ P ∧ p.Prime ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsmoothSquareSourceSet, Finset.mem_inter, mem_squareSourceSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hnonsmooth, p, hyp, hpP, hp, hsquare, _hn, _hnx⟩
    exact ⟨hnonsmooth, p, hyp, hpP, hp, hsquare⟩
  · rintro ⟨hnonsmooth, p, hyp, hpP, hp, hsquare⟩
    have hnData := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp hnonsmooth
    exact ⟨hnonsmooth, p, hyp, hpP, hp, hsquare, hnData.1, hnData.2.1⟩

name: RankAmplification.mem_nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_sqrt_cutoff
statement:
theorem mem_nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_sqrt_cutoff {x h y n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hhy : h ≤ y) (hhx : h ≤ x) :
    n ∈ nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt ↔
      n ∈ nonsmoothShiftedSet x h y ∧
        ∃ p, y < p ∧ p.Prime ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ n * (n + h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonsmoothSquareSourceSet, Finset.mem_inter,
    mem_squareSourceSet_sqrt_cutoff hh hhy hhx]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hnonsmooth, _hnPos, _hnx, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hnonsmooth, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hnonsmooth, hp⟩
    have hnData := mem_nonsmoothShiftedSet.mp hnonsmooth
    exact ⟨hnonsmooth, hnData.1, hnData.2.1, hp⟩

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_subset_squareSourceSet
statement:
theorem nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_subset_squareSourceSet (x h y P : ℕ) :
    nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y P ⊆ squareSourceSet x h y P
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.inter_subset_right

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_card_le_sum
statement:
theorem nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_card_le_sum {x h y P : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) :
    (nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y P).card ≤
      ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, 2 * (x / p ^ 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finset.card_le_card (nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_subset_squareSourceSet x h y P)).trans
    (squareSourceSet_card_le_sum hh hhy)

name: RankAmplification.squareSourcePrimeRange_subset_Ioc
statement:
theorem squareSourcePrimeRange_subset_Ioc (y P : ℕ) :
    squareSourcePrimeRange y P ⊆ Finset.Ioc y P
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact Finset.mem_of_mem_filter p hp

name: RankAmplification.squareSourcePrimeRange_card_le
statement:
theorem squareSourcePrimeRange_card_le (y P : ℕ) :
    (squareSourcePrimeRange y P).card ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (squareSourcePrimeRange y P).card ≤ (Finset.Ioc y P).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (squareSourcePrimeRange_subset_Ioc y P)
    _ = P - y := by simp
    _ ≤ P := Nat.sub_le P y

name: RankAmplification.sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.Ioc y P, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (squareSourcePrimeRange_subset_Ioc y P)
      intro p _ _
      positivity
    _ ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹ - (P : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
      sum_Ioc_inv_sq_le_sub hy.ne' hyP
    _ ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := sub_le_self _ (by positivity)

name: RankAmplification.squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sum
statement:
theorem squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sum {x h y P : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) :
    ((squareSourceSet x h y P).card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
        2 * ((x : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := squareSourceSet_card_le_sum (x := x) (P := P) hh hhy
  calc
    ((squareSourceSet x h y P).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, 2 * (x / p ^ 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hfinite
    _ = ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
        ((2 * (x / p ^ 2 + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [Nat.cast_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
        2 * ((x : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _hp
      have hdiv : ((x / p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (x : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        have hcast : ((p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by norm_num
        have hdivNat := Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := x) (n := p ^ 2)
        rw [hcast] at hdivNat
        simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hdivNat
      norm_num only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      have hadd : ((x / p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤
          (x : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) + 1 := by linarith
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hadd (by norm_num)

name: RankAmplification.squareSourceSet_card_cast_le
statement:
theorem squareSourceSet_card_cast_le {x h y P : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hyP : y ≤ P) :
    ((squareSourceSet x h y P).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * (P : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := sum_squareSourcePrimeRange_inv_sq_le_inv hy hyP
  have hcard : ((squareSourcePrimeRange y P).card : ℝ) ≤ P := by
    exact_mod_cast squareSourcePrimeRange_card_le y P
  calc
    ((squareSourceSet x h y P).card : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
          2 * ((x : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) + 1) :=
      squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sum hh hhy
    _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) *
          (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
        2 * (squareSourcePrimeRange y P).card := by
      calc
        (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
            2 * ((x : ℝ) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) + 1)) =
            (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
              ((2 * (x : ℝ)) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) + 2)) := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro p _hp
                ring
        _ = (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P,
              (2 * (x : ℝ)) * (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
            ∑ _p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, (2 : ℝ) :=
              Finset.sum_add_distrib
        _ = 2 * (x : ℝ) *
              (∑ p ∈ squareSourcePrimeRange y P, (((p : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
            2 * (squareSourcePrimeRange y P).card := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              simp
              ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * (P : ℝ) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcard (by norm_num))

name: RankAmplification.squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_at_sqrt_cutoff
statement:
theorem squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_at_sqrt_cutoff {x h y P : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) (hyP : y ≤ P)
    (hP : P ≤ (2 * x).sqrt) :
    ((squareSourceSet x h y P).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hPReal : (P : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hP
  have htwice : 2 * (P : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPReal (by norm_num)
  exact (squareSourceSet_card_cast_le hh hhy hy hyP).trans
    (add_le_add le_rfl htwice)

name: RankAmplification.squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff
statement:
theorem squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff {x h y : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ((squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyCutoff : y ≤ (2 * x).sqrt
  · exact squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_at_sqrt_cutoff
      hh hhy hy hyCutoff le_rfl
  · classical
    have hrange : squareSourcePrimeRange y (2 * x).sqrt = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
      intro p hp
      have hpData := mem_squareSourcePrimeRange.mp hp
      omega
    have hset : squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt = ∅ := by
      simp [squareSourceSet, hrange]
    rw [hset]
    simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
    positivity

name: RankAmplification.nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff
statement:
theorem nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff {x h y : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhy : h ≤ y) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ((nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (x : ℝ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * ((2 * x).sqrt : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : (nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card ≤
      (squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (nonsmoothSquareSourceSet_subset_squareSourceSet
      x h y (2 * x).sqrt)
  have hsubsetReal : ((nonsmoothSquareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((squareSourceSet x h y (2 * x).sqrt).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hsubset
  exact hsubsetReal.trans (squareSourceSet_card_cast_le_sqrt_cutoff hh hhy hy)

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_support
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_support {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x : ℕ) :
    (supplierFiniteDivisorWeight P x).support = supplierDivisorSupport P x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_weight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_weight {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x d : ℕ) :
    (supplierFiniteDivisorWeight P x).weight d = supplierWeight P x d
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_weight_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_support_pos
proof:
:=
  (supplierFiniteDivisorWeight P x).support_pos d hd

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_weight_pos_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : 0 < supplierWeight P x d :=
    (supplierWeight_pos_iff_mem_support P x d).mpr hd
  change (0 : ℝ) < (supplierWeight P x d : ℝ)

name: RankAmplification.supplier_eval_nat_sum_eq
statement:
private theorem supplier_eval_nat_sum_eq {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    (∑ d ∈ (supplierDivisorSupport P x).filter (· ∣ N), supplierWeight P x d) =
      supplierDivisorWeight P x N
proof:
:= by
  unfold supplierDivisorWeight
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro d hd
    exact Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2, hN⟩
  · intro d hdDivisors hdSupport
    have hdvd : d ∣ N := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hdDivisors).1
    have hnotSupport : d ∉ supplierDivisorSupport P x := by
      intro hs
      exact hdSupport (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hs, hdvd⟩)
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos fun hpos ↦
      hnotSupport ((supplierWeight_pos_iff_mem_support P x d).mp hpos)

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_eval
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteDivisorWeight.eval_eq_sum_filter]
  change (∑ d ∈ (supplierDivisorSupport P x).filter (· ∣ N),
    (supplierWeight P x d : ℝ)) = (supplierDivisorWeight P x N : ℝ)
  exact_mod_cast supplier_eval_nat_sum_eq P x N hN

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_mass
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ d ∈ supplierDivisorSupport P x,
    (supplierWeight P x d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) =
      ((∑ d ∈ supplierDivisorSupport P x,
        (supplierWeight P x d : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
  push_cast
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_tailMass
statement:
theorem supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_tailMass {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x H : ℕ) :
    (supplierFiniteDivisorWeight P x).tailMass H =
      (supplierReciprocalTail P x H : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ d ∈ (supplierDivisorSupport P x).filter (H < ·),
    (supplierWeight P x d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) =
      ((∑ d ∈ (supplierDivisorSupport P x).filter (H < ·),
        (supplierWeight P x d : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
  push_cast
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.supplierSupNorm_nonneg
proof:
:=
  (supplierFiniteDivisorWeight P x).supNorm_nonneg hB

name: RankAmplification.supplierDivisorWeight_le_supplierSupNorm
proof:
:= by
  have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.zero_lt_one.trans_le (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hN).1
  rw [← supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_eval P x N hNpos.ne']
  exact (supplierFiniteDivisorWeight P x).eval_le_supNorm hN

name: RankAmplification.supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_primeFactor_gt_lowerCutoff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change d ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).image SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor at hd
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
  rw [← hsd] at hpd
  exact s.primeFactor_selectedDivisor_gt_lowerCutoff hp hpd

name: RankAmplification.supplier_shifted_divisor_convolution
statement:
theorem supplier_shifted_divisor_convolution {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x h : ℕ)
    (hh : 0 < h) (hhx : h ≤ x) (hhy : h ≤ y) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x,
        (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
          (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * x * (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ^ 2 +
        4 * x * supplierSupNorm P x (2 * x) *
          (supplierReciprocalTail P x x.sqrt : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let W := supplierFiniteDivisorWeight P x
  have hlarge : ∀ d ∈ W.support, 0 < W.weight d →
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ d → h < p := by
    intro d hd hwd p hp hpd
    exact hhy.trans_lt
      (supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_primeFactor_gt_lowerCutoff P x hd hp hpd)
  have hconv := W.shifted_divisor_convolution_supNorm hh hhx hlarge
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x,
        (supplierDivisorWeight P x n : ℝ) *
          (supplierDivisorWeight P x (n + h) : ℝ)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x, W.eval n * W.eval (n + h) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      have hnpos : 0 < n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
      rw [supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_eval P x n hnpos.ne',
        supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_eval P x (n + h) (Nat.add_pos_left hnpos h).ne']
    _ ≤ 2 * x * W.mass ^ 2 +
        4 * x * W.supNorm (2 * x) * W.tailMass x.sqrt := hconv
    _ = 2 * x * (supplierReciprocalMass P x : ℝ) ^ 2 +
        4 * x * supplierSupNorm P x (2 * x) *
          (supplierReciprocalTail P x x.sqrt : ℝ) := by
      rw [supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_mass, supplierFiniteDivisorWeight_tailMass]
      rfl

proof:

name: RankAmplification.PowerDescriptor.powerSourceChoiceWeight_toPowerSourceChoice
statement:
theorem powerSourceChoiceWeight_toPowerSourceChoice
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y}
    {B : Finset (Fin J)} (d : PowerDescriptor P B) :
    powerSourceChoiceWeight d.toPowerSourceChoice =
      (((d.natBase ^ (powerMultiplicity P B d.natBase + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹
proof:
:= by

  simp only [toPowerSourceChoice, powerSourceChoiceWeight]

proof:

name: RankAmplification.powerSourceChoice_sum
statement:
theorem powerSourceChoice_sum (y Y E : ℕ) :
    (∑ choice : PowerSourceChoice y Y E, powerSourceChoiceWeight choice) =
      1 + powerSourceLocalMass y Y E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.sum_option]
  simp only [powerSourceChoiceWeight]
  unfold powerSourceLocalMass powerExponentReciprocalMass
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply congrArg (1 + ·)
  calc
    (∑ q : {q : ℕ // q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y},
        ∑ e : Fin E, (q.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e.1 + 2)) =
        ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y,
          ∑ e : Fin E, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e.1 + 2) := by
      simpa only [Finset.univ_eq_attach] using
        (Finset.sum_attach (powerSourcePrimeSet y Y)
          (fun q ↦ ∑ e : Fin E, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e.1 + 2)))
    _ = ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y,
        ∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e + 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro q hq
      simpa using (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (n := E) (fun e : ℕ ↦ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (e + 2)))

name: RankAmplification.powerSourceTupleMass_eq_pow
statement:
theorem powerSourceTupleMass_eq_pow (J y Y E : ℕ) :
    powerSourceTupleMass J y Y E = (1 + powerSourceLocalMass y Y E) ^ J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold powerSourceTupleMass
  calc
    (∑ choices : Fin J → PowerSourceChoice y Y E,
        ∏ i, powerSourceChoiceWeight (choices i)) =
        ∏ _i : Fin J, ∑ choice : PowerSourceChoice y Y E,
          powerSourceChoiceWeight choice := by
      exact (Fintype.prod_sum
        (fun (_i : Fin J) (choice : PowerSourceChoice y Y E) ↦
          powerSourceChoiceWeight choice)).symm
    _ = (∑ choice : PowerSourceChoice y Y E,
        powerSourceChoiceWeight choice) ^ J := by simp
    _ = (1 + powerSourceLocalMass y Y E) ^ J := by
      rw [powerSourceChoice_sum]

name: RankAmplification.powerTelescopingKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem powerTelescopingKernel_nonneg {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) :
    0 ≤ powerTelescopingKernel q
proof:
:= by
  unfold powerTelescopingKernel
  apply sub_nonneg.mpr
  have hpred : 0 < (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hq
  have hle : (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le q 1
  simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpred hle

name: RankAmplification.powerExponentReciprocalMass_le_kernel
statement:
theorem powerExponentReciprocalMass_le_kernel {q E : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) :
    powerExponentReciprocalMass q E ≤ powerTelescopingKernel q
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := (q : ℝ)⁻¹
  have hqReal : (1 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hrPos : 0 < r := by simp [r, Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq.pos]
  have hrLt : r < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hqReal
  have hgeom : (∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, r ^ e) ≤ (1 - r)⁻¹ :=
    by
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using
        (geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 0) (n := E) hrPos.le hrLt)
  calc
    powerExponentReciprocalMass q E =
        r ^ 2 * ∑ e ∈ Finset.range E, r ^ e := by
      unfold powerExponentReciprocalMass
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro e he
      simp only [r]
      rw [← pow_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    _ ≤ r ^ 2 * (1 - r)⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgeom (sq_nonneg r)
    _ = powerTelescopingKernel q := by
      unfold powerTelescopingKernel r
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hq.le]
      norm_num
      have hqZero : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.pos.ne'
      have hqSub : (q : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hqReal.ne'
      field_simp
      ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc
statement:
theorem sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc (y n : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc y (y + n), powerTelescopingKernel q) =
      (y : ℝ)⁻¹ - ((y + n : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      have hnot : y + n + 1 ∉ Finset.Ioc y (y + n) := by simp
      have hset : Finset.Ioc y (y + (n + 1)) =
          insert (y + n + 1) (Finset.Ioc y (y + n)) := by
        ext q
        simp
        omega
      rw [hset, Finset.sum_insert hnot, ih]
      unfold powerTelescopingKernel
      have hsub : y + n + 1 - 1 = y + n := by omega
      rw [hsub]
      push_cast
      ring

name: RankAmplification.sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc_eq
statement:
theorem sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc_eq {y Y : ℕ} (hyY : y ≤ Y) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc y Y, powerTelescopingKernel q) =
      (y : ℝ)⁻¹ - (Y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hadd : y + (Y - y) = Y := Nat.add_sub_of_le hyY
  simpa only [hadd] using sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc y (Y - y)

name: RankAmplification.sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc_le
statement:
theorem sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc_le {y Y : ℕ} :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc y Y, powerTelescopingKernel q) ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyY : y ≤ Y
  · rw [sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc_eq hyY]
    exact sub_le_self _ (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg Y))
  · have hempty : Finset.Ioc y Y = ∅ := by
      ext q
      simp
      omega
    rw [hempty]
    simp

name: RankAmplification.powerExponentReciprocalMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem powerExponentReciprocalMass_nonneg (q E : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ powerExponentReciprocalMass q E
proof:
:= by
  unfold powerExponentReciprocalMass
  positivity

name: RankAmplification.powerSourceLocalMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem powerSourceLocalMass_nonneg (y Y E : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ powerSourceLocalMass y Y E
proof:
:= by
  unfold powerSourceLocalMass
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun q hq ↦ powerExponentReciprocalMass_nonneg q E

name: RankAmplification.powerSourceLocalMass_le_inv
statement:
theorem powerSourceLocalMass_le_inv {y Y E : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    powerSourceLocalMass y Y E ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  calc
    powerSourceLocalMass y Y E ≤
        ∑ q ∈ powerSourcePrimeSet y Y, powerTelescopingKernel q := by
      unfold powerSourceLocalMass
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro q hq
      exact powerExponentReciprocalMass_le_kernel
        (mem_powerSourcePrimeSet.mp hq).1.one_lt
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc y Y, powerTelescopingKernel q := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (powerSourcePrimeSet_subset_Ioc y Y)
      intro q hq hnot
      exact powerTelescopingKernel_nonneg (by
        have hqy := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hq).1
        omega)
    _ ≤ (y : ℝ)⁻¹ := sum_powerTelescopingKernel_Ioc_le

name: RankAmplification.powerSourceTupleMass_le_exp
statement:
theorem powerSourceTupleMass_le_exp {J y Y E : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    powerSourceTupleMass J y Y E ≤ Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerSourceTupleMass_eq_pow]
  calc
    (1 + powerSourceLocalMass y Y E) ^ J ≤
        Real.exp (powerSourceLocalMass y Y E) ^ J := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀
        (add_nonneg zero_le_one (powerSourceLocalMass_nonneg y Y E)) (by
          simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (powerSourceLocalMass y Y E)) J
    _ = Real.exp ((J : ℕ) * powerSourceLocalMass y Y E) := by
      exact (Real.exp_nat_mul (powerSourceLocalMass y Y E) J).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp ((J : ℕ) * (y : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (powerSourceLocalMass_le_inv hy) (Nat.cast_nonneg J)
    _ = Real.exp ((J : ℝ) / y) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: RankAmplification.powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem powerSourceTupleMass_nonneg (J y Y E : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ powerSourceTupleMass J y Y E
proof:
:= by
  unfold powerSourceTupleMass
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro choices hchoices
  apply Finset.prod_nonneg
  intro i hi
  cases choices i <;> simp [powerSourceChoiceWeight]

name: RankAmplification.finitePowerEncodingFactor_nonneg
statement:
theorem finitePowerEncodingFactor_nonneg (J y M : ℕ) :

proof:

name: RankAmplification.slot_mul_powerSourceTupleMass_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor
statement:
theorem slot_mul_powerSourceTupleMass_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor
    {J y Y E M : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    slotEncodingFactor J M * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y E ≤
      finitePowerEncodingFactor J y M
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePowerEncodingFactor
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (powerSourceTupleMass_le_exp hy)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg (slotEncodingFactor J M))

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_eq_predecessorFibreSum
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_eq_predecessorFibreSum
    {J y Y x H Hcode : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail J y Y x H =
      ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J),
        aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_eq_tailEntrySum]
  unfold aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass
  symm
  exact Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    (fun (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) ha ↦
      a.2.linearPredecessorProduct_mem_finiteSmoothTailSet hx
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2 hscale)
    (fun (a : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) ↦
      1 / (a.2.selectedDivisor : ℝ))

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_finitePowerEncodingTauTail
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_finitePowerEncodingTauTail
    {J y Y x H Hcode E M : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H)
    (hfibre : HasWeightedPowerFibreBound J y Y x H Hcode E M) :
    aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail J y Y x H ≤
      finitePowerEncodingFactor J y M *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_eq_predecessorFibreSum hx hscale]
  have htail : 0 ≤ finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) := by
    unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
    positivity
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J),
        aggregateSupplierPredecessorFibreMass J y Y x H m) ≤
        ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J),
          (slotEncodingFactor J M * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y E) *
            ((orderedDivisorCount J m : ℝ) / m) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hfibre m hm
    _ = (slotEncodingFactor J M * powerSourceTupleMass J y Y E) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) := by
      unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ finitePowerEncodingFactor J y M *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (slot_mul_powerSourceTupleMass_le_finitePowerEncodingFactor hy) htail

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_finitePowerEncodingRankin
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_finitePowerEncodingRankin
    {J y Y x H Hcode E M : ℕ} {delta : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H)
    (hfibre : HasWeightedPowerFibreBound J y Y x H Hcode E M)
    (hHcode : 0 < Hcode) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) :
    aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail J y Y x H ≤
      finitePowerEncodingFactor J y M *
        ((Hcode : ℝ) ^ (-delta) *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount J m) Y ((2 * x) ^ J)
            (delta - 1))
proof:
:= by
  exact (aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_finitePowerEncodingTauTail
    hy hx hscale hfibre).trans <| by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin hHcode hdelta)
        (finitePowerEncodingFactor_nonneg J y M)

name: RankAmplification.globalLabelBaseCode_injective
statement:
theorem globalLabelBaseCode_injective {J y Y x : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective
      (globalLabelBaseCode : AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x →
        GlobalLabelBaseCode J y Y x)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨P, ⟨pi, descriptor, basesInjective⟩⟩
    ⟨Q, ⟨rho, otherDescriptor, otherBasesInjective⟩⟩ hcode
  have hP : P = Q := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.1.1) hcode
  subst Q
  have hpartition : pi = rho := congrArg (fun c ↦ c.1.2) hcode
  have hfunctions := congrArg Prod.snd hcode
  dsimp [globalLabelBaseCode] at hfunctions
  cases hpartition
  have hdescriptor : descriptor = otherDescriptor := by
    funext B
    apply SupplierDescriptor.eq_of_base_eq
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := pi.block_nonempty B
    have hiCode := congrArg
      (fun z : Fin (max (2 * x) Y + 1) ↦ (z : ℕ)) (congrFun hfunctions i)
    have hblock : pi.blockOf i = B := pi.block_eq_of_mem i B hi
    exact (congrArg (fun C ↦ (descriptor C).base) hblock).symm.trans <|
      hiCode.trans (congrArg (fun C ↦ (otherDescriptor C).base) hblock)
  cases hdescriptor
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_tauSmoothTail
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_tauSmoothTail {J y Y x H Hcode : ℕ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail J y Y x H ≤
      globalLabelBaseEncodingFactor J Y x *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_eq_tailEntrySum]
  let S := aggregateSupplierTailEntries J y Y x H
  apply finite_reciprocal_sum_le_card_mul_tau_smooth_tail S
    (fun a ↦ a.2.linearPredecessorProduct) (fun a ↦ a.2.selectedDivisor)
    J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) (globalLabelBaseEncodingFactor J Y x) hJ
  · intro a ha
    exact a.2.linearPredecessorProduct_mem_finiteSmoothTailSet hx
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2 hscale
  · intro a ha
    exact a.2.linearPredecessorProduct_le_selectedDivisor
  · calc
      S.card ≤ Fintype.card (AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) := by
        unfold S aggregateSupplierTailEntries allAggregateSupplierEntries
        simpa using Finset.card_filter_le
          (Finset.univ : Finset (AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x))
          (fun a ↦ H < a.2.selectedDivisor)
      _ ≤ globalLabelBaseEncodingFactor J Y x :=
        aggregateSupplierEntry_card_le_globalLabelBaseEncodingFactor J y Y x

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_tauRankin
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_tauRankin
    {J y Y x H Hcode : ℕ} {delta : ℝ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H)
    (hHcode : 0 < Hcode) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) :
    aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail J y Y x H ≤
      globalLabelBaseEncodingFactor J Y x *
        ((Hcode : ℝ) ^ (-delta) *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount J m) Y ((2 * x) ^ J)
            (delta - 1))
proof:
:= by
  exact (aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_tauSmoothTail hJ hx hscale).trans <| by
    gcongr
    exact finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin hHcode hdelta

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_chosenTauRankin
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_chosenTauRankin
    {J y Y x H Hcode : ℕ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H)
    (hHcode : 0 < Hcode) (hY : 1 < Y) (hu : 1 ≤ rankinU Hcode Y) :
    aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail J y Y x H ≤
      globalLabelBaseEncodingFactor J Y x *
        (Real.exp (-rankinU Hcode Y * Real.log (rankinU Hcode Y)) *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount J m) Y ((2 * x) ^ J)
            (rankinDelta Hcode Y - 1))
proof:
:= by
  exact (aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_tauSmoothTail hJ hx hscale).trans <| by
    gcongr
    exact finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_chosen_rankin hHcode hY hu

name: RankAmplification.sourceTypeWord_card_le
statement:
theorem sourceTypeWord_card_le (J : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SourceTypeWord J) ≤ (J + 1) * 2 ^ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  calc
    (∑ b : Fin (J + 1), Fintype.card (Fin (b : ℕ) → SupplierSourceType)) =
        ∑ b : Fin (J + 1), 2 ^ (b : ℕ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b hb
      simp
    _ ≤ ∑ _b : Fin (J + 1), 2 ^ J := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro b hb
      exact pow_le_pow_right' (by norm_num) (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp b.isLt)
    _ = (J + 1) * 2 ^ J := by simp

name: RankAmplification.GlobalSlotReconstruction.fibre_card_le_slotEncodingFactor_mul_tau
statement:
theorem fibre_card_le_slotEncodingFactor_mul_tau {J y Y x M : ℕ}
    (R : GlobalSlotReconstruction J y Y x M)
    (S : Finset (AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x)) (m : ℕ) :
    (S.filter fun a ↦ R.key a = m).card ≤
      slotEncodingFactor J M * orderedDivisorCount J m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype R.NumericalCode := R.numericalFintype
  let source := S.filter fun a ↦ R.key a = m
  let target := {n : R.NumericalCode // R.product n = m} × SlotCombinatorialCode J M
  let encode : {a // a ∈ source} → target := fun a ↦
    ⟨⟨R.numerical a.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp a.2).2⟩, R.combinatorial a.1⟩
  have hencode : Function.Injective encode := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply R.encode_injective
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact congrArg (fun z : target ↦ z.1.1) hab
    · exact congrArg (fun z : target ↦ z.2) hab
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective encode hencode
  calc
    (S.filter fun a ↦ R.key a = m).card = Fintype.card {a // a ∈ source} := by
      change source.card = Fintype.card {a // a ∈ source}
      exact (Fintype.card_coe source).symm
    _ ≤ Fintype.card target := hcard
    _ = Fintype.card {n : R.NumericalCode // R.product n = m} *
        Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M) := by
      simp [target]
    _ ≤ orderedDivisorCount J m * slotEncodingFactor J M :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (R.product_fibre_le m) (slotCombinatorialCode_card_le J M)
    _ = slotEncodingFactor J M * orderedDivisorCount J m := Nat.mul_comm _ _

name: RankAmplification.GlobalSlotReconstruction.aggregateSupplierEntry_card_le_numerical_mul_slotEncodingFactor
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierEntry_card_le_numerical_mul_slotEncodingFactor
    {J y Y x M : ℕ} (R : GlobalSlotReconstruction J y Y x M) :
    Fintype.card (AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) ≤
      (@Fintype.card R.NumericalCode R.numericalFintype) * slotEncodingFactor J M
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype R.NumericalCode := R.numericalFintype
  calc
    Fintype.card (AggregateSupplierEntry J y Y x) ≤
        Fintype.card (R.NumericalCode × SlotCombinatorialCode J M) :=
      Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ R.encode_injective
    _ = Fintype.card R.NumericalCode *
        Fintype.card (SlotCombinatorialCode J M) := Fintype.card_prod _ _
    _ ≤ Fintype.card R.NumericalCode * slotEncodingFactor J M := by
      gcongr
      exact slotCombinatorialCode_card_le J M

name: RankAmplification.aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_slotEncodingTauSmoothTail
statement:
theorem aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_le_slotEncodingTauSmoothTail
    {J y Y x H Hcode M : ℕ} (R : GlobalSlotReconstruction J y Y x M)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail J y Y x H ≤
      slotEncodingFactor J M *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [aggregateSupplierReciprocalTail_eq_tailEntrySum]
  let S := aggregateSupplierTailEntries J y Y x H
  apply finite_reciprocal_sum_le_tau_smooth_tail S R.key
    (fun a ↦ a.2.selectedDivisor) J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) (slotEncodingFactor J M)
  · intro a ha
    rw [R.key_eq_linearPredecessorProduct]
    exact a.2.linearPredecessorProduct_mem_finiteSmoothTailSet hx
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2 hscale
  · intro a ha
    rw [R.key_eq_linearPredecessorProduct]
    exact a.2.linearPredecessorProduct_le_selectedDivisor
  · intro m hm
    exact R.fibre_card_le_slotEncodingFactor_mul_tau S m

name: RankAmplification.isSmooth_of_largestPrimeFactor_le
statement:
theorem isSmooth_of_largestPrimeFactor_le {Y n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hlarge : largestPrimeFactor n ≤ Y) :
    IsSmooth Y n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  exact (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hp).trans
    ((le_max_right 1 ((primeSupport n).sup id)).trans hlarge)

name: RankAmplification.isSmooth_mul
statement:
theorem isSmooth_mul {Y m n : ℕ} (hm : IsSmooth Y m) (hn : IsSmooth Y n) :
    IsSmooth Y (m * n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero hm.1 hn.1, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  change p ∈ (m * n).primeFactors at hp
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul hm.1 hn.1] at hp
  exact (Finset.mem_union.mp hp).elim (hm.2 p) (hn.2 p)

name: RankAmplification.isSmooth_finset_prod
statement:
theorem isSmooth_finset_prod {Y : ℕ} { α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ) (hf : ∀ a ∈ S, IsSmooth Y (f a)) :
    IsSmooth Y (∏ a ∈ S, f a)
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [IsSmooth]
  | @insert a S ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
      exact isSmooth_mul (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a S))
        (ih fun b hb ↦ hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))

name: RankAmplification.one_le_orderedDivisorCount_two
statement:
theorem one_le_orderedDivisorCount_two {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ orderedDivisorCount 2 m
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedDivisorCount_two]
  exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨1, Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨one_dvd m, hm⟩⟩

name: RankAmplification.one_le_orderedDivisorCount_of_pos_rank
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => omega
  | succ j ih =>
      by_cases hjzero : j = 0
      · subst j
        rw [orderedDivisorCount_one hm]
      · rw [orderedDivisorCount_succ]
        exact (ih (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hjzero)).trans <|
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun d hd ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
            (Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨dvd_rfl, hm⟩)

name: RankAmplification.finite_reciprocal_sum_le_tau_smooth_tail
statement:
@[nolint unusedArguments]
theorem finite_reciprocal_sum_le_tau_smooth_tail
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) (code denominator : α → ℕ)
    (j R H X C : ℕ)
    (hcode : ∀ a ∈ S, code a ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X)
    (hdenominator : ∀ a ∈ S, code a ≤ denominator a)
    (hfibre : ∀ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X,
      (S.filter fun a ↦ code a = m).card ≤ C * orderedDivisorCount j m) :
    (∑ a ∈ S, 1 / (denominator a : ℝ)) ≤
      C * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X
proof:
:= by
  have hreciprocal : ∀ a ∈ S,
      1 / (denominator a : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (code a : ℝ) := by
    intro a ha
    have hcodePos : 0 < code a := by
      have hmem := mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mp (hcode a ha)
      omega
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
    · exact_mod_cast hcodePos
    · exact_mod_cast hdenominator a ha
  calc
    (∑ a ∈ S, 1 / (denominator a : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ a ∈ S, 1 / (code a : ℝ) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun a ha ↦ hreciprocal a ha
    _ = ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X,
        ∑ a ∈ S.filter (fun a ↦ code a = m), 1 / (code a : ℝ) := by
      symm
      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun a ha ↦ hcode a ha)
        (fun a ↦ 1 / (code a : ℝ))
    _ = ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X,
        ((S.filter fun a ↦ code a = m).card : ℝ) / m := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      calc
        (∑ a ∈ S.filter (fun a ↦ code a = m), 1 / (code a : ℝ)) =
            ∑ _a ∈ S.filter (fun a ↦ code a = m), 1 / (m : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a ha
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
        _ = ((S.filter fun a ↦ code a = m).card : ℝ) / m := by
          simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X,
        (C * orderedDivisorCount j m : ℕ) / (m : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      have hmPos : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mp hm).1
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hfibre m hm) hmPos.le
    _ = C * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X := by
      unfold finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail
      push_cast
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      ring

name: RankAmplification.finite_reciprocal_sum_le_card_mul_divisor_smooth_tail
statement:
theorem finite_reciprocal_sum_le_card_mul_divisor_smooth_tail
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) (code denominator : α → ℕ)
    (R H X C : ℕ)
    (hcode : ∀ a ∈ S, code a ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X)
    (hdenominator : ∀ a ∈ S, code a ≤ denominator a)
    (hcard : S.card ≤ C) :
    (∑ a ∈ S, 1 / (denominator a : ℝ)) ≤
      C * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail 2 R H X
proof:
:= by
  apply finite_reciprocal_sum_le_tau_smooth_tail S code denominator 2 R H X C
    hcode hdenominator
  intro m hm
  calc
    (S.filter fun a ↦ code a = m).card ≤ S.card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    _ ≤ C := hcard
    _ = C * 1 := by simp
    _ ≤ C * orderedDivisorCount 2 m := by
      gcongr
      exact one_le_orderedDivisorCount_two
        (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mp hm).1))

name: RankAmplification.finite_reciprocal_sum_le_card_mul_tau_smooth_tail
statement:
theorem finite_reciprocal_sum_le_card_mul_tau_smooth_tail
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) (code denominator : α → ℕ)
    (j R H X C : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j)
    (hcode : ∀ a ∈ S, code a ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X)
    (hdenominator : ∀ a ∈ S, code a ≤ denominator a)
    (hcard : S.card ≤ C) :
    (∑ a ∈ S, 1 / (denominator a : ℝ)) ≤
      C * finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail j R H X
proof:
:= by
  apply finite_reciprocal_sum_le_tau_smooth_tail S code denominator j R H X C
    hcode hdenominator
  intro m hm
  calc
    (S.filter fun a ↦ code a = m).card ≤ S.card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    _ ≤ C := hcard
    _ = C * 1 := by simp
    _ ≤ C * orderedDivisorCount j m := by
      gcongr
      exact one_le_orderedDivisorCount_of_pos_rank hj
        (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mp hm).1))

name: RankAmplification.finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_two_le_count_div
statement:
theorem finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_two_le_count_div (R H X : ℕ) :
    finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail 2 R H X ≤
      finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X / (H + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail, finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
  simp_rw [orderedDivisorCount_two]
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X, (m.divisors.card : ℝ) / m) ≤
        ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet R H X,
          (m.divisors.card : ℝ) / (H + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      · positivity
      · exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (mem_finiteSmoothTailSet.mp hm).1
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X,
        (m.divisors.card : ℝ) / (H + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (finiteSmoothTailSet_subset R H X)
      intro m hm hnot
      positivity
    _ = (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (m.divisors.card : ℝ)) / (H + 1) := by
      simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: RankAmplification.finiteLargePrimeTransfer_le_rankin
statement:
theorem finiteLargePrimeTransfer_le_rankin {Z W : ℕ} {sigma : ℝ}
    (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma) :
    finiteLargePrimeTransfer Z W ≤
      ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Ioc Z W.sqrt).filter Nat.Prime,
        ((W / p ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ sigma *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount 2 m)
            p (W / p ^ 2) (-sigma)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteLargePrimeTransfer
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro p hp
  simpa only [finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount] using
    finiteTauSmoothCount_le_rankin (j := 2) (R := p) (X := W / p ^ 2) hsigma

name: RankAmplification.finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_square
statement:
theorem finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_le_square (R X : ℕ) :
    finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount R X ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finiteDivisorWeightedSmoothCount_eq]
  have hcard : (finiteSmoothSet R X).card ≤ X := by
    unfold finiteSmoothSet
    exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans_eq (by simp)
  calc
    (∑ m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (m.divisors.card : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ _m ∈ finiteSmoothSet R X, (X : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.card_divisors_le_self m).trans
        (mem_finiteSmoothSet.mp hm).2.1
    _ = ((finiteSmoothSet R X).card : ℝ) * X := by simp
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) * X := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) (Nat.cast_nonneg X)
    _ = (X : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor_eq_linearSelectedPart_mul_powerSelectedPart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selectedDivisor_eq_linearSelectedPart_mul_powerSelectedPart
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x : ℕ}
    {B : Finset (Fin J)} (d : SupplierDescriptor P x B) :
    d.selectedDivisor = d.linearSelectedPart * d.powerSelectedPart
proof:
:= by
  cases d <;> simp [selectedDivisor, linearSelectedPart, powerSelectedPart,
    powerSelectedExponent, base]

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor_pos
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | inl source =>
      exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt source.base_prime.one_lt
  | inr source => simp [linearPredecessor]

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor_smooth
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | inl source =>
      exact isSmooth_of_largestPrimeFactor_le
        (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt source.base_prime.one_lt)) source.smooth
  | inr source => simp [linearPredecessor, IsSmooth]

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor_le_selectedDivisor
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | inl source =>
      simp [linearPredecessor, selectedDivisor]
  | inr source =>
      exact Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (selectedDivisor_pos (Sum.inr source))

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.linearSelectedPart_le_two_mul_predecessor
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | inl source =>
      simp only [linearSelectedPart, linearPredecessor, Sum.elim_inl]
      have hbase : 2 ≤ source.natBase := source.base_prime.two_le
      omega
  | inr source => simp [linearSelectedPart, linearPredecessor]

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.powerSelectedExponent_le_card_add_one
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | inl source => simp [powerSelectedExponent]
  | inr source =>
      unfold powerSelectedExponent powerMultiplicity powerLabels
      simpa only [Sum.elim_inr] using Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_filter_le B _) 1

name: RankAmplification.SupplierDescriptor.powerSelectedPart_le_Y_pow
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | inl source => simp [powerSelectedPart, powerSelectedExponent]
  | inr source =>
      exact pow_le_pow_left' source.base_le _

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.block_card_le
statement:
theorem block_card_le {J : ℕ} (pi : LabelPartition J) :
    Fintype.card pi.Block ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let representative : pi.Block → Fin J := fun B ↦ B.1.min' (pi.block_nonempty B)
  have hinjective : Function.Injective representative := by
    intro B C h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply pi.eq_of_overlap B.2 C.2
    · exact Finset.min'_mem B.1 (pi.block_nonempty B)
    · have hmem := Finset.min'_mem C.1 (pi.block_nonempty C)
      change representative C ∈ C.1 at hmem
      change representative B ∈ C.1
      rwa [h]
  simpa [representative] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective representative hinjective

name: RankAmplification.LabelPartition.sum_block_card
statement:
theorem sum_block_card {J : ℕ} (pi : LabelPartition J) :
    (∑ B : pi.Block, B.1.card) = J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpairwise : (pi.blocks : Set (Finset (Fin J))).PairwiseDisjoint id := by
    intro B hB C hC hne
    change Disjoint B C
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro i hiB hiC
    exact hne (pi.eq_of_overlap hB hC hiB hiC)
  have hunion : pi.blocks.biUnion id = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin J)) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hi⟩ := pi.covers i
    exact ⟨B, hB, hi⟩
  have hcard := Finset.card_biUnion hpairwise
  rw [hunion] at hcard
  change (∑ B ∈ pi.blocks.attach, B.1.card) = J
  rw [Finset.sum_attach]
  simpa using hcard.symm

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor_eq_linear_mul_power
proof:
:= by
  unfold selectedDivisor linearSelectedProduct powerSelectedProduct
  simp_rw [SupplierDescriptor.selectedDivisor_eq_linearSelectedPart_mul_powerSelectedPart]
  exact Finset.prod_mul_distrib

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct_pos
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearPredecessorProduct
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun B hB ↦ (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor_pos

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct_smooth
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearPredecessorProduct
  exact isSmooth_finset_prod Finset.univ
    (fun B : s.partition.Block ↦ (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor)
    (fun B hB ↦ (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor_smooth)

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct_le_selectedDivisor
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearPredecessorProduct selectedDivisor
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun B hB ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
    (fun B hB ↦ (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor_le_selectedDivisor)

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.linearSelectedProduct_le_two_pow_mul_predecessor
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearSelectedProduct linearPredecessorProduct
  calc
    (∏ B : s.partition.Block, (s.descriptor B).linearSelectedPart) ≤
        ∏ B : s.partition.Block, 2 * (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor := by
      exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun B hB ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
        (fun B hB ↦ (s.descriptor B).linearSelectedPart_le_two_mul_predecessor)
    _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card s.partition.Block *
        ∏ B : s.partition.Block, (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor := by
      exact (Finset.pow_card_mul_prod (s := Finset.univ) (b := 2)).symm
    _ ≤ 2 ^ J * ∏ B : s.partition.Block,
        (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor := by
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
        (pow_le_pow_right' (by norm_num) s.partition.block_card_le)

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.sum_powerSelectedExponent_le_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ B : s.partition.Block, (s.descriptor B).powerSelectedExponent) ≤
        ∑ B : s.partition.Block, (B.1.card + 1) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun B hB ↦
        (s.descriptor B).powerSelectedExponent_le_card_add_one
    _ = J + Fintype.card s.partition.Block := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, s.partition.sum_block_card]
      simp
    _ ≤ 2 * J := by
      simpa [two_mul] using Nat.add_le_add_left s.partition.block_card_le J

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.one_le_upperCutoff_of_pos_rank
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin J := ⟨0, hJ⟩
  exact (P.prime i).one_lt.le.trans (P.upper i)

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.powerSelectedProduct_le_upperCutoff_pow_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  unfold powerSelectedProduct
  calc
    (∏ B : s.partition.Block, (s.descriptor B).powerSelectedPart) ≤
        ∏ B : s.partition.Block, Y ^ (s.descriptor B).powerSelectedExponent := by
      exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun B hB ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
        (fun B hB ↦ (s.descriptor B).powerSelectedPart_le_Y_pow)
    _ = Y ^ (∑ B : s.partition.Block,
        (s.descriptor B).powerSelectedExponent) := by
      exact Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum Finset.univ _ Y
    _ ≤ Y ^ (2 * J) := by
      by_cases hJ : J = 0
      · subst J
        have hcard : Fintype.card s.partition.Block = 0 :=
          Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero s.partition.block_card_le
        letI : IsEmpty s.partition.Block := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hcard
        simp
      · exact pow_le_pow_right'
          (one_le_upperCutoff_of_pos_rank P (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hJ))
          s.sum_powerSelectedExponent_le_two_mul

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor_le_encodingFactor_mul_predecessor
statement:
theorem selectedDivisor_le_encodingFactor_mul_predecessor {J y Y : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x : ℕ} (s : SupplierSystem P x) :
    s.selectedDivisor ≤
      (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * s.linearPredecessorProduct
proof:
:= by
  rw [s.selectedDivisor_eq_linear_mul_power]
  calc
    s.linearSelectedProduct * s.powerSelectedProduct ≤
        (2 ^ J * s.linearPredecessorProduct) * Y ^ (2 * J) := by
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul s.linearSelectedProduct_le_two_pow_mul_predecessor
        s.powerSelectedProduct_le_upperCutoff_pow_two_mul
    _ = (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * s.linearPredecessorProduct := by
      ac_rfl

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.encodingFactor_pos
statement:
theorem encodingFactor_pos {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) :
    0 < 2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hJ : J = 0
  · subst J
    simp
  · exact Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos (by omega) _)
      (pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (one_le_upperCutoff_of_pos_rank P
        (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hJ))) _)

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem linearPredecessorProduct_le_two_mul_pow {J y Y : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x : ℕ} (s : SupplierSystem P x)
    (hx : 0 < x) :
    s.linearPredecessorProduct ≤ (2 * x) ^ J
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearPredecessorProduct
  calc
    (∏ B : s.partition.Block, (s.descriptor B).linearPredecessor) ≤
        ∏ _B : s.partition.Block, 2 * x := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · exact fun B hB ↦ Nat.zero_le _
      · intro B hB
        cases s.descriptor B with
        | inl source =>
            exact (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans source.base_le
        | inr source =>
            simp only [SupplierDescriptor.linearPredecessor, Sum.elim_inr]
            omega
    _ = (2 * x) ^ Fintype.card s.partition.Block := by simp
    _ ≤ (2 * x) ^ J := by
      exact pow_le_pow_right' (by omega) s.partition.block_card_le

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct_mem_finiteSmoothTailSet
statement:
theorem linearPredecessorProduct_mem_finiteSmoothTailSet {J y Y : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x H Hcode : ℕ} (s : SupplierSystem P x)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hlarge : H < s.selectedDivisor)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    s.linearPredecessorProduct ∈ finiteSmoothTailSet Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_finiteSmoothTailSet]
  refine ⟨?_, s.linearPredecessorProduct_le_two_mul_pow hx,
    s.linearPredecessorProduct_smooth⟩
  have hmul : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode <
      (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * s.linearPredecessorProduct :=
    hscale.trans_lt <| hlarge.trans_le s.selectedDivisor_le_encodingFactor_mul_predecessor
  exact (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left (encodingFactor_pos P)).mp hmul

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_divisorSmoothTail
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supplierReciprocalTail_eq_systemTail]
  unfold supplierSystemReciprocalTail
  push_cast
  let S := (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (H < ·.selectedDivisor)
  apply finite_reciprocal_sum_le_card_mul_divisor_smooth_tail S
    SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor
    Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) (Fintype.card (SupplierSystem P x))
  · intro s hs
    exact s.linearPredecessorProduct_mem_finiteSmoothTailSet hx
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2 hscale
  · intro s hs
    exact s.linearPredecessorProduct_le_selectedDivisor
  · unfold S
    simpa [allSupplierSystems] using
      (Finset.card_filter_le (allSupplierSystems P x) (H < ·.selectedDivisor))

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_tauSmoothTail
statement:
theorem supplierReciprocalTail_le_tauSmoothTail {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) {x H Hcode : ℕ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H) :
    (supplierReciprocalTail P x H : ℝ) ≤
      Fintype.card (SupplierSystem P x) *
        finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supplierReciprocalTail_eq_systemTail]
  unfold supplierSystemReciprocalTail
  push_cast
  let S := (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (H < ·.selectedDivisor)
  apply finite_reciprocal_sum_le_card_mul_tau_smooth_tail S
    SupplierSystem.linearPredecessorProduct SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor
    J Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J) (Fintype.card (SupplierSystem P x)) hJ
  · intro s hs
    exact s.linearPredecessorProduct_mem_finiteSmoothTailSet hx
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2 hscale
  · intro s hs
    exact s.linearPredecessorProduct_le_selectedDivisor
  · unfold S
    simpa [allSupplierSystems] using
      (Finset.card_filter_le (allSupplierSystems P x) (H < ·.selectedDivisor))

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_divisorSmoothCount
proof:
:= by
  exact (supplierReciprocalTail_le_divisorSmoothTail P hx hscale).trans <| by

    exact finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_two_le_count_div Y Hcode ((2 * x) ^ J)

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_rankin

    (hHcode : 0 < Hcode) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) :
    (supplierReciprocalTail P x H : ℝ) ≤
      Fintype.card (SupplierSystem P x) *
        ((Hcode : ℝ) ^ (-delta) *
          finiteSmoothRpowSum (fun m ↦ orderedDivisorCount 2 m) Y ((2 * x) ^ J)
            (delta - 1))
proof:
:= by

    gcongr
    exact finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_rankin hHcode hdelta

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_tauRankin

theorem supplierReciprocalTail_le_tauRankin {J y Y : ℕ}

    (hHcode : 0 < Hcode) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) :

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_chosenTauRankin
statement:
theorem supplierReciprocalTail_le_chosenTauRankin {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) {x H Hcode : ℕ}
    (hJ : 0 < J) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hscale : (2 ^ J * Y ^ (2 * J)) * Hcode ≤ H)

    gcongr
    exact finiteTauSmoothReciprocalTail_le_chosen_rankin hHcode hY hu

name: RankAmplification.supplierWeight_pos_iff_mem_support

theorem supplierWeight_pos_iff_mem_support {J y Y : ℕ} (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y)
    (x d : ℕ) :
    0 < supplierWeight P x d ↔ d ∈ supplierDivisorSupport P x
proof:
:= by

  change 0 < ((allSupplierSystems P x).filter fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor = d).card ↔
    d ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).image SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor
  rw [Finset.card_pos]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨s, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h

name: RankAmplification.supplierDivisorWeight_eq_dividingSystemCard

name: RankAmplification.one_le_supplierDivisorWeight_of_system

name: RankAmplification.reciprocal_fiber_sum
statement:
private theorem reciprocal_fiber_sum {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (g : α → ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ S.image g, ((S.filter fun a ↦ g a = d).card : ℚ) / d) =
      ∑ a ∈ S, 1 / (g a : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ S.image g, ((S.filter fun a ↦ g a = d).card : ℚ) / d) =
        ∑ d ∈ S.image g, ∑ a ∈ S.filter (fun a ↦ g a = d), 1 / (g a : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      calc
        (((S.filter fun a ↦ g a = d).card : ℚ) / d) =
            ∑ _a ∈ S.filter (fun a ↦ g a = d), 1 / (d : ℚ) := by
          simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
        _ = ∑ a ∈ S.filter (fun a ↦ g a = d), 1 / (g a : ℚ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a ha
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
    _ = ∑ a ∈ S, 1 / (g a : ℚ) :=
      Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
        (fun a ha ↦ Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩) (fun a ↦ 1 / (g a : ℚ))

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalMass_eq_systemMass
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold supplierReciprocalMass supplierDivisorSupport supplierWeight
    supplierSystemReciprocalMass
  exact reciprocal_fiber_sum (allSupplierSystems P x) SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.toRelaxedData_injective
statement:
theorem SupplierSystem.toRelaxedData_injective {J y Y : ℕ}
    {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (SupplierSystem.toRelaxedData :
      SupplierSystem P x → RelaxedSupplierData P x)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  cases s
  cases t
  cases h
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.reciprocalWeight_toRelaxedData
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∏ B : s.partition.Block, 1 / ((s.descriptor B).selectedDivisor : ℚ)) =
    1 / (s.selectedDivisor : ℚ)
  simp only [SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor, Nat.cast_prod, one_div]
  exact Finset.prod_inv_distrib fun B : s.partition.Block ↦
    ((s.descriptor B).selectedDivisor : ℚ)

name: RankAmplification.relaxedSupplierReciprocalMass_eq_partitionSum
statement:
theorem relaxedSupplierReciprocalMass_eq_partitionSum {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x : ℕ) :
    relaxedSupplierReciprocalMass P x =
      ∑ π : LabelPartition J, partitionDescriptorMass P x π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [relaxedSupplierReciprocalMass, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro π hπ
  unfold partitionDescriptorMass descriptorReciprocalMass
    RelaxedSupplierData.reciprocalWeight
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum
    (κ := fun B : π.Block ↦ SupplierDescriptor P x B.1)
    fun (B : π.Block) (d : SupplierDescriptor P x B.1) ↦
      1 / (d.selectedDivisor : ℚ)).symm

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalMass_le_partitionDescriptorMass
statement:
theorem supplierReciprocalMass_le_partitionDescriptorMass {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x : ℕ) :
    supplierReciprocalMass P x ≤
      ∑ π : LabelPartition J, partitionDescriptorMass P x π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supplierReciprocalMass_eq_systemMass,
    ← relaxedSupplierReciprocalMass_eq_partitionSum]
  unfold supplierSystemReciprocalMass relaxedSupplierReciprocalMass
  calc
    (∑ s ∈ allSupplierSystems P x, 1 / (s.selectedDivisor : ℚ)) =
        ∑ s ∈ allSupplierSystems P x, s.toRelaxedData.reciprocalWeight := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      exact s.reciprocalWeight_toRelaxedData.symm
    _ = ∑ a ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).image SupplierSystem.toRelaxedData,
          a.reciprocalWeight :=
      (Finset.sum_image SupplierSystem.toRelaxedData_injective.injOn).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ a : RelaxedSupplierData P x, a.reciprocalWeight := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro a ha
        simp
      · intro a ha hnot
        unfold RelaxedSupplierData.reciprocalWeight
        exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun B hB ↦ one_div_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.descriptorReciprocalMass_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold descriptorReciprocalMass
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd ↦ one_div_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalMass_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold supplierReciprocalMass
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd ↦ div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_eq_systemTail
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold supplierReciprocalTail supplierDivisorSupport supplierWeight
    supplierSystemReciprocalTail
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ ((allSupplierSystems P x).image SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor).filter (H < ·),
        (((allSupplierSystems P x).filter fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor = d).card : ℚ) / d) =
        ∑ d ∈ ((allSupplierSystems P x).image SupplierSystem.selectedDivisor).filter (H < ·),
          ∑ s ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor = d),
            1 / (s.selectedDivisor : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      calc
        ((((allSupplierSystems P x).filter fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor = d).card : ℚ) / d) =
            ∑ _s ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor = d),
              1 / (d : ℚ) := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
        _ = ∑ s ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor = d),
              1 / (s.selectedDivisor : ℚ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro s hs
            rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2]
    _ = ∑ s ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (H < ·.selectedDivisor),
          1 / (s.selectedDivisor : ℚ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise_eq_sum_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr
      · ext s
        simp [allSupplierSystems]
      · intro s hs
        rfl

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold supplierReciprocalTail
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd ↦ div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_mass
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supplierReciprocalTail_eq_systemTail, supplierReciprocalMass_eq_systemMass]
  unfold supplierSystemReciprocalTail supplierSystemReciprocalMass
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · intro s hs
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1
  · intro s hs hnot
    exact one_div_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_partitionDescriptorMass
statement:
theorem supplierReciprocalTail_le_partitionDescriptorMass {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x H : ℕ) :
    supplierReciprocalTail P x H ≤
      ∑ π : LabelPartition J, partitionDescriptorMass P x π
proof:
:=
  (supplierReciprocalTail_le_mass P x H).trans
    (supplierReciprocalMass_le_partitionDescriptorMass P x)

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_systemCount_div
statement:
theorem supplierReciprocalTail_le_systemCount_div {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x H : ℕ) :
    supplierReciprocalTail P x H ≤
      (Fintype.card (SupplierSystem P x) : ℚ) / (H + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supplierReciprocalTail_eq_systemTail]
  unfold supplierSystemReciprocalTail
  calc
    (∑ s ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (H < ·.selectedDivisor),
        1 / (s.selectedDivisor : ℚ)) ≤
        ∑ _s ∈ (allSupplierSystems P x).filter (H < ·.selectedDivisor),
          1 / ((H + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro s hs
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
    _ = (((allSupplierSystems P x).filter (H < ·.selectedDivisor)).card : ℚ) /
          (H + 1) := by
      simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ ((allSupplierSystems P x).card : ℚ) / (H + 1) := by
      gcongr
      exact Finset.filter_subset _ _
    _ = (Fintype.card (SupplierSystem P x) : ℚ) / (H + 1) := by
      simp [allSupplierSystems]

name: RankAmplification.supplierReciprocalTail_le_relaxedSystemCount_div
statement:
theorem supplierReciprocalTail_le_relaxedSystemCount_div {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x H : ℕ) :
    supplierReciprocalTail P x H ≤
      (Fintype.card (RelaxedSupplierData P x) : ℚ) / (H + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine (supplierReciprocalTail_le_systemCount_div P x H).trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (SupplierSystem.toRelaxedData : SupplierSystem P x → RelaxedSupplierData P x)
    SupplierSystem.toRelaxedData_injective

name: RankAmplification.admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount_le_primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  unfold admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount admissibleSourceOccurrenceBases
  exact Finset.card_filter_le _ _

name: RankAmplification.admissibleSourceOccurrenceBase_gt_lowerCutoff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, d, rfl⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
  exact d.base_gt_lowerCutoff hB

name: RankAmplification.cutoffSucc_pow_admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let sources := admissibleSourceOccurrenceBases P x N
  have hsources : sources ⊆ N.primeFactors := by
    intro q hq
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
  have hprodDvd : (∏ q ∈ sources, q) ∣ N :=
    (Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset sources N.primeFactors id hsources).trans
      (Nat.prod_primeFactors_dvd N)
  calc
    (y + 1) ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N =
        ∏ _q ∈ sources, (y + 1) := by
      simp [sources, admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount]
    _ ≤ ∏ q ∈ sources, q := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · exact fun q hq ↦ Nat.zero_le _
      · intro q hq
        exact Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr
          (admissibleSourceOccurrenceBase_gt_lowerCutoff (P := P) (x := x) (N := N) hq)
    _ ≤ N := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN) hprodDvd

name: RankAmplification.exp_occurrenceCount_mul_le_ambient
statement:
theorem exp_occurrenceCount_mul_le_ambient {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hscale : HasExponentialCutoffScale y T) :
    Real.exp ((admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) * T) ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
  calc
    Real.exp T ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ≤
        ((y + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N := by
      gcongr
      simpa [HasExponentialCutoffScale] using hscale
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast cutoffSucc_pow_admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount_le P x N hN

name: RankAmplification.occurrenceCount_le_log_two_mul_div_scale
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hT).mpr
  calc
    (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N : ℝ) * T ≤ Real.log N :=
      (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by positivity)).mpr
        (exp_occurrenceCount_mul_le_ambient P x N hN.ne' hscale)
    _ ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := by
      apply Real.log_le_log
      · positivity
      · exact_mod_cast hNx

name: RankAmplification.SupplierSystem.descriptorBase_mem_admissibleSourceOccurrenceBases
statement:
private theorem SupplierSystem.descriptorBase_mem_admissibleSourceOccurrenceBases
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x N : ℕ}
    (s : SupplierSystem P x) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hdvd : s.selectedDivisor ∣ N)
    (B : s.partition.Block) :
    (s.descriptor B).base ∈ admissibleSourceOccurrenceBases P x N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
  constructor
  · apply Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
    exact ⟨(s.descriptor B).base_prime, (s.descriptor_base_dvd B).trans hdvd, hN⟩
  · exact ⟨B.1, s.partition.block_nonempty B, s.descriptor B, rfl⟩

name: RankAmplification.DividingSupplierSystem.labelBaseCode_injective
statement:
theorem DividingSupplierSystem.labelBaseCode_injective
    {J y Y : ℕ} {P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y} {x N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (DividingSupplierSystem.labelBaseCode (P := P) (x := x) hN)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨π, descriptor, bases_injective⟩, hdvd⟩
    ⟨⟨ρ, otherDescriptor, otherBases_injective⟩, otherDvd⟩ hcode
  have hpartition : π = ρ := congrArg Prod.fst hcode
  have hfunctions := congrArg Prod.snd hcode
  dsimp [labelBaseCode] at hpartition hfunctions
  cases hpartition
  apply Subtype.ext
  dsimp
  have hdescriptor : descriptor = otherDescriptor := by
    funext B
    apply SupplierDescriptor.eq_of_base_eq
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := π.block_nonempty B
    have hiCode := congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hfunctions i)
    have hblock : π.blockOf i = B := π.block_eq_of_mem i B hi
    exact (congrArg (fun C ↦ (descriptor C).base) hblock).symm.trans <|
      hiCode.trans (congrArg (fun C ↦ (otherDescriptor C).base) hblock)
  cases hdescriptor
  rfl

name: RankAmplification.supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_occurrenceCount_pow
statement:
theorem supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_occurrenceCount_pow {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
      labelledPartitionCount J * admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N ^ J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supplierDivisorWeight_eq_dividingSystemCard P x N hN]
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (DividingSupplierSystem.labelBaseCode (P := P) (x := x) hN)
    (DividingSupplierSystem.labelBaseCode_injective (P := P) (x := x) hN)
  have hfilterCard :
      ((allSupplierSystems P x).filter fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor ∣ N).card =
        Fintype.card (DividingSupplierSystem P x N) := by
    let dividingSystems :=
      (allSupplierSystems P x).filter fun s ↦ s.selectedDivisor ∣ N
    let e : {s // s ∈ dividingSystems} ≃ DividingSupplierSystem P x N :=
      { toFun := fun s ↦ ⟨s.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp s.2).2⟩
        invFun := fun s ↦ ⟨s.1, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_allSupplierSystems s.1, s.2⟩⟩
        left_inv := fun s ↦ by rfl
        right_inv := fun s ↦ by rfl }
    exact (Fintype.card_coe dividingSystems).symm.trans (Fintype.card_congr e)
  rw [hfilterCard]
  simpa [labelledPartitionCount, admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount] using hcard

name: RankAmplification.supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_maxOccurrenceCount_pow
statement:
theorem supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_maxOccurrenceCount_pow {J y Y : ℕ}
    (P : LabelledPrimeDemands J y Y) (x N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    supplierDivisorWeight P x N ≤
      labelledPartitionCount J * max 1 (admissibleSourceOccurrenceCount P x N) ^ J
proof:
:= by
  refine (supplierDivisorWeight_le_partitionCount_mul_occurrenceCount_pow P x N hN).trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact le_max_right _ _
